english: Mentally turning the matter over, the highsouled one thought, Why do I not celebrate a horse-sacrifice with the intention of obtaining a son?

transliteration: ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī cha bharatarṣhabha
english: But, O Arguna! doers of good (acts) of four classes worship me: one who is distressed, one who is seeking after knowledge, one who wants wealth, and one, O chief of the descendants of Bharata! who is possessed of knowledge.

sanskrit: स निश्चिताम् मतिम् कृत्वा यष्टव्यम् इति बुद्धिमान्
मंत्रिभिः सह धर्मात्मा सर्वैः अपि कृत आत्मभिः
transliteration: sa niścitām matim kṛtvā yaṣṭavyam iti buddhimān
maṃtribhiḥ saha dharmātmā sarvaiḥ api kṛta ātmabhiḥ
english: That highly-energetic, pious and intelligent monarch, in consultation with all his counsellors of sedate minds, having made up his mind to celebrate the sacrifice, said to that best of counsellors, Sumantra, Do you speedily summon my spiritual guides, along with the family priests.

sanskrit: प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
transliteration: priyo hi jñānino ’tyartham ahaṁ sa cha mama priyaḥ
english: Of these, he who is possessed of knowledge, who is always devoted, and whose worship is (addressed) to one (Being) only, is esteemed highest.

sanskrit: शीघ्रम् आनय मे सर्वान् गुरून् तान् स पुरोहितान्
transliteration: śīghram ānaya me sarvān gurūn tān sa purohitān
english: That highly-energetic, pious and intelligent monarch, in consultation with all his counsellors of sedate minds, having made up his mind to celebrate the sacrifice, said to that best of counsellors, Sumantra, Do you speedily summon my spiritual guides, along with the family priests.

sanskrit: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
transliteration: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṁ gatim
english: For to the man of knowledge I am dear above all things, and he is dear to me. All these are noble. But the man possessed of knowledge is deemed by me to be my own self. For he with (his) self devoted to abstraction, has taken to me as the goal than which there is nothing higher.

sanskrit: ततः सुमंत्रः त्वरितम् गत्वा त्वरित विक्रमः
सम् आनयत् स तान् सर्वान् समस्तान् वेद पारगान्
transliteration: tataḥ sumaṃtraḥ tvaritam gatvā tvarita vikramaḥ
sam ānayat sa tān sarvān samastān veda pāragān
english: Thereupon, going out speeding, Sumantra of swift movements called together all the spiritual guides, as well as others versed in the Vedic ritual.

transliteration: bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ
english: At the end of many lives, the man possessed of knowledge approaches me, (believing) that Vasudeva is everything. Such a high-souled man is very hard to find.

sanskrit: सुयज्ञम् वामदेवम् च जाबालिम् अथ काश्यपम्
पुरोहितम् वशिष्ठम् च ये च अपि अन्ये द्विजोत्तमाः
transliteration: suyajñam vāmadevam ca jābālim atha kāśyapam
purohitam vaśiṣṭham ca ye ca api anye dvijottamāḥ
english: They were Suyajña, and Vămadeva, and Jabali, and Kasyapa, and Vasistha, and other principal twice-born ones. And having paid homage to them, the virtuous king Dasaratha then spoke to them these sweet words.

sanskrit: तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
transliteration: taṁ taṁ niyamam āsthāya prakṛityā niyatāḥ svayā
english: Those who are deprived of knowledge by various desires approach other divinities, observing various regulations, and controlled by their own natures.

sanskrit: तान् पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथः तदा
इदम् धर्म अर्थ सहितम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tān pūjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā
idam dharma artha sahitam ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt
english: They were Suyajña, and Vămadeva, and Jabali, and Kasyapa, and Vasistha, and other principal twice-born ones. And having paid homage to them, the virtuous king Dasaratha then spoke to them these sweet words.

sanskrit: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति
transliteration: yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati
tasya tasyāchalāṁ śhraddhāṁ tām eva vidadhāmyaham
english: Whichever form (of deity) any worshipper wishes to worship with faith, to that form I render his faith steady.

sanskrit: मम लालस्य मानस्य सुतार्थम् नास्ति वै सुखम्
तदर्थम् हयमेधेन यक्ष्ह्यामि इति मतिर् मम
transliteration: mama lālasya mānasya sutārtham nāsti vai sukham
tadartham hayamedhena yakṣhyāmi iti matir mama
english: Consistent with duty and interest,-Ever pining on account of a son, I know no happiness,-therefore it is my intention that I should celebrate a horse sacrifice.

sanskrit: लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्
transliteration: sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate
labhate cha tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān
english: Possessed of that faith, he seeks to propitiate (the deity in) that (form), and obtains from it those beneficial things which he desires, (though they are) really given by me.

sanskrit: तत् अहम् यष्टुम् इच्छमि शास्त्र दृष्टेन कर्मणा
कथम् प्राप्स्यामि अहम् कामम् बुद्धिः अत्र विचिन्त्यताम्
transliteration: tat aham yaṣṭum icchami śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
katham prāpsyāmi aham kāmam buddhiḥ atra vicintyatām
english: I intend to celebrate it according to the ordinance. Do you, therefore, consider how I may attain my object.

transliteration: antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām
devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api
english: But the fruit thus (obtained) by them, who have little judgment, is perishable. Those who worship the divinities go to the divinities, and my worshippers, too, go to me.

sanskrit: ततः साधु इति तद्वाक्यम् ब्राह्मणाः प्रत्यपूजयन्
transliteration: tataḥ sādhu iti tadvākyam brāhmaṇāḥ pratyapūjayan
english: Thereat, the Brāhmaṇas with Vasiştha at their head, exclaiming well! Well 1 approved the words that had fallen from the lips of the monarch.

transliteration: avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ
english: The undiscerning ones, not knowing my transcendent and inexhaustible essence, than which there is nothing higher, think me, who am unperceived, to have become perceptible.

sanskrit: ऊचुः च परम प्रीताः सर्वे दशरथम् वचः
संभाराः संभ्रियंताम् ते तुरगः च विमुच्यताम्
transliteration: ūcuḥ ca parama prītāḥ sarve daśaratham vacaḥ
saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyaṃtām te turagaḥ ca vimucyatām
mūḍho ’yaṁ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam
english: Surrounded by the delusion of my mystic power, I am not manifest to all. This deluded world knows not me unborn and inexhaustible.

sanskrit: सरय्वाः च उत्तरे तीरे यज्ञ भूमिर् विधीयताम्
सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रान् अभिप्रेतान् च पार्थिव
transliteration: sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmir vidhīyatām
sarvathā prāpsyase putrān abhipretān ca pārthiva
english: And exceedingly pleased, they asked Daſaratha,-“Do you order the necessary articles, loose the horse, and prepare the sacrificial ground on the north bank of the Sarayû." And, king, since with the intention of obtaining offspring your purpose so piously, you will surely obtain sons after your heart.

sanskrit: भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
transliteration: bhaviṣhyāṇi cha bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaśhchana
english: I know, O Arguna! the things which have been, those which are, and those which are to be. But me nobody knows.

sanskrit: यस्य ते धर्मिकी बुद्धिः इयम् पुत्रार्थम् आगता
ततः तुष्टोऽभवत् राजा श्रुत्वा तद् द्विज भाषितम्
transliteration: yasya te dharmikī buddhiḥ iyam putrārtham āgatā
tataḥ tuṣṭo'bhavat rājā śrutvā tad dvija bhāṣitam

english: All beings, O terror of (your) foes! are deluded at the time of birth by the delusion, O descendant of Bharata! caused by the pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion.

sanskrit: अमात्यान् अब्रवीत् राजा हर्ष पर्याकुल लोचन
संभाराः संभ्रियंताम् मे गुरूणाम् वचनात् इह
transliteration: amātyān abravīt rājā harṣa paryākula locana
saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyaṃtām me gurūṇām vacanāt iha

english: But the men of meritorious actions, whose sins have terminated, worship me, being released from the delusion (caused) by the pairs of opposites, and being firm in their beliefs.

sanskrit: समर्थ अधिष्ठितः च अश्वः सः उपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्
सरय्वाः च उत्तरे तीरे यज्ञ भूमिर् विधीयताम्
transliteration: samartha adhiṣṭhitaḥ ca aśvaḥ saḥ upādhyāyo vimucyatām
sarayvāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmir vidhīyatām

sanskrit: ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
transliteration: te brahma tadviduḥ kṛitsnam adhyātmaṁ karma chākhilam
english: Those who, resting on me, work for release from old age and death, know the Brahman, the whole Adhyitma, and all action.

sanskrit: शान्तयः च अपि वर्धन्ताम् यथा कल्पम् यथा विधि
शक्यः प्राप्तुम् अयम् यज्ञः सर्वेण अपि महीक्षिता
transliteration: śāntayaḥ ca api vardhantām yathā kalpam yathā vidhi
śakyaḥ prāptum ayam yajñaḥ sarveṇa api mahīkṣitā

sanskrit: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः
transliteration: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ cha ye viduḥ
prayāṇa-kāle ’pi cha māṁ te vidur yukta-chetasaḥ
english: And those who know me with the Adhibhuta, the Adhidaiva, and the Adhiyagna, having minds devoted to abstraction, know me at the time of departure (from this world).

sanskrit: न अपराथो भवेत् कष्टो यदि अस्मिन् क्रतु सत्तमे
च्छिद्रम् हि मृगयन्ते स्म विद्वांसो ब्रह्म राक्षसाः
transliteration: na aparātho bhavet kaṣṭo yadi asmin kratu sattame
cchidram hi mṛgayante sma vidvāṃso brahma rākṣasāḥ

sanskrit: किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम
transliteration: kiṁ tad brahma kim adhyātmaṁ kiṁ karma puruṣhottama
adhibhūtaṁ cha kiṁ proktam adhidaivaṁ kim uchyate
english: Arguna said: What is that Brahman, what the Adhyatma, and what, O best of beings! is action? And what is called the Adhibhuta?

sanskrit: विधि हीनस्य यज्ञस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति
तद्यथा विधि पूर्वम् मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते
transliteration: vidhi hīnasya yajñasya sadyaḥ kartā vinaśyati
tadyathā vidhi pūrvam me kratureṣa samāpyate
english: The performer thereof speedily perishes, should anything take place not consonant to the ordinance. And do you possessed of ability so arrange, that this sacrifice may be completed in harmony with the ritual.
And who is the Adhiyagna, and how in this body, O destroyer of Madhu? And how, too, are you to be known at the time of departure (from this world) by those who restrain their selfs?

sanskrit: तथा विधानम् क्रियताम् समर्थाः साधनेषु इति
तथा इति च अब्रुवन् सर्वे मंत्रिणः प्रतिपूजिता
transliteration: tathā vidhānam kriyatām samarthāḥ sādhaneṣu iti
tathā iti ca abruvan sarve maṃtriṇaḥ pratipūjitā
english: Thus addressed with due respect, the counsellors listened to the word of the monarch, and said, So be it.

The Deity said: The Brahman is the supreme, the indestructibleIts manifestation (as an individual self) is called the Adhyatma. The offering (of an oblation to any divinity), which is the cause of the production and development of all things, is named action.

sanskrit: पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद् वाक्यम् यथा पूर्वम् निशम्य ते
तथा द्विजाः ते धर्मज्ञा वर्थयतो नृपोत्तमम्
transliteration: pārthivendrasya tad vākyam yathā pūrvam niśamya te
tathā dvijāḥ te dharmajñā varthayato nṛpottamam
english: Then hearing those words of that best king again, as heard before, conversant with their duty, having blessed the monarch, taking permission of the king, they returned to their respective quarters.
The Adhibhuta is all perishable thingsThe Adhidaivata is the (primal) being. And the Adhiyagna, O best of embodied (beings)! is I myself in this body.

sanskrit: अनुज्ञाताः ततः सर्वे पुनर् जग्मुर् यथा आगतम्
विसर्जयित्वा तान् विप्रान् सचिवान् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: anujñātāḥ tataḥ sarve punar jagmur yathā āgatam
visarjayitvā tān viprān sacivān idam abravīt

sanskrit: यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
transliteration: anta-kāle cha mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṁ yāti nāstyatra sanśhayaḥ
english: And he who leaves this body and departs (from this world) remembering me in (his) last moments, comes into my essence. There is no doubt of that.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा नृप शार्दूलः सचिवान् समुपस्थितान्
transliteration: iti uktvā nṛpa śārdūlaḥ sacivān samupasthitān

sanskrit: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम्
transliteration: yaṁ yaṁ vāpi smaran bhāvaṁ tyajatyante kalevaram
taṁ tam evaiti kaunteya sadā tad-bhāva-bhāvitaḥ
english: Also whichever form (of deity) he remembers when he finally leaves this body, to that he goes, O son of Kunti! having been used to ponder on it.

sanskrit: ततः स गत्वा ताः पत्नीर् नरेन्द्रो हृदयंगमाः
transliteration: tataḥ sa gatvā tāḥ patnīr narendro hṛdayaṃgamāḥ
tasmāt sarveṣhu kāleṣhu mām anusmara yudhya cha
english: Therefore, at all times remember me, and engage in battle.

sanskrit: उवाच दीक्षाम् विशत यक्षेऽहम् सुत कारणात्
तासाम् तेन अति कान्तेन वचनेन सुवर्चसाम्
transliteration: uvāca dīkṣām viśata yakṣe'ham suta kāraṇāt
tāsām tena ati kāntena vacanena suvarcasām
english: And hearing those sweet words, the countenances of those shining dames looked resplendent, like lotuses after the cold season is over.
Fixing your mind and understanding on me, you will come to me, there is no doubt.

sanskrit: एतत् श्रुत्वा रहः सूतो राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
श्रूयताम् तत् पुरा वृत्तम् पुराणे च मया श्रुतम्
transliteration: etat śrutvā rahaḥ sūto rājānam idam abravīt
śrūyatām tat purā vṛttam purāṇe ca mayā śrutam
english: Hearing all about it, the king's charioteer addressed the monarch in private, saying, Do you listen to what is related in the Purānas, and to what I have heard myself!

He who thinks of the supreme divine Being, O son of Pritha! with a mind not (running) to other (objects), and possessed of abstraction in the shape of continuous meditation (about the supreme), goes to him.

sanskrit: ऋत्विग्भिः उपदिष्टोऽयम् पुरा वृत्तो मया श्रुतः
transliteration: ṛtvigbhiḥ upadiṣṭo'yam purā vṛtto mayā śrutaḥ
english: This horse-sacrifice is enjoined by the family priests; and I have myself heard the following story celebrated in ancient chronicle. And what the worshipful Sanatkumāra had said formerly in the presence of the saints, applies, O king, to the case of your having a son.

transliteration: sa taṁ paraṁ puruṣham upaiti divyam
english: He who, possessed of reverence (for the supreme Being) with a steady mind, and with the power of devotion, properly concentrates the life-breath between the brows, and meditates on the ancient Seer, the ruler, more minute than the minutest atom, the supporter of all, who is of an unthinkable form, whose brilliance is like that of the sun, and who is beyond all darkness, he attains to that transcendent and divine Being.

sanskrit: ऋषीणाम् सन्निधौ राजन् तव पुत्राअगमम् प्रति
काश्यपस्य च पुत्रोऽस्ति विभाण्डक इति श्रुतः
transliteration: ṛṣīṇām sannidhau rājan tava putrāagamam prati
kāśyapasya ca putro'sti vibhāṇḍaka iti śrutaḥ

english: I will tell you briefly about the seat, which those who know the Vedas declare to be indestructible; which is entered by ascetics from whom all desires have departed; and wishing for which, people pursue the mode of life of Brahmakarins.

sanskrit: ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातः तस्य पुत्रो भविष्यति
स वने नित्य संवृद्धो मुनिर् वनचरः सदा
transliteration: ṛṣyaśṛṅga iti khyātaḥ tasya putro bhaviṣyati
sa vane nitya saṃvṛddho munir vanacaraḥ sadā
english: Kaśyapa has a son known by the name of Vibhāņdaka. He will get a son called Rșyasſiga. And he will grow up and pass his days in the forests.

sanskrit: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च
transliteration: sarva-dvārāṇi sanyamya mano hṛidi nirudhya cha
english: He who leaves the body and departs (from this world), stopping up all passages, and confining the mind within the heart placing the life-breath in the head, and adhering to uninterrupted meditation,

sanskrit: न अन्यम् जानाति विप्रेन्द्रो नित्यम् पित्र अनुवर्तनात्
transliteration: na anyam jānāti viprendro nityam pitra anuvartanāt
english: And that foremost of Brāhmaṇas will not know anything else save following his father. And, O king, it is rumoured abroad, and also always said by the Vipras, that the high-souled one will practise (Those that assume the staff and the kamaņdalu are reckoned the first order; while those that continue to live with their wives are considered as next in worth.) the two modes of Brahmacarya life.

sanskrit: यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
transliteration: oṁ ityekākṣharaṁ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran
yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṁ sa yāti paramāṁ gatim
english: repeating the single syllable 'Om,' (signifying) the eternal Brahman, and meditating on me, he reaches the highest goal.

sanskrit: लोकेषु प्रथितम् राजन् विप्रैः च कथितम् सदा
transliteration: lokeṣu prathitam rājan vipraiḥ ca kathitam sadā

sanskrit: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः
transliteration: ananya-chetāḥ satataṁ yo māṁ smarati nityaśhaḥ
english: To the devotee who constantly practises abstraction, O son of Pritha! and who with a mind not (turned) to anything else, is ever and constantly meditating on me, I am easy of access.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु रोमपादः प्रतापवान्
transliteration: etasmin eva kāle tu romapādaḥ pratāpavān
mām upetya punar janma duḥkhālayam aśhāśhvatam
english: The high-souled ones, who achieve the highest perfection, attaining to me, do not again come to life, which is transient, a home of woes.

sanskrit: मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
transliteration: mām upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate
english: All worlds, O Arguna! up to the world of Brahman, are (destined) to return. But, O son of Kunti! after attaining to me, there is no birth again.

sanskrit: अनावृष्ट्याम् तु वृत्तायाम् राजा दुःख समन्वितः
transliteration: anāvṛṣṭyām tu vṛttāyām rājā duḥkha samanvitaḥ

english: Those who know a day of Brahman to end after one thousand ages, and the night to terminate after one thousand ages, are the persons who know day and night.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् श्रुत संवृद्धान् च समानीय प्रवक्ष्यति
भवन्तः श्रुत कर्माणो लोक चारित्र वेदिनः
transliteration: brāhmaṇān śruta saṃvṛddhān ca samānīya pravakṣyati
bhavantaḥ śruta karmāṇo loka cāritra vedinaḥ
english: And filled with grief on account of this drought, the king will call about him Vedaaccomplished Brāhmaṇas, and speak to them, saying, You are conversant with the Vedic ritual and the social duties. Do therefore, tell me how to expiate for this evil.
On the advent of day, all perceptible things are produced from the unperceived; and on the advent of night they dissolve in that same (principle) called the unperceived.

sanskrit: इति उक्ताः ते ततो राज्ञा सर्वे ब्राह्मण सत्तमाः
transliteration: iti uktāḥ te tato rājñā sarve brāhmaṇa sattamāḥ

sanskrit: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते
transliteration: bhūta-grāmaḥ sa evāyaṁ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
english: This same assemblage of entities, being produced again and again, dissolves on the advent of night, and, O son of Pritha! issues forth on the advent of day, without a will of its own.

sanskrit: वक्ष्यन्ति ते महीपालम् ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः
विभाण्डक सुतम् राजन् सर्व उपायैः इह आनय
transliteration: vakṣyanti te mahīpālam brāhmaṇā veda pāragāḥ
vibhāṇḍaka sutam rājan sarva upāyaiḥ iha ānaya

sanskrit: यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
transliteration: yaḥ sa sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu naśhyatsu na vinaśhyati
english: But there is another entity, unperceived and eternal, and distinct from this unperceived (principle), which is not destroyed when all entities are destroyed.

sanskrit: विभाण्डक सुतम् राजन् ब्राह्मणम् वेद पारगम्
प्रयच्छ कन्याम् शान्ताम् वै विधिना सुसमाहितः
transliteration: vibhāṇḍaka sutam rājan brāhmaṇam veda pāragam
prayaccha kanyām śāntām vai vidhinā susamāhitaḥ
english: Do you, O monarch, by all means, bring Vibhandaka's son. And having, Oking, brought that Brāhmaṇa versed in the Vedas, Vibhandaka's son Rsyaśộnga, and duly honoured him, do you, O monarch, with a concentrated mind, perform the betrothal of your daughter śāntā, with him according to the ordinance.

sanskrit: यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
transliteration: avyakto ’kṣhara ityuktas tam āhuḥ paramāṁ gatim
yaṁ prāpya na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
english: It is called the unperceived, the indestructible; they call it the highest goal. Attaining to it, none returns. That is my supreme abode.

sanskrit: तेषाम् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजा चिन्ताम् प्रपत्स्यते
केन उपायेन वै शक्यम् इह आनेतुम् स वीर्यवान्
transliteration: teṣām tu vacanam śrutvā rājā cintām prapatsyate
kena upāyena vai śakyam iha ānetum sa vīryavān
english: And hearing those words of theirs, the king will began to think as to how he can bring over that one endowed with energy.

sanskrit: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया
transliteration: puruṣhaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tvananyayā
yasyāntaḥ-sthāni bhūtāni yena sarvam idaṁ tatam
english: That supreme Being, O son of Pritha! he in whom all these entities dwell, and by whom all this is permeated, is to be attained to by reverence not (directed) to another.

sanskrit: ततो राजा विनिश्चित्य सह मंत्रिभिः आत्मवान्
transliteration: tato rājā viniścitya saha maṃtribhiḥ ātmavān
english: Then in consultation with his counsellors, the prudent king having come to a conclusion will, honouring them duly, desire his priest and his courtiers to set out in quest of Rsyaśộnga.

sanskrit: प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
transliteration: yatra kāle tvanāvṛittim āvṛittiṁ chaiva yoginaḥ
prayātā yānti taṁ kālaṁ vakṣhyāmi bharatarṣhabha
english: I will state the times, O descendant of Bharata! at which devotees departing (from this world) go, never to return, or to return.

sanskrit: ते तु राज्ञो वचः श्रुत्वा व्यथिता विनत आननाः
न गच्छेम ऋषेः भीता अनुनेष्यन्ति तम् नृपम्
transliteration: te tu rājño vacaḥ śrutvā vyathitā vinata ānanāḥ
na gacchema ṛṣeḥ bhītā anuneṣyanti tam nṛpam
english: Thereupon hearing the king's words, with aggrieved hearts, and with heads hanging down, they will beseech the monarch, saying, Afraid of the saint, Vibhāndaka, we shall not be able to repair thither.

sanskrit: तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
transliteration: agnir jyotir ahaḥ śhuklaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā uttarāyaṇam
tatra prayātā gachchhanti brahma brahma-vido janāḥ
english: The fire, the flame, the day, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern solstice, departing (from the world) in these, those who know the Brahman go to the Brahman.

sanskrit: वक्ष्ष्यन्ति चिंतयित्वा ते तस्य उपायाम् च तान् क्षमान्
आनेष्यामो वयम् विप्रम् न च दोषो भविष्यति
transliteration: vakṣṣyanti ciṃtayitvā te tasya upāyām ca tān kṣamān
āneṣyāmo vayam vipram na ca doṣo bhaviṣyati
english: Anon hitting upon the appropriate means, they say, 'We will search for the Vipra, and no blame shall accrue to us.'

transliteration: dhūmo rātris tathā kṛiṣhṇaḥ ṣhaṇ-māsā dakṣhiṇāyanam
tatra chāndramasaṁ jyotir yogī prāpya nivartate
english: Smoke, night, the dark fortnight, the six months of the southern solstice, (dying) in these, the devotee goes to the lunar light and returns.

sanskrit: एवम् अङ्गाधिपेन एव गणिकाभिः ऋषेः सुतः
आनीतोऽवर्षयत् देव शान्ता च अस्मै प्रदीयते
transliteration: evam aṅgādhipena eva gaṇikābhiḥ ṛṣeḥ sutaḥ
ānīto'varṣayat deva śāntā ca asmai pradīyate
english: Thus by help of courtesans, the saint's son was brought by the lord of the Angas. And then the god (Indra) poured down showers; and the king conferred on him śānta.

sanskrit: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते
transliteration: śhukla-kṛiṣhṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śhāśhvate mate
english: These two paths, bright and dark, are deemed to be eternal in this world. By the one, (a man) goes never to return, by the other he comes back.

sanskrit: ऋष्यशृङ्गः तु जामाता पुत्रान् तव विधास्यति
transliteration: ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ tu jāmātā putrān tava vidhāsyati
english: And now your son-in-law Rşyaśộnga will help you in obtaining a son. Now I have related to you what Sanatkumāra had communicated.

sanskrit: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन
transliteration: naite sṛitī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaśhchana
english: Knowing these two paths, O son of Pritha! no devotee is deluded. Therefore at all times be possessed of devotion, O Arguna!

sanskrit: यथा ऋष्यशृङ्गः तु आनीतो येन उपायेन स उच्चताम्
transliteration: yathā ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ tu ānīto yena upāyena sa uccatām
english: Thereupon king Dasaratha, well pleased, asked Sumantra, Do you now tell me by what means Rşyaśộnga was brought over (by the lord of the Angas).
A devotee knowing all this, obtains all the holy fruit which is prescribed for (study of) the Vedas, for sacrifices, and also for penances and gifts, and he attains to the highest and primeval seat.

sanskrit: सुमंत्रः चोदितो राज्ञा प्रोवाच इदम् वचः तदा
यथा ऋष्यशृङ्गः तु आनीतो येन उपायेन मंत्रिभिःतन्मे निगदितम् सर्वम् शृणु मे मंत्रिभिः सह
transliteration: sumaṃtraḥ codito rājñā provāca idam vacaḥ tadā
yathā ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ tu ānīto yena upāyena maṃtribhiḥtanme nigaditam sarvam śṛṇu me maṃtribhiḥ saha
english: Thus asked by the king, Sumantra said these words-I will relate to you how the counsellors brought Rşyaśộnga. Do you listen with your counsellors!
Now I will speak to you, who are not given to carping, of that most mysterious knowledge, accompanied by experience, by knowing which you will be released from evil.

sanskrit: रोमपादम् उवाच इदम् सह अमात्यः पुरोहितः
transliteration: romapādam uvāca idam saha amātyaḥ purohitaḥ
english: The priest together with the counsellors spoke to Romapada, saying, 'The means that we have hit upon can never fail of effect.'

It is the chief among the sciences, the chief among the mysteries. It is the best means of sanctification. It is imperishable, not opposed to the sacred law. It is to be apprehended directly, and is easy to practise.

sanskrit: अनभिज्ञः तु नारीणाम् विषयाणाम् सुखस्य च
transliteration: anabhijñaḥ tu nārīṇām viṣayāṇām sukhasya ca
english: Rşyaśộnga has been brought up in woods; and is engaged in austerities and the study of the Vedas. He is ignorant of the pleasure that ensues from contact with women,
O terror of your foes! those men who have no faith in this holy doctrine, return to the path of this mortal world, without attaining to me.
By help of things agreeably ministering to the sense, and ravishing the soul, we shall bring him to the city. Do you, therefore, arrange for them!

transliteration: mayā tatam idaṁ sarvaṁ jagad avyakta-mūrtinā
english: This whole universe is pervaded, by me in an unperceived form. All entities live in me, but I, do not live in them.

sanskrit: प्रलोभ्य विविध उपायैः आनेष्यन्ति इह सत्कृताः
transliteration: pralobhya vividha upāyaiḥ āneṣyanti iha satkṛtāḥ
english: Let courtezans of comely presence, clad in ornaments, repair thither. And if well treated, they will by various means bring him here.'

sanskrit: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
transliteration: na cha mat-sthāni bhūtāni paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
bhūta-bhṛin na cha bhūta-stho mamātmā bhūta-bhāvanaḥ
english: Nor yet do all entities live in meSee my divine power. Supporting all entities and producing all entities, my self lives not in (those) entities.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तथा इति राजा च प्रत्युवाच पुरोहितम्
पुरोहितो मंत्रिणः च तथा चक्रुः च ते तथा
transliteration: śrutvā tathā iti rājā ca pratyuvāca purohitam
purohito maṃtriṇaḥ ca tathā cakruḥ ca te tathā
english: Hearing this, the king said to the priest, 'So be it!' Then the priest and courtiers acted accordingly.
As the great and ubiquitous atmosphere always remains in space, know that similarly all entities live in me.

sanskrit: वारमुख्याः तु तत् श्रुत्वा वनम् प्रविविशुः महत्
आश्रमस्य अविदूरे अस्मिन् यत्नम् कुर्वन्ति दर्शने
transliteration: vāramukhyāḥ tu tat śrutvā vanam praviviśuḥ mahat
āśramasya avidūre asmin yatnam kurvanti darśane
english: In accordance with the instructions, the courtezans entered that great forest; and remaining at some distance from the hermitage, endeavoured to meet with the sober son of the saint ever dwelling in the woods. And satisfied with serving his sire, he never strayed from the hermitage.
At the expiration of a Kalpa, O son of Kunti! all entities enter my nature; and at the beginning of a Kalpa, I again bring them forth.

sanskrit: ऋषेः पुत्रस्य धीरस्य नित्यम् आश्रम वासिनः
पितुः स नित्य संतुष्टो न अतिचक्राम च आश्रमात्
transliteration: ṛṣeḥ putrasya dhīrasya nityam āśrama vāsinaḥ
pituḥ sa nitya saṃtuṣṭo na aticakrāma ca āśramāt
english: In accordance with the instructions, the courtezans entered that great forest; and remaining at some distance from the hermitage, endeavoured to meet with the sober son of the saint ever dwelling in the woods. And satisfied with serving his sire, he never strayed from the hermitage.

transliteration: prakṛitiṁ svām avaṣhṭabhya visṛijāmi punaḥ punaḥ
bhūta-grāmam imaṁ kṛitsnam avaśhaṁ prakṛiter vaśhāt
english: Taking the control of my own nature, I bring forth again and again this whole collection of entities, without a will of its own, by the power of nature.

sanskrit: न तेन जन्म प्रभृति दृष्ट पूर्वम् तपस्विना
स्त्री वा पुमान् वा यच्च अन्यत् सत्त्वम् नगर राष्ट्रजम्
transliteration: na tena janma prabhṛti dṛṣṭa pūrvam tapasvinā
strī vā pumān vā yacca anyat sattvam nagara rāṣṭrajam
english: Since his birth he had never before seen men and women, or any other creatures living in cities and towns.

sanskrit: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय
transliteration: na cha māṁ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
english: But, O Arguna! these actions do not fetter me, who remain like one unconcerned, and who am unattached to those actions.

sanskrit: ततः कदाचित् तम् देशम् आजगाम यदृच्छया
विभाण्डक सुतः तत्र ताः च अपश्यत् वरांगनाः
transliteration: tataḥ kadācit tam deśam ājagāma yadṛcchayā
vibhāṇḍaka sutaḥ tatra tāḥ ca apaśyat varāṃganāḥ
english: It came to pass that on one occasion, walking about at will, Vibhandaka's son came to that spot and beheld the courtezans.
Nature gives birth to movables and immovables through me, the supervisor, and by reason of that, O son of Kunti! the universe revolves.

sanskrit: ताः चित्र वेषाः प्रमदा गायंत्यो मधुर स्वरम्
ऋषि पुत्रम् उपागम्य सर्वा वचनम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: tāḥ citra veṣāḥ pramadā gāyaṃtyo madhura svaram
ṛṣi putram upāgamya sarvā vacanam abruvan
english: Colourfully attired, and singing sweet songs, the women came to the saint's son and said.

transliteration: avajānanti māṁ mūḍhā mānuṣhīṁ tanum āśhritam
english: Deluded people of vain hopes, vain acts, vain knowledge, whose minds are disordered,

sanskrit: कः त्वम् किम् वर्तसे ब्रह्मन् ज्ञातुम् इच्छामहे वयम्
एकः त्वम् विजने दूरे वने चरसि शंस नः
transliteration: kaḥ tvam kim vartase brahman jñātum icchāmahe vayam
ekaḥ tvam vijane dūre vane carasi śaṃsa naḥ
english: Who are you? And where are you going, O Brahman? We wish to learn all this. And why is it that you range alone this far-off forest?

transliteration: rākṣhasīm āsurīṁ chaiva prakṛitiṁ mohinīṁ śhritāḥ
english: and who are inclined to the delusive nature of Asuras and Rakshasas, not knowing my highest nature as great lord of all entities, disregard me as I have assumed a human body.

sanskrit: अदृष्ट रूपाः ताः तेन काम्य रूपा वने स्त्रियः
हार्दात् तस्य मतिः जाता अख्यातुम् पितरम् स्वकम्
transliteration: adṛṣṭa rūpāḥ tāḥ tena kāmya rūpā vane striyaḥ
hārdāt tasya matiḥ jātā akhyātum pitaram svakam
english: Beholding these beautiful damsels never seen before, he from delight, hastened to inform them of his lineage.

transliteration: mahātmānas tu māṁ pārtha daivīṁ prakṛitim āśhritāḥ
english: But the high-souled ones, O son of Pritha! who are inclined to the godlike nature, knowing me as the inexhaustible source of (all) entities, worship me with minds not (turned) elsewhere.

sanskrit: पिता विभाण्डको अस्माकम् तस्य अहम् सुत औरसः
ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातम् नाम कर्म च मे भुवि
transliteration: pitā vibhāṇḍako asmākam tasya aham suta aurasaḥ
ṛṣyaśṛṅga iti khyātam nāma karma ca me bhuvi
english: My father is Vibhăndaka; and I am his son. My name is Rşyasſiga and my occupation is known the world over.

transliteration: satataṁ kīrtayanto māṁ yatantaśh cha dṛiḍha-vratāḥ
namasyantaśh cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya-yuktā upāsate
english: Constantly glorifying me, and exerting themselves, firm in their vows, and saluting me with reverence, they worship me, being always devoted.

sanskrit: इह आश्रम पदोऽस्माकम् समीपे शुभ दर्शनाः
करिष्ये वोऽत्र पूजाम् वै सर्वेषाम् विधि पूर्वकम्
transliteration: iha āśrama pado'smākam samīpe śubha darśanāḥ
kariṣye vo'tra pūjām vai sarveṣām vidhi pūrvakam
english: This auspicious hermitage hard by belongs to us; and there I shall receive you all in due form O' lovely ones! .
And others again, offering up the sacrifice of knowledge, worship me as one, as distinct, and as allpervading in numerous forms.

sanskrit: ऋषि पुत्र वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वासाम् मतिरास वै
तत् आश्रम पदम् द्रष्टुम् जग्मुः सर्वाः ततो अंगनः
transliteration: ṛṣi putra vacaḥ śrutvā sarvāsām matirāsa vai
tat āśrama padam draṣṭum jagmuḥ sarvāḥ tato aṃganaḥ
english: Hearing the words of the saint's son, they all consented, and the women went to behold that asylum.

transliteration: ahaṁ kratur ahaṁ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣhadham
mantro ’ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṁ hutam
english: I am the Kratu, I am the Yagna, I am the Svadha, I the product of the herbs. I am the sacred verse. I too am the sacrificial butter, and I the fire, I the offering.

sanskrit: गतानाम् तु ततः पूजाम् ऋषि पुत्रः चकार ह
इदम् अर्घ्यम् इदम् पाद्यम् इदम् मूलम् फलम् च नः
transliteration: gatānām tu tataḥ pūjām ṛṣi putraḥ cakāra ha
idam arghyam idam pādyam idam mūlam phalam ca naḥ
english: When they had come there, the saint's son received them hospitably, saying, 'Here is Arghya,' 'Here is water for washing the feet,' 'Here are fruits and roots.'

sanskrit: वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च
transliteration: pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ
vedyaṁ pavitram oṁkāra ṛik sāma yajur eva cha
english: I am the father of this universe, the mother, the creator, the grandsire, the thing to be known, the means of sanctification, the syllable Om, the Rik, Saman, and Yagus also;

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य तु ताम् पूजाम् सर्वा एव समुत्सुकाः
ऋषेर् भीताः च शीघ्रम् तु गमनाय मतिम् दधुः
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tām pūjām sarvā eva samutsukāḥ
ṛṣer bhītāḥ ca śīghram tu gamanāya matim dadhuḥ
english: And thereupon they readily received his hospitality. And actuated by the fear of the saint, Vibhāndaka, they bent their minds upon departing soon.

sanskrit: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत्
transliteration: gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣhī nivāsaḥ śharaṇaṁ suhṛit
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṁ nidhānaṁ bījam avyayam
english: the goal, the sustainer, the lord, the supervisor, the residence, the asylum, the friend, the source, and that in which it merges, the support, the receptacle, and the inexhaustible seed.

sanskrit: अस्माकम् अपि मुख्यानि फलानि इमानि हे द्विज
गृहाण विप्र भद्रम् ते भक्षयस्व च मा अचिरम्
transliteration: asmākam api mukhyāni phalāni imāni he dvija
gṛhāṇa vipra bhadram te bhakṣayasva ca mā aciram
english: They said, Do you also, O twice-born one, receive from us these excellent fruits! O Vipra! good betide you, eat them without delay.

transliteration: amṛitaṁ chaiva mṛityuśh cha sad asach chāham arjuna
english: I cause heat and I send forth and stop showersI am immortality and also death; and I, O Arguna! am that which is and that which is not.

sanskrit: ततः ताः तम् समालिंग्य सर्वा हर्ष समन्विताः
मोदकान् प्रददुः तस्मै भक्ष्याम् च विविधान् शुभान्
transliteration: tataḥ tāḥ tam samāliṃgya sarvā harṣa samanvitāḥ
modakān pradaduḥ tasmai bhakṣyām ca vividhān śubhān
english: Thereupon, embracing him joyfully, they gave him sweetmeats and various kinds of savoury viands.

Those who know the three (branches of) knowledge, who drink the Soma juice, whose sins are washed away, offer sacrifices and pray to me for a passage into heaven; and reaching the holy world of the lord of gods, they enjoy in the celestial regions the celestial pleasures of the gods. And having enjoyed that great heavenly world, they enter the mortal world when (their) merit is exhausted.

sanskrit: तानि च आस्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानि इति स्म मन्यते
transliteration: tāni ca āsvādya tejasvī phalāni iti sma manyate
english: And tasting those things, the glorious one took them for fruits, never tasted before by the dwellers of the forest.
Thus those who wish for objects of desire, and resort to the ordinances of the three (Vedas), obtain (as the fruit) going and coming.

sanskrit: आपृच्छ्य च तदा विप्रम् व्रत चर्याम् निवेद्य च
गच्छन्ति स्म अपदेशात् ता भीताः तस्य पितुः स्त्रियः
transliteration: āpṛcchya ca tadā vipram vrata caryām nivedya ca
gacchanti sma apadeśāt tā bhītāḥ tasya pituḥ striyaḥ
english: Then, having accosted him the women, feigning the observance of some vow, went away, inspired with the fear of his father.

transliteration: ananyāśh chintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
english: To those men who worship me, meditating on me and on no one else, and who are constantly devoted, I give new gifts and preserve what is acquired by them.

sanskrit: गतासु तासु सर्वासु काश्यपस्य आत्मजो द्विजः
अस्वस्थ हृदयः च आसीत् दुःखात् च परिवर्तते
transliteration: gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu kāśyapasya ātmajo dvijaḥ
asvastha hṛdayaḥ ca āsīt duḥkhāt ca parivartate
english: And when they had gone, that twice-born one, Kasyapa's son, became sad, and suffered from grief of heart and became restless due to sadness.
Even those, O son of Kunti! who being devotees of other divinities worship with faith, worship me only, (but) irregularly.

sanskrit: ततोऽपरे द्युः तम् देशम् आजगाम स वीर्यवान्
विभाण्डक सुतः श्रीमान् मनसा विचिन्तयन् मुहुः
transliteration: tato'pare dyuḥ tam deśam ājagāma sa vīryavān
vibhāṇḍaka sutaḥ śrīmān manasā vicintayan muhuḥ
english: And the next day his mind momentarily running upon it, the graceful son of Vibhāņdaka, endowed with prowess, came to that spot where he had encountered the comely courtesans, adorned with ornaments.

sanskrit: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च
transliteration: ahaṁ hi sarva-yajñānāṁ bhoktā cha prabhureva cha
na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaśh chyavanti te
english: For I am the enjoyer as well as the lord of all sacrifices. But they know me not truly, therefore do they fall.

sanskrit: मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्याः स्वलंकृताः
दृष्ट्वा एव च ततो विप्रम् आयान्तम् हृष्ट मानसाः
transliteration: manojñā yatra tā dṛṣṭā vāramukhyāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ
dṛṣṭvā eva ca tato vipram āyāntam hṛṣṭa mānasāḥ

sanskrit: भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
transliteration: yānti deva-vratā devān pitṝīn yānti pitṛi-vratāḥ
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti mad-yājino ’pi mām
english: Those who make vows to the gods go to the gods; those who make vows to the manes go to the manes those who worship the Bhutas go to the Bhutas; and those likewise who worship me go to me.

sanskrit: उपसृत्य ततः सर्वाः ताः तम् ऊचुर् इदम् वचः
एहि आश्रम पदम् सौम्य अस्माकम् इति च अब्रुवन्
transliteration: upasṛtya tataḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ tam ūcur idam vacaḥ
ehi āśrama padam saumya asmākam iti ca abruvan
english: As soon as they observed him coming, they came forward, and said, Do you, O Brāhmaṇa, come into our hermitage.

sanskrit: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति
transliteration: patraṁ puṣhpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ yo me bhaktyā prayachchhati
english: Whoever with devotion offers me leaf, flower, fruit, water, that, presented with devotion, I accept from him whose self is pure.

sanskrit: चित्राणि अत्र बहूनि स्युः मूलानि च फलनि च
तत्र अपि एष विशेषेण विधिः हि भविता ध्रुवम्
transliteration: citrāṇi atra bahūni syuḥ mūlāni ca phalani ca
tatra api eṣa viśeṣeṇa vidhiḥ hi bhavitā dhruvam
english: There are in that asylum diverse kinds of fruits and roots; and there you will surely feed your fill.

transliteration: yat karoṣhi yad aśhnāsi yaj juhoṣhi dadāsi yat
yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣhva mad-arpaṇam
english: Whatever you do, O son of Kunti! whatever you eat, whatever sacrifice you make, whatever you give, whatever penance you perform, do that as offered to me.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु वचनम् तासाम् सर्वासाम् हृदयम् गमम्
गमनाय मतिम् चक्रे तम् च निन्युः तथा स्त्रियः
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanam tāsām sarvāsām hṛdayam gamam
gamanāya matim cakre tam ca ninyuḥ tathā striyaḥ
english: Thereupon hearing those words of theirs capable of influencing the heart, he became bent upon going, and the women brought him away.

Thus will you be released from the bonds of action, the fruits of which are agreeable or disagreeable. And with your self possessed of (this) devotion, (this) renunciation, you will be released (from the bonds of action) and will come to me.

sanskrit: तत्र च आनीयमाने तु विप्रे तस्मिन् महात्मनि
ववर्ष सहसा देवो जगत् प्रह्लादयन् तदा
transliteration: tatra ca ānīyamāne tu vipre tasmin mahātmani
vavarṣa sahasā devo jagat prahlādayan tadā
english: When that great-souled Vipra had been brought over, the god, Indra, suddenly poured forth plenteous showers, enlivening the spirits of men.

sanskrit: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
transliteration: samo ’haṁ sarva-bhūteṣhu na me dveṣhyo ’sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṁ bhaktyā mayi te teṣhu chāpyaham
english: I am alike to all beings; to me none is hateful, none dear. But those who worship me with devotion (dwell) in me, and I too in them.

sanskrit: वर्षेण एव आगतम् विप्रम् तापसम् स नराधिपः
प्रति उद्गम्य मुनिम् प्रह्वः शिरसा च महीम् गतः
transliteration: varṣeṇa eva āgatam vipram tāpasam sa narādhipaḥ
prati udgamya munim prahvaḥ śirasā ca mahīm gataḥ
english: When the ascetic had arrived, with showers, the king approached him in bumble guise, bending his head to the ground.

sanskrit: साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
transliteration: api chet su-durāchāro bhajate mām ananya-bhāk
sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ
english: Even if a very ill-conducted man worships me, not worshipping any one else, he must certainly be deemed to be good, for he has well resolved.

sanskrit: अर्घ्यम् च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतः सुसमाहितः
वव्रे प्रसादम् विप्रेइन्द्रात् मा विप्रम् मन्युः आविशेत्
transliteration: arghyam ca pradadau tasmai nyāyataḥ susamāhitaḥ
vavre prasādam vipreindrāt mā vipram manyuḥ āviśet
english: He offered him Arghya in due form, and with a collected mind; and asked for his favour, so that wrath could not influence the Vipra.

sanskrit: कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
transliteration: kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśhyati
english: He soon becomes devout of heart, and obtains lasting tranquillity. (You may) affirm, O son of Kunti! that my devotee is never ruined.

sanskrit: अन्तःपुरम् प्रवेश्य अस्मै कन्याम् दत्त्वा यथाविधि
शांताम् शान्तेन मनसा राजा हर्षम् अवाप सः
transliteration: antaḥpuram praveśya asmai kanyām dattvā yathāvidhi
śāṃtām śāntena manasā rājā harṣam avāpa saḥ
english: And taking him into the inner apartments, and in due form conferring upon him in sober mood his daughter śāntā, the king became happy.

sanskrit: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
transliteration: māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśhritya ye ’pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
striyo vaiśhyās tathā śhūdrās te ’pi yānti parāṁ gatim
english: For, O son of Pritha! even those who are of sinful birth, women, Vaisyas, and Sudras likewise, resorting to me, attain the supreme goal.

sanskrit: एवम् स न्यवसत् तत्र सर्व कामैः सुपूजितः
transliteration: evam sa nyavasat tatra sarva kāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ
english: Thus the highly powerful Rşyaśřnga together with his wife śāntä, began to live there, respectfully ministered to in regard to every desire.

transliteration: kiṁ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣhayas tathā
anityam asukhaṁ lokam imaṁ prāpya bhajasva mām
english: What then (need be said of) holy Brahmanas and royal saints who are (my) devotees? Coming to this transitent unhappy world, worship me.

sanskrit: भूय एव हि राजेन्द्र शृणु मे वचनम् हितम्
transliteration: bhūya eva hi rājendra śṛṇu me vacanam hitam
english: And he said again, O foremost of monarchs, do you listen to me as I relate how that intelligent Sanatkumāra, best of deities, spoke.

sanskrit: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु
transliteration: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru
english: (Place your) mind on me, become my devotee, my worshipper; reverence me, and thus making me your highest goal, and devoting your self to abstraction, you will certainly come to me.

sanskrit: नाम्ना दशरथो राजा श्रीमान् सत्य प्रतिश्रवः
transliteration: nāmnā daśaratho rājā śrīmān satya pratiśravaḥ
english: In the line of Ikşvāku will be born a righteous king, named Dasaratha, fair of form, and firm in promise.

sanskrit: भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः
transliteration: bhūya eva mahā-bāho śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ
english: Yet again, O you of mighty arms! listen to my excellent words, which, out of a wish for your welfare, I speak to you who are delighted (with them).

sanskrit: अङ्ग राजेन सख्यम् च तस्य राज्ञो भविष्यति
कन्या च अस्य महाभागा शांता नाम भविष्यति
transliteration: aṅga rājena sakhyam ca tasya rājño bhaviṣyati
kanyā ca asya mahābhāgā śāṃtā nāma bhaviṣyati

sanskrit: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः
transliteration: na me viduḥ sura-gaṇāḥ prabhavaṁ na maharṣhayaḥ
aham ādir hi devānāṁ maharṣhīṇāṁ cha sarvaśhaḥ
english: Not the multitudes of gods, nor the great sages know my source; for I am in every way the origin of the gods and great sages.

sanskrit: पुत्रस्तुः अङ्गस्य राज्ञः तु रोमपाद इति श्रुतः
तम् स राजा दशरथो गमिष्यति महायशाः
transliteration: putrastuḥ aṅgasya rājñaḥ tu romapāda iti śrutaḥ
tam sa rājā daśaratho gamiṣyati mahāyaśāḥ
yo māmajam anādiṁ cha vetti loka-maheśhvaram
english: Of (all) mortals, he who knows me to be unborn, without beginning, the great lord of the world, being free from delusion, is released from all sins.

sanskrit: अनपत्योऽस्मि धर्मात्मन् शांता भर्ता मम क्रतुम्
आहरेत त्वया आज्ञप्तः संतानार्थम् कुलस्य च
transliteration: anapatyo'smi dharmātman śāṃtā bhartā mama kratum
āhareta tvayā ājñaptaḥ saṃtānārtham kulasya ca

sanskrit: सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
transliteration: buddhir jñānam asammohaḥ kṣhamā satyaṁ damaḥ śhamaḥ
sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ bhavo ’bhāvo bhayaṁ chābhayameva cha
english: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from delusion, forgiveness, truth, restraint of the senses,

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा राज्ञोऽथ तत् वाक्यम् मनसा स विचिंत्य च
transliteration: śrutvā rājño'tha tat vākyam manasā sa viciṃtya ca
english: Hearing these words of the king, and having pondered well, he will make over to him Rsyasînga of subdued senses, together with Santa and his children.

sanskrit: भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
transliteration: ahiṁsā samatā tuṣṭis tapo dānaṁ yaśo 'yaśaḥ bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṁ matta eva pṛthag-vidhāḥ
english: tranquillity, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, and also security, harmlessness, equability, contentment, penance, (making) gifts, glory, disgrace, all these different tempers of living beings are from me alone.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्यम् च तम् विप्रम् स राजा विगत ज्वरः
transliteration: pratigṛhyam ca tam vipram sa rājā vigata jvaraḥ
english: And taking that Vipra, that king, his mind free from anxiety, with a glad heart, will prepare for that sacrifice.

sanskrit: मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: maharṣhayaḥ sapta pūrve chatvāro manavas tathā
mad-bhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣhāṁ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
english: The seven great sages, and likewise the four ancient Manus, whose descendants are (all) these people in the world, were all born from my mind, (partaking) of my powers.

sanskrit: तम् च राजा दशरथो यशस् कामः कृतांलिः
transliteration: tam ca rājā daśaratho yaśas kāmaḥ kṛtāṃliḥ
english: And king Dasaratha, knowing duty and desirous of fame, with the intention of obtaining offspring and heaven, with folded hands, will appoint that best of Brahmanas, Rsyasriga, to conduct the ceremony. And that bringer of good will attain his object at the hands of that foremost of Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
transliteration: etāṁ vibhūtiṁ yogaṁ cha mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
english: Whoever correctly knows these powers and emanations of mine, becomes possessed of devotion free from indecision; of this (there is) no doubt.

sanskrit: यज्ञार्थम् प्रसवार्थम् च स्वर्गार्थम् च नरेश्वरः
लभते च स तम् कामम् द्विज मुख्यात् विशांपतिः
transliteration: yajñārtham prasavārtham ca svargārtham ca nareśvaraḥ
labhate ca sa tam kāmam dvija mukhyāt viśāṃpatiḥ
english: And king Dasaratha, knowing duty and desirous of fame, with the intention of obtaining offspring and heaven, with folded hands, will appoint that best of Brahmanas, Rsyasriga, to conduct the ceremony. And that bringer of good will attain his object at the hands of that foremost of Brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
transliteration: ahaṁ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṁ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṁ budhā bhāva-samanvitāḥ
english: The wise, full of love, worship me, believing that I am the origin of all, and that all moves on through me.

sanskrit: पुत्राः च अस्य भविष्यन्ति चत्वारो अमित विक्रमाः
transliteration: putrāḥ ca asya bhaviṣyanti catvāro amita vikramāḥ
english: And four sons will be born to him of immeasurable prowess, bringing fame to the family, and known by all.' Thus spoke formerly in the divine age, that worshipful and foremost of deities, Sanatkumāra.

sanskrit: कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
transliteration: kathayantaśh cha māṁ nityaṁ tuṣhyanti cha ramanti cha
english: (Placing their) minds on me, offering (their) lives to me, instructing each other, and speaking about me, they are always contented and happy.

sanskrit: एवम् स देव प्रवरः पूर्वम् कथितवान् कथाम्
transliteration: evam sa deva pravaraḥ pūrvam kathitavān kathām
english: And four sons will be born to him of immeasurable prowess, bringing fame to the family, and known by all.' Thus spoke formerly in the divine age, that worshipful and foremost of deities, Sanatkumāra.

sanskrit: ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
transliteration: dadāmi buddhi-yogaṁ taṁ yena mām upayānti te
english: To these, who are constantly devoted, and who worship with love, I give that knowledge by which they attain to me.

sanskrit: स त्वम् पुरुष शार्दूल समानय सुसत्कृतम्
स्वयम् एव महाराज गत्वा स बल वाहनः
transliteration: sa tvam puruṣa śārdūla samānaya susatkṛtam
svayam eva mahārāja gatvā sa bala vāhanaḥ
english: Therefore, do you, O tiger among men, repairing there, accompanied with your forces and equipage, yourself, O mighty king, bring Rşyasſrga over with due honours.
And remaining in their hearts, I destroy, with the brilliant lamp of knowledge, the darkness born of ignorance in such (men) only, out of compassion for them.

sanskrit: अनुमान्य वसिष्ठम् च सूतवाक्यम् निशाम्य च
transliteration: anumānya vasiṣṭham ca sūtavākyam niśāmya ca
english: Hearing Sumantra's words, Dasaratha was exceedingly delighted. And hearing these words, and permitted by Vasistha, he, accompanied with the ladies, and his courtiers, set out for the place where that twice-born one was.

sanskrit: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्
transliteration: paraṁ brahma paraṁ dhāma pavitraṁ paramaṁ bhavān
puruṣhaṁ śhāśhvataṁ divyam ādi-devam ajaṁ vibhum
english: Arguna said: You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme goal, the holiest of the holy.

sanskrit: स अन्तःपुरः सह अमात्यः प्रययौ यत्र स द्विजः
वनानि सरितः च एव व्यतिक्रम्य शनैः शनैः
transliteration: sa antaḥpuraḥ saha amātyaḥ prayayau yatra sa dvijaḥ
vanāni saritaḥ ca eva vyatikramya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ

sanskrit: असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
transliteration: āhus tvām ṛiṣhayaḥ sarve devarṣhir nāradas tathā
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṁ chaiva bravīṣhi me
english: All sages, as well as the divine sage Narada, Asita, Devala, and Vyasa, call you the eternal being, divine, the first god, the unborn, the all-pervading.

sanskrit: अभिचक्राम तम् देशम् यत्र वै मुनिपुंगवः
आसाद्य तम् द्विज श्रेष्ठम् रोमपाद समीपगम्
transliteration: abhicakrāma tam deśam yatra vai munipuṃgavaḥ
āsādya tam dvija śreṣṭham romapāda samīpagam

sanskrit: न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्ितं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
transliteration: sarvam etad ṛitaṁ manye yan māṁ vadasi keśhava
na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṁ vidur devā na dānavāḥ
english: And so, too, you tell me yourself, O Kesava!

sanskrit: ऋषिपुत्रम् ददर्श अथो दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम्
ततो राजा यथा योग्यम् पूजाम् चक्रे विशेषतः
transliteration: ṛṣiputram dadarśa atho dīpyamānam iva analam
tato rājā yathā yogyam pūjām cakre viśeṣataḥ

english: I believe all this that you tell me (to be) true; for, O lord! neither the gods nor demons understand your manifestation. You only know your self by your self.

sanskrit: सखित्वात् तस्य वै राज्ञः प्रहृष्टेन अंतरात्मना
transliteration: sakhitvāt tasya vai rājñaḥ prahṛṣṭena aṃtarātmanā
english: Then the king received him respectfully, and with a delighted mind, on account of the friendship he bore him. He communicated to the intelligent son of the saint, the fact of their intimacy, and then the latter paid homage to Dasaratha.

transliteration: yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṁs tvaṁ vyāpya tiṣhṭhasi
english: O best of beings! creator of all things! lord of all things! god of gods! lord of the universe! be pleased to declare without exception your divine emanations, by which emanations you stand pervading all these worlds.

sanskrit: सख्यम् संबन्धकम् चैव तदा तम् प्रत्यपूजयत्
transliteration: sakhyam saṃbandhakam caiva tadā tam pratyapūjayat

sanskrit: केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
transliteration: kathaṁ vidyām ahaṁ yogins tvāṁ sadā parichintayan
keṣhu keṣhu cha bhāveṣhu chintyo ’si bhagavan mayā
english: How shall I know you, O you of mystic power! always meditating on you? And in what various entities, O lord! should I meditate on you?

sanskrit: सप्ताष्ट दिवसान् राजा राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
शांता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशाम् पते
transliteration: saptāṣṭa divasān rājā rājānam idam abravīt
śāṃtā tava sutā rājan saha bhartrā viśām pate
english: Having passed seven or eight days with Romapäda, receiving high honours, that foremost of men, Dasaratha spoke to Romapada,. saying, Let your daughter, O king, together with her husband, O lord of men, repair to my city. I am going to be engaged in a mighty enterprise.

sanskrit: भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
transliteration: bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛiptir hi śhṛiṇvato nāsti me ’mṛitam
english: Again, O Ganardana! do you yourself declare your powers and emanations; because hearing this nectar, I (still) feel no satiety. The Deity said:

sanskrit: मदीयम् नगरम् यातु कार्यम् हि महदुद्यतम्
तथा इति राजा संश्रुत्य गमनम् तस्य धीमतः
transliteration: madīyam nagaram yātu kāryam hi mahadudyatam
tathā iti rājā saṃśrutya gamanam tasya dhīmataḥ

english: Well then, O best of Kauravas! I will state to you my own divine emanations; but (only) the chief (ones), for there is no end to the extent of my (emanations).

sanskrit: उवाच वचनम् विप्रम् गच्छ त्वम् सह भार्यया
ऋषिपुत्रः प्रतिश्रुत्य तथा इति आहः नृपम् तदा
transliteration: uvāca vacanam vipram gaccha tvam saha bhāryayā
ṛṣiputraḥ pratiśrutya tathā iti āhaḥ nṛpam tadā
english: Hearing this as to the journey of that intelligent one, the king said to that Vipra, Do you repair with your wife! Thereupon the saint's son, promising to go, said to the king, So be it!

sanskrit: अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
transliteration: aham ādiśh cha madhyaṁ cha bhūtānām anta eva cha
english: I am the self, O Gudakesa! seated in the hearts of all beings. I am the beginning and the middle and the end also of all beings.

sanskrit: स नृपेण अभ्यनुज्ञातः प्रययौ सह भार्यया
ताव अन्योन्य अंजलिम् कृत्वा स्नेहात् संश्लिष्य च उरसा
transliteration: sa nṛpeṇa abhyanujñātaḥ prayayau saha bhāryayā
tāva anyonya aṃjalim kṛtvā snehāt saṃśliṣya ca urasā
english: Then with the king's permission, he set out with his wife. Dasaratha and the puissant Romapāda clasping each other by the palm, and embracing each other in affection, attained excess. of joy. Then Raghu's son, bidding farewell to his friend, set out.

transliteration: ādityānām ahaṁ viṣhṇur jyotiṣhāṁ ravir anśhumān
marīchir marutām asmi nakṣhatrāṇām ahaṁ śhaśhī
english: I am Vishnu among the Adityas, the beaming sun among the shining (bodies); I am Mariki among the Maruts, and the moon among the lunar mansions.

Then with the king's permission, he set out with his wife. Dasaratha and the puissant Romapāda clasping each other by the palm, and embracing each other in affection, attained excess. of joy. Then Raghu's son, bidding farewell to his friend, set out.

transliteration: indriyāṇāṁ manaśh chāsmi bhūtānām asmi chetanā
english: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama-vedaI am Indra among the gods. And I am mind among the senses. I am consciousness in (living) beings.

sanskrit: पौरेषु प्रेषयामास दूतान् वै शीघ्र गामिनः
क्रियताम् नगरम् सर्वम् क्षिप्रम् एव स्वलंकृतम्
transliteration: paureṣu preṣayāmāsa dūtān vai śīghra gāminaḥ
kriyatām nagaram sarvam kṣipram eva svalaṃkṛtam
english: He despatched swift messengers to the citizens, saying, Let the entire city be embellished; let it be perfumed with dhupa, and watered and decked with pennons.

transliteration: vasūnāṁ pāvakaśh chāsmi meruḥ śhikhariṇām aham
english: And I am Sankara among the Rudras, the lord of wealth among Yakshas and Rakshases. And I am fire among the Vasus, and Meru among the hightopped (mountains).

sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टाः पौराः ते श्रुत्वा राजानम् आगतम्
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paurāḥ te śrutvā rājānam āgatam

sanskrit: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्
transliteration: purodhasāṁ cha mukhyaṁ māṁ viddhi pārtha bṛihaspatim
senānīnām ahaṁ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ
english: And know me, O Arguna! to be Brihaspati, the chief among domestic priests. I am Skanda among generals. I am the ocean among reservoirs of water.

sanskrit: तथा चक्रुः च तत् सर्वम् राज्ञा यत् प्रेषितम् तदा
ततः स्वलंकृतम् राजा नगरम् प्रविवेश ह
transliteration: tathā cakruḥ ca tat sarvam rājñā yat preṣitam tadā
tataḥ svalaṃkṛtam rājā nagaram praviveśa ha
maharṣhīṇāṁ bhṛigur ahaṁ girām asmyekam akṣharam
english: I am Bhrigu among the great sagesI am the single syllable (OM) among words. Among sacrifices I am the Gapa sacrifice; the Himalaya among the firmly-fixed (mountains);

sanskrit: ततः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तम् नागरा द्विजम्
transliteration: tataḥ pramuditāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tam nāgarā dvijam

english: the Asvattha among all trees, and Narada among divine sages; Kitraratha among the heavenly choristers, the sage Kapila among the Siddhas.

And beholding that Brāhmaṇa entering the city, duly honoured by the prime of men; subservient to Indra, like to Kaśyapa's son entering the celestial regions honoured of the thousand eyed lord of the celestials, all the citizens rejoiced exceedingly.
Among horses know me to be Ukkaissravas, brought forth by (the labours for) the nectar; and Airavata among the great elephants, and the ruler of men among men.

sanskrit: अन्तःपुरम् प्रवेश्य एनम् पूजाम् कृत्वा च शास्त्रतः
कृतकृत्यम् तदा आत्मानम् मेने तस्य उपवाहनात्
transliteration: antaḥpuram praveśya enam pūjām kṛtvā ca śāstrataḥ
kṛtakṛtyam tadā ātmānam mene tasya upavāhanāt
english: Then taking him into the inner apartment, and paying him homage according to the ordinance, the king considered himself as having gained his object, in consequence of the presence of that Brahmana.

transliteration: āyudhānām ahaṁ vajraṁ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk
prajanaśh chāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ
english: I am the thunderbolt among weapons, the wishgiving (cow) among cowsAnd I am love which generates. Among serpents I am Vasuki.

sanskrit: अन्तःपुराणि सर्वाणि शांताम् दृष्ट्वा तथा आगताम्
सह भर्त्रा विशालाक्षीम् प्रीत्या आनंदम् उपागमन्
transliteration: antaḥpurāṇi sarvāṇi śāṃtām dṛṣṭvā tathā āgatām
saha bhartrā viśālākṣīm prītyā ānaṃdam upāgaman
english: And all the inmates of the inner apartment, seeing the large-eyed Săntă thus arrived with her husband, experienced excess of joy.

transliteration: anantaśh chāsmi nāgānāṁ varuṇo yādasām aham
pitṝīṇām aryamā chāsmi yamaḥ sanyamatām aham
english: Among Naga snakes I am Ananta; I am Varuna among aquatic beings. And I am Aryaman among the manes, and Yama among rulers.

sanskrit: पूज्यमाना तु ताभिः सा राज्ञा च एव विशेषतः
उवास तत्र सुखिता कन्चित् कालम् सह द्विजा
transliteration: pūjyamānā tu tābhiḥ sā rājñā ca eva viśeṣataḥ
uvāsa tatra sukhitā kancit kālam saha dvijā
english: Then honoured by them and the king in especial, she happily spent there some time along with that twice-born one.

transliteration: prahlādaśh chāsmi daityānāṁ kālaḥ kalayatām aham
mṛigāṇāṁ cha mṛigendro ’haṁ vainateyaśh cha pakṣhiṇām
english: Among demons, too, I am PralhadaI am the king of death (Kala, time) among those that count. Among beasts I am the lord of beasts, and the son of Vinata among birds.

sanskrit: ततः काले बहु तिथे कस्मिन् चित् सुमनोहरे
transliteration: tataḥ kāle bahu tithe kasmin cit sumanohare
english: Then after a long while, when the charming spring had appeared on the earth, the king conceived the desire of celebrating the sacrifice.

transliteration: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śhastra-bhṛitām aham
jhaṣhāṇāṁ makaraśh chāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī
english: I am the wind among those that blowI am Rama among those that wield weapons. Among fishes I am Makara, and among streams the Gahnavi.

sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा तम् विप्रम् देव वर्णिनम्
transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya śirasā tam vipram deva varṇinam
english: Then bowing down the head before the Vipra effulgent like a celestial, he appointed him to undertake the ceremony, for the purpose of obtaining offspring to perpetuate his line.

transliteration: sargāṇām ādir antaśh cha madhyaṁ chaivāham arjuna
english: Of created things I am the beginning and the end and the middle also, O Arguna! Among sciences, I am the science of the Adhyatma, and I am the argument of controversialists.

sanskrit: तथेइति च स राजानम् उवाच वसुधाधिपम्
transliteration: tatheiti ca sa rājānam uvāca vasudhādhipam
english: Then that Brāhmana said to the lord of the earth, the king, So be it! Get order the necessary provisions procured, free the horse set, and prepare a sacrificial ground on the north bank of the Sarayd.
Among letters I am the letter A, and among the group of compounds the copulative compound. I myself am time inexhaustible, and I the creator whose faces are in all directions.

sanskrit: सरव्याः च उत्तरे तीरे यज्ञ भूमिः विधीयताम्
ततो अब्रवीत् नृपः वाक्यम् ब्राह्मणान् वेद पारगान्
transliteration: saravyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmiḥ vidhīyatām
tato abravīt nṛpaḥ vākyam brāhmaṇān veda pāragān

sanskrit: कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
transliteration: mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām
kīrtiḥ śhrīr vāk cha nārīṇāṁ smṛitir medhā dhṛitiḥ kṣhamā
english: I am death who seizes all, and the source of what is to be. And among females, fame, fortune, speech, memory, intellect, courage, forgiveness.

sanskrit: सुमंत्र आवाहय क्ष्षिप्रम् ऋत्विजो ब्रह्म वादिनः
सुयज्ञम् वामदेवम् च जाबालिम् अथ काश्यपम्
transliteration: sumaṃtra āvāhaya kṣṣipram ṛtvijo brahma vādinaḥ
suyajñam vāmadevam ca jābālim atha kāśyapam
english: Then the king spoke to Sumantra, saying, O Sumantra, do you summon speedily Brāhmaṇas versed in the Vedas and priests professing the Vedānta philosophy, Suyajña, and Vāmadeva, and Jabali, and Kasyapa, and the priest Vasistha, together with other excellent twice-born ones.

transliteration: bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham
english: Likewise among Saman hymns, I am the Brihatsaman, and I the Gayatri among metresI am Margasirsha among the months, the spring among the seasons;

sanskrit: पुरोहितम् वसिष्ठम् च ये च अन्ये द्विज सत्तमाः
ततः सुमंत्रः त्वरितम् गत्वा त्वरित विक्रमः
transliteration: purohitam vasiṣṭham ca ye ca anye dvija sattamāḥ
tataḥ sumaṃtraḥ tvaritam gatvā tvarita vikramaḥ
dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
english: of cheats, I am the game of dice; I am the glory of the glorious; victory, I am industry, I am the goodness of the good.

sanskrit: समानयत् स तान् सर्वान् समस्तान् वेद पारगान्
तान् पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथः तदा
transliteration: samānayat sa tān sarvān samastān veda pāragān
tān pūjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā
munīnām apyahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśhanā kaviḥ
english: I am Vasudeva among the descendants of Vrishni, and Arguna among the Pandavas. Among sages also, I am Vyasa; and among the discerning ones, I am the discerning Usanas.

sanskrit: धर्मार्थ सहितम् युक्तम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
मम तातप्य मानस्य पुत्रार्थम् नास्ति वै सुखम्
transliteration: dharmārtha sahitam yuktam ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt
mama tātapya mānasya putrārtham nāsti vai sukham
daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām
maunaṁ chaivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham
english: I am the rod of those that restrain, and the policy of those that desire victory. I am silence respecting secrets. I am the knowledge of those that have knowledge.

sanskrit: न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
transliteration: yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna
na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ charācharam
english: And, O Arguna! I am also that which is the seed of all things. There is nothing movable or immovable which can exist without me.

sanskrit: ऋषिपुत्र प्रभावेण कामान् प्राप्स्यामि च अपि अहम्
ततः साधु इति तद् वाक्यम् ब्राह्मणाः प्रत्यपूजयन्
transliteration: ṛṣiputra prabhāveṇa kāmān prāpsyāmi ca api aham
tataḥ sādhu iti tad vākyam brāhmaṇāḥ pratyapūjayan
eṣha tūddeśhataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā
english: O terror of your foes! there is no end to my divine emanations. Here I have declared the extent of (those) emanations only in part.

sanskrit: वसिष्ठ प्रमुखाः सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखात् च्युतम्
ऋष्यशृङ्ग पुरोगाः च प्रति ऊचुः नृपतिम् तदा
transliteration: vasiṣṭha pramukhāḥ sarve pārthivasya mukhāt cyutam
ṛṣyaśṛṅga purogāḥ ca prati ūcuḥ nṛpatim tadā
yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā
tat tad evāvagachchha tvaṁ mama tejo ’nśha-sambhavam
english: Whatever thing (there is) of power, or glorious, or splendid, know all that to be produced from portions of my energy.

sanskrit: संभाराः संभ्रियम्ताम् ते तुरगः च विमुच्यताम्
सरव्याः च उत्तरे तीरे यज्ञ भूमिः विधीयताम्
transliteration: saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyamtām te turagaḥ ca vimucyatām
saravyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmiḥ vidhīyatām
atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣhṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛitsnam ekānśhena sthito jagat
english: Or rather, O Arguna! what have you to do, knowing all this at large? I stand supporting all this by (but) a single portion (of myself).

sanskrit: सर्वथा प्राप्यसे पुत्राम् चतुरो अमित विक्रमान्
यस्य ते धर्मिकी बुद्धिः इयम् पुत्रार्थम् आगता
transliteration: sarvathā prāpyase putrām caturo amita vikramān
yasya te dharmikī buddhiḥ iyam putrārtham āgatā
english: Since you purpose so virtuously for obtaining offspring, you shall obtain four sons of immeasurable prowess.

transliteration: yat tvayoktaṁ vachas tena moho ’yaṁ vigato mama
english: Arguna said: In consequence of the excellent and mysterious words concerning the relation of the supreme and individual soul, which you have spoken for my welfare, this delusion of mine is gone away.

sanskrit: ततः प्रीतोऽभवत् राजा श्रुत्वा तु द्विज भाषितम्
अमात्यान् अब्रवीत् राजा हर्षेण इदम् शुभ अक्षरम्
transliteration: tataḥ prīto'bhavat rājā śrutvā tu dvija bhāṣitam
amātyān abravīt rājā harṣeṇa idam śubha akṣaram
english: Hearing those words of the regenerate ones, the king was exceedingly delighted. And cheerfully he spoke these auspicious words to his courtiers.

sanskrit: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया
transliteration: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śhrutau vistaraśho mayā
english: O you whose eyes are like lotus leaves! I have heard from you at large about the production and dissolution of things, and also about your inexhaustible greatness.

sanskrit: गुरूणाम् वचनात् शीघ्रम् संभाराः संभ्रियन्तु मे
समर्थ अधिष्टितः च अश्वः सः उपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्
transliteration: gurūṇām vacanāt śīghram saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantu me
samartha adhiṣṭitaḥ ca aśvaḥ saḥ upādhyāyo vimucyatām
english: In accordance with the directions of my spiritual guides, do you speedily procure these provisions, loose the horse well protected, and followed by a priest.

transliteration: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśhvara
draṣhṭum ichchhāmi te rūpam aiśhwaraṁ puruṣhottama
english: O highest lord! what you have said about yourself is so. I wish, O best of beings! to see your divine form.

sanskrit: सरयव्याः च उत्तरे तीरे यज्ञ भूमिः विधीयताम्
शांतयः च अभिवर्थन्ताम् यथा कल्पम् यथा विधि
transliteration: sarayavyāḥ ca uttare tīre yajña bhūmiḥ vidhīyatām
śāṃtayaḥ ca abhivarthantām yathā kalpam yathā vidhi
english: And prepare the sacrificial ground on the north bank of the Sarayu. And perform the ceremonies capable of securing the rites from disturbance.

sanskrit: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो
transliteration: manyase yadi tach chhakyaṁ mayā draṣhṭum iti prabho
yogeśhvara tato me tvaṁ darśhayātmānam avyayam
english: If, O lord! you think that it is possible for me to look upon it, then, O lord of the possessors of mystic power! show your inexhaustible form to me.

sanskrit: शक्यः कर्तुम् अयम् यज्ञः सर्वेण अपि महीक्षिता
न अपराथो भवेत् कष्टो यद्य अस्मिन् क्रतु सत्तमे
transliteration: śakyaḥ kartum ayam yajñaḥ sarveṇa api mahīkṣitā
na aparātho bhavet kaṣṭo yadya asmin kratu sattame
english: Surely every king is competent to perform this sacrifice yet care must be taken that no default occurs in it.

sanskrit: पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः
transliteration: paśhya me pārtha rūpāṇi śhataśho ’tha sahasraśhaḥ
english: The Deity said: In hundreds and in thousands see my forms, O son of Pritha! various, divine, and of various colours and shapes.

sanskrit: छिद्रम् हि मृगयन्त एते विद्वान्सो ब्रह्म राक्षसाः
transliteration: chidram hi mṛgayanta ete vidvānso brahma rākṣasāḥ
english: For flaws in this foremost of sacrifices are watched by learned Brahma-Rākşasas. And should it come to be celebrated in violation of the ordinance, ihe performer thereof shall meet with instant destruction.

transliteration: paśhyādityān vasūn rudrān aśhvinau marutas tathā
english: See the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Asvins, and Maruts likewise. And O descendant of Bharata! see wonders, in numbers, unseen before.

sanskrit: तद् यथा विधि पूर्वम् क्रतुः एष समाप्यते
तथा विधानम् क्रियताम् समर्थाः करणेषु इह
transliteration: tad yathā vidhi pūrvam kratuḥ eṣa samāpyate
tathā vidhānam kriyatām samarthāḥ karaṇeṣu iha
english: And do you so order that this sacrifice of mine may be completed according to the prescribed ritual.

transliteration: mama dehe guḍākeśha yach chānyad draṣhṭum ichchhasi
english: Within my body, O Gudakesa! see to-day the whole universe, including (everything) movable and immovable, (all) in one, and whatever else you wish to see.

sanskrit: तथा इति च ततः सर्वे मंत्रिणः प्रत्यपूजयन्
पार्थिव इन्द्रस्य तत् वाक्यम् यथा आज्ञप्तम् अकुर्वत
transliteration: tathā iti ca tataḥ sarve maṃtriṇaḥ pratyapūjayan
pārthiva indrasya tat vākyam yathā ājñaptam akurvata
english: Thereupon honouring those words of the king, the ministers did as ordered.

sanskrit: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
transliteration: na tu māṁ śhakyase draṣhṭum anenaiva sva-chakṣhuṣhā
divyaṁ dadāmi te chakṣhuḥ paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
english: But you will not be able to see me with merely this eye of yours. I give you an eye divine. (Now) see my divine power.

sanskrit: ततो द्विजाः ते धर्मज्ञम् अस्तुवन् पार्थिवर्षभम्
अनुज्ञाताः ततः सर्वे पुनः जग्मुः यथा आगतम्
transliteration: tato dvijāḥ te dharmajñam astuvan pārthivarṣabham
anujñātāḥ tataḥ sarve punaḥ jagmuḥ yathā āgatam
english: And having eulogised the king knowing duty, the twice-born ones, with the Monarch's leave, departed for their respective quarters.

transliteration: evam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśhvaro hariḥ
darśhayām āsa pārthāya paramaṁ rūpam aiśhwaram
english: Sangaya said: Having spoken thus, O king! Hari, the great lord of the possessors of mystic power, then showed to the son of Pritha his supreme divine form,

sanskrit: गतेषु तेषु विप्रेषु मंत्रिणः तान् नराधिपः
transliteration: gateṣu teṣu vipreṣu maṃtriṇaḥ tān narādhipaḥ
english: When the Vipras had gone, the mightyminded lord of men dismissing his counsellors, entered his place. When the Vipras had gone, the mightyminded lord of men dismissing his counsellors, entered his place.
having many mouths and eyes, having (within it) many wonderful sights,

sanskrit: पुनः प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णः संवत्सरोऽभवत्
transliteration: punaḥ prāpte vasante tu pūrṇaḥ saṃvatsaro'bhavat
english: When after a full one year, spring had again appeared on the face of the earth, the puissant king, intent upon getting offspring through the horse-sacrifice, sough Vasistha's side.

having many celestial ornaments, having, many celestial weapons held erect, wearing celestial flowers and vestments, having an anointment of celestial perfumes, full of every wonder, the infinite deity with faces in all directions.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य वसिष्ठम् च न्यायतः प्रतिपूज्य च
transliteration: abhivādya vasiṣṭham ca nyāyataḥ pratipūjya ca
english: Having saluted Vasiştha and duly paid him homage, he humbly spoke to that best of twiceborn ones, with the intention of having offspring.

sanskrit: यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: yadi bhāḥ sadṛiśhī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ
english: If in the heavens, the lustre of a thousand suns burst forth all at once, that would be like the lustre of that mighty one.

sanskrit: यज्ञो मे क्रियताम् ब्रह्मन् यथोक्तम् मुनिपुङ्गव
यथा न विघ्नाः क्रियन्ते यज्ञांगेषु विधीयताम्
transliteration: yajño me kriyatām brahman yathoktam munipuṅgava
yathā na vighnāḥ kriyante yajñāṃgeṣu vidhīyatām
english: O Brahman, undertake to perform this sacrifice of mine, according to the ordinance, O foremost of ascetics! do you order so that no impediment may happen to the sacrifice!.
There the son of Pandu then observed in the body of the god of gods the whole universe (all) in one, and divided into numerous (divisions).

sanskrit: भवान् स्निग्धः सुहृन् मह्यम् गुरुः च परमो महान्
वोढव्यो भवता च एव भारो यज्ञस्य च उद्यतः
transliteration: bhavān snigdhaḥ suhṛn mahyam guruḥ ca paramo mahān
voḍhavyo bhavatā ca eva bhāro yajñasya ca udyataḥ
english: You are my kind friend, and prime and mighty spiritual guide. Engaged in it, you will have to bear the entire burden of the ceremony.
Then Dhanangaya filled with amazement, and with hair standing on end, bowed his head before the god, and spoke with joined hands.

sanskrit: तथा इति च स राजानम् अब्रवीत् द्विजसत्तमः
करिष्ये सर्वम् एव एतत् भवता यत् समर्थितम्
transliteration: tathā iti ca sa rājānam abravīt dvijasattamaḥ
kariṣye sarvam eva etat bhavatā yat samarthitam
english: Thereupon that best of Brāhmaṇas said to the king, 'So be it! I will do all that you asked.

transliteration: ṛiṣhīnśh cha sarvān uragānśh cha divyān
english: Arguna said: O god! I see within your body the gods, as also all the groups of various beings; and the lord Brahman seated on (his) lotus seat, and all the sages and celestial snakes.

sanskrit: ततोऽब्रवीत् द्विजान् वृद्धान् यज्ञ कर्मसु निष्ठितान्
स्थापत्ये निष्ठिताम् च एव वृद्धान् परम धार्मिकान्
transliteration: tato'bravīt dvijān vṛddhān yajña karmasu niṣṭhitān
sthāpatye niṣṭhitām ca eva vṛddhān parama dhārmikān
nāntaṁ na madhyaṁ na punas tavādiṁ
english: I see you, who are of countless forms, possessed of many arms, stomachs, mouths, and eyes on all sides. And, O lord of the universe! O you of all forms! I do not see your end or middle or beginning.

sanskrit: कर्म अन्तिकान् शिल्पकारान् वर्धकीन् खनकान् अपि
गणकान् शिल्पिनः च एव तथा एव नट नर्तकान्
transliteration: karma antikān śilpakārān vardhakīn khanakān api
gaṇakān śilpinaḥ ca eva tathā eva naṭa nartakān

english: I see you bearing a coronet and a mace and a discus a mass of glory, brilliant on all sides, difficult to look at, having on all sides the effulgence of a blazing fire or sun, and indefinable.

sanskrit: तथा शुचीन् शास्त्र विदः पुरुषान् सु बहु श्रुतान्
यज्ञ कर्म समीहन्ताम् भवन्तो राज शासनात्
transliteration: tathā śucīn śāstra vidaḥ puruṣān su bahu śrutān
yajña karma samīhantām bhavanto rāja śāsanāt

english: You are indestructible, the supreme one to be known. You are the highest support of this universe. You are the inexhaustible protector of everlasting piety. I believe you to be the eternal being.

sanskrit: इष्टका बहु साहस्री शीघ्रम् आनीयताम् इति
उपकार्याः क्रियन्ताम् च राज्ञो बहु गुणान्विताः
transliteration: iṣṭakā bahu sāhasrī śīghram ānīyatām iti
upakāryāḥ kriyantām ca rājño bahu guṇānvitāḥ
english: And fetch bricks by thousands. And do raise structures for the kings, commanding every convenience.
I see you void of beginning, middle, end of infinite power, of unnumbered arms, having the sun and moon for eyes, having a mouth like a blazing fire, and heating the universe with your radiance.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मण आवसथाः चैव कर्तव्याः शतशः शुभाः
भक्ष्य अन्न पानैः बहुभिः समुपेताः सुनिष्ठिताः
transliteration: brāhmaṇa āvasathāḥ caiva kartavyāḥ śataśaḥ śubhāḥ
bhakṣya anna pānaiḥ bahubhiḥ samupetāḥ suniṣṭhitāḥ
english: Do you rear goodly and comfortable buildings by hundreds for the Brāhmaṇas, replenished with various meats and drinks.
For this space between heaven and earth and all the quarters are pervaded by you alone. Looking, at this wonderful and terrible form of yours, O high-souled one! the three worlds are affrighted.

sanskrit: तथा पौर जनस्य अपि कर्तव्याः च सुविस्तराः
आगतानाम् सुदूरात् च पार्थिवानाम् पृथक् पृथक्
transliteration: tathā paura janasya api kartavyāḥ ca suvistarāḥ
āgatānām sudūrāt ca pārthivānām pṛthak pṛthak
english: You should provide spacious apartments for the citizens and the dwellers, of provinces, and separate quarters for the princes, coming from foreign parts. And stables and sleeping apartments be raised for warriors coming from foreign countries.

For here these groups of gods are entering into you. Some being afraid are praying with joined hands, and the groups of great sages and Siddhas are saying 'Welfare!' and praising you with abundant (hymns) of praise.

sanskrit: वाजिवारण शलाः च तथा शय्या गृहाणि च
transliteration: vājivāraṇa śalāḥ ca tathā śayyā gṛhāṇi ca
english: You should provide spacious apartments for the citizens and the dwellers, of provinces, and separate quarters for the princes, coming from foreign parts. And stables and sleeping apartments be raised for warriors coming from foreign countries.
The Rudras, and Adityas, the Vasus, the Sadhyas, the Visvas, the two Asvins, the Maruts, and the Ushmapas, and the groups of Gandharvas, Yakshas, demons, and Siddhas are all looking at you amazed.

sanskrit: आवासा बहु भक्ष्या वै सर्व कामैः उपस्थिताः
तथा पौरजन्स्य अपि जनस्य बहु शोभनम्
transliteration: āvāsā bahu bhakṣyā vai sarva kāmaiḥ upasthitāḥ
tathā paurajansya api janasya bahu śobhanam

english: Seeing your mighty form, with many mouths and eyes, with many arms, thighs, and feet, with many stomachs, and fearful with many jaws, all people, and I like-wise, are much alarmed, O you of mighty arms!

sanskrit: दातव्यम् अन्नम् विधिवत् सत्कृत्य न तु लीलया
सर्वे वर्णा यथा पूजाम् प्राप्नुवन्ति सुसत्कृताः
transliteration: dātavyam annam vidhivat satkṛtya na tu līlayā
sarve varṇā yathā pūjām prāpnuvanti susatkṛtāḥ
english: And dwellings filled with diverse kinds of viands, and commanding everything desirable, and mansions for the lower orders of the citizens, exceedingly beautiful to behold. And meats should be duly dispensed with all hospitality, and not in the indifference of festive occasions, so that all may regard themselves as honourably entertained. And none should be disregarded out of lust or passion.

sanskrit: धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो
transliteration: dhṛitiṁ na vindāmi śhamaṁ cha viṣhṇo
english: Seeing you, O Vishnu! touching the skies, radiant, possessed of many hues, with a gaping mouth, and with large blazing eyes, I am much alarmed in my inmost self, and feel no courage, no tranquillity.
