transliteration: sabalo vā muniśreṣṭha sahito vā mama ātmajaiḥ
katham api amara prakhyam saṃgrāmāṇām akovidam

sanskrit: बालम् मे तनयम् ब्रह्मन् नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम्
अथ काल उपमौ युद्धे सुतौ सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः
transliteration: bālam me tanayam brahman naiva dāsyāmi putrakam
atha kāla upamau yuddhe sutau sundopasundayoḥ

sanskrit: यज्ञ विघ्न करौ तौ ते न एव दास्यामि पुत्रकम्
मारीचः च सुबाहुः च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ
transliteration: yajña vighna karau tau te na eva dāsyāmi putrakam
mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca vīryavantau suśikṣitau
english: The sons of Sunda and Upasunda resemble Kāla himself in battle, and it is they who are disturbing your sacrifice. Therefore I will not part with my son. And Mārīca and Subāhu are possessed of prowess, and accomplished in weapons.

sanskrit: तयोः अन्यतरम् योद्धुम् यास्यामि स सुहृत् गणः
transliteration: tayoḥ anyataram yoddhum yāsyāmi sa suhṛt gaṇaḥ
english: But with my friends I will repair to encounter one of them. If you do not consent to this, I beseech you with my friends, (do you desist! 27

sanskrit: इति नरपति जल्पनात् द्विजेन्द्रम्कुशिक सुतम् सुमहान् विवेश मन्युः
सु हुत इव मखे अग्निः आज्य सिक्तःसमभवत् उज्वलितो महर्षि वह्निः
transliteration: iti narapati jalpanāt dvijendramkuśika sutam sumahān viveśa manyuḥ
su huta iva makhe agniḥ ājya siktaḥsamabhavat ujvalito maharṣi vahniḥ
english: Hearing these words of the lord of men, a mighty ire took possession of that foremost of regenerate ones, Kusika's son; and the fire of the Maharși's wrath flamed up even like to a fire fed by fuel and clarified butter.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य स्नेह पर्याकुलाक्षरम्
समन्युः कौशिको वाक्यम् प्रति उवाच महीपतिम्
transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya sneha paryākulākṣaram
samanyuḥ kauśiko vākyam prati uvāca mahīpatim
english: Hearing those words of Dasaratha's composed of letters faltering with affection, Kusika's son, stirred up with anger, answered the monarch, saying,

sanskrit: पूर्वम् अर्थम् प्रति श्रुत्य प्रतिज्ञाम् हातुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: pūrvam artham prati śrutya pratijñām hātum icchasi
english: Having promised me first, you endeavour to renounce that proinise of yours. This surely is unworthy of a descendant of Raghu, and this can bring destruction upon the dynasty.

sanskrit: यद् इदम् ते क्षमम् राजन् गमिष्यामि यथा आगतम्
मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञः काकुत्स्थ सुखी भव सु हृद् वृतः
transliteration: yad idam te kṣamam rājan gamiṣyāmi yathā āgatam
mithyā pratijñaḥ kākutstha sukhī bhava su hṛd vṛtaḥ
english: If, O king, in acting thus, you have acted properly, I will then repair to the place whence I had come. O Kākutstha's descendant false in promise, do you attain happiness, being surrounded by your friends.

sanskrit: चचाल वसुधा कृत्स्ना देवानाम् च भयम्
transliteration: cacāla vasudhā kṛtsnā devānām ca bhayam
english: And when the intelligent Viśvāmitra was exercised with wrath, the entire earth began to tremble, and the gods even were inspired with awe.

sanskrit: त्रस्त रूपम् तु विज्ञाय जगत्सर्वम् महान् ऋषिः
नृपतिम् सुव्रतो धीरो वसिष्ठो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: trasta rūpam tu vijñāya jagatsarvam mahān ṛṣiḥ
nṛpatim suvrato dhīro vasiṣṭho vākyam abravīt
english: And knowing that the entire universe was in trepidation, that mighty saint, the sedate Vasiştha of excellent vows, said these words to the king.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले जातः साक्षात् धर्म इव अपरः
धृतिमान् सुव्रतः श्रीमान् न धर्मम् हातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām kule jātaḥ sākṣāt dharma iva aparaḥ
dhṛtimān suvrataḥ śrīmān na dharmam hātum arhasi
english: Born in the line of Ikşvāku, you are the very second self of virtue. And endowed with patience, and auspicious, and observing excellent vows, you ought not to renounce virtue.

sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातो धर्मात्मा इति राघव
स्व धर्मम् प्रतिपद्यस्व न अधर्मम् वोढुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto dharmātmā iti rāghava
sva dharmam pratipadyasva na adharmam voḍhum arhasi
english: The descendant of Raghu is famed over the three worlds as righteous-souled. Do you maintain your habit of adhering to promise; for it does not behove you to act unrighteously.

sanskrit: प्रति श्रुत्य करिष्ये इति उक्तम् वाक्यम् अकुर्वतः
इष्टापूर्त वधो भूयात् तस्मात् रामम् विसर्जय
transliteration: prati śrutya kariṣye iti uktam vākyam akurvataḥ
iṣṭāpūrta vadho bhūyāt tasmāt rāmam visarjaya
english: If having promised, I will do so, you do not act up to your word, the merit you have achieved by digging tanks, shall come to naught, therefore do you renounce Rāma!

sanskrit: कृतास्त्रम् अकृतास्त्रम् वा न एवम् शक्ष्यन्ति राक्षसाः
गुप्तम् कुइशिक पुत्रेण ज्वलनेन अमृतम् यथा
transliteration: kṛtāstram akṛtāstram vā na evam śakṣyanti rākṣasāḥ
guptam kuiśika putreṇa jvalanena amṛtam yathā
english: Accomplished or not accomplished in weapons, the Rākṣasas cannot bear him protected by Kusika's son, like ambrosia, by flaming fire.

sanskrit: एष विग्रहवान् धर्म एष वीर्यवताम् वरः
एष विद्य अधिको लोके तपसः च परायणम्
transliteration: eṣa vigrahavān dharma eṣa vīryavatām varaḥ
eṣa vidya adhiko loke tapasaḥ ca parāyaṇam
english: This one is Virtue incarnate : this one is the foremost of those possessing prowess. This one surpass all others in learning, and is the refuge of asceticism.

sanskrit: एषो अस्त्रान् विविधान् वेत्ति त्रैलोक्ये स चराचरे
न एनम् अन्यः पुमान् वेत्ति न च वेत्स्यन्ति केचन
transliteration: eṣo astrān vividhān vetti trailokye sa carācare
na enam anyaḥ pumān vetti na ca vetsyanti kecana
english: This one is congnizant of all that exist in the three worlds furnished with mobile and immobile things;. but others do not know him,-nor yet shall know him hereafter.

sanskrit: न देवा न ऋषयः के चित् न अमरा न च राक्षसाः
गन्धर्व यक्ष प्रवराः स किन्नर महोरगाः
transliteration: na devā na ṛṣayaḥ ke cit na amarā na ca rākṣasāḥ
gandharva yakṣa pravarāḥ sa kinnara mahoragāḥ
english: And neither the gods, nor the saints, nor the immortals, nor the Rakşasas, nor the foremost of Gandharvas and Yaksas, nor the Kinnaras, nor the mighty Serpents can know him.

sanskrit: सर्व अस्त्राणि कृशाश्वस्य पुत्राः परम धार्मिकाः
कौशिकाय पुरा दत्ता यदा राज्यम् प्रशासति
transliteration: sarva astrāṇi kṛśāśvasya putrāḥ parama dhārmikāḥ
kauśikāya purā dattā yadā rājyam praśāsati
english: And formerly while the descendant of Kusika was ruling his kingdom, Siva conferred upon him the highly famous sons of Kțśāśva in the shape of all w apons.

sanskrit: ते अपि पुत्रा कृशाश्वस्य प्रजापति सुता सुताः
न एक रूपा महावीर्या दीप्तिमंतो जयावहाः
transliteration: te api putrā kṛśāśvasya prajāpati sutā sutāḥ
na eka rūpā mahāvīryā dīptimaṃto jayāvahāḥ
english: Those sons of Krśāśva were the offspring of Prajāpati's daughters. And they were endowed with various forms, and were effulgent and dreadful.

sanskrit: जया च सुप्रभा च एव दक्ष कन्ये सुमध्यमे
ते सूते अस्त्र शस्त्राणि शतम् परम भास्वरम्
transliteration: jayā ca suprabhā ca eva dakṣa kanye sumadhyame
te sūte astra śastrāṇi śatam parama bhāsvaram
english: And Dakşa's daughters of elegant waists, Jayā and Suprabhā, brought forth an hundred exceedingly effulgent weapons.

sanskrit: पंचाशतम् सुतान् लेभे जया लब्ध वरा वरान्
वधायासुरसैन्यानामप्रमेयानरूपिणः - यद्वा -वधाय असुर सैन्यानाम् अप्रमेयान् अरूपिणः
transliteration: paṃcāśatam sutān lebhe jayā labdha varā varān
vadhāyāsurasainyānāmaprameyānarūpiṇaḥ - yadvā -vadhāya asura sainyānām aprameyān arūpiṇaḥ
english: And by virtue of her boon, Jayā obtained fifty sons of immeasurable strength and endued with the power of becoming invisible for the purpose of slaughtering the hosts of the Asuras.

sanskrit: सुप्रभा अजनयत् च अपि पुत्रान् पंचाशतम् पुनः
transliteration: suprabhā ajanayat ca api putrān paṃcāśatam punaḥ
english: Suprabhā also brought forth fifty sons named Sanhäras, incapable of being borne, and infallible and powerful.

sanskrit: तानि च अस्त्राणि वेत्ति एष यथावत् कुशिक आत्मजः
अपूर्वाणाम् च जनने शक्तो भूयः च धर्मवित्
transliteration: tāni ca astrāṇi vetti eṣa yathāvat kuśika ātmajaḥ
apūrvāṇām ca janane śakto bhūyaḥ ca dharmavit
english: Kuśika's son is adequately conversant with all those weapons. And that one knowing duty is also capable of creating wonderful weapons.

sanskrit: तेन अस्य मुनि मुख्यस्य धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः
न किंचिद् अस्ति अविदितम् भूतम् भव्यम् च राघव
transliteration: tena asya muni mukhyasya dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ
na kiṃcid asti aviditam bhūtam bhavyam ca rāghava
english: O descendant of Raghu, there is nothing present, past, or future which is not known by that foremost of ascetics of high soul, and cognizant of morality.

sanskrit: एवम् वीर्यो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महा यशाः
न राम गमने राजन् संशयम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: evam vīryo mahātejā viśvāmitro mahā yaśāḥ
na rāma gamane rājan saṃśayam gantum arhasi
english: Such is the prowess of that highly famous Viśvāmitra possessed of mighty energy. Therefore, O king, it behove you not to hesitate in the matter of Rāma's going.

sanskrit: तेषाम् निग्रहणे शक्तः स्वयम् च कुशिकात्मजः
तव पुत्र हितार्थाय त्वाम् उपेत्य अभि याचते
transliteration: teṣām nigrahaṇe śaktaḥ svayam ca kuśikātmajaḥ
tava putra hitārthāya tvām upetya abhi yācate
english: The descendant of Kusika is himself capable of repressing the Rākşasas; and it is in order to your son's welfare that coming to you, he ask for him of you.

sanskrit: इति मुनि वचनात् प्रसन्न चित्तोरघु वृषभः च मुमोद पार्थिव अग्र्यः
गमनम् अभिरुरोच राघवस्यप्रथित यशाः कुशिक आत्मजाय बुध्या
transliteration: iti muni vacanāt prasanna cittoraghu vṛṣabhaḥ ca mumoda pārthiva agryaḥ
gamanam abhiruroca rāghavasyaprathita yaśāḥ kuśika ātmajāya budhyā
english: At this speech of the ascetic, that foremost of Raghus, the king, well-pleased, became exceedingly delighted. And that famous one, relishing the journey of Rāma, began to reflect in his mind about consigning him to Kusika's son.

sanskrit: तथा वसिष्टे ब्रुवति राजा दशरथः स्वयम्
प्रहृष्ट वदनो रामम् आजुहाव स लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: tathā vasiṣṭe bruvati rājā daśarathaḥ svayam
prahṛṣṭa vadano rāmam ājuhāva sa lakṣmaṇam
english: Upon Vasistha's representing this, king Dasaratha himself, with complacent countenance, summoned to him Rāma and Laksmana.

sanskrit: कृतः स्वस्त्ययनम् मात्रा पित्रा दशरथेन च
transliteration: kṛtaḥ svastyayanam mātrā pitrā daśarathena ca
english: And when the auspicious rites had been performed by both Rāma's father and mother, and when the priest Vasiştha had uttered mantras, king Dasaratha, smelling his son's crown, with a glad heart, made him over to the descendant of Kusika.

sanskrit: स पुत्रम् मूर्ध्नि उपाघ्राय राजा दशरथः तदा
transliteration: sa putram mūrdhni upāghrāya rājā daśarathaḥ tadā

sanskrit: ततो वायुः सुख स्पर्शो नीरजस्को ववौ तदा
विश्वामित्र गतम् रामम् दृष्ट्वा राजीव लोचनम्
transliteration: tato vāyuḥ sukha sparśo nīrajasko vavau tadā
viśvāmitra gatam rāmam dṛṣṭvā rājīva locanam
english: Then there blow a Breeze free from dust and of delicious feel, on witnessing the lotus-eyed Rāma at the hands of Viśvāmitra. And as the high-souled one was about to set out, blossoms began to shower down copiously, accompanied with the sounds of celestial kettle-drums and the loud blares of conch.

sanskrit: पुष्प वृष्टिः महती आसीत् देव दुन्दुभि निःस्वनैः
शङ्ख दुन्दुभि निर्घोषः प्रयाते तु महात्मनि
transliteration: puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ mahatī āsīt deva dundubhi niḥsvanaiḥ
śaṅkha dundubhi nirghoṣaḥ prayāte tu mahātmani
english: Then there blow a Breeze free from dust and of delicious feel, on witnessing the lotus-eyed Rāma at the hands of Viśvāmitra. And as the high-souled one was about to set out, blossoms began to shower down copiously, accompanied with the sounds of celestial kettle-drums and the loud blares of conch.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो ययौ अग्रे ततो रामो महायशाः
काक पक्ष धरो धन्वी तम् च सौमित्रिः अन्वगात्
transliteration: viśvāmitro yayau agre tato rāmo mahāyaśāḥ
kāka pakṣa dharo dhanvī tam ca saumitriḥ anvagāt
english: Viśvāmitra went first, and next the highly famous Rāma with the side-locks, holding the bow. And him followed Sumitrā's Sun

sanskrit: कलापिनौ धनुष् पाणी शोभयानौ दिशो दश
विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् त्रि शीर्षौ इव पन्नगौ
transliteration: kalāpinau dhanuṣ pāṇī śobhayānau diśo daśa
viśvāmitram mahātmānam tri śīrṣau iva pannagau
english: And equipped with quivers, and with bows in hand, gracing the ten cardinal points and resembling three-hooded serpents, they followed the high-souled Viśvāmitra, like the two stalwart Asvins following the Grand-sire.

sanskrit: तदा कुशिक पुत्रम् तु धनुष् पाणी स्वलंकृतौ
बद्ध गोध अंगुलि त्राणौ खड्गवन्तौ महाद्युती
transliteration: tadā kuśika putram tu dhanuṣ pāṇī svalaṃkṛtau
baddha godha aṃguli trāṇau khaḍgavantau mahādyutī

sanskrit: कुमारौ चारु वपुषौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: kumārau cāru vapuṣau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau

sanskrit: स्थाणुम् देवम् इव अचिन्त्यम् कुमारौ इव पावकी
अध्यर्ध योजनम् गत्वा सरय्वा दक्षिणे तटे
transliteration: sthāṇum devam iva acintyam kumārau iva pāvakī
adhyardha yojanam gatvā sarayvā dakṣiṇe taṭe

sanskrit: रामा इति मधुराम् वाणीम् विश्वामित्रः अभ्यभाषत
गृहाण वत्स सलिलम् मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः
transliteration: rāmā iti madhurām vāṇīm viśvāmitraḥ abhyabhāṣata
gṛhāṇa vatsa salilam mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
english: And having proceeded over half a Yojana, and arriving at the right bank of the Sarayū, Viśvāmitra addressed these sweet words to Rāma, O Rāma! do you, O child, take of this water: let no delay occur.

sanskrit: मंत्र ग्रामम् गृहाण त्वम् बलाम् अतिबलाम् तथा
न श्रमो न ज्वरो वा ते न रूपस्य विपर्ययः
transliteration: maṃtra grāmam gṛhāṇa tvam balām atibalām tathā
na śramo na jvaro vā te na rūpasya viparyayaḥ
english: Do you receive the mantras Bala and Atibala, and you will not feel fatigue or fever or undergo any change of look, and whether asleep or heedless, the Rākşasas will not be able to surprise you. And, O Rāma, the might of your arms will be unequalled in this world,-nay, in all the three worlds.

sanskrit: न च सुप्तम् प्रमत्तम् वा धर्ष इष्यन्ति नैरृताः
न बाह्वोः सदृशो वीर्ये पृथिव्याम् अस्ति कश्चन
transliteration: na ca suptam pramattam vā dharṣa iṣyanti nairṛtāḥ
na bāhvoḥ sadṛśo vīrye pṛthivyām asti kaścana
english: Do you receive the mantras Bala and Atibala, and you will not feel fatigue or fever or undergo any change of look, and whether asleep or heedless, the Rākşasas will not be able to surprise you. And, O Rāma, the might of your arms will be unequalled in this world,-nay, in all the three worlds.

sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु वा राम न भवेत् सदृशः तव
बलाम् अतिबलाम् चैव पठतः तात राघव
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vā rāma na bhavet sadṛśaḥ tava
balām atibalām caiva paṭhataḥ tāta rāghava

sanskrit: न सौभाग्ये न दाक्षिण्ये न ज्ञाने बुद्धि निश्चये
न उत्तरे प्रति वक्तव्ये समो लोके तव अनघ
transliteration: na saubhāgye na dākṣiṇye na jñāne buddhi niścaye
na uttare prati vaktavye samo loke tava anagha

sanskrit: एतत् विद्या द्वये लब्धे न भवेत् सदृशः तव
बला च अतिबला चैव सर्व ज्ञानस्य मातरौ
transliteration: etat vidyā dvaye labdhe na bhavet sadṛśaḥ tava
balā ca atibalā caiva sarva jñānasya mātarau

sanskrit: क्षुत् पिपासे न ते राम भविष्येते नरोत्तम
बलाम् अतिबलाम् चैव पठतः तात राघव
transliteration: kṣut pipāse na te rāma bhaviṣyete narottama
balām atibalām caiva paṭhataḥ tāta rāghava
english: And, O Rāma, O foremost of men, if you recite Bala and Atibala on the way, neither hunger nor thirst will exercise you, O descendant of Raghu! And if you recite these, you will attain fame on earth. Those sciences fraught with energy are the daughters of the Grandsire.

sanskrit: गृहाण सर्व लोकस्य गुप्तये रघु नन्दन
विद्या द्वयम् अधीयाने यशः च अथ भवेत् भुवि
पितामह सुते हि एते विद्ये तेजः समन्विते
transliteration: gṛhāṇa sarva lokasya guptaye raghu nandana
vidyā dvayam adhīyāne yaśaḥ ca atha bhavet bhuvi
pitāmaha sute hi ete vidye tejaḥ samanvite
english: And, O Rāma, O foremost of men, if you recite Bala and Atibala on the way, neither hunger nor thirst will exercise you, O descendant of Raghu! And if you recite these, you will attain fame on earth. Those sciences fraught with energy are the daughters of the Grandsire.

sanskrit: प्रदातुम् तव काकुत्थ्स सदृअशः त्वम् हि पार्थिव
कामम् बहुगुणाः सर्वे त्वयि एते न अत्र संशयः
transliteration: pradātum tava kākutthsa sadṛaśaḥ tvam hi pārthiva
kāmam bahuguṇāḥ sarve tvayi ete na atra saṃśayaḥ
english: I intend to confer them upon you, O Kākutstha; and, O lord of earth, they are worthy to be conferred upon you; and they are possessed of various virtues. You need not entertain any doubt about it. And if you bear them in consonance with the precepts, they will prove of manifold good to you.

sanskrit: तपसा संभृते च एते बहु रूपे भविष्यतः
ततो रामो जलम् स्पृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्ट वदनः शुचिः
transliteration: tapasā saṃbhṛte ca ete bahu rūpe bhaviṣyataḥ
tato rāmo jalam spṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śuciḥ

sanskrit: प्रति जग्राह ते विद्ये महर्षेर् भावित आत्मनः
विद्या समुदितो रामः शुशुभे भीम विक्रमः
transliteration: prati jagrāha te vidye maharṣer bhāvita ātmanaḥ
vidyā samudito rāmaḥ śuśubhe bhīma vikramaḥ

sanskrit: गुरु कार्याणि सर्वाणि नियुज्य कुशिक आत्मजे
ऊषुः ताम् रजनीम् तत्र सरय्वाम् सुसुखम् त्रयः
transliteration: guru kāryāṇi sarvāṇi niyujya kuśika ātmaje
ūṣuḥ tām rajanīm tatra sarayvām susukham trayaḥ
english: Then Rāma having rendered to Kuśika's son all the duties pertaining to a spiritual guide, the three happily spent that night on the banks of the Sarayu.

sanskrit: दशरथ नृइप सूनु सत्तमाभ्याम्तृण शयने अनुचिते तदा उषिताभ्याम्
transliteration: daśaratha nṛipa sūnu sattamābhyāmtṛṇa śayane anucite tadā uṣitābhyām
english: And although those excellent of Dasaratha lay down on an unbeseeming bed of grass, yet in consequence of the sweet converse of Kusika's son, the night seemed to pass pleasantly away. sons

And when the night had passed away, the mighty ascetic spoke to Kākutstha, lying down on a bed of leaves, O Rāma, surely has Kausalyā given birth to an excellent son! The first Sandhyā* should now be performed. Do you, O tiger among men, arise! You should perform the purificatory rites and contemplate the gods. *Brāhmaṇas have to perform their daily devotions thrice,-in the morning, at noon, and in the evening.

sanskrit: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते
transliteration: kausalyā suprajā rāma pūrvā saṃdhyā pravartate
english: And when the night had passed away, the mighty ascetic spoke to Kākutstha, lying down on a bed of leaves, O Rāma, surely has Kausalyā given birth to an excellent son! The first Sandhyā* should now be performed. Do you, O tiger among men, arise! You should perform the purificatory rites and contemplate the gods. *Brāhmaṇas have to perform their daily devotions thrice,-in the morning, at noon, and in the evening.

sanskrit: तस्य ऋषेः परम उदारम् वचः श्रुत्वा नृप नरोत्तमौ
स्नात्वा कृत उदकौ वीरौ जेपतुः परमम् जपम्
transliteration: tasya ṛṣeḥ parama udāram vacaḥ śrutvā nṛpa narottamau
snātvā kṛta udakau vīrau jepatuḥ paramam japam
english: Hearing those proper words of the ascetic, those foremost of men, endowed with heroism, bathed, and, sipping water, began to recite the Gayatri. (The solar hymn of the Veda).
And having performed these daily duties, those exceedingly powerful ones, greeting Viśvāmitra having asceticism for wealth, stood before him, with the object of starting on their journey.

sanskrit: तौ प्रयान्तौ महावीर्यौ दिव्यम् त्रिपथगाम् नदीम्
ददृशा ते ततः तत्र सरय्वाः संगमे शुभे
transliteration: tau prayāntau mahāvīryau divyam tripathagām nadīm
dadṛśā te tataḥ tatra sarayvāḥ saṃgame śubhe
english: And as those ones endowed with exceeding prowess were proceeding, at the shining confluence of the Sarayū and the Gangā they bcheld a noble river flowing in three branches.

sanskrit: तत्र आश्रम पदम् पुण्यम् ऋषीणाम् भाविअत आत्मानाम्
बहु वर्ष सहस्राणि तप्यताम् परमम् तपः
transliteration: tatra āśrama padam puṇyam ṛṣīṇām bhāviata ātmānām
bahu varṣa sahasrāṇi tapyatām paramam tapaḥ
english: There lay a holy hermitage, belonging to ascetics of subdued souls, where they had been carrying on their high austerities for thousands of years.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा परम प्रीतौ राघवौ पुण्यम् आश्रमम्
ऊचतुः तम् महात्मानम् विश्वामित्रम् इदम् वचः
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā parama prītau rāghavau puṇyam āśramam
ūcatuḥ tam mahātmānam viśvāmitram idam vacaḥ
english: Beholding that sacred asylum those descendants of Raghu, exceedingly delighted, spoke to the high-souled Viśvāmitra, these words.

sanskrit: कस्य अयम् आश्रमः पुण्यः को नु अस्मिन् वसते पुमान्
भगवन् श्रोतुम् इच्छावः परम् कौतूहलम् हि नौ
transliteration: kasya ayam āśramaḥ puṇyaḥ ko nu asmin vasate pumān
bhagavan śrotum icchāvaḥ param kautūhalam hi nau
english: Whose is this sacred hemmilage? And what man lives here? O worshipfui one, we are desirous of hcasing this. Surciy, great is our curiosity.

sanskrit: तयोः तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुंगवः
अब्रवीत् श्रूयताम् राम यस्य अयम् पूर्व आश्रमः
transliteration: tayoḥ tad vacanam śrutvā prahasya munipuṃgavaḥ
abravīt śrūyatām rāma yasya ayam pūrva āśramaḥ
english: At those words of theirs, that foremost of ascetics, smiling, said, Hear, O Rama, as to whom the asylum has belonged in time past.

sanskrit: कन्दर्पो मूर्तिमान् आसीत् काम इति उच्यते बुधैः
transliteration: kandarpo mūrtimān āsīt kāma iti ucyate budhaiḥ
english: Kandarpa, called Käma by the wise, was once incarnate (on earth.) And it came to pass that as that lord of the deities, Sthāņu, having performed here his austerities in accordance with the prescribed restrictions, was wending his way in company with the Maruts, that fool-hardy wight dared disturb the equanimity of his mind.

sanskrit: कृत उद्वाहम् तु देवेशम् गच्छन्तम् स मरुद् गणम्
धर्षयामास दुर्मेधा हुम् कृतः च महात्मना
transliteration: kṛta udvāham tu deveśam gacchantam sa marud gaṇam
dharṣayāmāsa durmedhā hum kṛtaḥ ca mahātmanā
english: Kandarpa, called Käma by the wise, was once incarnate (on earth.) And it came to pass that as that lord of the deities, Sthāņu, having performed here his austerities in accordance with the prescribed restrictions, was wending his way in company with the Maruts, that fool-hardy wight dared disturb the equanimity of his mind.

sanskrit: अवध्यतः च रुद्रेण चक्षुषा रघु नन्दन
व्यशीर्यन्त शरीरात् स्वात् सर्व गात्राणि दुर्मतेः
transliteration: avadhyataḥ ca rudreṇa cakṣuṣā raghu nandana
vyaśīryanta śarīrāt svāt sarva gātrāṇi durmateḥ
english: Thereupon, O descendant of Raghu, uttering a roar, the high-souled Rudra eyed him steadfastly. And thereat all the limbs of that perverse-hearted one became blasted.

sanskrit: तत्र गात्रम् हतम् तस्य निर्दग्धस्य महात्मनः
अशरीरः कृतः कामः क्रोधात् देव ईश्वरेण ह
transliteration: tatra gātram hatam tasya nirdagdhasya mahātmanaḥ
aśarīraḥ kṛtaḥ kāmaḥ krodhāt deva īśvareṇa ha
english: And on his body being consumed by that high-souled one, Kāma was deprived of his person in consequence of the ire of that foremost among the deities.

sanskrit: अनङ्ग इति विख्यातः तदा प्रभृति राघव
स च अङ्ग विषयः श्रीमान् यत्र अंगम् स मुमोच ह
transliteration: anaṅga iti vikhyātaḥ tadā prabhṛti rāghava
sa ca aṅga viṣayaḥ śrīmān yatra aṃgam sa mumoca ha
english: O Rāghava, from that time forth, he has become known as Ananga. And the place where he was deprived of his body is the lovely land of Anga.

sanskrit: तस्य अयम् आश्रमः पुण्यः तस्य इमे मुनयः पुरा
शिष्या धर्मपरा वीर तेषाम् पापम् न विद्यते
transliteration: tasya ayam āśramaḥ puṇyaḥ tasya ime munayaḥ purā
śiṣyā dharmaparā vīra teṣām pāpam na vidyate
english: This sacred hermitage belongs to Śiva; and these ascetics engaged in pious acts, O hero, have been from father to son his disciples. And no sin touch them.

sanskrit: इह अद्य रजनीम् राम वसेम शुभ दर्शन
पुण्ययोः सरितोः मध्ये श्वः तरिष्यामहे वयम्
transliteration: iha adya rajanīm rāma vasema śubha darśana
puṇyayoḥ saritoḥ madhye śvaḥ tariṣyāmahe vayam
english: Here, O Rāma, in the midst of the sacred streams, will we spend the night, O you of gracious presence, crossing over on the morrow.

sanskrit: इह वासः परोऽस्माकम् सुखम् वस्त्यामहे वयम्
transliteration: iha vāsaḥ paro'smākam sukham vastyāmahe vayam
english: Let us then, having purified ourselves, enter the holy hermitage! It is highly desirable for us to sojourn here, here will we happily spend the night, having bathed, and recited the mantras, and offered oblations to the sacrificial fire, O best of men.

sanskrit: स्नाताः च कृत जप्याः च हुत हव्या नरोत्तम
तेषाम् संवदताम् तत्र तपो दीर्घेण चक्षुषा
transliteration: snātāḥ ca kṛta japyāḥ ca huta havyā narottama
teṣām saṃvadatām tatra tapo dīrgheṇa cakṣuṣā

sanskrit: विज्ञाय परम प्रीता मुनयो हर्षम् आगमन्
अर्घ्यम् पाद्यम् तथा आतिथ्यम् निवेद्य कुशिकात्मजे
transliteration: vijñāya parama prītā munayo harṣam āgaman
arghyam pādyam tathā ātithyam nivedya kuśikātmaje

sanskrit: राम लक्ष्मणयोः पश्चात् अकुर्वन् अतिथि क्रियाम्
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ paścāt akurvan atithi kriyām

sanskrit: यथा अर्हम् अजपन् संध्याम् ऋषयः ते समाहिताः
तत्र वासिभिः आनीता मुनिभिः सुव्रतैः सह
transliteration: yathā arham ajapan saṃdhyām ṛṣayaḥ te samāhitāḥ
tatra vāsibhiḥ ānītā munibhiḥ suvrataiḥ saha

sanskrit: न्यवसन् सुसुखम् तत्र काम आश्रम पदे तथा
यद्वा -कथाभिः अभि रामभिः अभि रमौ नृप आत्मजौरमयामास धर्मात्मा कौशिको मुनिपुङ्गवः
transliteration: nyavasan susukham tatra kāma āśrama pade tathā
yadvā -kathābhiḥ abhi rāmabhiḥ abhi ramau nṛpa ātmajauramayāmāsa dharmātmā kauśiko munipuṅgavaḥ
english: And that foremost of ascetics, the righteoussouled son of Kuśika, by means of his excellent converse, charmed the prepossessing sons of the monarch.

sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते विमले कृत आह्निकम् अरिन्दमौ
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛta āhnikam arindamau
english: Then next morning which happened to be fine, those repressors of their foes, with Viśvāmitra at their head, came to the banks of the river.* Ganga. The legend is that when the saint Agastya had sucked up the ocean, the Ganges replenished it.

sanskrit: ते च सर्वे महात्मानो मुनयः संश्रित व्रताः
उपस्थाप्य शुभाम् नावम् विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रुवन्
transliteration: te ca sarve mahātmāno munayaḥ saṃśrita vratāḥ
upasthāpya śubhām nāvam viśvāmitram atha abruvan
english: And those high-souled ascetics observing vows, having brought an elegant bark, addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

sanskrit: अरिष्टम् गच्छ पन्थानम् मा भूत् काल विपर्ययः
transliteration: ariṣṭam gaccha panthānam mā bhūt kāla viparyayaḥ
english: Do you ascend the bark, with the princes at your head! May your journey be auspicious: let no delay occur

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रः तथा इति उक्त्वा तान् ऋषीन् प्रतिपूज्य च
ततार सहितः ताभ्याम् सरितम् सागरम् गमाम्
transliteration: viśvāmitraḥ tathā iti uktvā tān ṛṣīn pratipūjya ca
tatāra sahitaḥ tābhyām saritam sāgaram gamām
english: Thereupon saying, So be it! and having paid homage to those ascetics, Viśvāmitra set about crossing that river, which had replenished the ocean.

sanskrit: तत्र शुश्राव वै शब्दम् तोय संरम्भ वर्धितम्
मध्यम् आगम्य तोयस्य तस्य शब्दस्य निश्चयम्
transliteration: tatra śuśrāva vai śabdam toya saṃrambha vardhitam
madhyam āgamya toyasya tasya śabdasya niścayam
english: It came to pass that while thus engaged, they heard a sound augmented by the dashing of the waves. And having come to the middle of the stream, the highly energetic Rāma with his younger brother, became curious to ascertain the cause of that sound.

sanskrit: ज्ञातु कामो महातेजा सह रामः कनीयसा
अथ रामः सरिन् मध्ये पप्रच्छ मुनि पुङ्गवम्
transliteration: jñātu kāmo mahātejā saha rāmaḥ kanīyasā
atha rāmaḥ sarin madhye papraccha muni puṅgavam

sanskrit: वारिणो भिद्यमानस्य किम् अयम् तुमुलो ध्वनिः
transliteration: vāriṇo bhidyamānasya kim ayam tumulo dhvaniḥ

sanskrit: कैलास पर्वते राम मनसा निर्मितम् परम्
transliteration: kailāsa parvate rāma manasā nirmitam param

sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा नरशार्दूल तेन इदम् मानसम् सरः
तस्मात् सुस्राव सरसः सा अयोध्याम् उपगूहते
transliteration: brahmaṇā naraśārdūla tena idam mānasam saraḥ
tasmāt susrāva sarasaḥ sā ayodhyām upagūhate

sanskrit: सरः प्रवृत्ता सरयूः पुण्या ब्रह्म सरः च्युता
तस्य अयम् अतुलः शब्दो जाह्नवीम् अभिवर्तते
transliteration: saraḥ pravṛttā sarayūḥ puṇyā brahma saraḥ cyutā
tasya ayam atulaḥ śabdo jāhnavīm abhivartate

sanskrit: वारि संक्षोभजो राम प्रणामम् नियतः कुरु
ताभ्याम् तु तावुभौ कृत्वा प्रणामम् अतिधार्मिकौ
transliteration: vāri saṃkṣobhajo rāma praṇāmam niyataḥ kuru
tābhyām tu tāvubhau kṛtvā praṇāmam atidhārmikau

sanskrit: तीरम् दक्षिणम् आसाद्य जग्मतुर् लघु विक्रमौ
स वनम् घोर संकाशम् दृष्ट्वा नरवरात्मजः
transliteration: tīram dakṣiṇam āsādya jagmatur laghu vikramau
sa vanam ghora saṃkāśam dṛṣṭvā naravarātmajaḥ

sanskrit: अहो वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् झिल्लिका गण संयुतम्
transliteration: aho vanam idam durgam jhillikā gaṇa saṃyutam

sanskrit: भैरवैः श्वापदैः कीर्णम् शकुनैः दारुण आरवैः
नाना प्रकारैः शकुनैः वाश्यद्भिः भैरव स्वनैः
transliteration: bhairavaiḥ śvāpadaiḥ kīrṇam śakunaiḥ dāruṇa āravaiḥ
nānā prakāraiḥ śakunaiḥ vāśyadbhiḥ bhairava svanaiḥ

sanskrit: सिंह व्याघ्र वराहैः च वारणैः च अपि शोभितम्
धव अश्वकर्ण ककुभैः बिल्व तिन्दुक पाटलैः
transliteration: siṃha vyāghra varāhaiḥ ca vāraṇaiḥ ca api śobhitam
dhava aśvakarṇa kakubhaiḥ bilva tinduka pāṭalaiḥ

sanskrit: संकीर्णम् बदरीभिः च किम् नु एतत् दारुणम् वनम्
transliteration: saṃkīrṇam badarībhiḥ ca kim nu etat dāruṇam vanam

sanskrit: श्रूयताम् वत्स काकुत्स्थ यस्य एतत् दारुणम् वनम्
एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ पूर्वम् आस्ताम् नरोउत्तम
transliteration: śrūyatām vatsa kākutstha yasya etat dāruṇam vanam
etau janapadau sphītau pūrvam āstām narouttama

sanskrit: मलदाः च करूषाः च देव निर्माण निर्मितौ
पुरा वृत्र वधे राम मलेन समभिप्लुतम्
transliteration: maladāḥ ca karūṣāḥ ca deva nirmāṇa nirmitau
purā vṛtra vadhe rāma malena samabhiplutam

sanskrit: क्षुधा चैव सहस्राक्षम् ब्रह्म हत्या सम् आविशत्
तम् इन्द्रम् मलिनम् देवा ऋषयः च तपोधनाः
transliteration: kṣudhā caiva sahasrākṣam brahma hatyā sam āviśat
tam indram malinam devā ṛṣayaḥ ca tapodhanāḥ

sanskrit: कलशैः स्नापयामासुः मलम् च अस्य प्रमोचयन्
इह भूम्याम् मलम् दत्त्वा देवाः कारुषम् एव च
transliteration: kalaśaiḥ snāpayāmāsuḥ malam ca asya pramocayan
iha bhūmyām malam dattvā devāḥ kāruṣam eva ca

sanskrit: निर्मलो निष्करूषः च शुद्ध इन्द्रो यथा अभवत्
transliteration: nirmalo niṣkarūṣaḥ ca śuddha indro yathā abhavat

sanskrit: ततो देशस्य सुप्रीतो वरम् प्रादाद् अनुत्तमम्
इमौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ ख्यातिम् लोके गमिष्यतः
transliteration: tato deśasya suprīto varam prādād anuttamam
imau janapadau sphītau khyātim loke gamiṣyataḥ
english: And thereat Indra becoming purified, attained his former brightness, and looked like to gold. And mightily pleased with this region, he conferred on it an excellent boon, saying, Since these two places have held excreta from my body, the going by the names of Maladā and Kārūsa, shall attain exceeding prosperity and fame among men.

sanskrit: मलदाः च करूषाः च मम अंग मल धारिणौ
साधु साधु इति तम् देवाः पाकशासनम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: maladāḥ ca karūṣāḥ ca mama aṃga mala dhāriṇau
sādhu sādhu iti tam devāḥ pākaśāsanam abruvan

sanskrit: देशस्य पूजाम् ताम् दृष्ट्वा कृताम् शक्रेण धीमता
एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ दीर्घ कालम् अरिन्दम
transliteration: deśasya pūjām tām dṛṣṭvā kṛtām śakreṇa dhīmatā
etau janapadau sphītau dīrgha kālam arindama

sanskrit: मलदाः च करूषाः च मुदिता धन धान्यतः
कस्य चित् अथ कालस्य यक्षी काम रूपिणी
transliteration: maladāḥ ca karūṣāḥ ca muditā dhana dhānyataḥ
kasya cit atha kālasya yakṣī kāma rūpiṇī

sanskrit: बलम् नाग सहस्रस्य धारयन्ती तदा हि आभूत्
ताटका नाम भद्रम् ते भार्या सुन्दस्य धीमतः
transliteration: balam nāga sahasrasya dhārayantī tadā hi ābhūt
tāṭakā nāma bhadram te bhāryā sundasya dhīmataḥ

sanskrit: मारीचो राक्षसः पुत्रो यस्याः शक्र पराक्रमः
वृत्त बाहुर् महा शीर्षो विपुला अस्य तनुर् महान्
transliteration: mārīco rākṣasaḥ putro yasyāḥ śakra parākramaḥ
vṛtta bāhur mahā śīrṣo vipulā asya tanur mahān
english: Her name, good betide you! was Tātakā, and she was the spouse of the intelligent Sundashe whose son is the Rākşasa, Mārīca, possessed of the prowess of Sacra; having round arms, with a huge head, a capacious mouth and a cyclopean body.

sanskrit: राक्षसो भैरव आकारो नित्यम् त्रासयते प्रजाः
transliteration: rākṣaso bhairava ākāro nityam trāsayate prajāḥ
english: And that Rākṣasa of dreadful form daily frightens people. And, O descendant of Raghu, Tātakā of wicked deeds, daily commits havoc upon these countries, Maladã and Karuşă.

sanskrit: सा इयम् पन्थानम् आवृत्य वसति अध्यर्ध योजने
transliteration: sā iyam panthānam āvṛtya vasati adhyardha yojane

sanskrit: अत एव च गन्तव्यम् ताटकाया वनम् यतः
स्व बाहु बलम् आश्रित्य जहि इमाम् दुष्ट चारिणीम्
transliteration: ata eva ca gantavyam tāṭakāyā vanam yataḥ
sva bāhu balam āśritya jahi imām duṣṭa cāriṇīm
english: And now at the distance of over half a Yojana, she stays, obstructing the way. And since this forest belong to Tāțakā, you should repair there; and, resorting to the might of your own arms, slay this one of wicked deeds.

sanskrit: मत् नियोगात् इमम् देशम् कुरु निष्कण्टकम् पुनः
न हि कश्चित् इमम् देशम् शक्तो हि आगन्तुम् ईदृशम्
transliteration: mat niyogāt imam deśam kuru niṣkaṇṭakam punaḥ
na hi kaścit imam deśam śakto hi āgantum īdṛśam
english: And, by my direction, do you again rid this region of its thorn; for no one dare to approach such a place, infested,

sanskrit: एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् यथा एतत् दारुणम् वनम्
यक्ष्या च उत्सादितम् सर्वम् अद्य अपि न निवर्तते
transliteration: etat te sarvam ākhyātam yathā etat dāruṇam vanam
yakṣyā ca utsāditam sarvam adya api na nivartate
english: O Rāma, by the dreadful and unbearable Yakşiņi. And now I have related to you all about this fearful forest. And to this day none is capable of letting that Yakşiņi from committing ravages right an left.

sanskrit: अथ तस्य अप्रमेयस्य मुनेर् वचनम् उत्तमम्
श्रुत्वा पुरुष शार्दूलः प्रत्युवाच शुभाम् गिरम्
transliteration: atha tasya aprameyasya muner vacanam uttamam
śrutvā puruṣa śārdūlaḥ pratyuvāca śubhām giram
english: Hearing this excellent speech of that ascetic of immeasurable energy, that foremost of men answered him in these happy words,

sanskrit: अल्प वीर्या यदा यक्षी श्रूयते मुनिपुङ्गव
कथम् नाग सहस्रस्य धारयति अबला बलम्
transliteration: alpa vīryā yadā yakṣī śrūyate munipuṅgava
katham nāga sahasrasya dhārayati abalā balam
english: O best of ascetics, I have heard that the Yakşa race is endowed with but small prowess. How can then that one of the weaker sex possess the strength of a thousand elephants?

sanskrit: इति उक्त,म् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राघवस्य अमित ओजसा
हर्षयन् श्लक्ष्णया वचा स लक्ष्मणम् अरिन्दमम्
transliteration: iti ukta,m vacanam śrutvā rāghavasya amita ojasā
harṣayan ślakṣṇayā vacā sa lakṣmaṇam arindamam
english: Hearing this speech that was uttered by Rāghava of immeasurable energy, Viśvāmitra, delighting with his amiable words that subduer of foes, Rāma, and Laksmana, said, Do you listen as to the means whereby attaining terrible strength, that one belonging to the weaker sex has come to possess strength and prowess by virtue of a boon.

sanskrit: वर दान कृतम् वीर्यम् धारयति अबला बलम्
transliteration: vara dāna kṛtam vīryam dhārayati abalā balam
english: Hearing this speech that was uttered by Rāghava of immeasurable energy, Viśvāmitra, delighting with his amiable words that subduer of foes, Rāma, and Laksmana, said, Do you listen as to the means whereby attaining terrible strength, that one belonging to the weaker sex has come to possess strength and prowess by virtue of a boon.

sanskrit: पूर्वम् आसीत् महा यक्षः सुकेतुर् नाम वीर्यवान्
अनपत्यः शुभाचारः स च तेपे महत् तपः
transliteration: pūrvam āsīt mahā yakṣaḥ suketur nāma vīryavān
anapatyaḥ śubhācāraḥ sa ca tepe mahat tapaḥ
english: In former times there was a mighty and exceedingly powerful Yaksa, named Suketu. And he had no issue. And he was of pure practices, and used to perform rigid austerities.

sanskrit: पितामहः तु सुप्रीतः तस्य यक्षपतेः तदा
कन्या रत्नम् ददौ राम ताटकाम् नाम नामतः
transliteration: pitāmahaḥ tu suprītaḥ tasya yakṣapateḥ tadā
kanyā ratnam dadau rāma tāṭakām nāma nāmataḥ
english: And, O Rāma, the Grand-sire endowed her with that lord of Yakşas, conferred upon him a gem of a daughter, by name Tāțakā.

sanskrit: ददौ नाग सहस्रस्य बलम् च अस्याः पितामहः
न तु एव पुत्रम् यक्षाय ददौ च असौ महायशाः
transliteration: dadau nāga sahasrasya balam ca asyāḥ pitāmahaḥ
na tu eva putram yakṣāya dadau ca asau mahāyaśāḥ
english: And the Grand-sire endowed her with the strength of a thousand elephants; yet that illustrious one did not bestow a son on that Yaksa.

sanskrit: ताम् तु बालाम् विवर्धन्तीम् रूप यौवन शालिनीम्
जंभ पुत्राय सुन्दाय ददौ भार्याम् यशस्विनीम्
transliteration: tām tu bālām vivardhantīm rūpa yauvana śālinīm
jaṃbha putrāya sundāya dadau bhāryām yaśasvinīm
english: When she had grown, and attained youth and beauty, he gave that famous damsel to Jambha's son, Sunda, for wife.

sanskrit: कस्यचित् तु अथ कालस्य यक्षी पुत्रम् व्यजायत
मारीचम् नाम दुर्धर्षम् यः शापात् राक्षसोऽभवत्
transliteration: kasyacit tu atha kālasya yakṣī putram vyajāyata
mārīcam nāma durdharṣam yaḥ śāpāt rākṣaso'bhavat
english: After a length of time, that Yakṣī gave birth to a son, named Mārīca, possessed of irrepressible energy, him who became a Rākṣasa in consequence of a curse.

sanskrit: सुन्दे तु निहते राम सा अगस्त्यम् ऋषि सत्तमम्
transliteration: sunde tu nihate rāma sā agastyam ṛṣi sattamam
english: O Rāma, when Sunda had been destroyed, Tat akā along with her son, set her heart upon afflicting that excellent saint Agastya.

sanskrit: भक्षार्थम् जात संरम्भा गर्जन्ती सा अभ्यधावत
आपतन्तीम् तु ताम् दृष्ट्वा अगस्त्यो भगवान् ऋषिः
transliteration: bhakṣārtham jāta saṃrambhā garjantī sā abhyadhāvata
āpatantīm tu tām dṛṣṭvā agastyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
english: And enraged with Agastya, she rushed at him with a roar, intending to devour him. And on seeing her thus rushing, that worshipful saint, Agastya, said to Mārīca, Do you become a Raksasa! .

sanskrit: राक्षसत्वम् भजस्व इति मारीचम् व्याजहार सः
अगस्त्यः परम अमर्षः ताटकाम् अपि शप्तवान्
transliteration: rākṣasatvam bhajasva iti mārīcam vyājahāra saḥ
agastyaḥ parama amarṣaḥ tāṭakām api śaptavān

sanskrit: इदम् रूपम् विहायाशु दारुणम् रूपम् अस्तु ते
transliteration: idam rūpam vihāyāśu dāruṇam rūpam astu te
english: And, in exceeding wrath, he also cursed Tataka. And, O mighty Yaksi, since in frightful guise with a frightful face you have desired to eat up a human being, do you immediately leave this (your original) shape, and become of a terrible form!

sanskrit: सैषा शाप कृताम् अर्षा ताटका क्रोध मूर्छिता
देशम् उत्सादयति एनम् अगस्त्या चरितम् शुभम्
transliteration: saiṣā śāpa kṛtām arṣā tāṭakā krodha mūrchitā
deśam utsādayati enam agastyā caritam śubham
english: Thus cursed by Agastya, Tățakā, overwhelmed with rage, lays waste this fair region, where Agastya carry on his austerities.

sanskrit: एनाम् राघव दुर्वृत्ताम् यक्षीम् परम दारुणाम्
गो ब्राह्मण हितार्थाय जहि दुष्ट पराक्रमाम्
transliteration: enām rāghava durvṛttām yakṣīm parama dāruṇām
go brāhmaṇa hitārthāya jahi duṣṭa parākramām
english: Do you, O descendant of Raghu, for the welfare of Brāhmaṇas and kine, slay this exceedingly terrible Yakṣī of wicked ways and vile prowess!

sanskrit: न हि एनाम् शाप संसृष्टाम् कश्चित् उत्सहते पुमान्
निहन्तुम् त्रिषु लोकेषु त्वाम् ऋते रघु नन्दन
transliteration: na hi enām śāpa saṃsṛṣṭām kaścit utsahate pumān
nihantum triṣu lokeṣu tvām ṛte raghu nandana
english: Nor, O son of Raghu, does any one in the three worlds, save, you, dare to slay this Yaksi joined with a curse.

sanskrit: न हि ते स्त्री वध कृते घृणा कार्या नरोत्तम
चातुर् वर्ण्य हितार्थाम् हि कर्तव्यम् राज सूनुना
transliteration: na hi te strī vadha kṛte ghṛṇā kāryā narottama
cātur varṇya hitārthām hi kartavyam rāja sūnunā
english: Nor should you, O best of men, shrink from slaying a woman; for even this should be accomplished by a prince in the interests of the four orders.

sanskrit: नृशंसम् अनृशंसम् वा प्रजा रक्षण कारणात्
पातकम् वा सदोषम् वा कर्तव्यम् रक्षता सदा
transliteration: nṛśaṃsam anṛśaṃsam vā prajā rakṣaṇa kāraṇāt
pātakam vā sadoṣam vā kartavyam rakṣatā sadā
english: Whether an act be cruel or otherwise, slightly or highly sinful, it should for protecting the subjects, be performed by a ruler.

sanskrit: राज्य भार नियुक्तानाम् एष धर्मः सनातनः
अधर्म्याम् जहि काकुत्स्थ धर्मो हि अस्याम् न विद्यते
transliteration: rājya bhāra niyuktānām eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
adharmyām jahi kākutstha dharmo hi asyām na vidyate
english: Of those engaged in the onerous task of government, even this is the eternal rule of conduct. Do you, O Kākutstha, slay this impious one; for she know no righteousness!

sanskrit: श्रूयते हि पुरा शक्रो विरोचन सुताम् नृप
transliteration: śrūyate hi purā śakro virocana sutām nṛpa
english: We hear, O king, that in days of yore, ſakra slew Virocana's daughter, Mantharā, who had intended to destroy the earth.

sanskrit: विष्णुना च पुरा राम भृगु पत्नी पतिव्रता
transliteration: viṣṇunā ca purā rāma bhṛgu patnī pativratā
english: And formerly, O Rama, Visnu destroyed Kāvya's mother, the devoted wife of Bhrgu, who had set her heart upon annihilating the world, deprived of sleep (through fear of her.)

sanskrit: एतैः च अन्यैः च बहुभी राजपुत्रैः महात्मभिः
तस्माद् एनाम् घृणाम् त्यक्त्वा जहि मत् शासनान् नृप
transliteration: etaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca bahubhī rājaputraiḥ mahātmabhiḥ
tasmād enām ghṛṇām tyaktvā jahi mat śāsanān nṛpa
english: By these as well as innumerable princesforemost of men have wicked women been slain. Therefore, O king, renouncing antipathy, do you, by my command, slay this one!
Hearing those bold words of the ascetic, the son of that foremost of men, Rāghava firm in his vows, with clasped hands answered.

sanskrit: पितुर् वचन निर्देशात् पितुर् वचन गौरवात्
transliteration: pitur vacana nirdeśāt pitur vacana gauravāt
english: In accordance with the desire of my sire, and in order to glorify it, I ought fearlessly to do even as Kusika's son says. And having been desired to that end while at Ayodhyā by that high-souled one, my father Dasaratha, in the midst of the spiritual guides, I ought not to pass by your words.

sanskrit: अनुशिष्टो अस्मि अयोध्यायाम् गुरु मध्ये महात्मना
पित्रा दशरथेन अहम् न अवज्ञेयम् च तद् वचः
transliteration: anuśiṣṭo asmi ayodhyāyām guru madhye mahātmanā
pitrā daśarathena aham na avajñeyam ca tad vacaḥ
english: In accordance with the desire of my sire, and in order to glorify it, I ought fearlessly to do even as Kusika's son says. And having been desired to that end while at Ayodhyā by that high-souled one, my father Dasaratha, in the midst of the spiritual guides, I ought not to pass by your words.

sanskrit: सोऽहम् पितुर्वचः श्रुत्वा शासनाद् ब्रह्म वादिनः
करिष्यामि न संदेहः ताटका वधम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: so'ham piturvacaḥ śrutvā śāsanād brahma vādinaḥ
kariṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ tāṭakā vadham uttamam
english: Therefore, commanded by that upholder of the Veda, I, agreeably to my father's mandate, will, without doubt, bring about that welcome event-the death of Tataka.

sanskrit: गो ब्राह्मण हितार्थाय देशस्य च हिताय च
तव चैव अप्रमेयस्य वचनम् कर्तुम् उद्यतः
transliteration: go brāhmaṇa hitārthāya deśasya ca hitāya ca
tava caiva aprameyasya vacanam kartum udyataḥ
english: And in the interests of Brāhmaṇas, kine, and celestials, I am ready to act as desired by you of immeasurable energy.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा धनुर्मध्ये बध्वा मुष्टिम् अरिन्दमः
ज्या घोषम् अकरोत् तीव्रम् दिशः शब्देन नादयन्
transliteration: evam uktvā dhanurmadhye badhvā muṣṭim arindamaḥ
jyā ghoṣam akarot tīvram diśaḥ śabdena nādayan
english: Having said this, that repressor of foes, with clenched fist, twanged his bow-string, filling the ten cardinal points with the sounds. And at those sounds, the dwellers in Tāțakā's forest were filled with perturbation, and Tātakā also amazed at those sounds, became exceedingly wroth.

sanskrit: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः ताटका वन वासिनः
ताटका च सुसंक्रुद्धा तेन शब्देन मोहिता
transliteration: tena śabdena vitrastāḥ tāṭakā vana vāsinaḥ
tāṭakā ca susaṃkruddhā tena śabdena mohitā
english: Having said this, that repressor of foes, with clenched fist, twanged his bow-string, filling the ten cardinal points with the sounds. And at those sounds, the dwellers in Tāțakā's forest were filled with perturbation, and Tātakā also amazed at those sounds, became exceedingly wroth.

sanskrit: तम् शब्दम् अभिनिध्याय राक्षसी क्रोध मूर्चिता
श्रुत्वा च अभ्यद्रवत् क्रुद्धा यत्र शब्दो विनिस्सृतः
transliteration: tam śabdam abhinidhyāya rākṣasī krodha mūrcitā
śrutvā ca abhyadravat kruddhā yatra śabdo vinissṛtaḥ
english: And rendered almost insensible by anger, that Räksasī furiously rushed in a main towards the spot whence had come the report.

sanskrit: ताम् दृष्ट्वा राघवः क्रुद्धाम् विकृताम् विकृत आननाम्
प्रमाणेन अति वृद्धाम् च लक्ष्मणम् सोऽभ्यभाषत
transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ kruddhām vikṛtām vikṛta ānanām
pramāṇena ati vṛddhām ca lakṣmaṇam so'bhyabhāṣata
english: And beholding that frightful one of hideous visage and colossal proportions, transported with rage, Raghu's descendant spoke to Laksmana,9

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण यक्षिण्या भैरवम् दारुणम् वपुः
भिद्येरन् दर्शनात् अस्या भीरूणाम् हृदयानि च
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa yakṣiṇyā bhairavam dāruṇam vapuḥ
bhidyeran darśanāt asyā bhīrūṇām hṛdayāni ca
english: Behold, O Laksmana, the terrible and hideous body of yonder Yakṣiṇī! The sight of her strike terror into the hearts of even the brave.

sanskrit: एताम् पश्य दुराधर्षाम् माया बल समन्विताम्
विनिवृत्ताम् करोमि अद्य हृत कर्णाग्र नासिकाम्
transliteration: etām paśya durādharṣām māyā bala samanvitām
vinivṛttām karomi adya hṛta karṇāgra nāsikām
english: Mark! This irrepressible one, possessing all the resources of illusion, will I oppose, and deprive her of ears and nose.

sanskrit: न हि एनाम् उत्सहे हन्तुम् स्त्री स्वभावेन रक्षिताम्
वीर्यम् च अस्या गतिम् च एव हन्यताम् इति मे मतिः
transliteration: na hi enām utsahe hantum strī svabhāvena rakṣitām
vīryam ca asyā gatim ca eva hanyatām iti me matiḥ
english: But I dare not slay her, she being protected by virtue of her feminineness. I intend only to oppose her course, and deprive her of her prowess.

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवाणे रामे तु ताटका क्रोध मूर्छिता
उद्यम्य बाहूम् गर्जन्ती रामम् एव अभ्यधावत
transliteration: evam bruvāṇe rāme tu tāṭakā krodha mūrchitā
udyamya bāhūm garjantī rāmam eva abhyadhāvata
english: As Rāma was speaking thus, Tāțakā, deprived of sense through ire, uttering roars, with uplifted arms rushed against him.

sanskrit: स्वस्ति राघवयोः अस्तु जयम् च एव अभ्यभाषत
transliteration: svasti rāghavayoḥ astu jayam ca eva abhyabhāṣata
english: And thereat the Brahmarsi, Visvāmitra, uttering a roar, upbraided her, and said, Svasti!* May victory attend the descendants of Raghu! *A particle of benediction, indeclinable.

sanskrit: उद् धुन्वाना रजो घोरम् ताटका राघवौ उभौ
रजो मेघेन महता मुहूर्तम् सा व्यमोहयत्
transliteration: ud dhunvānā rajo ghoram tāṭakā rāghavau ubhau
rajo meghena mahatā muhūrtam sā vyamohayat
english: And raising thick clouds of dust, Tāțakā instantly bewildered both the descendants of Raghu.

sanskrit: ततो मायाम् समास्थाय शिला वर्षेण राघवौ
transliteration: tato māyām samāsthāya śilā varṣeṇa rāghavau
english: And then by help of illusion, she began to pour upon them a mighty shower of crags. And thereat Raghu's descendant was wroth.

sanskrit: शिला वर्षम् महत् तस्याः शर वर्षेण राघवः
transliteration: śilā varṣam mahat tasyāḥ śara varṣeṇa rāghavaḥ
english: And resisting that mighty shower of crags by vollies of shafts, Rāghava with arrows cut off her hands.

sanskrit: ततः च्छिन्न भुजाम् श्रान्ताम् अभ्याशे परिगर्जतीम्
सौमित्रिः अकरोत् क्रोधात् हृत कर्णाग्र नासिकाम्
transliteration: tataḥ cchinna bhujām śrāntām abhyāśe parigarjatīm
saumitriḥ akarot krodhāt hṛta karṇāgra nāsikām
english: And with the fore-parts of her arms lopped off, as she was roaring before them, Sumitra's son waxing wroth deprived her of her ears and nose.

sanskrit: काम रूपधरा सा तु कृत्वा रूपाणि अनेकशः
अन्तर्धानम् गता यक्षी मोहयन्ति स्व मायया
transliteration: kāma rūpadharā sā tu kṛtvā rūpāṇi anekaśaḥ
antardhānam gatā yakṣī mohayanti sva māyayā
english: Thereupon that one capable of assuming forms at will, began to assume various shapes; and to vanish from sight, bewildering her antagonists with her illusory displays.

sanskrit: अश्म वर्षम् विमुंचन्ती भैरवम् विचचार सा
ततः तौ अश्म वर्षेण कीर्यमाणौ समन्ततः
transliteration: aśma varṣam vimuṃcantī bhairavam vicacāra sā
tataḥ tau aśma varṣeṇa kīryamāṇau samantataḥ

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा गाधि सुतः श्रीईमान् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
अलम् ते घृणया राम पापा एषा दुष्ट चारिणी
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā gādhi sutaḥ śrīīmān idam vacanam abravīt
alam te ghṛṇayā rāma pāpā eṣā duṣṭa cāriṇī

sanskrit: यज्ञ विघ्न करी यक्षी पुरा वर्धेत मायया
वध्यताम् तावत् एव एषा पुरा संध्या प्रवर्तते
transliteration: yajña vighna karī yakṣī purā vardheta māyayā
vadhyatām tāvat eva eṣā purā saṃdhyā pravartate

sanskrit: रक्षांसि संध्या काले तु दुर्धर्षाणि भवन्ति हि
इति उक्तः स तु ताम् यक्षीम् अश्म वृष्ट्या अभिवर्षणीम्
transliteration: rakṣāṃsi saṃdhyā kāle tu durdharṣāṇi bhavanti hi
iti uktaḥ sa tu tām yakṣīm aśma vṛṣṭyā abhivarṣaṇīm

sanskrit: दर्शयन् शब्द वेधित्वम् ताम् रुरोध स सायकैः
सा रुद्धा बाण जालेन माया बल समन्विता
transliteration: darśayan śabda vedhitvam tām rurodha sa sāyakaiḥ
sā ruddhā bāṇa jālena māyā bala samanvitā

sanskrit: अभि दुद्राव काकुत्स्थम् लक्षमणम् च विनेषुदी
ताम् आपतन्तीम् वेगेन विक्रान्ताम् अशनीम् इव
transliteration: abhi dudrāva kākutstham lakṣamaṇam ca vineṣudī
tām āpatantīm vegena vikrāntām aśanīm iva
english: Being thus hemmed in with a network of shafts, she possessed of the powers of illusion, rushed against Kākutstha and Lakşmaņa, uttering terrible roars. And as that Yaksi, in prowess like to a thunder-bolt, was rushing on, Rāma pierced her chest with arrows, and thereat she dropped down and died.

sanskrit: शरेण उरसि विव्याध सा पपात ममार च
ताम् हताम् भीम संकाशाम् दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिः तदा
transliteration: śareṇa urasi vivyādha sā papāta mamāra ca
tām hatām bhīma saṃkāśām dṛṣṭvā surapatiḥ tadā

sanskrit: साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थम् सुराः च अपि अभिपूजयन्
transliteration: sādhu sādhviti kākutstham surāḥ ca api abhipūjayan

sanskrit: सुराः च सर्वे संहृष्टा विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रुवन्
मुने कौशिक भद्रम् ते सह इन्द्राः सर्वे मरुद् गणाः
transliteration: surāḥ ca sarve saṃhṛṣṭā viśvāmitram atha abruvan
mune kauśika bhadram te saha indrāḥ sarve marud gaṇāḥ

sanskrit: तोषिताः कर्मणा अनेन स्नेहम् दर्शय राघवे
transliteration: toṣitāḥ karmaṇā anena sneham darśaya rāghave
english: O ascetic, O Kusika's son, good betide you! all the Maruts with Indra at their head, have been gratified with this act (of Rāma's). Do you, O Brāhmaṇa, confer upon Raghu's descendant the sons of Prajāpati Kțśāśva, of true prowess, and charged with ascetic energy.

sanskrit: तपो बल भृतो ब्रह्मन् राघवाय निवेदय
पात्रभूतः च ते ब्रह्मन् तव अनुगमने रतः
transliteration: tapo bala bhṛto brahman rāghavāya nivedaya
pātrabhūtaḥ ca te brahman tava anugamane rataḥ

sanskrit: कर्तव्यम् सुमहत् कर्म सुराणाम् राज सूनुना
एवम् उक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुर् हृष्टा विहायसम्
transliteration: kartavyam sumahat karma surāṇām rāja sūnunā
evam uktvā surāḥ sarve jagmur hṛṣṭā vihāyasam

sanskrit: ततो मुनिवरः प्रीतः ताटका वध तोषितः
transliteration: tato munivaraḥ prītaḥ tāṭakā vadha toṣitaḥ

sanskrit: मूर्ध्नि रामम् उपाघ्राय इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
इह अद्य रजनीम् राम वसाम शुभ दर्शन
transliteration: mūrdhni rāmam upāghrāya idam vacanam abravīt
iha adya rajanīm rāma vasāma śubha darśana

sanskrit: श्वः प्रभाते गमिष्यामः तद् आश्रम पदम् मम
transliteration: śvaḥ prabhāte gamiṣyāmaḥ tad āśrama padam mama

sanskrit: उवास रजनीम् तत्र ताटकाया वने सुखम्
मुक्त शापम् वनम् तत् च तस्मिन् एव तत् आहनि
रमणीयम् विबभ्राज यथा चैत्र रथम् वनम्
transliteration: uvāsa rajanīm tatra tāṭakāyā vane sukham
mukta śāpam vanam tat ca tasmin eva tat āhani
ramaṇīyam vibabhrāja yathā caitra ratham vanam
english: And being thus freed from all disturbances, from that day forth that forest appeared charming, even like to the forest of Caitraratha.

sanskrit: निहत्य ताम् यक्ष सुताम् स रामःप्रशस्यमानः सुर सिद्ध सन्घैः
उवास तस्मिन् मुनिना सह एवप्रभात वेलाम् प्रति बोध्यमानः
transliteration: nihatya tām yakṣa sutām sa rāmaḥpraśasyamānaḥ sura siddha sanghaiḥ
uvāsa tasmin muninā saha evaprabhāta velām prati bodhyamānaḥ
english: Having thus slain the Yakşa's daughter, Rāma, eulogised by celestials and Siddhas, spent there that night with the saint, being awakened by the latter at the break of day.

sanskrit: अथ ताम् रजनीम् उष्य विश्वामिरो महायशाः
प्रहस्य राघवम् वाक्यम् उवाच मधुर स्वरम्
transliteration: atha tām rajanīm uṣya viśvāmiro mahāyaśāḥ
prahasya rāghavam vākyam uvāca madhura svaram
english: Having passed that night, the illustrious Viśvāmitra, smiling complacently, sweetly spoke to Rāghava, saying,

sanskrit: परितुष्टो अस्मि भद्रम् ते राजपुत्र महायशः
प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददामि अस्त्राणि सर्वशः
transliteration: parituṣṭo asmi bhadram te rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ
prītyā paramayā yukto dadāmi astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ
english: Pleased am I with you. Good betide you, O highly famous prince! With supreme pleasure, do I confer upon you all the weapons.

sanskrit: देव असुर गणान् वा अपि स गन्धर्व उरगान् भुवि
यैः अमित्रान् प्रसह्य आजौ वशीकृत्य जयिष्यसि
transliteration: deva asura gaṇān vā api sa gandharva uragān bhuvi
yaiḥ amitrān prasahya ājau vaśīkṛtya jayiṣyasi
english: By means of which subduing such antagonists as celestials and Asuras backed on carth by Gandharvas and Uragas, you will in battle be crowned with victory.

sanskrit: तानि दिव्यानि भद्रम् ते ददामि अस्त्राणि सर्वशः
दण्ड चक्रम् महत् दिव्यम् तव दास्यामि राघव
transliteration: tāni divyāni bhadram te dadāmi astrāṇi sarvaśaḥ
daṇḍa cakram mahat divyam tava dāsyāmi rāghava
english: All those celestial weapons, good betide you, I will confer upon you. And I will confer upon you, O Rāghava, the celestial and mighty Dandacakra,* and Dharmacakra, and also Kalacakra. And, ) foremost of men, I will confer upon you the fierce Vişnucakra, and Indracakra. *Cakra means discus. These enumerations specify different kinds of the discus.

sanskrit: धर्म चक्रम् ततो वीर काल चक्रम् तथैव च
विष्णु चक्रम् तथा अति उग्रम् ऐन्द्रम् चक्रम् तथैव च
transliteration: dharma cakram tato vīra kāla cakram tathaiva ca
viṣṇu cakram tathā ati ugram aindram cakram tathaiva ca

sanskrit: वज्रम् अस्त्रम् नरश्रेष्ठ शैवम् शूलवरम् तथा
अस्त्रम् ब्रह्मशिरः च एव ऐषीकम् अपि राघव
transliteration: vajram astram naraśreṣṭha śaivam śūlavaram tathā
astram brahmaśiraḥ ca eva aiṣīkam api rāghava

sanskrit: ददामि ते महाबाहो ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् अनुत्तमम्
गदे द्वे चैव काकुत्स्थ मोदकी शिखरी शुभे
transliteration: dadāmi te mahābāho brāhmam astram anuttamam
gade dve caiva kākutstha modakī śikharī śubhe

sanskrit: धर्म पाशम् अहम् राम काल पाशम् तथैव च
transliteration: dharma pāśam aham rāma kāla pāśam tathaiva ca

sanskrit: वारुणम् पाशम् अस्त्रम् च ददामि अहम् अनुत्तमम्
अशनी द्वे प्रयच्छामि शुष्क आर्द्रे रघुनन्दन
transliteration: vāruṇam pāśam astram ca dadāmi aham anuttamam
aśanī dve prayacchāmi śuṣka ārdre raghunandana

sanskrit: ददामि च अस्त्रम् पैनाकम् अस्त्रम् नारायणम् तथा
आग्नेयम् अस्त्रम् दयितम् शिखरम् नाम नामतः
transliteration: dadāmi ca astram painākam astram nārāyaṇam tathā
āgneyam astram dayitam śikharam nāma nāmataḥ
english: O descendant of Raghu, I will bestow upon you the two Asanis, Suska and Ardra, and the Pināka weapon, and the Nārāyaṇa, and the Āgneya weapon called Sikhara, and the Vāyavya, called Prathama.

sanskrit: वायव्यम् प्रथमम् नाम ददामि तव च अनघ
अस्त्रम् हयशिरः नाम क्रौञ्चम् अस्त्रम् तथैव च
transliteration: vāyavyam prathamam nāma dadāmi tava ca anagha
astram hayaśiraḥ nāma krauñcam astram tathaiva ca

sanskrit: शक्ति द्वयम् च काकुत्स्थ ददामि तव राघव
कंकालम् मुसलम् घोरम् कापालम् अथ किन्किणीम्
transliteration: śakti dvayam ca kākutstha dadāmi tava rāghava
kaṃkālam musalam ghoram kāpālam atha kinkiṇīm

sanskrit: वधार्थम् राक्षसाम् यानि ददामि एतानि सर्वशः
वैद्याधरम् महा अस्त्रम् च नन्दनम् नाम नामतः
transliteration: vadhārtham rākṣasām yāni dadāmi etāni sarvaśaḥ
vaidyādharam mahā astram ca nandanam nāma nāmataḥ

sanskrit: गान्धर्वम् अस्त्रम् दयितम् मोहनम् नाम नामतः
transliteration: gāndharvam astram dayitam mohanam nāma nāmataḥ
english: And, O mighty-armed one, O son of the best of men, I will confer upon you the mighty weapon Vidyadhara, and that excellent scimitar named Nandana, and the favourite Gandharva weapon, Mohana, and Prasvapana, Pasamana, and Saumya,

sanskrit: प्रस्वापनम् प्रशमनम् दद्मि सौम्यम् च राघव
transliteration: prasvāpanam praśamanam dadmi saumyam ca rāghava

sanskrit: मादनम् चैव दुर्धर्षम् कन्दर्प दयितम् तथा
गान्धर्वम् अस्त्रम् दयितम् मानवम् नाम नामतः
transliteration: mādanam caiva durdharṣam kandarpa dayitam tathā
gāndharvam astram dayitam mānavam nāma nāmataḥ

sanskrit: पैशाचम् अस्त्रम् दयितम् मोहनम् नाम नामतः
transliteration: paiśācam astram dayitam mohanam nāma nāmataḥ

sanskrit: संवर्तम् चैव दुर्धर्षम् मौसलम् च नृपात्मज
transliteration: saṃvartam caiva durdharṣam mausalam ca nṛpātmaja

sanskrit: सत्यम् अस्त्रम् महाबाहो तथा मायामयम् परम्
सौरम् तेजःप्रभम् नाम पर तेजो अपकर्षणम्
transliteration: satyam astram mahābāho tathā māyāmayam param
sauram tejaḥprabham nāma para tejo apakarṣaṇam

sanskrit: सोम अस्त्रम् शिशिरम् नाम त्वाष्ट्रम् अस्त्रम् सुदारुरणम्
दारुणम् च भगस्य अपि शितेषुम् अथ मानवम्
transliteration: soma astram śiśiram nāma tvāṣṭram astram sudāruraṇam
dāruṇam ca bhagasya api śiteṣum atha mānavam

sanskrit: एतान् राम महाबाहो काम रूपान् महाबलान्
transliteration: etān rāma mahābāho kāma rūpān mahābalān
english: O long-armed king's son, Rama! receive instantly all powerful, highly exalted forms that can be modified at will.

sanskrit: स्थितः तु प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा शुचिर् मुनिवरः तदा
ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतो मंत्र ग्रामम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: sthitaḥ tu prāṅmukho bhūtvā śucir munivaraḥ tadā
dadau rāmāya suprīto maṃtra grāmam anuttamam
english: Then with his face turned towards the east, that foremost of ascetics having purified himself, gladly conferred the mantras upon Rāma.

sanskrit: सर्व संग्रहणम् एषाम् दैवतैः अपि दुर्लभम्
तानि अस्त्राणि तदा विप्रो राघवाय न्यवेदत्
transliteration: sarva saṃgrahaṇam eṣām daivataiḥ api durlabham
tāni astrāṇi tadā vipro rāghavāya nyavedat
english: And the Vipra also bestowed upon Rāghava those weapons, of which even the celestials are incapable of holding all.

sanskrit: जपतः तु मुनेः तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः
उपतस्थुः महा अर्हाणि सर्वाणि अस्त्राणि राघवम्
transliteration: japataḥ tu muneḥ tasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
upatasthuḥ mahā arhāṇi sarvāṇi astrāṇi rāghavam
english: As that intelligent ascetic, Viśvāmitra, recited mantras, all those invaluable weapons appeared before that descendant of Raghu. And with clasped hands, they well-pleased, addressed Rama,-These, O highly generous one, are your servants, O Rāghava. And whatever you wish, good betide you, shall by all means be accomplished by us.

sanskrit: ऊचुः च मुदिता रामम् सर्वे प्रांजलयः तदा
इमे च परमोदार किंकराः तव राघव
transliteration: ūcuḥ ca muditā rāmam sarve prāṃjalayaḥ tadā
ime ca paramodāra kiṃkarāḥ tava rāghava

sanskrit: यद् यद् इच्छसि भद्रन् ते तत् सर्वम् करवाम वै
ततो राम प्रसन्न आत्मा तैः इति उक्तो महाबलैः
transliteration: yad yad icchasi bhadran te tat sarvam karavāma vai
tato rāma prasanna ātmā taiḥ iti ukto mahābalaiḥ

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थः समालभ्य च पाणिना
मनसा मे भविष्यध्वम् इति तानि अभ्यचोदयत्
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca kākutsthaḥ samālabhya ca pāṇinā
manasā me bhaviṣyadhvam iti tāni abhyacodayat
english: Thus addressed by those highly powerful weapons, Kākutstha Rama, with a delighted soul, accepting them, touched them with his hand, and said, Do you appear before me as I remember you!

sanskrit: ततः प्रीत मना रामो विश्वामित्रम् महामुनिम्
transliteration: tataḥ prīta manā rāmo viśvāmitram mahāmunim
english: Then the exceedingly energetic Rāma, well pleased, paying reverence to the mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, prepared to set out. pleased, paying reverence to the mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, prepared to set out.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य ततः अस्त्राणि प्रहृष्ट वदनः शुचिः
गच्छन् एव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: pratigṛhya tataḥ astrāṇi prahṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śuciḥ
gacchan eva ca kākutstho viśvāmitram atha abravīt
english: Having accepted those weapons with purity, Käkutstha while proceeding, with a complacent countenance spoke these words to sage Visvāmitra,-

sanskrit: गृहीत अस्त्रो अस्मि भगवन् दुराधर्षः सुरैः अपि
अस्त्राणाम् तु अहम् इच्छामि संहारम् मुनिपुंगव
transliteration: gṛhīta astro asmi bhagavan durādharṣaḥ suraiḥ api
astrāṇām tu aham icchāmi saṃhāram munipuṃgava
english: O adorable one, I have received these weapons, incapable of being repressed even by the celestials themselves. Now, O best of ascetics, I would acquire a knowledge of with drawing them.

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रो महा तपाः
संहारान् व्याजहार अथ धृतिमान् सुव्रतः शुचिः
transliteration: evam bruvati kākutsthe viśvāmitro mahā tapāḥ
saṃhārān vyājahāra atha dhṛtimān suvrataḥ śuciḥ
english: Upon Kākutstha's representing this, Viśvāmitra of high austerities, endowed with patience, of excellent vows, and pure in spirit, communicated to him the mantras for restraining the weapons.

sanskrit: सत्यवन्तम् सत्य कीर्तिम् धृष्टम् रभसम् एव च
transliteration: satyavantam satya kīrtim dhṛṣṭam rabhasam eva ca

sanskrit: लक्ष्या अलक्ष्याः इमौ चैव दृढ नाभ सुनाभकौ
दशाक्ष शतवक्त्रौ च दश शीर्ष शत उदरौ
transliteration: lakṣyā alakṣyāḥ imau caiva dṛḍha nābha sunābhakau
daśākṣa śatavaktrau ca daśa śīrṣa śata udarau

sanskrit: ज्योतिषम् शकुनम् चैव नैराश्य विमलौ उभौ
transliteration: jyotiṣam śakunam caiva nairāśya vimalau ubhau

sanskrit: यौगंधर विनिद्रौ च दैत्य प्रमधनौ तथा
शुचि बाहुर् महाबाहुर् निष्कलि विरुचर् तथासार्चिर्माली धृतिमाली वृत्तिमान् रुचिरः तथा
transliteration: yaugaṃdhara vinidrau ca daitya pramadhanau tathā
śuci bāhur mahābāhur niṣkali virucar tathāsārcirmālī dhṛtimālī vṛttimān ruciraḥ tathā

sanskrit: पित्र्यः सौमनसः चैव विधूत मकरौ उभौ
परवीरम् रतिम् चैव धन धान्यौ च राघव
transliteration: pitryaḥ saumanasaḥ caiva vidhūta makarau ubhau
paravīram ratim caiva dhana dhānyau ca rāghava

sanskrit: जृंभकम् सर्पनाथम् च पन्थान वरणौ तथा
transliteration: jṛṃbhakam sarpanātham ca panthāna varaṇau tathā

sanskrit: कृशाश्व तनयान् राम भास्वरान् काम रूपिणः
प्रतीच्छ मम भद्रम् ते पात्र भूतोऽसि राघव
transliteration: kṛśāśva tanayān rāma bhāsvarān kāma rūpiṇaḥ
pratīccha mama bhadram te pātra bhūto'si rāghava

sanskrit: बाढम् इति एव काकुत्स्थ प्रहृष्टेन अंतरात्मना
दिव्य भास्वर देहाः च मूर्तिमन्तः सुखप्रदाः
transliteration: bāḍham iti eva kākutstha prahṛṣṭena aṃtarātmanā
divya bhāsvara dehāḥ ca mūrtimantaḥ sukhapradāḥ

sanskrit: केचिद् अंगार सदृशाः केचिद् धूम उपमाः तथा
चन्द्र अर्क सदृशाः केचित् प्रह्व अंजलि पुटाः तथा
transliteration: kecid aṃgāra sadṛśāḥ kecid dhūma upamāḥ tathā
candra arka sadṛśāḥ kecit prahva aṃjali puṭāḥ tathā

sanskrit: रामम् प्रांजलयो भूत्वा अब्रुवन् मधुर भाषिणः
इमे स्म नरशार्दूल शाधि किम् करवाम ते
transliteration: rāmam prāṃjalayo bhūtvā abruvan madhura bhāṣiṇaḥ
ime sma naraśārdūla śādhi kim karavāma te

sanskrit: गम्यताम् इति तान् आह यथा इष्टम् रघुनन्दनः
मानसाः कार्य कालेषु साहाय्यम् मे करिष्यथ
transliteration: gamyatām iti tān āha yathā iṣṭam raghunandanaḥ
mānasāḥ kārya kāleṣu sāhāyyam me kariṣyatha
english: Then the descendant of Raghu answered, saying, Repair whither soever you will! Recurring to my memory, do you in time of need, render me assistance!

sanskrit: अथ ते रामम् आमन्त्र्य कृत्वा च अपि प्रदक्षिणम्
एवम् अस्तु इति काकुत्स्थम् उक्त्वा जग्मुः यथाआगतम्
transliteration: atha te rāmam āmantrya kṛtvā ca api pradakṣiṇam
evam astu iti kākutstham uktvā jagmuḥ yathāāgatam

sanskrit: स च तान् राघवो ज्ञात्वा विश्वामित्रम् महामुनिम्
गच्छन् एव अथ मधुरम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa ca tān rāghavo jñātvā viśvāmitram mahāmunim
gacchan eva atha madhuram ślakṣṇam vacanam abravīt

sanskrit: किम् एतन् मेघ संकाशम् पर्वतस्य अविदूरतः
वृक्ष खण्डम् इतः भाति परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे
transliteration: kim etan megha saṃkāśam parvatasya avidūrataḥ
vṛkṣa khaṇḍam itaḥ bhāti param kautūhalam hi me

english: It is pleasing to the sight, and abounds in beasts, and is exceedingly romantic, and is adorned with various birds singing sweetly.
Now, O foremost of ascetics, we have come out of a wilderness capable of making one's hair stand on end. And from the pleasantness attaching to this place, I have come to a conclusion.

sanskrit: सर्वम् मे शंस भगवन् कस्य आश्रम पदम् तु इदम्
संप्राप्ताः यत्र ते पापाः ब्रह्मघ्नाः दुष्ट चारिणः
transliteration: sarvam me śaṃsa bhagavan kasya āśrama padam tu idam
saṃprāptāḥ yatra te pāpāḥ brahmaghnāḥ duṣṭa cāriṇaḥ

sanskrit: भगवन् तस्य को देशः सा यत्र तव याज्ञिकी
transliteration: bhagavan tasya ko deśaḥ sā yatra tava yājñikī

sanskrit: रक्षितव्या क्रिया ब्रह्मन् मया वध्याः च राक्षसाः
एतत् सर्वम् मुनिश्रेष्टः श्रोतुम् इच्छामि अहम् प्रभो
transliteration: rakṣitavyā kriyā brahman mayā vadhyāḥ ca rākṣasāḥ
etat sarvam muniśreṣṭaḥ śrotum icchāmi aham prabho

english: Hearing those words of Rāma of measureless prowess, who had asked the question, the highly energetic Viśvāmitra answered, saying,

sanskrit: इह राम महाबाहो विष्णुर् देव नमस्कृत
वर्षाणि सुबहूनि इह तथा युग शतानि च
transliteration: iha rāma mahābāho viṣṇur deva namaskṛta
varṣāṇi subahūni iha tathā yuga śatāni ca
english: Here, O mighty-armed Rama, Visnu of mighty asceticism worshipped of all the deities, for years upon years, and hundreds of Yugas, dwelt for carrying on his austerities and Yoga. This, O Rāma, was formerly the hermitage of the high-souled Vāmana.

sanskrit: तपः चरण योगार्थम् उवास सु महातपाः
एष पूर्व आश्रमो राम वामनस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: tapaḥ caraṇa yogārtham uvāsa su mahātapāḥ
eṣa pūrva āśramo rāma vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ
english: Here, O mighty-armed Rama, Visnu of mighty asceticism worshipped of all the deities, for years upon years, and hundreds of Yugas, dwelt for carrying on his austerities and Yoga. This, O Rāma, was formerly the hermitage of the high-souled Vāmana.

sanskrit: सिद्ध आश्रम इति ख्यातः सिद्धो हि अत्र महातपाः
एतस्मिन् एव काले तु राजा वैरोचनिर् बलिः
transliteration: siddha āśrama iti khyātaḥ siddho hi atra mahātapāḥ
etasmin eva kāle tu rājā vairocanir baliḥ
english: And this famed as Siddhāśrama, in consequence of that one of potent asceticism having attained fruition there. And it came to pass that at this time Virocana's son, king Välī; having vanquished the celestials with Indra and the Maruts, established that dominion of his, famous in the three worlds.

sanskrit: निर्जित्य दैवत गणान् स इन्द्रान् स मरुद् गणान्
कारयामास तद् राज्यम् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
transliteration: nirjitya daivata gaṇān sa indrān sa marud gaṇān
kārayāmāsa tad rājyam triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
english: And this famed as Siddhāśrama, in consequence of that one of potent asceticism having attained fruition there. And it came to pass that at this time Virocana's son, king Välī; having vanquished the celestials with Indra and the Maruts, established that dominion of his, famous in the three worlds.

sanskrit: बलेः तु यजमानस्य देवाः साग्नि पुरोगमाः
समागम्य स्वयम् चैव विष्णुम् ऊचुः इह आश्रमे
transliteration: baleḥ tu yajamānasya devāḥ sāgni purogamāḥ
samāgamya svayam caiva viṣṇum ūcuḥ iha āśrame
english: And that mighty chief of the Asuras celebrated a sacrifice. And as Vāli was performing that sacrifice, the deities with Agni at their head, coming to Vişnu himself at this asylum, addressed him saying,

sanskrit: बलिः वैरोचनिः विष्णो यजते यज्ञम् उत्तमम्
असमाप्त व्रते तस्मिन् स्व कार्यम् अभिपद्यताम्
transliteration: baliḥ vairocaniḥ viṣṇo yajate yajñam uttamam
asamāpta vrate tasmin sva kāryam abhipadyatām
english: Virocana's son, Vali, O Visnu, is celebrating a sacrifice. Do you, before the ceremony is finished, accomplish your own end.

sanskrit: ये च एनम् अभिवर्तन्ते याचितार इतः ततः
यत् च यत्र यथावत् च सर्वम् तेभ्यः प्रयच्छति
transliteration: ye ca enam abhivartante yācitāra itaḥ tataḥ
yat ca yatra yathāvat ca sarvam tebhyaḥ prayacchati
english: He duly confer upon such as repair to him from various quarters all those things that they ask for. And do yourself.

sanskrit: स त्वम् सुर हितार्थाय माया योगम् उपाश्रितः
वामनत्वम् गतो विष्णो कुरु कल्याणम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: sa tvam sura hitārthāya māyā yogam upāśritaḥ
vāmanatvam gato viṣṇo kuru kalyāṇam uttamam
english: O Visnu, aided by your power of illusion, assuming a Dwarf form, accomplish the welfare of the gods.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् अनन्तरे राम काश्यपो अग्नि सम प्रभः
अदित्या सहितः राम दीप्यमान इव ओजसा
transliteration: etasmin anantare rāma kāśyapo agni sama prabhaḥ
adityā sahitaḥ rāma dīpyamāna iva ojasā
english: In the meantime, O Rāma, the worshipful Kaśyapa resembling fire in splendour, and flaming in energy, having in company with, and with the assistance of, the divine Aditi, O Rāma, accomplished his vow, began to hymn the destroyer of Madhu ready to confer boons.

sanskrit: देवी सहायो भगवन् दिव्यम् वर्ष सहस्रकम्
transliteration: devī sahāyo bhagavan divyam varṣa sahasrakam
english: In the meantime, O Rāma, the worshipful Kaśyapa resembling fire in splendour, and flaming in energy, having in company with, and with the assistance of, the divine Aditi, O Rāma, accomplished his vow, began to hymn the destroyer of Madhu ready to confer boons.

sanskrit: शरीरे तव पश्यामि जगत् सर्वम् इदम् प्रभो
त्वम् अनादिः अनिर्देश्यः त्वाम् अहम् शरणम् गतः
transliteration: śarīre tava paśyāmi jagat sarvam idam prabho
tvam anādiḥ anirdeśyaḥ tvām aham śaraṇam gataḥ

sanskrit: तम् उवाच हरिः प्रीतः कश्यपम् धूत कल्मषम्
वरम् वरय भद्रम् ते वर अर्हः असि मतो मम
transliteration: tam uvāca hariḥ prītaḥ kaśyapam dhūta kalmaṣam
varam varaya bhadram te vara arhaḥ asi mato mama

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य मारीचः कश्यपो अब्रवीत्
अदित्या देवतानाम् च मम च एव अनुयाचितम्
transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya mārīcaḥ kaśyapo abravīt
adityā devatānām ca mama ca eva anuyācitam
english: Hearing these words of his, Marici's son, Kaśyapa, said, Aditi, the gods, and I myself, crave of you this, and, O bestower of boons, it behove you well pleased to confer on us this boon, O you of excellent vows! Do you, o sinless one, become born as my son in Aditi.

sanskrit: वरम् वरद सुप्रीतो दातुम् अर्हसि सुव्रत
पुत्रत्वम् गच्छ भगवन् अदित्या मम च अनघ
transliteration: varam varada suprīto dātum arhasi suvrata
putratvam gaccha bhagavan adityā mama ca anagha
english: Hearing these words of his, Marici's son, Kaśyapa, said, Aditi, the gods, and I myself, crave of you this, and, O bestower of boons, it behove you well pleased to confer on us this boon, O you of excellent vows! Do you, o sinless one, become born as my son in Aditi.

sanskrit: भ्राता भव यवीयान् त्वम् शक्रस्य असुरसूदन
शोक आर्तानाम् तु देवानाम् साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: bhrātā bhava yavīyān tvam śakrasya asurasūdana
śoka ārtānām tu devānām sāhāyyam kartum arhasi
english: O adorable deity! Do you become the younger brother of Sakra, O destroyer of Asuras. It behove you to help the celestials afflicted with grief.

sanskrit: अयम् सिद्ध आश्रमो नाम प्रसादात् ते भविष्यति
सिद्धे कर्मणि देवेश उत्तिष्ठ भगवन् इतः
transliteration: ayam siddha āśramo nāma prasādāt te bhaviṣyati
siddhe karmaṇi deveśa uttiṣṭha bhagavan itaḥ
english: And this place through your grace will attain the name of Siddhasrama. The work, O lord of the celestials, has been accomplished.

Do you now, O you of the six attributes, ascend from hence! And accordingly Vişnu of mighty energy took his birth in Aditi. And assuming the form of a dwarf, he presented himself before Virocana's son.

sanskrit: त्रीन् पादान् अथ भिक्षित्वा प्रतिगृह्य च मेदिनीम्
आक्रम्य लोकान् लोकार्थो सर्व लोक हिते रतः
transliteration: trīn pādān atha bhikṣitvā pratigṛhya ca medinīm
ākramya lokān lokārtho sarva loka hite rataḥ
english: And then asking for as much earth as could be covered by three footsteps, that one ever engaged in the welfare of all creatures; with the object of compassing the good of all, stood occupying the worlds. And having by his power restrained Bali, that one of exceeding energy, again conferred the three worlds upon the mighty Indra, and made them subject to his control.

sanskrit: महेन्द्राय पुनः प्रादात् नियम्य बलिम् ओजसा
त्रैलोक्यम् स महातेजाः चक्रे शक्र वशम् पुनः
transliteration: mahendrāya punaḥ prādāt niyamya balim ojasā
trailokyam sa mahātejāḥ cakre śakra vaśam punaḥ
english: And then asking for as much earth as could be covered by three footsteps, that one ever engaged in the welfare of all creatures; with the object of compassing the good of all, stood occupying the worlds. And having by his power restrained Bali, that one of exceeding energy, again conferred the three worlds upon the mighty Indra, and made them subject to his control.

sanskrit: तेन एव पूर्वम् आक्रान्त आश्रमः श्रम नाशनः
मया अपि भक्त्या तस्य एव वामनस्य उपभुज्यते
transliteration: tena eva pūrvam ākrānta āśramaḥ śrama nāśanaḥ
mayā api bhaktyā tasya eva vāmanasya upabhujyate
english: Formerly he used to dwell in this asylum capable of removing fatigue. And hermitage is infested by Raksasas disturbing rites. And, O most puissant of men, here you should slay those ones of wicked ways.

sanskrit: एनम् आश्रमम् आयान्ति राक्षसा विघ्न कारिणः
अत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्र हन्तव्या दुष्ट चारिणः
transliteration: enam āśramam āyānti rākṣasā vighna kāriṇaḥ
atra te puruṣavyāghra hantavyā duṣṭa cāriṇaḥ
english: Formerly he used to dwell in this asylum capable of removing fatigue. And hermitage is infested by Raksasas disturbing rites. And, O most puissant of men, here you should slay those ones of wicked ways.

sanskrit: तत् आश्रम पदम् तात तव अपि एतद् यथा मम
transliteration: tat āśrama padam tāta tava api etad yathā mama
english: To-day, O Rama, will I repair to this supremely excellent Siddhāśrama. And this asylum, child, is as much your as mine.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा परम प्रीतो गृह्य रामम् स लक्ष्मणम्
शशी इव गत नीहारः पुनर्वसु समन्वितः
transliteration: iti uktvā parama prīto gṛhya rāmam sa lakṣmaṇam
śaśī iva gata nīhāraḥ punarvasu samanvitaḥ
english: Saying this, taking Rāma and Lakşmaņa, the mighty ascetic, experiencing exceeding delight, entered that asylum, and appeared graceful, like the Moon emerged from mist in conjunction with the Punarvasu stars.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे सिद्धाश्रम निवासिनः
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve siddhāśrama nivāsinaḥ
english: And beholding Viśvāmitra, the ascetics inhabiting Siddhāśrama, suddenly rising in joy, worshipped that intelligent one, and extended to the princes the rites of hospitality.

sanskrit: यथा अर्हम् चक्रिरे पूजाम् विश्वामित्राय धीमते
तथैव राज पुत्राभ्याम् अकुर्वन् अतिथि क्रियाम्
transliteration: yathā arham cakrire pūjām viśvāmitrāya dhīmate
tathaiva rāja putrābhyām akurvan atithi kriyām
english: And beholding Viśvāmitra, the ascetics inhabiting Siddhāśrama, suddenly rising in joy, worshipped that intelligent one, and extended to the princes the rites of hospitality.

sanskrit: मुहूर्तम् अथ विश्रान्तौ राज पुत्रौ अरिन्दमौ
transliteration: muhūrtam atha viśrāntau rāja putrau arindamau
english: And then having reposed for a while, those unreproved princes, the descendants of Raghu, with clasped hands, addressed that foremost of ascetics.

sanskrit: अद्य एव दीक्षाम् प्रविश भद्रम् ते मुनिपुंगव
सिद्धाश्रमो अयम् सिद्धः स्यात् सत्यम् अस्तु वचः तव
transliteration: adya eva dīkṣām praviśa bhadram te munipuṃgava
siddhāśramo ayam siddhaḥ syāt satyam astu vacaḥ tava
english: Be you even to-day initiated to the ceremony. Good betide you, O best of ascetics! Let this Siddhāśrama verily attain fruition, and let your words be verified!

sanskrit: कुमारौ एव ताम् रात्रिम् उषित्वा सुसमाहितौ
प्रभात काले च उत्थाय पूर्वाम् संध्याम् उपास्य च
transliteration: kumārau eva tām rātrim uṣitvā susamāhitau
prabhāta kāle ca utthāya pūrvām saṃdhyām upāsya ca

sanskrit: प्रशुची परम् जाप्यम् समाप्य नियमेन च
transliteration: praśucī param jāpyam samāpya niyamena ca

sanskrit: अथ तौ देश कालज्ञौ राजपुत्रौ अरिंदमौ
देशे काले च वाक्यज्ञौ अब्रूताम् कौशिकम् वचः
transliteration: atha tau deśa kālajñau rājaputrau ariṃdamau
deśe kāle ca vākyajñau abrūtām kauśikam vacaḥ
english: Then those princes, repressors of foes, cognizant of place, and time, and words, thus spoke to Kuśika's son agreeably to time and place, saying,

sanskrit: भगवन् श्रोतुम् इच्छावो यस्मिन् काले निशाचरौ
संरक्षणीयौ तौ ब्रूहि न अतिवर्तेत तत् क्षणम्
transliteration: bhagavan śrotum icchāvo yasmin kāle niśācarau
saṃrakṣaṇīyau tau brūhi na ativarteta tat kṣaṇam
english: O adorable one, do you tell us as to the time when we should oppose those rangers of the night! Let not that hour pass away!

sanskrit: सर्वे ते मुनयः प्रीताः प्रशशंसुर् नृपात्मजौ
transliteration: sarve te munayaḥ prītāḥ praśaśaṃsur nṛpātmajau
english: Upon the two Kākutsthas' saying this, and finding them prompt for the encounter, those ascetics well-pleased, fell to extolling the sons of the king.

sanskrit: अद्य प्रभृति षट् रात्रम् रक्षतम् राघवौ युवाम्
दीक्षाम् गतो हि येष मुनिर् मौनित्वम् च गमिष्यति
transliteration: adya prabhṛti ṣaṭ rātram rakṣatam rāghavau yuvām
dīkṣām gato hi yeṣa munir maunitvam ca gamiṣyati
english: For six nights from to-day, you should protects us. This ascetic has been initiated into the sacrifice, and must, therefore, observe taciturnity.

sanskrit: तौ तु तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रौ यशस्विनौ
transliteration: tau tu tad vacanam śrutvā rājaputrau yaśasvinau
english: Hearing these words of theirs, those illustrious princes, renouncing sleep, began to guard the hermitage day and night; and those heroic and mighty archers protected that best of ascetics and subduer of enemies.

sanskrit: उपासाम् चक्रतुर् वीरौ यत्तौ परम धन्विनौ
transliteration: upāsām cakratur vīrau yattau parama dhanvinau
english: Hearing these words of theirs, those illustrious princes, renouncing sleep, began to guard the hermitage day and night; and those heroic and mighty archers protected that best of ascetics and subduer of enemies.

sanskrit: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् षष्ठे अहनि तदा आगते
सौमित्रम् अब्रवीद् रामो यत्तो भव समाहितः
transliteration: atha kāle gate tasmin ṣaṣṭhe ahani tadā āgate
saumitram abravīd rāmo yatto bhava samāhitaḥ
english: When time had thus gone by and the sixth day had arrived, Rāma said to Sumitrā's son. Being well equipped, be you vigilant!

sanskrit: प्रजज्वाल ततो वेदिः स उपाध्याय पुरोहिता
transliteration: prajajvāla tato vediḥ sa upādhyāya purohitā
english: When Räma, manifesting emotion, and being eager for encounter, had said this, the priests and spiritual guides lit up the altar. And along with Viśvāmitra and the family priests, they lit up the altar furnished with Kusa, and Kasa, and ladles, and faggots, and flowers.

sanskrit: स दर्भ चमस स्रुक्का स समित् कुसुमोच्चया
विश्वामित्रेण सहिता वेदिः जज्वाल स ऋत्विजा
transliteration: sa darbha camasa srukkā sa samit kusumoccayā
viśvāmitreṇa sahitā vediḥ jajvāla sa ṛtvijā
english: When Räma, manifesting emotion, and being eager for encounter, had said this, the priests and spiritual guides lit up the altar. And along with Viśvāmitra and the family priests, they lit up the altar furnished with Kusa, and Kasa, and ladles, and faggots, and flowers.

sanskrit: मंत्रवत् च यथा न्यायम् यज्ञो असौ संप्रवर्तते
आकाशे च महान् शब्दः प्रादुर् आसीत् भयानकः
transliteration: maṃtravat ca yathā nyāyam yajño asau saṃpravartate
ākāśe ca mahān śabdaḥ prādur āsīt bhayānakaḥ
english: And as reciting mantras, they were about to duly engage in that sacrifice, there arose a mighty and dreadful uproar in the sky.

sanskrit: आवार्य गगनम् मेघो यथा प्रावृषि दृश्यते
transliteration: āvārya gaganam megho yathā prāvṛṣi dṛśyate
english: And as in the rains, masses of clouds appear enveloping the firmament, the Rākşasas, displaying illusions in that wise, began to rush onward. And Mārīca and Subāhu together with their followers coming in dreadful forms, began to shower down blood upon the altar.

sanskrit: मारीचः च सुबाहुः च तयोर् अनुचराः तथा
आगम्य भीम संकाशा रुधिर ओघान् अवासृजन्
transliteration: mārīcaḥ ca subāhuḥ ca tayor anucarāḥ tathā
āgamya bhīma saṃkāśā rudhira oghān avāsṛjan
english: And as in the rains, masses of clouds appear enveloping the firmament, the Rākşasas, displaying illusions in that wise, began to rush onward. And Mārīca and Subāhu together with their followers coming in dreadful forms, began to shower down blood upon the altar.

sanskrit: ताम् तेन रुधिर ओघेण वेदीम् वीक्ष्य समुक्षिताम्
सहसा अभिद्रुतो रामः तान् अपश्यत् ततो दिवि
