transliteration: tām tena rudhira ogheṇa vedīm vīkṣya samukṣitām
sahasā abhidruto rāmaḥ tān apaśyat tato divi
english: And on seeing the altar deluged with gore, Rāma suddenly rushed forward, and behold them in the sky. And suddenly seeing them rushing in amain, the lotus-eyed Rāma fixing his gaze at Laksmana, said.

sanskrit: तौ आपतन्तौ सहसा दृष्ट्वा राजीव लोचनः
लक्ष्मणम् तौ अभिसंप्रेक्ष्य रामो वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tau āpatantau sahasā dṛṣṭvā rājīva locanaḥ
lakṣmaṇam tau abhisaṃprekṣya rāmo vacanam abravīt
english: And on seeing the altar deluged with gore, Rāma suddenly rushed forward, and behold them in the sky. And suddenly seeing them rushing in amain, the lotus-eyed Rāma fixing his gaze at Laksmana, said.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण दुर्वृत्तान् राक्षसान् पिशित अशनान्
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa durvṛttān rākṣasān piśita aśanān
english: Behold O Lakşmana, by means of a Mānava weapon, I shall, without doubt, drive away the wicked; flesh-eating Raksasas, even as the wind drive away clouds before it. Surely I cannot bring myself to slay such as these.

sanskrit: करिष्यामि न संदेहो न उत्सहे हन्तुम् ईदृशान्
इति उक्त्वा वचनम् रामः चापे संधाय वेगवान्
transliteration: kariṣyāmi na saṃdeho na utsahe hantum īdṛśān
iti uktvā vacanam rāmaḥ cāpe saṃdhāya vegavān

sanskrit: मानवम् परम उदारम् अस्त्रम् परम भास्वरम्
चिक्षेप परम क्रुद्धो मारीच उरसि राघवः
transliteration: mānavam parama udāram astram parama bhāsvaram
cikṣepa parama kruddho mārīca urasi rāghavaḥ
english: Saying this, that descendant of Raghu, Rāma, in vehemence fixing on his bow an exceedingly mighty and gloriously-dazzling Mānava weapon, discharged it in great wrath at Mārīca's chest.

sanskrit: संपूर्णम् योजन शतम् क्षिप्तः सागर संप्लवे
transliteration: saṃpūrṇam yojana śatam kṣiptaḥ sāgara saṃplave
english: And wounded by that foremost of Mānava weapons, Mārīca carried off a sheer hundred Yojanas, dropped in the midst of the ocean.

sanskrit: निरस्तम् दृश्य मारीचम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: nirastam dṛśya mārīcam rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: And finding Mārica senseless, and whirling, and afflicted by the might of the weapon, and overcome, Rama addressed Laksmana, saying.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण शीतेषुम् मानवम् मनु संहितम्
मोहयित्वा नयति एनम् न च प्राणैर् व्ययुज्यत
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa śīteṣum mānavam manu saṃhitam
mohayitvā nayati enam na ca prāṇair vyayujyata
english: Behold, O Laksmana, this Manava weapon first used by Manu, depriving him of his senses has carried him off, and yet has not taken his life!

sanskrit: इमान् अपि वधिष्यामि निर्घृणान् दुष्ट चारिणः
राक्षसान् पाप कर्मस्थान् यज्ञ घ्नान् रुधिर अशनान्
transliteration: imān api vadhiṣyāmi nirghṛṇān duṣṭa cāriṇaḥ
rākṣasān pāpa karmasthān yajña ghnān rudhira aśanān
english: But these shameless, wicked, and blooddrinking Raksasas, delighting in wrong-doing, these disturbers of sacrifices, will I slaughter.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा लक्ष्मणम् च अशु लाघवम् दर्शयन् इव
संगृह्य सुमहत् च अस्त्रम् आग्नेयम् रघुनंदनः
सुबाहु उरसि चिक्षेप स विद्धः प्रापतत् भुवि
transliteration: iti uktvā lakṣmaṇam ca aśu lāghavam darśayan iva
saṃgṛhya sumahat ca astram āgneyam raghunaṃdanaḥ
subāhu urasi cikṣepa sa viddhaḥ prāpatat bhuvi
english: Having said this, anon showing to Lakşmaņa his lightness of hand, Raghu's descendant took out a mighty Āgneya weapon, and discharged it at the breast of Subāhu. Thereat being pierced with that shaft, he fell down upon the ground. Then taking a Vāyavya weapon, the illustrious and exceedingly generous Rāghava, bringing delight to those ascetics, slew the rest.

sanskrit: स हत्वा राक्षसान् सर्वान् यज्ञ घ्नान् रघुनंदनः
ऋषिभिः पूजितः तत्र यथा इन्द्रो विजये पुरा
transliteration: sa hatvā rākṣasān sarvān yajña ghnān raghunaṃdanaḥ
ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaḥ tatra yathā indro vijaye purā
english: Having destroyed all those Rākşasas disturbing sacrifices, Raghu's descendant was honoured by the saints, even as Indra in day of yore, after having vanquished the Asuras.

sanskrit: अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
निरीतिका दिशो दृष्ट्वा काकुत्स्थम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: atha yajñe samāpte tu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
nirītikā diśo dṛṣṭvā kākutstham idam abravīt
english: When the sacrifice had been completed, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, beholding all sides cleared of Rākṣasas, spoke to Käkutstha, saying,

sanskrit: कृतार्थो अस्मि महाबाहो कृतम् गुरु वचः त्वया
सिद्धाश्रमम् इदम् सत्यम् कृतम् वीर महायशः
स हि रामम् प्रशस्य एवम् ताभ्याम् संध्याम् उपागमत्
transliteration: kṛtārtho asmi mahābāho kṛtam guru vacaḥ tvayā
siddhāśramam idam satyam kṛtam vīra mahāyaśaḥ
sa hi rāmam praśasya evam tābhyām saṃdhyām upāgamat
english: O mighty-armed one, I have obtained my desire; and you have executed your preceptor's mandate. And, O illustrious hero, you have truly made this a Siddhāśrama. Having thus extolled Rāma, he took Rāma and Lakşmaņa, to perform his evening devotions.

sanskrit: अथ ताम् रजनीम् तत्र कृतार्थौ राम लक्षणौ
transliteration: atha tām rajanīm tatra kṛtārthau rāma lakṣaṇau
english: Those heroes, Rāma and Laksmana, their interest secured, with glad hearts passed that night there.

sanskrit: प्रभातायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् कृत पौर्व अह्णिक क्रियौ
विश्वामित्रम् ऋषीम् च अन्यान् सहितौ अभिजग्मतुः
transliteration: prabhātāyām tu śarvaryām kṛta paurva ahṇika kriyau
viśvāmitram ṛṣīm ca anyān sahitau abhijagmatuḥ
english: And when the night had passed away and the morning come, they together appeared before the saint, Visvāmitra, and the rest.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य मुनि श्रेष्ठम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम्
transliteration: abhivādya muni śreṣṭham jvalaṃtam iva pāvakam
english: And having saluted that foremost of ascetics resembling flaming fire, your addressed him in gentle and honied accents.

sanskrit: इमौ स्म मुनि शार्दूल किंकरौ समुपस्थितौ
transliteration: imau sma muni śārdūla kiṃkarau samupasthitau
english: These servants of yours, O best of ascetics, have come before you. Do you command, O chief of anchorites, what command of your are we to execute

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ते तयोः वाक्यम् सर्व एव महर्षयः
transliteration: evam ukte tayoḥ vākyam sarva eva maharṣayaḥ
english: Thus addressed by them the Maharșis with Viśvāmitra at their head spoke to Rāma, saying,

sanskrit: यज्नः परम धर्मिष्ठः तत्र यास्यामहे वयम्
transliteration: yajnaḥ parama dharmiṣṭhaḥ tatra yāsyāmahe vayam
english: A highly meritorious sacrifice, O foremost of men, is to be celebrated by Mithila's lord, Janaka. Thither shall we repair.

sanskrit: त्वम् चैव नरशार्दूल सह अस्माभिर् गमिष्यसि
अद्भुतम् च धनू रत्नम् तत्र त्वम् द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: tvam caiva naraśārdūla saha asmābhir gamiṣyasi
adbhutam ca dhanū ratnam tatra tvam draṣṭum arhasi
english: And you, O tiger among men, men, must accompany us, and there behold a wonderful jewel of a bow.

sanskrit: तद्धि पूर्वम् नरश्रेष्ठ दत्तम् सदसि दैवतैः
अप्रमेय बलम् घोरम् मखे परम भास्वरम्
transliteration: taddhi pūrvam naraśreṣṭha dattam sadasi daivataiḥ
aprameya balam ghoram makhe parama bhāsvaram
english: And formerly this bow of immeasurable energy, and dreadful, and exceedingly effulgent at the sacrifice, had been conferred in court by the celestials (on king Devarata.)8

sanskrit: न अस्य देवा न गंधर्वा न असुरा न च राक्षसाः
कर्तुम् आरोपणम् शक्ता न कथंचन मानुषाः
transliteration: na asya devā na gaṃdharvā na asurā na ca rākṣasāḥ
kartum āropaṇam śaktā na kathaṃcana mānuṣāḥ
english: And neither gods nor Gandharvas, neither Asuras nor Rākşasas nor men, can fix the string upon it.

sanskrit: धनुषस्य तस्य वीर्यम् हि जिज्ञासन्तो महीक्षितः
transliteration: dhanuṣasya tasya vīryam hi jijñāsanto mahīkṣitaḥ
english: And desirous of being acquainted with the prowess of this bow, many kings and princes came; but they in spite of their mighty strength, failed in stringing it.

sanskrit: तत्र द्रक्ष्यसि काकुत्स्थ यज्ञम् च परम अद्भुतम्
transliteration: tatra drakṣyasi kākutstha yajñam ca parama adbhutam
english: There, O Kākutstha, you will behold that bow belonging to the high-souled king of Mithila, as well as his exceedingly wonderful sacrifice..

sanskrit: तद्धि यज्ञ फलम् तेन मैथिलेन उत्तमम् धनुः
याचितम् नर शार्दूल सुनाभम् सर्व दैवतैः
transliteration: taddhi yajña phalam tena maithilena uttamam dhanuḥ
yācitam nara śārdūla sunābham sarva daivataiḥ
english: That rare bow, O foremost of men, furnished with an excellent device for griping it, had been solicited by Mithila's lord as the fruit of his sacrifice; and the celestials conferred it upon him.

sanskrit: अर्चितम् विविधैः गन्धैः धूपैः च अगुरु गंध्भिः
transliteration: arcitam vividhaiḥ gandhaiḥ dhūpaiḥ ca aguru gaṃdhbhiḥ
english: Now, O descendant of Raghu, in the residence of the king, the bow is worshipped like a deity with agaru dhüpa, and various other incenses.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा मुनिवरः प्रस्थानम् अकरोत् तदा
स ऋषि संघः स काकुत्स्थ आमंत्र्य वन देवताः
transliteration: evam uktvā munivaraḥ prasthānam akarot tadā
sa ṛṣi saṃghaḥ sa kākutstha āmaṃtrya vana devatāḥ
english: This having been said, that foremost of ascetics, in company with Kākutstha and the saints, departed.

sanskrit: स्वस्ति वो अस्तु गमिष्यामि सिद्धः सिद्ध आश्रमात् अहम्
transliteration: svasti vo astu gamiṣyāmi siddhaḥ siddha āśramāt aham
english: And on the eve of setting out, he addressed the sylvan deities, saying, Luck! I will, with my desire obtained, go from forth this Siddhāśrama to the Himavat mountain on the north of the Jahnavi.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलः कौशिकः स तपोधनः
transliteration: iti uktvā muniśārdūlaḥ kauśikaḥ sa tapodhanaḥ
english: Having said this, that tiger-like ascetic, Kusika's son, along with other anchorets having asceticism for their wealth, set out in a northerly direction.

sanskrit: शकटी शत मात्रम् तु प्रयाणे ब्रह्म वादिनाम्
transliteration: śakaṭī śata mātram tu prayāṇe brahma vādinām
english: And as that best of ascetics proceeded, he was followed by Brāhmaṇas, unholding the Veda, carrying the sacrificial necessaries on an hundred cars.

sanskrit: मृग पक्षि गणाः चैव सिद्ध आश्रम निवासिनः
transliteration: mṛga pakṣi gaṇāḥ caiva siddha āśrama nivāsinaḥ
english: And birds and beasts dwelling in Siddhāśrama followed the high-souled Viśvāmitra having asceticism for wealth.

sanskrit: निवर्तयामास ततः स ऋसि सन्घः स पक्षिणः
ते गत्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् लम्बमाने दिवाकरे
transliteration: nivartayāmāsa tataḥ sa ṛsi sanghaḥ sa pakṣiṇaḥ
te gatvā dūram adhvānam lambamāne divākare

sanskrit: वासम् चक्रुर् मुनि गणाः शोणा कूले समाहिताः
ते अस्तम् गते दिनकरे स्नात्वा हुत हुताशनाः
transliteration: vāsam cakrur muni gaṇāḥ śoṇā kūle samāhitāḥ
te astam gate dinakare snātvā huta hutāśanāḥ

sanskrit: रामो अपि सह सौमित्रिः मुनीम् तान् अभिपूज्य च
transliteration: rāmo api saha saumitriḥ munīm tān abhipūjya ca

sanskrit: भगवन् कः नु अयम् देशः समृद्ध वन शोभितः
transliteration: bhagavan kaḥ nu ayam deśaḥ samṛddha vana śobhitaḥ
english: Then Rama of exceeding energy, influenced by curiosity, asked that foremost of ascetics, Viśvāmitra, having asceticism for his wealth, saying, 'O worshipful one, what country is this, graced with luxuriant woods? I am desirous of hearing this Good betide you, it behove you to tell me this truly.

sanskrit: श्रोतुम् इच्छामि भद्रम् ते वक्तुम् अर्हसि तत्त्वतः
तस्य देशस्य निखिलम् ऋषि मध्ये महातपाः
transliteration: śrotum icchāmi bhadram te vaktum arhasi tattvataḥ
tasya deśasya nikhilam ṛṣi madhye mahātapāḥ
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, that one of high austerities and excellent vows began in the midst of the saints to describe the opulence of that region.

sanskrit: ब्रह्म योनिर् महान् आसीत् कुशो नाम महातपाः
अक्लिष्ट व्रत धर्मज्ञः सज्जन प्रति पूजकः
transliteration: brahma yonir mahān āsīt kuśo nāma mahātapāḥ
akliṣṭa vrata dharmajñaḥ sajjana prati pūjakaḥ
english: Once upon a time there was a mighty son of Brahmā, of high austerities, named Kusa. And he was cognizant of duty, and ever engaged in observing vows and honouring good men.

sanskrit: वैदर्भ्याम् जनयाम् आस चतुरः सदृशान् सुतान्
transliteration: vaidarbhyām janayām āsa caturaḥ sadṛśān sutān

sanskrit: तान् उवाच कुशः पुत्रान् धर्मिष्ठान् सत्यवादिनः
क्रियताम् पालनम् पुत्रा धर्म प्राप्यथ पुष्कलम्
transliteration: tān uvāca kuśaḥ putrān dharmiṣṭhān satyavādinaḥ
kriyatām pālanam putrā dharma prāpyatha puṣkalam

sanskrit: कुशस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा चत्वारो लोक सत्तमाः
निवेशम् चक्रिरे सर्वे पुराणाम् नृ वराः तदा
transliteration: kuśasya vacanam śrutvā catvāro loka sattamāḥ
niveśam cakrire sarve purāṇām nṛ varāḥ tadā

sanskrit: कुशाम्बः तु महातेजाः कौशांबीम् अकरोत् पुरीम्
कुशनाभः तु धर्मात्मा पुरम् चक्रे महोदयम्
transliteration: kuśāmbaḥ tu mahātejāḥ kauśāṃbīm akarot purīm
kuśanābhaḥ tu dharmātmā puram cakre mahodayam

sanskrit: चक्रे पुरवरम् राजा वसुर् नाम गिरिव्रजम्
transliteration: cakre puravaram rājā vasur nāma girivrajam

sanskrit: एषा वसुमती नाम वसोः तस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: eṣā vasumatī nāma vasoḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ
english: This city (otherwise) called Vasumatī belongs to the high-souled Vasu. And the river known by the name of Sumāgadhi flows through the Māgadhas. And in the midst of the five foremost of hills, it looks like a garland.

sanskrit: सुमागधी नदी रम्या मागधान् विश्रुता आययौ
पंचानाम् शैल मुख्यानाम् मध्ये माला इव शोभते
transliteration: sumāgadhī nadī ramyā māgadhān viśrutā āyayau
paṃcānām śaila mukhyānām madhye mālā iva śobhate
english: This city (otherwise) called Vasumatī belongs to the high-souled Vasu. And the river known by the name of Sumāgadhi flows through the Māgadhas. And in the midst of the five foremost of hills, it looks like a garland.

sanskrit: सा एषा हि मागधी राम वसोः तस्य महात्मनः
पूर्व अभिचरिता राम सुक्षेत्रा सस्य मालिनी
transliteration: sā eṣā hi māgadhī rāma vasoḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ
pūrva abhicaritā rāma sukṣetrā sasya mālinī
english: And this Mägadhi, O Råma, belongs to the high-souled Vasu, taking, O Rāma, an easterly course, and flowing through fertile fields furnished with corn.

sanskrit: कुशनाभः तु राजर्षिः कन्या शतम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: kuśanābhaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ kanyā śatam anuttamam
english: O descendant of Raghu, the Rājarși Kusanābha beget an hundred godly daughters on Ghrtaci.

sanskrit: ताः तु यौवन शालिन्यो रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः
उद्यान भूमिम् आगम्य प्रावृषि इव शतह्रदाः
transliteration: tāḥ tu yauvana śālinyo rūpavatyaḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ
udyāna bhūmim āgamya prāvṛṣi iva śatahradāḥ

sanskrit: गायंत्यो नृत्यमानाः च वादयंत्यः च राघव
आमोदम् परमम् जग्मुर् वर आभरण भूषिताः
transliteration: gāyaṃtyo nṛtyamānāḥ ca vādayaṃtyaḥ ca rāghava
āmodam paramam jagmur vara ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ

sanskrit: अथ ताः चारु सर्व अंग्यो रूपेण अप्रतिमा भुवि
उद्यान भूमिम् आगम्य तारा इव घन अन्तरे
transliteration: atha tāḥ cāru sarva aṃgyo rūpeṇa apratimā bhuvi
udyāna bhūmim āgamya tārā iva ghana antare

sanskrit: ताः सर्वगुण संपन्ना रूप यौवन संयुताः
दृष्ट्वा सर्वात्मको वायुर् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tāḥ sarvaguṇa saṃpannā rūpa yauvana saṃyutāḥ
dṛṣṭvā sarvātmako vāyur idam vacanam abravīt

sanskrit: अहम् वः कामये सर्वा भार्या मम भविष्यथ
मानुषः त्यज्यताम् भावो दीर्घम् आयुर् अवाप्स्यथ
transliteration: aham vaḥ kāmaye sarvā bhāryā mama bhaviṣyatha
mānuṣaḥ tyajyatām bhāvo dīrgham āyur avāpsyatha
english: I seek for you: do you become my wives. Do you renounce this human guise, and attain long lives.

sanskrit: चलम् हि यौवनम् नित्यम् मानुषेषु विशेषतः
अक्षयम् यौवनम् प्राप्ता अमर्यः च भविष्य्थ
transliteration: calam hi yauvanam nityam mānuṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ
akṣayam yauvanam prāptā amaryaḥ ca bhaviṣytha
english: Youth verily is unstable, specially with the human beings: do you attaining unfading youth, become immortal!

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा वायोः अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः
अपहास्य ततो वाक्यम् कन्या शतम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā vāyoḥ akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ
apahāsya tato vākyam kanyā śatam atha abravīt
english: Hearing this speech of the Air of ever fresh energy, the damsels ridiculing it, said.

sanskrit: अन्तः चरसि भूतानाम् सर्वेषाम् त्वम् सुर सत्तम
प्रभावज्ञाः च ते सर्वाः किम् अर्थम् अवमन्यसे
transliteration: antaḥ carasi bhūtānām sarveṣām tvam sura sattama
prabhāvajñāḥ ca te sarvāḥ kim artham avamanyase
english: You range the hearts of all creatures, O foremost of celestials, and we also know your influence. Wherefore, then, do you dishonour us?

sanskrit: कुशनाभ सुताः देवम् समस्ता सुर सत्तम
स्थानात् च्यावयितुम् देवम् रक्षामः तु तपो वयम्
transliteration: kuśanābha sutāḥ devam samastā sura sattama
sthānāt cyāvayitum devam rakṣāmaḥ tu tapo vayam
english: O foremost of celestials, we are the daughters of Kušanābha O divine one. And god as you are, we can dislodge you from your place; but we refrain from doing so, lest thereby we lose our ascetic merit.

sanskrit: मा भूत् स कालो दुर्मेधः पितरम् सत्य वादिनम्
अवमन्यस्व स्व धर्मेण स्वयम् वरम् उपास्महे
transliteration: mā bhūt sa kālo durmedhaḥ pitaram satya vādinam
avamanyasva sva dharmeṇa svayam varam upāsmahe
english: May, O foolish one, that time never come, when disregarding our truthful sire, we following our inclination, shall resort to self choice.

sanskrit: पिता हि प्रभुर् अस्माकम् दैवतम् परमम् च सः
यस्य नो दास्यति पिता स नो भर्ता भविष्यति
transliteration: pitā hi prabhur asmākam daivatam paramam ca saḥ
yasya no dāsyati pitā sa no bhartā bhaviṣyati
english: Our father verily is our lord an prime god. Of him even shall we become the wives to whom our father give us away.

sanskrit: तासाम् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरिः परम कोपनः
प्रविश्य सर्व गात्राणि बभंज भगवान् प्रभुः
transliteration: tāsām tu vacanam śrutvā hariḥ parama kopanaḥ
praviśya sarva gātrāṇi babhaṃja bhagavān prabhuḥ
english: At these words of theirs, that lord and adorable one, the Air, exceedingly enraged, then entered into their bodies, and brake all their limbs. Their bodies being thus broken by Air, those damsels, exceedingly agitated and overwhelmed with shame, with tears in their eyes entered the residence of the king.

sanskrit: ताः कन्या वायुना भग्ना विविशुर् नृपतेः गृहम्
प्रविश्य च सुसंभ्रान्ताः स लज्जाः स अस्र लोचन
transliteration: tāḥ kanyā vāyunā bhagnā viviśur nṛpateḥ gṛham
praviśya ca susaṃbhrāntāḥ sa lajjāḥ sa asra locana
english: At these words of theirs, that lord and adorable one, the Air, exceedingly enraged, then entered into their bodies, and brake all their limbs. Their bodies being thus broken by Air, those damsels, exceedingly agitated and overwhelmed with shame, with tears in their eyes entered the residence of the king.

sanskrit: स च ता दयिता भग्नाः कन्याः परम शोभनाः
दृष्ट्वा दीनाः तदा राजा संभ्रांत इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa ca tā dayitā bhagnāḥ kanyāḥ parama śobhanāḥ
dṛṣṭvā dīnāḥ tadā rājā saṃbhrāṃta idam abravīt
english: And finding his supremely beautiful and favourite daughters with their limbs broken, and woebegone, the king bewildered, spoke.

sanskrit: किम् इदम् कथ्यताम् पुत्र्यः को धर्मम् अवमन्यते
कुब्जाः केन कृताः सर्वाः चेष्टन्त्यो न अभिभाषथ
एवम् राजा विनिःश्वस्य समाधिम् संदधे ततः
transliteration: kim idam kathyatām putryaḥ ko dharmam avamanyate
kubjāḥ kena kṛtāḥ sarvāḥ ceṣṭantyo na abhibhāṣatha
evam rājā viniḥśvasya samādhim saṃdadhe tataḥ
english: You daughters, what is this? Who is it that thus disregards virtue? By whom have you all come by this crooked form? And why demonstrating your grief, do you not answer me?' Having said this, the king heaved a deep sigh and became eager to hear all about it.

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा कुशनाभस्य धीमतः
शिरोभिः चरणौ स्पृष्ट्वा कन्या शतम् अभाषत
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ
śirobhiḥ caraṇau spṛṣṭvā kanyā śatam abhāṣata
english: Hearing those words of the intelligent Kusanābha, his hundred daughters touching his feet with their heads, said,

sanskrit: अशुभम् मार्गम् आस्थाय न धर्मम् प्रत्यवेक्षते
transliteration: aśubham mārgam āsthāya na dharmam pratyavekṣate
english: O king, that life of all, the Air, was desirous of overcoming us, having recourse to an improper way; nor did he regard morality.

sanskrit: पितृमत्यः स्म भद्रम् ते स्वच्छन्दे न वयम् स्थिताः
पितरम् नो वृणीष्व त्वम् यदि नो दास्यते तव
transliteration: pitṛmatyaḥ sma bhadram te svacchande na vayam sthitāḥ
pitaram no vṛṇīṣva tvam yadi no dāsyate tava
english: We have a father, good betide you; and we live at ease. Do you ask our father about it, if he consent conferring us on you.

sanskrit: तेन पाप अनुबन्धेन वचनम् न प्रतीच्छता
एवम् ब्रुवंत्यः सर्वाः स्म वायुना अभिहता भृषम्
transliteration: tena pāpa anubandhena vacanam na pratīcchatā
evam bruvaṃtyaḥ sarvāḥ sma vāyunā abhihatā bhṛṣam
english: But that wicked wight did not listen to our words; and as we were saying this, were we roughly handled by him.'

sanskrit: तासाम् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजा परम धार्मिकः
transliteration: tāsām tu vacanam śrutvā rājā parama dhārmikaḥ
english: Hearing those words of theirs, the highly pious and puissant king addressed his hundred beautiful daughters, saying

sanskrit: क्षान्तम् क्षमावताम् पुत्र्यः कर्तव्यम् सुमहत् कृतम्
ऐकमत्यम् उपागम्य कुलम् च आवेक्षितम् मम
transliteration: kṣāntam kṣamāvatām putryaḥ kartavyam sumahat kṛtam
aikamatyam upāgamya kulam ca āvekṣitam mama
english: You have displayed a signal example of that forgiveness which is fit to be followed by the forbearing; and that you have unanimously regarded the honour of my house, also conduces to your praise.

sanskrit: अलंकारो हि नारीणाम् क्षमा तु पुरुषस्य वा
दुष्करम् तत् च वै क्षान्तम् त्रिदशेषु विशेषतः
transliteration: alaṃkāro hi nārīṇām kṣamā tu puruṣasya vā
duṣkaram tat ca vai kṣāntam tridaśeṣu viśeṣataḥ
english: Alike to men and women, forbearance is an ornament. And difficult it is for one to exercise that forbearance, specially in respect of the celestials. And may every descendant of mine possess forbearance like to yours!

sanskrit: यादृशीः वः क्षमा पुत्र्यः सर्वासाम् अविशेषतः
क्षमा दानम् क्षमा सत्यम् क्षमा यज्ञः च पुत्रिकाः
transliteration: yādṛśīḥ vaḥ kṣamā putryaḥ sarvāsām aviśeṣataḥ
kṣamā dānam kṣamā satyam kṣamā yajñaḥ ca putrikāḥ

sanskrit: क्षमा यशः क्षमा धर्मः क्षमायाम् विष्ठितम् जगत्
विसृज्य कन्याः काकुत्स्थ राजा त्रिदश विक्रमः
transliteration: kṣamā yaśaḥ kṣamā dharmaḥ kṣamāyām viṣṭhitam jagat
visṛjya kanyāḥ kākutstha rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ

sanskrit: देशे काले च कर्तव्यम् सदृशे प्रतिपादनम्
transliteration: deśe kāle ca kartavyam sadṛśe pratipādanam
english: Then dismissing his daughters, the king endowed with the prowess of celestials, and versed in counsel, began to consult with his counsellors about the bestowal of his daughters, in respect of time and place and person and equability of lineage.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु चूली नाम महाद्युतिः
ऊर्ध्व रेताः शुभाचारो ब्राह्मम् तप उपागमत्
transliteration: etasmin eva kāle tu cūlī nāma mahādyutiḥ
ūrdhva retāḥ śubhācāro brāhmam tapa upāgamat
english: It came to pass that at this time, an ascetic named Culi, highly effulgent, with his vital fluid under control, and of pure practices, was performing Brāhma austerities.

sanskrit: सोमदा नाम भद्रम् ते ऊर्मिला तनया तदा
transliteration: somadā nāma bhadram te ūrmilā tanayā tadā
english: And as the saint was engaged in austerities, good betide you, Urmila's daughter named Somada-a Gandharvi-ministered to him.

sanskrit: सा च तम् प्रणता भूत्वा शुश्रूषण परायणा
उवास काले धर्मिष्ठा तस्याः तुष्टो अभवत् गुरुः
transliteration: sā ca tam praṇatā bhūtvā śuśrūṣaṇa parāyaṇā
uvāsa kāle dharmiṣṭhā tasyāḥ tuṣṭo abhavat guruḥ
english: And in all humility that virtuous one for a definite period was engaged in ministering to him. And thereat, her spiritual guide was gratified with her.

sanskrit: स च ताम् काल योगेन प्रोवाच रघु नंदन
परितुष्टो अस्मि भद्रम् ते किम् करोमि तव प्रियम्
transliteration: sa ca tām kāla yogena provāca raghu naṃdana
parituṣṭo asmi bhadram te kim karomi tava priyam
english: And, O descendant of Raghu, once he said to her, I am gratified, good betide you! What good shall I render you?

sanskrit: परितुष्टम् मुनिम् ज्ञात्वा गन्धर्वी मधुर स्वरम्
उवाच परम प्रीता वाक्यज्ञा वाक्य कोविदम्
transliteration: parituṣṭam munim jñātvā gandharvī madhura svaram
uvāca parama prītā vākyajñā vākya kovidam
english: Thereupon, concluding that the ascetic was gratified, the Gandharvi, cognizant of words, exceedingly delighted, sweetly addressed that one versed in speech.

sanskrit: लक्ष्म्या समुदितो ब्राह्म्या ब्रह्म भूतो महातपाः
ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तम् पुत्रम् इच्छामि धार्मिकम्
transliteration: lakṣmyā samudito brāhmyā brahma bhūto mahātapāḥ
brāhmeṇa tapasā yuktam putram icchāmi dhārmikam
english: You are furnished with the Brāhma marks, art sprung from Brahmă, and art of mighty austerities. I desire of you a righteous son endowed with the Brāhma ascetic virtues.

sanskrit: अपतिः च अस्मि भद्रम् ते भार्या च अस्मि न कस्यचित्
ब्राह्मेण उपगतायाः च दातुम् अर्हसि मे सुतम्
transliteration: apatiḥ ca asmi bhadram te bhāryā ca asmi na kasyacit
brāhmeṇa upagatāyāḥ ca dātum arhasi me sutam
english: I am without a husband, good betide you, and I am no one's wife. Upon me who is your servant you should confer such a son by help of Brāhma means.

sanskrit: तस्याः प्रसन्नो ब्रह्मर्षिर् ददौ ब्राह्मम् अनुत्तमम्
ब्रह्मदत्त इति ख्यातम् मानसम् चूलिनः सुतम्
transliteration: tasyāḥ prasanno brahmarṣir dadau brāhmam anuttamam
brahmadatta iti khyātam mānasam cūlinaḥ sutam
english: Thereupon, well pleased with her, Cūlina conferred upon her an excellent Brāhma mindbegotten son, named Brahmadatta,

sanskrit: स राजा ब्रह्मदत्तः तु पुरीम् अध्यवसत् तदा
कांपिल्याम् परया लक्ष्म्या देवराजो यथा दिवम्
transliteration: sa rājā brahmadattaḥ tu purīm adhyavasat tadā
kāṃpilyām parayā lakṣmyā devarājo yathā divam
english: And that king, Brahmadatta, founded the flourishing city of Kampilya, even as the sovereign of the celestials founded the celestial regions.

sanskrit: स बुद्धिम् कृतवान् राजा कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः
ब्रह्मदत्ताय काकुत्स्थ दातुम् कन्या शतम् तदा
transliteration: sa buddhim kṛtavān rājā kuśanābhaḥ sudhārmikaḥ
brahmadattāya kākutstha dātum kanyā śatam tadā
english: And, O Kākutstha, the righteous king Kusanābha finally decided on conferring his hundred daughters upon Brahmadatta.

sanskrit: ददौ कन्या शतम् राजा सुप्रीतेन अंतरात्मना
transliteration: dadau kanyā śatam rājā suprītena aṃtarātmanā
english: And inviting Brahmadatta, that highly energetic lord of earth, with a glad heart conferred his hundred daughters upon him.

sanskrit: यथा क्रमम् ततः पाणिम् जग्राह रघुनंदन
transliteration: yathā kramam tataḥ pāṇim jagrāha raghunaṃdana
english: And O descendant of Raghu, king Brahmadatta resembling the lord himself of the celestials, by turns received their hands in marriage.

sanskrit: स्पृष्ट मात्रे ततः पाणौ विकुब्जा विगत ज्वराः
युक्ताः परमया लक्ष्म्या बभौ कन्या शतम् तदा
transliteration: spṛṣṭa mātre tataḥ pāṇau vikubjā vigata jvarāḥ
yuktāḥ paramayā lakṣmyā babhau kanyā śatam tadā
english: And as soon as he touched them, the hundred daughters were cured of their crookedness, and became free from anguish, and were endowed with pre-eminent beauty.

sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा वायुना मुक्ताः कुशनाभो महीपतिः
बभूव परम प्रीतो हर्षम् लेभे पुनः पुनः
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā vāyunā muktāḥ kuśanābho mahīpatiḥ
babhūva parama prīto harṣam lebhe punaḥ punaḥ
english: And upon beholding them delivered from (the tyranny of) the Air, the monarch Kušanābha became exceedingly delighted, and rejoiced again and again.

sanskrit: कृत उद्वाहम् तु राजानम् ब्रह्मदत्तम् महीपतिः
सदारम् प्रेषयामास स उपाध्याय गणम् तदा
transliteration: kṛta udvāham tu rājānam brahmadattam mahīpatiḥ
sadāram preṣayāmāsa sa upādhyāya gaṇam tadā
english: And he dismissed that lord of earth, king Brahmadatta, in company with his consorts and the priests.

sanskrit: सोमदा अपि सुतम् दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्य सदृशीम् क्रियाम्
यथा न्यायम् च गन्धर्वी स्नुषाः ताः प्रत्यनंदत
स्पृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा च ताः कन्याः कुशनाभम् प्रशस्य च
transliteration: somadā api sutam dṛṣṭvā putrasya sadṛśīm kriyām
yathā nyāyam ca gandharvī snuṣāḥ tāḥ pratyanaṃdata
spṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca tāḥ kanyāḥ kuśanābham praśasya ca

sanskrit: कृत उद्वाहे गते तस्मिन् ब्रह्मदत्ते च राघव
अपुत्रः पुत्र लाभाय पौत्रीम् इष्टिम् अकल्पयत्
transliteration: kṛta udvāhe gate tasmin brahmadatte ca rāghava
aputraḥ putra lābhāya pautrīm iṣṭim akalpayat
english: And, O Raghava, when Brahmadatta was married, that sonless one, (Kušanābha), with the intention of obtaining male offspring, took in hand a son-conferring sacrifice.
And when the sacrifice had commenced, that son of Brahmā, the exceedingly noble Kusa, spoke to king Kusanābha, saying,

sanskrit: पुत्रः ते सदृशः पुत्र भविष्यति सुधार्मिकः
गाधिम् प्राप्स्यसि तेन त्वम् कीर्तिम् लोके च शाश्वतीम्
transliteration: putraḥ te sadṛśaḥ putra bhaviṣyati sudhārmikaḥ
gādhim prāpsyasi tena tvam kīrtim loke ca śāśvatīm
english: O son, there will be born to you a virtuous son like to thyself: you will obtain even Gādhi, and through him enduring fame in this world.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा कुशो राम कुशनाभम् महीपतिम्
जगाम आकाशम् आविश्य ब्रह्म लोकम् सनातनम्
transliteration: evam uktvā kuśo rāma kuśanābham mahīpatim
jagāma ākāśam āviśya brahma lokam sanātanam
english: Having said this to king Kusanabha, Kusa, O Rāma, entering the welkin, went to the eternal regions of Brahmā.

sanskrit: कस्यचित् तु अथ कालस्य कुशनाभस्य धीमतः
जज्ञे परम धर्मिष्ठो गाधिः इति एव नामतः
transliteration: kasyacit tu atha kālasya kuśanābhasya dhīmataḥ
jajñe parama dharmiṣṭho gādhiḥ iti eva nāmataḥ
english: Then after sometime, an eminently virtuous son, named Gadhi, was born to the intelligent Kusanabha.

sanskrit: स पिता मम काकुत्स्थ गाधिः परम धार्मिकः
कुश वंश प्रसूतो अस्मि कौशिको रघुनंदन
transliteration: sa pitā mama kākutstha gādhiḥ parama dhārmikaḥ
kuśa vaṃśa prasūto asmi kauśiko raghunaṃdana
english: O Kākutstha, even that highly pious Gadhi is my sire. And, O descendant of Raghu, I, called Kausika, am sprung from Kusa's line.

sanskrit: पूर्वजा भगिनी च अपि मम राघव सुव्रता
transliteration: pūrvajā bhaginī ca api mama rāghava suvratā
english: O Rāghava, I had a sister of noble vows born before me. And her name was Satyavatī; and she was bestowed upon Rcīkā.
And following her lord, she ascended heaven in her own proper person. And my highly generous sister, Kausikī, has finally assumed the form of a mighty river.

sanskrit: दिव्या पुण्य उदका रम्या हिमवंतम् उपाश्रिता
लोकस्य हितकार्य अर्थम् प्रवृत्ता भगिनी मम
transliteration: divyā puṇya udakā ramyā himavaṃtam upāśritā
lokasya hitakārya artham pravṛttā bhaginī mama
english: And in order to compass the welfare of all creatures, my sister is now a noble and charming river of sacred waters, issuing from the Himavat mountains.

sanskrit: ततो अहम् हिमवत् पार्श्वे वसामि नियतः सुखम्
transliteration: tato aham himavat pārśve vasāmi niyataḥ sukham
english: And thenceforth, out of affection for my sister, Kausiki, I ever dwell happily in the vicinity of the Himavat, O Raghava.

sanskrit: सा तु सत्यवती पुण्या सत्ये धर्मे प्रतिष्ठिता
transliteration: sā tu satyavatī puṇyā satye dharme pratiṣṭhitā
english: And that virtuous Kausiki, Satyavati, as well established in religion as truth, and chaste, and eminently pious, is now the foremost of streams.

sanskrit: अहम् हि नियमात् राम हित्वा ताम् समुपागतः
सिद्ध आश्रमम् अनुप्राप्तः सिद्धो अस्मि तव तेजसा
transliteration: aham hi niyamāt rāma hitvā tām samupāgataḥ
siddha āśramam anuprāptaḥ siddho asmi tava tejasā
english: And, O Rama, it is only for the purpose of completing my sacrifice that leaving her behind, I have come to Siddhāśrama. And now by virtue of your energy, have I attained fruition.

sanskrit: एषा राम मम उत्पत्तिः स्वस्य वंशस्य कीर्तिता
देशस्य च महाबाहो यन् माम् त्वम् परिपृच्छसि
transliteration: eṣā rāma mama utpattiḥ svasya vaṃśasya kīrtitā
deśasya ca mahābāho yan mām tvam paripṛcchasi
english: Now, O Rāma, I have narrated to you the circumstances connected with the history of my line and myself, as also of this place, O mightyarmed one, which you had asked me to relate.

sanskrit: गतो अर्ध रात्रः काकुत्स्थ कथाः कथयतो मम
निद्राम् अभ्येहि भद्रम् ते मा भूत् विघ्नो अध्वनि इह नः
transliteration: gato ardha rātraḥ kākutstha kathāḥ kathayato mama
nidrām abhyehi bhadram te mā bhūt vighno adhvani iha naḥ
english: But, O Kākutstha, while I was speaking, half the night has been spent. Do you now sleep, good betide you, so that you may not feel any difficulty while on the journey.

sanskrit: निष्पन्दाः तरवः सर्वे निलीना मृग पक्षिणः
नैशेन तमसा व्याप्ता दिशः च रघुनंदन
transliteration: niṣpandāḥ taravaḥ sarve nilīnā mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ
naiśena tamasā vyāptā diśaḥ ca raghunaṃdana
english: The trees stand motionless, and the beasts and birds are silent, and, O descendant of Raghu, all sides have become enveloped in nocturnal gloom.

sanskrit: शनैः विसृज्यते संध्या नभो नेत्रैः इव आवृतम्
transliteration: śanaiḥ visṛjyate saṃdhyā nabho netraiḥ iva āvṛtam
english: The noon of night is gradually passing away; and the firmament thick-studded with stars resembling eyes, is illumined up with their light.

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठते च शीतांशुः शशी लोक तमो नुदः
ह्लादयन् प्राणिनाम् लोके मनांसि प्रभया स्वया
transliteration: uttiṣṭhate ca śītāṃśuḥ śaśī loka tamo nudaḥ
hlādayan prāṇinām loke manāṃsi prabhayā svayā
english: And that dispeller of darkness, the mildbeaming moon is rising, gladdening the hearts of all creatures with his splendour.

sanskrit: नैशानि सर्व भूतानि प्रचरंति ततः ततः
यक्ष राक्षस संघाः च रौद्राः च पिशित अशनाः
transliteration: naiśāni sarva bhūtāni pracaraṃti tataḥ tataḥ
yakṣa rākṣasa saṃghāḥ ca raudrāḥ ca piśita aśanāḥ
english: And night-ranging being terrible carnivorous Yaksas and Rākşasas—walk here and there,

sanskrit: साधु साधु इति ते सर्वे मुनयो हि अभ्यपूजयन्
transliteration: sādhu sādhu iti te sarve munayo hi abhyapūjayan
english: Having said this the mighty ascetic of exceeding energy paused. And those ascetics honouring him, said, Excellent! Excellent!

sanskrit: कुशिकनाम् अयम् वंशो महान् धर्मपरः सदा
transliteration: kuśikanām ayam vaṃśo mahān dharmaparaḥ sadā
english: This line belonging to the Kuśikas is exalted and devoted to virtue. And those foremost of men sprung in the Kuśa race are high-souled and like to Brahmarsis.

sanskrit: कौशिकी सरिताम् श्रेष्ठः कुल उद्योतकरी तव
transliteration: kauśikī saritām śreṣṭhaḥ kula udyotakarī tava
english: And specially you, O illustrious Viśvāmitra, art so. And that best of streams, Kausiki, has added lustre to your lien.

sanskrit: मुदितैः मुनि शार्दूलैः प्रशस्तः कुशिक आत्मजः
निद्राम् उपागमत् श्रीमान् अस्तम् गत इव अंशुमान्
transliteration: muditaiḥ muni śārdūlaiḥ praśastaḥ kuśika ātmajaḥ
nidrām upāgamat śrīmān astam gata iva aṃśumān
english: And the auspicious son of Kuśika having been extolled by those delighted ascetic, the foremost of their order-slept, like to the sun, when setting

sanskrit: रामो अपि सह सौमित्रिः किंचित् आगत विस्मयः
transliteration: rāmo api saha saumitriḥ kiṃcit āgata vismayaḥ
english: Rāma too along with Sumitrā's son having in admiration praised that tiger among ascetics, enjoyed the luxury of slumber.

sanskrit: उपास्य रात्रि शेषम् तु शोणा कूले महर्षिभिः
transliteration: upāsya rātri śeṣam tu śoṇā kūle maharṣibhiḥ
english: HAVING in company with the ascetics passed the remainder of the night on the banks of the Sona, Visvāmitra, when the day broke, spoke,

sanskrit: सुप्रभाता निशा राम पूर्वा संध्या प्रवर्तते
उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ भद्रम् ते गमनाय अभिरोचय
transliteration: suprabhātā niśā rāma pūrvā saṃdhyā pravartate
uttiṣṭha uttiṣṭha bhadram te gamanāya abhirocaya
english: O Rāma, the night has passed away, and the morn has come. The hour for performing the prior devotions has arrived. Arise! arise! good betide you! Do you prepare for going.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य कृत्वा पौर्व आह्णिक क्रियः
गमनम् रोचयामास वाक्यम् च इदम् उवाच ह
transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya kṛtvā paurva āhṇika kriyaḥ
gamanam rocayāmāsa vākyam ca idam uvāca ha
english: Hearing these words of his, Rāma, having finished his morning devotions and rites, and ready for departure, said,

sanskrit: अयम् शोणः शुभ जलो गाधः पुलिन मण्डितः
transliteration: ayam śoṇaḥ śubha jalo gādhaḥ pulina maṇḍitaḥ
english: This is the Sona, of excellent waters, fathomless, and studded with islets. O Brāhmaṇa, by which way shall we repair

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण विश्वामित्रो अब्रवीत् इदम्
एष पंथा मया उद्दिष्टो येन यान्ति महर्षयः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa viśvāmitro abravīt idam
eṣa paṃthā mayā uddiṣṭo yena yānti maharṣayaḥ
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, Viśvāmitra replied. Even this path has been fixed upon by men, that, namely, by which the Maharșis go.

sanskrit: पश्यन्तः ते प्रयाता वै वनानि विविधानि च
transliteration: paśyantaḥ te prayātā vai vanāni vividhāni ca

sanskrit: ते गत्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् गते अर्ध दिवसे तदा
जाह्नवीम् सरिताम् श्रेष्ठाम् ददृशुर् मुनि सेविताम्
transliteration: te gatvā dūram adhvānam gate ardha divase tadā
jāhnavīm saritām śreṣṭhām dadṛśur muni sevitām
english: Having proceeded far, when the day had been half spent, they beheld that foremost of streams, the Jahnavi, worshipped by ascetics.

sanskrit: ताम् दृष्ट्वा पुण्य सलिलाम् हंस सारस सेविताम्
बभूवुर् मुनयः सर्वे मुदिता सह राघवाः
transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā puṇya salilām haṃsa sārasa sevitām
babhūvur munayaḥ sarve muditā saha rāghavāḥ
english: Having beheld that river furnished with sacred waters, and frequented by swans and cranes, the ascetics who accompanied Rāghava were exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit: तस्याः तीरे ततः चक्रुः ते आवास परिग्रहम्
ततः स्नात्वा यथा न्यायम् संतर्प्य पितृ देवताः
transliteration: tasyāḥ tīre tataḥ cakruḥ te āvāsa parigraham
tataḥ snātvā yathā nyāyam saṃtarpya pitṛ devatāḥ

sanskrit: हुत्वा चैव अग्निहोत्राणि प्राश्य च अमृतवत् हविः
विविशुर् जाह्नवी तीरे शुभा मुदित मानसाः
transliteration: hutvā caiva agnihotrāṇi prāśya ca amṛtavat haviḥ
viviśur jāhnavī tīre śubhā mudita mānasāḥ
english: And they took up their quarters on the banks of the river. And then having bathed and duly offered oblations of water to the gods and the manes of their ancestors, and performed Agnihotra* (Sacrifice with burnt offering.) sacrifices, and partaken of clarified butter like to nectar, those high-souled and auspicious ones, with glad hearts, sat down surrounding Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: विष्टिताः च यथा न्यायम् राघवो च यथा अर्हम्
संप्रहृष्ट मना रामो विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: viṣṭitāḥ ca yathā nyāyam rāghavo ca yathā arham
saṃprahṛṣṭa manā rāmo viśvāmitram atha abravīt
english: And the descendants of Raghu also sat down, occupying prominent places as befitted their rank. Then Rāma with a heart surcharged with cheerfulness spoke to Viśvāmitra, saying,

sanskrit: भगवन् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि गङ्गाम् त्रि पथ गाम् नदीम्
त्रैलोक्यम् कथम् आक्रम्य गता नद नदीपतिम्
transliteration: bhagavan śrotum icchāmi gaṅgām tri patha gām nadīm
trailokyam katham ākramya gatā nada nadīpatim
english: O adorable one, I desire to hear how the Gangă flowing in three directions and embracing the three worlds, falls into the lord of streams and rivers.

sanskrit: वृद्धिम् जन्म च गंगाया वक्तुम् एव उपचक्रमे
transliteration: vṛddhim janma ca gaṃgāyā vaktum eva upacakrame
english: Influenced by Rama's speech, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra entered upon the history of the Gangā's origin and progress.

sanskrit: शैलेन्द्रो हिमवान् राम धातूनाम् आकरो महान्
तस्य कन्या द्वयम् राम रूपेण अप्रतिमम् भुवि
transliteration: śailendro himavān rāma dhātūnām ākaro mahān
tasya kanyā dvayam rāma rūpeṇa apratimam bhuvi
english: O Rāma, that great mine of ore, Himavat is the foremost of mountains. To him were born two daughters, unparalleled on earth in loveliness.

sanskrit: या मेरु दुहिता राम तयोर् माता सुमध्यमा
नाम्ना मेना मनोज्ञा वै पत्नी हिमवतः प्रिया
transliteration: yā meru duhitā rāma tayor mātā sumadhyamā
nāmnā menā manojñā vai patnī himavataḥ priyā
english: O Rāma, their mother of dainty waist, the amiable daughter of Meru, named Menā, was the beloved wife of Himavat.

sanskrit: तस्याम् गंग इयम् अभवत् ज्येष्ठा हिमवतः सुता
उमा नाम द्वितीया अभूत् कन्या तस्य एव राघव
transliteration: tasyām gaṃga iyam abhavat jyeṣṭhā himavataḥ sutā
umā nāma dvitīyā abhūt kanyā tasya eva rāghava
english: She of whom was born Gangā the elder daughter of Himavat; and , O Raghava, a second daughter was also born to him, named Uma.

sanskrit: अथ ज्येष्ठाम् सुराः सर्वे देव कार्य चिकीर्षया
शैलेन्द्रम् वरयामासुः गंगाम् त्रि पथ गाम् नदीम्
transliteration: atha jyeṣṭhām surāḥ sarve deva kārya cikīrṣayā
śailendram varayāmāsuḥ gaṃgām tri patha gām nadīm

sanskrit: ददौ धर्मेण हिमवान् तनयाम् लोक पावनीम्
स्वच्छंद पथ गाम् गंगाम् त्रैलोक्य हित काम्यया
transliteration: dadau dharmeṇa himavān tanayām loka pāvanīm
svacchaṃda patha gām gaṃgām trailokya hita kāmyayā

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य त्रिलोक अर्थम् त्रिलोक हित कांक्षिणः
गंगाम् आदाय ते अगच्छन् कृतार्थेन अंतरात्मना
transliteration: pratigṛhya triloka artham triloka hita kāṃkṣiṇaḥ
gaṃgām ādāya te agacchan kṛtārthena aṃtarātmanā

sanskrit: या च अन्या शैल दुहिता कन्या आसीत् रघुनंदन
उग्रम् सुव्रतम् आस्थाय तपः तेपे तपोधना
transliteration: yā ca anyā śaila duhitā kanyā āsīt raghunaṃdana
ugram suvratam āsthāya tapaḥ tepe tapodhanā
english: The other daughter of the mountain, O descendant of Raghu, adopting a stern vow, began to carry on austerities, having asceticism for her wealth.

sanskrit: उग्रेण तपसा युक्ताम् ददौ शैलवरः सुताम्
transliteration: ugreṇa tapasā yuktām dadau śailavaraḥ sutām
english: And that best of mountains bestowed upon Rudra of unequalled form his daughter Uma, furnished with fiery asceticism and worshipped of the worlds.

sanskrit: एते ते शैल राजस्य सुते लोक नमस्कृते
गंगा च सरिताम् श्रेष्ठा उमादेवी च राघव
transliteration: ete te śaila rājasya sute loka namaskṛte
gaṃgā ca saritām śreṣṭhā umādevī ca rāghava
english: And these, O Rāghava, are the daughters of that king of mountains, worshipped of all, viz, Gangā, the foremost of streams, and the divine Uma.

sanskrit: एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् यथा त्रि पथ गामिनी
खम् गता प्रथमम् तात गतिम् गतिमताम् वर
transliteration: etat te sarvam ākhyātam yathā tri patha gāminī
kham gatā prathamam tāta gatim gatimatām vara
english: Now, O best of those endowed with motion, have I related to you how that sin-destroying one flowing with her waters in three diverse directions, first, O child, went to the firmament and then ascended the celestial regions.

sanskrit: स एषा सुर नदी रम्या शैलेन्द्र तनया तदा
सुर लोकम् समारूढा विपापा जल वाहिनी
transliteration: sa eṣā sura nadī ramyā śailendra tanayā tadā
sura lokam samārūḍhā vipāpā jala vāhinī
english: Now, O best of those endowed with motion, have I related to you how that sin-destroying one flowing with her waters in three diverse directions, first, O child, went to the firmament and then ascended the celestial regions.

sanskrit: उक्त वाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् उभौ राघव लक्ष्मणौ
प्रतिनंद्य कथाम् वीरौ ऊचतुः मुनि पुंगवम्
transliteration: ukta vākye munau tasmin ubhau rāghava lakṣmaṇau
pratinaṃdya kathām vīrau ūcatuḥ muni puṃgavam
english: When the ascetic had spoken thus, both the heroes, Rāma and Lakşmaņa, saluting that first of anchorites, said,

sanskrit: धर्म युक्तम् इदम् ब्रह्मन् कथितम् परमम् त्वया
दुहितुः शैल राजस्य ज्येष्ठाय वक्तुम् अर्हसि
विस्तरम् विस्तरज्ञो असि दिव्य मानुष संभवम्
transliteration: dharma yuktam idam brahman kathitam paramam tvayā
duhituḥ śaila rājasya jyeṣṭhāya vaktum arhasi
vistaram vistarajño asi divya mānuṣa saṃbhavam
english: O Brāhmaṇa, you have delivered this noble narration fraught with morality. Now it behoves you to speak about the elder daughter of the mountain-king. You are extensively conversant with everything relative to men or gods.

sanskrit: त्रीन् पथो हेतुना केन पावयेत् लोक पावनी
कथम् गङ्गा त्रिपथगा विश्रुता सरित् उत्तमा
transliteration: trīn patho hetunā kena pāvayet loka pāvanī
katham gaṅgā tripathagā viśrutā sarit uttamā
english: Why is it that purifier of the worlds lave three directions? And why is that foremost of streams, Gangā, famous as wending in three ways

sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु धर्मज्ञ कर्मभिः कैः समन्विता
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu dharmajña karmabhiḥ kaiḥ samanvitā
english: And, O you cognizant of morality, what are her performances in the three worlds? Thereat Viśvāmitra having asceticism for this wealth, began to relate to Käkutstha that history in detail in the midst of the ascetics.

sanskrit: निखिलेन कथाम् सर्वाम् ऋषि मध्ये न्यवेदयत्
पुरा राम कृत उद्वाहः शिति कण्ठो महा तपाः
transliteration: nikhilena kathām sarvām ṛṣi madhye nyavedayat
purā rāma kṛta udvāhaḥ śiti kaṇṭho mahā tapāḥ

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा च भगवान् देवीम् मैथुनाय उपचक्रमे
शितिकण्ठस्य देवस्य दिव्यम् वर्ष शतम् गतम्
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā ca bhagavān devīm maithunāya upacakrame
śitikaṇṭhasya devasya divyam varṣa śatam gatam
english: In days of yore, O Rāma, the blue-throated one of mighty asceticism, having entered into matrimony, commenced upon knowing the goddess. And as that intelligent blue-throated god, Mahadeva, was thus engaged in sport, a divine hundred years passed away.

sanskrit: न च अपि तनयो राम तस्याम् आसीत् परंतप
transliteration: na ca api tanayo rāma tasyām āsīt paraṃtapa
english: And yet, O Rāma, chastiser of foes, no son was born of her. Thereat all the gods with the Grand-sire at their head became exceedingly anxious.

sanskrit: यत् इह उत्पद्यते भूतम् कः तत् प्रतिसहिष्यति
अभिगम्य सुराः सर्वे प्रणिपत्य इदम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: yat iha utpadyate bhūtam kaḥ tat pratisahiṣyati
abhigamya surāḥ sarve praṇipatya idam abruvan
english: Who will be able to bear the offspring of this union? And thereupon the celestials repairing to Mahadeva, thus addressed him, saluting low,

sanskrit: देव देव महादेव लोकस्य अस्य हिते रत
transliteration: deva deva mahādeva lokasya asya hite rata
english: O god of gods! O mighty deity! ever engaged in the welfare of all, it behove you to be propitious at the humble salutations of the celestials.

sanskrit: न लोका धारयिष्यन्ति तव तेजः सुरोत्तम
ब्राह्मेण तपसा युक्तो देव्या सह तपः चर
transliteration: na lokā dhārayiṣyanti tava tejaḥ surottama
brāhmeṇa tapasā yukto devyā saha tapaḥ cara
english: The worlds, O foremost of celestials, are incapable of bearing your energy. Therefore, for the welfare of the three worlds, do you, being furnished with Brahmā asceticism, in company with the goddess practise austerities, and rein in your energy by your native indomitableness.

sanskrit: त्रैलोक्य हित काम अर्थम् तेजः तेजसि धारय
रक्ष सर्वान् इमान् लोकान् न अलोकम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: trailokya hita kāma artham tejaḥ tejasi dhāraya
rakṣa sarvān imān lokān na alokam kartum arhasi
english: Do you preserve these worlds; for it become you not to destroy all.'

sanskrit: देवतानाम् वचः श्रुत्वा सर्व लोक महेश्वरः
बाढम् इति अब्रवीत् सर्वान् पुनः च इदम् उवाच ह
transliteration: devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā sarva loka maheśvaraḥ
bāḍham iti abravīt sarvān punaḥ ca idam uvāca ha
english: Hearing the words of the deities, the great god of the worlds said to them, 'So be it!' And addressing them again he said,

sanskrit: धारयिष्यामि अहम् तेजः तेजसि एव सह उमया
transliteration: dhārayiṣyāmi aham tejaḥ tejasi eva saha umayā
english: You gods, by my own energy I will assisted by Uma bear my virile vigour, therefore let the creation find rest!

sanskrit: यद् इदम् क्षुभितम् स्थानात् मम तेजो हि अनुत्तमम्
धारयिष्यति कः तत् मे ब्रुवन्तु सुर सत्तमाः
transliteration: yad idam kṣubhitam sthānāt mama tejo hi anuttamam
dhārayiṣyati kaḥ tat me bruvantu sura sattamāḥ
english: But tell me, you foremost of celestials, who will sustain my potent virility rushing out from its receptacle?'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ताः ततो देवाः प्रत्यूचुर् वृषभ ध्वजम्
यत् तेजः क्षुभितम् हि अद्य तद् धरा धारयिष्यति
transliteration: evam uktāḥ tato devāḥ pratyūcur vṛṣabha dhvajam
yat tejaḥ kṣubhitam hi adya tad dharā dhārayiṣyati
english: Being thus addressed, the gods answered him having the bull for his mark, ‘The earth will today bear your vital flow.'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः सुर पतिः प्रमुमोच महाबलः
तेजसा पृथिवी येन व्याप्ता स गिरि कानना
transliteration: evam uktaḥ sura patiḥ pramumoca mahābalaḥ
tejasā pṛthivī yena vyāptā sa giri kānanā
english: Thus assured, the mighty lord of the celestials let go his vital fluid; and thereat the earth containing mountains and forests was overspread with the energy.

sanskrit: ततो देवाः पुनर् इदम् ऊचुः च अपि हुताशनम्
आविश त्वम् महातेजो रौद्रम् वायु समन्वितः
transliteration: tato devāḥ punar idam ūcuḥ ca api hutāśanam
āviśa tvam mahātejo raudram vāyu samanvitaḥ
english: Then the gods spoke to the Fire, saying, 'Do you in company with the Wind entrain to this fierce an mighty energy!'

sanskrit: तद् अग्निना पुनर् व्याप्तम् संजातम् श्वेत पर्वतम्
दिव्यम् शरवणम् चैव पावक आदित्य संनिभम्
transliteration: tad agninā punar vyāptam saṃjātam śveta parvatam
divyam śaravaṇam caiva pāvaka āditya saṃnibham
english: When the Wind had entered into it, it was developed into a white hill, and a forest of glossy reeds, resembling fire or the Sun.

sanskrit: यत्र जातो महातेजाः कार्तिकेयो अग्नि संभवः
अथ उमाम् च शिवम् चैव देवाः स ऋषि गणाः तदा
transliteration: yatra jāto mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo agni saṃbhavaḥ
atha umām ca śivam caiva devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ tadā
english: Here sprang from Fire Kārtikeya of mighty energy. And thereupon the celestials and the saints, with gratified hearts, began to pay enthusiastic adorations to Uma and Siva.

sanskrit: अथ शैल सुता राम त्रिदशान् इदम् अब्रवीत्
समन्युः अशपत् सर्वान् क्रोध संरक्त लोचना
यस्मात् निवारिता च अहम् संगता पुत्र काम्यया
transliteration: atha śaila sutā rāma tridaśān idam abravīt
samanyuḥ aśapat sarvān krodha saṃrakta locanā
yasmāt nivāritā ca aham saṃgatā putra kāmyayā
english: Then the Mountain's daughter, O Rama, addressed the celestials, cursing them with eyes reddened in wrath.

sanskrit: अपत्यम् स्वेषु दारेषु न उत्पदयितुम् अर्हथ
अद्य प्रभृति युष्माकम् अप्रजाः सन्तु पत्नयः
transliteration: apatyam sveṣu dāreṣu na utpadayitum arhatha
adya prabhṛti yuṣmākam aprajāḥ santu patnayaḥ
english: While in association with Mahadeva for obtaining sons, I was broken in upon by you, for this, you shall not be able yourselves to beget offspring on your wives. And from this day forth, your wives shall remain without issue.'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा सुरान् सर्वान् शशाप पृथिवीम् अपि
अवने न एक रूपा त्वम् बहु भार्या भविष्यसि
transliteration: evam uktvā surān sarvān śaśāpa pṛthivīm api
avane na eka rūpā tvam bahu bhāryā bhaviṣyasi
english: Having thus spoke to the celestials, she cursed the Earth also, saying, 'O Earth, you will have multiform surface and many husbands.'

sanskrit: न च पुत्र कृताम् प्रीतिम् मत् क्रोध कलुषीकृता
प्राप्स्यसि त्वम् सुदुर्मेधे मम पुत्रम् अनिच्छती
transliteration: na ca putra kṛtām prītim mat krodha kaluṣīkṛtā
prāpsyasi tvam sudurmedhe mama putram anicchatī
english: Nor, stained because of my ire, shall you experience the pleasure that is felt on obtaining a son, O you of wicked understanding, O you that do not wish me a son!

sanskrit: तान् सर्वान् पीडितान् दृष्ट्वा सुरान् सुरपतिः तदा
transliteration: tān sarvān pīḍitān dṛṣṭvā surān surapatiḥ tadā
english: Witnessing the gods, thus distressed, the lord of the celestials set out in the direction presided over by Varuna (The West).

sanskrit: स गत्वा तप आतिष्ठत् पार्श्वे तस्य उत्तरे गिरेः
हिमवत् प्रभवे शृंगे सह देव्या महेश्वरः
transliteration: sa gatvā tapa ātiṣṭhat pārśve tasya uttare gireḥ
himavat prabhave śṛṃge saha devyā maheśvaraḥ
english: And having repaired to the north side of that mountain, Mahesvara along with the goddess became engaged in austerities on the peak Himavatprabhava.

sanskrit: एष ते विस्तरो राम शैल पुत्र्या निवेदितः
गन्गायाः प्रभवम् चैव शृणु मे सह लक्ष्मण
transliteration: eṣa te vistaro rāma śaila putryā niveditaḥ
gangāyāḥ prabhavam caiva śṛṇu me saha lakṣmaṇa
english: I have now related to you, O Rāma, the spread of the Mountain's daughter, (Gangā). Do you now together with Lakşmaņa listen to the narration of Bhāgīrathi's potency.

sanskrit: तप्यमाने तदा देवे स इन्द्राः स अग्नि पुरोगमाः
transliteration: tapyamāne tadā deve sa indrāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ
english: On that celestial being engaged in austerities, the deities with Indra and Agni at their head, desirous of gaining over the generalissimo, Appeared before the Grand-sire.

sanskrit: ततो अब्रुवन् सुराः सर्वे भगवंतम् पितामहम्
प्रणिपत्य सुराः राम स इन्द्राः स अग्नि पुरोगमाः
transliteration: tato abruvan surāḥ sarve bhagavaṃtam pitāmaham
praṇipatya surāḥ rāma sa indrāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ
english: And, O Rāma, the gods with Agni at their head, bowing to him, addressed that possessor of the six attributes, the Grand-sir, saying,

sanskrit: येन सेनापतिः देव दत्तो भगवता पुरा
स तपः परम् आस्थाय तप्यते स्म सह उमया
transliteration: yena senāpatiḥ deva datto bhagavatā purā
sa tapaḥ param āsthāya tapyate sma saha umayā
english: 'O God, that adorable one who had formerly consigned to us the generalissimo, resorting to high asceticism, is practising austerities with Uma.

sanskrit: यत् अत्र अनंतरम् कार्यम् लोकानाम् हित काम्यया
संविधत्स्व विधानज्ञ त्वम् हि नः परमा गतिः
transliteration: yat atra anaṃtaram kāryam lokānām hita kāmyayā
saṃvidhatsva vidhānajña tvam hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ
english: Do you now, O you conversant with resources, so order as is advisable in the interests of the worlds! Verily you are our prime way.'

sanskrit: देवतानाम् वचः श्रुत्वा सर्व लोक पितामहः
सान्त्वयन् मधुरैः वाक्यैः त्रिदशान् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā sarva loka pitāmahaḥ
sāntvayan madhuraiḥ vākyaiḥ tridaśān idam abravīt
english: Hearing the words of the deities, the Grandsire of all creatures, 'consoling them with soft words, spoke to them saying

sanskrit: शैल पुत्र्या यत् उक्तम् तत् न प्रजाः स्वासु पत्निषु
तस्या वचनम् अक्लिष्टम् सत्यम् एव न संशयः
transliteration: śaila putryā yat uktam tat na prajāḥ svāsu patniṣu
tasyā vacanam akliṣṭam satyam eva na saṃśayaḥ
english: 'Even as the Mountain's daughter has said, sons will not be born to you of your own wives. Her words is infallible of a certainty: there is no doubt about it.

sanskrit: इयम् आकाश गंगा यस्याम् पुत्रम् हुताशनः
transliteration: iyam ākāśa gaṃgā yasyām putram hutāśanaḥ
english: This is the celestial Gangă she on whom Hutaśana will beget a son-the foe-subduing generalissimo of the celestials.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठा शैलेन्द्र दुहिता मानयिष्यति तम् सुतम्
उमायाः तत् बहुमतम् भविष्यति न संशयः
transliteration: jyeṣṭhā śailendra duhitā mānayiṣyati tam sutam
umāyāḥ tat bahumatam bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
english: And the elder daughter of the Mountain will consider that son as brought forth by Uma; and Uma also will, without doubt, look upon him with regard.'

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य कृतार्था रघुनन्दन
transliteration: tat śrutvā vacanam tasya kṛtārthā raghunandana
english: Hearing these words of him o descendant of Raghu, the gods bowing to the Grand-sire, paid him homage.

sanskrit: ते गत्वा परमम् राम कैलासम् धातु मण्डितम्
transliteration: te gatvā paramam rāma kailāsam dhātu maṇḍitam
english: Then, O Rama, repairing to the Kailasa mountain teeming with metals, the deities commissioned Agni with the view of having a son (born to him.)10

sanskrit: देव कार्यम् इदम् देव समाधत्स्व हुताशन
शैल पुत्र्याम् महातेजो गंगायाम् तेज उत्सृज
transliteration: deva kāryam idam deva samādhatsva hutāśana
śaila putryām mahātejo gaṃgāyām teja utsṛja
english: ‘Do you, O god, accomplish this work of the oddities! O you of mighty energy, do you discharge your energy into that daughter of the Mountain, Ganga.

sanskrit: गर्भम् धारय वै देवि देवतानाम् इदम् प्रियम्
transliteration: garbham dhāraya vai devi devatānām idam priyam
english: Thereupon giving his promise to the gods, Pavaka* (Fire) approached Ganga, saying, Do you, O Goddess, bear an embryo; for even this is the desire of the deities.

sanskrit: इति एतत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा दिव्यम् रूपम् अधारयत्
स तस्या महिमाम् दृष्ट्वा समंतात् अवकीर्यत
transliteration: iti etat vacanam śrutvā divyam rūpam adhārayat
sa tasyā mahimām dṛṣṭvā samaṃtāt avakīryata
english: Hearing this speech, she assumed a divine appearance. And beholding her mightiness, Agni was shrunk up on all sides.
And then Pavaka from all sides discharged his energy into her, and thereat all her streams became surcharged with it,

sanskrit: तम् उवाच ततो गंगा सर्व देव पुरोगमम्
अशक्ता धारणे देव तेजः तव समुद्धतम्
transliteration: tam uvāca tato gaṃgā sarva deva purogamam
aśaktā dhāraṇe deva tejaḥ tava samuddhatam
english: O descendant of Raghu. And to him staying at the head of all the deities, Gangā spoke, saying, "O god, I am incapable of sustaining this new sprung energy of yours: I am burning with that fire, and my consciousness fails me.

sanskrit: अथ अब्रवीत् इदम् गंगाम् सर्व देव हुताशनः
transliteration: atha abravīt idam gaṃgām sarva deva hutāśanaḥ

sanskrit: इह हैमवते पार्श्वे गर्भो अयम् संनिवेश्यताम्
श्रुत्वा तु अग्नि वचो गंगा तम् गर्भम् अतिभास्वरम्
transliteration: iha haimavate pārśve garbho ayam saṃniveśyatām
śrutvā tu agni vaco gaṃgā tam garbham atibhāsvaram

sanskrit: उत्ससर्ज महातेजाः स्रोतोभ्यो हि तदा अनघ
यत् अस्या निर्गतम् तस्मात् तप्त जांबूनद प्रभम्
transliteration: utsasarja mahātejāḥ srotobhyo hi tadā anagha
yat asyā nirgatam tasmāt tapta jāṃbūnada prabham

sanskrit: कांचनम् धरणीम् प्राप्तम् हिरण्यम् अतुल प्रभम्
ताम्रम् कार्ष्णायसम् चैव तैक्ष्ण्यात् एव अभिजायत
transliteration: kāṃcanam dharaṇīm prāptam hiraṇyam atula prabham
tāmram kārṣṇāyasam caiva taikṣṇyāt eva abhijāyata
english: And as it came out of her, it wore the splendour of molten gold; and in consequence of its fiery virtue, objects near and objects far were converted into gold and silver of unsurpassed sheen, while those that were more distant were turned into copper and iron.

sanskrit: मलम् तस्य अभवत् तत्र त्रपु सीसकम् एव च
तत् एतत् धरणीम् प्राप्य नाना धातुः अवर्धत
transliteration: malam tasya abhavat tatra trapu sīsakam eva ca
tat etat dharaṇīm prāpya nānā dhātuḥ avardhata
english: Her excreta were turned into lead. In this wise, various metals began to increase on earth.

sanskrit: निक्षिप्त मात्रे गर्भे तु तेजोभिः अभिरंजितम्
सर्वम् पर्वत संनद्धम् सौवर्णम् अभवत् वनम्
transliteration: nikṣipta mātre garbhe tu tejobhiḥ abhiraṃjitam
sarvam parvata saṃnaddham sauvarṇam abhavat vanam
english: As soon as the embryo was brought forth, the woods adjoining the mountain, being overspread with that energy, were turned into gold.

sanskrit: जातरूपम् इति ख्यातम् तदा प्रभृति राघव
तृण वृक्ष लता गुल्मम् सर्वम् भवति कांचनम्
transliteration: jātarūpam iti khyātam tadā prabhṛti rāghava
tṛṇa vṛkṣa latā gulmam sarvam bhavati kāṃcanam
english: And from that day, O descendant of Raghu, gold of effulgence like to that of fire, became known as Jātarūpa, O foremost of men!

sanskrit: तम् कुमारम् ततो जातम् स इन्द्राः सह मरुद् गणाः
transliteration: tam kumāram tato jātam sa indrāḥ saha marud gaṇāḥ
english: And when the son was born, the deities with Indra and the Maruts enjoined upon the Křttikā stars to suckle him.

sanskrit: ताः क्षीरम् जात मात्रस्य कृत्वा समयम् उत्तमम्
ददुः पुत्रो अयम् अस्माकम् सर्वासाम् इति निश्चिताः
transliteration: tāḥ kṣīram jāta mātrasya kṛtvā samayam uttamam
daduḥ putro ayam asmākam sarvāsām iti niścitāḥ
english: 'Surely he shall be son to us all’-concluding thus, they as soon as he was born, by turns began to dispense milk to him.

sanskrit: ततः तु देवताः सर्वाः कार्तिकेय इति ब्रुवन्
पुत्रः त्रैलोक्य विख्यातो भविष्यति न संशयः
transliteration: tataḥ tu devatāḥ sarvāḥ kārtikeya iti bruvan
putraḥ trailokya vikhyāto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
english: Then the celestials called him Kārtikeya, saying, “Without doubt, this son shall become famed over the three worlds.'

sanskrit: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा स्कन्नम् गर्भ परिस्रवे
स्नापयन् परया लक्ष्म्या दीप्यमानम् यथा अनलम्
transliteration: teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā skannam garbha parisrave
snāpayan parayā lakṣmyā dīpyamānam yathā analam
english: And hearing those words of theirs, the Kșttikās bathed the offspring that had issued from her womb, flaming like fire, and with auspicious marks.

sanskrit: स्कंद इति अब्रुवन् देवाः स्कन्नम् गर्भ परिस्रवात्
transliteration: skaṃda iti abruvan devāḥ skannam garbha parisravāt
english: And, O Kākutstha, since Kārtikeya had issued from (Gangā's) womb the celestials called that effulgent and mighty-armed one, Skanda.

sanskrit: षण्णाम् षड् आननो भूत्वा जग्राह स्तनजम् पयः
transliteration: ṣaṇṇām ṣaḍ ānano bhūtvā jagrāha stanajam payaḥ
english: And then the teats of the Křttikās were filled with milk; and thereupon assuming six mouths, he began to suck milk from the teats of those six.

sanskrit: गृहीत्वा क्षीरम् एक अह्ना सुकुमार वपुः तदा
अजयत् स्वेन वीर्येण दैत्य सैन्य गणान् विभुः
transliteration: gṛhītvā kṣīram eka ahnā sukumāra vapuḥ tadā
ajayat svena vīryeṇa daitya sainya gaṇān vibhuḥ
english: Having drunk the milk, that lord although then possessed of a tender frame, by virtue of his inbom prowess in one day vanquished the Dänava forces.

sanskrit: सुर सेना गण पतिम् अभ्यषिंचत् महाद्युतिम्
ततः तम् अमराः सर्वे समेत्य अग्नि पुरोगमाः
transliteration: sura senā gaṇa patim abhyaṣiṃcat mahādyutim
tataḥ tam amarāḥ sarve sametya agni purogamāḥ
english: And him possessed of mighty effulgence, the celestials assembled with Agni as their leader sprinkled with water, by way of installing him as their generalissimo.

sanskrit: एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरो अभिहितो मया
कुमार संभवः चैव धन्यः पुण्यः तथैव च
transliteration: eṣa te rāma gaṃgāyā vistaro abhihito mayā
kumāra saṃbhavaḥ caiva dhanyaḥ puṇyaḥ tathaiva ca

sanskrit: भक्तः च यः कार्तिकेये काकुत्स्थ भुवि मानवः
आयुष्मान् पुत्र पौत्रः च स्कन्द सालोक्यताम् व्रजते
transliteration: bhaktaḥ ca yaḥ kārtikeye kākutstha bhuvi mānavaḥ
āyuṣmān putra pautraḥ ca skanda sālokyatām vrajate
english: He who, O Kākutstha, on earth revere Kārtikeya, is blessed, and attain righteousness, and being long-lived and obtaining sons and grand-sons, repair to the regions of Skanda.

sanskrit: ताम् कथाम् कौशिको रामे निवेद्य मधुर अक्षरम्
पुनः एव अपरम् वाक्यम् काकुत्स्थम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tām kathām kauśiko rāme nivedya madhura akṣaram
punaḥ eva aparam vākyam kākutstham idam abravīt
english: Having said those words to Rāma, composed of melodious letters, Kausika again spoke to Kākutstha, saying,

sanskrit: अयोध्या अधिपतिः वीरः पूर्वम् आसीत् नराधिपः
सगरो नाम धर्मात्मा प्रजाकामः स च अप्रजः
transliteration: ayodhyā adhipatiḥ vīraḥ pūrvam āsīt narādhipaḥ
sagaro nāma dharmātmā prajākāmaḥ sa ca aprajaḥ
english: Formerly there was a king-lord of Ayodhyā-named Sagara. And it came to pass that righteous one, though eagerly wishing for children was without issue.

sanskrit: वैदर्भ दुहिता राम केशिनी नाम नामतः
ज्येष्ठा सगर पत्नी सा धर्मिष्ठा सत्य वादिनी
transliteration: vaidarbha duhitā rāma keśinī nāma nāmataḥ
jyeṣṭhā sagara patnī sā dharmiṣṭhā satya vādinī
english: O Räma, Vidarbha's daughter, named Kesinī, was the elder wife of Sagara. And she was virtuous and truthful.

sanskrit: अरिष्ठनेमि दुहिता सुपर्ण भगिनी तु सा
द्वितीया सगरस्य आसीत् पत्नी सुमति संज्ञिता
transliteration: ariṣṭhanemi duhitā suparṇa bhaginī tu sā
dvitīyā sagarasya āsīt patnī sumati saṃjñitā
english: The second wife of Sagara was called Sumati, who was the daughter of Aristanemi and the sister of Suparna (Garuda).

sanskrit: ताभ्याम् सह महाराजा पत्नीभ्याम् तप्तवान् तपः
transliteration: tābhyām saha mahārājā patnībhyām taptavān tapaḥ
english: And with those wives of his, that mighty king, coming to the Himavat, began to practice austerities on the mountain Bhrguprasravaņa.

sanskrit: अथ वर्ष शते पूर्णे तपसा आराधितो मुनिः
सगराय वरम् प्रादाद् भृगुः सत्यवताम् वरः
transliteration: atha varṣa śate pūrṇe tapasā ārādhito muniḥ
sagarāya varam prādād bhṛguḥ satyavatām varaḥ
english: When a full hundred years had been numbered, the ascetic that had been adored by means of these austerities, Bright, best of those endowed with truth, conferred a boon upon Sagara, saying.

sanskrit: अपत्य लाभः सुमहान् भविष्यति तव अनघ
कीर्तिम् च अप्रतिमाम् लोके प्राप्स्यसे पुरुषर्षभ
transliteration: apatya lābhaḥ sumahān bhaviṣyati tava anagha
kīrtim ca apratimām loke prāpsyase puruṣarṣabha
english: O sinless one, you shall obtain glorious offspring; and, O foremost of men, you shall attain unparalleled renown among Man.

sanskrit: एका जनयिता तात पुत्रम् वंशकरम् तव
transliteration: ekā janayitā tāta putram vaṃśakaram tava
english: O child, one of your con sorts shall bring forth a son who will perpetuate your race; and the other give birth to sixty thousand sons.'

sanskrit: भाषमाणम् महात्मानम् राज पुत्र्यौ प्रसाद्य तम्
ऊचतुः परम प्रीते कृतांजलि पुटे तदा
transliteration: bhāṣamāṇam mahātmānam rāja putryau prasādya tam
ūcatuḥ parama prīte kṛtāṃjali puṭe tadā
english: As that best of men was saying this, those daughters of kings, exceedingly delighted, propitiating him, addressed him with clasped hands.

sanskrit: एकः कस्याः सुतो ब्रह्मन् का बहून् जनयिष्यति
श्रोतुम् इच्छावहे ब्रह्मन् सत्यम् अस्तु वचः तव
transliteration: ekaḥ kasyāḥ suto brahman kā bahūn janayiṣyati
śrotum icchāvahe brahman satyam astu vacaḥ tava
english: Who of us, O Brahmana, shall produce a single son, and who many? This, O Brāhmaṇa, we wish to hear. May your word prove true!

sanskrit: तयोः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा भृगुः परमधार्मिकः
उवाच परमाम् वाणीम् स्वच्छन्दो अत्र विधीयताम्
transliteration: tayoḥ tat vacanam śrutvā bhṛguḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
uvāca paramām vāṇīm svacchando atra vidhīyatām
english: Hearing this, the highly pious Bhỉgu said these pregnant words, 'Do you unfold your minds. Who wishes for what boon, between a single perpetuator of the line, and innumerable sons, possessed of mighty strength, and furnished with fame, and endowed with high spirits?'

sanskrit: एको वंश करो वा अस्तु बहवो वा महाबलाः
कीर्तिमन्तो महोत्साहाः का वा कम् वरम् इच्छति
transliteration: eko vaṃśa karo vā astu bahavo vā mahābalāḥ
kīrtimanto mahotsāhāḥ kā vā kam varam icchati
english: Hearing this, the highly pious Bhỉgu said these pregnant words, 'Do you unfold your minds. Who wishes for what boon, between a single perpetuator of the line, and innumerable sons, possessed of mighty strength, and furnished with fame, and endowed with high spirits?'

sanskrit: मुनेः तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा केशिनी रघुनंदन
पुत्रम् वंश करम् राम जग्राह नृप संनिधौ
transliteration: muneḥ tu vacanam śrutvā keśinī raghunaṃdana
putram vaṃśa karam rāma jagrāha nṛpa saṃnidhau
english: Hearing the ascetic's words, O descendant of Raghu, Kesinī in the presence of the monarch chose, O Rāma, a single son to perpetuate the line.

sanskrit: षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि सुपर्ण भगिनी तदा
transliteration: ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi suparṇa bhaginī tadā
english: And Suparna's sister, Sumati, sixty thousand sons, high-spirited and furnished with fame.

sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणम् ऋषिम् कृत्वा शिरसा अभिप्रणम्य च
जगाम स्व पुरम् राजा सभार्या रघु नन्दन
transliteration: pradakṣiṇam ṛṣim kṛtvā śirasā abhipraṇamya ca
jagāma sva puram rājā sabhāryā raghu nandana
english: Then, O son of Raghu, having gone round the saint and bowed down the head, the king went to his own capital, accompanied by his consorts.

sanskrit: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् ज्येष्ठा पुत्रम् व्यजायत
transliteration: atha kāle gate tasmin jyeṣṭhā putram vyajāyata
english: And after a length of time, the elder, Kesini, bore a son to Sagara, known by the name of Asamanja.

sanskrit: सुमतिः तु नरव्याघ्र गर्भ तुंबम् व्यजायत
षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि तुंब भेदात् विनिःसृताः
transliteration: sumatiḥ tu naravyāghra garbha tuṃbam vyajāyata
ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi tuṃba bhedāt viniḥsṛtāḥ
english: And Sumati, O foremost of men, brought forth a gourd. And when it burst open, out came from it sixty thousand sons.

sanskrit: घृत पूर्णेषु कुंभेषु धात्र्यः तान् समवर्धयन्
transliteration: ghṛta pūrṇeṣu kuṃbheṣu dhātryaḥ tān samavardhayan
english: And the nurses fostered them by keeping them in jars filled with clarified butter. And after a great length of time, they attained to youth.

sanskrit: षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि सगरस्य अभवन् तदा
transliteration: ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi sagarasya abhavan tadā
english: And after a long lapse of time, Sagara's sixty thousand sons attained to youth and beauty.

sanskrit: स च ज्येष्ठो नरश्रेष्ठ सगरस्य आत्म संभवः
बालान् गृहीत्वा तु जले सरय्वा रघुनंदन
transliteration: sa ca jyeṣṭho naraśreṣṭha sagarasya ātma saṃbhavaḥ
bālān gṛhītvā tu jale sarayvā raghunaṃdana
english: O foremost of men,* the eldest son of Sagara, taking those children, would, O descendant of Raghu, often cast them into the Sarayū, and in mirth behold them sinking in the waters. *The text has Narasresthas, put for Asamanja. Evidently this is an error. I make it a vocative.

sanskrit: प्रक्षिप्य प्रहसन् नित्यम् मज्जतस् तान् निरीक्ष्य वै
transliteration: prakṣipya prahasan nityam majjatas tān nirīkṣya vai

sanskrit: पौराणाम् अहिते युक्तः पित्रा निर्वासितः पुरात्
तस्य पुत्रो अंशुमान् नाम असमंजस्य वीर्यवान्
transliteration: paurāṇām ahite yuktaḥ pitrā nirvāsitaḥ purāt
tasya putro aṃśumān nāma asamaṃjasya vīryavān

sanskrit: सम्मतः सर्व लोकस्य सर्वस्य अपि प्रियम् वदः
transliteration: sammataḥ sarva lokasya sarvasya api priyam vadaḥ

sanskrit: स कृत्वा निश्चयम् राजा स उपाध्याय गणः तदा
transliteration: sa kṛtvā niścayam rājā sa upādhyāya gaṇaḥ tadā
english: Having determined upon it, that one versed in the Vedas set about it, in company with his priests.

sanskrit: उवाच परम प्रीतो मुनिम् दीप्तम् इव अनलम्
transliteration: uvāca parama prīto munim dīptam iva analam
english: When Viśvāmitra had ended, hearing his words, Rāma exceedingly pleased, spoke to that ascetic resembling flaming fire, saying,

sanskrit: श्रोतुम् इच्छामि भद्रम् ते विस्तरेण कथाम् इमाम्
पूर्वजो मे कथम् ब्रह्मन् यज्ञम् वै समुपाहरत्
transliteration: śrotum icchāmi bhadram te vistareṇa kathām imām
pūrvajo me katham brahman yajñam vai samupāharat
english: I am anxious to hear in detail, good betide you, how, O Brāhmaṇa, my ancestor arranged for the sacrifice.

sanskrit: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा कौतूहल समन्वितः
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā kautūhala samanvitaḥ
english: Hearing those words of his, Viśvāmitra, smiling, eagerly spoke to Kākutstha, saying,

sanskrit: शंकर श्वशुरो नाम हिमवान् इति विश्रुतः
transliteration: śaṃkara śvaśuro nāma himavān iti viśrutaḥ
english: Do you, O Rāma, hearken to the story of the high-souled Sagara's sacrifice. Sankara's fatherin-law is the far-famed Himavat. And approaching each other, the Himavat and the vindhya behold each other. And on the region lying between them took place, O foremost of men, that sacrifice of Sagara's.

sanskrit: तयोर् मध्ये संभवत् यज्ञः स पुरुषोत्तम
transliteration: tayor madhye saṃbhavat yajñaḥ sa puruṣottama
english: Do you, O Rāma, hearken to the story of the high-souled Sagara's sacrifice. Sankara's fatherin-law is the far-famed Himavat. And approaching each other, the Himavat and the vindhya behold each other. And on the region lying between them took place, O foremost of men, that sacrifice of Sagara's.

sanskrit: स हि देशो नरव्याघ्र प्रशस्तो यज्ञ कर्मणि
तस्य अश्व चर्याम् काकुत्स्थ दृढ धन्वा महारथः
transliteration: sa hi deśo naravyāghra praśasto yajña karmaṇi
tasya aśva caryām kākutstha dṛḍha dhanvā mahārathaḥ
english: And that country, O best of men, is excellent as a sacrificial ground. And, O Kākutstha, equipped with a powerful bow, that mighty carwarrior, living under Sagara's sway, Ansumat, O child, followed the horse, for the purpose of protecting it.

sanskrit: अंशुमान् अकरोत् तात सगरस्य मते स्थितः
तस्य पर्वणि तम् यज्ञम् यजमानस्य वासवः १-३९-७राक्षसीम् तनुम् आस्थाय यज्ञिय अश्वम् अपाहरत्
ह्रियमाणे तु काकुत्स्थ तस्मिन् अश्वे महात्मनः
transliteration: aṃśumān akarot tāta sagarasya mate sthitaḥ
tasya parvaṇi tam yajñam yajamānasya vāsavaḥ 1-39-7rākṣasīm tanum āsthāya yajñiya aśvam apāharat
hriyamāṇe tu kākutstha tasmin aśve mahātmanaḥ
english: It came to pass that with the intention of disturbing the sacrifice of that monarch, on a certain day Vasava, assuming the, form of a Raksasi, stole away the sacrificial horse. us

sanskrit: उपाध्याय गणाः सर्वे यजमानम् अथ अब्रुवन्
अयम् पर्वणि वेगेन यज्ञिय अश्वो अपनीयते
transliteration: upādhyāya gaṇāḥ sarve yajamānam atha abruvan
ayam parvaṇi vegena yajñiya aśvo apanīyate

sanskrit: हर्तारम् जहि काकुत्स्थ हयः च एव उपनीयताम्
यज्ञः च्छिद्रम् भवति एतत् सर्वेषाम् अशिवाय नः
transliteration: hartāram jahi kākutstha hayaḥ ca eva upanīyatām
yajñaḥ cchidram bhavati etat sarveṣām aśivāya naḥ

sanskrit: तत् तथा क्रियताम् राजन् यज्ञो अच्छिद्रः क्रुतो भवेत्
सो उपाध्याय वचः श्रुत्वा तस्मिन् सदसि पार्थिवः
transliteration: tat tathā kriyatām rājan yajño acchidraḥ kruto bhavet
so upādhyāya vacaḥ śrutvā tasmin sadasi pārthivaḥ

sanskrit: षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि वाक्यम् एतत् उवाच ह
गतिम् पुत्रा न पश्यामि रक्षसाम् पुरुषर्षभाः
transliteration: ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi vākyam etat uvāca ha
gatim putrā na paśyāmi rakṣasām puruṣarṣabhāḥ
english: Hearing the words of the priests, the king addressed his sixty thousand sons in the midst of his court, saying, 'l'eing, as this great sacrifice is, presided over by eminently pious Brāhmaṇas sanctified by mantras, I do not, you foremost of men, you sons, see how Raksasas may find entrance into it.'

sanskrit: मंत्र पूतैः महाभागैः आस्थितो हि महाक्रतुः
तत् गच्छत विचिन्वध्वम् पुत्रका भद्रम् अस्तु वः
transliteration: maṃtra pūtaiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ āsthito hi mahākratuḥ
tat gacchata vicinvadhvam putrakā bhadram astu vaḥ

sanskrit: एक एकम् योजनम् पुत्रा विस्तारम् अभिगच्छत
transliteration: eka ekam yojanam putrā vistāram abhigacchata

sanskrit: यावत् तुरग संदर्शः तावत् खनत मेदिनीम्
तम् एव हय हर्तारम् मार्गमाणा मम आज्ञया
transliteration: yāvat turaga saṃdarśaḥ tāvat khanata medinīm
tam eva haya hartāram mārgamāṇā mama ājñayā

sanskrit: दीक्षितः पौत्र सहितः स उपाध्याय गणः तु अहम्
इह स्थास्यामि भद्रम् वो यावत् तुरग दर्शनम्
transliteration: dīkṣitaḥ pautra sahitaḥ sa upādhyāya gaṇaḥ tu aham
iha sthāsyāmi bhadram vo yāvat turaga darśanam
english: I have been initiated into this sacrifice with my grand-sons and priests.' I will stay here till you light upon the horse.

sanskrit: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसो राज पुत्रा महाबलाः
जग्मुर् मही तलम् राम पितुर् वचन यंत्रिताः
transliteration: te sarve hṛṣṭamanaso rāja putrā mahābalāḥ
jagmur mahī talam rāma pitur vacana yaṃtritāḥ
english: And thereat the mighty princes, enjoined by their father, breathing high spirits, began to range the earth.

sanskrit: गत्व तु पृथिवीम् सर्वम् अदृष्टा तम् महबलाः
बिभिदुः पुरुषव्याघ्र वज्र स्पर्श समैः भुजैः
transliteration: gatva tu pṛthivīm sarvam adṛṣṭā tam mahabalāḥ
bibhiduḥ puruṣavyāghra vajra sparśa samaiḥ bhujaiḥ
english: O Rāma. Then, they each fell to delving the bowels of the earth for the space of a Yojana in length and breadth, with their hands resembling thunder-bolts in feel, and with darts like to thunder-bolts, and with gigantic ploughshares. And being thus rived, the earth, O descendant of Raghu, began to send forth loud cries.

sanskrit: शूलैः अशनि कल्पैः च हलैः च अपि सुदारुणैः
transliteration: śūlaiḥ aśani kalpaiḥ ca halaiḥ ca api sudāruṇaiḥ
english: O Rāma. Then, they each fell to delving the bowels of the earth for the space of a Yojana in length and breadth, with their hands resembling thunder-bolts in feel, and with darts like to thunder-bolts, and with gigantic ploughshares. And being thus rived, the earth, O descendant of Raghu, began to send forth loud cries.

sanskrit: राक्षसानाम् च दुर्धर्षः सत्त्वानाम् निनदो अभवत्
transliteration: rākṣasānām ca durdharṣaḥ sattvānām ninado abhavat
english: O Rāghava, O you hard to repress, there arose an uproar from serpents, and Asuras, and Rāks asas, and other creatures, that were being slaughtered.

sanskrit: बिभिदुर् धरणीम् राम रसा तलम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: bibhidur dharaṇīm rāma rasā talam anuttamam
english: O descendant of Raghu, they excavated the earth, O Rāma, for sixty thousand Yojanas, you, as if they had intended to reach the lowest depths underground.

sanskrit: एवम् पर्वत संबाधम् जम्बू द्वीपम् नृपात्मजाः
transliteration: evam parvata saṃbādham jambū dvīpam nṛpātmajāḥ
english: Thus, O foremost of kings, those sons of the monarch dug all around Jambūdvīpa, filled with mountains.

sanskrit: ततो देवाः स गंधर्वाः स असुराः सह पन्नगाः
transliteration: tato devāḥ sa gaṃdharvāḥ sa asurāḥ saha pannagāḥ
english: Thereat, the gods together with the Gandharvas, and Asuras, and Pannagas, in trepidation appeared before the Grand-sire.

sanskrit: ते प्रसाद्य महात्मानम् विषण्ण वदनाः तदा
ऊचुः परम संत्रस्ताः पितामहम् इदम् वचः
transliteration: te prasādya mahātmānam viṣaṇṇa vadanāḥ tadā
ūcuḥ parama saṃtrastāḥ pitāmaham idam vacaḥ
english: And propitiating that high-souled one, they with melancholy countenances and in exceeding agitation, spoke these words to the Grand-sire,

sanskrit: भगवन् पृथिवी सर्वा खन्यते सगर आत्मजैः
बहवः च महात्मानो वध्यन्ते जल चारिणः
transliteration: bhagavan pṛthivī sarvā khanyate sagara ātmajaiḥ
bahavaḥ ca mahātmāno vadhyante jala cāriṇaḥ
english: O adorable one, the entire earth is being excavated by the sons of Sagara; and many are the high-souled ones as well as the aquatic animals that are being slain in consequence.

sanskrit: अयम् यज्ञ हरो अस्माकम् अनेन अश्वो अपनीयते
इति ते सर्व भूतानि हिंसन्ति सगर आत्मजः
transliteration: ayam yajña haro asmākam anena aśvo apanīyate
iti te sarva bhūtāni hiṃsanti sagara ātmajaḥ
english: This one is the disturber of our sacrifice, and by him has the sacrificial horse been stolen, saying this Sagara's sons are committing havoc upon all creatures.

sanskrit: देवतानाम् वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान् वै पितामहः
transliteration: devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān vai pitāmahaḥ
english: Hearing the speech of the celestials, that possessor of the six attributes, the Grand-sire, spoke to them exceedingly frightened and deprived of their senses on beholding the prowess of Sagara's sons like to the Destroyer himself.

sanskrit: यस्य इयम् वसुधा कृत्स्ना वासुदेवस्य धीमतः
महिषी माधवसय स एषा स एव भगवन् प्रभुः
transliteration: yasya iyam vasudhā kṛtsnā vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ
mahiṣī mādhavasaya sa eṣā sa eva bhagavan prabhuḥ
english: This entire Earth belong to the intelligent Vasudeva, she being his consort. And that adorable one is indeed her lord. And assuming the form of Kapila, he unceasingly sustain the Earth. And the sons of king Sagara will be consumed by the fire of his wrath.

sanskrit: कापिलम् रूपम् आस्थाय धारयत्य अनिशम् धराम्
transliteration: kāpilam rūpam āsthāya dhārayatya aniśam dharām
english: This entire Earth belong to the intelligent Vasudeva, she being his consort. And that adorable one is indeed her lord. And assuming the form of Kapila, he unceasingly sustain the Earth. And the sons of king Sagara will be consumed by the fire of his wrath.

sanskrit: पृथिव्याः च अपि निर्भेदो दृष्ट एव सनातनः
सगरस्य च पुत्राणाम् विनाशो दीर्घ दर्शिनाम्
transliteration: pṛthivyāḥ ca api nirbhedo dṛṣṭa eva sanātanaḥ
sagarasya ca putrāṇām vināśo dīrgha darśinām
english: The pre-ordained excavation of the Earth, as well as the testruction of Sagara's sons, had been foreseen by the farsighted.

sanskrit: पितामह वचः श्रुत्वा त्रयः त्रिंशत् अरिन्दमः
देवाः परम संहृष्टाः पुनर् जग्मुर् यथा आगतम्
transliteration: pitāmaha vacaḥ śrutvā trayaḥ triṃśat arindamaḥ
devāḥ parama saṃhṛṣṭāḥ punar jagmur yathā āgatam
english: Hearing the words of the Grand-sire. those repressors of their foes, the three and thirty* celestials, being exceedingly rejoiced, went back to their respective quarters. *The eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas and two Asvins.

sanskrit: सगरस्य च पुत्राणाम् प्रादुर् आसीत् महास्वनः
transliteration: sagarasya ca putrāṇām prādur āsīt mahāsvanaḥ
english: And as the sons of Sagara were riving the Earth, there arose a mighty noise, like to the bursting of thunder.

sanskrit: ततो भित्त्वा महीम् सर्वाम् कृत्वा च अपि प्रदक्षिणम्
सहिताः सगराः सर्वे पितरम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: tato bhittvā mahīm sarvām kṛtvā ca api pradakṣiṇam
sahitāḥ sagarāḥ sarve pitaram vākyam abruvan
english: Then, having rived the entire Earth and ranged it all around, the sons, of Sagara together (returned to their father) and spoke to him.

sanskrit: परिक्रांता मही सर्वा सत्त्ववन्तः च सूदिताः
देव दानव रक्षांसि पिशाच उरग पन्नगाः
transliteration: parikrāṃtā mahī sarvā sattvavantaḥ ca sūditāḥ
deva dānava rakṣāṃsi piśāca uraga pannagāḥ
english: By us has the Earth been extensively surveyed, and have powerful deities and Dānavas. Rākşasas, Piśācas, Uragas and Pannagas been slain; and yet do we find neither the horse nor the stealer thereof. What are we to do now? Good betide you, do you consider it well.

sanskrit: न च पश्यामहे अश्वम् ते अश्व हर्तारम् एव च
