किम् करिष्याम भद्रम् ते बुद्धिः अत्र विचार्यताम्
transliteration: na ca paśyāmahe aśvam te aśva hartāram eva ca
kim kariṣyāma bhadram te buddhiḥ atra vicāryatām
english: By us has the Earth been extensively surveyed, and have powerful deities and Dānavas. Rākşasas, Piśācas, Uragas and Pannagas been slain; and yet do we find neither the horse nor the stealer thereof. What are we to do now? Good betide you, do you consider it well.

sanskrit: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा पुत्राणाम् राज सत्तमः
transliteration: teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā putrāṇām rāja sattamaḥ
english: Hearing those words of his sons, that foremost of kings, getting into a wrath, said, O descendant of Raghu.

sanskrit: भूयः खनत भद्रम् वो विभेद्य वसुधा तलम्अश्व हर्तारम् आसाद्य कृतार्थाः च निवर्तत
transliteration: bhūyaḥ khanata bhadram vo vibhedya vasudhā talamaśva hartāram āsādya kṛtārthāḥ ca nivartata
english: 'Do you yet again, good betide you, delve the earth, and having got at the stealer of the horse, cease.'
Receiving this mandate of their sire, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara rushed towards the depths of the earth.

sanskrit: खन्यमाने ततः तस्मिन् ददृशुः पर्वत उपमम्
transliteration: khanyamāne tataḥ tasmin dadṛśuḥ parvata upamam
english: And as they were engaged in excavating, they beheld the elephant of the quarter resembling a hill, named Virūpākṣa, holding the earth.

sanskrit: स पर्वत वनाम् कृत्स्नाम् पृथिवीम् रघुनंदन
transliteration: sa parvata vanām kṛtsnām pṛthivīm raghunaṃdana
english: O son of Raghu, that mighty elephant, Virūpākşa, held on his head the entire earth with its mountains and forests.

sanskrit: खेदात् चालयते शीर्षम् भूमि कम्पः तदा भवेत्
transliteration: khedāt cālayate śīrṣam bhūmi kampaḥ tadā bhavet
english: And, O Kākutstha, when on sacred days the mighty elephant, from fatigue, shake his head, then takes place the earthquake.

sanskrit: ते तम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा दिशा पालम् महागजम्
मानयन्तो हि ते राम जग्मुर् भित्त्वा रसातलम्
transliteration: te tam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā diśā pālam mahāgajam
mānayanto hi te rāma jagmur bhittvā rasātalam
english: Thereupon, O Rāma, going round that mighty elephant, and honouring him duly, they went on piercing the under earth.

sanskrit: ततः पूर्वाम् दिशम् भित्त्वा दक्षिणाम् बिभिदुः पुनः
दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिशि ददृशुः ते महागजम्
transliteration: tataḥ pūrvām diśam bhittvā dakṣiṇām bibhiduḥ punaḥ
dakṣiṇasyām api diśi dadṛśuḥ te mahāgajam
english: And having pierced the East, they pierced the South, and in the Southern quarter also they beheld a mighty elephant, the high-souled Mahāpadma, resembling a huge hill, holding the earth on his head. And thereat they marvelled greatly.

sanskrit: शिरसा धारयंतम् गाम् विस्मयम् जग्मुर् उत्तमम्
transliteration: śirasā dhārayaṃtam gām vismayam jagmur uttamam

sanskrit: ते तम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा सगरस्य महात्मनः
षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि पश्चिमाम् बिभिदुर् दिशम्
transliteration: te tam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā sagarasya mahātmanaḥ
ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi paścimām bibhidur diśam
english: And having gone round him, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara began to penetrate into the Western region.

sanskrit: दिशा गजम् सौमनसम् ददृशुः ते महा बलाः
transliteration: diśā gajam saumanasam dadṛśuḥ te mahā balāḥ
english: And in the western quarter also those highly powerful ones beheld the elephant of that quarter named Saumanas, resembling a mighty mountain.

sanskrit: ते तम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा च अपि निरामयम्
transliteration: te tam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā ca api nirāmayam
english: And having gone round him and asked him as to his welfare, they delving on, arrived at the Northern region.

sanskrit: भद्रम् भद्रेण वपुषा धारयंतम् महीम् इमाम्
transliteration: bhadram bhadreṇa vapuṣā dhārayaṃtam mahīm imām
english: And on the North like wise, O foremost of the Raghus, they beheld Bhadra, white as snow, holding this earth on his goodly person.

sanskrit: समालभ्य ततः सर्वे कृत्वा च एनम् प्रदक्षिणम्
षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि बिभिदुर् वसुधा तलम्
transliteration: samālabhya tataḥ sarve kṛtvā ca enam pradakṣiṇam
ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi bibhidur vasudhā talam
english: Having felt as well as gone round him, those sixty thousand sons of Sagara went on penetrating the depths of the earth.

sanskrit: ततः प्राक् उत्तराम् गत्वा सागराः प्रथिताम् दिशम्
रोषात् अभ्यखनन् सर्वे पृथिवीम् सगर आत्मजाः
transliteration: tataḥ prāk uttarām gatvā sāgarāḥ prathitām diśam
roṣāt abhyakhanan sarve pṛthivīm sagara ātmajāḥ
english: Then repairing to the famous North eastern region, Sagara's sons becoming enraged, began to dig the earth.

sanskrit: ते तु सर्वे महत्मानो भिमवेग महबलाः
transliteration: te tu sarve mahatmāno bhimavega mahabalāḥ
english: And there those high-souled, exceedingly powerful and vehement ones beheld the eternal Vasudeva in the guise of Kapila.

sanskrit: हयम् च तस्य देवस्य चरन्तम् अविदूरतः
प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् प्रप्तः सर्वे ते रघुनंदन
transliteration: hayam ca tasya devasya carantam avidūrataḥ
praharṣam atulam praptaḥ sarve te raghunaṃdana
english: And there also, experiencing exceeding delight, O descendant of Raghu, they found his horse, browsing hard by.

sanskrit: ते तम् हय हरम् ज्ञात्वा क्रोध पर्याकुल ईक्षणाः
खनित्र लांगला धर नाना वृक्ष शिला धराः
transliteration: te tam haya haram jñātvā krodha paryākula īkṣaṇāḥ
khanitra lāṃgalā dhara nānā vṛkṣa śilā dharāḥ

sanskrit: अभ्यधावन्त संक्रुद्धाः तिष्ठ तिष्ठ इति च अब्रुवन्
अस्माकम् त्वम् हि तुरगम् यज्ञियम् हृतवान् असि
transliteration: abhyadhāvanta saṃkruddhāḥ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti ca abruvan
asmākam tvam hi turagam yajñiyam hṛtavān asi

sanskrit: दुर्मेधः त्वम् हि संप्राप्तान् विद्धि नः सगरात्मजान्
श्रुत्वा तत् वचनम् तेषाम् कपिलो रघुनंदन
transliteration: durmedhaḥ tvam hi saṃprāptān viddhi naḥ sagarātmajān
śrutvā tat vacanam teṣām kapilo raghunaṃdana

sanskrit: रोषेण महता आविष्टो हुम् कारम् अकरोत् तदा
भस्म राशी कृताः सर्वे काकुत्स्थ सगरात्मजाः
transliteration: roṣeṇa mahatā āviṣṭo hum kāram akarot tadā
bhasma rāśī kṛtāḥ sarve kākutstha sagarātmajāḥ
english: And then, O Kākutstha, the sons of Sagara were reduced to ashes by the high-souled and incomparable Kapila.

sanskrit: पुत्रान् चिर गतान् ज्ञात्वा सगरो रघुनंदन
नप्तारम् अब्रवीत् राजा दीप्यमानम् स्व तेजसा
transliteration: putrān cira gatān jñātvā sagaro raghunaṃdana
naptāram abravīt rājā dīpyamānam sva tejasā
english: Being the delay on the part of his sons, King Sagara, O son of Raghu, addressed his grandson, flaming in his native energy, saying,

sanskrit: शूरः च कृत विद्यः च पूर्वैः तुल्यो असि तेजसा
पितृणाम् गतिम् अन्विच्छ येन च अश्वो अपहारितः
transliteration: śūraḥ ca kṛta vidyaḥ ca pūrvaiḥ tulyo asi tejasā
pitṛṇām gatim anviccha yena ca aśvo apahāritaḥ
english: You are heroic and accomplished and like to your uncles. Do you enquire into the circumstances that have befallen your uncles, as also about the way by which the horse has escaped.

sanskrit: अन्तर् भौमानि सत्त्वानि वीर्यवन्ति महान्ति च
तेषाम् त्वम् प्रतिघात अर्थम् स असिम् गृह्णीष्व कार्मुकम्
transliteration: antar bhaumāni sattvāni vīryavanti mahānti ca
teṣām tvam pratighāta artham sa asim gṛhṇīṣva kārmukam
english: And as there are strong and mighty creatures inhabiting the Earth's interior, with the view of resisting them, do you take your how along with your scimitar.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य अभिवाद्यान् त्वम् हत्वा विघ्न करान् अपि
transliteration: abhivādya abhivādyān tvam hatvā vighna karān api
english: And honouring those that deserve to be honoured and slaying such as disturb you, do you, having attained your end, come back, becoming the instrument for the completion of my sacrifice.'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो अंशुमान् सम्यक् सगरेण महात्मना
धनुर् आदाय खड्गम् च जगाम लघुविक्रमः
transliteration: evam ukto aṃśumān samyak sagareṇa mahātmanā
dhanur ādāya khaḍgam ca jagāma laghuvikramaḥ
english: Thus duly enjoined by the high-souled Sagara, Anśumān endowed with fleet vigour, taking his bow as well as his scimitar, set out.

sanskrit: स खातम् पितृभिः मार्गम् अन्तर् भौमम् महात्मभिः
transliteration: sa khātam pitṛbhiḥ mārgam antar bhaumam mahātmabhiḥ
english: An commanded by the monarch, he found the underground way that had been carved out by those high-souled ones.

sanskrit: देव दानव रक्षोभिः पिशाच पतग उरगैः
transliteration: deva dānava rakṣobhiḥ piśāca pataga uragaiḥ
english: He found an exceedingly powerful elephant belonging to the cardinal point, worshipped by deities, and Dānavas, and Rākşasas, and goblins, and birds, and Uragas.

sanskrit: स तम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा चैव निरामयम्
पितृइन् स परिपप्रच्छ वाजि हर्तारम् एव च
transliteration: sa tam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā caiva nirāmayam
pitṛin sa paripapraccha vāji hartāram eva ca
english: Having gone round him, and asked him as to his welfare, he enquired after his uncles and the stealer of the horse.

sanskrit: दिशा गजः तु तत् श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच महामतिः
आसमंज कृतार्थः त्वम् सह अश्वः शीघ्रम् एष्यसि
transliteration: diśā gajaḥ tu tat śrutvā pratyuvāca mahāmatiḥ
āsamaṃja kṛtārthaḥ tvam saha aśvaḥ śīghram eṣyasi
english: Hearing this, the mighty-minded elephant of that quarter answered, 'O son of Asamañja, having attained your object, you will speedily return with the horse.'

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सर्वान् एव दिशा गजान्
यथा क्रमम् यथा न्यायम् प्रष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā sarvān eva diśā gajān
yathā kramam yathā nyāyam praṣṭum samupacakrame
english: And hearing those words of his, Ansumat by turns duly asked the same question of all the elephants belonging to the cardinal points.

sanskrit: तैः च सर्वैः दिशा पालैः वाक्यज्ञैः वाक्यकोविदैः
पूजितः स हयः चैव गन्ता असि इति अभिचोदितः
transliteration: taiḥ ca sarvaiḥ diśā pālaiḥ vākyajñaiḥ vākyakovidaiḥ
pūjitaḥ sa hayaḥ caiva gantā asi iti abhicoditaḥ
english: And being honoured by those guardians of the cardinal points, knowing words as well as their application in regard to time, place, and person, he was asked by them saying, 'Did you come with the horse?'

sanskrit: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा जगाम लघुविक्रमः
भस्म राशी कृता यत्र पितरः तस्य सागराः
transliteration: teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā jagāma laghuvikramaḥ
bhasma rāśī kṛtā yatra pitaraḥ tasya sāgarāḥ
english: Hearing those words of theirs, that one of fleet vigour repaired to the spot where the sons of Sagara, his uncles, had been reduced to a heap of ashes.

sanskrit: स दुःख वशम् आपन्नः तु असमंज सुतः तदा
चुक्रोश परम आर्तः तु वधात् तेषाम् सुदुःखितः
transliteration: sa duḥkha vaśam āpannaḥ tu asamaṃja sutaḥ tadā
cukrośa parama ārtaḥ tu vadhāt teṣām suduḥkhitaḥ
english: And (arriving there), Asamañja's son, smitten with grief, and being exceedingly afflicted at their destruction, bewailed in heaviness of heart.

sanskrit: यज्ञियम् च हयम् तत्र चरन्तम् अविदूरतः
transliteration: yajñiyam ca hayam tatra carantam avidūrataḥ
english: And exercised by grief and sorrow, at foremost of men espied there the sacrificial horse straying near.

sanskrit: स तेषाम् राज पुत्राणाम् कर्तु कामो जल क्रियाम्
स जलार्थम् महातेजा न च अपश्यत् जल आशयम्
transliteration: sa teṣām rāja putrāṇām kartu kāmo jala kriyām
sa jalārtham mahātejā na ca apaśyat jala āśayam
english: And desirous of offering oblations of water to those princes, that highly powerful one, in need of water, did not find any watery expanse in the neighbourhood.

sanskrit: विसार्य निपुणाम् दृष्टिम् ततो अपश्यत् खग अधिपम्
पितृणाम् मातुलम् राम सुपर्णम् अनिल उपमम्
transliteration: visārya nipuṇām dṛṣṭim tato apaśyat khaga adhipam
pitṛṇām mātulam rāma suparṇam anila upamam
english: And it came to pass, O Rāma, that surveying wide, he descried the maternal uncle to the princes, Suparna, resembling the Wind.

sanskrit: स च एनम् अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् वैनतेयो महाबलः
मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र वधो अयम् लोक सम्मतः
transliteration: sa ca enam abravīt vākyam vainateyo mahābalaḥ
mā śucaḥ puruṣavyāghra vadho ayam loka sammataḥ
english: And thereupon Vinata's son possessed of mighty strength spoke to him, saying, 'Do not lament, O foremost of men. The destruction of these was for the welfare of all.'

sanskrit: कपिलेन अप्रमेयेण दग्धा हि इमे महाबलाः
सलिलम् न अर्हसि प्राज्ञ दातुम् एषाम् हि लौकिकम्
transliteration: kapilena aprameyeṇa dagdhā hi ime mahābalāḥ
salilam na arhasi prājña dātum eṣām hi laukikam
english: These highly powerful ones had been consumed by the peerless Kapila, therefore, you ought not to offer water to them in consonance with social usage.

sanskrit: तस्याम् कुरु महाबाहो पितॄणाम् तु जल क्रियाम्
transliteration: tasyām kuru mahābāho pitṝṇām tu jala kriyām
english: Gangā, O foremost of men, is the elder daughter of Himavat. In her (streams) do you perform the watery rites of your uncles,

sanskrit: भस्म राशी कृतान् एतान् पावयेत् लोक कांतया
तया क्लिन्नम् इदम् भस्म गंगया लोक कान्तया
षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि स्वर्ग लोकम् गमिष्यति
transliteration: bhasma rāśī kṛtān etān pāvayet loka kāṃtayā
tayā klinnam idam bhasma gaṃgayā loka kāntayā
ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi svarga lokam gamiṣyati
english: O mighty-armed one: let that purifier of the worlds lave these reduced to a heap of ashes. And on these ashes being watered by Gangā, dear to all, the sixty thousand sons of Sagara will repair to the celestial regions.

sanskrit: निर्गच्छ च अश्वम् महाभाग संगृह्य पुरुषर्षभ
transliteration: nirgaccha ca aśvam mahābhāga saṃgṛhya puruṣarṣabha
english: Do you, O highly pious one, go back, taking this horse, O foremost of men; and do you complete the sacrifice of your grand-father,

sanskrit: सुपर्ण वचनम् श्रुत्वा सः अंशुमान् अतिवीर्यवान्
त्वरितम् हयम् आदाय पुनर् आयात् महायशाः
transliteration: suparṇa vacanam śrutvā saḥ aṃśumān ativīryavān
tvaritam hayam ādāya punar āyāt mahāyaśāḥ
english: O hero, Hearing Suparna's speech, the exceedingly powerful Ansumat of mighty asceticism speedily taking the horse, retraced his steps.

sanskrit: न्यवेदयत् यथा वृत्तम् सुपर्ण वचनम् तथा
transliteration: nyavedayat yathā vṛttam suparṇa vacanam tathā
english: Then coming to the king who had been initiated into the ceremony, he, O descendant of Raghu, faithfully communicated to him the words of Suparna.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा घोर संकाशम् वाक्यम् अंशुमतो नृपः
यज्ञम् निर्वर्तयामास यथा कल्पम् यथा विधि
transliteration: tat śrutvā ghora saṃkāśam vākyam aṃśumato nṛpaḥ
yajñam nirvartayāmāsa yathā kalpam yathā vidhi
english: Hearing this sorrowful intelligence, the king duly finished the sacrifice agreeably to the scriptures.

sanskrit: स्व पुरम् च अगमत् श्रीमान् इष्ट यज्ञो महीपतिः
गंगायाः च आगमे राजा निश्चयम् न अध्यगच्छत
transliteration: sva puram ca agamat śrīmān iṣṭa yajño mahīpatiḥ
gaṃgāyāḥ ca āgame rājā niścayam na adhyagacchata
english: And having seen the completion of the sacrifice, that lord of earth entered his capital; but the king could not see how to bring Gangā on earth.

sanskrit: अगत्वा निश्चयम् राजा कालेन महता महान्
त्रिंशत् वर्ष सहस्राणि राज्यम् कृत्वा दिवम् गतः
transliteration: agatvā niścayam rājā kālena mahatā mahān
triṃśat varṣa sahasrāṇi rājyam kṛtvā divam gataḥ
english: And without being able to ascertain it, the mighty monarch after a long course of time, and having reigned for thirty thousand years, ascended heaven.

sanskrit: कालधर्मम् गते राम सगरे प्रकृती जनाः
transliteration: kāladharmam gate rāma sagare prakṛtī janāḥ
english: When Sagara had bowed to the influence of Time, the subjects selected the righteous Ansumat for their king.

sanskrit: स राजा सुमहान् आसीत् अंशुमान् रघुनंदन
तस्य पुत्रो महान् आसीत् दिलीप इति विश्रुतः
transliteration: sa rājā sumahān āsīt aṃśumān raghunaṃdana
tasya putro mahān āsīt dilīpa iti viśrutaḥ
english: O descendant of Raghu, Ansumat proved a great ruler. And his son, the celebrated Dilīpa, was also a great king.

sanskrit: हिमवत् शिखरे रम्ये तपः तेपे सुदारुणम्
transliteration: himavat śikhare ramye tapaḥ tepe sudāruṇam
english: O Raghu's son, consigning to Dilipa his kingdom, Ansumat entered upon rigid austerities on the romantic summit of the Himavat.

sanskrit: द्वा त्रिंशत् सहस्राम् वर्षाणि सुमहा यशाः
तपोवन गतो राजा स्वर्गम् लेभे तपोधनः
transliteration: dvā triṃśat sahasrām varṣāṇi sumahā yaśāḥ
tapovana gato rājā svargam lebhe tapodhanaḥ
english: Having for the space of thirty-two you sand years carried on austerities in the woods, that highly famous one, crowned with the wealth of asceticism, attained the celestial regions.

sanskrit: दिलीपः तु महातेजाः श्रुत्वा पैतामहम् वधम्
दुःख उपहतया बुद्ध्या निश्चयम् न अध्यगच्छत
transliteration: dilīpaḥ tu mahātejāḥ śrutvā paitāmaham vadham
duḥkha upahatayā buddhyā niścayam na adhyagacchata
english: The exceedingly powerful Dilīpa, hearing of the destruction of his grand-fathers, was stricken with grief; yet he could not ascertain his grandfathers, was stricken with grief; yet he could not ascertain his course about it.

sanskrit: कथम् गंगा अवतरणम् कथम् तेषां जलक्रिया
तारयेयम् कथम् च एतान् इति चिंतापरो अभवत्
transliteration: katham gaṃgā avataraṇam katham teṣāṃ jalakriyā
tārayeyam katham ca etān iti ciṃtāparo abhavat
english: He constantly thought as to how Gangă could be brought down, how to perform their watery rites, and how to deliver them.

sanskrit: तस्य चिंतयतो नित्यम् धर्मेण विदित आत्मनः
पुत्रो भगीरथो नाम जज्ञे परम धार्मिकः
transliteration: tasya ciṃtayato nityam dharmeṇa vidita ātmanaḥ
putro bhagīratho nāma jajñe parama dhārmikaḥ
english: As that pious one furnished with selfknowledge was always meditating upon this, an eminently virtuous son was born to him named Bhagiratha.

sanskrit: दिलीपः तु महातेजा यज्ञैः बहुभिः इष्टवान्
त्रिंशत् वर्ष सहस्राणि राजा राज्यम् अकारयत्
transliteration: dilīpaḥ tu mahātejā yajñaiḥ bahubhiḥ iṣṭavān
triṃśat varṣa sahasrāṇi rājā rājyam akārayat
english: Performing numerous sacrifices, the mighty king Dilīpa reigned for thirty thousand years.

sanskrit: अगत्वा निश्चयम् राजा तेषाम् उद्धरणम् प्रति
व्याधिना नर शार्दूल काल धर्मम् उपेयिवान्
transliteration: agatvā niścayam rājā teṣām uddharaṇam prati
vyādhinā nara śārdūla kāla dharmam upeyivān
english: And without having arrived at any definite decision in regard to their deliverance, the king, O puissant one, being attacked with an ailment, breathed his last.

sanskrit: इन्द्रलोकम् गतो राजा स्व अर्जितेन एव कर्मणा
transliteration: indralokam gato rājā sva arjitena eva karmaṇā
english: Having sprinkled his son Bhagiratha in the way of installing him in the kingdom, that prime of men, the king, by virtue of his own acts, repaired to the region of Indra.

sanskrit: अनपत्यो महारजाः प्रजा कामः स च प्रजाः
transliteration: anapatyo mahārajāḥ prajā kāmaḥ sa ca prajāḥ
english: O descendant of Raghu, that royal saint Bhagiratha was possessed of righteousness. And being without issue, and desiring to obtain it, the mighty monarch consigned his kingdom and his subjects to the care of his counsellors, and engaged in bringing down Gangā.

sanskrit: मंत्रिषु आधाय तत् रज्यम् गङ्ग अवतरणे रतः
transliteration: maṃtriṣu ādhāya tat rajyam gaṅga avataraṇe rataḥ
english: O descendant of Raghu, that royal saint Bhagiratha was possessed of righteousness. And being without issue, and desiring to obtain it, the mighty monarch consigned his kingdom and his subjects to the care of his counsellors, and engaged in bringing down Gangā.

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्व बाहुः पंच तपा मास आहारो जितेइन्द्रियः
तस्य वर्ष सहस्राणि घोरे तपसि तिष्ठतः
transliteration: ūrdhva bāhuḥ paṃca tapā māsa āhāro jiteindriyaḥ
tasya varṣa sahasrāṇi ghore tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ
english: And, O Raghu's descendant, restraining his senses, and eating once a month, and surrounding himself with five fires, and with arms upraised, he for a long lapse of time performed austerities at Gokarna. And as he was performing his terrible austerities, a thousand years rolled away.

sanskrit: सुप्रीतो भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रजानाम् पतिः ईश्वरः
transliteration: suprīto bhagavān brahmā prajānām patiḥ īśvaraḥ

sanskrit: ततः सुर गणैः सार्धम् उपागम्य पितामहः
transliteration: tataḥ sura gaṇaiḥ sārdham upāgamya pitāmahaḥ
english: And thereat that possessor of the six attributes and lord of all creatures, Brahmā, was well pleased with that high-souled monarch. And presenting himself together with the celestials, the Grand-sire thus spoke to the high-souled Bhagiratha engaged in austerities.

sanskrit: भगीरथ महाराज प्रीतः ते अहम् जनाधिप
तपसा च सुतप्तेन वरम् वरय सुव्रत
transliteration: bhagīratha mahārāja prītaḥ te aham janādhipa
tapasā ca sutaptena varam varaya suvrata
english: O Bhagiratha, O mighty monarch, pleased am I with you. O lord' of men, on account of your ardent austerities: do you, O you of excellent vows, ask for the boon you would have.
Thereupon that great car-warrior, the highly powerful and mighty-armed Bhagiratha, with clasped hands, said to the grand sire of all creatures,

sanskrit: यदि मे भगवान् प्रीतो यदि अस्ति तपसः फलम्
सगरस्य आत्मजाः सर्वे मत्तः सलिलम् आप्नुयुः
transliteration: yadi me bhagavān prīto yadi asti tapasaḥ phalam
sagarasya ātmajāḥ sarve mattaḥ salilam āpnuyuḥ
english: If, adorable one, you are pleased with me, if you would grant me the fruit of my asceticism, may Sagara's sons receive water at my hands; and on the ashes of those high-souled ones being laved by the waters of Gangā, may my greatgrand-father without fail repair to heaven!

sanskrit: गन्गायाः सलिल क्लिन्ने भस्मनि एषाम् महात्मनाम्
स्वर्गम् गच्छेयुर् अत्यंतम् सर्वे मे प्रपितामहाः
transliteration: gangāyāḥ salila klinne bhasmani eṣām mahātmanām
svargam gaccheyur atyaṃtam sarve me prapitāmahāḥ
english: If, adorable one, you are pleased with me, if you would grant me the fruit of my asceticism, may Sagara's sons receive water at my hands; and on the ashes of those high-souled ones being laved by the waters of Gangā, may my greatgrand-father without fail repair to heaven!

sanskrit: देव याचे ह संतत्यै न अवसीदेत् कुलम् च नः
इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले देव एष मे अस्तु वरः परः
transliteration: deva yāce ha saṃtatyai na avasīdet kulam ca naḥ
ikṣvākūṇām kule deva eṣa me astu varaḥ paraḥ
english: And, O divine one, I beseech you, may our line never languish for want of offspring. May, O God, this prime boon light upon Iksvāku's race!

sanskrit: उक्त वाक्यम् तु राजानम् सर्वलोक पितामहः
प्रत्युवाच शुभाम् वाणीम् मधुरम् मधुर अक्षराम्
transliteration: ukta vākyam tu rājānam sarvaloka pitāmahaḥ
pratyuvāca śubhām vāṇīm madhuram madhura akṣarām
english: When the king had said this, the Grand-sire addressed him these sweet and auspicious words composed of melting letters.

sanskrit: एवम् भवतु भद्रम् ते इक्ष्वाकु कुल वर्धन
transliteration: evam bhavatu bhadram te ikṣvāku kula vardhana
english: O mighty car-warrior Bhagiratha, high is this your aim. Be it so, good betide you, you enhancer of the Ikşvāku line.

sanskrit: इयम् हैमवती ज्येष्ठा गंगा हिमवतः सुता
ताम् वै धारयितुम् राजन् हरः तत्र नियुज्यताम्
transliteration: iyam haimavatī jyeṣṭhā gaṃgā himavataḥ sutā
tām vai dhārayitum rājan haraḥ tatra niyujyatām
english: This Haimavati Ganga, Himavat's elder daughter, even her to hold, Oking do you employ Hara.

sanskrit: गंगायाः पतनम् राजन् पृथिवी न सहिष्यते
ताम् वै धारयितुम् राजन् न अन्यम् पश्यामि शूलिनः
transliteration: gaṃgāyāḥ patanam rājan pṛthivī na sahiṣyate
tām vai dhārayitum rājan na anyam paśyāmi śūlinaḥ
english: For Gangā's fall, O king, Earth will not be able to sustain. And to hold her, O king find I none save the wielder of the Trident.'

sanskrit: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा राजानम् गंगाम् च आभाष्य लोककृत्
जगाम त्रिदिवम् देवैः सर्वैः सह मरुत् गणैः
transliteration: tam evam uktvā rājānam gaṃgām ca ābhāṣya lokakṛt
jagāma tridivam devaiḥ sarvaiḥ saha marut gaṇaiḥ
english: Having thus addressed the monarch, and greeted Gangā, the creator of the worlds repaired to heaven with the celestials.

sanskrit: देव देवे गते तस्मिन् सो अंगुष्ठ अग्र निपीडिताम्
transliteration: deva deve gate tasmin so aṃguṣṭha agra nipīḍitām
english: When that god of gods had gone away, Bhagiratha, O Rāma, pressing the earth with his thumb, spent a year in adoring Siva.

sanskrit: अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे सर्व लोक नमस्कृतः
transliteration: atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe sarva loka namaskṛtaḥ
english: And when the yea was complete, Uma's lord, Pasupati, worshipped of all the worlds, spoke to the king, saying,

sanskrit: प्रीतः ते अहम् नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि तव प्रियम्
transliteration: prītaḥ te aham naraśreṣṭha kariṣyāmi tava priyam
english: O foremost of men, I am well pleased with you: I will do what will before your welfare. I will hold the Mountain's daughter on my head.

sanskrit: ततो हैमवती ज्येष्ठा सर्व लोक नमस्कृता
तदा सा अति महत् रूपम् कृत्वा वेगम् च दुःसहम्
transliteration: tato haimavatī jyeṣṭhā sarva loka namaskṛtā
tadā sā ati mahat rūpam kṛtvā vegam ca duḥsaham
english: Then, O Rāma. that one bowed to by all creatures, the elder daughter of Himavat, assuming an exceedingly mighty shape, with irresistible impetus precipitated herself from the welkin upon Siva's gracious head.

sanskrit: आकाशात् अपतत् राम शिवे शिव शिरस्य् उत
अचिन्तयः च सा देवी गंग परम दुर्धरा
transliteration: ākāśāt apatat rāma śive śiva śirasy uta
acintayaḥ ca sā devī gaṃga parama durdharā

sanskrit: विशामि अहम् हि पातालम् स्त्रोतसा गृह्य शंकरम्
तस्याः वलेपनम् ज्ञत्व क्रुद्धः तु भगवन् हरः
transliteration: viśāmi aham hi pātālam strotasā gṛhya śaṃkaram
tasyāḥ valepanam jñatva kruddhaḥ tu bhagavan haraḥ

sanskrit: सा तस्मिन् पतिता पुण्या पुण्ये रुद्रस्य मूर्धनि
transliteration: sā tasmin patitā puṇyā puṇye rudrasya mūrdhani

sanskrit: हिमवत् प्रतिमे राम जटा मण्डल गह्वरे
सा कथंचित् महीम् गंतुम् न अशक्नोत् यत्नम् आस्थिता
transliteration: himavat pratime rāma jaṭā maṇḍala gahvare
sā kathaṃcit mahīm gaṃtum na aśaknot yatnam āsthitā

sanskrit: न एव सा निर्गमम् लेभे जटा मण्डल अंततः
तत्र एव आबंभ्रमत् देवी संवत्सर गणान् बहून्
transliteration: na eva sā nirgamam lebhe jaṭā maṇḍala aṃtataḥ
tatra eva ābaṃbhramat devī saṃvatsara gaṇān bahūn

sanskrit: ताम् अपश्यन् पुनः तत्र तपः परमम् आस्थितः
स तेन तोषितः च असीत् अत्यंतम् रघुनंदन
transliteration: tām apaśyan punaḥ tatra tapaḥ paramam āsthitaḥ
sa tena toṣitaḥ ca asīt atyaṃtam raghunaṃdana

sanskrit: विससर्ज ततो गंगाम् हरो बिन्दु सरः प्रति
transliteration: visasarja tato gaṃgām haro bindu saraḥ prati
english: And finding Gangā in this plight, Bhagīratha became again engaged in high austerities. And thereupon Siva, O descendant of Raghu, was exceedingly gratified; and cast Gangā off in the direction of the Bindu lake. And as she was let off, seven streams branched out from her.

sanskrit: ह्लादिनी पावनी चैव नलिनी च तथा एव च
तिस्रः प्राचीम् दिशम् जग्मुः गंगाः शिव जलाः शुभाः
transliteration: hlādinī pāvanī caiva nalinī ca tathā eva ca
tisraḥ prācīm diśam jagmuḥ gaṃgāḥ śiva jalāḥ śubhāḥ
english: And the three streams of the excellent Gangā of auspicious waters took an easterly direction; while the Sucakşu, the Sītā, and that mighty river the Sindhu flowed on the auspicious west.

sanskrit: सुचक्षुः च एव सीता च सिन्धुः च एव महानदी
तिस्रः एता दिशम् जग्मुः प्रतीचीम् तु शुभ उदकाः
transliteration: sucakṣuḥ ca eva sītā ca sindhuḥ ca eva mahānadī
tisraḥ etā diśam jagmuḥ pratīcīm tu śubha udakāḥ

sanskrit: सप्तमी च अन्वगात् तासम् भगीरथ रथम् तदा
भगीरथो अपि रजर्षि दिव्यम् स्यंदनम् आस्थितः
transliteration: saptamī ca anvagāt tāsam bhagīratha ratham tadā
bhagīratho api rajarṣi divyam syaṃdanam āsthitaḥ
english: And the seventh followed Bhagiratha's car. And that royal saint, the exceedingly puissant Bhagiratha, mounted on a superb car, went before; and Gariga followed him. And she descended from the welkin upon Sankara's head, thence alighting upon the earth.

sanskrit: प्रायात् अग्रे महातेजा गंग तम् च अपि अनुव्रजत्
गगनात् शंकर शिरः ततो धरणिम् आगता
transliteration: prāyāt agre mahātejā gaṃga tam ca api anuvrajat
gaganāt śaṃkara śiraḥ tato dharaṇim āgatā

sanskrit: असर्पत जलम् तत्र तीव्र शब्द पुरस्कृतम्
मत्स्य कच्छप संघैः च शिशुमार गणैः तथा
transliteration: asarpata jalam tatra tīvra śabda puraskṛtam
matsya kacchapa saṃghaiḥ ca śiśumāra gaṇaiḥ tathā
english: And there her waters flowed with thundering sounds. And earth looked beautiful with swarms of fallen and falling fishes, and tortoises, and porpoises.

sanskrit: पतद्भिः पतितैः च एव व्यरोचत वसुंधरा
ततो देव ऋषि गंधर्वा यक्ष सिद्ध गणाः तथा
transliteration: patadbhiḥ patitaiḥ ca eva vyarocata vasuṃdharā
tato deva ṛṣi gaṃdharvā yakṣa siddha gaṇāḥ tathā

sanskrit: व्यलोकयन्त ते तत्र गगनात् गाम् गताम् तदा
विमानैः नगर आकारैः हयैः गज वरैः तथा
transliteration: vyalokayanta te tatra gaganāt gām gatām tadā
vimānaiḥ nagara ākāraiḥ hayaiḥ gaja varaiḥ tathā
english: Then celestials and saints and Gandharvas and Yakşas and Siddhas mounted on excellent elephants and horses and cars resembling cities, looked on Gangă descending upon earth.

sanskrit: पारिप्लव गताः च अपि देवताः तत्र विष्ठिताः
तत् अद्भुततमम् लोके गंगा अवतरम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: pāriplava gatāḥ ca api devatāḥ tatra viṣṭhitāḥ
tat adbhutatamam loke gaṃgā avataram uttamam
english: And the celestials stationed on cars were struck with surprise; and all creatures marvelled at the excellent descent of Gangā.

sanskrit: दिदृक्षवो देव गणाः समीयुः अमित ओजसः
संपतद्भिः सुर गणैः तेषाम् च आभरण ओजसा
transliteration: didṛkṣavo deva gaṇāḥ samīyuḥ amita ojasaḥ
saṃpatadbhiḥ sura gaṇaiḥ teṣām ca ābharaṇa ojasā

sanskrit: शत आदित्यम् इव आभाति गगनम् गत तोयदम्
शिंशुमार उरग गणैः मीनैः अपि च चंचलैः
transliteration: śata ādityam iva ābhāti gaganam gata toyadam
śiṃśumāra uraga gaṇaiḥ mīnaiḥ api ca caṃcalaiḥ

sanskrit: विद्युद्भिः इव विक्षिप्तैः आकाशम् अभवत् तदा
transliteration: vidyudbhiḥ iva vikṣiptaiḥ ākāśam abhavat tadā
english: And the sky was graced with fast-fleeting porpoises and serpents and fishes resembling playing lightning; and the welkin scattered with pale foam-flakes by thousands, appeared as if it was scattered with autumnal clouds swarming with cranes.

sanskrit: शारद अभ्रैः इव आक्रीणम् गगनम् हंस संप्लवैः
क्वचित् द्रुततरम् याति कुटिलम् क्वचित् आयतम्
transliteration: śārada abhraiḥ iva ākrīṇam gaganam haṃsa saṃplavaiḥ
kvacit drutataram yāti kuṭilam kvacit āyatam

sanskrit: विनतम् क्वचित् उद्धूतम् क्वचित् याति शनैः शनैः
सलिलेन एव सलिलम् क्वचित् अभ्याहतम् पुनः
transliteration: vinatam kvacit uddhūtam kvacit yāti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
salilena eva salilam kvacit abhyāhatam punaḥ
english: And the river proceeded sometimes rapidly, and sometimes awry, and sometimes in volumes and sometimes sloping, and sometimes ascending and sometimes languidly; and sometimes water clashed with water.

sanskrit: मुहुर् ऊर्ध्व पथम् गत्वा पपात वसुधाम् पुनः
तत् शंकर शिरो भ्रष्टम् भ्रष्टम् भूमि तले पुनः
transliteration: muhur ūrdhva patham gatvā papāta vasudhām punaḥ
tat śaṃkara śiro bhraṣṭam bhraṣṭam bhūmi tale punaḥ
english: Sometimes ascending an upland, it descended it no a dell. And the pellucid and pure water first descending upon Śankara's head, and thence on to the earth, appeared exceedingly beautiful.

sanskrit: व्यरोचत तदा तोयम् निर्मलम् गत कल्मषम्
तत्र ऋषि गण गन्धर्वा वसुधा तल वासिनः १-४३-२६भव अंग पतितम् तोयम् पवित्रम् इति पस्पृशुः
शापात् प्रपतिता ये च गगनात् वसुधा तलम्
transliteration: vyarocata tadā toyam nirmalam gata kalmaṣam
tatra ṛṣi gaṇa gandharvā vasudhā tala vāsinaḥ 1-43-26bhava aṃga patitam toyam pavitram iti paspṛśuḥ
śāpāt prapatitā ye ca gaganāt vasudhā talam
english: And there the saints and the Gandharvas, as well as the inhabitants of the earth, touched the sacred water flowing from Bhava's body.

sanskrit: कृत्वा तत्र अभिषेकम् ते बभूवुः गत कल्मषाः
धूत पापाः पुनः तेन तोयेन अथ शुभ अन्विता
transliteration: kṛtvā tatra abhiṣekam te babhūvuḥ gata kalmaṣāḥ
dhūta pāpāḥ punaḥ tena toyena atha śubha anvitā
english: And those that had fallen from the sky to the earth in consequence of some curse of other, having bathed there, and thereby having their sins washed an removed by that sanctifying water, again ascended the sky and entered the celestial regions.

sanskrit: पुनः आकाशम् आविश्य स्वान् लोकान् प्रतिपेदिरे
मुमुदे मुदितो लोकः तेन तोयेन भास्वता
transliteration: punaḥ ākāśam āviśya svān lokān pratipedire
mumude mudito lokaḥ tena toyena bhāsvatā

sanskrit: कृत अभिषेको गंगायाम् बभूव गत कल्मषः
transliteration: kṛta abhiṣeko gaṃgāyām babhūva gata kalmaṣaḥ

sanskrit: प्रायात् अग्रे महाराजाः तम् गंगा पृष्ठतो अन्वगात्
देवाः स ऋषि गणाः सर्वे दैत्य दानव राक्षसाः
transliteration: prāyāt agre mahārājāḥ tam gaṃgā pṛṣṭhato anvagāt
devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ sarve daitya dānava rākṣasāḥ

sanskrit: गन्धर्व यक्ष प्रवराः स किंनर महोरगाः
सर्पाः च अप्सरसो राम भगीरथ रथ अनुगाः
transliteration: gandharva yakṣa pravarāḥ sa kiṃnara mahoragāḥ
sarpāḥ ca apsaraso rāma bhagīratha ratha anugāḥ
english: The gods, and the saints, and the Daityas, and the Dānavas, and the Rākşasas, and the foremost of Gandharvas and Yaksas, and the Kinnaras, and the mighty Uragas, and the Serpents, and the Apsaras, O Rāma, and the acquatic animals in a body following Bhagirahta's car, with glad hearts went in the wake of Gangā.

sanskrit: गंगाम् अन्वगमन् प्रीताः सर्वे जल चराः च ये
यतो भगीरथो राजा ततो गंगा यशस्विनी
transliteration: gaṃgām anvagaman prītāḥ sarve jala carāḥ ca ye
yato bhagīratho rājā tato gaṃgā yaśasvinī

sanskrit: जगाम सरिताम् श्रेष्ठा सर्व पाप प्रणाशिनी
ततो हि यजमानस्य जह्नोः अद्भुत कर्मणः
transliteration: jagāma saritām śreṣṭhā sarva pāpa praṇāśinī
tato hi yajamānasya jahnoḥ adbhuta karmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: तसया वलेपनम् ज्ञत्व कृद्धो जह्नुः च राघव
transliteration: tasayā valepanam jñatva kṛddho jahnuḥ ca rāghava

sanskrit: अपिबत् तु जलम् सर्वम् गंगयाः परम अद्भुतम्
ततो देवाः स गंघर्व ऋषयः च सु विस्मिताः
transliteration: apibat tu jalam sarvam gaṃgayāḥ parama adbhutam
tato devāḥ sa gaṃgharva ṛṣayaḥ ca su vismitāḥ
english: Thereat, O Rāghava, reading her insolence, Jahnu, waxing wroth, drank up all her wonderful waters. Thereupon, the deities, and the Gandharvas, and the saints, struck with amazement fell to worshipping that foremost of men, the high-souled Jahnu.

sanskrit: गंगम् च अपि नयन्ति स्म दुहितृत्वे महात्मनः
transliteration: gaṃgam ca api nayanti sma duhitṛtve mahātmanaḥ

sanskrit: ततः तुष्टः महातेजाः श्रोत्राभ्याम् असृउजत् प्रभुः
तस्मात् जह्नु सुता गंग प्रोच्यते जाह्नवी इति च
transliteration: tataḥ tuṣṭaḥ mahātejāḥ śrotrābhyām asṛujat prabhuḥ
tasmāt jahnu sutā gaṃga procyate jāhnavī iti ca
english: And that highly energetic lord, being propitiated, let Ganga off through his ears. Therefore it is that Gangā goes by the name of Jahnu's daughter.

sanskrit: जगाम च पुनः गंग भगीरथ रथ अनुगा
सागरम् च अपि संप्रप्ता सा सरित् प्रवरा तदा
transliteration: jagāma ca punaḥ gaṃga bhagīratha ratha anugā
sāgaram ca api saṃpraptā sā sarit pravarā tadā
english: Then Gargā again began to follow Bhagīratha's car. And having reached the ocean, that foremost of streams, with the object of accomplishing that work, entered into the subterranean regions.

sanskrit: भगीरथो अपि रजार्षि गंगम् आदाय यत्नतः
transliteration: bhagīratho api rajārṣi gaṃgam ādāya yatnataḥ

sanskrit: पितमहान् भस्म क्रुतम् अपश्यत् गत चेतनः
अथ तत् भस्मनाम् राशिम् गंग सलिलम् उत्तमम्
प्लावयत् पूत पाप्मानः स्वर्गम् प्रप्ता रघु उत्तम
transliteration: pitamahān bhasma krutam apaśyat gata cetanaḥ
atha tat bhasmanām rāśim gaṃga salilam uttamam
plāvayat pūta pāpmānaḥ svargam praptā raghu uttama
english: The excellent waters of Gangā overflowed that heap of ashes; and thereupon, O best of the Raghus, they their sins purged; attained heaven.

sanskrit: स गत्वा सागरम् राजा गंगया अनुगतस् तदा
प्रविवेश तलम् भूमेः यत्र ते भस्मसात् कृताः
transliteration: sa gatvā sāgaram rājā gaṃgayā anugatas tadā
praviveśa talam bhūmeḥ yatra te bhasmasāt kṛtāḥ
english: Then having arrived at the Ocean, the king wending in Ganga's wake, entered underneath the Earth, at that spot where those (sons of Sagara) had been reduced to ashes. And, O Rāma, on the ashes being washed by the waters of Gangā, Brahmā, the lord of all creatures thus spoke to the monarch.

sanskrit: भस्मनि अथ आप्लुते राम गंगाइआः सलिलेन वै
सर्व लोक प्रभुः ब्रह्मा राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: bhasmani atha āplute rāma gaṃgāiāḥ salilena vai
sarva loka prabhuḥ brahmā rājānam idam abravīt
english: Then having arrived at the Ocean, the king wending in Ganga's wake, entered underneath the Earth, at that spot where those (sons of Sagara) had been reduced to ashes. And, O Rāma, on the ashes being washed by the waters of Gangā, Brahmā, the lord of all creatures thus spoke to the monarch.

sanskrit: तारिता नरशार्दूल दिवम् याताः च देववत्
transliteration: tāritā naraśārdūla divam yātāḥ ca devavat
english: O most puissant of men, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara have been delivered and they have ascended heaven like to celestials themselves.

sanskrit: सागरस्य जलम् लोके यावत् स्थास्यति पार्थिव
सगरस्य आत्मजाः सर्वे दिवि स्थास्यन्ति देववत्
transliteration: sāgarasya jalam loke yāvat sthāsyati pārthiva
sagarasya ātmajāḥ sarve divi sthāsyanti devavat
english: O lord of earth, as long as the waters of the ocean shall endure in the world. Sagara's sons shall reside in heaven like to celestials.

sanskrit: इयम् च दुहिता ज्येष्ठा तव गंगा भविष्यति
त्वत् कृतेन च नाम्ना अथ लोके स्थास्यति विश्रुता
transliteration: iyam ca duhitā jyeṣṭhā tava gaṃgā bhaviṣyati
tvat kṛtena ca nāmnā atha loke sthāsyati viśrutā
english: This Gangā shall become your eldest daughter; and she shall attain celebrity among all, being called after your name.

sanskrit: गंगा त्रिपथगा नाम दिव्या भागीरथी इति च
त्रीन् पथो भावयन्ति इति तस्मत् त्रिपथगा स्मृता
transliteration: gaṃgā tripathagā nāma divyā bhāgīrathī iti ca
trīn patho bhāvayanti iti tasmat tripathagā smṛtā
english: And Gangā is called both Tripathagã and Bhăgirathi. And she is know as Tripathagā, is consequence of her proceeding in three directions.
Do you now, O lord of men, her offer oblations of water to your grand-sires, and thereby, O king, make good your promise.

sanskrit: पूर्वकेण हि ते राजन् तेन अतियशसा तदा
धर्मिणाम् प्रवरेण अथ न एष प्राप्तो मनोरथः
transliteration: pūrvakeṇa hi te rājan tena atiyaśasā tadā
dharmiṇām pravareṇa atha na eṣa prāpto manorathaḥ
english: O king, that foremost of righteous ones, your ancestor of exceeding renown, had failed to attain his desire.

sanskrit: तथैव अंशुमता वत्स लोके अप्रतिम तेजसा
गंगाम् प्रार्थयता नेतुम् प्रतिज्ञा न अपवर्जिता
transliteration: tathaiva aṃśumatā vatsa loke apratima tejasā
gaṃgām prārthayatā netum pratijñā na apavarjitā
english: O child Ansumat likewise unparalleled in the worlds in energy, had failed in realising his cherished promise of bringing down Gangā.

sanskrit: मत् तुल्य तपसा चैव क्षत्र धर्म स्थितेन च
transliteration: mat tulya tapasā caiva kṣatra dharma sthitena ca
english: O child Ansumat likewise unparalleled in the worlds in energy, had failed in realising his cherished promise of bringing down Gangā.

sanskrit: पुनर् न शकिता नेतुम् गंगाम् प्रार्थयत अनघ
transliteration: punar na śakitā netum gaṃgām prārthayata anagha
english: Then again that royal saint, crowned with qualities; of austerities like to mine, ever abiding by his Ksatriya duties, even Dilipa's self, your exceedingly puissant sire.

sanskrit: प्राप्तो असि परमम् लोके यशः परम संमतम्
transliteration: prāpto asi paramam loke yaśaḥ parama saṃmatam
english: O eminently righteous one, had failed in bringing down Gangā according to his cherished resolve, O sinless one. And now, O foremost of men, that promise having been fulfilled by you, you shall attain signal glory in the world by the common consent of all.

sanskrit: तत् च गंगा अवतरणम् त्वया कृतम् अरिन्दम
अनेन च भवान् प्राप्तो धर्मस्य आयतनम् महत्
transliteration: tat ca gaṃgā avataraṇam tvayā kṛtam arindama
anena ca bhavān prāpto dharmasya āyatanam mahat
english: And, O vanquisher of your foes, having brought about Ganga's dissension, you shall from this act of your also attain the regions of Brahma.

sanskrit: प्लावयस्व त्वम् आत्मानम् नरोत्तम सदा उचिते
transliteration: plāvayasva tvam ātmānam narottama sadā ucite
english: Do you, O best of me, lave thyself in these waters worthy of the pious, O prime of men, and thereby become purified, and attain sanctity.

sanskrit: स्वस्ति ते अस्तु गमिष्यामि स्वम् लोकम् गम्यताम् नृप
transliteration: svasti te astu gamiṣyāmi svam lokam gamyatām nṛpa
english: Do you perform the watery rites of your grand-sires. May luck be your, I shall now repair to my own regions: do you depart, O king.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा देवेशः सर्वलोक पितामहः
यथा आगतम् तथा अगच्छत् देव लोकम् महायशाः
transliteration: iti evam uktvā deveśaḥ sarvaloka pitāmahaḥ
yathā āgatam tathā agacchat deva lokam mahāyaśāḥ
english: Having said this, the illustrious lord of the celestials the Grand-sire of all creatures, went to the celestial regions.

sanskrit: भगीरथः तु राजर्षिः कृत्वा सलिलम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: bhagīrathaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā salilam uttamam
english: The royal saint king Bhagiratha also of high fame having performed his ablutions and purified himself, and duly and in proper order offered oblations of water to the sons of Sagara, entered his capital. And attaining exceeding prosperity, that foremost of men ruled his kingdom.

sanskrit: कृतोदकः शुची राजा स्वपुरम् प्रविवेश ह
transliteration: kṛtodakaḥ śucī rājā svapuram praviveśa ha
english: The royal saint king Bhagiratha also of high fame having performed his ablutions and purified himself, and duly and in proper order offered oblations of water to the sons of Sagara, entered his capital. And attaining exceeding prosperity, that foremost of men ruled his kingdom.

sanskrit: प्रमुमोद च लोकः तम् नृपम् आसाद्य राघव
transliteration: pramumoda ca lokaḥ tam nṛpam āsādya rāghava
english: O descendant of Raghu, having him as their sovereign, the people rejoiced greatly; and with their griefs removed and prosperity secured, they lived in peace of mind.

sanskrit: एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरो अभिहितो मया
स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते संध्या कालो अतिवर्तते
transliteration: eṣa te rāma gaṃgāyā vistaro abhihito mayā
svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te saṃdhyā kālo ativartate
english: Thus, O Rama, have I defailed to you the history of Gangā. Auspiciousness may you obtain! Good betide you, the evening draw nigh.

sanskrit: धन्यम् यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् पुत्र्यम् स्वर्ग्यम् अथ अपि च
यः श्रावयति विप्रेषु क्षत्रियेषु इतेरेषु च
transliteration: dhanyam yaśasyam āyuṣyam putryam svargyam atha api ca
yaḥ śrāvayati vipreṣu kṣatriyeṣu itereṣu ca
english: He that recite this story conferring prosperity, fame, long life, and heaven to Vipras, Kșatriyas, and other, attain the good graces of his ancestors and the celestials.

sanskrit: इदम् आKयनम् आयुश्यम् गंगा अवतरणम् शुभम्
transliteration: idam āyanam āyuśyam gaṃgā avataraṇam śubham

sanskrit: यः श्रुणोति च काकुत्स्थ सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात्
सर्वे पापाः प्रणश्यन्ति आयुः कीर्तिः च वर्धते
transliteration: yaḥ śruṇoti ca kākutstha sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt
sarve pāpāḥ praṇaśyanti āyuḥ kīrtiḥ ca vardhate
english: O Kākutstha, he that listen to the sacred history of Ganga's descent, conferring length of days, attain all his desires, and all his sins are destroyed, and his life and fame increase.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः
विस्मयम् परमम् गत्वा विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
vismayam paramam gatvā viśvāmitram atha abravīt
english: Hearing the words of Viśvāmitra, Rāghava, together with Laksmana, was struck with amazement, and spoke to Viśvāmitra, saying,

sanskrit: अति अद्भुतम् इदम् ब्रह्मन् कथितम् परमम् त्वया
गंगा अवतरणम् पुण्यम् सागरस्य अपि पूरणम्
transliteration: ati adbhutam idam brahman kathitam paramam tvayā
gaṃgā avataraṇam puṇyam sāgarasya api pūraṇam
english: O Brāhmaṇa, wonderful is the story that you have recited to us, viz; that of Ganga's sacred dissension and the replenishing of the Ocean.

sanskrit: क्षण भूत इव नौ रात्रिः संवृत्त इयम् परंतप
इमाम् चिंतयतोः सर्वम् निखिलेन कथाम् तव
transliteration: kṣaṇa bhūta iva nau rātriḥ saṃvṛtta iyam paraṃtapa
imām ciṃtayatoḥ sarvam nikhilena kathām tava
english: And, O afflicter of foes, as we had been reflecting upon all this at length, the night has passed away as if it were as moment.

sanskrit: तस्य सा शर्वरी सर्वा मम सौमित्रिणा सह
जगाम चिंतयान् अस्य विश्वामित्र कथाम् शुभाम्
transliteration: tasya sā śarvarī sarvā mama saumitriṇā saha
jagāma ciṃtayān asya viśvāmitra kathām śubhām
english: And the live-long night has passed away as I in company with Sumitrā's son, was pondering over Viśvāmitra's auspicious speech.'

sanskrit: उवाच राघवो वाक्यम् कृत आह्निकम् अरिन्दमः
transliteration: uvāca rāghavo vākyam kṛta āhnikam arindamaḥ
english: Then in the morning which happened to be bright, that subduer of his foes, Raghu's descendant, addressed the ascetic Viśvāmitra, who had finished his devotion.

sanskrit: गता भगवती रात्रिः श्रोतव्यम् परमम् श्रुतम्
तराम सरितम् श्रेष्टम् पुण्यम् त्रि पथ गाम् नदीम्
transliteration: gatā bhagavatī rātriḥ śrotavyam paramam śrutam
tarāma saritam śreṣṭam puṇyam tri patha gām nadīm
english: The auspicious night is past, and we shall (again) listen to your wonderful narrations. Let us now cross over this sacred stream, foremost of rivers, wending in three ways.

sanskrit: नौः एषा हि सुख आस्तीर्णा ऋषीणाम् पुण्य कर्मणाम्
भगवंतम् इह प्राप्तम् ज्ञात्वा त्वरितम् आगता
transliteration: nauḥ eṣā hi sukha āstīrṇā ṛṣīṇām puṇya karmaṇām
bhagavaṃtam iha prāptam jñātvā tvaritam āgatā
english: And learning that you have arrived at this place, the pious ascetics have speedily come hither, and have also brought this barque with a spacious carpet.

sanskrit: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः
संतारम् कारयामास स ऋषि संघस्य कौशिकः
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
saṃtāram kārayāmāsa sa ṛṣi saṃghasya kauśikaḥ
english: Hearing those words of the high-souled Rāghava, Kausika crossed over the crowds of ascetics; and on reaching the north bank, he paid homage to the saints. And when they had landed on the banks of the Gangā, they beheld a city named Viśālā.

sanskrit: उत्तरम् तीरम् आसाद्य संपूज्य ऋषि गणम् ततः
गंगा कूले निविष्टाः ते विशालाम् ददृशुः पुरीम्
transliteration: uttaram tīram āsādya saṃpūjya ṛṣi gaṇam tataḥ
gaṃgā kūle niviṣṭāḥ te viśālām dadṛśuḥ purīm
english: Hearing those words of the high-souled Rāghava, Kausika crossed over the crowds of ascetics; and on reaching the north bank, he paid homage to the saints. And when they had landed on the banks of the Gangā, they beheld a city named Viśālā.

sanskrit: ततो मुनि वरः तूर्णम् जगाम सह राघवः
विशालाम् नगरीम् रम्याम् दिव्याम् स्वर्ग उपमाम् तदा
transliteration: tato muni varaḥ tūrṇam jagāma saha rāghavaḥ
viśālām nagarīm ramyām divyām svarga upamām tadā
english: And thereupon speedily that that foremost of ascetics in company with Rāghava, went towards Viśālā, beautiful and elegant like to the celestial regions.

sanskrit: पप्रच्छ प्रांजलिः भूत्वा विशालाम् उत्तमाम् पुरीम्
transliteration: papraccha prāṃjaliḥ bhūtvā viśālām uttamām purīm
english: Then the highly wise Rāma, with folded hands, asked that mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra concerning the excellent city of Viśālā.

sanskrit: कतमो राज वंशो अयम् विशालायाम् महामुने
श्रोतुम् इच्छामि भद्रम् ते परम् कौतूहलम् हि मे
transliteration: katamo rāja vaṃśo ayam viśālāyām mahāmune
śrotum icchāmi bhadram te param kautūhalam hi me
english: O mighty ascetic, what royal line reside in yonder large city? I desire to hear this, good betide you; and great is my curiosity.

sanskrit: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा रामस्य मुनिपुंगवः
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā rāmasya munipuṃgavaḥ
english: Hearing those words of Rāma, that foremost of ascetics began to relate the history of Viśālā, saying,

sanskrit: श्रूयताम् राम शक्रस्य कथाम् कथयतः श्रुताम्
अस्मिन् देशे हि यत् वृत्तम् शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव
transliteration: śrūyatām rāma śakrasya kathām kathayataḥ śrutām
asmin deśe hi yat vṛttam śṛṇu tattvena rāghava
english: Do you listen, O Rāma to what I had heard from Sakra relating this history; and, O descendant of Raghu, do you listen to all that befell in this city.

sanskrit: पूर्वम् कृत युगे राम दितेः पुत्रा महाबलाः
transliteration: pūrvam kṛta yuge rāma diteḥ putrā mahābalāḥ
english: Formerly in the Krita age, O Rāma, Diti's highly powerful sons, as well as those of Aditi, possessed of prowess, and virtuous and pious, high-souled ones both.

sanskrit: ततः तेषाम् नरव्याघ्रः बुद्धिः आसीत् महात्मनाम्
अमरा विर्जराः चैव कथम् स्यामो निरामयाः
transliteration: tataḥ teṣām naravyāghraḥ buddhiḥ āsīt mahātmanām
amarā virjarāḥ caiva katham syāmo nirāmayāḥ
english: O foremost of men, fell to reflecting, 'How can we become exempt from decrepitude and disease, and immortal.'

sanskrit: तेषाम् चिंतयताम् तत्र बुद्धिः आसीत् विपश्चिताम्
क्षीर उद मथनम् कृत्वा रसम् प्राप्स्याम तत्र वै
transliteration: teṣām ciṃtayatām tatra buddhiḥ āsīt vipaścitām
kṣīra uda mathanam kṛtvā rasam prāpsyāma tatra vai
english: And as they reflected, it struck them, 'By churning the ocean of milk, we must obtain ambrosia.'

sanskrit: ततो निश्चित्य मथनम् योक्त्रम् कृत्वा च वासुकिम्
मन्थानम् मन्दरम् कृत्वा ममन्थुर् अमित ओजसः
transliteration: tato niścitya mathanam yoktram kṛtvā ca vāsukim
manthānam mandaram kṛtvā mamanthur amita ojasaḥ
english: Then deciding upon churning (the ocean), those ones of immeasurable energy making Vasuki the cord, and the Mandara (hill), the stick, began to churn the deep.

sanskrit: अथ वर्ष सहस्रेण योक्त्र सर्प शिरांसि च
वमन्तो अति विषम् तत्र ददंशुर् दशनैः शिलाः
transliteration: atha varṣa sahasreṇa yoktra sarpa śirāṃsi ca
vamanto ati viṣam tatra dadaṃśur daśanaiḥ śilāḥ
english: After a thousand years had gone by, the hoods (of the serpent) serving as the churning cord, began to vomit virulent venom and to bite at the crags, with their fangs.

sanskrit: तेन दग्धम् जगत् सर्वम् स देव असुर मानुषम्
transliteration: tena dagdham jagat sarvam sa deva asura mānuṣam
english: And thereat there came out powerful poison like to fire; and in consequence the entire universe with celestials, and Asuras, and men, began to burm.

sanskrit: जग्मुः पशुपतिम् रुद्रम् त्राहि त्राहि इति तुष्टुवुः
transliteration: jagmuḥ paśupatim rudram trāhi trāhi iti tuṣṭuvuḥ
english: And thereupon, intending to seek refuge, they appeared before that mighty god, Sarkara, or Pasupati, or Rudra, hymning him.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्{]तः ततो देवैः देवेश्वरः प्रभुः
प्रादुर् आसीत् ततो अत्र एव शंख चक्र धरो हरिः
transliteration: evam uk]taḥ tato devaiḥ deveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
prādur āsīt tato atra eva śaṃkha cakra dharo hariḥ
english: 'Save us, Save us.' When that master, the lord of the celestials, was being thus addressed by the deities, there appeared before them Hari bearing the conch and the discus.

sanskrit: उवाच एनम् स्मितम् कृत्वा रुद्रम् शूलधरम् हरिः
दैवतैः मध्यमानो तु तत् पूर्वम् समुपस्थितम्
transliteration: uvāca enam smitam kṛtvā rudram śūladharam hariḥ
daivataiḥ madhyamāno tu tat pūrvam samupasthitam
english: Smiling Hari said to the trident-bearing Rudra, 'O chief of the celestials, since you are the foremost of the gods, this that has come out of the ocean churned by the celestials, in your as Remaining here, O lord, do you receive the first offering in the form of this poison.'

sanskrit: तत् त्वदीयम् सुरश्रेष्ठः सुराणाम् अग्रतो हि यत्
अग्र पूजामि इह स्थित्वा गृहाण इदम् विषम् प्रभो
transliteration: tat tvadīyam suraśreṣṭhaḥ surāṇām agrato hi yat
agra pūjāmi iha sthitvā gṛhāṇa idam viṣam prabho
english: Smiling Hari said to the trident-bearing Rudra, 'O chief of the celestials, since you are the foremost of the gods, this that has come out of the ocean churned by the celestials, in your as Remaining here, O lord, do you receive the first offering in the form of this poison.'

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा च सुरश्रेष्ठः तत्र एव अंतर्धीयत
देवतानाम् भयम् दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा वाक्यम् तु शारङ्गिणः
transliteration: iti uktvā ca suraśreṣṭhaḥ tatra eva aṃtardhīyata
devatānām bhayam dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vākyam tu śāraṅgiṇaḥ
english: Having said this, that best of celestials vanished there. Witnessing the dismay of the celestials, and hearing also the words of Śārngiņa, Śiva took in that dreadful poison as if it were nectar, and then leaving the deities, the worshipful Hara wen away.

sanskrit: हालाहलम् विषम् घोरम् संजग्राह अमृत उपमम्
देवान् विसृउज्य देवेशो जगाम भगवान् हरः
transliteration: hālāhalam viṣam ghoram saṃjagrāha amṛta upamam
devān visṛujya deveśo jagāma bhagavān haraḥ
english: Having said this, that best of celestials vanished there. Witnessing the dismay of the celestials, and hearing also the words of Śārngiņa, Śiva took in that dreadful poison as if it were nectar, and then leaving the deities, the worshipful Hara wen away.

sanskrit: ततो देव असुराः सर्वे ममन्थू रघुनंदन
transliteration: tato deva asurāḥ sarve mamanthū raghunaṃdana
english: And then, O descendant of Raghu, as the celestials resumed the churning, that foremost of hills serving the cord, entered the subterranean regions.

sanskrit: ततो देवाः स गन्धर्वाः तुष्टुवुः मधुसूदनम्
त्वम् गतिः सर्व भूतानाम् विशेषेण दिवौकसाम्
transliteration: tato devāḥ sa gandharvāḥ tuṣṭuvuḥ madhusūdanam
tvam gatiḥ sarva bhūtānām viśeṣeṇa divaukasām
english: Thereupon the gods and the Gandharvas felt to extolling the slayer of Madhu, saying, “You are the way of all beings, of the celestials in especial. do you, O mighty-armed one, protect us, and recover the mountain.'

sanskrit: पालय अस्मान् महाबाहो गिरिम् उद्धर्तुम् अर्हसि
इति श्रुत्वा हृषीकेशः कामठम् रूपम् आस्थितः
transliteration: pālaya asmān mahābāho girim uddhartum arhasi
iti śrutvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ kāmaṭham rūpam āsthitaḥ

sanskrit: पर्वतम् पृष्टतः कृत्वा शिश्ये तत्र उदधौ हरिः
पर्वत अग्रम् तु लोकात्मा हस्तेन आक्रम्य केशवः
transliteration: parvatam pṛṣṭataḥ kṛtvā śiśye tatra udadhau hariḥ
parvata agram tu lokātmā hastena ākramya keśavaḥ

sanskrit: उदतिष्ठत् सुधर्मात्मा स दण्ड स कमण्दुलुः
पूर्वम् धन्वन्तरिर् नाम अप्सराः च सु वर्चसः
transliteration: udatiṣṭhat sudharmātmā sa daṇḍa sa kamaṇduluḥ
pūrvam dhanvantarir nāma apsarāḥ ca su varcasaḥ

sanskrit: अप्सु निर्मथनात् एव रसात् तस्मात् वर स्त्रियः
उत्पेतुः मनुज श्रेष्ठ तस्मात् अप्सरसो अभवन्
transliteration: apsu nirmathanāt eva rasāt tasmāt vara striyaḥ
utpetuḥ manuja śreṣṭha tasmāt apsaraso abhavan

sanskrit: षष्टिः कोट्यो अभवन् तासाम् अप्सराणाम् सुवर्चसाम्
असंख्येयाः तु काकुत्स्थ याः तासाम् परिचारिकाः
transliteration: ṣaṣṭiḥ koṭyo abhavan tāsām apsarāṇām suvarcasām
asaṃkhyeyāḥ tu kākutstha yāḥ tāsām paricārikāḥ
english: There sprang sixty koțis of shining Apsaras. And, O Kākutstha, the female attendants of those are numberless.

sanskrit: न ताः स्म प्रतिगृह्णन्ति सर्वे ते देव दानवाः
अप्रतिग्रहणात् एव ता वै साधारणाः स्मृताः
transliteration: na tāḥ sma pratigṛhṇanti sarve te deva dānavāḥ
apratigrahaṇāt eva tā vai sādhāraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
english: And neither the deities nor the Dānavas would accept them, and in consequence of this nonacceptance, they are known as women belonging to all.
And then, O Raghu's descendant, arose the eminently pious daughter of Varuna, Varuni, who fell to looking for acceptance.

sanskrit: दितेः पुत्रा न ताम् राम जगृहुर् वरुण आत्मजाम्
अदितेः तु सुता वीर जगृहुः ताम् अनिंदिताम्
transliteration: diteḥ putrā na tām rāma jagṛhur varuṇa ātmajām
aditeḥ tu sutā vīra jagṛhuḥ tām aniṃditām
english: And Diti's sons, O Rāma, did not accept the daughter of Varuna and Aditi's sons, O hero, accepted that one of blameless limbs.

sanskrit: असुराः तेन दैतेयाः सुराः तेन अदितेः सुताः
हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः च आसन् वारुणी ग्रहणात् सुराः
transliteration: asurāḥ tena daiteyāḥ surāḥ tena aditeḥ sutāḥ
hṛṣṭāḥ pramuditāḥ ca āsan vāruṇī grahaṇāt surāḥ
english: Hence Diti's son go by the name of Asuras; and Aditi's by that of Suras. And the celestials became exceeding glad, on having accepted Vāruņi.

sanskrit: उच्चैःश्रवा हय श्रेष्ठो मणि रत्नम् च कौस्तुभम्
transliteration: uccaiḥśravā haya śreṣṭho maṇi ratnam ca kaustubham
english: O foremost of men, next arose ucchaiśravā best of horses, and also Kaustubha; and next, the excellent ambrosia.

sanskrit: अथ तस्य कृते राम महान् आसीत् कुल क्षयः
अदितेः तु ततः पुत्रा दितेः पुत्रान् असूदयन्
transliteration: atha tasya kṛte rāma mahān āsīt kula kṣayaḥ
aditeḥ tu tataḥ putrā diteḥ putrān asūdayan
english: O Rāma, tremendous was the carnage for the possession thereof (ambrosia); and Aditi's and Diti's sons fought together.

sanskrit: एकताम् अगमन् सर्वे असुरा राक्षसैः सह
युद्धम् आसीत् महाघोरम् वीर त्रैलोक्य मोहनम्
transliteration: ekatām agaman sarve asurā rākṣasaiḥ saha
yuddham āsīt mahāghoram vīra trailokya mohanam
english: And the Asuras assembled together with the Raksasas; and, C hero, mighty was the battle that was fought, striking terror into the three worlds.

sanskrit: यदा क्षयम् गतम् सर्वम् तदा विष्णुः महाबलः
अमृतम् सः अहरत् तूर्णम् मायाम् आस्थाय मोहिनीम्
transliteration: yadā kṣayam gatam sarvam tadā viṣṇuḥ mahābalaḥ
amṛtam saḥ aharat tūrṇam māyām āsthāya mohinīm
english: And when a great havoc had been committed the highly powerful Vişņu, assuming a captivating form speedily stole away the ambrosia.

sanskrit: ये गता अभिमुखम् विष्णुम् अक्षरम् पुरुषोत्तमम्
संपिष्टाः ते तदा युद्धे बिष्णुना प्रभ विष्णुना
transliteration: ye gatā abhimukham viṣṇum akṣaram puruṣottamam
saṃpiṣṭāḥ te tadā yuddhe biṣṇunā prabha viṣṇunā
english: And those that came forward before that best of male beings, Visnu, knowing no deterioration, were crushed in conflict by Vişnu in a different form.

sanskrit: अदितेः आत्मजा वीरा दितेः पुत्रान् निजघ्निरे
अस्मिन् घोरे महायुद्धे दैतेया अदित्यायोः भृशम्
transliteration: aditeḥ ātmajā vīrā diteḥ putrān nijaghnire
asmin ghore mahāyuddhe daiteyā adityāyoḥ bhṛśam
english: And in that exceedingly dreadful battle between the sons of Diti and Aditi, those heroic ones viz., Aditi's heroic sons slaughtered those of Diti.

sanskrit: निहत्य दिति पुत्रान् तु राज्यम् प्राप्य पुरंदरः
शशास मुदितो लोकान् स ऋषि संघान् स चारणान्
transliteration: nihatya diti putrān tu rājyam prāpya puraṃdaraḥ
śaśāsa mudito lokān sa ṛṣi saṃghān sa cāraṇān
english: Having slaughtered the sons of Diti's and regained his kingdom, he happily began to rule the worlds, containing saints and Caranas.

sanskrit: हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु दितिः परम दुःखिता
मारीचम् काश्यपम् राम भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: hateṣu teṣu putreṣu ditiḥ parama duḥkhitā
mārīcam kāśyapam rāma bhartāram idam abravīt
english: On those sons of her being slain, Diti afflicted with great grief, thus addressed her husband, Marici's son, Kasyapa.

sanskrit: हत पुत्रा अस्मि भगवन् तव पुत्रैः महाबलैः
शक्र हन्तारम् इच्छामि पुत्रम् दीर्घ तपो अर्जितम्
transliteration: hata putrā asmi bhagavan tava putraiḥ mahābalaiḥ
śakra hantāram icchāmi putram dīrgha tapo arjitam
english: O adorable one, your high-souled sons have slain mine. I now wish for a son, who, obtained through long austerities, will be able to slay Sakra.

sanskrit: सा अहम् तपः चरिष्यामि गर्भम् मे दातुम् अर्हसि
ईश्वरम् शक्र हन्तारम् त्वम् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: sā aham tapaḥ cariṣyāmi garbham me dātum arhasi
īśvaram śakra hantāram tvam anujñātum arhasi
english: I will engage in austerities: it behoves you to grant me such an embryo, such a slayer of Sakra it behoves you to promise me.

sanskrit: तस्याः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा मारीचः काश्यपः तदा
transliteration: tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā mārīcaḥ kāśyapaḥ tadā
english: Hearing those words of hers, Marici's son, Kaśyapa of exceeding energy answered the deeply aggrieved Diti, saying.

sanskrit: एवम् भवतु भद्रम् ते शुचिः भव तपोधने
जनयिष्यसि पुत्रम् त्वम् शक्र हन्तारम् आहवे
transliteration: evam bhavatu bhadram te śuciḥ bhava tapodhane
janayiṣyasi putram tvam śakra hantāram āhave

sanskrit: पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे तु शुचिः यदि भविष्यसि
पुत्रम् त्रैलोक्य हन्तारम् मत्तः त्वम् जनयिष्यसि
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu śuciḥ yadi bhaviṣyasi
putram trailokya hantāram mattaḥ tvam janayiṣyasi
english: Be it so. Good betide you, do you become pure, O ascetic. If you remain pure, when a full thousand years shall be complete, you will give birth to a son who will slay ſakra in battle.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महा तेजाः पाणिना स ममार्ज ताम्
तम् आलभ्य ततः स्वस्ति इति उक्त्वा तपसे ययौ
transliteration: evam uktvā mahā tejāḥ pāṇinā sa mamārja tām
tam ālabhya tataḥ svasti iti uktvā tapase yayau
english: And through me, you will give birth to a son that will destroy the three worlds. Having said this, that highly energetic one rubbed her person with his palm. And having rubbed her, he said, 'Luck!' and then went away to carry on austerities.

sanskrit: गते तस्मिन् नरश्रेष्ठ दितिः परम हर्षिता
transliteration: gate tasmin naraśreṣṭha ditiḥ parama harṣitā
english: When he had gone, Diti, O foremost of men, becoming exceedingly delighted, went to, Kuśaplava and began to practise rigid mortifications.

sanskrit: तपः तस्याम् हि कुर्वत्याम् परिचर्याम् चकार ह
transliteration: tapaḥ tasyām hi kurvatyām paricaryām cakāra ha
english: O foremost of men, as she was practising austerities, the thousand-eyed deity most dutifully ministered to her.

sanskrit: अग्निम् कुशान् काष्ठम् अपः फलम् मूलम् तथैव च
न्यवेदयत् सहस्राक्षो यच् च अन्यत् अपि कान्क्षितम्
transliteration: agnim kuśān kāṣṭham apaḥ phalam mūlam tathaiva ca
nyavedayat sahasrākṣo yac ca anyat api kānkṣitam
english: The thousand-eyed one provided for her fire, and Kusa, and faggots, and water, and fruits, and roots, and other things that she wanted.

sanskrit: गात्र संवाहनैः चैव श्रम अपनयनैः तथा
शक्रः सर्वेषु कालेषु दितिम् परिचचार ह
transliteration: gātra saṃvāhanaiḥ caiva śrama apanayanaiḥ tathā
śakraḥ sarveṣu kāleṣu ditim paricacāra ha
english: And at all times, Sakra served Diti by rubbing her person, and removing her fatigue.

sanskrit: पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे दश ऊने रघुनंदन
दितिः परम संहृष्टा सहस्राक्षम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣa sahasre daśa ūne raghunaṃdana
ditiḥ parama saṃhṛṣṭā sahasrākṣam atha abravīt
english: When ten years only were wanting to complete the thousand years, Diti, O descendant of Raghu, being exceedingly delighted, thus spoke to the thousand-eyed one.

sanskrit: तपः चरन्त्या वर्षाणि दश वीर्यवताम् वर
अवशिष्टानि भद्रम् ते भ्रातरम् द्रक्ष्यसे ततः
transliteration: tapaḥ carantyā varṣāṇi daśa vīryavatām vara
avaśiṣṭāni bhadram te bhrātaram drakṣyase tataḥ
english: O best of those endowed with prowess, of me engaged in austerities, ten years only remain (to complete the period.) And after that time, good betide you, you will behold your brother.

sanskrit: यम् अहम् त्वत् कृते पुत्र तम् आधास्ये जय उत्सुकम्
त्रैलोक्य विजयम् पुत्र सह भोक्ष्यसि विज्वरः
transliteration: yam aham tvat kṛte putra tam ādhāsye jaya utsukam
trailokya vijayam putra saha bhokṣyasi vijvaraḥ
english: I will, O son, bind him to you in affection, whom I had besought for to compass your destruction, so that, the fever of your heart removed, you will with him enjoy the victory of the three worlds.

sanskrit: वरो वर्ष सस्र अन्ते मम दत्तः सुतम् प्रति
transliteration: varo varṣa sasra ante mama dattaḥ sutam prati
english: On your high-souled sire having been besought by me, he, O foremost of celestials, granted me the boon that after a thousand years, I shall obtain a son.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा च दितिः तत्र प्राप्ते मध्यन्दिन ईश्वरे
निद्रया पहृता देवी पादौ कृत्वाथ शीर्षतः
transliteration: iti uktvā ca ditiḥ tatra prāpte madhyandina īśvare
nidrayā pahṛtā devī pādau kṛtvātha śīrṣataḥ
english: And it came to pass that having said this, the sun being in his meridian, the worshipful Diti with her feet placed at that part of the bed which should contain her head, was overpowered by sleep.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा ताम् अशुचिम् शक्रः पादयोः कृत मूर्धजाम्
शिरः स्थाने कृतौ पादौ जहास च मुमोद च
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tām aśucim śakraḥ pādayoḥ kṛta mūrdhajām
śiraḥ sthāne kṛtau pādau jahāsa ca mumoda ca
english: And thereupon seeing her resting her feet at the place where she should place her head, and consequently unclean, Śakra was exceedingly delighted, and smiled.

sanskrit: गर्भम् च सप्तधा राम चिच्छेद परम आत्मवान्
transliteration: garbham ca saptadhā rāma ciccheda parama ātmavān
english: O Rāma, Purandara entered into her womb, and that highly self-controlled one served the embryo in seven parts.

sanskrit: भिद्यमानः ततो गर्भो वज्रेण शत पर्वणा
रुरोद सुस्वरम् राम ततो दितिः अबुध्यत
transliteration: bhidyamānaḥ tato garbho vajreṇa śata parvaṇā
ruroda susvaram rāma tato ditiḥ abudhyata
english: And the embryo being pierced by the thunderbold of an hundred knots, cried at the top of its voice, and thereat Diti awoke.

sanskrit: मा रुदो मा रुदः च इति गर्भम् शक्रो अभ्यभाषत
बिभेद च महातेजा रुदन्तम् अपि वासवः
transliteration: mā rudo mā rudaḥ ca iti garbham śakro abhyabhāṣata
bibheda ca mahātejā rudantam api vāsavaḥ
english: 'Do not cry, do not cry,' exclaimed Sakra: and even while it was crying, the mighty-minded Vāsava continued piercing it.

sanskrit: न हन्तव्यम् न हन्तव्यम् इति एवम् दितिः अब्रवीत्
निष्पपात ततः शक्रो मातुर् वचन गौरवात्
transliteration: na hantavyam na hantavyam iti evam ditiḥ abravīt
niṣpapāta tataḥ śakro mātur vacana gauravāt
english: 'Do not slay it; do not slay it' said Diti. Thereupon, in consideration of the honour of his mother, Sakra went out.

sanskrit: प्रांजलिः वज्र सहितो दितिम् शक्रो अभ्यभाषत
अशुचिः देवि सुप्ता असि पादयोः कृत मूर्धजा
transliteration: prāṃjaliḥ vajra sahito ditim śakro abhyabhāṣata
aśuciḥ devi suptā asi pādayoḥ kṛta mūrdhajā
english: Then he with clasped palms accosted Diti, saying, 'O worshipful one, you did sleep with they feet placed where your head should have lain, and hast therefore become impure. And finding this opportunity, I severed in seven pieces that would-be slayer of mine in battle. Do you, O worshipful one, excuse me.'

sanskrit: तत् अन्तरम् अहम् लब्ध्वा शक्र हन्तारम् आहवे
अभिन्दम् सप्तधा देवि तन् मे त्वम् क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: tat antaram aham labdhvā śakra hantāram āhave
abhindam saptadhā devi tan me tvam kṣantum arhasi
english: Then he with clasped palms accosted Diti, saying, 'O worshipful one, you did sleep with they feet placed where your head should have lain, and hast therefore become impure. And finding this opportunity, I severed in seven pieces that would-be slayer of mine in battle. Do you, O worshipful one, excuse me.'

sanskrit: सप्तधा तु कृते गर्भे दितिः परम दुःखिता
सहस्राक्षम् दुराधर्षम् वाक्यम् स अनुनया अब्रवीत्
transliteration: saptadhā tu kṛte garbhe ditiḥ parama duḥkhitā
sahasrākṣam durādharṣam vākyam sa anunayā abravīt
english: When the embryo had been sundered is seven, Díti exceedingly aggrieved humbly spoke to the irrepressible thousand-eyed deity, saying, as

sanskrit: मम अपराधात् गर्भो अयम् सप्तधा शकली कृतः
न अपराधो हि देव ईश तव अत्र बलसूदन
transliteration: mama aparādhāt garbho ayam saptadhā śakalī kṛtaḥ
na aparādho hi deva īśa tava atra balasūdana
english: By my fault it is that the embryo has been sundered in seven. O chief of the celestials, herein you are guilty of no transgression, o destroyer of Bala.

sanskrit: प्रियम् त्वत् कृतम् इच्छामि मम गर्भ विपर्यये
मरुताम् सप्त सप्तानाम् स्थानपाला भवन्तु ते
transliteration: priyam tvat kṛtam icchāmi mama garbha viparyaye
marutām sapta saptānām sthānapālā bhavantu te
english: And since calamity has befallen the embryo, I wish to do you a good turn. Let the seven parts become the guardians of the seven Maruts.

sanskrit: वात स्कंधा इमे सप्त चरन्तु दिवि पुत्रक
मारुता इति विख्याता दिव्यरूपा मम आत्मजाः
transliteration: vāta skaṃdhā ime sapta carantu divi putraka
mārutā iti vikhyātā divyarūpā mama ātmajāḥ
english: O son, let my sons having noble forms, becoming famous Marutas range the Vātaskandha regions in heaven.

sanskrit: ब्रह्म लोकम् चरतु एक इन्द्र लोकम् तथा अपरः
दिव्य वायुः इति ख्यातः तृतीयो अपि महायशाः
transliteration: brahma lokam caratu eka indra lokam tathā aparaḥ
divya vāyuḥ iti khyātaḥ tṛtīyo api mahāyaśāḥ
english: Let one range Brahmā's regions, and another Indra's, and the highly illustrious third also range around, being known as Divya Vāyu. (Ether).

sanskrit: चत्वारः तु सुरश्रेष्ठ दिशो वै तव शासनात्
संचरिष्यन्ति भद्रम् ते कलेन हि मम आत्मजाः
transliteration: catvāraḥ tu suraśreṣṭha diśo vai tava śāsanāt
saṃcariṣyanti bhadram te kalena hi mama ātmajāḥ
english: O best of celestials, by they command, let the four remaining sons of mine, known by the name which you have mentioned, range about in appointed periods.'

sanskrit: त्वत् कृतेन एव नाम्ना वै मारुता इति विश्रुताः
तस्याः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः
transliteration: tvat kṛtena eva nāmnā vai mārutā iti viśrutāḥ
tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ

sanskrit: सर्वम् एतत् यथा उक्तम् ते भविष्यति न संशयः
transliteration: sarvam etat yathā uktam te bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: विचरिष्यन्ति भद्रम् ते देवरूपाः तव आत्मजाः
एवम् तौ निश्चयम् कृत्वा माता पुत्रौ तपोवने
transliteration: vicariṣyanti bhadram te devarūpāḥ tava ātmajāḥ
evam tau niścayam kṛtvā mātā putrau tapovane

sanskrit: जग्मतुः त्रिदिवम् राम कृतार्थौ इति नः श्रुतम्
एष देशः स काकुत्स्थ महेन्द्रात् अद्युषितः पुरा
transliteration: jagmatuḥ tridivam rāma kṛtārthau iti naḥ śrutam
eṣa deśaḥ sa kākutstha mahendrāt adyuṣitaḥ purā

sanskrit: दितिम् यत्र तपः सिद्धाम् एवम् परिचचार सः
transliteration: ditim yatra tapaḥ siddhām evam paricacāra saḥ

sanskrit: तेन च आसीत् इह स्थाने विशाले इति पुरी कृता
transliteration: tena ca āsīt iha sthāne viśāle iti purī kṛtā
english: O most powerful of men, Ikşvāku had an exceedingly righteous son born to him of Alambusa, known by the name of Viśāla. And here stood a palace, built by him, called Viśālā.
Viśāla's son, O Rāma, was the mighty Hemacandra. And after Hemacandra comes the celebrated Sucandra.

sanskrit: सुचन्द्र तनयो राम धूम्र अश्व इति विश्रुतः
धूम्राश्व तनयः च अपि सृंजयः समपद्यत
transliteration: sucandra tanayo rāma dhūmra aśva iti viśrutaḥ
dhūmrāśva tanayaḥ ca api sṛṃjayaḥ samapadyata
english: O Rāma, the son of Sucandra was Dhumrāśva, and then was born Sšñjaya son to Dhumrāśva.
Srinjaya's son was the powerful Sahadeva, And Sahadeva's son was the pre-eminently pious Kuśāśva.

sanskrit: सोमदत्तस्य पुत्रः तु काकुत्स्थ इति विश्रुतः
transliteration: somadattasya putraḥ tu kākutstha iti viśrutaḥ
english: Kuśāśva's son was the puissant Somadatta. And now, O Kākutstha, Somadatta's son, the effulgent and invincible and renowned Sumati reside in this mansion.

sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो महातेजाः सम्प्रति एष पुरीम् इमाम्
आवसत् परम प्रख्यः सुमतिः नाम दुर्जयः
transliteration: tasya putro mahātejāḥ samprati eṣa purīm imām
āvasat parama prakhyaḥ sumatiḥ nāma durjayaḥ
english: Kuśāśva's son was the puissant Somadatta. And now, O Kākutstha, Somadatta's son, the effulgent and invincible and renowned Sumati reside in this mansion.
And by the grace of Ikşvāku, all the sovereigns of Viśālā are long-loved, and highsouled, and puissant, and pious.

sanskrit: इह अद्य रजनीम् एकाम् सुखम् स्वप्स्यामहे वयम्
श्वः प्रभाते नरश्रेष्ठ जनकम् द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: iha adya rajanīm ekām sukham svapsyāmahe vayam
śvaḥ prabhāte naraśreṣṭha janakam draṣṭum arhasi
english: And here will we happily spend a night; an on the morning of the morrow you will, O foremost of men, behold Janaka.'

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा नर वर श्रेष्ठः प्रत्यागच्छन् महायशाः
transliteration: śrutvā nara vara śreṣṭhaḥ pratyāgacchan mahāyaśāḥ
english: And having heard that the illustrious Viśvāmitra had come, that best of kings, the effulgent Sumati, appeared before him.

sanskrit: पूजाम् च परमाम् कृत्वा स उपाध्यायः सबान्धवः
प्रांजलिः कुशलम् पृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: pūjām ca paramām kṛtvā sa upādhyāyaḥ sabāndhavaḥ
prāṃjaliḥ kuśalam pṛṣṭvā viśvāmitram atha abravīt
english: And having paid Viśvāmitra high homage together with his priests and friends, and with clasped hands enquired after the former's welfare, he addressed Viśvāmitra, saying.

sanskrit: धन्यो अस्मि अनुगृहीतो अस्मि यस्य मे विषयम् मुने
संप्राप्तो दर्शनम् चैव न अस्ति धन्यतरो मम
transliteration: dhanyo asmi anugṛhīto asmi yasya me viṣayam mune
saṃprāpto darśanam caiva na asti dhanyataro mama
english: Blessed are we, and obliged are we, whose domains, O ascetic, have been graced with your presence. Surely none is more blessed than I am.

sanskrit: पृष्ट्वा तु कुशलम् तत्र परस्पर समागमे
transliteration: pṛṣṭvā tu kuśalam tatra paraspara samāgame
english: Having met together they enquired after each other's welfare. And then Sumati spoke to the mighty ascetic, saying.

sanskrit: इमौ कुमारौ भद्रम् ते देव तुल्य पराक्रमौ
गज सिंह गती वीरौ शार्दूल वृषभ उपमौ
transliteration: imau kumārau bhadram te deva tulya parākramau
gaja siṃha gatī vīrau śārdūla vṛṣabha upamau

sanskrit: पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षौ खड्ग तूणी धनुर् धरौ
transliteration: padma patra viśālākṣau khaḍga tūṇī dhanur dharau

sanskrit: यदृच्छया एव गाम् प्राप्तौ देवलोकात् इव अमरौ
कथम् पद्भ्याम् इह प्राप्तौ किम् अर्थम् कस्य वा मुने
transliteration: yadṛcchayā eva gām prāptau devalokāt iva amarau
katham padbhyām iha prāptau kim artham kasya vā mune

sanskrit: भूषयन्तौ इमम् देशम् चन्द्र सूर्यौ इव अंबरम्
transliteration: bhūṣayantau imam deśam candra sūryau iva aṃbaram

sanskrit: किम् अर्थम् च नर श्रेष्ठौ सम्प्राप्तौ दुर्गमे पथि
वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः
transliteration: kim artham ca nara śreṣṭhau samprāptau durgame pathi
vara āyudha dharau vīrau śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ
english: And adorning all directions, like to the Sun or Moon adorning the firmament, and resembling each other. in personal proportions, and expressions, and gestures, and equipped with excellent weapons, and war-like, how have these paragons of men, into this impracticable way? I Wish to hear all this related truly.

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा यथा वृत्तम् न्यवेदयत्
सिद्ध आश्रम निवासम् च राक्षसानाम् वधम् तथा
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā yathā vṛttam nyavedayat
siddha āśrama nivāsam ca rākṣasānām vadham tathā

sanskrit: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा राजा परम विस्मितः
transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā rājā parama vismitaḥ
english: Having heard his words, Viśvāmitra faithfully related all about it. Hearing Viśvāmitra's words, the king was extremely surprised; and having those sons of Daśaratha as his all-worthy guests, received with becoming respect those highly powerful ones deserving of hospitality.

sanskrit: च्अतिथी परमौ प्राप्तम् पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ
transliteration: catithī paramau prāptam putrau daśarathasya tau
english: Having heard his words, Viśvāmitra faithfully related all about it. Hearing Viśvāmitra's words, the king was extremely surprised; and having those sons of Daśaratha as his all-worthy guests, received with becoming respect those highly powerful ones deserving of hospitality.

sanskrit: ततः परम सत्कारम् सुमतेः प्राप्य राघवौ
उष्य तत्र निशाम् एकाम् जग्मतुः मिथिलाम् ततः
transliteration: tataḥ parama satkāram sumateḥ prāpya rāghavau
uṣya tatra niśām ekām jagmatuḥ mithilām tataḥ
english: Meeting with such splendid reception from Sumati, those descendants of Raghu spent there a night, and the next day set out for Mithila.

sanskrit: ताम् दृष्ट्वा मुनयः सर्वे जनकस्य पुरीम् शुभाम्
साधु साधु इति शंसन्तो मिथिलाम् समपूजयन्
transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve janakasya purīm śubhām
sādhu sādhu iti śaṃsanto mithilām samapūjayan
english: Beholding Janaka's beauteous city, the ascetics exclaiming, 'Excellent' fell to admiring Mithila.

sanskrit: मिथिल उपवने तत्र आश्रमम् दृश्य राघवः
पुराणम् निर्जनम् रम्यम् पप्रच्छ मुनि पुंगवम्
transliteration: mithila upavane tatra āśramam dṛśya rāghavaḥ
purāṇam nirjanam ramyam papraccha muni puṃgavam
english: And in a grove at Mithilā, Rāghava saw an ancient, lonely, and romantic asylum, and asked that foremost of ascetics, saying.

sanskrit: इदम् आश्रम संकाशम् किम् नु इदम् मुनि वर्जितम्
श्रोतुम् इच्छामि भगवन् कस्य अयम् पूर्व आश्रमः
transliteration: idam āśrama saṃkāśam kim nu idam muni varjitam
śrotum icchāmi bhagavan kasya ayam pūrva āśramaḥ
english: What is this that look like an asylum, though without any ascetics? I wish to hear, O worshipful one, to whom this asylum belonged in time past.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुता राघवेण उक्तम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
transliteration: tat śrutā rāghaveṇa uktam vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
english: Hearing this speech addressed by Raghu's descendant that one versed in speech, the highly energetic and mighty saint, Viśvāmitra, answered.

sanskrit: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि शृणु तत्त्वेन राघव
यस्य एतत् आश्रम पदम् शप्तम् कोपान् महात्मना
transliteration: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena rāghava
yasya etat āśrama padam śaptam kopān mahātmanā
english: Ah! Do you listen. I will tell you through the wrath of what high-souled one this hermitage came to he cursed.

sanskrit: आश्रमो दिव्य संकाशः सुरैः अपि सुपूजितः
transliteration: āśramo divya saṃkāśaḥ suraiḥ api supūjitaḥ
english: O foremost of men, this excellent asylum honoured by the celestials themselves, formerly belonged to the high-souled Gautama.

sanskrit: स च अत्र तप आतिष्ठत् अहल्या सहितः पुरा
transliteration: sa ca atra tapa ātiṣṭhat ahalyā sahitaḥ purā
english: Here, O illustrious prince, in days of yore Gautama in company with Ahalyā carried on austerities for a long series of years.

sanskrit: तस्य अन्तरम् विदित्वा तु सहस्राक्षः शची पतिः
मुनि वेष धरो भूत्वा अहल्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tasya antaram viditvā tu sahasrākṣaḥ śacī patiḥ
muni veṣa dharo bhūtvā ahalyām idam abravīt
english: And perceiving occasion Saci's lord, the thousand-eyed deity assuming the form of that ascetic thus addressed Ahalyā.

sanskrit: ऋतु कालम् प्रतीक्षन्ते न अर्थिनः सुसमाहिते
संगमम् तु अहम् इच्छामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे
transliteration: ṛtu kālam pratīkṣante na arthinaḥ susamāhite
saṃgamam tu aham icchāmi tvayā saha sumadhyame
english: O exceedingly beautiful one, those bent upon sport, do not stay for the menstrual season. And, O graceful one, I desire to enjoy your company (on the instant).

sanskrit: मतिम् चकार दुर्मेधा देव राज कुतूहलात्
transliteration: matim cakāra durmedhā deva rāja kutūhalāt
english: Thereupon, out of curiosity, that one of perverse understanding consented to the proposals of the chief of the celestials.

sanskrit: कृतार्था अस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ गच्छ शीघ्रम् इतः प्रभो
transliteration: kṛtārthā asmi suraśreṣṭha gaccha śīghram itaḥ prabho
english: Then, having attained her object, she spoke to that foremost of the celestials, saying, 'O best of the immortals, I have obtained my desire, do you speedily go from this place, O lord. Do you, O lord of the celestials, from a sense of respectability preserve yourself and me also.'

sanskrit: आत्मानम् माम् च देवेश सर्वदा रक्ष गौतमात्
इन्द्रः तु प्रहसन् वाक्यम् अहल्याम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: ātmānam mām ca deveśa sarvadā rakṣa gautamāt
indraḥ tu prahasan vākyam ahalyām idam abravīt

sanskrit: सुश्रोणि परितुष्टो अस्मि गमिष्यामि यथा आगतम्
एवम् संगम्य तु तया निश्चक्राम उटजात् ततः
transliteration: suśroṇi parituṣṭo asmi gamiṣyāmi yathā āgatam
evam saṃgamya tu tayā niścakrāma uṭajāt tataḥ

sanskrit: स संभ्रमात् त्वरन् राम शन्कितो गौतमम् प्रति
गौतमम् स ददर्श अथ प्रविशंतम् महामुनिम्
transliteration: sa saṃbhramāt tvaran rāma śankito gautamam prati
gautamam sa dadarśa atha praviśaṃtam mahāmunim

sanskrit: देव दानव दुर्धर्षम् तपो बल समन्वितम्
तीर्थ उदक परिक्लिन्नम् दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम्
transliteration: deva dānava durdharṣam tapo bala samanvitam
tīrtha udaka pariklinnam dīpyamānam iva analam
english: Just at this time, Indra saw that mighty ascetic Gautama entering, that foremost of anchorets, incapable of being repressed by the deities and the Dānavas, and equipped with ascetic energy, having based in the waters of holy spots, and flaming like fire, carrying faggots and Kuća grass.

sanskrit: गृहीत समिधम् तत्र स कुशम् मुनि पुंगवम्
दृष्ट्वा सुर पतिः त्रस्तो विषण्ण वदनो अभवत्
transliteration: gṛhīta samidham tatra sa kuśam muni puṃgavam
dṛṣṭvā sura patiḥ trasto viṣaṇṇa vadano abhavat

sanskrit: अथ दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षम् मुनि वेष धरम् मुनिः
दुर्वृत्तम् वृत्त संपन्नो रोषात् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣam muni veṣa dharam muniḥ
durvṛttam vṛtta saṃpanno roṣāt vacanam abravīt
english: And seeing him, the countenance of the lord of the celestials turned pale. And seeing the wicked thousand-eyed deity in the guise of an ascetic, the well-behaved anchorite fired with rage said.

sanskrit: मम रूपम् समास्थाय कृतवान् असि दुर्मते
अकर्तव्यम् इदम् यस्मात् विफलः त्वम् भविष्यति
transliteration: mama rūpam samāsthāya kṛtavān asi durmate
akartavyam idam yasmāt viphalaḥ tvam bhaviṣyati
english: 'And since, O you of wicked understanding, assuming my form, you have done this foul. deed, you shall lose your scrotum.'

sanskrit: गौतमेन एवम् उक्तस्य स रोषेण महात्मना
पेततुः वृषणौ भूमौ सहस्राक्षस्य तत् क्षणात्
transliteration: gautamena evam uktasya sa roṣeṇa mahātmanā
petatuḥ vṛṣaṇau bhūmau sahasrākṣasya tat kṣaṇāt
