na abhyāgaman tadā bhāga artham sarva devatāḥ
english: Then after a long time, Viśvāmitra of mighty austerities invoked thither all the celestials for receiving their respective shares; but the deities did not come to receive them.

sanskrit: स्रुवम् उद्यम्य स क्रोधः त्रिशंकुम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sruvam udyamya sa krodhaḥ triśaṃkum idam abravīt
english: Thereupon, getting into a wrath, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, lifting up a garland, wrathfully exclaimed.

sanskrit: पश्य मे तपसो वीर्यम् स्व आर्जितस्य नर ईश्वर
एष त्वाम् स्व शरीरेण नयामि स्वर्गम् ओजसा
transliteration: paśya me tapaso vīryam sva ārjitasya nara īśvara
eṣa tvām sva śarīreṇa nayāmi svargam ojasā
english: O lord of men, do you witness the prowess of my self-earned asceticism. And, O king, do you in person repair to heaven hard to attain.

sanskrit: दुष्प्रापम् स्व शरीरेण दिवम् गच्छ नर अधिप
स्वार्जितम् किंचित् अपि अस्ति मया हि तपसः फलम्
transliteration: duṣprāpam sva śarīreṇa divam gaccha nara adhipa
svārjitam kiṃcit api asti mayā hi tapasaḥ phalam
english: Something yet remains in me of the selfearned fruit of my asceticism; and, O king, through the energy of that asceticism, do you repair to heaven in person.

sanskrit: राजन् त्वम् तेजसा तस्य स शरीरो दिवम् व्रज
उक्त वाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् स शरीरो नर ईश्वरः
transliteration: rājan tvam tejasā tasya sa śarīro divam vraja
ukta vākye munau tasmin sa śarīro nara īśvaraḥ

sanskrit: दिवम् जगाम काकुत्स्थ मुनीनाम् पश्यताम् तदा
स्वर्ग लोकम् गतम् दृष्ट्वा त्रिशंकुम् पाक शासनः
transliteration: divam jagāma kākutstha munīnām paśyatām tadā
svarga lokam gatam dṛṣṭvā triśaṃkum pāka śāsanaḥ

sanskrit: सह सर्वैः सुर गणैः इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
त्रिशंको गच्छ भूयः त्वम् न असि स्वर्ग कृत आलयः
transliteration: saha sarvaiḥ sura gaṇaiḥ idam vacanam abravīt
triśaṃko gaccha bhūyaḥ tvam na asi svarga kṛta ālayaḥ

sanskrit: गुरु शाप हतो मूढ पत भूमिम् अवाग् शिराः
एवम् उक्तो महेन्द्रेण त्रिशंकुः अपतत् पुनः
transliteration: guru śāpa hato mūḍha pata bhūmim avāg śirāḥ
evam ukto mahendreṇa triśaṃkuḥ apatat punaḥ

sanskrit: विक्रोशमानः त्राहि इति विश्वामित्रम् तपो धनम्
तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य क्रोशमानस्य कौशिकः
transliteration: vikrośamānaḥ trāhi iti viśvāmitram tapo dhanam
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya krośamānasya kauśikaḥ

sanskrit: रोषम् आहारयत् तीव्रम् तिष्ठ तिष्ठ इति च अब्रवीत्
ऋषि मध्ये स तेजस्वी प्रजापतिः इव अपरः
transliteration: roṣam āhārayat tīvram tiṣṭha tiṣṭha iti ca abravīt
ṛṣi madhye sa tejasvī prajāpatiḥ iva aparaḥ

sanskrit: सृजन् दक्षिण मार्गस्थान् सप्त ऋषीन् अपरान् पुनः
नक्षत्र वंश परंपरम् असृजत् क्रोध मूर्छितः
transliteration: sṛjan dakṣiṇa mārgasthān sapta ṛṣīn aparān punaḥ
nakṣatra vaṃśa paraṃparam asṛjat krodha mūrchitaḥ
english: In the midst of the ascetics, like to another Prajapati, he created other seven Rsis* on the Southern way: and also, overwhelined with wrath created another set of stars. *Ursa major.

sanskrit: दक्षिणाम् दिशम् आस्थाय मुनि मध्ये महायशाः
सृष्ट्वा नक्षत्र वंशम् च क्रोधेन कलुषी कृतः
transliteration: dakṣiṇām diśam āsthāya muni madhye mahāyaśāḥ
sṛṣṭvā nakṣatra vaṃśam ca krodhena kaluṣī kṛtaḥ
english: And collied* with passion, that illustrious one in the midst of the ascetics created another system of stars in the southern direction. And, saying, 'I will create another Indra, or the world (that I create) shall be without an Indra.' And in anger, he went the length of creating celestials. *And passion having my best judgement collied.

sanskrit: अन्यम् इंद्रम् करिष्यामि लोको वा स्यात् अनिंद्रकः
दैवतानि अपि स क्रोधात् स्रष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे
transliteration: anyam iṃdram kariṣyāmi loko vā syāt aniṃdrakaḥ
daivatāni api sa krodhāt sraṣṭum samupacakrame
english: And collied* with passion, that illustrious one in the midst of the ascetics created another system of stars in the southern direction. And, saying, 'I will create another Indra, or the world (that I create) shall be without an Indra.' And in anger, he went the length of creating celestials. *And passion having my best judgement collied.

sanskrit: ततः परम संभ्रान्ताः स ऋषि संघाः सुर असुराः
विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् ऊचुः स अनुनयम् वचः
transliteration: tataḥ parama saṃbhrāntāḥ sa ṛṣi saṃghāḥ sura asurāḥ
viśvāmitram mahātmānam ūcuḥ sa anunayam vacaḥ
english: Thereupon, in trepidation, the saints and the celestials and the Asuras humbly addressed the high souled Viśvāmitra thus.

sanskrit: अयम् राजा महाभाग गुरु शाप परिक्षतः
स शरीरो दिवम् यातुम् न अर्हति एव तपो धन
transliteration: ayam rājā mahābhāga guru śāpa parikṣataḥ
sa śarīro divam yātum na arhati eva tapo dhana
english: 'This king, O highly exalted one, has been visited with the curse of his preceptor, therefore, O ascetic; he deserves not to ascend heaven in person.

sanskrit: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा देवानाम् मुनि पुंगवः
अब्रवीत् सु महत् वाक्यम् कौशिकः सर्व देवताः
transliteration: teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā devānām muni puṃgavaḥ
abravīt su mahat vākyam kauśikaḥ sarva devatāḥ
english: Hearing those words of theirs, that best of anchorets, Kausika, in company with the celestials, said these pregnant words.

sanskrit: स शरीरस्य भद्रम् वः त्रिहन्कोः अस्य भूपतेः
आरोहणम् प्रतिज्ञातम् न अनृतम् कर्तुम् उत्सहे
transliteration: sa śarīrasya bhadram vaḥ trihankoḥ asya bhūpateḥ
ārohaṇam pratijñātam na anṛtam kartum utsahe
english: Good betide you, I have vowed to this king, Trišanku's bodily ascension unto heaven, therefore, I dare not falsify my vow.

sanskrit: स्वर्गो अस्तु स शरीरस्य त्रिशंकोः अस्य शाश्वतः
नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि मामकानि ध्रुवाणि अथ
transliteration: svargo astu sa śarīrasya triśaṃkoḥ asya śāśvataḥ
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi māmakāni dhruvāṇi atha
english: Let Trisanku evermore dwell in heaven in person, and let these stars created by me verily endure as long as the worlds. This it behove you, you gods, to ordain.

sanskrit: यावत् लोका धरिष्यन्ति तिष्ठन्ति एतानि सर्वशः
यत् कृतानि सुराः सर्वे तत् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हथ
transliteration: yāvat lokā dhariṣyanti tiṣṭhanti etāni sarvaśaḥ
yat kṛtāni surāḥ sarve tat anujñātum arhatha
english: Let Trisanku evermore dwell in heaven in person, and let these stars created by me verily endure as long as the worlds. This it behove you, you gods, to ordain.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ताः सुराः सर्वे प्रति ऊचुः मुनि पुंगवम्
एवम् भवतु भद्रम् ते तिष्ठन्तु एतानि सर्वशः
transliteration: evam uktāḥ surāḥ sarve prati ūcuḥ muni puṃgavam
evam bhavatu bhadram te tiṣṭhantu etāni sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: गगने तानि अनेकानि वैश्वानर पथात् बहिः
नक्षत्राणि मुनि श्रेष्ठ तेषु ज्योतिःषु जाज्वलन्
transliteration: gagane tāni anekāni vaiśvānara pathāt bahiḥ
nakṣatrāṇi muni śreṣṭha teṣu jyotiḥṣu jājvalan

sanskrit: अवाग् शिराः त्रिशंकुः च तिष्ठतु अमर संनिभः
अनुयास्यन्ति च एतानि ज्योतीन्षि नृप सत्तमम्
transliteration: avāg śirāḥ triśaṃkuḥ ca tiṣṭhatu amara saṃnibhaḥ
anuyāsyanti ca etāni jyotīnṣi nṛpa sattamam

sanskrit: कृतार्थम् कीर्तिमन्तम् च स्वर्ग लोक गतम् यथा
विश्वामित्रः तु धर्मात्मा सर्व देवैः अभिष्टुतः
transliteration: kṛtārtham kīrtimantam ca svarga loka gatam yathā
viśvāmitraḥ tu dharmātmā sarva devaiḥ abhiṣṭutaḥ

sanskrit: ऋषि मध्ये महातेजा बाढम् इति आह देवताः
ततो देवा महात्मानो ऋषयः च तपो धनाः
जग्मुः यथा आगतम् सर्वे यज्ञस्य अन्ते नरोत्तम
transliteration: ṛṣi madhye mahātejā bāḍham iti āha devatāḥ
tato devā mahātmāno ṛṣayaḥ ca tapo dhanāḥ
jagmuḥ yathā āgatam sarve yajñasya ante narottama
english: Then, after the sacrifice had concluded, the high-souled celestials and the saints of ascetic wealth went to their respective regions, o foremost of men.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः प्रस्थितान् वीक्ष्य तान् ऋषीन्
अब्रवीत् नरशार्दूल सर्वान् तान् वन वासिनः
transliteration: viśvāmitro mahātejāḥ prasthitān vīkṣya tān ṛṣīn
abravīt naraśārdūla sarvān tān vana vāsinaḥ
english: And, O puissant one, seeing those saints gone, the highly energetic Viśvāmitra addressed those inhabitants of the forest.

sanskrit: महाविघ्नः प्रवृत्तो अयम् दक्षिणाम् आस्थितो दिशम्
दिशम् अन्याम् प्रपत्स्यामः तत्र तप्स्यामहे तपः
transliteration: mahāvighnaḥ pravṛtto ayam dakṣiṇām āsthito diśam
diśam anyām prapatsyāmaḥ tatra tapsyāmahe tapaḥ
english: A mighty disturbance has happened in regard to the southern quarter: let us therefore repairing to another region, carry on austerities.

sanskrit: सुखम् तपः चरिष्यामः परम् तत् हि तपो वनम्
transliteration: sukham tapaḥ cariṣyāmaḥ param tat hi tapo vanam
english: You high-souled ones, in the west there are extensive tracts; and there in Puşkara will we peaceably carry on our austerities. That asylum is really pleasant.

sanskrit: तप उग्रम् दुराधर्षम् तेपे मूल फल अशनः
transliteration: tapa ugram durādharṣam tepe mūla phala aśanaḥ
english: Having said this, that exceedingly energetic and mighty Muni (Ascetic) began to perform terrible austerities, subsisting on fruits and roots.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु अयोध्या अधिपतिः महान्
transliteration: etasmin eva kāle tu ayodhyā adhipatiḥ mahān
english: And it came to pass that at this time that mighty lord of Ayodhyā, Ambarışa, prepared for celebrating a sacrifice.

sanskrit: तस्य वै यजमानस्य पशुम् इन्द्रो जहार ह
प्रणष्टे तु पशौ विप्रो राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tasya vai yajamānasya paśum indro jahāra ha
praṇaṣṭe tu paśau vipro rājānam idam abravīt
english: And as he was sacrificing, Indra stole away his sacrificial beast. And on the beast being stolen, the priest said unto the king.

sanskrit: पशुः अभ्याहृतः राजन् प्रणष्टः तव दुर्नयात्
transliteration: paśuḥ abhyāhṛtaḥ rājan praṇaṣṭaḥ tava durnayāt
english: O king, the beast has been stolen (away); and it has been lost through your dereliction. And, O lord of men, his own fault destroy the king that fail to protect (the beast).7

sanskrit: प्रायः चित्तम् महत् हि एतत् नरम् वा पुरुषर्षभ
आनयस्व पशुम् शीघ्रम् यावत् कर्म प्रवर्तते
transliteration: prāyaḥ cittam mahat hi etat naram vā puruṣarṣabha
ānayasva paśum śīghram yāvat karma pravartate
english: O best of men, even this is the expiation: do you, while the ceremony lasts, speedily bring back the beast, or bring a man in its stead.

sanskrit: उपाध्याय वचः श्रुत्वा स राजा पुरुषर्षभ
transliteration: upādhyāya vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā puruṣarṣabha
english: Hearing the priest's words, that highly intelligent king began to range various countries and provinces, cities, forests, and holy asylums, searching for the beast, with a thousand king (as the price thereof.)

sanskrit: देशान् जनपदान् तान् तान् नगराणि वनानि च
transliteration: deśān janapadān tān tān nagarāṇi vanāni ca
english: And, O child, it came to pass that arriving at Bhrgutunga, (A mountain peak) he beheld Řcīka seated there in company with his wife and sons.

sanskrit: स पुत्र सहितम् तात स भार्यम् रघुनंदन
transliteration: sa putra sahitam tāta sa bhāryam raghunaṃdana

sanskrit: तम् उवाच महातेजाः प्रणम्य अभिप्रसाद्य च
महर्षिम् तपसा दीप्तम् राजर्षिः अमित प्रभः
transliteration: tam uvāca mahātejāḥ praṇamya abhiprasādya ca
maharṣim tapasā dīptam rājarṣiḥ amita prabhaḥ

sanskrit: पृष्ट्वा सर्वत्र कुशलम् ऋचीकम् तम् इदम् वचः
गवाम् शत सहस्रेण विक्रीणीषे सुतम् यदि
transliteration: pṛṣṭvā sarvatra kuśalam ṛcīkam tam idam vacaḥ
gavām śata sahasreṇa vikrīṇīṣe sutam yadi

sanskrit: पशोः अर्थे महाभाग कृत कृत्यो अस्मि भार्गव
सर्वे परिगता देशा यज्ञियम् न लभे पशुम्
transliteration: paśoḥ arthe mahābhāga kṛta kṛtyo asmi bhārgava
sarve parigatā deśā yajñiyam na labhe paśum

sanskrit: दातुम् अर्हसि मूल्येन सुतम् एकम् इतो मम
एवम् उक्तो महातेजा ऋचीकः तु अब्रवीत् वचः
transliteration: dātum arhasi mūlyena sutam ekam ito mama
evam ukto mahātejā ṛcīkaḥ tu abravīt vacaḥ

sanskrit: न अहम् ज्येष्ठम् नर श्रेष्ठ विक्रीणीयाम् कथंचन
ऋचीकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तेषाम् माता महात्मनाम्
transliteration: na aham jyeṣṭham nara śreṣṭha vikrīṇīyām kathaṃcana
ṛcīkasya vacaḥ śrutvā teṣām mātā mahātmanām

sanskrit: उवाच नर शार्दूलम् अंबरीषम् इदम् वचः
अविक्रेयम् सुतम् ज्येष्ठम् भगवान् आह भार्गवः
transliteration: uvāca nara śārdūlam aṃbarīṣam idam vacaḥ
avikreyam sutam jyeṣṭham bhagavān āha bhārgavaḥ

sanskrit: मम अपि दयितम् विद्धि कनिष्ठम् शुनकम् प्रभो
तस्मात् कनीयसम् पुत्रम् न दास्ये तव पार्थिव
transliteration: mama api dayitam viddhi kaniṣṭham śunakam prabho
tasmāt kanīyasam putram na dāsye tava pārthiva
english: The worshipful son of Bhțgu has said that his first-born cannot be disposed of-do you, O lord, also know that the youngest, Sunaka, is my favourite. Therefore my youngest son will I not give to you.

sanskrit: प्रायेण हि नरश्रेष्ठ ज्येष्ठाः पितृषु वल्लभाः
मातॄणाम् च कनीयांसः तस्मात् रक्षे कनीयसम्
transliteration: prāyeṇa hi naraśreṣṭha jyeṣṭhāḥ pitṛṣu vallabhāḥ
mātṝṇām ca kanīyāṃsaḥ tasmāt rakṣe kanīyasam
english: O foremost of men, the eldest sons are generally the best beloved of their fathers; and the youngest, of their mother, therefore the youngest I would retain.

sanskrit: उक्त वाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् मुनि पत्न्याम् तथैव च
शुनःशेपः स्वयम् राम मध्यमो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: ukta vākye munau tasmin muni patnyām tathaiva ca
śunaḥśepaḥ svayam rāma madhyamo vākyam abravīt
english: And when the ascetic as well as his wife had spoken thus, the second son, Sunahsepa, O Rāma, himself said.

sanskrit: पिता ज्येष्ठम् अविक्रेयम् माता च आह कनीयसम्
विक्रेतम् मध्यमम् मन्ये राजपुत्र नयस्व माम्
transliteration: pitā jyeṣṭham avikreyam mātā ca āha kanīyasam
vikretam madhyamam manye rājaputra nayasva mām
english: My father would not sell the eldest; nor my mother the youngest,—therefore, I consider even the second as disposable. Do you then, O prince, take me.

sanskrit: अथ राजा महाबाहो वाक्य अन्ते ब्रह्म वादिनः
transliteration: atha rājā mahābāho vākya ante brahma vādinaḥ
english: When that one versed in the Veda had ended, that lord of men, O mighty-armed descendant of Raghu, taking possession of Sunaḥsepa, by paying koțis of kine, and heaps of jewels, and gold and silver by hundreds and thousands, went away exceedingly delighted.

When that one versed in the Veda had ended, that lord of men, O mighty-armed descendant of Raghu, taking possession of Sunaḥsepa, by paying koțis of kine, and heaps of jewels, and gold and silver by hundreds and thousands, went away exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit: अंबरीषः तु राजर्षी रथम् आरोप्य सत्वरः
transliteration: aṃbarīṣaḥ tu rājarṣī ratham āropya satvaraḥ
english: That royal saint, the exceedingly energetic and highly famous Ambarīşa, placing Sunaḥsepa on his car, speedily set out.
O foremost of men, taking Sunaḥsepa, that illustrious king at noon rested in Puşkara, O descendant of Raghu.

sanskrit: पुष्करम् ज्येष्ठम् आगम्य विश्वामित्रम् ददर्श ह
transliteration: puṣkaram jyeṣṭham āgamya viśvāmitram dadarśa ha
english: And having arrived at the excellent Puskara, as the king was resting, the famous Sunaḥsepa with an aggrieved heart saw his maternal uncle Viśvāmitra in company with some saints engaged in asceticism. Thereupon, with a woebegone countenance, and sore afflicted with fatigue and thirst, he, O Rāma, flung himself into (Viśvāmitra's) lap, and said.

sanskrit: तप्यन्तम् ऋषिभिः सार्थम् मातुलम् परम आतुरः
विषण्ण वदनो दीनः तृष्णया च श्रमेण च
transliteration: tapyantam ṛṣibhiḥ sārtham mātulam parama āturaḥ
viṣaṇṇa vadano dīnaḥ tṛṣṇayā ca śrameṇa ca
english: And having arrived at the excellent Puskara, as the king was resting, the famous Sunaḥsepa with an aggrieved heart saw his maternal uncle Viśvāmitra in company with some saints engaged in asceticism. Thereupon, with a woebegone countenance, and sore afflicted with fatigue and thirst, he, O Rāma, flung himself into (Viśvāmitra's) lap, and said.

sanskrit: पपात अन्के मुने राम वाक्यम् च इदम् उवाच ह
न मे अस्ति माता न पिता ज्ञातयो बान्धवाः कुतः
transliteration: papāta anke mune rāma vākyam ca idam uvāca ha
na me asti mātā na pitā jñātayo bāndhavāḥ kutaḥ
english: I have neither father, nor mother, nor relatives, nor friends anywhere. It therefore behoves you, O gentle one, to save me in the interests of virtue, O foremost of ascetics.

sanskrit: त्रातुम् अर्हसि माम् सौम्य धर्मेण मुनिपुंगव
त्राता त्वम् हि नरश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषाम् त्वम् हि भावनः
transliteration: trātum arhasi mām saumya dharmeṇa munipuṃgava
trātā tvam hi naraśreṣṭha sarveṣām tvam hi bhāvanaḥ

sanskrit: राजा च कृतकार्यः स्यात् अहम् दीर्घ आयुः अव्ययः
स्वर्ग लोकम् उपाश्नीयाम् तपः तप्त्वा हि अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: rājā ca kṛtakāryaḥ syāt aham dīrgha āyuḥ avyayaḥ
svarga lokam upāśnīyām tapaḥ taptvā hi anuttamam
english: And, O best of men, you are the protector of all, and their refuge. May the king have his desire and may I at the same time, attaining long life, and undeteriorating, gain heaven, having performed meritorious austerities!

sanskrit: स मे नाथो हि अनाथस्य भव भव्येन चेतसा
पिता इव पुत्रम् धर्माअत्मन् त्रातुम् अर्हसि किल्बिषात्
transliteration: sa me nātho hi anāthasya bhava bhavyena cetasā
pitā iva putram dharmāatman trātum arhasi kilbiṣāt
english: Do you with a delighted heart become a lord to me that am without one. And, O righteous one, even as a father rescue a son, do you deliver me from this peril.

sanskrit: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महातपाः
सान्त्वयित्वा बहु विधम् पुत्रान् इदम् उवाच ह
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ
sāntvayitvā bahu vidham putrān idam uvāca ha
english: Hearing his words, Viśvāmitra of mighty austerities, pacifying him by every means, spoke to this sons, saying,

sanskrit: यत् कृते पितरः पुत्रान् जनयन्ति शुभ अर्थिनः
पर लोक हित अर्थाय तस्य कालो अयम् आगतः
transliteration: yat kṛte pitaraḥ putrān janayanti śubha arthinaḥ
para loka hita arthāya tasya kālo ayam āgataḥ
english: That in view of which fathers beget wellwishing sons, the compassing of other's welfare is at hand.

sanskrit: अयम् मुनि सुतो बालो मत्तः शरणम् इच्छति
अस्य जीवित मात्रेण प्रियम् कुरुत पुत्रकाः
transliteration: ayam muni suto bālo mattaḥ śaraṇam icchati
asya jīvita mātreṇa priyam kuruta putrakāḥ
english: This youthful son. of the ascetic crave my protection. O you sons, do accomplish my desire by saving his life.

sanskrit: सर्वे सुकृत कर्माणः सर्वे धर्म परायणाः
पशु भूता नरेन्द्रस्य तृप्तिम् अग्नेः प्रयच्छत
transliteration: sarve sukṛta karmāṇaḥ sarve dharma parāyaṇāḥ
paśu bhūtā narendrasya tṛptim agneḥ prayacchata
english: You are all of virtuous deeds, you are all engaged in the observance of righteousness, do you confer satisfaction upon Agni by one of you becoming the (sacrificial) beast of the lord of men.

sanskrit: नाथनान् च शुनःशेपो यज्ञः च अविघ्नतो भवेत्
देवताः तर्पिताः च स्युः मम च अपि कृतम् वचः
transliteration: nāthanān ca śunaḥśepo yajñaḥ ca avighnato bhavet
devatāḥ tarpitāḥ ca syuḥ mama ca api kṛtam vacaḥ
english: Thus Sunaḥsepa will obtain protection, the sacrifice will be freed from hindrance the deities will be propitiated, and finally my word will be made good.

sanskrit: मुनेः तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा मधुष्यन्द आदयः सुताः
स अभिमानम् नरश्रेष्ठ स लीलम् इदम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: muneḥ tu vacanam śrutvā madhuṣyanda ādayaḥ sutāḥ
sa abhimānam naraśreṣṭha sa līlam idam abruvan
english: Hearing the ascetic's words, his sons, Madhucchanda and others, O foremost of me, haughtily and tauntingly answered.

sanskrit: कथम् आत्म सुतान् हित्वा त्रायसे अन्य सुतम् विभो
अकार्यम् इव पश्यामः श्व मांसम् इव भोजने
transliteration: katham ātma sutān hitvā trāyase anya sutam vibho
akāryam iva paśyāmaḥ śva māṃsam iva bhojane
english: O lord, how, neglecting your own sons, you desire to deliver that of another? This we consider as heinous, even like to eating one's own flesh.

sanskrit: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा पुत्राणाम् मुनिपुंगवः
transliteration: teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā putrāṇām munipuṃgavaḥ
english: Hearing this speech of his sons, that best of anchorets, with eyes reddened with anger, said.

sanskrit: निःसाध्वसम् इदम् प्रोक्तम् धर्मात् अपि विगर्हितम्
अतिक्रम्य तु मत् वाक्यम् दारुणम् रोम हर्षणम्
transliteration: niḥsādhvasam idam proktam dharmāt api vigarhitam
atikramya tu mat vākyam dāruṇam roma harṣaṇam
english: Disregarding my words, you have uttered this audacious and shocking speech, disclaimed by morality, and capable of causing one's hair to stand on end. Therefore, becoming Mustikas, and living on dogs' flesh, do you all, even like Vasiştha's sons, inhabit the earth for a thousand years.

sanskrit: श्व मांस भोजिनः सर्वे वासिष्ठा इव जातिषु
पूर्णम् वर्ष सहस्रम् तु पृथिव्याम् अनुवत्स्यथ
transliteration: śva māṃsa bhojinaḥ sarve vāsiṣṭhā iva jātiṣu
pūrṇam varṣa sahasram tu pṛthivyām anuvatsyatha
english: Disregarding my words, you have uttered this audacious and shocking speech, disclaimed by morality, and capable of causing one's hair to stand on end. Therefore, becoming Mustikas, and living on dogs' flesh, do you all, even like Vasiştha's sons, inhabit the earth for a thousand years.

sanskrit: कृत्वा शाप समायुक्तान् पुत्रान् मुनिवरः तदा
शुनःशेपम् उवाच आर्तम् कृत्वा रक्षाम् निरामयाम्
transliteration: kṛtvā śāpa samāyuktān putrān munivaraḥ tadā
śunaḥśepam uvāca ārtam kṛtvā rakṣām nirāmayām
english: Having cursed his sons, that best of ascetics then, by all means cheering up the distressed Śunaḥsepa as to his protection, addressed him.

sanskrit: पवित्र पाशैर् बद्धो रक्त माल्य अनुलेपनः
वैष्णवम् यूपम् आसाद्य वाग्भिः अग्निम् उदाहर
transliteration: pavitra pāśair baddho rakta mālya anulepanaḥ
vaiṣṇavam yūpam āsādya vāgbhiḥ agnim udāhara
english: Do you donning on a sacred zone, and wearing a garland of red flowers, and bedaubing your person with red sand paste, hymn Agni with mantras, approaching the Vaisnava sacrificial stake; and, O ascetic's son, (at the same time) chant these two verses in that sacrifice of Amvarisha. Then you will attain success.

sanskrit: इमे च गाथे द्वे दिव्ये गायेथा मुनि पुत्रक
अंबरीषस्य यज्ञे अस्मिन् ततः सिद्धिम् अवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: ime ca gāthe dve divye gāyethā muni putraka
aṃbarīṣasya yajñe asmin tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi
english: Do you donning on a sacred zone, and wearing a garland of red flowers, and bedaubing your person with red sand paste, hymn Agni with mantras, approaching the Vaisnava sacrificial stake; and, O ascetic's son, (at the same time) chant these two verses in that sacrifice of Amvarisha. Then you will attain success.

sanskrit: शुनःशेपो गृहीत्वा ते द्वे गाथे सुसमाहितः
त्वरया राज सिंहम् तम् अंबरीषम् उवाच ह
transliteration: śunaḥśepo gṛhītvā te dve gāthe susamāhitaḥ
tvarayā rāja siṃham tam aṃbarīṣam uvāca ha
english: Thereupon, with a concentrated mind securing those two verses, Sunaḥsepa speedily presented himself before that leonine monarch saying,

sanskrit: राज सिंह महाबुद्धे शीघ्रम् गच्छावहे वयम्
transliteration: rāja siṃha mahābuddhe śīghram gacchāvahe vayam
english: O lion of a king, O you endued with high intelligence, let us without delay repair hence. And, O foremost of monarchs, do you engage in the sacrifice and commence upon the initiation.

sanskrit: तत् वाक्यम् ऋषि पुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा हर्ष समन्वितः
जगाम नृपतिः शीघ्रम् यज्ञ वाटम् अतन्द्रितः
transliteration: tat vākyam ṛṣi putrasya śrutvā harṣa samanvitaḥ
jagāma nṛpatiḥ śīghram yajña vāṭam atandritaḥ
english: Hearing those words of the ascetic's son, the king, filled with delight, readily at once repaired to the sacrificial ground.

sanskrit: सदस्य अनुमते राजा पवित्र कृत लक्षणम्
पशुम् रक्त अंबरम् कृत्वा यूपे तम् समबन्धयत्
transliteration: sadasya anumate rājā pavitra kṛta lakṣaṇam
paśum rakta aṃbaram kṛtvā yūpe tam samabandhayat
english: With the consent of his court, the king fastened Sunaħsepa with a Kuśa cord, and investing him with a crimson apparel tethered him to the stake as the (sacrificial) beast.

sanskrit: स बद्धो वाग्भिः अग्र्याभिः अभितुष्टाव वै सुरौ
इन्द्रम् इन्द्र अनुजम् चैव यथावत् मुनि पुत्रकः
transliteration: sa baddho vāgbhiḥ agryābhiḥ abhituṣṭāva vai surau
indram indra anujam caiva yathāvat muni putrakaḥ
english: Being bound (to the stake), the ascetic's son first of all duly hymned Agni, and next those deities, Indra and his younger brother.

sanskrit: ततः प्रीतः सहस्र अक्षो रहस्य स्तुति तोषितः
दीर्घम् आयुः तदा प्रादात् शुनःशेपाय राघव
transliteration: tataḥ prītaḥ sahasra akṣo rahasya stuti toṣitaḥ
dīrgham āyuḥ tadā prādāt śunaḥśepāya rāghava
english: Thereupon, gratified with the excellent eulogy, the thousand eyed Väsava conferred upon Sunaḥsepa long life.

sanskrit: स च राजा नरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञस्य च समाप्तवान्
फलम् बहु गुणम् राम सहस्राक्ष प्रसादजम्
transliteration: sa ca rājā naraśreṣṭha yajñasya ca samāptavān
phalam bahu guṇam rāma sahasrākṣa prasādajam
english: And, O foremost of men, that king also, having completed the sacrifice, obtained the manifold fruit thereof through the grace of the thousand-eyed deity,

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो अपि धर्मात्मा भूयः तेपे महातपाः
पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ दश वर्ष शतानि च
transliteration: viśvāmitro api dharmātmā bhūyaḥ tepe mahātapāḥ
puṣkareṣu naraśreṣṭha daśa varṣa śatāni ca
english: O Rāma, And, O best of men, the righteous Viśvāmitra of mighty asceticism again carried on austerities at Puskara for ten hundred years.

sanskrit: पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे तु व्रत स्नातम् महामुनिम्
अभ्यागच्चन् सुराः सर्वे तपः फल चिकीर्षवः
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu vrata snātam mahāmunim
abhyāgaccan surāḥ sarve tapaḥ phala cikīrṣavaḥ
english: When the thousand years had been completed and the mighty ascetic had accomplished his vow, the celestials in a body desirous of conferring upon him the fruit thereof, appeared before him.

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् सु महातेजा ब्रह्मा सु रुचिरम् वचः
ऋषिः त्वम् असि भद्रम् ते स्व अर्जितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः
transliteration: abravīt su mahātejā brahmā su ruciram vacaḥ
ṛṣiḥ tvam asi bhadram te sva arjitaiḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ
english: The exceedingly effulgent Brahmă addressed him in soothing words, saying, “You are henceforth a saint, good to you, and (this. eminence) you have attained through your own laudable exertions.'

sanskrit: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा देवेशः त्रिदिवम् पुनः अभ्यगात्
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा भूयः तेपे महत् तपः
transliteration: tam evam uktvā deveśaḥ tridivam punaḥ abhyagāt
viśvāmitro mahātejā bhūyaḥ tepe mahat tapaḥ
english: Having spoken thus to him, the lord of celestials returned to heaven. And Viśvāmitra of mighty energy became again engaged in rigid austerities.

sanskrit: ततः कालेन महता मेनका परम अप्सराः
transliteration: tataḥ kālena mahatā menakā parama apsarāḥ

sanskrit: ताम् ददर्श महातेजा मेनकाम् कुशिक आत्मजः
रूपेण अप्रतिमाम् तत्र विद्युतम् जलदे यथा
transliteration: tām dadarśa mahātejā menakām kuśika ātmajaḥ
rūpeṇa apratimām tatra vidyutam jalade yathā

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा कन्दर्प वशगो मुनिः ताम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
अप्सरः स्वागतम् ते अस्तु वस च इह मम आश्रमे
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kandarpa vaśago muniḥ tām idam abravīt
apsaraḥ svāgatam te astu vasa ca iha mama āśrame

sanskrit: अनुगृह्णीष्व भद्रम् ते मदनेन सु मोहितम्
इति उक्ता सा वरारोहा तत्र वासम् अथ अकरोत्
transliteration: anugṛhṇīṣva bhadram te madanena su mohitam
iti uktā sā varārohā tatra vāsam atha akarot
english: Do you favour me; for, good betide you, I have been rendered senseless by Madana. Thus addressed, that one of shapely hips began to dwell there.

sanskrit: तस्याम् वसन्त्याम् वर्षाणि पंच पंच च राघव
transliteration: tasyām vasantyām varṣāṇi paṃca paṃca ca rāghava
english: And mighty was the hindrance that befell Viśvāmitra as regarded his asceticism, as she, O Rāghava, staying in that asylum of his, pleasantly spent five and five years, O gentle one.

sanskrit: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
transliteration: atha kāle gate tasmin viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ

sanskrit: स व्रीड इव संवृत्तः चिन्ता शोक परायणः
बुद्धिर् मुनेः समुत्पन्ना स अमर्षा रघुनंदन
transliteration: sa vrīḍa iva saṃvṛttaḥ cintā śoka parāyaṇaḥ
buddhir muneḥ samutpannā sa amarṣā raghunaṃdana

sanskrit: सर्वम् सुराणाम् कर्म एतत् तपो अपहरणम् महत्
अहो रात्रा अपदेशेन गताः संवत्सरा दश
transliteration: sarvam surāṇām karma etat tapo apaharaṇam mahat
aho rātrā apadeśena gatāḥ saṃvatsarā daśa

sanskrit: काम मोह अभिभूतस्य विघ्नो अयम् प्रत्युपस्थितः
transliteration: kāma moha abhibhūtasya vighno ayam pratyupasthitaḥ

sanskrit: भीताम् अप्सरसम् दृष्ट्वा वेपन्तीम् प्रांजलिम् स्थिताम्
मेनकाम् मधुरैः वाक्यैः विसृज्य कुशिक आत्मजः
transliteration: bhītām apsarasam dṛṣṭvā vepantīm prāṃjalim sthitām
menakām madhuraiḥ vākyaiḥ visṛjya kuśika ātmajaḥ
english: Having a sigh, that best of ascetics burned in repentance. And with sweet words renouncing the terrified and trembling Menaka standing with clasped hands, Kusika's son, Visvamitra, O Rāma, went to the northern mountains.

sanskrit: उत्तरम् पर्वतम् राम विश्वामित्रो जगाम ह
स कृत्वा नैष्ठिकीम् बुद्धिम् जेतु कामो महायशाः
transliteration: uttaram parvatam rāma viśvāmitro jagāma ha
sa kṛtvā naiṣṭhikīm buddhim jetu kāmo mahāyaśāḥ

sanskrit: कौशिकी तीरम् आसाद्य तपः तेपे दुरासदम्
तस्य वर्ष सहस्राणि घोरम् तप उपासतः
transliteration: kauśikī tīram āsādya tapaḥ tepe durāsadam
tasya varṣa sahasrāṇi ghoram tapa upāsataḥ

sanskrit: उत्तरे पर्वते राम देवतानाम् अभूत् भयम्
अमंत्रयन् समागम्य सर्वे स ऋषि गणाः सुराः
transliteration: uttare parvate rāma devatānām abhūt bhayam
amaṃtrayan samāgamya sarve sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ surāḥ

sanskrit: महर्षि शब्दम् लभताम् साधु अयम् कुशिक आत्मजः
देवतानाम् वचः श्रुत्वा सर्व लोक पितामहः
transliteration: maharṣi śabdam labhatām sādhu ayam kuśika ātmajaḥ
devatānām vacaḥ śrutvā sarva loka pitāmahaḥ

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् मधुरम् वाक्यम् विश्वामित्रम् तपो धनम्
महर्षे स्वागतम् वत्स तपसा उग्रेण तोषितः
transliteration: abravīt madhuram vākyam viśvāmitram tapo dhanam
maharṣe svāgatam vatsa tapasā ugreṇa toṣitaḥ
english: Hearing the words of the celestials, the Grand sire of all addressed the ascetic Viśvāmitra, in these sweet words, 'O mighty saint, hast you had a pleasant journey? Satisfied with your fierce austerities, O Kausika, I confer upon you the eminence of the foremost saintship.'

sanskrit: महत्त्वम् ऋषि मुख्यत्वम् ददामि तव कौशिक
ब्रह्मणः स वचः श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रः तपो धनः
transliteration: mahattvam ṛṣi mukhyatvam dadāmi tava kauśika
brahmaṇaḥ sa vacaḥ śrutvā viśvāmitraḥ tapo dhanaḥ

sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षि शब्दम् अतुलम् स्व अर्जितैः कर्मभिः शुभैः
transliteration: brahmarṣi śabdam atulam sva arjitaiḥ karmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ

sanskrit: यदि मे भगवान् आह ततो अहम् विजित इन्द्रियः
तम् उवाच ततो ब्रह्मा न तावत् त्वम् जित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: yadi me bhagavān āha tato aham vijita indriyaḥ
tam uvāca tato brahmā na tāvat tvam jita indriyaḥ

sanskrit: यतस्व मुनि शार्दूल इति उक्त्वा त्रिदिवम् गतः
transliteration: yatasva muni śārdūla iti uktvā tridivam gataḥ

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्व बाहुः निरालंबो वायु भक्षः तपः चरन्
धर्मे पंच तपा भूत्वा वर्षासु आकाश संश्रयः
transliteration: ūrdhva bāhuḥ nirālaṃbo vāyu bhakṣaḥ tapaḥ caran
dharme paṃca tapā bhūtvā varṣāsu ākāśa saṃśrayaḥ

sanskrit: शिशिरे सलिले शायी रात्रि अहानि तपो धनः
एवम् वर्ष सहस्रम् हि तपो घोरम् उपागमत्
transliteration: śiśire salile śāyī rātri ahāni tapo dhanaḥ
evam varṣa sahasram hi tapo ghoram upāgamat
english: And in summer, the ascetic surrounded himself with five fires, and in rains remained in an uncovered place, and in winter day and night stood submerged in water. Thus passed by a thousand years of terrible penances.

sanskrit: संतापः सुमहान् आसीत् सुराणाम् वासवस्य च
transliteration: saṃtāpaḥ sumahān āsīt surāṇām vāsavasya ca
english: And on the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra being engaged in austerities, great was the agitation that exercised the celestials and Indra, in particular.

sanskrit: रंभाम् अप्सरसम् शक्रः सह सर्वैः मरुत् गणैः
उवाच आत्म हितम् वाक्यम् अहितम् कौशिकस्य च
transliteration: raṃbhām apsarasam śakraḥ saha sarvaiḥ marut gaṇaiḥ
uvāca ātma hitam vākyam ahitam kauśikasya ca
english: Śakra together with the Maruts spoke to Rambha these words, fraught with weal to himself, and woe to Kausika.'

sanskrit: सुर कार्यम् इदम् रंभे कर्तव्यम् सुमहत् त्वया
लोभनम् कौशिकस्य इह काम मोह समन्वितम्
transliteration: sura kāryam idam raṃbhe kartavyam sumahat tvayā
lobhanam kauśikasya iha kāma moha samanvitam
english: O Rambha, this mighty service you will have to perform in the interest of the celestials, even to take Kausika with the witchery of love.'

sanskrit: तथा उक्ता स अप्सरा राम सहस्राक्षेण धीमता
व्रीडिता प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् प्रत्युवाच सुर ईश्वरम्
transliteration: tathā uktā sa apsarā rāma sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā
vrīḍitā prāṃjaliḥ vākyam pratyuvāca sura īśvaram
english: Thus addressed by the intelligent thousandeyed deity, the Apsarā, O Rāma, with clasped palms, thus bashfully answered the chief of the celestials,

sanskrit: अयम् सुर पते घोरो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः
क्रोधम् उत्स्रच्यते घोरम् मयि देव न संशयः
transliteration: ayam sura pate ghoro viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
krodham utsracyate ghoram mayi deva na saṃśayaḥ
english: O lord of the celestials, this mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra, is a terrible person; and, without doubt, he will, O divine one, waxing wroth, curse me.

sanskrit: ततो हि मे भयम् देव प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
एवम् उक्तः तया राम स भयम् भीतया तदा
transliteration: tato hi me bhayam deva prasādam kartum arhasi
evam uktaḥ tayā rāma sa bhayam bhītayā tadā

sanskrit: मा भैषी रंभे भद्रम् ते कुरुष्व मम शासनम्
transliteration: mā bhaiṣī raṃbhe bhadram te kuruṣva mama śāsanam
english: And O god, even this is my fear, and therefore it behove you to favour me. Thus apprehensively addressed by her in fear, the thousand-eyed one answered that damsel trembling and staying with clasped hands, 'Never fear, O Rambhā, good to you! Do you perform my bidding.'

sanskrit: कोकिलो हृदय ग्राही माधवे रुचिर द्रुमे
अहम् कंदर्प सहितः स्थास्यामि तव पार्श्वतः
transliteration: kokilo hṛdaya grāhī mādhave rucira drume
aham kaṃdarpa sahitaḥ sthāsyāmi tava pārśvataḥ
english: Assuming the form of a Cole, captivating the heart, I will in this spring crowned with graceful trees, stay by your side in company with Kandarpa.

sanskrit: त्वम् हि रूपम् बहु गुणम् कृत्वा परम भास्वरम्
तम् ऋषिम् कौशिकम् रंभे भेदयस्व तपस्विनम्
transliteration: tvam hi rūpam bahu guṇam kṛtvā parama bhāsvaram
tam ṛṣim kauśikam raṃbhe bhedayasva tapasvinam
english: Do you adding to your beauty, diverse blandishments bewitch this ascetic, Kusika's son, O gentle one?'

sanskrit: सा श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य कृत्वा रूपम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: sā śrutvā vacanam tasya kṛtvā rūpam anuttamam
english: Hearing Indra's words, that comely damsel of luminous smiles, heightening her charms exceedingly inspired Viśvāmitra with desire.

sanskrit: कोकिलस्य तु शुश्राव वल्गु व्याहरतः स्वनम्
transliteration: kokilasya tu śuśrāva valgu vyāharataḥ svanam
english: He listened to the mellifluous strains of the Cole; and with a delighted heart, he beheld the fair one.

sanskrit: अथ तस्य च शब्देन गीतेन अप्रतिमेन च
दर्शनेन च रंभाया मुनिः संदेहम् आगतः
transliteration: atha tasya ca śabdena gītena apratimena ca
darśanena ca raṃbhāyā muniḥ saṃdeham āgataḥ
english: Anon, listening to the warbling of the Cole and her own incomparable singing, as well as beholding Rambha, the ascetic began to entertain doubts.

sanskrit: रंभाम् क्रोध समाविष्टः शशाप कुशिक आत्मजः
transliteration: raṃbhām krodha samāviṣṭaḥ śaśāpa kuśika ātmajaḥ
english: And knowing for certain that it was the thousand-eyed deity who had devised all that, that foremost of anchorets, Kusika's son, overwhelmed with anger, cursed Rambha, saying,

sanskrit: यत् माम् लोभयसे रंभे काम क्रोध जय एषिणम्
दश वर्ष सहस्राणि शैली स्थास्यसि दुर्भगे
transliteration: yat mām lobhayase raṃbhe kāma krodha jaya eṣiṇam
daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi śailī sthāsyasi durbhage
english: Since, O Rambhā, you endeavour to seduce me who is bent upon subduing his anger and lust, you shall, O luckless one, remain as a stone for ten thousand years.

sanskrit: उद्धरिष्यति रंभे त्वाम् मत् क्रोध कलुषी कृताम्
transliteration: uddhariṣyati raṃbhe tvām mat krodha kaluṣī kṛtām
english: And a highly energetic Brāhmaṇa equipped with ascetic energy, will, O Rambha, deliver you, stained because of my ire.'
Thus said that exceedingly energetic and mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra, unable to contain his anger and indignation of heart.

sanskrit: तस्य शापेन महता रम्भा शैली तदा अभवत्
वचः श्रुत्वा च कन्दर्पो महर्षेः स च निर्गतः
transliteration: tasya śāpena mahatā rambhā śailī tadā abhavat
vacaḥ śrutvā ca kandarpo maharṣeḥ sa ca nirgataḥ
english: And in consequence of his mighty curse, Rambha was turned into a stone. Hearing the curse of the mighty saint, both Kandarpa and Indra left the place.

sanskrit: कोपेन स महातेजाः तपो अपहरणे कृते
इन्द्रियैर् अजितै राम न लेभे शान्तिम् आत्मनः
transliteration: kopena sa mahātejāḥ tapo apaharaṇe kṛte
indriyair ajitai rāma na lebhe śāntim ātmanaḥ
english: O Rāma, on account of his anger, and his sense remaining still unsubdued he found no rest from deterioration of ascetic merit. And coming by decrease of ascetic merit, he thought within himself, ‘No more shall I suffer anger to exercise me, nor will I ever say anything to any.'

sanskrit: बभूव अस्य मनः चिंता तपो अपहरणे कृते
न एव क्रोधम् गमिष्यामि न च वक्ष्ये कथंचन
transliteration: babhūva asya manaḥ ciṃtā tapo apaharaṇe kṛte
na eva krodham gamiṣyāmi na ca vakṣye kathaṃcana
english: O Rāma, on account of his anger, and his sense remaining still unsubdued he found no rest from deterioration of ascetic merit. And coming by decrease of ascetic merit, he thought within himself, ‘No more shall I suffer anger to exercise me, nor will I ever say anything to any.'

sanskrit: अथवा न उच्छासिष्यामि संवत्स्र शतानि अपि
transliteration: athavā na ucchāsiṣyāmi saṃvatsra śatāni api
english: And I shall not breathe for an hundred years; and controlling my sense, I shall dry up my body.

sanskrit: तावत् यावत् हि मे प्राप्तम् ब्राह्मण्यम् तपसा आर्जितम्
transliteration: tāvat yāvat hi me prāptam brāhmaṇyam tapasā ārjitam
english: And so long as I do not attain Brāhmaṇa-hood as earned by my austerities, I shall suspending ny breath and abstaining from food, stay for a long lapse of time.

sanskrit: न हि मे तप्यमानस्य क्षयम् यास्यन्ति मूर्तयः
एवम् वेअर्ष शस्रस्य दीक्षाम् स मुनिपुंगवः
transliteration: na hi me tapyamānasya kṣayam yāsyanti mūrtayaḥ
evam vearṣa śasrasya dīkṣām sa munipuṃgavaḥ
english: And engaged in austerities, my form will not undergo any deterioration. That foremost of ascetics bound himself by this unparalleled vow to lead a life of such self-denial.

sanskrit: अथ हैमवतीम् राम दिशम् त्यक्त्वा महामुनिः
पूर्वाम् दिशम् अनुप्राप्य तपः तेपे सुदारुणम्
transliteration: atha haimavatīm rāma diśam tyaktvā mahāmuniḥ
pūrvām diśam anuprāpya tapaḥ tepe sudāruṇam
english: Forsaking the northern direction the mighty Muni, O Rāma, betaking himself to the Eastern quarter, became engaged in dreadful austerities.

sanskrit: मौनम् वर्ष सहस्रस्य कृत्वा व्रतम् अनुत्तमम्
चकार अप्रतिमम् राम तपः परम दुष्करम्
transliteration: maunam varṣa sahasrasya kṛtvā vratam anuttamam
cakāra apratimam rāma tapaḥ parama duṣkaram
english: Adopting the high vow of taciturnity for a thousand years, he, O Rāma began to perform the most signal and arduous austerities.

sanskrit: पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे तु काष्ठ भूतम् महामुनिम्
विघ्नैः बहुभिः आधूतम् क्रोधो न अंतरम् आविशत्
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣa sahasre tu kāṣṭha bhūtam mahāmunim
vighnaiḥ bahubhiḥ ādhūtam krodho na aṃtaram āviśat
english: When the thousand years had been complete, many an impediment tried the mighty Muni staying like the trunk of a tree, yet could not anger enter his heart.

sanskrit: सः कृत्वा निश्चयम् राम तप आतिष्टत् अव्ययम्
तस्य वर्ष सहस्रस्य व्रते पूर्णे महाव्रतः
transliteration: saḥ kṛtvā niścayam rāma tapa ātiṣṭat avyayam
tasya varṣa sahasrasya vrate pūrṇe mahāvrataḥ
english: And firmly deter mined to shut out anger, he, O Rāma, kept his asceticism from deterioration. And, O foremost of the Raghus, when his vow of a thousand years had been observed, that one of mighty vows became desirous of feeding on boiled rice. And it came to pass ( best of the Raghus that at this time Indra assuming the guise of a regenerate one, asked for the rice.

sanskrit: भोक्तुम् आरब्धवान् अन्नम् तस्मिन् काले रघूत्तम
इन्द्रो द्विजातिः भूत्वा तम् सिद्ध अन्नम् अयाचत्
transliteration: bhoktum ārabdhavān annam tasmin kāle raghūttama
indro dvijātiḥ bhūtvā tam siddha annam ayācat
english: And firmly deter mined to shut out anger, he, O Rāma, kept his asceticism from deterioration. And, O foremost of the Raghus, when his vow of a thousand years had been observed, that one of mighty vows became desirous of feeding on boiled rice. And it came to pass ( best of the Raghus that at this time Indra assuming the guise of a regenerate one, asked for the rice.

sanskrit: तस्मैः दत्त्वा तदा सिद्धम् सर्वम् विप्राय निश्चितः
निःषेषिते अन्ने भगवान् अभुक्त्वा इव महातपाः
transliteration: tasmaiḥ dattvā tadā siddham sarvam viprāya niścitaḥ
niḥṣeṣite anne bhagavān abhuktvā iva mahātapāḥ
english: Thereupon he gave it away to the Vipra; and when the rice had been thus exhausted, that worshipful one of mighty austerities went without foot.

sanskrit: न किंचित् अवदत् विप्रम् मौन व्रतम् उपास्थितः
तथा एव आसीत् पुनः मौनम् अनुच्छ्वासम् चकार ह
transliteration: na kiṃcit avadat vipram mauna vratam upāsthitaḥ
tathā eva āsīt punaḥ maunam anucchvāsam cakāra ha
english: Nor, abiding by the vow of reticence, did he say aught to the Vipra. And he then again resumed his dumb guise, restraining his breath at the same time.

sanskrit: अथ वर्ष सहस्रम् च न उच्छ्वसन् मुनिपुंगवः
transliteration: atha varṣa sahasram ca na ucchvasan munipuṃgavaḥ
english: And that puissant ascetic did not breathe for a you sand years. And as he restrained his breath, vapours began to issue out of his head.

sanskrit: त्रै लोक्यम् येन संभ्रांतम् आतापितम् इव अभवत्
ततो देवर्षि गन्धर्वाः पन्नग उरग राक्षसाः
transliteration: trai lokyam yena saṃbhrāṃtam ātāpitam iva abhavat
tato devarṣi gandharvāḥ pannaga uraga rākṣasāḥ
english: And at this, the three worlds became afflicted with fear. And bewildered on account of the energy of his asceticisin, and shorn of their brightness, and afflicted with anguish, the Devarsis and the Gandharvas and the Pannagas and the Uragas and the Rakşasas in a body addressed the Pitāmaha, (Brahmā).

sanskrit: कश्मल उपहताः सर्वे पितामहम् अथ अब्रुवन्
transliteration: kaśmala upahatāḥ sarve pitāmaham atha abruvan
english: And at this, the three worlds became afflicted with fear. And bewildered on account of the energy of his asceticisin, and shorn of their brightness, and afflicted with anguish, the Devarsis and the Gandharvas and the Pannagas and the Uragas and the Rakşasas in a body addressed the Pitāmaha, (Brahmā).

sanskrit: लोभितः क्रोधितः चैव तपसा च अभिवर्धते
transliteration: lobhitaḥ krodhitaḥ caiva tapasā ca abhivardhate
english: O divine one, various were the means by which we endeavoured to affect the mighty Muni Viśvāmitra with covetousness and lust; but for all that he increase in asceticism.

sanskrit: न हि अस्य वृजिनम् किंचित् दृश्यते सूक्ष्मम् अपि अथ
न दीयते यदि तु अस्य मनसा यत् अभीप्सितम्
transliteration: na hi asya vṛjinam kiṃcit dṛśyate sūkṣmam api atha
na dīyate yadi tu asya manasā yat abhīpsitam
english: Nor do we perceive in him ever so little of anger or lust. And if you do not confer upon him what his mind desire to have, he will annihilate the three worlds with all that is mobile and immobile in them. And the ten cardinal points are disconsolate: and nothing can be discovered therein.

sanskrit: विनाशयति त्रैलोक्यम् तपसा स चर अचरम्
व्याकुलाः च दिशः सर्वा न च किंचित् प्रकाशते
transliteration: vināśayati trailokyam tapasā sa cara acaram
vyākulāḥ ca diśaḥ sarvā na ca kiṃcit prakāśate
english: Nor do we perceive in him ever so little of anger or lust. And if you do not confer upon him what his mind desire to have, he will annihilate the three worlds with all that is mobile and immobile in them. And the ten cardinal points are disconsolate: and nothing can be discovered therein.

sanskrit: सागराः क्षुभिताः सर्वे विशीर्यन्ते च पर्वताः
प्रकंपते च वसुधा वायुः वाति इह संकुलः
transliteration: sāgarāḥ kṣubhitāḥ sarve viśīryante ca parvatāḥ
prakaṃpate ca vasudhā vāyuḥ vāti iha saṃkulaḥ
english: And the seas are vexed, and the mountains, riven. And the earth shake, and the winds keep steadily blowing.
O Brahmana, we do not know how to remedy, this. And every one is inactive like an infidel. And the three worlds look as if stupefied, with their minds exceedingly exercised.

sanskrit: भास्करो निष्प्रभः चैव महर्षेः तस्य तेजसा
बुद्धिम् न कुरुते यावत् नाशे देव महामुनिः
transliteration: bhāskaro niṣprabhaḥ caiva maharṣeḥ tasya tejasā
buddhim na kurute yāvat nāśe deva mahāmuniḥ
english: By virtue of that mighty saint's energy, the sun itself has been deprived of his splendour.

sanskrit: तावत् प्रसादो भगवान् अग्नि रूपो महाद्युतिः
काल अग्निना यथा पूर्वम् त्रैलोक्यम् दह्यते अखिलम्
transliteration: tāvat prasādo bhagavān agni rūpo mahādyutiḥ
kāla agninā yathā pūrvam trailokyam dahyate akhilam

sanskrit: देव राज्यम् चिकीर्षेत दीयताम् अस्य यत् मतम्
ततः सुर गणाः सर्वे पितामह पुरोगमाः
transliteration: deva rājyam cikīrṣeta dīyatām asya yat matam
tataḥ sura gaṇāḥ sarve pitāmaha purogamāḥ

sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षे स्वागतम् ते अस्तु तपसा स्म सु तोषिताः
transliteration: brahmarṣe svāgatam te astu tapasā sma su toṣitāḥ

sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्यम् तपसा उग्रेण प्राप्तवान् असि कौशिक
दीर्घम् आयुः च ते ब्रह्मन् ददामि स मरुद् गणः
transliteration: brāhmaṇyam tapasā ugreṇa prāptavān asi kauśika
dīrgham āyuḥ ca te brahman dadāmi sa marud gaṇaḥ

sanskrit: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते गच्छ सौम्य यथा सुखम्
पितामह वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वेषाम् त्रिदिव ओकसाम्
transliteration: svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te gaccha saumya yathā sukham
pitāmaha vacaḥ śrutvā sarveṣām tridiva okasām
english: O Brāhmaṇa, I will in company with the Maruts confer on you long life. hail to you! Do you accept this, good betide you. Go you, O gentle ascetic, bowing down to the celestials, said in delight,

sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्यम् यदि मे प्राप्तम् दीर्घम् आयुः तथैव च
transliteration: brāhmaṇyam yadi me prāptam dīrgham āyuḥ tathaiva ca

sanskrit: आऊं कारो अथ वषट् कारो वेदाः च वरयन्तु माम्
क्षत्र वेदविदाम् श्रेष्ठो ब्रह्म वेदविदाम् अपि
transliteration: āūṃ kāro atha vaṣaṭ kāro vedāḥ ca varayantu mām
kṣatra vedavidām śreṣṭho brahma vedavidām api

sanskrit: ब्रह्म पुत्रो वसिष्ठो माम् एवम् वदतु देवताः
यदि अयम् परमः कामः कृतो यान्तु सुरर्षभाः
transliteration: brahma putro vasiṣṭho mām evam vadatu devatāḥ
yadi ayam paramaḥ kāmaḥ kṛto yāntu surarṣabhāḥ

sanskrit: ततः प्रसादितो देवैः वसिष्ठो जपताम् वरः
सख्यम् चकार ब्रह्मर्षिः एवम् अस्तु इति च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ prasādito devaiḥ vasiṣṭho japatām varaḥ
sakhyam cakāra brahmarṣiḥ evam astu iti ca abravīt
english: Then pacified by the celestials, that best of reciters, the Brahmarsi Vasistha, made friends (with Viśvāmitra), saying,

sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षिः त्वम् न संदेहः सर्वम् संपद्यते तव
इति उक्त्वा देवताः च अपि सर्वा जग्मुः यथा आगतम्
transliteration: brahmarṣiḥ tvam na saṃdehaḥ sarvam saṃpadyate tava
iti uktvā devatāḥ ca api sarvā jagmuḥ yathā āgatam
english: 'So be it.' You are a Brahmarsi. There is no doubt about this. And everything has been compassed in your behalf, having said this, the deities went to their respective regions.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो अपि धर्मात्मा लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मण्यम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: viśvāmitro api dharmātmā labdhvā brāhmaṇyam uttamam
english: And that Brahmarși, the righteous Viśvāmitra also, having attained excellent Brāhmaṇa-hood, paid his homage to that best of reciters, Vasistha.

sanskrit: कृत कामो महीम् सर्वाम् चचार तपसि स्थितः
एवम् तु अनेन ब्राह्मण्यम् प्राप्तम् राम महात्मना
transliteration: kṛta kāmo mahīm sarvām cacāra tapasi sthitaḥ
evam tu anena brāhmaṇyam prāptam rāma mahātmanā
english: And, having secured his end, began to range the entire world, staying in asceticism. In this wise, O Rāma, was Brāhmanya actually obtained by the high-souled one.

sanskrit: एष राम मुनि श्रेष्ठ एष विग्रहवान् तपः
एष धर्मः परो नित्यम् वीर्यस्य एष परायणम्
transliteration: eṣa rāma muni śreṣṭha eṣa vigrahavān tapaḥ
eṣa dharmaḥ paro nityam vīryasya eṣa parāyaṇam
english: This, O Rāma, is the foremost of ascetics, this one is Asceticism incarnate. This one ever abide by duty; and he is the stay of ascetic energy.

sanskrit: शतानंद वचः श्रुत्वा राम लक्ष्मण संनिधौ
transliteration: śatānaṃda vacaḥ śrutvā rāma lakṣmaṇa saṃnidhau
english: Having said this, that best of regenerate persons paused. Hearing Satānanda's narration delivered in the presence of Rāma and Laks maņa, Janaka with clasped hands addressed the son of Kusika.

sanskrit: धन्यो अस्मि अनुगृहीतो अस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुंगव
transliteration: dhanyo asmi anugṛhīto asmi yasya me munipuṃgava

sanskrit: यज्ञम् काकुत्स्थ सहितः प्राप्तवान् असि कौशिक
पावितो अहम् त्वया ब्रह्मन् दर्शनेन महामुने
transliteration: yajñam kākutstha sahitaḥ prāptavān asi kauśika
pāvito aham tvayā brahman darśanena mahāmune
english: Blessed and beholden am I, that you, O Kausika, accompanied with Kākutstha, hast arrived at my sacrifice, O puissant anchorite. Purified am I, O Brāhmaṇa, by your very sight.

sanskrit: गुणा बहु विधाः प्राप्ताः तव संदर्शनात् मया
विस्तरेण च वै ब्रह्मन् कीर्त्यमानम् महत्तपः
transliteration: guṇā bahu vidhāḥ prāptāḥ tava saṃdarśanāt mayā
vistareṇa ca vai brahman kīrtyamānam mahattapaḥ
english: O mighty Muni. And from your sight have I received various qualities. O Brāhmaṇa, your mighty austerities have been related in detail; and myself as well as he high-souled Rāma have listened to the narration relative to your formidable ascetic energy; and the assembled courtiers have heard of your various perfections.

sanskrit: श्रुतम् मया महातेजो रामेण च महात्मना
सदस्यैः प्राप्य च सदः श्रुताः ते बहवो गुणाः
transliteration: śrutam mayā mahātejo rāmeṇa ca mahātmanā
sadasyaiḥ prāpya ca sadaḥ śrutāḥ te bahavo guṇāḥ
english: O mighty Muni. And from your sight have I received various qualities. O Brāhmaṇa, your mighty austerities have been related in detail; and myself as well as he high-souled Rāma have listened to the narration relative to your formidable ascetic energy; and the assembled courtiers have heard of your various perfections.

sanskrit: अप्रमेयम् तपः तुभ्यम् अप्रमेयम् च ते बलम्
अप्रमेया गुणाः चैव नित्यम् ते कुशिकात्मज
transliteration: aprameyam tapaḥ tubhyam aprameyam ca te balam
aprameyā guṇāḥ caiva nityam te kuśikātmaja
english: Immeasurable is your asceticism; and ever immeasurable your power; and immeasurable your qualities,

sanskrit: तृप्तिः आश्चर्य भूतानाम् कथानाम् न अस्ति मे विभो
कर्म कालो मुनि श्रेष्ठ लम्बते रवि मण्डलम्
transliteration: tṛptiḥ āścarya bhūtānām kathānām na asti me vibho
karma kālo muni śreṣṭha lambate ravi maṇḍalam
english: O Kusika's son. I never, O lord, am tired of listening to that wonderful narration. Now, O foremost of ascetics, the hour for performing the daily devotions has arrived, and the solar disc hangs aslope.

sanskrit: श्वः प्रभाते महातेजो द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि माम् पुनः
स्वागतम् जपताम् श्रेष्ठ माम् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: śvaḥ prabhāte mahātejo draṣṭum arhasi mām punaḥ
svāgatam japatām śreṣṭha mām anujñātum arhasi
english: To-morrow morning, O highly energetic one, you will see me again. Welcome, best of reciters. It behove you to favour me.

sanskrit: विससर्ज आशु जनकम् प्रीतम् प्रीतिमान् तदाअ
transliteration: visasarja āśu janakam prītam prītimān tadāa
english: Thus addressed, that best of ascetics, extolling that powerful one, well pleased, dismissed the delighted Janaka.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा मुनि श्रेष्ठम् वैदेहो मिथिला अधिपः
प्रदक्षिणम् चकार आशु स उपाध्यायः स बांधवः
transliteration: evam uktvā muni śreṣṭham vaideho mithilā adhipaḥ
pradakṣiṇam cakāra āśu sa upādhyāyaḥ sa bāṃdhavaḥ
english: Thus accosted, Mithila's lord, Vaideha, in company with his priests and friends, went round that foremost of ascetics,

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो अपि धर्मात्मा सह रामः स लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: viśvāmitro api dharmātmā saha rāmaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: And the righteous Viśvāmitra also together with Rāma and Lakşmaņa, having been honoured by the high-souled ones, took up their quarters there.

sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते विमले कृत कर्मा नराधिपः
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛta karmā narādhipaḥ
english: The next morning, which happened to be bright, the lord of men, having performed his daily devotions, welcomed Viśvāmitra and Rāghava. And having, in accordance with the scriptures, paid homage to the former as well as the two high-souled Rāghavas, that virtuous one said,

sanskrit: तम् अर्चयित्वा धर्माअत्मा शास्त्र दृष्टेन कर्मणा
राघवौ च महात्मानौ तदा वाक्यम् उवाच ह
transliteration: tam arcayitvā dharmāatmā śāstra dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
rāghavau ca mahātmānau tadā vākyam uvāca ha
english: The next morning, which happened to be bright, the lord of men, having performed his daily devotions, welcomed Viśvāmitra and Rāghava. And having, in accordance with the scriptures, paid homage to the former as well as the two high-souled Rāghavas, that virtuous one said,

sanskrit: भगवन् स्वागतम् ते अस्तु किम् करोमि तव अनघ
भवान् आज्ञापयतु माम् आज्ञाप्यो भवता हि अहम्
transliteration: bhagavan svāgatam te astu kim karomi tava anagha
bhavān ājñāpayatu mām ājñāpyo bhavatā hi aham
english: Hail, O worshipful sir! What shall I do to you, O sinless one? Do you command. Surely, I deserve to be commanded by you.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः स धर्मात्मा जनकेन महात्मना
प्रत्युवाच मुनिर् वीरम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ sa dharmātmā janakena mahātmanā
pratyuvāca munir vīram vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
english: Thus addressed by the high-souled Janaka, that first of ascetics endowed with a righteous soul, well versed in speech, answered,

sanskrit: पुत्रौ दशरथस्य इमौ क्षत्रियौ लोक विश्रुतौ
द्रष्टु कामौ धनुः श्रेष्ठम् यत् एतत् त्वयि तिष्ठति
transliteration: putrau daśarathasya imau kṣatriyau loka viśrutau
draṣṭu kāmau dhanuḥ śreṣṭham yat etat tvayi tiṣṭhati
english: These sons of Dasaratha-Ksatriyas, famed among men, are eager to behold than best of bows.

sanskrit: एतत् दर्शय भद्रम् ते कृत कामौ नृप आत्मजौ
दर्शनात् अस्य धनुषो यथा इष्टम् प्रतियास्यतः
transliteration: etat darśaya bhadram te kṛta kāmau nṛpa ātmajau
darśanāt asya dhanuṣo yathā iṣṭam pratiyāsyataḥ
english: If it be with you, do you show it to them, may it be well with you! having obtained a sight of that bow, the king's sons, their desires crowned with success, will success, will return as they list.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु जनकः प्रत्युवाच महामुनिम्
श्रूयताम् अस्य धनुषो यत् अर्थम् इह तिष्ठति
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu janakaḥ pratyuvāca mahāmunim
śrūyatām asya dhanuṣo yat artham iha tiṣṭhati
english: Thus accosted, Janaka replied to the mighty Muni, saying, Lisen to why the bow lie here.

sanskrit: देवरात इति ख्यातो निमेः ज्येष्ठो मही पतिः
न्यासो अयम् तस्य भगवन् हस्ते दत्तो महात्मना
transliteration: devarāta iti khyāto nimeḥ jyeṣṭho mahī patiḥ
nyāso ayam tasya bhagavan haste datto mahātmanā
english: There was a king known by the name of Devarata. He was the elder brother of Nimi. And, Oworshipful one, this bow was consigned to the hands of that high-souled one, this bow was consigned to the hands of that high-souled one as a trust.

sanskrit: दक्ष यज्ञ वधे पूर्वम् धनुः आयम्य वीर्यवान्
रुद्रः तु त्रिदशान् रोषात् स लीलम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: dakṣa yajña vadhe pūrvam dhanuḥ āyamya vīryavān
rudraḥ tu tridaśān roṣāt sa līlam idam abravīt
english: Formerly with the view of destroying Dakşa's sacrifice, the puissant (Śiva), drawing this bow, sportively spoke to the celestials in ire, saying, 'Since, you gods, you deny me the shares (of this sacrifice), which I lay claim to, I will with my bow even sever those heads of yours.'

sanskrit: यस्मात् भाग अर्थिनो भागान् न अकल्पयत मे सुराः
वर अंगानि महाअर्हाणि धनुषा शातयामि वः
transliteration: yasmāt bhāga arthino bhāgān na akalpayata me surāḥ
vara aṃgāni mahāarhāṇi dhanuṣā śātayāmi vaḥ
english: Formerly with the view of destroying Dakşa's sacrifice, the puissant (Śiva), drawing this bow, sportively spoke to the celestials in ire, saying, 'Since, you gods, you deny me the shares (of this sacrifice), which I lay claim to, I will with my bow even sever those heads of yours.'

sanskrit: ततो विमनसः सर्वे देवा वै मुनिपुंगव
प्रसादयन्ति देवेशम् तेषाम् प्रीतो अभवत् भवः
transliteration: tato vimanasaḥ sarve devā vai munipuṃgava
prasādayanti deveśam teṣām prīto abhavat bhavaḥ
english: Thereat, O powerful ascetic, with agitated hearts, the deities fell to propitiating that lord of the celestials, and Bhava was pleased with them.

sanskrit: प्रीति युक्तः तु सर्वेषाम् ददौ तेषाम् महात्मनाम्
तत् एतत् देवदेवस्य धनू रत्नम् महात्मनः
transliteration: prīti yuktaḥ tu sarveṣām dadau teṣām mahātmanām
tat etat devadevasya dhanū ratnam mahātmanaḥ
english: And well-pleased with them, he conferred this upon those high-souled ones. And even this is that jewel of a bow belonging to the high-souled god of gods, and which was ultimately, O lord, consigned as a trust to our ancestor.

sanskrit: न्यासभूतम् तदा न्यस्तम् अस्माकम् पूर्वजे विभो
अथ मे कृषतः क्षेत्रम् लांगलात् उत्थिता मम
transliteration: nyāsabhūtam tadā nyastam asmākam pūrvaje vibho
atha me kṛṣataḥ kṣetram lāṃgalāt utthitā mama

sanskrit: क्षेत्रम् शोधयता लब्ध्वा नाम्ना सीता इति विश्रुता
भू तलात् उत्थिता सा तु व्यवर्धत मम आत्मजा
transliteration: kṣetram śodhayatā labdhvā nāmnā sītā iti viśrutā
bhū talāt utthitā sā tu vyavardhata mama ātmajā
english: And as I was ploughing the mead, arose a damsel, and as I obtained her while hallowing the field (for sacrifice), she has come to be known by the name of Sītā. And arising from the earth, she grew as my daughter.

sanskrit: वीर्य शुल्का इति मे कन्या स्थापिता इयम् अयोनिजा
भूतलात् उत्थिताम् ताम् तु वर्धमानाम् मम आत्मजाम्
transliteration: vīrya śulkā iti me kanyā sthāpitā iyam ayonijā
bhūtalāt utthitām tām tu vardhamānām mama ātmajām

sanskrit: वीर्य शुल्का इति भगवन् न ददामि सुताम् अहम्
transliteration: vīrya śulkā iti bhagavan na dadāmi sutām aham

sanskrit: न शेकुः ग्रहणे तस्य धनुषः तोलने अपि वा
तेषाम् वीर्यवताम् वीर्यम् अल्पम् ज्ञात्वा महामुने
transliteration: na śekuḥ grahaṇe tasya dhanuṣaḥ tolane api vā
teṣām vīryavatām vīryam alpam jñātvā mahāmune

sanskrit: अरुन्धन् मिथिलाम् सर्वे वीर्य संदेहम् आगताः
transliteration: arundhan mithilām sarve vīrya saṃdeham āgatāḥ

sanskrit: रोषेण महता आविष्टाः पीडयन् मिथिलाम् पुरीम्
ततः संवत्सरे पूर्णे क्षयम् यातानि सर्वशः
transliteration: roṣeṇa mahatā āviṣṭāḥ pīḍayan mithilām purīm
tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe kṣayam yātāni sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: साधनानि मुनिश्रेष्ठ ततो अहम् भृश दुःखितः
ततो देव गणान् सर्वान् तपसा अहम् प्रसादयम्
transliteration: sādhanāni muniśreṣṭha tato aham bhṛśa duḥkhitaḥ
tato deva gaṇān sarvān tapasā aham prasādayam

sanskrit: ददुः च परम प्रीताः चतुरंग बलम् सुराः
ततो भग्ना नृपतयो हन्यमाना दिशो ययुः
transliteration: daduḥ ca parama prītāḥ caturaṃga balam surāḥ
tato bhagnā nṛpatayo hanyamānā diśo yayuḥ

sanskrit: अवीर्या वीर्य संदिग्धा स अमात्याः पाप कारिणः
तत् एतत् मुनिशार्दूल धनुः परम भास्वरम्
transliteration: avīryā vīrya saṃdigdhā sa amātyāḥ pāpa kāriṇaḥ
tat etat muniśārdūla dhanuḥ parama bhāsvaram

sanskrit: राम लक्ष्मणयोः च अपि दर्शयिष्यामि सुव्रत
यदि अस्य धनुषो रामः कुर्यात् आरोपणम् मुने
सुताम् अयोनिजाम् सीताम् दद्याम् दाशरथेः अहम्
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ ca api darśayiṣyāmi suvrata
yadi asya dhanuṣo rāmaḥ kuryāt āropaṇam mune
sutām ayonijām sītām dadyām dāśaratheḥ aham
english: O you of excellent vows. And, if, Ascetic, Rāma succeeds in fixing string to it, I will confer upon Daſaratha's son my daughter unsprung from the usual source. Sītā,

sanskrit: धनुर् दर्शय रामाय इति ह उवाच पार्थिवम्
transliteration: dhanur darśaya rāmāya iti ha uvāca pārthivam
english: Hearing Janaka's words, the mighty Muni Viśvāmitra said to the king, Do you show the bow to Rāma.

sanskrit: ततः स राजा जनकः सचिवान् व्यादिदेश ह
धनुर् आनीयताम् दिव्यम् गन्ध माल्य अनुलेपितम्
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā janakaḥ sacivān vyādideśa ha
dhanur ānīyatām divyam gandha mālya anulepitam
english: Thereupon the king Janaka commanded his ministers, saying, Do you bring the wonderful bow furnished with unguents and garlands.

sanskrit: तत् धनुः पुरतः कृत्वा निर्जग्मुः अमित औजसः
transliteration: tat dhanuḥ purataḥ kṛtvā nirjagmuḥ amita aujasaḥ
english: Commanded by Janaka, the ministers entered the city; and placing the bow in their front, those, endowed with immeasurable energy, came out.

sanskrit: मंजूषाम् अष्ट चक्राम् ताम् समूहुः ते कथंचन
transliteration: maṃjūṣām aṣṭa cakrām tām samūhuḥ te kathaṃcana
english: And deposited in a case on a cart borne upon eight wheels, it was with difficulty drawn along by five thousand stalwart persons of welldeveloped frames.

sanskrit: ताम् आदाय तु मंजूषाम् आयसीम् यत्र तत् धनुः
सुरोपमम् ते जनकम् ऊचुः नृपति मन्त्रिणः
transliteration: tām ādāya tu maṃjūṣām āyasīm yatra tat dhanuḥ
suropamam te janakam ūcuḥ nṛpati mantriṇaḥ
english: And having brought that bow plaited with iron, placed in its case, the royal counsellors spoke to Janaka resembling an immortal, saying,

sanskrit: इदम् धनुर् वरम् राजन् पूजितम् सर्व राजभिः
मिथिला अधिप राज इन्द्र दर्शनीयम् यत् इच्छसि
transliteration: idam dhanur varam rājan pūjitam sarva rājabhiḥ
mithilā adhipa rāja indra darśanīyam yat icchasi
english: Here is the best of bow, O king, worshipped of all sovereigns. O foremost of kings, O lord of Mithilā, if it please you, behold the same.

sanskrit: तेषाम् नृपो वचः श्रुत्वा कृत अंजलिः अभाषत
विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् तौ उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: teṣām nṛpo vacaḥ śrutvā kṛta aṃjaliḥ abhāṣata
viśvāmitram mahātmānam tau ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: Hearing their speech, the king with ciasped palms said to the high-souled Viśvāmitra as well as Rāma and Laksmana,

sanskrit: इदम् धनुर् वरम् ब्रह्मन् जनकैः अभिपूजितम्
राजभिः च महा वीर्यैः अशक्तैः पूरितम् तदा
transliteration: idam dhanur varam brahman janakaiḥ abhipūjitam
rājabhiḥ ca mahā vīryaiḥ aśaktaiḥ pūritam tadā
english: This best of bows, O Brāhmaṇa, has always been worshipped by the Janakas: as also by mighty kings incapable of wielding and stringing it.)

sanskrit: न एतत् सुर गणाः सर्वे स असुरा न च राक्षसाः
गंधर्व यक्ष प्रवराः स किन्नर महोरगाः
transliteration: na etat sura gaṇāḥ sarve sa asurā na ca rākṣasāḥ
gaṃdharva yakṣa pravarāḥ sa kinnara mahoragāḥ
english: And neither the celestials, nor the Asuras, nor the Rākşasas, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Yakş as, nor the Kinnaras, nor the mighty Uragas, how shall men fare have succeeded in stringing or stretching it, or fixing the arrow to it, or pulling its string, or wielding it.

sanskrit: क्व गतिः मानुषाणाम् च धनुषो अस्य प्रपूरणे
आरोपणे समायोगे वेपने तोलने अपि वा
transliteration: kva gatiḥ mānuṣāṇām ca dhanuṣo asya prapūraṇe
āropaṇe samāyoge vepane tolane api vā
english: And neither the celestials, nor the Asuras, nor the Rākşasas, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Yakş as, nor the Kinnaras, nor the mighty Uragas, how shall men fare have succeeded in stringing or stretching it, or fixing the arrow to it, or pulling its string, or wielding it.

sanskrit: तत् एतत् धनुषाम् श्रेष्ठम् आनीतम् मुनिपुंगव
दर्शय एतत् महाभाग अनयोः राज पुत्रयोः
transliteration: tat etat dhanuṣām śreṣṭham ānītam munipuṃgava
darśaya etat mahābhāga anayoḥ rāja putrayoḥ
english: This foremost of bows has been brought here, O chief of ascetics. Do you, O exalted one, show it to these sons of the king.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रः स रामः तु श्रुत्वा जनक भाषितम्
वत्स राम धनुः पश्य इति राघवम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: viśvāmitraḥ sa rāmaḥ tu śrutvā janaka bhāṣitam
vatsa rāma dhanuḥ paśya iti rāghavam abravīt
english: Hearing Janaka's words, the righteous Viśvāmitra said to Rāghava, O Rāma, do you, my child, behold the bow.

sanskrit: महर्षेः वचनात् रामो यत्र तिष्ठति तत् धनुः
मंजूषाम् ताम् अपावृत्य दृष्ट्वा धनुः अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: maharṣeḥ vacanāt rāmo yatra tiṣṭhati tat dhanuḥ
maṃjūṣām tām apāvṛtya dṛṣṭvā dhanuḥ atha abravīt
english: At the words of the Maharsi, Rama, opening the case, took a sight of the bow, and said,

sanskrit: इदम् धनुर्वरम् ब्रह्मन् संस्पृशामि इह पाणिना
यत्नवान् च भविष्यामि तोलने पूरणे अपि वा
transliteration: idam dhanurvaram brahman saṃspṛśāmi iha pāṇinā
yatnavān ca bhaviṣyāmi tolane pūraṇe api vā
english: This divine bow will I touch with my hand, and shall I also strive to wield and draw it?

sanskrit: बाढम् इति एव तम् राजा मुनिः च समभाषत
लीलया स धनुर् मध्ये जग्राह वचनात् मुनेः
transliteration: bāḍham iti eva tam rājā muniḥ ca samabhāṣata
līlayā sa dhanur madhye jagrāha vacanāt muneḥ

sanskrit: आरोपयत् स धर्मात्मा स लीलम् इव तत् धनुः
transliteration: āropayat sa dharmātmā sa līlam iva tat dhanuḥ

sanskrit: तत् बभंज धनुर् मध्ये नरश्रेष्ठो महायशाः
transliteration: tat babhaṃja dhanur madhye naraśreṣṭho mahāyaśāḥ

sanskrit: तस्य शब्दो महान् आसीत् निर्घात सम निःस्वनः
भूमि कंपः च सुमहान् पर्वतस्य इव दीर्यतः
transliteration: tasya śabdo mahān āsīt nirghāta sama niḥsvanaḥ
bhūmi kaṃpaḥ ca sumahān parvatasya iva dīryataḥ

sanskrit: निपेतुः च नराः सर्वे तेन शब्देन मोहिताः
व्रजयित्वा मुनि वरम् राजानम् तौ च राघवौ
transliteration: nipetuḥ ca narāḥ sarve tena śabdena mohitāḥ
vrajayitvā muni varam rājānam tau ca rāghavau

sanskrit: प्रति आश्वस्तो जने तस्मिन् राजा विगत साध्वसः
transliteration: prati āśvasto jane tasmin rājā vigata sādhvasaḥ
english: On the people being reassured, the king conversant with speech, his apprehension removed, with folded hands addressed that puissant ascetic, saying.

sanskrit: भगवन् दृष्ट वीर्यो मे रामो दशरथ आत्मजः
अति अद्भुतम् अचिंत्यम् च अतर्कितम् इदम् मया
transliteration: bhagavan dṛṣṭa vīryo me rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ
ati adbhutam aciṃtyam ca atarkitam idam mayā
english: O worshipful one, I have beheld the prowess of Dasaratha's son. This is verily wonderful and inconceivable; and I did not think this was possible.

sanskrit: जनकानाम् कुले कीर्तिम् आहरिष्यति मे सुता
सीता भर्तारम् आसाद्य रामम् दशरथ आत्मजम्
transliteration: janakānām kule kīrtim āhariṣyati me sutā
sītā bhartāram āsādya rāmam daśaratha ātmajam
english: My daughter, Sītā, being united with her lord, Dasaratha's son, Rama, will shed lustre on Janaka's line.

sanskrit: मम सत्या प्रतिज्ञा सा वीर्य शुल्का इति कौशिक
सीता प्राणैः बहुमता देया रामाय मे सुता
transliteration: mama satyā pratijñā sā vīrya śulkā iti kauśika
sītā prāṇaiḥ bahumatā deyā rāmāya me sutā
english: My promise viz., that I will confer Sītā upon him that will bend the bow, has been fulfilled, O son of Kusika. And this Sītā, this my daughter, dearer to me than life will I confer upon Rāma.

sanskrit: भवतो अनुमते ब्रह्मन् शीघ्रम् गच्छंतु मंत्रिणः
मम कौशिक भद्रम् ते अयोध्याम् त्वरिता रथैः
transliteration: bhavato anumate brahman śīghram gacchaṃtu maṃtriṇaḥ
mama kauśika bhadram te ayodhyām tvaritā rathaiḥ
english: O Brāhmaṇa, by your permission let my counsellors speedily post hence, O Kausika, to Ayodhyā, in cars; and with humble speech bring the king to my capital. And let them communicate to him all about the bestowal of Sītå upon Răma, in consequence of his having bent the bow.

sanskrit: राजानम् प्रश्रितैः वाक्यैः आनयंतु पुरम् मम
प्रदानम् वीर्य शुक्लायाः कथयंतु च सर्वशः
transliteration: rājānam praśritaiḥ vākyaiḥ ānayaṃtu puram mama
pradānam vīrya śuklāyāḥ kathayaṃtu ca sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: मुनि गुप्तौ च काकुत्स्थौ कथयंतु नृपाय वै
प्रीति युक्तम् तु राजानम् आनयंतु सु शीघ्र गाः
transliteration: muni guptau ca kākutsthau kathayaṃtu nṛpāya vai
prīti yuktam tu rājānam ānayaṃtu su śīghra gāḥ
english: Let them acquaint the monarch with the welfare of the Kākutsthas protected by the ascetic; and let them, speedily posting hence, bring the delighted king.

sanskrit: कौशिकः च तथा इति आह राजा च आभाष्य मंत्रिणः
यथा वृत्तम् समाख्यातुम् आनेतुम् च नृपम् तथा
transliteration: kauśikaḥ ca tathā iti āha rājā ca ābhāṣya maṃtriṇaḥ
yathā vṛttam samākhyātum ānetum ca nṛpam tathā
english: And thereupon Kusika's son said,-So be it. And the righteous king, summoning his counsellors, despatched them to Ayodhyā with his letter, to communicate all duly to the king, and bring him thither.

sanskrit: जनकेन समादिष्टा दूताः ते क्लान्त वाहनाः
त्रि रात्रम् उषिता मार्गे ते अयोध्याम् प्राविशन् पुरीम्
transliteration: janakena samādiṣṭā dūtāḥ te klānta vāhanāḥ
tri rātram uṣitā mārge te ayodhyām prāviśan purīm
english: Thus commissioned by Janaka, the envoys, having spent three nights on the way, entered the city of Ayodhyā, with their conveyances afflicted with fatigue.

sanskrit: ते राज वचनात् गत्वा राजवेश्म प्रवेशिताः
ददृशुः देव संकाशम् वृद्धम् दशरथम् नृपम्
transliteration: te rāja vacanāt gatvā rājaveśma praveśitāḥ
dadṛśuḥ deva saṃkāśam vṛddham daśaratham nṛpam
english: In accordance with the royal commission, entering the king's residence, they saw the aged king Dasaratha, resembling a celestial.

sanskrit: बद्ध अंजलि पुटाः सर्वे दूता विगत साध्वसाः
राजानम् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् मधुर अक्षरम्
transliteration: baddha aṃjali puṭāḥ sarve dūtā vigata sādhvasāḥ
rājānam praśritam vākyam abruvan madhura akṣaram

sanskrit: मैथिलो जनको राजा स अग्नि होत्र पुरस्कृतः
मुहुर् मुहुर् मधुरया स्नेह संरक्तया गिरा
transliteration: maithilo janako rājā sa agni hotra puraskṛtaḥ
muhur muhur madhurayā sneha saṃraktayā girā

sanskrit: कुशलम् च अव्ययम् चैव स उपाध्याय पुरोहितम्
जनकः त्वाम् महाराज पृच्छते स पुरः सरम्
transliteration: kuśalam ca avyayam caiva sa upādhyāya purohitam
janakaḥ tvām mahārāja pṛcchate sa puraḥ saram

sanskrit: कौशिक अनुमते वाक्यम् भवन्तम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: kauśika anumate vākyam bhavantam idam abravīt
english: After having enquired after your complete welfare, Mithila's lord, Vaideha, by permission of Kausika, addresses you thus,

sanskrit: पूर्वम् प्रतिज्ञा विदिता वीर्य शुल्का मम आत्मजा
राजानः च कृत अमर्षा निर्वीर्या विमुखी कृताः
transliteration: pūrvam pratijñā viditā vīrya śulkā mama ātmajā
rājānaḥ ca kṛta amarṣā nirvīryā vimukhī kṛtāḥ
english: You know the vow I had made formerlyviz., to confer my daughter upon him that would bend the bow,-and the kings, in consequence of their having been deprived of prowess, and being baffled, have come to entertain spite against me.

sanskrit: सा इयम् मम सुता राजन् विश्वामित्र पुरस्कृतैः
यदृच्छया आगतैः वीरैः निर्जिता तव पुत्रकैः
transliteration: sā iyam mama sutā rājan viśvāmitra puraskṛtaiḥ
yadṛcchayā āgataiḥ vīraiḥ nirjitā tava putrakaiḥ
english: And that daughter of mine, O king, has been won by your son, arrived one, that divine, jewelled bow has been snapped in the middle by the high-souled Rāma in the midst of a large assembly.

sanskrit: तत् च रत्नम् धनुर् दिव्यम् मध्ये भग्नम् महात्मना
रामेण हि महाबाहो महत्याम् जन संसदि
transliteration: tat ca ratnam dhanur divyam madhye bhagnam mahātmanā
rāmeṇa hi mahābāho mahatyām jana saṃsadi
english: And that daughter of mine, O king, has been won by your son, arrived one, that divine, jewelled bow has been snapped in the middle by the high-souled Rāma in the midst of a large assembly.

sanskrit: अस्मै देया मया सीता वीर्य शुल्का महात्मने
प्रतिज्ञाम् तर्तुम् इच्छामि तत् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: asmai deyā mayā sītā vīrya śulkā mahātmane
pratijñām tartum icchāmi tat anujñātum arhasi
english: Upon that high-souled one should I confer Sītā, having prowess assigned for her dower. And in this wise will I free myself from my vow; and this you should permit. 10

sanskrit: शीघ्रम् आगच्छ भद्रम् ते द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि राघवौ
transliteration: śīghram āgaccha bhadram te draṣṭum arhasi rāghavau
english: O mighty king, do you, good betide you, come speedily headed by your priests. It behove you to see the Rāghavas;

sanskrit: पुत्रयोः उभयोः एव प्रीतिम् त्वम् अपि लप्स्यसे
transliteration: putrayoḥ ubhayoḥ eva prītim tvam api lapsyase
english: And, O foremost of kings, to see me delivered from this vow. And do you attain the joy incident to the nuptials of both your sons,

sanskrit: एवम् विदेह अधिपतिः मधुरम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam videha adhipatiḥ madhuram vākyam abravīt
english: Thus spoke sweetly the lord of Videha, permitted by Viśvāmitra and staying by the opinions of Satānanda.'

sanskrit: दूत वाक्यम् तु तत् श्रुत्वा राजा परम हर्षितः
वसिष्ठम् वामदेवम् च मंत्रिणः च एवम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: dūta vākyam tu tat śrutvā rājā parama harṣitaḥ
vasiṣṭham vāmadevam ca maṃtriṇaḥ ca evam abravīt
english: Hearing the words of the envoys, the king, exceedingly rejoiced, addressed Vasiştha and Vamadeva, as well as his counsellors, saying,

sanskrit: गुप्तः कुशिक पुत्रेण कौसल्य आनन्द वर्धनः
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा विदेहेषु वसति असौ
transliteration: guptaḥ kuśika putreṇa kausalya ānanda vardhanaḥ
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā videheṣu vasati asau
english: Protected by Kusika's son, that exhancer of Kausalyā's joy stay in Videha in company with his brother, Laksmana.15

sanskrit: दृष्ट वीर्यः तु काकुत्स्थो जनकेन महात्मना
संप्रदानम् सुतायाः तु राघवे कर्तुम् इच्छति
transliteration: dṛṣṭa vīryaḥ tu kākutstho janakena mahātmanā
saṃpradānam sutāyāḥ tu rāghave kartum icchati
english: And the high-souled Janaka has witnessed the prowess of Kākutstha; and he wish to bestow his daughter upon Rāghava.

sanskrit: यदि वो रोचते वृत्तम् जनकस्य महात्मनः
पुरीम् गच्छामहे शीघ्रम् मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः
transliteration: yadi vo rocate vṛttam janakasya mahātmanaḥ
purīm gacchāmahe śīghram mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
english: If this alliance with the high-souled Janaka is relished by you, we shall speedily repair to his capital. Let there be no waste of time.

sanskrit: मंत्रिणो बाढम् इति आहुः सह सर्वैः महर्षिभिः
सु प्रीतः च अब्रवीत् राजा श्वः यात्रा इति च मंत्रिणः
transliteration: maṃtriṇo bāḍham iti āhuḥ saha sarvaiḥ maharṣibhiḥ
su prītaḥ ca abravīt rājā śvaḥ yātrā iti ca maṃtriṇaḥ
english: Thereupon, the counsellors along with the Maharsis said, Excellent! And the king highly delighted, said to the counsellors, Our journey commence on the morrow.

sanskrit: मंत्रिणः तु नरेन्द्रस्य रात्रिम् परम सत्कृताः
ऊषुः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे गुणैः सर्वैः समन्विताः
transliteration: maṃtriṇaḥ tu narendrasya rātrim parama satkṛtāḥ
ūṣuḥ pramuditāḥ sarve guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitāḥ
english: And excellently ministered to, the counsellors of that foremost of monarchs (Janaka), endowed with every excellent quality, spent that night in joy.

sanskrit: ततो रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् स उपाध्यायः स बान्धवः
राजा दशरथो हृष्टः सुमंत्रम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tato rātryām vyatītāyām sa upādhyāyaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ
rājā daśaratho hṛṣṭaḥ sumaṃtram idam abravīt
english: Then when the night had been spent, king Dasaratha accompanied with his priests and adherents, well pleased spoke to Sumantra, saying,

sanskrit: अद्य सर्वे धन अध्यक्षा धनम् आदाय पुष्कलम्
व्रजंति अग्रे सु विहिता नाना रत्न समन्विताः
transliteration: adya sarve dhana adhyakṣā dhanam ādāya puṣkalam
vrajaṃti agre su vihitā nānā ratna samanvitāḥ
english: To-day let the officers in charge of the treasury, taking plenty of excellent wealth, and furnished with various gems, go in advance under proper escort.

sanskrit: चतुरंग बलम् च अपि शीघ्रम् निर्यातु सर्वशः
मम आज्ञा समकालम् च यानम् युग्मम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: caturaṃga balam ca api śīghram niryātu sarvaśaḥ
mama ājñā samakālam ca yānam yugmam anuttamam
english: And let the fore-fold forces sally out with speed. And at my command let horses and conveyances and elegant vehicles march out

sanskrit: वसिष्ठो वामदेवः च जाबालिः अथ काश्यपः
मार्कण्डेयः च दीर्घायुः ऋषिः कात्यायनः तथा
transliteration: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaḥ ca jābāliḥ atha kāśyapaḥ
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ ca dīrghāyuḥ ṛṣiḥ kātyāyanaḥ tathā
english: And let Vasiştha and Vamadeva and Jābāli and Kasyapa and Mārkandeya endowed with long life and the saint Katyāyana-let these regenerate ones go forward. And do you also yoke my car. Let not the proper time pass away; for the envoys urge speed upon me.

sanskrit: एते द्विजाः प्रयान्तु अग्रे स्यंदनम् योजयस्व मे
यथा काल अत्ययो न स्यात् दूता हि त्वरयन्ति माम्
transliteration: ete dvijāḥ prayāntu agre syaṃdanam yojayasva me
yathā kāla atyayo na syāt dūtā hi tvarayanti mām
english: And let Vasiştha and Vamadeva and Jābāli and Kasyapa and Mārkandeya endowed with long life and the saint Katyāyana-let these regenerate ones go forward. And do you also yoke my car. Let not the proper time pass away; for the envoys urge speed upon me.

sanskrit: वचनात् च नरेन्द्रस्य सेना च चतुरंगिणी
राजानम् ऋषिभिः सार्धम् व्रजंतम् पृष्ठतो अन्वगात्
transliteration: vacanāt ca narendrasya senā ca caturaṃgiṇī
rājānam ṛṣibhiḥ sārdham vrajaṃtam pṛṣṭhato anvagāt
english: At these words of the king, the four-fold forces together with the saints went in the wake of the monarch.

sanskrit: गत्वा चतुर् अहम् मार्गम् विदेहान् अभ्युपेयिवान्
राजा तु जनकः श्रीमान् श्रुत्वा पूजाम् अकल्पयत्
transliteration: gatvā catur aham mārgam videhān abhyupeyivān
rājā tu janakaḥ śrīmān śrutvā pūjām akalpayat
english: After having passed four days on the way, they arrived at Videha. And bearing of Dasaratha's arrival, the auspicious king Janaka experienced great delight, and having obtained the aged king Dasaratha, he honoured him duly.

sanskrit: ततो राजानम् आसाद्य वृद्धम् दशरथम् नृपम्
जनको मुदितो राजा हर्षम् च परमम् ययौ
transliteration: tato rājānam āsādya vṛddham daśaratham nṛpam
janako mudito rājā harṣam ca paramam yayau

sanskrit: उवाच वचनम् श्रेष्ठो नरश्रेष्ठम् मुदा अन्वितम्
स्वागतम् ते नरश्रेष्ठः दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो असि राघव
transliteration: uvāca vacanam śreṣṭho naraśreṣṭham mudā anvitam
svāgatam te naraśreṣṭhaḥ diṣṭyā prāpto asi rāghava
english: That chief of men well pleased, spoke these words, Have your journey been a pleasant one, O best of men? By luck have I obtained you, O descendant of Raghu.

sanskrit: पुत्रयोः उभयोः प्रीतिम् लप्स्यसे वीर्य निर्जिताम्
दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो महातेजा वसिष्ठो भगवान् ऋषिः
transliteration: putrayoḥ ubhayoḥ prītim lapsyase vīrya nirjitām
diṣṭyā prāpto mahātejā vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
english: Do you experience the joy earned by the prowess of your sons. And by luck it is that I have obtained the highly energetic and worshipful saint Vasistha accompanied by the foremost regenerate ones, like him of an hundred sacrifices, by the celestials.

sanskrit: सह सर्वैः द्विज श्रेष्ठैः देवैः इव शतक्रतुः
दिष्ट्या मे निर्जिता विघ्ना दिष्ट्या मे पूजितम् कुलम्
transliteration: saha sarvaiḥ dvija śreṣṭhaiḥ devaiḥ iva śatakratuḥ
diṣṭyā me nirjitā vighnā diṣṭyā me pūjitam kulam

sanskrit: राघवैः सह संबंधात् वीर्य श्रेष्ठैः महात्मभिः
श्वः प्रभाते नरेन्द्र त्वम् सम्वर्तयितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: rāghavaiḥ saha saṃbaṃdhāt vīrya śreṣṭhaiḥ mahātmabhiḥ
śvaḥ prabhāte narendra tvam samvartayitum arhasi

sanskrit: यज्ञस्य अन्ते नरश्रेष्ठ विवाहम् ऋषि सत्तमैः
तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा ऋषि मध्ये नराधिपः
transliteration: yajñasya ante naraśreṣṭha vivāham ṛṣi sattamaiḥ
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā ṛṣi madhye narādhipaḥ

sanskrit: प्रतिग्रहो दातृ वशः श्रुतम् एतत् मया पुरा
transliteration: pratigraho dātṛ vaśaḥ śrutam etat mayā purā

sanskrit: यथा वक्ष्यसि धर्मज्ञ तत् करिष्यामहे वयम्
तत् धर्मिष्ठम् यशस्यम् च वचनम् सत्य वादिनः
transliteration: yathā vakṣyasi dharmajña tat kariṣyāmahe vayam
tat dharmiṣṭham yaśasyam ca vacanam satya vādinaḥ

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा विदेह अधिपतिः परम् विस्मयम् आगतः
ततः सर्वे मुनि गणाः परस्पर समागमे
transliteration: śrutvā videha adhipatiḥ param vismayam āgataḥ
tataḥ sarve muni gaṇāḥ paraspara samāgame

sanskrit: हर्षेण महता युक्ताः ताम् निशाम् अवसन् सुखम्
अथ रामो महातेजा लक्ष्मणेन समम् ययौ
transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktāḥ tām niśām avasan sukham
atha rāmo mahātejā lakṣmaṇena samam yayau

sanskrit: राजा च राघवौ पुत्रौ निशाम्य परिहर्षितः
transliteration: rājā ca rāghavau putrau niśāmya pariharṣitaḥ

sanskrit: जनको अपि महातेजाः क्रिया धर्मेण तत्त्ववित्
यज्ञस्य च सुताभ्याम् च कृत्वा रात्रिम् उवास ह
transliteration: janako api mahātejāḥ kriyā dharmeṇa tattvavit
yajñasya ca sutābhyām ca kṛtvā rātrim uvāsa ha
english: And the exceedingly energetic Janaka also, versed in men and things, having in accordance with the ordinance completed the sacrifice and performed all the preliminary rites relative to the nuptials of his daughters, reposed for the night.

sanskrit: ततः प्रभाते जनकः कृत कर्मा महर्षिभिः
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte janakaḥ kṛta karmā maharṣibhiḥ
english: Then next morning Janaka skilled in speech, having in company with the Maharsis performed his daily duties, addressed the priest Satānanda, saying

sanskrit: कुशध्वज इति ख्यातः पुरीम् अध्यवसत् शुभाम्
transliteration: kuśadhvaja iti khyātaḥ purīm adhyavasat śubhām
english: My highly energetic, puissant and eminently righteous brother known by the name of Kusadhvaja dwell in the auspicious city, Sāņkāśyā, whose ramparts are ranged round with pointed weapons, and which is laved by the river Ikşumatī, and which resembles the celestial regions or the aerial car, Pușpaka.

sanskrit: वार्या फलक पर्यन्ताम् पिबन् इक्षुमतीम् नदीम्
सांकाश्याम् पुण्य संकाशाम् विमानम् इव पुष्पकम्
transliteration: vāryā phalaka paryantām piban ikṣumatīm nadīm
