sāṃkāśyām puṇya saṃkāśām vimānam iva puṣpakam
english: My highly energetic, puissant and eminently righteous brother known by the name of Kusadhvaja dwell in the auspicious city, Sāņkāśyā, whose ramparts are ranged round with pointed weapons, and which is laved by the river Ikşumatī, and which resembles the celestial regions or the aerial car, Pușpaka.

sanskrit: तम् अहम् द्रष्टुम् इच्छामि यज्ञ गोप्ता स मे मतः
प्रीतिम् सो अपि महातेजा इमाम् भोक्ता मया सह
transliteration: tam aham draṣṭum icchāmi yajña goptā sa me mataḥ
prītim so api mahātejā imām bhoktā mayā saha
english: I wish to see him, and he is in charge of my sacrifice. And that highly energetic one will partake with me the joy of this occasion.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो तु वचने शतानंदस्य संनिधौ
आगताः केचिद् अव्यग्रा जनकः तान् समादिशत्
transliteration: evam ukto tu vacane śatānaṃdasya saṃnidhau
āgatāḥ kecid avyagrā janakaḥ tān samādiśat
english: This having been said to Satānanda, some competent persons presented themselves; and Janaka commanded them (to set up) for Sāņkāśyā.

sanskrit: शासनात् तु नरेन्द्रस्य प्रययुः शीघ्र वाजिभिः
समानेतुम् नरव्याघ्रम् विष्णुम् इन्द्र आज्ञया यथा
transliteration: śāsanāt tu narendrasya prayayuḥ śīghra vājibhiḥ
samānetum naravyāghram viṣṇum indra ājñayā yathā
english: And commanded by the monarch, off they want, mounting on fleet coursers, with the view of bringing over that tiger among men, like Viş nu at the mandate of Indra.

sanskrit: संकास्याम् ते समागम्य ददृशुः च कुश्ध्वजम्
न्यवेदयन् यथा वृत्तम् जनकस्य च चिन्तितम्
transliteration: saṃkāsyām te samāgamya dadṛśuḥ ca kuśdhvajam
nyavedayan yathā vṛttam janakasya ca cintitam
english: And arriving at Sāņkāśyā, they presented themselves before Kušadhvaja, and faithfully delivered to him the intention of Janaka.

sanskrit: तद् वृत्तम् नृपतिः श्रुत्वा दूत श्रेष्ठैः महा जवैः
transliteration: tad vṛttam nṛpatiḥ śrutvā dūta śreṣṭhaiḥ mahā javaiḥ
english: And hearing the tidings conveyed by those foremost of envoys endowed with great fleetness, Kusadhvaja set out at the mandate of the monarch.

sanskrit: स ददर्श महात्मानम् जनकम् धर्म वत्सलम्
सो अभिवाद्य शतानंदम् जनकम् च अति धार्मिकम्
transliteration: sa dadarśa mahātmānam janakam dharma vatsalam
so abhivādya śatānaṃdam janakam ca ati dhārmikam
english: And on coming to Videha, he appeared before the high-souled Janaka addicted to righteousness. And saluting Satānanda as well as the eminently virtuous Janaka, he sat down on an excellent and superb seat worthy of a King.

sanskrit: राज अर्हम् परमम् दिव्यम् आसनम् च अध्यरोहत
उपविष्टौ उभौ तौ तु भ्रातरौ अमित ओजसौ
transliteration: rāja arham paramam divyam āsanam ca adhyarohata
upaviṣṭau ubhau tau tu bhrātarau amita ojasau

sanskrit: गच्छ मंत्रि पते शीघ्रम् इक्ष्वाकम् अमित प्रभम्
transliteration: gaccha maṃtri pate śīghram ikṣvākam amita prabham
english: Having been seated, both the heroic brothers of immeasurable splendour addressed that foremost of counsellors, Sudáman, saying, 'Go, foremost of counsellors, and speedily bring over the irrepressible Ikşvāku of immeasurable splendour along with his sons and ministers.

sanskrit: आत्मजैः सह दुर्धर्षम् आनयस्व स मंत्रिणम्
औपकार्याम् स गत्वा तु रघूणाम् कुल वर्धनम्
transliteration: ātmajaiḥ saha durdharṣam ānayasva sa maṃtriṇam
aupakāryām sa gatvā tu raghūṇām kula vardhanam

sanskrit: ददर्श शिरसा च एनम् अभिवाद्य इदम् अब्रवीत्
अयोध्या अधिपते वीर वैदेहो मिथिला अधिपः
transliteration: dadarśa śirasā ca enam abhivādya idam abravīt
ayodhyā adhipate vīra vaideho mithilā adhipaḥ

sanskrit: स त्वाम् द्रष्टुम् व्यवसितः स उपाध्याय पुरोहितम्
मंत्रि श्रेष्ठ वचः श्रुत्वा राजा स ऋषि गणः तदा
transliteration: sa tvām draṣṭum vyavasitaḥ sa upādhyāya purohitam
maṃtri śreṣṭha vacaḥ śrutvā rājā sa ṛṣi gaṇaḥ tadā

sanskrit: स बन्धुः अगमत् तत्र जनको यत्र वर्तते
राजा च मंत्रि सहितः स उपाध्यायः स बांधवः
transliteration: sa bandhuḥ agamat tatra janako yatra vartate
rājā ca maṃtri sahitaḥ sa upādhyāyaḥ sa bāṃdhavaḥ

sanskrit: वाक्यम् वाक्य विदाम् श्रेष्ठो वैदेहम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
विदितम् ते महाराज इक्ष्वाकु कुल दैवतम्
transliteration: vākyam vākya vidām śreṣṭho vaideham idam abravīt
viditam te mahārāja ikṣvāku kula daivatam

sanskrit: वक्ता सर्वेषु कृत्येषु वसिष्ठो भगवान् ऋषिः
transliteration: vaktā sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ

sanskrit: एष वक्ष्यति धर्मात्मा वसिष्ठो मे यथा क्रमम्
तूष्णीम् भूते दशरथे वसिष्ठो भगवान् ऋषिः
transliteration: eṣa vakṣyati dharmātmā vasiṣṭho me yathā kramam
tūṣṇīm bhūte daśarathe vasiṣṭho bhagavān ṛṣiḥ

sanskrit: उवाच वाक्यम् वाक्यज्ञो वैदेहम् स पुरोधसाम्
अव्यक्त प्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्ययः
transliteration: uvāca vākyam vākyajño vaideham sa purodhasām
avyakta prabhavo brahmā śāśvato nitya avyayaḥ

sanskrit: तस्मात् मरीचिः संजज्ञे मरीचेः कश्यपः सुतः
विवस्वान् कश्यपात् जज्ञे मनुर् वैवस्वतः स्मृतः
transliteration: tasmāt marīciḥ saṃjajñe marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ sutaḥ
vivasvān kaśyapāt jajñe manur vaivasvataḥ smṛtaḥ
english: The perpetual, everlasting, and undeteriorating Brahmā sprang from the Unmanifest (Brahmā). From him sprang Marīci; and Kasyapa is son to Marīci. And from Kaśyapa sprung Vivasvat; and Manu is son to Vivasvat.

sanskrit: मनुः प्रजापतिः पूर्वम् इक्ष्वाकुः च मनोः सुतः
तम् इक्ष्वाकुम् अयोध्यायाम् राजानम् विद्धि पूर्वकम्
transliteration: manuḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvam ikṣvākuḥ ca manoḥ sutaḥ
tam ikṣvākum ayodhyāyām rājānam viddhi pūrvakam
english: This Manu is otherwise called Prajäpati; and Ikşvāku is Manu's son. And this Ikşvāku you must understand, was the first king of Ayodhyā.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकोः तु सुतः श्रीमान् कुक्षिः इति एव विश्रुतः
कुक्षेः अथ आत्मजः श्रीमान् विकुक्षिः उपपद्यत
transliteration: ikṣvākoḥ tu sutaḥ śrīmān kukṣiḥ iti eva viśrutaḥ
kukṣeḥ atha ātmajaḥ śrīmān vikukṣiḥ upapadyata
english: And Ikşvāku's son, it is well known, was the graceful Kuksi. And Kuksi's son was the graceful Vikuksi.

sanskrit: विकुक्षेः तु महातेजा बाणः पुत्रः प्रतापवान्
transliteration: vikukṣeḥ tu mahātejā bāṇaḥ putraḥ pratāpavān
english: And Vikuksi's son was the exceedingly energetic and powerful Bāņa. And Bāna's son was the highly energetic and powerful Anaranya.

sanskrit: अनरण्यात् पृथुः जज्ञे त्रिशंकुः तु पृथोः सुतः
transliteration: anaraṇyāt pṛthuḥ jajñe triśaṃkuḥ tu pṛthoḥ sutaḥ
english: From Anaranya sprang Prithu; and from Prithu, Trisanku. And Trisanku's son was the highly famous Dhundhumāra.

sanskrit: युवनाश्व सुतः असीत् मान्धाता पृथिवी पतिः
transliteration: yuvanāśva sutaḥ asīt māndhātā pṛthivī patiḥ
english: And from Dhundhumāra sprung the Mahāratha, Yuvanāśva. And from Yuvanāśva sprung Māndhātā, lord of earth.

sanskrit: मान्धातुः तु सुतः श्रीमान् सुसन्धिः उदपद्यत
सुसंधेः अपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसंधिः प्रसेनजित्
transliteration: māndhātuḥ tu sutaḥ śrīmān susandhiḥ udapadyata
susaṃdheḥ api putrau dvau dhruvasaṃdhiḥ prasenajit
english: And Māndhātā's son was the graceful Susandhi. And Susandhi's two sons were Dhruvasandhi and Prasenajit.

sanskrit: यशस्वी ध्रुवसंधेः तु भरतो नाम नामतः
भरतात् तु महातेजा असितो नाम जायत
transliteration: yaśasvī dhruvasaṃdheḥ tu bharato nāma nāmataḥ
bharatāt tu mahātejā asito nāma jāyata
english: And from Dhruvasandhi sprung the famous Bharata. And from Bharata sprung Asita; to fight whom were born as hostile kings, those heroes, the Haihayas, the Talajanghas, and the Sasabindus.

sanskrit: यस्य एते प्रति राजन उदपत्यन्त शात्रवः
हैहय तालजंघाः च शूराः च शशबिंद्वः
transliteration: yasya ete prati rājana udapatyanta śātravaḥ
haihaya tālajaṃghāḥ ca śūrāḥ ca śaśabiṃdvaḥ
english: And from Dhruvasandhi sprung the famous Bharata. And from Bharata sprung Asita; to fight whom were born as hostile kings, those heroes, the Haihayas, the Talajanghas, and the Sasabindus.

sanskrit: तान् च स प्रति युद्ध्यन् वै युद्धे राजा प्रवासितः
transliteration: tān ca sa prati yuddhyan vai yuddhe rājā pravāsitaḥ
english: And engaged in conflict with them, that king fled (from his kingdom); and repairing to the Himavat in company with his two consorts, the feeble Asita there paid his debt to nature.

sanskrit: असितो अल्प बलो राजा काल धर्मम् उपेयिवान्
द्वे च अस्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यै बभूवतुः इति श्रुति
transliteration: asito alpa balo rājā kāla dharmam upeyivān
dve ca asya bhārye garbhiṇyai babhūvatuḥ iti śruti
english: The story runs that his two wives were in the family way; and that with the intention of destroying the embryo of the other, one of them administered poison to the former mixed in her food.

sanskrit: एका गर्भ विनाश अर्थम् सपत्नै सगरम् ददौ
ततः शैलवरे रम्ये बभूव अभिरतो मुनिः
transliteration: ekā garbha vināśa artham sapatnai sagaram dadau
tataḥ śailavare ramye babhūva abhirato muniḥ

sanskrit: तत्र च एका महाभागा भार्गवम् देव वर्चसम्
transliteration: tatra ca ekā mahābhāgā bhārgavam deva varcasam

sanskrit: ववन्दे पद्म पत्राक्षी कांक्षन्ती सुतम् उत्तमम्
तम् ऋषिम् सा अभ्युपगम्य कालिन्दी च अभ्यवादत
transliteration: vavande padma patrākṣī kāṃkṣantī sutam uttamam
tam ṛṣim sā abhyupagamya kālindī ca abhyavādata
english: And it came to pass that at this time, Bhrgu's son, the ascetic Cyavana, had become addicted to the romantic Himavat, foremost of mountains. And here one of those exalted dames with eyes resembling lotus-petals, saluting Bhrigu's son born shining like a celestial, desired of him an excellent. son. And drawing near to that sage, Kalindi saluted him.

sanskrit: स ताम् अभ्यवदत् विप्रः पुत्र ईप्सुम् पुत्र जन्मनि
तव कुक्षौ महाभागे सु पुत्रः सु महाबलः
transliteration: sa tām abhyavadat vipraḥ putra īpsum putra janmani
tava kukṣau mahābhāge su putraḥ su mahābalaḥ
english: And that Vipra said to her, who was desiring of having a son born of her,-In your womb, O exalted one, will be speedily born an excellent son mixed up with poison, highly powerful, and exceedingly energetic, and possessed of mighty strength, and graceful.

sanskrit: गरेण सहितः श्रीमान् मा शुचः कमलेक्षणे
transliteration: gareṇa sahitaḥ śrīmān mā śucaḥ kamalekṣaṇe
english: And that Vipra said to her, who was desiring of having a son born of her,-In your womb, O exalted one, will be speedily born an excellent son mixed up with poison, highly powerful, and exceedingly energetic, and possessed of mighty strength, and graceful.

sanskrit: पत्या विरहिता तस्मात् पुत्रम् देवी व्यजायत
transliteration: patyā virahitā tasmāt putram devī vyajāyata
english: Therefore, do you not grieve, O you of lotuseyes. And having paid reverence to Cyavana, that chaste and worshipful princess, although bereft of her husband, gave birth to a son.

sanskrit: सपत्न्या तु गरः तस्यैः दत्तो गर्भ जिघांसया
सह तेन गरेण एव संजातः सगरोइ अभवत्
transliteration: sapatnyā tu garaḥ tasyaiḥ datto garbha jighāṃsayā
saha tena gareṇa eva saṃjātaḥ sagaroi abhavat
english: And since intending to destroy her foetus she that was co-wife with her had administered poison to her, Sagara* was born together with the poison. *Gara-poison. Sagara means, with poison, i.e. here, one born with poison.

sanskrit: सगरस्य अस्य असमंजः तु असमंजात् अथ अंशुमान्
transliteration: sagarasya asya asamaṃjaḥ tu asamaṃjāt atha aṃśumān
english: And Sagara's son was Asamanja, and Ansumat. And Dilīpa was son to Ansumat, and Bhagiratha to Dilīpa.

sanskrit: भगीरथात् ककुत्स्थः च ककुत्स्थस्य रघुः तथा
रघोः तु पुत्रः तेजस्वी प्रवृद्धः पुरुषादकः
transliteration: bhagīrathāt kakutsthaḥ ca kakutsthasya raghuḥ tathā
raghoḥ tu putraḥ tejasvī pravṛddhaḥ puruṣādakaḥ
english: And from Bhagiratha sprang Kākutstha, and from Kākutstha, Raghu. And Raghu's son was the puissant Pravşdha, feeding on human flesh.

sanskrit: कल्माषपादो हि अभवत् तस्मात् जातः तु शङ्खणः
transliteration: kalmāṣapādo hi abhavat tasmāt jātaḥ tu śaṅkhaṇaḥ
english: And he came finally to be known by the name of Kalmāşapāda.* And from him sprung Śarkhana. And Sudarśana was Sankhana's and Agnivarna was Sudaśana's son. He incurred Vasiştha's curse, and was turned into a Rākşasa. He took up water, intending to clear scores with Vasistha; but at the request of his wife, desisted, pouring down the water at his own feet. Hence the name of Kalmāşapāda.

sanskrit: शीघ्रगः तु अग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगस्य मरुः सुतः
मरोः प्रशुश्रुकः तु आसीत् अंबरीषः प्रशुश्रुकात्
transliteration: śīghragaḥ tu agnivarṇasya śīghragasya maruḥ sutaḥ
maroḥ praśuśrukaḥ tu āsīt aṃbarīṣaḥ praśuśrukāt
english: Śīghraga was Agnivarņa’s, and Maru was Śīghraga's son. And Maru's son was Prasuśruka, and from Praśuśruka sprung Ambarīşa.

sanskrit: अंबरीषस्य पुत्रो अभूत् नहुषः च महीपतिः
नहुषस्य ययातिः तु नाभागः तु ययाति जः
transliteration: aṃbarīṣasya putro abhūt nahuṣaḥ ca mahīpatiḥ
nahuṣasya yayātiḥ tu nābhāgaḥ tu yayāti jaḥ
english: Ambarisa's son was Nahusa, lord of earth. And Nahusa's son was Yayāti, was Nābhāga. And Nābhāga's son was Aja, and from Aja sprung Dasaratha. And from this Dasaratha have come the brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: नाभागस्य भभूव अज अजात् दशरथो अभवत्
अस्मात् दशरथात् जातौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: nābhāgasya bhabhūva aja ajāt daśaratho abhavat
asmāt daśarathāt jātau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: Ambarisa's son was Nahusa, lord of earth. And Nahusa's son was Yayāti, was Nābhāga. And Nābhāga's son was Aja, and from Aja sprung Dasaratha. And from this Dasaratha have come the brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: आदि वंश विशुद्धानाम् राज्ञाम् परम धर्मिणाम्
इक्ष्वाकु कुल जातानाम् वीराणाम् सत्य वादिनाम्
transliteration: ādi vaṃśa viśuddhānām rājñām parama dharmiṇām
ikṣvāku kula jātānām vīrāṇām satya vādinām
english: It is in the interests of Rāma and Lakşmaņa belonging to the heroic and truthful and pious sovereigns sprung in the Ikşvāku line, and possessing purity of race even from the time of their founder, that, Oking, we solicit the hands of your daughters. And, O foremost of men, it be-hove you to confer like brides upon like bridegrooms.

sanskrit: राम लक्ष्मणयोः अर्थे त्वत् सुते वरये नृप
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ arthe tvat sute varaye nṛpa
english: It is in the interests of Rāma and Lakşmaņa belonging to the heroic and truthful and pious sovereigns sprung in the Ikşvāku line, and possessing purity of race even from the time of their founder, that, Oking, we solicit the hands of your daughters. And, O foremost of men, it be-hove you to confer like brides upon like bridegrooms.

sanskrit: श्रोतुम् अर्हसि भद्रम् ते कुलम् नः परिकीर्तितम्
transliteration: śrotum arhasi bhadram te kulam naḥ parikīrtitam
english: When Vasiştha had spoken thus, Janaka with clasped hands answered to him, saying,-It behove you to listen to our genealogy as related by myself. In the matter of disposal of daughters, O foremost of anchorets, one's own line should be described by one boasting of a noble ancestry. Do you then, O mighty-minded one, listen to the same.

sanskrit: प्रदाने हि मुनि श्रेष्ठ कुलम् निरवशेषतः
वक्तव्यम् कुल जातेन तन् निबोध महामुने
transliteration: pradāne hi muni śreṣṭha kulam niravaśeṣataḥ
vaktavyam kula jātena tan nibodha mahāmune
english: When Vasiştha had spoken thus, Janaka with clasped hands answered to him, saying,-It behove you to listen to our genealogy as related by myself. In the matter of disposal of daughters, O foremost of anchorets, one's own line should be described by one boasting of a noble ancestry. Do you then, O mighty-minded one, listen to the same.

sanskrit: राजा अभूत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः स्वेन कर्मणा
निमिः परम धर्मात्मा सर्व सत्त्ववताम् वरः
transliteration: rājā abhūt triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ svena karmaṇā
nimiḥ parama dharmātmā sarva sattvavatām varaḥ
english: There was a king famed over the three worlds by his own acts, Nimi-eminently picus and the foremost of those endowed with strength.

sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो मिथिः नाम जनको मिथि पुत्रकः
प्रथमो जनको नाम जनकात् अपि उदावसुः
transliteration: tasya putro mithiḥ nāma janako mithi putrakaḥ
prathamo janako nāma janakāt api udāvasuḥ
english: His son was named Mithi, and Mithi's son was Janaka. And from this king Janaka have we son was derived that word as applied to every one of us. And from Janaka sprang Udāvasu;

sanskrit: उदावसोः तु धर्मात्मा जातो वै नन्दिवर्धनः
नन्दिवर्धन पुत्रः तु सुकेतुः नाम नामतः
transliteration: udāvasoḥ tu dharmātmā jāto vai nandivardhanaḥ
nandivardhana putraḥ tu suketuḥ nāma nāmataḥ
english: Udāvasu's the pious-souled Nandivardhana. And Nandivardha's son was the heroic Suketu.
Suketu's son was the mighty and righteous Devarata. And the Rājarși Devarāta's son was Brhadratha.
Bịhadratha's son was the heroic and puissant Mahāvīra. And Mahāvīra's son was Sudhști, endowed with fortitude and having truth for prowess.

sanskrit: सुधृतेः अपि धर्मात्मा धृष्टकेतुः सु धार्मिकः
धृष्टकेतोः च राजर्षेः हर्यश्व इति विश्रुतः
transliteration: sudhṛteḥ api dharmātmā dhṛṣṭaketuḥ su dhārmikaḥ
dhṛṣṭaketoḥ ca rājarṣeḥ haryaśva iti viśrutaḥ
english: Sudhrtia's son was the pious-spirited and eminently righteous Dhīșțaketu. And the Rājarși Dhistaketu's son was Haryasva.

sanskrit: हर्यश्वस्य मरुः पुत्रो मरोः पुत्रः प्रतीन्धकः
transliteration: haryaśvasya maruḥ putro maroḥ putraḥ pratīndhakaḥ
english: Haryaśva's son was Maru; and Maru's son was Pratīndhaka. And Pratīndhaka's son was the righteous king Kirtiratha.

sanskrit: पुत्रः कीर्तिरथस्य अपि देवमीढ इति स्मृतः
transliteration: putraḥ kīrtirathasya api devamīḍha iti smṛtaḥ
english: Kirtiratha's Devamidha, and Devamidha's Vibudha, and Vibudha's Mahidhraka.
Mahīdhraka's son was king Kirtirāta endowed with great strength. And the Rājarşi Kirtirāta had Mahāroman born to him.
Mahāroman, the virtuous Svarnaroman. And the Rājarşi Svarnaroman had Hrasvaroman born to him. son was

sanskrit: तस्य पुत्र द्वयम् जज्ञे धर्मज्ञस्य महात्मनः
ज्येष्ठो अहम् अनुजो भ्राता मम वीरः कुशध्वज
transliteration: tasya putra dvayam jajñe dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ
jyeṣṭho aham anujo bhrātā mama vīraḥ kuśadhvaja
english: This high-souled king conversant with morality had two sons: the elder, myself the younger, even my brother, who was the elder son, and consigning to my care Kusadhvaja, our father sought the forest.

sanskrit: माम् तु ज्येष्ठम् पिता राज्ये सो अभिषिच्य नराधिप
कुशध्वजम् समावेश्य भारम् मयि वनम् गतः
transliteration: mām tu jyeṣṭham pitā rājye so abhiṣicya narādhipa
kuśadhvajam samāveśya bhāram mayi vanam gataḥ

sanskrit: वृद्धे पितरि स्वर् याते धर्मेण धुरम् आवहम्
भ्रातरम् देव संकाशम् स्नेहात् पश्यन् कुशध्वजम्
transliteration: vṛddhe pitari svar yāte dharmeṇa dhuram āvaham
bhrātaram deva saṃkāśam snehāt paśyan kuśadhvajam
english: And on my aged sire ascending heaven, I righteously ruled the kingdom and cherished my brother Kusadvaja resembling a celestial, with the eye of affection.

sanskrit: कस्यचित् तु अथ कालस्य सांकाश्यात् अगमत् पुरात्
transliteration: kasyacit tu atha kālasya sāṃkāśyāt agamat purāt
english: It came to pass that on one occasion a certain powerful king named Sudhanvan came before Mithilā intending to lay siege to it.

sanskrit: स च मे प्रेषयामास शैवम् धनुः अनुत्तमम्
सीता कन्या च पद्माक्षी मह्यम् वै दीयताम् इति
transliteration: sa ca me preṣayāmāsa śaivam dhanuḥ anuttamam
sītā kanyā ca padmākṣī mahyam vai dīyatām iti
english: He sent word to me, saying, 'Do you give me the all-excellent bow of Śiva, as well as your daughter, the lotus-even Sītā.'

sanskrit: तस्य अप्रदानात् ब्रह्मर्षे युद्धम् आसीत् मया सह
स हतो अभिमुखो राजा सुधन्वा तु मया रणे
transliteration: tasya apradānāt brahmarṣe yuddham āsīt mayā saha
sa hato abhimukho rājā sudhanvā tu mayā raṇe
english: And is consequence of my not granting him either, king Sudhanvan, O Brahmarsi, entered into hostilities with me; but he was both defeated and slain by me in the encounter.
O foremost of ascetics, slaying king Sudhanvan. I installed in Sānkāśyā my heroic brother Kuśadhvaja.

sanskrit: कनीयान् एष मे भ्राता अहम् ज्येष्ठो महामुने
ददामि परम प्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुंगव
transliteration: kanīyān eṣa me bhrātā aham jyeṣṭho mahāmune
dadāmi parama prīto vadhvau te munipuṃgava
english: Thus one, O mighty anchorite, is my younger brother, and I am his elder. O powerful ascetic, well pleased will I confer on you these as your daughter-in-law,

sanskrit: सीताम् रामाय भद्रम् ते ऊर्मिलाम् लक्ष्मणाय वै
वीर्य शुल्काम् मम सुताम् सीताम् सुर सुत उपमाम्
transliteration: sītām rāmāya bhadram te ūrmilām lakṣmaṇāya vai
vīrya śulkām mama sutām sītām sura suta upamām
english: Sītā on Rāma, good betide you, and Urmilā on Laksmana. And, I take oath thrice that, without doubt, I will with a glad heart confer upon you, O potent ascetic, as your daughters-in-law my second daughter Urmilā and also Sītā resembling the daughter of a celestial, having prowess assigned for her dower.

sanskrit: द्वितीयाम् ऊर्मिलाम् चैव त्रिः वदामि न संशयः
ददामि परम प्रीतो वध्वौ ते मुनिपुंगव
transliteration: dvitīyām ūrmilām caiva triḥ vadāmi na saṃśayaḥ
dadāmi parama prīto vadhvau te munipuṃgava

sanskrit: राम लक्ष्मणयो राजन् गो दानम् कारयस्व ह
पितृ कार्यम् च भद्रम् ते ततो वैवाहिकम् कुरु
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayo rājan go dānam kārayasva ha
pitṛ kāryam ca bhadram te tato vaivāhikam kuru
english: do you now, O king, give away kine on behalf of the nuptials of Rāma and Lakşmaņa; and also perform their ancestral rites, good to you; and then complete the marriage ceremony.

sanskrit: मघा हि अद्य महाबाहो तृतीये दिवसे प्रभो
फल्गुन्याम् उत्तरे राजन् तस्मिन् वैवाहिकम् कुरु
राम लक्ष्मणयोः अर्थे दानम् कार्यम् सुखोदयम्
transliteration: maghā hi adya mahābāho tṛtīye divase prabho
phalgunyām uttare rājan tasmin vaivāhikam kuru
rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ arthe dānam kāryam sukhodayam
english: To-day the star Magha is on the ascendant. On the third day, my master, when the Phalguna will be on the north, do you, O monarch, perform the marriage ceremony. Do you now, however, dispense gifts for invoking blessings upon Rāma and Laksmana.24

sanskrit: उवाच वचनम् वीरम् वसिष्ठ सहितो नृपम्
transliteration: uvāca vacanam vīram vasiṣṭha sahito nṛpam
english: When Vaideha had spoken thus, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra is company with Vasiștha addressed that heroic king, saying.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् विदेहानाम् न एषाम् तुल्यो अस्ति कश्चन
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām videhānām na eṣām tulyo asti kaścana
english: O puissant one, the lines of the Ikşvākus and the Vaidehas are exceedingly noble and incomparable. No other race can by any means compare with them.

sanskrit: सदृशो धर्म संबन्धः सदृशो रूप संपदा
राम लक्ष्मणयो राजन् सीता च ऊर्मिलया सह
transliteration: sadṛśo dharma saṃbandhaḥ sadṛśo rūpa saṃpadā
rāma lakṣmaṇayo rājan sītā ca ūrmilayā saha
english: O monarch, this youthful union of Rāma and Lakşmaņa with Sītā and Urmilā is fit by all means; and it is worthy of their wealth of grace.

sanskrit: वक्तव्यम् च नर श्रेष्ठ श्रूयताम् वचनम् मम
भ्राता यवीयान् धर्मज्ञ एष राजा कुशध्वजः
transliteration: vaktavyam ca nara śreṣṭha śrūyatām vacanam mama
bhrātā yavīyān dharmajña eṣa rājā kuśadhvajaḥ

sanskrit: अस्य धर्मात्मनो राजन् रूपेण अप्रतिमम् भुवि
सुता द्वयम् नरश्रेष्ठ पत्नि अर्थम् वरयामहे
transliteration: asya dharmātmano rājan rūpeṇa apratimam bhuvi
sutā dvayam naraśreṣṭha patni artham varayāmahe

sanskrit: वरयेम सुते राजन् तयोः अर्थे महात्मनोः
transliteration: varayema sute rājan tayoḥ arthe mahātmanoḥ

sanskrit: पुत्रा दशरथस्य इमे रूप यौवन शालिनः
लोक पाल समाः सर्वे देव तुल्य पराक्रमाः
transliteration: putrā daśarathasya ime rūpa yauvana śālinaḥ
loka pāla samāḥ sarve deva tulya parākramāḥ
english: And these sons of Daśaratha are endued with youth and beauty, resembling the Lokapalas, and possessed of the prowess of celestials.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकु कुलम् अव्यग्रम् भवतः पुण्य कर्मणः
transliteration: ikṣvāku kulam avyagram bhavataḥ puṇya karmaṇaḥ
english: Therefore do you, O foremost of sovereigns, by this alliance with both the brothers, bind the Ikşvāku race. And in this may your mind never waver!

sanskrit: विश्वामित्र वचः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठस्य मते तदा
transliteration: viśvāmitra vacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mate tadā
english: Hearing Viśvāmitra's words embodying the sentiments of Vasiştha, Janaka with clasped hands addressed both the potent ascetics, saying,

sanskrit: कुलम् धन्यम् इदम् मन्ये येषाम् तौ मुनिपुंगवौ
सदृशम् कुल संबन्धम् यत् आज्ञापयथः स्वयम्
transliteration: kulam dhanyam idam manye yeṣām tau munipuṃgavau
sadṛśam kula saṃbandham yat ājñāpayathaḥ svayam
english: I consider my line as blessed; since such puissant ascetics wish for such a desirable alliance.

sanskrit: एवम् भवतु भद्रम् वः कुशध्वज सुते इमे
पत्न्यौ भजेताम् सहितौ शत्रुघ्न भरतौ उभौ
transliteration: evam bhavatu bhadram vaḥ kuśadhvaja sute ime
patnyau bhajetām sahitau śatrughna bharatau ubhau
english: Whatever you wish, even that shall be done, good betide you. Let these daughters of Kusadhvaja together become the wives of Śatrughna and Bharata.

sanskrit: एक अह्ना राज पुत्रीणाम् चतसॄणाम् महामुने
पाणीन् गृह्णन्तु चत्वारो राज पुत्रा महाबलाः
transliteration: eka ahnā rāja putrīṇām catasṝṇām mahāmune
pāṇīn gṛhṇantu catvāro rāja putrā mahābalāḥ
english: On the same day, O mighty Muni, let the four highly powerful princes espouse the hands of the four princesses.
The learned consider bridal celebrated on the day succeeding those on which the Phalgunis are on the ascendant, and having for its presiding deity Bhagas-the most auspicious.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा वचः सौम्यम् प्रत्युत्थाय कृतांजलिः
उभौ मुनि वरौ राजा जनको वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktvā vacaḥ saumyam pratyutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ
ubhau muni varau rājā janako vākyam abravīt
english: Having said these amiable words, king' Janaka arose, and with clasped hands addressed both the foremost of ascetics, saying.

sanskrit: परो धर्मः कृतो मह्यम् शिष्यो अस्मि भवतोः सदा
transliteration: paro dharmaḥ kṛto mahyam śiṣyo asmi bhavatoḥ sadā
english: I have reaped high religious merit (by these nuptials), and I also am your disciple. And do you, you anchorets, occupy these best of thrones, (belonging to us).15

sanskrit: यथा दशरथस्य इयम् तथा अयोध्या पुरी मम
प्रभुत्वे न अस्ति सन्देहो यथा अर्हम् कर्तुम् अर्हथः
transliteration: yathā daśarathasya iyam tathā ayodhyā purī mama
prabhutve na asti sandeho yathā arham kartum arhathaḥ
english: And even as this kingdom is to Dasaratha is Ayodhyā to myself. Do you not therefore entertain any doubts as to your lordship. Do you therefore do as it behove you.

sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवति वैदेहे जनके रघु नंदनः
राजा दशरथो हृष्टः प्रत्युवाच मही पतिम्
transliteration: tathā bruvati vaidehe janake raghu naṃdanaḥ
rājā daśaratho hṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvāca mahī patim
english: And as Vaideha Janaka was speaking thus, Raghu's son, king Dasaratha, well pleased answered that monarch, saying,

sanskrit: ऋषयो राज संघाः च भवद्भ्याम् अभिपूजिताः
transliteration: ṛṣayo rāja saṃghāḥ ca bhavadbhyām abhipūjitāḥ
english: Countless are the excellences that pertain to you brothers, lords of Mithilā; and saints and sovereigns are honoured by you,* auspiciousness be yours. *The commentator here seems to be in fault. He ever explains-By you have your royal ancestors been honoured. Evidently an error. I differ from him. The particle ca (and) makes the point clear.

sanskrit: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते गमिष्यामः स्वम् आलयम्
श्राद्ध कर्माणि विधिवत् विधास्य इति च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te gamiṣyāmaḥ svam ālayam
śrāddha karmāṇi vidhivat vidhāsya iti ca abravīt
english: Good betide you, I will repair to my own quarters, there to duly perform the Śrāddha ceremonies.

sanskrit: तम् आपृष्ट्वा नर पतिम् राजा दशरथः तदा
मुनीन्द्रौ तौ पुरस्कृत्य जगाम आशु महायशाः
transliteration: tam āpṛṣṭvā nara patim rājā daśarathaḥ tadā
munīndrau tau puraskṛtya jagāma āśu mahāyaśāḥ
english: Then having greeted that king of men, the illustrious Dasaratha, placing those foremost of ascetics in his front, went away.

sanskrit: स गत्वा निलयम् राजा श्राद्धम् कृत्वा विधानतः
प्रभाते काल्यम् उत्थाय चक्रे गो दानम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: sa gatvā nilayam rājā śrāddham kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
prabhāte kālyam utthāya cakre go dānam uttamam
english: And reaching his quarters, the king performed the Srāddha according to the ordinance, arose the next morning, and made excellent gifts of kine.

sanskrit: गवाम् शत सहस्रम् च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिपः
एक एकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रान् उद्धिश्य धर्मतः
transliteration: gavām śata sahasram ca brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipaḥ
eka ekaśo dadau rājā putrān uddhiśya dharmataḥ
english: And to Brāhmaṇas the monarch severally gavę away kine by hundreds and by thousands, for the welfare of his sons.

sanskrit: सुवर्ण शृंगयः संपन्नाः स वत्साः काम्स्य दोहनाः
गवाम् शत सहस्राणि चत्वारि पुरुष ऋषभः
transliteration: suvarṇa śṛṃgayaḥ saṃpannāḥ sa vatsāḥ kāmsya dohanāḥ
gavām śata sahasrāṇi catvāri puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ
english: And that puissant one gave away to the regenerate ones four hundred thousands of kine furnished with horns plaited with gold, and each having her calf, together with bell-Mattel vessels for milking them.

sanskrit: वित्तम् अन्यत् च सु बहु द्विजेभ्यो रघु नंदनः
ददौ गो दानम् उद्दिश्य पुत्राणाम् पुत्र वत्सलः
transliteration: vittam anyat ca su bahu dvijebhyo raghu naṃdanaḥ
dadau go dānam uddiśya putrāṇām putra vatsalaḥ
english: And that puissant one gave away to the regenerate ones four hundred thousands of kine furnished with horns plaited with gold, and each having her calf, together with bell-Mattel vessels for milking them.

sanskrit: स सुतैः कृत गो दानैः वृतः सः नृपतिः तदा
लोक पालैः इव आभाति वृतः सौम्यः प्रजापतिः
transliteration: sa sutaiḥ kṛta go dānaiḥ vṛtaḥ saḥ nṛpatiḥ tadā
loka pālaiḥ iva ābhāti vṛtaḥ saumyaḥ prajāpatiḥ
english: And that descendant of Raghu addicted to his sons made presents of various other valuables and the Brāhmaṇas, on behalf of his sons. And having given away kine, the surrounded by his sons looked like to the amiable Prajāpati surrounded by the Lokapālas.

sanskrit: यस्मिन् तु दिवसे राजा चक्रे गो दानम् उत्तमम्
तस्मिन् तु दिवसे शूरो युधाजित् समुपेयिवान्
transliteration: yasmin tu divase rājā cakre go dānam uttamam
tasmin tu divase śūro yudhājit samupeyivān
english: And it came to pass that the day on which the king made excellent presents of kine, the heroic Yudhājit, son to the lord of the Kekayas and maternal uncle to Bharata, presented himself before Dasaratha. And having seen the king and enquired after his welfare, he said to him.

sanskrit: पुत्रः केकय राजस्य साक्षात् भरत मातुलः
दृष्ट्वा पृष्ट्वा च कुशलम् राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: putraḥ kekaya rājasya sākṣāt bharata mātulaḥ
dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalam rājānam idam abravīt
english: And it came to pass that the day on which the king made excellent presents of kine, the heroic Yudhājit, son to the lord of the Kekayas and maternal uncle to Bharata, presented himself before Dasaratha. And having seen the king and enquired after his welfare, he said to him.

sanskrit: केकय अधिपती राजा स्नेहात् कुशलम् अब्रवीत्
येषाम् कुशलकामो असि तेषाम् संप्रति अनामयम्
transliteration: kekaya adhipatī rājā snehāt kuśalam abravīt
yeṣām kuśalakāmo asi teṣām saṃprati anāmayam
english: The lord of the Kekayas has from affection enquired after your welfare, sayiing,-'They of whose peace you are anxious, are at present well.' And, O foremost of kings, desirous of seeing (Bharata) together with his wife, that lord of earth repaired to Ayodhyā.

sanskrit: स्वस्रीयम् मम राजेन्द्र द्रष्टु कामो महीपतिः
तत् अर्थम् उपयातो अहम् अयोध्याम् रघुनंदन
transliteration: svasrīyam mama rājendra draṣṭu kāmo mahīpatiḥ
tat artham upayāto aham ayodhyām raghunaṃdana

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु अहम् अयोध्यायाम् विवाह अर्थम् तव आत्मजान्
मिथिलाम् उपयातान् तु त्वया सह महीपते
transliteration: śrutvā tu aham ayodhyāyām vivāha artham tava ātmajān
mithilām upayātān tu tvayā saha mahīpate
english: O descendant of Raghu. And learning at Ayodhyā that your sons for the purpose of marriage had, O monarch, come to Mithilā with yourself, I have speedily hide hither, with the intention of seeing my sister's son.

sanskrit: त्वरया अभुपयातो अहम् द्रष्टु कामः स्वसुः सुतम्
अथ राजा दशरथः प्रिय अतिथिम् उपस्थितम्
transliteration: tvarayā abhupayāto aham draṣṭu kāmaḥ svasuḥ sutam
atha rājā daśarathaḥ priya atithim upasthitam

sanskrit: ततः ताम् उषितो रात्रिम् सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः
transliteration: tataḥ tām uṣito rātrim saha putraiḥ mahātmabhiḥ

sanskrit: प्रभाते पुनः उत्थाय कृत्वा कर्माणि तत्त्ववित्
ऋषीन् तदा पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञ वाटम् उपागमत्
transliteration: prabhāte punaḥ utthāya kṛtvā karmāṇi tattvavit
ṛṣīn tadā puraskṛtya yajña vāṭam upāgamat
english: Then having passed the night in company with his high-souled sons, that one versed in men and things arose in the morning, and having disposed of his daily duties, approached the entrance of the sacrificial ground, headed by the saints.

sanskrit: युक्ते मुहूर्ते विजये सर्व आभरण भूषितैः
भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः कृत कौतुक मंगलः
transliteration: yukte muhūrte vijaye sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitaiḥ
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ kṛta kautuka maṃgalaḥ
english: Then at an auspicious moment called Vijaya; Rāma with Vasiştha as well as other Maharşis at his head, and accompanied by his brothers adorned with various ornaments, who had all performed the rites relative to their nuptials, (approached the entrance of the sacrificial ground). Then the worshipful Vasistha, coming to Vaideha, spoke as follows.

sanskrit: वसिष्ठम् पुरतः कृत्वा महर्षीन् अपरान् अपि
वशिष्टःओ भगवान् एत्य वैदेहम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: vasiṣṭham purataḥ kṛtvā maharṣīn aparān api
vaśiṣṭaḥo bhagavān etya vaideham idam abravīt
english: Then at an auspicious moment called Vijaya; Rāma with Vasiştha as well as other Maharşis at his head, and accompanied by his brothers adorned with various ornaments, who had all performed the rites relative to their nuptials, (approached the entrance of the sacrificial ground). Then the worshipful Vasistha, coming to Vaideha, spoke as follows.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो राजन् कृत कौतुक मन्गलैः
पुत्रैः नर वर श्रेष्ठ दातारम् अभिकांक्षते
transliteration: rājā daśaratho rājan kṛta kautuka mangalaiḥ
putraiḥ nara vara śreṣṭha dātāram abhikāṃkṣate
english: King Dasaratha, O foremost of sovereigns, that chief among the best of men-accompanied with his son, who have performed all the rites relative to their nuptials, stay the orders of the bestower (of the bride); for the meeting of the giver and the receiver is indispensable to every transaction (of this nature). Do you therefore maintain your merit by accomplishing this excellent nuptial ceremony.

sanskrit: दातृ प्रतिग्रहीतृभ्याम् सर्व अर्थाः संभवन्ति हि
transliteration: dātṛ pratigrahītṛbhyām sarva arthāḥ saṃbhavanti hi
english: King Dasaratha, O foremost of sovereigns, that chief among the best of men-accompanied with his son, who have performed all the rites relative to their nuptials, stay the orders of the bestower (of the bride); for the meeting of the giver and the receiver is indispensable to every transaction (of this nature). Do you therefore maintain your merit by accomplishing this excellent nuptial ceremony.

sanskrit: इति उक्तः परम उदारो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना
transliteration: iti uktaḥ parama udāro vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā
english: Thus addressed by the high-souled Vasistha, that exceedingly generous and energetic one versed in morality answered, saying,

sanskrit: कः स्थितः प्रतिहारो मे कस्य आज्ञा संप्रतीक्ष्यते
स्व गृहे को विचारो अस्ति यथा राज्यम् इदम् तव
transliteration: kaḥ sthitaḥ pratihāro me kasya ājñā saṃpratīkṣyate
sva gṛhe ko vicāro asti yathā rājyam idam tava
english: Who act as my warder there? And whose commands does he stay? And what need of exercising judgement in such a matter? As this kingdom is mine, so it is verily your. O foremost of anchorets, my daughters resembling flames of fire, having performed all the rites relative to the incoming nuptials, are at the foot of the dais; and, sitting beside the dais.

sanskrit: कृत कौतुक सर्वस्वा वेदि मूलम् उपागताः
मम कन्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ दीप्ता वह्नेः इव अर्चिषः
transliteration: kṛta kautuka sarvasvā vedi mūlam upāgatāḥ
mama kanyā muniśreṣṭha dīptā vahneḥ iva arciṣaḥ
english: Who act as my warder there? And whose commands does he stay? And what need of exercising judgement in such a matter? As this kingdom is mine, so it is verily your. O foremost of anchorets, my daughters resembling flames of fire, having performed all the rites relative to the incoming nuptials, are at the foot of the dais; and, sitting beside the dais.

sanskrit: सद्यो अहम् त्वत् प्रतीक्षो अस्मि वेद्याम् अस्याम् प्रतिषितः
अविघ्नम् कुरुताम् राजा किम् अर्थम् हि विलम्ब्यते
transliteration: sadyo aham tvat pratīkṣo asmi vedyām asyām pratiṣitaḥ
avighnam kurutām rājā kim artham hi vilambyate
english: I myself had been expecting you every moment. Do you perform everything without let. What need of delaying further?

sanskrit: तत् वाक्यम् जनकेन उक्तम् श्रुत्वा दशरथः तदा
प्रवेशयामास सुतान् सर्वान् ऋषि गणान् अपि
transliteration: tat vākyam janakena uktam śrutvā daśarathaḥ tadā
praveśayāmāsa sutān sarvān ṛṣi gaṇān api
english: Hearing those words uttered by Janaka, Dasaratha entered in together with his sons and the body of saints.

sanskrit: ततो राजा विदेहानाम् वशिष्ठम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
कारयस्व ऋषे सर्वान् ऋषिभिः सह धार्मिक
transliteration: tato rājā videhānām vaśiṣṭham idam abravīt
kārayasva ṛṣe sarvān ṛṣibhiḥ saha dhārmika
english: Then to the king of the Videhas, Vasiştha spoke as follows, O saint, do you, O pious one, in company with the saints, perform, O master, the nuptial ceremonies of Rāma charming to all.

sanskrit: रामस्य लोक रामस्य क्रियाम् वैवाहिकीम् प्रभो
तथा इति उक्त्वा तु जनकम् वशिष्टःओ भगवान् ऋषिः
transliteration: rāmasya loka rāmasya kriyām vaivāhikīm prabho
tathā iti uktvā tu janakam vaśiṣṭaḥo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ

sanskrit: प्रपा मध्ये तु विधिवत् वेदीम् कृत्वा महातपाः
transliteration: prapā madhye tu vidhivat vedīm kṛtvā mahātapāḥ

sanskrit: अलम् चकार ताम् वेदीम् गन्ध पुष्पैः समंततः
सुवर्ण पालिकाभिः च चित्र कुम्भैः च स अंकुरैः
transliteration: alam cakāra tām vedīm gandha puṣpaiḥ samaṃtataḥ
suvarṇa pālikābhiḥ ca citra kumbhaiḥ ca sa aṃkuraiḥ

sanskrit: अंकुर आढ्यैः शरावैः च धूप पात्रैः स धूपकैः
शंख पात्रैः श्रुवैः स्रुग्भिः पात्रैः अर्घ्यादि पूजितैः
transliteration: aṃkura āḍhyaiḥ śarāvaiḥ ca dhūpa pātraiḥ sa dhūpakaiḥ
śaṃkha pātraiḥ śruvaiḥ srugbhiḥ pātraiḥ arghyādi pūjitaiḥ

sanskrit: लाज पूर्णैः च पात्रीभिः रक्षितैः अपि संस्कृतैः
दर्भैः समैः समास्तीर्य विधिवत् मंत्र पुरस्कृतम्
transliteration: lāja pūrṇaiḥ ca pātrībhiḥ rakṣitaiḥ api saṃskṛtaiḥ
darbhaiḥ samaiḥ samāstīrya vidhivat maṃtra puraskṛtam

sanskrit: अग्निम् आधाय तम् वेद्याम् विधि मंत्र पूर्वकम्
transliteration: agnim ādhāya tam vedyām vidhi maṃtra pūrvakam

sanskrit: ततः सीताम् समानीय सर्व आभरण भुषिताम्
समक्षम् अग्नेः संस्थाप्य राघव अभिमुखे तदा
transliteration: tataḥ sītām samānīya sarva ābharaṇa bhuṣitām
samakṣam agneḥ saṃsthāpya rāghava abhimukhe tadā

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् जनको राजा कौसल्य आनंद वर्धनम्
इयम् सीता मम सुता सह धर्म चरी तव
transliteration: abravīt janako rājā kausalya ānaṃda vardhanam
iyam sītā mama sutā saha dharma carī tava

sanskrit: प्रतीच्छ च एनाम् भद्रम् ते पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व पाणिना
पतिव्रता महभागा छाय इव अनुगता सदा
transliteration: pratīccha ca enām bhadram te pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā
pativratā mahabhāgā chāya iva anugatā sadā

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा प्राक्षिपत् राजा मंत्र पूतम् जलम् तदा
साधु साधु इति देवानाम् ऋषीणाम् वदताम् तदा
transliteration: iti uktvā prākṣipat rājā maṃtra pūtam jalam tadā
sādhu sādhu iti devānām ṛṣīṇām vadatām tadā
english: Saying this, the king sprinkled Rāma's palm with water sanctified with mantras; with the celestials and saints exclaiming, Excellent! Excellent!

sanskrit: देव दुंदुभि निर्घोषः पुष्प वर्षम् महान् अभूत्
एवम् दत्त्वा सुताम् सीताम् मंत्र उदक पुरस्कृताम्
transliteration: deva duṃdubhi nirghoṣaḥ puṣpa varṣam mahān abhūt
evam dattvā sutām sītām maṃtra udaka puraskṛtām

sanskrit: लक्ष्मण आगच्छ भद्रम् ते ऊर्मिलाम् उद्यताम् मया
transliteration: lakṣmaṇa āgaccha bhadram te ūrmilām udyatām mayā

sanskrit: प्रतीच्छ पाणिम् गृह्णीष्व मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः
तम् एवम् उक्त्वा जनको भरतम् च अभ्यभाषत
transliteration: pratīccha pāṇim gṛhṇīṣva mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
tam evam uktvā janako bharatam ca abhyabhāṣata

sanskrit: शत्रुघ्नम् च अपि धर्माअत्मा अब्रवीत् मिथिलेश्वरः
transliteration: śatrughnam ca api dharmāatmā abravīt mithileśvaraḥ

sanskrit: सर्वे भवन्तः सौम्याः च सर्वे सुचरित व्रताः
transliteration: sarve bhavantaḥ saumyāḥ ca sarve sucarita vratāḥ
english: The righteous lord of Mithila spoke also to Satrughna, saying, Do you, O you of mighty arms, take Śrutakīrti's hand by your own. May you all be good, and vowed to excellent life! And be, you Kākutsthas, you united with your wives. Let there be no delay about it.

sanskrit: पत्नीभिः सन्तु काकुत्स्था मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः
जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पाणीन् पाणिभिः अस्पृशन्
transliteration: patnībhiḥ santu kākutsthā mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā pāṇīn pāṇibhiḥ aspṛśan

sanskrit: चत्वारः ते चतसॄणाम् वसिष्ठस्य मते स्थिताः
अग्निम् प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा वेदिम् राजानम् एव च
transliteration: catvāraḥ te catasṝṇām vasiṣṭhasya mate sthitāḥ
agnim pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā vedim rājānam eva ca

sanskrit: ऋषीन् चैव महात्मानः सह भार्या रघु उद्वहाः
यथा उक्तेन तथा चक्रुः विवाहम् विधि पूर्वकम्
transliteration: ṛṣīn caiva mahātmānaḥ saha bhāryā raghu udvahāḥ
yathā uktena tathā cakruḥ vivāham vidhi pūrvakam

sanskrit: यद्वा -पुष्प वृष्टिः महति आसीत् अंतरिक्षात् सु भास्वरा
दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषैः गीत वादित्र निःस्वनैः
transliteration: yadvā -puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ mahati āsīt aṃtarikṣāt su bhāsvarā
divya dundubhi nirghoṣaiḥ gīta vāditra niḥsvanaiḥ

sanskrit: ननृतुः च अप्सरः संघा गन्धर्वाः च जगुः कलम्
विवाहे रघु मुख्यानाम् तद् अद्भुतम् अदृश्यत
transliteration: nanṛtuḥ ca apsaraḥ saṃghā gandharvāḥ ca jaguḥ kalam
vivāhe raghu mukhyānām tad adbhutam adṛśyata
english: There was a mighty shower of shining blossoms from the firmament accompanied with the sounds of celestial kettle-drums, and choiring and instrumental music. And the Apsaras, danced and the Gandharvas sang melodiously, at the bridal of the foremost of the Raghus. And this seemed wonderful to witness.

sanskrit: ईदृशे वर्तमाने तु तूर्य उद्घुष्ट निनादिते
त्रिः अग्निम् ते परिक्रम्य ऊहुः भार्या महौजसः
transliteration: īdṛśe vartamāne tu tūrya udghuṣṭa ninādite
triḥ agnim te parikramya ūhuḥ bhāryā mahaujasaḥ
english: To the blowing of trumpets, those exceedingly puissant ones, thrice going round the fire, in company with their wives went the encampment.

sanskrit: अथ उपकार्याम् जग्मुः ते स दारा रघुनंदनाः
राजा अपि अनुययौ पश्यन् स ऋषि संघः स बान्धवः
transliteration: atha upakāryām jagmuḥ te sa dārā raghunaṃdanāḥ
rājā api anuyayau paśyan sa ṛṣi saṃghaḥ sa bāndhavaḥ
english: to The king, having seen that all the auspicious ceremonies were performed, went in their wake accompanied by the sages and his adherents.

sanskrit: आपृष्ट्वा तौ च राजानौ जगाम उत्तर पर्वतम्
transliteration: āpṛṣṭvā tau ca rājānau jagāma uttara parvatam
english: Then when the right had passed away, the mighty Muni Viśvāmitra, having greeted the monarchs, yet out for the Northern mountains.

sanskrit: विश्वामित्रो गते राजा वैदेहम् मिथिला अधिपम्
आपृष्ट्व इव जगाम आशु राजा दशरथः पुरीम्
transliteration: viśvāmitro gate rājā vaideham mithilā adhipam
āpṛṣṭva iva jagāma āśu rājā daśarathaḥ purīm
english: When Viśvāmitra had gone away, king Dasaratha, greeting Mithila's lord, Vaideha, actively prepared for setting out for his own capital.

sanskrit: अथ राजा विदेहानाम् ददौ कन्या धनम् बहु
transliteration: atha rājā videhānām dadau kanyā dhanam bahu

sanskrit: कंबलानाम् च मुख्यानाम् क्षौमान् कोटि अंबराणि च
हस्ति अश्व रथ पादातम् दिव्य रूपम् स्वलंकृतम्
transliteration: kaṃbalānām ca mukhyānām kṣaumān koṭi aṃbarāṇi ca
hasti aśva ratha pādātam divya rūpam svalaṃkṛtam

sanskrit: ददौ कन्या शतम् तासाम् दासी दासम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: dadau kanyā śatam tāsām dāsī dāsam anuttamam

sanskrit: ददौ राजा सुसंहृष्टः कन्या धनम् अनुत्तमम्
दत्त्वा बहु विधम् राजा समनुज्ञाप्य पार्थिवम्
transliteration: dadau rājā susaṃhṛṣṭaḥ kanyā dhanam anuttamam
dattvā bahu vidham rājā samanujñāpya pārthivam
english: Having given divers kinds of articles, that king, the lord of Mithila, bidding adieu to the monarch (Dasaratha), re-entered his own capital. And the master of Ayodhyā accompanied with his high-souled sons, and headed by the saints in a body, started on the journey, followed by his own army.

sanskrit: राजा अपि अयोध्या अधिपतिः सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः
transliteration: rājā api ayodhyā adhipatiḥ saha putraiḥ mahātmabhiḥ

sanskrit: ऋषीन् सर्वान् पुरस्कृत्य जगाम स बल अनुगः
गच्छंतम् तु नरव्याघ्रम् स ऋषि संघम् स राघवम्
transliteration: ṛṣīn sarvān puraskṛtya jagāma sa bala anugaḥ
gacchaṃtam tu naravyāghram sa ṛṣi saṃgham sa rāghavam

sanskrit: घोराः तु पक्षिणो वाचो व्याहरन्ति समंततः
भौमाः चैव मृगाः सर्वे गच्छन्ति स्म प्रदक्षिणम्
transliteration: ghorāḥ tu pakṣiṇo vāco vyāharanti samaṃtataḥ
bhaumāḥ caiva mṛgāḥ sarve gacchanti sma pradakṣiṇam
english: As that tiger-like one was on his way, in company with Rāghava and the saints, the fowls began to utter frightful cries all around, and the beasts on earth to stream in a Southern direction.

sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा राज शार्दूलो वसिष्ठम् पर्यपृच्छत
असौम्याः पक्षिणो घोरा मृगाः च अपि प्रदक्षिणाः
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā rāja śārdūlo vasiṣṭham paryapṛcchata
asaumyāḥ pakṣiṇo ghorā mṛgāḥ ca api pradakṣiṇāḥ
english: Beholding them, that tiger-like monarch asked Vasistha, saying, Those birds of fierce aspects emit frightful cries and beasts stream in a Southerly direction. What is this? My heart tremble and my mind is not at ease.

sanskrit: किम् इदम् हृदय उत्कम्पि मनो मम विषीदति
राज्ञो दशरथस्य एतत् श्रुत्वा वाक्यम् महान् ऋषिः
transliteration: kim idam hṛdaya utkampi mano mama viṣīdati
rājño daśarathasya etat śrutvā vākyam mahān ṛṣiḥ

sanskrit: उवाच मधुराम् वाणीम् श्रूयताम् अस्य यत् फलम्
उपस्थितम् भयम् घोरम् दिव्यम् पक्षि मुखात् च्युतम्
transliteration: uvāca madhurām vāṇīm śrūyatām asya yat phalam
upasthitam bhayam ghoram divyam pakṣi mukhāt cyutam
english: Hearing the speech of king Dasaratha, that mighty saint spoke sweetly, saying, 'These fowls of the air by their cries presage some dreadful impending evil; but these beasts betoken peace restored. Therefore do you renounce anxiety'

sanskrit: मृगाः प्रशमयन्ति एते संतापः त्यज्यताम् अयम्
तेषाम् संवदताम् तत्र वायुः प्रादुर् बभूव ह
transliteration: mṛgāḥ praśamayanti ete saṃtāpaḥ tyajyatām ayam
teṣām saṃvadatām tatra vāyuḥ prādur babhūva ha

sanskrit: कम्पयन् मेदिनीम् सर्वाम् पातयन् च महान् द्रुमान्
तमसा संवृतः सूर्यः सर्वे न वेदिषुर् दिशः
transliteration: kampayan medinīm sarvām pātayan ca mahān drumān
tamasā saṃvṛtaḥ sūryaḥ sarve na vediṣur diśaḥ
english: As they were thus conversing, there blew a strong wind; and all the earth began to speak; and the trees to topple down. And a deep gloom enveloped the sun; and no quarter could be discovered. And enveloped in ashes, that host became stupefied.

sanskrit: भस्मना च आवृतम् सर्वम् सम्मूढम् इव तत् बलम्
वसिष्ठ ऋषयः च अन्ये राजा च ससुतः तदा
transliteration: bhasmanā ca āvṛtam sarvam sammūḍham iva tat balam
vasiṣṭha ṛṣayaḥ ca anye rājā ca sasutaḥ tadā

sanskrit: स संज्ञा इव तत्र आसन् सर्वम् अन्यत् विचेतनम्
तस्मिन् तमसि घोरे तु भस्म छन्न इव सा चमूः
transliteration: sa saṃjñā iva tatra āsan sarvam anyat vicetanam
tasmin tamasi ghore tu bhasma channa iva sā camūḥ
english: At that dreadful hour, Vasiştha and the other saints and the king alone retained their senses, all else were deprived of their senses, and the army was enveloped with ashes.

sanskrit: ददर्श भीम संकाशम् जटा मण्डल धारिणम्
भार्गवम् जमदग्ने अयम् राजा राज विमर्दनम्
transliteration: dadarśa bhīma saṃkāśam jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇam
bhārgavam jamadagne ayam rājā rāja vimardanam

sanskrit: कैलासम् इव दुर्धर्षम् काल अग्निम् इव दुःसहम्
ज्वलंतम् इव तेजोभिः दुर् निरीक्ष्यम् पृथक् जनैः
transliteration: kailāsam iva durdharṣam kāla agnim iva duḥsaham
jvalaṃtam iva tejobhiḥ dur nirīkṣyam pṛthak janaiḥ

sanskrit: स्कन्धे च आसज्य परशुम् धनुः विद्युत् गण उपमम्
प्रगृह्य शरम् उग्रम् च त्रि पुर घ्नम् यथा शिवम्
transliteration: skandhe ca āsajya paraśum dhanuḥ vidyut gaṇa upamam
pragṛhya śaram ugram ca tri pura ghnam yathā śivam

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा भीम संकाशम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम्
वसिष्ठ प्रमुखा विप्रा जप होम परायणाः
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā bhīma saṃkāśam jvalaṃtam iva pāvakam
vasiṣṭha pramukhā viprā japa homa parāyaṇāḥ
english: Beholding him of dreadful appearance like to flaming fire, the Vipras headed by Viśvāmitra, engaged in reciting mantras and and offering oblations to the fire, those saints assembled together, began to converse with each other.

sanskrit: संगता मुनयः सर्वे संजजल्पुः अथो मिथः
कच्चित् पितृ वध अमर्षी क्षत्रम् न उत्सादयिष्यति
transliteration: saṃgatā munayaḥ sarve saṃjajalpuḥ atho mithaḥ
kaccit pitṛ vadha amarṣī kṣatram na utsādayiṣyati

sanskrit: पूर्वम् क्षत्र वधम् कृत्वा गत मन्युः गत ज्वरः
क्षत्रस्य उत्सादनम् भूयो न खलु अस्य चिकीर्षितम्
transliteration: pūrvam kṣatra vadham kṛtvā gata manyuḥ gata jvaraḥ
kṣatrasya utsādanam bhūyo na khalu asya cikīrṣitam
english: Is this one, enraged because of the slaughter of this sire, intent upon exterminating the Kș atriyas? Formerly, having slaughtered the Kșatriyas, he pacified his ire and mental ferment, 'therefore, the annihilate the Ksatriya once again can never be his endeavour.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा अर्घ्यम् आदाय भार्गवम् भीम दर्शनम्
ऋषयो राम राम इति मधुरम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: evam uktvā arghyam ādāya bhārgavam bhīma darśanam
ṛṣayo rāma rāma iti madhuram vākyam abruvan
english: Having said this, the saints offered Arghya to Bhrgu's son of dreadful appearance; and addressed him in soothing words, saying, 'Q Rāma! O Rāma.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य तु ताम् पूजाम् ऋषि दत्ताम् प्रतापवान्
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tām pūjām ṛṣi dattām pratāpavān
english: Accepting that homage rendered to him by the saints, that puissant one, Jamadagni's son, Rāma, addressed Rāma, the son of Dasaratha.

sanskrit: राम दाशरथे वीर वीर्यम् ते श्रूयते अद्भुतम्
धनुषो भेदनम् चैव निखिलेन मया श्रुतम्
transliteration: rāma dāśarathe vīra vīryam te śrūyate adbhutam
dhanuṣo bhedanam caiva nikhilena mayā śrutam
english: Rama, son of Dasaratha, I have, O hero, heard of your wonderful prowess; and I have also heard all about your breaking of the bow.

sanskrit: तत् अद्भुतम् अचिंत्यम् च भेदनम् धनुषः तथा
तत् श्रुत्वा अहम् अनुप्राप्तो धनुर् गृह्य अपरम् शुभम्
transliteration: tat adbhutam aciṃtyam ca bhedanam dhanuṣaḥ tathā
tat śrutvā aham anuprāpto dhanur gṛhya aparam śubham
english: Having heard of that wonderful and inconceivable breaking of the bow, I have bent my steps hither. Do you take another auspicious bow,. Do you stretch it, fix the arrow upon this mighty and dreadful bow, belonging to Jamadagni; and thus display your prowess.

sanskrit: तत् इदम् घोर संकाशम् जामदग्न्यम् महत् धनुः
पूरयस्व शरेण एव स्व बलम् दर्शयस्व च
transliteration: tat idam ghora saṃkāśam jāmadagnyam mahat dhanuḥ
pūrayasva śareṇa eva sva balam darśayasva ca
english: Having heard of that wonderful and inconceivable breaking of the bow, I have bent my steps hither. Do you take another auspicious bow,. Do you stretch it, fix the arrow upon this mighty and dreadful bow, belonging to Jamadagni; and thus display your prowess.

sanskrit: तत् अहम् ते बलम् दृष्ट्वा धनुषो अपि अस्य पूरणे
द्वंद्व युद्धम् प्रदास्यामि वीर्य श्लाघ्यम् अहम् तव
transliteration: tat aham te balam dṛṣṭvā dhanuṣo api asya pūraṇe
dvaṃdva yuddham pradāsyāmi vīrya ślāghyam aham tava
english: Then, having witnessed your might in stretching the bow, I shall offer you combat, laying under contribution our utmost strength.

sanskrit: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजा दशरथः तदा
विषण्ण वदनो दीनः प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā
viṣaṇṇa vadano dīnaḥ prāṃjaliḥ vākyam abravīt

sanskrit: क्षत्र रोषात् प्रशांतः त्वम् ब्राह्मणः च महातपाः
बालानाम् मम पुत्राणाम् अभयम् दातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: kṣatra roṣāt praśāṃtaḥ tvam brāhmaṇaḥ ca mahātapāḥ
bālānām mama putrāṇām abhayam dātum arhasi

sanskrit: भार्गवाणाम् कुले जातः स्वाध्याय व्रत शालिनाम्
सहस्राक्षे प्रतिज्ञाय शस्त्रम् प्रक्ष्द् इप्तवान् असि
transliteration: bhārgavāṇām kule jātaḥ svādhyāya vrata śālinām
sahasrākṣe pratijñāya śastram prakṣd iptavān asi

sanskrit: स त्वम् धर्म परो भूत्वा काश्यपाय वसुंधराम्
दत्त्वा वनम् उपागम्य महेन्द्र कृत केतनः
transliteration: sa tvam dharma paro bhūtvā kāśyapāya vasuṃdharām
dattvā vanam upāgamya mahendra kṛta ketanaḥ
english: Embracing a life of righteousness, you did were confer the earth upon Kaśyapa and repaired to the forest, making the Mahendra hill your home.

sanskrit: मम सर्व विनाशाय संप्राप्तः त्वम् महामुने
न च एकस्मिन् हते रामे सर्वे जीवामहे वयम्
transliteration: mama sarva vināśāya saṃprāptaḥ tvam mahāmune
na ca ekasmin hate rāme sarve jīvāmahe vayam
english: O mighty Muni, you have come here to compass the destruction of my all; but if Rāma be slain, we shall never live.

sanskrit: अनादृत्य तु तत् वाक्यम् रामम् एव अभ्यभाषत
transliteration: anādṛtya tu tat vākyam rāmam eva abhyabhāṣata
english: Thus addressed by Dasaratha, the powerful son of Jamadagni, disregarding his words, thus addressed Rāma,

sanskrit: इमे द्वे धनुषी श्रेष्ठे दिव्ये लोक अभिपूजिते
transliteration: ime dve dhanuṣī śreṣṭhe divye loka abhipūjite
english: These two foremost of bows, extraordinary, and worshipped of all the worlds, and stout, and powerful, surpassingly excellent, constructed with care by Viśvakarman.

sanskrit: त्रिपुर घ्नम् नरश्रेष्ठ भग्नम् काकुत्स्थ यत् त्वया
transliteration: tripura ghnam naraśreṣṭha bhagnam kākutstha yat tvayā
english: One of these, O foremost of men, for the destruction of Tripura, the celestials gave to Tryambaka, desirous of encounter, even that which, O Kākutstha, which you have snapped.

sanskrit: इदम् द्वितीयम् दुर्धर्षम् विष्णोर् दत्तम् सुरोत्तमैः
तत् इदम् वैष्णवम् राम धनुः पर पुरम् जयम्
transliteration: idam dvitīyam durdharṣam viṣṇor dattam surottamaiḥ
tat idam vaiṣṇavam rāma dhanuḥ para puram jayam
english: This second, which is irrepressible, was given to Vişnu, by the chiefs of the celestials. And, O Rāma, this bow belonging to Vişnu, is capable of conquering hostile cities.

sanskrit: समान सारम् काकुत्स्थ रौद्रेण धनुषा तु इदम्
तदा तु देवताः सर्वाः पृच्छन्ति स्म पितामहम्
transliteration: samāna sāram kākutstha raudreṇa dhanuṣā tu idam
tadā tu devatāḥ sarvāḥ pṛcchanti sma pitāmaham
english: O Kākutstha, equal in energy to the bow belonging to Rudra. Once on a time the deities, with the object of ascertaining the respective prowess of Visnu and the blue-throated one, asked the great-father, foremost of those abiding by truth, reading the intention of the deities, fomented a quarrel between them.

sanskrit: शिति कण्ठस्य विष्णोः च बल अबल निरीक्षया
transliteration: śiti kaṇṭhasya viṣṇoḥ ca bala abala nirīkṣayā

sanskrit: विरोधे तु महत् युद्धम् अभवत् रोम हर्षणम्
transliteration: virodhe tu mahat yuddham abhavat roma harṣaṇam

sanskrit: शिति कण्ठस्य विष्णोः च परस्पर जय एषिणोः
तदा तु जृम्भितम् शैवम् धनुः भीम पराक्रमम्
transliteration: śiti kaṇṭhasya viṣṇoḥ ca paraspara jaya eṣiṇoḥ
tadā tu jṛmbhitam śaivam dhanuḥ bhīma parākramam

sanskrit: हुम् कारेण महादेवः स्तम्भितो अथ त्रिलोचनः
देवैः तदा समागम्य स ऋषि सन्घैः स चारणैः
transliteration: hum kāreṇa mahādevaḥ stambhito atha trilocanaḥ
devaiḥ tadā samāgamya sa ṛṣi sanghaiḥ sa cāraṇaiḥ

sanskrit: याचितौ प्रशमम् तत्र जग्मतुः तौ सुर उत्तमौ
जृम्भितम् तत् धनुः दृष्ट्वा शैवम् विष्णु पराक्रमैः
transliteration: yācitau praśamam tatra jagmatuḥ tau sura uttamau
jṛmbhitam tat dhanuḥ dṛṣṭvā śaivam viṣṇu parākramaiḥ

sanskrit: अधिकम् मेनिरे विष्णुम् देवाः स ऋषि गणाः तदा
धनू रुद्रः तु संक्रुद्धो विदेहेषु महायशाः
transliteration: adhikam menire viṣṇum devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ tadā
dhanū rudraḥ tu saṃkruddho videheṣu mahāyaśāḥ

sanskrit: देवरातस्य राज ऋषेः ददौ हस्ते स सायकम्
इदम् च वैष्णवम् राम धनुः पर पुरम् जयम्
transliteration: devarātasya rāja ṛṣeḥ dadau haste sa sāyakam
idam ca vaiṣṇavam rāma dhanuḥ para puram jayam

sanskrit: ऋचीके भार्गवे प्रादात् विष्णुः स न्यासम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: ṛcīke bhārgave prādāt viṣṇuḥ sa nyāsam uttamam

sanskrit: पितुः मम ददौ दिव्यम् जमदग्नेः महात्मनः
न्यस्त शस्त्रे पितरि मे तपो बल समन्विते
transliteration: pituḥ mama dadau divyam jamadagneḥ mahātmanaḥ
nyasta śastre pitari me tapo bala samanvite

sanskrit: अर्जुनो विदधे मृत्युम् प्राकृताम् बुद्धिम् आस्थितः
वधम् अप्रतिरूपम् तु पितुः श्रुत्वा सु दारुणम्
क्षत्रम् उत्सादयन् रोषात् जातम् जातम् अनेकशः
transliteration: arjuno vidadhe mṛtyum prākṛtām buddhim āsthitaḥ
vadham apratirūpam tu pituḥ śrutvā su dāruṇam
kṣatram utsādayan roṣāt jātam jātam anekaśaḥ

sanskrit: पृथिवीम् च अखिलाम् प्राप्य काश्यपाय महात्मने
यज्ञस्य अन्ते तदा राम दक्षिणाम् पुण्य कर्मणे
transliteration: pṛthivīm ca akhilām prāpya kāśyapāya mahātmane
yajñasya ante tadā rāma dakṣiṇām puṇya karmaṇe
english: Thereupon, learning of the lamentable and untoward slaughter of my sire, I from ire, annihilated the Kșatryas, springing up afresh by numbers, then bringing under sway the whole earth, I, O Rāma, on the sacrifice being over, conferred it upon the righteous Kasyapa as Daksina.

sanskrit: दत्त्वा महेन्द्र निलयः तपो बल समन्वितः
श्रुत्वा तु धनुषो भेदम् ततो अहम् द्रुतम् आगतः
transliteration: dattvā mahendra nilayaḥ tapo bala samanvitaḥ
śrutvā tu dhanuṣo bhedam tato aham drutam āgataḥ
english: Having made this gift, I was dwelling in the Mahendra hill equipped with ascetic energy, when, hearing of your snapping of the bow, I have speedily come hither.

sanskrit: तत् एवम् वैष्णवम् राम पितृ पैतामहम् महत्
क्षत्र धर्मम् पुरस् कृत्य गृह्णीष्व धनुर् उत्तमम्
transliteration: tat evam vaiṣṇavam rāma pitṛ paitāmaham mahat
kṣatra dharmam puras kṛtya gṛhṇīṣva dhanur uttamam
english: Do you now, O Rāma, agreeably to the cannon of the Kșatrya morality, take this excellent and mighty bow of Vişņu, that had belonged to my father and grand father. And do you set upon this best of bows an arrow capable of conquering hostile cities. And, O Kākutstha, if you succeed, I shall then offer you combat.-28

sanskrit: योजयस्व धनुः श्रेष्ठे शरम् पर पुरम् जयम्
यदि शक्तः असि काकुत्स्थ द्वन्द्वम् दास्यामि ते ततः
transliteration: yojayasva dhanuḥ śreṣṭhe śaram para puram jayam
yadi śaktaḥ asi kākutstha dvandvam dāsyāmi te tataḥ
english: Do you now, O Rāma, agreeably to the cannon of the Kșatrya morality, take this excellent and mighty bow of Vişņu, that had belonged to my father and grand father. And do you set upon this best of bows an arrow capable of conquering hostile cities. And, O Kākutstha, if you succeed, I shall then offer you combat.-28

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तत् जामदग्न्यस्य वाक्यम् दाशरथिः तदा
गौरवात् यंत्रित कथः पितू रामम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: śrutvā tat jāmadagnyasya vākyam dāśarathiḥ tadā
gauravāt yaṃtrita kathaḥ pitū rāmam atha abravīt
english: Hearing Jamadagni's, words, the son of Dasaratha, in consideration of the presence of his father, said these words in subdued tone,

sanskrit: कृतवान् अस्मि यत् कर्म श्रुतवान् असि भार्गव
transliteration: kṛtavān asmi yat karma śrutavān asi bhārgava
english: O Bhrgu's son, I have heard of the deeds you have performed, resolved on avenging your sire. O Brāhmaṇa, I acknowledge that.

sanskrit: वीर्य हीनम् इव अशक्तम् क्षत्र धर्मेण भार्गव
अवजानासि मे तेजः पश्य मे अद्य पराक्रमम्
transliteration: vīrya hīnam iva aśaktam kṣatra dharmeṇa bhārgava
avajānāsi me tejaḥ paśya me adya parākramam
english: But, O Bhargava, you insulted me abiding by the Kșatriya duties, as pusillaniinous or devoid of prowess. Do you to-day witness my energy and vigour.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा राघवः क्रुद्धो भार्गवस्य वर आयुधम्
शरम् च प्रतिजग्राह हस्तात् लघु पराक्रमः
transliteration: iti uktvā rāghavaḥ kruddho bhārgavasya vara āyudham
śaram ca pratijagrāha hastāt laghu parākramaḥ
english: Saying this, the enraged Rāghava, endowed with fleet vigour, took up Bhrgu's noble bow, together with the shaft.

sanskrit: आरोप्य स धनू रामः शरम् सज्यम् चकार ह
जामदग्न्यम् ततो रामम् रामः क्रुद्धो अब्रवीत् इदम्
transliteration: āropya sa dhanū rāmaḥ śaram sajyam cakāra ha
jāmadagnyam tato rāmam rāmaḥ kruddho abravīt idam
english: And fixing the string upon it he set the arrow. And then Rāma enraged addressed Jamadagni's son, Rāma, saying,

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणो असि इति पूज्यो मे विश्वामित्र कृतेन च
तस्मात् शक्तो न ते राम मोक्तुम् प्राण हरम् शरम्
transliteration: brāhmaṇo asi iti pūjyo me viśvāmitra kṛtena ca
tasmāt śakto na te rāma moktum prāṇa haram śaram
english: You are a Brāhmana and through Viśvāmitra, art worthy of my homage. Therefore it is, o Rāma, that I can not let go this life-destroying shaft.

sanskrit: इमाम् वा त्वत् गतिम् राम तपो बल समार्जितान्
लोकान् अप्रतिमान् वा अपि हनिष्यामि यत् इच्छसि
transliteration: imām vā tvat gatim rāma tapo bala samārjitān
lokān apratimān vā api haniṣyāmi yat icchasi
english: Which of these shall I reduce to aught, O Rama, Your aerial course, or the merit you have attained through your asceticism of ascending to certain incomparable regions. This wonderful arrow of ours sprung from Vişnu, capable of conquering hostile towns, never hit fruitless, with energy destroying the pride of prowess of foes.

sanskrit: न हि अयम् वैष्णवो दिव्यः शरः पर पुरंजयः
मोघः पतति वीर्येण बल दर्प विनाशनः
transliteration: na hi ayam vaiṣṇavo divyaḥ śaraḥ para puraṃjayaḥ
moghaḥ patati vīryeṇa bala darpa vināśanaḥ
english: Which of these shall I reduce to aught, O Rama, Your aerial course, or the merit you have attained through your asceticism of ascending to certain incomparable regions. This wonderful arrow of ours sprung from Vişnu, capable of conquering hostile towns, never hit fruitless, with energy destroying the pride of prowess of foes.

sanskrit: वर आयुध धरम् रामम् द्रष्टुम् स ऋषि गणाः सुराः
transliteration: vara āyudha dharam rāmam draṣṭum sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ surāḥ
english: And with the object of beholding Rāma holding that foremost of weapons, there assembled in a body the celestials and the saints, with the great-father at their head.

sanskrit: गंधर्व अप्सरसः चैव सिद्ध चारण किन्नराः
यक्ष राक्षस नागाः च तत् द्रष्टुम् महत् अद्भुतम्
transliteration: gaṃdharva apsarasaḥ caiva siddha cāraṇa kinnarāḥ
yakṣa rākṣasa nāgāḥ ca tat draṣṭum mahat adbhutam
english: The Gandharvas and the Apsara and the Siddhas and the Cāraņas and the Kinnaras and the Yakşas and the Rākşasas and the Nagas assembled to behold that mighty wonder.

sanskrit: जडी कृते तदा लोके रामे वर धनुर् धरे
निर्वीर्यो जामदग्न्यो असौ रमो रामम् उदैक्षत
transliteration: jaḍī kṛte tadā loke rāme vara dhanur dhare
nirvīryo jāmadagnyo asau ramo rāmam udaikṣata
english: And on Bhārgava's energy having been observed by Rāma bearing that best of bows, Jamadagni's son became bereft of prowess, and Rāma (Parasurāma) kept steadily eyeing Răma.

sanskrit: तेजोभिः हत वीर्यत्वात् जामदग्न्यो जडी कृतः
रामम् कमल पत्र अक्षम् मन्दम् मन्दम् उवाच ह
transliteration: tejobhiḥ hata vīryatvāt jāmadagnyo jaḍī kṛtaḥ
rāmam kamala patra akṣam mandam mandam uvāca ha
english: And rendered inert in consequence of his energy having been dispelled by Rāma's own, Jamadagna mildly addressed Rāma of eyes like lotus' petals, saying,

sanskrit: काश्यपाय मया दत्ता यदा पूर्वम् वसुंधरा
विषये मे न वस्तव्यम् इति माम् काश्यपो अब्रवीत्
transliteration: kāśyapāya mayā dattā yadā pūrvam vasuṃdharā
viṣaye me na vastavyam iti mām kāśyapo abravīt
english: When formerly I gave away the earth to Kasyapas, he said to me, You must no longer stay in my dominions.

sanskrit: सो अहम् गुरु वचः कुर्वन् पृथिव्याम् न वसे निशाम्
तदा प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ कृता मे काश्यपस्य ह
transliteration: so aham guru vacaḥ kurvan pṛthivyām na vase niśām
tadā prabhṛti kākutstha kṛtā me kāśyapasya ha
english: In consonance with the words of my spiritual guide, ever since that time I have never spent three nights together on earth. Even this had been promised by me, O Kākutstha.

sanskrit: तम् इमाम् मत् गतिम् वीर हन्तुम् न अर्हसि राघव
मनो जवम् गमिष्यामि महेन्द्रम् पर्वत उत्तमम्
transliteration: tam imām mat gatim vīra hantum na arhasi rāghava
mano javam gamiṣyāmi mahendram parvata uttamam
english: Therefore, O hero, it behove you not to destroy my course, O descendant of Raghu. With the speed of the mind shall I now wend my way to the Mahendra, best of hills.

sanskrit: लोकाः तु अप्रतिमा राम निर्जिताः तपसा मया
जहि तान् शर मुख्येन मा भूत् कालस्य पर्ययः
transliteration: lokāḥ tu apratimā rāma nirjitāḥ tapasā mayā
jahi tān śara mukhyena mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
english: O Rāma, the regions I have conquered by my asceticism do you destroy with that foremost of arrows: let there be no delay about it.

sanskrit: अक्षय्यम् मधु हन्तारम् जानामि त्वाम् सुरेश्वरम्
धनुषो अस्य परामर्शात् स्वस्ति ते अस्तु परंतप
transliteration: akṣayyam madhu hantāram jānāmi tvām sureśvaram
dhanuṣo asya parāmarśāt svasti te astu paraṃtapa
english: Even from your handing of this bow I know you to be the chief of the celestials even that eternal one, the slayer of Madhu. Hail to you,

sanskrit: एते सुर गणाः सर्वे निरीक्षन्ते समागताः
transliteration: ete sura gaṇāḥ sarve nirīkṣante samāgatāḥ
english: O vanquisher of foes! And all these celestials assembled are beholding you of unparalleled deeds, and without an antagonist in fight.

sanskrit: न च इयम् तव काकुत्स्थ व्रीडा भवितुम् अर्हति
त्वया त्रैलोक्य नाथेन यत् अहम् विमुखी कृतः
transliteration: na ca iyam tava kākutstha vrīḍā bhavitum arhati
tvayā trailokya nāthena yat aham vimukhī kṛtaḥ
english: And, O Kākutstha, neither ought I to be ashamed (because of this discomfiture); I have been baffled by the lord himself of the three worlds.

sanskrit: शरम् अप्रतिमम् राम मोक्तुम् अर्हसि सु व्रत
transliteration: śaram apratimam rāma moktum arhasi su vrata
english: And it behove, O Rāma to disengage this peerless shaft (from the bow), O you of noble vows; and on your shooting the shaft. I shall repair to that fore most of mountains, the Mahendra.

sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवति रामे तु जामदग्न्ये प्रतापवान्
रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् चिक्षेप शरम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: tathā bruvati rāme tu jāmadagnye pratāpavān
rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmān cikṣepa śaram uttamam
english: When Jamadagni's son, Rāma, had said this, the puissant and graceful son of Daśaratha, had said this, the puissant and graceful son of Dasaratha shot that excellent arrow.

sanskrit: स हतान् दृश्य रामेण स्वान् लोकान् तपसा आर्जितान्
transliteration: sa hatān dṛśya rāmeṇa svān lokān tapasā ārjitān
english: And witnessing the destruction by Rāma of his regions earned by his own austerities, Jamadagni's son speedily started for that best of mountains, the Mahendra.

sanskrit: ततो वि तिमिराः सर्वा दिशा च उपदिशः तथा
सुराः स ऋषि गणाः रामम् प्रशशंसुः उदायुधम्
transliteration: tato vi timirāḥ sarvā diśā ca upadiśaḥ tathā
surāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ rāmam praśaśaṃsuḥ udāyudham
english: Then all the quarters became cleared of gloom; and the celestials and saints fell to extol Rāma when he had shot the arrow.

sanskrit: रामम् दाशरथिम् रामो जामदग्न्यः प्रशस्य च
ततः प्रदक्षिणी कृत्य जगाम आत्म गतिम् प्रभुः
transliteration: rāmam dāśarathim rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ praśasya ca
tataḥ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya jagāma ātma gatim prabhuḥ
english: And that lord, Jamadagni's son Rama, having gone round Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, and honoured (by all), set out (for his own quarters).

sanskrit: गते रामे प्रशांत आत्मा रामो दाशरथिः धनुः
transliteration: gate rāme praśāṃta ātmā rāmo dāśarathiḥ dhanuḥ
english: When Rāma had departed, Dasaratha's son the illustrious Rāma, of serene soul, made over the bow to the hands of Varuna of immeasurable strength.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य ततो रामो वसिष्ठ प्रमुखान् ऋषीन्
transliteration: abhivādya tato rāmo vasiṣṭha pramukhān ṛṣīn
english: Then saluting the saints headed by Vasiștha, Rāma, the descendant of Raghu, seeing his son stupefied, addressed him, saying,

sanskrit: जामदग्न्यो गतो रामः प्रयातु चतुर् अन्गिणी
अयोध्या अभिमुखी सेना त्वया नाथेन पालिता
transliteration: jāmadagnyo gato rāmaḥ prayātu catur angiṇī
ayodhyā abhimukhī senā tvayā nāthena pālitā
english: Now that Jamadagni's son has gone away, let the fourfold forces maintained by you as their lord, march in the direction of Ayodhyā.

sanskrit: रामस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा राजा दशरथः सुतम्
transliteration: rāmasya vacanam śrutvā rājā daśarathaḥ sutam
english: Hearing Rama's words, king Dasaratha embraced his son with his arms, and smelt Rāghava's crown; and hearing that Rāma had gone, the monarch became exceedingly delighted, and considered himself and his son as having attained a second birth.

sanskrit: गतो राम इति श्रुत्वा हृष्टः प्रमुदितो नृपः
पुनर्जातम् तदा मेने पुत्रम् आत्मानम् एव च
transliteration: gato rāma iti śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ pramudito nṛpaḥ
punarjātam tadā mene putram ātmānam eva ca
english: Hearing Rama's words, king Dasaratha embraced his son with his arms, and smelt Rāghava's crown; and hearing that Rāma had gone, the monarch became exceedingly delighted, and considered himself and his son as having attained a second birth.

sanskrit: चोदयामास ताम् सेनाम् जगाम आशु ततः पुरीम्
पताका ध्वजिनीम् रम्याम् तूर्य उद् घुष्ट निनादिताम्
transliteration: codayāmāsa tām senām jagāma āśu tataḥ purīm
patākā dhvajinīm ramyām tūrya ud ghuṣṭa nināditām

sanskrit: सिक्त राज पथा रम्याम् प्रकीर्ण कुसुम उत्कराम्
राज प्रवेश सुमुखैः पौरैः मंगल पाणिभिः
transliteration: sikta rāja pathā ramyām prakīrṇa kusuma utkarām
rāja praveśa sumukhaiḥ pauraiḥ maṃgala pāṇibhiḥ

sanskrit: सम्पूर्णाम् प्राविशत् राजा जन ओघैः समलम्कृताम्
पौरैः प्रति उद्गतो दूरम् द्विजैः च पुर वासिभिः
transliteration: sampūrṇām prāviśat rājā jana oghaiḥ samalamkṛtām
pauraiḥ prati udgato dūram dvijaiḥ ca pura vāsibhiḥ

sanskrit: पुत्रैः अनुगतः श्रीमान् श्रीमद्भिः च महायशाः
प्रविवेश गृहम् राजा हिमवत् सदृशम् प्रियम्
transliteration: putraiḥ anugataḥ śrīmān śrīmadbhiḥ ca mahāyaśāḥ
praviveśa gṛham rājā himavat sadṛśam priyam

sanskrit: ननन्द स्वजनैः राजा गृहे कामैः सुपूजितः
कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च सुमध्यमा
transliteration: nananda svajanaiḥ rājā gṛhe kāmaiḥ supūjitaḥ
kausalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca sumadhyamā
english: And entertained by his own relatives with all objects of enjoyment, the monarch rejoiced exceedingly. And Kausalya and Sumitră and the slender waisted Kaikeyi, together with other wives of the king, were busy, receiving the brides, with the necessary ceremonies.

sanskrit: वधू प्रतिग्रहे युक्ता याः च अन्या राज योषितः
ततः सीताम् महाभागाम् ऊर्मिलाम् च यशस्विनीम्
transliteration: vadhū pratigrahe yuktā yāḥ ca anyā rāja yoṣitaḥ
tataḥ sītām mahābhāgām ūrmilām ca yaśasvinīm

sanskrit: कुशध्वज सुते च उभे जगृहुः नृप योषितः
मंगल आलापनैः होमैः शोभिताः क्षौम वाससः
transliteration: kuśadhvaja sute ca ubhe jagṛhuḥ nṛpa yoṣitaḥ
maṃgala ālāpanaiḥ homaiḥ śobhitāḥ kṣauma vāsasaḥ

sanskrit: देवत आयतनानि आशु सर्वाः ताः प्रत्यपूजयन्
अभिवाद्य अभिवाद्यान् च सर्वा राज सुताः तदा
transliteration: devata āyatanāni āśu sarvāḥ tāḥ pratyapūjayan
abhivādya abhivādyān ca sarvā rāja sutāḥ tadā

sanskrit: रेमिरे मुदिताः सर्वा भर्तृभिः सहिता रहः
कृत दाराः कृत अस्त्राः च स धनाः स सुहृत् जनाः
transliteration: remire muditāḥ sarvā bhartṛbhiḥ sahitā rahaḥ
kṛta dārāḥ kṛta astrāḥ ca sa dhanāḥ sa suhṛt janāḥ

sanskrit: कस्यचित् अथ कालस्य राजा दशरधः सुतम्
transliteration: kasyacit atha kālasya rājā daśaradhaḥ sutam

sanskrit: अयम् केकय राजस्य पुत्रो वसति पुत्रक
transliteration: ayam kekaya rājasya putro vasati putraka

sanskrit: त्वाम् नेतुम् आगतो वीरो युधाजित् मातुलः तव
श्रुत्वा दशरथस्य एतत् भरतः कैकेयि सुतः
transliteration: tvām netum āgato vīro yudhājit mātulaḥ tava
śrutvā daśarathasya etat bharataḥ kaikeyi sutaḥ

sanskrit: आपृच्छ्य पितरम् शूरो रामम् च अक्लिष्ट कर्मणम्
transliteration: āpṛcchya pitaram śūro rāmam ca akliṣṭa karmaṇam

sanskrit: मातॄः च अपि नरश्रेष्ट शत्रुघ्न सहितो ययौ
युधाजित् प्राप्य भरतम् स शत्रुघ्नम् प्रहर्षितः
transliteration: mātṝḥ ca api naraśreṣṭa śatrughna sahito yayau
yudhājit prāpya bharatam sa śatrughnam praharṣitaḥ

sanskrit: स्व पुरम् प्रविवेशत् वीरः पिता तस्य तुतोष ह
गते च भरते रामो लक्ष्मणः च महाबलः
transliteration: sva puram praviveśat vīraḥ pitā tasya tutoṣa ha
gate ca bharate rāmo lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahābalaḥ

sanskrit: पितुः आज्ञाम् पुरस्कृत्य पौर कार्याणि सर्वशः
transliteration: pituḥ ājñām puraskṛtya paura kāryāṇi sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: चकार रामः सर्वाणि प्रियाणि च हितानि च
मातृभ्यो मातृ कार्याणि कृत्वा परम यंत्रितः
transliteration: cakāra rāmaḥ sarvāṇi priyāṇi ca hitāni ca
mātṛbhyo mātṛ kāryāṇi kṛtvā parama yaṃtritaḥ

sanskrit: गुरूणाम् गुरु कार्याणि काले काले अन्ववैक्षत
एवम् दशरथः प्रीतो ब्राह्मणा नैगमाः तथा
transliteration: gurūṇām guru kāryāṇi kāle kāle anvavaikṣata
evam daśarathaḥ prīto brāhmaṇā naigamāḥ tathā

sanskrit: रामस्य शील वृत्तेन सर्वम् विषय वासिनः
तेषाम् अति यशा लोके रामः सत्य पराक्रमः
transliteration: rāmasya śīla vṛttena sarvam viṣaya vāsinaḥ
teṣām ati yaśā loke rāmaḥ satya parākramaḥ

sanskrit: रामः च सीतया सार्धम् विजहार बहून् ऋतून्
transliteration: rāmaḥ ca sītayā sārdham vijahāra bahūn ṛtūn

sanskrit: मनस्वी तद् गतमानस्य तस्या हृदि समर्पितः
प्रिया तु सीता रामस्य दाराः पितृ कृता इति
transliteration: manasvī tad gatamānasya tasyā hṛdi samarpitaḥ
priyā tu sītā rāmasya dārāḥ pitṛ kṛtā iti

sanskrit: गुणात् रूप गुणात् च अपि प्रीतिः भूयो अभिवर्धते
तस्याः च भर्ता द्विगुणम् हृदये परिवर्तते
transliteration: guṇāt rūpa guṇāt ca api prītiḥ bhūyo abhivardhate
tasyāḥ ca bhartā dviguṇam hṛdaye parivartate
english: Rāma's beloved Sītā, as having been bestowed upon him by his sire, by her loveliness, and her perfections as much as by her loveliness, went on enhancing his joy. And her lord came to exercise a double influence on her heart.

sanskrit: अन्तर् गतम् अपि व्यक्तम् आख्याति हृदयम् हृदा
तस्य भूयो विशेषेण मैथिली जनक आत्मजा
देवताभिः समा रूपे सीता श्रीः इव रूपिणी
transliteration: antar gatam api vyaktam ākhyāti hṛdayam hṛdā
tasya bhūyo viśeṣeṇa maithilī janaka ātmajā
devatābhiḥ samā rūpe sītā śrīḥ iva rūpiṇī
english: And by her own heart, the daughter of Janaka, Mithila's lord, resembling a goddess in grace, and like to Śrī (goddess of wealth) herself in loveliness, completely read his inmost sentiments.

sanskrit: तया स राज ऋषि सुतो अभिकामयासमेयिवान् उत्तम राज कन्यया
अतीव रामः शुशुभे मुदा अन्वितोविभुः श्रिया विष्णुः इव अमर ईश्वरः
transliteration: tayā sa rāja ṛṣi suto abhikāmayāsameyivān uttama rāja kanyayā
atīva rāmaḥ śuśubhe mudā anvitovibhuḥ śriyā viṣṇuḥ iva amara īśvaraḥ
english: And experiencing delight, Rama, receiving the Rājarși's daughter, exercising her own will the excellent princess-looked graceful, even like the lord Vişņu the chief of celestials on being joined with Śrī. BĀLAKĀŅDA
When Bharata set out for the home of his maternal uncle, he affectionately took with him the sinless Satrughna ever repressing his passions.
And there he abode with his brother, being ministered to in very respect and tended by his maternal uncle, Aśvapati, with all the fondness of a father (with the fondness shown to a son).

sanskrit: तत्रापि निवसन्तौ तौ तर्प्यमाणौ च कामतः
भ्रातरौ स्मरतां वीरौ वृद्धं दसरथं नृपम्
transliteration: tatrāpi nivasantau tau tarpyamāṇau ca kāmataḥ
bhrātarau smaratāṃ vīrau vṛddhaṃ dasarathaṃ nṛpam
english: Albeit thus staying, with every ministration extended towards them as much as they could wish, yet those heroic brothers failed not to remember the aged king Daſaratha.

sanskrit: राजापि तौ महातेजाः सस्मार प्रोषितौ सुतौ
transliteration: rājāpi tau mahātejāḥ sasmāra proṣitau sutau
english: And the puissant king also on his pare remembered his sons away from home, Bharata and Śatrughna, resembling the mighty Indra and Varuna.

sanskrit: सर्व एव तु तस्येष्ट श्चत्वारः पुरुषर्षभाः
transliteration: sarva eva tu tasyeṣṭa ścatvāraḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ
english: All those four chiefs of men were dear to him even as four hands issuing from his own body.
Yet among them all, that highly energetic. Rāma was the favourite of his sire. He was the foremost of in every virtue, like to Svayambhu's (Brahmā) self in the esteem of creation.

sanskrit: स हि देवै रुदीर्णस्य रावणस्य वधार्थिभिः
अर्थितो मानुषे लोके जज्ञे विष्णुः सनातनः
transliteration: sa hi devai rudīrṇasya rāvaṇasya vadhārthibhiḥ
arthito mānuṣe loke jajñe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
english: Solicited by the celestials wishing for the destruction of Rāvana, he, who is the eternal Vis ņu, was born as Rāma in the world of men.
And with that son of immeasurable energy, Kausalya looked graceful, even as Aditi, with that foremost of the celestials, the wielder of the thunder-bolt.

He was furnished with grace, and possessed of prowess; and he did not seek for defects in others in the midst of virtues. That son of Kausalyā and incomparable on earth and in worth fully equal to Daśaratha him self.

sanskrit: स च नित्यं प्रशान्तात्मा मृदुपूर्वं तु भाषते
transliteration: sa ca nityaṃ praśāntātmā mṛdupūrvaṃ tu bhāṣate
english: He was aye of quiescent soul; and always precluded his speech with an amiable phrase; and although he might be addressed in a harsh manner, yet he returned no corresponding reply.
He was gratified even with a solitary instance of benefit; and from freedom of soul did not remember an hundred injuries.
In the intervals of martial exercises, he always discoursed with persons of character, or wise men, or the aged, or the virtuous.

sanskrit: वीर्यवान्न च वीर्येण महता स्वेन विस्मितः
transliteration: vīryavānna ca vīryeṇa mahatā svena vismitaḥ
english: He was intelligent, and sweet-speeched, and spoke first (to visitors) and used grateful words, and was possessed of prowess, withal not proud of his mighty native virtue.
He never spoke untruths; and he was learned; and he rendered homage to the aged. He felt kindly towards the subjects; and the subjects on their pare held him in dear regard.

He was kind to the poor; and he had conquered his anger; and he regarded the Brāhmaṇas; and he commiserated the wretched; and was versed in morality; and always chastised the wicked; and was pure in spirit; and possessed the thoughts and sentiments of his race; and regarded highly his own Kșatriya duties; and considered that heaven was to be attained through the glory acquired by performing them.

He was kind to the poor; and he had conquered his anger; and he regarded the Brāhmaṇas; and he commiserated the wretched; and was versed in morality; and always chastised the wicked; and was pure in spirit; and possessed the thoughts and sentiments of his race; and regarded highly his own Kșatriya duties; and considered that heaven was to be attained through the glory acquired by performing them.
He was never engaged in forbidden piactises; and never relished improper talk; and argued in chain even like the lord of speech himself.
And he was free from ailments, and of young years; and endued with eloquence; and of an excellent person; and versed in season and place; and discerned character, the one honest person ever created.

sanskrit: बहिश्चर इव प्राणो बभूव गुणतः प्रियः
transliteration: bahiścara iva prāṇo babhūva guṇataḥ priyaḥ
english: Endowed with supreme excellence that son or the monarch was by virtue of his merit dear to the subjects like their life ranging externally.

sanskrit: इष्वस्त्रे च पितुः श्रेष्ठो बभूव भरताग्रजः
transliteration: iṣvastre ca pituḥ śreṣṭho babhūva bharatāgrajaḥ
english: He had performed his ablutions after having mastered all learning; and was properly versed in the Vedas with their branches. In all weapons either inspired with mantras or otherwise Bharata's eldest brother was superior even to his father.
And he was the spring of all good; and was saintly; and of undisturbed soul; and truthtelling; and candid; and humble towards the aged twice-born ones cognisant of virtue and interest.
He was cognizant of virtue, profit, and interest; had an excellent memory; and was possessed of genius. He was an adept and was well versed in social usages and customs.

He was lowly; and of close counsel; and used to keep to himself his purposes; and was resourceful. Neither his pleasure nor his displeasure went for naught. He knew the season of amassing riches, and of giving them away.

And he was ardently reverential; and his wisdom never wavered; and he accepted no improper present; and he used no rough speech. He knew no idleness; and was vigilant; and had a knowledge of his own as well as of others' failings.
He was conversant with the scriptures; and was grateful; and could read the hearts of others. He had sagacity to perceive the seasons for duly showing favour or disfavour. are

He understood all about the reception of the righteous, the maintenance of family, and the occasion for chastising, evil-doers; and he was an expert in collecting dues (from the people;) and knew the manner prescribed (by the authorities) for expending money.

sanskrit: अर्थधर्मौ च संगृह्य सुखतन्त्रो न चालसः
