katham sa bhokṣyate nātho vane mūla phalāni ayam
english: How shall that Rāma live upon fruits and roots, whose servants and attendants fare on well cooked rice?

sanskrit: क एतत् श्रद्दधेत् श्रुत्वा कस्य वा न भवेद् भयम्
गुणवान् दयितः राज्ञो राघवो यद् विवास्यते
transliteration: ka etat śraddadhet śrutvā kasya vā na bhaved bhayam
guṇavān dayitaḥ rājño rāghavo yad vivāsyate
english: Who shall believe, or believing who shall not be afraid, that his highly accomplished descendant of Kākutstha, favourite of the king, is going to be exiled?

sanskrit: नूनम् तु बलवान् लोके कृतान्तः सर्वमादिशन्
transliteration: nūnam tu balavān loke kṛtāntaḥ sarvamādiśan
english: Certainly Destiny, who crowns or afflicts people with happiness or misery, is the most powerful agency in the world, or why shall you, Oh pleasing Rāma, fly as an exile to the forest?

sanskrit: त्वया विहीनाम् इह माम् शोक अग्निर् अतुलो महान्
प्रधक्ष्यति यथा कक्षम् चित्र भानुर् हिम अत्यये
transliteration: tvayā vihīnām iha mām śoka agnir atulo mahān
pradhakṣyati yathā kakṣam citra bhānur hima atyaye

sanskrit: कथम् हि धेनुः स्वम् वत्सम् गच्चन्तम् न अनुगच्चति
अहम् त्वा अनुगमिष्यामि यत्र पुत्र गमिष्यसि
transliteration: katham hi dhenuḥ svam vatsam gaccantam na anugaccati
aham tvā anugamiṣyāmi yatra putra gamiṣyasi
english: Like to a cow following its young one shall I follow you, Oh my darling, wherever shall go.

sanskrit: तथा निगदितम् मात्रा तत् वाक्यम् पुरुष Rषभः
श्रुत्वा रामः अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् मातरम् भृश दुह्खिताम्
कैकेय्या वन्चितः राजा मयि च अरण्यम् आश्रिते
भवत्या च परित्यक्तः न नूनम् वर्तयिष्यति
transliteration: tathā nigaditam mātrā tat vākyam puruṣa ṣabhaḥ
śrutvā rāmaḥ abravīd vākyam mātaram bhṛśa duhkhitām
kaikeyyā vancitaḥ rājā mayi ca araṇyam āśrite
bhavatyā ca parityaktaḥ na nūnam vartayiṣyati

sanskrit: भर्तुः किल परित्यागो नृशम्सः केवलम् स्त्रियाः
स भवत्या न कर्तव्यो मनसा अपि विगर्हितः
transliteration: bhartuḥ kila parityāgo nṛśamsaḥ kevalam striyāḥ
sa bhavatyā na kartavyo manasā api vigarhitaḥ
english: There is nothing more cruel for women than the forsaking of their husband; it does not behove you therefore, to think even of this opprobrious action.

sanskrit: यावज् जीवति काकुत्स्थः पिता मे जगती पतिः
शुश्रूषा क्रियताम् तावत् स हि धर्मः सनातनः
transliteration: yāvaj jīvati kākutsthaḥ pitā me jagatī patiḥ
śuśrūṣā kriyatām tāvat sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
english: Do you serve this descendant of Kākutstha, my father, and the lord of the earth as long as he lives, know you this to be the eternal virtue

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु रामेण कौसल्या शुभ दर्शना
तथा इति उवाच सुप्रीता रामम् अक्लिष्ट कारिणम्
transliteration: evam uktā tu rāmeṇa kausalyā śubha darśanā
tathā iti uvāca suprītā rāmam akliṣṭa kāriṇam
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, Kausalyā of auspicious looks, being gratified greatly, spoke to him, the remover of her sorrows. “Truely it is."

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु वचनम् रामः धर्मभ्Rताम् वरः
भूयः ताम् अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् मातरम् भृश दुह्खिताम्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu vacanam rāmaḥ dharmabhtām varaḥ
bhūyaḥ tām abravīd vākyam mātaram bhṛśa duhkhitām
english: Rāma, the foremost amongst religious men, being spoken thus, said to his mother, who was greatly disturbed with sorrow, again in the following strain.

sanskrit: मया चैव भवत्या च कर्तव्यम् वचनम् पितुः
राजा भर्ता गुरुः श्रेष्ठः सर्वेषाम् ईश्वरः प्रभुः
transliteration: mayā caiva bhavatyā ca kartavyam vacanam pituḥ
rājā bhartā guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarveṣām īśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
english: “Proper it is both for you and me to carry out father's words” he is your husband, and my best preceptor and the lord and master of all people.

sanskrit: इमानि तु महा अरण्ये विह्Rत्य नव पन्च च
वर्षाणि परम प्रीतः स्थास्यामि वचने तव
transliteration: imāni tu mahā araṇye vihtya nava panca ca
varṣāṇi parama prītaḥ sthāsyāmi vacane tava
english: With great pleasure shall I abide in your words after passing these nine and five years in the great forest.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता प्रियम् पुत्रम् बाष्प पूर्ण आनना तदा
उवाच परम आर्ता तु कौसल्या पुत्र वत्सला
transliteration: evam uktā priyam putram bāṣpa pūrṇa ānanā tadā
uvāca parama ārtā tu kausalyā putra vatsalā
english: Thus addressed, Kausalyā, bearing great affection for her son, sorely pained and having her eyes full of tears, spoke to her beloved son the following words.

sanskrit: आसाम् राम सपत्नीनाम् वस्तुम् मध्ये न मे क्षमम्
नय माम् अपि काकुत्स्थ वनम् वन्यम् म्Rगीम् यथा
transliteration: āsām rāma sapatnīnām vastum madhye na me kṣamam
naya mām api kākutstha vanam vanyam mgīm yathā
english: Oh Rāma, I shall not be able to live amongst these co-wives, if are you resolved to go to the forest for the discharge of your father's behest; do you take me with you, Oh Kākutstha, like to a wild hind.

sanskrit: यदि ते गमने बुद्धिः कृता पितुर् अपेक्षया
ताम् तथा रुदतीम् रामः रुदन् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: yadi te gamane buddhiḥ kṛtā pitur apekṣayā
tām tathā rudatīm rāmaḥ rudan vacanam abravīt

sanskrit: जीवन्त्या हि स्त्रिया भर्ता दैवतम् प्रभुर् एव च
भवत्या मम चैव अद्य राजा प्रभवति प्रभुः
भरतः च अपि धर्मात्मा सर्व भूत प्रियम् वदः
transliteration: jīvantyā hi striyā bhartā daivatam prabhur eva ca
bhavatyā mama caiva adya rājā prabhavati prabhuḥ
bharataḥ ca api dharmātmā sarva bhūta priyam vadaḥ
english: Rāma, suppressing his feeling, spoke to his mother who was lamenting, thus, saying:, Husband is the deity and master of the wife as long as she lives; so the monarch being the lord can deal with you and me in any way he likes.

sanskrit: भवतीम् अनुवर्तेत स हि धर्म रतः सदा
यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्र शोकेन पार्थिवः
transliteration: bhavatīm anuvarteta sa hi dharma rataḥ sadā
yathā mayi tu niṣkrānte putra śokena pārthivaḥ

sanskrit: यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवः
transliteration: yathā mayi tu niṣkrānte putraśokena pārthivaḥ
english: Do you now take care that on my retiring the monarch does not wear away by the pangs of my separation, that this terrible sorrow may not kill him. Do you look after the welfare of the old king always.

sanskrit: श्रमम् न अवाप्नुयात् किम्चित् अप्रमत्ता तथा कुरु
transliteration: śramam na avāpnuyāt kimcit apramattā tathā kuru
english: Do you now take care that on my retiring the monarch does not wear away by the pangs of my separation, that this terrible sorrow may not kill him. Do you look after the welfare of the old king always.

sanskrit: राज्ञो वृद्धस्य सततम् हितम् चर समाहिता
व्रत उपवास निरता या नारी परम उत्तमा
transliteration: rājño vṛddhasya satatam hitam cara samāhitā
vrata upavāsa niratā yā nārī parama uttamā

sanskrit: भर्तारम् न अनुवर्तेत सा च पाप गतिर् भवेत्
भर्तुः शुश्रूषया नारी लभते स्वर्गमु त्तमम्
transliteration: bhartāram na anuvarteta sā ca pāpa gatir bhavet
bhartuḥ śuśrūṣayā nārī labhate svargamu ttamam

sanskrit: शुश्रूषम् एव कुर्वीत भर्तुः प्रिय हिते रता
transliteration: śuśrūṣam eva kurvīta bhartuḥ priya hite ratā
english: Even those who do not worship and bow to the celestials should serve their husbands alone being intent upon their welfare. Such is the virtue that should be always pursued by women according to the Vedas and Smſtis.

sanskrit: एष धर्मः पुरा द्Rष्टः लोके वेदे श्रुतः स्म्Rतः
transliteration: eṣa dharmaḥ purā dṣṭaḥ loke vede śrutaḥ smtaḥ

sanskrit: पूज्याः ते मत् क्Rते देवि ब्राह्मणाः चैव सुव्रताः
एवम् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व मम आगमन कान्क्षिणी
transliteration: pūjyāḥ te mat kte devi brāhmaṇāḥ caiva suvratāḥ
evam kālam pratīkṣasva mama āgamana kānkṣiṇī

sanskrit: प्राप्स्यसे परमम् कामम् मयि प्रत्यागते सति
प्राप्स्यसे परमम् कामम् मयि प्रत्यागते सति
transliteration: prāpsyase paramam kāmam mayi pratyāgate sati
prāpsyase paramam kāmam mayi pratyāgate sati

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु रामेण बाष्प पर्याकुल ईक्षणा
transliteration: evam uktā tu rāmeṇa bāṣpa paryākula īkṣaṇā

sanskrit: कौसल्या पुत्र शोक आर्ता रामम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
गमने सुकृताम् बुद्धिम् न ते शक्नोमि पुत्रक
transliteration: kausalyā putra śoka ārtā rāmam vacanam abravīt
gamane sukṛtām buddhim na te śaknomi putraka

sanskrit: गच्च पुत्र त्वम् एक अग्रः भद्रम् ते अस्तु सदा विभो
transliteration: gacca putra tvam eka agraḥ bhadram te astu sadā vibho

sanskrit: कृतान्तस्य गतिः पुत्र दुर्विभाव्या सदा भुवि
transliteration: kṛtāntasya gatiḥ putra durvibhāvyā sadā bhuvi

sanskrit: यस्त्वा सम्चोदयति मे वच आच्चिद्य राघव
transliteration: yastvā samcodayati me vaca āccidya rāghava

sanskrit: नन्दयिष्यसि माम् पुत्रः साम्ना वाक्येन चारुणा
transliteration: nandayiṣyasi mām putraḥ sāmnā vākyena cāruṇā

sanskrit: तथा हि रामम् वन वास निश्चितम्
transliteration: tathā hi rāmam vana vāsa niścitam
english: With great earnestness, the worshipful one began to eye Rāma, determined to go as an exile to the forest and spoke to his auspicious words and became desirous of performing benedictory ceremonies.

sanskrit: सा अपनीय तम् आयासम् उपस्पृश्य जलम् शुचि
transliteration: sā apanīya tam āyāsam upaspṛśya jalam śuci
english: Kausalyā subduing her sorrow, and touching holy water, began to perform auspicious ceremonies for Rāma, and spoke to him saying Do you, Oh best amongst the descendants of Raghu, repair now, as I cannot dissuade you, but do you return speedily and, follow the footsteps of great ones.

sanskrit: श्रीघ्रम् च विनिवर्तस्व वर्तस्व च सताम् क्रमे
transliteration: śrīghram ca vinivartasva vartasva ca satām krame
english: Kausalyā subduing her sorrow, and touching holy water, began to perform auspicious ceremonies for Rāma, and spoke to him saying Do you, Oh best amongst the descendants of Raghu, repair now, as I cannot dissuade you, but do you return speedily and, follow the footsteps of great ones.

sanskrit: यम् पालयसि धर्मम् त्वम् धृत्या च नियमेन च
transliteration: yam pālayasi dharmam tvam dhṛtyā ca niyamena ca
english: Let that virt'e, Oh best of Rāghavas, protect you, which you have followed with gladness and self-discipline.

sanskrit: ते च त्वामभिरक्षन्तु वने सह महर्षिभिः
transliteration: te ca tvāmabhirakṣantu vane saha maharṣibhiḥ
english: Let the deities, whom you worship every day in the temple, together with the Maharsis protect you in the forest.

sanskrit: यानि दत्तानि तेऽ स्त्राणि विश्वामित्रेण धीमता
transliteration: yāni dattāni te' strāṇi viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā
english: Let those weapons conferred upon you by the great Viśvāmitra protect you always, gifted with good qualities.
Do you of mighty hands live forever, being protected by the truth and merit of your continual services to your father and mother.

sanskrit: स्थण्ढिलानि विचित्राणि शैला वृक्षाः कुशुफा ह्रदाः
transliteration: sthaṇḍhilāni vicitrāṇi śailā vṛkṣāḥ kuśuphā hradāḥ
english: May the holy fuel, sacrificial grass, sanctified altars and court-yards, the sacred ground of mendicant Brahmins, mountains, trees great and small, lakes, birds, serpents and lions protect you.

sanskrit: स्वस्ति साध्याः च विश्वे च मरुतः च महर्षयः
transliteration: svasti sādhyāḥ ca viśve ca marutaḥ ca maharṣayaḥ

sanskrit: स्वस्ति धाता विधाता च स्वस्ति पूषा भगो अर्यमा
ऋतवः चैव पक्षाः च मासाः सम्वत्सराः क्षपाः
transliteration: svasti dhātā vidhātā ca svasti pūṣā bhago aryamā
ṛtavaḥ caiva pakṣāḥ ca māsāḥ samvatsarāḥ kṣapāḥ

sanskrit: दिनानि च मुहूर्ताः च स्वस्ति कुर्वन्तु ते सदा
transliteration: dināni ca muhūrtāḥ ca svasti kurvantu te sadā

sanskrit: स्मृतिर् धृतिः च धर्मः च पान्तु त्वाम् पुत्र सर्वतः
स्कन्दः च भगवान् देवः सोमः च सबृहस्पतिः
transliteration: smṛtir dhṛtiḥ ca dharmaḥ ca pāntu tvām putra sarvataḥ
skandaḥ ca bhagavān devaḥ somaḥ ca sabṛhaspatiḥ

sanskrit: सप्त ऋषयो नारदः च ते त्वाम् रक्षन्तु सर्वतः
transliteration: sapta ṛṣayo nāradaḥ ca te tvām rakṣantu sarvataḥ

sanskrit: स्तुता मया वने तस्मिन् पान्तुत्वाम् पुत्र नित्यशः
शैलाः सर्वे समुद्राश्च राजा वरुण एव च
transliteration: stutā mayā vane tasmin pāntutvām putra nityaśaḥ
śailāḥ sarve samudrāśca rājā varuṇa eva ca

sanskrit: नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि ग्रहाः च सहदेवताः
transliteration: nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāḥ ca sahadevatāḥ

sanskrit: अहोरात्रे तथा सन्ध्ये पान्तु त्वाम् वनमाश्रितम्
transliteration: ahorātre tathā sandhye pāntu tvām vanamāśritam

sanskrit: कलाश्च काष्ठाश्च तथा तव शर्म दिशन्तु ते
महा वनानि चरतः मुनि वेषस्य धीमतः
transliteration: kalāśca kāṣṭhāśca tathā tava śarma diśantu te
mahā vanāni carataḥ muni veṣasya dhīmataḥ

sanskrit: क्रव्यादानाम् च सर्वेषम् माभूत्पुत्रक ते भयम्
प्लवगा वृश्चिका दम्शा मशकाः चैव कानने
transliteration: kravyādānām ca sarveṣam mābhūtputraka te bhayam
plavagā vṛścikā damśā maśakāḥ caiva kānane

sanskrit: सरी सृपाः च कीटाः च मा भूवन् गहने तव
महा द्विपाः च सिम्हाः च व्याघ्राऋक्षाः च दम्ष्ट्रिणः
transliteration: sarī sṛpāḥ ca kīṭāḥ ca mā bhūvan gahane tava
mahā dvipāḥ ca simhāḥ ca vyāghrāṛkṣāḥ ca damṣṭriṇaḥ
english: May the apes, scorpions, wild gnats, reptiles and insects make you no harm; may not the elephants, tigers, terrible looking bears, hogs, buffaloes and other horned animals hurt you.

sanskrit: महिषाः शृन्गिणो रौद्रा न ते द्रुह्यन्तु पुत्रक
नृ माम्स भोजना रौद्रा ये च अन्ये सत्त्व जातयः
transliteration: mahiṣāḥ śṛngiṇo raudrā na te druhyantu putraka
nṛ māmsa bhojanā raudrā ye ca anye sattva jātayaḥ

sanskrit: मा च त्वाम् हिम्सिषुः पुत्र मया सम्पूजिताः तु इह
आगमाः ते शिवाः सन्तु सिध्यन्तु च पराक्रमाः
transliteration: mā ca tvām himsiṣuḥ putra mayā sampūjitāḥ tu iha
āgamāḥ te śivāḥ santu sidhyantu ca parākramāḥ

sanskrit: सर्व सम्पत्तयो राम स्वस्तिमान् गच्च पुत्रक
स्वस्ति ते अस्तु आन्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यः पुनः पुनः
transliteration: sarva sampattayo rāma svastimān gacca putraka
svasti te astu āntarikṣebhyaḥ pārthivebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ

sanskrit: सर्वेभ्यः चैव देवेभ्यो ये च ते परिपन्थिनः
transliteration: sarvebhyaḥ caiva devebhyo ye ca te paripanthinaḥ

sanskrit: सर्व लोक प्रभुर् ब्रह्मा भूत भर्ता तथा ऋषयः
transliteration: sarva loka prabhur brahmā bhūta bhartā tathā ṛṣayaḥ

sanskrit: ये च शेषाः सुराः ते त्वाम् रक्षन्तु वन वासिनम्
इति माल्यैः सुर गणान् गन्धैः च अपि यशस्विनी
transliteration: ye ca śeṣāḥ surāḥ te tvām rakṣantu vana vāsinam
iti mālyaiḥ sura gaṇān gandhaiḥ ca api yaśasvinī

sanskrit: स्तुतिभिः च अनुरूपाभिर् आनर्च आयत लोचना
transliteration: stutibhiḥ ca anurūpābhir ānarca āyata locanā

english: The spiritual preceptor, after offering oblations to the fire with due rites for his peace and health, presenting what was then left as offerings to the lords of the four cardinal points and others,* and giving the Brahmins a dish of curd, ghi and honey, made them benedictory prayers for Rāma who was going to the forest. *The Gürhyasthabuli or the daily offering of the householder, meant here, may be thus explained. After the performance of oblation to the fire, the householder should present offerings to the lords of the four cardinal points. Indra, Yama Varuņa, Soma and to their retinue. The offering for the Marutas should be placed on the threshold; for the presiding deities of the water in water; for the lords of the forest to the wooden pestle and mortar; for Śrī and Bhadrakäli on the grounds adjacent to the beddings on the side of the head and that of the feet respectively; for Brahmanaspati and Vāstupati on the site of the habitation; for Viśvedeva and for day and night thrown in the air of the house, for Sarvātmabhūta scattered on the terrace. After offering to all these what remains should be thrown on the south for the manes. The offerings to the dogs, the fallen, the drags of the people, the lepers, the crows and the worms and the insects should be placed on uncovered ground.

sanskrit: यन् मन्गलम् सहस्र अक्षे सर्व देव नमः कृते
transliteration: yan mangalam sahasra akṣe sarva deva namaḥ kṛte

sanskrit: वृत्र नाशे समभवत् तत् ते भवतु मन्गलम्
यन् मन्गलम् सुपर्णस्य विनता अकल्पयत् पुरा
transliteration: vṛtra nāśe samabhavat tat te bhavatu mangalam
yan mangalam suparṇasya vinatā akalpayat purā

sanskrit: अमृतम् प्रार्थयानस्य तत् ते भवतु मन्गलम्
transliteration: amṛtam prārthayānasya tat te bhavatu mangalam

sanskrit: ऋतवः सागरा द्वीपा वेदा लोका दिश्श्चते
transliteration: ṛtavaḥ sāgarā dvīpā vedā lokā diśścate

sanskrit: इति पुत्रस्य शेषाश्च कृत्वा शिरसि भामिनी
transliteration: iti putrasya śeṣāśca kṛtvā śirasi bhāminī

sanskrit: ओषधीम् च अपि सिद्ध अर्थाम् विशल्य करणीम् शुभाम्
transliteration: oṣadhīm ca api siddha arthām viśalya karaṇīm śubhām
english: Saying this Kausalyā, the foremost of all women, having expansive eyes, placed the grains on Rāma's head; sprinkled his body with fragrant substances, and tied to his hands, as amulet, twigs of such auspicious plants as Viśalyakaraṇī, with due mental repetition of mantras.

sanskrit: चकार रक्षाम् कौसल्या मन्त्रैः अभिजजाप च
transliteration: cakāra rakṣām kausalyā mantraiḥ abhijajāpa ca

sanskrit: आनम्य मूर्ध्नि च आघ्राय परिष्वज्य यशस्विनी
transliteration: ānamya mūrdhni ca āghrāya pariṣvajya yaśasvinī

sanskrit: अवदत् पुत्र सिद्ध अर्थो गच्च राम यथा सुखम्
अरोगम् सर्व सिद्ध अर्थम् अयोध्याम् पुनर् आगतम्
transliteration: avadat putra siddha artho gacca rāma yathā sukham
arogam sarva siddha artham ayodhyām punar āgatam
english: Oh my son, Oh Rāma, have your desires attained, and do you go, wherever you like. I shall see you. Oh my darling, with great delight, when shall you, returning Ayodhyā in excellent health and having all your ends satisfied, resume the administration of your kingdom.

sanskrit: पश्यामि त्वाम् सुखम् वत्स सुस्थितम् राज वेश्मनि
transliteration: paśyāmi tvām sukham vatsa susthitam rāja veśmani

english: Myself having sorrows removed and having my face glowing with joy, shall see you coming from the forest like to the rising of the full moon.

sanskrit: द्रक्षामि च पुनस्त्वाम् तु तीर्णवन्तम् पितुर्वचः
transliteration: drakṣāmi ca punastvām tu tīrṇavantam piturvacaḥ

sanskrit: पध्वा मम च नित्यम् त्वम् कामान् सम्वर्ध याहि भोः
मया अर्चिता देव गणाः शिव आदयो
transliteration: padhvā mama ca nityam tvam kāmān samvardha yāhi bhoḥ
mayā arcitā deva gaṇāḥ śiva ādayo
english: Worshipped have I deities headed by Siva and others, the great ascetics, the Bhūtagaņas and the snakes; may they all and the four cardinal points, Oh Rāghava, contribute to your welfare, who are going to the forest for a long time.

sanskrit: इति इव च अश्रु प्रतिपूर्ण लोचना
पुनः पुनः च अपि निपीड्य सस्वजे
transliteration: iti iva ca aśru pratipūrṇa locanā
punaḥ punaḥ ca api nipīḍya sasvaje
english: Kausalya, having her eyes full of tears, and performing the benedictory ceremonies with due rites, went round Rāghava with solemnity, and seeing him again and again sighed hot and hard.

sanskrit: तथा तु देव्या स कृत प्रदक्षिणो
transliteration: tathā tu devyā sa kṛta pradakṣiṇo
english: Being gone round by his mother thus, Rāghava, of great lame, and resplendent with the splendour of beauty, proceeded towards the abode of Sītā, after bowing down to the feet of his mother repeatedly.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य तु कौसल्याम् रामः सम्प्रस्थितः वनम्
कृत स्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः
transliteration: abhivādya tu kausalyām rāmaḥ samprasthitaḥ vanam
kṛta svastyayano mātrā dharmiṣṭhe vartmani sthitaḥ
english: Rāma, intent on repairing to the forest, and treading in pious tracks, after duly saluting Kausalyā and beautifying the royal road, crowded with people, captivated their hearts by means of his high accomplishments.

sanskrit: विराजयन् राज सुतः राज मार्गम् नरैः वृतम्
transliteration: virājayan rāja sutaḥ rāja mārgam naraiḥ vṛtam

sanskrit: वैदेही च अपि तत् सर्वम् न शुश्राव तपस्विनी
तत् एव हृदि तस्याः च यौवराज्य अभिषेचनम्
transliteration: vaidehī ca api tat sarvam na śuśrāva tapasvinī
tat eva hṛdi tasyāḥ ca yauvarājya abhiṣecanam
english: Vaidehi, ever engaged in ascetic rites, did not hear of all these affairs; there was in her heart only the thought of Rāma's installation.

sanskrit: देव कार्यम् स्म सा कृत्वा कृतज्ञा हृष्ट चेतना
अभिज्ञा राज धर्मानाम् राज पुत्रम् प्रतीक्षते
transliteration: deva kāryam sma sā kṛtvā kṛtajñā hṛṣṭa cetanā
abhijñā rāja dharmānām rāja putram pratīkṣate
english: That daughter of the king, after offering her service to the deities according to the proper royal rites, was eagerly awaiting the approach of Rāma with a grateful and pleased heart.

sanskrit: प्रविवेश अथ रामः तु स्व वेश्म सुविभूषितम्
प्रहृष्ट जन सम्पूर्णम् ह्रिया किम्चित् अवान् मुखः
transliteration: praviveśa atha rāmaḥ tu sva veśma suvibhūṣitam
prahṛṣṭa jana sampūrṇam hriyā kimcit avān mukhaḥ
english: Entered Rāma this beautiful abode, excellently furnished and filled with people highly delighted, having his head hanging down a little with shame.

sanskrit: अथ सीता समुत्पत्य वेपमाना च तम् पतिम्
अपश्यत् शोक सम्तप्तम् चिन्ता व्याकुलिल इन्द्रियम्
transliteration: atha sītā samutpatya vepamānā ca tam patim
apaśyat śoka samtaptam cintā vyākulila indriyam
english: Sītā, seeing her husband, racked with sorrow and troubled in mind with anxiety, rose up trembling from her seat.

sanskrit: ताम् दृष्ट्वा स हि धर्मात्मा न शशाक मनोगतम्
तम् शोकम् राघवह् सोढुम् ततो विवृतताम् गतः
transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā sa hi dharmātmā na śaśāka manogatam
tam śokam rāghavah soḍhum tato vivṛtatām gataḥ
english: Seeing her, that virtuous souled Rāghava, could not bear his internal sorrow, which manifested itself by external signs.

sanskrit: विवर्ण वदनम् दृष्ट्वा तम् प्रस्विन्नम् अमर्षणम्
आह दुह्ख अभिसम्तप्ता किम् इदानीम् इदम् प्रभो
transliteration: vivarṇa vadanam dṛṣṭvā tam prasvinnam amarṣaṇam
āha duhkha abhisamtaptā kim idānīm idam prabho
english: Finding him with face pale and perspiring, and incapable of containing grief within, Sītā sore distressed with sorrow addressed him, saying, Oh my lord, why do I perceive such a change in you?

sanskrit: अद्य बार्हस्पतः श्रीमान् युक्तः पुष्यो न राघव
प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वम् असि दुर्मनाः
transliteration: adya bārhaspataḥ śrīmān yuktaḥ puṣyo na rāghava
procyate brāhmaṇaiḥ prājñaiḥ kena tvam asi durmanāḥ
english: To day the constellation Puşya is in conjunction with the moon, and planet Bịhaspati is presiding over this conjunction, this day has been declared as the most auspicious one by the learned Brahmins, then why do you cherish such a sorrow in the mind?

sanskrit: न ते शत शलाकेन जल फेन निभेन च
transliteration: na te śata śalākena jala phena nibhena ca
english: Why has not your charming face been placed under the shade of an umbrella having hundred ribs and white as a watery foam?

sanskrit: व्यजनाभ्याम् च मुख्याभ्याम् शत पत्र निभ ईक्षणम्
चन्द्र हम्स प्रकाशाभ्याम् वीज्यते न तव आननम्
transliteration: vyajanābhyām ca mukhyābhyām śata patra nibha īkṣaṇam
candra hamsa prakāśābhyām vījyate na tava ānanam
english: Why do not the servants fan you, having eyes like lotus' petals, with chowries white as the moon or a goose?

sanskrit: वाग्मिनो बन्दिनः च अपि प्रहृष्टाः त्वम् नर ऋषभ
स्तुवन्तः न अद्य दृश्यन्ते मन्गलैः सूत मागधाः
transliteration: vāgmino bandinaḥ ca api prahṛṣṭāḥ tvam nara ṛṣabha
stuvantaḥ na adya dṛśyante mangalaiḥ sūta māgadhāḥ
english: I do not see you, Oh best of men, eulogised with auspicious songs by the panegyrists, encomiasts and family bards.

sanskrit: न ते क्षौद्रम् च दधि च ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः
मूर्ध्नि मूर्ध अवसिक्तस्य दधति स्म विधानतः
transliteration: na te kṣaudram ca dadhi ca brāhmaṇā veda pāragāḥ
mūrdhni mūrdha avasiktasya dadhati sma vidhānataḥ
english: Why do not the Brahmins, versed in the Vedas, observing the formal rites, sprinkle on your head honey and curd, after washing it duly?

sanskrit: न त्वाम् प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणी मुख्याः च भूषिताः
transliteration: na tvām prakṛtayaḥ sarvā śreṇī mukhyāḥ ca bhūṣitāḥ
english: Why are not your subjects, citizens urbans, and leading members of society dressed and adorned, willing to follow you?

sanskrit: चतुर्भिर् वेग सम्पन्नैः हयैः कान्चन भूषणैः
मुख्यः पुष्य रथो युक्तः किम् न गच्चति ते अग्रतः
transliteration: caturbhir vega sampannaiḥ hayaiḥ kāncana bhūṣaṇaiḥ
mukhyaḥ puṣya ratho yuktaḥ kim na gaccati te agrataḥ
english: Why does not that excellent sport-chariot go before you, having four fast going steeds, adorned with golden ornaments tied to it?

sanskrit: न हस्ती च अग्रतः श्रीमाम्स् तव लक्षण पूजितः
प्रयाणे लक्ष्यते वीर कृष्ण मेघ गिरि प्रभः
transliteration: na hastī ca agrataḥ śrīmāms tava lakṣaṇa pūjitaḥ
prayāṇe lakṣyate vīra kṛṣṇa megha giri prabhaḥ
english: Why does not that excellent elephant precede you, Oh great hero, which is gifted with auspicious marks and resembles as mass of dark clouds and a mighty hill?

sanskrit: न च कान्चन चित्रम् ते पश्यामि प्रिय दर्शन
भद्र आसनम् पुरः कृत्य यान्तम् वीर पुरह्सरम्
transliteration: na ca kāncana citram te paśyāmi priya darśana
bhadra āsanam puraḥ kṛtya yāntam vīra purahsaram
english: Why do not the servants run before you, Oh mighty hero, with a pretty looking royal seat embroidered with gold?

sanskrit: अभिषेको यदा सज्जः किम् इदानीम् इदम् तव
अपूर्वो मुख वर्णः च न प्रहर्षः च लक्ष्यते
transliteration: abhiṣeko yadā sajjaḥ kim idānīm idam tava
apūrvo mukha varṇaḥ ca na praharṣaḥ ca lakṣyate
english: Why do I perceive your face so pale as never seen before, and why therein is no mark of gladness, when every thing for your installation has been made ready?

sanskrit: इति इव विलपन्तीम् ताम् प्रोवाच रघु नन्दनः
सीते तत्रभवाम्स् तात प्रव्राजयति माम् वनम्
transliteration: iti iva vilapantīm tām provāca raghu nandanaḥ
sīte tatrabhavāms tāta pravrājayati mām vanam
english: Whereupon spoke to that weeping Sītā, the descendant of Raghu thus:, Oh Sītā, Oh you born of a great family, versed in the knowledge of religion and intent on the performance of religious rites, my father has banished me to the forest! Do you hear, Oh daughter of Janaka, how has this calamity befallen me.

sanskrit: कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्म चारिणि
शृणु जानकि येन इदम् क्रमेण अभ्यागतम् मम
transliteration: kule mahati sambhūte dharmajñe dharma cāriṇi
śṛṇu jānaki yena idam krameṇa abhyāgatam mama
english: Whereupon spoke to that weeping Sītā, the descendant of Raghu thus:, Oh Sītā, Oh you born of a great family, versed in the knowledge of religion and intent on the performance of religious rites, my father has banished me to the forest! Do you hear, Oh daughter of Janaka, how has this calamity befallen me.

sanskrit: राज्ञा सत्य प्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन मे
कैकेय्यै प्रीत मनसा पुरा दत्तौ महा वरौ
transliteration: rājñā satya pratijñena pitrā daśarathena me
kaikeyyai prīta manasā purā dattau mahā varau
english: In the days of yore was granted to my mother, Kaikeyi two boons by my father, king Dasaratha of truthful vows.

sanskrit: तया अद्य मम सज्जे अस्मिन्न् अभिषेके नृप उद्यते
transliteration: tayā adya mama sajje asminn abhiṣeke nṛpa udyate
english: When every thing was made ready by my father for my installation, Kaikeyi reminded him of his promise and gained over him for this righteousness.

sanskrit: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यम् दण्डके मया
पित्रा मे भरतः च अपि यौवराज्ये नियोजितः
transliteration: caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vastavyam daṇḍake mayā
pitrā me bharataḥ ca api yauvarājye niyojitaḥ
english: I shall live in the forest of Dandaka for fourteen years and Bharata shall be installed by my father as the heir apparent of the throne.

sanskrit: सो अहम् त्वाम् आगतः द्रष्टुम् प्रस्थितः विजनम् वनम्
भरतस्य समीपे ते न अहम् कथ्यः कदाचन
transliteration: so aham tvām āgataḥ draṣṭum prasthitaḥ vijanam vanam
bharatasya samīpe te na aham kathyaḥ kadācana
english: And myself bound to fly as an exile to the wood, have come here to see you; do you not praise me ever before Bharata. Those who are crowned with prosperity cannot bear another's praise; is it therefore behoves you not to extol my virtues in the presence of Bharata.

sanskrit: ऋद्धि युक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते पर स्तवम्
तस्मान् न ते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्य अग्रतः मम
transliteration: ṛddhi yuktā hi puruṣā na sahante para stavam
tasmān na te guṇāḥ kathyā bharatasya agrataḥ mama
english: And myself bound to fly as an exile to the wood, have come here to see you; do you not praise me ever before Bharata. Those who are crowned with prosperity cannot bear another's praise; is it therefore behoves you not to extol my virtues in the presence of Bharata.

sanskrit: न अपि त्वम् तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचनअनुकूलतया शक्यम् समीपे तस्य वर्तितुम्
transliteration: na api tvam tena bhartavyā viśeṣeṇa kadācanaanukūlatayā śakyam samīpe tasya vartitum
english: You should not extol me even in the company of your friends; you shall be then able to live with Bharata as one favourable to his party.
The monarch has granted him this lasting heir appearentship; it is therefore proper for you, Oh Sītā, to please him specially for he is the king now.

sanskrit: अहम् च अपि प्रतिज्ञाम् ताम् गुरोह् समनुपालयन्
वनम् अद्य एव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनि
transliteration: aham ca api pratijñām tām guroh samanupālayan
vanam adya eva yāsyāmi sthirā bhava manasvini
english: To day shall I repair to the forest for redeeming my father's vows; do you, Oh high minded one, live here in undisturbed mind.

sanskrit: याते च मयि कल्याणि वनम् मुनि निषेवितम्
व्रत उपवास रतया भवितव्यम् त्वया अनघे
transliteration: yāte ca mayi kalyāṇi vanam muni niṣevitam
vrata upavāsa ratayā bhavitavyam tvayā anaghe
english: Do you, Oh sinless and auspicious one, live here engaged in religious rites and fasts, when I shall wend my way to the forest inhabited by the great ascetics.

sanskrit: काल्यम् उत्थाय देवानाम् कृत्वा पूजाम् यथा विधि
वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम नर ईश्वरः
transliteration: kālyam utthāya devānām kṛtvā pūjām yathā vidhi
vanditavyo daśarathaḥ pitā mama nara īśvaraḥ
english: Rising from the bed early in the morning, adore the deities, every day, and then bow down to the feet of my father Dasaratha, the lord of men.

sanskrit: माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा सम्ताप कर्शिता
धर्मम् एव अग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः सम्मानम् अर्हति
transliteration: mātā ca mama kausalyā vṛddhā samtāpa karśitā
dharmam eva agrataḥ kṛtvā tvattaḥ sammānam arhati
english: My mother Kausalyā is old and much pressed down with sorrow; do you show proper respects to her, considering it to be a pious deed.

sanskrit: वन्दितव्याः च ते नित्यम् याः शेषा मम मातरः
स्नेह प्रणय सम्भोगैः समा हि मम मातरः
transliteration: vanditavyāḥ ca te nityam yāḥ śeṣā mama mātaraḥ
sneha praṇaya sambhogaiḥ samā hi mama mātaraḥ
english: You should then bow down to my other mothers who all minister to me, with equal love and affection.

sanskrit: भ्रातृ पुत्र समौ च अपि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः
त्वया लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम
transliteration: bhrātṛ putra samau ca api draṣṭavyau ca viśeṣataḥ
tvayā lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau prāṇaiḥ priyatarau mama
english: Should you specially regard Bharata and Śatrughna like to your sons or brothers, who are dearer to me than my life itself.

sanskrit: विप्रियम् न च कर्तव्यम् भरतस्य कदाचन
स हि राजा प्रभुः चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च
transliteration: vipriyam na ca kartavyam bharatasya kadācana
sa hi rājā prabhuḥ caiva deśasya ca kulasya ca
english: You should not do, Oh Vaidehī, any such thing as might be unpleasant to Bharata, for he is the king of the land as well as of the family.

sanskrit: आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैः च उपसेविताः
transliteration: ārādhitā hi śīlena prayatnaiḥ ca upasevitāḥ
english: The monarchs are always propitiated by being served with assiduity and good temper; they are offended when any thing contrary to it happens.

sanskrit: औरसान् अपि पुत्रान् हि त्यजन्ति अहित कारिणः
समर्थान् सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनान् अपि नर अधिपाः
transliteration: aurasān api putrān hi tyajanti ahita kāriṇaḥ
samarthān sampragṛhṇanti janān api nara adhipāḥ
english: They renounce even their own son, born of their lions, when they find him bringing about their mischief, and admit into their favour persons devoted to their welfare bearing no relationship whatever.

sanskrit: सा त्वम् वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी
transliteration: sā tvam vaseha kalyāṇi rājñaḥ samanuvartinī
english: It therefore behoves you, Oh auspicious one, to live here, abiding by Bharata's commands and being engaged in religious rites and truthful vows.

sanskrit: त्वया हि वस्तव्यम् इह एव भामिनि
तथा त्वया कार्यम् इदम् वचो मम
transliteration: tvayā hi vastavyam iha eva bhāmini
tathā tvayā kāryam idam vaco mama
english: I am going to the forest, Oh my darling, and you shall live here. Oh excellent lady, abide by my word as did you never formerly falsify it.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही प्रिय अर्हा प्रिय वादिनी
प्रणयात् एव सम्क्रुद्धा भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktā tu vaidehī priya arhā priya vādinī
praṇayāt eva samkruddhā bhartāram idam abravīt
english: Being addressed thus, Vaidehi, beloved and sweet speeched, spoke to her husband the following words, offended as it were on account of her great affection.

sanskrit: किमिदम् भाषसे राम वाक्यम् लघुतया ध्रुवम्
transliteration: kimidam bhāṣase rāma vākyam laghutayā dhruvam
english: It is that you speak me thus, thinking me, no doubt, mean minded. I can not but laugh at your words.

sanskrit: आर्य पुत्र पिता माता भ्राता पुत्रः तथा स्नुषा
स्वानि पुण्यानि भुन्जानाः स्वम् स्वम् भाग्यम् उपासते
transliteration: ārya putra pitā mātā bhrātā putraḥ tathā snuṣā
svāni puṇyāni bhunjānāḥ svam svam bhāgyam upāsate
english: Oh dear husband, father, mother, son, brother, daughter-in-law, all of them abide by the consequences of their own actions, it is the wife alone, Oh best of men, that shares the fate of her husband; it is therefore that ever along with you I have been ordered to live in the forest.

sanskrit: भर्तुर् भाग्यम् तु भार्या एका प्राप्नोति पुरुष ऋषभ
अतः चैव अहम् आदिष्टा वने वस्तव्यम् इति अपि
transliteration: bhartur bhāgyam tu bhāryā ekā prāpnoti puruṣa ṛṣabha
ataḥ caiva aham ādiṣṭā vane vastavyam iti api

sanskrit: न पिता न आत्मजो न आत्मा न माता न सखी जनः
इह प्रेत्य च नारीणाम् पतिर् एको गतिः सदा
transliteration: na pitā na ātmajo na ātmā na mātā na sakhī janaḥ
iha pretya ca nārīṇām patir eko gatiḥ sadā
english: Neither father, mother, son, friends, nor her ownself is the stay of a woman in this or in after life, it is the husband along that is her only support.

sanskrit: यदि त्वम् प्रस्थितः दुर्गम् वनम् अद्य एव राघव
अग्रतः ते गमिष्यामि मृद्नन्ती कुश कण्टकान्
transliteration: yadi tvam prasthitaḥ durgam vanam adya eva rāghava
agrataḥ te gamiṣyāmi mṛdnantī kuśa kaṇṭakān
english: If do you repair today to the forest impregnable, I shall go before you, oh Rāghava, treading upon the thorns and prickly grass.

sanskrit: ईर्ष्या रोषौ बहिष् कृत्य भुक्त शेषम् इव उदकम्
नय माम् वीर विश्रब्धः पापम् मयि न विद्यते
transliteration: īrṣyā roṣau bahiṣ kṛtya bhukta śeṣam iva udakam
naya mām vīra viśrabdhaḥ pāpam mayi na vidyate
english: Confident do you take me with you, Oh great hero, renouncing jealousy and indignation, like to water left after drinking; there exists no sin in me that could justify forsaking.

sanskrit: प्रासाद अग्रैः विमानैः वा वैहायस गतेन वा
सर्व अवस्था गता भर्तुः पादच् चाया विशिष्यते
transliteration: prāsāda agraiḥ vimānaiḥ vā vaihāyasa gatena vā
sarva avasthā gatā bhartuḥ pādac cāyā viśiṣyate
english: To woman is preferable under all circumstances the shade of her husband's feet to the tops of a palace, the celestial car or excursion in the airy path.* *It was generally believed that by certain processes of Yoga one acquired power to fly in the air.

sanskrit: अनुशिष्टा अस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविध आश्रयम्
न अस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यम् यथा मया
transliteration: anuśiṣṭā asmi mātrā ca pitrā ca vividha āśrayam
na asmi samprati vaktavyā vartitavyam yathā mayā
english: I have been taught by my father and mother to follow my husband in all conditions of life; and I shall carry out now what I have been taught; I shall not abide by any other counsel.
I shall wend my way to the forest impassable, devoid of men, inhabited by various deers, tigers and other voracious animals.

sanskrit: सुखम् वने निवत्स्यामि यथा एव भवने पितुः
अचिन्तयन्ती त्रीम्ल् लोकामः चिन्तयन्ती पति व्रतम्
transliteration: sukham vane nivatsyāmi yathā eva bhavane pituḥ
acintayantī trīml lokāmaḥ cintayantī pati vratam
english: Happily shall I live there as if in my paternal house, giving no thought upon the prosperity of the three worlds, thinking only of the services that are to be rendered to my husband.

sanskrit: शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यम् नियता ब्रह्म चारिणी
सह रम्स्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु
transliteration: śuśrūṣamāṇā te nityam niyatā brahma cāriṇī
saha ramsye tvayā vīra vaneṣu madhu gandhiṣu
english: I shall sport with you, O great hero, in that forest impregnated with the fragrance of flowers, tending you constantly, having my senses subdued, and being engaged in austere performances.

sanskrit: त्वम् हि कर्तुम् वने शक्तः राम सम्परिपालनम्
अन्यस्य पै जनस्य इह किम् पुनर् मम मानद
transliteration: tvam hi kartum vane śaktaḥ rāma samparipālanam
anyasya pai janasya iha kim punar mama mānada
english: Oh great hero, capable are you to maintain many thousand others in the forest, what of me.

sanskrit: सह त्वया गमिश्यामि वसमद्य न सम्शयः
transliteration: saha tvayā gamiśyāmi vasamadya na samśayaḥ
english: Surely shall I go to-day to the forest with you; there is no doubt about it and you shall not be able. Oh great hero, to dissuade me from so doing.

sanskrit: फल मूल अशना नित्यम् भविष्यामि न सम्शयः
न ते दुह्खम् करिष्यामि निवसन्ती सह त्वया
transliteration: phala mūla aśanā nityam bhaviṣyāmi na samśayaḥ
na te duhkham kariṣyāmi nivasantī saha tvayā
english: Undoubtedly I shall always live upon roots and fruits, living with you always I shall not bring about your affliction.

sanskrit: इच्चामि सरितः शैलान् पल्वलानि वनानि च
द्रष्टुम् सर्वत्र निर्भीता त्वया नाथेन धीमता
transliteration: iccāmi saritaḥ śailān palvalāni vanāni ca
draṣṭum sarvatra nirbhītā tvayā nāthena dhīmatā

sanskrit: हम्स कारण्डव आकीर्णाः पद्मिनीः साधु पुष्पिताः
इच्चेयम् सुखिनी द्रष्टुम् त्वया वीरेण सम्गता
transliteration: hamsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇāḥ padminīḥ sādhu puṣpitāḥ
icceyam sukhinī draṣṭum tvayā vīreṇa samgatā

sanskrit: सह त्वया विशाल अक्ष रम्स्ये परम नन्दिनी
transliteration: saha tvayā viśāla akṣa ramsye parama nandinī

sanskrit: एवम् वर्ष सहस्राणाम् शतम् वा अहम् त्वया सह
व्यतिक्रमम् न वेत्स्यामि स्वर्गोऽपि हि न मे मतः
transliteration: evam varṣa sahasrāṇām śatam vā aham tvayā saha
vyatikramam na vetsyāmi svargo'pi hi na me mataḥ

sanskrit: स्वर्गे अपि च विना वासो भविता यदि राघव
त्वया मम नर व्याघ्र न अहम् तम् अपि रोचये
transliteration: svarge api ca vinā vāso bhavitā yadi rāghava
tvayā mama nara vyāghra na aham tam api rocaye

english: I shall go there in that dense forest full of deers, monkeys and elephants and live there as if under my paternal roof cleaving to your feet and abiding in your pleasure.

sanskrit: न ते मया अतः गुरुता भविष्यति
transliteration: na te mayā ataḥ gurutā bhaviṣyati
english: Do you accept my entreaty whose heart is entirely yours, knows none else, and is ever attached to you, and who am resolved to die if forsaken by you; thus repairing I shall be in no way a burden to you.

sanskrit: न च स्म सीताम् नृ वरः निनीषति
transliteration: na ca sma sītām nṛ varaḥ ninīṣati
english: That best of men, reluctant to take Sītā with him, who had spoken thus and who was greatly attached to virtue, related to her about the many miseries consequent upon dwelling in the forest, with a view to prevent her from following him.

sanskrit: सएवम् ब्रुवतीम् सीताम् धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः
निवर्तन अर्थे धर्म आत्मा वाक्यम् एतत् उवाच ह
transliteration: saevam bruvatīm sītām dharmajño dharma vatsalaḥ
nivartana arthe dharma ātmā vākyam etat uvāca ha

english: And consoling her whose eyes were stained with tears, that virtuous-souled one spoke to her the following words with a view to prevent her from going.

sanskrit: सीते महा कुलीना असि धर्मे च निरता सदा
इह आचर स्वधर्मम् त्वम् मा यथा मनसः सुखम्
transliteration: sīte mahā kulīnā asi dharme ca niratā sadā
iha ācara svadharmam tvam mā yathā manasaḥ sukham
english: Oh Sītā, you are born of an illustrious family and ever intent on the performance of religious deeds; do you practise virtue here as it may conduce to the happiness of my mind.

sanskrit: सीते यथा त्वाम् वक्ष्यामि तथा कार्यम् त्वया अबले
वने दोषा हि बहवो वदतः तान् निबोध मे
transliteration: sīte yathā tvām vakṣyāmi tathā kāryam tvayā abale
vane doṣā hi bahavo vadataḥ tān nibodha me
english: Oh Sītā, Oh you of the weaker sex, Do you act up to my counsels; there are evils enough in the forest, do you learn them from me who am about to dwell in it.

sanskrit: सीते विमुच्यताम् एषा वन वास कृता मतिः
बहु दोषम् हि कान्तारम् वनम् इति अभिधीयते
transliteration: sīte vimucyatām eṣā vana vāsa kṛtā matiḥ
bahu doṣam hi kāntāram vanam iti abhidhīyate
english: Renounce therefore, Oh Sītă, your intention of flying as an exile to the forest, which for its impenetrableness is said to abound in evils.

sanskrit: हित बुद्ध्या खलु वचो मया एतत् अभिधीयते
सदा सुखम् न जानामि दुह्खम् एव सदा वनम्
transliteration: hita buddhyā khalu vaco mayā etat abhidhīyate
sadā sukham na jānāmi duhkham eva sadā vanam
english: It is for your welfare that I give utterance to these words; happiness there is none, it is always covered with miseries.

sanskrit: गिरि निर्झर सम्भूता गिरि कन्दर वासिनाम्
सिम्हानाम् निनदा दुह्खाः श्रोतुम् दुह्खम् अतः वनम्
transliteration: giri nirjhara sambhūtā giri kandara vāsinām
simhānām ninadā duhkhāḥ śrotum duhkham ataḥ vanam
english: The roarings of the lions living in the caves of mountains, swelling with the sounds of the water-falls, produce a very painful impression upon the ears; so the wood is full of misery.
Animals, all maddened, sporting in solitude, seeing (man), approach to attack him; so the wood is full of misery.
The rivers are full of crocodiles, sharks, and other fearful animals, muddy and impassable and always infested with infuriated elephants; so the wood is full of misery.
There the wayfarers are covered with creepers and thorns they are void of drinking water ever resounded with the noise of the wild fowls, so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: सुप्यते पर्ण शय्यासु स्वयम् भग्नासु भू तले
रात्रिषु श्रम खिन्नेन तस्मात् दुह्खतरम् वनम्
transliteration: supyate parṇa śayyāsu svayam bhagnāsu bhū tale
rātriṣu śrama khinnena tasmāt duhkhataram vanam
english: Being exhausted with the toil of the day, the dwellers of the wood have to sleep in night on the bed made of leaves fallen from the trees on the surface of the ground; so the wood is full of misery.
With the (supply of) fruits that have fallen from the trees man of self discipline must content himself morning and evening; so the wood, O Sītă, is full of misery.

sanskrit: उपवासः च कर्तव्या यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि
जटा भारः च कर्तव्यो वल्कल अम्बर धारिणा
transliteration: upavāsaḥ ca kartavyā yathā prāṇena maithili
jaṭā bhāraḥ ca kartavyo valkala ambara dhāriṇā

sanskrit: आर्षेण विधिना वेद्याम् बाले दुःखमतो वनम्
transliteration: ārṣeṇa vidhinā vedyām bāle duḥkhamato vanam
english: One has to offer presents of flowers collected by his ownself to the altars, O Sītā, according to the rites of the ascetics; so the wood is full of misery.
Those that dwell in the forest will have to remain content, having practised moderation in food, O Maithill, with whatever edibles are attainable in the forest; so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: अतीव वातः तिमिरम् बुभुक्षा च अत्र नित्यशः
भयानि च महान्ति अत्र ततः दुह्खतरम् वनम्
transliteration: atīva vātaḥ timiram bubhukṣā ca atra nityaśaḥ
bhayāni ca mahānti atra tataḥ duhkhataram vanam
english: There are always violent winds, darkness hunger, and great fear; so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: सरी सृपाः च बहवो बहु रूपाः च भामिनि
चरन्ति पृथिवीम् दर्पात् अतः दुखतरम् वनम्
transliteration: sarī sṛpāḥ ca bahavo bahu rūpāḥ ca bhāmini
caranti pṛthivīm darpāt ataḥ dukhataram vanam
english: Reptiles, many and of various kinds, creep there on the path, O excellent lady, with haughtiness; so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: नदी निलयनाः सर्पा नदी कुटिल गामिनः
तिष्ठन्ति आवृत्य पन्थानम् अतः दुह्खतरम् वनम्
transliteration: nadī nilayanāḥ sarpā nadī kuṭila gāminaḥ
tiṣṭhanti āvṛtya panthānam ataḥ duhkhataram vanam
english: And snakes living in the rivers and of crooked course like them, always await the wayfarers, hindering the passers-by: so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: पतम्गा वृश्चिकाः कीटा दम्शाः च मशकैः सह
बाधन्ते नित्यम् अबले सर्वम् दुह्खम् अतः वनम्
transliteration: patamgā vṛścikāḥ kīṭā damśāḥ ca maśakaiḥ saha
bādhante nityam abale sarvam duhkham ataḥ vanam
english: Birds, scorpions, insects mosquito's and wild gnats, always disturb the dwellers, O fair one' of the weaker sex; so the wood is full misery.

sanskrit: द्रुमाः कण्टकिनः चैव कुश काशाः च भामिनि
वने व्याकुल शाखा अग्राः तेन दुह्खतरम् वनम्
transliteration: drumāḥ kaṇṭakinaḥ caiva kuśa kāśāḥ ca bhāmini
vane vyākula śākhā agrāḥ tena duhkhataram vanam
english: There are trees full of thorns, having their branches moving to and fro, and the kusa and kāsa grasses with thorny blades constantly undulating; so the wood is full misery.

There are various physical afflictions and divers fears and great misery consequent upon living in the forest. Anger and desires are to be renounced, the heart is to be set on ascetic austerities, fear in the fearful objects is to be cast off; so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: न भेतव्यम् च भेतव्ये नित्यम् दुःखमतो वनम्
transliteration: na bhetavyam ca bhetavye nityam duḥkhamato vanam
english: There are various physical afflictions and divers fears and great misery consequent upon living in the forest. Anger and desires are to be renounced, the heart is to be set on ascetic austerities, fear in the fearful objects is to be cast off; so the wood is full of misery.

sanskrit: तत् अलम् ते वनम् गत्वा क्षमम् न हि वनम् तव
विमृशन्न् इह पश्यामि बहु दोषतरम् वनम्
transliteration: tat alam te vanam gatvā kṣamam na hi vanam tava
vimṛśann iha paśyāmi bahu doṣataram vanam
english: You should not therefore go to the forest, it forebodes no good to you. Weighing well, have I concluded that the forest abounds in innumerable evils.

sanskrit: वनम् तु नेतुम् न कृता मतिस् तदा
न तस्य सीता वचनम् चकार तत्
transliteration: vanam tu netum na kṛtā matis tadā
na tasya sītā vacanam cakāra tat
english: While the high-souled Rāma, resolved thus not to take Sītā with him to the forest, she, greatly sorry, did not accept his words and spoke to him in the following way.

sanskrit: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुह्खिता
प्रसक्त अश्रु मुखी मन्दम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: etat tu vacanam śrutvā sītā rāmasya duhkhitā
prasakta aśru mukhī mandam idam vacanam abravīt
english: Hearing these words of Rāma, Sītā greatly sorry, with tears in her eyes, spoke gently to him the following words.

sanskrit: ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यताम् प्रति
गुणान् इति एव तान् विद्धि तव स्नेह पुरः कृतान्
transliteration: ye tvayā kīrtitā doṣā vane vastavyatām prati
guṇān iti eva tān viddhi tava sneha puraḥ kṛtān
english: The evils, thus enumerated by you of living in the forest, do you know, appear as so many good qualities to me, who have been made forward by your affection.

Deer, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, camaras, srmaras, and other animals which have not seen you before, seeing you, O Rāghava, will stand off, for they all fear you. 1. A fabulous animal supposed to have eight legs and to inhabit particularly the snowy mountains. 2. A kind of deer, or rather the Bos Gruriniens erroneously classed by the Hindu writers amongst the deer. 3. A young deer.

Deer, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, camaras, srmaras, and other animals which have not seen you before, seeing you, O Rāghava, will stand off, for they all fear you. 1. A fabulous animal supposed to have eight legs and to inhabit particularly the snowy mountains. 2. A kind of deer, or rather the Bos Gruriniens erroneously classed by the Hindu writers amongst the deer. 3. A young deer.

sanskrit: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया
त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम्
transliteration: tvayā ca saha gantavyam mayā guru jana ājñayā
tvad viyogena me rāma tyaktavyam iha jīvitam
english: I shall follow you, taking the permission of the respected ones, without you, O, Rāma, I will renounce my life.

sanskrit: न च माम् त्वत् समीपस्थम् अपि शक्नोति राघव
transliteration: na ca mām tvat samīpastham api śaknoti rāghava
english: If I live by you, O Rāghava, Sakra, the lord of celestials, shall not be able with his mighty power to defeat me.

sanskrit: पति हीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम्
कामम् एवम् विधम् राम त्वया मम विदर्शितम्
transliteration: pati hīnā tu yā nārī na sā śakṣyati jīvitum
kāmam evam vidham rāma tvayā mama vidarśitam
english: 'A woman, without her husband, cannot live' this truth has been pointed out by you. O Rāma, to me.

sanskrit: अथ च अपि महा प्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानाम् मया श्रुतम्
पुरा पितृ गृहे सत्यम् वस्तव्यम् किल मे वने
transliteration: atha ca api mahā prājña brāhmaṇānām mayā śrutam
purā pitṛ gṛhe satyam vastavyam kila me vane
english: Besides, I heard before, O you of great intelligence, in my paternal house from the Brāhmaṇas that I should live in the forest.

sanskrit: लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे
वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल
transliteration: lakṣaṇibhyo dvijātibhyaḥ śrutvā aham vacanam gṛhe
vana vāsa kṛta utsāhā nityam eva mahā bala
english: I have heard this from the Brāhmaṇas versed in palmistry, and I have all along been anxious.

sanskrit: आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल
सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा
transliteration: ādeśo vana vāsasya prāptavyaḥ sa mayā kila
sā tvayā saha tatra aham yāsyāmi priya na anyathā
english: O mighty hero, to go to the forest; I shall therefore obtain permission and go, O dearly beloved to the forest with you; nothing can make it otherwise.

sanskrit: कृत आदेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया
कालः च अयम् समुत्पन्नः सत्य वाग् भवतु द्विजः
transliteration: kṛta ādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi saha tvayā
kālaḥ ca ayam samutpannaḥ satya vāg bhavatu dvijaḥ
english: I shall secure permission and follow you; the time has arrived; may the Brāhmaṇas be of truthful words.

sanskrit: वन वासे हि जानामि दुह्खानि बहुधा किल
प्राप्यन्ते नियतम् वीर पुरुषैः अकृत आत्मभिः
transliteration: vana vāse hi jānāmi duhkhāni bahudhā kila
prāpyante niyatam vīra puruṣaiḥ akṛta ātmabhiḥ
english: I know, O great hero, that there are many evils incident to living in the forest; but they generally befall those men who have not their senses subdued.

sanskrit: कन्यया च पितुर् गेहे वन वासः श्रुतः मयाभिक्षिण्याः साधु वृत्ताया मम मातुर् इह अग्रतः
transliteration: kanyayā ca pitur gehe vana vāsaḥ śrutaḥ mayābhikṣiṇyāḥ sādhu vṛttāyā mama mātur iha agrataḥ
english: I heard, when I was a girl, that an ascetic woman of well-disciplined character, came to my mother and apprised her of my future abode in the forest.

sanskrit: प्रसादितः च वै पूर्वम् त्वम् वै बहु विधम् प्रभो
गमनम् वन वासस्य कान्क्षितम् हि सह त्वया
transliteration: prasāditaḥ ca vai pūrvam tvam vai bahu vidham prabho
gamanam vana vāsasya kānkṣitam hi saha tvayā
english: I had requested you, O my lord, many times before in this house to take me to the forest with you for enjoyment, and you ware pleased to agree.

sanskrit: कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव
वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते
transliteration: kṛta kṣaṇā aham bhadram te gamanam prati rāghava
vana vāsasya śūrasya caryā hi mama rocate
english: For your welfare, O Raghava, having received your permission to follow you, I like to serve you, O great hero, while living in the forest.

sanskrit: शुद्ध आत्मन् प्रेम भावाद्द् हि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा
भर्तारम् अनुगच्चन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम्
transliteration: śuddha ātman prema bhāvādd hi bhaviṣyāmi vikalmaṣā
bhartāram anugaccantī bhartā hi mama daivatam
english: O you, pure-hearted one, surely shall I become sinless if I follow my husband, out of affection; for my husband is my Divinity.

sanskrit: प्रेत्य भावे अपि कल्याणः सम्गमः मे सह त्वया
श्रुतिर् हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानाम् यशस्विनाम्
transliteration: pretya bhāve api kalyāṇaḥ samgamaḥ me saha tvayā
śrutir hi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānām yaśasvinām
english: I have heard this pious report from the Brāhmaṇas of great fame that even in after life your company is greatly beneficial to me.

sanskrit: इह लोके च पितृभिर् या स्त्री यस्य महा मते
अद्भिर् दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्य भावे अपि तस्य सा
transliteration: iha loke ca pitṛbhir yā strī yasya mahā mate
adbhir dattā svadharmeṇa pretya bhāve api tasya sā
english: She, who has been given away as wife by her father to one, with due rites of gift peculiar to each class, touching holy water, shall be his, even in her after life.

sanskrit: एवम् अस्मात् स्वकाम् नारीम् सुवृत्ताम् हि पति व्रताम्
न अभिरोचयसे नेतुम् त्वम् माम् केन इह हेतुना
transliteration: evam asmāt svakām nārīm suvṛttām hi pati vratām
na abhirocayase netum tvam mām kena iha hetunā
english: For what reason then did you not wish to take your wife with you who is of good character and devoted to her husband? Do you take me.

sanskrit: भक्ताम् पति व्रताम् दीनाम् माम् समाम् सुख दुह्खयोह्
नेतुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुख दुह्खिनीम्
transliteration: bhaktām pati vratām dīnām mām samām sukha duhkhayoh
netum arhasi kākutstha samāna sukha duhkhinīm
english: O Kākutstha, who am poor in spirit, devoted to my husband, ever given to your service, and participating equally in your joy and sorrow.

sanskrit: यदि माम् दुह्खिताम् एवम् वनम् नेतुम् न च इच्चसि
विषम् अग्निम् जलम् वा अहम् आस्थास्ये मृत्यु कारणात्
transliteration: yadi mām duhkhitām evam vanam netum na ca iccasi
viṣam agnim jalam vā aham āsthāsye mṛtyu kāraṇāt
english: If you do not purpose to take me with you, surely will I do away with my life by drinking poison, entering into fire, or drowning myself in water.

sanskrit: एवम् बहु विधम् तम् सा याचते गमनम् प्रति
न अनुमेने महा बाहुस् ताम् नेतुम् विजनम् वनम्
transliteration: evam bahu vidham tam sā yācate gamanam prati
na anumene mahā bāhus tām netum vijanam vanam
english: She begged Rāma in these and various other means to take her with him, but that mighty hero did not consent to lead her into the lonely forest.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता
स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः
transliteration: evam uktā tu sā cintām maithilī samupāgatā
snāpayantī iva gām uṣṇaiḥ aśrubhir nayana cyutaiḥ
english: Being accosted thus, Maithili was wrapt up in thought and bathed her breast with tears trickling down from her eyes.

sanskrit: चिन्तयन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु निवर्तयितुम् आत्मवान्
ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीताम् काकुत्स्थो बह्व् असान्त्वयत्
transliteration: cintayantīm tathā tām tu nivartayitum ātmavān
tāmroṣṭhīṃ sa tadā sītām kākutstho bahv asāntvayat
english: And Kākutstha having control over his ownself, with a view to dissuade her who was angry and engrossed in anxious thoughts, began to console her in divers way.

sanskrit: सान्त्व्यमाना तु रामेण मैथिली जनक आत्मजा
वन वास निमित्ताय भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sāntvyamānā tu rāmeṇa maithilī janaka ātmajā
vana vāsa nimittāya bhartāram idam abravīt
english: Being consoled thus by Rāma, Maithilī, the daughter of Janaka, fearing separation, lovingly and haughtily laughed at Rāghava of spacious breast, and spoke to him, her husband, the following words with a view to follow him to the forest.

sanskrit: सा तम् उत्तम सम्विग्ना सीता विपुल वक्षसम्
प्रणयाच् च अभिमानाच् च परिचिक्षेप राघवम्
transliteration: sā tam uttama samvignā sītā vipula vakṣasam
praṇayāc ca abhimānāc ca paricikṣepa rāghavam
english: Being consoled thus by Rāma, Maithilī, the daughter of Janaka, fearing separation, lovingly and haughtily laughed at Rāghava of spacious breast, and spoke to him, her husband, the following words with a view to follow him to the forest.

sanskrit: किम् त्वा अमन्यत वैदेहः पिता मे मिथिला अधिपः
राम जामातरम् प्राप्य स्त्रियम् पुरुष विग्रहम्
transliteration: kim tvā amanyata vaidehaḥ pitā me mithilā adhipaḥ
rāma jāmātaram prāpya striyam puruṣa vigraham
english: What thought of you, O Rāma, my father, the king of Mithilā, accepting you as his son-in-law, who was a man if form but (in deeds)a woman?

sanskrit: अनृतम् बल लोको अयम् अज्ञानात् यद्द् हि वक्ष्यति
तेजो न अस्ति परम् रामे तपति इव दिवा करे
transliteration: anṛtam bala loko ayam ajñānāt yadd hi vakṣyati
tejo na asti param rāme tapati iva divā kare
english: Henceforth, if people through ignorance say that the sun has not that burning flood of light which in Rāma does shine forth, woe is them, it is falsehood.

sanskrit: किम् हि कृत्वा विषण्णः त्वम् कुतः वा भयम् अस्ति ते
यत् परित्यक्तु कामः त्वम् माम् अनन्य परायणाम्
transliteration: kim hi kṛtvā viṣaṇṇaḥ tvam kutaḥ vā bhayam asti te
yat parityaktu kāmaḥ tvam mām ananya parāyaṇām
english: Why are you so dejected and whence is your fear that you are willing to leave behind your wife who has none else but you?

sanskrit: सावित्रीम् इव माम् विद्धि त्वम् आत्म वश वर्तिनीम्
transliteration: sāvitrīm iva mām viddhi tvam ātma vaśa vartinīm
english: Know me to be perfectly under your influence like to Sāvitri, following her husband Satyavān, the son of Dyumatsen.

sanskrit: न तु अहम् मनसा अपि अन्यम् द्रष्टा अस्मि त्वद् ऋते अनघ
त्वया राघव गच्चेयम् यथा अन्या कुल पाम्सनी
transliteration: na tu aham manasā api anyam draṣṭā asmi tvad ṛte anagha
tvayā rāghava gacceyam yathā anyā kula pāmsanī
english: I have not, like one bringing stigma on her line, ever in my life thought of a second person, but of you whom I must follow into the forest.

sanskrit: स्वयम् तु भार्याम् कौमारीम् चिरम् अध्युषिताम् सतीम्
शैलूषैव माम् राम परेभ्यो दातुम् इच्चसि
transliteration: svayam tu bhāryām kaumārīm ciram adhyuṣitām satīm
śailūṣaiva mām rāma parebhyo dātum iccasi
english: Do you, like to an ordinary actor, wish to hand me over to others, who am chaste, pure as a virgin, and long held in conjugal affection?

sanskrit: यस्य पथ्यम् च रामात्थ यस्य चार्थेऽवरुध्यसे
त्वम् तस्य भव वश्यश्च विधेयश्छ सदानघ
transliteration: yasya pathyam ca rāmāttha yasya cārthe'varudhyase
tvam tasya bhava vaśyaśca vidheyaścha sadānagha
english: O, sinless one, do you become subservient and serviceable to him whose pleasure you bid me seek, and for whom you have suffered yourself to be impeded (in the installation).

sanskrit: स माम् अनादाय वनम् न त्वम् प्रस्थातुम् अर्हसि
तपो वा यदि वा अरण्यम् स्वर्गो वा स्यात् सह त्वया
transliteration: sa mām anādāya vanam na tvam prasthātum arhasi
tapo vā yadi vā araṇyam svargo vā syāt saha tvayā
english: It does not behove you to repair to the forest without taking me along with you. Be it the austerity of an ascetic, the forest or heaven, with you will I be everywhere.

sanskrit: न च मे भविता तत्र कश्चित् पथि परिश्रमः
पृष्ठतः तव गच्चन्त्या विहार शयनेष्व् अपि
transliteration: na ca me bhavitā tatra kaścit pathi pariśramaḥ
pṛṣṭhataḥ tava gaccantyā vihāra śayaneṣv api
english: No toil shall I suffer on the way, as if lying on a bed of luxury, while following you in they footstep.

sanskrit: कुश काश शर इषीका ये च कण्टकिनो द्रुमाः
तूल अजिन सम स्पर्शा मार्गे मम सह त्वया
transliteration: kuśa kāśa śara iṣīkā ye ca kaṇṭakino drumāḥ
tūla ajina sama sparśā mārge mama saha tvayā
english: When with you, the various thorny grasses, the Kuśa, the Käsa, the Sara, and the Işika, and the thistles and brambles on the way, shall be to me in touch like to linen and deer-skin.

sanskrit: महा वात समुद्धूतम् यन् माम् अवकरिष्यति
रजो रमण तन् मन्ये पर अर्ध्यम् इव चन्दनम्
transliteration: mahā vāta samuddhūtam yan mām avakariṣyati
rajo ramaṇa tan manye para ardhyam iva candanam
english: The dust that will cover me, thrown up by the gush of wind shall be, O ravisher of my heart regarded by me as the finest sandal dust.

sanskrit: शाद्वलेषु यद् आसिष्ये वन अन्ते वन गोरचा
कुथा आस्तरण तल्पेषु किम् स्यात् सुखतरम् ततः
transliteration: śādvaleṣu yad āsiṣye vana ante vana goracā
kuthā āstaraṇa talpeṣu kim syāt sukhataram tataḥ
english: When I shall lie down on the bed of green grass in the forest, it shall appear to me more pleasant than one covered with a coloured blanket.

sanskrit: पत्रम् मूलम् फलम् यत् त्वम् अल्पम् वा यदि वा बहु
दास्यसि स्वयम् आहृत्य तन् मे अमृत रस उपमम्
transliteration: patram mūlam phalam yat tvam alpam vā yadi vā bahu
dāsyasi svayam āhṛtya tan me amṛta rasa upamam
english: Fruits, roots and leaves which you will bring yourself and give me, be they great or small in quantity, shall be to me like to the ambrosiajuice.

sanskrit: न मातुर् न पितुस् तत्र स्मरिष्यामि न वेश्मनः
आर्तवानि उपभुन्जाना पुष्पाणि च फलानि च
transliteration: na mātur na pitus tatra smariṣyāmi na veśmanaḥ
ārtavāni upabhunjānā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
english: I shall never think of my father, mother, or my abode; I shall enjoy fruits and flowers growing in various seasons.

sanskrit: न च तत्र गतः किम्चित् द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि विप्रियम्
मत् कृते न च ते शोको न भविष्यामि दुर्भरा
transliteration: na ca tatra gataḥ kimcit draṣṭum arhasi vipriyam
mat kṛte na ca te śoko na bhaviṣyāmi durbharā
english: You shall not witness any thing disagreeable there; for me you shall not experience any sorrow, no shall I be a burden to you; do you take me with you.

sanskrit: यः त्वया सह स स्वर्गो निरयो यः त्वया विना
इति जानन् पराम् प्रीतिम् गच्च राम मया सह
transliteration: yaḥ tvayā saha sa svargo nirayo yaḥ tvayā vinā
iti jānan parām prītim gacca rāma mayā saha
english: O, Rāma, conceiving with pleasure that your company is a heaven to me and your absence a hell. If you do not take me to the forest which I count freed from all evils, surely I shall drink poison and never come under the influence of my enemies.

sanskrit: अथ माम् एवम् अव्यग्राम् वनम् न एव नयिष्यसि
विषम् अद्य एव पास्यामि मा विशम् द्विषताम् वशम्
transliteration: atha mām evam avyagrām vanam na eva nayiṣyasi
viṣam adya eva pāsyāmi mā viśam dviṣatām vaśam

sanskrit: पश्चात् अपि हि दुह्खेन मम न एव अस्ति जीवितम्
उज्झितायाः त्वया नाथ तदा एव मरणम् वरम्
transliteration: paścāt api hi duhkhena mama na eva asti jīvitam
ujjhitāyāḥ tvayā nātha tadā eva maraṇam varam
english: When through affliction I shall not live after separation, better it is, O Lord, that I die immediately at the time of my being forsaken by you; I cannot bear this grief even for a moment. How shall I be able to live without you for fourteen years?

sanskrit: इदम् हि सहितुम् शोकम् मुहूर्तम् अपि न उत्सहे
किम् पुनर् दश वर्षाणि त्रीणि च एकम् च दुह्खिता
transliteration: idam hi sahitum śokam muhūrtam api na utsahe
kim punar daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi ca ekam ca duhkhitā
english: When through affliction I shall not live after separation, better it is, O Lord, that I die immediately at the time of my being forsaken by you; I cannot bear this grief even for a moment. How shall I be able to live without you for fourteen years?

sanskrit: इति सा शोक सम्तप्ता विलप्य करुणम् बहु
चुक्रोश पतिम् आयस्ता भृशम् आलिन्ग्य सस्वरम्
transliteration: iti sā śoka samtaptā vilapya karuṇam bahu
cukrośa patim āyastā bhṛśam ālingya sasvaram
english: Thus lamenting, Sītā, racked with sorrow, embraced her husband and began to cry aloud.

sanskrit: सा विद्धा बहुभिर् वाक्यैः दिग्धैः इव गज अन्गना
चिर सम्नियतम् बाष्पम् मुमोच अग्निम् इव अरणिः
transliteration: sā viddhā bahubhir vākyaiḥ digdhaiḥ iva gaja anganā
cira samniyatam bāṣpam mumoca agnim iva araṇiḥ
english: Like to a she-elephant, she being pierced by the poisonous shafts of Rāma's words, began to shed tears, long kept off, as an Araņi wood emits fire continually.

sanskrit: तस्याः स्फटिक सम्काशम् वारि सम्ताप सम्भवम्
transliteration: tasyāḥ sphaṭika samkāśam vāri samtāpa sambhavam
english: Tears caused by her sorrow and white as the crystal began to trickle down from her eyes, like to water falling in drops from lotus petals.
And that beautiful face having expansive eyes and resembling the full moon in its splendour, with tears became pale and parched, like to a lotus taken out of its watery bed.

sanskrit: ताम् परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्याम् विसम्ज्ञाम् इव दुह्खिताम्
transliteration: tām pariṣvajya bāhubhyām visamjñām iva duhkhitām
english: Finding her almost insensible with sorrow, Rāma flung his arms round her and reviving her (with consolation) spoke the following words to her.

sanskrit: न देवि तव दुह्खेन स्वर्गम् अपि अभिरोचये
न हि मे अस्ति भयम् किम्चित् स्वयम्भोर् इव सर्वतः
transliteration: na devi tava duhkhena svargam api abhirocaye
na hi me asti bhayam kimcit svayambhor iva sarvataḥ
english: I do not long for, Oh worshipful one, even the abode of celestials gained through your affliction; fear there is none for me like to the self-create Brahma.

sanskrit: तव सर्वम् अभिप्रायम् अविज्ञाय शुभ आनने
वासम् न रोचये अरण्ये शक्तिमान् अपि रक्षणे
transliteration: tava sarvam abhiprāyam avijñāya śubha ānane
vāsam na rocaye araṇye śaktimān api rakṣaṇe
english: Not apprised of your full intention, O you of beautiful countenance, I could not, though capable of escorting you, desire your abode in the forest.

sanskrit: यत् सृष्टा असि मया सार्धम् वन वासाय मैथिलि
न विहातुम् मया शक्या कीर्तिर् आत्मवता यथा
transliteration: yat sṛṣṭā asi mayā sārdham vana vāsāya maithili
na vihātum mayā śakyā kīrtir ātmavatā yathā
english: When you are determined O Maithili, repair to the forest with me, I cannot leave you behind, as one possessing self-knowledge cannot renounce munificence.

sanskrit: धर्मः तु गज नास ऊरु सद्भिर् आचरितः पुरा
तम् च अहम् अनुवर्ते अद्य यथा सूर्यम् सुवर्चला
transliteration: dharmaḥ tu gaja nāsa ūru sadbhir ācaritaḥ purā
tam ca aham anuvarte adya yathā sūryam suvarcalā
english: O you, having thighs resembling the trunks of an elephant, I shall resort to that virtue which was exercised by great and good men going before, do you follow me therefore like Suvarcalā following the Sun.

sanskrit: न खल्वहम् न गच्छेयम् वनम् जनकनन्दिनि
transliteration: na khalvaham na gaccheyam vanam janakanandini
english: I cannot but go to the forest, O daughter of Janaka, as the truthful word of my father leads me thereto.

sanskrit: एष धर्मः तु सुश्रोणि पितुर् मातुः च वश्यता
अतः च आज्ञाम् व्यतिक्रम्य न अहम् जीवितुम् उत्सहे
transliteration: eṣa dharmaḥ tu suśroṇi pitur mātuḥ ca vaśyatā
ataḥ ca ājñām vyatikramya na aham jīvitum utsahe
english: Obedience to his parents is the virtue of a son. Disobeying the command of my father I am not eager to live. we
Why should with meditations and adorations worship Destiny, which is not cognizable to the worshippers, neglecting our parents, who are ever present to our senses?

sanskrit: यत्त्रयम् तत्त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रम् तत्समम् भुवि
transliteration: yattrayam tattrayo lokāḥ pavitram tatsamam bhuvi
english: In the worship of the parents are fulfilled the triple object of religious pursuit, and the adoration of the three regions, there is nothing equal to it, conducing to purity; so do I, O you of excellent-look , resort to it.

sanskrit: न सत्यम् दानमानौ वा न यज्ञाश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः
तथा बलकराः सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्मता
transliteration: na satyam dānamānau vā na yajñāścāptadakṣiṇāḥ
tathā balakarāḥ sīte yathā sevā piturmatā
english: Truth, almsgiving, honour, and sacrifices with profuse gifts are not so strengthening (in life to come) as the service rendered to the parents.

sanskrit: स्वर्गो धनम् वा धान्यम् वा विद्याः पुत्राः सुखानि च
transliteration: svargo dhanam vā dhānyam vā vidyāḥ putrāḥ sukhāni ca
english: Heaven, wealth, grains, learning, son, and happiness, nothing remains inaccessible to us.
Great souls following the desires, and resorting to the service of their parents, get at the abodes of celestials, Gandharvas, the seats of Brahma and Vişnu, and other excellent regions.

sanskrit: स माम् पिता यथा शास्ति सत्य धर्म पथे स्थितः
तथा वर्तितुम् इच्चामि स हि धर्मः सनातनः
transliteration: sa mām pitā yathā śāsti satya dharma pathe sthitaḥ
tathā vartitum iccāmi sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
english: Therefore do I desire to follow what my father commands me, treading in the path of truth, and this is the virtue eternal.

sanskrit: मम सन्ना मतिः सीते त्वाम् नेतुम् दण्डकावनम्
transliteration: mama sannā matiḥ sīte tvām netum daṇḍakāvanam
english: My resolution of not taking you, O Sītā, to the forest of Dandaka is now rent asunder, as you have prepared yourself to live in the forest and follow me.

sanskrit: अनुगच्चस्व माम् भीरु सह धर्म चरी भव
transliteration: anugaccasva mām bhīru saha dharma carī bhava
english: Permitted by me, O fair one of exquisite beauty, to repair to the forest, do you follow me, O you timid one, and be the partner of my righteousness.

sanskrit: सर्वथा सदृशम् सीते मम स्वस्य कुलस्य च
transliteration: sarvathā sadṛśam sīte mama svasya kulasya ca
english: Your determination to follow me, O beautiful one, is very excellent and is in perfect keeping with myself and my family.

sanskrit: नेदानीम् त्वदृते सीते स्वर्गोऽपि मम रोचते
transliteration: nedānīm tvadṛte sīte svargo'pi mama rocate
english: Do you address yourself to repairing to the forest, for without this now even heaven itself does not please me.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेभ्यः च रत्नानि भिक्षुकेभ्यः च भोजनम्
देहि च आशम्समानेभ्यः सम्त्वरस्व च माचिरम्
transliteration: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ ca ratnāni bhikṣukebhyaḥ ca bhojanam
dehi ca āśamsamānebhyaḥ samtvarasva ca māciram
english: Do you give away jewels to the Brāhmaṇas and edibles to the beggars longing for them, and make haste without delay.

sanskrit: शयनीयानि यानानि मम चान्यानि यानि च
transliteration: śayanīyāni yānāni mama cānyāni yāni ca
english: Confer upon the Brāhmaṇas, valuable ornaments, excellent clothes, pleasant toys, beds, conveyances and other fine things in your possession and then what remains do you distribute amongst the servants.

sanskrit: अनुकूलम् तु सा भर्तुर् ज्ञात्वा गमनम् आत्मनः
क्षिप्रम् प्रमुदिता देवी दातुम् एव उपचक्रमे
transliteration: anukūlam tu sā bhartur jñātvā gamanam ātmanaḥ
kṣipram pramuditā devī dātum eva upacakrame

english: Convinced that her going to the forest was desired by her husband, Sītā began to distribute them speedily with a delighted heart.

sanskrit: एवम् श्रुत्वा तु सम्वादम् लक्ष्मणः पूर्वमागतः
transliteration: evam śrutvā tu samvādam lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ
english: Hearing this conversation, Laksmana, who had gone there before, with tears in his eyes and being unable to bear this terrible sorrow, took hold of his brother's feet and spoke thus to that greatly renowned Sītā and Rāghava.

Hearing this conversation, Laksmana, who had gone there before, with tears in his eyes and being unable to bear this terrible sorrow, took hold of his brother's feet and spoke thus to that greatly renowned Sītā and Rāghava.
If you are resolved to repair to the forest filled with deer and elephants, I shall accompany you, always going before with bows in my hands.
You shall range with me in that charming pare of the forest which resounds with the music of the birds and the humming of the bees.

sanskrit: ऐश्वर्यम् वापि लोकानाम् कामये न त्वया विना
transliteration: aiśvaryam vāpi lokānām kāmaye na tvayā vinā
english: Alienated from you I do not long for the abode of the celestials, nor for eternal life, nor for the wealth of the three regions.
The son of Sumitrā, who spoke thus and was determined upon going to the forest, being repeatedly requested by Rāma with consoling words to desist from his purpose, spoke to him the following words.
Formerly you did order me to follow you; and why do you prevent me now from accompanying you to the forest.
I want to learn, Oh sinless one, why you do prevent me now from following you. I entertain a grave doubt in this.

sanskrit: ततः अब्रवीन् महा तेजा रामः लक्ष्मणम् अग्रतः
स्थितम् प्राग् गामिनम् वीरम् याचमानम् कृत अन्जलिम्
transliteration: tataḥ abravīn mahā tejā rāmaḥ lakṣmaṇam agrataḥ
sthitam prāg gāminam vīram yācamānam kṛta anjalim
english: Then the highly effulgent Rāma spoke thus to that sedate Lakşmaņa, who stood praying before him with clasped hands.

sanskrit: प्रियः प्राणसमो वशो भ्राता चापि सखा च मे
transliteration: priyaḥ prāṇasamo vaśo bhrātā cāpi sakhā ca me
english: You are sedate, fond of virtue, of peaceful temper, and you walk always in the paths of righteousness. I hold you dear as my life and you are obedient to me and are my friend.

sanskrit: मया अद्य सह सौमित्रे त्वयि गच्चति तत् वनम्
को भरिष्यति कौसल्याम् सुमित्राम् वा यशस्विनीम्
transliteration: mayā adya saha saumitre tvayi gaccati tat vanam
ko bhariṣyati kausalyām sumitrām vā yaśasvinīm
english: If you do accompany me to you forest, O son of Sumitrā, who shall serve Kausalyā and the highly renowned Sumitrā.

sanskrit: अभिवर्षति कामैः यः पर्जन्यः पृथिवीम् इव
स काम पाश पर्यस्तः महा तेजा मही पतिः
transliteration: abhivarṣati kāmaiḥ yaḥ parjanyaḥ pṛthivīm iva
sa kāma pāśa paryastaḥ mahā tejā mahī patiḥ
english: That highly effulgent lord of earth who will satisfy the world with the fulfilment of its desires like to rain spreading in showers over the earth, is himself now shackled with desires to Kaikeyi.

sanskrit: सा हि राज्यम् इदम् प्राप्य नृपस्य अश्व पतेः सुता
transliteration: sā hi rājyam idam prāpya nṛpasya aśva pateḥ sutā
english: That daughter of Aśvapati obtaining this kingdom from the monarch, there will be no end of the miseries of these co-wives.

sanskrit: न स्मरिष्यति कौसल्याम् सुमित्राम् च सुदुःखिताम्
transliteration: na smariṣyati kausalyām sumitrām ca suduḥkhitām
english: Bharata attaining the throne and siding his mother, Kaikeyī will never think of Kausalyā or Sumitrā sore distressed with grief.
Do you therefore, Oh son of Sumitrā, live here of your won accord or by the favour of the monarch, and maintain these worshipful ones.

sanskrit: एवम् मम च ते भक्तिर्भविष्यति सुदर्शिता
transliteration: evam mama ca te bhaktirbhaviṣyati sudarśitā
english: If you do act thus, it will be showing your best regard in me. O you, versed in the knowledge of religion, real virtue consists in the adoration of superiors.
Do this oh son of Sumitrā, for my sake; if we all go away leaving her aside, she will not be happy in any way.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः श्लक्ष्णया गिरा
प्रत्युवाच तदा रामम् वाक्यज्ञो वाक्य कोविदम्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ ślakṣṇayā girā
pratyuvāca tadā rāmam vākyajño vākya kovidam
english: Accosted thus by Rama, Laksmana, well versed in speech, spoke to him the following humble words.

sanskrit: तव एव तेजसा वीर भरतः पूजयिष्यति
कौसल्याम् च सुमित्राम् च प्रयतः न अत्र सम्शयः
transliteration: tava eva tejasā vīra bharataḥ pūjayiṣyati
kausalyām ca sumitrām ca prayataḥ na atra samśayaḥ
english: Being afraid of your power, O hero, Bharata shall adore. Kausalyā and Sumitrā, there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit: कौसल्या बिभृयात् आर्या सहस्रम् अपि मद् विधान्
transliteration: kausalyā bibhṛyāt āryā sahasram api mad vidhān

english: Do you therefore-permit me to follow you; there will be no breach of virtue in this, and I shall have my desires attained and your interests shall be secured.

sanskrit: धनुर् आदाय सशरम् खनित्र पिटका धरः
transliteration: dhanur ādāya saśaram khanitra piṭakā dharaḥ
english: I shall go before you pointing out your course, with stringed bows, a hoe, and a basket in my hands.

sanskrit: आहरिष्यामि ते नित्यम् मूलानि च फलानि च
वन्यानि यानि च अन्यानि स्वाहाराणि तपस्विनाम्
transliteration: āhariṣyāmi te nityam mūlāni ca phalāni ca
vanyāni yāni ca anyāni svāhārāṇi tapasvinām
english: I shall bring for you every day various roots and fruits and other that grow in the forest and which the ascetics use in their sacrifice.

sanskrit: भवाम्स् तु सह वैदेह्या गिरि सानुषु रम्स्यते
अहम् सर्वम् करिष्यामि जाग्रतः स्वपतः च ते
transliteration: bhavāms tu saha vaidehyā giri sānuṣu ramsyate
aham sarvam kariṣyāmi jāgrataḥ svapataḥ ca te
english: You shall amuse yourself with Vaidehī on the sides of the hill, and I shall perform everything for you whether you are asleep or awake.

sanskrit: रामः तु अनेन वाक्येन सुप्रीतः प्रत्युवाच तम्
व्रज आपृच्चस्व सौमित्रे सर्वम् एव सुहृज् जनम्
transliteration: rāmaḥ tu anena vākyena suprītaḥ pratyuvāca tam
vraja āpṛccasva saumitre sarvam eva suhṛj janam
english: Being extremely gratified with these words, Rāma spoke to him, saying, Do you follow me, O son of Sumitrā, obtaining permission from all your relatives.

sanskrit: ये च राज्ञो ददौ दिव्ये महात्मा वरुणः स्वयम्
जनकस्य महा यज्ञे धनुषी रौद्र दर्शने
transliteration: ye ca rājño dadau divye mahātmā varuṇaḥ svayam
janakasya mahā yajñe dhanuṣī raudra darśane
english: The high-souled Varuņa himself offered two terrible-looking bows of ethereal temper, two sets of weapons at the great sacrifice of the royal Janaka, namely, impenetrable mail, two quivers, two inexhaustible arrows, two swords burnished with gold and bright as the sun. These things were offered to me as bridal presents, and I have kept them at the house of my preceptor. Do you, O Lakşmaņa, paying homage to my preceptor, taking all those weapons, swiftly bring them hither. Determined upon going to the forest, Lakşmaņa, taking leave of his friends, went to the abode of the spiritual preceptor of the Ikşvākus and took from him those excellent weapons.

sanskrit: अभेद्य कवचे दिव्ये तूणी च अक्षय सायकौ
आदित्य विमलौ च उभौ खड्गौ हेम परिष्कृतौ
transliteration: abhedya kavace divye tūṇī ca akṣaya sāyakau
āditya vimalau ca ubhau khaḍgau hema pariṣkṛtau

sanskrit: सत्कृत्य निहितम् सर्वम् एतत् आचार्य सद्मनि
स त्वम् आयुधम् आदाय क्षिप्रम् आव्रज लक्ष्मण
transliteration: satkṛtya nihitam sarvam etat ācārya sadmani
sa tvam āyudham ādāya kṣipram āvraja lakṣmaṇa

sanskrit: स सुहृज् जनम् आमन्त्र्य वन वासाय निश्चितः
इष्क्वाकु गुरुम् आमन्त्र्य जग्राह आयुधम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: sa suhṛj janam āmantrya vana vāsāya niścitaḥ
iṣkvāku gurum āmantrya jagrāha āyudham uttamam

sanskrit: तत् दिव्यम् राज शार्दूलः सत्कृतम् माल्य भूषितम्
रामाय दर्शयाम् आस सौमित्रिः सर्वम् आयुधम्
transliteration: tat divyam rāja śārdūlaḥ satkṛtam mālya bhūṣitam
rāmāya darśayām āsa saumitriḥ sarvam āyudham
english: And that best of princes, the son of Sumitrā, showed Rāma those heavenly arms worshipped and well adorned with garlands...........

sanskrit: तम् उवाच आत्मवान् रामः प्रीत्या लक्ष्मणम् आगतम्
काले त्वम् आगतः सौम्य कान्क्षिते मम लक्ष्मण
transliteration: tam uvāca ātmavān rāmaḥ prītyā lakṣmaṇam āgatam
kāle tvam āgataḥ saumya kānkṣite mama lakṣmaṇa
english: Seeing Laksmana arrive there, Rama, having control over his ownself, greatly pleased, spoke to him the following words. "You have arrived, O Laksmana, just when I wanted you."

sanskrit: अहम् प्रदातुम् इच्चामि यद् इदम् मामकम् धनम्
transliteration: aham pradātum iccāmi yad idam māmakam dhanam
english: I want to distribute with you these my riches amongst the Brāhmaṇas and the ascetics.

sanskrit: वसन्ति इह दृढम् भक्त्या गुरुषु द्विज सत्तमाः
तेषाम् अपि च मे भूयः सर्वेषाम् च उपजीविनाम्
transliteration: vasanti iha dṛḍham bhaktyā guruṣu dvija sattamāḥ
teṣām api ca me bhūyaḥ sarveṣām ca upajīvinām
english: There are many excellent Brāhmaṇas having firm reverence in their preceptor. I want to distribute my wealth amongst them and many other personages who depend upon me for their maintenance.
Bring here speedily the worshipful Suyajña, the son of Vasiştha; want to repair to the forest after duly adoring him and other excellent Brahmanas.

sanskrit: ततः शासनम् आज्ञाय भ्रातुः शुभतरम् प्रियम्
गत्वा स प्रविवेश आशु सुयज्ञस्य निवेशनम्
transliteration: tataḥ śāsanam ājñāya bhrātuḥ śubhataram priyam
gatvā sa praviveśa āśu suyajñasya niveśanam

sanskrit: तम् विप्रम् अग्नि अगारस्थम् वन्दित्वा लक्ष्मणो अब्रवीत्
सखे अभ्यागच्च पश्य त्वम् वेश्म दुष्कर कारिणः
transliteration: tam vipram agni agārastham vanditvā lakṣmaṇo abravīt
sakhe abhyāgacca paśya tvam veśma duṣkara kāriṇaḥ
english: Receiving this pleasant and beneficial mandate of his brother, Lakşmaņa speedily went to the abode of Sujajña, and finding thai vipra in the chamber where the sacrificial fire was maintained, worshipped him and addressed him, saying; "friend, come and behold the abode of that one of arduous deeds(Răma) renouncing his incoming installation.”

sanskrit: ततः सम्ध्याम् उपास्य आशु गत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह
जुष्टम् तत् प्राविशल् लक्ष्म्या रम्यम् राम निवेशनम्
transliteration: tataḥ samdhyām upāsya āśu gatvā saumitriṇā saha
juṣṭam tat prāviśal lakṣmyā ramyam rāma niveśanam
english: Finishing his prayers, Sujajña accompanied Lakşmaņa and arrived at the splendid mansion of Rama, filled with riches.

sanskrit: तम् आगतम् वेदविदम् प्रान्जलिः सीतया सह
सुयज्ञम् अभिचक्राम राघवो अग्निम् इव अर्चितम्
transliteration: tam āgatam vedavidam prānjaliḥ sītayā saha
suyajñam abhicakrāma rāghavo agnim iva arcitam

sanskrit: जात रूपमयैः मुख्यैः अन्गदैः कुण्डलैः शुभैः
सहेम सूत्रैः मणिभिः केयूरैः वलयैः अपि
transliteration: jāta rūpamayaiḥ mukhyaiḥ angadaiḥ kuṇḍalaiḥ śubhaiḥ
sahema sūtraiḥ maṇibhiḥ keyūraiḥ valayaiḥ api

sanskrit: अन्यैः च रत्नैः बहुभिः काकुत्स्थः प्रत्यपूजयत्
