sanskrit: स मूद्र्ह्नि बद्ध्वा रुदती राज्ञः पद्मम् इव अन्जलिम्
सम्भ्रमात् अब्रवीत् त्रस्ता त्वरमाण अक्षरम् वचः
transliteration: sa mūdrhni baddhvā rudatī rājñaḥ padmam iva anjalim
sambhramāt abravīt trastā tvaramāṇa akṣaram vacaḥ
english: And weeping, she drew on her head the joined hands of the king resembling lotuses; and then flurried spoke these words hurriedly informed with extreme affection.

sanskrit: प्रसीद शिरसा याचे भूमौ निततिता अस्मि ते
याचिता अस्मि हता देव हन्तव्या अहम् न हि त्वया
transliteration: prasīda śirasā yāce bhūmau nitatitā asmi te
yācitā asmi hatā deva hantavyā aham na hi tvayā
english: Be you propitious; I beseech with (bended) head. I bow to you, falling on the ground. O reverend one, besought by you, I shall be undone. I do not deserve to be forgiven by you.

sanskrit: न एषा हि सा स्त्री भवति श्लाघनीयेन धीमता
उभयोः लोकयोः वीर पत्या या सम्प्रसाद्यते
transliteration: na eṣā hi sā strī bhavati ślāghanīyena dhīmatā
ubhayoḥ lokayoḥ vīra patyā yā samprasādyate
english: She cannot be reckoned a gentlewoman, who is propitiated by her intelligent husband, worthy of being extolled in both worlds.

sanskrit: जानामि धर्मम् धर्मज्ञ त्वाम् जाने सत्यवादिनम्
पुत्र शोक आर्तया तत् तु मया किम् अपि भाषितम्
transliteration: jānāmi dharmam dharmajña tvām jāne satyavādinam
putra śoka ārtayā tat tu mayā kim api bhāṣitam
english: I know duty, O righteous one; I know that you are truth-telling. And it is because I was exceedingly distressed on account of my son that I spoke harshly to you.

sanskrit: शोको नाशयते धैर्यम् शोको नाशयते श्रुतम्
शोको नाशयते सर्वम् न अस्ति शोक समः रिपुः
transliteration: śoko nāśayate dhairyam śoko nāśayate śrutam
śoko nāśayate sarvam na asti śoka samaḥ ripuḥ
english: Sorrow destroys patience, sorrow destroys knowledge of the scriptures, sorrow destroys every things; there is no enemy like to sorrow.

sanskrit: शक्यम् आपतितः सोढुम् प्रहरः रिपु हस्ततः
सोढुम् आपतितः शोकः सुसूक्ष्मः अपि न शक्यते
transliteration: śakyam āpatitaḥ soḍhum praharaḥ ripu hastataḥ
soḍhum āpatitaḥ śokaḥ susūkṣmaḥ api na śakyate
english: One can falling down bear ever beating from an enemy; but one cannot falling down bear ever so little sorrow.

sanskrit: वन वासाय रामस्य पन्च रात्रः अद्य गण्यते
यः शोक हत हर्षायाः पन्च वर्ष उपमः मम
transliteration: vana vāsāya rāmasya panca rātraḥ adya gaṇyate
yaḥ śoka hata harṣāyāḥ panca varṣa upamaḥ mama
english: This is the fifth night of the banishment of Rāma, as calculated by me; and to me rendered cheerless by sorrow, this interval has assumed the proportions of five years.

sanskrit: तम् हि चिन्तयमानायाः शोको अयम् हृदि वर्धते
अदीनाम् इव वेगेन समुद्र सलिलम् महत्
transliteration: tam hi cintayamānāyāḥ śoko ayam hṛdi vardhate
adīnām iva vegena samudra salilam mahat
english: And fostered by thought on my part, this grief increases in my bosom, like the mighty waters of the ocean increased by the vehement discharge of rivers.

sanskrit: एवम् हि कथयन्त्याः तु कौसल्यायाः शुभम् वचः
मन्द रश्मिर् अभूत् सुर्यो रजनी च अभ्यवर्तत
transliteration: evam hi kathayantyāḥ tu kausalyāyāḥ śubham vacaḥ
manda raśmir abhūt suryo rajanī ca abhyavartata
english: As Kausalyā was thus speaking auspiciously, the rays of the sun grew milder, and the night arrived. Cheered up by the words of Kausalya, the king overcome by grief, felt the influence of sleep.

sanskrit: तथ प्रह्लादितः वाक्यैः देव्या कौसल्यया नृपः
शोकेन च समाक्रान्तः निद्राया वशम् एयिवान्
transliteration: tatha prahlāditaḥ vākyaiḥ devyā kausalyayā nṛpaḥ
śokena ca samākrāntaḥ nidrāyā vaśam eyivān
english: As Kausalyā was thus speaking auspiciously, the rays of the sun grew milder, and the night arrived. Cheered up by the words of Kausalya, the king overcome by grief, felt the influence of sleep.

sanskrit: प्रतिबुद्धो मुहुर् तेन शोक उपहत चेतनः
अथ राजा दशरथः स चिन्ताम् अभ्यपद्यत
transliteration: pratibuddho muhur tena śoka upahata cetanaḥ
atha rājā daśarathaḥ sa cintām abhyapadyata
english: Starting in a moment from sleep, king Dasaratha deprived (almost) of his consciousness by grief, (again) became a prey to thought.

sanskrit: राम लक्ष्मणयोः चैव विवासात् वासव उपमम्
आविवेश उपसर्गः तम् तमः सूर्यम् इव आसुरम्
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ caiva vivāsāt vāsava upamam
āviveśa upasargaḥ tam tamaḥ sūryam iva āsuram
english: I consequence of the exile of Rāma and Laks mana, the king resembling Våsava was overpowered by grief, like the darkness of Rāhu enveloping the sun. was own

Then on Răma's having gone along with his wife, the lord of the Kosalas, remembering his own misdeed, felt anxious to communicate himself to that lady having her eyes furnished with dark outer corners.

sanskrit: स राजा रजनीम् षष्ठीम् रामे प्रव्रजिते वनम्
अर्ध रात्रे दशरथः सम्स्मरन् दुष्कृतम् कृतम्
transliteration: sa rājā rajanīm ṣaṣṭhīm rāme pravrajite vanam
ardha rātre daśarathaḥ samsmaran duṣkṛtam kṛtam
english: And on the sixth night after Rāma had repaired to the forest, the king Dasaratha, when it midnight, remembered his unrighteous act.

sanskrit: कौसल्याम् पुत्र शोक आर्ताम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: kausalyām putra śoka ārtām idam vacanam abravīt
english: And then to Kausalyā aggrieved on account of her son, her spoke these words.

sanskrit: यद् आचरति कल्याणि शुभम् वा यदि वा अशुभम्
तत् एव लभते भद्रे कर्ता कर्मजम् आत्मनः
transliteration: yad ācarati kalyāṇi śubham vā yadi vā aśubham
tat eva labhate bhadre kartā karmajam ātmanaḥ
english: As are the actions of one, O auspicious one, whether good otherwise, the consequences, O gentle lady, reaped by the doer of them.

sanskrit: गुरु लाघवम् अर्थानाम् आरम्भे कर्मणाम् फलम्
दोषम् वा यो न जानाति स बालैति ह उच्यते
transliteration: guru lāghavam arthānām ārambhe karmaṇām phalam
doṣam vā yo na jānāti sa bālaiti ha ucyate
english: He that on the eve of beginning an action either relating to this world or the next, does not take into consideration the fact that actions entail consequences light or grave, disagreeable (or otherwise), is styled a child.

sanskrit: कश्चित् आम्र वणम् चित्त्वा पलाशामः च निषिन्चति
पुष्पम् दृष्ट्वा फले गृध्नुः स शोचति फल आगमे
transliteration: kaścit āmra vaṇam cittvā palāśāmaḥ ca niṣincati
puṣpam dṛṣṭvā phale gṛdhnuḥ sa śocati phala āgame
english: He that cutting down a mango grove, waters Palasa trees, beholding the flowers (blooming), will covet fruits; and grieve when their season arrives. The person that without apprehending (the principle of causation) rushed to action, grieves at the season of fruits, even like him that waters kinsuka trees (hewing down his mango grove). or are

sanskrit: अविज्ञाय फलम् यो हि कर्म त्वेवानुधावति
transliteration: avijñāya phalam yo hi karma tvevānudhāvati
english: He that cutting down a mango grove, waters Palasa trees, beholding the flowers (blooming), will covet fruits; and grieve when their season arrives. The person that without apprehending (the principle of causation) rushed to action, grieves at the season of fruits, even like him that waters kinsuka trees (hewing down his mango grove). or are

sanskrit: सो अहम् आम्र वणम् चित्त्वा पलाशामः च न्यषेचयम्
रामम् फल आगमे त्यक्त्वा पश्चात् शोचामि दुर्मतिः
transliteration: so aham āmra vaṇam cittvā palāśāmaḥ ca nyaṣecayam
rāmam phala āgame tyaktvā paścāt śocāmi durmatiḥ
english: And is this way, I fool that I am having hewn down my grove of mangoes and watered Palāsas, having renounced Räma in the season of fruit, is grieving in the end.

sanskrit: कुमारः शब्द वेधी इति मया पापम् इदम् कृतम्
transliteration: kumāraḥ śabda vedhī iti mayā pāpam idam kṛtam
english: Having, O Kausalyā, earned the expression, 'The Prince can pierce his aim by sound alone,', I, a prince and bowman, did this offence.

sanskrit: तत् इदम् मे अनुसम्प्राप्तम् देवि दुह्खम् स्वयम् कृतम्
सम्मोहात् इह बालेन यथा स्यात् भक्षितम् विषम्
transliteration: tat idam me anusamprāptam devi duhkham svayam kṛtam
sammohāt iha bālena yathā syāt bhakṣitam viṣam
english: Therefore, O noble dame, I have myself brought this misfortune on me, like a child who has eaten poison through ignorance.

sanskrit: एवम् मम अपि अविज्ञातम् शब्द वेध्यमयम् फलम्
transliteration: evam mama api avijñātam śabda vedhyamayam phalam
english: Even like another person fascinated by the sight of some Palasa trees (and doing as mentioned above), I (did this act) not fore knowing the consequence that would follow my shooting by sound.

sanskrit: देव्य् अनूढा त्वम् अभवो युव राजो भवाम्य् अहम्
ततः प्रावृड् अनुप्राप्ता मद काम विवर्धिनी
transliteration: devy anūḍhā tvam abhavo yuva rājo bhavāmy aham
tataḥ prāvṛḍ anuprāptā mada kāma vivardhinī
english: O lady, you were then unwedded; and I was a youthful prince. And it was at this time that the rainy season increasing my desire set in.

sanskrit: उपास्यहि रसान् भौमाम्स् तप्त्वा च जगद् अम्शुभिः
परेत आचरिताम् भीमाम् रविर् आविशते दिशम्
transliteration: upāsyahi rasān bhaumāms taptvā ca jagad amśubhiḥ
pareta ācaritām bhīmām ravir āviśate diśam
english: Drawing moisture from the ground and heated the earth by his rays, the Sun goes to the dreadful quarter whither repair the dead.

sanskrit: उष्णम् अन्तर् दधे सद्यः स्निग्धा ददृशिरे घनाः
ततः जहृषिरे सर्वे भेक सारन्ग बर्हिणः
transliteration: uṣṇam antar dadhe sadyaḥ snigdhā dadṛśire ghanāḥ
tataḥ jahṛṣire sarve bheka sāranga barhiṇaḥ
english: The heat was immediately dispelled, and the gelid clouds snowed themselves; and frogs and Sārangas and peacocks began to rejoice; and, finding it unpleasant, the feathered ones bathed and with the surface of their plumage shrunk up from the wet, took refuge in trees shaken by the wind and rain.

The heat was immediately dispelled, and the gelid clouds snowed themselves; and frogs and Sārangas and peacocks began to rejoice; and, finding it unpleasant, the feathered ones bathed and with the surface of their plumage shrunk up from the wet, took refuge in trees shaken by the wind and rain.

sanskrit: पतितेन अम्भसा चन्नः पतमानेन च असकृत्
आबभौ मत्त सारन्गः तोय राशिर् इव अचलः
transliteration: patitena ambhasā cannaḥ patamānena ca asakṛt
ābabhau matta sārangaḥ toya rāśir iva acalaḥ
english: And the hill graced by maddened Sārangas, covered by showers falling simultaneously looked like a mass of waters.
And the waters although unstained, being mixed up with mineral substances and ashes from the mountains, flowed in serpentine torrents black and red.

sanskrit: तस्मिन्न् अतिसुखे काले धनुष्मान् इषुमान् रथी
व्यायाम कृत सम्कल्पः सरयूम् अन्वगाम् नदीम्
transliteration: tasminn atisukhe kāle dhanuṣmān iṣumān rathī
vyāyāma kṛta samkalpaḥ sarayūm anvagām nadīm
english: At such a sweet hour, I intent upon taking exercise, taking my bow and arrows and mounted on my car, sallied out for the river Sarayū, with the intention that I with my senses under control, should in the watery expense slay any buffalo, elephant, or any other beast that mighty have come there in the night.

sanskrit: निपाने महिषम् रात्रौ गजम् वा अभ्यागतम् नदीम्
अन्यम् वा श्वा पदम् कम्चिज् जिघाम्सुर् अजित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: nipāne mahiṣam rātrau gajam vā abhyāgatam nadīm
anyam vā śvā padam kamcij jighāmsur ajita indriyaḥ
english: At such a sweet hour, I intent upon taking exercise, taking my bow and arrows and mounted on my car, sallied out for the river Sarayū, with the intention that I with my senses under control, should in the watery expense slay any buffalo, elephant, or any other beast that mighty have come there in the night.

sanskrit: अन्यम् चापि मृगम् हिम्स्रम् शब्दम् श्रुत्वाभु पागतम्
अथ अन्ध कारे तु अश्रौषम् जले कुम्भस्य पर्यतः
transliteration: anyam cāpi mṛgam himsram śabdam śrutvābhu pāgatam
atha andha kāre tu aśrauṣam jale kumbhasya paryataḥ

sanskrit: अचक्षुर् विषये घोषम् वारणस्य इव नर्दतः
ततः अहम् शरम् उद्धृत्य दीप्तम् आशी विष उपमम्
transliteration: acakṣur viṣaye ghoṣam vāraṇasya iva nardataḥ
tataḥ aham śaram uddhṛtya dīptam āśī viṣa upamam

sanskrit: अमुन्चम् निशितम् बाणम् अहम् आशी विष उपमम्
transliteration: amuncam niśitam bāṇam aham āśī viṣa upamam

sanskrit: तत्र वाग् उषसि व्यक्ता प्रादुर् आसीद् वन ओकसः
हा हा इति पततः तोये बाणाभिहतमर्मणः
transliteration: tatra vāg uṣasi vyaktā prādur āsīd vana okasaḥ
hā hā iti patataḥ toye bāṇābhihatamarmaṇaḥ
english: Thereupon from the spot whereto the sharpened shaft resembling a poisonous snake had been discharged by me in the twilight, proceeded cries of 'Oh' and 'Alas' uttered by a forester pierced to the quick by the arrow, and falling into the water. And when he had dropped down, words spoken by a human being became audible.

sanskrit: कथम् अस्मद् विधे शस्त्रम् निपतेत् तु तपस्विनि
transliteration: katham asmad vidhe śastram nipatet tu tapasvini

sanskrit: प्रविविक्ताम् नदीम् रात्राव् उदाहारः अहम् आगतः
इषुणा अभिहतः केन कस्य वा किम् कृतम् मया
transliteration: praviviktām nadīm rātrāv udāhāraḥ aham āgataḥ
iṣuṇā abhihataḥ kena kasya vā kim kṛtam mayā

sanskrit: ऋषेर् हि न्यस्त दण्डस्य वने वन्येन जीवतः
कथम् नु शस्त्रेण वधो मद् विधस्य विधीयते
transliteration: ṛṣer hi nyasta daṇḍasya vane vanyena jīvataḥ
katham nu śastreṇa vadho mad vidhasya vidhīyate

sanskrit: जटा भार धरस्य एव वल्कल अजिन वाससः
को वधेन मम अर्थी स्यात् किम् वा अस्य अपकृतम् मया
transliteration: jaṭā bhāra dharasya eva valkala ajina vāsasaḥ
ko vadhena mama arthī syāt kim vā asya apakṛtam mayā

sanskrit: एवम् निष्फलम् आरब्धम् केवल अनर्थ सम्हितम्
न कश्चित् साधु मन्येत यथैव गुरु तल्पगम्
transliteration: evam niṣphalam ārabdham kevala anartha samhitam
na kaścit sādhu manyeta yathaiva guru talpagam

sanskrit: नहम् तथा अनुशोचामि जीवित क्षयम् आत्मनः
मातरम् पितरम् च उभाव् अनुशोचामि मद् विधे
transliteration: naham tathā anuśocāmi jīvita kṣayam ātmanaḥ
mātaram pitaram ca ubhāv anuśocāmi mad vidhe

sanskrit: तत् एतान् मिथुनम् वृद्धम् चिर कालभृतम् मया
मयि पन्चत्वम् आपन्ने काम् वृत्तिम् वर्तयिष्यति
transliteration: tat etān mithunam vṛddham cira kālabhṛtam mayā
mayi pancatvam āpanne kām vṛttim vartayiṣyati

sanskrit: वृद्धौ च माता पितराव् अहम् च एक इषुणा हतः
केन स्म निहताः सर्वे सुबालेन अकृत आत्मना
transliteration: vṛddhau ca mātā pitarāv aham ca eka iṣuṇā hataḥ
kena sma nihatāḥ sarve subālena akṛta ātmanā

sanskrit: तम् गिरम् करुणाम् श्रुत्वा मम धर्म अनुकान्क्षिणः
कराभ्याम् सशरम् चापम् व्यथितस्य अपतत् भुवि
transliteration: tam giram karuṇām śrutvā mama dharma anukānkṣiṇaḥ
karābhyām saśaram cāpam vyathitasya apatat bhuvi

sanskrit: तस्याहम् करुणम् श्रुत्वा निशि लालपतो बहु
transliteration: tasyāham karuṇam śrutvā niśi lālapato bahu

sanskrit: तम् देशम् अहम् आगम्य दीन सत्त्वः सुदुर्मनाः
अपश्यम् इषुणा तीरे सरय्वाः तापसम् हतम्
transliteration: tam deśam aham āgamya dīna sattvaḥ sudurmanāḥ
apaśyam iṣuṇā tīre sarayvāḥ tāpasam hatam

sanskrit: स माम् उद्वीक्ष्य नेत्राभ्याम् त्रस्तम् अस्वस्थ चेतसम्
इति उवाच वचः क्रूरम् दिधक्षन्न् इव तेजसा
transliteration: sa mām udvīkṣya netrābhyām trastam asvastha cetasam
iti uvāca vacaḥ krūram didhakṣann iva tejasā

sanskrit: किम् तव अपकृतम् राजन् वने निवसता मया
जिहीर्षिउर् अम्भो गुर्व् अर्थम् यद् अहम् ताडितः त्वया
transliteration: kim tava apakṛtam rājan vane nivasatā mayā
jihīrṣiur ambho gurv artham yad aham tāḍitaḥ tvayā
english: What wrong, O monarch, had I residing in the woods done you, that coming to procure water for my parents, I have been thus afflicted by. you?

sanskrit: एकेन खलु बाणेन मर्मणि अभिहते मयि
द्वाव् अन्धौ निहतौ वृद्धौ माता जनयिता च मे
transliteration: ekena khalu bāṇena marmaṇi abhihate mayi
dvāv andhau nihatau vṛddhau mātā janayitā ca me
english: By piercing my marrow with a shaft, you have slain both my aged and blind father and mother.

sanskrit: तौ नूनम् दुर्बलाव् अन्धौ मत् प्रतीक्षौ पिपासितौ
चिरम् आशा कृताम् तृष्णाम् कष्टाम् सम्धारयिष्यतः
transliteration: tau nūnam durbalāv andhau mat pratīkṣau pipāsitau
ciram āśā kṛtām tṛṣṇām kaṣṭām samdhārayiṣyataḥ
english: Surely, they feeble and blind, who afflicted by thirst are remaining in expectation of me, will now bear (the stress and tension of) the expectation as well as the parching thirst.

sanskrit: न नूनम् तपसो वा अस्ति फल योगः श्रुतस्य वा
पिता यन् माम् न जानाति शयानम् पतितम् भुवि
transliteration: na nūnam tapaso vā asti phala yogaḥ śrutasya vā
pitā yan mām na jānāti śayānam patitam bhuvi
english: Surely asceticism and study carry no fruit with them, since I lying low on the ground, my father knows nothing about it.

sanskrit: जानन्न् अपि च किम् कुर्यात् अशक्तिर् अपरिक्रमः
चिद्यमानम् इव अशक्तः त्रातुम् अन्यो नगो नगम्
transliteration: jānann api ca kim kuryāt aśaktir aparikramaḥ
cidyamānam iva aśaktaḥ trātum anyo nago nagam
english: And what could he do, even if he knew it, being as he is incapable and unable to go about? One tree cannot rescue another that is being battered (by the winds).

sanskrit: पितुस् त्वम् एव मे गत्वा शीघ्रम् आचक्ष्व राघव
न त्वाम् अनुदहेत् क्रुद्धो वनम् वह्निर् इव एधितः
transliteration: pitus tvam eva me gatvā śīghram ācakṣva rāghava
na tvām anudahet kruddho vanam vahnir iva edhitaḥ
english: Do you, O descendant of Raghu, yourself going to my father, speedily inform of him this that has occurred. But take care that like a fire waxing furious consuming a woods, he in his ire do not burn you.

sanskrit: इयम् एक पदी राजन् यतः मे पितुर् आश्रमः
तम् प्रसादय गत्वा त्वम् न त्वाम् स कुपितः शपेत्
transliteration: iyam eka padī rājan yataḥ me pitur āśramaḥ
tam prasādaya gatvā tvam na tvām sa kupitaḥ śapet
english: This narrow way, O king, will lead you to my father's dwelling. Do you going there, pacify him, so that getting wroth he may not curse you.

sanskrit: विशल्यम् कुरु माम् राजन् मर्म मे निशितः शरः
रुणद्धि मृदु स उत्सेधम् तीरम् अम्बु रयो यथा
transliteration: viśalyam kuru mām rājan marma me niśitaḥ śaraḥ
ruṇaddhi mṛdu sa utsedham tīram ambu rayo yathā
english: Do you (now), O king, take out the arrow. Your sharpened shaft afflicts my marrow, like the tide of a river wearing away a hollowheaving sand bank.

But touching the extracting of the arrow, this thought perplexed me: 'If the arrow is left alone, it pains; if extracted, death ensues.' As I was distressed, aggrieved an afflicted with sorrow, the son of the ascetic perceived my anxiety.

sanskrit: दुःखितस्य च दीनस्य मम शोकातुरस्य च
transliteration: duḥkhitasya ca dīnasya mama śokāturasya ca
english: But touching the extracting of the arrow, this thought perplexed me: 'If the arrow is left alone, it pains; if extracted, death ensues.' As I was distressed, aggrieved an afflicted with sorrow, the son of the ascetic perceived my anxiety.

sanskrit: न द्विजातिर् अहम् राजन् मा भूत् ते मनसो व्यथा
शूद्रायाम् अस्मि वैश्येन जातः जन पद अधिप
transliteration: na dvijātir aham rājan mā bhūt te manaso vyathā
śūdrāyām asmi vaiśyena jātaḥ jana pada adhipa

sanskrit: इति इव वदतः कृच्च्रात् बाण अभिहत मर्मणः
transliteration: iti iva vadataḥ kṛccrāt bāṇa abhihata marmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: तस्य तु आनम्यमानस्य तम् बाणम् अहम् उद्धरम्
transliteration: tasya tu ānamyamānasya tam bāṇam aham uddharam

sanskrit: जल आर्द्र गात्रम् तु विलप्य कृच्चान्
transliteration: jala ārdra gātram tu vilapya kṛccān
english: On beholding him with his body dripping with water, and mortally wounded, and breathing hard without respite, after he had bewailed his mortal wound, lying on the banks of the Sarayü, I lamented him and was, O gentle lady, greatly aggrieved.

sanskrit: विलपन्ने व धर्मात्मा कौसल्याम् पुन रब्रवीत्
transliteration: vilapanne va dharmātmā kausalyām puna rabravīt
english: Remembering the extraordinary death of the Maharsi, that righteous descendant of Raghu, lamenting his son, thus spoke to Kausalyā.

sanskrit: तत् अज्ञानान् महत् पापम् कृत्वा सम्कुलित इन्द्रियः
एकः तु अचिन्तयम् बुद्ध्या कथम् नु सुकृतम् भवेत्
transliteration: tat ajñānān mahat pāpam kṛtvā samkulita indriyaḥ
ekaḥ tu acintayam buddhyā katham nu sukṛtam bhavet
english: Having unwittingly committed that great sin, I, with my senses oppressed through grief, thought within myself as to how I could mend it.

sanskrit: ततः तम् घटम् आदय पूर्णम् परम वारिणा
आश्रमम् तम् अहम् प्राप्य यथा आख्यात पथम् गतः
transliteration: tataḥ tam ghaṭam ādaya pūrṇam parama vāriṇā
āśramam tam aham prāpya yathā ākhyāta patham gataḥ
english: Then taking up the pitcher filled with excellent water, I went by the way mentioned and (at last) reached the asylum.

sanskrit: तत्र अहम् दुर्बलाव् अन्धौ वृद्धाव् अपरिणायकौ
अपश्यम् तस्य पितरौ लून पक्षाव् इव द्विजौ
transliteration: tatra aham durbalāv andhau vṛddhāv apariṇāyakau
apaśyam tasya pitarau lūna pakṣāv iva dvijau
english: There I found his aged, infirm, forlorn, parents, without any one to help them in moving about, like to birds whose wings have been severed, keeping up a talk about (their son) without experiencing any fatigue, and like helpless ones feeding on a hope which had been blasted by me.

sanskrit: ताम् आशाम् मत् कृते हीनाव् उदासीनाव् अनाथवत्
transliteration: tām āśām mat kṛte hīnāv udāsīnāv anāthavat
english: There I found his aged, infirm, forlorn, parents, without any one to help them in moving about, like to birds whose wings have been severed, keeping up a talk about (their son) without experiencing any fatigue, and like helpless ones feeding on a hope which had been blasted by me.
My senses overpowered by grief, and my consciousness almost lost through apprehension, I, arrived at the hermitage, again overwhelmed with sorrow.

sanskrit: पद शब्दम् तु मे श्रुत्वा मुनिर् वाक्यम् अभाषत
किम् चिरायसि मे पुत्र पानीयम् क्षिप्रम् आनय
transliteration: pada śabdam tu me śrutvā munir vākyam abhāṣata
kim cirāyasi me putra pānīyam kṣipram ānaya
english: Hearing my footsteps, the ascetic said, “Why, my son, delay you? Bring the drink at once.

sanskrit: यन् निमित्तम् इदम् तात सलिले क्रीडितम् त्वया
उत्कण्ठिता ते माता इयम् प्रविश क्षिप्रम् आश्रमम्
transliteration: yan nimittam idam tāta salile krīḍitam tvayā
utkaṇṭhitā te mātā iyam praviśa kṣipram āśramam
english: Your mother, O child, was exceedingly anxious in consequence of your sporting in the waters. Do you speedily enter the asylum.

sanskrit: यद् व्यलीकम् कृतम् पुत्र मात्रा ते यदि वा मया
न तन् मनसि कर्तव्यम् त्वया तात तपस्विना
transliteration: yad vyalīkam kṛtam putra mātrā te yadi vā mayā
na tan manasi kartavyam tvayā tāta tapasvinā
english: O child, it behove you not to take to heart any unkind action that, O son, may have been done to you of high fame either by your mother or myself.

sanskrit: त्वम् गतिस् तु अगतीनाम् च चक्षुस् त्वम् हीन चक्षुषाम्
समासक्ताः त्वयि प्राणाः किम्चिन् नौ न अभिभाषसे
transliteration: tvam gatis tu agatīnām ca cakṣus tvam hīna cakṣuṣām
samāsaktāḥ tvayi prāṇāḥ kimcin nau na abhibhāṣase
english: You are the resource of these helpless ones; you are the eyes of these bereft of their sight. was Our lives are bound up with you. Why do not answer?'

sanskrit: मुनिम् अव्यक्तया वाचा तम् अहम् सज्जमानया
हीन व्यन्जनया प्रेक्ष्य भीतः भीतैव अब्रुवम्
transliteration: munim avyaktayā vācā tam aham sajjamānayā
hīna vyanjanayā prekṣya bhītaḥ bhītaiva abruvam
english: Seeing the ascetic with a choked utterance indistinctly speaking thus with the letters not articulated clearly, I, dashed in spirits, yet concealing the real state of my mind by assuming a doughty tongue, communicated to him the danger that had befallen him in consequence of the calamity of his son:

sanskrit: मनसः कर्म चेष्टाभिर् अभिसम्स्तभ्य वाग् बलम्
आचचक्षे तु अहम् तस्मै पुत्र व्यसनजम् भयम्
transliteration: manasaḥ karma ceṣṭābhir abhisamstabhya vāg balam
ācacakṣe tu aham tasmai putra vyasanajam bhayam
english: Seeing the ascetic with a choked utterance indistinctly speaking thus with the letters not articulated clearly, I, dashed in spirits, yet concealing the real state of my mind by assuming a doughty tongue, communicated to him the danger that had befallen him in consequence of the calamity of his son:

sanskrit: क्षत्रियो अहम् दशरथो न अहम् पुत्रः महात्मनः
सज्जन अवमतम् दुह्खम् इदम् प्राप्तम् स्व कर्मजम्
transliteration: kṣatriyo aham daśaratho na aham putraḥ mahātmanaḥ
sajjana avamatam duhkham idam prāptam sva karmajam
english: I am a Ksatriya, Dasaratha (by name), and no son of yours, O magnanimous one. I have come by a misfortune in consequence of an act blamed by the good.

sanskrit: भगवमः च अपहस्तः अहम् सरयू तीरम् आगतः
जिघाम्सुः श्वा पदम् किम्चिन् निपाने वा आगतम् गजम्
transliteration: bhagavamaḥ ca apahastaḥ aham sarayū tīram āgataḥ
jighāmsuḥ śvā padam kimcin nipāne vā āgatam gajam
english: O revered one, desirous of killing some beast of prey, and elephant (or some other), come to the waters, I went to the banks of the Sarayū bow in hand.

sanskrit: ततः श्रुतः मया शब्दो जले कुम्भस्य पूर्यतः
द्विपो अयम् इति मत्वा हि बाणेन अभिहतः मया
transliteration: tataḥ śrutaḥ mayā śabdo jale kumbhasya pūryataḥ
dvipo ayam iti matvā hi bāṇena abhihataḥ mayā
english: Then hearing sounds from the water of a filling pitcher, I thought, This must be an elephant. I wounded it with a shaft. Next coming to the edge of the river, I saw an ascetic lying down on the ground almost deprived of life, with his heart pierced with an arrow.

sanskrit: गत्वा नद्याः ततः तीरम् अपश्यम् इषुणा हृदि
विनिर्भिन्नम् गत प्राणम् शयानम् भुवि तापसम्
transliteration: gatvā nadyāḥ tataḥ tīram apaśyam iṣuṇā hṛdi
vinirbhinnam gata prāṇam śayānam bhuvi tāpasam
english: Then hearing sounds from the water of a filling pitcher, I thought, This must be an elephant. I wounded it with a shaft. Next coming to the edge of the river, I saw an ascetic lying down on the ground almost deprived of life, with his heart pierced with an arrow.

sanskrit: भगवन् शब्दम् आलक्ष्य मया गज जिघाम्सुना
विसृष्टः अम्भसि नाराचः तेन ते निहतः सुतः
transliteration: bhagavan śabdam ālakṣya mayā gaja jighāmsunā
visṛṣṭaḥ ambhasi nārācaḥ tena te nihataḥ sutaḥ

sanskrit: स मया सहसा बण उद्धृतो मर्मतस्तदा
transliteration: sa mayā sahasā baṇa uddhṛto marmatastadā
english: Then coming forward, I in accordance with the direction given by him as he lay in agony, suddenly extracted the arrow from his vitals.

sanskrit: स च उद्धृतेन बाणेन तत्र एव स्वर्गम् आस्थितः
भगवन्ताव् उभौ शोचन्न् अन्धाव् इति विलप्य च
transliteration: sa ca uddhṛtena bāṇena tatra eva svargam āsthitaḥ
bhagavantāv ubhau śocann andhāv iti vilapya ca
english: And as soon as the arrow had been extracted, he ascended heaven, O reverend sir, lamenting and bewailing you, both grown old.

sanskrit: अज्ञानात् भवतः पुत्रः सहसा अभिहतः मया
शेषम् एवम् गते यत् स्यात् तत् प्रसीदतु मे मुनिः
transliteration: ajñānāt bhavataḥ putraḥ sahasā abhihataḥ mayā
śeṣam evam gate yat syāt tat prasīdatu me muniḥ
english: It is through ignorance that I suddenly wounded your son. This having been past, do you favour me with telling me what is now to be done, O ascetic.

sanskrit: स तत् श्रुत्वा वचः क्रूरम् निह्श्वसन् शोक कर्शितः
transliteration: sa tat śrutvā vacaḥ krūram nihśvasan śoka karśitaḥ
english: Having heard these cruel words, the worshipful ascetic could well by his curse consume me to ashes.

sanskrit: माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम्
transliteration: mām uvāca mahā tejāḥ kṛta anjalim upasthitam
english: With eyes flooded with tears, and well nigh deprived of his senses by grief, that highly energetic one said to me standing with joined hands.

sanskrit: यद्य् एतत् अशुभम् कर्म न स्म मे कथयेः स्वयम्
फलेन् मूर्धा स्म ते राजन् सद्यः शत सहस्रधा
transliteration: yady etat aśubham karma na sma me kathayeḥ svayam
phalen mūrdhā sma te rājan sadyaḥ śata sahasradhā
english: If, O king, you had not of yourself immediately communicated to us this unpleasant news, your head would have been reduced to a thousand flaws.

sanskrit: ज्ञान पूर्वम् कृतः स्थानाच् च्यावयेद् अपि वज्रिणम्
transliteration: jñāna pūrvam kṛtaḥ sthānāc cyāvayed api vajriṇam
english: Not to speak of Kștriyas, I can even drag the very wielder of the thunderbolt himself from his position, if he knowingly kills one, in especial, that has assumed the Vånaprastha mode of life.

sanskrit: सप्तधा तु फलेन्मूर्धा मुनौ तपसि तिष्ठति
transliteration: saptadhā tu phalenmūrdhā munau tapasi tiṣṭhati
english: Your head would have been severed in seven, if you had discharged the weapon knowingly at such an ascetic staying in austerities and versed in the Vedas.

sanskrit: अज्ञानाद्द् हि कृतम् यस्मात् इदम् तेन एव जीवसि
अपि हि अद्य कुलम् नस्यात् राघवाणाम् कुतः भवान्
transliteration: ajñānādd hi kṛtam yasmāt idam tena eva jīvasi
api hi adya kulam nasyāt rāghavāṇām kutaḥ bhavān
english: It is because you have done this through ignorance that you (still) live, else the race itself of the Rāghavas should be not, and where are you?

sanskrit: नय नौ नृप तम् देशम् इति माम् च अभ्यभाषत
अद्य तम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चावः पुत्रम् पश्चिम दर्शनम्
transliteration: naya nau nṛpa tam deśam iti mām ca abhyabhāṣata
adya tam draṣṭum iccāvaḥ putram paścima darśanam
english: He then said, 'Do you, o king, take us to the scene. To day will we look our last on our son besmeared with blood, his deer-skin garb falling off (from his body), lying senseless on the earth, and come under the subjection of the lord of righteousness.'

sanskrit: रुधिरेण अवसित अन्गम् प्रकीर्ण अजिन वाससम्
शयानम् भुवि निह्सम्ज्ञम् धर्म राज वशम् गतम्
transliteration: rudhireṇa avasita angam prakīrṇa ajina vāsasam
śayānam bhuvi nihsamjñam dharma rāja vaśam gatam
english: Thereupon I alone taking them exceedingly disconsolate to the spot, made the ascetic and his wife touch their son.

sanskrit: अथ अहम् एकः तम् देशम् नीत्वा तौ भृश दुह्खितौ
अस्पर्शयम् अहम् पुत्रम् तम् मुनिम् सह भार्यया
transliteration: atha aham ekaḥ tam deśam nītvā tau bhṛśa duhkhitau
asparśayam aham putram tam munim saha bhāryayā

sanskrit: तौ पुत्रम् आत्मनः स्पृष्ट्वा तम् आसाद्य तपस्विनौ
निपेततुः शरीरे अस्य पिता च अस्य इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tau putram ātmanaḥ spṛṣṭvā tam āsādya tapasvinau
nipetatuḥ śarīre asya pitā ca asya idam abravīt
english: And having approached their son and touched him, ascetics fell on his person, and then his father addressed him thus.

sanskrit: न न्व् अहम् ते प्रियः पुत्र मातरम् पश्य धार्मिक
किम् नु न आलिन्गसे पुत्र सुकुमार वचो वद
transliteration: na nv aham te priyaḥ putra mātaram paśya dhārmika
kim nu na ālingase putra sukumāra vaco vada
english: If, my son, you do not feel kindly to me, do you look up to your virtuous mother. And why, O son, do you not embrace me? Do you speak tender words.

sanskrit: न त्वहम् ते प्रियः पुत्र मातरम् पस्य धार्मिक
किम् नु नालिङ्गसे पुत्र सुकुमार वचो वद
transliteration: na tvaham te priyaḥ putra mātaram pasya dhārmika
kim nu nāliṅgase putra sukumāra vaco vada
english: If, my son, you do not feel kindly to me, do you look up to your virtuous mother. And why, O son, do you not embrace me? Do you speak tender words.

sanskrit: कस्य वा अपर रात्रे अहम् श्रोष्यामि हृदयम् गमम्
अधीयानस्य मधुरम् शास्त्रम् वा अन्यद् विशेषतः
transliteration: kasya vā apara rātre aham śroṣyāmi hṛdayam gamam
adhīyānasya madhuram śāstram vā anyad viśeṣataḥ
english: At the small hours, form whom engaged in study, shall I hear the scriptures sweetly read in a way coming home to the listener's mind?

sanskrit: को माम् सम्ध्याम् उपास्य एव स्नात्वा हुत हुत अशनः
श्लाघयिष्यति उपासीनः पुत्र शोक भय अर्दितम्
transliteration: ko mām samdhyām upāsya eva snātvā huta huta aśanaḥ
ślāghayiṣyati upāsīnaḥ putra śoka bhaya arditam
english: Who, having performed his daily devotions and offered oblation to the sacrificial fire, will bathe me, afflicted with grief for my son?

sanskrit: कन्द मूल फलम् हृत्वा को माम् प्रियम् इव अतिथिम्
transliteration: kanda mūla phalam hṛtvā ko mām priyam iva atithim
english: Who procuring Kandas, fruits and roots, will feed me like an welcome guest, incapable of and doing anything and furnishing provisions, and without any one to take care of myself.?

sanskrit: इमाम् अन्धाम् च वृद्धाम् च मातरम् ते तपस्विनीम्
कथम् पुत्र भरिष्यामि कृपणाम् पुत्र गर्धिनीम्
transliteration: imām andhām ca vṛddhām ca mātaram te tapasvinīm
katham putra bhariṣyāmi kṛpaṇām putra gardhinīm
english: And, my son, how will I maintain this blind ascetic mother of yours, proud of her son, who is passing her days in misery?

sanskrit: तिष्ठ मा मा गमः पुत्र यमस्य सदनम् प्रति
श्वो मया सह गन्ता असि जनन्या च समेधितः
transliteration: tiṣṭha mā mā gamaḥ putra yamasya sadanam prati
śvo mayā saha gantā asi jananyā ca samedhitaḥ
english: Do you stay my son, in my behalf. Tomorrow you will go to Yama's mansion with me and your mother.

sanskrit: उभाव् अपि च शोक आर्ताव् अनाथौ कृपणौ वने
क्षिप्रम् एव गमिष्यावः त्वया हीनौ यम क्षयम्
transliteration: ubhāv api ca śoka ārtāv anāthau kṛpaṇau vane
kṣipram eva gamiṣyāvaḥ tvayā hīnau yama kṣayam
english: Distressed with grief and rendered miserable in the forest, both of us deprived of you shall soon repair to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: ततः वैवस्वतम् दृष्ट्वा तम् प्रवक्ष्यामि भारतीम्
क्षमताम् धर्म राजो मे बिभृयात् पितराव् अयम्
transliteration: tataḥ vaivasvatam dṛṣṭvā tam pravakṣyāmi bhāratīm
kṣamatām dharma rājo me bibhṛyāt pitarāv ayam
english: Seeing Vivasvata's son, I will say to him, Do you, O lord of justice forgive me, and let this my son, continue to maintain us, his parents.
It behove you, O righteous and illustrious guardian of the words, to confer on me reduced to such a pass this one enduring dakşiņā capable of removing our fear.

sanskrit: अपापो असि यथा पुत्र निहतः पाप कर्मणा
तेन सत्येन गच्च आशु ये लोकाः शस्त्र योधिनाम्
transliteration: apāpo asi yathā putra nihataḥ pāpa karmaṇā
tena satyena gacca āśu ye lokāḥ śastra yodhinām
english: You, my son, are sinless, although slain by this one who has done an unrighteous act; and by the force of this truth , do you repair to the world of warriors. Do you, O son, go the supreme way that is gone by heroes who without turning back from the fight, are slain in open encounter.

sanskrit: यान्ति शूरा गतिम् याम् च सम्ग्रामेष्व् अनिवर्तिनः
हताः तु अभिमुखाः पुत्र गतिम् ताम् परमाम् व्रज
transliteration: yānti śūrā gatim yām ca samgrāmeṣv anivartinaḥ
hatāḥ tu abhimukhāḥ putra gatim tām paramām vraja

sanskrit: याम् गतिम् सगरः शैब्यो दिलीपो जनमेजयः
नहुषो धुन्धुमारः च प्राप्ताः ताम् गच्च पुत्रक
transliteration: yām gatim sagaraḥ śaibyo dilīpo janamejayaḥ
nahuṣo dhundhumāraḥ ca prāptāḥ tām gacca putraka
english: Do you, O son, go the way that has been gone by Sagara and Saivya and Dilīpa and Janamejaya and Nahusa and Dhundhumāra.

sanskrit: या गतिः सर्व साधूनाम् स्वाध्यायात् पतसः च या
भूमिदस्य आहित अग्नेः चएक पत्नी व्रतस्य च
transliteration: yā gatiḥ sarva sādhūnām svādhyāyāt patasaḥ ca yā
bhūmidasya āhita agneḥ caeka patnī vratasya ca
english: Do you, O son, go the way that is gone by all creatures, even by ascetics engaged in the study of the Veda, by bestowers of lands, by those performing fire-sacrifices, by individuals each devoted to a single wife, men giving away a thousand kine, persons tending their preceptors, and individuals renouncing lives by fasting.

sanskrit: गो सहस्र प्रदातृऋणाम् या या गुरुभृताम् अपि
देह न्यास कृताम् या च ताम् गतिम् गच्च पुत्रक
transliteration: go sahasra pradātṛṛṇām yā yā gurubhṛtām api
deha nyāsa kṛtām yā ca tām gatim gacca putraka

sanskrit: न हि तु अस्मिन् कुले जातः गच्चति अकुशलाम् गतिम्
स तु यास्यति येन त्वम् निहतो मम बान्धवः
transliteration: na hi tu asmin kule jātaḥ gaccati akuśalām gatim
sa tu yāsyati yena tvam nihato mama bāndhavaḥ
english: He that is born in such a race cannot come by any evil case. Such a condition be his that has taken the life of you, my friend.'

sanskrit: एवम् स कृपणम् तत्र पर्यदेवयत असकृत्
ततः अस्मै कर्तुम् उदकम् प्रवृत्तः सह भार्यया
transliteration: evam sa kṛpaṇam tatra paryadevayata asakṛt
tataḥ asmai kartum udakam pravṛttaḥ saha bhāryayā
english: Having thus piteously wept, he along with his wife set about performing the watery rites on behalf of his son.

sanskrit: स तु दिव्येन रूपेण मुनि पुत्रः स्व कर्मभिः
transliteration: sa tu divyena rūpeṇa muni putraḥ sva karmabhiḥ
english: Thereupon speedily assuming a celestial shape, the virtuous son of the ascetic by his own actions ascended heaven in company with Sakra.

sanskrit: आबभाषे च वृद्धौ तौ सह शक्रेण तापसः
आश्वास्य च मुहूर्तम् तु पितरौ वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: ābabhāṣe ca vṛddhau tau saha śakreṇa tāpasaḥ
āśvāsya ca muhūrtam tu pitarau vākyam abravīt
english: Then (returning) along with Sakra, the ascetic comforting his aged parents, addressed them, sa ing.

sanskrit: स्थानम् अस्मि महत् प्राप्तः भवतोह् परिचारणात्
भवन्ताव् अपि च क्षिप्रम् मम मूलम् उपैष्यतः
transliteration: sthānam asmi mahat prāptaḥ bhavatoh paricāraṇāt
bhavantāv api ca kṣipram mama mūlam upaiṣyataḥ
english: I have attained a high state in consequence of having served you. Do you also without delay come to me.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु दिव्येन विमानेन वपुष्मता
आरुरोह दिवम् क्षिप्रम् मुनि पुत्रः जित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: evam uktvā tu divyena vimānena vapuṣmatā
āruroha divam kṣipram muni putraḥ jita indriyaḥ
english: Having said this, the ascetic's son of restrained sense ascended heaven by means of an excellent and commodious car.

sanskrit: स कृत्वा तु उदकम् तूर्णम् तापसः सह भार्यया
माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम्
transliteration: sa kṛtvā tu udakam tūrṇam tāpasaḥ saha bhāryayā
mām uvāca mahā tejāḥ kṛta anjalim upasthitam
english: Having performed the watery rites, the highly energetic ascetic along with his wife speedily said to me staying with joined hands.

sanskrit: अद्य एव जहि माम् राजन् मरणे न अस्ति मे व्यथा
यत् शरेण एक पुत्रम् माम् त्वम् अकार्षीर् अपुत्रकम्
transliteration: adya eva jahi mām rājan maraṇe na asti me vyathā
yat śareṇa eka putram mām tvam akārṣīr aputrakam
english: Do you, O monarch, slay me on the instant. I do not grieve to die', you have by your shaft rendered me who had an only son, absolutely sonless.

sanskrit: त्वया तु यद् अविज्ञानान् निहतः मे सुतः शुचिः
transliteration: tvayā tu yad avijñānān nihataḥ me sutaḥ śuciḥ

sanskrit: पुत्र व्यसनजम् दुह्खम् यद् एतन् मम साम्प्रतम्
एवम् त्वम् पुत्र शोकेन राजन् कालम् करिष्यसि
transliteration: putra vyasanajam duhkham yad etan mama sāmpratam
evam tvam putra śokena rājan kālam kariṣyasi
english: Since this sorrow arising from the calamity that has befallen my son, is at present mine (through your instrumentality), I curse you. You shall even in this way find your death from grief born of separation from your son.

sanskrit: अज्ञानात्तु हतो यस्मात् क्षत्रियेण त्वया मुनिः
transliteration: ajñānāttu hato yasmāt kṣatriyeṇa tvayā muniḥ
english: As you a Kşatriya has through ignorance slain an ascetic, the sin, O lord of men, of slaying a Brāhmaṇa will not envelope you speedily; but you shall shortly come by this dreadful and mortal condition, like a donor of Dakşiņās (coming by the things given away).'

As you a Kşatriya has through ignorance slain an ascetic, the sin, O lord of men, of slaying a Brāhmaṇa will not envelope you speedily; but you shall shortly come by this dreadful and mortal condition, like a donor of Dakşiņās (coming by the things given away).'

sanskrit: एवम् शापम् मयि न्यस्य विलप्य करुणम् बहु
transliteration: evam śāpam mayi nyasya vilapya karuṇam bahu
english: Having thus inflicted on me the curse and piteously lamented long, the coupe ascended the funeral pile and went to heaven.
O noble dame, the crime that I hitting by help of sound, had committed in my boyhood, has reverted to my recollection in course of thought.

O exalted lady, even as a disease generated by one's taking rice with unhealthy curry, this danger is imminent in consequence of that act. O gentle one, the words of that noble-minded person are about to be verified in me.

sanskrit: तस्मान् माम् आगतम् भद्रे तस्य उदारस्य तत् वचः
यद् अहम् पुत्र शोकेन सम्त्यक्ष्याम्य् अद्य जीवितम्
transliteration: tasmān mām āgatam bhadre tasya udārasya tat vacaḥ
yad aham putra śokena samtyakṣyāmy adya jīvitam

sanskrit: चक्षुर्भ्याम् त्वाम् न पश्यामि कौसल्ये साधु माम्स्फृश
इत्युक्त्वा स रुदम्स्त्रस्तो भार्यामाह च भूमिपः
transliteration: cakṣurbhyām tvām na paśyāmi kausalye sādhu māmsphṛśa
ityuktvā sa rudamstrasto bhāryāmāha ca bhūmipaḥ

sanskrit: एतन्मे सदृशम् देवि यन्मया राघवे कृतम्
सदृशम् तत्तु तस्यैव यदनेन कृतम् मयि
transliteration: etanme sadṛśam devi yanmayā rāghave kṛtam
sadṛśam tattu tasyaiva yadanena kṛtam mayi
english: O noble lady, what I have done to Rāghava in not surely like myself; but what (on the other hand) he has done by me is worthy of him.
What sensible man for sake his son, albeit he may be wicked? And what son being banished, does not bear ill will towards his father?

sanskrit: यदि माम् सम्स्पृशेद् रामः सकृदद्य लभेत वा
transliteration: yadi mām samspṛśed rāmaḥ sakṛdadya labheta vā

sanskrit: चक्षुषा त्वाम् न पश्यामि स्मृतिर् मम विलुप्यते
दूता वैवस्वतस्य एते कौसल्ये त्वरयन्ति माम्
transliteration: cakṣuṣā tvām na paśyāmi smṛtir mama vilupyate
dūtā vaivasvatasya ete kausalye tvarayanti mām
english: But I do not see you with my eyes, and my memory fails. These envoys of Vivasvata's son, OKausalya, urge speed upon me.

sanskrit: अतः तु किम् दुह्खतरम् यद् अहम् जीवित क्षये
न हि पश्यामि धर्मज्ञम् रामम् सत्य पराक्यमम्
transliteration: ataḥ tu kim duhkhataram yad aham jīvita kṣaye
na hi paśyāmi dharmajñam rāmam satya parākyamam
english: What can be an object of greater regret than that I during my last moments cannot behold the righteous Rāma having truth for prowess?
Even as the sun dried up a drop of water, grief for not seeing my son of incomparable acts dried my spirits.

sanskrit: न ते मनुष्या देवाः ते ये चारु शुभ कुण्डलम्
मुखम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति रामस्य वर्षे पन्च दशे पुनः
transliteration: na te manuṣyā devāḥ te ye cāru śubha kuṇḍalam
mukham drakṣyanti rāmasya varṣe panca daśe punaḥ
english: Those are not men, those are gods who in the fifteenth year shall again behold Rāma's countenance graced with elegant and burnished ear-rings.

sanskrit: पद्म पत्र ईक्षणम् सुभ्रु सुदम्ष्ट्रम् चारु नासिकम्
धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति रामस्य तारा अधिप निभम् मुखम्
transliteration: padma patra īkṣaṇam subhru sudamṣṭram cāru nāsikam
dhanyā drakṣyanti rāmasya tārā adhipa nibham mukham
english: O you of graceful eye-brows, blessed are they who shall behold Rāma's countenance furnished with eyes resembling lotus-petals, with excellent teeth and a shapely nose, like to the lord of the stars himself.

sanskrit: सदृशम् शारदस्य इन्दोह् फुल्लस्य कमलस्य च
सुगन्धि मम नाथस्य धन्या द्रक्ष्यन्ति तन् मुखम्
transliteration: sadṛśam śāradasya indoh phullasya kamalasya ca
sugandhi mama nāthasya dhanyā drakṣyanti tan mukham
english: Blessed are they that shall behold that fragrant face of his like to the autumnal moon, or the fullblown lotus. Thrice-blessed they who with delighted hearts, shall behold Rāma returned from the forest and come back to Ayodhyā, like to Sukra crowning the zenith?

sanskrit: निवृत्त वन वासम् तम् अयोध्याम् पुनर् आगतम्
द्रक्ष्यन्ति सुखिनो रामम् शुक्रम् मार्ग गतम् यथा
transliteration: nivṛtta vana vāsam tam ayodhyām punar āgatam
drakṣyanti sukhino rāmam śukram mārga gatam yathā
english: Blessed are they that shall behold that fragrant face of his like to the autumnal moon, or the fullblown lotus. Thrice-blessed they who with delighted hearts, shall behold Rāma returned from the forest and come back to Ayodhyā, like to Sukra crowning the zenith?

sanskrit: कौसल्ये चित्त मोहेन हृदयम् सीदतीव मे
transliteration: kausalye citta mohena hṛdayam sīdatīva me

english: O Kausalyā, my heart is weighed down with grief; and I do not perceive objects of hearing, feeling, or taste. My senses are growing dim in consequence of the mental stupor, like the rays of a lamp reduced to smoke, becoming dim when the oil has been exhausted.

sanskrit: अयम् आत्म भवः शोको माम् अनाथम् अचेतनम्
सम्सादयति वेगेन यथा कूलम् नदी रयः
transliteration: ayam ātma bhavaḥ śoko mām anātham acetanam
samsādayati vegena yathā kūlam nadī rayaḥ
english: As the violence of a river wears away its banks, my grief occasioned through my own agency is destroying me, who am helpless and insensible.

sanskrit: हा राघव महा बाहो हा मम आयास नाशन
हा पितृप्रिय मे नाथ हाद्य क्वासि गतः सुत
transliteration: hā rāghava mahā bāho hā mama āyāsa nāśana
hā pitṛpriya me nātha hādya kvāsi gataḥ suta
english: O mighty-armed Rāghava! O you remover of my troubles! O you that do delight in your father! you are my stay, O my son, that have gone away.

sanskrit: हा कौसल्ये नशिष्यामि हा सुमित्रे तपस्विनि
transliteration: hā kausalye naśiṣyāmi hā sumitre tapasvini
english: O Kausalyā, I do not see. O wretched Sumitrā! O cruel one, you enemy of mine, you Kaikeyī, who have befouled your line!

sanskrit: राजा दशरथः शोचन् जीवित अन्तम् उपागमत्
transliteration: rājā daśarathaḥ śocan jīvita antam upāgamat
english: Having thus lamented in presence of Rāma's mother and Sumitrā, king Daſaratha breathed his last.

sanskrit: यथा तु दीनम् कथयन् नर अधिपः
गते अर्ध रात्रे भृश दुह्ख पीडितः
transliteration: yathā tu dīnam kathayan nara adhipaḥ
gate ardha rātre bhṛśa duhkha pīḍitaḥ
english: Thus that distressed lord of men, smitten with 1e exile of his beloved son, that one possessed fa gracious presence, when the night had been alf spent, wrought up with the violence of his notion, departed this life.

sanskrit: अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् प्रातर् एव अपरे अहनि
transliteration: atha rātryām vyatītāyām prātar eva apare ahani

english: And as the bards hymned the monarch, palmplayers celebrating the deeds of the kings of the Raghu race, began to play with their palms.

And awakened by those sounds, birds on boughs and in cages worthy of the royal race, uttered notes. And the sacred words uttered by these), the notes of Vinas, and the valedictory songs of singers filled that mansion.

sanskrit: आशीर्गेयम् च गाथानाम् पूरयामास वेश्म तत
transliteration: āśīrgeyam ca gāthānām pūrayāmāsa veśma tata
english: And awakened by those sounds, birds on boughs and in cages worthy of the royal race, uttered notes. And the sacred words uttered by these), the notes of Vinas, and the valedictory songs of singers filled that mansion.

sanskrit: स्त्री वर्ष वर भूयिष्ठाउपतस्थुर् यथा पुरम्
transliteration: strī varṣa vara bhūyiṣṭhāupatasthur yathā puram
english: And as on former occasions, men practising purity and well up in serving, with numerous women and eunuchs entered appearance.

sanskrit: हरि चन्दन सम्पृक्तम् उदकम् कान्चनैः घटैः
आनिन्युः स्नान शिक्षा आज्ञा यथा कालम् यथा विधि
transliteration: hari candana sampṛktam udakam kāncanaiḥ ghaṭaiḥ
āninyuḥ snāna śikṣā ājñā yathā kālam yathā vidhi
english: Persons acquainted with the ceremonials connected with bath, according to the ordinance and in due time, in golden vessels brought water impregnated with Hair sandal powder.

sanskrit: उपनिन्युस् तथा अपि अन्याः कुमारी बहुलाः स्त्रियः
transliteration: upaninyus tathā api anyāḥ kumārī bahulāḥ striyaḥ
english: Pure females together with many virgins brought kine &c, which were to be touched, Ganges water for sipping, mirrors, cloths, ornaments and other areicles.

All the things that were procured (for presentation to the monarch) were worshipped in accordance with prescription, were furnished with auspicious marks, and were of excellent virtues and possessed of auspiciousness.
As along as the sun did not rise, all these people remained expecting the presence of the king; but then they were alarmed as to what had occurred.

sanskrit: अथ याः कोसल इन्द्रस्य शयनम् प्रत्यनन्तराः
ताः स्त्रियः तु समागम्य भर्तारम् प्रत्यबोधयन्
transliteration: atha yāḥ kosala indrasya śayanam pratyanantarāḥ
tāḥ striyaḥ tu samāgamya bhartāram pratyabodhayan
english: Those ladies that were beside the bed of the lord of Kosala, were consoling their husband.

sanskrit: न ह्यस्य शयनम् स्पृष्ट्वा किम् चिदप्युपलेभिरे
transliteration: na hyasya śayanam spṛṣṭvā kim cidapyupalebhire
english: And engaged in tending the monarch with mild and pliant words, those females knowing the condition of sleep, feeling him as he lay in his bed, did not perceive any action in the evermoving pulse.

sanskrit: ता वेपथु परीताः च राज्ञः प्राणेषु शन्किताः
transliteration: tā vepathu parītāḥ ca rājñaḥ prāṇeṣu śankitāḥ

sanskrit: अथ सम्वेपमनानाम् स्त्रीणाम् दृष्ट्वा च पार्थिवम्
transliteration: atha samvepamanānām strīṇām dṛṣṭvā ca pārthivam

sanskrit: यत् तत् आशन्कितम् पापम् तस्य जज्ञे विनिश्चयः
transliteration: yat tat āśankitam pāpam tasya jajñe viniścayaḥ

sanskrit: निष्प्रभा च विवर्णा च सन्ना शोकेन सन्नता
transliteration: niṣprabhā ca vivarṇā ca sannā śokena sannatā

sanskrit: ते च दृष्ट्वा तथा सुप्ते शुभे देव्यौ च तम् नृपम्
transliteration: te ca dṛṣṭvā tathā supte śubhe devyau ca tam nṛpam

sanskrit: ततः प्रचुक्रुशुर् दीनाः सस्वरम् ता वर अन्गनाः
transliteration: tataḥ pracukruśur dīnāḥ sasvaram tā vara anganāḥ

sanskrit: तासाम् आक्रन्द शब्देन सहसा उद्गत चेतने
transliteration: tāsām ākranda śabdena sahasā udgata cetane

sanskrit: कौसल्या च सुमित्राच त्यक्त निद्रे बभूवतुः
कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च दृष्ट्वा स्पृष्ट्वा च पार्थिवम्
transliteration: kausalyā ca sumitrāca tyakta nidre babhūvatuḥ
kausalyā ca sumitrā ca dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca pārthivam
english: And Kausalya and Sumitrā looking at the king and feeling him, fell down to the earth, exclaiming, "Ah lord.”

sanskrit: हा नाथ इति परिक्रुश्य पेततुर् धरणी तले
सा कोसल इन्द्र दुहिता वेष्टमाना मही तले
transliteration: hā nātha iti parikruśya petatur dharaṇī tale
sā kosala indra duhitā veṣṭamānā mahī tale

sanskrit: न बभ्राज रजो ध्वस्ता तारा इव गगन च्युता
नृपे शान्तगुणे जाते कौसल्याम् पतिताम् भुवि
transliteration: na babhrāja rajo dhvastā tārā iva gagana cyutā
nṛpe śāntaguṇe jāte kausalyām patitām bhuvi

sanskrit: तत् समुत्त्रस्त सम्भ्रान्तम् पर्युत्सुक जन आकुलम्
transliteration: tat samuttrasta sambhrāntam paryutsuka jana ākulam

sanskrit: सर्वतः तुमुल आक्रन्दम् परिताप आर्त बान्धवम्
सद्यो निपतित आनन्दम् दीन विक्लव दर्शनम्
transliteration: sarvataḥ tumula ākrandam paritāpa ārta bāndhavam
sadyo nipatita ānandam dīna viklava darśanam
english: The mansion of the king became filled with people exceedingly excited and frightened, eager to know all about the matter, became filled with lamentations, with friends afflicted with distress, its joy instantaneously vanished, a scene of distress and dole.

sanskrit: बभूव नर देवस्य सद्म दिष्ट अन्तम् ईयुषः
transliteration: babhūva nara devasya sadma diṣṭa antam īyuṣaḥ
english: Knowing that the lord of earth had departed, his wives surrounding that illustrious one, smitten with excess of sorrow and weeping bitterly and piteously, holding the king's hands indulged in lamentations, like forlorn ones.

sanskrit: तम् अग्निम् इव सम्शान्तम् अम्बु हीनम् इव अर्णवम्
हतप्रभम् इव आदित्यम् स्वर्गथम् प्रेक्ष्य भूमिपम्
transliteration: tam agnim iva samśāntam ambu hīnam iva arṇavam
hataprabham iva ādityam svargatham prekṣya bhūmipam
english: Seeing the king had ascended heaven, like to a fire that has cooled, or an ocean deprived of its waters, or the sun shorn of his splendour, Kausalyā afflicted with woe, taking on her lap the head of the king, with tears in her eyes, said.

sanskrit: कौसल्या बाष्प पूर्ण अक्षी विविधम् शोक कर्शिता
transliteration: kausalyā bāṣpa pūrṇa akṣī vividham śoka karśitā
english: Seeing the king had ascended heaven, like to a fire that has cooled, or an ocean deprived of its waters, or the sun shorn of his splendour, Kausalyā afflicted with woe, taking on her lap the head of the king, with tears in her eyes, said.

sanskrit: सकामा भव कैकेयि भुन्क्ष्व राज्यम् अकण्टकम्
त्यक्त्वा राजानम् एक अग्रा नृशम्से दुष्ट चारिणि
transliteration: sakāmā bhava kaikeyi bhunkṣva rājyam akaṇṭakam
tyaktvā rājānam eka agrā nṛśamse duṣṭa cāriṇi
english: O Kaikeyī, attain you your wished: do you enjoy this kingdom rid of your thorn. O cruel one, O you of wicked ways, you that forsaking the king had set your heart (on having your son crowned), Rāma had gone away, forsaking me; and now my lord has ascended heaven. I can no longer bear to live, like one left lone in a wilderness by her companions.

sanskrit: विहाय माम् गतः रामः भर्ता च स्वर् गतः मम
विपथे सार्थ हीना इव न अहम् जीवितुम् उत्सहे
transliteration: vihāya mām gataḥ rāmaḥ bhartā ca svar gataḥ mama
vipathe sārtha hīnā iva na aham jīvitum utsahe
english: O Kaikeyī, attain you your wished: do you enjoy this kingdom rid of your thorn. O cruel one, O you of wicked ways, you that forsaking the king had set your heart (on having your son crowned), Rāma had gone away, forsaking me; and now my lord has ascended heaven. I can no longer bear to live, like one left lone in a wilderness by her companions.

sanskrit: भर्तारम् तम् परित्यज्य का स्त्री दैवतम् आत्मनः
इच्चेज् जीवितुम् अन्यत्र कैकेय्याः त्यक्त धर्मणः
transliteration: bhartāram tam parityajya kā strī daivatam ātmanaḥ
iccej jīvitum anyatra kaikeyyāḥ tyakta dharmaṇaḥ
english: What other woman except Kaikeyi lost to righteousness, having lost her deity, her lord, wishes to carry on existence in another's kingdom?

sanskrit: न लुब्धो बुध्यते दोषान् किम् पाकम् इव भक्षयन्
कुब्जा निमित्तम् कैकेय्या राघवाणान् कुलम् हतम्
transliteration: na lubdho budhyate doṣān kim pākam iva bhakṣayan
kubjā nimittam kaikeyyā rāghavāṇān kulam hatam
english: As a covetous person taking poison (through anger or some other passion), does not consider himself guilty, (so Kaikeyī) having done this evil through Manthara's incitement, does not bring her guilt home to her mind. It is through the instrumentality of the humpbacked woman that this race of the Rāghavas has been destroyed by Kaikeyi. Hearing that the king being made to do an unrighteous action, has banished Rāma together with his wife, king Janaka will be filled with grief as I have been.

sanskrit: सभार्यम् जनकः श्रुत्वा पतितप्स्यति अहम् यथा
transliteration: sabhāryam janakaḥ śrutvā patitapsyati aham yathā
english: As a covetous person taking poison (through anger or some other passion), does not consider himself guilty, (so Kaikeyī) having done this evil through Manthara's incitement, does not bring her guilt home to her mind. It is through the instrumentality of the humpbacked woman that this race of the Rāghavas has been destroyed by Kaikeyi. Hearing that the king being made to do an unrighteous action, has banished Rāma together with his wife, king Janaka will be filled with grief as I have been.

sanskrit: स मामनाथाम् विधवाम् नाद्य जानाति धार्मिकः
रामः कमल पत्र अक्षो जीव नाशम् इतः गतः
transliteration: sa māmanāthām vidhavām nādya jānāti dhārmikaḥ
rāmaḥ kamala patra akṣo jīva nāśam itaḥ gataḥ
english: That virtuous one does not know that to-day I have become helpless and been widowed. Răma of eyes resembling lotus-petals has living been removed from my sight.

sanskrit: विदेह राजस्य सुता तहा सीता तपस्विनी
transliteration: videha rājasya sutā tahā sītā tapasvinī
english: The fair daughter of Videha's king unworthy of hardship, in ascetic guise is leading a life of trouble and terror in the woods.

sanskrit: नदताम् भीम घोषाणाम् निशासु मृग पक्षिणाम्
transliteration: nadatām bhīma ghoṣāṇām niśāsu mṛga pakṣiṇām
english: Hearing at night the dreadful roars of birds and beasts crying, she exceedingly frightened takes shelter with Rāghava.

sanskrit: वृद्धः चैव अल्प पुत्रः च वैदेहीम् अनिचिन्तयन्
सो अपि शोक समाविष्टः ननु त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्
transliteration: vṛddhaḥ caiva alpa putraḥ ca vaidehīm anicintayan
so api śoka samāviṣṭaḥ nanu tyakṣyati jīvitam
english: Old and having an only daughter, he revolving in his mind thoughts of Vaidehi, shall, smitten with grief, surely renounce his life. I ever faithful to my lord will die this very day, embracing this body; I will enter fire.

Old and having an only daughter, he revolving in his mind thoughts of Vaidehi, shall, smitten with grief, surely renounce his life. I ever faithful to my lord will die this very day, embracing this body; I will enter fire.
As embracing the (dead) body, that unfortunate lady was bewailing, the courtiers had the distressed (queen) removed from there.

sanskrit: तैल द्रोण्याम् अथ अमात्याः सम्वेश्य जगती पतिम्
राज्ञः सर्वाणि अथ आदिष्टाः चक्रुः कर्माणि अनन्तरम्
transliteration: taila droṇyām atha amātyāḥ samveśya jagatī patim
rājñaḥ sarvāṇi atha ādiṣṭāḥ cakruḥ karmāṇi anantaram
english: Then placing the corpse of the king in a (capacious) pan with oil, the courtiers performed the mourning rites of the monarch.

sanskrit: न तु सम्कलनम् राज्ञो विना पुत्रेण मन्त्रिणः
सर्वज्ञाः कर्तुम् ईषुस् ते ततः रक्षन्ति भूमिपम्
transliteration: na tu samkalanam rājño vinā putreṇa mantriṇaḥ
sarvajñāḥ kartum īṣus te tataḥ rakṣanti bhūmipam
english: But well versed in everything, the counsellors, in the absence of his son, did not perform the funeral obsequies of the king; and therefore they placed his body stretched in the pan of oil. Alas! at length concluding it for certain that the king was dead, the ladies burst out into lamentaions.

sanskrit: तैल द्रोण्याम् तु सचिवैः शायितम् तम् नर अधिपम्
हा मृतः अयम् इति ज्ञात्वा स्त्रियः ताः पर्यदेवयन्
transliteration: taila droṇyām tu sacivaiḥ śāyitam tam nara adhipam
hā mṛtaḥ ayam iti jñātvā striyaḥ tāḥ paryadevayan

sanskrit: बाहून् उद्यम्य कृपणा नेत्र प्रस्रवणैः मुखैः
transliteration: bāhūn udyamya kṛpaṇā netra prasravaṇaiḥ mukhaiḥ
english: And raising their arms, with tears trickling down their faces, they in dire affliction and extremely exercised with grief, lamented.
O monarch, why do you forsake us, who have been already deprived of Rāma ever speaking fair and firm in promise?

sanskrit: कथम् पतिघ्न्या वत्स्यामः समीपे विधवा वयम्
transliteration: katham patighnyā vatsyāmaḥ samīpe vidhavā vayam
english: Renounced by Rāma, how shall we, rendered widows, stay with the wicked Kaikeyi, co-wife with us?

sanskrit: स हि नाथः सदास्माकम् तव च प्रभुरात्मवान्
वनम् रामो गतः श्रीमान् विहाय नृपतिश्रियम्
transliteration: sa hi nāthaḥ sadāsmākam tava ca prabhurātmavān
vanam rāmo gataḥ śrīmān vihāya nṛpatiśriyam
english: That one of free soul is our master, as he is the lord of yourself. Rāma has gone to the woods, forsaking regal dignity.

sanskrit: त्वया तेन च वीरेण विना व्यसनमोहिताः
कथम् वयम् निवत्स्यामः कैकेय्या च विदूषिताः
transliteration: tvayā tena ca vīreṇa vinā vyasanamohitāḥ
katham vayam nivatsyāmaḥ kaikeyyā ca vidūṣitāḥ
english: Deprived of you as well as that hero, and overwhelmed with misfortune, how shall we live reprimanded by Kaikeyi?

sanskrit: यया तु राजा रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः
सीतया सह सम्त्य्क्ताः सा कमन्यम् न हास्यति
transliteration: yayā tu rājā rāmaśca lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ
sītayā saha samtyktāḥ sā kamanyam na hāsyati
english: She that has renounced the king, Rāma, and Lakşmaņa along with Sītā, whom can such a one not renounce?

sanskrit: ता बाष्पेण च सम्वीताः शोकेन विपुलेन च
transliteration: tā bāṣpeṇa ca samvītāḥ śokena vipulena ca
english: Thus with tears in their eyes, the wives of that descendant of Raghu, joyless and convulsed with a huge passion, displayed signs of sorrow.

sanskrit: निशा नक्षत्र हीना इव स्त्री इव भर्तृ विवर्जिता
पुरी न अराजत अयोध्या हीना राज्ञा महात्मना
transliteration: niśā nakṣatra hīnā iva strī iva bhartṛ vivarjitā
purī na arājata ayodhyā hīnā rājñā mahātmanā
english: Like a night without stars, like a fair one forsaken by her husband, the city of Ayodhyā without the magnanimous monarch did not appear delightful as it had done before, with the populace filled with tears, the ladies uttering exclamations of distress, and the terraces and courts deserted.

sanskrit: बाष्प पर्याकुल जना हाहा भूत कुल अन्गना
शून्य चत्वर वेश्म अन्ता न बभ्राज यथा पुरम्
transliteration: bāṣpa paryākula janā hāhā bhūta kula anganā
śūnya catvara veśma antā na babhrāja yathā puram
english: Like a night without stars, like a fair one forsaken by her husband, the city of Ayodhyā without the magnanimous monarch did not appear delightful as it had done before, with the populace filled with tears, the ladies uttering exclamations of distress, and the terraces and courts deserted.

sanskrit: गत प्रभा द्यौर् इव भास्करम् विना
transliteration: gata prabhā dyaur iva bhāskaram vinā
english: On the lord of men having ascended heaven from grief, and the wives of the king remaining on the earth, the sun, his journey done, set, and the night began her course.

The idea of consuming the king's corpse in the absence of his son did not recommended itself to the assembled. adherents (of the departed). Thinking this, they in that way laid the king endowed with an inconceivably dignified presence.

sanskrit: न च अस्र कण्ठ आकुल मार्ग चत्वरा
transliteration: na ca asra kaṇṭha ākula mārga catvarā
english: And with her terraces overflowing with tears that flooded the throats of the mourners, the city appeared like the welkin without its splendour in the absence of the sun, or the night with the stars enveloped.

sanskrit: नराः च नार्यः च समेत्य सम्घशो
बभूवुर् आर्ता न च शर्म लेभिरे
transliteration: narāḥ ca nāryaḥ ca sametya samghaśo
babhūvur ārtā na ca śarma lebhire
english: And on on the demise of that illustrious personage, in the city men and women in multitudes, censuring Bharata's mother, became extremely distressed, and did not attain peace of mind.
At length the weary night in Ayodhya rendered cheerless cheerless by lamentations, and populous with men with voice choked with tears, was spent.

sanskrit: व्यतीतायाम् तु शर्वर्याम् आदित्यस्य उदये ततः
समेत्य राज कर्तारः सभाम् ईयुर् द्विजातयः
transliteration: vyatītāyām tu śarvaryām ādityasya udaye tataḥ
sametya rāja kartāraḥ sabhām īyur dvijātayaḥ

sanskrit: मार्कण्डेयो अथ मौद्गल्यो वामदेवः च काश्यपः
कात्ययनो गौतमः च जाबालिः च महा यशाः
transliteration: mārkaṇḍeyo atha maudgalyo vāmadevaḥ ca kāśyapaḥ
kātyayano gautamaḥ ca jābāliḥ ca mahā yaśāḥ

sanskrit: एते द्विजाः सह अमात्यैः पृथग् वाचम् उदीरयन्
वसिष्ठम् एव अभिमुखाः श्रेष्ठः राज पुरोहितम्
transliteration: ete dvijāḥ saha amātyaiḥ pṛthag vācam udīrayan
vasiṣṭham eva abhimukhāḥ śreṣṭhaḥ rāja purohitam

sanskrit: अतीता शर्वरी दुह्खम् या नो वर्ष शत उपमा
अस्मिन् पन्चत्वम् आपन्ने पुत्र शोकेन पार्थिवे
transliteration: atītā śarvarī duhkham yā no varṣa śata upamā
asmin pancatvam āpanne putra śokena pārthive
english: Then facing the royal priest, the eminent Vasistha, they said, "That night that had appeared like to an hundred years has at last been painfully passed.

sanskrit: स्वर् गतः च महा राजो रामः च अरण्यम् आश्रितः
लक्ष्मणः च अपि तेजस्वी रामेण एव गतः सह
transliteration: svar gataḥ ca mahā rājo rāmaḥ ca araṇyam āśritaḥ
lakṣmaṇaḥ ca api tejasvī rāmeṇa eva gataḥ saha
english: The king racked by sorrow for his son having breathed his last, the mighty monarch has ascended heaven, Rāma has taken refuge in the woods, the energetic Lakşmaņa has gone with Rama, and does Bharata and Satrughna, repressors of foes, are staying in Kekaya in pleasant Rājagrha, the abode of their maternal grandfather.

sanskrit: उभौ भरत शत्रुघ्नौ क्केकयेषु परम् तपौ
पुरे राज गृहे रम्ये मातामह निवेशने
transliteration: ubhau bharata śatrughnau kkekayeṣu param tapau
pure rāja gṛhe ramye mātāmaha niveśane
english: The king racked by sorrow for his son having breathed his last, the mighty monarch has ascended heaven, Rāma has taken refuge in the woods, the energetic Lakşmaņa has gone with Rama, and does Bharata and Satrughna, repressors of foes, are staying in Kekaya in pleasant Rājagrha, the abode of their maternal grandfather.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् इह अद्य एव कश्चित् राजा विधीयताम्
अराजकम् हि नो राष्ट्रम् न विनाशम् अवाप्नुयात्
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām iha adya eva kaścit rājā vidhīyatām
arājakam hi no rāṣṭram na vināśam avāpnuyāt
english: Do you select some on this very day from the descendants of Ikşvāku, to be king here. Verily does a kingdom go to ruin, when without a king.

sanskrit: न अराजले जन पदे विद्युन् माली महा स्वनः
transliteration: na arājale jana pade vidyun mālī mahā svanaḥ
english: He that goes garlanded with lightning, and has a mighty voice, even the Cloud, does not with Skye shower drench the Earth in a kingdom without a king.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे बीज मुष्टिः प्रकीर्यते
न अराकके पितुः पुत्रः भार्या वा वर्तते वशे
transliteration: na arājake jana pade bīja muṣṭiḥ prakīryate
na arākake pituḥ putraḥ bhāryā vā vartate vaśe
english: In a kingless kingdom no one sows corn. In a kingless kingdom the son does not obey his sire, or the wife her husband.

sanskrit: अराजके धनम् न अस्ति न अस्ति भार्या अपि अराजके
इदम् अत्याहितम् च अन्यत् कुतः सत्यम् अराजके
transliteration: arājake dhanam na asti na asti bhāryā api arājake
idam atyāhitam ca anyat kutaḥ satyam arājake
english: A kingless kingdom possesses no wealth, and wives are hard to keep in such a place. This great fear attends a kingless country. And where is other morality (besides that detailed above) to be found at such a place?

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे कारयन्ति सभाम् नराः
उद्यानानि च रम्याणि हृष्टाः पुण्य गृहाणि च
transliteration: na arājake jana pade kārayanti sabhām narāḥ
udyānāni ca ramyāṇi hṛṣṭāḥ puṇya gṛhāṇi ca
english: In a kingless country men do not form themselves into associations, nor do they, inspired with cheerfulness, make elegant gardens or sacred edifices.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे यज्ञ शीला द्विजातयः
सत्राणि अन्वासते दान्ता ब्राह्मणाः सम्शित व्रताः
transliteration: na arājake jana pade yajña śīlā dvijātayaḥ
satrāṇi anvāsate dāntā brāhmaṇāḥ samśita vratāḥ
english: In a kingless country, the twice-born ones do not celebrate sacrifices. In a kingless country, in mighty sacrifices wealthy Brāhmaṇas do not confer (on the officiating priests) the Dakșiņās (which they receive according to the ordinance).

In a kingless country, the twice-born ones do not celebrate sacrifices. In a kingless country, in mighty sacrifices wealthy Brāhmaṇas do not confer (on the officiating priests) the Dakșiņās (which they receive according to the ordinance).

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे प्रभूत नट नर्तकाः
उत्सवाः च समाजाः च वर्धन्ते राष्ट्र वर्धनाः
transliteration: na arājake jana pade prabhūta naṭa nartakāḥ
utsavāḥ ca samājāḥ ca vardhante rāṣṭra vardhanāḥ
english: In a kingless country, neither neither social gatherings, nor festivities characterised by the presence of merry theatrical managers and performers, increase.

sanskrit: न अरजके जन पदे सिद्ध अर्था व्यवहारिणः
कथाभिर् अनुरज्यन्ते कथा शीलाः कथा प्रियैः
transliteration: na arajake jana pade siddha arthā vyavahāriṇaḥ
kathābhir anurajyante kathā śīlāḥ kathā priyaiḥ
english: In a kingless country disputants cannot decide their point; nor are persons given to hearing Puranic recitations pleased by those delighting in the practice.
In a kingless country, bevies of virgins decked in gold do not repair to gardens for purposes of sport.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे वाहनैः शीघ्र गामिभिः
नरा निर्यान्ति अरण्यानि नारीभिः सह कामिनः
transliteration: na arājake jana pade vāhanaiḥ śīghra gāmibhiḥ
narā niryānti araṇyāni nārībhiḥ saha kāminaḥ
english: In a kingless country pleasure-seeking people do not in company with females go to the woods by means of swift vehicles.

sanskrit: न अराकजे जन पदे धनवन्तः सुरक्षिताः
शेरते विवृत द्वाराः कृषि गो रक्ष जीविनः
transliteration: na arākaje jana pade dhanavantaḥ surakṣitāḥ
śerate vivṛta dvārāḥ kṛṣi go rakṣa jīvinaḥ
english: In a kingless country, the wealthy are not well protected; nor do shepherds and cultivators sleep with their doors open.
In a kingless country long-tusked elephants sixty years old, bearing bells on their necks, do not walk the high-way.
In a kingless country one hears not the clappings of persons engaged in shooting arrows constantly.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे वणिजो दूर गामिनः
गच्चन्ति क्षेमम् अध्वानम् बहु पुण्य समाचिताः
transliteration: na arājake jana pade vaṇijo dūra gāminaḥ
gaccanti kṣemam adhvānam bahu puṇya samācitāḥ
english: In a kingless country traders coming from distant lands, loaded with various kinds of merchandise, do not with safety go along the roads.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे चरति एक चरः वशी
भावयन्न् आत्मना आत्मानम् यत्र सायम् गृहो मुनिः
transliteration: na arājake jana pade carati eka caraḥ vaśī
bhāvayann ātmanā ātmānam yatra sāyam gṛho muniḥ
english: In a kingless country the ascetic with his subdued senses, himself his sole protector, who makes his quarters wherever evening overtakes him, cannot walk contemplating the Deity.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे योग क्षेमम् प्रवर्तते
न च अपि अराजके सेना शत्रून् विषहते युधि
transliteration: na arājake jana pade yoga kṣemam pravartate
na ca api arājake senā śatrūn viṣahate yudhi
english: In a kingless country, one cannot protect what one has, or procure what one has not. In a kingless country, the forces cannot bear the onslaught of the foe.
In a kingless country men cannot at will go on excellent and high-mettled horses and ornamented cars.
In a kingless country persons well versed in learning can not engage in controversy, repairing to woods and groves.

In a kingless country, persons with intent hearts do not offer garlands, sweets, and Daksinās, for worshipping the gods. In a kingless country princes smeared with sandal and aguru, do not look graceful like trees in spring.

In a kingless country, persons with intent hearts do not offer garlands, sweets, and Daksinās, for worshipping the gods. In a kingless country princes smeared with sandal and aguru, do not look graceful like trees in spring.

sanskrit: यथा हि अनुदका नद्यो यथा वा अपि अतृणम् वनम्
अगोपाला यथा गावः तथा राष्ट्रम् अराजकम्
transliteration: yathā hi anudakā nadyo yathā vā api atṛṇam vanam
agopālā yathā gāvaḥ tathā rāṣṭram arājakam
english: Even as a river without water, a wood without grass, a herd of kine without a keeper, is a kingdom without a king.

sanskrit: ध्वजो रथस्य प्रज्ञानम् धूमो ज्ञानम् विभावसोः
तेषाम् यो नो ध्वजो राज स देवत्वमितो गतः
transliteration: dhvajo rathasya prajñānam dhūmo jñānam vibhāvasoḥ
teṣām yo no dhvajo rāja sa devatvamito gataḥ
english: The sign of a car is its pennon, of fire is smoke, and our banner the king, has gone to heaven.

sanskrit: न अराजके जन पदे स्वकम् भवति कस्यचित्
transliteration: na arājake jana pade svakam bhavati kasyacit
english: In a kingless country a person hardly preserves his life; and like fishes people eat up one another.

sanskrit: येहि सम्भिन्न मर्यादा नास्तिकाः चिन्न सम्शयाः
ते अपि भावाय कल्पन्ते राज दण्ड निपीडिताः
transliteration: yehi sambhinna maryādā nāstikāḥ cinna samśayāḥ
te api bhāvāya kalpante rāja daṇḍa nipīḍitāḥ
english: Even those heretics who having disregarded the dignity of social morality had met with chastisement at the hands of the king, their fear removed, give themselves airs.
As the sight is engaged in the welfare of the body, the king, that fountain of truth and religion, is engaged in compassing the good of the kingdom.

sanskrit: राजा सत्यम् च धर्मश्च राजा कुलवताम् कुलम्
राजा माता पिता चैव राजा हितकरो नृणाम्
transliteration: rājā satyam ca dharmaśca rājā kulavatām kulam
rājā mātā pitā caiva rājā hitakaro nṛṇām
english: The king is truth, the king is morality, the king is the racial dignity of those possessed of the same, the king is the father, the king is the ON 68 RĀMĀYAŅAM mother, the king compasses the welfare of men.
By virtue of magnanimity of character, a king surpasses Yama and Vaiśravaṇa and Śakra and Varuņa endowed with mighty strength.

sanskrit: अहो तमैव इदम् स्यान् न प्रज्ञायेत किम्चन
राजा चेन् न भवेन् लोके विभजन् साध्व् असाधुनी
transliteration: aho tamaiva idam syān na prajñāyeta kimcana
rājā cen na bhaven loke vibhajan sādhv asādhunī
english: If there were not a king in this world to adjudge fair and foul, darkness would overspread (the face of the earth) and people could not distinguish anything whatever. As the ocean keeps within its continent, we even while the monarch lived, did not disregard your words.

sanskrit: जीवति अपि महा राजे तव एव वचनम् वयम्
न अतिक्रमामहे सर्वे वेलाम् प्राप्य इव सागरः
transliteration: jīvati api mahā rāje tava eva vacanam vayam
na atikramāmahe sarve velām prāpya iva sāgaraḥ
english: If there were not a king in this world to adjudge fair and foul, darkness would overspread (the face of the earth) and people could not distinguish anything whatever. As the ocean keeps within its continent, we even while the monarch lived, did not disregard your words.

sanskrit: स नः समीक्ष्य द्विज वर्य वृत्तम्
transliteration: sa naḥ samīkṣya dvija varya vṛttam
english: Do you, O best of Brāhmaṇas, beholding our acts rendered nugatory, and this empire became a wilderness for want of a king, install that descendant of Ikşvāku or any other as king of this realm.

sanskrit: तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठः प्रत्युवाच ह
मित्र अमात्य गणान् सर्वान् ब्राह्मणाम्स् तान् इदम् वचः
transliteration: teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā vasiṣṭhaḥ pratyuvāca ha
mitra amātya gaṇān sarvān brāhmaṇāms tān idam vacaḥ
english: Hearing their words, Vasiştha said to the Brāhmaṇas and the adherents and counsellors (of the king)

sanskrit: यद् असौ मातुल कुले पुरे राज गृहे सुखी
transliteration: yad asau mātula kule pure rāja gṛhe sukhī
english: Bharata, on whom the king has conferred the kingdom, along with his brother Satrughna, is living happily in the house of his maternal uncle.

sanskrit: तत् शीघ्रम् जवना दूता गच्चन्तु त्वरितैः हयैः
आनेतुम् भ्रातरौ वीरौ किम् समीक्षामहे वयम्
transliteration: tat śīghram javanā dūtā gaccantu tvaritaiḥ hayaiḥ
ānetum bhrātarau vīrau kim samīkṣāmahe vayam
english: Let envoys by means of fleet coursers speedily repair thither and bring those heroic brothers. What shall we decide?

sanskrit: गच्चन्तु इति ततः सर्वे वसिष्ठम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन्
तेषाम् तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: gaccantu iti tataḥ sarve vasiṣṭham vākyam abruvan
teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā vasiṣṭho vākyam abravīt
english: "Let them go", said all to Vasistha. Hearing their words, Vasistha spoke to them, saying.

sanskrit: एहि सिद्ध अर्थ विजय जयन्त अशोक नन्दन
श्रूयताम् इतिकर्तव्यम् सर्वान् एव ब्रवीमि वः
transliteration: ehi siddha artha vijaya jayanta aśoka nandana
śrūyatām itikartavyam sarvān eva bravīmi vaḥ
english: Come here, you Siddhārtha, and Vijaya, and Jayanta, and Asokanandana. Do you hear. I well tell you what you are to do.

sanskrit: पुरम् राज गृहम् गत्वा शीघ्रम् शीघ्र जवैः हयैः
त्यक्त शोकैः इदम् वाच्यः शासनात् भरतः मम
transliteration: puram rāja gṛham gatvā śīghram śīghra javaiḥ hayaiḥ
tyakta śokaiḥ idam vācyaḥ śāsanāt bharataḥ mama
english: First going speedily to the royal residence by means of swift horses, do you, renouncing grief, by my order speak these words of mine to Bharata.

sanskrit: पुरोहितः त्वाम् कुशलम् प्राह सर्वे च मन्त्रिणः
त्वरमाणः च निर्याहि कृत्यम् आत्ययिकम् त्वया
transliteration: purohitaḥ tvām kuśalam prāha sarve ca mantriṇaḥ
tvaramāṇaḥ ca niryāhi kṛtyam ātyayikam tvayā
english: The priest as well as the counsellors have enquired after your welfare. Do you at once set out. A business is at hand that brooks no delay on your part.

sanskrit: मा च अस्मै प्रोषितम् रामम् मा च अस्मै पितरम् मृतम्
भवन्तः शम्सिषुर् गत्वा राघवाणाम् इमम् क्षयम्
transliteration: mā ca asmai proṣitam rāmam mā ca asmai pitaram mṛtam
bhavantaḥ śamsiṣur gatvā rāghavāṇām imam kṣayam
english: But you must on no account communicate to him the exile of Rāma, or the demise of the monarch, or the destruction that has befallen the Raghu race through this occasion.

sanskrit: कौशेयानि च वस्त्राणि भूषणानि वराणि च
क्षिप्रम् आदाय राज्ञः च भरतस्य च गच्चत
transliteration: kauśeyāni ca vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni varāṇi ca
kṣipram ādāya rājñaḥ ca bharatasya ca gaccata
english: Do you, speedily taking silk apparel and excellent ornaments for king Bharata, set off.
Thereupon, having been furnished with the necessaries for the journey, they bound for Kekaya went to their respective abodes, mounted on goodly horses.
Then having supplied themselves with the necessaries of the journey, the envoys in consonance with Vasiştha's injunction, speedily went away.
Having proceeded by the west of Aparatāla, they in the middle crossed the Mālinſ, and went towards the north of Pralamba.

sanskrit: ते हस्तिनापुरे गङ्गाम् तीर्त्वा प्रत्यङ्मुखा ययुः
transliteration: te hastināpure gaṅgām tīrtvā pratyaṅmukhā yayuḥ
english: Then crossing the Gangā at Hastināpura, and arriving at Pāñcāla, they proceeded west ward through Kurujāngala.
And beholding watery expan'ses filled with blown blossoms, and rivers containing pellucid waters, the envoys proceeded apace on account of the errand they had on hand.
And they darted past the Saradanda overflowing with delightful water, beautiful, and haunted by fowls of various kinds.
Then on the western bank of the stream, coming upon a tree called Satyopayācana presided by a deity, and bowing down to the tree and going round it, they entered the city of Kulinga.
And having passed Tejobhibhavana and arrived at Abhikāla, they crossed the sacred stream Ikşumatī belonging to the Ikşvākus for generations.
Beholding here Brāhmaṇas versed in the Vedas drinking water with their joined hands, they went through Vahllika towards the mount Sudaman.

sanskrit: विष्णोः पदम् प्रेक्षमाणा विपाशाम् चापि शाल्मालीम्
transliteration: viṣṇoḥ padam prekṣamāṇā vipāśām cāpi śālmālīm
english: There seeing the foot-print of Visnu, they desirous of doing the bidding of their master, proceeded a long way, viewing the Vipasa and the Salmali and rivers and tanks and pools and ponds and sheets of water and various kinds of lions and tigers and deer and elephants.

There seeing the foot-print of Visnu, they desirous of doing the bidding of their master, proceeded a long way, viewing the Vipasa and the Salmali and rivers and tanks and pools and ponds and sheets of water and various kinds of lions and tigers and deer and elephants.

sanskrit: ते श्रान्त वाहना दूता विकृष्टेन सता पथा
गिरि व्रजम् पुर वरम् शीघ्रम् आसेदुर् अन्जसा
transliteration: te śrānta vāhanā dūtā vikṛṣṭena satā pathā
giri vrajam pura varam śīghram āsedur anjasā
english: And with their vehicles fatigued, the ambassadors, on account of the great distance of the way; speedily reached that best of cities, Girivraja.

sanskrit: भर्तुः प्रिय अर्थम् कुल रक्षण अर्थम्
रात्र्याम् तु ते तत् पुरम् एव याताः
transliteration: bhartuḥ priya artham kula rakṣaṇa artham
rātryām tu te tat puram eva yātāḥ
english: And for pleasing their master, for the preservation of the people, and enabling Bharata to assume the reins of government, those envoys, casting aside negligence, swiftly entered the city in the night.

sanskrit: याम् एव रात्रिम् ते दूताः प्रविशन्ति स्म ताम् पुरीम्
भरतेन अपि ताम् रात्रिम् स्वप्नो दृष्टः अयम् अप्रियः
transliteration: yām eva rātrim te dūtāḥ praviśanti sma tām purīm
bharatena api tām rātrim svapno dṛṣṭaḥ ayam apriyaḥ
english: The very same night that the envoys entered the city, Bharata saw an evil dream.

sanskrit: व्युष्टाम् एव तु ताम् रात्रिम् दृष्ट्वा तम् स्वप्नम् अप्रियम्
transliteration: vyuṣṭām eva tu tām rātrim dṛṣṭvā tam svapnam apriyam
english: And seeing that evil dream during the short hours, the son of that king of kings exceedingly burned in grief.

sanskrit: आयासम् हि विनेष्यन्तः सभायाम् चक्रिरे कथाः
transliteration: āyāsam hi vineṣyantaḥ sabhāyām cakrire kathāḥ
english: And finding him aggrieved, his sweet. speeched associates, endeavouring to chase the heaviness, began to converse on a variety of subjects.

sanskrit: वादयन्ति तथा शान्तिम् लासयन्ति अपि च अपरे
नाटकानि अपरे प्राहुर् हास्यानि विविधानि च
transliteration: vādayanti tathā śāntim lāsayanti api ca apare
nāṭakāni apare prāhur hāsyāni vividhāni ca
english: Some played on instruments; some for the purpose of pacifying his mind, danced (the courtezans); others performed scenes variously fraught with the sentiment of mirth.

sanskrit: स तैः महात्मा भरतः सखिभिः प्रिय वादिभिः
गोष्ठी हास्यानि कुर्वद्भिर् न प्राहृष्यत राघवः
transliteration: sa taiḥ mahātmā bharataḥ sakhibhiḥ priya vādibhiḥ
goṣṭhī hāsyāni kurvadbhir na prāhṛṣyata rāghavaḥ
english: But although his friends intending to ally his agitation set about enacting passages calculated to amuse family circles, that magnanimous descendant of Raghu did not indulge in laughter.

sanskrit: तम् अब्रवीत् प्रिय सखो भरतम् सखिभिर् वृतम्
सुहृद्भिः पर्युपासीनः किम् सखे न अनुमोदसे
transliteration: tam abravīt priya sakho bharatam sakhibhir vṛtam
suhṛdbhiḥ paryupāsīnaḥ kim sakhe na anumodase
english: Then a dear friend addressed Bharata, as he sat surrounded by his friends, “Surrounded by your friends, why do you not, my friend, join in the mirth?"

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सुहृदम् भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह
शृणु त्वम् यन् निमित्तम्मे दैन्यम् एतत् उपागतम्
transliteration: evam bruvāṇam suhṛdam bharataḥ pratyuvāca ha
śṛṇu tvam yan nimittamme dainyam etat upāgatam
