transliteration: mohāc ca śoka samrodhāt babhūva lulitam manaḥ
english: And bewailing thus, the mind of the high souled (Bharata) wrought with sorrow, was overcome with the burden of grief.
And fallen the ground, lamenting, senseless, with his intellect overpowered, and momentarily heaving sighs, Bharata passed away night in grief.

sanskrit: तम् एवम् शोक सम्तप्तम् भरतम् केकयी सुतम्
उवाच वदताम् श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठः श्रेष्ठ वाग् ऋषिः
transliteration: tam evam śoka samtaptam bharatam kekayī sutam
uvāca vadatām śreṣṭho vasiṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭha vāg ṛṣiḥ
english: As Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi was thus burning in grief, that foremost of those skilled in speech, the saint Vasistha, endowed with excellence of language, said.

sanskrit: अलम् शोकेन भद्रम् ते राज पुत्र महा यशः
प्राप्त कालम् नर पतेः कुरु सम्यानम् उत्तरम्
transliteration: alam śokena bhadram te rāja putra mahā yaśaḥ
prāpta kālam nara pateḥ kuru samyānam uttaram
english: Do not weep, good betide you, O illustrious prince. Do you perform the funereal rites of the departed king.

sanskrit: वसिष्ठस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भरतः धारणाम् गतः
प्रेत कार्याणि सर्वाणि कारयाम् आस धर्मवित्
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā bharataḥ dhāraṇām gataḥ
preta kāryāṇi sarvāṇi kārayām āsa dharmavit
english: Hearing Vasistha's words, Bharata cognisant of duty, bowed down to the ground and despatched the ministers for performing the last rites.

sanskrit: उद्धृतम् तैल सम्क्लेदात् स तु भूमौ निवेशितम्
आपीत वर्ण वदनम् प्रसुप्तम् इव भूमिपम्
transliteration: uddhṛtam taila samkledāt sa tu bhūmau niveśitam
āpīta varṇa vadanam prasuptam iva bhūmipam
english: And raising from under the oil the body of the king with a sallow countenance, and appearing to be asleep. Bharata placed it on the ground upon a couch in front adorned with various gems. Then overwhelmed with grief, Dasaratha's son bewailed him thus.

sanskrit: सम्वेश्य शयने च अग्र्ये नाना रत्न परिष्कृते
transliteration: samveśya śayane ca agrye nānā ratna pariṣkṛte
english: And raising from under the oil the body of the king with a sallow countenance, and appearing to be asleep. Bharata placed it on the ground upon a couch in front adorned with various gems. Then overwhelmed with grief, Dasaratha's son bewailed him thus.

sanskrit: किम् ते व्यवसितम् राजन् प्रोषिते मय्य् अनागते
विवास्य रामम् धर्मज्ञम् लक्ष्मणम् च महा बलम्
transliteration: kim te vyavasitam rājan proṣite mayy anāgate
vivāsya rāmam dharmajñam lakṣmaṇam ca mahā balam
english: O king, what was it that you had intended to do, I absent and away from home, by banishing righteous Rāma and the powerful Lakşmana?

sanskrit: क्व यास्यसि महा राज हित्वा इमम् दुह्खितम् जनम्
हीनम् पुरुष सिम्हेन रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा
transliteration: kva yāsyasi mahā rāja hitvā imam duhkhitam janam
hīnam puruṣa simhena rāmeṇa akliṣṭa karmaṇā
english: Whither wend you, O mighty monarch, forsaking these aggrieved people, who have already been deprived of the lion like Rāma energetic in action?

sanskrit: योग क्षेमम् तु ते राजन् को अस्मिन् कल्पयिता पुरे
त्वयि प्रयाते स्वः तात रामे च वनम् आश्रिते
transliteration: yoga kṣemam tu te rājan ko asmin kalpayitā pure
tvayi prayāte svaḥ tāta rāme ca vanam āśrite
english: O father, you having ascended heaven and Rāma having taken refuge in the woods, who now in this city of yours shall protect what the people possess and secure to them what they have not?

sanskrit: विधवा पृथिवी राजम्स् त्वया हीना न राजते
हीन चन्द्रा इव रजनी नगरी प्रतिभाति माम्
transliteration: vidhavā pṛthivī rājams tvayā hīnā na rājate
hīna candrā iva rajanī nagarī pratibhāti mām
english: Widowed in consequence of losing you, this earth does not look graceful. The city appears to me like the night deprived of the Moon

sanskrit: एवम् विलपमानम् तम् भरतम् दीन मानसम्
अब्रवीद् वचनम् भूयो वसिष्ठः तु महान् ऋषिः
transliteration: evam vilapamānam tam bharatam dīna mānasam
abravīd vacanam bhūyo vasiṣṭhaḥ tu mahān ṛṣiḥ
english: As Bharata was lamenting thus in dejected mood, the mighty ascetic Vasiştha again addressed him, saying.

sanskrit: प्रेत कार्याणि यानि अस्य कर्तव्यानि विशाम्पतेः
तानि अव्यग्रम् महा बाहो क्रियताम् अविचारितम्
transliteration: preta kāryāṇi yāni asya kartavyāni viśāmpateḥ
tāni avyagram mahā bāho kriyatām avicāritam
english: O mighty armed one, do you without indulging in any reflections, perform those funeral ceremonies of the monarch which ought to be performed.

sanskrit: तथा इति भरतः वाक्यम् वसिष्ठस्य अभिपूज्य तत्
ऋत्विक् पुरोहित आचार्याम्स् त्वरयाम् आस सर्वशः
transliteration: tathā iti bharataḥ vākyam vasiṣṭhasya abhipūjya tat
ṛtvik purohita ācāryāms tvarayām āsa sarvaśaḥ
english: Thereupon honouring his words by saying, "So be it,” he urged speed upon all the Rtvigs, priests, and Acāryas.

sanskrit: ये तु अग्रतः नर इन्द्रस्याग्नि अगारात् बहिष् कृताः
ऋत्विग्भिर् याजकैः चैव ते ह्रियन्ते यथा विधि
transliteration: ye tu agrataḥ nara indrasyāgni agārāt bahiṣ kṛtāḥ
ṛtvigbhir yājakaiḥ caiva te hriyante yathā vidhi
english: And then those that had brought the king's corpse out side from the fire chamber, instructed by the Rtvigs and priests according to the ordinance began to offer oblations into the fire.

sanskrit: शिबिलायाम् अथ आरोप्य राजानम् गत चेतनम्
बाष्प कण्ठा विमनसः तम् ऊहुः परिचारकाः
transliteration: śibilāyām atha āropya rājānam gata cetanam
bāṣpa kaṇṭhā vimanasaḥ tam ūhuḥ paricārakāḥ
english: Next placing the king deprived of life on a car, the servants with their throats oppressed with vapour and with their minds weighed down with dejection carried him.

sanskrit: हिरण्यम् च सुवर्णम् च वासाम्सि विविधानि च
प्रकिरन्तः जना मार्गम् नृपतेर् अग्रतः ययुः
transliteration: hiraṇyam ca suvarṇam ca vāsāmsi vividhāni ca
prakirantaḥ janā mārgam nṛpater agrataḥ yayuḥ
english: And scattering gold and silver and various kinds of cloth, on the way people went in front of the king.

sanskrit: चन्दन अगुरु निर्यासान् सरलम् पद्मकम् तथा
देव दारूणि च आहृत्य चिताम् चक्रुस् तथा अपरे
transliteration: candana aguru niryāsān saralam padmakam tathā
deva dārūṇi ca āhṛtya citām cakrus tathā apare

sanskrit: गन्धान् उच्च अवचामः च अन्याम्स् तत्र दत्त्वा अथ भूमिपम्
ततः सम्वेशयाम् आसुः चिता मध्ये तम् ऋत्विजः
transliteration: gandhān ucca avacāmaḥ ca anyāms tatra dattvā atha bhūmipam
tataḥ samveśayām āsuḥ citā madhye tam ṛtvijaḥ
english: Others procuring sandal, aguru and other sarala, padmaka and devadari, cast it (on the earth). And drawing near the king there, Rtvigs laid various other fragrant substances on the funeral pile.

sanskrit: तथा हुत अशनम् हुत्वा जेपुस् तस्य तदा ऋत्विजः
जगुः च ते यथा शास्त्रम् तत्र सामानि सामगाः
transliteration: tathā huta aśanam hutvā jepus tasya tadā ṛtvijaḥ
jaguḥ ca te yathā śāstram tatra sāmāni sāmagāḥ
english: Then offering oblations into the fire, the Rtvigs began to recite japa; and as laid down in the scriptures, Sāma-singers chanted Sämans.

sanskrit: शिबिकाभिः च यानैः च यथा अर्हम् तस्य योषितः
नगरान् निर्ययुस् तत्र वृद्धैः परिवृताः तदा
transliteration: śibikābhiḥ ca yānaiḥ ca yathā arham tasya yoṣitaḥ
nagarān niryayus tatra vṛddhaiḥ parivṛtāḥ tadā
english: By means of litters and other conveyances, each mounted according to her rank, the wives of the king went out from the city, surrounded by aged men. And Rtvijas went round the corpse on the king who performed many sacrifices leaving it on the left side.

sanskrit: प्रसव्यम् च अपि तम् चक्रुर् ऋत्विजो अग्नि चितम् नृपम्
स्त्रियः च शोक सम्तप्ताः कौसल्या प्रमुखाः तदा
transliteration: prasavyam ca api tam cakrur ṛtvijo agni citam nṛpam
striyaḥ ca śoka samtaptāḥ kausalyā pramukhāḥ tadā
english: By means of litters and other conveyances, each mounted according to her rank, the wives of the king went out from the city, surrounded by aged men. And Rtvijas went round the corpse on the king who performed many sacrifices leaving it on the left side.

sanskrit: क्रौन्चीनाम् इव नारीणाम् निनादः तत्र शुश्रुवे
transliteration: krauncīnām iva nārīṇām ninādaḥ tatra śuśruve
english: And kindling with grief, the females also headed by Kausalyā (circumambulated the pyre). And then there was heard the wail of women distressed with grief weeping piteously by thousands like to Krauñcis.

sanskrit: ततः रुदन्त्यो विवशा विलप्य च पुनः पुनः
यानेभ्यः सरयू तीरम् अवतेरुर् वर अन्गनाः
transliteration: tataḥ rudantyo vivaśā vilapya ca punaḥ punaḥ
yānebhyaḥ sarayū tīram avaterur vara anganāḥ
english: Weeping again and again with their sense lost, the wives of the king alighted from the car on the banks of the Sarayu.

Having performed the watery rites, the wives of the monarch as well as the counsellors and priests, in company with Bharata entering the city with tears in their eyes, spent ten days* in mourning lying down on the ground. *The Smrti: lays down twelve days of mourning for kings, and sixteen for Khatriyas. Parasara, however, fixes ten days for Ksatriyas in general.

sanskrit: ततः दश अहे अतिगते कृत शौचो नृप आत्मजः
द्वादशे अहनि सम्प्राप्ते श्राद्ध कर्माणि अकारयत्
transliteration: tataḥ daśa ahe atigate kṛta śauco nṛpa ātmajaḥ
dvādaśe ahani samprāpte śrāddha karmāṇi akārayat
english: When the ten days had gone by, the king's son, his uncleanness (consequent on the demise of his father) removed, performed the sraddha on the twelfth day.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ रत्नम् धनम् अन्नम् च पुष्कलम्
वासाम्सि च महार्हाणि रत्नानि विविधानि च
transliteration: brāhmaṇebhyo dadau ratnam dhanam annam ca puṣkalam
vāsāmsi ca mahārhāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca

sanskrit: बास्तिकम् बहु शुक्लम् च गाः च अपि शतशः तथा
दासी दासम् च यानम् च वेश्मानि सुमहान्ति च
transliteration: bāstikam bahu śuklam ca gāḥ ca api śataśaḥ tathā
dāsī dāsam ca yānam ca veśmāni sumahānti ca

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ पुत्रः राज्ञः तस्य और्ध्वदैहिकम्
ततः प्रभात समये दिवसे अथ त्रयोदशे
transliteration: brāhmaṇebhyo dadau putraḥ rājñaḥ tasya aurdhvadaihikam
tataḥ prabhāta samaye divase atha trayodaśe

sanskrit: विललाप महा बाहुर् भरतः शोक मूर्चितः
शब्द अपिहित कण्ठः च शोधन अर्थम् उपागतः
transliteration: vilalāpa mahā bāhur bharataḥ śoka mūrcitaḥ
śabda apihita kaṇṭhaḥ ca śodhana artham upāgataḥ

sanskrit: चिता मूले पितुर् वाक्यम् इदम् आह सुदुह्खितः
तात यस्मिन् निषृष्टः अहम् त्वया भ्रातरि राघवे
transliteration: citā mūle pitur vākyam idam āha suduhkhitaḥ
tāta yasmin niṣṛṣṭaḥ aham tvayā bhrātari rāghave
english: And coming to the foot of the funeral pyre for gathering the bones of the departed, he overcome with grief, with his throat obstructed with the sounds of lamentation, said, “my father, on brother Rāma, to whom I had been consigned by you, having gone to the forest, I have been cast by you into vacancy.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् वनम् प्रव्रजिते शून्ये त्यक्तः अस्म्य् अहम् त्वया
यथा गतिर् अनाथायाः पुत्रः प्रव्राजितः वनम्
transliteration: tasmin vanam pravrajite śūnye tyaktaḥ asmy aham tvayā
yathā gatir anāthāyāḥ putraḥ pravrājitaḥ vanam

sanskrit: ताम् अम्बाम् तात कौसल्याम् त्यक्त्वा त्वम् क्व गतः नृप
दृष्ट्वा भस्म अरुणम् तच् च दग्ध अस्थि स्थान मण्डलम्
transliteration: tām ambām tāta kausalyām tyaktvā tvam kva gataḥ nṛpa
dṛṣṭvā bhasma aruṇam tac ca dagdha asthi sthāna maṇḍalam

sanskrit: पितुः शरीर निर्वाणम् निष्टनन् विषसाद ह
स तु दृष्ट्वा रुदन् दीनः पपात धरणी तले
transliteration: pituḥ śarīra nirvāṇam niṣṭanan viṣasāda ha
sa tu dṛṣṭvā rudan dīnaḥ papāta dharaṇī tale

sanskrit: अभिपेतुस् ततः सर्वे तस्य अमात्याः शुचि व्रतम्
transliteration: abhipetus tataḥ sarve tasya amātyāḥ śuci vratam

sanskrit: अन्त काले निपतितम् ययातिम् ऋषयो यथा
शत्रुघ्नः च अपि भरतम् दृष्ट्वा शोक परिप्लुतम्
transliteration: anta kāle nipatitam yayātim ṛṣayo yathā
śatrughnaḥ ca api bharatam dṛṣṭvā śoka pariplutam

sanskrit: विसम्ज्ञो न्यपतत् भूमौ भूमि पालम् अनुस्मरन्
transliteration: visamjño nyapatat bhūmau bhūmi pālam anusmaran

sanskrit: स्मृत्वा पितुर् गुण अन्गानि तनि तानि तदा तदा
मन्थरा प्रभवः तीव्रः कैकेयी ग्राह सम्कुलः
transliteration: smṛtvā pitur guṇa angāni tani tāni tadā tadā
mantharā prabhavaḥ tīvraḥ kaikeyī grāha samkulaḥ

sanskrit: वर दानमयो अक्षोभ्यो अमज्जयत् शोक सागरः
सुकुमारम् च बालम् च सततम् लालितम् त्वया
transliteration: vara dānamayo akṣobhyo amajjayat śoka sāgaraḥ
sukumāram ca bālam ca satatam lālitam tvayā

sanskrit: क्व तात भरतम् हित्वा विलपन्तम् गतः भवान्
ननु भोज्येषु पानेषु वस्त्रेष्व् आभरणेषु च
transliteration: kva tāta bharatam hitvā vilapantam gataḥ bhavān
nanu bhojyeṣu pāneṣu vastreṣv ābharaṇeṣu ca

sanskrit: प्रवारयसि नः सर्वाम्स् तन् नः को अद्य करिष्यति
अवदारण काले तु पृथिवी न अवदीर्यते
transliteration: pravārayasi naḥ sarvāms tan naḥ ko adya kariṣyati
avadāraṇa kāle tu pṛthivī na avadīryate

sanskrit: विहीना या त्वया राज्ञा धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना
पितरि स्वर्गम् आपन्ने रामे च अरण्यम् आश्रिते
transliteration: vihīnā yā tvayā rājñā dharmajñena mahātmanā
pitari svargam āpanne rāme ca araṇyam āśrite

sanskrit: किम् मे जीवित सामर्थ्यम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुत अशनम्
हीनो भ्रात्रा च पित्रा च शून्याम् इक्ष्वाकु पालिताम्
transliteration: kim me jīvita sāmarthyam pravekṣyāmi huta aśanam
hīno bhrātrā ca pitrā ca śūnyām ikṣvāku pālitām

sanskrit: अयोध्याम् न प्रवेक्ष्यामि प्रवेक्ष्यामि तपो वनम्
तयोः विलपितम् श्रुत्वा व्यसनम् च अन्ववेक्ष्य तत्
transliteration: ayodhyām na pravekṣyāmi pravekṣyāmi tapo vanam
tayoḥ vilapitam śrutvā vyasanam ca anvavekṣya tat

sanskrit: ततः विषण्णौ श्रान्तौ च शत्रुघ्न भरताव् उभौ
transliteration: tataḥ viṣaṇṇau śrāntau ca śatrughna bharatāv ubhau

sanskrit: धरण्याम् सम्व्यचेष्टेताम् भग्न शृन्गाव् इव ऋषभौ
ततः प्रकृतिमान् वैद्यः पितुर् एषाम् पुरोहितः
transliteration: dharaṇyām samvyaceṣṭetām bhagna śṛngāv iva ṛṣabhau
tataḥ prakṛtimān vaidyaḥ pitur eṣām purohitaḥ

sanskrit: वसिष्ठो भरतम् वाक्यम् उत्थाप्य तम् उवाच ह
transliteration: vasiṣṭho bharatam vākyam utthāpya tam uvāca ha

sanskrit: तेषु च अपरिहार्येषु न एवम् भवितुम् अर्हति
सुमन्त्रः च अपि शत्रुघ्नम् उत्थाप्य अभिप्रसाद्य च
transliteration: teṣu ca aparihāryeṣu na evam bhavitum arhati
sumantraḥ ca api śatrughnam utthāpya abhiprasādya ca

sanskrit: श्रावयाम् आस तत्त्वज्ञः सर्व भूत भव अभवौ
उत्थितौ तौ नर व्याघ्रौ प्रकाशेते यशस्विनौ
transliteration: śrāvayām āsa tattvajñaḥ sarva bhūta bhava abhavau
utthitau tau nara vyāghrau prakāśete yaśasvinau

sanskrit: वर्ष आतप परिक्लिन्नौ पृथग् इन्द्र ध्वजाव् इव
अश्रूणि परिमृद्नन्तौ रक्त अक्षौ दीन भाषिणौ
transliteration: varṣa ātapa pariklinnau pṛthag indra dhvajāv iva
aśrūṇi parimṛdnantau rakta akṣau dīna bhāṣiṇau

sanskrit: अमात्याः त्वरयन्ति स्म तनयौ च अपराः क्रियाः
transliteration: amātyāḥ tvarayanti sma tanayau ca aparāḥ kriyāḥ
english: And as the princes stood there shedding tears, with reddened eyes, and speaking sadly, the courers urged nem on in behalf of the rites that remained.

sanskrit: अत्र यात्राम् समीहन्तम् शत्रुघ्नः लक्ष्मण अनुजः
भरतम् शोक सम्तप्तम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: atra yātrām samīhantam śatrughnaḥ lakṣmaṇa anujaḥ
bharatam śoka samtaptam idam vacanam abravīt
english: Then ſatrughna, the younger brother of Lakşmaņa spoke to Bharata burning in grief as he was revolving in his mind the (intended) journey (to Rāma).

sanskrit: गतिर् यः सर्व भूतानाम् दुह्खे किम् पुनर् आत्मनः
स रामः सत्त्व सम्पन्नः स्त्रिया प्रव्राजितः वनम्
transliteration: gatir yaḥ sarva bhūtānām duhkhe kim punar ātmanaḥ
sa rāmaḥ sattva sampannaḥ striyā pravrājitaḥ vanam
english: Need it be said that Rāma is the refuge both of himself and all creatures in trouble? That Rāma possessed of strength has been exiled into the woods by a woman!

sanskrit: बलवान् वीर्य सम्पन्नो लक्ष्मणो नाम यो अपि असौ
किम् न मोचयते रामम् कृत्वा अपि पितृ निग्रहम्
transliteration: balavān vīrya sampanno lakṣmaṇo nāma yo api asau
kim na mocayate rāmam kṛtvā api pitṛ nigraham
english: And powerful and having prowess, why did not Laksmana deliver Rāma by checking our father?

sanskrit: पूर्वम् एव तु निग्राह्यः समवेक्ष्य नय अनयौ
उत्पथम् यः समारूढो नार्या राजा वशम् गतः
transliteration: pūrvam eva tu nigrāhyaḥ samavekṣya naya anayau
utpatham yaḥ samārūḍho nāryā rājā vaśam gataḥ
english: The king bent upon following an unrighteous course through the influence of a woman, should, the justice or otherwise of the measure being fully weighed, at the very outset have been checked.

sanskrit: इति सम्भाषमाणे तु शत्रुघ्ने लक्ष्मण अनुजे
प्राग् द्वारे अभूत् तदा कुब्जा सर्व आभरण भूषिता
transliteration: iti sambhāṣamāṇe tu śatrughne lakṣmaṇa anuje
prāg dvāre abhūt tadā kubjā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā
english: As Lakşmaņa's younger brother Satrughna was speaking thus, appeared there at the door in front the hump backed one adorned with every kind of ornament, with her body besmeared with sandal paste, wearing regal apparel, and variously decked out with a variety of ornaments.

sanskrit: लिप्ता चन्दन सारेण राज वस्त्राणि बिभ्रती
transliteration: liptā candana sāreṇa rāja vastrāṇi bibhratī
english: As Lakşmaņa's younger brother Satrughna was speaking thus, appeared there at the door in front the hump backed one adorned with every kind of ornament, with her body besmeared with sandal paste, wearing regal apparel, and variously decked out with a variety of ornaments.

sanskrit: मेखला दामभिः चित्रै रज्जु बद्धा इव वानरी
transliteration: mekhalā dāmabhiḥ citrai rajju baddhā iva vānarī
english: And adorned with elegant zones, and divers other superb ornaments, she looked like a female monkey tethered with a rope.

sanskrit: ताम् समीक्ष्य तदा द्वाह्स्थो भृशम् पापस्य कारिणीम्
transliteration: tām samīkṣya tadā dvāhstho bhṛśam pāpasya kāriṇīm
english: At that time seeing that one of horrible misdeeds, (Bharata) who stood near the door, seizing the hump backed one ruthlessly, took her to Satrughna, and said.

sanskrit: यस्याः कृते वने रामः न्यस्त देहः च वः पिता
सा इयम् पापा नृशम्सा च तस्याः कुरु यथा मति
transliteration: yasyāḥ kṛte vane rāmaḥ nyasta dehaḥ ca vaḥ pitā
sā iyam pāpā nṛśamsā ca tasyāḥ kuru yathā mati
english: That one through whom Rāma has gone to the wood and our father has renounced his body this is that wicked and remorseless one. Do you deal with her as you like.

sanskrit: शत्रुघ्नः च तत् आज्ञाय वचनम् भृश दुह्खितः
अन्तः पुर चरान् सर्वान् इति उवाच धृत व्रतः
transliteration: śatrughnaḥ ca tat ājñāya vacanam bhṛśa duhkhitaḥ
antaḥ pura carān sarvān iti uvāca dhṛta vrataḥ
english: At Bharata's command Satrughna observing vows waxing exceedingly aggrieved, addressed all the inmates of the inner apartment, saying.

sanskrit: तीव्रम् उत्पादितम् दुह्खम् भ्रातृऋणाम् मे तथा पितुः
यया सा इयम् नृशम्सस्य कर्मणः फलम् अश्नुताम्
transliteration: tīvram utpāditam duhkham bhrātṛṛṇām me tathā pituḥ
yayā sā iyam nṛśamsasya karmaṇaḥ phalam aśnutām
english: This one has occasioned intense misery to my father and brothers Let her now take the fruit of her fell deed.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता च तेन आशु सखी जन समावृता
गृहीता बलवत् कुब्जा सा तत् गृहम् अनादयत्
transliteration: evam uktā ca tena āśu sakhī jana samāvṛtā
gṛhītā balavat kubjā sā tat gṛham anādayat
english: Having said this, he furiously fell upon the hump backed one surrounded by her maids. Thereupon she with her cries made the chamber resound.

sanskrit: ततः सुभृश सम्तप्तः तस्याः सर्वः सखी जनः
transliteration: tataḥ subhṛśa samtaptaḥ tasyāḥ sarvaḥ sakhī janaḥ
english: Concluding Śatrughna fired with rage, her associates extremely pained, fled away in all directions.

sanskrit: अमन्त्रयत कृत्स्नः च तस्याः सर्व सखी जनः
यथा अयम् समुपक्रान्तः निह्शेषम् नः करिष्यति
transliteration: amantrayata kṛtsnaḥ ca tasyāḥ sarva sakhī janaḥ
yathā ayam samupakrāntaḥ nihśeṣam naḥ kariṣyati
english: Then her companions in a body took counsel of each other, saying, “considering the way in which he has entered upon it, he will annihilate us quite."

sanskrit: सानुक्रोशाम् वदान्याम् च धर्मज्ञाम् च यशस्विनीम्
कौसल्याम् शरणम् यामः सा हि नो अस्तु ध्रुवा गतिः
transliteration: sānukrośām vadānyām ca dharmajñām ca yaśasvinīm
kausalyām śaraṇam yāmaḥ sā hi no astu dhruvā gatiḥ
english: Let us therefore seek the protection of the tender hearted generous, pious and illustrious Kausalyā. Even she is our sure refuge.

sanskrit: स च रोषेण ताम्र अक्षः शत्रुघ्नः शत्रु तापनः
विचकर्ष तदा कुब्जाम् क्रोशन्तीम् पृथिवी तले
transliteration: sa ca roṣeṇa tāmra akṣaḥ śatrughnaḥ śatru tāpanaḥ
vicakarṣa tadā kubjām krośantīm pṛthivī tale
english: Overpowered with rage, that chastiser of foes, Śatrughna, dragged the shrieking hump backed one to the ground.

sanskrit: तस्या हि आकृष्यमाणाया मन्थरायाः ततः ततः
चित्रम् बहु विधम् भाण्डम् पृथिव्याम् तत् व्यशीर्यत
transliteration: tasyā hi ākṛṣyamāṇāyā mantharāyāḥ tataḥ tataḥ
citram bahu vidham bhāṇḍam pṛthivyām tat vyaśīryata
english: As Mantharā was pushed this way and that, her various ornaments were scattered over the floor.

sanskrit: तेन भाण्डेन सम्कीर्णम् श्रीमद् राज निवेशनम्
अशोभत तदा भूयः शारदम् गगनम् यथा
transliteration: tena bhāṇḍena samkīrṇam śrīmad rāja niveśanam
aśobhata tadā bhūyaḥ śāradam gaganam yathā
english: And strewn with those ornaments, the graceful chamber of the palace looked like the autumnal firmament.

sanskrit: स बली बलवत् क्रोधात् गृहीत्वा पुरुष ऋषभः
transliteration: sa balī balavat krodhāt gṛhītvā puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ
english: And that foremost of men possessed of strength holding her, began to reprove Kaikeyī with harsh speech.

sanskrit: तैः वाक्यैः परुषैः दुह्खैः कैकेयी भृश दुह्हिता
शत्रुघ्न भय सम्त्रस्ता पुत्रम् शरणम् आगता
transliteration: taiḥ vākyaiḥ paruṣaiḥ duhkhaiḥ kaikeyī bhṛśa duhhitā
śatrughna bhaya samtrastā putram śaraṇam āgatā
english: Extremely hurt by those rough words, Kaikeyi terrified on account of Satrughna, took refuge with her son.

sanskrit: ताम् प्रेक्ष्य भरतः क्रुद्धम् शत्रुघ्नम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
अवध्याः सर्व भूतानाम् प्रमदाः क्षम्यताम् इति
transliteration: tām prekṣya bharataḥ kruddham śatrughnam idam abravīt
avadhyāḥ sarva bhūtānām pramadāḥ kṣamyatām iti
english: Thereupon casting his eyes on Satrughna, Bharata said, “A woman is incapable of being slain by any. Do you therefore excuse her.”

sanskrit: हन्याम् अहम् इमाम् पापाम् कैकेयीम् दुष्ट चारिणीम्
यदि माम् धार्मिको रामः न असूयेन् मातृ घातकम्
transliteration: hanyām aham imām pāpām kaikeyīm duṣṭa cāriṇīm
yadi mām dhārmiko rāmaḥ na asūyen mātṛ ghātakam
english: I myself would have slain this wicked Kaikeyi of impious deeds, if the righteous Rāma should not be displeased with me on account of my slaying my mother.

sanskrit: इमाम् अपि हताम् कुब्जाम् यदि जानाति राघवः
त्वाम् च माम् चैव धर्म आत्मा न अभिभाषिष्यते ध्रुवम्
transliteration: imām api hatām kubjām yadi jānāti rāghavaḥ
tvām ca mām caiva dharma ātmā na abhibhāṣiṣyate dhruvam
english: If Rāghava knows that the hump-backed one has been slain, he sure' will speak neither with you nor me.

sanskrit: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नः लक्ष्मण अनुजः
न्यवर्तत ततः रोषात् ताम् मुमोच च मन्थराम्
transliteration: bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā śatrughnaḥ lakṣmaṇa anujaḥ
nyavartata tataḥ roṣāt tām mumoca ca mantharām
english: Hearing Bharata's words, Satrughna, younger brother to Lakşmaņa, refrained from that wrong and set free the hump-backed woman in a swoon.

sanskrit: सा पाद मूले कैकेय्या मन्थरा निपपात ह
निह्श्वसन्ती सुदुह्ख आर्ता कृपणम् विललाप च
transliteration: sā pāda mūle kaikeyyā mantharā nipapāta ha
nihśvasantī suduhkha ārtā kṛpaṇam vilalāpa ca
english: Thereat, sighing hard in exceeding grief, Mantharā flung herself and Kaikeyi's feet, weeping piteously.

Seeing the hump-backed one deprived of her senses in consequence of the pushing she had received at the hands of Satrughna, Bharata's mother consoled that distressed woman, who appeared like a Krauñci that had been entrapped.

sanskrit: ततः प्रभात समये दिवसे अथ चतुर्दशे
समेत्य राज कर्तारः भरतम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāta samaye divase atha caturdaśe
sametya rāja kartāraḥ bharatam vākyam abruvan
english: Then on the morning of the fourteenth day, the ministers of the king assembled addressed Bharata in the following words.

sanskrit: गतः दशरथः स्वर्गम् यो नो गुरुतरः गुरुः
रामम् प्रव्राज्य वै ज्येष्ठम् लक्ष्मणम् च महा बलम्
transliteration: gataḥ daśarathaḥ svargam yo no gurutaraḥ guruḥ
rāmam pravrājya vai jyeṣṭham lakṣmaṇam ca mahā balam
english: Having exiled his eldest son and the exceedingly strong Lakşmaņa, Dasaratha who was the superior of our superiors has gone to heaven. Do you, therefore, O illustrious prince, become our king. Having been permitted by the king you will commit no fault (by doing so), as this kingdom is without a master.

sanskrit: त्वम् अद्य भव नो राजा राज पुत्र महा यशः
सम्गत्या न अपराध्नोति राज्यम् एतत् अनायकम्
transliteration: tvam adya bhava no rājā rāja putra mahā yaśaḥ
samgatyā na aparādhnoti rājyam etat anāyakam
english: Having exiled his eldest son and the exceedingly strong Lakşmaņa, Dasaratha who was the superior of our superiors has gone to heaven. Do you, therefore, O illustrious prince, become our king. Having been permitted by the king you will commit no fault (by doing so), as this kingdom is without a master.

sanskrit: प्रतीक्षते त्वाम् स्व जनः श्रेणयः च नृप आत्मज
transliteration: pratīkṣate tvām sva janaḥ śreṇayaḥ ca nṛpa ātmaja
english: O Raghava, having procured all these necessaries for the installation, the counsellor and othe, as well as the citizens wait, О king's son.

sanskrit: राज्यम् गृहाण भरत पितृ पैतामहम् महत्
अभिषेचय च आत्मानम् पाहि च अस्मान् नर ऋषभ
transliteration: rājyam gṛhāṇa bharata pitṛ paitāmaham mahat
abhiṣecaya ca ātmānam pāhi ca asmān nara ṛṣabha
english: Do you, O Bharata, take charge of this secure kingdom bequeathed by your father and grandfather. Do you, O foremost of men, have yourself sprinkled, and rule over us.

sanskrit: भरतः तम् जनम् सर्वम् प्रत्युवाच धृत व्रतः
transliteration: bharataḥ tam janam sarvam pratyuvāca dhṛta vrataḥ
english: Thereupon, having gone round all the things procured for the sprinkling, Bharata from in his vows addressed those persons, saying.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठस्य राजता नित्यम् उचिता हि कुलस्य नः
न एवम् भवन्तः माम् वक्तुम् अर्हन्ति कुशला जनाः
transliteration: jyeṣṭhasya rājatā nityam ucitā hi kulasya naḥ
na evam bhavantaḥ mām vaktum arhanti kuśalā janāḥ
english: In our line it is ever fit for the first-born alone to perform the task of government. It does not behove you who are wise to say so to me.

sanskrit: रामः पूर्वो हि नो भ्राता भविष्यति मही पतिः
अहम् तु अरण्ये वत्स्यामि वर्षाणि नव पन्च च
transliteration: rāmaḥ pūrvo hi no bhrātā bhaviṣyati mahī patiḥ
aham tu araṇye vatsyāmi varṣāṇi nava panca ca
english: Certainly Rāma our eldest brother shall become the king; and I will abide in the forest for five all nine years.

sanskrit: युज्यताम् महती सेना चतुर् अन्ग महा बला
आनयिष्याम्य् अहम् ज्येष्ठम् भ्रातरम् राघवम् वनात्
transliteration: yujyatām mahatī senā catur anga mahā balā
ānayiṣyāmy aham jyeṣṭham bhrātaram rāghavam vanāt
english: Do you array the grand and mighty my consisting of fourfold forces. I will bring back from the forest my eldest brother Rāghava.

sanskrit: पुरः कृत्य गमिष्यामि राम हेतोर् वनम् प्रति
transliteration: puraḥ kṛtya gamiṣyāmi rāma hetor vanam prati
english: And taking all these necessaries for the investiture in front, I will go in the direction of the forest for Rāma. And sprinkling that chief of men on the spot, I will placing him in our front, bring Rāma back, like to fire brought in from the sacrifice.

sanskrit: तत्र एव तम् नर व्याघ्रम् अभिषिच्य पुरः कृतम्
आनेष्यामि तु वै रामम् हव्य वाहम् इव अध्वरात्
transliteration: tatra eva tam nara vyāghram abhiṣicya puraḥ kṛtam
āneṣyāmi tu vai rāmam havya vāham iva adhvarāt
english: And taking all these necessaries for the investiture in front, I will go in the direction of the forest for Rāma. And sprinkling that chief of men on the spot, I will placing him in our front, bring Rāma back, like to fire brought in from the sacrifice.

sanskrit: न सकामा करिष्यामि स्वम् इमाम् मातृ गन्धिनीम्
वने वत्स्याम्य् अहम् दुर्गे रामः राजा भविष्यति
transliteration: na sakāmā kariṣyāmi svam imām mātṛ gandhinīm
vane vatsyāmy aham durge rāmaḥ rājā bhaviṣyati
english: I will never fulfil the desire of this lady proud of her son. I will inhabit the impracticable woods, and Rāma shall become the monarch.

sanskrit: क्रियताम् शिल्पिभिः पन्थाः समानि विषमाणि च
रक्षिणः च अनुसम्यान्तु पथि दुर्ग विचारकाः
transliteration: kriyatām śilpibhiḥ panthāḥ samāni viṣamāṇi ca
rakṣiṇaḥ ca anusamyāntu pathi durga vicārakāḥ
english: Let workmen lay out level roads in uneven tracts; and let those men that are adepts in threading places difficult to pass through, follow us.

sanskrit: एवम् सम्भाषमाणम् तम् राम हेतोर् नृप आत्मजम्
प्रत्युवाच जनः सर्वः श्रीमद् वाक्यम् अनुत्तमम्
transliteration: evam sambhāṣamāṇam tam rāma hetor nṛpa ātmajam
pratyuvāca janaḥ sarvaḥ śrīmad vākyam anuttamam
english: When the prince had spoken thus in behalf of Rāma, all those persons answered him in these excellent words.

sanskrit: एवम् ते भाषमाणस्य पद्मा श्रीर् उपतिष्ठताम्
यः त्वम् ज्येष्ठे नृप सुते पृथिवीम् दातुम् इच्चसि
transliteration: evam te bhāṣamāṇasya padmā śrīr upatiṣṭhatām
yaḥ tvam jyeṣṭhe nṛpa sute pṛthivīm dātum iccasi
english: For saying this, may Lakşmi seated on the lotus remain at they side; inasmuch you wish to confer the earth on the eldest son of the monarch!
Hearing that graceful speech of the king's son, tear-drops. begot of delight began to trickle from their eyes and adorned those noble countenances.

sanskrit: ऊचुस् ते वचनम् इदम् निशम्य हृष्टाः
पन्थानम् नर वर भक्तिमान् जनः च
व्यादिष्टः तव वचनाच् च शिल्पि वर्गः
transliteration: ūcus te vacanam idam niśamya hṛṣṭāḥ
panthānam nara vara bhaktimān janaḥ ca
vyādiṣṭaḥ tava vacanāc ca śilpi vargaḥ
english: Their grief removed, with cheerful hearts, the counsellors, courtiers, and others hearing that speech (of the prince), said, “O best of men, according to your order artizans as well as people cherishing a high regard for you have been directed to lay out a read."

sanskrit: अथ भूमि प्रदेशज्ञाः सूत्र कर्म विशारदाः
स्व कर्म अभिरताः शूराः खनका यन्त्रकाः तथा
transliteration: atha bhūmi pradeśajñāḥ sūtra karma viśāradāḥ
sva karma abhiratāḥ śūrāḥ khanakā yantrakāḥ tathā

sanskrit: कर्म अन्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुषा यन्त्र कोविदाः
तथा वर्धकयः चैव मार्गिणो वृक्ष तक्षकाः
transliteration: karma antikāḥ sthapatayaḥ puruṣā yantra kovidāḥ
tathā vardhakayaḥ caiva mārgiṇo vṛkṣa takṣakāḥ

sanskrit: कूप काराः सुधा कारा वम्श कर्म कृतः तथा
समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतः ते प्रतस्थिरे
transliteration: kūpa kārāḥ sudhā kārā vamśa karma kṛtaḥ tathā
samarthā ye ca draṣṭāraḥ purataḥ te pratasthire

sanskrit: स तु हर्षात् तम् उद्देशम् जन ओघो विपुलः प्रयान्
अशोभत महा वेगः सागरस्य इव पर्वणि
transliteration: sa tu harṣāt tam uddeśam jana ogho vipulaḥ prayān
aśobhata mahā vegaḥ sāgarasya iva parvaṇi
english: And as the mighty throng began to proceed, it resembled the swell of the sea on the occasion of a parva.

sanskrit: ते स्व वारम् समास्थाय वर्त्म कर्माणि कोविदाः
transliteration: te sva vāram samāsthāya vartma karmāṇi kovidāḥ
english: And number of men skilled in roadconstructing went before furnished with various implements.

sanskrit: लता वल्लीः च गुल्मामः च स्थाणून् अश्मनएव च
जनाः ते चक्रिरे मार्गम् चिन्दन्तः विविधान् द्रुमान्
transliteration: latā vallīḥ ca gulmāmaḥ ca sthāṇūn aśmanaeva ca
janāḥ te cakrire mārgam cindantaḥ vividhān drumān
english: And hewing away boughs, plants and shrubs and woody projections, stones, and diverse trees, they went on preparing a road.

sanskrit: अवृक्षेषु च देशेषु केचित् वृक्षान् अरोपयन्
केचित् कुठारैअः टन्कैः च दात्रैः चिन्दन् क्वचित् क्वचित्
transliteration: avṛkṣeṣu ca deśeṣu kecit vṛkṣān aropayan
kecit kuṭhāraiaḥ ṭankaiḥ ca dātraiḥ cindan kvacit kvacit

sanskrit: विधमन्ति स्म दुर्गाणि स्थलानि च ततः ततः
transliteration: vidhamanti sma durgāṇi sthalāni ca tataḥ tataḥ

sanskrit: अपरे अपूरयन् कूपान् पाम्सुभिः श्वभ्रम् आयतम्
निम्न भागाम्स् तथा केचित् समामः चक्रुः समन्ततः
transliteration: apare apūrayan kūpān pāmsubhiḥ śvabhram āyatam
nimna bhāgāms tathā kecit samāmaḥ cakruḥ samantataḥ

sanskrit: बबन्धुर् बन्धनीयामः च क्षोद्यान् सम्चुक्षुदुस् तदा
बिभिदुर् भेदनीयामः च ताम्स् तान् देशान् नराः तदा
transliteration: babandhur bandhanīyāmaḥ ca kṣodyān samcukṣudus tadā
bibhidur bhedanīyāmaḥ ca tāms tān deśān narāḥ tadā
english: And those men threw bridges wherever they became necessary, and broke the earth wherever such a process was required, and excavated whenever such a process was required, and excavated whenever it was necessary.

sanskrit: अचिरेण एव कालेन परिवाहान् बहु उदकान्
चक्रुर् बहु विध आकारान् सागर प्रतिमान् बहून्
transliteration: acireṇa eva kālena parivāhān bahu udakān
cakrur bahu vidha ākārān sāgara pratimān bahūn
english: In a short time, they made places poor of water overflow with many and various expanses resembling the ocean.
And in tracts void of water, they digged divers receptacles of water, decorated with daises.

sanskrit: ससुधा कुट्टिम तलः प्रपुष्पित मही रुहः
मत्त उद्घुष्ट द्विज गणः पताकाभिर् अलम्कृतः
transliteration: sasudhā kuṭṭima talaḥ prapuṣpita mahī ruhaḥ
matta udghuṣṭa dvija gaṇaḥ patākābhir alamkṛtaḥ
english: And the way of the army, furnished with pavements of bricks and clay, with trees bearing blossoms, eloquent with the tunes of birds, decorated with pennons, sprinkled with sandal showers, and garnished with flowers of various kinds, looked exceedingly beautiful, like to the way of the celestials.

sanskrit: चन्दन उदक सम्सिक्तः नाना कुसुम भूषितः
बह्व् अशोभत सेनायाः पन्थाः स्वर्ग पथ उपमः
transliteration: candana udaka samsiktaḥ nānā kusuma bhūṣitaḥ
bahv aśobhata senāyāḥ panthāḥ svarga patha upamaḥ
english: And the way of the army, furnished with pavements of bricks and clay, with trees bearing blossoms, eloquent with the tunes of birds, decorated with pennons, sprinkled with sandal showers, and garnished with flowers of various kinds, looked exceedingly beautiful, like to the way of the celestials.

sanskrit: आज्ञाप्य अथ यथा आज्ञप्ति युक्ताः ते अधिकृता नराः
रमणीयेषु देशेषु बहु स्वादु फलेषु च
transliteration: ājñāpya atha yathā ājñapti yuktāḥ te adhikṛtā narāḥ
ramaṇīyeṣu deśeṣu bahu svādu phaleṣu ca
english: Then having received the command of Bharata, the men that were in charge of the tents, ordered (the workmen) to pitch the tents, and when they had been pitched at a romantic spot filled with tasteful fruits, in consonance with the injunction of the high-souled Bharata, the men decorated splendidly the tents which themselves were like the ornaments of the road.

sanskrit: यो निवेशः तु अभिप्रेतः भरतस्य महात्मनः
भूयः तम् शोभयाम् आसुर् भूषाभिर् भूषण उपमम्
transliteration: yo niveśaḥ tu abhipretaḥ bharatasya mahātmanaḥ
bhūyaḥ tam śobhayām āsur bhūṣābhir bhūṣaṇa upamam

english: Under an auspicious star and at a favourable hour, men well up in the work set the encampment of the high-souled Bharata.

sanskrit: बहु पाम्सु चयाः च अपि परिखा परिवारिताः
तन्त्र इन्द्र कील प्रतिमाः प्रतोली वर शोभिताः
transliteration: bahu pāmsu cayāḥ ca api parikhā parivāritāḥ
tantra indra kīla pratimāḥ pratolī vara śobhitāḥ

sanskrit: प्रासाद माला सम्युक्ताः सौध प्राकार सम्वृताः
पताका शोभिताः सर्वे सुनिर्मित महा पथाः
transliteration: prāsāda mālā samyuktāḥ saudha prākāra samvṛtāḥ
patākā śobhitāḥ sarve sunirmita mahā pathāḥ

sanskrit: विसर्पत्भिर् इव आकाशे विटन्क अग्र विमानकैः
समुच्च्रितैः निवेशाः ते बभुः शक्र पुर उपमाः
transliteration: visarpatbhir iva ākāśe viṭanka agra vimānakaiḥ
samuccritaiḥ niveśāḥ te babhuḥ śakra pura upamāḥ

sanskrit: जाह्नवीम् तु समासाद्य विविध द्रुम काननाम्
शीतल अमल पानीयाम् महा मीन समाकुलाम्
transliteration: jāhnavīm tu samāsādya vividha druma kānanām
śītala amala pānīyām mahā mīna samākulām

sanskrit: नर इन्द्र मार्गः स तथा व्यराजत
transliteration: nara indra mārgaḥ sa tathā vyarājata
english: And passing by the Jāhnavi abounding in various trees and woods, of cool and crystal waters, and filled with mighty fishes, that way of the chief of men constructed by artizans, looked more and more lovely as it proceeded, as the unclouded sky looks beautiful at night, adorned with innumerable stars.

sanskrit: ततः नान्दी मुखीम् रात्रिम् भरतम् सूत मागधाः
तुष्टुवुर् वाग् विशेषज्ञाः स्तवैः मन्गल सम्हितैः
transliteration: tataḥ nāndī mukhīm rātrim bharatam sūta māgadhāḥ
tuṣṭuvur vāg viśeṣajñāḥ stavaiḥ mangala samhitaiḥ
english: Then seeing that the night in which had been performed the auspicious preliminary ceremonies, was about to be spent, eulogists and genealogists hymned Bharata with consecrated hymns.

sanskrit: सुवर्ण कोण अभिहतः प्राणदद् याम दुन्दुभिः
दध्मुः शन्खामः च शतशो वाद्यामः च उच्च अवच स्वरान्
transliteration: suvarṇa koṇa abhihataḥ prāṇadad yāma dundubhiḥ
dadhmuḥ śankhāmaḥ ca śataśo vādyāmaḥ ca ucca avaca svarān
english: And then sounded the kettle-drum, beaten by a golden stick, announcing the departure of the night; and people sounded conchs and other instruments by hundreds furnished with soft and loud sounds.

sanskrit: स तूर्य घोषः सुमहान् दिवम् आपूरयन्न् इव
भरतम् शोक सम्तप्तम् भूयः शोकैः अरन्ध्रयत्
transliteration: sa tūrya ghoṣaḥ sumahān divam āpūrayann iva
bharatam śoka samtaptam bhūyaḥ śokaiḥ arandhrayat
english: And as if filling the heavens, those powerful blasts of the trumpet repeatedly rendered Bharata burning in grief the more aggrieved.

sanskrit: ततः प्रबुद्धो भरतः तम् घोषम् सम्निवर्त्य च
न अहम् राजा इति च अपि उक्त्वा शत्रुघ्नम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ prabuddho bharataḥ tam ghoṣam samnivartya ca
na aham rājā iti ca api uktvā śatrughnam idam abravīt
english: Then awaking and silencing those sounds with saying, “I am not the king," he said to Satrughna.

sanskrit: पश्य शत्रुघ्न कैकेय्या लोकस्य अपकृतम् महत्
विसृज्य मयि दुह्खानि राजा दशरथो गतः
transliteration: paśya śatrughna kaikeyyā lokasya apakṛtam mahat
visṛjya mayi duhkhāni rājā daśaratho gataḥ
english: Behold, O Satrughna, in what a mighty wrong the people are engaged, on account of Kaikeyi. The king Dasaratha has gone away throwing down on me (the burthen of) this misery.

sanskrit: तस्य एषा धर्म राजस्य धर्म मूला महात्मनः
परिभ्रमति राज श्रीर् नौर् इव अकर्णिका जले
transliteration: tasya eṣā dharma rājasya dharma mūlā mahātmanaḥ
paribhramati rāja śrīr naur iva akarṇikā jale
english: The royal grace founded in righteousness of that magnanimous and virtuous monarch is wandering even like a boat on water having no helmsman.

sanskrit: यो हि नः सुमहान्नाथः सोऽपि प्रव्राजितो वनम्
अनया धर्ममुत्सृज्य मात्रा मे राघवः स्वयम्
transliteration: yo hi naḥ sumahānnāthaḥ so'pi pravrājito vanam
anayā dharmamutsṛjya mātrā me rāghavaḥ svayam
english: And he who is our mighty master has been banished into the woods by this mother of mine, who had (in doing so) renounced virtue.

sanskrit: इति एवम् भरतम् प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तम् विचेतनम्
कृपणम् रुरुदुः सर्वाः सस्वरम् योषितः तदा
transliteration: iti evam bharatam prekṣya vilapantam vicetanam
kṛpaṇam ruruduḥ sarvāḥ sasvaram yoṣitaḥ tadā
english: Seeing Bharata lamenting thus senseless, the ladies afflicted with sorrow began to wail in winsome accents.

sanskrit: तथा तस्मिन् विलपति वसिष्ठो राज धर्मवित्
सभाम् इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य प्रविवेश महा यशाः
transliteration: tathā tasmin vilapati vasiṣṭho rāja dharmavit
sabhām ikṣvāku nāthasya praviveśa mahā yaśāḥ

sanskrit: शात कुम्भमयीम् रम्याम् मणि रत्न समाकुलाम्
सुधर्माम् इव धर्म आत्मा सगणः प्रत्यपद्यत
transliteration: śāta kumbhamayīm ramyām maṇi ratna samākulām
sudharmām iva dharma ātmā sagaṇaḥ pratyapadyata

sanskrit: स कान्चनमयम् पीठम् पर अर्ध्य आस्तरण आवृतम्
अध्यास्त सर्व वेदज्ञो दूतान् अनुशशास च
transliteration: sa kāncanamayam pīṭham para ardhya āstaraṇa āvṛtam
adhyāsta sarva vedajño dūtān anuśaśāsa ca

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् योधान् अमात्यान् गण बल्लभान्
क्षिप्रम् आनयत अव्यग्राः कृत्यम् आत्ययिकम् हि नः
transliteration: brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān yodhān amātyān gaṇa ballabhān
kṣipram ānayata avyagrāḥ kṛtyam ātyayikam hi naḥ
english: Do you speedily with collected minds bring hither Brāhmaṇas and Kștriyas and warriors and counsellors and generals of forces and Satrughna with the other princes, and the famous Bharata and Yuddhajit* and Sumantra and others that are engaged in our welfare. *One of the counsellors.

sanskrit: युधाजितम् सुमन्त्रम् च ये च तत्र हिता जनाः
transliteration: yudhājitam sumantram ca ye ca tatra hitā janāḥ

sanskrit: रथैः अश्वैः गजैः च अपि जनानाम् उपगच्चताम्
transliteration: rathaiḥ aśvaiḥ gajaiḥ ca api janānām upagaccatām
english: Then there arose a mighty hubbub occasioned by people coming up in cars, horses and elephants.

sanskrit: ततः भरतम् आयान्तम् शत क्रतुम् इव अमराः
transliteration: tataḥ bharatam āyāntam śata kratum iva amarāḥ
english: When Bharata arrived, the subjects rejoiced as they used to rejoice on Daſaratha's arrival; and as rejoiced the immortals on the arrival of him of an hundred sacrifices.

And then the court resembling a moveless ocean containing whales and serpents,* and gems and conchs and gold-mines, being graced with the presence of Dasaratha's son, looked splendid as it formerly did with that of Dasaratha himself. *Nāga may also mean hypopotamus.

sanskrit: ताम् आर्य गण सम्पूर्णाम् भरतः प्रग्रहाम् सभाम्
ददर्श बुद्धि सम्पन्नः पूर्ण चन्द्राम् निशाम् इव
transliteration: tām ārya gaṇa sampūrṇām bharataḥ pragrahām sabhām
dadarśa buddhi sampannaḥ pūrṇa candrām niśām iva
english: And then the intelligent Bharata surveyed that assembly filled with noble, and worthy personages, resembling the night of the full moon.

sanskrit: आसनानि यथा न्यायम् आर्याणाम् विशताम् तदा
अदृश्यत घन अपाये पूर्ण चन्द्रा इव शर्वरी
transliteration: āsanāni yathā nyāyam āryāṇām viśatām tadā
adṛśyata ghana apāye pūrṇa candrā iva śarvarī
english: And that splendid assembly filled with learned people looked like he night of the full moon after the clouds have dispersed.
And that splendid assembly filled with learned people looked like he night of the full moon after the clouds have dispersed.

sanskrit: राज्ञः तु प्रकृतीः सर्वाः समग्राः प्रेक्ष्य धर्मवित्
इदम् पुरोहितः वाक्यम् भरतम् मृदु च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: rājñaḥ tu prakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ samagrāḥ prekṣya dharmavit
idam purohitaḥ vākyam bharatam mṛdu ca abravīt
english: And seeing all the subjects of the sovereign gathered together, the priest cognizant of virtue softly spoke to Bharata.

sanskrit: तात राजा दशरथः स्वर् गतः धर्मम् आचरन्
धन धान्यवतीम् स्फीताम् प्रदाय पृथिवीम् तव
transliteration: tāta rājā daśarathaḥ svar gataḥ dharmam ācaran
dhana dhānyavatīm sphītām pradāya pṛthivīm tava
english: Your child, leaving to you this prosperous carth abounding in corn and wealth, king Dasaratha having performed his duties, has gone to heaven.

sanskrit: रामः तथा सत्य धृतिः सताम् धर्मम् अनुस्मरन्
न अजहात् पितुर् आदेशम् शशी ज्योत्स्नाम् इव उदितः
transliteration: rāmaḥ tathā satya dhṛtiḥ satām dharmam anusmaran
na ajahāt pitur ādeśam śaśī jyotsnām iva uditaḥ
english: And Rāma of truthful character observing the virtue of the righteous has not set aside his father's commands. even as the risen moon does not renounce the moonlight.

sanskrit: पित्रा भ्रात्रा च ते दत्तम् राज्यम् निहत कण्टकम्
तत् भुन्क्ष्व मुदित अमात्यः क्षिप्रम् एव अभिषेचय
transliteration: pitrā bhrātrā ca te dattam rājyam nihata kaṇṭakam
tat bhunkṣva mudita amātyaḥ kṣipram eva abhiṣecaya
english: Loved by the courtiers, do you, having been installed, enjoy this kingdom conferred on you by your father and mother, rid of its thorn. Let princes throned as well as those without thrones, from east, and west, north and south, and also persons ranging the sea, procure countless gems (for presenting them to you.

sanskrit: उदीच्याः च प्रतीच्याः च दाक्षिणात्याः च केवलाः
कोट्या अपर अन्ताः सामुद्रा रत्नानि अभिहरन्तु ते
transliteration: udīcyāḥ ca pratīcyāḥ ca dākṣiṇātyāḥ ca kevalāḥ
koṭyā apara antāḥ sāmudrā ratnāni abhiharantu te
english: Loved by the courtiers, do you, having been installed, enjoy this kingdom conferred on you by your father and mother, rid of its thorn. Let princes throned as well as those without thrones, from east, and west, north and south, and also persons ranging the sea, procure countless gems (for presenting them to you.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा भरतः वाक्यम् शोकेन अभिपरिप्लुतः
जगाम मनसा रामम् धर्मज्ञो धर्म कान्क्षया
transliteration: tat śrutvā bharataḥ vākyam śokena abhipariplutaḥ
jagāma manasā rāmam dharmajño dharma kānkṣayā
english: Hearing this speech, Bharata cognizant of virtue, filled with sorrow, mentally repaired to Rāma desirous of reaping merit.

sanskrit: स बाष्प कलया वाचा कल हम्स स्वरः युवा
विललाप सभा मध्ये जगर्हे च पुरोहितम्
transliteration: sa bāṣpa kalayā vācā kala hamsa svaraḥ yuvā
vilalāpa sabhā madhye jagarhe ca purohitam
english: Then in words choked with the melodious voice of a swan, lamented and taxed the priest, in the midst of the assembly.

sanskrit: धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य को राज्यम् मद्विधो हरेत्
transliteration: dharme prayatamānasya ko rājyam madvidho haret
english: Who like myself ever deprives one that has led a Brahmacharya mode of life, that is endowed with understanding and performed his bath after having acquired learning, and that is always intent on righteousness, of one's kingdom?

sanskrit: कथम् दशरथाज् जातः भवेद् राज्य अपहारकः
राज्यम् च अहम् च रामस्य धर्मम् वक्तुम् इह अर्हसि
transliteration: katham daśarathāj jātaḥ bhaved rājya apahārakaḥ
rājyam ca aham ca rāmasya dharmam vaktum iha arhasi
english: How begot of Dasaratha, shall I deprive Rāma of his kingdom. It behove you to speak righteousness before this assembly.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः च धर्म आत्मा दिलीप नहुष उपमः
लब्धुम् अर्हति काकुत्स्थो राज्यम् दशरथो यथा
transliteration: jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ ca dharma ātmā dilīpa nahuṣa upamaḥ
labdhum arhati kākutstho rājyam daśaratho yathā
english: First-born, and foremost in merit, righteoussouled, and comparable to Dilipa and Nahuşa, Kākutstha deserves the kingdom, just as Dasaratha did.

sanskrit: अनार्य जुष्टम् अस्वर्ग्यम् कुर्याम् पापम् अहम् यदि
इक्ष्वाकूणाम् अहम् लोके भवेयम् कुल पाम्सनः
transliteration: anārya juṣṭam asvargyam kuryām pāpam aham yadi
ikṣvākūṇām aham loke bhaveyam kula pāmsanaḥ
english: If I commit myself to this sin dishonourable and calculated to bring me to perdition, I shall in this world bring disgrace on the race of the Ikşvākus.

sanskrit: यद्द् हि मात्रा कृतम् पापम् न अहम् तत् अभिरोचये
इहस्थो वन दुर्गस्थम् नमस्यामि कृत अन्जलिः
transliteration: yadd hi mātrā kṛtam pāpam na aham tat abhirocaye
ihastho vana durgastham namasyāmi kṛta anjaliḥ
english: I do not at all relish the sin that has been committed by mother. Remaining here with joined hands I bow down to Rāma gone to the forest fastness.

sanskrit: रामम् एव अनुगच्चामि स राजा द्विपदाम् वरः
त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् राघवो राज्यम् अर्हति
transliteration: rāmam eva anugaccāmi sa rājā dvipadām varaḥ
trayāṇām api lokānām rāghavo rājyam arhati
english: I will follow Rāma. That best of men is the king. Rāghava deserves the dominion of the three worlds themselves.

sanskrit: तत् वाक्यम् धर्म सम्युक्तम् श्रुत्वा सर्वे सभासदः
हर्षान् मुमुचुर् अश्रूणि रामे निहित चेतसः
transliteration: tat vākyam dharma samyuktam śrutvā sarve sabhāsadaḥ
harṣān mumucur aśrūṇi rāme nihita cetasaḥ
english: Hearing words informed with those righteousness, the entire assembly with their minds intent upon Rāma, from joy shed tears.

sanskrit: यदि तु आर्यम् न शक्ष्यामि विनिवर्तयितुम् वनात्
वने तत्र एव वत्स्यामि यथा आर्यो लक्ष्मणः तथा
transliteration: yadi tu āryam na śakṣyāmi vinivartayitum vanāt
vane tatra eva vatsyāmi yathā āryo lakṣmaṇaḥ tathā
english: If I fail to bring back the noble one from the forest, I will like the exalted Lakşmaņa remain even in that forest.

sanskrit: सर्व उपायम् तु वर्तिष्ये विनिवर्तयितुम् बलात्
समक्षम् आर्य मिश्राणाम् साधूनाम् गुण वर्तिनाम्
transliteration: sarva upāyam tu vartiṣye vinivartayitum balāt
samakṣam ārya miśrāṇām sādhūnām guṇa vartinām
english: I will in presence of this mixed assembly of pious and honourable persons following every perfection, adopt every expedient to bring back Rāma.

sanskrit: प्रस्थापिता मया पूर्वम् यात्रापि मम रोचते
transliteration: prasthāpitā mayā pūrvam yātrāpi mama rocate
english: I have already despatched beforehand persons serving for love as well as those for money, and layers of roads and their keepers, and I intend setting out now.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु धर्म आत्मा भरतः भ्रातृ वत्सलः
समीपस्थम् उवाच इदम् सुमन्त्रम् मन्त्र कोविदम्
transliteration: evam uktvā tu dharma ātmā bharataḥ bhrātṛ vatsalaḥ
samīpastham uvāca idam sumantram mantra kovidam
english: Having said this, the virtuous Bharata attached to his brother spoke to Sumantra skilled in counsel, who was by, saying.

sanskrit: तूर्णम् उत्थाय गच्च त्वम् सुमन्त्र मम शासनात्
यात्राम् आज्ञापय क्षिप्रम् बलम् चैव समानय
transliteration: tūrṇam utthāya gacca tvam sumantra mama śāsanāt
yātrām ājñāpaya kṣipram balam caiva samānaya
english: Up, and go, O Sumantra at my command. Do you make known this journey and bring the forces.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः सुमन्त्रः तु भरतेन महात्मना
हृष्टः सो अदिशत् सर्वम् यथा सम्दिष्टम् इष्टवत्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ sumantraḥ tu bharatena mahātmanā
hṛṣṭaḥ so adiśat sarvam yathā samdiṣṭam iṣṭavat
english: Thus accosted by the magnanimous Bharata, Sumantra with a cheerful heart issued orders concerning everything desirable as he was ordered.

sanskrit: ताः प्रहृष्टाः प्रकृतयो बल अध्यक्षा बलस्य च
transliteration: tāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ prakṛtayo bala adhyakṣā balasya ca
english: Hearing that the army had been ordered to march forth for bringing back Rāma, the subjects as well as the generals of the forces became exceedingly delighted.

sanskrit: ततः योध अन्गनाः सर्वा भर्तृऋन् सर्वान् गृहे गृहे
यात्रा गमनम् आज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः
transliteration: tataḥ yodha anganāḥ sarvā bhartṛṛn sarvān gṛhe gṛhe
yātrā gamanam ājñāya tvarayanti sma harṣitāḥ
english: Hearing of the journey to Rāma, for bringing him back the wives of the soldiers apprised of the order that had been issued to the latter, being exceedingly delighted, hurried on.

sanskrit: ते हयैः गो रथैः शीघ्रैः स्यन्दनैः च मनो जवैः
सह योधैः बल अध्यक्षा बलम् सर्वम् अचोदयन्
transliteration: te hayaiḥ go rathaiḥ śīghraiḥ syandanaiḥ ca mano javaiḥ
saha yodhaiḥ bala adhyakṣā balam sarvam acodayan
english: And the generals expeditiously despatched their forces with warriors by means of horses and cares and cars fleet as the mind.

sanskrit: सज्जम् तु तत् बलम् दृष्ट्वा भरतः गुरु सम्निधौ
रथम् मे त्वरयस्व इति सुमन्त्रम् पार्श्वतः अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sajjam tu tat balam dṛṣṭvā bharataḥ guru samnidhau
ratham me tvarayasva iti sumantram pārśvataḥ abravīt
english: Seeing those force marshalled, Bharata staying near his preceptor, said to Sumantra who was at his side, “Do you speedily bring my car”

sanskrit: भरतस्य तु तस्य आज्ञाम् प्रतिगृह्य प्रहर्षितः
रथम् गृहीत्वा प्रययौ युक्तम् परम वाजिभिः
transliteration: bharatasya tu tasya ājñām pratigṛhya praharṣitaḥ
ratham gṛhītvā prayayau yuktam parama vājibhiḥ
english: In obedience to the mandate of Bharata, Sumantra exceedingly rejoiced, appeared with the car yoked with superb steeds.

Then that powerful descendant of Raghu of truthful character, and having unswerving truth for his prowess, Bharata, having said what was fit, spoke words calculated to gladden his illustrious superior gone to the mighty forest.
O Sumantra, arise you speedily and, your desire fully attained, go by my command, and tell the chiefs of the army, and our principal adherents to array the forces.

sanskrit: बलस्य मुख्यामः च सुहृज् जनम् च
transliteration: balasya mukhyāmaḥ ca suhṛj janam ca

english: Thereat rising, Rājanyas and Vaisyas, and Vņşalas; and Vipras in every house began to yoke camels and cars and mules and elephants and excellent steeds.

sanskrit: ततः समुत्थितः काल्यम् आस्थाय स्यन्दन उत्तमम्
प्रययौ भरतः शीघ्रम् राम दर्शन कान्क्षया
transliteration: tataḥ samutthitaḥ kālyam āsthāya syandana uttamam
prayayau bharataḥ śīghram rāma darśana kānkṣayā
english: Rising with the morrow, Bharata anxious to behold Rāma, speedily set out ascending an excellent car.

sanskrit: अग्रतः प्रययुस् तस्य सर्वे मन्त्रि पुरोधसः
अधिरुह्य हयैः युक्तान् रथान् सूर्य रथ उपमान्
transliteration: agrataḥ prayayus tasya sarve mantri purodhasaḥ
adhiruhya hayaiḥ yuktān rathān sūrya ratha upamān
english: Before him went the councillors and priests, ascending cars resembling that of the Sun yoked with steeds.

sanskrit: नव नाग सहस्राणि कल्पितानि यथा विधि
अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दनम्
transliteration: nava nāga sahasrāṇi kalpitāni yathā vidhi
anvayur bharatam yāntam ikṣvāku kula nandanam
english: And a thousand elephants duly consecrated went in the wake of that son of the Ikşvāku line as he was proceeding.

sanskrit: षष्ठी रथ सहस्राणि धन्विनो विविध आयुधाः
अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् राज पुत्रम् यशस्विनम्
transliteration: ṣaṣṭhī ratha sahasrāṇi dhanvino vividha āyudhāḥ
anvayur bharatam yāntam rāja putram yaśasvinam
english: And six thousand with bow-men furnished with various weapons followed the illustrious prince Bharata as he was proceeding.

sanskrit: अन्वयुर् भरतम् यान्तम् राज पुत्रम् यशस्विनम्
transliteration: anvayur bharatam yāntam rāja putram yaśasvinam
english: And a hundred thousand horses mounted (by riders) went in the wake of that descendant of Raghu intent upon truth and having his senses under control.

sanskrit: कैकेयी च सुमित्रा च कौसल्या च यशस्विनी
राम आनयन सम्हृष्टा ययुर् यानेन भास्वता
transliteration: kaikeyī ca sumitrā ca kausalyā ca yaśasvinī
rāma ānayana samhṛṣṭā yayur yānena bhāsvatā
english: Kaikeyi and Sumitrā and the highly famous Kausalyā rejoicing at the prospect of the bringing of Rāma, went in an effulgent car. cars

sanskrit: प्रयाताः च आर्य सम्घाता रामम् द्रष्टुम् सलक्ष्मणम्
तस्य एव च कथाः चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्ट मानसाः
transliteration: prayātāḥ ca ārya samghātā rāmam draṣṭum salakṣmaṇam
tasya eva ca kathāḥ citrāḥ kurvāṇā hṛṣṭa mānasāḥ
english: And the honourable persons (belonging to all the three orders) went with the object of beholding Rāma in company with Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: मेघ श्यामम् महा बाहुम् स्थिर सत्त्वम् दृढ व्रतम्
कदा द्रक्ष्यामहे रामम् जगतः शोक नाशनम्
transliteration: megha śyāmam mahā bāhum sthira sattvam dṛḍha vratam
kadā drakṣyāmahe rāmam jagataḥ śoka nāśanam
english: They with glad hearts variously conversed with each other, “When shall we see the mighty armed Rāma sable like to a cloud, of steady strength, firm in vows, the remover of the world's grief?

sanskrit: दृष्टएव हि नः शोकम् अपनेष्यति राघवः
तमः सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्न् इव भास्करः
transliteration: dṛṣṭaeva hi naḥ śokam apaneṣyati rāghavaḥ
tamaḥ sarvasya lokasya samudyann iva bhāskaraḥ
english: As soon as we shall see him, Rāghava will remove our sorrow; even as the Sun arising dispels the darkness of the entire world.

sanskrit: इति एवम् कथयन्तः ते सम्प्रहृष्टाः कथाः शुभाः
परिष्वजानाः च अन्योन्यम् ययुर् नागरिकाः तदा
transliteration: iti evam kathayantaḥ te samprahṛṣṭāḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ
pariṣvajānāḥ ca anyonyam yayur nāgarikāḥ tadā
english: Thus cheerfully carrying on an auspicious talk, the citizens embracing each other went along.

sanskrit: ये च तत्र अपरे सर्वे सम्मता ये च नैगमाः
रामम् प्रति ययुर् हृष्टाः सर्वाः प्रकृतयः तदा
transliteration: ye ca tatra apare sarve sammatā ye ca naigamāḥ
rāmam prati yayur hṛṣṭāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayaḥ tadā
english: And all other, and the foremost merchants as well as all the principal classes, joyfully went in quest of Rāma.

sanskrit: मणि काराः च ये केचित् कुम्भ काराः च शोभनाः
सूत्र कर्म कृतः चैव ये च शस्त्र उपजीविनः
transliteration: maṇi kārāḥ ca ye kecit kumbha kārāḥ ca śobhanāḥ
sūtra karma kṛtaḥ caiva ye ca śastra upajīvinaḥ

sanskrit: दन्त काराः सुधा काराः तथा गन्ध उपजीविनः
transliteration: danta kārāḥ sudhā kārāḥ tathā gandha upajīvinaḥ

sanskrit: सुवर्ण काराः प्रख्याताः तथा कम्बल धावकाः
स्नापक आच्चादका वैद्या धूपकाः शौण्डिकाः तथा
transliteration: suvarṇa kārāḥ prakhyātāḥ tathā kambala dhāvakāḥ
snāpaka āccādakā vaidyā dhūpakāḥ śauṇḍikāḥ tathā

sanskrit: रजकाः तुन्न वायाः च ग्राम घोष महत्तराः
शैलूषाः च सह स्त्रीभिर् यान्ति कैवर्तकाः तथा
transliteration: rajakāḥ tunna vāyāḥ ca grāma ghoṣa mahattarāḥ
śailūṣāḥ ca saha strībhir yānti kaivartakāḥ tathā

sanskrit: गो रथैः भरतम् यान्तम् अनुजग्मुः सहस्रशः
transliteration: go rathaiḥ bharatam yāntam anujagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ

sanskrit: सुवेषाः शुद्ध वसनाः ताम्र मृष्ट अनुलेपनाः
सर्वे ते विविधैः यानैः शनैः भरतम् अन्वयुः
transliteration: suveṣāḥ śuddha vasanāḥ tāmra mṛṣṭa anulepanāḥ
sarve te vividhaiḥ yānaiḥ śanaiḥ bharatam anvayuḥ

sanskrit: प्रहृष्ट मुदिता सेना सान्वयात् कैकयी सुतम्
transliteration: prahṛṣṭa muditā senā sānvayāt kaikayī sutam
english: All these gradually followed Bharata by means of excellent vehicles. And the army delighted and in high spirits went in the wake of Kaikeyi's son attached to his brother, going to bring back his brother.

Going far by means of cars, vehicles, elephants, and horses, they arrived at the Gangā near Śrngaverapura, where was peacefully staying that friend of Rāma, the heroic Guha, surrounded by his relatives ruling the realm.

Going far by means of cars, vehicles, elephants, and horses, they arrived at the Gangā near Śrngaverapura, where was peacefully staying that friend of Rāma, the heroic Guha, surrounded by his relatives ruling the realm.

Having come to the banks of the Gangā graced with Cakravākas, the army which was following Bharata halted. Seeing the army inactive as well as the Gangā of sacred waters, Bharata versed in speech spoke to the courtiers.

sanskrit: निरीक्ष्य अनुगताम् सेनाम् ताम् च गन्गाम् शिव उदकाम्
भरतः सचिवान् सर्वान् अब्रवीद् वाक्य कोविदः
transliteration: nirīkṣya anugatām senām tām ca gangām śiva udakām
bharataḥ sacivān sarvān abravīd vākya kovidaḥ
english: Having come to the banks of the Gangā graced with Cakravākas, the army which was following Bharata halted. Seeing the army inactive as well as the Gangā of sacred waters, Bharata versed in speech spoke to the courtiers.
Do you communicating to all our intentions, encamp the army. Having been fatigued, we shall cross the ocean-going Gangā on the morrow.

sanskrit: दातुम् च तावद् इच्चामि स्वर् गतस्य मही पतेः
और्ध्वदेह निमित्त अर्थम् अवतीर्य उदकम् नदीम्
transliteration: dātum ca tāvad iccāmi svar gatasya mahī pateḥ
aurdhvadeha nimitta artham avatīrya udakam nadīm
english: Having crossed the stream, I am anxious to offer its water to the monarch, who has gone to heaven in behalf of his spiritual body.

sanskrit: तस्य एवम् ब्रुवतः अमात्याः तथा इति उक्त्वा समाहिताः
न्यवेशयम्स् तामः चन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक् पृथक्
transliteration: tasya evam bruvataḥ amātyāḥ tathā iti uktvā samāhitāḥ
nyaveśayams tāmaḥ candena svena svena pṛthak pṛthak
english: When he had said this, the courtiers with collected minds saying, “Be it so,” disposed their forces, each according to his wish.

sanskrit: निवेश्य गन्गाम् अनु ताम् महा नदीम्
transliteration: niveśya gangām anu tām mahā nadīm
english: Having on the mighty stream, Gangā, quartered his forces furnished with all appliances for the journey, Bharata remained there, revolving the means of making the high-souled Rāma turn back.

sanskrit: ततः निविष्टाम् ध्वजिनीम् गन्गाम् अन्वाश्रिताम् नदीम्
निषाद राजो दृष्ट्वा एव ज्ञातीन् सम्त्वरितः अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ niviṣṭām dhvajinīm gangām anvāśritām nadīm
niṣāda rājo dṛṣṭvā eva jñātīn samtvaritaḥ abravīt
english: Seeing the forces with banners flying quartered on the banks of the river Gangā, and engaged in carious occupations, the lord of the Nisadas, Guha, said to his relatives ranged around.

sanskrit: महती इयम् अतः सेना सागर आभा प्रदृश्यते
न अस्य अन्तम् अवगच्चामि मनसा अपि विचिन्तयन्
transliteration: mahatī iyam ataḥ senā sāgara ābhā pradṛśyate
na asya antam avagaccāmi manasā api vicintayan
english: This mighty host here appears like an ocean. I do not find its end even by thinking of it in my mind.

sanskrit: स एष हि महा कायः कोविदार ध्वजो रथे
transliteration: sa eṣa hi mahā kāyaḥ kovidāra dhvajo rathe
english: Surely the foolish Bharata has come hither himself: on his car appears the huge Kovidāra banner.

sanskrit: बन्धयिष्यति वा दाशान् अथ वा अस्मान् वधिष्यति
अथ दाशरथिम् रामम् पित्रा राज्यात् विवासितम्
transliteration: bandhayiṣyati vā dāśān atha vā asmān vadhiṣyati
atha dāśarathim rāmam pitrā rājyāt vivāsitam
english: Be like, he will either bind us by nooses or slay us and next Daśaratha's son Rāma banished from the kingdom by his sire.
Desirous of taking complete possession of the rare regal fortune of that sovereign (Rāma), Kaikeyi's son, Bharata, comes to destroy him.

sanskrit: भर्ता चैव सखा चैव रामः दाशरथिर् मम
तस्य अर्थ कामाः सम्नद्धा गन्गा अनूपे अत्र तिष्ठत
transliteration: bhartā caiva sakhā caiva rāmaḥ dāśarathir mama
tasya artha kāmāḥ samnaddhā gangā anūpe atra tiṣṭhata
english: Rāma the son of Daśaratha is both my maintainer and friend. Do you in his interests, donning on your mail, wait on the banks of the river.

sanskrit: तिष्ठन्तु सर्व दाशाः च गन्गाम् अन्वाश्रिता नदीम्
बल युक्ता नदी रक्षा माम्स मूल फल अशनाः
transliteration: tiṣṭhantu sarva dāśāḥ ca gangām anvāśritā nadīm
bala yuktā nadī rakṣā māmsa mūla phala aśanāḥ
english: And stationed on the river Gangā, let my powerful retainers subsisting on fruits and roots and meat, be prepared for opposing Bharata's passages over the river.

sanskrit: नावाम् शतानाम् पन्चानाम् कैवर्तानाम् शतम् शतम्
transliteration: nāvām śatānām pancānām kaivartānām śatam śatam
english: And let hundreds upon hundreds of Kaivarta youths accoutred in mail remain in each of five hundred barks., Guha issued this order.

sanskrit: यदा तुष्टः तु भरतः रामस्य इह भविष्यति
सा इयम् स्वस्तिमयी सेना गन्गाम् अद्य तरिष्यति
transliteration: yadā tuṣṭaḥ tu bharataḥ rāmasya iha bhaviṣyati
sā iyam svastimayī senā gangām adya tariṣyati
english: But if Bharata be well disposed towards Rāma, this host shall today safely cross the Ganga.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा उपायनम् गृह्य मत्स्य माम्स मधूनि च
transliteration: iti uktvā upāyanam gṛhya matsya māmsa madhūni ca
english: Having said this, the lord of the Nişādas, Guha, taking a present of flesh, fish and honey, went out for interviewing Bharata.

sanskrit: तम् आयान्तम् तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य सूत पुत्रः प्रतापवान्
transliteration: tam āyāntam tu samprekṣya sūta putraḥ pratāpavān
english: Seeing Guha approaching, the powerful son of the charioteer knowing season, humbly informed Bharata of it, saying.

sanskrit: कुशलो दण्डक अरण्ये वृद्धो भ्रातुः च ते सखा
transliteration: kuśalo daṇḍaka araṇye vṛddho bhrātuḥ ca te sakhā
english: This lord (that approaches) surrounded by his relatives, is very potent in Dandaka and is an old friend of your brother. Therefore let Guha, the lord of the Nişādas, see you, O Kākutstha. He indubitably knows where Rāma and Lakşmaņa are.

sanskrit: तस्मात् पश्यतु काकुत्स्थ त्वाम् निषाद अधिपो गुहः
असम्शयम् विजानीते यत्र तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: tasmāt paśyatu kākutstha tvām niṣāda adhipo guhaḥ
asamśayam vijānīte yatra tau rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: This lord (that approaches) surrounded by his relatives, is very potent in Dandaka and is an old friend of your brother. Therefore let Guha, the lord of the Nişādas, see you, O Kākutstha. He indubitably knows where Rāma and Lakşmaņa are.

sanskrit: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुमन्त्रात् भरतः शुभम्
उवाच वचनम् शीघ्रम् गुहः पश्यतु माम् इति
transliteration: etat tu vacanam śrutvā sumantrāt bharataḥ śubham
uvāca vacanam śīghram guhaḥ paśyatu mām iti
english: Hearing these wise words of Sumantra, Bharata at once said, "Let Guha see me."

sanskrit: आगम्य भरतम् प्रह्वो गुहो वचनम् अब्रवीइत्
transliteration: āgamya bharatam prahvo guho vacanam abravīit
english: Receiving permission, Guha, right glad, appeared before Bharata, bending low, and said.

sanskrit: निष्कुटः चैव देशो अयम् वन्चिताः च अपि ते वयम्
निवेदयामः ते सर्वे स्वके दाश कुले वस
transliteration: niṣkuṭaḥ caiva deśo ayam vancitāḥ ca api te vayam
nivedayāmaḥ te sarve svake dāśa kule vasa
english: This place is your home. But you have stolen a march over us. We dedicate all this to you. Do you reside in the abode of your servant.

sanskrit: अस्ति मूलम् फलम् चैव निषादैः समुपाहृतम्
आर्द्रम् च माम्सम् शुष्कम् च वन्यम् च उच्च अवचम् महत्
transliteration: asti mūlam phalam caiva niṣādaiḥ samupāhṛtam
ārdram ca māmsam śuṣkam ca vanyam ca ucca avacam mahat
english: Here are fruits and roots gathered by the Nişādas and meat dry and moist and various other produces of the forest.

sanskrit: आशम्से स्वाशिता सेना वत्स्यति इमाम् विभावरीम्
अर्चितः विविधैः कामैः श्वः ससैन्यो गमिष्यसि
transliteration: āśamse svāśitā senā vatsyati imām vibhāvarīm
arcitaḥ vividhaiḥ kāmaiḥ śvaḥ sasainyo gamiṣyasi
english: I pray that entertained in various ways and heartily partaking of meats and drinks, this army may spend the night here. Tomorrow morning, you will go along with your forces.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु भरतः निषाद अधिपतिम् गुहम्
प्रत्युवाच महा प्राज्ञो वाक्यम् हेतु अर्थ सम्हितम्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu bharataḥ niṣāda adhipatim guham
pratyuvāca mahā prājño vākyam hetu artha samhitam
english: Thus addressed, the exceedingly wise Bharata answered the lord of the Nişādas, in words fraught with sense and reason.

sanskrit: ऊर्जितः खलु ते कामः कृतः मम गुरोह् सखे
यो मे त्वम् ईदृशीम् सेनाम् एको अभ्यर्चितुम् इच्चसि
transliteration: ūrjitaḥ khalu te kāmaḥ kṛtaḥ mama guroh sakhe
yo me tvam īdṛśīm senām eko abhyarcitum iccasi
english: Your great desire, O friend of my superior, is surely as good as attained; since you of mighty energy have set your heart on entertaining my army.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा तु महा तेजा गुहम् वचनम् उत्तमम्
अब्रवीद् भरतः श्रीमान् निषाद अधिपतिम् पुनः
transliteration: iti uktvā tu mahā tejā guham vacanam uttamam
abravīd bharataḥ śrīmān niṣāda adhipatim punaḥ
english: Having said these fair words to Guha, the graceful and highly energetic Bharata again addressed the lord of Nişādas.

sanskrit: गहनो अयम् भृशम् देशो गन्गा अनूपो दुरत्ययः
transliteration: gahano ayam bhṛśam deśo gangā anūpo duratyayaḥ
english: By what way shall I go to Bharadvāja's hermitage? These lands watered by the Gangā are dense and hard to track.

sanskrit: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राज पुत्रस्य धीमतः
अब्रवीत् प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् गुहो गहन गोचरः
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā rāja putrasya dhīmataḥ
abravīt prānjalir vākyam guho gahana gocaraḥ
english: Hearing these words of the intelligent son of the king, Guha well acquainted with the forest, said with joined hands.

sanskrit: अहम् च अनुगमिष्यामि राज पुत्र महा यशः
transliteration: aham ca anugamiṣyāmi rāja putra mahā yaśaḥ
english: My servant well acquainted with the place shall attentively follow you; and, O prince possessed of mighty strength, I myself will also walk in your wake.

sanskrit: कच्चिन् न दुष्टः व्रजसि रामस्य अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः
इयम् ते महती सेना शन्काम् जनयति इव मे
transliteration: kaccin na duṣṭaḥ vrajasi rāmasya akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ
iyam te mahatī senā śankām janayati iva me
english: But do you go after Rāma of energetic acts with some evil intention? This vast force of yours raise my apprehension/

sanskrit: भरतः श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गुहम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: bharataḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā guham vacanam abravīt
english: When Guha had asked this, Bharata with a presence unclouded like the sky, spoke to Guha these sweet words.

sanskrit: मा भूत् स कालो यत् कष्टम् न माम् शन्कितुम् अर्हसि
राघवः स हि मे भ्राता ज्येष्ठः पितृ समः मम
transliteration: mā bhūt sa kālo yat kaṣṭam na mām śankitum arhasi
rāghavaḥ sa hi me bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛ samaḥ mama
english: May a time never come when I shall do wrong to Rāghava! It behoves you not to fear me. Rāghava is my eldest brother dear to me even as my sire himself.

sanskrit: तम् निवर्तयितुम् यामि काकुत्स्थम् वन वासिनम्
बुद्धिर् अन्या न ते कार्या गुह सत्यम् ब्रवीमि ते
transliteration: tam nivartayitum yāmi kākutstham vana vāsinam
buddhir anyā na te kāryā guha satyam bravīmi te
english: I go to make Kākutstha dwelling in the woods, turn back. Other intention cherish I none. O Guha, this I tell you truly.

sanskrit: स तु सम्हृष्ट वदनः श्रुत्वा भरत भाषितम्
पुनर् एव अब्रवीद् वाक्यम् भरतम् प्रति हर्षितः
transliteration: sa tu samhṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śrutvā bharata bhāṣitam
punar eva abravīd vākyam bharatam prati harṣitaḥ
english: Having heard Bharata's speech, Guha with a countenance lighted up with delight, again cheerfully addressed Bharata, saying.

sanskrit: धन्यः त्वम् न त्वया तुल्यम् पश्यामि जगती तले
अयत्नात् आगतम् राज्यम् यः त्वम् त्यक्तुम् इह इच्चसि
transliteration: dhanyaḥ tvam na tvayā tulyam paśyāmi jagatī tale
ayatnāt āgatam rājyam yaḥ tvam tyaktum iha iccasi
english: Blessed are you! Your like find I none on earth, inasmuch as you wish to resign a kingdom that comes to you without search.

sanskrit: शाश्वती खलु ते कीर्तिर् लोकान् अनुचरिष्यति
यः त्वम् कृच्च्र गतम् रामम् प्रत्यानयितुम् इच्चसि
transliteration: śāśvatī khalu te kīrtir lokān anucariṣyati
yaḥ tvam kṛccra gatam rāmam pratyānayitum iccasi
english: Your eternal fame will certainly range this world, since you wish to bring back Rāma passing through misfortune.

sanskrit: बभौ नष्ट प्रभः सूर्यो रजनी च अभ्यवर्तत
transliteration: babhau naṣṭa prabhaḥ sūryo rajanī ca abhyavartata
english: As Guha was speaking thus to Bharata, the sun became shorn of his splendour and night fell.

sanskrit: सम्निवेश्य स ताम् सेनाम् गुहेन परितोषितः
शत्रुघ्नेन सह श्रीमान् शयनम् पुनर् आगमत्
transliteration: samniveśya sa tām senām guhena paritoṣitaḥ
śatrughnena saha śrīmān śayanam punar āgamat
english: Thereupon having disposed his troops, the auspicious Bharata gratified by Guha, went to bed along with Śatrughna.

sanskrit: उपस्थितः हि अनर्हस्य धर्म प्रेक्षस्य तादृशः
transliteration: upasthitaḥ hi anarhasya dharma prekṣasya tādṛśaḥ
english: Then arose thoughts of Rāma in the mind of the magnanimous Bharata ever having his gaze fixed on virtue and undeserving (of hardship).

sanskrit: वन दाह अभिसम्तप्तम् गूढो अग्निर् इव पादपम्
transliteration: vana dāha abhisamtaptam gūḍho agnir iva pādapam
english: Then even as a tree already heated by a forestfire burns with a fire hidden in its cavity that descendant of Raghu began to burn with the fire of grief inflamed in his heart.

sanskrit: प्रस्रुतः सर्व गात्रेभ्यः स्वेदः शोक अग्नि सम्भवः
यथा सूर्य अम्शु सम्तप्तः हिमवान् प्रस्रुतः हिमम्
transliteration: prasrutaḥ sarva gātrebhyaḥ svedaḥ śoka agni sambhavaḥ
yathā sūrya amśu samtaptaḥ himavān prasrutaḥ himam
english: Perspiration produced by the fire of sorrow issued out of all his limbs, as the Himavat heated by the solar warmth generates water.

sanskrit: दैन्य पादप सम्घेन शोक आयास अधिशृन्गिणा
transliteration: dainya pādapa samghena śoka āyāsa adhiśṛngiṇā
english: And Kaikeyi's son was overpowered and drowned by the mountain of grief, having thoughts (of Rāma) for its entire crags, sighs for its mineral substance, disgust with the avocations of life, for its trees, mental feebleness through grief for its summits, stupor for the animals inhabiting it, and burning for its annual shrubs and bamboos.

sanskrit: प्रमोह अनन्त सत्त्वेन सम्ताप ओषधि वेणुना
आक्रान्तः दुह्ख शैलेन महता कैकयी सुतः
transliteration: pramoha ananta sattvena samtāpa oṣadhi veṇunā
ākrāntaḥ duhkha śailena mahatā kaikayī sutaḥ
english: And Kaikeyi's son was overpowered and drowned by the mountain of grief, having thoughts (of Rāma) for its entire crags, sighs for its mineral substance, disgust with the avocations of life, for its trees, mental feebleness through grief for its summits, stupor for the animals inhabiting it, and burning for its annual shrubs and bamboos.

And sighing heavily with a heart oppressed with sorrow, well nigh deprived of consciousness, and involved in high peril, that best of men, oppressed by the fever of his heart, like to a mighty leader of a herd, separated from it, did not attain peace of mind.

Meeting with Guha, the magnanimous Bharata accompanied by his people, engrossed with the thoughts of Rāma, became oppressed with grief. (Seeing this), Guha by and by encouraged Bharata concerning his elder brother.
Guha, acquainted with the forest, described to Bharata of immeasurable prowess the regard the high-souled Laksmana bore to Rama.

sanskrit: तम् जाग्रतम् गुणैर् युक्तम् वर चाप इषु धारिणम्
भ्रातृ गुप्त्य् अर्थम् अत्यन्तम् अहम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवम्
transliteration: tam jāgratam guṇair yuktam vara cāpa iṣu dhāriṇam
bhrātṛ gupty artham atyantam aham lakṣmaṇam abravam
english: To Lakşmaņa crowned with every virtue, waking up, holding the bow with the arrow fixed on it for the purpose of guarding well his brother.

sanskrit: इयम् तात सुखा शय्या त्वद् अर्थम् उपकल्पिता
प्रत्याश्वसिहि शेष्व अस्याम् सुखम् राघव नन्दन
transliteration: iyam tāta sukhā śayyā tvad artham upakalpitā
pratyāśvasihi śeṣva asyām sukham rāghava nandana
english: I said, “This easeful bed has been prepared for you, my child. O son of Raghu's descendant, cheer up! Do you lie down at ease. All these people can bear hardship; but you are meant for comfort. For protecting him religiously, we shall wake.

sanskrit: उचितो अयम् जनः सर्वे दुह्खानाम् त्वम् सुख उचितः
धर्म आत्ममः तस्य गुप्त्य् अर्थम् जागरिष्यामहे वयम्
transliteration: ucito ayam janaḥ sarve duhkhānām tvam sukha ucitaḥ
dharma ātmamaḥ tasya gupty artham jāgariṣyāmahe vayam
english: I said, “This easeful bed has been prepared for you, my child. O son of Raghu's descendant, cheer up! Do you lie down at ease. All these people can bear hardship; but you are meant for comfort. For protecting him religiously, we shall wake.

sanskrit: न हि रामात् प्रियतरो मम अस्ति भुवि कश्चन
मा उत्सुको भूर् ब्रवीम्य् एतद् अप्य् असत्यम् तव अग्रतः
transliteration: na hi rāmāt priyataro mama asti bhuvi kaścana
mā utsuko bhūr bravīmy etad apy asatyam tava agrataḥ
english: To me also there is none that is dearer on earth than Rāma. Do not be anxious. This I tell you truly, through his grace I expect high fame among men, and immense religious merit, and interest and desire in entirety.

sanskrit: अस्य प्रसादाद् आशम्से लोके अस्मिन् सुमहद् यशः
धर्म अवाप्तिम् च विपुलाम् अर्थ अवाप्तिम् च केवलाम्
transliteration: asya prasādād āśamse loke asmin sumahad yaśaḥ
dharma avāptim ca vipulām artha avāptim ca kevalām
english: To me also there is none that is dearer on earth than Rāma. Do not be anxious. This I tell you truly, through his grace I expect high fame among men, and immense religious merit, and interest and desire in entirety.

sanskrit: सो अहम् प्रिय सखम् रामम् शयानम् सह सीतया
रक्षिष्यामि धनुष् पाणिः सर्वैः स्वैर् ज्नातिभिः सह
transliteration: so aham priya sakham rāmam śayānam saha sītayā
rakṣiṣyāmi dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ sarvaiḥ svair jnātibhiḥ saha
english: Bow in hand I shall along with my kin protect Rāma lying down with Sītā.

sanskrit: न हि मे अविदितम् किम्चिद् वने अस्मिमः चरतः सदा
चतुर् अन्गम् ह्य् अपि बलम् प्रसहेम वयम् युधि
transliteration: na hi me aviditam kimcid vane asmimaḥ carataḥ sadā
catur angam hy api balam prasahema vayam yudhi
english: To me always ranging in this forest, nothing whatever is unknown. I can even cope in battle with an army of fourfold forces.

sanskrit: अनुनीता वयम् सर्वे धर्मम् एव अनुपश्यता
transliteration: anunītā vayam sarve dharmam eva anupaśyatā
english: Thus accosted by us, the magnanimous Laks maņa with his gaze ever fixed on virtue, humbly observed.

sanskrit: कथम् दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया
शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धुम् जीवितम् वा सुखानि वा
transliteration: katham dāśarathau bhūmau śayāne saha sītayā
śakyā nidrā mayā labdhum jīvitam vā sukhāni vā
english: How, Dasaratha's son sleeping on the earth with Sītā, can I attain sleep, or life, or happiness?

sanskrit: यो न देव असुरैः सर्वैः शक्यः प्रसहितुम् युधि
तम् पश्य गुह सम्विष्टम् तृणेषु सह सीतया
transliteration: yo na deva asuraiḥ sarvaiḥ śakyaḥ prasahitum yudhi
tam paśya guha samviṣṭam tṛṇeṣu saha sītayā
english: How see him who is capable of bearing in battle the onslaught of the gods and the Asuras combined, sleeping in a cave on grass?

sanskrit: महता तपसा लब्धो विविधैः च परिश्रमैः
एको दशरथस्य एष पुत्रः सदृश लक्षणः
transliteration: mahatā tapasā labdho vividhaiḥ ca pariśramaiḥ
eko daśarathasya eṣa putraḥ sadṛśa lakṣaṇaḥ
english: It is by virtue of mighty austerities and uncommon exertions that Dasaratha has obtained this son of his crowned with every auspicious sign. He being banished, the king shall not live long; and the Earth shall certainly be widowed soon.

sanskrit: अस्मिन् प्रव्राजिते राजा न चिरम् वर्तयिष्यति
विधवा मेदिनी नूनम् क्षिप्रम् एव भविष्यति
transliteration: asmin pravrājite rājā na ciram vartayiṣyati
vidhavā medinī nūnam kṣipram eva bhaviṣyati
english: It is by virtue of mighty austerities and uncommon exertions that Dasaratha has obtained this son of his crowned with every auspicious sign. He being banished, the king shall not live long; and the Earth shall certainly be widowed soon.

sanskrit: विनद्य सुमहा नादम् श्रमेण उपरताः स्त्रियः
निर्घोष उपरतम् नूनम् अद्य राज निवेशनम्
transliteration: vinadya sumahā nādam śrameṇa uparatāḥ striyaḥ
nirghoṣa uparatam nūnam adya rāja niveśanam
english: Having bewailed aloud, by this time have the women got exhausted; and surely the king's mansion is to-day still.

sanskrit: कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथा एव जननी मम
न आशम्से यदि ते सर्वे जीवेयुः शर्वरीम् इमाम्
transliteration: kausalyā caiva rājā ca tathā eva jananī mama
na āśamse yadi te sarve jīveyuḥ śarvarīm imām
english: I do not expect that either Kausalyā or the king or my mother is alive. If they live, it can be for this night only.

sanskrit: जीवेद् अपि हि मे माता शत्रुघ्नस्य अन्ववेक्षया
दुह्खिता या तु कौसल्या वीरसूर् विनशिष्यति
transliteration: jīved api hi me mātā śatrughnasya anvavekṣayā
duhkhitā yā tu kausalyā vīrasūr vinaśiṣyati
english: Even if my mother live seeing Satrughna, that mother of a hero, the afflicted Kausalyā, will (surely) resign her existence.

sanskrit: राज्ये रामम् अनिक्षिप्य पिता मे विनशिष्यति
transliteration: rājye rāmam anikṣipya pitā me vinaśiṣyati
english: Saying, All is lost, All is lost, with his desire unattained, my father having failed to install Rāma in the kingdom, will resign his existence.

sanskrit: सिद्ध अर्थाः पितरम् वृत्तम् तस्मिन् काले ह्य् उपस्थिते
transliteration: siddha arthāḥ pitaram vṛttam tasmin kāle hy upasthite
english: Blessed are they that when the time shall come for the same, shall perform the funeral ceremonies of the king, my deceased sire.

sanskrit: रम्य चत्वर सम्स्थानाम् सुविभक्त महा पथाम्
हर्म्य प्रासाद सम्पन्नाम् सर्व रत्न विभूषिताम्
transliteration: ramya catvara samsthānām suvibhakta mahā pathām
harmya prāsāda sampannām sarva ratna vibhūṣitām
english: Then shall they with happy hearts range the looking terraces, with the highways laid out orderly, crowned with lordly edifices, adorned with various gems, crowded by cars and elephants and horses, resounding with the notes of trumpets, abounding in auspicious things, filled with fat and contented people, having gardens and pleasure-houses, and possessed of divers classed of men indulging festal mirth.

sanskrit: गज अश्व रथ सम्बाधाम् तूर्य नाद विनादिताम्
सर्व कल्याण सम्पूर्णाम् हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आकुलाम्
transliteration: gaja aśva ratha sambādhām tūrya nāda vināditām
sarva kalyāṇa sampūrṇām hṛṣṭa puṣṭa jana ākulām
english: Then shall they with happy hearts range the looking terraces, with the highways laid out orderly, crowned with lordly edifices, adorned with various gems, crowded by cars and elephants and horses, resounding with the notes of trumpets, abounding in auspicious things, filled with fat and contented people, having gardens and pleasure-houses, and possessed of divers classed of men indulging festal mirth.

sanskrit: आराम उद्यान सम्पूर्णाम् समाज उत्सव शालिनीम्
सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राज धानीम् पितुर् मम
transliteration: ārāma udyāna sampūrṇām samāja utsava śālinīm
sukhitā vicariṣyanti rāja dhānīm pitur mama
english: Shall we, on the occasion of Rāma's return, with glad hearts peacefully enter the city in company with that one firm in his promise?

sanskrit: अपि सत्य प्रतिज्नेन सार्धम् कुशलिना वयम्
निवृत्ते समये ह्य् अस्मिन् सुखिताः प्रविशेमहि
transliteration: api satya pratijnena sārdham kuśalinā vayam
nivṛtte samaye hy asmin sukhitāḥ praviśemahi
english: Shall we, on the occasion of Rāma's return, with glad hearts peacefully enter the city in company with that one firm in his promise?

sanskrit: तिष्ठतो राज पुत्रस्य शर्वरी सा अत्यवर्तत
transliteration: tiṣṭhato rāja putrasya śarvarī sā atyavartata
english: As the magnanimous son of the king was thus lamenting, the night passed away.

sanskrit: प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये कारयित्वा जटा उभौ
अस्मिन् भागीरथी तीरे सुखम् सम्तारितौ मया
transliteration: prabhāte vimale sūrye kārayitvā jaṭā ubhau
asmin bhāgīrathī tīre sukham samtāritau mayā
