transliteration: tam āhave dāruṇam āśu vikramausthirau ubhau saṃyati rāma lakṣmaṇau
mudānvitau cikṣipatur bhayāvahamnadantam utkṣipya bilena rākṣsam
english: Then when his throat had been freed (Laks maņa) cast into the pit Virādha having ears resembling javelins, sending loud and dreadful sounds.

sanskrit: अवध्यताम् प्रेक्ष्य महासुरस्य तौशितेन शस्त्रेण तदा नरर्षभौ
समर्थ्य च अत्यर्थ विशारदौ उभौबिले विरधस्य वधम् प्रचक्रतुः
transliteration: avadhyatām prekṣya mahāsurasya tauśitena śastreṇa tadā nararṣabhau
samarthya ca atyartha viśāradau ubhaubile viradhasya vadham pracakratuḥ
english: Having vanquished him in fight, Rāma and Lakşmana possessed of activity and steady in fight, being exceedingly delighted, raising up the dreadful Räksasa by main force, cast him howling (into the pit). Reflecting that he was incapable of being slain (by sharpened weapons), those foremost of men, exceedingly well versed (in arms), compassed the death of that mighty Asura, Virādha, in the pit, after they had dug it.

sanskrit: स्वयम् विराधेन हि मृत्युम् आत्मनःप्रसह्य रामेण वधार्थम् ईप्सितः
निवेदितः कानन चारिणा स्वयम्न मे वधः शस्त्र कृतो भवेत् इति
transliteration: svayam virādhena hi mṛtyum ātmanaḥprasahya rāmeṇa vadhārtham īpsitaḥ
niveditaḥ kānana cāriṇā svayamna me vadhaḥ śastra kṛto bhavet iti
english: Virādha had himself sincerely wished for his death at the hands of Räma; and that ranger of the woods had accordingly told (Rāma),: My death cannot be effected by means of weapons.

sanskrit: तदेव रामेण निशम्य भाषितम्कृता मतिः तस्य बिल प्रवेशने
बिलम् च तेन अति बलेन रक्षसाप्रवेश्यमानेन वनम् विनादितम्
transliteration: tadeva rāmeṇa niśamya bhāṣitamkṛtā matiḥ tasya bila praveśane
bilam ca tena ati balena rakṣasāpraveśyamānena vanam vināditam
english: Having heard these words, Rāma decided upon casting him into a pit. And when the excessively strong Rākṣasa entered the cavity, he made the forest resound with his cries,

sanskrit: प्रहृष्ट रूपौ इव राम लक्ष्मणौविराधम् उर्व्याम् प्रदरे निपात्य तम्
ननन्दतुः वीत भयौ महावनेशिलाभिः अन्तर् दधतुः च राक्षसम्
transliteration: prahṛṣṭa rūpau iva rāma lakṣmaṇauvirādham urvyām pradare nipātya tam
nanandatuḥ vīta bhayau mahāvaneśilābhiḥ antar dadhatuḥ ca rākṣasam

sanskrit: ततः तु तौ कांचन चित्र कार्मुकौनिहत्य रक्षः परिगृह्य मैथिलीम्
विजह्रतुः तौ मुदितौ महावनेदिवि स्थितौ चन्द्र दिवाकरौ इव
transliteration: tataḥ tu tau kāṃcana citra kārmukaunihatya rakṣaḥ parigṛhya maithilīm
vijahratuḥ tau muditau mahāvanedivi sthitau candra divākarau iva

sanskrit: हत्वा तु तम् भीम बलम् विराधम् राक्षसम् वने
ततः सीताम् परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान्
transliteration: hatvā tu tam bhīma balam virādham rākṣasam vane
tataḥ sītām pariṣvajya samāśvāsya ca vīryavān

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् भ्रातरम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम्
कष्टम् वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् न च स्मो वन गोचराः
transliteration: abravīt bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam
kaṣṭam vanam idam durgam na ca smo vana gocarāḥ

sanskrit: तस्य देव प्रभावस्य तपसा भावित आत्मनः
transliteration: tasya deva prabhāvasya tapasā bhāvita ātmanaḥ
english: And Rāma beheld a mighty wonder near that one of celestial virtue, who had purified his soul through asceticism.

sanskrit: रथ प्रवरम् आरूढम् आकाशे विबुध अनुगम्
transliteration: ratha pravaram ārūḍham ākāśe vibudha anugam
english: He saw the lord of the celestials, possessed of a resplendent person, resembling in effulgence the sun or Vaisvanara-mounted on a superb car (saw) him that is followed by all the celestials, stationed in the sky, not touching the earth, adorned in luminous ornaments-the god dressed in a clean appear!

sanskrit: संप्रभ आभरणम् देवम् विरजो अंबर धारिणम्
transliteration: saṃprabha ābharaṇam devam virajo aṃbara dhāriṇam
english: He saw the lord of the celestials, possessed of a resplendent person, resembling in effulgence the sun or Vaisvanara-mounted on a superb car (saw) him that is followed by all the celestials, stationed in the sky, not touching the earth, adorned in luminous ornaments-the god dressed in a clean appear!

sanskrit: तत् विधैः एव बहुभिर् पूज्यमानम् महात्मभिः
हरितैः वाजिभिर् युक्तम् अंतरिक्ष गतम् रथम्
transliteration: tat vidhaiḥ eva bahubhir pūjyamānam mahātmabhiḥ
haritaiḥ vājibhir yuktam aṃtarikṣa gatam ratham
english: Worshipped by many a high-should personage dressed in the same way. And from a distance, (Rāma) saw the car stationed in the sky yoked with green steeds-resembling the infant sun;

sanskrit: ददर्श अदूरतः तस्य तरुण आदित्य संनिभम्
पाण्डुर अभ्र घन प्रख्यम् चन्द्र मण्डल संनिभम्
transliteration: dadarśa adūrataḥ tasya taruṇa āditya saṃnibham
pāṇḍura abhra ghana prakhyam candra maṇḍala saṃnibham

sanskrit: अपश्यत् विमलम् छत्रम् चित्र माल्य उपशोभितम्
चामर व्यजने च अग्र्ये रुक्म दण्डे महाधने
transliteration: apaśyat vimalam chatram citra mālya upaśobhitam
cāmara vyajane ca agrye rukma daṇḍe mahādhane

sanskrit: गृहीते वर नारीभ्याम् धूयमाने च मूर्धनि
गन्धर्व अमर सिद्धाः च बहवः परम ऋषयः
transliteration: gṛhīte vara nārībhyām dhūyamāne ca mūrdhani
gandharva amara siddhāḥ ca bahavaḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ

sanskrit: अन्तरिक्ष गतम् देवम् गीर्भिर् अग्र्याभिर् ऐडियन्
transliteration: antarikṣa gatam devam gīrbhir agryābhir aiḍiyan

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा शत क्रतुम् तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
रामोऽथ रथम् उद्दिश्य भ्रातुर् दर्शयत अद्भुतम्
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śata kratum tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
rāmo'tha ratham uddiśya bhrātur darśayata adbhutam

sanskrit: अर्चिष्मन्तम् श्रिया जुष्टम् अद्भुतम् पश्य लक्ष्मण
प्रतपन्तम् इव आदित्यम् अन्तरिक्ष गतम् रथम्
transliteration: arciṣmantam śriyā juṣṭam adbhutam paśya lakṣmaṇa
pratapantam iva ādityam antarikṣa gatam ratham

sanskrit: ये हयाः पुरु हूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नः श्रुताः
अन्तरिक्ष गता दिव्याः ते इमे हरयो ध्रुवम्
transliteration: ye hayāḥ puru hūtasya purā śakrasya naḥ śrutāḥ
antarikṣa gatā divyāḥ te ime harayo dhruvam
english: The steeds standing in the sky are for certain those of which we had formerly heard as beionging to Sakra of many sacrifices.

sanskrit: इमे च पुरुष व्याघ्र ये तिष्ठन्ति अभितः दिशम्
शतम् शतम् कुण्डलिनो युवानः खड्ग पाणयः
transliteration: ime ca puruṣa vyāghra ye tiṣṭhanti abhitaḥ diśam
śatam śatam kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ khaḍga pāṇayaḥ
english: And, you foremost of men, these youths envisioning (the celestial) by hundreds, wearing earrings, and bearing swords in their hands, are broad of chest, have arms resembling bludgeons in size, and are clad in crimson vesture, like to tigers incapable of being approached.

sanskrit: शोणांशु वसनाः सर्वे व्याघ्र इव दुरासदाः
transliteration: śoṇāṃśu vasanāḥ sarve vyāghra iva durāsadāḥ
english: And, you foremost of men, these youths envisioning (the celestial) by hundreds, wearing earrings, and bearing swords in their hands, are broad of chest, have arms resembling bludgeons in size, and are clad in crimson vesture, like to tigers incapable of being approached.

sanskrit: उरो देशेषु सर्वेषाम् हारा ज्वलन संनिभाः
रूपम् बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पंच विंशति वार्षिकम्
transliteration: uro deśeṣu sarveṣām hārā jvalana saṃnibhāḥ
rūpam bibhrati saumitre paṃca viṃśati vārṣikam
english: Over the breasts of all appear chains of blazing sheen; and, O son of Sumitrā, their beauty appears that of five and twenty.

sanskrit: एतद्धि किल देवानाम् वयो भवति नित्यदा
यथा इमे पुरुष व्याघ्रा दृश्यन्ते प्रिय दर्शनाः
transliteration: etaddhi kila devānām vayo bhavati nityadā
yathā ime puruṣa vyāghrā dṛśyante priya darśanāḥ
english: And even this is the ever-enduring age of the celestials, as these foremost of men of sweet looks appear.

sanskrit: इह एव सह वैदेह्या मुहूर्तम् तिष्ठ लक्ष्मण
यावत् जानामि अहम् व्यक्तम् क एष द्युतिमान् रथे
transliteration: iha eva saha vaidehyā muhūrtam tiṣṭha lakṣmaṇa
yāvat jānāmi aham vyaktam ka eṣa dyutimān rathe
english: O Laksmana, stay here awhile with Vaidehi, so long as I do not gather who it is that is in the effulgent car.

sanskrit: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा सौमित्रिम् इह एव स्थीयताम् इति
transliteration: tam evam uktvā saumitrim iha eva sthīyatām iti
english: Saying to Sumitrās son, Stay here, Kākutstha bent his steps towards Sarabhaiga's asylum.

sanskrit: ततः समभिगच्छन्तम् प्रेक्ष्य रामम् शची पतिः
transliteration: tataḥ samabhigacchantam prekṣya rāmam śacī patiḥ
english: And seeing Rāma approach, Saci's lord, taking Sarabhanga's permission, addressed the celestials.

sanskrit: इह उपयाति असौ रामो यावन् माम् न अभिभाषते
निष्ठाम् नयत तावत् तु ततो मा द्रष्टुम् अर्हति
transliteration: iha upayāti asau rāmo yāvan mām na abhibhāṣate
niṣṭhām nayata tāvat tu tato mā draṣṭum arhati
english: Rāma is coming hither. Do you set out for another place, ere he yet addresses me. He is not fit to behold me (now.)

sanskrit: जितवन्तम् कृतार्थम् हि तदा अहम् अचिराद् इमम्
कर्म हि अनेन कर्तव्यम् महत् अन्यैः सुदुष्करम्
transliteration: jitavantam kṛtārtham hi tadā aham acirād imam
karma hi anena kartavyam mahat anyaiḥ suduṣkaram
english: When he shall have vanquished (his foe in fight) and won success, shall I readily show myself to him. He shall have to achieve an act incapable of being achieved by others.

sanskrit: अथ वज्री तम् आमंत्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम्
रथेन हय युक्तेन ययौ दिवम् अरिन्दमः
transliteration: atha vajrī tam āmaṃtrya mānayitvā ca tāpasam
rathena haya yuktena yayau divam arindamaḥ
english: Then rendering homage to that anchorite and conversing with him, the wielder of the thunderbolt-subduer of enemies-repaired to heaven in a car yoked with steeds.
When the thousand-eyed one had gone away, Rāghava accompanied by his companions appeared before Sarabhanga in the (Agni-hotra) chamber.

sanskrit: तस्य पादौ च संगृह्य रामः सीता च लक्ष्मणः
निषेदुः तद् अनुज्ञाता लब्ध वासा निमंत्रिताः
transliteration: tasya pādau ca saṃgṛhya rāmaḥ sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ
niṣeduḥ tad anujñātā labdha vāsā nimaṃtritāḥ
english: Taking his feet, Rāma, Sītā and Lakşmaņa sat down with the permission of the ascetic, who received them and set apart quarters for them.

sanskrit: ततः शक्र उपयानम् तु पर्यपृच्छत राघवः
शरभंगः च तत् सर्वम् राघवाय न्यवेदयत्
transliteration: tataḥ śakra upayānam tu paryapṛcchata rāghavaḥ
śarabhaṃgaḥ ca tat sarvam rāghavāya nyavedayat
english: Then Rāghava questioned (the sage) concerning the visit of Sakra; and Sarabhanga related everything to Rāghava.

sanskrit: माम् एष वरदो राम ब्रह्म लोकम् निनीषति
जितम् उग्रेण तपसा दुष्प्रापम् अकृत आत्मभिः
transliteration: mām eṣa varado rāma brahma lokam ninīṣati
jitam ugreṇa tapasā duṣprāpam akṛta ātmabhiḥ
english: O Rāma, this bestower of boons wishes to take me to the regions of Brahmā. I have conquered them, incapable of being attained by persons that have not schooled themselves, by virtue of fierce austerities.

sanskrit: अहम् ज्ञात्वा नर व्याघ्र वर्तमानम् अदूरतः
ब्रह्म लोकम् न गच्छामि त्वाम् अदृष्ट्वा प्रिय अतिथिम्
transliteration: aham jñātvā nara vyāghra vartamānam adūrataḥ
brahma lokam na gacchāmi tvām adṛṣṭvā priya atithim
english: O chief of men, knowing that you were near, I became anxious to go to the minor celestial regions and the supreme heaven (of Brahmā), after I had seen you, righteous and high-souled, who are my dear guest now.

sanskrit: समागम्य गमिष्यामि त्रिदिवम् च अवरम् परम्
transliteration: samāgamya gamiṣyāmi tridivam ca avaram param
english: O foremost of men, having had a meeting with you, a high-souled prince of righteous nature, I have for aye attained the excellent regions of Brahmã and Nākaprştha. Do you receive them as pertaining to me.

sanskrit: अक्षया नर शार्दूल जितालोका मया शुभाः
ब्राह्म्याः च नाक पृष्ठ्याः च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मामकान्
transliteration: akṣayā nara śārdūla jitālokā mayā śubhāḥ
brāhmyāḥ ca nāka pṛṣṭhyāḥ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva māmakān
english: O foremost of men, having had a meeting with you, a high-souled prince of righteous nature, I have for aye attained the excellent regions of Brahmã and Nākaprştha. Do you receive them as pertaining to me.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो नरव्याघ्रः सर्व शास्त्र विशारदः
transliteration: evam ukto naravyāghraḥ sarva śāstra viśāradaḥ
english: Thus addressed by the sage, Sarabhanga, that best of men, Rāghava, versed in every branch of learning, said.

sanskrit: अहम् एव आहरिष्यामि सर्वान् लोकान् महामुने
आवासम् तु अहम् इच्छामि प्रदिष्टम् इह कानने
transliteration: aham eva āhariṣyāmi sarvān lokān mahāmune
āvāsam tu aham icchāmi pradiṣṭam iha kānane
english: O mighty anchorite, I shall acquire all those regions myself. I now wish that you may direct me as to my abode in this forest.

sanskrit: राघवेण एवम् उक्तः तु शक्र तुल्य बलेन वै
शरभंगो महाप्राज्ञः पुनर् एव अब्रवीत् वचः
transliteration: rāghaveṇa evam uktaḥ tu śakra tulya balena vai
śarabhaṃgo mahāprājñaḥ punar eva abravīt vacaḥ
english: Thus accosted by Rāghava resembling Sakra in strength, the eminently wise Sarabhanga again said,

sanskrit: इह राम महातेजाः सुतीक्ष्णो नम धार्मिकः
वसति अरण्ये नियतः स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति
transliteration: iha rāma mahātejāḥ sutīkṣṇo nama dhārmikaḥ
vasati araṇye niyataḥ sa te śreyo vidhāsyati
english: O Rāma, here in this forest lives a pious and self-restrained ascetic of mighty energy, named Sutiksna. He will bring about your good.

sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णम् अभिगच्छ त्वम् शुचौ देशे तपस्विनम्
रमणीये वनोद्देशे स ते वासम् विधास्यति
transliteration: sutīkṣṇam abhigaccha tvam śucau deśe tapasvinam
ramaṇīye vanoddeśe sa te vāsam vidhāsyati
english: O Rāma, follow this Mandākini flowing among flowers, which (here runs in an opposite direction to her usual course; and then will you reach there.

sanskrit: नदीम् पुष्पोडुप वहाम् ततः तत्र गमिष्यसि
transliteration: nadīm puṣpoḍupa vahām tataḥ tatra gamiṣyasi
english: O Rāma, follow this Mandākini flowing among flowers, which (here runs in an opposite direction to her usual course; and then will you reach there.

sanskrit: एष पन्था नरव्याघ्र मुहूर्तम् पश्य तात माम्
यावत् जहामि गात्राणि जीर्णाम् त्वचम् इव उरगः
transliteration: eṣa panthā naravyāghra muhūrtam paśya tāta mām
yāvat jahāmi gātrāṇi jīrṇām tvacam iva uragaḥ
english: This is your course, you best of men. Do you now, my child, for a space look at me; while I leave of my limbs, even as a serpent renounces its slough.

sanskrit: ततो अग्निम् सु समाधाय हुत्वा च आज्येन मंत्रवित्
transliteration: tato agnim su samādhāya hutvā ca ājyena maṃtravit
english: Then preparing a .fire and with Mantras a offering obiations into it, the exceedingly energetic Sarabhanga entered into the fire.

sanskrit: तस्य रोमाणि केशाम् च तदा वह्निः महात्मनः
जीर्णम् त्वचम् तद् अस्थीनि यत् च मांसम् च शोणितम्
transliteration: tasya romāṇi keśām ca tadā vahniḥ mahātmanaḥ
jīrṇam tvacam tad asthīni yat ca māṃsam ca śoṇitam
english: The fire consumed the down, hair, old skin, bones, flesh and blood of that high-souled one.

sanskrit: स च पावक संकाशः कुमारः समपद्यत
transliteration: sa ca pāvaka saṃkāśaḥ kumāraḥ samapadyata
english: (Anon) Śarabharga became youth resembling fire; and rising from the flame, he appeared splendid.

sanskrit: स लोकान् आहिताग्नीनाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम्
देवानाम् च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्म लोकम् व्यरोहत
transliteration: sa lokān āhitāgnīnām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām
devānām ca vyatikramya brahma lokam vyarohata
english: And proceeding past the regions of highsouled sages sacrificing with fire, as well as of the celestials, he ascended those of Brahmā.

sanskrit: स पुण्य कर्मा भुवने द्विजर्षभःपितामहम् सानुचरम् ददर्श ह
पितामहः च अपि समीक्ष्य तम् द्विजम्ननन्द सुस्वागतम् इति उवाच ह
transliteration: sa puṇya karmā bhuvane dvijarṣabhaḥpitāmaham sānucaram dadarśa ha
pitāmahaḥ ca api samīkṣya tam dvijamnananda susvāgatam iti uvāca ha
english: That one of pious acts done on earth-that best of the twice-born the grandfather, in company with his followers. And the grand-father also, beholding that Brahmana, rejoiced greatly, and said-Hail! race-saw

sanskrit: शरभङ्गे दिवम् प्राप्ते मुनि संघाः समागताः
transliteration: śarabhaṅge divam prāpte muni saṃghāḥ samāgatāḥ
english: After Sarabhanga had ascended heaven, ascetics in bodies, assembled together, presented themselves before Kākutstha, Rāma of flaming energy.

sanskrit: अश्म कुट्टाः च बहवः पत्र आहाराः च तापसाः
transliteration: aśma kuṭṭāḥ ca bahavaḥ patra āhārāḥ ca tāpasāḥ

sanskrit: दन्त उलूखलिनः च एव तथा एव उन्मज्जकाः परे
गात्र शय्या अशय्याः च तथा एव अनवकाशिकाः
transliteration: danta ulūkhalinaḥ ca eva tathā eva unmajjakāḥ pare
gātra śayyā aśayyāḥ ca tathā eva anavakāśikāḥ

sanskrit: मुनयः सलिल आहारा वायु भक्षाः तथा अपरे
आकाश निलयाः च एव तथा स्थण्डिल शायिनः
transliteration: munayaḥ salila āhārā vāyu bhakṣāḥ tathā apare
ākāśa nilayāḥ ca eva tathā sthaṇḍila śāyinaḥ

sanskrit: तथा ऊर्थ्व वासिनः दान्ताः तथा आर्द्र पट वाससः
स जपाः च तपो नित्याः तथा पंच तपोऽन्विताः
transliteration: tathā ūrthva vāsinaḥ dāntāḥ tathā ārdra paṭa vāsasaḥ
sa japāḥ ca tapo nityāḥ tathā paṃca tapo'nvitāḥ

sanskrit: सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया ज्युक्ता दृढ योग समाहिताः
शरभंग आश्रमे रामम् अभिजग्मुः च तापसाः
transliteration: sarve brāhmyā śriyā jyuktā dṛḍha yoga samāhitāḥ
śarabhaṃga āśrame rāmam abhijagmuḥ ca tāpasāḥ

sanskrit: अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामम् धर्म भृताम् वरम्
ऊचुः परम धर्मज्ञम् ऋषि संघाः समागताः
transliteration: abhigamya ca dharmajñā rāmam dharma bhṛtām varam
ūcuḥ parama dharmajñam ṛṣi saṃghāḥ samāgatāḥ
english: And coming before Rāma, the foremost of those practising righteousness, those sages conversant with morality, met in a body, said to that pre-eminently virtuous one,

sanskrit: त्वम् इक्ष्वाकु कुलस्य अस्य पृथिव्याः च महारथः
प्रधानः च अपि नाथः च देवानाम् मघवान् इव
transliteration: tvam ikṣvāku kulasya asya pṛthivyāḥ ca mahārathaḥ
pradhānaḥ ca api nāthaḥ ca devānām maghavān iva
english: A mighty car-warrior, you are the foremost person of the lkshvāku race and the world; as well as their lord, even as Maghavān is the lord of the celestials.

sanskrit: विश्रुतः त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च
पितृ व्रतत्वम् सत्यम् च त्वयि धर्मः च पुष्कलः
transliteration: viśrutaḥ triṣu lokeṣu yaśasā vikrameṇa ca
pitṛ vratatvam satyam ca tvayi dharmaḥ ca puṣkalaḥ
english: Famous over the three worlds in high worth and prowess, in you are found truth and virtue in profusion and obedience to the mandate of your sire.

sanskrit: त्वाम् आसाद्य महात्मानम् धर्मज्ञम् धर्म वत्सलम्
अर्थित्वात् नाथ वक्ष्यामः तत् च नः क्षन्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: tvām āsādya mahātmānam dharmajñam dharma vatsalam
arthitvāt nātha vakṣyāmaḥ tat ca naḥ kṣantum arhasi
english: O lord, it behoves you cognizant of virtue and attached to it, to forgive us for what we as suiters say to you.

sanskrit: अधार्मः सुमहान् नाथ भवेत् तस्य तु भूपतेः
यो हरेत् बलि षड् भागम् न च रक्षति पुत्रवत्
transliteration: adhārmaḥ sumahān nātha bhavet tasya tu bhūpateḥ
yo haret bali ṣaḍ bhāgam na ca rakṣati putravat
english: The sin, O lord, of that monarch is mighty that take a sixth part of the subjects' incomes, but dose not protect them as sons.

sanskrit: युंजानः स्वान् इव प्राणान् प्राणैः इष्टान् सुतान् इव
नित्य युक्तः सदा रक्षन् सर्वान् विषय वासिनः
transliteration: yuṃjānaḥ svān iva prāṇān prāṇaiḥ iṣṭān sutān iva
nitya yuktaḥ sadā rakṣan sarvān viṣaya vāsinaḥ
english: But he that, setting his heart on protecting the people, dose ever carefully protect all the inhabitants of his dominions, like his own life or like his son dearer to him than life itself, repeat, O Rāma, enduring renown extending over many years, and (at length) attaining the regions of Brahmā, is glorified there.

sanskrit: प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् राम कीर्तिम् स बहु वार्षिकीम्
ब्रह्मणः स्थानम् आसाद्य तत्र च अपि महीयते
transliteration: prāpnoti śāśvatīm rāma kīrtim sa bahu vārṣikīm
brahmaṇaḥ sthānam āsādya tatra ca api mahīyate
english: But he that, setting his heart on protecting the people, dose ever carefully protect all the inhabitants of his dominions, like his own life or like his son dearer to him than life itself, repeat, O Rāma, enduring renown extending over many years, and (at length) attaining the regions of Brahmā, is glorified there.

sanskrit: यत् करोति परम् धर्मम् मुनिः मूल फल अशनः
तत्र राज्ञः चतुर् भागः प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः
transliteration: yat karoti param dharmam muniḥ mūla phala aśanaḥ
tatra rājñaḥ catur bhāgaḥ prajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ
english: The king that protect his subjects righteously, is entitled to a fourth part of the great religious merit that is reaped by an ascetic subsisting on fruits and roots.

sanskrit: सो अयम् ब्राह्मण भूयिष्ठो वानप्रस्थ गणो महान्
त्वम् नाथो अनाथवत् राम राक्षसैः हन्यते भृशम्
transliteration: so ayam brāhmaṇa bhūyiṣṭho vānaprastha gaṇo mahān
tvam nātho anāthavat rāma rākṣasaiḥ hanyate bhṛśam
english: O Rāma, this many Brahmanas-this great body of men that have assumed the Vānaprastha mode of life, although having you for their lord, are being sorely troubled by Rákşasas, as if they had none.

sanskrit: एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनाम् भावित आत्मनाम्
हतानाम् राक्षसैः घोरैः बहूनाम् बहुधा वने
transliteration: ehi paśya śarīrāṇi munīnām bhāvita ātmanām
hatānām rākṣasaiḥ ghoraiḥ bahūnām bahudhā vane
english: Come and behold the bodies of innumerable ascetics of pure hearts that have in various ways been slaughtered by Rākşasas in the forest.

sanskrit: चित्रकूट आलयानाम् च क्रियते कदनम् महत्
transliteration: citrakūṭa ālayānām ca kriyate kadanam mahat
english: And great is the worry that is experienced by the dwellers on the river Pampā and the Mandakini as well as those that reside in Citrakūta.

sanskrit: एवम् वयम् न मृष्यामो विप्रकारम् तपस्विनाम्
क्रियमाणम् वने घोरम् रक्षोभिः भीम कर्मभिः
transliteration: evam vayam na mṛṣyāmo viprakāram tapasvinām
kriyamāṇam vane ghoram rakṣobhiḥ bhīma karmabhiḥ
english: We cannot bear the terrible affliction of the ascetics in the forest at the hands of Räkşasas of dreadful deeds.

sanskrit: ततः त्वाम् शरणार्थम् च शरण्यम् समुपस्थिताः
transliteration: tataḥ tvām śaraṇārtham ca śaraṇyam samupasthitāḥ
english: Therefore, for obtaining refuge, have we come before you who are the refuge (of all). Do you, O Rāma, deliver us all, who are being exceedingly afflicted by the rangers of the night.

sanskrit: परा त्वत्तः गतिः वीर पृधिव्यम् न उपपद्यते
transliteration: parā tvattaḥ gatiḥ vīra pṛdhivyam na upapadyate
english: O hero, we have no greater refuge on earth than yourself. Do you, O king's son, rescues us all from Raksasas.

sanskrit: एतत् श्रुत्वा तु काकुत्स्थः तापसानाम् तपस्विनाम्
इदम् प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा सर्वान् एव तपस्विनः
transliteration: etat śrutvā tu kākutsthaḥ tāpasānām tapasvinām
idam provāca dharmātmā sarvān eva tapasvinaḥ
english: Hearing these words of the sages and ascetics, that righteous-souled one addressed them.

sanskrit: न एवम् अर्हथ माम् वक्तुम् आज्ञाप्यः अहम् तपस्विनाम्
केवलेन स्व कार्येण प्रवेष्टव्यम् वनम् मया
transliteration: na evam arhatha mām vaktum ājñāpyaḥ aham tapasvinām
kevalena sva kāryeṇa praveṣṭavyam vanam mayā
english: It dose not behove you to speak thus. I should be commanded by the anchorets. I have entered the forest solely with a view to my own purpose.

sanskrit: पितुः तु निर्देशकरः प्रविष्टो अहम् इदम् वनम्
transliteration: pituḥ tu nirdeśakaraḥ praviṣṭo aham idam vanam
english: I have entered this forest in obedience to the mandate of my father, with the object (at the same time) of putting an end to these ravages of the Rākşasas on you.

sanskrit: तस्य मे अयम् वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः
transliteration: tasya me ayam vane vāso bhaviṣyati mahāphalaḥ
english: I have at my own will come hither for securing your interest. Then shall my stay in the woods be crowned with mighty fruit.

sanskrit: तपस्विनाम् रणे शत्रून् हन्तुम् इच्छामि राक्षसान्
पश्यन्तु वीर्यम् ऋषयः सः ब्रातुर् मे तपोधनाः
transliteration: tapasvinām raṇe śatrūn hantum icchāmi rākṣasān
paśyantu vīryam ṛṣayaḥ saḥ brātur me tapodhanāḥ
english: I wish to slay in battle the enemies of the ascetics. Let the sages and ascetics behold my prowess as well as that of my brother.

sanskrit: दत्त्वा अभयम् च अपि तपो धनानाम्धर्मे धृइत आत्मा सह लक्ष्मणेन
तपो धनैः च अपि सह आर्य दत्तःसुतीक्ष्णम् एव अभिजगाम वीरः
transliteration: dattvā abhayam ca api tapo dhanānāmdharme dhṛita ātmā saha lakṣmaṇena
tapo dhanaiḥ ca api saha ārya dattaḥsutīkṣṇam eva abhijagāma vīraḥ
english: Having been conferred a boon by the ascetics, that hero entered upon a noble undertaking, and accompanied by the ascetics, in company with Laksmana directed his course to the hermitage of) Sutiksna.

sanskrit: रामः तु सहितः भ्रात्रा सीतया च परंतपः
सुतीक्ष्णस्य आश्रम पदम् जगाम सह तैः द्विजैः
transliteration: rāmaḥ tu sahitaḥ bhrātrā sītayā ca paraṃtapaḥ
sutīkṣṇasya āśrama padam jagāma saha taiḥ dvijaiḥ
english: And Rāma accompanied by his brother as well as Sītā went to the asylum of Sutīksna in company with the twice-born ones.

sanskrit: रामः तु सहितः भ्रात्रा सीतया च परंतपः
सुतीक्ष्णस्य आश्रम पदम् जगाम सह तैः द्विजैः
transliteration: rāmaḥ tu sahitaḥ bhrātrā sītayā ca paraṃtapaḥ
sutīkṣṇasya āśrama padam jagāma saha taiḥ dvijaiḥ
english: And Rāma accompanied by his brother as well as Sītā went to the asylum of Sutīksna in company with the twice-born ones.

sanskrit: स गत्वा दीर्घम् अध्वानम् नदीः तीर्त्वा बहु उदकाः
ददर्श विमलम् शैलम् महा मेरुम् इव उन्नतम्
transliteration: sa gatvā dīrgham adhvānam nadīḥ tīrtvā bahu udakāḥ
dadarśa vimalam śailam mahā merum iva unnatam
english: And having proceeded far, and crossed many a stream of copious waters, Rāma saw a holy peak towering high like the mighty Meru.

sanskrit: ततः तद् इक्ष्वाकु वरौ सततम् विविधैः द्रुमैः
काननम् तौ विविशतुः सीतया सह राघवौ
transliteration: tataḥ tad ikṣvāku varau satatam vividhaiḥ drumaiḥ
kānanam tau viviśatuḥ sītayā saha rāghavau
english: Then those worthy scions of the Ikşvāku race-descendants of Raghu—with Sītā entered the forest ever furnished with various kinds of trees.

sanskrit: प्रविष्टः तु वनम् घोरम् बहु पुष्प फल द्रुमम्
ददर्श आश्रमम् एकान्ते चीर माला परिष्कृतम्
transliteration: praviṣṭaḥ tu vanam ghoram bahu puṣpa phala drumam
dadarśa āśramam ekānte cīra mālā pariṣkṛtam
english: And having entered the dense forest abounding in blossoms and fruits and trees, Rāma saw in a recess an asylum glittering with bark and garlands.

sanskrit: तत्र तापसम् आसीनम् मल पङ्कज धारिणम्
transliteration: tatra tāpasam āsīnam mala paṅkaja dhāriṇam
english: There Rāma duly addressed an ascetic seated in the lotus-attitude* for warding off evil, even Sutīksna, *The yoya system has many positions for concentrating thought.

sanskrit: रामोऽहम् अस्मि भगवन् भवन्तम् द्रष्टुम् आगतः
तत् मा अभिवद धर्मज्ञ महर्षे सत्य विक्रम
transliteration: rāmo'ham asmi bhagavan bhavantam draṣṭum āgataḥ
tat mā abhivada dharmajña maharṣe satya vikrama
english: O you conversant with righteousness, speak to me, O Maharsi, You that have truth for your prowess.

sanskrit: स निरीक्ष्य ततः धीरो रामम् धर्मभृताम् वरम्
समाश्लिष्य च बाहुभ्याम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa nirīkṣya tataḥ dhīro rāmam dharmabhṛtām varam
samāśliṣya ca bāhubhyām idam vacanam abravīt
english: Thereupon eyeing Rāma keenly, that calm (ascetic)-the foremost of those practising righteousness, embracing him with his arms, said,

sanskrit: स्वागतम् ते रघु श्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृताम् वर
आश्रमओ अयम् त्वया आक्रान्तः सनाथ इव सांप्रतम्
transliteration: svāgatam te raghu śreṣṭha rāma satyabhṛtām vara
āśramao ayam tvayā ākrāntaḥ sanātha iva sāṃpratam
english: Welcome, you foremost of the Raghus, O Rāma, you the best of those practising righteousness. This asylum now has been furnished with its master in consequence of your visit.

sanskrit: प्रतीक्षमाणः त्वाम् एव न आरोहे अहम् महायशः
देव लोकम् इतो वीर देहम् त्यक्त्वा महीतले
transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇaḥ tvām eva na ārohe aham mahāyaśaḥ
deva lokam ito vīra deham tyaktvā mahītale
english: O illustrious one, O hero, expecting you, I have not yet ascended heaven, renouncing on earth this body of mine.

sanskrit: चित्रकूटम् उपादाय राज्य भ्रष्टो असि मे श्रुतः
transliteration: citrakūṭam upādāya rājya bhraṣṭo asi me śrutaḥ
english: I had already) heard that, coming to Citrakūta, (you had been staying there), having been deprived of the kingdom. Here came, O Kākutstha, the Sovereign of the celestials of an hundred sacrifices.

sanskrit: उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवः सुर ईश्वरः
सर्वान् लोकान् जितान् आह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा
transliteration: upāgamya ca me devo mahādevaḥ sura īśvaraḥ
sarvān lokān jitān āha mama puṇyena karmaṇā
english: Coming to me, that mighty deity, the Sovereign of the celestials, said that I had acquired all the worlds by my pious acts.

sanskrit: तेषु देव ऋषि जुष्टेषु जितेशु तपसा मया
मत् प्रसादात् स भार्यः त्वम् विहरस्व स लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: teṣu deva ṛṣi juṣṭeṣu jiteśu tapasā mayā
mat prasādāt sa bhāryaḥ tvam viharasva sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: Do you, by my grace, in company with your wife and Lakşmaņa, dwell delightfully in those regions won by my asceticism, containing Devarsis.

sanskrit: तम् उग्र तपसम् दीप्तम् महर्षिम् सत्य वादिनम्
प्रत्युवाच आत्मवान् रामो ब्रह्माणम् इव वासवः
transliteration: tam ugra tapasam dīptam maharṣim satya vādinam
pratyuvāca ātmavān rāmo brahmāṇam iva vāsavaḥ
english: Thereupon the self-possessed Rāma answered that blazing and truth-telling Brāhmana of fiery austerities, like Vasava answering Brahma.

sanskrit: अहम् एव आहरिष्यामि स्वयम् लोकान् महामुने
आवासम् तु अहम् इच्छामि प्रदिष्टम् इह कानने
transliteration: aham eva āhariṣyāmi svayam lokān mahāmune
āvāsam tu aham icchāmi pradiṣṭam iha kānane
english: O mighty ascetic, I myself will win those regions. I wish to be directed to a dwelling in this forest.

sanskrit: भवान् सर्वत्र कुशलः सर्वभूत हिते रतः
transliteration: bhavān sarvatra kuśalaḥ sarvabhūta hite rataḥ
english: You are possessed of ability in respect of everything, and are (at the same time) engaged in the welfare of all beings, this has been told to me by the high-soulcd Sarabhanga of the Gautama race.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण महर्षिः लोक विश्रुतः
अब्रवीत् मधुरम् वाक्यम् हर्षेण महता युतः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa maharṣiḥ loka viśrutaḥ
abravīt madhuram vākyam harṣeṇa mahatā yutaḥ
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, that Maharşi known over all the worlds, Spoke sweet words in great joy,

sanskrit: अयम् एव आश्रमो राम गुणवान् रम्यताम् इति
ऋषि संघ अनुचरितः सदा मूल फलैर् युतः
transliteration: ayam eva āśramo rāma guṇavān ramyatām iti
ṛṣi saṃgha anucaritaḥ sadā mūla phalair yutaḥ
english: O meritorious Rāma, even this is the asylum (for you). Do you live here pleasantly. It is inhabited by numbers of saints and is always provided with fruits and roots.

sanskrit: इमम् आश्रमम् आगम्य मृग संघा महीयसः
transliteration: imam āśramam āgamya mṛga saṃghā mahīyasaḥ
english: This forest is haunted by herds of deer that range here without doing harm to any one, although they possess great energy; and go away, having bewitched people (by their beauty).

sanskrit: ना अन्यो दोषो भवेत् अत्र मृगेभ्यः अन्यत्र विद्धि वै
तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तस्य महर्षेः लक्ष्मणाग्रजः
transliteration: nā anyo doṣo bhavet atra mṛgebhyaḥ anyatra viddhi vai
tat śrutvā vacanam tasya maharṣeḥ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
english: Save what comes, from these deer, there is no other evil to be encountered here. Hearing those words of the Maharși, the placid elder brother of Lakşınaņa, taking up his bow with the arrow set, said

sanskrit: उवाच वचनम् धीरो विगृह्य स शरम् धनुः
transliteration: uvāca vacanam dhīro vigṛhya sa śaram dhanuḥ

sanskrit: हन्याम् निशित धारेण शरेण नत पर्वणा
भवान् तत्र अभिषज्येत किम् स्यात् कृच्छ्र तरम् ततः
transliteration: hanyām niśita dhāreṇa śareṇa nata parvaṇā
bhavān tatra abhiṣajyeta kim syāt kṛcchra taram tataḥ
english: O exalted one, if by means of sharpened shafts blazing like lightning, I slay those herds of deer when they come, it shall impart pain to you, and what can be more unfortunate than this?

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् आश्रमे वासम् चिरम् तु न समर्थये
तम् एवम् उक्त्वा उपरमम् रामः संध्याम् उपागमत्
transliteration: etasmin āśrame vāsam ciram tu na samarthaye
tam evam uktvā uparamam rāmaḥ saṃdhyām upāgamat

sanskrit: अन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् तत्र वासम् अकल्पयत्
सुतीक्ष्णस्य आश्रमे रम्ये सीतया लक्ष्मनेन च
transliteration: anvāsya paścimām saṃdhyām tatra vāsam akalpayat
sutīkṣṇasya āśrame ramye sītayā lakṣmanena ca
english: Therefore I shall not be able to dwell long in this asylum. Having said this, Rāma ceased and became engaged in his evening adorations, and, having finished them, along with Sīta and Lakşmaņa fixed his quarters in the asylum of Sutiksna.

sanskrit: ततः शुभम् तापस अन्नम्स्वयम् सुतीक्ष्णः पुरुषर्षभाभ्याम्
ताभ्याम् सुसत्कृत्य ददौ महात्मासंध्या निवृत्तौ रजनीम् समीक्ष्य
transliteration: tataḥ śubham tāpasa annamsvayam sutīkṣṇaḥ puruṣarṣabhābhyām
tābhyām susatkṛtya dadau mahātmāsaṃdhyā nivṛttau rajanīm samīkṣya
english: Then, when the evening had passed away and night fell, Sutiksna, having done homage to those chiefs of men, offered them excellent fare, suitable to ascetics.

sanskrit: रामः तु सह सौमित्रिः सुतीक्ष्णेन अभिपूजितः
transliteration: rāmaḥ tu saha saumitriḥ sutīkṣṇena abhipūjitaḥ
english: Having been well entertained by Sutīksna, Rāma in company with Sumitrā's son, having passed away the night there, awoke in the morning.

sanskrit: उत्थाय च यथा कालम् राघवः सह सीतया
उपस्पृश्य सु शीतेन तोयेन उत्पल गंधिना
transliteration: utthāya ca yathā kālam rāghavaḥ saha sītayā
upaspṛśya su śītena toyena utpala gaṃdhinā

sanskrit: अथ ते अग्निम् सुराम् च एव वैदेही राम लक्ष्मणौ
काल्यम् विधिवत् अभ्यर्च्य तपस्वि शरणे वने
transliteration: atha te agnim surām ca eva vaidehī rāma lakṣmaṇau
kālyam vidhivat abhyarcya tapasvi śaraṇe vane

sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णम् अभिगम्य इदम् श्लक्ष्णम् वचनम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: sutīkṣṇam abhigamya idam ślakṣṇam vacanam abruvan

sanskrit: सुखोषिताः स्म भगवन् त्वया पूज्येन पूजिताः
transliteration: sukhoṣitāḥ sma bhagavan tvayā pūjyena pūjitāḥ
english: O Reverend sir, we we have stayed here pleasantly, being excellently ministered to by you. We greet you, and go away. The ascetics urge speed upon us.

sanskrit: त्वरामहे वयम् द्रष्टुम् कृत्स्नम् आश्रम मण्डलम्
transliteration: tvarāmahe vayam draṣṭum kṛtsnam āśrama maṇḍalam
english: We hasten to view the collections of asylums that belong to the holy sages inhabiting the forest of Dandaka.

sanskrit: धर्म नित्यैः तपो दान्तैः विशिखैः इव पावकैः
transliteration: dharma nityaiḥ tapo dāntaiḥ viśikhaiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ
english: Now we crave your permission along with that of these foremost of anchorites, steady in virtue, crowned with asceticism and selfcontrolled, resembling smokeless flames.

sanskrit: अविषह्य आतपो यावत् सूर्यो न अति विराजते
अमार्गेण आगताम् लक्ष्मीम् प्राप्य इव अन्वय वर्जितः
transliteration: aviṣahya ātapo yāvat sūryo na ati virājate
amārgeṇa āgatām lakṣmīm prāpya iva anvaya varjitaḥ
english: And we intend to set out ere the sun like to a low-sprung one that has attained to auspicious fortune through evil ways, with rays incapable of being borne, shines too fiercely.

sanskrit: तावत् इच्छामहे गन्तुम् इति उक्त्वा चरणौ मुनेः
ववन्दे सह सौमित्रिः सीतया सह राघवः
transliteration: tāvat icchāmahe gantum iti uktvā caraṇau muneḥ
vavande saha saumitriḥ sītayā saha rāghavaḥ
english: And we intend to set out ere the sun like to a low-sprung one that has attained to auspicious fortune through evil ways, with rays incapable of being borne, shines too fiercely.

sanskrit: तौ सम् स्पृशंतौ चरणौ उत्थाप्य मुनिपुंगवः
गाढम् आश्लिष्य सस्नेहम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tau sam spṛśaṃtau caraṇau utthāpya munipuṃgavaḥ
gāḍham āśliṣya sasneham idam vacanam abravīt
english: Having said this, Rāghava along with Sītā and Sumitrā's son bowed down to the ascetic's feet.

sanskrit: अरिष्टम् गच्छ पन्थानम् राम सौमित्रिणा सह
सीतया च अनया सार्धम् छाय एव अनुवृत्तया
transliteration: ariṣṭam gaccha panthānam rāma saumitriṇā saha
sītayā ca anayā sārdham chāya eva anuvṛttayā
english: And as they touched his feet, that best of ascetics, raising Rāma and Lakşmaņa up, embraced them closely and said, O Rāma, go your way safely, in company with Sumitrā's son and this Sītā that follows you like a shadow.

sanskrit: पश्य आश्रम पदम् रम्यम् दण्डकारण्य वासिनाम्
एषाम् तपस्विनाम् वीर तपसा भावित आत्मनाम्
transliteration: paśya āśrama padam ramyam daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinām
eṣām tapasvinām vīra tapasā bhāvita ātmanām
english: Behold the beauteous asylums, O hero. of these pure-spirited ascetics inhabiting the forest of Dandaka.

sanskrit: सुप्राज्य फल मूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च
प्रशस्त मृग यूथानि शान्त पक्षि गणानि च
transliteration: suprājya phala mūlāni puṣpitāni vanāni ca
praśasta mṛga yūthāni śānta pakṣi gaṇāni ca
english: You will see blossoming woods garnished with fruits and roots, containing goodly deer, and mild feathered tribes; tanks and pools laughing with blown lotuses, containing pleasant waters, and abounding in Kārandavas; charming mountain-springs; and romantic forests picturesque with peacocks.

sanskrit: फुल्ल पंकज खण्डानि प्रसन्न सलिलानि च
transliteration: phulla paṃkaja khaṇḍāni prasanna salilāni ca

sanskrit: द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टि रम्याणि गिरि प्रस्रवणानि च
transliteration: drakṣyase dṛṣṭi ramyāṇi giri prasravaṇāni ca

sanskrit: गम्यताम् वत्स सौमित्रे भवान् अपि च गच्छतु
आगन्तव्यम् च ते दृष्ट्वा पुनः एव आश्रमम् प्रति
transliteration: gamyatām vatsa saumitre bhavān api ca gacchatu
āgantavyam ca te dṛṣṭvā punaḥ eva āśramam prati
english: Go, O child; and go you also, O Sumitra's son. And come again to my asylum after having seen these.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तथा इति उक्त्वा काकुत्स्थः सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tathā iti uktvā kākutsthaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: Thus addressed, Kākutstha along with Laks maņa, having gone round the ascetic, prepared for departing.

sanskrit: ततः शुभतरे तूणी धनुषी च आयतेक्षणा
ददौ सीता तयोः भ्रात्रोः खड्गौ च विमलौ ततः
transliteration: tataḥ śubhatare tūṇī dhanuṣī ca āyatekṣaṇā
dadau sītā tayoḥ bhrātroḥ khaḍgau ca vimalau tataḥ
english: Then Sīlā of expansive eyes handed to the brothers excellent quivers bows and shining swords.

sanskrit: आबध्य च शुभे तूणी चापे च आदाय सस्वने
निष्क्रान्तौ आश्रमात् गन्तुम् उभौ तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: ābadhya ca śubhe tūṇī cāpe ca ādāya sasvane
niṣkrāntau āśramāt gantum ubhau tau rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: Then fastening the graceful quivers, and taking the sweet-sounding bows, both Rāma and Lakşmaņa issued from the hermitage.

sanskrit: प्रस्थितौ धृत चापा असी सीतया सह राघवौ
transliteration: prasthitau dhṛta cāpā asī sītayā saha rāghavau
english: And permitted by the Maharşi, the Rāghavas furnished with grace, equipped with bows and scimitars, swiftly set out along with Sītā.

sanskrit: हृद्यया स्निग्धया वाचा भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: hṛdyayā snigdhayā vācā bhartāram idam abravīt
english: When the son of Raghu had set out with Sutiksna's permission, SItā addressed him in affectionate words and convincing speech.

sanskrit: अधर्मम् तु सुसूक्ष्मेण विधिना प्राप्यते महान्
निवृत्तेन च शक्यो अयम् व्यसनात् कामजाद् इह
transliteration: adharmam tu susūkṣmeṇa vidhinā prāpyate mahān
nivṛttena ca śakyo ayam vyasanāt kāmajād iha
english: Although you are great and follow the narrow way (of righteousness), yet you are on the eve of entering into unrighteousness. But you could by refraining from action, eschew this unrighteousness that springs from an evil begot of desire.

sanskrit: त्रीणि एव व्यसनानि अत्र कामजानि भवन्ति उत
मिथ्या वाक्यम् तु परमम् तस्मात् गुरुतरा उभौ
transliteration: trīṇi eva vyasanāni atra kāmajāni bhavanti uta
mithyā vākyam tu paramam tasmāt gurutarā ubhau
english: This evil begot of desire is threefold. One prominent evil is falsehood, and both the others' are of weightier significance, association with others; wives, and vindictiveness without any (basis of) hostility. Falsehood, O Rāghava, has never been yours nor can it ever be yours (in the future).

sanskrit: पर दार अभिगमनम् विना वैरम् च रौद्रता
मिथ्या वाक्यम् न ते भूतम् न भविष्यति राघव
transliteration: para dāra abhigamanam vinā vairam ca raudratā
mithyā vākyam na te bhūtam na bhaviṣyati rāghava
english: This evil begot of desire is threefold. One prominent evil is falsehood, and both the others' are of weightier significance, association with others; wives, and vindictiveness without any (basis of) hostility. Falsehood, O Rāghava, has never been yours nor can it ever be yours (in the future).

sanskrit: कुतो अभिलषणम् स्त्रीणाम् परेषाम् धर्म नाशनम्
तव नास्ति मनुष्येन्द्र न च आभूत् ते कदाचन
transliteration: kuto abhilaṣaṇam strīṇām pareṣām dharma nāśanam
tava nāsti manuṣyendra na ca ābhūt te kadācana

sanskrit: मनस्यपि तथा राम न च एतत् विद्यते क्वचित्
स्व दार निरतः च एव नित्यम् एव नृपात्मज
transliteration: manasyapi tathā rāma na ca etat vidyate kvacit
sva dāra nirataḥ ca eva nityam eva nṛpātmaja

sanskrit: धर्मिष्टः सत्य सन्धः च पितुः निर्देश कारकः
त्वयि धर्मः च सत्यम् च त्वयि सर्वम् प्रतिष्टितम्
transliteration: dharmiṣṭaḥ satya sandhaḥ ca pituḥ nirdeśa kārakaḥ
tvayi dharmaḥ ca satyam ca tvayi sarvam pratiṣṭitam

sanskrit: तच्च सर्वम् महाबाहो शक्यम् वोढुम् जितेइन्द्रियैः
तव वश्य इन्द्रियत्वम् च जानामि शुभदर्शन
transliteration: tacca sarvam mahābāho śakyam voḍhum jiteindriyaiḥ
tava vaśya indriyatvam ca jānāmi śubhadarśana
english: O you of a gracious presence, yours is control over sense. The third evil that leads men through ignorance to bear hostility towards others without any (cause of) hostility, is now present (to you).

sanskrit: तृतीयम् यद् इदम् रौद्रम् पर प्राण अभिहिंसनम्
निर्वैरम् क्रियते मोहात् तत् च ते समुपस्थितम्
transliteration: tṛtīyam yad idam raudram para prāṇa abhihiṃsanam
nirvairam kriyate mohāt tat ca te samupasthitam
english: O you of a gracious presence, yours is control over sense. The third evil that leads men through ignorance to bear hostility towards others without any (cause of) hostility, is now present (to you).
You have, O hero, for the protection of the saints dwelling in the forest of Dandaka, Promised the slaughter of Rākṣasas in battle.

sanskrit: एतन् निमित्तम् च वनम् दण्डका इति विश्रुतम्
प्रस्थितः त्वम् सह भ्रात्रा धृत बाण शराअसनः
transliteration: etan nimittam ca vanam daṇḍakā iti viśrutam
prasthitaḥ tvam saha bhrātrā dhṛta bāṇa śarāasanaḥ
english: And it is for this reason that equipped with bows and arrows, you have along with your brother set out for the forest known as Dandaka.

sanskrit: ततः त्वाम् प्रस्थितम् दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्त आकुलम् मनः
त्वत् वृत्तम् चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेत् निःश्रेयसम् हितम्
transliteration: tataḥ tvām prasthitam dṛṣṭvā mama cinta ākulam manaḥ
tvat vṛttam cintayantyā vai bhavet niḥśreyasam hitam
english: Seeing you set out, my mind reflecting on your truthfulness as well as your happiness in this world and welfare in the next, is wrought up with anxiety.

sanskrit: न हि मे रोचते वीरः गमनम् दण्डकान् प्रति
कारणम् तत्र वक्ष्यामि वदन्त्याः श्रूयताम् मम
transliteration: na hi me rocate vīraḥ gamanam daṇḍakān prati
kāraṇam tatra vakṣyāmi vadantyāḥ śrūyatām mama
english: O hero, I do not relish this journey to Dandaka. Thereof I will tell you the reason. Do you listen to me as I tell you.

sanskrit: त्वम् हि बाण धनुष्पाणिः भ्रात्रा सह वनम् गतः
दृष्ट्वा वन चरान् सर्वान् कच्चित् कुर्याः शर व्ययम्
transliteration: tvam hi bāṇa dhanuṣpāṇiḥ bhrātrā saha vanam gataḥ
dṛṣṭvā vana carān sarvān kaccit kuryāḥ śara vyayam
english: Bearing bows and arrows in your hands, you have come to the wood along with your brother; and it may well happen) that seeing grim rangers of the forest, you may discharge your shafts.

sanskrit: क्षत्रियाणाम् इह धनुर् हुताशस्य इन्धनानि च
समीपतः स्थितम् तेजो बलम् उच्छ्रयते भृशम्
transliteration: kṣatriyāṇām iha dhanur hutāśasya indhanāni ca
samīpataḥ sthitam tejo balam ucchrayate bhṛśam
english: Even as the vicinity of faggots increases the energy of fire, the proximity of (the bow) enhances the strength and energy of the Ksatriya.

sanskrit: पुरा किल महाबाहो तपस्वी सत्य वाक् शुचिः
कस्मिन् चित् अभवत् पुण्ये वने रत मृग द्विजे
transliteration: purā kila mahābāho tapasvī satya vāk śuciḥ
kasmin cit abhavat puṇye vane rata mṛga dvije
english: Formerly, O long-armed one, in a sacred wood haunted by beasts and birds, there lived a truthful ascetic of a pure person.

sanskrit: तस्य एव तपसो विघ्नम् कर्तुम् इन्द्रः शचीपतिः
खड्ग पाणिः अथ आगच्छत् आश्रमम् भट रूप धृक्
transliteration: tasya eva tapaso vighnam kartum indraḥ śacīpatiḥ
khaḍga pāṇiḥ atha āgacchat āśramam bhaṭa rūpa dhṛk
english: Intending to disturb his austerities, Saci's lord, Indra, bearing a sword in his hand, came to the asylum in the guise of a warrior.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् तत् आश्रम पदे निहितः खड्ग उत्तमः
स न्यास विधिना दत्तः पुण्ये तपसि तिष्ठतः
transliteration: tasmin tat āśrama pade nihitaḥ khaḍga uttamaḥ
sa nyāsa vidhinā dattaḥ puṇye tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ
english: And in that asylum, that excellent scimitar was deposited as a trust with that righteous person practising asceticisin.

sanskrit: स तत् शस्त्रम् अनुप्राप्य न्यास रक्षण तत्परः
वने तु विचरति एव रक्षन् प्रत्ययम् आत्मनः
transliteration: sa tat śastram anuprāpya nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ
vane tu vicarati eva rakṣan pratyayam ātmanaḥ
english: Receiving that weapon, that ascetic intent upon preserving his trust, range the forest, maintaining his faith.

sanskrit: यत्र गच्छति उपादातुम् मूलानि च फलानि च
न विना याति तम् खड्गम् न्यास रक्षण तत्परः
transliteration: yatra gacchati upādātum mūlāni ca phalāni ca
na vinā yāti tam khaḍgam nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ
english: And intent upon preserving his trust, he goes nowhere for procuring fruits and roots without that sword deposited with him as a trust.

sanskrit: नित्यम् शस्त्रम् परिवहन् क्रमेण स तपोधनः
चकार रौद्रीम् स्वाम् बुद्धिम् त्यक्त्वा तपसि निश्चयम्
transliteration: nityam śastram parivahan krameṇa sa tapodhanaḥ
cakāra raudrīm svām buddhim tyaktvā tapasi niścayam
english: Constantly carrying the sword, by degrees, the ascetic, foregoing all thoughts about asceticism, had his mind involved in fierce sentiments.

sanskrit: ततः स रौद्र अभिरतः प्रमत्तो अधर्म कर्षितः
तस्य शस्त्रस्य संवासात् जगाम नरकम् मुनिः
transliteration: tataḥ sa raudra abhirataḥ pramatto adharma karṣitaḥ
tasya śastrasya saṃvāsāt jagāma narakam muniḥ
english: Thus in consequence of bearing that weapon, that ascetic taken up with fierce thoughts, losing his sobriety and led astray from righteousness, went to hell.

sanskrit: एवम् एतत् पुरा वृत्तम् शस्त्र संयोग कारणम्
अग्नि संयोगवत् हेतुः शस्त्र संयोग उच्यते
transliteration: evam etat purā vṛttam śastra saṃyoga kāraṇam
agni saṃyogavat hetuḥ śastra saṃyoga ucyate
english: This ancient story anent the carrying of arms, asserts that even as fire works change in a piece of wood, the presence of arms works alteration in the mind of him bearing them.

sanskrit: स्नेहात् च बहुमानात् च स्मारये त्वाम् न शिक्षये
न कथंचन सा कार्या गृहीत धनुषा त्वया
transliteration: snehāt ca bahumānāt ca smāraye tvām na śikṣaye
na kathaṃcana sā kāryā gṛhīta dhanuṣā tvayā
english: From affection and the high honour in which I hold you, I merely remind you of this matter. I do not teach you. Equipped with bows as you are, you should renounce all thoughts of slaying without hostility the Rākṣasas residing in Dandaka. Without offence none should be slain.

sanskrit: बुद्धिः वैरम् विना हन्तुम् राक्षसान् दण्डक आश्रितान्
अपराधम् विना हन्तुम् लोको वीर न कामये
transliteration: buddhiḥ vairam vinā hantum rākṣasān daṇḍaka āśritān
aparādham vinā hantum loko vīra na kāmaye
english: From affection and the high honour in which I hold you, I merely remind you of this matter. I do not teach you. Equipped with bows as you are, you should renounce all thoughts of slaying without hostility the Rākṣasas residing in Dandaka. Without offence none should be slain.
It is the duty of Kșatriya heroes by means of their bows to protect persons of subdued souls, come by any calamity.

sanskrit: क्व च शस्त्रम् क्व च वनम् क्व च क्षात्रम् तपः क्व च
व्याविद्धम् इदम् अस्माभिः देश धर्मः तु पूज्यताम्
transliteration: kva ca śastram kva ca vanam kva ca kṣātram tapaḥ kva ca
vyāviddham idam asmābhiḥ deśa dharmaḥ tu pūjyatām
english: Where are arms? And where is the forest? Where is Kaştriya virtue? And where is asceticism? These are opposed to each other, let us, therefore, honour the morality that pertains to this place.

sanskrit: तदार्य कलुषा बुद्धिः जायते शस्त्र सेवनात्
पुनर् गत्वात् तत् अयोध्यायाम् क्षत्र धर्मम् चरिष्यसि
transliteration: tadārya kaluṣā buddhiḥ jāyate śastra sevanāt
punar gatvāt tat ayodhyāyām kṣatra dharmam cariṣyasi
english: From following arms, one's sense gets befouled and deformed. Again going to Ayodhyā, You will observe the duties of Kastriyas.

sanskrit: अक्षया तु भवेत् प्रीतिः श्वश्रू श्वशुरयोः मम
यदि राज्यम् हि संन्यस्य भवेत् त्वम् निरतो मुनिः
transliteration: akṣayā tu bhavet prītiḥ śvaśrū śvaśurayoḥ mama
yadi rājyam hi saṃnyasya bhavet tvam nirato muniḥ
english: Then my mother-in-law and father-in-law shall experience enduring delight, if having renounced the kingdom, you lead the life of an ascetic.

sanskrit: धर्मात् अर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात् प्रभवते सुखम्
धर्मेण लभते सर्वम् धर्म सारम् इदम् जगत्
transliteration: dharmāt arthaḥ prabhavati dharmāt prabhavate sukham
dharmeṇa labhate sarvam dharma sāram idam jagat
english: Interest springs from righteousness; and happiness also results therefrom. One attains everything through righteousness, in this world the only substantial thing.

sanskrit: आत्मानम् नियमैः तैः तैः कर्षयित्वा प्रयत्नतः
प्राप्यते निपुणैः धर्मो न सुखात् लभते सुखम्
transliteration: ātmānam niyamaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ karṣayitvā prayatnataḥ
prāpyate nipuṇaiḥ dharmo na sukhāt labhate sukham
english: Repressing self by diverse restrictions, intelligent people attain righteousness; but virtue crowned with felicity, is incapable of being attained by following pleasure.

sanskrit: नित्यम् शुचि मतिः सौम्य चर धर्मम् तपो वने
सर्वम् हि विदितम् तुभ्यम् त्रैलोक्यम् अपि तत्त्वतः
transliteration: nityam śuci matiḥ saumya cara dharmam tapo vane
sarvam hi viditam tubhyam trailokyam api tattvataḥ
english: O mild one! ever cherishing your heart in purity, do you practise piety in the wood of asceticism Everything the three worlds are truly known to you.

sanskrit: स्त्री चापलात् एतत् उदाहृतम् मेधर्मम् च वक्तुम् तव कः समर्थः
विचार्य बुद्ध्या तु सह अनुजेनयत् रोचते तत् कुरु म अचिरेण
transliteration: strī cāpalāt etat udāhṛtam medharmam ca vaktum tava kaḥ samarthaḥ
vicārya buddhyā tu saha anujenayat rocate tat kuru ma acireṇa
english: I have spoken this through feminine fickleness. Who can speak of righteousness to you? Reflecting on and understanding things, do you along with your younger brother speedily do what you like.

sanskrit: वाक्यम् एतत् तु वैदेह्या व्याहृतम् भर्तृ भक्त्या
श्रुत्वा धर्मे स्थितो रामः प्रत्युवाच जानकीम्
transliteration: vākyam etat tu vaidehyā vyāhṛtam bhartṛ bhaktyā
śrutvā dharme sthito rāmaḥ pratyuvāca jānakīm
english: Hearing Vaidehi's words spoken through high regard (for her husband), Rāma with his energy enhanced, answered Janaka's daughter.

sanskrit: हितम् उक्तम् त्वया देवि स्निग्धया सदृशम् वचः
कुलम् व्यपदिशन्त्या च धर्मज्ञे जनक आत्मजे
transliteration: hitam uktam tvayā devi snigdhayā sadṛśam vacaḥ
kulam vyapadiśantyā ca dharmajñe janaka ātmaje
english: O noble lady, you have spoken wild words fraught with worth and profit; and, O Janaka's daughter versed in virtue, you have expounded the duties of Kșatriyas.

sanskrit: किम् नु वक्ष्यामि अहम् देवि त्वया एव उक्तम् इदम् वचः
क्षत्रियैः धार्यते चापो न आर्त शब्दो भवेद् इति
transliteration: kim nu vakṣyāmi aham devi tvayā eva uktam idam vacaḥ
kṣatriyaiḥ dhāryate cāpo na ārta śabdo bhaved iti
english: What, O exalted one, shall I say? You have yourself by your words (furnished an answer to what you had said). Kşatriyas wear bows in order that the word 'distressed' may not exist (on earth).

sanskrit: ते च आर्ता दण्डकारण्ये मुनयः संशित व्रताः
माम् सीते स्वयम् आगम्य शरण्याः शरणम् गताः
transliteration: te ca ārtā daṇḍakāraṇye munayaḥ saṃśita vratāḥ
mām sīte svayam āgamya śaraṇyāḥ śaraṇam gatāḥ
english: O Sītā, those ascetics of severe vows that are beset with perils in Dandaka, having personally come to me, who am their refuge, have sought protection at my hands.

sanskrit: वसन्तः काल कालेषु वने मूल फल अशनाः
न लभन्ते सुखम् भीरु राक्षसैः क्रूर कर्मभिः
transliteration: vasantaḥ kāla kāleṣu vane mūla phala aśanāḥ
na labhante sukham bhīru rākṣasaiḥ krūra karmabhiḥ
english: O Sītā, those ascetics of severe vows that are beset with perils in Dandaka, having personally come to me, who am their refuge, have sought protection at my hands.

Always dwelling in the forest, subsisting on fruits and roots, they on account of Rākṣasas of cruel deeds do not, O timid attain ease. These ascetics are devoured by terrible Rākṣasas living on human flesh. Being eaten up (by the Rākşasas), the anchorites living in the forest of Dandaka, those best of the twice-born ones, said to us-Be you gracious to us.'

sanskrit: अस्मान् अभ्यवपद्य इति माम् ऊचुर् द्विज सत्तमाः
मया तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा तेषाम् एवम् मुखात् च्युतम्
transliteration: asmān abhyavapadya iti mām ūcur dvija sattamāḥ
mayā tu vacanam śrutvā teṣām evam mukhāt cyutam

sanskrit: कृत्वा वचन शुश्रुषाम् वाक्यम् एतत् उदाहृतम्
प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे ह्रीः एषा तु मम अतुला
transliteration: kṛtvā vacana śuśruṣām vākyam etat udāhṛtam
prasīdantu bhavanto me hrīḥ eṣā tu mama atulā

sanskrit: यद् ईदृशैः अहम् विप्रैः उपस्थेयैः उपस्थितः
किम् करोमि इति च मया व्याहृतम् द्विज संनिधौ
transliteration: yad īdṛśaiḥ aham vipraiḥ upastheyaiḥ upasthitaḥ
kim karomi iti ca mayā vyāhṛtam dvija saṃnidhau
english: 'Be you propitious.' This is surpassing shame to me that such Vipras who themselves are worthy of being sought, seek me. What shall I do? I said this in the presence of those twiceborn ones.

sanskrit: सर्वैः एव समागम्य वाक् इयम् समुदाहृता
transliteration: sarvaiḥ eva samāgamya vāk iyam samudāhṛtā
english: Thereat all those that had come, said, We have been, O Rāma, immensely harassed in the forest of Dandaka by Räkşasas wearing shapes at will. Do you deliver us.

sanskrit: अर्दिताः स्म भृशम् राम भवान् नः तत्र रक्षतु
होम काले तु संप्राप्ते पर्व कालेषु च अनघ
transliteration: arditāḥ sma bhṛśam rāma bhavān naḥ tatra rakṣatu
homa kāle tu saṃprāpte parva kāleṣu ca anagha
english: O sinless one! These irrepressible Rākṣasas living on human flesh vanquish us at the time of Homa, and on the occasions of Parvas.

sanskrit: गतिम् मृगयमाणानाम् भवान् नः परमा गतिः
कामम् तपः प्रभावेण शक्ता हन्तुम् निशाचरान्
transliteration: gatim mṛgayamāṇānām bhavān naḥ paramā gatiḥ
kāmam tapaḥ prabhāveṇa śaktā hantum niśācarān

sanskrit: चिरार्जितम् न च इच्छामः तपः खण्डयितुम् वयम्
बहु विघ्नम् तपो नित्यम् दुःश्चरम् चैव राघव
transliteration: cirārjitam na ca icchāmaḥ tapaḥ khaṇḍayitum vayam
bahu vighnam tapo nityam duḥścaram caiva rāghava
english: We can by virtue of the energy of our asceticism easily destroy the rangers of the night; but we are loath to lose our asceticism earned in a long time. O Rāghava our austerities are constantly disturbed, and we can hardly perform thein.

sanskrit: तेन शापम् न मुंचामो भक्ष्यमाणाः च राक्षसैः
transliteration: tena śāpam na muṃcāmo bhakṣyamāṇāḥ ca rākṣasaiḥ
english: Therefore, although afflicted and devoured by the Rākşasas dwelling in the forest of Dandaka, we do not cast our curse on them. You along with your brother are our protector: you are our master in this forest.

sanskrit: रक्ष नः त्वम् सह भ्रात्रा त्वम् नाथा हि वयम् वने
मया च एतत् वचः श्रुत्वा कार्त्स्न्येन परिपालनम्
transliteration: rakṣa naḥ tvam saha bhrātrā tvam nāthā hi vayam vane
mayā ca etat vacaḥ śrutvā kārtsnyena paripālanam

sanskrit: संश्रुत्य न च शक्ष्यामि जीवमानः प्रतिश्रवम्
transliteration: saṃśrutya na ca śakṣyāmi jīvamānaḥ pratiśravam

sanskrit: मुनीनाम् अन्यथा कर्तुम् सत्यम् इष्टम् हि मे सदा
अपि अहम् जीवितम् जह्याम् त्वाम् वा सीते स लक्ष्मणाम्
transliteration: munīnām anyathā kartum satyam iṣṭam hi me sadā
api aham jīvitam jahyām tvām vā sīte sa lakṣmaṇām

sanskrit: न तु प्रतिज्ञाम् संश्रुत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशेषतः
तत् अवश्यम् मया कार्यम् ऋषीणाम् परिपालनम्
transliteration: na tu pratijñām saṃśrutya brāhmaṇebhyo viśeṣataḥ
tat avaśyam mayā kāryam ṛṣīṇām paripālanam

sanskrit: अनुक्तेन अपि वैदेहि प्रतिज्ञाय कथम् पुनः
मम स्नेहात् च सौहार्दात् इदम् उक्तम् त्वया वचः
transliteration: anuktena api vaidehi pratijñāya katham punaḥ
mama snehāt ca sauhārdāt idam uktam tvayā vacaḥ

sanskrit: परितुष्टो अस्मि अहम् सीते न हि अनिष्टो अनुशास्यते
सदृशम् च अनुरूपम् च कुलस्य तव शोभने
सधर्म चारिणी मे त्वम् प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसी
transliteration: parituṣṭo asmi aham sīte na hi aniṣṭo anuśāsyate
sadṛśam ca anurūpam ca kulasya tava śobhane
sadharma cāriṇī me tvam prāṇebhyo api garīyasī
english: O beauteous damsel, (wat you have said) is worthy of both your love and your race. You are dearer to me even than life, being a companion in my religious acts.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा वचनम् महात्मासीताम् प्रियाम् मैथिल राज पुत्रीम्
रामो धनुष्मान् सह लक्ष्मणेनजगाम रम्याणि तपो वनानि
transliteration: iti evam uktvā vacanam mahātmāsītām priyām maithila rāja putrīm
rāmo dhanuṣmān saha lakṣmaṇenajagāma ramyāṇi tapo vanāni
english: Having said these words to Mithila's princess, the, beloved Sītā, the high-souled Răma, equipped with bows, along with Laksmana, directed his steps towards the inviting woods of asceticism.

sanskrit: अग्रतः प्रययौ रामः सीता मध्ये सुशोभना
पृष्ठतः तु धनुष्पाणिः लक्ष्मणः अनुजगाम ह
transliteration: agrataḥ prayayau rāmaḥ sītā madhye suśobhanā
pṛṣṭhataḥ tu dhanuṣpāṇiḥ lakṣmaṇaḥ anujagāma ha
english: Rāma went first; in the middle, Sītā; and bearing a bow in his hand, Laksmana went in their wake.

sanskrit: तौ पश्यमानौ विविधान् शैल प्रस्थान् वनानि च
नदीः च विविधा रम्या जग्मतुः सह सीतया
transliteration: tau paśyamānau vividhān śaila prasthān vanāni ca
nadīḥ ca vividhā ramyā jagmatuḥ saha sītayā

sanskrit: सारसान् चक्रवाकां च नदी पुलिन चारिणः
सरांसि च सपद्मानि युतानि जलजैः खगैः
transliteration: sārasān cakravākāṃ ca nadī pulina cāriṇaḥ
sarāṃsi ca sapadmāni yutāni jalajaiḥ khagaiḥ

sanskrit: यूथ बद्धाम् च पृषतान् मद उन्मत्तान् विषाणिनः
महिषाम् च वराहाम् च गजाम् च द्रुम वैरिणः
transliteration: yūtha baddhām ca pṛṣatān mada unmattān viṣāṇinaḥ
mahiṣām ca varāhām ca gajām ca druma vairiṇaḥ

sanskrit: ते गत्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् लंबमाने दिवाकरे
ददृशुः सहिता रंयम् तटाकम् योजन आयुतम्
transliteration: te gatvā dūram adhvānam laṃbamāne divākare
dadṛśuḥ sahitā raṃyam taṭākam yojana āyutam
english: Having proceeded a long way, when the sun was aslant, they together saw a delightful tank measuring a Yojana, filled with red and pale Swans lotuses, graced with herds of elephants, and abounding in aquatic cranes, and Kadambas.

sanskrit: पद्म पुष्कर संबाधम् गज यूथैः अलंकृतम्
सारसैः हंस कादम्बैः संकुलम् जल जातिभिः
transliteration: padma puṣkara saṃbādham gaja yūthaiḥ alaṃkṛtam
sārasaiḥ haṃsa kādambaiḥ saṃkulam jala jātibhiḥ
english: Having proceeded a long way, when the sun was aslant, they together saw a delightful tank measuring a Yojana, filled with red and pale Swans lotuses, graced with herds of elephants, and abounding in aquatic cranes, and Kadambas.

sanskrit: प्रसन्न सलिले रम्ये तस्मिन् सरसि शुश्रुवे
गीत वादित्र निर्घोषो न तु कश्चन दृश्यते
transliteration: prasanna salile ramye tasmin sarasi śuśruve
gīta vāditra nirghoṣo na tu kaścana dṛśyate
english: And in that tank containing charming and pleasant waters, they heard sounds of song and instrumental music; but no one was seen there.

sanskrit: ततः कौतूहलात् रामो लक्ष्मणः च महारथः
transliteration: tataḥ kautūhalāt rāmo lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahārathaḥ
english: There at, from curiosity, Rāma and Lakşmana, mighty car warrior, asked an ascetic named Dharmabhrt.

sanskrit: इदम् अत्यद्भुतम् श्रुत्वा सर्वेषाम् नो महामुने
कौतूहलम् महत् जातम् किम् इदम् साधु कथ्यताम्
transliteration: idam atyadbhutam śrutvā sarveṣām no mahāmune
kautūhalam mahat jātam kim idam sādhu kathyatām
english: Hearing this mighty wonder, we have been worked up with intense curiosity. Do you tell us what this is.

sanskrit: तेन एवम् उक्तो धर्मात्मा राघवेण मुनिः तदा
transliteration: tena evam ukto dharmātmā rāghaveṇa muniḥ tadā
english: Thus accosted by Rāghava, the ascetic then at once began to expatiate over the potency of the pool.

sanskrit: इदम् पंच अप्सरो नाम तटाकम् सार्व कालिकम्
transliteration: idam paṃca apsaro nāma taṭākam sārva kālikam
english: This tank goes by the name of Pancāpsara, and is always filled with water. It was made, O Rāma, by the ascetic Măndakarni, by virtue of his asceticism.

sanskrit: स हि तेपे तपः तीव्रम् माण्डकर्णिः महामुनिः
दश वर्ष सहस्राणि वायु भक्षो जलाशये
transliteration: sa hi tepe tapaḥ tīvram māṇḍakarṇiḥ mahāmuniḥ
daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi vāyu bhakṣo jalāśaye
english: In yonder tank, the mighty ascetic, living on air, performed signal austerities for ten thousand years.

sanskrit: ततः प्रव्यथिताः सर्वे देवाः स अग्नि पुरोगमाः
transliteration: tataḥ pravyathitāḥ sarve devāḥ sa agni purogamāḥ
english: Thereat, exceedingly agitated, all the deities with Agni at their head assembled together, said, This ascetic wishes to have the position of one of us.' Thus all the deities present there were filled with anxiety.

sanskrit: अस्मकम् कस्यचित् स्थानम् एष प्रार्थयते मुनिः
इति संविग्न मनसः सर्वे तत्र दिवौकसः
transliteration: asmakam kasyacit sthānam eṣa prārthayate muniḥ
iti saṃvigna manasaḥ sarve tatra divaukasaḥ
english: Thereat, exceedingly agitated, all the deities with Agni at their head assembled together, said, This ascetic wishes to have the position of one of us.' Thus all the deities present there were filled with anxiety.

sanskrit: ततः कर्तुम् तपो विघ्नम् सर्व देवैः नियोजिताः
प्रधान अप्सरसः पंच विद्युत् चलित वर्चसः
transliteration: tataḥ kartum tapo vighnam sarva devaiḥ niyojitāḥ
pradhāna apsarasaḥ paṃca vidyut calita varcasaḥ
english: Then with the view of disturbing his austerities, the deities ordered five principal Apsarās, possessed of the splendour of live lighting.

sanskrit: अप्सरोभिः ततः ताभिः मुनिः दृष्ट परावरः
नीतो मदन वश्यत्वम् देवानाम् कार्य सिद्धये
transliteration: apsarobhiḥ tataḥ tābhiḥ muniḥ dṛṣṭa parāvaraḥ
nīto madana vaśyatvam devānām kārya siddhaye
english: And for compassing the end of the celestials, that ascetic conversant with the morality and otherwise as well of this life as that to come, was brought by those Apsaras (nymphs) under the sway of Madana.

sanskrit: ताः चैव अप्सरसः पंच मुनेः पत्नीत्वम् आगताः
तटाके निर्मितम् तासाम् तस्मिन् अन्तर्हितम् गृहम्
transliteration: tāḥ caiva apsarasaḥ paṃca muneḥ patnītvam āgatāḥ
taṭāke nirmitam tāsām tasmin antarhitam gṛham
english: And those five nymphs (ultimately) became the wives of the ascetic; and their hidden residence was reared in the pool.

sanskrit: तत्र एव अप्सरसः पंच निवसन्त्यो यथा सुखम्
transliteration: tatra eva apsarasaḥ paṃca nivasantyo yathā sukham
english: And there the five nymphs living happily, pleased the anchorite, established in youth through asceticism and yoga.

sanskrit: तासाम् संक्रीड मानानाम् एष वादित्र निःस्वनः
श्रूयते भूषण उन्मिश्रः गीत शब्दः मनोहरः
transliteration: tāsām saṃkrīḍa mānānām eṣa vāditra niḥsvanaḥ
śrūyate bhūṣaṇa unmiśraḥ gīta śabdaḥ manoharaḥ
english: As your sport, we hear the sounds of their musical instruments, and the sweet voice of their song mixed with the tinkling of their instruments.

sanskrit: आश्चर्यम् इति तस्य एतद् वचनम् भावितात्मनः
राघवः प्रतिजग्राह सह भ्रात्रा महा यशाः
transliteration: āścaryam iti tasya etad vacanam bhāvitātmanaḥ
rāghavaḥ pratijagrāha saha bhrātrā mahā yaśāḥ
english: (Hearing this), the illustrious Rāghava along with his brother declared the story narrated by that one of a pure heart to be wonderful.

sanskrit: एवम् कथयमानः स ददर्श आश्रम मण्डलम्
कुश चीर परिक्षिप्तम् ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम्
transliteration: evam kathayamānaḥ sa dadarśa āśrama maṇḍalam
kuśa cīra parikṣiptam brāhmyā lakṣmyā samāvṛtam
english: Thus conversing, Rāma saw the collection of asylums, strewn with Kusa and bark, and be-girt with energy derived from Brahmā lore.

sanskrit: प्रविश्य सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च राघवः
तदा तस्मिन् स काकुत्स्थः श्रीमति आश्रम मण्डले
transliteration: praviśya saha vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena ca rāghavaḥ
tadā tasmin sa kākutsthaḥ śrīmati āśrama maṇḍale
english: Entering (the place) along with Vaidehi and Lakşmaņa, the highly famous Rāghava dwelt there respected by all the ascetics.

sanskrit: उषित्वा स सुखम् तत्र पूर्ज्यमानो महर्षिभिः
जगाम च आश्रमान् तेषाम् पर्यायेण तपस्विनाम्
transliteration: uṣitvā sa sukham tatra pūrjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
jagāma ca āśramān teṣām paryāyeṇa tapasvinām

sanskrit: येषाम् उषितवान् पूर्वम् सकाशे स महास्त्रवित्
क्वचित् परिदशान् मासान् एक संवत्सरम् क्वचित्
transliteration: yeṣām uṣitavān pūrvam sakāśe sa mahāstravit
kvacit paridaśān māsān eka saṃvatsaram kvacit

sanskrit: क्वचित् च चतुरो मासान् पंच षट् च परान् क्वचित्
अपरत्र अधिकान् मासान् अध्यर्धम् अधिकम् क्वचित्
transliteration: kvacit ca caturo māsān paṃca ṣaṭ ca parān kvacit
aparatra adhikān māsān adhyardham adhikam kvacit
english: And Rāghava happily passed his days somewhere for ten months, somewhere for one year, somewhere for four months somewhere for five or six months, somewhere for many months, somewhere for a month and a half, somewhere for more, somewhere for three months, and somewhere for eight.

sanskrit: त्रीन् मासान् अष्ट मासान् च राघवो न्यवसत् सुखम्
तत्र संवसतः तस्य मुनीनाम् आश्रमेषु वै
transliteration: trīn māsān aṣṭa māsān ca rāghavo nyavasat sukham
tatra saṃvasataḥ tasya munīnām āśrameṣu vai

sanskrit: रमतः च आनुकूल्येन ययुः संवत्सरा दश
परिसृत्य च धर्मज्ञः राघवः सह सीतया
transliteration: ramataḥ ca ānukūlyena yayuḥ saṃvatsarā daśa
parisṛtya ca dharmajñaḥ rāghavaḥ saha sītayā

sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णस्य आश्रमम् श्रीमान् पुनर् एव आजगाम ह
स तम् आश्रमम् आगम्य मुनिभिः परिपूजितः
transliteration: sutīkṣṇasya āśramam śrīmān punar eva ājagāma ha
sa tam āśramam āgamya munibhiḥ paripūjitaḥ

sanskrit: तत्र अपि न्यवसत् रामः कंचित् कालम् अरिन्दमः
अथ आश्रमस्थो विनयात् कदाचित् तम् महामुनिम्
transliteration: tatra api nyavasat rāmaḥ kaṃcit kālam arindamaḥ
atha āśramastho vinayāt kadācit tam mahāmunim

sanskrit: उपासीनः स काकुत्स्थः सुतीक्ष्णम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: upāsīnaḥ sa kākutsthaḥ sutīkṣṇam idam abravīt

sanskrit: वसति इति मया नित्यम् कथाः कथयताम् श्रुतम्
न तु जानामि तम् देशम् वनस्य अस्य महत्तया
transliteration: vasati iti mayā nityam kathāḥ kathayatām śrutam
na tu jānāmi tam deśam vanasya asya mahattayā
english: I have always heard from men speaking on the subject that that foremost of ascetics, the reverend Agastya, lives in this forest. On account of the vastness of this forest, I do not know that place.

sanskrit: कुत्र आश्रम पदम् पुण्यम् महर्षेः तस्य धीमतः
प्रसाद अर्थम् भगवतः सानुजः सह सीतया
transliteration: kutra āśrama padam puṇyam maharṣeḥ tasya dhīmataḥ
prasāda artham bhagavataḥ sānujaḥ saha sītayā
english: Where is the hermitage of that intelligent Maharsi? For propitiating that revered one, I, accompanied by my brother and Sītā, will go to Agastya for paying our respects to the ascetic.
Where is the hermitage of that intelligent Maharsi? For propitiating that revered one, I, accompanied by my brother and Sītā, will go to Agastya for paying our respects to the ascetic.

sanskrit: यदि अहम् तम् मुनिवरम् शुश्रूषेयम् अपि स्वयम्
इति रामस्य स मुनिः श्रुत्वा धर्मात्मनो वचः
transliteration: yadi aham tam munivaram śuśrūṣeyam api svayam
iti rāmasya sa muniḥ śrutvā dharmātmano vacaḥ
english: This great desire is burning in my heart, that I should myself minister to that best of anchorets. Hearing these words of the righteous-souled Rama, Sutiksna, well pleased, answered Dasaratha's son.

sanskrit: अहम् अपि एतद् एव त्वाम् वक्तु कामः स लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: aham api etad eva tvām vaktu kāmaḥ sa lakṣmaṇam

sanskrit: अगस्त्यम् अभिगच्छ इति सीतया सह राघव
दिष्ट्या तु इदानीम् अर्थे अस्मिन् स्वयम् एव ब्रवीषि माम्
transliteration: agastyam abhigaccha iti sītayā saha rāghava
diṣṭyā tu idānīm arthe asmin svayam eva bravīṣi mām
english: I also am desirous of telling you this along with Lakşmaņa. Repair to Agastya in company with Sītā, O Rāghava. By luck you have yourself said this to me as to your purpose.

sanskrit: अयम् आख्यामि ते राम यत्र अगस्त्यो महामुनिः
योजनानि आश्रमात् तात याहि चत्वारि वै ततः
दक्षिणेन महान् श्रीमान् अगस्त्य भ्रातुर् आश्रमः
transliteration: ayam ākhyāmi te rāma yatra agastyo mahāmuniḥ
yojanāni āśramāt tāta yāhi catvāri vai tataḥ
dakṣiṇena mahān śrīmān agastya bhrātur āśramaḥ

sanskrit: स्थली प्राय वनोद्देशे पिप्पली वन शोभिते
बहु पुष्प फले रम्ये नाना विहग नादिते
transliteration: sthalī prāya vanoddeśe pippalī vana śobhite
bahu puṣpa phale ramye nānā vihaga nādite
english: I will, O Rāma, tell you where that mighty ascetic, Agastya, is. My child, go four miles from the hermitage in a southerly direction; and you will come to the hermitage of the brother of the auspicious Agastya situated on a land covered with trees, graced with Pippali woods, abounding in fruits and flowers, charming, and resonant with the notes of various birds. There are many tanks containing delightful waters, swarming with swans and Kārandavas, and beauteous with Cakravākas.

sanskrit: पद्मिन्यो विविधाः तत्र प्रसन्न सलिल आशयाः
transliteration: padminyo vividhāḥ tatra prasanna salila āśayāḥ

sanskrit: तत्र एकाम् रजनीम् व्युष्य प्रभाते राम गम्यताम्
दक्षिणाम् दिशम् आस्थाय वन षण्डस्य पार्श्वतः
transliteration: tatra ekām rajanīm vyuṣya prabhāte rāma gamyatām
dakṣiṇām diśam āsthāya vana ṣaṇḍasya pārśvataḥ
english: Passing a night there, do you, O Rāma, in the morning, taking a southerly course, go by the skirts of the forest tract. Passing a Yojana, you । shall come upon Agastya's asylum, located at a charming woodland graced with many a tree.

sanskrit: तत्र अगस्त्य आश्रम पदम् गत्वा योजनम् अन्तरम्
transliteration: tatra agastya āśrama padam gatvā yojanam antaram
english: Passing a night there, do you, O Rāma, in the morning, taking a southerly course, go by the skirts of the forest tract. Passing a Yojana, you । shall come upon Agastya's asylum, located at a charming woodland graced with many a tree.

sanskrit: रंस्यते तत्र वैदेही लक्ष्मणः च त्वया सह
स हि रम्यो वनोउद्देशो बहु पादप संयुतः
transliteration: raṃsyate tatra vaidehī lakṣmaṇaḥ ca tvayā saha
sa hi ramyo vanouddeśo bahu pādapa saṃyutaḥ
english: There Videha's daughter and Lakşınana shall experience delight in your company.

sanskrit: यदि बुद्धिः कृता द्रष्टुम् अगस्त्यम् तम् महामुनिम्
अद्य एव गमने बुद्धिम् रोचयस्व महामते
transliteration: yadi buddhiḥ kṛtā draṣṭum agastyam tam mahāmunim
adya eva gamane buddhim rocayasva mahāmate
english: O magnanimous one, if you intend to see the mighty ascetic, Agastya, in that charming woodland, containing a great many trees, then do you make up your mind to set out this very day.

sanskrit: इति रामो मुनेः श्रुत्वा सह भ्रात्रा अभिवाद्य च
प्रतस्थे अगस्त्यम् उद्दिश्य सानुगः सह सीतया
transliteration: iti rāmo muneḥ śrutvā saha bhrātrā abhivādya ca
pratasthe agastyam uddiśya sānugaḥ saha sītayā
english: Hearing these words of the anchorite, Rāma, saluting him, along with his brother, set off for Agastya's (place) with his younger brother and Sītā.

sanskrit: पश्यन् वनानि चित्राणि पर्वतां च अभ्र संनिभान्
सरांसि सरितः चैव पथि मार्ग वश अनुगतान्
transliteration: paśyan vanāni citrāṇi parvatāṃ ca abhra saṃnibhān
sarāṃsi saritaḥ caiva pathi mārga vaśa anugatān
english: And, pleasantly proceeding by the way dire ted by Sutiksna, seeing picturesque woods, hills resembling clouds, watery expanses and streams flowing by their path; Rāma filled with delight said these words to Lakşmana,

sanskrit: सुतीक्ष्णेन उपदिष्टेन गत्वा तेन पथा सुखम्
इदम् परम संहृष्टो वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sutīkṣṇena upadiṣṭena gatvā tena pathā sukham
idam parama saṃhṛṣṭo vākyam lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: And, pleasantly proceeding by the way dire ted by Sutiksna, seeing picturesque woods, hills resembling clouds, watery expanses and streams flowing by their path; Rāma filled with delight said these words to Lakşmana,

sanskrit: एतद् एव आश्रम पदम् नूनम् तस्य महात्मनः
अगस्त्यस्य मुनेर् भ्रातुर् दृश्यते पुण्य कर्मणः
transliteration: etad eva āśrama padam nūnam tasya mahātmanaḥ
agastyasya muner bhrātur dṛśyate puṇya karmaṇaḥ
english: 'Surely we see the asylumn of that high-souled one, the ascetic, Agastya's brother of pious acts.

sanskrit: यथा हि इमे वनस्य अस्य ज्ञाताः पथि सहस्रशः
संनताः फल भरेण पुष्प भारेण च द्रुमाः
transliteration: yathā hi ime vanasya asya jñātāḥ pathi sahasraśaḥ
saṃnatāḥ phala bhareṇa puṣpa bhāreṇa ca drumāḥ
english: These trees standing by thousands on the way bending beneath the weight of fruits and flowers, bear the signs that had been mentioned to me as belonging to this wood.

sanskrit: पिप्पलीनाम् च पक्वानाम् वनाद् अस्माद् उपागतः
गन्धो अयम् पवन उत्क्षिप्तः सहसा कटुकोदयः
transliteration: pippalīnām ca pakvānām vanād asmād upāgataḥ
gandho ayam pavana utkṣiptaḥ sahasā kaṭukodayaḥ
english: And coming from the wood this scent is wafted by the wind the pungent odour of ripe Pippalis.

sanskrit: तत्र तत्र च दृश्यन्ते संक्षिप्ताः काष्ठ संचयाः
लूनाः च परिदृश्यन्ते दर्भा वैदूर्य वर्चसः
transliteration: tatra tatra ca dṛśyante saṃkṣiptāḥ kāṣṭha saṃcayāḥ
lūnāḥ ca paridṛśyante darbhā vaidūrya varcasaḥ
english: And here and there are found heaps of firewood, and torn Darbha are seen, of the lustre of lapses.

sanskrit: एतत् च वन मध्यस्थम् कृष्ण अभ्र शिखर उपमम्
transliteration: etat ca vana madhyastham kṛṣṇa abhra śikhara upamam
english: And the top of the column of smoke belonging to the fire lit in the asylum in this wood, appears like the peak of a dark mountain.

sanskrit: विविक्तेषु च तीर्थेषु कृत स्नाना द्विजातयः
पुष्प उपहारम् कुर्वन्ति कुसुमैः स्वयम् आर्जितैः
transliteration: vivikteṣu ca tīrtheṣu kṛta snānā dvijātayaḥ
puṣpa upahāram kurvanti kusumaiḥ svayam ārjitaiḥ
english: And twice-born ones, having performed their ablutions in sacred and retired bathing places, are offering flowers gathered by themselves.

sanskrit: ततः सुतीक्ष्णस्य वचनम् यथा सौम्य मया श्रुतम्
अगस्त्यस्य आश्रमो भ्रातुर् नूनम् एष भविष्यति
transliteration: tataḥ sutīkṣṇasya vacanam yathā saumya mayā śrutam
agastyasya āśramo bhrātur nūnam eṣa bhaviṣyati
english: O placid one, from what I had heard from Sutiksna, this would appear to be the asylum of Agastya's brother.

sanskrit: निगृह्य तरसा मृत्युम् लोकानाम् हित काम्यया
यस्य भ्रात्रा कृता इयम् दिक् शरण्या पुण्य कर्मणा
transliteration: nigṛhya tarasā mṛtyum lokānām hita kāmyayā
yasya bhrātrā kṛtā iyam dik śaraṇyā puṇya karmaṇā
english: The righteous Agastya it is who, wishing for the welfare of the worlds, destroying by virtue of his austerities a Daitya resembling Death, has rendered this quarter habitable.

sanskrit: इह एकदा किल क्रूरो वातापिः अपि च इल्वलः
भ्रातरौ सहितौ आस्ताम् ब्राह्मणघ्नौ महा असुरौ
transliteration: iha ekadā kila krūro vātāpiḥ api ca ilvalaḥ
bhrātarau sahitau āstām brāhmaṇaghnau mahā asurau
english: Once on a time here dwelt together two mighty Asuras, brothers, given to slaughtering Brāhmanas, the wily Vātāpi and Ilvala.

sanskrit: धारयन् ब्राह्मणम् रूपम् इल्वलः संस्कृतम् वदन्
आमंत्रयति विप्रान् स श्राद्धम् उद्दिश्य निर्घृणः
transliteration: dhārayan brāhmaṇam rūpam ilvalaḥ saṃskṛtam vadan
āmaṃtrayati viprān sa śrāddham uddiśya nirghṛṇaḥ
english: Wearing the form of a Brāhmana, and speaking Sanskrit, the cruel one used to invite Vipras to a Śrāddha. And, cooking his brother wearing the shape of a sheep, he used to feed the twice-born ones according to the rites prescribed for Śrāddhas.

sanskrit: भ्रातरम् संस्कृतम् कृत्वा ततः तम् मेष रूपिणम्
तान् द्विजान् भोजयामास श्राद्ध दृष्टेन कर्मणा
transliteration: bhrātaram saṃskṛtam kṛtvā tataḥ tam meṣa rūpiṇam
tān dvijān bhojayāmāsa śrāddha dṛṣṭena karmaṇā
english: Wearing the form of a Brāhmana, and speaking Sanskrit, the cruel one used to invite Vipras to a Śrāddha. And, cooking his brother wearing the shape of a sheep, he used to feed the twice-born ones according to the rites prescribed for Śrāddhas.

sanskrit: ततो भुक्तवताम् तेषाम् विप्राणाम् इल्वलो अब्रवीत्
वातापे निष्क्रमस्व इति स्वरेण महता वदन्
transliteration: tato bhuktavatām teṣām viprāṇām ilvalo abravīt
vātāpe niṣkramasva iti svareṇa mahatā vadan
english: Then when the Vipras had fed, Ilvala said'uttering a loud sound, O Vātāpi; come out.'

sanskrit: ततो भ्रातुर् वचः श्रुत्वा वातापिः मेषवत् नदन्
transliteration: tato bhrātur vacaḥ śrutvā vātāpiḥ meṣavat nadan
english: Hearing his brother's words, Vātāpi, bleating like a sheep, came out, riving their bodies.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणानाम् सहस्राणि तैः एवम् काम रूपिभिः
transliteration: brāhmaṇānām sahasrāṇi taiḥ evam kāma rūpibhiḥ
english: In this way, thousands of Brāhmaṇas gathered together, were destroyed by flesh eating ones wearing shapes at will.

sanskrit: अनुभूय किल श्राद्धे भक्षितः स महा असुरः
transliteration: anubhūya kila śrāddhe bhakṣitaḥ sa mahā asuraḥ
english: (And it came to pass that once upon a time) the Maharși Agastya, having been invited to a Sraddha, fed on the mighty Asura.

sanskrit: ततः संपन्नम् इति उक्त्वा दत्त्वा हस्ते अवनेजनम्
भ्रातरम् निष्क्रमस्व इति च इल्वलः समभाषत
transliteration: tataḥ saṃpannam iti uktvā dattvā haste avanejanam
bhrātaram niṣkramasva iti ca ilvalaḥ samabhāṣata
english: Thereupon uttering Finished' and offering water to wash hands with, Ilvala said to his brother, 'Come out'!

sanskrit: स तदा भाषमाणम् तु भ्रातरम् विप्र घातिनम्
अब्रवीत् प्रहसन् धीमान् अगस्त्यो मुनि सत्तमः
transliteration: sa tadā bhāṣamāṇam tu bhrātaram vipra ghātinam
abravīt prahasan dhīmān agastyo muni sattamaḥ
english: And, as that brother of Vātãpi, given to slaughtering Vipras was speaking thus, that foremost of ascetics, the intelligent Agastya, said with a laugh,

sanskrit: कुतो निष्क्रमितुम् शक्तिर् मया जीर्णस्य रक्षसः
भ्रातुः ते मेष रूपस्य गतस्य यम सादनम्
transliteration: kuto niṣkramitum śaktir mayā jīrṇasya rakṣasaḥ
bhrātuḥ te meṣa rūpasya gatasya yama sādanam
english: 'Where is the power of coming out, of the Rākṣasa, your brother wearing the shape of a sheep, who has gone to Yama's abode?'

sanskrit: अथ तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर् निधन संश्रितम्
प्रधर्षयितुम् आरेभे मुनिम् क्रोधात् निशा चरः
transliteration: atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhrātur nidhana saṃśritam
pradharṣayitum ārebhe munim krodhāt niśā caraḥ
english: Hearing his words, from wrath the ranger of the night prepared to assail the ascetic, and he rushed against that foremost of the twice-born ones.

sanskrit: सो अभ्यद्रवत् द्विजेंद्रम् तम् मुनिना दीप्त तेजसा
चक्षुषा अनल कल्पेन निर्दग्धो निधनम् गतः
transliteration: so abhyadravat dvijeṃdram tam muninā dīpta tejasā
cakṣuṣā anala kalpena nirdagdho nidhanam gataḥ
english: And, being consumed by that ascetic of flaming energy with his eyes resembling fire, the Rākşasa met his end.

sanskrit: तस्य अयम् आश्रमो भ्रातुः तटाक वन शोभितः
विप्र अनुकम्पया येन कर्म इदम् दुष्करम् कृतम्
transliteration: tasya ayam āśramo bhrātuḥ taṭāka vana śobhitaḥ
vipra anukampayā yena karma idam duṣkaram kṛtam
english: This asylum graced with pools and groves belongs to the brother of him who has performed this arduous feat from compassion for the Vipras'.

sanskrit: रामस्य अस्तम् गतः सूर्यः संध्या कालो अभ्यवर्तत
transliteration: rāmasya astam gataḥ sūryaḥ saṃdhyā kālo abhyavartata
english: As Rāma was thus conversing with Sumitra's son, the sun set and evening approached.

sanskrit: उपास्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् सह भ्रात्रा यथा विधि
प्रविवेश आश्रम पदम् तम् ऋषिम् च अभ्यवादयत्
transliteration: upāsya paścimām saṃdhyām saha bhrātrā yathā vidhi
praviveśa āśrama padam tam ṛṣim ca abhyavādayat
english: Then, duly performing his afternoon adorations along with his brother, Rāma entered the hermitage, and saluted the ascetic.

sanskrit: सम्यक् प्रतिगृहीतः तु मुनिना तेन राघवः
न्यवसत् ताम् निशाम् एकाम् प्राश्य मूल फलानि च
transliteration: samyak pratigṛhītaḥ tu muninā tena rāghavaḥ
nyavasat tām niśām ekām prāśya mūla phalāni ca
english: Well received by the ascetic, Rāghava spent there a night, eating fruits and roots.

sanskrit: तस्याम् रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् उदिते रवि मण्डले
transliteration: tasyām rātryām vyatītāyām udite ravi maṇḍale
english: When the night had passed away, and solar disc arose, Rāghava greeted Agastya's brother.

sanskrit: अभिवादये त्वाम् भगवन् सुखम् स्म उष्यतो निशाम्
आमंत्रये त्वाम् गच्छामि गुरुम् ते द्रष्टुम् अग्रजम्
transliteration: abhivādaye tvām bhagavan sukham sma uṣyato niśām
āmaṃtraye tvām gacchāmi gurum te draṣṭum agrajam
english: O reverend Sir, I salute you. I have pleasantly passed the night. I greet you; I shall go to behold my preceptor, your elder brother.

sanskrit: गम्यताम् इति तेन उक्तो जगाम रघु नन्दनः
यथा उद्दिष्टेन मार्गेण वनम् तत् च अवलोकयन्
transliteration: gamyatām iti tena ukto jagāma raghu nandanaḥ
