yathā uddiṣṭena mārgeṇa vanam tat ca avalokayan
english: Thereat on the ascetic's saying, 'Go you,' the descendant of Raghu went away by the prescribed route.

sanskrit: नीवारान् पनसान् सालान् वन्जुलान् तिनिशान् तथा
चिरि बिल्वान् मधूकान् च बिल्वान् अथ च तिन्दुकान्
transliteration: nīvārān panasān sālān vanjulān tiniśān tathā
ciri bilvān madhūkān ca bilvān atha ca tindukān

sanskrit: ददर्श रामः शतशः तत्र कान्तार पादपान्
transliteration: dadarśa rāmaḥ śataśaḥ tatra kāntāra pādapān

sanskrit: मत्तैः शकुनि संघैः च शतशः प्रति नादितान्
transliteration: mattaiḥ śakuni saṃghaiḥ ca śataśaḥ prati nāditān

sanskrit: ततो अब्रवीत् समीपस्थम् रामो राजीव लोचनः
transliteration: tato abravīt samīpastham rāmo rājīva locanaḥ
english: Then the lotus-eyed Rāma said to that enhancer of auspiciousness, the heroic Laks maņa, who was by him, and was following him at his back,

sanskrit: स्निग्ध पत्रा यथा वृक्षा यथा क्षान्ता मृग द्विजाः
आश्रमो न अतिदूरस्थो महर्षेर् भावित आत्मनः
transliteration: snigdha patrā yathā vṛkṣā yathā kṣāntā mṛga dvijāḥ
āśramo na atidūrastho maharṣer bhāvita ātmanaḥ
english: The leaves of these trees are glossy, and the beasts and birds are mild, even as (we had been told). This asylum of the pure-hearted Maharsi must not be far.

sanskrit: अगस्त्य इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेन एव कर्मणा
आश्रमो दृश्यते तस्य परिश्रान्त श्रम अपहः
transliteration: agastya iti vikhyāto loke svena eva karmaṇā
āśramo dṛśyate tasya pariśrānta śrama apahaḥ
english: This asylum capable of removing the fatigue of the weary, belonging to him that is known among men as Agastya by his own acts, is seen, with the (neighbouring woods) filled with smoke, and itself decorated with bark and wreaths, containing herds of mild deer, and ringing with the notes of various birds.

sanskrit: प्राज्य धूम आकुल वनः चीर माला परिष्कृतः
प्रशान्त मृग यूथः च नाना शकुनि नादितः
transliteration: prājya dhūma ākula vanaḥ cīra mālā pariṣkṛtaḥ
praśānta mṛga yūthaḥ ca nānā śakuni nāditaḥ
english: This asylum capable of removing the fatigue of the weary, belonging to him that is known among men as Agastya by his own acts, is seen, with the (neighbouring woods) filled with smoke, and itself decorated with bark and wreaths, containing herds of mild deer, and ringing with the notes of various birds.

sanskrit: निगृह्य तरसा मृत्युम् लोकानाम् हित काम्यया
दक्षिणा दिक् कृता येन शरण्या पुण्य कर्मणा
transliteration: nigṛhya tarasā mṛtyum lokānām hita kāmyayā
dakṣiṇā dik kṛtā yena śaraṇyā puṇya karmaṇā
english: The righteous Agastya it is who, wishing for the welfare of the worlds, destroying by virtue of his austerities a Daitya resembling Death, has rendered this quarter habitable.

sanskrit: तस्य इदम् आश्रम पदम् प्रभावाद् यस्य राक्षसैः
दिक् इयम् दक्षिणा त्रासाद् दृश्यते न उपभुज्यते
transliteration: tasya idam āśrama padam prabhāvād yasya rākṣasaiḥ
dik iyam dakṣiṇā trāsād dṛśyate na upabhujyate
english: This is the asylum of that pious one, who destroying (the Asura resembling) Death, has, desirous of the welfare of mankind, rendered the Southern quarter habitable, and through whose potency the Rākşasas from fear barely cast their eyes in this direction, but do not approach.

sanskrit: यदा प्रभृति च आक्रान्ता दिग् इयम् पुण्य कर्मणा
तदा प्रभृति निर् वैराः प्रशान्ता रजनी चराः
transliteration: yadā prabhṛti ca ākrāntā dig iyam puṇya karmaṇā
tadā prabhṛti nir vairāḥ praśāntā rajanī carāḥ
english: Ever since that one of pious ways possessed himself of this quarter, the rangers of the night have foregone their hostility, and assumed a peaceful attitude.

sanskrit: नाम्ना च इयम् भगवतो दक्षिणा दिक् प्रदक्षिणा
प्रथिता त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्धर्षा क्रूर कर्मभिः
transliteration: nāmnā ca iyam bhagavato dakṣiṇā dik pradakṣiṇā
prathitā triṣu lokeṣu durdharṣā krūra karmabhiḥ
english: This Southern quarter rendered safe (by Agastya), and incapable of being harassed by those ones of tortuous ways, is created over the three worlds in connection with the name of the reverend ascetic.

sanskrit: मार्गम् निरोद्धुम् सततम् भास्करस्य अचल उत्तमः
संदेशम् पालयन् तस्य विंध्य शैलो न वर्धते
transliteration: mārgam niroddhum satatam bhāskarasya acala uttamaḥ
saṃdeśam pālayan tasya viṃdhya śailo na vardhate
english: This graceful asylum ranged by mild beasts belongs to that long-lived one of renowned achievements, Agastya, in obedience to whose command, the Vindhya mountain-foremost of its kind, which had always obstructed the way of the Sun, does not increase.

sanskrit: अयम् दीर्घ आयुषः तस्य लोके विश्रुत कर्मणः
अगस्त्यस्य आश्रमः श्रीमान् विनीत मृग सेवितः
transliteration: ayam dīrgha āyuṣaḥ tasya loke viśruta karmaṇaḥ
agastyasya āśramaḥ śrīmān vinīta mṛga sevitaḥ
english: This graceful asylum ranged by mild beasts belongs to that long-lived one of renowned achievements, Agastya, in obedience to whose command, the Vindhya mountain-foremost of its kind, which had always obstructed the way of the Sun, does not increase.

sanskrit: एष लोक अर्चितः साधुः हिते नित्यम् रतः सताम्
transliteration: eṣa loka arcitaḥ sādhuḥ hite nityam rataḥ satām
english: This pious one honoured of men, ever engaged in the welfare of the righteous, shall do good to us, who have come to him.

sanskrit: आराधयिष्यामि अत्र अहम् अगस्त्यम् तम् महामुनिम्
शेषम् च वन वासस्य सौम्य वत्स्यामि अहम् प्रभो
transliteration: ārādhayiṣyāmi atra aham agastyam tam mahāmunim
śeṣam ca vana vāsasya saumya vatsyāmi aham prabho
english: I shall adore the mighty ascetic, Agastya, and, O mild one, O master, here pass away the remainder of the term of my banishment.

sanskrit: अत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च परम ऋषयः
transliteration: atra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ
english: Here celestials with the Gandharvas, and Siddhas and eminent saints, observing restrictions in respect of food, aye adore Agastya.

sanskrit: न अत्र जीवेत् मृषावादी क्रूरो वा यदि वा शठः
नृशंसः पाप वृत्तो वा मुनिः एष तथा विधः
transliteration: na atra jīvet mṛṣāvādī krūro vā yadi vā śaṭhaḥ
nṛśaṃsaḥ pāpa vṛtto vā muniḥ eṣa tathā vidhaḥ
english: And the ascetic is such that a liar cannot live here, nor a cunning or a crafty person, nor a wicked wight, nor one that is given to unrighteousness.

sanskrit: अत्र देवाः च यक्षाः च नागाः च पतगैः सह
transliteration: atra devāḥ ca yakṣāḥ ca nāgāḥ ca patagaiḥ saha
english: And adoring righteousness, celestials, and Yaksas, and Nagas, and birds, live here restricting their fare.

sanskrit: अत्र सिद्धा महात्मानो विमानैः सूर्य सन्निभैः
त्यक्त्वा देहान् नवैर् देहैः स्वर् याताः परम ऋषयः
transliteration: atra siddhā mahātmāno vimānaiḥ sūrya sannibhaiḥ
tyaktvā dehān navair dehaiḥ svar yātāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ
english: And high-souled Siddhas and eminent saints, renouncing their bodies, repair to the celestial regions in cars resembling the sun.

sanskrit: यक्षत्वम् अमरत्वम् च राज्यानि विविधानि च
अत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति भूतैः आराधिताः शुभैः
transliteration: yakṣatvam amaratvam ca rājyāni vividhāni ca
atra devāḥ prayacchanti bhūtaiḥ ārādhitāḥ śubhaiḥ
english: And adored by auspicious individuals, the deities here confer on them the states of Yakşas and celestials, and divers kingdoms.

sanskrit: आगताः स्म आश्रम पदम् सौमित्रे प्रविश अग्रतः
निवेदय इह माम् प्राप्तम् ऋषये सह सीतया
transliteration: āgatāḥ sma āśrama padam saumitre praviśa agrataḥ
nivedaya iha mām prāptam ṛṣaye saha sītayā
english: Sumitra's son, entering the asylum before us, do you announce to the saints that I along with Sītā, have arrived here.

sanskrit: स प्रविश्य आश्रम पदम् लक्ष्मणो राघव अनुजः
अगस्त्य शिष्यम् आसाद्य वाक्यम् एतद् उवाच ह
transliteration: sa praviśya āśrama padam lakṣmaṇo rāghava anujaḥ
agastya śiṣyam āsādya vākyam etad uvāca ha
english: Having entered the asylum, Räghava's younger brother, Lakşmana, coming to a disciple of Agastya, spoke to him.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो नाम ज्येष्ठः तस्य सुतो बली
रामः प्राप्तो मुनिम् द्रष्टुम् भार्यया सह सीतया
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma jyeṣṭhaḥ tasya suto balī
rāmaḥ prāpto munim draṣṭum bhāryayā saha sītayā
english: There was a king, named Dasaratha. His eldest son, the strong Rāma, has come (to this asylum) along with his wife, Sītā, for seeing the ascetic. Named Lakşmaņa, I am his younger brother, obedient and devoted to him. you may have heard of it.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणो नाम तस्य अहम् भ्राता तु अवरजो हितः
अनुकूलः च भक्तः च यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः
transliteration: lakṣmaṇo nāma tasya aham bhrātā tu avarajo hitaḥ
anukūlaḥ ca bhaktaḥ ca yadi te śrotram āgataḥ
english: There was a king, named Dasaratha. His eldest son, the strong Rāma, has come (to this asylum) along with his wife, Sītā, for seeing the ascetic. Named Lakşmaņa, I am his younger brother, obedient and devoted to him. you may have heard of it.

sanskrit: ते वयम् वनम् अत्युग्रम् प्रविष्टाः पितृ शासनात्
transliteration: te vayam vanam atyugram praviṣṭāḥ pitṛ śāsanāt
english: Having entered this horrid forest, in consonance with the mandate of our sire, we desire to see the reverend one. Tell this to him.

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य तपोधनः
तथा इति उक्त्वा अग्नि शरणम् प्रविवेश निवेदितुम्
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya tapodhanaḥ
tathā iti uktvā agni śaraṇam praviveśa niveditum
english: Hearing Laksmana's words, that ascetic, saying, “So be it," entered the chamber of the sacrificial fire, for the purpose of communicating (the news to Agastya).

sanskrit: कृत अंजलिः उवाच इदम् राम आगमनम् अञ्जसा
transliteration: kṛta aṃjaliḥ uvāca idam rāma āgamanam añjasā
english: Entering in, Agastya's beloved disciple, with joined hands communicated to that foremost of ascetics, incapable of being repressed*, exactly what Laksmana had told him, *Some texts:-Effulgent.

sanskrit: यथा उक्तम् लक्ष्मणेन एव शिष्यः तस्य अगस्तस्य संमतः
पुत्रौ दशरथस्य इमौ रामो लक्ष्मण एव च
transliteration: yathā uktam lakṣmaṇena eva śiṣyaḥ tasya agastasya saṃmataḥ
putrau daśarathasya imau rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca

english: For seeing the reverend one, and serving him as well, those subduers of their foes, Dasaratha's sons, Rama and Laksmana, accompanied by Sītā, have entered this asylum. It now behoves you to command what is to be done next.

sanskrit: यद् अत्र अनंतरम् तत् त्वम् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि
ततः शिष्यात् उपश्रुत्य प्राप्तम् रामम् स लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: yad atra anaṃtaram tat tvam ājñāpayitum arhasi
tataḥ śiṣyāt upaśrutya prāptam rāmam sa lakṣmaṇam

sanskrit: वैदेहीम् च महाभागाम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
दिष्ट्या रामः चिरस्य अद्य द्रष्टुम् माम् समुपागतः
transliteration: vaidehīm ca mahābhāgām idam vacanam abravīt
diṣṭyā rāmaḥ cirasya adya draṣṭum mām samupāgataḥ

sanskrit: मनसा कांक्षितम् हि अस्य मया अपि आगमनम् प्रति
गम्यताम् सत्कृतो रामः स भार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: manasā kāṃkṣitam hi asya mayā api āgamanam prati
gamyatām satkṛto rāmaḥ sa bhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: By luck it is that after a long time, Rāma has come to see me. I had mentally wished for his arrival. Go you; and let Rāma, having been respectfully received, come before me. Why have you not brought himself?

sanskrit: प्रवेश्यताम् समीपम् मे किम् असौ न प्रवेशितः
एवम् उक्तः तु मुनिना धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना
transliteration: praveśyatām samīpam me kim asau na praveśitaḥ
evam uktaḥ tu muninā dharmajñena mahātmanā
english: Thus addressed by the high-souled and righteous ascetic, the disciple saluting him, with joined hands, said, So be it.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य अब्रवीत् शिष्यः तथा इति नियत अंजलिः
तदा निष्क्रम्य संभ्रान्तः शिष्यो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: abhivādya abravīt śiṣyaḥ tathā iti niyata aṃjaliḥ
tadā niṣkramya saṃbhrāntaḥ śiṣyo lakṣmaṇam abravīt

sanskrit: क्व असौ रामो मुनिम् द्रष्टुम् एतु प्रविशतु स्वयम्
ततो गत्वा आश्रम पदम् शिष्येण सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: kva asau rāmo munim draṣṭum etu praviśatu svayam
tato gatvā āśrama padam śiṣyeṇa saha lakṣmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: तम् शिष्यः प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् अगस्त्य वचनम् ब्रुवन्
transliteration: tam śiṣyaḥ praśritam vākyam agastya vacanam bruvan

sanskrit: प्रावेशयत् यथा न्यायम् सत्कार अर्ह सुसत्कृतम्
प्रविवेश ततो रामः सीतया सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: prāveśayat yathā nyāyam satkāra arha susatkṛtam
praviveśa tato rāmaḥ sītayā saha lakṣmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: प्रशान्त हरिण आकीर्णम् आश्रमम् हि अवलोकयन्
स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानम् अग्नेः स्थानम् तथैव च
transliteration: praśānta hariṇa ākīrṇam āśramam hi avalokayan
sa tatra brahmaṇaḥ sthānam agneḥ sthānam tathaiva ca
english: And seeing the asylum teeming with mild deer, Rama entered in with Laksmana and Sita. And there Rāma beheld the place of Brahmä, and that of Agni,

sanskrit: विष्णोः स्थानम् महेन्द्रस्य स्थानम् चैव विवस्वतः
सोम स्थानम् भग स्थानम् स्थानम् कौबेरम् एव च
transliteration: viṣṇoḥ sthānam mahendrasya sthānam caiva vivasvataḥ
soma sthānam bhaga sthānam sthānam kauberam eva ca

sanskrit: धातुर् विधातुः स्थानम् च वायोः स्थानम् तथैव च
स्थानम् च पाश हस्तस्य वारुणस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: dhātur vidhātuḥ sthānam ca vāyoḥ sthānam tathaiva ca
sthānam ca pāśa hastasya vāruṇasya mahātmanaḥ

sanskrit: स्थानम् तथैव गायत्र्या वसूनाम् स्थानम् एव च
स्थानम् च नागराजस्य गरुड स्थानम् एव च
transliteration: sthānam tathaiva gāyatryā vasūnām sthānam eva ca
sthānam ca nāgarājasya garuḍa sthānam eva ca

sanskrit: कार्तिकेयस्य च स्थानम् धर्म स्थानम् च पश्यति
ततः शिष्यैः परिवृतो मुनिर् अपि अभिनिष्पतत्
transliteration: kārtikeyasya ca sthānam dharma sthānam ca paśyati
tataḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto munir api abhiniṣpatat

sanskrit: तम् ददर्श अग्रतो रामो मुनीनाम् दीप्त तेजसम्
transliteration: tam dadarśa agrato rāmo munīnām dīpta tejasam
english: And it came to pass that, surrounded by his disciples, the ascetic came (before Rāma). And Rāma saw that one of flaming energy at the head of the ascetics, and the hero said to Lakşınana, enhancer of auspiciousness.

sanskrit: बहिर् लक्ष्मण निष्क्रामति अगस्त्यो भगवान् ऋषिः
transliteration: bahir lakṣmaṇa niṣkrāmati agastyo bhagavān ṛṣiḥ
english: O Laksmana, the revered saint, Agastya, is coming out. I recognize that mass of asceticism by a certain kind of majesty (that characterises him).

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महाबाहुः अगस्त्यम् सूर्य वर्चसम्
जग्राह आपतत् तस्य पादौ च रघुनन्दन
transliteration: evam uktvā mahābāhuḥ agastyam sūrya varcasam
jagrāha āpatat tasya pādau ca raghunandana
english: Having said this touching Agastya of the splendour of the sun, that son of Raghu took hold of his feet.

sanskrit: अभिवाद्य तु धर्मात्मा तस्थौ रामः कृतांजलिः
सीतया सह वैदेह्या तदा रामः स लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: abhivādya tu dharmātmā tasthau rāmaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ
sītayā saha vaidehyā tadā rāmaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: Then, having paid him homage, Rama with joined hands stood there in company with Videha's daughter, Sītā, and Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थम् अर्चयित्वा आसन उदकैः
कुशल प्रश्नम् उक्त्वा च आस्यताम् इति सोऽब्रवीत्
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca kākutstham arcayitvā āsana udakaiḥ
kuśala praśnam uktvā ca āsyatām iti so'bravīt
english: Thereat, embracing Rāma and honouring him with water and a seat, and asking him questions anent his welfare, the saint said, Welcome!

sanskrit: अग्निम् हुत्वा प्रदाय अर्घ्यम् अतिथिन् प्रतिपूज्य च
वानप्रस्थेन धर्मेण स तेषाम् भोजनम् ददौ
transliteration: agnim hutvā pradāya arghyam atithin pratipūjya ca
vānaprasthena dharmeṇa sa teṣām bhojanam dadau

sanskrit: प्रथमम् च उपविश्य अथ धर्मज्ञो मुनिपुंगवः
transliteration: prathamam ca upaviśya atha dharmajño munipuṃgavaḥ

sanskrit: अग्निम् हुत्वा प्रदाय अर्घ्यम् अतिथिम् प्रतिपूजयेत्
दुःसाक्षी इव परे लोके स्वानि मांसानि भक्षयेत्
transliteration: agnim hutvā pradāya arghyam atithim pratipūjayet
duḥsākṣī iva pare loke svāni māṃsāni bhakṣayet
english: Offering oblations to the fire, and presenting Arghya to the guests, and paying them homage, that ascetic entertained them with food in accordance with the Vānaprastha mode of life; and then first sitting down, that foremost of ascetics, the pious Agastya, addressed Rāma cognizant of righteousness, staying with joined hands, O Kākutstha, if an ascetic acts otherwise (in respect of a guest), he in the next world feeds on his own flesh, like a false witness.

sanskrit: पूजनीयः च मान्यः च भवान् प्राप्तः प्रिय अतिथिः
transliteration: pūjanīyaḥ ca mānyaḥ ca bhavān prāptaḥ priya atithiḥ
english: The sovereign of all the worlds, righteous, a mighty car warrior, worthy of being honoured and worshipped, you have become our beloved guest.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा फलैः मूलैः पुष्पैः च अन्यैः च राघवम्
पूजयित्वा यथा कामम् ततो अगस्त्यः तम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktvā phalaiḥ mūlaiḥ puṣpaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca rāghavam
pūjayitvā yathā kāmam tato agastyaḥ tam abravīt
english: Having said this, Agastya, according to his desire, worshipping Rāghava with fruits, roots and flowers, said to him,

sanskrit: इदम् दिव्यम् महत् चापम् हेम वज्र विभूषितम्
transliteration: idam divyam mahat cāpam hema vajra vibhūṣitam

sanskrit: अमोघः सूर्य संकाशो ब्रह्मदत्तः शर उत्तमः
दत्तो मम महेन्द्रेण तूणी च अक्षय सायकौ
transliteration: amoghaḥ sūrya saṃkāśo brahmadattaḥ śara uttamaḥ
datto mama mahendreṇa tūṇī ca akṣaya sāyakau

sanskrit: संपूर्णौ निशितैः बाणैः ज्वलद्भिः इव पावकैः
महा रजत कोशो अयम् असिः हेमविभूषितः
transliteration: saṃpūrṇau niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ jvaladbhiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ
mahā rajata kośo ayam asiḥ hemavibhūṣitaḥ

sanskrit: अनेन धनुषा राम हत्वा संख्ये महासुरान्
आजहार श्रियम् दीप्ताम् पुरा विष्णुर् दिव ओकसाम्
transliteration: anena dhanuṣā rāma hatvā saṃkhye mahāsurān
ājahāra śriyam dīptām purā viṣṇur diva okasām
english: Having, O Rama, slain the mighty Asuras with this bow, Vişņu in days of yorc in battle secured the effulgent Fortune of the celestials. O bestower of honour, do you for securing victory, take this bow, these quivers, this arrow, and this scimitar, like the holder of the thunderbolt, taking the same.

sanskrit: तत् धनुः तौ च तूणि च शरम् खड्गम् च मानद
transliteration: tat dhanuḥ tau ca tūṇi ca śaram khaḍgam ca mānada
english: Having, O Rama, slain the mighty Asuras with this bow, Vişņu in days of yorc in battle secured the effulgent Fortune of the celestials. O bestower of honour, do you for securing victory, take this bow, these quivers, this arrow, and this scimitar, like the holder of the thunderbolt, taking the same.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा महा तेजाः समस्तम् तत् वर आयुधम्
दत्त्वा रामाय भगवान् अगस्त्यः पुनर् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktvā mahā tejāḥ samastam tat vara āyudham
dattvā rāmāya bhagavān agastyaḥ punar abravīt
english: Having said this, that highly energetic one, the reverend Agastya, consigning to Rāma all those weapon, again said. SCCTION 13

sanskrit: राम प्रीतो अस्मि भद्रम् ते परितुष्टो अस्मि लक्ष्मण
अभिवादयितुम् यन् माम् प्राप्तौ स्थः सह सीतया
transliteration: rāma prīto asmi bhadram te parituṣṭo asmi lakṣmaṇa
abhivādayitum yan mām prāptau sthaḥ saha sītayā

sanskrit: अध्व श्रमेण वाम् खेदो बाधते प्रचुर श्रमः
व्यक्तम् उत्कण्ठते वा अपि मैथिली जनक आत्मजा
transliteration: adhva śrameṇa vām khedo bādhate pracura śramaḥ
vyaktam utkaṇṭhate vā api maithilī janaka ātmajā

sanskrit: एषा च सुकुमारी च खेदैः च न विमानिता
प्राअज्य दोषम् वनम् प्रप्ता भर्तृ स्नेह प्रचोदिता
transliteration: eṣā ca sukumārī ca khedaiḥ ca na vimānitā
prāajya doṣam vanam praptā bhartṛ sneha pracoditā

sanskrit: यथा एषा रमते राम इह सीता तथा कुरु
दुष्करम् कृतवती एषा वने त्वाम् अभिगच्छती
transliteration: yathā eṣā ramate rāma iha sītā tathā kuru
duṣkaram kṛtavatī eṣā vane tvām abhigacchatī

sanskrit: एषा हि प्रकृतिः स्त्रीणाम् आसृष्टे रघुनंदन
transliteration: eṣā hi prakṛtiḥ strīṇām āsṛṣṭe raghunaṃdana

sanskrit: शत ह्रदानाम् लोलत्वम् शस्त्राणाम् तीक्ष्णताम् तथा
transliteration: śata hradānām lolatvam śastrāṇām tīkṣṇatām tathā

sanskrit: इयम् तु भवतो भार्या दोषैर् एतैर् विवर्जिताः
श्लाघ्या च व्यपदेश्या च यथा देवी हि अरुन्धती
transliteration: iyam tu bhavato bhāryā doṣair etair vivarjitāḥ
ślāghyā ca vyapadeśyā ca yathā devī hi arundhatī

sanskrit: अलंकृतो अयम् देशः च यत्र सौमित्रिणा सह
वैदेह्या च अनया राम वत्स्यसि त्वम् अरिंदम
transliteration: alaṃkṛto ayam deśaḥ ca yatra saumitriṇā saha
vaidehyā ca anayā rāma vatsyasi tvam ariṃdama

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु मुनिना राघवः संयत अंजलिः
उवाच प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् ऋषिम् दीप्तम् इव अनलम्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu muninā rāghavaḥ saṃyata aṃjaliḥ
uvāca praśritam vākyam ṛṣim dīptam iva analam

sanskrit: धन्योस्मि अनुगृहीतोस्मि यस्य मे मुनि पुंगवः
गुणैः सभ्रातृ भार्यस्य गुरुः नः परितुष्यति
transliteration: dhanyosmi anugṛhītosmi yasya me muni puṃgavaḥ
guṇaiḥ sabhrātṛ bhāryasya guruḥ naḥ parituṣyati

sanskrit: किन्तु व्यादिश मे देशम् स उदकम् बहु काननम्
यत्र आश्रम पदम् कृत्वा वसेयम् निरतः सुखम्
transliteration: kintu vyādiśa me deśam sa udakam bahu kānanam
yatra āśrama padam kṛtvā vaseyam nirataḥ sukham

sanskrit: ततो अब्रवीत् मुनि श्रेष्ठः श्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्
ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तम् धर्मात्मा धीरो धीरतरम् वचः
transliteration: tato abravīt muni śreṣṭhaḥ śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam
dhyātvā muhūrtam dharmātmā dhīro dhīrataram vacaḥ

sanskrit: इतो द्वि योजने तात बहु मूल फल उदकः
देशो बहु मृगः श्रीमान् पंचवटि अभिविश्रुतः
transliteration: ito dvi yojane tāta bahu mūla phala udakaḥ
deśo bahu mṛgaḥ śrīmān paṃcavaṭi abhiviśrutaḥ

sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा आश्रम पदम् कृत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह
रमस्व त्वम् पितुर् वाक्यम् यथा उक्तम् अनुपालयन्
transliteration: tatra gatvā āśrama padam kṛtvā saumitriṇā saha
ramasva tvam pitur vākyam yathā uktam anupālayan

sanskrit: विदितो हि एष वृत्तांतो मम सर्वः तव अनघ
तपसः च प्रभावेण स्नेहाद् दशरथस्य च
transliteration: vidito hi eṣa vṛttāṃto mama sarvaḥ tava anagha
tapasaḥ ca prabhāveṇa snehād daśarathasya ca

sanskrit: हृदयस्थः च ते छन्दो विज्ञातः तपसा मया
इह वासम् प्रतिज्ञाय मया सह तपो वने
transliteration: hṛdayasthaḥ ca te chando vijñātaḥ tapasā mayā
iha vāsam pratijñāya mayā saha tapo vane

sanskrit: अतः च त्वाम् अहम् ब्रूमि गच्छ पंचवटीम् इति
स हि रम्यो वनोद्देशो मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते
transliteration: ataḥ ca tvām aham brūmi gaccha paṃcavaṭīm iti
sa hi ramyo vanoddeśo maithilī tatra raṃsyate

sanskrit: स देशः श्लाघनीयः च न अतिदूरे च राघव
गोदावर्याः समीपे च मैथिली तत्र रंस्यते
transliteration: sa deśaḥ ślāghanīyaḥ ca na atidūre ca rāghava
godāvaryāḥ samīpe ca maithilī tatra raṃsyate

sanskrit: प्राज्य मूल फलैः चैव नाना द्विज गणैर् युतः
विविक्तः च महाबाहो पुण्यो रम्यः तथैव च
transliteration: prājya mūla phalaiḥ caiva nānā dvija gaṇair yutaḥ
viviktaḥ ca mahābāho puṇyo ramyaḥ tathaiva ca

sanskrit: भवान् अपि सदाचारः च शक्तः च परिरक्षणे
अपि च अत्र वसन् राम तापसान् पालयिष्यसि
transliteration: bhavān api sadācāraḥ ca śaktaḥ ca parirakṣaṇe
api ca atra vasan rāma tāpasān pālayiṣyasi

sanskrit: एतत् आलक्ष्यते वीर मधूकानाम् महत् वनम्
उत्तरेण अस्य गंतव्यम् न्यग्रोधम् अपि गच्छता
transliteration: etat ālakṣyate vīra madhūkānām mahat vanam
uttareṇa asya gaṃtavyam nyagrodham api gacchatā

sanskrit: ख्यातः पंचवटी इति एव नित्य पुष्पित काननः
transliteration: khyātaḥ paṃcavaṭī iti eva nitya puṣpita kānanaḥ

sanskrit: अगस्त्येन एवम् उक्तः तु रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
सत्कृत्य आमंत्रयामास तम् ऋषिम् सत्य वादिनम्
transliteration: agastyena evam uktaḥ tu rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha
satkṛtya āmaṃtrayāmāsa tam ṛṣim satya vādinam

sanskrit: तौ तु तेन अभ्यनुज्ञातौ कृत पाद अभिवन्दनौ
तम् आश्रमम् पंचवटीम् जग्मतुः सह सीतया
transliteration: tau tu tena abhyanujñātau kṛta pāda abhivandanau
tam āśramam paṃcavaṭīm jagmatuḥ saha sītayā

sanskrit:
गृहीत चापौ तु नराधिप आत्मजौ
विषक्त तूणी समरेषु अकातरौ
transliteration: gṛhīta cāpau tu narādhipa ātmajauviṣakta tūṇī samareṣu akātarau

english: As he was proceeding to Pancavati, Raghu's son saw a huge-bodied vulture of terrible prowess.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा तौ महाभागौ वनस्थम् राम लक्ष्मणौ
मेनाते राक्षसम् पक्षिम् ब्रुवाणौ को भवान् इति
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā tau mahābhāgau vanastham rāma lakṣmaṇau
menāte rākṣasam pakṣim bruvāṇau ko bhavān iti
english: And seeing him in the forest, the exalted Rāma and Lakşmaņa, as they were conversing with each other, knowing the bird to be (in reality) a Raksasa, asked him, saying, Who are you?

sanskrit: स तौ मधुरया वाचा सौम्यया प्रीणयन्न् इव
उवाच वत्स माम् विद्धि वयस्यम् पितुर् आत्मनः
transliteration: sa tau madhurayā vācā saumyayā prīṇayann iva
uvāca vatsa mām viddhi vayasyam pitur ātmanaḥ
english: There-upon, in soft and sweet words, he, pleasing them, said, My child, know me for a friend of your father.'

sanskrit: स तम् पितृ सखम् मत्वा पूजयामास राघवः
स तस्य कुलम् अव्यग्रम् अथ पप्रच्छ नाम च
transliteration: sa tam pitṛ sakham matvā pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
sa tasya kulam avyagram atha papraccha nāma ca
english: Knowing him to be a friend of his sire, Rāghava paid him homage, and enquired for his name and lineage.

sanskrit: रामस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा कुलम् आत्मानम् एव च
transliteration: rāmasya vacanam śrutvā kulam ātmānam eva ca
english: Hearing Rama's words, he mentioned his own lineage, and related the origin of all beings.

sanskrit: तान् मे निगदतः सर्वान् आदितः शृणु राघव
transliteration: tān me nigadataḥ sarvān āditaḥ śṛṇu rāghava
english: O mighty-armed one, I shall describe (to you) from the very beginning the (history of) those that were Prajāpatis in days of yore.

sanskrit: कर्दमः प्रथमः तेषाम् विकृतः तद् अनन्तरम्
शेषः च संश्रयः चैव बहु पुत्रः च वीर्यवान्
transliteration: kardamaḥ prathamaḥ teṣām vikṛtaḥ tad anantaram
śeṣaḥ ca saṃśrayaḥ caiva bahu putraḥ ca vīryavān

sanskrit: स्थाणुर् मरीचिर् अत्रिः च क्रतुः चैव महाबलः
पुलस्त्यः च अंगिराः चैव प्रचेताः पुलहः तथा
transliteration: sthāṇur marīcir atriḥ ca kratuḥ caiva mahābalaḥ
pulastyaḥ ca aṃgirāḥ caiva pracetāḥ pulahaḥ tathā

sanskrit: दक्षो विवस्वान् अपरो अरिष्टनेमिः च राघव
कश्यपः च महातेजाः तेषाम् आसीत् च पश्चिमः
transliteration: dakṣo vivasvān aparo ariṣṭanemiḥ ca rāghava
kaśyapaḥ ca mahātejāḥ teṣām āsīt ca paścimaḥ

sanskrit: प्रजापतेः तु दक्षस्य बभूवुर् इति विश्रुतम्
transliteration: prajāpateḥ tu dakṣasya babhūvur iti viśrutam
english: The Prajāpati Dakşa, it has been heard by us, O Rāma, had sixty famous and illustrious daughters.

sanskrit: अदितिम् च दितिम् चैव दनूम् अपि च कालकाम्
transliteration: aditim ca ditim caiva danūm api ca kālakām
english: Of these Kaśyapa wed eight, with elegant waists; Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kālikā, Tamră, Krodhavāśa, Manu and Analā.

sanskrit: ताम्राम् क्रोध वशाम् चैव मनुम् च अप्य् अनलाम् अपि
ताः तु कन्याः ततः प्रीतः कश्यपः पुनर् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tāmrām krodha vaśām caiva manum ca apy analām api
tāḥ tu kanyāḥ tataḥ prītaḥ kaśyapaḥ punar abravīt

sanskrit: पुत्रामः त्रैलोक्य भर्तॄन् वै जनयिष्यथ मत् समान्
अदितिः तन् मना राम दितिः च दनुर् एव च
transliteration: putrāmaḥ trailokya bhartṝn vai janayiṣyatha mat samān
aditiḥ tan manā rāma ditiḥ ca danur eva ca

sanskrit: कालका च महाबाहो शेषाः तु अमनसो अभवन्
अदित्याम् जज्ञिरे देवाः त्रयः त्रिंशत् अरिंदम
transliteration: kālakā ca mahābāho śeṣāḥ tu amanaso abhavan
adityām jajñire devāḥ trayaḥ triṃśat ariṃdama

sanskrit: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ च परंतप
दितिः तु अजनयत् पुत्रान् दैत्याम् तात यशस्विनः
transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca paraṃtapa
ditiḥ tu ajanayat putrān daityām tāta yaśasvinaḥ

sanskrit: तेषाम् इयम् वसुमती पुरा आसीत् स वन अर्णवा
दनुः तु अजनयत् पुत्रम् अश्वग्रीवम् अरिंदम
transliteration: teṣām iyam vasumatī purā āsīt sa vana arṇavā
danuḥ tu ajanayat putram aśvagrīvam ariṃdama

sanskrit: नरकम् कालकम् चैव कालका अपि व्यजायत
क्रौन्चीम् भासीम् तथा श्येनीम् धृतराष्ट्रीम् तथा शुकीम्
transliteration: narakam kālakam caiva kālakā api vyajāyata
krauncīm bhāsīm tathā śyenīm dhṛtarāṣṭrīm tathā śukīm

sanskrit: ताम्रा तु सुषुवे कन्याः पंच एता लोकविश्रुताः
उलूकान् जनयत् क्रौन्ची भासी भासान् व्यजायत
transliteration: tāmrā tu suṣuve kanyāḥ paṃca etā lokaviśrutāḥ
ulūkān janayat krauncī bhāsī bhāsān vyajāyata

sanskrit: श्येनी श्येनाम् च गृध्राम च व्यजायत सुतेजसः
धृतराष्ट्री तु हंसाम् च कलहंसाम् च सर्वशः
transliteration: śyenī śyenām ca gṛdhrāma ca vyajāyata sutejasaḥ
dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsām ca kalahaṃsām ca sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: चक्रवाकाम् च भद्रम् ते विजज्ञे सा अपि भामिनी
शुकी नताम् विजज्ञे तु नताया विनता सुता
transliteration: cakravākām ca bhadram te vijajñe sā api bhāminī
śukī natām vijajñe tu natāyā vinatā sutā

sanskrit: दश क्रोधवशा राम विजज्ञे अपि आत्मसंभवाः
मृगीम् च मृगमंदाम् च हरीम् भद्रमदाम् अपि
transliteration: daśa krodhavaśā rāma vijajñe api ātmasaṃbhavāḥ
mṛgīm ca mṛgamaṃdām ca harīm bhadramadām api

sanskrit: मातंगीम् अथ शार्दूलीम् श्वेताम् च सुरभीम् तथा
सर्व लक्षण संपन्नाम् सुरसाम् कद्रुकाम् अपि
transliteration: mātaṃgīm atha śārdūlīm śvetām ca surabhīm tathā
sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannām surasām kadrukām api
english: And Krodhavasā, O Rāma, brought forth ten daughters viz., Mrgi, Mrgamanda, Hari, Bhadramadā, Mātangi, Śårdūlī, Śvetā, Surabhi crowned with every (auspicious mark), Surasā and Kadrukā.

sanskrit: अपत्यम् तु मृगाः सर्वे मृग्या नरवरोत्तम
ऋक्षाः च मृगमंदायाः सृमराः चमराः तथा
transliteration: apatyam tu mṛgāḥ sarve mṛgyā naravarottama
ṛkṣāḥ ca mṛgamaṃdāyāḥ sṛmarāḥ camarāḥ tathā
english: You foremost of the best of men, Mrgi's sons were all the deer, and those of Mſgamandã were bears, Srmaras and Camaras.

sanskrit: ततः तु इरावतीम् नाम जज्ञे भद्रमदा सुताम्
तस्याः तु ऐरावतः पुत्रो लोकनाथो महागजः
transliteration: tataḥ tu irāvatīm nāma jajñe bhadramadā sutām
tasyāḥ tu airāvataḥ putro lokanātho mahāgajaḥ
english: And Bhadramadā bore one daughter, Irāvati. And Irāvati's son is the mighty elephant; who is the lord of the worlds.

sanskrit: हर्याः च हरयो अपत्यम् वानराः च तपस्विनः
गोलांगूलाः च शार्दूली व्याघ्राम् च अजनयत् सुतान्
transliteration: haryāḥ ca harayo apatyam vānarāḥ ca tapasvinaḥ
golāṃgūlāḥ ca śārdūlī vyāghrām ca ajanayat sutān
english: And Hari's sons are lions and the nimble monkeys. And Śārdúlí brought forth as her sons, Golāngūlas, and tigers; and the offspring of Matangi were mad elephants, O best of men. And Śvetā, O Kākutstha, gave birth to the elephants of the cardinal points.

sanskrit: मातंग्याः तु अथ मातन्गाअपत्यम् मनुज ऋषभ
दिशागजम् तु श्वेत काकुत्स्थ श्वेता व्यजनयत् सुतम्
transliteration: mātaṃgyāḥ tu atha mātangāapatyam manuja ṛṣabha
diśāgajam tu śveta kākutstha śvetā vyajanayat sutam

sanskrit: ततो दुहितरौ राम सुरभिर् द्वे वि अजायत
रोहिणीम् नाम भद्रम् ते गन्धर्वीम् च यशस्विनीम्
transliteration: tato duhitarau rāma surabhir dve vi ajāyata
rohiṇīm nāma bhadram te gandharvīm ca yaśasvinīm
english: O Rāma, then, Surabhi gave birth to two daughters-the famous Rohini, and Gandharvi.

sanskrit: रोहिणि अजनयद् गावो गन्धर्वी वाजिनः सुतान्
सुरसा अजनयन् नागान् राम कद्रूः च पन्नगान्
transliteration: rohiṇi ajanayad gāvo gandharvī vājinaḥ sutān
surasā ajanayan nāgān rāma kadrūḥ ca pannagān
english: Rohini produced kine, and the sons of Gandharvī are horses. And Surasā, O Rāma, gave birth to Nāgas, and Kadru to Pannagas.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् शूद्राम् च मनुजर्षभ
transliteration: brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyān śūdrām ca manujarṣabha
english: Kāśyapa's other wife Manu begot mankind-Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, and Sudras.

sanskrit: मुखतो ब्राह्मणा जाता उरसः क्षत्रियाः तथा
ऊरुभ्याम् जज्ञिरे वैश्याः पद्भ्याम् शूद्रा इति श्रुतिः
transliteration: mukhato brāhmaṇā jātā urasaḥ kṣatriyāḥ tathā
ūrubhyām jajñire vaiśyāḥ padbhyām śūdrā iti śrutiḥ
english: From the mouth, it is known sprang Brahmanas, from the breast, Ksatriya, from the thighs, Vaisyas, and from the feet, Sudras.

sanskrit: सर्वान् पुण्य फलान् वृक्षान् अनला अपि व्यजायत
विनता च शुकी पौत्री कद्रूः च सुरसा स्वसा
transliteration: sarvān puṇya phalān vṛkṣān analā api vyajāyata
vinatā ca śukī pautrī kadrūḥ ca surasā svasā
english: And Anală produced all trees bearing sacred fruits. Vinatā (was) Śuki' grand-daughter, and Kadru, Surasā's aunt.

sanskrit: कद्रूर् नाग सहस्रम् तु विजज्ञे धरणीधरन्
द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायाः तु गरुडो अरुण एव च
transliteration: kadrūr nāga sahasram tu vijajñe dharaṇīdharan
dvau putrau vinatāyāḥ tu garuḍo aruṇa eva ca
english: And Kadru gave birth to a thousand Nāgas with the holder of the Earth. And Vinatā brought forth two sons-Garuda and Aruna.

sanskrit: तस्मात् जातो अहम् अरुणात् संपातिः च मम अग्रजः
जटायुर् इति माम् विद्धि श्येनी पुत्रम् अरिंदम
transliteration: tasmāt jāto aham aruṇāt saṃpātiḥ ca mama agrajaḥ
jaṭāyur iti mām viddhi śyenī putram ariṃdama
english: An from Aruņa sprang myself and my elder brother Sampāti subduer of enemies, know me for Jatayu, the son of Syeni.

sanskrit: सो अहम् वास सहायः ते भविष्यामि यदि इच्छसि
इदम् दुर्गम् हि कान्तारम् मृग राक्षस सेवितम् सीताम् च तात रक्षिष्ये त्वयि याते सलक्ष्मणे
transliteration: so aham vāsa sahāyaḥ te bhaviṣyāmi yadi icchasi
idam durgam hi kāntāram mṛga rākṣasa sevitam sītām ca tāta rakṣiṣye tvayi yāte salakṣmaṇe
english: If you will, I shall become your help during your abode (in the woods). And, O child, I shall protect Sītā when you shall go out along with Laksimana.

sanskrit: जटायुषम् तु प्रतिपूज्य राघवो मुदा परिष्वज्य च सन्नतो अभवत्
पितुर् हि शुश्राव सखित्वम् आत्मवान् जटायुषा संकथितम् पुनः पुनः
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣam tu pratipūjya rāghavo mudā pariṣvajya ca sannato abhavat
pitur hi śuśrāva sakhitvam ātmavān jaṭāyuṣā saṃkathitam punaḥ punaḥ
english: There Rāghava paying homage to Jațāyu, and embracing him jcyfully, bent low; and that selfpossessed one listened to the story of Jațāyu's friendship with his father, as related by him repeatedly.

sanskrit: स तत्र सीताम् परिदाय मैथिलीम् सह एव तेन अतिबलेन पक्षिणा
जगाम ताम् पंचवटीम् सलक्ष्मणो रिपून् दिधक्षन् शलभान् इव अनलः
transliteration: sa tatra sītām paridāya maithilīm saha eva tena atibalena pakṣiṇā
jagāma tām paṃcavaṭīm salakṣmaṇo ripūn didhakṣan śalabhān iva analaḥ
english: Then consigning to that bird of exceeding strength, Mithila's daughter, Sita, Rama accompanied by Lakşmana went to Pañcavatī, destroying his foes and protecting the worlds.

sanskrit: ततः पंचवटीम् गत्वा नाना व्याल मृगायुताम्
उवाच भ्रातरम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम्
transliteration: tataḥ paṃcavaṭīm gatvā nānā vyāla mṛgāyutām
uvāca bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam
english: Then repairing to Pañcavațī filled with various animals and beasts of prey, Rāma remarked to his brother Laksmana of flaming energy,

sanskrit: आगताः स्म यथा उद्दिष्टम् यम् देशम् मुनिः अब्रवीत्
अयम् पंचवटी देशः सौम्य पुष्पित काननः
transliteration: āgatāḥ sma yathā uddiṣṭam yam deśam muniḥ abravīt
ayam paṃcavaṭī deśaḥ saumya puṣpita kānanaḥ
english: (Now) we have come to the place to which we had been directed by the ascetic This, O amiable one, is Pañcavați furnished with blossoming woods.

sanskrit: सर्वतः चार्यताम् दृष्टिः कानने निपुणो हि असि
आश्रमः कतर अस्मिन् नः देशे भवति सम्मतः
transliteration: sarvataḥ cāryatām dṛṣṭiḥ kānane nipuṇo hi asi
āśramaḥ katara asmin naḥ deśe bhavati sammataḥ
english: Do you cast your eyes around this forest, and (ascertain) what spot shall suit our asylum.

sanskrit: रमते यत्र वैदेही त्वम् अहम् चैव लक्ष्मण
transliteration: ramate yatra vaidehī tvam aham caiva lakṣmaṇa
english: Do you find out such a place in the vicinity of a tank where yourself Sītā and I may dwell happily, which is graced with the garniture of woods and delightful with liquid lapses, and whose neighbourhood yields fuel, flowers, Kuća and water.

sanskrit: वन रामण्यकम् यत्र जल रामण्यकम् तथा
संनिकृष्टम् च यस्मिन् तु समित् पुष्प कुश उदकम्
transliteration: vana rāmaṇyakam yatra jala rāmaṇyakam tathā
saṃnikṛṣṭam ca yasmin tu samit puṣpa kuśa udakam
english: Do you find out such a place in the vicinity of a tank where yourself Sītā and I may dwell happily, which is graced with the garniture of woods and delightful with liquid lapses, and whose neighbourhood yields fuel, flowers, Kuća and water.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्मणः संयत अंजलिः
सीता समक्षम् काकुत्स्थम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakmaṇaḥ saṃyata aṃjaliḥ
sītā samakṣam kākutstham idam vacanam abravīt
english: Thus addressed by Rāma. Lakşmaņa with joined hands, said to Kākutstha in the presence of Sītā,

sanskrit: परवान् अस्मि काकुत्स्थ त्वयि वर्ष शतम् स्थिते
स्वयम् तु रुचिरे देशे क्रियताम् इति माम् वद
transliteration: paravān asmi kākutstha tvayi varṣa śatam sthite
svayam tu rucire deśe kriyatām iti mām vada
english: O Kákutstha, even if I were to stay with you for an hundred years, I shall remain your servant. Thyself selecting some beauteous spot do you tell me-'Construct (an asylum)'.

sanskrit: विमृशन् रोचयामास देशम् सर्व गुण अन्वितम्
transliteration: vimṛśan rocayāmāsa deśam sarva guṇa anvitam
english: Well pleased with the words of Lakşınana, that highly effulgent one, after dure reflection, selected a site having every recommendation. Going to that romantic spot for rearing an asylum, Rama, taking the hand of Sumitra's son in his, said to him.

sanskrit: स तम् रुचिरम् आक्रम्य देशम् आश्रम कर्मणि
हस्ते गृहीत्वा हस्तेन रामः सौमित्रिम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa tam ruciram ākramya deśam āśrama karmaṇi
haste gṛhītvā hastena rāmaḥ saumitrim abravīt
english: Well pleased with the words of Lakşınana, that highly effulgent one, after dure reflection, selected a site having every recommendation. Going to that romantic spot for rearing an asylum, Rama, taking the hand of Sumitra's son in his, said to him.

sanskrit: अयम् देशः समः श्रीमान् पुष्पितैर् तरुभिर् वृतः
इह आश्रम पदम् सौम्य यथावत् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: ayam deśaḥ samaḥ śrīmān puṣpitair tarubhir vṛtaḥ
iha āśrama padam saumya yathāvat kartum arhasi
english: This place is level, graceful and surrounded with blossoming trees. Do you duly construct an asylum at this spot.

sanskrit: इयम् आदित्य संकाशैः पद्मैः सुरभि गंधिभिः
अदूरे दृश्यते रम्या पद्मिनी पद्म शोभिता
transliteration: iyam āditya saṃkāśaiḥ padmaiḥ surabhi gaṃdhibhiḥ
adūre dṛśyate ramyā padminī padma śobhitā
english: Hard by is seen a beautiful pool, embellished with lotuses, resembling the sun, and breathing balmy perfume.

sanskrit: इयम् गोदावरी रम्या पुष्पितैः तरुभिर् वृता
transliteration: iyam godāvarī ramyā puṣpitaiḥ tarubhir vṛtā
english: And, as told by that pure-hearted ascetic, Agastya, this is the graceful Godåvarī, bordered by flowering trees; swarming with swans and Kārandavas, delighted with Cakravākas, thronged with herds of deer,* not far, yet not so very near.

sanskrit: न अतिदूरे न च आसन्ने मृग यूथ निपीडिता
transliteration: na atidūre na ca āsanne mṛga yūtha nipīḍitā
english: And, as told by that pure-hearted ascetic, Agastya, this is the graceful Godåvarī, bordered by flowering trees; swarming with swans and Kārandavas, delighted with Cakravākas, thronged with herds of deer,* not far, yet not so very near.

sanskrit: मयूर नादिता रम्याः प्रांशवो बहु कंदराः
दृश्यन्ते गिरयः सौम्य फुल्लैः तरुभिर् आवृताः
transliteration: mayūra nāditā ramyāḥ prāṃśavo bahu kaṃdarāḥ
dṛśyante girayaḥ saumya phullaiḥ tarubhir āvṛtāḥ

sanskrit: सौवर्णै राजतैः ताम्रैः देशे देशे च धातुभिः
गवाक्षिता इव आभान्ति गजाः परम भक्तिभिः
transliteration: sauvarṇai rājataiḥ tāmraiḥ deśe deśe ca dhātubhiḥ
gavākṣitā iva ābhānti gajāḥ parama bhaktibhiḥ

sanskrit: सालैः तालैः तमालैः च खर्जूरैः पनसैः द्रुमैः
नीवारैः तिनिशैः चैव पुन्नागैः च उपशोभिताः
transliteration: sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca kharjūraiḥ panasaiḥ drumaiḥ
nīvāraiḥ tiniśaiḥ caiva punnāgaiḥ ca upaśobhitāḥ

sanskrit: चूतैर् अशोकैः तिलकैः केतकैर् अपि चंपकैः
पुष्प गुल्म लता उपेतैः तैः तैः तरुभिर् आवृताः
transliteration: cūtair aśokaiḥ tilakaiḥ ketakair api caṃpakaiḥ
puṣpa gulma latā upetaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ tarubhir āvṛtāḥ

sanskrit: स्यन्दनैः चंदनैः नीपैः पर्णासैः लकुचैः अपि
धव अश्वकर्ण खदिरैः शमी किंशुक पाटलैः
transliteration: syandanaiḥ caṃdanaiḥ nīpaiḥ parṇāsaiḥ lakucaiḥ api
dhava aśvakarṇa khadiraiḥ śamī kiṃśuka pāṭalaiḥ

sanskrit: इदम् पुण्यम् इदम् रम्यम् इदम् बहु मृग द्विजम्
इह वत्स्याम सौमित्रे सार्धम् एतेन पक्षिणा
transliteration: idam puṇyam idam ramyam idam bahu mṛga dvijam
iha vatsyāma saumitre sārdham etena pakṣiṇā
english: This spot is sacred-this spot is charmingthis spot abounds in beasts and birds. Here will I dwell, O Sumitra's son, in company with this birds.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, the exceedingly powerful Lakşmaņa, slayer of hostile heroes, in a short time raised as asylum for his brother.

sanskrit: सुस्तंभाम् मस्करैर् दीर्घैः कृत वंशाम् सुशोभनाम्
transliteration: sustaṃbhām maskarair dīrghaiḥ kṛta vaṃśām suśobhanām

sanskrit: कुश काश शरैः पर्णैः सुपरिच्छादिताम् तथा
transliteration: kuśa kāśa śaraiḥ parṇaiḥ suparicchāditām tathā

sanskrit: स गत्वा लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् नदीम् गोदावरीम् तदा
स्नात्वा पद्मानि च आदाय सफलः पुनर् आगतः
transliteration: sa gatvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śrīmān nadīm godāvarīm tadā
snātvā padmāni ca ādāya saphalaḥ punar āgataḥ
english: And then going to the river Godāvarī, the lovely Lakşmana, performing his bath, and securing lotuses and fruits, came back (to the asylum).

sanskrit: ततः पुष्प बलिम् कृत्वा शान्तिम् च स यथाविधि
दर्शयामास रामाय तद् आश्रम पदम् कृतम्
transliteration: tataḥ puṣpa balim kṛtvā śāntim ca sa yathāvidhi
darśayāmāsa rāmāya tad āśrama padam kṛtam
english: Then offering flowers, and duly performing rites for the peace (of the habitation), Lakşmaņa showed the asylum which he had made to Rāma.

sanskrit: स तम् दृष्ट्वा कृतम् सौम्यम् आश्रमम् सह सीतया
transliteration: sa tam dṛṣṭvā kṛtam saumyam āśramam saha sītayā
english: Seeing the beautiful asylum along with Sitā, Rāghava experienced high raptures.

sanskrit: अति स्निग्धम् च गाढम् च वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: ati snigdham ca gāḍham ca vacanam ca idam abravīt
english: And joyfully embracing Lakṣmaṇa with his arms, Rāma said these exceedingly calm and solemn words.

sanskrit: प्रीतो अस्मि ते महत् कर्म त्वया कृतम् इदम् प्रभो
प्रदेयो यन् निमित्तम् ते परिष्वंगो मया कृतः
transliteration: prīto asmi te mahat karma tvayā kṛtam idam prabho
pradeyo yan nimittam te pariṣvaṃgo mayā kṛtaḥ
english: Pleased am I with you. You have done a great deed, my brother; for which I have granted you my embrace by way of reward.

sanskrit: त्वया पुत्रेण धर्मात्मा न संवृत्तः पिता मम
transliteration: tvayā putreṇa dharmātmā na saṃvṛttaḥ pitā mama
english: While you, his son skilled in reading thought, grateful, and cognizant of righteousness are alive, O Laksmana, my father is not dead.

sanskrit: एवम् लक्ष्मणम् उक्त्वा तु राघवो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः
तस्मिन् देशे बहु फले न्यवसत् स सुखम् सुखी
transliteration: evam lakṣmaṇam uktvā tu rāghavo lakṣmivardhanaḥ
tasmin deśe bahu phale nyavasat sa sukham sukhī
english: Having said this to Lakşmana, Rāghava— the enhancer of auspiciousness experiencing felicity, began to dwell happily in that region filled with fruits.

sanskrit: वसतः तस्य तु सुखम् राघवस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: vasataḥ tasya tu sukham rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
english: As the high-souled Rāghava was dwelling there peacefully, after autumn had departed, the welcome winter commenced.
And it came to pass that once on a time, when the night had passed away and day broke, that son of Raghu went to the romantic river Godāvarī for performing his bath.

sanskrit: प्रह्वः कलश हसतः तम् सीतया सह वीर्यवान्
पृष्ठतो अनुव्रजन् भ्राता सौमित्रिर् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: prahvaḥ kalaśa hasataḥ tam sītayā saha vīryavān
pṛṣṭhato anuvrajan bhrātā saumitrir idam abravīt
english: And as the humble son of Sumitrā Rāma's puissant brother bearing a water pitcher in his hand was following Rāma along with Sītā at his back, the former said to Rāma,

sanskrit: अयम् स कालः संप्राप्तः प्रियो यः ते प्रियंवद
अलंकृत इव आभाति येन संवत्सरः शुभः
transliteration: ayam sa kālaḥ saṃprāptaḥ priyo yaḥ te priyaṃvada
alaṃkṛta iva ābhāti yena saṃvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ
english: O sweet-speeched one, now is come that season which you have ever held dear; and as if decorated by which comes on the entire auspicious year.

sanskrit: नीहार परुषो लोकः पृथिवी सस्य मालिनी
transliteration: nīhāra paruṣo lokaḥ pṛthivī sasya mālinī
english: Now people have their persons rendered rough from dew; the earth is replenished with com; water is difficult of being used; and fire becomes enjoyable.

sanskrit: नव आग्रयण पूजाभिर् अभ्यर्च्य पितृ देवताः
कृत आग्रयणकाः काले सन्तो विगत कल्मषाः
transliteration: nava āgrayaṇa pūjābhir abhyarcya pitṛ devatāḥ
kṛta āgrayaṇakāḥ kāle santo vigata kalmaṣāḥ
english: And men having worshipped the gods and the Pitſis by celebrating Āgrayana on the occasion of partaking new rice, have at this season, their sins purged off.
The provinces overflow with food, and abound in milk and articles prepared therefrom; and kings bent on conquest, range about for surveying thein.

sanskrit: सेवमाने दृढम् सूर्ये दिशम् अन्तक सेविताम्
विहीन तिलका इव स्त्री न उत्तरा दिक् प्रकाशते
transliteration: sevamāne dṛḍham sūrye diśam antaka sevitām
vihīna tilakā iva strī na uttarā dik prakāśate
english: And on the sun having veered steadily to the quarter presided over by the Destroyer*, the north appears like a female without her tilaka. ** *i.e.-The South, **A mark made with coloured earth's or unguents upon the forehead and between the eye-brows either by way of ornament or a sectarial distinction.

sanskrit: प्रकृत्या हिम कोश आढ्यो दूर सूर्याः च सांप्रतम्
यथार्थ नामा सुव्यक्तम् हिमवान् हिमवान् गिरिः
transliteration: prakṛtyā hima kośa āḍhyo dūra sūryāḥ ca sāṃpratam
yathārtha nāmā suvyaktam himavān himavān giriḥ
english: Naturally abounding in snow, and now having the sun at a great distance, the mountain Himavān+ justly bear that name. Himavan means having snow.-T

sanskrit: अत्यन्त सुख संचारा मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतः सुखाः
दिवसाः सुभग आदित्याअः छाया सलिल दुर्भगाः
transliteration: atyanta sukha saṃcārā madhyāhne sparśataḥ sukhāḥ
divasāḥ subhaga ādityāaḥ chāyā salila durbhagāḥ
english: At midday the days are delightful to a degree to range in, feel highly agreeable, and have pleasant suns; while shade and water are uncomfortable.

sanskrit: मृदु सूर्याः सनीहाराः पटु शीताः समारुताः
शून्य अरण्या हिम ध्वस्ता दिवसा भान्ति साम्प्रतम्
transliteration: mṛdu sūryāḥ sanīhārāḥ paṭu śītāḥ samārutāḥ
śūnya araṇyā hima dhvastā divasā bhānti sāmpratam
english: The days now have mild suns, are covered with dew severely cold, with the forests remaining idle, and the lotuses destroyed by frost.

sanskrit: निवृत्त आकाश शयनाः पुष्यनीता हिम अरुणाः
शीता वृद्धतर आयामः त्रि यामा यान्ति सांप्रतम्
transliteration: nivṛtta ākāśa śayanāḥ puṣyanītā hima aruṇāḥ
śītā vṛddhatara āyāmaḥ tri yāmā yānti sāṃpratam

sanskrit: रवि संक्रान्त सौभाग्यः तुषार अरुण मण्डलः
निःश्वास अन्ध इव आदर्शाः चंद्रमा न प्रकाशते
transliteration: ravi saṃkrānta saubhāgyaḥ tuṣāra aruṇa maṇḍalaḥ
niḥśvāsa andha iva ādarśāḥ caṃdramā na prakāśate

sanskrit: ज्योत्स्ना तुषार मलिना पौर्णमास्याम् न राजते
सीता इव च आतप श्यामा लक्ष्यते न तु शोभते
transliteration: jyotsnā tuṣāra malinā paurṇamāsyām na rājate
sītā iva ca ātapa śyāmā lakṣyate na tu śobhate

sanskrit: प्रकृत्या शीतल स्पर्शो हिम विद्धाः च सांप्रतम्
प्रवाति पश्चिमो वायुः काले द्वि गुण शीतलः
transliteration: prakṛtyā śītala sparśo hima viddhāḥ ca sāṃpratam
pravāti paścimo vāyuḥ kāle dvi guṇa śītalaḥ
english: And at this season the western wind naturally of gelid feel, being permeated at present with cold, Flows with ouble coldness.

sanskrit: बाष्प च्छन्नानि अरण्यानि यव गोधूमवंति च
शोभन्ते अभ्युदिते सूर्ये नदद्भिः क्रौन्च सारसैः
transliteration: bāṣpa cchannāni araṇyāni yava godhūmavaṃti ca
śobhante abhyudite sūrye nadadbhiḥ kraunca sārasaiḥ
english: And the forests enveloped in mist, and stocked with wheat and barley, look brilliant at sunrise, with Krauñcas and cranes crying (in chorus).

sanskrit: खर्जूर पुष्प आकृतिभिः शिरोभिः पूर्ण तण्डुलैः
शोभन्ते किंचिद् आलंबाः शालयः कनक प्रभाः
transliteration: kharjūra puṣpa ākṛtibhiḥ śirobhiḥ pūrṇa taṇḍulaiḥ
śobhante kiṃcid ālaṃbāḥ śālayaḥ kanaka prabhāḥ
english: Golden-hued paddy slightly inclined, appear graceful, with their heads like to date-flowers filled with rice.

sanskrit: दूरम् अभ्युदितः सूर्यः शशांक इव लक्ष्यते
transliteration: dūram abhyuditaḥ sūryaḥ śaśāṃka iva lakṣyate
english: And the sun although high advanced. yet having its rays covered with thick mist, appear like the moon,

sanskrit: अग्राह्य वीर्यः पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतः सुखः
संरक्तः किंचिद् आपाण्डुः आतपः शोभते क्षितौ
transliteration: agrāhya vīryaḥ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne sparśataḥ sukhaḥ
saṃraktaḥ kiṃcid āpāṇḍuḥ ātapaḥ śobhate kṣitau
english: And feeble at the first part of the day, and of agreeable touch at mid-day, the sunshine, being surcharged with mist, appear polish over the face of the earth.

sanskrit: वनानाम् शोभते भूमिर् निविष्ट तरुण आतपा
transliteration: vanānām śobhate bhūmir niviṣṭa taruṇa ātapā
english: And in the woods, swards covered with green grass, and with dew-drops on it, look handsome on the morning sun brightening it up.

sanskrit: स्पृशन् तु सुविपुलम् शीतम् उदकम् द्विरदः सुखम्
transliteration: spṛśan tu suvipulam śītam udakam dviradaḥ sukham
english: And wild elephants waxing exceedingly thirsty, draw away their trunks, just as they touch beautifully clear and cold water.

sanskrit: न अवगाहन्ति सलिलम् अप्रगल्भा इव आवहम्
transliteration: na avagāhanti salilam apragalbhā iva āvaham
english: And those aquatic fowls seated by, do not dip themselves in the water, like to cravens shunning fight.

sanskrit: अवश्याय तमो नद्धा नीहार तमसा आवृताः
प्रसुप्ता इव लक्ष्यन्ते विपुष्पा वन राजयः
transliteration: avaśyāya tamo naddhā nīhāra tamasā āvṛtāḥ
prasuptā iva lakṣyante vipuṣpā vana rājayaḥ
english: And the rows of trees, shorn of their blossoms, on being enveloped with dew at night and mist at morn, look as if they were fast asleep.

sanskrit: बाष्प संचन्न सलिला रुत विज्ञेय सारसाः
हिमाअर्द्र वालुकैः तीरैः सरितो भान्ति सांप्रतम्
transliteration: bāṣpa saṃcanna salilā ruta vijñeya sārasāḥ
himāardra vālukaiḥ tīraiḥ sarito bhānti sāṃpratam
english: And the streams appear with their waters enveloped in vapour and the cranes, perceived through their cries, and their banks having their sands wet.

sanskrit: तुषार पतनात् चैव मृदुत्वात् भास्करस्य च
शैत्यात् अग अग्रस्थम् अपि प्रायेण रसवत् जलम्
transliteration: tuṣāra patanāt caiva mṛdutvāt bhāskarasya ca
śaityāt aga agrastham api prāyeṇa rasavat jalam
english: What on account of the snow-fall, what of the mildness of the sun, and what through the cold, water even when it is on a mountain top, tastes sweet.

sanskrit: जरा जर्जरितैः पत्रैः शीर्ण केसर कर्णिकैः
नाल शेषा हिम ध्वस्ता न भान्ति कमलाकराः
transliteration: jarā jarjaritaiḥ patraiḥ śīrṇa kesara karṇikaiḥ
nāla śeṣā hima dhvastā na bhānti kamalākarāḥ
english: And lotuses afflicted by the cold, with the stalks only left, and with their petals dropping down and their pericarps and filaments shrivelled up, do not appear beautiful.

sanskrit: अस्मिन् तु पुरुषव्याघ्र काले दुःख समन्वितः
तपश्चरति धर्मात्मा त्वत् भक्त्या भरतः पुरे
transliteration: asmin tu puruṣavyāghra kāle duḥkha samanvitaḥ
tapaścarati dharmātmā tvat bhaktyā bharataḥ pure
english: O foremost of men, at this season, influenced by regard for you, Bharata undergoing affliction of spirit, is performing mortification's in the city.

sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा राज्यम् च मानम् च भोगांश्च विविधान् बहून्
transliteration: tyaktvā rājyam ca mānam ca bhogāṃśca vividhān bahūn
english: And forsaking kingdom, and dignity, and the many and various enjoyments, Bharata practising asceticism and restraining himself in respect of food, in this winter lie down on the bare earth.

sanskrit: सोऽपि वेलाम् इमाम् नूनम् अभिषेक अर्थम् उद्यतः
वृतः प्रकृतिभिर् नित्यम् प्रयाति सरयूम् नदीम्
transliteration: so'pi velām imām nūnam abhiṣeka artham udyataḥ
vṛtaḥ prakṛtibhir nityam prayāti sarayūm nadīm
english: He also for certain, at this hour of the day, surrounded by this subjects, daily wend to the river Sarayū for performing his ablutions.

sanskrit: कथम् तु अपर रात्रेषु सरयूम् अवगाहते
transliteration: katham tu apara rātreṣu sarayūm avagāhate
english: Brought up in luxury, and exceedingly tender, how can he, afflicted with cold, perforim his ablutions in the Sarayū during the latter part of the night?

sanskrit: धर्मज्ञः सत्यवादी च ह्री निषेधो जितेन्द्रियः
transliteration: dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca hrī niṣedho jitendriyaḥ
english: Of eyes resembling lotus petals, grey-hued, endued with grace, with a navel depressed, and mighty, Bharata understand righteousness, is truth-speaking, of restrained senses (in respect of other' wives) and also of subdued senses. And he speak fair, and is sweet-tempered, and longarmed and the vanquisher of foes. And renouncing various pleasures, he has devoted himself to the noble one.

sanskrit: संत्यज्य विविधान् भोगान् आर्यम् सर्वात्मना आश्रितः
transliteration: saṃtyajya vividhān bhogān āryam sarvātmanā āśritaḥ
english: Of eyes resembling lotus petals, grey-hued, endued with grace, with a navel depressed, and mighty, Bharata understand righteousness, is truth-speaking, of restrained senses (in respect of other' wives) and also of subdued senses. And he speak fair, and is sweet-tempered, and longarmed and the vanquisher of foes. And renouncing various pleasures, he has devoted himself to the noble one.

sanskrit: जितः स्वर्गः तव भ्रात्रा भरतेन महात्मना
वनस्थम् अपि तापस्ये यः त्वाम् अनुविधीयते
transliteration: jitaḥ svargaḥ tava bhrātrā bharatena mahātmanā
vanastham api tāpasye yaḥ tvām anuvidhīyate
english: Your high-souled brother has secured heaven, since he, resorting to asceticism, is iinitating you that resident in the woods.

sanskrit: न पित्र्यम् अनुवर्न्तन्ते मातृकम् द्विपदा इति
ख्यातो लोक प्रवादो अयम् भरतेन अन्यथा कृतः
transliteration: na pitryam anuvarntante mātṛkam dvipadā iti
khyāto loka pravādo ayam bharatena anyathā kṛtaḥ
english: The saying that people follow their mother and not their father, is falsified in the case of Bharata.

sanskrit: भर्ता दशरथो यस्याः साधुः च भरतः सुतः
कथम् नु सा अम्बा कैकेयी तादृशी क्रूरदर्शिनी
transliteration: bhartā daśaratho yasyāḥ sādhuḥ ca bharataḥ sutaḥ
katham nu sā ambā kaikeyī tādṛśī krūradarśinī
english: How can mother Kaikeyī, whose husband is Daśaratha and son the righteous Bharata, have such crooked way?

sanskrit: इति एवम् लक्ष्मणे वाक्यम् स्नेहात् वदति धर्मिके
परिवादम् जनन्यः तम् असहन् राघवो अब्रवीत्
transliteration: iti evam lakṣmaṇe vākyam snehāt vadati dharmike
parivādam jananyaḥ tam asahan rāghavo abravīt
english: As the virtuous Lakṣmaṇa was speaking thus from affection, Rāghava, not bearing the blame cast upon his mother (Kaikeyi), said, My brother, you should by no means, tax our second mother. Do you talk of that lord of the Ikşvāku race, Bharata.

sanskrit: न ते अम्बा मध्यमा तात गर्हितव्या कथंचन
ताम् एव इक्ष्वाकु नाथस्य भरतस्य कथाम् कुरु
transliteration: na te ambā madhyamā tāta garhitavyā kathaṃcana
tām eva ikṣvāku nāthasya bharatasya kathām kuru
english: As the virtuous Lakṣmaṇa was speaking thus from affection, Rāghava, not bearing the blame cast upon his mother (Kaikeyi), said, My brother, you should by no means, tax our second mother. Do you talk of that lord of the Ikşvāku race, Bharata.

sanskrit: निश्चिता एव हि मे बुद्धिः वन वासे दृढ व्रता
भरत स्नेह संतप्ता बालिशी क्रियते पुनः
transliteration: niścitā eva hi me buddhiḥ vana vāse dṛḍha vratā
bharata sneha saṃtaptā bāliśī kriyate punaḥ
english: Albeit my mind is firm as regards my sojourn in the woods, yet is my mind unsteady, being inflained with affection for Bharata.

sanskrit: संस्मरामि अस्य वाक्यानि प्रियाणि मधुराणि च
हृद्यानि अमृत कल्पानि मनः प्रह्लादानि च
transliteration: saṃsmarāmi asya vākyāni priyāṇi madhurāṇi ca
hṛdyāni amṛta kalpāni manaḥ prahlādāni ca
english: I remember his dear sweet words, taking the heart, resembling ambrosia, filling the soul with delight.

sanskrit: कदा हि अहम् समेष्यामि भरतेन महात्मना
शत्रुघ्नेन च वीरेण त्वया च रघुनंदन
transliteration: kadā hi aham sameṣyāmi bharatena mahātmanā
śatrughnena ca vīreṇa tvayā ca raghunaṃdana
english: When shall I; O son of Raghu, meet with the high-souled Bharata, and the heroic Satrughna, and yourself*. *The meaning is evident when shall we all meet together.-T

sanskrit: इति एवम् विलपन् तत्र प्राप्य गोदावरीम् नदीम्
चक्रे अभिषेकम् काकुत्स्थः सानुजः सह सीतया
transliteration: iti evam vilapan tatra prāpya godāvarīm nadīm
cakre abhiṣekam kākutsthaḥ sānujaḥ saha sītayā
english: Having bewailed thus, Kākutstha, coming to the river Godāvarī, there performed his ablutions in company with his younger brother and Sītā.

sanskrit: तर्पयित्वा अथ सलिलैः तैः पितॄन् दैवतानि च
स्तुवन्ति स्म उदितम् सूर्यम् देवताअः च तथा अनघाः
transliteration: tarpayitvā atha salilaiḥ taiḥ pitṝn daivatāni ca
stuvanti sma uditam sūryam devatāaḥ ca tathā anaghāḥ
english: Then having offered his adorations with water to the gods and the pitrs, those sinless ones hymned the risen sun as well as the celestials.

sanskrit: कृताभिषेकः स रराज रामः सीता द्वितीयः सह लक्ष्मणेन
कृत अभिषेको तु अग राज पुत्र्या रुद्रः स नन्दिः भगवान् इव ईशः
transliteration: kṛtābhiṣekaḥ sa rarāja rāmaḥ sītā dvitīyaḥ saha lakṣmaṇena
kṛta abhiṣeko tu aga rāja putryā rudraḥ sa nandiḥ bhagavān iva īśaḥ
english: Having with Sītā as the second and Laksmana, performed his bath. Rama looked beautiful like that lord the reverend Rudra in company with Nandi and the daughter of the king of mountains.

sanskrit: कृत अभिषेको रामः तु सीता सौमित्रिर् एव च
तस्मात् गोदावरी तीरात् ततो जग्मुः स्वम् आश्रमम्
transliteration: kṛta abhiṣeko rāmaḥ tu sītā saumitrir eva ca
tasmāt godāvarī tīrāt tato jagmuḥ svam āśramam
english: Having bathed, Rāma Sītā and Sumitrā's son went to their own asylum from the banks of the Godāvarī.

sanskrit: आश्रमम् तम् उपागम्य राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: āśramam tam upāgamya rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: Arriving at the asylum, Rāghava along with Lakşmana, performing his morning devotions, entered the cottage.

sanskrit: स रामः पर्ण शालायाम् आसीनः सह सीतया
transliteration: sa rāmaḥ parṇa śālāyām āsīnaḥ saha sītayā
english: And honoured of the Maharsis, Rāma happily dwelt in that cottage; and seated with Sītā that mighty-armed one looked like the moon in conjunction with Citrā. And he carried on various converse with his brother Lakşınana.

sanskrit: विरराज महा बाहुः चित्रया चन्द्रमा इव
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चकार विविधाः कथाः
transliteration: virarāja mahā bāhuḥ citrayā candramā iva
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ
english: And honoured of the Maharsis, Rāma happily dwelt in that cottage; and seated with Sītā that mighty-armed one looked like the moon in conjunction with Citrā. And he carried on various converse with his brother Lakşınana.

sanskrit: तदा आसीनस्य रामस्य कथा संसक्त चेतसः
तम् देशम् राक्षसी काचिद् आजगाम यदृच्छया
transliteration: tadā āsīnasya rāmasya kathā saṃsakta cetasaḥ
tam deśam rākṣasī kācid ājagāma yadṛcchayā

sanskrit: सा तु शूर्पणखा नाम दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः
भगिनी रामम् आसाद्य ददर्श त्रिदश उपमम्
transliteration: sā tu śūrpaṇakhā nāma daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ
bhaginī rāmam āsādya dadarśa tridaśa upamam

sanskrit: दीप्तास्यम् च महाबाहुम् पद्म पत्रायत ईक्षणम्
गज विक्रांत गमनम् जटा मण्दल धारिणम्
transliteration: dīptāsyam ca mahābāhum padma patrāyata īkṣaṇam
gaja vikrāṃta gamanam jaṭā maṇdala dhāriṇam

sanskrit: सुकुमारम् महा सत्त्वम् पार्थिव व्यंजन अन्वितम्
रामम् इन्दीवर श्यामम् कन्दर्प सदृश प्रभम्
transliteration: sukumāram mahā sattvam pārthiva vyaṃjana anvitam
rāmam indīvara śyāmam kandarpa sadṛśa prabham
english: And beholding Rāma dark-blue like the lotus, and becoming like Kandarpa himself, and resembling Indra, the Rākşasi was maddened with desire.

sanskrit: बभूव इन्द्रोपमम् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काम मोहिता
सुमुखम् दुर्मुखी रामम् वृत्त मध्यम् महोदरी
transliteration: babhūva indropamam dṛṣṭvā rākṣasī kāma mohitā
sumukham durmukhī rāmam vṛtta madhyam mahodarī

sanskrit: प्रियरूपम् विरूपा सा सुस्वरम् भैरव स्वना
transliteration: priyarūpam virūpā sā susvaram bhairava svanā
english: Rāma graced with beauteous continence, that Raksasi had a hideous face; Ráma had a slender waist, she had a huge abdomen; he had expansive eyes, she had terrible eyes; he was gifted with an elegant head of hair, she had coppery hair; Rāma was of a dear presence, she was of an unsightly presence; Rāma had a sonorous voice, she had a hideous voice.

sanskrit: तरुणम् दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणम् वाम भाषिणी
न्याय वृत्तम् सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियम् अप्रिय दर्शना
transliteration: taruṇam dāruṇā vṛddhā dakṣiṇam vāma bhāṣiṇī
nyāya vṛttam sudurvṛttā priyam apriya darśanā
english: Rāma was youthful, the Rākşasi was an old hag; Rāma had mellifluous accents, she had was a harsh accents; Rāma was ever abiding by justice, she was unruly; Rāma was handsome, she was ugly.

sanskrit: जटी तापस रूपेण सभार्यः शर चाप धृक्
transliteration: jaṭī tāpasa rūpeṇa sabhāryaḥ śara cāpa dhṛk
english: That Rākşasī being wrought up with passion addressed Rāma saying Wearing matted locks, and equipped with bows and arrows, why hast you along with your wife come to this region haunted by Rākșasas? It behove you to say "what the object of your visit is."

sanskrit: आगतः त्वम् इमम् देशम् कथम् राक्षस सेवितम्
किम् आगमन कृत्यम् ते तत् त्वम् आख्यातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: āgataḥ tvam imam deśam katham rākṣasa sevitam
kim āgamana kṛtyam te tat tvam ākhyātum arhasi
english: That Rākşasī being wrought up with passion addressed Rāma saying Wearing matted locks, and equipped with bows and arrows, why hast you along with your wife come to this region haunted by Rākșasas? It behove you to say "what the object of your visit is."

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु राक्षस्या शूर्पणख्या परंतपः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rākṣasyā śūrpaṇakhyā paraṃtapaḥ
english: Thus accosted by the Rākṣasī, Śūrpanakhă, that subduer of his foes from sincerity of disposition began to relate everything;

sanskrit: आसीत् दशरथो नाम राजा त्रिदश विक्रमः
तस्य अहम् अग्रजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः
transliteration: āsīt daśaratho nāma rājā tridaśa vikramaḥ
tasya aham agrajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ
english: There was a king named Dasaratha endued with the prowess of a celestial. I am his eldest son known among men by the name of Rāma.

sanskrit: भ्राता अयम् लक्ष्मणो नाम यवीयान् माम् अनुव्रतः
इयम् भार्या च वैदेही मम सीतेति विश्रुता
transliteration: bhrātā ayam lakṣmaṇo nāma yavīyān mām anuvrataḥ
iyam bhāryā ca vaidehī mama sīteti viśrutā
english: This is my younger brother (named) Laks inana, (ever)serving me. This is my wife, known by the name of Sītā.

sanskrit: नियोगात् तु नरेन्द्रस्य पितुर् मातुः च यंत्रितः
धर्मार्थम् धर्मकांक्षी च वनम् वस्तुम् इह आगतः
transliteration: niyogāt tu narendrasya pitur mātuḥ ca yaṃtritaḥ
dharmārtham dharmakāṃkṣī ca vanam vastum iha āgataḥ
english: Commanded by my father and mother, I in obedience their mandate, desirous of acquiring religious merits, have for the purpose of securing righteousness, come to the forest for dwelling here.

sanskrit: त्वाम् तु वेदितुम् इच्छामि कस्य त्वम् का असि कस्य वा
त्वम् हि तावन्मनोज्ञांगी राक्षसी प्रतिभासि मे
transliteration: tvām tu veditum icchāmi kasya tvam kā asi kasya vā
tvam hi tāvanmanojñāṃgī rākṣasī pratibhāsi me
english: I also am anxious to know you. Whose daughter are you? And what is your name, and what your lineage? Possessed of a captivating form, you appear to me as a Rākşasī. Tell me truly why you have come here. to

sanskrit: इह वा किम् निमित्तम् त्वम् आगता ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः
सा अब्रवीत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसी मदन अर्दिता
transliteration: iha vā kim nimittam tvam āgatā brūhi tattvataḥ
sā abravīt vacanam śrutvā rākṣasī madana arditā

sanskrit: श्रूयताम् राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थम् वचनम् मम
transliteration: śrūyatām rāma vakṣyāmi tattvārtham vacanam mama
english: Hearing these words the Rákşasi, afflicted with lust said, Listen, O Rāma. I will relate everything truly. I am a Räkșasī, capable of wearing shapes at will. My name in Śūrpanakhā.

sanskrit: अरण्यम् विचरामि इदम् एका सर्व भयंकरा
रावणो नाम मे भ्राता यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः
transliteration: araṇyam vicarāmi idam ekā sarva bhayaṃkarā
rāvaṇo nāma me bhrātā yadi te śrotram āgataḥ
english: Striking terror into the hearts of all, I range this forest alone. My brother is named Ravana* You may have heard of him.

sanskrit: वीरो विश्रवसः पुत्रो यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः
प्रवृद्ध निद्रः च सदा कुंभकर्णो महाबलः
transliteration: vīro viśravasaḥ putro yadi te śrotram āgataḥ
pravṛddha nidraḥ ca sadā kuṃbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ
english: My brother Råvana is a valiant son of Viśravā if you have heard of him. And he that is given to long sleep-the mighty Kumbhakarna, the righteous Vibhīşaņa, who never serves the Rākşasas, and the brothers Khara and Düşaņa renowned in conflict (are also my brothers).

sanskrit: विभीषणः तु धर्मात्मा न तु राक्षस चेष्टितः
प्रख्यात वीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ खर दूषणौ
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaḥ tu dharmātmā na tu rākṣasa ceṣṭitaḥ
prakhyāta vīryau ca raṇe bhrātarau khara dūṣaṇau
english: My brother Råvana is a valiant son of Viśravā if you have heard of him. And he that is given to long sleep-the mighty Kumbhakarna, the righteous Vibhīşaņa, who never serves the Rākşasas, and the brothers Khara and Düşaņa renowned in conflict (are also my brothers).

sanskrit: तान् अहम् समतिक्रान्ता राम त्वा पूर्व दर्शनात्
transliteration: tān aham samatikrāntā rāma tvā pūrva darśanāt
english: O Rāma, I have surpassed them all (in prowess). At first sight of you, I approach you, you best of men, as iny husband, with (feelings of) love.

sanskrit: अहम् प्रभाव संपन्ना स्वच्छंद बल गामिनी
चिराय भव भर्ता मे सीतया किम् करिष्यसि
transliteration: aham prabhāva saṃpannā svacchaṃda bala gāminī
cirāya bhava bhartā me sītayā kim kariṣyasi
english: I am endued with power, and range about at will by virtue of my strength. Become my husband for ever and a day. What will you do with Sita?

sanskrit: विकृता च विरूपा च न सा इयम् सदृशी तव
अहम् एव अनुरूपा ते भार्या रूपेण पश्य माम्
transliteration: vikṛtā ca virūpā ca na sā iyam sadṛśī tava
aham eva anurūpā te bhāryā rūpeṇa paśya mām
english: Deformed and unsightly, she is not worthy of you. I am fit for you. Do you look upon me as a wife.

sanskrit: इमाम् विरूपाम् असतीम् करालाम् निर्णत उदरीम्
अनेन सह ते भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम्
transliteration: imām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm
anena saha te bhrātrā bhakṣayiṣyāmi mānuṣīm
english: This unsightly, grim unchaste and human one with me, with a lean abdomen, will I devour up, along with this brother of yours.

sanskrit: ततः पर्वत शृंगाणि वनानि विविधानि च
पश्यन्सहमयाकामीदण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि - यद्वा - पश्यन् सह मया कामी दण्डकान् विचरिष्यसि
transliteration: tataḥ parvata śṛṃgāṇi vanāni vividhāni ca
paśyansahamayākāmīdaṇḍakānvicariṣyasi - yadvā - paśyan saha mayā kāmī daṇḍakān vicariṣyasi

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्तः काकुत्स्थः प्रहस्य मदिर ईक्षणाम्
इदम् वचनम् आरेभे वक्तुम् वाक्य विशारदः
transliteration: iti evam uktaḥ kākutsthaḥ prahasya madira īkṣaṇām
idam vacanam ārebhe vaktum vākya viśāradaḥ

sanskrit: ताम् तु शूर्पणखाम् रामः काम पाश अवपाशिताम्
स्वच्छया श्लक्ष्णया वाचा स्मित पूर्वम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tām tu śūrpaṇakhām rāmaḥ kāma pāśa avapāśitām
svacchayā ślakṣṇayā vācā smita pūrvam atha abravīt
english: With a smile, Rāma jestingly addressed Śūrpanakhā who had been ensnared in the noose of love, in soft words.

sanskrit: कृत दारो अस्मि भवति भार्या इयम् दयिता मम
त्वत् विधानाम् तु नारीणाम् सुदुःखा ससपत्नता
transliteration: kṛta dāro asmi bhavati bhāryā iyam dayitā mama
tvat vidhānām tu nārīṇām suduḥkhā sasapatnatā
english: Gentle one, I am already wedded; this is my beloved wife. To females like to you co-wifehood is exceedingly miserable.

sanskrit: अनुजः तु एष मे भ्राता शीलवान् प्रिय दर्शनः
श्रीमान् अकृत दारः च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्
transliteration: anujaḥ tu eṣa me bhrātā śīlavān priya darśanaḥ
śrīmān akṛta dāraḥ ca lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān
english: This young brother of mine is good-looking, and is of an excellent character; he is graceful, and is still unwived. The powerful one is named Laksmana. He has not yet tested the pleasures of a wife's company, and is desirous of having a spouse. And he is youthful and of an inviting presence. He will become a fit husband for you, considering this your beauty.

sanskrit: अपूर्वी भार्यया च अर्थी तरुणः प्रिय दर्शनः
अनुरूपः च ते भर्ता रूपस्य अस्य भविष्यति
transliteration: apūrvī bhāryayā ca arthī taruṇaḥ priya darśanaḥ
anurūpaḥ ca te bhartā rūpasya asya bhaviṣyati
english: This young brother of mine is good-looking, and is of an excellent character; he is graceful, and is still unwived. The powerful one is named Laksmana. He has not yet tested the pleasures of a wife's company, and is desirous of having a spouse. And he is youthful and of an inviting presence. He will become a fit husband for you, considering this your beauty.

sanskrit: एनम् भज विशालाक्षि भर्तारम् भ्रातरम् मम
असपत्ना वरारोहे मेरुम् अर्क प्रभा यथा
transliteration: enam bhaja viśālākṣi bhartāram bhrātaram mama
asapatnā varārohe merum arka prabhā yathā
english: O you of expansive eyes, seek this brother of mine as your husband, even as the solar beam seeks Meru. (By doing so), You O supremely beautiful damsel, will not have to fear a co-wife.

sanskrit: इति रामेण सा प्रोक्ता राक्षसी काम मोहिता
विसृज्य रामम् सहसा ततो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: iti rāmeṇa sā proktā rākṣasī kāma mohitā
visṛjya rāmam sahasā tato lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: Having been thus addressed by Rāma, the Rākṣasī intoxicated with lust, at once leaving Rāma, spoke to Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: अस्य रूपस्य ते युक्ता भार्या अहम् वरवर्णिनी
मया सह सुखम् सर्वान् दण्डकान् विचरिष्यसि
transliteration: asya rūpasya te yuktā bhāryā aham varavarṇinī
mayā saha sukham sarvān daṇḍakān vicariṣyasi
english: I am fit to be your wife possessed of transcendental grace, having regard to this beauty of yours. And with me you will happily range these Dandakas.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सौमित्री राक्षस्या वाक्य कोविदः
ततः शूर्पणखीम् स्मित्वा लक्ष्मणो युक्तम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu saumitrī rākṣasyā vākya kovidaḥ
tataḥ śūrpaṇakhīm smitvā lakṣmaṇo yuktam abravīt
english: Thus accosted by the Räkşasi, Sumitrā's son, Lakşmana versed in speech, with a smile appropriately observed to Śūrpanakhā,

sanskrit: कथम् दासस्य मे दासी भार्या भवितुम् इच्छसि
सो अहम् आर्येण परवान् भ्रात्रा कमल वर्णिनी
transliteration: katham dāsasya me dāsī bhāryā bhavitum icchasi
so aham āryeṇa paravān bhrātrā kamala varṇinī
english: Why wish you to be the servant of me who am a servant myself*? O lotus-hued one, I am dependant on my noble brother. The text is difficult to render literally:—Why wish you to be the female servant of me who am myself a male servant.

sanskrit: समृद्ध अर्थस्य सिद्धार्था मुदित अमल वर्णिनी
आर्यस्य त्वम् विशालाक्षि भार्या भव यवीयसी
transliteration: samṛddha arthasya siddhārthā mudita amala varṇinī
āryasya tvam viśālākṣi bhāryā bhava yavīyasī
english: O you of expansive eyes, be you securing the sumimum bonum, with a joyful heart, become, O superbly beautiful wench, the younger wife of the noble one of great good fortune.

sanskrit: एनाम् विरूपाम् असतीम् करालाम् निर्णत उदरीम्
भार्याम् वृद्धाम् परित्यज्य त्वाम् एव एष भजिष्यति
transliteration: enām virūpām asatīm karālām nirṇata udarīm
bhāryām vṛddhām parityajya tvām eva eṣa bhajiṣyati
english: Renouncing this frightful, unchaste, hideous, old wife possessed of a lean abdomen; he will devote himself to you.

sanskrit: को हि रूपम् इदम् श्रेष्ठम् संत्यज्य वरवर्णिनि
transliteration: ko hi rūpam idam śreṣṭham saṃtyajya varavarṇini
english: O paragon among damsels, O supremely charming lady, what man possessed of discernment, passing by such grace, would bear affliction to a human female?

sanskrit: इति सा लक्ष्मणेन उक्ता कराला निर्णतोदरी
मन्यते तत् वचः सत्यम् परिहास अविचक्षणा
transliteration: iti sā lakṣmaṇena uktā karālā nirṇatodarī
manyate tat vacaḥ satyam parihāsa avicakṣaṇā
english: Thus accosted by Lakşmaņa, that hideous one having a lean abdomen being incapable of understanding jest, took his words as true.

sanskrit: सीतया सह दुर्धर्षम् अब्रवीत् काम मोहिता
transliteration: sītayā saha durdharṣam abravīt kāma mohitā
english: Thereupon as that subduer of enemies, the irrepressible Rāma, was seated in the cottage in company with Sītā, the Rākşasī, transported with lust, said to him.

sanskrit: वृद्धाम् भार्याम् अवष्टभ्य न माम् त्वम् बहु मन्यसे
transliteration: vṛddhām bhāryām avaṣṭabhya na mām tvam bahu manyase
english: Forsaking this deformed, unchaste, horrible old wife of yours possessed of a lean abdomen, you do not regard me.

sanskrit: अद्य इमाम् भक्षयिष्यामि पश्यतः तव मानुषीम्
त्वया सह चरिष्यामि निःसपत्ना यथा सुखम्
transliteration: adya imām bhakṣayiṣyāmi paśyataḥ tava mānuṣīm
tvayā saha cariṣyāmi niḥsapatnā yathā sukham
english: To-day, you looking on, I shall eat up this human female. And I shall, rid of a co-wife, happily range with you.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा मृगशावाक्षीम् अलात सदृश ईक्षणा
अभ्यधावत् सुसंक्रुद्धा महा उल्का रोहिणीम् इव
transliteration: iti uktvā mṛgaśāvākṣīm alāta sadṛśa īkṣaṇā
abhyadhāvat susaṃkruddhā mahā ulkā rohiṇīm iva
english: Having said this, even as a mighty meteor strike Rohiņī, that one having eyes resembling live coals, waxing exceedingly enraged, rushed towards that (damsel) with the eyes of a doe.

sanskrit: ताम् मृत्यु पाश प्रतिमाम् आपतंतीम् महाबलः
विगृह्य रामः कुपितः ततो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tām mṛtyu pāśa pratimām āpataṃtīm mahābalaḥ
vigṛhya rāmaḥ kupitaḥ tato lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: Thereupon, hindering the Rākṣasi resembling the noose of death, as she was rushing on, the mighty Rāma, growing wroth said to Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: न कार्यः पश्य वैदेहीम् कथंचित् सौम्य जीवतीम्
transliteration: na kāryaḥ paśya vaidehīm kathaṃcit saumya jīvatīm
english: O Saumitri (Sumitrā's son), what is the good of jesting with a base and wicked one? No use of doing it. Look, I amiable one, Vaidehi (Videha's daughter) is well nigh dead.
It behoves you, O foremost of men, to deform this frightful, unchaste Rākşasī of a huge abdomen, transported with lust.

sanskrit: इति उक्तो लक्ष्मणः तस्याः क्रुद्धो रामस्य पश्यतः
उद्धृत्य खड्गम् चिच्छेद कर्ण नासम् महाबलः
transliteration: iti ukto lakṣmaṇaḥ tasyāḥ kruddho rāmasya paśyataḥ
uddhṛtya khaḍgam ciccheda karṇa nāsam mahābalaḥ
english: Thus desired the exceedingly strong Laksmana, fired with wrath, taking out his sword, in the sight of Rāma, cut off her nose and ears.

sanskrit: निकृत्त कर्ण नासा तु विस्वरम् सा विनद्य च
यथा आगतम् प्रदुद्राव घोरा शूर्पणखा वनम्
transliteration: nikṛtta karṇa nāsā tu visvaram sā vinadya ca
yathā āgatam pradudrāva ghorā śūrpaṇakhā vanam
english: Her ears and nose cut off, the terrible Śūrpanakhā, uttering frightful cries, fled a main into the forest whence she had come.

sanskrit: सा विरूपा महाघोरा राक्षसी शोणित उक्षिता
ननाद विविधान् नादान् यथा प्रावृषि तोयदः
transliteration: sā virūpā mahāghorā rākṣasī śoṇita ukṣitā
nanāda vividhān nādān yathā prāvṛṣi toyadaḥ
english: And being deformed, and covered with gore, the dreadful Rākşasī sent up many a roar, like clouds rumbling in the rains.

sanskrit: सा विक्षरंती रुधिरम् बहुधा घोर दर्शना
transliteration: sā vikṣaraṃtī rudhiram bahudhā ghora darśanā
english: And bleeding profusely, the grimvisaged Rākṣasī, lifting up her arms, and roaring, entered the mighty forest.

sanskrit: ततः तु सा राक्षस संघ सम्वृतम् खरम् जन स्थान गतम् विरूपिता
उपेत्य तम् भ्रातरम् उग्र तेजसम् पपात भूमौ गगनाद् यथा अशनिः
transliteration: tataḥ tu sā rākṣasa saṃgha samvṛtam kharam jana sthāna gatam virūpitā
upetya tam bhrātaram ugra tejasam papāta bhūmau gaganād yathā aśaniḥ
english: Then having been deformed, (the Rākşasī) approaching, her brother of fierce energy, Khara, come to Janasthāna, (seated surrounded by numbers of Raksasas), fell down to the earth, even as the thunderbolt bursts from the sky.

sanskrit: ततः सभार्यम् भय मोह मूर्चिता सलक्ष्मणम् राघवम् आगतम् वनम्
विरूपणम् च आत्मनि शोणित उक्षिता शशम्स सर्वम् भगिनी खरस्य सा
transliteration: tataḥ sabhāryam bhaya moha mūrcitā salakṣmaṇam rāghavam āgatam vanam
virūpaṇam ca ātmani śoṇita ukṣitā śaśamsa sarvam bhaginī kharasya sā
english: Then that sister of Khara, bathed in blood, and deprived of her senses through fright, related all about Räma's arrival at the forest along with Lakşmaņa and his own wife, as well as the forest along with Lakşmana and his own wife, as well as the circumstances connected with her being deformed.

sanskrit: ताम् तथा पतिताम् दृष्ट्वा विरूपाम् शोणित उक्षिताम्
भगिनीम् क्रोध संतप्तः खरः पप्रच्छ राक्षसः
transliteration: tām tathā patitām dṛṣṭvā virūpām śoṇita ukṣitām
bhaginīm krodha saṃtaptaḥ kharaḥ papraccha rākṣasaḥ
english: Seeing his sister deformed, and covered with blood, fallen on the ground, the Raksasa, Khara, fired with wrath asked her.

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ तावत् आख्याहि प्रमोहम् जहि संभ्रमम्
व्यक्तम् आख्याहि केन त्वम् एवम् रूपा विरूपिता
transliteration: uttiṣṭha tāvat ākhyāhi pramoham jahi saṃbhramam
vyaktam ākhyāhi kena tvam evam rūpā virūpitā
english: Arise! Leave off fear and amazement. Tell me plainly by whom you have been thus deformed.

sanskrit: कः कृष्ण सर्पम् असीनम् आशी विषम नागसम्
transliteration: kaḥ kṛṣṇa sarpam asīnam āśī viṣama nāgasam
english: Who is it that with his finger-end has by way of sport hart a black venomous snake that was innocent?

sanskrit: काल पाशम् समासज्य कण्ठे मोहात् न जानते
यः त्वाम् अद्य समासाद्य पीतवान् विषम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: kāla pāśam samāsajya kaṇṭhe mohāt na jānate
yaḥ tvām adya samāsādya pītavān viṣam uttamam
english: He that coming in contact with you has to-day drunk virulent poison, winding a fatal noose round about his neck, know it not through ignorance.

sanskrit: बल विक्रम संपन्ना कामगा काम रूपिणी
इमाम् अवस्थाम् नीता त्वम् केन अंतक समा गता
transliteration: bala vikrama saṃpannā kāmagā kāma rūpiṇī
imām avasthām nītā tvam kena aṃtaka samā gatā
english: Endowed with strength and prowess, ranging about at will, wearing shapes at pleasure, and resembling the destroyer himself, going to whom hast you come by this condition?

sanskrit: देव गन्धर्व भूतानाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम्
को अयम् एवम् महावीर्यः त्वाम् विरूपाम् चकार ह
transliteration: deva gandharva bhūtānām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām
ko ayam evam mahāvīryaḥ tvām virūpām cakāra ha
english: Who among the gods, Gandharvas or creatures or the light souled saints is of such mighty energy as to have deformed you?

sanskrit: न हि पश्यामि अहम् लोके यः कुर्यात् मम विप्रियम्
transliteration: na hi paśyāmi aham loke yaḥ kuryāt mama vipriyam
english: In this world I do not see him that would do me : wrong, not even the mighty Indra, the thousand eyed tamer of the demon Pāka.

sanskrit: अद्य अहम् मार्गणैः प्राणान् आदास्ये जीवितांतगैः
सलिले क्षीरम् आसक्तम् निष्पिबन् इव सारसः
transliteration: adya aham mārgaṇaiḥ prāṇān ādāsye jīvitāṃtagaiḥ
salile kṣīram āsaktam niṣpiban iva sārasaḥ
english: a crane Even as afflicted with thirst appropriate milk mixed in water (leaving the latter out), so by means of fleet an lifedestroying shafts I will among the immortals take the life of that chastiser. The frothy blood of whom, having his marrow pierced (by me) and slain by me in battle, dose the Earth wish to drink?

sanskrit: निहतस्य मया संख्ये शर संकृत्त मर्मणः
सफेनम् रुधिरम् कस्य मेदिनी पातुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: nihatasya mayā saṃkhye śara saṃkṛtta marmaṇaḥ
saphenam rudhiram kasya medinī pātum icchasi
english: a crane Even as afflicted with thirst appropriate milk mixed in water (leaving the latter out), so by means of fleet an lifedestroying shafts I will among the immortals take the life of that chastiser. The frothy blood of whom, having his marrow pierced (by me) and slain by me in battle, dose the Earth wish to drink?

sanskrit: कस्य पत्ररथाः कायात् मांसम् उत्कृत्य संगताः
transliteration: kasya patrarathāḥ kāyāt māṃsam utkṛtya saṃgatāḥ
english: Tearing off flesh from the corpse of whom slain by me in conflict, shall the birds so joyfully feed on it?

sanskrit: तम् न देवा न गंधर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः
मया अपकृष्टम् कृपणम् शक्ताः त्रातुम् इह आहवे
transliteration: tam na devā na gaṃdharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ
mayā apakṛṣṭam kṛpaṇam śaktāḥ trātum iha āhave
english: Him, whom I shall wrong mightily, neither the gods, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Piśācas, nor the Rākşasas, will be able to rescue in fierce encounter.

sanskrit: उपलभ्य शनैः संज्ञाम् तम् मे शंसितुम् अर्हसि
येन त्वम् दुर्विनीतेन वने विक्रम्य निर्जिता
transliteration: upalabhya śanaiḥ saṃjñām tam me śaṃsitum arhasi
yena tvam durvinītena vane vikramya nirjitā
english: Recovering by degrees your sense, it behoves you to tell me what individual it was of execrable character, who by his prowess, half humbled you in the forest.

sanskrit: इति भ्रातुर् वचः श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धस्य च विशेषतः
ततः शूर्पणखा वाक्यम् सबाष्पम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: iti bhrātur vacaḥ śrutvā kruddhasya ca viśeṣataḥ
tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā vākyam sabāṣpam idam abravīt
english: Hearing these words of his brother, who was under the influence of extreme rage, Sūrpanakhā with tears in her eyes, said.
