sanskrit: पुण्डरीक विशालाक्षौ चीर कृष्ण अजिन अंबरौ
transliteration: puṇḍarīka viśālākṣau cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbarau

sanskrit: फल मूल अशिनौ दान्तौ तापसौ ब्रह्मचारिणौ
पुत्रौ दशरथस्य आस्ताम् भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मनौ
transliteration: phala mūla aśinau dāntau tāpasau brahmacāriṇau
putrau daśarathasya āstām bhrātarau rāma lakṣmanau

sanskrit: गन्धर्व राज प्रतिमौ पार्थिव व्यन्जन अन्वितौ
देवौ वा दानवौ - मानुषौ - वा तौ न तर्कयितुम् उत्सहे
transliteration: gandharva rāja pratimau pārthiva vyanjana anvitau
devau vā dānavau - mānuṣau - vā tau na tarkayitum utsahe

sanskrit: दृष्टा तत्र मया नारी तयोर् मध्ये सुमध्यमा
transliteration: dṛṣṭā tatra mayā nārī tayor madhye sumadhyamā
english: And between them I saw there a youthful female furnished with grace, and having a dainty waist; adorned with every kind of ornament.

sanskrit: ताभ्याम् उभाभ्याम् संभूय प्रमदाम् अधिकृत्य ताम्
इमाम् अवस्थाम् नीता अहम् यथा अनाथा सती तथा
transliteration: tābhyām ubhābhyām saṃbhūya pramadām adhikṛtya tām
imām avasthām nītā aham yathā anāthā satī tathā
english: And it is on account of this feinale that I have like one unchaste and uncared for, have come by this condition at their hands.

sanskrit: तस्याः च अनृजु वृत्तायाः तयोः च हतयोर् अहम्
सफेनम् पातुम् इच्छामि रुधिरम् रण मूर्धनि
transliteration: tasyāḥ ca anṛju vṛttāyāḥ tayoḥ ca hatayor aham
saphenam pātum icchāmi rudhiram raṇa mūrdhani
english: Nor I wish in the midst of encounter to drink the frothy blood of that crooked one as well as those two slain (in battle).

sanskrit: एष मे प्रथमः कामः कृतः तत्र त्वया भवेत्
तस्याः तयोः च रुधिरम् पिबेयम् अहम् आहवे
transliteration: eṣa me prathamaḥ kāmaḥ kṛtaḥ tatra tvayā bhavet
tasyāḥ tayoḥ ca rudhiram pibeyam aham āhave
english: Let this my prime wish be crowned there with fruition. her and their blood will I drink in dreadful conflict.

sanskrit: इति तस्याम् ब्रुवाणायाम् चतुर् दश महाबलान्
transliteration: iti tasyām bruvāṇāyām catur daśa mahābalān

sanskrit: मानुषौ शस्त्र सम्पन्नौ चीर कृष्ण अजिन अंबरौ
transliteration: mānuṣau śastra sampannau cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbarau

sanskrit: तौ हत्वा ताम् च दुर्वृत्ताम् उपावर्तितुम् अर्हथ
इयम् च रुधिरम् तेषाम् भगिनी मम पास्यति
transliteration: tau hatvā tām ca durvṛttām upāvartitum arhatha
iyam ca rudhiram teṣām bhaginī mama pāsyati

sanskrit: मनोरथो अयम् इष्टो अस्या भगिन्या मम राक्षसाः
शीघ्रम् संपद्यताम् गत्वा तौ प्रमथ्य स्व तेजसा
transliteration: manoratho ayam iṣṭo asyā bhaginyā mama rākṣasāḥ
śīghram saṃpadyatām gatvā tau pramathya sva tejasā
english: You Rākşasas, even this is my sister's dear desire. Repairing thither, specdily accomplish this, bearing them down by your native might.

sanskrit: युष्माबिः निर्हतो दृष्ट्वा तौ उभौ भ्रातौ रणे
इयम् प्रहृष्टा मुदिता रुधिरम् युधि पास्यति
transliteration: yuṣmābiḥ nirhato dṛṣṭvā tau ubhau bhrātau raṇe
iyam prahṛṣṭā muditā rudhiram yudhi pāsyati
english: Seeing those two brothers slain by you this one exceedingly rejoiced, will drink their blood in the field.

sanskrit: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टा राक्षसाः ते चतुर् दश
तत्र जग्मुः तया सार्धम् घना वातेरिताः यथा
transliteration: iti pratisamādiṣṭā rākṣasāḥ te catur daśa
tatra jagmuḥ tayā sārdham ghanā vāteritāḥ yathā
english: Thus commissioned, those fourteen Räksasas set out there like clouds driven by the winds, accompanied by Śürpanakhā.

sanskrit:
ततस्तु ते तम् समुदर्ग तेजसम्
तथापि तीक्ष्ण प्रदरा निशाचरा

न शेकुर् एनम् सहसा प्रमर्दितुम्
वनद्विपा दीप्त्वम् इव अग्निम् उथितम्
transliteration: tatastu te tam samudarga tejasamtathāpi tīkṣṇa pradarā niśācarā
na śekur enam sahasā pramarditumvanadvipā dīptvam iva agnim uthitam

sanskrit: ततः शूर्पणखा घोरा राघव आश्रमम् आगता
रक्षसान् आचचक्षे तौ भ्रातरौ सह सीतया
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā ghorā rāghava āśramam āgatā
rakṣasān ācacakṣe tau bhrātarau saha sītayā
english: Then the grim Śūrpanakhā, coming to Rāghava's asylum pointed out to the Rākşasas those brother in company with Sītā.

sanskrit: ते रामम् पर्ण शालायाम् उपविष्टम् महाबलम्
ददृशुः सीतया सार्धम् लक्ष्मणेन अपि सेवितम्
transliteration: te rāmam parṇa śālāyām upaviṣṭam mahābalam
dadṛśuḥ sītayā sārdham lakṣmaṇena api sevitam
english: And they saw the mighty Rāma seated in the cottage in company with Sītā, and ministered to by Laksmana.

sanskrit: ताम् दृष्ट्वा राघवः श्रीमान् आगताम् ताम् च राक्षसीम्
अब्रवीत् भ्रातरम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् दीप्त तेजसम्
transliteration: tām dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ śrīmān āgatām tām ca rākṣasīm
abravīt bhrātaram rāmo lakṣmaṇam dīpta tejasam
english: And seeing her, as well as the Rākşasas who had come, Rāma remarked to his brother, Lakşınaņa of flaming energy.

sanskrit: इमान् अस्या वधिष्यामि पदवीम् आगतान् इह
transliteration: imān asyā vadhiṣyāmi padavīm āgatān iha
english: O Sumitrā's son, do you for a while guard Sītā. I shall slay these that have come to this asylum here.

sanskrit: वाक्यम् एतत् ततः श्रुत्वा रामस्य विदित आत्मनः
तथा इति लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् रामस्य प्रत्यपूजयत्
transliteration: vākyam etat tataḥ śrutvā rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ
tathā iti lakṣmaṇo vākyam rāmasya pratyapūjayat
english: Hearing these words of Rāma versed in the knowledge of self, Lakşmaņa honoured his speech by saying, So be it.

sanskrit: राघवो अपि महत् चापम् चामीकर विभूषितम्
चकार सज्यम् धर्मात्मा तानि रक्षांसि च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: rāghavo api mahat cāpam cāmīkara vibhūṣitam
cakāra sajyam dharmātmā tāni rakṣāṃsi ca abravīt
english: And the righteous Rāghava strung his mighty bow decked with gold; and addressed the Raksasas.

sanskrit: पुत्रौ दशरथस्य आवाम् भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
प्रविष्टौ सीतया सार्धम् दुश्चरम् दण्डका वनम्
transliteration: putrau daśarathasya āvām bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
praviṣṭau sītayā sārdham duścaram daṇḍakā vanam
english: We that have entered into this untraceable forest of Dandaka in company with Sītā are the sons of Dasaratha, the brothers, Rama and Lakşmana. Why do you intend to do injury to us. Subsisting on fruits and roots, having our senses under control, carrying on asceticism and leading a Brahmacarya life, we are passing our days in the forest of Dandaka.

sanskrit: फल मूल अशनौ दांतौ तापसौ धर्म चारिणौ
transliteration: phala mūla aśanau dāṃtau tāpasau dharma cāriṇau
english: We that have entered into this untraceable forest of Dandaka in company with Sītā are the sons of Dasaratha, the brothers, Rama and Lakşmana. Why do you intend to do injury to us. Subsisting on fruits and roots, having our senses under control, carrying on asceticism and leading a Brahmacarya life, we are passing our days in the forest of Dandaka.

sanskrit: युष्मान् पाप आत्मकान् हंतुम् विप्रकारान् महाहवे
ऋषीणाम् तु नियोगेन प्राप्तो अहम् सशर आसनः
transliteration: yuṣmān pāpa ātmakān haṃtum viprakārān mahāhave
ṛṣīṇām tu niyogena prāpto aham saśara āsanaḥ
english: It is do destroy you, wicked, and troublesome that I equipped with the bow have come here at the desire of the saints.

sanskrit: तिष्ठत एव अत्र संतुष्टा न उपवरितितुम् अर्हथ
यदि प्राणैः इह अर्थो वो निवर्तध्वम् निशा चराः
transliteration: tiṣṭhata eva atra saṃtuṣṭā na upavarititum arhatha
yadi prāṇaiḥ iha artho vo nivartadhvam niśā carāḥ
english: Stay there content you should not move further. If you have a care for your lives, desist, you rangers of the night.

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसाः ते चतुर्दश
ऊचुर् वाचम् सुसंक्रुद्धा ब्रह्मघ्नः शूल पाणयः
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā rākṣasāḥ te caturdaśa
ūcur vācam susaṃkruddhā brahmaghnaḥ śūla pāṇayaḥ
english: Hearing those words of his, those fourteen grim Rākşasas bearing darts in their hands, exceedingly enraged, with their eyes reddened, breathing high spirits, harshly said to the sweetspeeched Rāma, having his eyes reddened whose prowess they had not seen before.

sanskrit: संरक्त नयना घोरा रामम् रक्तांत लोचनम्
परुषा मधुर आभाषम् हृष्टाः अदृष्ट पराक्रमम्
transliteration: saṃrakta nayanā ghorā rāmam raktāṃta locanam
paruṣā madhura ābhāṣam hṛṣṭāḥ adṛṣṭa parākramam
english: Hearing those words of his, those fourteen grim Rākşasas bearing darts in their hands, exceedingly enraged, with their eyes reddened, breathing high spirits, harshly said to the sweetspeeched Rāma, having his eyes reddened whose prowess they had not seen before.

sanskrit: क्रोधम् उत्पाद्य नो भर्तुः खरस्य सुमहात्मनः
त्वम् एव हास्यसे प्राणान् अद्य अस्माभिर् हतो युधि
transliteration: krodham utpādya no bhartuḥ kharasya sumahātmanaḥ
tvam eva hāsyase prāṇān adya asmābhir hato yudhi
english: Having excited there our lord. the high-souled Khara, it is you that shal: lose your life no later than this day, being slain by us in battle.

sanskrit: का हि ते शक्तिर् एकस्य बहूनाम् रण मूर्धनि
अस्माकम् अग्रतः स्थातुम् किम् पुनर् योद्धुम् आहवे
transliteration: kā hi te śaktir ekasya bahūnām raṇa mūrdhani
asmākam agrataḥ sthātum kim punar yoddhum āhave
english: What power hast you, being one to stay before us many in the field, what shall I say of your coping with us in conflict?

sanskrit: एभिः बाहु प्रयुक्तैः नः परिघैः शूल पट्टिशैः
प्राणाम् त्यक्ष्यसि वीर्यम् च धनुः च कर पीडितम्
transliteration: ebhiḥ bāhu prayuktaiḥ naḥ parighaiḥ śūla paṭṭiśaiḥ
prāṇām tyakṣyasi vīryam ca dhanuḥ ca kara pīḍitam
english: In consequence of the parighas (iron-clubs), darts, and pattisas (a kind of sharp-edged sword) discharged by our arms, you will surely lose your life, along with your prowess, and this bow which you press with your hand.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा संरब्धा राक्षसाः ते चतुर्दश
उद्यत आयुध निस्त्रिंशा रामम् एव अभिदुद्रुवुः
transliteration: iti evam uktvā saṃrabdhā rākṣasāḥ te caturdaśa
udyata āyudha nistriṃśā rāmam eva abhidudruvuḥ
english: Having said this in wrath, those fourteen Rākşasas, uplifting their weapons and daggers rushed towards Rāma.

sanskrit: चिक्षिपुः तानि शूलानि राघवम् प्रति दुर्जयम्
transliteration: cikṣipuḥ tāni śūlāni rāghavam prati durjayam
english: And discharged darts at the invincible Rāghava. Thereupon Kākutstha by means of shafts decked with gold, cut off those fourteen darts of theirs.

sanskrit: तावद्भिः एव चिच्छेद शरैः कांचन भूषितैः
ततः पश्चात् महातेजा नाराचान् सूर्य संनिभान्
transliteration: tāvadbhiḥ eva ciccheda śaraiḥ kāṃcana bhūṣitaiḥ
tataḥ paścāt mahātejā nārācān sūrya saṃnibhān

sanskrit: जग्राह परम क्रुद्धः चतुर्दश शिल अशितान्
गृहीत्वा धनुः आयम्य लक्ष्यान् उद्दिश्य राक्षसान्
transliteration: jagrāha parama kruddhaḥ caturdaśa śila aśitān
gṛhītvā dhanuḥ āyamya lakṣyān uddiśya rākṣasān

sanskrit: मुमोच राघवो बाणान् वज्रान् इव शतक्रतुः
ते भित्त्वा रक्षसाम् वेगात् वक्षांसि रुधिर आप्लुताः
transliteration: mumoca rāghavo bāṇān vajrān iva śatakratuḥ
te bhittvā rakṣasām vegāt vakṣāṃsi rudhira āplutāḥ

sanskrit: विनिष्पेतुः तदा भूमौ वल्मीकात् इव पन्नगाः
तैः भग्न हृदया बूमौ छिन्न मूला इव द्रुमाः
transliteration: viniṣpetuḥ tadā bhūmau valmīkāt iva pannagāḥ
taiḥ bhagna hṛdayā būmau chinna mūlā iva drumāḥ

sanskrit: निपेतुः शोणित स्नाता विकृता विगत असवः
तान् भूमौ पतितान् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी क्रोध मूर्च्छिता
transliteration: nipetuḥ śoṇita snātā vikṛtā vigata asavaḥ
tān bhūmau patitān dṛṣṭvā rākṣasī krodha mūrcchitā

sanskrit: उपगम्य खरम् सा तु किंचित् संशुष्क शोणिता
पपात पुनः एव आर्ता सनिर्यासा इव वल्लरी
transliteration: upagamya kharam sā tu kiṃcit saṃśuṣka śoṇitā
papāta punaḥ eva ārtā saniryāsā iva vallarī
english: Seeing them fallen-on the ground, the Rākşasī, beyond herself in wrath, approaching Khara, with her blood a little dried up, again in distressful guise threw herself on the earth, like a plant exuding gum.

sanskrit: भ्रातुः समीपे शोक आर्ता ससर्ज निनदम् महत्
सस्वरम् मुमोच बाष्पम् विवर्ण वदना तदा
transliteration: bhrātuḥ samīpe śoka ārtā sasarja ninadam mahat
sasvaram mumoca bāṣpam vivarṇa vadanā tadā
english: And in presence of her brother, she set up a mighty roar; and then her face grown pallid, she dropped tears, emitting cries.

sanskrit: निपातितान् प्रेक्ष्य रणे तु राक्षसान् प्रधाविता शूर्पणखा पुनः ततः
वधम् च तेषाम् निखिलेन रक्षसाम् शशंस सर्वम् भगिनी खरस्य सा
transliteration: nipātitān prekṣya raṇe tu rākṣasān pradhāvitā śūrpaṇakhā punaḥ tataḥ
vadham ca teṣām nikhilena rakṣasām śaśaṃsa sarvam bhaginī kharasya sā
english: Seeing those Rākşasas slain in battle, Śūrpanakhā again hastened (to his brother); and the sister of Khara, related in detail the slaughter of those Rākşasas.

sanskrit: स पुनः पतिताम् दृष्ट्वा क्रोधात् शूर्पणखाम् खरः
उवाच व्यक्तता वाचा ताम् अनर्थ अर्थम् आगताम्
transliteration: sa punaḥ patitām dṛṣṭvā krodhāt śūrpaṇakhām kharaḥ
uvāca vyaktatā vācā tām anartha artham āgatām
english: Seeing Sūrpanakhă again lying on the ground, Khara in anger spoke out to that one, who had come to bring on evil.

sanskrit: मया तु इदानीम् शूराः ते राक्षसा पिशित अशनाः
त्वत् प्रियार्थम् विनिर्दिष्टाः किम् अर्थम् रुद्यते पुनः
transliteration: mayā tu idānīm śūrāḥ te rākṣasā piśita aśanāḥ
tvat priyārtham vinirdiṣṭāḥ kim artham rudyate punaḥ
english: I had but recently commissioned for your behoof those heroic Rākşasas living on flesh. Why then do you again weep?

sanskrit: भक्ताः चैव अनुरक्ताः च हिताः च मम नित्यशः
हन्यमाना अपि न हन्यन्ते न न कुर्युः वचो मम
transliteration: bhaktāḥ caiva anuraktāḥ ca hitāḥ ca mama nityaśaḥ
hanyamānā api na hanyante na na kuryuḥ vaco mama
english: Bearing regard and attached to me, and ever engaged in my welfare, they, assailed by others, are incapable of being slain; nor do they not obey my orders.

sanskrit: किम् एतत् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि कारणम् यत् कृते पुनः
हा नाथ इति विनर्दन्ती सर्पवत् चेष्टसे क्षितौ
transliteration: kim etat śrotum icchāmi kāraṇam yat kṛte punaḥ
hā nātha iti vinardantī sarpavat ceṣṭase kṣitau
english: What can it be? I would hear of the occasion owing to which again, crying ‘Ah lord,' you roll on the earth like a serpent.

sanskrit: अनाथ वत् विलपसि किम् नु नाथे मयि स्थिते
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ मा मैवम् वैक्लव्यम् त्यज्यताम् इति
transliteration: anātha vat vilapasi kim nu nāthe mayi sthite
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha mā maivam vaiklavyam tyajyatām iti
english: Why do you be weep like one forlorn, while I your lord, am living? Arise! Arise! Do not fear, cast off your stupor.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्ता दुर्धर्षा खरेण परिसान्त्विता
विमृज्य नयने स अस्रे खरम् भ्रातरम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: iti evam uktā durdharṣā khareṇa parisāntvitā
vimṛjya nayane sa asre kharam bhrātaram abravīt
english: Thus addressed, and consoled by Khara, that irrepressible one, wiping her eyes, spoke to Khara.

sanskrit: अस्मि इदानीम् अहम् प्रप्ता हत श्रवण नासिका
शोणित ओघ परिक्लिन्ना त्वया च परिसमन्विता
transliteration: asmi idānīm aham praptā hata śravaṇa nāsikā
śoṇita ogha pariklinnā tvayā ca parisamanvitā
english: Having had my nose and ears cut off, I had come hither, covered with blood; and you had consoled me.

sanskrit: प्रेषिताः च त्वया शूरा राक्षसाः ते चतुर् दश
निहन्तुम् राघवम् घोराम् मत् प्रियार्थम् स लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: preṣitāḥ ca tvayā śūrā rākṣasāḥ te catur daśa
nihantum rāghavam ghorām mat priyārtham sa lakṣmaṇam
english: And you also had despatched fourteen heroic Rākṣasas, for my hehoof, for slaying the terrific Rāghava along with Lakşmaņa. But all those, bearing ill will (towards Rāma), bearing darts and pattiśas in their hands, have been slain in conflict by means of weapons penetrating into the vitals.

sanskrit: ते तु रामेण सामर्षाः शूल पट्टिस पाणयः
समरे निहताः सर्वे सायकैः मर्म भेदिभिः
transliteration: te tu rāmeṇa sāmarṣāḥ śūla paṭṭisa pāṇayaḥ
samare nihatāḥ sarve sāyakaiḥ marma bhedibhiḥ
english: And you also had despatched fourteen heroic Rākṣasas, for my hehoof, for slaying the terrific Rāghava along with Lakşmaņa. But all those, bearing ill will (towards Rāma), bearing darts and pattiśas in their hands, have been slain in conflict by means of weapons penetrating into the vitals.

sanskrit: तान् भूमौ पतितान् दृष्ट्वा क्षणेन एव महाजवान्
रामस्य च महत् कर्म महान् त्रासो अभवन् मम
transliteration: tān bhūmau patitān dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇena eva mahājavān
rāmasya ca mahat karma mahān trāso abhavan mama
english: Seeing those possessed of great speed, in a moment laid low on the ground, as well as (witnessing) Rāma's mighty deed, great fear has taken possession of me.

sanskrit: सा अस्मि भीता समुद्विग्ना विषण्णा च निशाचर
शरणम् त्वाम् पुनः प्राप्ता सर्वतो भय दर्शिनी
transliteration: sā asmi bhītā samudvignā viṣaṇṇā ca niśācara
śaraṇam tvām punaḥ prāptā sarvato bhaya darśinī
english: O ranger of the night, I am afraid, and agitated, and cast down. I have (at length) found in you a refuge, seeing fear on all sides. Will you not rescue me who am sinking in this ocean of grief, having sorrow for its alligators and affright for billows?

sanskrit: विषाद नक्र अध्युषिते परित्रास ऊर्मि मालिनि
किम् माम् न त्रायसे मग्नाम् विपुले शोक सागरे
transliteration: viṣāda nakra adhyuṣite paritrāsa ūrmi mālini
kim mām na trāyase magnām vipule śoka sāgare
english: O ranger of the night, I am afraid, and agitated, and cast down. I have (at length) found in you a refuge, seeing fear on all sides. Will you not rescue me who am sinking in this ocean of grief, having sorrow for its alligators and affright for billows?

sanskrit: एते च निहता भूमौ रामेण निशितैः शरैः
ये च मे पदवीम् प्राप्ता राक्षसाः पिशित अशनाः
transliteration: ete ca nihatā bhūmau rāmeṇa niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ye ca me padavīm prāptā rākṣasāḥ piśita aśanāḥ
english: And these Rākşasas, living on flesh who had arrived at that place, have been slain by Rāma with sharpened shafts.

sanskrit: मयि ते यदि अनुक्रोशो यदि रक्षःसु तेषु च
रामेण यदि शक्तिः ते तेजो वा अस्ति निशा चर
transliteration: mayi te yadi anukrośo yadi rakṣaḥsu teṣu ca
rāmeṇa yadi śaktiḥ te tejo vā asti niśā cara
english: If you have any kindness for me as well as those sons of Rākşasas* and, O ranger of night, if you have strength and energy to cope with Rāma, do you kill this thorn of the Rákşasas, who has set up his dwelling in the forest of Dandaka. Another reading is that enemy of mine.

sanskrit: यदि रामम् अमित्रघ्नम् न त्वम् अद्य वधिष्यसि
transliteration: yadi rāmam amitraghnam na tvam adya vadhiṣyasi

sanskrit: तव चैव अग्रतः प्राणान् त्यक्ष्यामि निरपत्रपा
बुद्ध्या अहम् अनुपश्यामि न त्वम् रामस्य संयुगे
transliteration: tava caiva agrataḥ prāṇān tyakṣyāmi nirapatrapā
buddhyā aham anupaśyāmi na tvam rāmasya saṃyuge

sanskrit: स्थातुम् प्रति मुखे शक्तः स बलो अपि महा रणे
शूरमानी न शूरः त्वम् मिथ्या आरोपित विक्रमः
transliteration: sthātum prati mukhe śaktaḥ sa balo api mahā raṇe
śūramānī na śūraḥ tvam mithyā āropita vikramaḥ

sanskrit: अपयाहि जन स्थानात् त्वरितः सह बान्धवः
जहि त्वम् समरे मूढान् यथा तु कुलपांसन
transliteration: apayāhi jana sthānāt tvaritaḥ saha bāndhavaḥ
jahi tvam samare mūḍhān yathā tu kulapāṃsana

sanskrit: मानुषौ तौ न शक्नोषि हन्तुम् वै राम लक्ष्मणौ
निःसत्त्वस्य अल्प वीर्यस्य वासः ते कीदृशः तु इह
transliteration: mānuṣau tau na śaknoṣi hantum vai rāma lakṣmaṇau
niḥsattvasya alpa vīryasya vāsaḥ te kīdṛśaḥ tu iha

sanskrit: राम तेजो अभिभूतो हि त्वम् क्षिप्रम् विनशिष्यसि
स हि तेजः समायुक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः
transliteration: rāma tejo abhibhūto hi tvam kṣipram vinaśiṣyasi
sa hi tejaḥ samāyukto rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
english: Overcome by the energy of Rāma, you shall speedily meet with destruction Dasaratha's son, Rāma, you shall speedily meet with destruction. Dasaratha's son, is endued with energy. His brother is possessed of high vigour by whom I have come to be deformed.

sanskrit: भ्राता च अस्य महा वीर्यो येन च अस्मि विरूपिता
transliteration: bhrātā ca asya mahā vīryo yena ca asmi virūpitā

sanskrit: भ्रातुः समीपे शोक आर्ता नष्ट संज्ञा बभूव ह
कराभ्याम् उदरम् हत्वा रुरोद भृश दुःखिता
transliteration: bhrātuḥ samīpe śoka ārtā naṣṭa saṃjñā babhūva ha
karābhyām udaram hatvā ruroda bhṛśa duḥkhitā
english: Having thus bewailed long, that Raksasi, possessed of a spacious abdomen, through sorrow, became bereft of her senses before her brother, and exercised with great grief cried, striking her abdomen with her hands.

sanskrit: एवम् आधर्षितः शूरः शूर्पणख्या खरः ततः
उवाच रक्षसाम् मध्ये खरः खरतरम् वचः
transliteration: evam ādharṣitaḥ śūraḥ śūrpaṇakhyā kharaḥ tataḥ
uvāca rakṣasām madhye kharaḥ kharataram vacaḥ
english: On being thus taunted by Śūrpanakha, Khara spoke these sharp words in the midst of the Raksasas.

sanskrit: तव अपमान प्रभवः क्रोधो अयम् अतुलो मम
न शक्यते धारयितुम् लवण अंभ इव उल्बणम्
transliteration: tava apamāna prabhavaḥ krodho ayam atulo mama
na śakyate dhārayitum lavaṇa aṃbha iva ulbaṇam
english: Arising from this your humiliating censure, my wrath is beyond compare. I can not bear it, like salt-water cast on a sore.

sanskrit: न रामम् गणये वीर्यान् मानुषम् क्षीण जीवितम्
आत्म दुश्चरितैः प्राणान् हतो यो अद्य विमोक्ष्यति
transliteration: na rāmam gaṇaye vīryān mānuṣam kṣīṇa jīvitam
ātma duścaritaiḥ prāṇān hato yo adya vimokṣyati
english: From my prowess I count not Rāma who is a human being possessed of a frail life him who slain by me shall to-day in consequence of his misdeed give up existence.

sanskrit: बाष्पः सम्धार्यताम् एष संभ्रमः च विमुच्यताम्
अहम् रामम् सह भ्रात्रा नयामि यम सादनम्
transliteration: bāṣpaḥ samdhāryatām eṣa saṃbhramaḥ ca vimucyatām
aham rāmam saha bhrātrā nayāmi yama sādanam
english: Restrain your tears, and remove your fear. I shall despatch a Rāma along with his brother to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: परश्वध हतस्य अद्य मन्द प्राणस्य भू तले
रामस्य रुधिरम् रक्तम् उष्णम् पास्यसि राक्षसि
transliteration: paraśvadha hatasya adya manda prāṇasya bhū tale
rāmasya rudhiram raktam uṣṇam pāsyasi rākṣasi
english: You shall O Rākşasī, quaff on the ground the hot blood of Rāma of evil life, slain by my axe.

sanskrit: सा प्रहृष्ट्वा वचः श्रुत्वा खरस्य वदनात् च्युतम्
प्रशशंस पुनर् मौर्ख्यात् भ्रातरम् रक्षसाम् वरम्
transliteration: sā prahṛṣṭvā vacaḥ śrutvā kharasya vadanāt cyutam
praśaśaṃsa punar maurkhyāt bhrātaram rakṣasām varam
english: Overjoyed on hearing the words that dropped from Khara's mouth, she again through fickleness extolled that foremost of Rākşasas, her brother.

sanskrit: तया परुषितः पूर्वम् पुनर् एव प्रशंसितः
अब्रवीत् दूषणम् नाम खरः सेना पतिम् तदा
transliteration: tayā paruṣitaḥ pūrvam punar eva praśaṃsitaḥ
abravīt dūṣaṇam nāma kharaḥ senā patim tadā
english: At first reprimanded by her and then praised, Khara spoke to is general, named Dusana.

Do you, O gentle one, array fourteen thousand of those those Rākṣasas, gifted with furious vehemence, ever following my wish, who never turn away froin the field; who are hued like to purple clouds, who revel in cruelty*, and who are elated (in consequence of their prowess). *The North-West Province's text has some additional sloka:-Dreadful, wearing forms at will, possessing the pride of the lion, having large mouth, high-souled, revelling in cruelty, endued with strength, of fierce energy.

sanskrit: नील जीमूत वर्णानाम् लोक हिंसा विहाराणाम्
सर्व उद्योगम् उदीर्णानाम् रक्षसाम् सौम्य कारय
transliteration: nīla jīmūta varṇānām loka hiṃsā vihārāṇām
sarva udyogam udīrṇānām rakṣasām saumya kāraya
english: Do you, O gentle one, array fourteen thousand of those those Rākṣasas, gifted with furious vehemence, ever following my wish, who never turn away froin the field; who are hued like to purple clouds, who revel in cruelty*, and who are elated (in consequence of their prowess). *The North-West Province's text has some additional sloka:-Dreadful, wearing forms at will, possessing the pride of the lion, having large mouth, high-souled, revelling in cruelty, endued with strength, of fierce energy.

sanskrit: उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रम् रथम् सौम्य धनूंषि च
शरान् च चित्रान् खड्गां च शक्ती च विविधाः शिताः
transliteration: upasthāpaya me kṣipram ratham saumya dhanūṃṣi ca
śarān ca citrān khaḍgāṃ ca śaktī ca vividhāḥ śitāḥ
english: And you gentle one, do you at once bring my car as well as my bows, and pasty coloured arrows and scimitars, and darts, and various whetted javelins.
O you versed in warfare, for slaying this haughty Rāma, I go in the very fore-front of the high-souled Paulastyas. Lit.-Pulastya's The Rākşasas commonly descended from Pulastya.

sanskrit: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सूर्य वर्णम् महारथम्
सत् अश्वैः शबलैः युक्तम् आचचक्षे अथ दूषणः
transliteration: iti tasya bruvāṇasya sūrya varṇam mahāratham
sat aśvaiḥ śabalaiḥ yuktam ācacakṣe atha dūṣaṇaḥ
english: As he said this, Dūşaņa brought his great car hued like the sun, yoked with excellent steeds of various colours. sons. were

sanskrit: तम् मेरु शिखर आकारम् तप्त कांचन भूषणम्
transliteration: tam meru śikhara ākāram tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇam

sanskrit: मत्स्यैः पुष्पैः द्रुमैः शैलैः चन्द्र सूर्यैः च कांचनैः
मांगल्यैः पक्षि सम्घैः च ताराभिः च समावृतम्
transliteration: matsyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ drumaiḥ śailaiḥ candra sūryaiḥ ca kāṃcanaiḥ
māṃgalyaiḥ pakṣi samghaiḥ ca tārābhiḥ ca samāvṛtam

sanskrit: ध्वज निस्त्रिंश संपन्नम् किंकिणी वर भूषितम्
सत् अश्व युक्तम् सः अमर्षात् आरुरोह खरः तदा
transliteration: dhvaja nistriṃśa saṃpannam kiṃkiṇī vara bhūṣitam
sat aśva yuktam saḥ amarṣāt āruroha kharaḥ tadā

sanskrit: खरः तु तान् महत् सैन्याम् रथ चर्म आयुध ध्वजान्
निर्यात इति अब्रवीत् प्रेक्ष्य दूषणः सर्व राक्षसान्
transliteration: kharaḥ tu tān mahat sainyām ratha carma āyudha dhvajān
niryāta iti abravīt prekṣya dūṣaṇaḥ sarva rākṣasān
english: Beholding that mighty army consisting of cars and arms and pennons, Khara as well as Dūşana, said to that multitude of Rākşasas, March forth!

sanskrit: ततः तद् राक्षसम् सैन्यम् घोर चर्म आयुध ध्वजम्
transliteration: tataḥ tad rākṣasam sainyam ghora carma āyudha dhvajam

sanskrit: मुद्गरैः पट्टिशैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैः च परश्वधैः
खड्गैः चक्रैः च हस्तस्थैः भ्राजमानैः स तोमरैः
transliteration: mudgaraiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ ca paraśvadhaiḥ
khaḍgaiḥ cakraiḥ ca hastasthaiḥ bhrājamānaiḥ sa tomaraiḥ

sanskrit: शक्तिभिः परिघैः घोरैः अतिमात्रैः च कार्मुकैः
गदा असि मुसलैः वज्रैः गृहीतैः भीम दर्शनैः
transliteration: śaktibhiḥ parighaiḥ ghoraiḥ atimātraiḥ ca kārmukaiḥ
gadā asi musalaiḥ vajraiḥ gṛhītaiḥ bhīma darśanaiḥ

sanskrit: निर्यातानि जन स्थानात् खर चित्त अनुवर्तिनाम्
transliteration: niryātāni jana sthānāt khara citta anuvartinām

sanskrit: तान् तु निर्धावतो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसान् भीम दर्शनम्
खरस्य अथ रथः किंचित् जगाम तत् अनन्तरम्
transliteration: tān tu nirdhāvato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasān bhīma darśanam
kharasya atha rathaḥ kiṃcit jagāma tat anantaram
english: Seeing those Rākṣasas of dreadful forms rushing out, Khara's car remaining a little away (from the press), proceeded after a short space.

sanskrit: ततः तान् शबलान् अश्वान् तप्त कांचन भूषितान्
transliteration: tataḥ tān śabalān aśvān tapta kāṃcana bhūṣitān
english: Then taking the perinission of Khara, the charioteer drove at speed those powerful steeds decked in shining gold.

sanskrit: संचोदितो रथः शीघ्रम् खरस्य रिपु घातिनः
शब्देन आपूरयामास दिशः स प्रदिशः तथा
transliteration: saṃcodito rathaḥ śīghram kharasya ripu ghātinaḥ
śabdena āpūrayāmāsa diśaḥ sa pradiśaḥ tathā
english: And driven with speed, the car of Khara. slayer of foes, filled all directions with its rattle.

sanskrit: प्रवृद्ध मन्युः तु खरः खर स्वरेरिपोः वध अर्थम् त्वरितो यथा अंतकः
अचूचुदत् सारथिम् उन्नदन् पुनर्महाबलो मेघ इव अश्म वर्षवान्
transliteration: pravṛddha manyuḥ tu kharaḥ khara svareripoḥ vadha artham tvarito yathā aṃtakaḥ
acūcudat sārathim unnadan punarmahābalo megha iva aśma varṣavān
english: Khara, fired with wrath, and having piercing voice, hastening to destroy his enemy like the destroyer himself, again urged his charioteer with roars, like a mighty cloud showering down stones.

sanskrit: तत् प्रयातम् बलम् घोरम् अशिवम् शोणित उदकम्
अभ्यवर्षत् महा मेघः तुमुलो गर्दभ अरुणः
transliteration: tat prayātam balam ghoram aśivam śoṇita udakam
abhyavarṣat mahā meghaḥ tumulo gardabha aruṇaḥ
english: As those terrible and inauspicious forces were marching on, a mighty sable cloud with dreadful sounds began to shower down blood.

sanskrit: निपेतुः तुरगाः तस्य रथ युक्ता महाजवाः
transliteration: nipetuḥ turagāḥ tasya ratha yuktā mahājavāḥ
english: The steeds yoked to his (Khara's) car, gifted with great celerity, dropped down all of a sudden on the level high ways strewn with blossoms.
A dark circle bordered with red, resembling that of charcoal, appeared in the vicinity of the sun.

sanskrit: ततो ध्वजम् उपागम्य हेम दण्डम् समुच्छ्रितम्
transliteration: tato dhvajam upāgamya hema daṇḍam samucchritam
english: And a frightful vulture, having a huge body, approaching the banner, sat upon the upraised golden flag-staff.

sanskrit: जनस्थान समीपे च समाक्रम्य खर स्वनाः
विस्वरान् विविधान् च चक्रुः मांस आदा मृग पक्षिणः
transliteration: janasthāna samīpe ca samākramya khara svanāḥ
visvarān vividhān ca cakruḥ māṃsa ādā mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ
english: And beasts and birds having shrill voices, living on flesh, remaining near Janasthāna, emitted various dissonant notes. And in the quarter lighted up by the sun, fierce jackals having mighty voices, in dreadful cries presaged evil to the Rākşasas.

sanskrit: व्याजह्रुः च पदीप्तायाम् दिशि वै भैरव स्वनम्
transliteration: vyājahruḥ ca padīptāyām diśi vai bhairava svanam
english: And beasts and birds having shrill voices, living on flesh, remaining near Janasthāna, emitted various dissonant notes. And in the quarter lighted up by the sun, fierce jackals having mighty voices, in dreadful cries presaged evil to the Rākşasas.

sanskrit: यद्वा -प्रभिन्न गज संकाश तोय शोणित धारिणः
आकाशम् तत् अनाकाशम् चक्रुः भीम अंबु वाहकाः
transliteration: yadvā -prabhinna gaja saṃkāśa toya śoṇita dhāriṇaḥ
ākāśam tat anākāśam cakruḥ bhīma aṃbu vāhakāḥ
english: And terrific clouds surcharged with water and blood, and resembling elephants with rent temples, enveloped the sky.

sanskrit: बभूव तिमिरम् घोरम् उद्धतम् रोम हर्षणम्
दिशो वा प्रदिशो वा अपि सुव्यक्तम् न चकाशिरे
transliteration: babhūva timiram ghoram uddhatam roma harṣaṇam
diśo vā pradiśo vā api suvyaktam na cakāśire
english: And a dense darkness appeared, capable of making one's hair stand on end, and no quarter was distinctly visible.

sanskrit: क्षतज आर्द्र सवर्णाभा संध्या कालम् विना बभौ
खरम् च अभिमुखम् नेदुः तदा घोरा मृगाः खगाः
transliteration: kṣataja ārdra savarṇābhā saṃdhyā kālam vinā babhau
kharam ca abhimukham neduḥ tadā ghorā mṛgāḥ khagāḥ
english: And out of season, there appeared evening hued like a cloth soaked in blood. And facing Khara, terrible beasts and birds set up cries.

sanskrit: कंक गोमायु गृध्राः च चुक्रुशुः भय संशिनः
नित्या अशिव करा युद्धे शिवा घोर निदर्शनाः
transliteration: kaṃka gomāyu gṛdhrāḥ ca cukruśuḥ bhaya saṃśinaḥ
nityā aśiva karā yuddhe śivā ghora nidarśanāḥ
english: Kankas, Gomayas and vultures, portending fear, began to cry. Ever inauspicious in war, jackals presaging evil, with their mouths belching forth flame, howled in the face of the forces.

sanskrit: नेदुः बलस्य अभिमुखम् ज्वाल उद्गारिभिः आननैः
कबन्धः परिघ आभासो दृश्यते भास्कर अंतिके
transliteration: neduḥ balasya abhimukham jvāla udgāribhiḥ ānanaiḥ
kabandhaḥ parigha ābhāso dṛśyate bhāskara aṃtike

sanskrit: प्रवाति मारुतः शीघ्रम् निष्प्रभो अभूत् दिवाकरः
transliteration: pravāti mārutaḥ śīghram niṣprabho abhūt divākaraḥ
english: And comets, resembling parighas appeared beside the sun. That mighty planet Svarbhānu seized the sun when there was no parva. And the winds blew violently; and the sun was without lustre.

sanskrit: उत्पेतुः च विना रात्रिम् ताराः खद्योतन प्रभाः
संलीन मीन विहगा नलिन्यः शुष्क पंकजाः
transliteration: utpetuḥ ca vinā rātrim tārāḥ khadyotana prabhāḥ
saṃlīna mīna vihagā nalinyaḥ śuṣka paṃkajāḥ
english: And when there was no night, stars wearing the sheen of fireflies, began to fall. And in the tanks fishes and fowls were inert, and the lotuses were withered.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षणे बभूवुः च विना पुष्प फलैः द्रुमाः
उद्धूतः च विना वातम् रेणुः जलधर अरुणः
transliteration: tasmin kṣaṇe babhūvuḥ ca vinā puṣpa phalaiḥ drumāḥ
uddhūtaḥ ca vinā vātam reṇuḥ jaladhara aruṇaḥ
english: And at that hour the trees were shorn of fruits and flowers; and without wind there arose dust dusky like clouds.

sanskrit: चीची कूचि इति वाश्यन्तो बभूवुः तत्र सारिकाः
उल्काः च अपि स निर्घोषा निपेतुः घोर दर्शनाः
transliteration: cīcī kūci iti vāśyanto babhūvuḥ tatra sārikāḥ
ulkāḥ ca api sa nirghoṣā nipetuḥ ghora darśanāḥ
english: And the parrots uttered wild notes-cīcīkūci. And meteors of terrific aspects fell with loud noises.

sanskrit: प्रचचाल मही च अपि स शैल वन कानना
transliteration: pracacāla mahī ca api sa śaila vana kānanā
english: And the earth with her mountains, woods, and forests, shook. And as the intelligent Khara was roaring from his car, his left arm shook, and his voice fell, and as he surveyed around, his eyes moistened, and his head ached; yet through ignorance, he did not desist.

sanskrit: प्राकम्पत भुजः सव्यः स्वरः च अस्य अवसज्जत
स अस्रा संपद्यते दृष्टिः पश्यमानस्य सर्वतः
transliteration: prākampata bhujaḥ savyaḥ svaraḥ ca asya avasajjata
sa asrā saṃpadyate dṛṣṭiḥ paśyamānasya sarvataḥ

sanskrit: ललाटे च रुजो जाता न च मोहात् न्यवर्तत
तान् समीक्ष्य महोत्पातान् उत्थितान् रोम हर्षणान्
transliteration: lalāṭe ca rujo jātā na ca mohāt nyavartata
tān samīkṣya mahotpātān utthitān roma harṣaṇān

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् राक्षसान् सर्वान् प्रहसन् स खरः तदा
महा उत्पातान् इमान् सर्वान् उत्थितान् घोर दर्शनान्
transliteration: abravīt rākṣasān sarvān prahasan sa kharaḥ tadā
mahā utpātān imān sarvān utthitān ghora darśanān

sanskrit: न चिंतयामि अहम् वीर्यात् बलवान् दुर्बलान् इव
तारा अपि शरैः तीक्ष्णैः पातयेयम् नभः तलात्
transliteration: na ciṃtayāmi aham vīryāt balavān durbalān iva
tārā api śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ pātayeyam nabhaḥ talāt

sanskrit: मृत्युम् मरण धर्मेण संक्रुद्धो योजयामि अहम्
राघवम् तम् बल उत्सिक्तम् भ्रातरम् च अस्य लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: mṛtyum maraṇa dharmeṇa saṃkruddho yojayāmi aham
rāghavam tam bala utsiktam bhrātaram ca asya lakṣmaṇam

sanskrit: अहत्वा सायकैः तीक्ष्णैः न उपावर्तितुम् उत्सहे
यन् निमित्तम् तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्य विपर्ययः
transliteration: ahatvā sāyakaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ na upāvartitum utsahe
yan nimittam tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇasya viparyayaḥ

sanskrit: सकामा भगिनी मे अस्तु पीत्वा तु रुधिरम् तयोः
न क्वचित् प्राप्त पूर्वो मे संयुगेषु पराजयः
transliteration: sakāmā bhaginī me astu pītvā tu rudhiram tayoḥ
na kvacit prāpta pūrvo me saṃyugeṣu parājayaḥ

sanskrit: युष्माकम् एतत् प्रत्यक्षम् न अनृतम् कथयामि अहम्
देव राजम् अपि क्रुद्धो मत्त ऐरावत गामिनम्
transliteration: yuṣmākam etat pratyakṣam na anṛtam kathayāmi aham
deva rājam api kruddho matta airāvata gāminam

sanskrit: वज्र हस्तम् रणे हन्याम् किम् पुनः तौ च मानुषौ
सा तस्य गर्जितम् श्रुत्वा राक्षसाअनाम् महा चमूः
transliteration: vajra hastam raṇe hanyām kim punaḥ tau ca mānuṣau
sā tasya garjitam śrutvā rākṣasāanām mahā camūḥ

sanskrit: प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे मृत्यु पाश अवपाशिता
समेयुः च महात्मानो युद्ध दर्शन कांक्षिणः
transliteration: praharṣam atulam lebhe mṛtyu pāśa avapāśitā
sameyuḥ ca mahātmāno yuddha darśana kāṃkṣiṇaḥ

sanskrit: ऋषयो देव गन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च सह चारणैः
समेत्य च ऊचुः सहिताः ते अन्यायम् पुण्यकर्मणः
transliteration: ṛṣayo deva gandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca saha cāraṇaiḥ
sametya ca ūcuḥ sahitāḥ te anyāyam puṇyakarmaṇaḥ
english: And anxious to see the encounter, there came high-souled saints, and celestials, and Gandharvas, and Siddhas, with the Cāranas. And these pious ones assembled, spoke to one another.

sanskrit: स्वस्ति गो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो अस्तु लोकानाम् ये च सम्मताः
जयताम् राघवो युद्धे पौलस्त्यान् रजनी चरान्
transliteration: svasti go brāhmaṇebhyo astu lokānām ye ca sammatāḥ
jayatām rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanī carān
english: Welfare to those cows, and Brāhmanas, and those that are prized by the worlds! As the discus-handed Vişņu vanquished the foremost Asuras, may Rāghava rout in battle those rangers of the night, the progeny of Pulastya!

sanskrit: चक्रहस्तो यथा विष्णुः सर्वान् असुर सत्तमान्
एतत् च अन्यत् च बहुशो ब्रुवाणाः परम ऋषयः
transliteration: cakrahasto yathā viṣṇuḥ sarvān asura sattamān
etat ca anyat ca bahuśo bruvāṇāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ

sanskrit: जात कौतूहलात् तत्र विमानस्थाः च देवताः
ददृशुर् वाहिनीम् तेषाम् राक्षसानाम् गत आयुषाम्
transliteration: jāta kautūhalāt tatra vimānasthāḥ ca devatāḥ
dadṛśur vāhinīm teṣām rākṣasānām gata āyuṣām
english: And saying this as well as various other things, the supreme saints and the celestials stationed in the sky conceiving curiosity (as to the issue of the conflict), beheld the host of those Rākşasas, whose days had been numbered.

sanskrit: रथेन तु खरो वेगात् सैन्यस्य अग्रात् विनिःसृतः
transliteration: rathena tu kharo vegāt sainyasya agrāt viniḥsṛtaḥ
english: Then impetuously Khara issued in his car from the van of the army*. And these twelve endowed with exceeding prowess, viz., Syenagāmí, Prthusyama, Yajñaśatru, Vihangama, Durjaya, Karavirāksa, Parusa, Kālakärmuka, Hemamāli, Mahāmāli, Sarpāsya, and Rudhirāśana posted themselves around Khara. The N.W.P. text has a different stoka. And seeing him come out on the ground, they themselves came out.

sanskrit: द्वादश एते महावीर्याः प्रतस्थुः अभितः खरम्
चत्वार एते सेना अग्रे दूषणम् पृष्ठतो अन्वयुः
transliteration: dvādaśa ete mahāvīryāḥ pratasthuḥ abhitaḥ kharam
catvāra ete senā agre dūṣaṇam pṛṣṭhato anvayuḥ
english: And Mahākapāla, Sthūlākṣa, Pramātha and Trisirā—These four going before the forces, went at the back of Dūşaņa.

sanskrit: सा भीम वेगा समर अभिकांक्षिणीसुदारुणा राक्षस वीर सेना
तौ राज पुत्रौ सहसा अभ्युपेतामाला ग्रहाणाम् इव चन्द्र सूर्यौ
transliteration: sā bhīma vegā samara abhikāṃkṣiṇīsudāruṇā rākṣasa vīra senā
tau rāja putrau sahasā abhyupetāmālā grahāṇām iva candra sūryau
english: Then as the planets dart towards the sun and moon, that heroic and dreadful army of Rākşasas, eager for victory suddenly rushed towards the princes with great vehemence.

sanskrit: आश्रमम् प्रति याते तु खरे खर पराक्रमे
तान् एव औत्पातिकान् रामः सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श ह
transliteration: āśramam prati yāte tu khare khara parākrame
tān eva autpātikān rāmaḥ saha bhrātrā dadarśa ha
english: When Khara of fierce prowess had come to the asylum Rāma in company with his brother saw all those evil prognostics.

sanskrit: तान् उत्पातान् महाघोरान् रामो दृष्ट्वा अति अमर्षण
प्रजानाम् अहितान् दृष्ट्वा वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tān utpātān mahāghorān rāmo dṛṣṭvā ati amarṣaṇa
prajānām ahitān dṛṣṭvā vākyam lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: And beholding those dreadful portents, Rāma exceedingly distressed, apprehending some calamity to the Rākşasas, observed to Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: इमान् पश्य महाबाहो सर्व भूत अपहारिणः
समुत्थितान् महा उत्पातान् संहर्तुम् सर्व राक्षसान्
transliteration: imān paśya mahābāho sarva bhūta apahāriṇaḥ
samutthitān mahā utpātān saṃhartum sarva rākṣasān
english: O mighty armed one, behold these great presages that have taken place, capable of annihilating all beings, and which have taken place, capable of annihilating all beings, and which have for their object the utter extermination of the Raksasas!

sanskrit: अमी रुधिर धाराः तु विसृजंतो खर स्वनाः
व्योम्नि मेघा निवर्तन्ते परुषा गर्दभ अरुणाः
transliteration: amī rudhira dhārāḥ tu visṛjaṃto khara svanāḥ
vyomni meghā nivartante paruṣā gardabha aruṇāḥ
english: Yonder threatening clouds of asinine sable, showering down blood and uttering loud sounds are ranging the welkin.

sanskrit: स धूमाः च शराः सर्वे मम युद्ध अभिनन्दिताः
transliteration: sa dhūmāḥ ca śarāḥ sarve mama yuddha abhinanditāḥ
english: And, O discerning one, rejoicing at the prospect of my fight, all these arrows emit smoke, and my bows plaited on the back with gold, are restless.

sanskrit: यादृशा इह कूजन्ति पक्षिणो वन चारिणः
अग्रतो नः भयम् प्राप्तम् संशयो जीवितस्य च
transliteration: yādṛśā iha kūjanti pakṣiṇo vana cāriṇaḥ
agrato naḥ bhayam prāptam saṃśayo jīvitasya ca
english: Meseems from the noise of the wild birds that impending on us is danger and uncertainty to life.

sanskrit: संप्रहारः तु सुमहान् भविष्यति न संशयः
अयम् आख्याति मे बाहुः स्फुरमाणो मुहुर् मुहुः
transliteration: saṃprahāraḥ tu sumahān bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
ayam ākhyāti me bāhuḥ sphuramāṇo muhur muhuḥ
english: Without doubt, there shall take place a mighty conflict. At this critical time, my arin shaking momentarily, betokens, O hero, victory to us, and defeat to the enemy. And your face appear pleasant with a delightful lustre.

sanskrit: संनिकर्षे तु नः शूर जयम् शत्रोः पराजयम्
सुप्रभम् च प्रसन्नम् च तव वक्त्रम् हि लक्ष्यते
transliteration: saṃnikarṣe tu naḥ śūra jayam śatroḥ parājayam
suprabham ca prasannam ca tava vaktram hi lakṣyate
english: Without doubt, there shall take place a mighty conflict. At this critical time, my arin shaking momentarily, betokens, O hero, victory to us, and defeat to the enemy. And your face appear pleasant with a delightful lustre.

sanskrit: उद्यतानाम् हि युद्धार्थम् येषाम् भवति लक्ष्मणः
निष्प्रभम् वदनम् तेषाम् भवति आयुः परिक्षयः
transliteration: udyatānām hi yuddhārtham yeṣām bhavati lakṣmaṇaḥ
niṣprabham vadanam teṣām bhavati āyuḥ parikṣayaḥ
english: O Lakşmaņa, the pallid face of those that prepare for conflict, auger shortening of life.

sanskrit: रक्षसाम् नर्दताम् घोरः श्रूयते अयम् महाध्वनिः
आहतानाम् च भेरीणाम् राक्षसैः क्रूर कर्मभिः
transliteration: rakṣasām nardatām ghoraḥ śrūyate ayam mahādhvaniḥ
āhatānām ca bherīṇām rākṣasaiḥ krūra karmabhiḥ
english: We can hear the shouts of the Rākşasas as they roar, as also the blasts of the trumpets of those doomed to be wounded blown by Rākṣasas of remorseless deeds.

sanskrit: अनागत विधानम् तु कर्तव्यम् शुभम् इच्छता
transliteration: anāgata vidhānam tu kartavyam śubham icchatā
english: A considerate person that wishes for his welfare, apprehending peril, should prevent disaster ere it arrives.

sanskrit: तस्मात् गृहीत्वा वैदेहीम् शर पाणिः धनुर् धरः
गुहाम् आश्रय शैलस्य दुर्गाम् पादप संकुलाम्
transliteration: tasmāt gṛhītvā vaidehīm śara pāṇiḥ dhanur dharaḥ
guhām āśraya śailasya durgām pādapa saṃkulām
english: Therefore bearing arrows in your hand, and equipped with your bow, do you, taking Videha's daughter, take refuge in the mountain cavern, covered with trees and difficult of access.

sanskrit: प्रतिकूलितुम् इच्छामि न हि वाक्यम् इदम् त्वया
शापितो मम पादाभ्याम् गम्यताम् वत्स मा चिरम्
transliteration: pratikūlitum icchāmi na hi vākyam idam tvayā
śāpito mama pādābhyām gamyatām vatsa mā ciram
english: That you should act contrary to my words, is what I do not wish. Swearing by my feet, go you without delay, my brother.

sanskrit: त्वम् हि शूरः च बलवान् हन्या एतान् न संशयः
स्वयम् निहन्तुम् इच्छमि सर्वान् एव निशाचरान्
transliteration: tvam hi śūraḥ ca balavān hanyā etān na saṃśayaḥ
svayam nihantum icchami sarvān eva niśācarān
english: You are both strong and a hero: You can, without doubt, slay these Rākşasas. But I wish to slay all these rangers of the night myself.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः सह सीतया
शरान् आदाय चापम् च गुहाम् दुर्गाम् समाश्रयत्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ saha sītayā
śarān ādāya cāpam ca guhām durgām samāśrayat
english: Thus accosted by Rama, Laksmana, taking arrows and a bow, took refuge in an inaccessible cave along with Sītā.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे तु गुहाम् लक्ष्मणे सह सीतया
हन्त निर्युक्तम् इति उक्त्वा रामः कवचम् आविशत्
transliteration: tasmin praviṣṭe tu guhām lakṣmaṇe saha sītayā
hanta niryuktam iti uktvā rāmaḥ kavacam āviśat
english: Thereupon, saying, Ah! we have spoken it sharp, Rāma put on his mail. And adorned with that mail resembling fire Rāma appeared in the dark like a mighty flame streaming up.

sanskrit: स तेन अग्नि निकाशेन कवचेन विभूषितः
बभूव रामः तिमिरे महान् अग्निर् इव उत्थितः
transliteration: sa tena agni nikāśena kavacena vibhūṣitaḥ
babhūva rāmaḥ timire mahān agnir iva utthitaḥ
english: Thereupon, saying, Ah! we have spoken it sharp, Rāma put on his mail. And adorned with that mail resembling fire Rāma appeared in the dark like a mighty flame streaming up.

sanskrit: स चापम् उद्यम्य महत् शरान् आदाय वीर्यवान्
संबभूव अवस्थितः तत्र ज्या स्वनैः पूरयन् दिशः
transliteration: sa cāpam udyamya mahat śarān ādāya vīryavān
saṃbabhūva avasthitaḥ tatra jyā svanaiḥ pūrayan diśaḥ
english: And uplifting his bow, and taking his arrows, that powerful one stood there, feeling all directions with the twangs of his bow-string.

sanskrit: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च सह चारणैः
समेयुः च महात्मनो युद्ध दर्शन कांक्षया
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca saha cāraṇaiḥ
sameyuḥ ca mahātmano yuddha darśana kāṃkṣayā
english: Then the high-souled gods and Gandharvas, Siddhas and Cāranas came there, with the intention of witnessing the fight.

sanskrit: ऋषयः च महात्मनो लोके ब्रह्मर्षि सत्तमाः
समेत्य च ऊचुः सहिताः ते अन्योन्यम् पुण्य कर्मणः
transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ ca mahātmano loke brahmarṣi sattamāḥ
sametya ca ūcuḥ sahitāḥ te anyonyam puṇya karmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: स्वस्ति गो ब्राह्मणानाम् च लोकानाम् च इति संस्थिताः
जयताम् राघवो युद्धे पौलस्त्यान् रजनी चरान्
transliteration: svasti go brāhmaṇānām ca lokānām ca iti saṃsthitāḥ
jayatām rāghavo yuddhe paulastyān rajanī carān

sanskrit: चक्र हस्तो यथा युद्धे सर्वान् असुर पुंगवान्
एवम् उक्त्वा पुनः प्र ऊचुः आलोक्य च परस्परम्
transliteration: cakra hasto yathā yuddhe sarvān asura puṃgavān
evam uktvā punaḥ pra ūcuḥ ālokya ca parasparam

sanskrit: एकः च रामो धर्मात्मा कथम् युद्धम् भविष्यति
transliteration: ekaḥ ca rāmo dharmātmā katham yuddham bhaviṣyati
english: Having said this, they again spoke, eyeing one another, There are fourteen thousand of the Rākşasas of dreadful deed while the righteous Rāma is single. How can fight take place (between two such parties)?

sanskrit: इति राजर्षयः सिद्धाः स गणाः च द्विजर्षभाः
जात कौतूहलात् तस्थुर् विमानस्थाः च देवता
transliteration: iti rājarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sa gaṇāḥ ca dvijarṣabhāḥ
jāta kautūhalāt tasthur vimānasthāḥ ca devatā
english: Having said this, the Rājarșis, Siddhas, multitudes of the best of the twice-born ones, and celestial stationed in the sky were moved with curiosity (as to the issue of the conflict).

sanskrit: आविष्टम् तेजसा रामम् संग्राम शिरसि स्थितम्
दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि भयात् विव्यथिरे तदा
transliteration: āviṣṭam tejasā rāmam saṃgrāma śirasi sthitam
dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhayāt vivyathire tadā
english: Then seeing Rāma filled with energy, remaining in the field, all beings from fear experienced great pain.

sanskrit: रूपम् अप्रतिमम् तस्य रामस्य अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः
बभूव रूपम् क्रुद्धस्य रुद्रस्य इव महात्मनः
transliteration: rūpam apratimam tasya rāmasya akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ
babhūva rūpam kruddhasya rudrasya iva mahātmanaḥ
english: And the peerless grace of Rāma of energetic deeds became like to that of the high souled infuriated Rudra.* There is a variation in reading here; the sense, however, is the same.

sanskrit: इति संभाष्यमाणो तु देव गंधर्व चारणैः
ततो गंभीर निर्ह्रादम् घोर चर्म आयुध ध्वजम्
transliteration: iti saṃbhāṣyamāṇo tu deva gaṃdharva cāraṇaiḥ
tato gaṃbhīra nirhrādam ghora carma āyudha dhvajam

sanskrit: चापानि विस्फरयताम् जृंभताम् च अपि अभीक्ष्णशः
विप्रघुष्ट स्वनानाम् च दुंदुभीम् च अपि निघ्नताम्
transliteration: cāpāni vispharayatām jṛṃbhatām ca api abhīkṣṇaśaḥ
vipraghuṣṭa svanānām ca duṃdubhīm ca api nighnatām

sanskrit: तेषाम् सुतुमुलः शब्दः पूरयामास तद् वनम्
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ताः श्वापदा वन चारिणः
transliteration: teṣām sutumulaḥ śabdaḥ pūrayāmāsa tad vanam
tena śabdena vitrastāḥ śvāpadā vana cāriṇaḥ
english: The universal uproar filled that (entire) forest. Scared and terrified at the hubbub the rangers of the wood fle: to quarters free from noise; nor did they cast their eyes backward.

sanskrit: दुद्रुवुः यत्र निःशब्दम् पृष्ठतो न अवलोकयन्
तत् च अनीकम् महावेगम् रामम् समनुवर्तत
transliteration: dudruvuḥ yatra niḥśabdam pṛṣṭhato na avalokayan
tat ca anīkam mahāvegam rāmam samanuvartata

sanskrit: रामो अपि चारयन् चक्षुः सर्वतो रण पण्डितः
transliteration: rāmo api cārayan cakṣuḥ sarvato raṇa paṇḍitaḥ

sanskrit: ददर्श खर सैन्यम् तत् युद्ध अभिमुखो गतः
वितत्य च धनुर् भीमम् तूण्याः च उद्धृत्य सायकान्
transliteration: dadarśa khara sainyam tat yuddha abhimukho gataḥ
vitatya ca dhanur bhīmam tūṇyāḥ ca uddhṛtya sāyakān

sanskrit: क्रोधम् आहारयत् तीव्रम् वधार्थम् सर्व रक्षसाम्
दुष्प्रेक्ष्यश्चाभवत्क्रुद्धोयुगान्ताग्निरिवज्वलन् - यद्वा -दुष्प्रेक्ष्यः च अभवत् क्रुद्धो युगान्त अग्निः इव ज्वलन्
transliteration: krodham āhārayat tīvram vadhārtham sarva rakṣasām
duṣprekṣyaścābhavatkruddhoyugāntāgnirivajvalan - yadvā -duṣprekṣyaḥ ca abhavat kruddho yugānta agniḥ iva jvalan
english: Then stretching his dreadful bow, and swiftly taking out shafts, (Rāma) for compassing the destruction of the entire body of the Rākşasas, waxed furiously enraged. And like to the flaming fire at the universal dissolution, he, growing wroth, was incapable of being looked i at.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा तेजसा आविष्टम् प्राव्यथन् वन देवताः
तस्य रुष्ट्स्य रूपम् तु रामस्य ददृशे तदा
दक्षस्य इव क्रतुम् हन्तुम् उद्यतस्य पिनाकिनी
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā tejasā āviṣṭam prāvyathan vana devatāḥ
tasya ruṣṭsya rūpam tu rāmasya dadṛśe tadā
dakṣasya iva kratum hantum udyatasya pinākinī
english: And seeing him filled with energy, the sylvan deities were extremely pained*. And the aspect of the enraged Rāma appeared like that of the holder of Pināka, intent upon destroying Dakşa's sacrifice. Another reading is:-The sylvan deities fled away.

sanskrit: तत् कार्मुकैः आभरणैः रथैः चतत् वर्माभिः च अग्नि समान वर्णैः
बभूव सैन्यम् पिशित अशनिनाम्सूर्य उदये नीलम् इव अभ्र जालम्
transliteration: tat kārmukaiḥ ābharaṇaiḥ rathaiḥ catat varmābhiḥ ca agni samāna varṇaiḥ
babhūva sainyam piśita aśanināmsūrya udaye nīlam iva abhra jālam
english: Furnished with bows and ornaments and cars and mail hued like fire, that army of those subsisting on flesh, appeared like masses of blue clouds at sunrise.

sanskrit: अवष्टब्ध धनुम् रामम् क्रुद्धम् च रिपु घातिनम्
ददर्श आश्रमम् आगम्य खरः सह पुरःसरैः
transliteration: avaṣṭabdha dhanum rāmam kruddham ca ripu ghātinam
dadarśa āśramam āgamya kharaḥ saha puraḥsaraiḥ
english: Coming to the asylum, Khara in company with those that went before him, saw that slayer of foes, the enraged Rāma, holding his bow. And seeing him, Khara possessing a shrill voice, raising his bow, commanded to the charioteer to drive towards Rāma, Drive on!

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा सगुणम् चापम् उद्यम्य खर निःस्वनम्
रामस्य अभिमुखम् सूतम् चोद्यताम् इति अचोदयत्
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā saguṇam cāpam udyamya khara niḥsvanam
rāmasya abhimukham sūtam codyatām iti acodayat
english: Coming to the asylum, Khara in company with those that went before him, saw that slayer of foes, the enraged Rāma, holding his bow. And seeing him, Khara possessing a shrill voice, raising his bow, commanded to the charioteer to drive towards Rāma, Drive on!

sanskrit: स खरस्य आज्ञया सूतः तुरगान् समचोदयत्
यत्र रामो महाबाहुः एको धुन्वन् धनुः स्थितः
transliteration: sa kharasya ājñayā sūtaḥ turagān samacodayat
yatra rāmo mahābāhuḥ eko dhunvan dhanuḥ sthitaḥ
english: At Khara's command, the charioteer drove the steeds to where the mighty—arined Rāma stood alone, holding his bow.

sanskrit: तम् तु निष्पतितम् दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ते रजनी चराः
transliteration: tam tu niṣpatitam dṛṣṭvā sarve te rajanī carāḥ
english: And seeing him (Khara) entered the field, all those rangers of the night-the counsellers-uttering mighty shouts, cnvironed him round.

sanskrit: स तेषाम् यातुधानानाम् मध्ये रथः गतः खरः
बभूव मध्ये ताराणाम् लोहितांग इव उदितः
transliteration: sa teṣām yātudhānānām madhye rathaḥ gataḥ kharaḥ
babhūva madhye tārāṇām lohitāṃga iva uditaḥ
english: Khara stationed on his car in the midst of Rākşasas appeared like red bodied one risen in the midst of the stars.

sanskrit: ततः शर सहस्रेन रामम् अप्रतिम ओजसम्
transliteration: tataḥ śara sahasrena rāmam apratima ojasam
english: Then in battle Khara, afflicting Rāma of incomparable energy with a thousand shafts, uttered a tremendous roar.

sanskrit: ततः तम् भीम धन्वानम् क्रुद्धाः सर्वे निशाचराः
रामम् नाना विधैः शस्त्रैः अभ्यवर्षन्त दुर्जयम्
transliteration: tataḥ tam bhīma dhanvānam kruddhāḥ sarve niśācarāḥ
rāmam nānā vidhaiḥ śastraiḥ abhyavarṣanta durjayam
english: Then all the rangers of the night, waxing exceeding wroth, showered various weapons on that terrible bowman, the invincible Rāma.

sanskrit: मुद्गरैः आयसैः शूलैः प्रासैः खड्गैः परश्वधैः
राक्षसाः समरे रामम् निजघ्नू रोष तत्पराः
transliteration: mudgaraiḥ āyasaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ
rākṣasāḥ samare rāmam nijaghnū roṣa tatparāḥ
english: And wrought up with rage, the Rākṣasas in battle assailed him with iron clubs, and darts, and prāsas, and swords, and axes.

sanskrit: अभ्यधावन्त काकुत्स्थम् रथैः वाजिभिः एव च
transliteration: abhyadhāvanta kākutstham rathaiḥ vājibhiḥ eva ca
english: And resembling clouds (in hue), the exceedingly strong Rākṣasas, having huge bodies, darted towards Kākutstha by means of steeds and cars.

sanskrit: गजैः पर्वत कूट अभैः रामम् युद्धे जिंघासवः
ते रामे शर वर्षाणि व्यसृजन् रक्षसाम् गणाः
transliteration: gajaiḥ parvata kūṭa abhaiḥ rāmam yuddhe jiṃghāsavaḥ
te rāme śara varṣāṇi vyasṛjan rakṣasām gaṇāḥ

sanskrit: तिथिषु इव महादेवो वृतः पारिषदाम् गणैः
तानि मुक्तानि शस्त्राणि यातुधानैः स राघवः
transliteration: tithiṣu iva mahādevo vṛtaḥ pāriṣadām gaṇaiḥ
tāni muktāni śastrāṇi yātudhānaiḥ sa rāghavaḥ

sanskrit: प्रतिजग्राह विशिखैः नदि ओघान् इव सागरः
स तैः प्रहरणैः घोरैः भिन्न गात्रो न विव्यथे
transliteration: pratijagrāha viśikhaiḥ nadi oghān iva sāgaraḥ
sa taiḥ praharaṇaiḥ ghoraiḥ bhinna gātro na vivyathe

sanskrit: रामः प्रदीप्तैर् बहुभिर् वज्रैर् इव महा अचलः
स विद्धः क्षतज दिग्धः सर्व गात्रेषु राघवः
transliteration: rāmaḥ pradīptair bahubhir vajrair iva mahā acalaḥ
sa viddhaḥ kṣataja digdhaḥ sarva gātreṣu rāghavaḥ

sanskrit: बभूव रामः सन्ध्य अभ्रैः दिवाकर इव आवृतः
विषेदुर् देव गन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च परम ऋषयः
transliteration: babhūva rāmaḥ sandhya abhraiḥ divākara iva āvṛtaḥ
viṣedur deva gandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ

sanskrit: एकम् सहस्रैः बहुभिः तदा दृष्ट्वा समावृतम्
ततो रामः तु सुसंक्रुद्धो मण्डली कृत कार्मुकः
transliteration: ekam sahasraiḥ bahubhiḥ tadā dṛṣṭvā samāvṛtam
tato rāmaḥ tu susaṃkruddho maṇḍalī kṛta kārmukaḥ

sanskrit: ससर्ज निशितान् बाणान् शतशः अथ सहस्रशः
transliteration: sasarja niśitān bāṇān śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ
english: Then Rama getting enraged, bringing his bow to a circle, discharged sharpened shafts by hundreds and by thousands. And as if in sport, Rāma in the conflict shot irresistible (shafts) furnished with Kanka feathers, and decked with gold, irresistible, capable of inflicting extreme pain, and resembling the noose of Death.

sanskrit: मुमोच लीलया रामः कंकपत्रान् कांचन भूषणान्
ते शराः शत्रु सैन्येषु मुक्ता रामेण लीलया
transliteration: mumoca līlayā rāmaḥ kaṃkapatrān kāṃcana bhūṣaṇān
te śarāḥ śatru sainyeṣu muktā rāmeṇa līlayā
english: And sportively discharged by Rāma, those arrows deprived the Rākṣasas of their lives, like the noose forged by death.

sanskrit: आददू रक्षसाम् प्राणान् पाशाः कालकृता इव
भित्त्वा राक्षस देहान् ताम् ते शरा रुधिर आप्लुताः
transliteration: ādadū rakṣasām prāṇān pāśāḥ kālakṛtā iva
bhittvā rākṣasa dehān tām te śarā rudhira āplutāḥ

sanskrit: अंतरिक्ष गता रेजुः दीप्त अग्नि सम तेजसः
असंख्येयाः तु रामस्य सायकाः चाप मण्डलात्
transliteration: aṃtarikṣa gatā rejuḥ dīpta agni sama tejasaḥ
asaṃkhyeyāḥ tu rāmasya sāyakāḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt

sanskrit: विनिष्पेतुः अतीव उग्रा रक्षः प्राण अपहारिणः
तैः धनूंषि ध्वज अग्राणि चर्माणि च शिरांसि च
transliteration: viniṣpetuḥ atīva ugrā rakṣaḥ prāṇa apahāriṇaḥ
taiḥ dhanūṃṣi dhvaja agrāṇi carmāṇi ca śirāṃsi ca

sanskrit: बहून् स हस्त आभरणान् ऊरून् करि कर उपमान्
चिछेद रामः समरे शतशः अथ सहस्रशः
transliteration: bahūn sa hasta ābharaṇān ūrūn kari kara upamān
cicheda rāmaḥ samare śataśaḥ atha sahasraśaḥ
english: And with those Rāma severed bows, in baitle by hundreds and by thousands and flag ends, and shields, and mail, and many arms with embellished hands, resembling the trunks of elephants.

sanskrit: हयान् कांचन सन्नाहान् रथ युक्तान् स सारथीन्
गजाम् च स गज आरोहान् स हयान् सारधिनः तदा
transliteration: hayān kāṃcana sannāhān ratha yuktān sa sārathīn
gajām ca sa gaja ārohān sa hayān sāradhinaḥ tadā
english: And the arrows of Rāma discharged from the string pierced and cut off steeds mailed in gold, yoked to cars, together with the charioteer; and elephants with their riders; and horsemen with horses. And slaying foot-soldiers, he despatched them to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: चिछिदुः बिभिदुः च एव राम बाणा गुण च्युताः
पदातीन् समरे हत्वा हि अनयत् यम सदनम्
transliteration: cichiduḥ bibhiduḥ ca eva rāma bāṇā guṇa cyutāḥ
padātīn samare hatvā hi anayat yama sadanam
english: And the arrows of Rāma discharged from the string pierced and cut off steeds mailed in gold, yoked to cars, together with the charioteer; and elephants with their riders; and horsemen with horses. And slaying foot-soldiers, he despatched them to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः विकर्णिभिः
भीमम् आर्त स्वरम् चक्रुः छिद्यमाना निशाचराः
transliteration: tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkṣṇa agraiḥ vikarṇibhiḥ
bhīmam ārta svaram cakruḥ chidyamānā niśācarāḥ
english: And cut off with nālīkas (steel-pointed arrows) and, nārācas (arrows wholly made of steel), and sharp-pointed vikarnas (barbed arrows), the rangers of the night uttered dreadful howls of distress.

sanskrit: तत् सैन्यम् निशितैः बाणैः अर्दितम् मर्म भेदिभिः
न रामेण सुखम् लेभे शुष्कम् वनम् इव अग्निना
transliteration: tat sainyam niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ arditam marma bhedibhiḥ
na rāmeṇa sukham lebhe śuṣkam vanam iva agninā
english: And like a withered wood afflicted by fire, that host harassed by the various marrowpiercing* shafts shot by Rāma, did not attain ease. Another reading is, sharpened.

sanskrit: केचिद् भीम बलाः शूराः प्रासान् शूलान् परश्वधान्
transliteration: kecid bhīma balāḥ śūrāḥ prāsān śūlān paraśvadhān
english: And some heroic rangers of the night possessed of great strength, waxing furious, threw at Rāma rrāsas, and darts and axes. Another reading: remaining before Rāma, threw powerful weapons.

sanskrit: तेषाम् बाणैः महाबाहुः शस्त्राणि आवार्य वीर्यवान्
जहार समरे प्राणान् चिच्छेद च शिरो धरान्
transliteration: teṣām bāṇaiḥ mahābāhuḥ śastrāṇi āvārya vīryavān
jahāra samare prāṇān ciccheda ca śiro dharān
english: Thereupon resisting by means of shafts those weapons of theirs, the mighty-armed Rāma endued with prowess, took their lives in the conflict, and cut off the heads (of warriors).

sanskrit: ते छिन्न शिरसः पेतुः छिन्न चर्म शरासनाः
सुपर्ण वात विक्षिप्ता जगत्याम् पादपा यथा
transliteration: te chinna śirasaḥ petuḥ chinna carma śarāsanāḥ
suparṇa vāta vikṣiptā jagatyām pādapā yathā
english: And having their heads, and shields and bowstrings, severed, they fell as fall on the earth trees thrown down by blasts froin the wings of Suparņa*. Those rangers of the night that remained there, wounded by arrows, and losing heart, fled with speed to Khara, to seek his protection. *Lit.-Of fair feather. A name of Garuda.

sanskrit: अवशिष्टाः च ये तत्र विषण्णाः ते निशाचराः
खरम् एव अभ्यधावन्त शरणार्थम् शर आहताः
transliteration: avaśiṣṭāḥ ca ye tatra viṣaṇṇāḥ te niśācarāḥ
kharam eva abhyadhāvanta śaraṇārtham śara āhatāḥ
english: And having their heads, and shields and bowstrings, severed, they fell as fall on the earth trees thrown down by blasts froin the wings of Suparņa*. Those rangers of the night that remained there, wounded by arrows, and losing heart, fled with speed to Khara, to seek his protection. *Lit.-Of fair feather. A name of Garuda.

sanskrit: तान् सर्वान् धनुर् आदाय समाश्वास्य च दूषणः
अभ्यधावत सुसंक्रुद्धः क्रुद्धः [रुद्रम्] क्रुद्ध इव अन्तकः
transliteration: tān sarvān dhanur ādāya samāśvāsya ca dūṣaṇaḥ
abhyadhāvata susaṃkruddhaḥ kruddhaḥ [rudram] kruddha iva antakaḥ
english: Thereat, encouraging them, Dāsana, taking his bow, ran furiously in high rage against Răma, like the enraged Destroyer himself,

sanskrit: निवृत्ताः तु पुनः सर्वे दूषण आश्रय निर्भयाः
रामम् एव अभ्यधावन्त साल ताल शिल आयुधाः
transliteration: nivṛttāḥ tu punaḥ sarve dūṣaṇa āśraya nirbhayāḥ
rāmam eva abhyadhāvanta sāla tāla śila āyudhāḥ
english: And rallied again (by Dāsana) and, their fear dispelled through their having founded refuge with him, they armed with sālas, tālas, and crags, darted against Rāma.

sanskrit: शूल मुद्गर हस्ताः च पाश हस्ता महाबलाः
सृजन्तः शर वर्षाणि शस्त्र वर्षाणि संयुगे
transliteration: śūla mudgara hastāḥ ca pāśa hastā mahābalāḥ
sṛjantaḥ śara varṣāṇi śastra varṣāṇi saṃyuge
english: And bearing in their hands darts, and clubs, and nooses, those exceedingly strong ones showered in battle shafts and weapons.

sanskrit: द्रुम वर्षाणि मुंचन्तः शिला वर्षाणि राक्षसाः
तद् बभूव अद्भुतम् युद्धम् तुमुलम् रोम हर्षणम्
transliteration: druma varṣāṇi muṃcantaḥ śilā varṣāṇi rākṣasāḥ
tad babhūva adbhutam yuddham tumulam roma harṣaṇam
english: And the Räkşasas discharged vollies of trees and crags. And capable of making one's hair stand on end, that battle was dreadful and furious and now on the side of Rāma and now again on : that of the Raksasas.

sanskrit: रामस्य अस्य महाघोरम् पुनः तेषाम् च रक्षसाम्
ते समन्तात् अभिक्रुद्धा राघवम् पुनर् आर्दयन्
transliteration: rāmasya asya mahāghoram punaḥ teṣām ca rakṣasām
te samantāt abhikruddhā rāghavam punar ārdayan

sanskrit: ततः सर्वा दिशो दृष्ट्वा प्रदिशाः च समावृताः
राक्षसैः सर्वतः प्राप्तैः शर वर्षाभिः आवृतः
transliteration: tataḥ sarvā diśo dṛṣṭvā pradiśāḥ ca samāvṛtāḥ
rākṣasaiḥ sarvataḥ prāptaiḥ śara varṣābhiḥ āvṛtaḥ
english: And waxing exceedingly wroth, they bore on him hard from all sides. Then finding all directions entirely covered with Rākṣasas, and showers of shafts, that one gifted with mighty strength, sending up a terrific shout, fixed (on the bow-string) the exceedingly effulgent Gandharva weapon (for discharging it) among the Raksasas.

sanskrit: स कृत्वा भैरवम् नादम् अस्त्रम् परम भास्वरम्
transliteration: sa kṛtvā bhairavam nādam astram parama bhāsvaram
english: Then thousands of shafts went forth from the circle of his bow; and all directions were covered with thronging arrows.

sanskrit: ततः शर सहस्राणि निर्ययुः चाप मण्डलात्
सर्वा दश दिशो बानैः आपूर्यन्त समागतैः
transliteration: tataḥ śara sahasrāṇi niryayuḥ cāpa maṇḍalāt
sarvā daśa diśo bānaiḥ āpūryanta samāgataiḥ
english: Then thousands of shafts went forth from the circle of his bow; and all directions were covered with thronging arrows.

sanskrit: न आददानाम् शरान् घोरान् विमुंचंतम् शर उत्तमान्
विकर्षमाणम् पश्यन्ति राक्षसाः ते शर आर्दिताः
transliteration: na ādadānām śarān ghorān vimuṃcaṃtam śara uttamān
vikarṣamāṇam paśyanti rākṣasāḥ te śara ārditāḥ
english: And those Rākṣasas, afflicted with arrows could not see Rāma how he took out his dread shafts, nor how he discharged those excellent shafts; they only saw him drawing his bow.

sanskrit: शर अन्धकारम् आकाशम् आवृणोत् स दिवाकरम्
बभूव अवस्थितो रामः प्रक्षिपन् इव तान् शरान्
transliteration: śara andhakāram ākāśam āvṛṇot sa divākaram
babhūva avasthito rāmaḥ prakṣipan iva tān śarān
english: And the darkness spread by the arrows envelope the sky with the sun. And Rāma stationed there continued pouring in shafts.

sanskrit: युगपत् पतमानैः च युगपच्च हतैः भ्रिशम्
युगपत् पतितैः चैव विकीर्णा वसुधा अभवत्
transliteration: yugapat patamānaiḥ ca yugapacca hataiḥ bhriśam
yugapat patitaiḥ caiva vikīrṇā vasudhā abhavat
english: And the earth was covered with shafts shot, and alighting, and alighted simultaneously. And at places were seen Rākṣasas by thousands slain, falling, enfeebled, torn and riven.

sanskrit: निहताः पतिताः क्षीणा च्छिन्न भिन्न विदारिताः
तत्र तत्र स्म दृश्यन्ते राक्षसाः ते सहस्रशः
transliteration: nihatāḥ patitāḥ kṣīṇā cchinna bhinna vidāritāḥ
tatra tatra sma dṛśyante rākṣasāḥ te sahasraśaḥ
english: And the earth was covered with shafts shot, and alighting, and alighted simultaneously. And at places were seen Rākṣasas by thousands slain, falling, enfeebled, torn and riven.

sanskrit: स उष्णीषैः उत्तम अन्गैः च स अंगदैः बाहुभिः तथा
ऊरुभिः बाहुभिः च्छिन्नैः नाना रूपैः विभूषणैः
transliteration: sa uṣṇīṣaiḥ uttama angaiḥ ca sa aṃgadaiḥ bāhubhiḥ tathā
ūrubhiḥ bāhubhiḥ cchinnaiḥ nānā rūpaiḥ vibhūṣaṇaiḥ

sanskrit: हयैः च द्विप मुख्यैः च रथैः भिन्नैः अनेकशः
चामर व्यजनैः छत्रैः ध्वजैः नाना विधैः अपि
transliteration: hayaiḥ ca dvipa mukhyaiḥ ca rathaiḥ bhinnaiḥ anekaśaḥ
cāmara vyajanaiḥ chatraiḥ dhvajaiḥ nānā vidhaiḥ api

sanskrit: रामेण बाण अभिहतैः विच्छिन्नैः शूल पट्टिशैः
खड्गैः खण्डीकृतैः प्रासैः विकीर्णैः च पश्वधैः
transliteration: rāmeṇa bāṇa abhihataiḥ vicchinnaiḥ śūla paṭṭiśaiḥ
khaḍgaiḥ khaṇḍīkṛtaiḥ prāsaiḥ vikīrṇaiḥ ca paśvadhaiḥ

sanskrit: चूणिताभिः शिलाभिः च शरैः चित्रैः अनेकशः
विच्छिन्नैः समरे भूमिः विस्तीर्णा आभूत् भयंकरा
transliteration: cūṇitābhiḥ śilābhiḥ ca śaraiḥ citraiḥ anekaśaḥ
vicchinnaiḥ samare bhūmiḥ vistīrṇā ābhūt bhayaṃkarā

sanskrit: तान् दृष्ट्वा निहतान् सर्वे रक्षसाः परम आतुराः
न तत्र चलितुम् शक्ता रामम् पर पुरंजयम्
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā nihatān sarve rakṣasāḥ parama āturāḥ
na tatra calitum śaktā rāmam para puraṃjayam
english: Beholding all those stain, the (remaining) Raksasas, sore distressed, could not (again) advance before that captor of hostile capitals Rāma.

sanskrit: दूषणः तु स्वकम् सैन्यम् हन्यमानम् विलोक्य च
transliteration: dūṣaṇaḥ tu svakam sainyam hanyamānam vilokya ca
english: Finding his own forces slaughtered, the mighty-armed Düşaņa speedily ordered five thousand Rākşasas, gifted with tremendous velocity, difficult of being approached, who never turned from the field.

sanskrit: ते शूलैः पट्टिशैः कदगैः शिला वरषैः द्रुमैः
transliteration: te śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kadagaiḥ śilā varaṣaiḥ drumaiḥ

sanskrit: शर वर्षैः विच्छिन्नम् ववर्षुः तम् समन्ततः
तत् द्रुमाणाम् शिलानाम् च वर्षम् प्राण हरम् महत्
transliteration: śara varṣaiḥ vicchinnam vavarṣuḥ tam samantataḥ
tat drumāṇām śilānām ca varṣam prāṇa haram mahat

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च तद् वर्षम् निमीलित इव ऋषभः
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tad varṣam nimīlita iva ṛṣabhaḥ

sanskrit: रामः क्रोधम् परम् लेभे वध अर्थम् सर्व रक्षसाम्
ततः क्रोध समाविष्टः प्रदीप्त इव तेजसा
transliteration: rāmaḥ krodham param lebhe vadha artham sarva rakṣasām
tataḥ krodha samāviṣṭaḥ pradīpta iva tejasā

sanskrit: शरैः अभ्यकिरत् सैन्यम् सर्वतः सह दूषणम्
ततः सेना पतिः क्रुद्धो दूषणः शत्रु दूषणः
transliteration: śaraiḥ abhyakirat sainyam sarvataḥ saha dūṣaṇam
tataḥ senā patiḥ kruddho dūṣaṇaḥ śatru dūṣaṇaḥ

sanskrit: शरैः अशनि कल्पैः तम् राघवम् समवारयत्
ततो रामः संक्रुद्धः क्षुरेण अस्य महत् धनुः
transliteration: śaraiḥ aśani kalpaiḥ tam rāghavam samavārayat
tato rāmaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kṣureṇa asya mahat dhanuḥ

sanskrit: चिच्छेद समरे वीरः चतुर्भिः चतुरो हयान्
हत्वा च अश्वान् शरैः तीक्ष्णैः अर्थ चन्द्रेण सारथे
transliteration: ciccheda samare vīraḥ caturbhiḥ caturo hayān
hatvā ca aśvān śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ artha candreṇa sārathe
english: Then heroic Răma highly angered, severed his (Dusana's) mighty bow with shafts sharp as razors, and slew his four horses by ineans of as many shafts. And having slain the steeds, he (Rāma) cut off the head of the charioteer by means of a crescent-shaped weapon, and pierced the (Rakşasa Dūşaņa) in the breast with a brace of shafts.

sanskrit: शिरो जहार तद् रक्षः त्रिभिर् विव्याध वक्षसि
स च्छिन्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः
transliteration: śiro jahāra tad rakṣaḥ tribhir vivyādha vakṣasi
sa cchinna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ

sanskrit: जग्राह गिरि शृंग आभम् परिघम् रोम हर्षणम्
वेष्टितम् कांचनैः पट्टैः देव सैन्य अभिमर्दनम्
transliteration: jagrāha giri śṛṃga ābham parigham roma harṣaṇam
veṣṭitam kāṃcanaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ deva sainya abhimardanam

sanskrit: आयसैः शंकुभिः तीक्ष्णैः कीर्णम् पर वसा उक्षिताम्
वज्र अशनि सम स्पर्शम् पर गोपुर दारणम्
transliteration: āyasaiḥ śaṃkubhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ kīrṇam para vasā ukṣitām
vajra aśani sama sparśam para gopura dāraṇam

sanskrit: तम् महा उरग संकाशम् प्रगृह्य परिघम् रणे
दूषणो अभ्यपतत् रामम् क्रूर कर्मा निशाचरः
transliteration: tam mahā uraga saṃkāśam pragṛhya parigham raṇe
dūṣaṇo abhyapatat rāmam krūra karmā niśācaraḥ
english: And taking up in that encounter the parigha (an iron club) resembling a mighty snake, that ranger of the night of cruel deeds Duşaņa, rushed towards Rāina.

sanskrit: द्वाभ्याम् शराभ्याम् चिच्छेद स हस्त आभरणौ भुजौ
transliteration: dvābhyām śarābhyām ciccheda sa hasta ābharaṇau bhujau
english: And as Dūsuņa was rushing forward, Rāghava by means of a couple of shafts cut off his two arms with the ornaments.

sanskrit: भ्रष्टः तस्य महाकायः पपात रण मूर्धनि
परिघः छिन्न हस्तस्य शक्र ध्वज इव अग्रतः
transliteration: bhraṣṭaḥ tasya mahākāyaḥ papāta raṇa mūrdhani
parighaḥ chinna hastasya śakra dhvaja iva agrataḥ
english: And the huge parigha (an iron club) escaping from (Dusana's grasp) fell forward on the field like the banner of Sakra.

sanskrit: कराभ्याम् च विकीर्णाभ्याम् पपात भुवि दूषणः
transliteration: karābhyām ca vikīrṇābhyām papāta bhuvi dūṣaṇaḥ
english: And like a nighty elephant whose husks have fallen off, Dūşana, on his arms having been severed, fell down to the earth.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तम् पतितम् भूमौ दूषणम् निहतम् रणे
साधु साधु इति काकुत्स्थम् सर्व भूतानि अपूजयन्
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tam patitam bhūmau dūṣaṇam nihatam raṇe
sādhu sādhu iti kākutstham sarva bhūtāni apūjayan
english: Seeing Dūşaņa down on the ground, and slain in battle, all creatures, saying, ''well done! well done!" paid homage to Kākutstha.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे क्रुद्धाः त्रयः सेना अग्र यायिनः
संहत्य अभ्यद्रवन् रामम् मृत्यु पाश अवपाशिताः
transliteration: etasmin antare kruddhāḥ trayaḥ senā agra yāyinaḥ
saṃhatya abhyadravan rāmam mṛtyu pāśa avapāśitāḥ
english: In the meantime, three generals, getting wioth, being entrapped in the noose of death, rushed against Rāma in a body, viz; Mahakapāla, Stūlākșa, and the mighty Pramāthī the Rāksasa, Mahākapäla, upraising a large dart, and Sthulaksa, taking a pattisa, and Pramāthi all axe.

sanskrit: स्थूलाक्षः पट्टिशम् गृह्य प्रमाथी च परश्वधम्
दृष्ट्वा एव आपततः ताम् तु राघवः सायकैः शितैः
transliteration: sthūlākṣaḥ paṭṭiśam gṛhya pramāthī ca paraśvadham
dṛṣṭvā eva āpatataḥ tām tu rāghavaḥ sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ

sanskrit: तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः प्रतिजग्राह संप्राप्तान् अतिथीन् इव
transliteration: tīkṣṇa agraiḥ pratijagrāha saṃprāptān atithīn iva

sanskrit: असंख्येयैः तु बाण ओघैः प्रममाथ प्रमाथिनम्
transliteration: asaṃkhyeyaiḥ tu bāṇa oghaiḥ pramamātha pramāthinam
english: And Raghu's son split Mahākapāla's head, afflicted Pramăthſ with countless shafts, and lodged the eyes of Sthūlāksya with sharp shafts.

sanskrit: स पपात हतो भूमौ विटपी इव महाद्रुमः
दूषणस्य अनुगान् पंच सहस्रान् कुपितः क्षणात्
transliteration: sa papāta hato bhūmau viṭapī iva mahādrumaḥ
dūṣaṇasya anugān paṃca sahasrān kupitaḥ kṣaṇāt
english: as soon And they fell down to the earth like mighty trees of many bough. Thereat instantly inflained with wrath, Räma by means of five thousand shafts, sent as many thousands of Dusana's followers to Yama's abode.

sanskrit: हत्वा तु पंच सहस्रान् अनयत् यम सदनम्
दूषणम् निहतम् श्रुत्वा तस्य च एव पदानुगान्
transliteration: hatvā tu paṃca sahasrān anayat yama sadanam
dūṣaṇam nihatam śrutvā tasya ca eva padānugān

sanskrit: व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धो सेन अध्यक्षान् महाबलान्
अयम् विनिहतः संख्ये दूषणः स पदानुगाः
transliteration: vyādideśa kharaḥ kruddho sena adhyakṣān mahābalān
ayam vinihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇaḥ sa padānugāḥ

sanskrit: महत्या सेनया सार्धम् युद्ध्वा रामम् कुमानुषम्
शस्त्रैः नाना विध अकारैः हनध्वम् सर्व राक्षसाः
transliteration: mahatyā senayā sārdham yuddhvā rāmam kumānuṣam
śastraiḥ nānā vidha akāraiḥ hanadhvam sarva rākṣasāḥ

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा खरः क्रुद्धो रामम् एव अभि दुद्रुवे
transliteration: evam uktvā kharaḥ kruddho rāmam eva abhi dudruve

sanskrit: स सैनिकाःरमम् एव अभ्यधावंत विसृजंतः शरोत्तमान्
transliteration: sa sainikāḥramam eva abhyadhāvaṃta visṛjaṃtaḥ śarottamān

sanskrit: ततः पावक संकाशैः हेम वज्र विभूषितैः
जघन शेषम् तेजस्वी तस्य सैन्यस्य सायकैः
transliteration: tataḥ pāvaka saṃkāśaiḥ hema vajra vibhūṣitaiḥ
jaghana śeṣam tejasvī tasya sainyasya sāyakaiḥ
english: Threat with shafts resembling fire, and decked with diamonds and with gold, (Rāma) possessed of energy destroyed the rest of his (Khara's) forces.

sanskrit: ते रुक्म पुंखा विशिखाः स धूमा इव पावकाः
निजघ्नुः तानि रक्षांसि वज्रा इव महाद्रुमान्
transliteration: te rukma puṃkhā viśikhāḥ sa dhūmā iva pāvakāḥ
nijaghnuḥ tāni rakṣāṃsi vajrā iva mahādrumān
english: And as the thunderbolt slay the mighty, Asuras, those shafts studded with gold, and like to smoking fire, slew those Rākşasas.

sanskrit: रक्षसाम् तु शतम् रामः शतेन एकेन कर्णिना
सहस्रम् तु सहस्रेण जघान रण मूर्धनि
transliteration: rakṣasām tu śatam rāmaḥ śatena ekena karṇinā
sahasram tu sahasreṇa jaghāna raṇa mūrdhani
english: And in the field Rāma slew an hundred Rāks asa with an hundred Karnis, and a thousand (again) with a thousand.

sanskrit: तैः भिन्न वर्म आभरणाः छिन्न भिन्न शर आसनाः
transliteration: taiḥ bhinna varma ābharaṇāḥ chinna bhinna śara āsanāḥ
english: And, their armour and ornaments severed, and their bows broken in shivers, those rangers of the night fell down on the earth, bathed in blood.

sanskrit: तैः मुक्त केशैः समरे पतितैः शोणित उक्षितैः
विस्तीर्णा वसुधा कृत्स्ना महावेदिः कुशैः इव
transliteration: taiḥ mukta keśaiḥ samare patitaiḥ śoṇita ukṣitaiḥ
vistīrṇā vasudhā kṛtsnā mahāvediḥ kuśaiḥ iva
english: And as a spacious dais is covered with Kusa, the entire field was scattered with the Rākṣasas fallen in battle with hair dishevelled, and covered with blood.

sanskrit: तत् क्षणे तु महा घोरम् वनम् निहत राक्षसम्
बभूव निरय प्रख्यम् मांस शोणित कर्दमम्
transliteration: tat kṣaṇe tu mahā ghoram vanam nihata rākṣasam
babhūva niraya prakhyam māṃsa śoṇita kardamam
english: And at that time that fearful forest, with the Rākṣasas slaughtered, and with its clay mired with flesh and blood, resembled hell itself.
Fourteen thousand Rākṣasas of dreadful deeds were slain by Rāma single, a human being, fighting, (moreover) on foot.

sanskrit: तस्य सैन्यस्य सर्वस्य खरः शेषो महारथः
राक्षसः त्रिशिराः चैव रामः च रिपुसूदनः
transliteration: tasya sainyasya sarvasya kharaḥ śeṣo mahārathaḥ
rākṣasaḥ triśirāḥ caiva rāmaḥ ca ripusūdanaḥ
english: And the remnant of his (Khara's) forces were that mighty car-warrior, Khara himself, and the Raksasa, Trisirā; and (on the other side) was that destroyer of foes-Rāma.

sanskrit: शेषा हता महावीर्या राक्षसा रण मूर्धनि
transliteration: śeṣā hatā mahāvīryā rākṣasā raṇa mūrdhani
english: The rest of the Rākşasas, gifted with great prowess, terrible, and difficult of being withstood, were all slain in battle by the elder brother of Laksmana.

sanskrit: ततः तु तद् भीम बलम् महा आहवेसमीक्ष्य रामेण हतम् बलीयसा
रथेन रामम् महता खरः ततःसमाससाद इन्द्र इव उद्यत अशनिः
transliteration: tataḥ tu tad bhīma balam mahā āhavesamīkṣya rāmeṇa hatam balīyasā
rathena rāmam mahatā kharaḥ tataḥsamāsasāda indra iva udyata aśaniḥ
english: Then seeing that dreadful army destroyed in terrible conflict by the mighty Rāma, Khara ascending a great car, advanced before Rāma, like Indra with the upraised thunderbolt. Then seeing that dreadful army destroyed in terrible conflict by the mighty Rāma, Khara ascending a great car, advanced before Rāma, like Indra with the upraised thunderbolt.

sanskrit: खरम् तु राम अभिमुखम् प्रयांतम् वाहिनी पतिः
राक्षसः त्रिशिरा नाम संनिपत्य इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: kharam tu rāma abhimukham prayāṃtam vāhinī patiḥ
rākṣasaḥ triśirā nāma saṃnipatya idam abravīt
english: As Khara was advancing before Rāma, that leader of the army named Triſirā, approaching him, said.

sanskrit: माम् नियोजय विक्रांतम् त्वम् निवर्तस्व साहसात्
transliteration: mām niyojaya vikrāṃtam tvam nivartasva sāhasāt
english: Do you employ me, who am possessed of prowess, and yourself desist from this rashness. Behold the mighty-armed Rāma brought down in battle.

sanskrit: प्रतिजानामि ते सत्यम् आयुधम् च अहम् आलभे
यथा रामम् वधिष्यामि वधार्हम् सर्व रक्षसाम्
transliteration: pratijānāmi te satyam āyudham ca aham ālabhe
yathā rāmam vadhiṣyāmi vadhārham sarva rakṣasām
english: I swear (to you) truly; I touch this weapon, (to say) that I will stay Rāma, who deserves to be slain by all the Rākşasas.

sanskrit: अहम् वा अस्य रणे मृत्युः एष वा समरे मम
विनिवर्त्य रण उत्साहम् मुहूर्तम् प्राश्निको भव
transliteration: aham vā asya raṇe mṛtyuḥ eṣa vā samare mama
vinivartya raṇa utsāham muhūrtam prāśniko bhava
english: Either I shall prove his death in battle, or he shall prove mine. Restraining your martial ardour, do you for a while become a witness.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टो वा हते रामे जनस्थानम् प्रयास्यसि
मयि वा निहते रामम् संयुगाय प्रयास्यसि
transliteration: prahṛṣṭo vā hate rāme janasthānam prayāsyasi
mayi vā nihate rāmam saṃyugāya prayāsyasi
english: Either, joyed in consequence of Rāma being slain, you shall repair to Janasthāna; or I being slain you shall enter the field (against him).

sanskrit: खरः त्रिशिरसा तेन मृत्यु लोभात् प्रसादितः
गच्छ युध्य इति अनुज्ञातो राघव अभिमुखो ययौ
transliteration: kharaḥ triśirasā tena mṛtyu lobhāt prasāditaḥ
gaccha yudhya iti anujñāto rāghava abhimukho yayau
english: Thus satisfied by Trisirā, from his desire to meet with death, the latter, on being permitted with Go, proceeded towards Rāma.

sanskrit: त्रिशिराः तु रथेन एव वाजि युक्तेन भास्वता
अभ्यद्रवत् रणे रामम् त्रि शृंग इव पर्वतः
transliteration: triśirāḥ tu rathena eva vāji yuktena bhāsvatā
abhyadravat raṇe rāmam tri śṛṃga iva parvataḥ
english: And like a hill with three sumınits, Trisirā rushed towards Rāma on an effulgent car yoked with steeds.

sanskrit: शर धारा समूहान् स महामेघ इव उत्सृजन्
व्यसृजत् सदृशम् नादम् जल आर्द्रस्य इव दुन्दुभेः
transliteration: śara dhārā samūhān sa mahāmegha iva utsṛjan
vyasṛjat sadṛśam nādam jala ārdrasya iva dundubheḥ
english: And as a mighty cloud pours down shower, (Trisirā) discharging vollies of shafts, uttered a roar resembling the sound of a wet kettledrum.
And seeing that the Rākşasa Trisirã was advancing, Raghava resisted (his attack) by discharging sharpened shafts.

sanskrit: स संप्रहारः तुमुलो राम त्रिशिरसोः तदा
संबभूव अतीव बलिनोः सिंह कुं~जरयोः इव
transliteration: sa saṃprahāraḥ tumulo rāma triśirasoḥ tadā
saṃbabhūva atīva balinoḥ siṃha kuṃjarayoḥ iva
english: And that encounter of those exceedingly powerful ones, Rāma and Triſiră was fierce, like to that between a lion and an elephant.

sanskrit: ततः त्रिशिरसा बाणैः ललाटे ताडितः त्रिभिः
अमर्षी कुपितो रामः संरब्धम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ triśirasā bāṇaiḥ lalāṭe tāḍitaḥ tribhiḥ
amarṣī kupito rāmaḥ saṃrabdham idam abravīt
english: Then struck on the forehead by a brace of shafts shot by Trisirā, the wrathful Rāma enraged, and inflamed with anger, said.

sanskrit: अहो विक्रम शूरस्य राक्षसस्य ईदृशम् बलम्
पुष्पैः इव शरैः यस्य ललाटे अस्मि परिक्षतः
transliteration: aho vikrama śūrasya rākṣasasya īdṛśam balam
puṣpaiḥ iva śaraiḥ yasya lalāṭe asmi parikṣataḥ
english: Ah! such is the strength of the heroic Rākşasas! I have been wounded in the forehead with shafts resembling flowers. Do you also take the arrows shot from my bow.

sanskrit: मम अपि प्रतिगृह्णीष्व शरान् चाप गुण च्युतान्
एवम् उक्त्वा सुसंरब्धः शरान् आशीविष उपमान्
transliteration: mama api pratigṛhṇīṣva śarān cāpa guṇa cyutān
evam uktvā susaṃrabdhaḥ śarān āśīviṣa upamān

sanskrit: त्रिशिरो वक्षसि क्रुद्धो निजघान चतुर् दश
चतुर्भिः तुरगान् अस्य शरैः संनत पर्वाभिः
transliteration: triśiro vakṣasi kruddho nijaghāna catur daśa
caturbhiḥ turagān asya śaraiḥ saṃnata parvābhiḥ

sanskrit: अष्टभिः सायकैः सूतम् रथ उपस्थे न्यपातयत्
transliteration: aṣṭabhiḥ sāyakaiḥ sūtam ratha upasthe nyapātayat
english: And that energetic one by means of four shafts having their joints bent, brought down his four steeds. And by means of eight arrows (Rāma) laid low the charioteer from the front of the car.

sanskrit: रामः चिच्छेद बाणेन ध्वजम् च अस्य समुच्छ्रितम्
ततो हत रथात् तस्मात् उत्पतंतम् निशाचरम्
transliteration: rāmaḥ ciccheda bāṇena dhvajam ca asya samucchritam
tato hata rathāt tasmāt utpataṃtam niśācaram
english: And Rāma with a shaft severed his upraised standard. Then as that ranger of the night was descending from his broken car, Rāma pierced his breast with arrows, and thereat he was stupified.

sanskrit: चिच्छेद रामः तम् बाणैः हृदये सो अभवत् जडः
सायकैः च अप्रमेय आत्मा सामर्षः तस्य रक्षसः
transliteration: ciccheda rāmaḥ tam bāṇaiḥ hṛdaye so abhavat jaḍaḥ
sāyakaiḥ ca aprameya ātmā sāmarṣaḥ tasya rakṣasaḥ

sanskrit: शिरांसि अपातयत् त्रीणि वेगवद्भिः त्रिभिः शतैः
स धूम शोणित उद्गारी राम बाण अभिपीडितः
transliteration: śirāṃsi apātayat trīṇi vegavadbhiḥ tribhiḥ śataiḥ
sa dhūma śoṇita udgārī rāma bāṇa abhipīḍitaḥ

sanskrit: हत शेषाः ततो भग्ना राक्षसाः खर संश्रयाः
transliteration: hata śeṣāḥ tato bhagnā rākṣasāḥ khara saṃśrayāḥ

sanskrit: द्रवन्ति स्म न तिष्ठन्ति व्याघ्र त्रस्ता मृगा इव
तान् खरो द्रवतो दृष्ट्वा निवर्त्य रुषितः त्वरन्
रामम् एव अभिदुद्राव राहुः चन्द्रमसम् यथा
transliteration: dravanti sma na tiṣṭhanti vyāghra trastā mṛgā iva
tān kharo dravato dṛṣṭvā nivartya ruṣitaḥ tvaran
rāmam eva abhidudrāva rāhuḥ candramasam yathā
