english: And the Räksasas remaining after the rest had been slain, belonging to Khara's original forces losing heart, began to flee like deer terrified at a hunter.

sanskrit: निहतम् दूषणम् दृष्ट्वा रणे त्रिशिरसा सह
खरस्य अपि अभवत् त्रासो दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम्
transliteration: nihatam dūṣaṇam dṛṣṭvā raṇe triśirasā saha
kharasya api abhavat trāso dṛṣṭvā rāmasya vikramam
english: Seeing Düşaņa slain in fight along with Trisiră, Khara, witnessing Rāma's prowess, was filled with fear.

sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा राक्षसम् सैन्यम् अविषह्यम् महाबलम्
हतम् एकेन रामेण दूषणः त्रिशिरा अपि
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā rākṣasam sainyam aviṣahyam mahābalam
hatam ekena rāmeṇa dūṣaṇaḥ triśirā api
english: Seeing that irresistible Raksasa host-even Düşaņa and Triſirā-slain by the mighty Rāma alone, and seeing the great courage that was made in the army, that Raksasa, Khara, was seized with despondency. Then as Namuci advances against Väsava, Khara stretching his powerful bow, advanced against Răma.

sanskrit: तद् बलम् हत भूयिष्ठम् विमनाः प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसः
आससाद खरो रामम् नमुचिर् वासवम् यथा
transliteration: tad balam hata bhūyiṣṭham vimanāḥ prekṣya rākṣasaḥ
āsasāda kharo rāmam namucir vāsavam yathā
english: Seeing that irresistible Raksasa host-even Düşaņa and Triſirā-slain by the mighty Rāma alone, and seeing the great courage that was made in the army, that Raksasa, Khara, was seized with despondency. Then as Namuci advances against Väsava, Khara stretching his powerful bow, advanced against Răma.

sanskrit: विकृष्य बलवत् चापम् नाराचान् रक्त भोजनान्
खरः चिक्षेप रामाय क्रुद्धान् आशी विषान् इव
transliteration: vikṛṣya balavat cāpam nārācān rakta bhojanān
kharaḥ cikṣepa rāmāya kruddhān āśī viṣān iva
english: Khara hurled at Rāma nārācas revelling in blood, resembling infuriated venomous snakes.

sanskrit: ज्याम् विधुन्वन् सुबहुशः शिक्षया अस्त्राणि दर्शयन्
चचार समरे मार्गान् शरै रथ गतः खरः
transliteration: jyām vidhunvan subahuśaḥ śikṣayā astrāṇi darśayan
cacāra samare mārgān śarai ratha gataḥ kharaḥ
english: Repeatedly twanging his twanging his bow, Khara, mounted on his car, began to range the field, displaying his weapons through his acquired skill.

sanskrit: स सर्वाः च दिशो बाणैः प्रदिशः च महारथः
पूरयामास तम् दृष्ट्वा रामो अपि सुमहत् धनुः
transliteration: sa sarvāḥ ca diśo bāṇaiḥ pradiśaḥ ca mahārathaḥ
pūrayāmāsa tam dṛṣṭvā rāmo api sumahat dhanuḥ
english: And that mighty car-warrior covered all sides with his shafts. And secing this, Rāma of a tremendous bow with shafts incapable of being borne, and resembling tongues of flaming fire, entirely enveloped the welkin, even as a cloud pour down showers.

sanskrit: स सायकैः दुर्विषहैः स स्फुलिन्गैः इव अग्निभिः
नभः चकार अविवरम् पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिभिः
transliteration: sa sāyakaiḥ durviṣahaiḥ sa sphulingaiḥ iva agnibhiḥ
nabhaḥ cakāra avivaram parjanya iva vṛṣṭibhiḥ
english: And that mighty car-warrior covered all sides with his shafts. And secing this, Rāma of a tremendous bow with shafts incapable of being borne, and resembling tongues of flaming fire, entirely enveloped the welkin, even as a cloud pour down showers.

sanskrit: तद् बभूव शितैः बाणैः खर राम विसर्जितैः
परि आकाशम् अनाकाशम् सर्वतः शर संकुलम्
transliteration: tad babhūva śitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ khara rāma visarjitaiḥ
pari ākāśam anākāśam sarvataḥ śara saṃkulam
english: With the sharpened shafts shot by Khara and Rāma, the entire firmament on all sides was thronged.

sanskrit: शर जाल आवृतः सूर्यो न तदा स्म प्रकाशते
transliteration: śara jāla āvṛtaḥ sūryo na tadā sma prakāśate
english: And as each enraged was engaged in coping with the other, the sun, enveloped in a net-work of shafts, did not appear.

sanskrit: ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः च विकर्णिभिः
आजघान रणे रामम् तोत्रैर् इव महा द्विपम्
transliteration: tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkṣṇa agraiḥ ca vikarṇibhiḥ
ājaghāna raṇe rāmam totrair iva mahā dvipam
english: As a mighty elephant is struck with the goad, Rāma in the conflict attacked (his opponent) with nalikas and nārācas and sharp-pointed vikarna.

sanskrit: तम् रथस्थम् धनुष् पाणिम् राक्षसम् पर्यवस्थितम्
ददृशुः सर्व भूतानि पाश हस्तम् इव अंतकम्
transliteration: tam rathastham dhanuṣ pāṇim rākṣasam paryavasthitam
dadṛśuḥ sarva bhūtāni pāśa hastam iva aṃtakam
english: And as that Rākşasa sat on his car, bow in hand, all creatures saw him, as if he were the very destroyer with the noose in his hand.

sanskrit: परिश्रन्तम् महासत्त्वम् मेने रामम् खरः तदा
transliteration: pariśrantam mahāsattvam mene rāmam kharaḥ tadā
english: At this time Khara thought that Destroyer of all his forces, established in his manliness, the exceedingly powerful Rāma to be overcome with fatigue.

sanskrit: तम् सिंहम् इव विक्रान्तम् सिंह विक्रान्त गामिनम्
दृष्ट्वा न उद्विजते रामः सिंहः क्षुद्र मृगम् यथा
transliteration: tam siṃham iva vikrāntam siṃha vikrānta gāminam
dṛṣṭvā na udvijate rāmaḥ siṃhaḥ kṣudra mṛgam yathā
english: Seeing that one powerful like the lion, and gifted with the vigorous gait of the lion, Rāma was not moved, as a lion seeing a puny deer (is not moved).

sanskrit: ततः सूर्य निकाशेन रथेन महता खरः
आससाद अथ तम् रामम् पतंग इव पावकम्
transliteration: tataḥ sūrya nikāśena rathena mahatā kharaḥ
āsasāda atha tam rāmam pataṃga iva pāvakam
english: And then as an insect falls into a flame, Khara mounting a mighty car, resembling the sun, approached Rāma.

sanskrit: ततो अस्य सशरम् चापम् मुष्टि देशे महात्मनः
खरः चिच्छेद रामस्य दर्शयन् हस्त लाघवम्
transliteration: tato asya saśaram cāpam muṣṭi deśe mahātmanaḥ
kharaḥ ciccheda rāmasya darśayan hasta lāghavam
english: And, displaying his lightness of hand, Khara severed the bow of the magnanimous Rāma, with the arrow (fixed on it) at the place where it is grasped.

sanskrit: स पुनः तु अपरान् सप्त शरान् आदाय वर्मणि
निजघान रणे क्रुद्धः शक्र अशनि सम प्रभान्
transliteration: sa punaḥ tu aparān sapta śarān ādāya varmaṇi
nijaghāna raṇe kruddhaḥ śakra aśani sama prabhān
english: Then taking up seven other shafts, resplendent like the thunderbolt of Sakra, Khara, enraged, sent them into (Rāma's) main-joints, and then afflicting Rāma of unparalleled energy with a thousand shafts, Khara sent up in that conflict a loud shout.

sanskrit: ततः शर सहस्रेण रामम् अप्रतिम ओजसम्
transliteration: tataḥ śara sahasreṇa rāmam apratima ojasam
english: Then taking up seven other shafts, resplendent like the thunderbolt of Sakra, Khara, enraged, sent them into (Rāma's) main-joints, and then afflicting Rāma of unparalleled energy with a thousand shafts, Khara sent up in that conflict a loud shout.

sanskrit: ततः तत् प्रहतम् बाणैः खर मुक्तैः सुपर्वभिः
पपात कवचम् भूमौ रामस्य आदित्य वर्चसः
transliteration: tataḥ tat prahatam bāṇaiḥ khara muktaiḥ suparvabhiḥ
papāta kavacam bhūmau rāmasya āditya varcasaḥ
english: And riven by the shafts discharged by Khara, Rāma's mail resembling the sun fell to the ground.

sanskrit: स शरैः अर्पितः क्रुद्धः सर्व गात्रेषु राघवः
रराज समरे रामो विधूमो अग्निर् इव ज्वलन्
transliteration: sa śaraiḥ arpitaḥ kruddhaḥ sarva gātreṣu rāghavaḥ
rarāja samare rāmo vidhūmo agnir iva jvalan
english: And pierced with those arrow, all over his body, and inflamed with rage, Rāghava appeared in the field, like a smokeless flaming fire.

sanskrit: ततो गंभीर निर्ह्रादम् रामः शत्रु निबर्हणः
चकार अंताय स रिपोः सज्यम् अन्यन् महत् धनुः
transliteration: tato gaṃbhīra nirhrādam rāmaḥ śatru nibarhaṇaḥ
cakāra aṃtāya sa ripoḥ sajyam anyan mahat dhanuḥ
english: Then that destroyer of foes, Rāma, for compassing the end of his enemy, stringed another mighty bow, sending forth solemn sounds, the redoubtable Vaisnava bow that had been conferred on him by the Maharşi.

sanskrit: सुमहत् वैष्णवम् यत् तत् अतिसृष्टम् महर्षिणा
वरम् तत् धनुः उद्यम्य खरम् समभिधावत
transliteration: sumahat vaiṣṇavam yat tat atisṛṣṭam maharṣiṇā
varam tat dhanuḥ udyamya kharam samabhidhāvata

sanskrit: ततः कनक पुंखैः तु शरैः संनत पर्वभिः
चिच्छेद रामः संक्रुद्धः खरस्य समरे ध्वजम्
transliteration: tataḥ kanaka puṃkhaiḥ tu śaraiḥ saṃnata parvabhiḥ
ciccheda rāmaḥ saṃkruddhaḥ kharasya samare dhvajam
english: And uplifting that superior bow, Rāma rushed against Khara. Then with shafts having bent knots and golden feathers, Rāma, wrought up with rage, severed in battle Khara's standard.

sanskrit: स दर्शनीयो बहुधा विच्छिन्नः कांचनो ध्वजः
जगाम धरणीम् सूर्यो देवतानाम् इव आज्ञया
transliteration: sa darśanīyo bahudhā vicchinnaḥ kāṃcano dhvajaḥ
jagāma dharaṇīm sūryo devatānām iva ājñayā
english: And on that exceedingly graceful golden standard being hewn down it seemed as if the sun dropped to the earth at the behest of the celestials.

sanskrit: तम् चतुर्भिः खरः क्रुद्धो रामम् गात्रेषु मार्गणैः
विव्याध हृदि मर्मज्ञो मातंगम् इव तोमरैः
transliteration: tam caturbhiḥ kharaḥ kruddho rāmam gātreṣu mārgaṇaiḥ
vivyādha hṛdi marmajño mātaṃgam iva tomaraiḥ
english: And thereat Khara, understanding the import of things, fired with wrath, pierced Rāma's breast with five arrows, like one striking an elephant with a goad.

sanskrit: स रामो बहुभिः बाणैः खर कार्मुक निःसृतैः
विद्धो रुधिर सिक्तांगो बभूव रुषितो भृशम्
transliteration: sa rāmo bahubhiḥ bāṇaiḥ khara kārmuka niḥsṛtaiḥ
viddho rudhira siktāṃgo babhūva ruṣito bhṛśam
english: Rāma on being pierced with a good many shafts discharged from Khara's bow, and having his body bathed in blood, was highly wroth.

sanskrit: स धनुर् धन्विनाम् श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य परम आहवे
मुमोच परम इष्वासः षट् शरान् अभिलक्षितान्
transliteration: sa dhanur dhanvinām śreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya parama āhave
mumoca parama iṣvāsaḥ ṣaṭ śarān abhilakṣitān
english: Thereupon that foremost of bowmen, and wielder of a mighty bow, taking six shafts, let them go, after aiming at them.

sanskrit: शिरसि एकेन बाणेन द्वाभ्याम् बाह्वोर् अथ आर्पयत्
त्रिभिः चन्द्र अर्ध वक्त्रैः च वक्षसि अभिजघान ह
transliteration: śirasi ekena bāṇena dvābhyām bāhvor atha ārpayat
tribhiḥ candra ardha vaktraiḥ ca vakṣasi abhijaghāna ha
english: And with one shaft he pierced Khara's head, with two his arms, and with three arrows headed like half-moons, Rāma wounded Khara in the chest.

sanskrit: ततः पश्चात् महातेजा नाराचान् भास्कर उपमान्
जघान राक्षसम् क्रुद्धः त्रयोदश शिला अशितान्
transliteration: tataḥ paścāt mahātejā nārācān bhāskara upamān
jaghāna rākṣasam kruddhaḥ trayodaśa śilā aśitān

sanskrit: रथस्य युगम् एकेन चतुर्भिः शबलान् हयान्
षष्ठेन च शिरः संख्ये चिच्छेद खर सारथेः
transliteration: rathasya yugam ekena caturbhiḥ śabalān hayān
ṣaṣṭhena ca śiraḥ saṃkhye ciccheda khara sāratheḥ

sanskrit: त्रिभिः त्रिवेणून् बलवान् द्वाभ्याम् अक्षम् महाबलः
द्वादशेन तु बाणेन खरस्य स शरम् धनुः
transliteration: tribhiḥ triveṇūn balavān dvābhyām akṣam mahābalaḥ
dvādaśena tu bāṇena kharasya sa śaram dhanuḥ

sanskrit: छित्त्वा वज्र निकाशेन राघवः प्रहसन् इव
त्रयोदशेन इन्द्र समो बिभेद समरे खरम्
transliteration: chittvā vajra nikāśena rāghavaḥ prahasan iva
trayodaśena indra samo bibheda samare kharam

sanskrit: प्रभग्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः
गदा पाणिः अवप्लुत्य तस्थौ भूमौ खरः तदा
transliteration: prabhagna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ
gadā pāṇiḥ avaplutya tasthau bhūmau kharaḥ tadā
english: Then with his bow shattered, deprived of his car, (Khara) having his horses slain as well as his charioteer killed, taking a mace in his hand leaped to the ground, and stood there.

sanskrit: तत् कर्म रामस्य महारथस्यसमेत्य देवाः च महर्षयः च
अपूजयन् प्रांजलयः प्रहृष्टाःतदा विमान अग्र गताः समेताः
transliteration: tat karma rāmasya mahārathasyasametya devāḥ ca maharṣayaḥ ca
apūjayan prāṃjalayaḥ prahṛṣṭāḥtadā vimāna agra gatāḥ sametāḥ
english: And the celestials and Maharsis exceedingly rejoiced, assembled in the welkin in a body, and with joined hands extolled that feat of that mighty car-warrior Rāma.

sanskrit: खरम् तु विरथम् रामो गदा पाणिम् अवस्थितम्
मृदु पूर्वम् महातेजाः परुषम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: kharam tu viratham rāmo gadā pāṇim avasthitam
mṛdu pūrvam mahātejāḥ paruṣam vākyam abravīt
english: And to Khara deprived of his car standing with a mace in his hand, that exceedingly energetic one, Rāma, precluding his speech with mildness, spoke.

sanskrit: गज अश्व रथ संबाधे बले महति तिष्ठता
कृतम् सुदारुणम् कर्म सर्व लोक जुगुप्सितम्
transliteration: gaja aśva ratha saṃbādhe bale mahati tiṣṭhatā
kṛtam sudāruṇam karma sarva loka jugupsitam

sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् ईश्वरो अपि न तिष्ठति
transliteration: trayāṇām api lokānām īśvaro api na tiṣṭhati

sanskrit: कर्म लोक विरुद्धम् तु कुर्वाणम् क्षणदा चर
तीक्ष्णम् सर्व जनो हन्ति सर्पम् दुष्टम् इव आगतम्
transliteration: karma loka viruddham tu kurvāṇam kṣaṇadā cara
tīkṣṇam sarva jano hanti sarpam duṣṭam iva āgatam

sanskrit: लोभात् पापानि कुर्वाणः कामात् वा यो न बुध्यते
हृष्टः पश्यति तस्य अन्तम् ब्राह्मणी करकात् इव
transliteration: lobhāt pāpāni kurvāṇaḥ kāmāt vā yo na budhyate
hṛṣṭaḥ paśyati tasya antam brāhmaṇī karakāt iva
english: People delightedly behold the end of him that doing an action either from covetousness or desire, dose not like a Brāhmaṇi swallowing a Karakā, see the consequence thereof.

sanskrit: किम् नु हत्वा महाभागान् फलम् प्राप्स्यसि राक्षस
transliteration: kim nu hatvā mahābhāgān phalam prāpsyasi rākṣasa
english: What, O Rākṣasa, do you gain by slaughtering exceedingly pious ascetics engaged in righteous acts, living in the forest of Dandaka?

sanskrit: न चिरम् पाप कर्माणः क्रूरा लोक जुगुप्सिताः
ऐश्वर्यम् प्राप्य तिष्ठन्ति शीर्ण मूला इव द्रुमाः
transliteration: na ciram pāpa karmāṇaḥ krūrā loka jugupsitāḥ
aiśvaryam prāpya tiṣṭhanti śīrṇa mūlā iva drumāḥ
english: Like to trees whose roots have been reduced, cruel persons, execrated of men, who perpetrate iniquitous acts, do not exist long.

sanskrit: अवश्यम् लभते कर्ता फलम् पापस्य कर्मणः
घोरम् पर्यागते काले द्रुमः पुष्पम् इव आर्तवम्
transliteration: avaśyam labhate kartā phalam pāpasya karmaṇaḥ
ghoram paryāgate kāle drumaḥ puṣpam iva ārtavam
english: As a tree puts forth blossoms in season, the doer of sinful deeds, at the hour (of repentance) inevitably reaps their fruit in the shape of dreadful anguish (of the spirit).

sanskrit: न चिरात् प्राप्यते लोके पापानाम् कर्मणाम् फलम्
स विषाणाम् इव अन्नानाम् भुक्तानाम् क्षणदाचर
transliteration: na cirāt prāpyate loke pāpānām karmaṇām phalam
sa viṣāṇām iva annānām bhuktānām kṣaṇadācara
english: O ranger of night, as the effect of having taken rice mixed with poison, appears without delay, even so also people readily reap the fruit of their own acts.

sanskrit: पापम् आचरताम् घोरम् लोकस्य अप्रियम् इच्छताम्
अहम् आसादितो राज्ञा प्राणान् हन्तुम् निशाचर
transliteration: pāpam ācaratām ghoram lokasya apriyam icchatām
aham āsādito rājñā prāṇān hantum niśācara
english: O ranger of the night, it is to take the lives of the perpetrators of dreadful sins, who wish ill to men, that I the king have come.

sanskrit: अद्य भित्वा मया मुक्ताः शराः कांचन भूषणाः
transliteration: adya bhitvā mayā muktāḥ śarāḥ kāṃcana bhūṣaṇāḥ
english: Today the gold-decked arrows discharged by ine, piercing (your body), shall enter into the carth, cleaving it, like serpents falling into an ant-hill.

sanskrit: ये त्वया दण्डकारण्ये भक्षिता धर्म चारिणः
तान् अद्य निहतः संख्ये स सैन्यो अनुगमिष्यसि
transliteration: ye tvayā daṇḍakāraṇye bhakṣitā dharma cāriṇaḥ
tān adya nihataḥ saṃkhye sa sainyo anugamiṣyasi
english: Slain in battle, you shall in company with your army, follow those people practising piety, whom you have devoured in the Dandaka forest.

sanskrit: अद्य त्वाम् निहतम् बाणैः पश्यन्तु परमर्षयः
निरयस्थम् विमानस्था ये त्वया निहता पुरा
transliteration: adya tvām nihatam bāṇaiḥ paśyantu paramarṣayaḥ
nirayastham vimānasthā ye tvayā nihatā purā
english: Today let those great saints, who had formerly been slain by you, stationed in the sky, behold you slain (in turn) with my arrows, and inhabiting hell.

sanskrit: प्रहरस्व यथा कामम् कुरु यत्नम् कुलाधम
अद्य ते पातयिष्यामि शिरः ताल फलम् यथा
transliteration: praharasva yathā kāmam kuru yatnam kulādhama
adya te pātayiṣyāmi śiraḥ tāla phalam yathā
english: Do you strike as you like. And youl that are of an odious race, do you put forth your energy. Today I will bring down your head, even as a palm falls to the ground.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण क्रुद्धः संरक्त लोचनः
प्रति उवाच ततो रामम् प्रहसन् क्रोध मूर्चितः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa kruddhaḥ saṃrakta locanaḥ
prati uvāca tato rāmam prahasan krodha mūrcitaḥ
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, Khara enraged and beyond himself with passion, with eyes reddened, replied.

sanskrit: प्राकृतान् राक्षसान् हत्वा युद्धे दशरथ आत्मज
transliteration: prākṛtān rākṣasān hatvā yuddhe daśaratha ātmaja
english: O son of Dasaratha, why having slain inferior Rākṣasas in battle, do you praise yourself without reason?

sanskrit: विक्रान्ता बलवन्तो वा ये भवन्ति नरर्षभाः
कथयन्ति न ते किंचित् तेजसा स्वेन गर्विताः
transliteration: vikrāntā balavanto vā ye bhavanti nararṣabhāḥ
kathayanti na te kiṃcit tejasā svena garvitāḥ
english: Those foremost of men that are puissant and powerful, do not, inflated with their energy, mouth (their own consequence).

sanskrit: प्राकृताः तु अकृत आत्मानो लोके क्षत्रिय पांसनाः
transliteration: prākṛtāḥ tu akṛta ātmāno loke kṣatriya pāṃsanāḥ
english: It is the mean-minded Kșatriyas of impure hearts that magnify themselves among men, even as you, O Rama,do.

sanskrit: कुलम् व्यपदिशन् वीरः समरे को अभिधास्यति
मृत्यु काले हि संप्राप्ते स्वयम् अप्रस्तवे स्तवम्
transliteration: kulam vyapadiśan vīraḥ samare ko abhidhāsyati
mṛtyu kāle hi saṃprāpte svayam aprastave stavam
english: What hero, when the hour of his death has approached, publishes in the field his own lofty lineage and sings his own hymn.

sanskrit: सर्वथा तु लघुत्वम् ते कत्थनेन विदर्शितम्
सुवर्ण प्रतिरूपेण तप्तेन इव कुश अग्निना
transliteration: sarvathā tu laghutvam te katthanena vidarśitam
suvarṇa pratirūpeṇa taptena iva kuśa agninā
english: As brass wearing the semblance of gold, displays its own defect on being heated*, with a fire lit with Kusa, so you have betrayed your own lightness by this speech of yours. i.c. becomes dusky, (Ramanuja).

sanskrit: न तु माम् इह तिष्ठंतम् पश्यसि त्वम् गदा धरम्
धराधरम् इव अकंप्यम् पर्वतम् धातुभिः चितम्
transliteration: na tu mām iha tiṣṭhaṃtam paśyasi tvam gadā dharam
dharādharam iva akaṃpyam parvatam dhātubhiḥ citam
english: You do not see me staying here mace in hand, like a moveless mountain dyed in metals, bearing mobile and immobile things.

sanskrit: पर्याप्तो अहम् गदा पाणिर् हन्तुम् प्राणान् रणे तव
त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् पाश हस्त इव अंतकः
transliteration: paryāpto aham gadā pāṇir hantum prāṇān raṇe tava
trayāṇām api lokānām pāśa hasta iva aṃtakaḥ
english: I can, mace in hand, deprive you and the three worlds to boot clean of your lives, like the very Destroyer with the noose in his hand.

sanskrit: कामम् बहु अपि वक्तव्यम् त्वयि वक्ष्यामि न तु अहम्
अस्तम् प्राप्नोति सविता युद्ध विघ्नः ततो भवेत्
transliteration: kāmam bahu api vaktavyam tvayi vakṣyāmi na tu aham
astam prāpnoti savitā yuddha vighnaḥ tato bhavet
english: But I will not parley much with you as much as I could wish: the sun is going to set, and our fight shall be interrupted.

sanskrit: त्वत् विनाशात् करोमि अद्य तेषाम् अश्रु प्रमार्जनम्
transliteration: tvat vināśāt karomi adya teṣām aśru pramārjanam
english: Fourteen thousand Räksasas have been slaughtered by you. I will for their deaths wipe their tears to-day.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा परम क्रुद्धः ताम् गदाम् परम अन्गदाम्
खरः चिक्षेप रामाय प्रदीप्ताम् अशनिम् यथा
transliteration: iti uktvā parama kruddhaḥ tām gadām parama angadām
kharaḥ cikṣepa rāmāya pradīptām aśanim yathā
english: Saying this Khara, highly enraged, hurled his mace+ provided with golden rings at Rāma, like to the blazing thunderbolt. Another reading is, plaited with gold.

sanskrit: खर बाहु प्रमुक्ता सा प्रदीप्ता महती गदा
भस्म वृक्षाम् च गुल्माम् च कृत्वा अगात् तत् समीपतः
transliteration: khara bāhu pramuktā sā pradīptā mahatī gadā
bhasma vṛkṣām ca gulmām ca kṛtvā agāt tat samīpataḥ
english: Thereat, reducing to ashes trees and shrubs, that mighty flaming mace, discharged by Khara's arm, fell before Rama.

sanskrit: ताम् आपतन्तीम् महतीम् मृत्यु पाश उपमाम् गदाम्
अंतरिक्ष गताम् रामः चिच्छेद बहुधा शरैः
transliteration: tām āpatantīm mahatīm mṛtyu pāśa upamām gadām
aṃtarikṣa gatām rāmaḥ ciccheda bahudhā śaraiḥ
english: And Rāma severed in many fragments that mighty mace, resembling the noose of Death, as ascending the welkin, it was coming down.

sanskrit: सा विशीर्णा शरैः भिन्ना पपात धरणी तले
गदा मंत्र औषधि बलैर् व्याली इव विनिपातिता
transliteration: sā viśīrṇā śaraiḥ bhinnā papāta dharaṇī tale
gadā maṃtra auṣadhi balair vyālī iva vinipātitā
english: Thereupon, like a she-serpent brought down by force of incantations, the mace fell to the earth shattered and riven.

sanskrit: भित्त्वा तु ताम् गदाम् बाणैः राघवो धर्म वत्सलः
स्मयमानः खरम् वाक्यम् संरब्धम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: bhittvā tu tām gadām bāṇaiḥ rāghavo dharma vatsalaḥ
smayamānaḥ kharam vākyam saṃrabdham idam abravīt
english: Cutting off the mace with his shafts, Rāghava attached to righteousness with a smile said to Khara these angry words.

sanskrit: एतत् ते बल सर्वस्वम् दर्शितम् राक्षसाधम
शक्ति हीनतरो मत्तो वृथा त्वम् उपगर्जसि
transliteration: etat te bala sarvasvam darśitam rākṣasādhama
śakti hīnataro matto vṛthā tvam upagarjasi
english: You vile of Rākșasas, this is the utmost of your might, which you have displayed.

sanskrit: एषा बाण विनिर्भिन्ना गदा भूमि तलम् गता
transliteration: eṣā bāṇa vinirbhinnā gadā bhūmi talam gatā
english: Rendered more nerveless at my hands, in vain do you storm. Riven by my shafts, your mace, belonging to you who are prolix in the matter of vocabulary, destroying your confidence, has sought the earth.

sanskrit: यत् त्वया उक्तम् विनष्टानाम् इदम् अश्रु प्रमार्जनम्
राक्षसानाम् करोमि इति मिथ्या तत् अपि ते वचः
transliteration: yat tvayā uktam vinaṣṭānām idam aśru pramārjanam
rākṣasānām karomi iti mithyā tat api te vacaḥ
english: And what you had said, will wipe the tears of the Rākşasas that have been slain, has also proved false.

sanskrit: नीचस्य क्षुद्र शीलस्य मिथ्या वृत्तस्य रक्षसः
transliteration: nīcasya kṣudra śīlasya mithyā vṛttasya rakṣasaḥ
english: As Garuda stole ambrosia, will I deprive you, O Rāksasa, who are base, of a mean disposition and a false character, of your life.

sanskrit: अद्य ते भिन्न कण्ठस्य फेन बुद्बुद भूषितम्
विदारितस्य मत् बाणैः मही पास्यति शोणितम्
transliteration: adya te bhinna kaṇṭhasya phena budbuda bhūṣitam
vidāritasya mat bāṇaiḥ mahī pāsyati śoṇitam
english: To day the earth shall drink the blood vitiated with foamy bubbles, of you, having your throat severed, and riven by my shafts.

sanskrit: पांसु रूषित सर्वान्गः स्रस्त न्यस्त भुज द्वयः
स्वप्स्यसे गाम् समाश्लिष्य दुर्लभाम् प्रमदाम् इव
transliteration: pāṃsu rūṣita sarvāngaḥ srasta nyasta bhuja dvayaḥ
svapsyase gām samāśliṣya durlabhām pramadām iva
english: Having all your body covered with dust, and your two arms lopped off, you shall, difficult to win, take your nap, embracing the earth, like a damsel difficult to win.

sanskrit: प्रवृद्ध निद्रे शयिते त्वयि राक्षस पांसने
transliteration: pravṛddha nidre śayite tvayi rākṣasa pāṃsane
english: On you, disgrace of Raksasas, lying down, and being fast asleep, this Dandaka shall be refuge of those that shall resort to it for shelter.

sanskrit: जनस्थाने हत स्थाने तव राक्षस मत् शरैः
transliteration: janasthāne hata sthāne tava rākṣasa mat śaraiḥ
english: O Rākşasa, in your Janasthāna, with its (Rāks asas) slain by my shafts, ascetics shall fearlessly go about in the wood.

sanskrit: बाष्प आर्द्र वदना दीना भयात् अन्य भयावहाः
transliteration: bāṣpa ārdra vadanā dīnā bhayāt anya bhayāvahāḥ
english: Today Rākṣasas, capable of exciting fear in others, rendered forlorn and with their friends slain, shall from fear, with their faces wet with tears, fly (this place).

sanskrit: अद्य शोक रसज्ञाः ताः भविष्यन्ति निरर्थकाः
अनुरूप कुलाः पत्न्यो यासाम् त्वम् पतिः ईदृशः
transliteration: adya śoka rasajñāḥ tāḥ bhaviṣyanti nirarthakāḥ
anurūpa kulāḥ patnyo yāsām tvam patiḥ īdṛśaḥ
english: To day your wives whose husband are you of such a nature, and who are of a like lineage (with yourself), shall experience the sentiment of sorrow, and be deprived of their all.

sanskrit: नृशंस शील क्षुद्र आत्मन् नित्यम् ब्राह्मण कण्टक
त्वत् कृते शन्कितैः अग्नौ मुनिभिः पात्यते हविः
transliteration: nṛśaṃsa śīla kṣudra ātman nityam brāhmaṇa kaṇṭaka
tvat kṛte śankitaiḥ agnau munibhiḥ pātyate haviḥ
english: You of a cruel disposition, you of ignoble soul, you that are aye a thorn (in the side) of Brāhmanas, it is for you that ascetics, frightened and dispirited, have so long been pouring the clarified butter.

sanskrit: तम् एवम् अभिसंरब्धम् ब्रुवाणम् राघवम् रणे
transliteration: tam evam abhisaṃrabdham bruvāṇam rāghavam raṇe
english: As Rāghava, influenced by anger, said this in the field, Khara f. wrath, with accents rendered harsher, fell to censuring (Rāma),

sanskrit: दृढम् खलु अवलिप्तो असि भयेषु अपि च निर्भयः
वाच्य अवाच्यम् ततो हि त्वम् मृत्यु वश्यो न बुध्यसे
transliteration: dṛḍham khalu avalipto asi bhayeṣu api ca nirbhayaḥ
vācya avācyam tato hi tvam mṛtyu vaśyo na budhyase
english: You are wondrous proud; and you are fearless albeit fear is present to you. And come under the sway of Death, you do not understand what should be said and what left unspoken.

sanskrit: काल पाश परिक्षिप्ता भवंति पुरुषा हि ये
कार्य अकार्यम् न जानन्ति ते निरस्त षड् इन्द्रियाः
transliteration: kāla pāśa parikṣiptā bhavaṃti puruṣā hi ye
kārya akāryam na jānanti te nirasta ṣaḍ indriyāḥ
english: Those persons that have been fast bound by the noose of death, do not in consequence of their senses having ceased to perform their functions, discern what is proper and what improper.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा ततो रामम् संरुध्य भृकुटिम् ततः
स ददर्श महा सालम् अविदूरे निशाचरः
transliteration: evam uktvā tato rāmam saṃrudhya bhṛkuṭim tataḥ
sa dadarśa mahā sālam avidūre niśācaraḥ
english: Saying this to Rāma, that ranger of the night (Khara), pursing his brows, espied a mighty Sāla hard by. And looking about him on all sides in the field for a weapon, he uprooted it, biting his Nether lip.

sanskrit: रणे प्रहरणस्य अर्थे सर्वतो हि अवलोकयन्
स तम् उत्पाटयामास संदष्ट दशन च्छदम्
transliteration: raṇe praharaṇasya arthe sarvato hi avalokayan
sa tam utpāṭayāmāsa saṃdaṣṭa daśana cchadam
english: Saying this to Rāma, that ranger of the night (Khara), pursing his brows, espied a mighty Sāla hard by. And looking about him on all sides in the field for a weapon, he uprooted it, biting his Nether lip.

sanskrit: रामम् उद्दिश्य चिक्षेप हतः त्वम् इति च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: rāmam uddiśya cikṣepa hataḥ tvam iti ca abravīt
english: And raising up the tree with his arms, and uttering a roar, that exceedingly powerful one aiming at Rāma discharged it, exclaiming, Dead you are.

sanskrit: तम् आपतन्तम् बाण ओघैः च्छित्त्वा रामः प्रतापवान्
रोषम् आहारयत् तीव्रम् निहंतुम् समरे खरम्
transliteration: tam āpatantam bāṇa oghaiḥ cchittvā rāmaḥ pratāpavān
roṣam āhārayat tīvram nihaṃtum samare kharam
english: And as it descended, the puissant Rāma cut it off by means of a multitude of shafts, got into a mighty rage for the purpose of slaying Khara is battle.

sanskrit: जात स्वेदः ततो रामो रोषात् रक्त अन्त लोचनः
transliteration: jāta svedaḥ tato rāmo roṣāt rakta anta locanaḥ
english: Then Rāma perspiring, with eyes reddened in wrath, pierced Khara in battle with a thousand shafts.

sanskrit: तस्य बाण अंतरात् रक्तम् बहु सुस्राव फेनिलम्
गिरेः प्रस्रवणस्य इव धाराणाम् च परिस्रवः
transliteration: tasya bāṇa aṃtarāt raktam bahu susrāva phenilam
gireḥ prasravaṇasya iva dhārāṇām ca parisravaḥ
english: And blood mixed with froth gushed by the sides of the shafts, like torrents flowing from fountain in a hill* stupefied in battle by the shafts shot by Rāina, and maddened by the smell of blood Khara furiously inade for Rāma. The text varies slightly in other texts.

sanskrit: विकल स कृतो बाणैः खरो रामेण संयुगे
मत्तो रुधिर गन्धेन तम् एव अभ्यद्रवत् द्रुतम्
transliteration: vikala sa kṛto bāṇaiḥ kharo rāmeṇa saṃyuge
matto rudhira gandhena tam eva abhyadravat drutam
english: And blood mixed with froth gushed by the sides of the shafts, like torrents flowing from fountain in a hill* stupefied in battle by the shafts shot by Rāina, and maddened by the smell of blood Khara furiously inade for Rāma. The text varies slightly in other texts.

sanskrit: तम् आपतंतम् संरब्धम् कृत अस्त्रो रुधिर आप्लुतम्
अपसर्पत् द्वि त्रि पदम् किंचित् त्वरित विक्रमः
transliteration: tam āpataṃtam saṃrabdham kṛta astro rudhira āplutam
apasarpat dvi tri padam kiṃcit tvarita vikramaḥ
english: And as he (Khara) was rushing on, bathed with blood, Rāma cquipped with arms, suddenly summoning his strength walked backward two or three paces.

sanskrit: ततः पावक संकाशम् वधाय समरे शरम्
खरस्य रामो जग्राह ब्रह्म दण्डम् इव अपरम्
transliteration: tataḥ pāvaka saṃkāśam vadhāya samare śaram
kharasya rāmo jagrāha brahma daṇḍam iva aparam
english: Then with the view of bringing about (Khara's end) Rāma took up in the conflict an arrow resembling fire or another weapon of Brahmã himself.

sanskrit: स तत् दत्तम् मघवता सुर राजेन धीमता
संदधे च स धर्मात्मा मुमोच च खरम् प्रति
transliteration: sa tat dattam maghavatā sura rājena dhīmatā
saṃdadhe ca sa dharmātmā mumoca ca kharam prati
english: And that righteous one shot at Khara, that (arrow), which had been conferred on him by the intelligent Maghavān.

sanskrit: स विमुक्तो महाबाणो निर्घात सम निःस्वनः
रामेण धनुरायम्य खरस्य उरसि च आपतत्
transliteration: sa vimukto mahābāṇo nirghāta sama niḥsvanaḥ
rāmeṇa dhanurāyamya kharasya urasi ca āpatat
english: And discharged by Rāma from his bent bow, that mighty arrow with the roaring of the thunderbolt fell at Khara's breast.

sanskrit: स पपात खरो भूमौ दह्यमानः शर अग्निना
रुद्रेण एव विनिर्दग्धः श्वेत अरण्ये यथा अन्धकः
transliteration: sa papāta kharo bhūmau dahyamānaḥ śara agninā
rudreṇa eva vinirdagdhaḥ śveta araṇye yathā andhakaḥ
english: And burning in the fire of the arrow, Khara fell down on the earth, like the giant Andakha* in the forest of Svetā, consumed by Rudra. The Asura Andhaka was slain in the forest of Svetă by Rudra. This is related in the Purāṇas. Another reading is Svetarayge yathantaka like the Destroyer in the forest of Svetā. Sva, according to the Kūrma Purāņa Uttara Khanda, in the Kalanyara hill, by a kick with his left leg. slew the Destroyer, engaged in penance's, who had come to kill the Rajarsi Svetā, who was a great votary of Siva.

sanskrit: स वृत्र इव वज्रेण फेनेन नमुचिर् यथाअ
बलो वा इन्द्र अशनि हतो निपपात हतः खरः
transliteration: sa vṛtra iva vajreṇa phenena namucir yathāa
balo vā indra aśani hato nipapāta hataḥ kharaḥ
english: And threat Khara slain fell down like Vritra slain by the thunder-bolt, or Namuci by foam, or Bala by Indra's Ašani. Namuci was slain by a thunder-bolt laid over with foam.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् अंतरे देवाः चारणयोः सह संगताः
दुन्दुभिः च अभिनिघ्नंतः पुष्प वर्ष समंततः
transliteration: etasmin aṃtare devāḥ cāraṇayoḥ saha saṃgatāḥ
dundubhiḥ ca abhinighnaṃtaḥ puṣpa varṣa samaṃtataḥ

sanskrit: रामस्य उपरि संहृष्टा ववर्षुः विस्मिताः तदा
अर्थ अधिक मुहूर्तेन रामेण निशितैः शरैः
transliteration: rāmasya upari saṃhṛṣṭā vavarṣuḥ vismitāḥ tadā
artha adhika muhūrtena rāmeṇa niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ

sanskrit: चतुर् दश सहस्राणि रक्ष्साम् काम रूपिणाम्
transliteration: catur daśa sahasrāṇi rakṣsām kāma rūpiṇām

sanskrit: अहो बत महत् कर्म रामस्य विदित आत्मनः
अहो वीर्यम् अहो दार्ढ्यम् विष्णोः इव हि दृश्यते
transliteration: aho bata mahat karma rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ
aho vīryam aho dārḍhyam viṣṇoḥ iva hi dṛśyate
english: Ah! mighty is the feat achieved by Rāma knowing self. Ah! this mighty prowess, this mighty firmness, show like to those of Vişnu himself.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा ते सर्वे ययुः देवा यथा आगतम्
ततो राज ऋषयः सर्वे सम्गताः परम ऋषयः
transliteration: iti evam uktvā te sarve yayuḥ devā yathā āgatam
tato rāja ṛṣayaḥ sarve samgatāḥ parama ṛṣayaḥ
english: Saying this all the deities went to from where they had come. Then the Rājarşis in company with supreme saints, with Agastya (at their head), gladly paying homage to Rāma, said the following words.

sanskrit: सभाज्य मुदिता रामम् स अगस्त्या इदम् अब्रुवन्
एतत् अर्थम् महातेजा महेन्द्रः पाक शासनः
transliteration: sabhājya muditā rāmam sa agastyā idam abruvan
etat artham mahātejā mahendraḥ pāka śāsanaḥ

sanskrit: आनीतः त्वम् इमम् देशम् उपायेन महर्षिभिः
transliteration: ānītaḥ tvam imam deśam upāyena maharṣibhiḥ

sanskrit: एषाम् वध अर्थम् शत्रूणाम् रक्षसाम् पाप कर्मणाम्
तत् इदम् नः कृतम् कार्यम् त्वया दशरथ आत्मज
transliteration: eṣām vadha artham śatrūṇām rakṣasām pāpa karmaṇām
tat idam naḥ kṛtam kāryam tvayā daśaratha ātmaja
english: And it is owing to this, that, O son of Dasaratha, you have performed this mighty deed. (Now) the Maharsis will carry on their proper pious offices in the Dandaka.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् अनंतरे वीरो लक्ष्मणः सह सीतया
transliteration: etasmin anaṃtare vīro lakṣmaṇaḥ saha sītayā

sanskrit: गिरि दुर्गात् विनिष्क्रम्य संविवेश आश्रमम् सुखी
ततो रामः तु विजयी पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः
transliteration: giri durgāt viniṣkramya saṃviveśa āśramam sukhī
tato rāmaḥ tu vijayī pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा शत्रु हंतारम् महर्षीणाम् सुख आवहम्
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā śatru haṃtāram maharṣīṇām sukha āvaham

sanskrit: मुदा परमया युक्ता दृष्ट्वा रक्षो गणान् हतान्
रामम् च एव अव्ययम् दृष्टा तुतोष जनक आत्मजा
transliteration: mudā paramayā yuktā dṛṣṭvā rakṣo gaṇān hatān
rāmam ca eva avyayam dṛṣṭā tutoṣa janaka ātmajā
english: And seeing that destroyer of foes, and bringer of coinfort to the Maharsis, her husband, Vaidehi embraced him. And seeing the multitudes of Raksasas siain, Janaka's daughter, beholding the undeteriorating Rāma, ministered to him with supreme joy.

sanskrit: ततः तु तम् राक्षस संघ मर्दनम्स पूज्यमानम् मुदितैः महात्मभिः
पुनः परिष्वज्य मुदा अन्वित आननाबभूव हृष्टा जनक आत्मजा तदा
transliteration: tataḥ tu tam rākṣasa saṃgha mardanamsa pūjyamānam muditaiḥ mahātmabhiḥ
punaḥ pariṣvajya mudā anvita ānanābabhūva hṛṣṭā janaka ātmajā tadā
english: And with a delightful countenance again embracing that destroyer of foes, who had been honoured by the delighted Maharşis, Janaka's daughter became exceedingly happy. honoured by the delighted Maharşis, Janaka's daughter became exceedingly happy.

sanskrit: प्रविश्य लंकाम् वेगेन रावणम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: praviśya laṃkām vegena rāvaṇam vākyam abravīt
english: Then Akampana bestirring himself, speedily issuing out of Janasthāna, spoke to Rāvana,

sanskrit: जनस्थान स्थिता राजन् रक्षसा बहवो हताः
खरः च निहतः संख्ये क्थम्चित् अहम् आगतः
transliteration: janasthāna sthitā rājan rakṣasā bahavo hatāḥ
kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṃkhye kthamcit aham āgataḥ
english: O king, a great many Rākşasa living in Janasthāna, have been slain, and Khara also had been slain in battle. I alone have with much difficulty managed to come here.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धः संरकत लोचनः
अकंपनम् उवाच इदम् निर्दहन् इव तेजसा
transliteration: evam ukto daśagrīvaḥ kruddhaḥ saṃrakata locanaḥ
akaṃpanam uvāca idam nirdahan iva tejasā
english: Thus addressed, the ten-necked one, flaming up in energy, with his eyes reddened in wrath, said this to Akampana,

sanskrit: केन भीमम् जनस्थानम् हतम् मम परासुना
को हि सर्वेषु लोकेषु गतिम् न अधिगमिष्यति
transliteration: kena bhīmam janasthānam hatam mama parāsunā
ko hi sarveṣu lokeṣu gatim na adhigamiṣyati
english: Who, having his days numbered, had ravaged the dreadful Janasthāna? Who shall no more wend the way of all beings?

sanskrit: न हि मे विप्रियम् कृता शक्यम् मघवता सुखम्
प्रप्तुम् वैश्रवणेन अपि न यमेन च विष्णुना
transliteration: na hi me vipriyam kṛtā śakyam maghavatā sukham
praptum vaiśravaṇena api na yamena ca viṣṇunā
english: Doing me a bad turn, Maghavan himself, or Vaiśravana, or Yama, or Vişnu, cannot attain happiness.

sanskrit: कालस्य च अपि अहम् कलो दहेयम् अपि पावकम्
transliteration: kālasya ca api aham kalo daheyam api pāvakam
english: I am the destroyer of the Destroyer himself; and I burn even very Fire. And I can bring Death itself to mortality.

sanskrit: वातस्य तरसा वेगम् निहन्तुम् अपि च उत्सहे
दहेयम् अपि संक्रुद्धः तेजसा आदित्य पावकौ
transliteration: vātasya tarasā vegam nihantum api ca utsahe
daheyam api saṃkruddhaḥ tejasā āditya pāvakau
english: I can by my impetus resist the force of the wind. And when enraged, I can by my energy consume the Sun and Fire.

sanskrit: भयात् संदिग्धया वचा रावणम् याचते अभयम्
transliteration: bhayāt saṃdigdhayā vacā rāvaṇam yācate abhayam
english: Thereat, Akampana, with joined hands, from fear replied to the ten-necked Rāvana, in faltering words, beseeching courage.

sanskrit: दशग्रीवो अभयम् तस्मै प्रददौ रक्षसाम् वरः
स विस्रब्धो अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् असंदिग्धम् अकंपनः
transliteration: daśagrīvo abhayam tasmai pradadau rakṣasām varaḥ
sa visrabdho abravīt vākyam asaṃdigdham akaṃpanaḥ
english: Thereat that foremost of Raksasas, the tennecked one, granted him courage. Then inspired with confidence, Akampana without fear spoke,

sanskrit: पुत्रो दशरथः ते सिंह संहननो युवा
रामो नाम महास्कंधो वृत्त आयत महाभुजः
transliteration: putro daśarathaḥ te siṃha saṃhanano yuvā
rāmo nāma mahāskaṃdho vṛtta āyata mahābhujaḥ
english: There is a son of Dasaratha, youthful, resembling a lion*, named Rāma. of broad shoulders, and possessed of excellent beauty of long and mighty-arms. (he) is sable-hued, of high fame, and of matchless prowess and vigour. It is he that in Janasthāna has slain Khara with Dusana. Another reading is Virunga: i upopetu: possessed of handsome person.-

sanskrit: श्यामः पृथुयशाः श्रीमान् अतुल्य बल विक्रमः
हतः तेन जनस्थाने खरः च सह दूषणः
transliteration: śyāmaḥ pṛthuyaśāḥ śrīmān atulya bala vikramaḥ
hataḥ tena janasthāne kharaḥ ca saha dūṣaṇaḥ
english: There is a son of Dasaratha, youthful, resembling a lion*, named Rāma. of broad shoulders, and possessed of excellent beauty of long and mighty-arms. (he) is sable-hued, of high fame, and of matchless prowess and vigour. It is he that in Janasthāna has slain Khara with Dusana. Another reading is Virunga: i upopetu: possessed of handsome person.-

sanskrit: नागेन्द्र इव निःश्वस्य इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: nāgendra iva niḥśvasya idam vacanam abravīt
english: Hearing Akampana's words, that lord of the Rākşasas, Rāvana, breathing like a mighty serpent, said these words,

sanskrit: स सुरेन्द्रेण संयुक्तो रामः सर्व अमरैः सह
transliteration: sa surendreṇa saṃyukto rāmaḥ sarva amaraiḥ saha
english: Tell me, O Akampana, has Rāma come to Janasthāna, accompanied with the sovereign of the celestials and the body of the immortals?

sanskrit: रावणस्य पुनर् वाक्यम् निशम्य तद् अकंपनः
आचचक्षे बलम् तस्य विक्रमम् च महात्मनः
transliteration: rāvaṇasya punar vākyam niśamya tad akaṃpanaḥ
ācacakṣe balam tasya vikramam ca mahātmanaḥ
english: Again hearing Rāvana's words, Akampana described the strength and energy of that highsouled one.

sanskrit: रामो नाम महातेजाः श्रेष्टः सर्व धनुष्मताम्
दिव्य अस्त्र गुण संपन्नः परम्धर्म गतो युधि
transliteration: rāmo nāma mahātejāḥ śreṣṭaḥ sarva dhanuṣmatām
divya astra guṇa saṃpannaḥ paramdharma gato yudhi
english: (He) is named Rama, and is exceedingly energetic; the foremost of al bowmenfurnished with celestial panoply; and is possessed of pre-eminent prowess in warfare.

sanskrit: तस्य अनुरूपो बलब्वान् रक्ताक्षो दुन्दुभि स्वनः
कनीयान् लक्ष्मणो भ्राता राका शशि निभ आननः
transliteration: tasya anurūpo balabvān raktākṣo dundubhi svanaḥ
kanīyān lakṣmaṇo bhrātā rākā śaśi nibha ānanaḥ
english: Like to him in strength, of red eyes, and gifted with a voice like the sound of a kettledrum, his younger brother, Laksmana has a countenance resembling the full-moon.

sanskrit: स तेन सह संयुक्तः पावकेन अनिलो यथा
श्रीमान् राज वरः तेन जनस्थानम् निपातितम्
transliteration: sa tena saha saṃyuktaḥ pāvakena anilo yathā
śrīmān rāja varaḥ tena janasthānam nipātitam
english: He has met with him (Rāma) as the wind meeteth with a flame. he is endeued with grace, and is the foremost of monarchs. It is he who has ravaged Janasthāna.

sanskrit: न एव देवा महत्मनो न अत्र कार्या विचारणा
शरा रामेण तु उत्सृष्टा रुक्मपुंखाः पतत्रिणः
transliteration: na eva devā mahatmano na atra kāryā vicāraṇā
śarā rāmeṇa tu utsṛṣṭā rukmapuṃkhāḥ patatriṇaḥ
english: The magnanimous gods did not come there, No doubts need be entertained on this head. The feathered shafts, plated with gold near the plumed part, becoming five-mouthed serpents at up the Raksasas.

sanskrit: सर्पाः पंचानना भूत्वा भक्षयन्ति स्म राक्षसान्
येन येन च गच्छन्ति राक्षसा भय कर्शिताः
transliteration: sarpāḥ paṃcānanā bhūtvā bhakṣayanti sma rākṣasān
yena yena ca gacchanti rākṣasā bhaya karśitāḥ

sanskrit: तेन तेन स्म पश्यन्ति रामम् एव अग्रतः स्थितम्
इत्थम् विनाशितम् जनस्थानम् तेन तव अनघ
transliteration: tena tena sma paśyanti rāmam eva agrataḥ sthitam
ittham vināśitam janasthānam tena tava anagha
english: Wherever oppressed with fear the Rākṣasas go, they see Rāma stationed before them. In this way, O sinless one, has Janasthāna been exterminated by him.

sanskrit: अकंपन अचः श्रुत्वा रावणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
गमिष्यामि जनस्थनम् रामम् हन्तुम् स लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: akaṃpana acaḥ śrutvā rāvaṇo vākyam abravīt
gamiṣyāmi janasthanam rāmam hantum sa lakṣmaṇam
english: Hearing Akmpana's words, Ravana said, “I will go to Janasthāna for slaying Rāma with Laksmana.

sanskrit: अथ एवम् उक्ते वचने प्रोवाच इदम् अकंपनः
श्रुणु राजन् यथा वृत्तम् रामस्य बल पौरुषम्
transliteration: atha evam ukte vacane provāca idam akaṃpanaḥ
śruṇu rājan yathā vṛttam rāmasya bala pauruṣam
english: When he had said this, Akampana said, He ar, O king, the true report of Rāma's prowess and manliness.

sanskrit: आप गायाः तु पूर्णाया वेगम् परिहरेत् शरैः
transliteration: āpa gāyāḥ tu pūrṇāyā vegam pariharet śaraiḥ
english: Enraged, the highly famous Rāma cannot by putting forth vigour be checked. And by means of his shafts, he can me river in full flood turn its course. And he can bring down from the sky its stars and planets, and that graceful one can recover the depressed Earth.

sanskrit: स तारा ग्रह नक्षत्रम् नभः च अपि अवसादयेत्
असौ रामः तु सीदन्तीम् श्रीमान् अभ्युद्धरेत् महीम्
transliteration: sa tārā graha nakṣatram nabhaḥ ca api avasādayet
asau rāmaḥ tu sīdantīm śrīmān abhyuddharet mahīm

sanskrit: भित्वा वेलाम् समुद्रस्य लोकान् आप्लावयेत् विभुः
वेगम् वा अपि समुद्रस्य वाअयुम् वा विधमेत् शरैः
transliteration: bhitvā velām samudrasya lokān āplāvayet vibhuḥ
vegam vā api samudrasya vāayum vā vidhamet śaraiḥ

sanskrit: संहृत्य वा पुनर् लोकान् विक्रमेण महायशाः
शकतः श्रेष्ठः स पुरुषः स्रष्टुम् पुनर् अपि प्रजाः
transliteration: saṃhṛtya vā punar lokān vikrameṇa mahāyaśāḥ
śakataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sraṣṭum punar api prajāḥ

sanskrit: न हि रामो दशग्रीव शक्यो जेतुम् रणे त्वया
रक्षसाम् वा अपि लोकेन स्वर्गः पाप जनैः इव
transliteration: na hi rāmo daśagrīva śakyo jetum raṇe tvayā
rakṣasām vā api lokena svargaḥ pāpa janaiḥ iva
english: O ten necked one, forsooth, Rāma cannot be subdued in conflict, either by you or the world of Rākşasas, as heaven is incapable of being attained by a sinner.

sanskrit: न तम् वध्यम् अहम् मन्ये सर्वैः देव असुरैः अपि
अयम् अस्य वध उपाय तत् एकमनाः शृउणु
transliteration: na tam vadhyam aham manye sarvaiḥ deva asuraiḥ api
ayam asya vadha upāya tat ekamanāḥ śṛuṇu
english: I deem him incapable of being slain by all the Gods and Asuras together. This alone is the means of slaying. Do you heedfully listen to it!

sanskrit: भार्या तस्य उत्तमा लोके सीता नाम सुमध्यमा
श्यामा सम विभक्त अंगी स्त्री रत्नम् रत्न बूषिता
transliteration: bhāryā tasya uttamā loke sītā nāma sumadhyamā
śyāmā sama vibhakta aṃgī strī ratnam ratna būṣitā
english: He has a wife of sterling worth in the world, and that slender-waisted one is known by the name of Sītā. She is in the full bloom of youth, and has a symmetrical person-a jewel among womankind embellished with jewels.

sanskrit: न एव देवी न गन्धर्वी न अप्सरा न च पन्नगी
तुल्या सीमन्तिनी तस्या मानुषी तु कुतो भवेत्
transliteration: na eva devī na gandharvī na apsarā na ca pannagī
tulyā sīmantinī tasyā mānuṣī tu kuto bhavet
english: And neither a goddess, nor a Gandharvī, nor yet an Apsarī, nor a. Pannagī is equal to her; and what is a human female?

sanskrit: तस्य अपहर भार्याम् त्वम् तम् प्रमथ्य महावने
सीताया रहितो रामो न च एव हि भविष्यति
transliteration: tasya apahara bhāryām tvam tam pramathya mahāvane
sītāyā rahito rāmo na ca eva hi bhaviṣyati
english: Thrashing him, do you in the mighty forest, carry away his wife. Without Sītā, Rama shall cease to exist.

sanskrit: अरोचयत् तद् वाक्यम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः
transliteration: arocayat tad vākyam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ
english: Thereupon, the lord of the Rākṣasas, Rāvaņa, happened to relish those words; and reflecting (a while), that mighty-armed one addressed Akampana.

sanskrit: बाढम् कल्यम् गमिष्यामि हि एकः सारथिना सह
आनेष्यामि च वैदेहीम् इमाम् हृष्टो महा पुरीम्
transliteration: bāḍham kalyam gamiṣyāmi hi ekaḥ sārathinā saha
āneṣyāmi ca vaidehīm imām hṛṣṭo mahā purīm
english: Excellent well. I will go there alone, accompanied by my charioteer only. I will this very morning with a glad heart bring Vaidehi to this spacious palace.

sanskrit: तत् एवम् उक्त्वा प्रययौ खर युक्तेन रावणः
रथेन आदित्य वर्णेन दिशः सर्वाः प्रकाशयन्
transliteration: tat evam uktvā prayayau khara yuktena rāvaṇaḥ
rathena āditya varṇena diśaḥ sarvāḥ prakāśayan
english: Saying this, Ravana departed, lighting up all sides, on a sun-shiny car, yoked with mules.

sanskrit: स रथो राक्षस इंद्रस्य नक्षत्र पथगो महान्
transliteration: sa ratho rākṣasa iṃdrasya nakṣatra pathago mahān
english: And coursing the firmament, that mighty car of that foremost of Rākşasas looked like the Moon among clouds. And proceeding far, he, approaching the asylum (of Taraka's son), presented himself before him. And Mārīca entertained the king with meats and drinks passing human.

sanskrit: स दूरे च आश्रमम् गत्वा ताटकेयम् उपागतम्
मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा भक्ष्य भोज्यैः अमानुषैः
transliteration: sa dūre ca āśramam gatvā tāṭakeyam upāgatam
mārīcena arcito rājā bhakṣya bhojyaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ
english: And coursing the firmament, that mighty car of that foremost of Rākşasas looked like the Moon among clouds. And proceeding far, he, approaching the asylum (of Taraka's son), presented himself before him. And Mārīca entertained the king with meats and drinks passing human.

sanskrit: तम् स्वयम् पूजयित्वा तु आसनेन उदकेन च
अर्थ उपहितया वाचा मारीचो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tam svayam pūjayitvā tu āsanena udakena ca
artha upahitayā vācā mārīco vākyam abravīt
english: Having entertained him personally with a seat and water (to wash the feet), Marica spoke these pregnant words.

sanskrit: आशंके न अथ जाने त्वम् यतः तूर्णम् उपागतम्
transliteration: āśaṃke na atha jāne tvam yataḥ tūrṇam upāgatam
english: O king, O lord of the Rākşasas, is it well with the worlds? I am filled with fear: I apprehend that all is not right, since you have come hither (alone) in such post-haste speed.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावण
ततः पश्चात् इदम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् वाक्य कोविदः
transliteration: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa
tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ
english: Thus addressed by Mārica, the highly energetic Ravana, versed in speech, said.

sanskrit: आरक्षो मे हतः तात रामेण अक्लिष्ट कारिणा
जनस्थानम् अवध्यम् तत् सर्वम् युधि निपातितम्
transliteration: ārakṣo me hataḥ tāta rāmeṇa akliṣṭa kāriṇā
janasthānam avadhyam tat sarvam yudhi nipātitam
english: My child, the guards (of Janasthāna) have been slain by Rāma of untiring energy; and all What Janasthāna, incapable of being slain, has (by him) been brought down in battle.

sanskrit: तस्य मे कुरु साचिव्यम् तस्य भार्य अपहरणे
राक्षसेन्द्र वचः श्रुत्वा मारीचो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tasya me kuru sācivyam tasya bhārya apaharaṇe
rākṣasendra vacaḥ śrutvā mārīco vākyam abravīt
english: Do you, therefore, assist me in carrying away his wife. Hearing these words of the lord of Rākş asas, Mārīca said.

sanskrit: आख्याता केन वा सीता मित्र रूपेण शत्रुणा
त्वया राक्षस शार्दूल को न नंदति नंदितः
transliteration: ākhyātā kena vā sītā mitra rūpeṇa śatruṇā
tvayā rākṣasa śārdūla ko na naṃdati naṃditaḥ
english: What enemy of yours in the guise of a friend, has spoken of Sītā to you? And, O foremost of monarchs, who, having been, entertained by you, dose not bear you good will?

sanskrit: सीताम् इह आनस्व इति को ब्रवीति ब्रवीहि मे
रक्षो लोकस्य सर्वस्य कः शृंगम् च्छेत्तुम् इच्छति
transliteration: sītām iha ānasva iti ko bravīti bravīhi me
rakṣo lokasya sarvasya kaḥ śṛṃgam cchettum icchati
english: Tell me, who is it that has told you, 'Bring Sītā hither?' Who is it that has set his heart on severing the summit of the entire Räksasa world?

sanskrit: प्रोत्साहयति यः च त्वम् स च शत्रुः असंशयम्
आशी मुखात् दंष्ट्राम् उद्धर्तुम् च इच्छति त्वया
transliteration: protsāhayati yaḥ ca tvam sa ca śatruḥ asaṃśayam
āśī mukhāt daṃṣṭrām uddhartum ca icchati tvayā
english: He must be your enemy that excites you to this. Of this there is not the least doubt. he wishes to extract through your agency the fangs of a venomous snake.

sanskrit: कर्मणा अनेन केन असि कापथम् प्रतिपादितः
सुख सुप्तस्य ते राजन् प्रहृतम् केन मूर्धनि
transliteration: karmaṇā anena kena asi kāpatham pratipāditaḥ
sukha suptasya te rājan prahṛtam kena mūrdhani
english: Who (intends) to lead you astray by imposing on you such a deed? Who, O king, has struck in the head, you that was slumbering in peace?

sanskrit: विशुद्ध वंश अभिजना अग्र हस्तःतेजो मदः संस्थित दोर्??? विषाणः
उदीक्षितुम् रावण न इह युक्तःस संयुगे राघव गन्धि हस्ती
transliteration: viśuddha vaṃśa abhijanā agra hastaḥtejo madaḥ saṃsthita dor??? viṣāṇaḥ
udīkṣitum rāvaṇa na iha yuktaḥsa saṃyuge rāghava gandhi hastī
english: Rāghava in war is like a mad elephant, having unblemished ancestry for his trunk, perspiration for his temporal exudation; and arms resting well beside him for his tusks. O Rāvaņa, you are not competent even to look at an him.

sanskrit: असौ रण अन्तः स्थिति संधि वालःविदग्ध रक्षो मृग हा नृसिंहः
सुप्तः त्वया बोधयितुम् न शक्यःशारांग पुर्णो निशित असि दंष्ट्Rअः
transliteration: asau raṇa antaḥ sthiti saṃdhi vālaḥvidagdha rakṣo mṛga hā nṛsiṃhaḥ
suptaḥ tvayā bodhayitum na śakyaḥśārāṃga purṇo niśita asi daṃṣṭaḥ
english: You ought not to rouse up the slecping manlion, that slayer of skilful Rākșasas resembling deer, with his sport in the field, for his joints and down; arrows for his body and sharp scimitar for his teeth.

sanskrit: चापापहारे भुज वेग पंकेशर ऊर्मिमाले सु महा आहव ओघे
न राम पाताल मुखे अति घोरेप्रस्कन्दितुम् राक्षस राज युक्तम्
transliteration: cāpāpahāre bhuja vega paṃkeśara ūrmimāle su mahā āhava oghe
na rāma pātāla mukhe ati ghorepraskanditum rākṣasa rāja yuktam
english: O Sovereign of the Räkşasas, you ought not to plunge yourself into this dreadful, and abyssless ocean, having the bow for its alligators, activity of arms for its shine, arrows for its billows, and engagement for its waters.

sanskrit: प्रसीद लंकेश्वर राक्षसेन्द्रलंकाम् प्रसन्नो भव साधु गच्छ
त्वम् स्वेषु दारेषु रमस्व नित्यम्रामः स भार्यो रमताम् वनेषु
transliteration: prasīda laṃkeśvara rākṣasendralaṃkām prasanno bhava sādhu gaccha
tvam sveṣu dāreṣu ramasva nityamrāmaḥ sa bhāryo ramatām vaneṣu
english: Be propitious, O lord of Lankā! O foremost of Rākşasas, with a contented heart, you had better go your way to Lankā. Do you ever sport with your own wives: let Rāma in company with his wife, sport in the woods.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो दशग्रीवो मारीचेन स रावणः
न्यवर्तत पुरीम् लंकाम् विवेश च गृह उत्तमम्
transliteration: evam ukto daśagrīvo mārīcena sa rāvaṇaḥ
nyavartata purīm laṃkām viveśa ca gṛha uttamam
english: Thus addressed by Mārīca, the ten-throated Rāvana desisted, and entered Lankā the best of capitals.

sanskrit: हतानि एकेन रामेण रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम्
transliteration: hatāni ekena rāmeṇa rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām
english: Seeing fourteen thousands of Rākşasas of dreadful deeds, together with Duşaņa, and Khara, and Trisirā, slain in battle by Rāma single-handed, that one resembling clouds, Śūrpanakhā, again fell to send up mighty sounds.

sanskrit: दूषणम् च खरम् चैव हतम् त्रिशिरसम् रणे
दृष्ट्वा पुनर् महानादम् ननाद जलद उपमा
transliteration: dūṣaṇam ca kharam caiva hatam triśirasam raṇe
dṛṣṭvā punar mahānādam nanāda jalada upamā
english: Seeing fourteen thousands of Rākşasas of dreadful deeds, together with Duşaņa, and Khara, and Trisirā, slain in battle by Rāma single-handed, that one resembling clouds, Śūrpanakhā, again fell to send up mighty sounds.

sanskrit: सा दृष्ट्वा कर्म रामस्य कृतम् अन्यैः सुदुष्करम्
जगाम परम उद्विग्ना लंकाम् रावण पालिताम्
transliteration: sā dṛṣṭvā karma rāmasya kṛtam anyaiḥ suduṣkaram
jagāma parama udvignā laṃkām rāvaṇa pālitām
english: And witnessing Rāma's deeds, incapable of being performed by others, she, extremely agitated, went to Lankā, ruled by Rāvana.

sanskrit: सा ददर्श विमान अग्रे रावणम् दीप्त तेजसम्
transliteration: sā dadarśa vimāna agre rāvaṇam dīpta tejasam
english: And she saw the effulgent Rāvaņa in front of his palace, surrounded by his counsellors, like Vāsava surrounded by the Maruts; scated on a supreme golden seat resembling the sun, and like to a flaming fire on a golden dais kept alive by sacrificial offerings.

sanskrit: रुक्म वेदि गतम् प्राज्यम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम्
transliteration: rukma vedi gatam prājyam jvalaṃtam iva pāvakam
english: And she saw the effulgent Rāvaņa in front of his palace, surrounded by his counsellors, like Vāsava surrounded by the Maruts; scated on a supreme golden seat resembling the sun, and like to a flaming fire on a golden dais kept alive by sacrificial offerings.

sanskrit: देव गन्धर्व भूतानाम् ऋषीणाम् च महात्मनाम्
अजेयम् समरे घोरम् व्यात्त आननम् इव अन्तकम्
transliteration: deva gandharva bhūtānām ṛṣīṇām ca mahātmanām
ajeyam samare ghoram vyātta ānanam iva antakam
english: Unconquerable by high-souled saints, celestials, Gandharvas and all creatures; terrible like the Destroyer with his mouth wide open; his persons containing scars* of wounds inflicted by the thunder bolt and the lightings, in the war between the gods and Asuras; his breast bearing marks of attacks made by Airāvata with the ends of his tusks. *This reminds one of Milton: of Belzebub, he says, His person Deep scars of thunder had intrenched-Par, Lost-Book I.

sanskrit: देव असुर विमर्देषु वज्र अशनि कृत व्रणम्
ऐरावत विषाण अग्रैः उत्कृष्ट किण वक्षसम्
transliteration: deva asura vimardeṣu vajra aśani kṛta vraṇam
airāvata viṣāṇa agraiḥ utkṛṣṭa kiṇa vakṣasam
english: Unconquerable by high-souled saints, celestials, Gandharvas and all creatures; terrible like the Destroyer with his mouth wide open; his persons containing scars* of wounds inflicted by the thunder bolt and the lightings, in the war between the gods and Asuras; his breast bearing marks of attacks made by Airāvata with the ends of his tusks. *This reminds one of Milton: of Belzebub, he says, His person Deep scars of thunder had intrenched-Par, Lost-Book I.

sanskrit: विंशत् भुजम् दश ग्रीवम् दर्शनीय परिच्छदम्
विशाल वक्षसम् वीरम् राज लक्ष्मण लक्षितम्
transliteration: viṃśat bhujam daśa grīvam darśanīya paricchadam
viśāla vakṣasam vīram rāja lakṣmaṇa lakṣitam
english: Having twenty hands, and ten heads, wearing elegant attire; broad breasted; heroic; marked with royal signs; (in hue) resembling cool lapises; embellished. in ornaments of burnished gold; having goodly hands, white teeth, and a huge face resembling a hill.

sanskrit: नद्ध वैदूर्य संकाशम् तप्त कान्चन कुण्डलम्
सुभुजम् शुक्ल दशनम् महा आस्यम् पर्वतोपमम्
transliteration: naddha vaidūrya saṃkāśam tapta kāncana kuṇḍalam
subhujam śukla daśanam mahā āsyam parvatopamam
english: Having twenty hands, and ten heads, wearing elegant attire; broad breasted; heroic; marked with royal signs; (in hue) resembling cool lapises; embellished. in ornaments of burnished gold; having goodly hands, white teeth, and a huge face resembling a hill.

sanskrit: विष्णु चक्र निपातैः च शतशो देव संयुगे
अन्यैः शस्त्रैः प्रहारैः च महायुद्धेषु ताडितम्
transliteration: viṣṇu cakra nipātaiḥ ca śataśo deva saṃyuge
anyaiḥ śastraiḥ prahāraiḥ ca mahāyuddheṣu tāḍitam

sanskrit: आहत अंगम् समस्तैः च देव प्रहरणैः तथा
transliteration: āhata aṃgam samastaiḥ ca deva praharaṇaiḥ tathā

sanskrit: क्षेप्तारम् पर्वत अग्राणाम् सुराणाम् च प्रमर्दनम्
उच्छेत्तारम् च धर्माणाम् पर दार अभिमर्शनम्
transliteration: kṣeptāram parvata agrāṇām surāṇām ca pramardanam
ucchettāram ca dharmāṇām para dāra abhimarśanam

sanskrit: सर्व दिव्य अस्त्र योक्तारम् यज्ञ विघ्न करम् सदा
पुरीम् भोगवतीम् गत्वा पराजित्य च वासुकिम्
transliteration: sarva divya astra yoktāram yajña vighna karam sadā
purīm bhogavatīm gatvā parājitya ca vāsukim
english: The employer of all celestial arms, and the disturber of sacrifics-who going to the city of Bhogavatī, and vanquishing Vāsuki, had carried off Taksa's beloved wife.

sanskrit: तक्षकस्य प्रियाम् भार्याम् पराजित्य जहार यः
कैलासम् पर्वतम् गत्वा विजित्य नर वाहनम्
transliteration: takṣakasya priyām bhāryām parājitya jahāra yaḥ
kailāsam parvatam gatvā vijitya nara vāhanam

sanskrit: विमानम् पुष्पकम् तस्य कामगम् वै जहार यः
वनम् चैत्ररथम् दिव्यम् नलिनीम् नंदनम् वनम्
transliteration: vimānam puṣpakam tasya kāmagam vai jahāra yaḥ
vanam caitraratham divyam nalinīm naṃdanam vanam

sanskrit: विनाशयति यः क्रोधात् देव उद्यानानि वीर्यवान्
चन्द्र सूर्यौ महा भागौ उत्तिष्ठन्तौ परंतपौ
transliteration: vināśayati yaḥ krodhāt deva udyānāni vīryavān
candra sūryau mahā bhāgau uttiṣṭhantau paraṃtapau

sanskrit: दश वर्ष सहस्राणि तपः तप्त्वा महावने
transliteration: daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi tapaḥ taptvā mahāvane

sanskrit: पुरा स्वयंभुवे धीरः शिरांसि उपजहार यः
देव दानव गधर्व पिशाच पतग उरगैः
transliteration: purā svayaṃbhuve dhīraḥ śirāṃsi upajahāra yaḥ
deva dānava gadharva piśāca pataga uragaiḥ

sanskrit: अभयम् यस्य संग्रामे मृत्युतो मानुषाद् ऋते
transliteration: abhayam yasya saṃgrāme mṛtyuto mānuṣād ṛte

sanskrit: प्राप्त यज्ञ हरम् दुष्टम् ब्रह्म घ्नम् क्रूर कारिणम्
transliteration: prāpta yajña haram duṣṭam brahma ghnam krūra kāriṇam

sanskrit: रावणम् सर्व भूतानाम् सर्व लोक भयावहम्
transliteration: rāvaṇam sarva bhūtānām sarva loka bhayāvaham

sanskrit: राक्षसी भ्रातरम् क्रूरम् सा ददर्श महाबलम्
तम् दिव्य वस्त्र आभरणम् दिव्य माल्य उपशोभितम्
transliteration: rākṣasī bhrātaram krūram sā dadarśa mahābalam
tam divya vastra ābharaṇam divya mālya upaśobhitam

sanskrit: आसने सूपविष्टम् तम् काले कालम् इव उद्यतम्
transliteration: āsane sūpaviṣṭam tam kāle kālam iva udyatam

sanskrit: उपगम्य अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् राक्षसी भय विह्वला
transliteration: upagamya abravīt vākyam rākṣasī bhaya vihvalā

sanskrit: तम् अब्रवीत् दीप्त विशाल लोचनम्प्रदर्शयित्वा भय लोभ मोहिता
सुदारुणम् वाक्यम् अभीत चारिणीमहात्मना शूर्पणखा विरूपिता
transliteration: tam abravīt dīpta viśāla locanampradarśayitvā bhaya lobha mohitā
sudāruṇam vākyam abhīta cāriṇīmahātmanā śūrpaṇakhā virūpitā
english: And transported with fear and desire, Śūrpanakhā, given to fearlessly ranging every where, who had been deformed by that highsouled one, showing (her mutilation), addressed these harsh words to Rāvana of flaming and expansive eyes.

sanskrit: ततः शूर्पणखा दीना रावणम् लोक रावणम्
अमात्य मध्ये संक्रुद्धा परुषम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā dīnā rāvaṇam loka rāvaṇam
amātya madhye saṃkruddhā paruṣam vākyam abravīt
english: Then the woe began Śūrpanakhā, in high wrath spoke harshly in the midst of the courtiers, to Rāvana, given to railing loudly against all creatures.

sanskrit: प्रमत्तः काम भोगेषु स्वैर वृत्तो निरंकुशः
समुत्पन्नम् भयम् घोरम् बोद्धव्यम् न अवबुध्यसे
transliteration: pramattaḥ kāma bhogeṣu svaira vṛtto niraṃkuśaḥ
samutpannam bhayam ghoram boddhavyam na avabudhyase
english: Intoxicated with enjoyments, acting as you will, and without any control whatever, you do not see that a dreadful disaster is impending.

sanskrit: सक्तम् ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु काम वृत्तम् महीपतिम्
लुब्धम् न बहु मन्यन्ते श्मशान अग्निम् इव प्रजाः
transliteration: saktam grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu kāma vṛttam mahīpatim
lubdham na bahu manyante śmaśāna agnim iva prajāḥ
english: The subjects do not esteem a monarch that is given to sensual enjoyments, in intent upon satisfying his lust and is covetous like the fire in a cemetery.

sanskrit: स्वयम् कार्याणि यः काले न अनुतिष्ठति पार्थिवः
स तु वै सह राज्येन तैः च कार्यैः विनश्यति
transliteration: svayam kāryāṇi yaḥ kāle na anutiṣṭhati pārthivaḥ
sa tu vai saha rājyena taiḥ ca kāryaiḥ vinaśyati
english: The king that dose not act at the proper time, finds destruction along with his kingdom and acts.

sanskrit: वर्जयन्ति नरा दूरात् नदी पंकम् इव द्विपाः
transliteration: varjayanti narā dūrāt nadī paṃkam iva dvipāḥ
english: Even as elephants shun the muddy river, do people shun from a distance, the ruler that dose not send cut spies, who show now himself (to his subjects), and who had lost his independence.

sanskrit: ये न रक्षन्ति विषयम् अस्वाधीना नराधिपः
ते न वृद्ध्या प्रकाशन्ते गिरयः सागरे यथा
transliteration: ye na rakṣanti viṣayam asvādhīnā narādhipaḥ
te na vṛddhyā prakāśante girayaḥ sāgare yathā
english: Like to rocks in the sea, those monarchs that do not administer their dominions, that are not dependent, do not prosper.

sanskrit: आत्मवद्भिः विगृह्य त्वम् देव गंधर्व दानवैः
अयुक्त चारः चपलः कथम् राजा भविष्यसि
transliteration: ātmavadbhiḥ vigṛhya tvam deva gaṃdharva dānavaiḥ
ayukta cāraḥ capalaḥ katham rājā bhaviṣyasi
english: Having incurred the hostility of the gods, the Dānavas and the Gandharvas of subdued souls and senses, how can you, who are fickle, and hast not employed spies, become the king?

sanskrit: त्वम् तु बाल स्वभावत् च बुद्धि हीनः च राक्षस
ज्ञातव्यम् तु न जानीषि कथम् राजा भविष्यसि
transliteration: tvam tu bāla svabhāvat ca buddhi hīnaḥ ca rākṣasa
jñātavyam tu na jānīṣi katham rājā bhaviṣyasi
english: And. O Raksasa, you are childish and foolish; and dose not know what you should. How can you then become the king?

sanskrit: येषाम् चारः च कोशः च नयः च जयताम् वर
अस्वाधीना नरेन्द्राणाम् प्राकृतैः ते जनैः समाः
transliteration: yeṣām cāraḥ ca kośaḥ ca nayaḥ ca jayatām vara
asvādhīnā narendrāṇām prākṛtaiḥ te janaiḥ samāḥ
english: O you best of conquerors, those kings whose spies, exchequer and morality are not free, are like the common head.

sanskrit: यस्मात् पश्यन्ति दूरस्थान् सर्वान् अर्थान् नराधिपाः
चारेण तस्मात् उच्यन्ते राजानो दीर्घ चक्षुषः
transliteration: yasmāt paśyanti dūrasthān sarvān arthān narādhipāḥ
cāreṇa tasmāt ucyante rājāno dīrgha cakṣuṣaḥ
english: It is because kings know distant dangers through spies, therefore they are styled farsighted.

sanskrit: अयुक्त चारम् मन्ये त्वाम् प्राकृतैः सचिवैः युतः
स्व जनम् च जनस्थानम् निहतम् न अवबुध्यसे
transliteration: ayukta cāram manye tvām prākṛtaiḥ sacivaiḥ yutaḥ
sva janam ca janasthānam nihatam na avabudhyase
english: I believe you have no spies, and that your counsellors are common folks, since although Janasthāna with your kinsman is destroyed, yet you take it not to heart.

sanskrit: हतानि एकेन रामेण खरः च सह दूषणः
transliteration: hatāni ekena rāmeṇa kharaḥ ca saha dūṣaṇaḥ
english: Fourteen thousands of Raksasas of dreadful deeds, with Khara and Dūşana, have all been slain by Rāma single-handed; Rāma of untiring energy has inspired the saints with courage; the Dandakas have been benefited; and Janasthāna had been harassed.

sanskrit: ऋषीणाम् अभयम् दत्तम् कृत क्षेमाः च दण्डकाः
धर्षितम् च जनस्थानम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कारिणा
transliteration: ṛṣīṇām abhayam dattam kṛta kṣemāḥ ca daṇḍakāḥ
dharṣitam ca janasthānam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa kāriṇā
english: Fourteen thousands of Raksasas of dreadful deeds, with Khara and Dūşana, have all been slain by Rāma single-handed; Rāma of untiring energy has inspired the saints with courage; the Dandakas have been benefited; and Janasthāna had been harassed.

sanskrit: त्वम् तु लुब्धः प्रमत्तः च पराधीनः च रावण
विषये स्वे समुत्पन्नम् यो भयम् न अवबुध्यसे
transliteration: tvam tu lubdhaḥ pramattaḥ ca parādhīnaḥ ca rāvaṇa
viṣaye sve samutpannam yo bhayam na avabudhyase
english: But you, covetous and intoxicated and in the power of others, do not understand that a great danger is over-hanging (you).

sanskrit: तीक्ष्णम् अल्प प्रदातारम् प्रमत्तम् गर्वितम् शठम्
व्यसने सर्व भूतानि न अभिधावन्ति पार्थिवम्
transliteration: tīkṣṇam alpa pradātāram pramattam garvitam śaṭham
vyasane sarva bhūtāni na abhidhāvanti pārthivam
english: People do not in times of peril assist a sovereign that is wrathful, stingy, intoxicated, haughty and deceitful.

sanskrit: क्रोधिनम् व्यसने हन्ति स्व जनो अपि नराधिपम्
transliteration: krodhinam vyasane hanti sva jano api narādhipam
english: Even his own kindred slay a sovereign that sets immense store by his own self, is of light worth, regards himself highly, and irascible. They do not serve him; nor do they fear when he intimidates them. Such an one is speedily dethroned; and reduced to poverty and becomes like a straw.

sanskrit: न अनुतिष्ठति कार्याणि भयेषु न बिभेति च
क्षिप्रम् राज्यात् च्युतो दीनः तृणैः तुल्यो भवेत् इह
transliteration: na anutiṣṭhati kāryāṇi bhayeṣu na bibheti ca
kṣipram rājyāt cyuto dīnaḥ tṛṇaiḥ tulyo bhavet iha
english: Even his own kindred slay a sovereign that sets immense store by his own self, is of light worth, regards himself highly, and irascible. They do not serve him; nor do they fear when he intimidates them. Such an one is speedily dethroned; and reduced to poverty and becomes like a straw.

sanskrit: शुष्क काष्ठैः भवेत् कार्यम् लोष्टैः अपि च पांसुभिः
न तु स्थानात् परिभ्रष्टैः कार्यम् स्यात् वसुधाधिपैः
transliteration: śuṣka kāṣṭhaiḥ bhavet kāryam loṣṭaiḥ api ca pāṃsubhiḥ
na tu sthānāt paribhraṣṭaiḥ kāryam syāt vasudhādhipaiḥ
english: Even dry wood may serve a purpose; or stone, or dust; but no purpose is capable of being served by a sovereign that has been cast off his place.

sanskrit: उपभुक्तम् यथा वासः स्रजो वा मृदिता यथा
एवम् राज्यात् परिभ्रष्टः समर्थो अपि निरर्थकः
transliteration: upabhuktam yathā vāsaḥ srajo vā mṛditā yathā
evam rājyāt paribhraṣṭaḥ samartho api nirarthakaḥ
english: Like a cloth that has been worn, like a garland that has been trodden, a king that had been dethroned, although able, is of no consequence.

sanskrit: अप्रमत्तः च यो राजा सर्वज्ञो विजितेन्द्रियः
कृतज्ञो धर्म शीलः च स राजा तिष्ठते चिरम्
transliteration: apramattaḥ ca yo rājā sarvajño vijitendriyaḥ
kṛtajño dharma śīlaḥ ca sa rājā tiṣṭhate ciram
english: But a king that keeps his wits about him, understands everything, is of controlled senses, and grateful, and of virtuous character, endure for ever.

sanskrit: नयनाभ्याम् प्रसुप्तो वा जागर्ति नय चक्षुषा
व्यक्त क्रोध प्रसादः च स राजा पूज्यते जनैः
transliteration: nayanābhyām prasupto vā jāgarti naya cakṣuṣā
vyakta krodha prasādaḥ ca sa rājā pūjyate janaiḥ
english: That king is honoured by men; that sleeping with his eyes, is awake as respects his eye of duty, and (the effects of) whose anger and favour, are seen (by all).

sanskrit: त्वम् तु रावण दुर्बुद्धिः गुणैः एतैः विवर्जितः
यस्य ते अविदितः चारैः रक्षसाम् सुमहान् वधः
transliteration: tvam tu rāvaṇa durbuddhiḥ guṇaiḥ etaiḥ vivarjitaḥ
yasya te aviditaḥ cāraiḥ rakṣasām sumahān vadhaḥ
english: But, you Rāvana, who hast not by means of spies; acquainted yourself with the slaughter of Rākşasas, are of evil understanding and bereft of all these virtues.

sanskrit: पर अवमंता विषयेषु संगवान्न देश काल प्रविभाग तत्त्व वित्
अयुक्त बुद्धिः गुण दोष निश्चयेविपन्न राज्यो न चिरात् विपत्स्यते
transliteration: para avamaṃtā viṣayeṣu saṃgavānna deśa kāla pravibhāga tattva vit
ayukta buddhiḥ guṇa doṣa niścayevipanna rājyo na cirāt vipatsyate
english: Given to disgracing others, ignorant of the proper distribution of time and place*, and never taking care to distinguish merits and defects, : you, your kingdom being in danger, will speedily meet with disaster. The commentator, is silent here. the meaning evidently is, you do not discern the where and when of things.

sanskrit: इति स्व दोषान् परिकीर्तिताम् तयासमीक्ष्य बुद्ध्या क्षणदा चरेश्वरः
धनेन दर्पेण बलेन च अन्वितोविचिन्तयामास चिरम् स रावणः
transliteration: iti sva doṣān parikīrtitām tayāsamīkṣya buddhyā kṣaṇadā careśvaraḥ
dhanena darpeṇa balena ca anvitovicintayāmāsa ciram sa rāvaṇaḥ
english: On his vices having been thus celebrated by her (Surpanakhā), that lord of the rangers of night, Råvaņa, musing awhile, was long plunged in thought.

sanskrit: ततः शूर्पणखाम् दृष्ट्वा ब्रुवन्तीम् परुषम् वचः
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhām dṛṣṭvā bruvantīm paruṣam vacaḥ
english: Seeing Śūrpanakhā speak harsh words in the midst of the courtiers, Ravana, being enraged, asked her.

sanskrit: कः च रामः कथम् वीर्यः किम् रूपः किम् पराक्रमः
किम् अर्थम् दण्डकारण्यम् प्रविष्टः च सुदुस्तरम्
transliteration: kaḥ ca rāmaḥ katham vīryaḥ kim rūpaḥ kim parākramaḥ
kim artham daṇḍakāraṇyam praviṣṭaḥ ca sudustaram
english: Who is Rāma? And what is his prowess? And what his form? And what his power? And why had he entered the forest of Dandaka, difficult to range?

sanskrit: आयुधम् किम् च रामस्य येन ते राक्षसाः हता
खरः च निहतः संख्ये दूषणः त्रिशिराः तथा
transliteration: āyudham kim ca rāmasya yena te rākṣasāḥ hatā
kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇaḥ triśirāḥ tathā
english: And what Rāma's weapons, by means of which he had slain the Rākşasas?. And Khara has been slain in battle, and Dūşaņa and Trisirā.

sanskrit: तत् त्वम् ब्रूहि मनोज्ञान्गी केन त्वम् च विरूपिता
इति उक्ता राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसी क्रोध मूर्च्छिता
transliteration: tat tvam brūhi manojñāngī kena tvam ca virūpitā
iti uktā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasī krodha mūrcchitā
english: Do you, O you of a pleasing person, tell me the truth. And who had deformed you?

sanskrit: ततो रामम् यथा न्यायम् आख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे
दीर्घबाहुः विशालाक्षः चीर कृष्ण अजिन अम्बरः
transliteration: tato rāmam yathā nyāyam ākhyātum upacakrame
dīrghabāhuḥ viśālākṣaḥ cīra kṛṣṇa ajina ambaraḥ
english: Thus addressed by the lord of the Rākṣasas, the Raksasi, transported with rage, commenced to duly narrate all about Rāma. Rāma the son of Dasaratha is long-armed, of expansive eyes, clad in bark and dark deer-skin, and like Kandarpa in grace.

sanskrit: कन्दर्प सम रूपः च रामो दशरथ आत्मजः
शक्र चाप निभम् चापम् विकृष्य कनकांगदम्
transliteration: kandarpa sama rūpaḥ ca rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ
śakra cāpa nibham cāpam vikṛṣya kanakāṃgadam

sanskrit: दीप्तान् क्षिपति नाराचान् सर्पान् इव महा विषान्
न आददानम् शरान् घोरान् न मुंचंतम् महाबलम्
transliteration: dīptān kṣipati nārācān sarpān iva mahā viṣān
na ādadānam śarān ghorān na muṃcaṃtam mahābalam

sanskrit: न कार्मुकम् विकर्षन्तम् रामम् पश्यामि संयुगे
हन्यमानम् तु तत् सैन्यम् पश्यामि शर वृष्टिभिः
transliteration: na kārmukam vikarṣantam rāmam paśyāmi saṃyuge
hanyamānam tu tat sainyam paśyāmi śara vṛṣṭibhiḥ

sanskrit: इन्द्रेण इव उत्तमम् सस्यम् आहतम् तु अश्म वृष्टिभिः
transliteration: indreṇa iva uttamam sasyam āhatam tu aśma vṛṣṭibhiḥ

sanskrit: निहतानि शरैः तीक्ष्णैः तेन एकेन पदातिना
अर्धाधिक मुहूर्तेन खरः च सह दूषणः
transliteration: nihatāni śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ tena ekena padātinā
ardhādhika muhūrtena kharaḥ ca saha dūṣaṇaḥ

sanskrit: ऋषीणाम् अभयम् दत्तम् कृत क्षेमाः च दण्डकाः
transliteration: ṛṣīṇām abhayam dattam kṛta kṣemāḥ ca daṇḍakāḥ

sanskrit: एका कथंचित् मुक्ता अहम् परिभूय महात्मना
transliteration: ekā kathaṃcit muktā aham paribhūya mahātmanā

sanskrit: भ्राता च अस्य महातेजा गुणतः तुल्य विक्रमः
अनुरक्तः च भक्तः च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्
transliteration: bhrātā ca asya mahātejā guṇataḥ tulya vikramaḥ
anuraktaḥ ca bhaktaḥ ca lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān

sanskrit: अमर्षी दुर्जयो जेता विक्रान्तो बुद्धिमान् बली
रामस्य दक्षिणे बाहुः नित्यम् प्राणो बहिः चरः
transliteration: amarṣī durjayo jetā vikrānto buddhimān balī
rāmasya dakṣiṇe bāhuḥ nityam prāṇo bahiḥ caraḥ
english: His brother is endued with mighty energy, and in merit, is of equal prowess, and he is devoted to his brother, and bear him regard; the puissant one is named Laksmana. And wrathful and invincible and victorious, and powerful, and intelligent and mighty, (he) is Rāma's right-arı-his life ranging externally.

sanskrit: रामस्य तु विशालाक्षी पूर्णेन्दु सदृश आनना
धर्म पत्नी प्रिया नित्यम् भर्तृः प्रिय हिते रता
transliteration: rāmasya tu viśālākṣī pūrṇendu sadṛśa ānanā
dharma patnī priyā nityam bhartṛḥ priya hite ratā
english: And Rāma's virtuously wedded beloved wife having expansive eyes, and a face resembling the full-moon, is ever to the welfare of her lord.

sanskrit: सा सुकेशी सुनासोरुः सुरूपा च यशस्विनी
देवत इव वनस्थ अस्यराजते श्रीर् इव अपरा
transliteration: sā sukeśī sunāsoruḥ surūpā ca yaśasvinī
devata iva vanastha asyarājate śrīr iva aparā
english: And that fair-haired, fair-nosed, and fairthighed illustrious one possessed of beauty, grace the forest like a goddess, as if a goddess of wealth herself.

sanskrit: तप्त कांचन वर्ण आभा रक्त तुंग नखी शुभा
सीता नाम वरारोहा वैदेही तनु मध्यमा
transliteration: tapta kāṃcana varṇa ābhā rakta tuṃga nakhī śubhā
sītā nāma varārohā vaidehī tanu madhyamā
english: Of the lustre of burnished gold, with her finger nails reddish and projecting, and graceful, that surpassingly lovely wench is named Sītā—the slender-waisted daughter of Videha.

sanskrit: न एव देवी न गंधर्वा न यक्षी न च किंनरी
तथा रूपा मया नारी दृष्ट पूर्वा महीतले
transliteration: na eva devī na gaṃdharvā na yakṣī na ca kiṃnarī
tathā rūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭa pūrvā mahītale
english: And neither a goddess, nor a Gandharvi, nor a Yaksi, nor a Kinnari, had I seen before on earth, possessed of such beauty.

sanskrit: यस्य सीता भवेत् भार्या यम् च हृष्टा परिष्वजेत्
अति जीवेत् स सर्वेषु लोकेषु अपि पुरंदरात्
transliteration: yasya sītā bhavet bhāryā yam ca hṛṣṭā pariṣvajet
ati jīvet sa sarveṣu lokeṣu api puraṃdarāt
english: He that shall have Sītā for his spouse, and who shall be warmly embraced by her, shall live longer in the world than the Lord of celestials himself.

sanskrit: सा सुशीला वपुः श्लाघ्या रूपेण अप्रतिमा भुवि
तव अनुरूपा भार्या सा त्वम् च तस्याः पतिः वरः
transliteration: sā suśīlā vapuḥ ślāghyā rūpeṇa apratimā bhuvi
tava anurūpā bhāryā sā tvam ca tasyāḥ patiḥ varaḥ
english: That good-natured girl, unparalleled on earth in loveliness, who can well pride herself on her person, is a worthy wife for you, and you too are a fit husband for her.

sanskrit: ताम् तु विस्तीर्ण जघनाम् पीन उत्तुंग पयो धराम्
भार्या अर्थे तु तव आनेतुम् उद्यता अहम् वर आननाम्
transliteration: tām tu vistīrṇa jaghanām pīna uttuṃga payo dharām
bhāryā arthe tu tava ānetum udyatā aham vara ānanām
english: It is to bring over for you that one of spacious hips, and a high and well-developed bust, that I had put forth my endeavours. But, O mightyarmed one I have been disfigured by the wicked Laksmana.

sanskrit: ताम् तु दृष्ट्वा अद्य वैदेहीम् पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननाम्
transliteration: tām tu dṛṣṭvā adya vaidehīm pūrṇa candra nibha ānanām
english: As soon as you have seen Vaidehi having a countenance resembling the full moon, you shall be afflicted with the shafts of Cupid.

sanskrit: मन्मथस्य शराणाम् च त्वम् विधेयो भविष्यसि
यदि तस्याम् अभिप्रायो भार्या अर्थे तव जायते
शीघ्रम् उद् ध्रियताम् पादो जयार्थम् इह दक्षिणः
transliteration: manmathasya śarāṇām ca tvam vidheyo bhaviṣyasi
yadi tasyām abhiprāyo bhāryā arthe tava jāyate
śīghram ud dhriyatām pādo jayārtham iha dakṣiṇaḥ
english: If it is your purpose to have her for your wife, at once stretch forth your right leg. for attaining success.

sanskrit: रोचते यदि ते वाक्यम् मम एतत् राक्षसेश्वर
transliteration: rocate yadi te vākyam mama etat rākṣaseśvara
english: If, O lord of Raksasas, you relish my speech, do you then, O Ravana, without fear, do as I tell you.

sanskrit: विज्ञाय इह आत्म शक्तिम् च क्रियताम् च महाबल
transliteration: vijñāya iha ātma śaktim ca kriyatām ca mahābala
english: Understanding their incapacity, do you, O lord of Rākṣasas, for making her your wife, by force carry away the frail Sītā of a blameless person.

sanskrit: निशम्य रामेण शरैः अजिह्मगैःहतान् जनस्थान गतान् निशाचरान्
खरम् च दृष्ट्वा निहतम् च दूषणम्त्वम् अद्य कृत्यम् प्रतिपत्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: niśamya rāmeṇa śaraiḥ ajihmagaiḥhatān janasthāna gatān niśācarān
kharam ca dṛṣṭvā nihatam ca dūṣaṇamtvam adya kṛtyam pratipattum arhasi
english: Hearing that Rāma by means of straight coursing shafts, has slain the Rākşasas that had gone to Janasthāna, and seeing Khara and Düşaņa, killed, do you ascertaining your course, adopt it.

sanskrit: ततः शूर्पणखा वाक्यम् तत् श्रुत्वा रोम हर्षणम्
सचिवान् अभ्यनुज्ञाय कार्यम् बुद्ध्वा जगाम ह
transliteration: tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā vākyam tat śrutvā roma harṣaṇam
sacivān abhyanujñāya kāryam buddhvā jagāma ha
english: Hearing those words of Śūrpanakhā, able to make one's hair stand on end, (Ravana) ascertaining his course after issuing his orders to this counsellors, departed.

sanskrit: तत् कार्यम् अनुगम्यांतर् यथावत् उपलभ्य च
दोषाणाम् च गुणानाम् च सम्प्रधार्य बल अबलम्
transliteration: tat kāryam anugamyāṃtar yathāvat upalabhya ca
doṣāṇām ca guṇānām ca sampradhārya bala abalam
english: And proposing to himself that act, weighing its good and evil, considering his capacity or Otherwise, and (finally) determining his purpose, Rāvana with a fixed mird went to the handsome stable.

sanskrit: इति कर्तव्यम् इति एव कृत्वा निश्चयम् आत्मनः
स्थिर बुद्धिः ततो रम्याम् यान शालाम् जगाम ह
transliteration: iti kartavyam iti eva kṛtvā niścayam ātmanaḥ
sthira buddhiḥ tato ramyām yāna śālām jagāma ha
english: And proposing to himself that act, weighing its good and evil, considering his capacity or Otherwise, and (finally) determining his purpose, Rāvana with a fixed mird went to the handsome stable.

sanskrit: यान शालाम् ततो गत्वा प्रच्छन्नम् राक्षस अधिपः
transliteration: yāna śālām tato gatvā pracchannam rākṣasa adhipaḥ
english: And going to the stable in disguise, the lord of the Rākṣasasas commanded the charioteer, saying, Yoke the car.:

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः क्षणेन एव सारथिः लघु विक्रमः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ kṣaṇena eva sārathiḥ laghu vikramaḥ
english: Thus asked, the charioteer possessed of fleet vigour, in a trice, yoked an excellent car after his heart.

sanskrit: कांचनम् रथम् आस्थाय कामगम् रत्न भूषितम्
पिशाच वदनैः युक्तम् खरैः कनक भूषणैः
transliteration: kāṃcanam ratham āsthāya kāmagam ratna bhūṣitam
piśāca vadanaiḥ yuktam kharaiḥ kanaka bhūṣaṇaiḥ
english: And ascending the car coursing at will, made of gold and garnished with spectral faces as well as arrow decked with gold, resembling a mass of clouds, the graceful ruler of the Rākşasasyounger brother to the Lord of wealth proceeded in that noiseless (vehicle), past the lord of rivers and streams.

sanskrit: मेघ प्रतिम नादेन स तेन धनद अनुजः
राक्षसाधिपतिः श्रीमान् ययौ नद नदी पतिम्
transliteration: megha pratima nādena sa tena dhanada anujaḥ
rākṣasādhipatiḥ śrīmān yayau nada nadī patim
english: And ascending the car coursing at will, made of gold and garnished with spectral faces as well as arrow decked with gold, resembling a mass of clouds, the graceful ruler of the Rākşasasyounger brother to the Lord of wealth proceeded in that noiseless (vehicle), past the lord of rivers and streams.

sanskrit: स श्वेत वाल व्यजनः श्वेतः छत्रो दशाननः
स्निग्ध वैदूर्य संकाश तप्त कान्चन भूषणः
transliteration: sa śveta vāla vyajanaḥ śvetaḥ chatro daśānanaḥ
snigdha vaidūrya saṃkāśa tapta kāncana bhūṣaṇaḥ

sanskrit: त्रिदश अरिः मुनीन्द्र घ्नो दश शीर्ष इव अद्रि राट्
transliteration: tridaśa ariḥ munīndra ghno daśa śīrṣa iva adri rāṭ

sanskrit: विद्युन् मण्डलवान् मेघः स बलाक इव अंबरे
transliteration: vidyun maṇḍalavān meghaḥ sa balāka iva aṃbare

sanskrit: स शैलम् सागर अनूपम् वीर्यवान् अवलोकयन्
नाना पुष्प फलैर् वृक्षैर् अनुकीर्णम् सहस्रशः
transliteration: sa śailam sāgara anūpam vīryavān avalokayan
nānā puṣpa phalair vṛkṣair anukīrṇam sahasraśaḥ

sanskrit: सालैः तालैः तमालैः च तरुभिः च सुपुष्पितैः
transliteration: sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca tarubhiḥ ca supuṣpitaiḥ

sanskrit: अत्यन्त नियत आहारैः शोभितम् परम ऋषिभिः
नागैः सुपर्णैः गंधर्वैः किंनरैः च सहस्रशः
transliteration: atyanta niyata āhāraiḥ śobhitam parama ṛṣibhiḥ
nāgaiḥ suparṇaiḥ gaṃdharvaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ ca sahasraśaḥ

sanskrit: जित कामैः च सिद्धैः च चारणैः च उपशोभितम्
transliteration: jita kāmaiḥ ca siddhaiḥ ca cāraṇaiḥ ca upaśobhitam

sanskrit: दिव्य आभरण माल्याभिः दिव्य रूपाभिः आवृतम्
transliteration: divya ābharaṇa mālyābhiḥ divya rūpābhiḥ āvṛtam

sanskrit: देव दानव सन्घैः च चरितम् तु अमृत अशिभिः
transliteration: deva dānava sanghaiḥ ca caritam tu amṛta aśibhiḥ

sanskrit: हंस क्रौन्च प्लव आकीर्णम् सारसैः संप्रणादितम्
