वैदूर्य प्रस्तरम् स्निग्धम् सांद्रम् सागर तेजसा
transliteration: haṃsa kraunca plava ākīrṇam sārasaiḥ saṃpraṇāditam
vaidūrya prastaram snigdham sāṃdram sāgara tejasā

sanskrit: पाण्डुराणि विशालानि दिव्य माल्य युतानि च
transliteration: pāṇḍurāṇi viśālāni divya mālya yutāni ca
english: And as he proceeded, the younger brother of the Lord of wealth, saw on all sides spacious cars capable of coursing at will, sable, furnished with fair garlands, and resounding with trumpet notes, and Gandharvas and Apsaras.

And as he proceeded, the younger brother of the Lord of wealth, saw on all sides spacious cars capable of coursing at will, sable, furnished with fair garlands, and resounding with trumpet notes, and Gandharvas and Apsaras.

sanskrit: वनानि पश्यन् सौम्यानि घ्राण तृप्ति कराणि च
transliteration: vanāni paśyan saumyāni ghrāṇa tṛpti karāṇi ca

sanskrit: अगुरूणाम् च मुख्यानाम् वनानि उपवनानि च
तक्कोलानाम् च जात्यानाम् फलानाम् च सुगन्धिनाम्
transliteration: agurūṇām ca mukhyānām vanāni upavanāni ca
takkolānām ca jātyānām phalānām ca sugandhinām

sanskrit: पुष्पाणि च तमालस्य गुल्मानि मरिचस्य च
transliteration: puṣpāṇi ca tamālasya gulmāni maricasya ca

sanskrit: शैलानि प्रवरान् चैव प्रवाल निचयान् तथा
कांचनानि च शृंगाणि राजतानि तथैव च
transliteration: śailāni pravarān caiva pravāla nicayān tathā
kāṃcanāni ca śṛṃgāṇi rājatāni tathaiva ca

sanskrit: धन धान्य उपपन्नानि स्त्री रत्नैः आवृतानि च
transliteration: dhana dhānya upapannāni strī ratnaiḥ āvṛtāni ca

sanskrit: हस्ति अश्व रथ गाढानि नगराणि विलोकयन्
तम् समम् सर्वतः स्निग्धम् मृदु संस्पर्श मारुतम्
transliteration: hasti aśva ratha gāḍhāni nagarāṇi vilokayan
tam samam sarvataḥ snigdham mṛdu saṃsparśa mārutam

sanskrit: अनूपे सिन्धु राजस्य ददर्श त्रिदिव उपमम्
तत्र अपश्यत् स मेघ आभम् न्यग्रोधम् मुनिभिर् वृतम्
transliteration: anūpe sindhu rājasya dadarśa tridiva upamam
tatra apaśyat sa megha ābham nyagrodham munibhir vṛtam

sanskrit: समंतात् यस्य ताः शाखाः शत योजनम् आयताः
यस्य हस्तिनम् आदाय महा कायम् च कच्छपम्
transliteration: samaṃtāt yasya tāḥ śākhāḥ śata yojanam āyatāḥ
yasya hastinam ādāya mahā kāyam ca kacchapam
english: And there he saw a fig tree, hued like clouds, surrounded by ascetics; its branches stretched around an hundred Yojanas, and the exceedingly powerful Garuda had ascended one of its boughs, taking an elephant and a huge tortoise, for the purpose of devouring them.

sanskrit: तस्य ताम् सहसा शाखाम् भारेण पतगोत्तमः
transliteration: tasya tām sahasā śākhām bhāreṇa patagottamaḥ

sanskrit: सुपर्णः पर्ण बहुलाम् बभंज अथ महाबलः
transliteration: suparṇaḥ parṇa bahulām babhaṃja atha mahābalaḥ

sanskrit: अजा बभूवुः धूम्राः च संगताः परमर्षयः
तेषाम् दयाअर्थम् गरुडः ताम् शाखाम् शत योजनाम्
transliteration: ajā babhūvuḥ dhūmrāḥ ca saṃgatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ
teṣām dayāartham garuḍaḥ tām śākhām śata yojanām

sanskrit: भग्नम् आदाय वेगेन तौ च उभौ गज कच्छपौ
एक पादेन धर्म आत्मा भक्षयित्वा तत् आमिषम्
transliteration: bhagnam ādāya vegena tau ca ubhau gaja kacchapau
eka pādena dharma ātmā bhakṣayitvā tat āmiṣam

sanskrit: स तेन तु प्रहर्षेण द्विगुणी कृत विक्रमः
अमृत आनयनार्थम् वै चकार मतिमान् मतिम्
transliteration: sa tena tu praharṣeṇa dviguṇī kṛta vikramaḥ
amṛta ānayanārtham vai cakāra matimān matim
english: Thereat, attaining double energy by virtue of that delight, that intelligent one set his heart on bringing ambrosia.

sanskrit: अयो जालानि निर्मथ्य भित्त्वा रत्न गृहम् वरम्
महेन्द्र भवनात् गुप्तम् आजहार अमृतम् ततः
transliteration: ayo jālāni nirmathya bhittvā ratna gṛham varam
mahendra bhavanāt guptam ājahāra amṛtam tataḥ
english: And tearing off the iron links of the network, and bursting into the repository of gem, he carried away secreted ambrosia from the residence of the great Indra.

sanskrit: तम् महर्षि गणैः जुष्टम् सुपर्ण कृत लक्षणम्
नाम्ना सुभद्रम् न्यग्रोधम् ददर्श धनद अनुजः
transliteration: tam maharṣi gaṇaiḥ juṣṭam suparṇa kṛta lakṣaṇam
nāmnā subhadram nyagrodham dadarśa dhanada anujaḥ
english: Kubera's younger brother beheld this fig tree, named Suparna had left his mark.

sanskrit: तम् तु गत्वा परम् पारम् समुद्रस्य नदी पतेः
ददर्श आश्रमम् एकांते पुण्ये रम्ये वनांतरे
transliteration: tam tu gatvā param pāram samudrasya nadī pateḥ
dadarśa āśramam ekāṃte puṇye ramye vanāṃtare
english: Then repairing to the other shore of that lord of rivers, the ocean, Rāvana saw an asylum lying in the forest in a charming and sacred recess.

sanskrit: तत्र कृष्ण अजिन धरम् जटा वल्कल धारिणम्
ददर्श नियत आहारम् मारीचम् नाम राक्षसम्
transliteration: tatra kṛṣṇa ajina dharam jaṭā valkala dhāriṇam
dadarśa niyata āhāram mārīcam nāma rākṣasam
english: And there he saw a Rākṣasa, named Mārīca, clad in a dark deer-skin, bearing a head of matted locks, subsisting on restricted fare.

sanskrit: स रावणः समागम्य विधिवत् तेन रक्षसा
मारीचेन अर्चितो राजा सर्व कामैः अमानुषैः
transliteration: sa rāvaṇaḥ samāgamya vidhivat tena rakṣasā
mārīcena arcito rājā sarva kāmaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ
english: And approaching Ravana duly, the Raksasa, Mārīca, received the king with every hospitality passing human.

sanskrit: तम् स्वयम् पूजयित्वा च भोजनेन उदकेन च
transliteration: tam svayam pūjayitvā ca bhojanena udakena ca
english: And having entertained him personally with meats and drinks, Mārica addressed him in weighty words.

sanskrit: कच्चित् ते कुशलम् राजन् लंकायाम् राक्षसेश्वर
केन अर्थेन् पुनः त्वम् वै तूर्णम् एव इह आगतः
transliteration: kaccit te kuśalam rājan laṃkāyām rākṣaseśvara
kena arthen punaḥ tvam vai tūrṇam eva iha āgataḥ
english: O lord of the Rākṣasas, O king, is it well with you in Lankā? And what for hast you again come hither so speedily?

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावण
ततः पश्चात् इदम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् वाक्य कोविदः
transliteration: evam ukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇa
tataḥ paścāt idam vākyam abravīt vākya kovidaḥ
english: Thus addressed by Mārīca, that highly powerful one, skilled in speech, Ravana said.

sanskrit: मारीच श्रूयताम् तात वचनम् मम भाषतः
आर्तो अस्मि मम च आर्तस्य भवान् हि परमा गतिः
transliteration: mārīca śrūyatām tāta vacanam mama bhāṣataḥ
ārto asmi mama ca ārtasya bhavān hi paramā gatiḥ
english: O Mărîca, hearken to me, my child, as I relate (everything to you). I am distressed and in this distress of mine, you are certainly my great refuge.

sanskrit: जानीषे त्वम् जनस्थाने भ्राता यत्र खरो मम
दूषणः च महाबाहुः स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे
transliteration: jānīṣe tvam janasthāne bhrātā yatra kharo mama
dūṣaṇaḥ ca mahābāhuḥ svasā śūrpaṇakhā ca me

sanskrit: त्रिशिराः च महातेजा राक्षसः पिशित अशनः
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा लब्ध लक्षा निशाचराः
transliteration: triśirāḥ ca mahātejā rākṣasaḥ piśita aśanaḥ
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā labdha lakṣā niśācarāḥ

sanskrit: वसन्ति मत् नियोगेन अधिवासम् च राक्षसः
बाधमाना महारण्ये मुनीन् ये धर्म चारिणः
transliteration: vasanti mat niyogena adhivāsam ca rākṣasaḥ
bādhamānā mahāraṇye munīn ye dharma cāriṇaḥ

sanskrit: शूराणाम् लब्ध लक्षाणाम् खर चित्त अनुवर्तिनाम्
transliteration: śūrāṇām labdha lakṣāṇām khara citta anuvartinām
english: And fourteen thousands of Rākşasas of dreadful deeds, heroic, high-spirited, Raksasas possessed of exceeding prowess; while residing in Janasthåna of late, clad in mail and equipped with various weapons, headed, by Khara, met with Rāma in the field.

sanskrit: ते तु इदानीम् जनस्थाने वसमाना महाबलाः
संगताः परम आयत्ता रामेण सह संयुगे
transliteration: te tu idānīm janasthāne vasamānā mahābalāḥ
saṃgatāḥ parama āyattā rāmeṇa saha saṃyuge
english: And fourteen thousands of Rākşasas of dreadful deeds, heroic, high-spirited, Raksasas possessed of exceeding prowess; while residing in Janasthåna of late, clad in mail and equipped with various weapons, headed, by Khara, met with Rāma in the field.

sanskrit: नाना शस्त्र प्रहरणाः खर प्रमुख राक्षसः
तेन संजात रोषेण रामेण रण मूर्धनि
transliteration: nānā śastra praharaṇāḥ khara pramukha rākṣasaḥ
tena saṃjāta roṣeṇa rāmeṇa raṇa mūrdhani

sanskrit: अनुक्त्वा परुषम् किंचित् शरैर् व्यापारितम् धनुः
transliteration: anuktvā paruṣam kiṃcit śarair vyāpāritam dhanuḥ

sanskrit: खरः च निहतः संख्ये दूषणः च निपातितः
transliteration: kharaḥ ca nihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇaḥ ca nipātitaḥ

sanskrit: हत्वा त्रिशिरसम् च अपि निर्भया दण्डकाः कृताः
पित्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन स भार्यः क्षीण जीवितः
transliteration: hatvā triśirasam ca api nirbhayā daṇḍakāḥ kṛtāḥ
pitrā nirastaḥ kruddhena sa bhāryaḥ kṣīṇa jīvitaḥ

sanskrit: स हन्ता तस्य सैन्यस्य रामः क्षत्रिय पांसनः
अशीलः कर्कशः तीक्ष्णो मूर्खो लुब्धो अजित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: sa hantā tasya sainyasya rāmaḥ kṣatriya pāṃsanaḥ
aśīlaḥ karkaśaḥ tīkṣṇo mūrkho lubdho ajita indriyaḥ

sanskrit: त्यक्त धर्मः तु अधर्म आत्मा भूतानाम् अहिते रतः
येन वैरम् विना अरण्ये सत्त्वम् आश्रित्य केवलम्
transliteration: tyakta dharmaḥ tu adharma ātmā bhūtānām ahite rataḥ
yena vairam vinā araṇye sattvam āśritya kevalam

sanskrit: कर्ण नास अपहारेण भगिनी मे विरूपिता
तस्य भार्याम् जनस्थानात् सीताम् सुर सुत उपमाम्
transliteration: karṇa nāsa apahāreṇa bhaginī me virūpitā
tasya bhāryām janasthānāt sītām sura suta upamām

sanskrit: आनयिष्यामि विक्रम्य सहायः तत्र मे भव
त्वया हि अहम् सहायेन पार्श्वस्थेन महाबल
transliteration: ānayiṣyāmi vikramya sahāyaḥ tatra me bhava
tvayā hi aham sahāyena pārśvasthena mahābala

sanskrit: भ्रातृभिः च सुरान् युद्धे समग्रान् न अभिचिंतये
तत् सहायो भव त्वम् मे समर्थो हि असि राक्षस
transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ ca surān yuddhe samagrān na abhiciṃtaye
tat sahāyo bhava tvam me samartho hi asi rākṣasa
english: Be you my help in it. For certain, O exceedingly strong one, if you help me at my side, if my brothers also back me, I do not think much of all the celestials. Therefore, be you my help; for, you are capable, O Raksasa.

sanskrit: वीर्ये युद्धे च दर्पे च न हि अस्ति सदृशः तव
उपायतो महान् शूरो महा माय विशारदः
transliteration: vīrye yuddhe ca darpe ca na hi asti sadṛśaḥ tava
upāyato mahān śūro mahā māya viśāradaḥ
english: In prowess in battle, and in indomitableness, there is none like you. You are a mighty hero commanding resources, and conversant with potent illusory displays.

sanskrit: एतत् अर्थम् अहम् प्राप्तः त्वत् समीपम् निशाचर
शृणु तत् कर्म साहाय्ये यत् कार्यम् वचनात् मम
transliteration: etat artham aham prāptaḥ tvat samīpam niśācara
śṛṇu tat karma sāhāyye yat kāryam vacanāt mama
english: Taking this to my heart, I have come to you, O ranger of the night. Do you listen as to the business in which by my command you are to help ime.

sanskrit: सौवर्णः त्वम् मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजत बिन्दुभिः
आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर
transliteration: sauvarṇaḥ tvam mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajata bindubhiḥ
āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara
english: Becoming a golden deer, marked with silver spots, do you range about in Rāma's asylum in presence of Sītā.

sanskrit: त्वाम् तु निःसंशयम् सीता दृष्ट्वा तु मृग रूपिणम्
गृह्यताम् इति भर्तारम् लक्ष्मणम् च अभिधास्यति
transliteration: tvām tu niḥsaṃśayam sītā dṛṣṭvā tu mṛga rūpiṇam
gṛhyatām iti bhartāram lakṣmaṇam ca abhidhāsyati
english: Seeing you helpless, in the shape of a deer, Sītā will say to her lord and Lakşmaņa also, Do you catch it.

sanskrit: ततः तयोः अपाये तु शून्ये सीताम् यथा सुखम्
निराबाधो हरिष्यामि राहुः चन्द्र प्रभाम् इव
transliteration: tataḥ tayoḥ apāye tu śūnye sītām yathā sukham
nirābādho hariṣyāmi rāhuḥ candra prabhām iva
english: When they shall have departed, I shall carry off from the empty asylum, Sītã without let, like Rāhu depriving the Moon of his splendour.

sanskrit: ततः पश्चात् सुखम् रामे भार्या आहरण कर्शिते
विस्रब्धम् प्रहरिष्यामि कृत अर्थेन अन्तर् आत्मना
transliteration: tataḥ paścāt sukham rāme bhāryā āharaṇa karśite
visrabdham prahariṣyāmi kṛta arthena antar ātmanā
english: Then when Rāma shall be sore afflicted because of the carrying off of his wife, I shall easily, crowning my soul with success, safely bear away Sita.

sanskrit: तस्य राम कथाम् श्रुत्वा मारीचस्य महात्मनः
शुष्कम् समभवत् वक्त्रम् परित्रस्तो बभूव च
transliteration: tasya rāma kathām śrutvā mārīcasya mahātmanaḥ
śuṣkam samabhavat vaktram paritrasto babhūva ca
english: Hearing Rāma's words, the face of the highsouled Mārīca became blank and he was seized with apprehension.

sanskrit: ओष्टौ परिलिहन् शुष्कौ नेत्रैः अनिमिषैः इव
मृत भूत इव आर्तः तु रावणम् समुत् ईक्षतः
transliteration: oṣṭau parilihan śuṣkau netraiḥ animiṣaiḥ iva
mṛta bhūta iva ārtaḥ tu rāvaṇam samut īkṣataḥ
english: And licking up his dried lips, with winkless eyes, (Marica) as if dead, and exceedingly distressed, eyed Ravana, steadily.

sanskrit: स रावणम् त्रस्त विषण्ण चेतामहावने राम पराक्रमज्ञः
कृत अंजलिः तत्त्वम् उवाच वाक्यम्हितम् च तस्मै हितम् आत्मनः च
transliteration: sa rāvaṇam trasta viṣaṇṇa cetāmahāvane rāma parākramajñaḥ
kṛta aṃjaliḥ tattvam uvāca vākyamhitam ca tasmai hitam ātmanaḥ ca
english: And alarmed because of Rāvana, with his mind depressed, Mārīca who well knew Rāma's prowess in the forest, with joined hands in agitation spoke words lending to his own as well as Rāvana's welfare.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
transliteration: tat śrutvā rākṣasendrasya vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ
english: Hearing the words of that sovereign of the Rākşasas, the highly energetic Mārica, skilled in speech, answered the Raksasa chief.

sanskrit: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन् सततम् प्रिय वादिनः
अप्रियस्य च पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः
transliteration: sulabhāḥ puruṣā rājan satatam priya vādinaḥ
apriyasya ca pathyasya vaktā śrotā ca durlabhaḥ
english: O king, the speaker of soft words is common, but the speaker and the listener of unwelcome though beneficial words are rarities.

sanskrit: न नूनम् बुध्यसे रामम् महावीर्यम् गुण उन्नतम्
अयुक्त चारः चपलो महेन्द्र वरुण उपमम्
transliteration: na nūnam budhyase rāmam mahāvīryam guṇa unnatam
ayukta cāraḥ capalo mahendra varuṇa upamam
english: Volatile, and employing no spies, you surely do not understand the exceedingly powerful Rāma towering high in virtues, and resembling the illustrious Indra or Varuņa himself.

sanskrit: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत् तात सर्वेषाम् भुवि रक्षसाम्
अपि रामो न संक्रुद्धः कुर्यात् लोकम् अराक्षसम्
transliteration: api svasti bhavet tāta sarveṣām bhuvi rakṣasām
api rāmo na saṃkruddhaḥ kuryāt lokam arākṣasam
english: I shall be well, me child, if Rāma fired with rage, do not render all the world bereft of Rākşasas;

sanskrit: अपि ते जीवित अंताय न उत्पन्ना जनकात्मजा
अपि सीता निमित्तम् च न भवेत् व्यसनम् महत्
transliteration: api te jīvita aṃtāya na utpannā janakātmajā
api sītā nimittam ca na bhavet vyasanam mahat
english: If Janaka's daughter has not sprung to compass your destruction, if a dreadful disaster do not befall you because of Sītā,

sanskrit: अपि त्वाम् ईश्वरम् प्राप्य काम वृत्तम् निरंकुशम्
न विनश्येत् पुरी लंका त्वया सह स राक्षसा
transliteration: api tvām īśvaram prāpya kāma vṛttam niraṃkuśam
na vinaśyet purī laṃkā tvayā saha sa rākṣasā
english: And if having obtained for her lord you that are wilful and wicked, the city of Lankā with you and the Rākṣasas do not meet with utter extermination.

sanskrit: त्वत् विधः काम वृत्तो हि दुःशीलः पाप मंत्रितः
आत्मानम् स्व जनम् राष्ट्रम् स राजा हन्ति दुर्मतिः
transliteration: tvat vidhaḥ kāma vṛtto hi duḥśīlaḥ pāpa maṃtritaḥ
ātmānam sva janam rāṣṭram sa rājā hanti durmatiḥ
english: The sovereign who is wicked, whimsical and of evil intent like you, bring about his own destruction as well as that of his kingdom and relatives.

sanskrit: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो न अमर्यादः कथंचन
न लुब्धो न च दुःशीलो न च क्षत्रिय पांसनः
transliteration: na ca pitrā parityakto na amaryādaḥ kathaṃcana
na lubdho na ca duḥśīlo na ca kṣatriya pāṃsanaḥ
english: Rāma, the enhancer of Kausalyā's delight had not been abandoned by his father, nor is he devoid of propriety of conduct; he is not avaricious, wicked nor the destroyer of Kaşatriya race.

sanskrit: न च धर्म गुणैर् हीनैः कौसल्या आनंद वर्धनः
न च तीक्ष्णो हि भूतानाम् सर्व भूत हिते रतः
transliteration: na ca dharma guṇair hīnaiḥ kausalyā ānaṃda vardhanaḥ
na ca tīkṣṇo hi bhūtānām sarva bhūta hite rataḥ
english: He does not lack religious merits or accomplishments, nor is he of a harsh temperament and intent on causing misery to creatures.

sanskrit: वंचितम् पितरम् दृष्ट्वा कैकेय्या सत्य वादिनम्
करिष्यामि इति धर्मात्मा ततः प्रव्रजितो वनम्
transliteration: vaṃcitam pitaram dṛṣṭvā kaikeyyā satya vādinam
kariṣyāmi iti dharmātmā tataḥ pravrajito vanam
english: Finding his truthful sire imposed on by Kaikeyi he has sojourned to woods. For compassing the welfare of his father Dasaratha and Kaikeyi he has entered the forest of Dandaka.

sanskrit: कैकेय्याः प्रिय कामार्थम् पितुर् दशरथस्य च
हित्वा राज्यम् च भोगान् च प्रविष्टो दण्डका वनम्
transliteration: kaikeyyāḥ priya kāmārtham pitur daśarathasya ca
hitvā rājyam ca bhogān ca praviṣṭo daṇḍakā vanam
english: Finding his truthful sire imposed on by Kaikeyi he has sojourned to woods. For compassing the welfare of his father Dasaratha and Kaikeyi he has entered the forest of Dandaka.

sanskrit: न रामः कर्कशः तात न अविद्वान् न अजित इन्द्रियः
अनृतम् न श्रुतम् चैव नैव त्वम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: na rāmaḥ karkaśaḥ tāta na avidvān na ajita indriyaḥ
anṛtam na śrutam caiva naiva tvam vaktum arhasi
english: Rāma, O my child is not harsh or foolish; nor has he not control over his senses. Far from speaking untruth he does not know false stories even.

sanskrit: रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मः साधुः सत्य पराक्रमः
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानाम् इव वासवः
transliteration: rāmo vigrahavān dharmaḥ sādhuḥ satya parākramaḥ
rājā sarvasya lokasya devānām iva vāsavaḥ
english: It did not behove you therefore to use such improper language towards him. he is an incarnation of virtue, pious and truthful, and lord of all men as Vāsava of all celestials.

sanskrit: कथम् नु तस्य वैदेहीम् रक्षिताम् स्वेन तेजसा
इच्छसे प्रसभम् हर्तुम् प्रभाम् इव विवस्वतः
transliteration: katham nu tasya vaidehīm rakṣitām svena tejasā
icchase prasabham hartum prabhām iva vivasvataḥ
english: How does you then wish to carry away by force his Vaidehī, protected by virtue of her own chastity, like to the rays of Sun?

sanskrit: शर अर्चिषम् अनाधृष्यम् चाप खड्ग इन्धनम् रणे
राम अग्निम् सहसा दीप्तम् न प्रवेष्टुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
transliteration: śara arciṣam anādhṛṣyam cāpa khaḍga indhanam raṇe
rāma agnim sahasā dīptam na praveṣṭum tvam arhasi
english: It did not behove you to enter that fire of Rāma who has arrows for rays and bow and scimitar for fuel. It did not behove you,

sanskrit: धनुर् व्यादित दीप्त आस्यम् शर अर्चिषम् अमर्षणम्
चाप बाण धरम् तीक्ष्णम् शत्रु सेना अपहारिणम्
transliteration: dhanur vyādita dīpta āsyam śara arciṣam amarṣaṇam
cāpa bāṇa dharam tīkṣṇam śatru senā apahāriṇam
english: O Rāvana, to approach Räma renouncing your kingdom, happiness and love of life, who is like to death itself and has bow for his widened and flaming mouth, and arrows for his rays and who is irrepressible, of mighty prowess, holding bows and arrows and repulsing the forces of the enemy.

sanskrit: राज्यम् सुखम् च संत्यज्य जीवितम् च इष्टम् आत्मनः
न अति आसादयितुम् तात राम अंतकम् इह अर्हसि
transliteration: rājyam sukham ca saṃtyajya jīvitam ca iṣṭam ātmanaḥ
na ati āsādayitum tāta rāma aṃtakam iha arhasi

sanskrit: अप्रमेयम् हि तत् तेजो यस्य सा जनकात्मजा
न त्वम् समर्थः ताम् हर्तुम् राम चाप आश्रयाम् वने
transliteration: aprameyam hi tat tejo yasya sā janakātmajā
na tvam samarthaḥ tām hartum rāma cāpa āśrayām vane
english: Incomparable is his power; daughter of Janaka is his wife and lives in the forest confiding in the mighty strength of his bow; you shall not be able to carry her away.

sanskrit: तस्य वै नर सिंहस्य सिंह उरस्कस्य भामिनी
प्राणेभ्यो अपि प्रियतरा भार्या नित्यम् अनुव्रता
transliteration: tasya vai nara siṃhasya siṃha uraskasya bhāminī
prāṇebhyo api priyatarā bhāryā nityam anuvratā
english: She is the beloved wife of that best of men having a leonine chest—and he holds his wife dearer than his life and is ever attached to her.

sanskrit: न सा धर्षयितुम् शक्या मैथिली ओजस्विनः प्रिया
दीप्तस्य इव हुत आशस्य शिखा सीता सुमध्यमा
transliteration: na sā dharṣayitum śakyā maithilī ojasvinaḥ priyā
dīptasya iva huta āśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā
english: And young Sītā beloved of the mighty Rāma, and like to the rays of flaming fire is ever incapable of being carried away by you.

sanskrit: किम् उद्यमम् व्यर्थम् इमम् कृत्वा ते राक्षसाधिप
दृष्टः चेत् त्वम् रणे तेन तत् अंतम् तव जीवितम्
transliteration: kim udyamam vyartham imam kṛtvā te rākṣasādhipa
dṛṣṭaḥ cet tvam raṇe tena tat aṃtam tava jīvitam
english: Of what avail is this vain attempt O Rākşasa chief? No sooner Rāma shall see you in the battle you shall meet with your end.

sanskrit: जीवितम् च सुखम् चैव राज्यम् चैव सुदुर्लभम्
यत् इच्छसि चिरम् भोक्तुम् मा कृथा राम विप्रियम्
transliteration: jīvitam ca sukham caiva rājyam caiva sudurlabham
yat icchasi ciram bhoktum mā kṛthā rāma vipriyam

sanskrit: स सर्वैः सचिवैः सार्धम् विभीषण पुरस्कृतैः
मंत्रयित्वा तु धर्मिष्ठैः कृत्वा निश्चयम् आत्मनः
दोषाणाम् च गुणानाम् च संप्रधार्य बल अबलम्
transliteration: sa sarvaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdham vibhīṣaṇa puraskṛtaiḥ
maṃtrayitvā tu dharmiṣṭhaiḥ kṛtvā niścayam ātmanaḥ
doṣāṇām ca guṇānām ca saṃpradhārya bala abalam

sanskrit: आत्मनः च बलम् ज्ञात्वा राघवस्य च तत्त्वतः
हितम् हि तव निश्चित्य क्षमम् त्वम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: ātmanaḥ ca balam jñātvā rāghavasya ca tattvataḥ
hitam hi tava niścitya kṣamam tvam kartum arhasi

sanskrit: अहम् तु मन्ये तव न क्षमम् रणेसमागमम् कोसल राज सूनुना
इदम् हि भूयः शृणु वाक्यम् उत्तमम्क्षमम् च युक्तम् च निशाचर अधिप
transliteration: aham tu manye tava na kṣamam raṇesamāgamam kosala rāja sūnunā
idam hi bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vākyam uttamamkṣamam ca yuktam ca niśācara adhipa
english: Methinks your approaching conflict with the son of the Kosala chief forebodes no good to you; hear again therefore O prince of the night rangers, words sensible and lending to your welfare.

sanskrit: कदाचित् अपि अहम् वीर्यात् पर्यटन् पृथिवीम् इमाम्
transliteration: kadācit api aham vīryāt paryaṭan pṛthivīm imām
english: Once on a time I was engaged in travelling all over the earth. I had in my body, resembling a huge mountain, the strength of a thousand Nagas.

sanskrit: नील जीमूत संकाशः तप्त कांचन कुण्डलः
भयम् लोकस्य जनयन् किरीटी परिघ आयुधः
transliteration: nīla jīmūta saṃkāśaḥ tapta kāṃcana kuṇḍalaḥ
bhayam lokasya janayan kirīṭī parigha āyudhaḥ
english: I had parigha in my hands, crown on my head and golden ear-rings on my ears and my body was of a dark blue colour like that of a cloud. Causing fright to the people I used to wander through the forest of Dandaka and live upon the flesh of the Rsis.

sanskrit: व्यचरम् दण्डक अरण्यम् ऋषि मांसानि भक्षयन्
विश्वामित्रो अथ धर्मात्मा मत् वित्रस्तो महामुनिः
transliteration: vyacaram daṇḍaka araṇyam ṛṣi māṃsāni bhakṣayan
viśvāmitro atha dharmātmā mat vitrasto mahāmuniḥ

sanskrit: स्वयम् गत्वा दशरथम् नरेन्द्रम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
अयम् रक्षतु माम् रामः पर्व काले समाहितः
transliteration: svayam gatvā daśaratham narendram idam abravīt
ayam rakṣatu mām rāmaḥ parva kāle samāhitaḥ

sanskrit: मारीचात् मे भयम् घोरम् समुत्पन्नम् नरेश्वर
इति एवम् उक्तो धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथः तदा
transliteration: mārīcāt me bhayam ghoram samutpannam nareśvara
iti evam ukto dharmātmā rājā daśarathaḥ tadā

sanskrit: ऊन द्वादश वर्षो अयम् अकृत अस्त्रः च राघवः
transliteration: ūna dvādaśa varṣo ayam akṛta astraḥ ca rāghavaḥ

sanskrit: कामम् तु मम यत् सैन्यम् मया सह गमिष्यति
transliteration: kāmam tu mama yat sainyam mayā saha gamiṣyati
english: Rāghava is still under twelve years of age and had not been well disciplined in military arts. But I have soldiers enough, and if permitted by you, O you best of ascetics, I shall with my fourfold forces kill your enemies, the rangers of the night.

sanskrit: वधिष्यामि मुनिश्रेष्ठ शत्रुम् तव यथा ईप्सितम्
] एवम् उक्तः स तु मुनी राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: vadhiṣyāmi muniśreṣṭha śatrum tava yathā īpsitam
] evam uktaḥ sa tu munī rājānam idam abravīt

sanskrit: रामात् न अन्यत् बलम् लोके पर्याप्तम् तस्य रक्षसः
transliteration: rāmāt na anyat balam loke paryāptam tasya rakṣasaḥ

sanskrit: आसीत् तव कृते कर्म त्रिलोक विदितम् नृप
कामम् अस्ति महत् सैन्यम् तिष्टतु इह परंतप
transliteration: āsīt tava kṛte karma triloka viditam nṛpa
kāmam asti mahat sainyam tiṣṭatu iha paraṃtapa

sanskrit: बालो अपि एष महातेजाः समर्थः तस्य निग्रहे
गमिष्ये रामम् आदाय स्वस्ति ते अस्तु परंतपः
transliteration: bālo api eṣa mahātejāḥ samarthaḥ tasya nigrahe
gamiṣye rāmam ādāya svasti te astu paraṃtapaḥ

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा स मुनिः तम् आदाय नृपात्मजम्
जगाम परम प्रीतो विश्वामित्रः स्वम् आश्रमम्
transliteration: iti evam uktvā sa muniḥ tam ādāya nṛpātmajam
jagāma parama prīto viśvāmitraḥ svam āśramam
english: Saying this the ascetic Viśvāmitra being pleased went to his asylum along with Rāma.

sanskrit: तम् तदा दण्डकारण्ये यज्ञम् उद्दिश्य दीक्षितम्
बभूव उपस्थितो रामः चित्रम् विस्फारयन् धनुः
transliteration: tam tadā daṇḍakāraṇye yajñam uddiśya dīkṣitam
babhūva upasthito rāmaḥ citram visphārayan dhanuḥ
english: After-words having been initiated for the sacrifice in the forest of Dandaka Rāma having unstrung his mighty bow came to the ascetic to protect the sacrifice.

sanskrit: अजात व्यंजनः श्रीमान् बालः श्यामः शुभेक्षणः
एक वस्त्र धरो धन्वी शिखी कनक मालया
transliteration: ajāta vyaṃjanaḥ śrīmān bālaḥ śyāmaḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ
eka vastra dharo dhanvī śikhī kanaka mālayā
english: He had a gold chain round his neck, a crest on his head and a bow in his hands; he had a pair of beautiful eyes, and only one piece of cloth; his countenance was of green hue and exquisite beauty and even then moustaches or other signs of manhood did not appear on his face.

sanskrit: अदृश्यत तदा रामो बाल चन्द्र इव उदितः
transliteration: adṛśyata tadā rāmo bāla candra iva uditaḥ
english: Beautifying the entire forest of Dandaka with his own splendour Rāma appeared like the newly risen moon.

sanskrit: ततो अहम् मेघ संकाशः तप्त कांचन कुण्डलः
बली दत्त वरो दर्पात् आजगाम आश्रम अंतरम्
transliteration: tato aham megha saṃkāśaḥ tapta kāṃcana kuṇḍalaḥ
balī datta varo darpāt ājagāma āśrama aṃtaram
english: Thereupon I resembling a cloud and having golden ear locks entered the asylum being proud of my power on account of the boons offered to me by Brahma.

sanskrit: तेन दृष्टः प्रविष्टो अहम् सहसा एव उद्यत आयुधः
माम् तु दृष्ट्वा धनुः सज्यम् असम्भ्रान्तः चकार ह
transliteration: tena dṛṣṭaḥ praviṣṭo aham sahasā eva udyata āyudhaḥ
mām tu dṛṣṭvā dhanuḥ sajyam asambhrāntaḥ cakāra ha
english: Seeing me enter he took up his dart and attached string to his bow with proper care.

sanskrit: अवजानन् अहम् मोहात् बालो अयम् इति राघवम्
विश्वामित्रस्य ताम् वेदिम् अभ्यधावम् कृत त्वरः
transliteration: avajānan aham mohāt bālo ayam iti rāghavam
viśvāmitrasya tām vedim abhyadhāvam kṛta tvaraḥ
english: Being under the influence of sheer foolishness I passed by him as a child and darted towards the sacrificial alter of Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: तेन मुक्तः ततो बाणः शितः शत्रु निबर्हणः
तेन अहम् ताडितः क्षिप्तः समुद्रे शत योजने
transliteration: tena muktaḥ tato bāṇaḥ śitaḥ śatru nibarhaṇaḥ
tena aham tāḍitaḥ kṣiptaḥ samudre śata yojane
english: Thereupon he wounded me with a sharpened sword capable of doing away with the enemies and threw me away into the ocean situated at a distance of hundred Yojanas.

sanskrit: न इच्छता तात माम् हन्तुम् तदा वीरेण रक्षितः
रामस्य शर वेगेन निरस्तो भ्रान्त चेतनः
transliteration: na icchatā tāta mām hantum tadā vīreṇa rakṣitaḥ
rāmasya śara vegena nirasto bhrānta cetanaḥ
english: He had no mind of killing me then and for this he saved my life. I was thrown however into the deep ocean being hindered by the velocity of his arrows and having lost my consciousness. Regaining my sense after a long while I returned to the city of Lankā.

sanskrit: पातितो अहम् तदा तेन गंभीरे सागर अंभसि
प्राप्य संज्ञाम् चिरात् तात लंकाम् प्रति गतः पुरीम्
transliteration: pātito aham tadā tena gaṃbhīre sāgara aṃbhasi
prāpya saṃjñām cirāt tāta laṃkām prati gataḥ purīm
english: He had no mind of killing me then and for this he saved my life. I was thrown however into the deep ocean being hindered by the velocity of his arrows and having lost my consciousness. Regaining my sense after a long while I returned to the city of Lankā.

sanskrit: एवम् अस्मि तदा मुक्तः सहायाः ते - शायास्तु - निपातिताः
अकृत अस्त्रेण रामेण बालेन अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा
transliteration: evam asmi tadā muktaḥ sahāyāḥ te - śāyāstu - nipātitāḥ
akṛta astreṇa rāmeṇa bālena akliṣṭa karmaṇā
english: Myself saved thus, my followers however all killed by Rāma of unwearied activity though a mere child and a novice in the are of warfare.

sanskrit: तत् मया वार्यमाणः त्वम् यदि रामेण विग्रहम्
करिष्यसि आपदम् घोराम् क्षिप्रम् प्राप्य न शिष्यसि
transliteration: tat mayā vāryamāṇaḥ tvam yadi rāmeṇa vigraham
kariṣyasi āpadam ghorām kṣipram prāpya na śiṣyasi
english: It is for this that I do prevent you; you shall be overwhelmed with calamities and meet with destruction if do you engage yourself in battle with him. In vain shall you bring about the affliction of the mirthful and sportive Rākşasas ever witnessing social festivities.

sanskrit: क्रीडा रति विधिज्ञानाम् समाज उत्सव शालिनाम्
रक्षसाम् चैव संतापम् अनर्थम् च आहरिष्यसि
transliteration: krīḍā rati vidhijñānām samāja utsava śālinām
rakṣasām caiva saṃtāpam anartham ca āhariṣyasi

sanskrit: हर्म्य प्रासाद संबाधाम् नाना रत्न विभूउषिताम्
द्रक्ष्यसि त्वम् पुरीम् लंकाम् विनष्टाम् मैथिली कृते
transliteration: harmya prāsāda saṃbādhām nānā ratna vibhūuṣitām
drakṣyasi tvam purīm laṃkām vinaṣṭām maithilī kṛte
english: And in vain shall you for Sītā compass the destruction of the city of Lankā, adorned with diverse jewels and filled with golden edifices.

sanskrit: अकुर्वन्तो अपि पापानि शुचयः पाप संश्रयात्
पर पापैः विनश्यन्ति मत्स्या नाग ह्रदे यथा
transliteration: akurvanto api pāpāni śucayaḥ pāpa saṃśrayāt
para pāpaiḥ vinaśyanti matsyā nāga hrade yathā
english: Pious men living with a vicious man, 'meet with destruction for his sins, though they themselves do not commit any misdeed, like to fish (devoured by Garuda) living in a lake where snakes dwell.

sanskrit: दिव्यचंदनदिग्धांगान्दिव्याअभरणभूषितान् -यद्वा-दिव्य चंदन दिग्ध अंगान् दिव्य आभरण भूषितान्
द्रक्ष्यसि अभिहतान् भूमौ तव दोषात् तु राक्षसान्
transliteration: divyacaṃdanadigdhāṃgāndivyāabharaṇabhūṣitān -yadvā-divya caṃdana digdha aṃgān divya ābharaṇa bhūṣitān
drakṣyasi abhihatān bhūmau tava doṣāt tu rākṣasān
english: Thus shall you witness that for your own folly the rangers of the night, adorned with celestial ornaments and having their body pasted with sandal, have been killed and brought down to the earth.

sanskrit: हृत दारान् स दारान् च दश विद्रवतो दिशः
हत शेषान् अशरणान् द्रक्ष्यसि त्वम् निशाचरान्
transliteration: hṛta dārān sa dārān ca daśa vidravato diśaḥ
hata śeṣān aśaraṇān drakṣyasi tvam niśācarān
english: And they deprived of shelter have fled away to different directions, some with their wives and some alone, having their wives carried away (by the enemies).

sanskrit: शर जाल परिक्षिप्ताम् अग्नि ज्वाला समावृताम्
प्रदग्ध भवनाम् लंकाम् द्रक्ष्यसि त्वम् असंशयम्
transliteration: śara jāla parikṣiptām agni jvālā samāvṛtām
pradagdha bhavanām laṃkām drakṣyasi tvam asaṃśayam
english: You shall further observe that all edifices of Lankā being enveloped with arrows and flaming fire have been burnt down to ashes.

sanskrit: पर दार अभिमर्षात् तु न अनयत् पाप तरम् महत्
transliteration: para dāra abhimarṣāt tu na anayat pāpa taram mahat
english: There is no greater sin on earth than carrying away another's wife. There are thousand ladies in your seraglio O king. Being attached to your wives do you preserve the race of the Rākşasas, your own line, your wished for life, kingdom, wealth and dignity.

sanskrit: भव स्व दार निरतः स्व कुलम् रक्ष राक्षस
मानम् वृद्धिम् च राज्यम् च जीवितम् च इष्टम् आत्मनः
transliteration: bhava sva dāra nirataḥ sva kulam rakṣa rākṣasa
mānam vṛddhim ca rājyam ca jīvitam ca iṣṭam ātmanaḥ
english: There is no greater sin on earth than carrying away another's wife. There are thousand ladies in your seraglio O king. Being attached to your wives do you preserve the race of the Rākşasas, your own line, your wished for life, kingdom, wealth and dignity.

sanskrit: कलत्राणि च सौम्यानि मित्र वर्गम् तथैव च
यदि इच्छसि चिरम् भोक्तुम् मा कृथा राम विप्रियम्
transliteration: kalatrāṇi ca saumyāni mitra vargam tathaiva ca
yadi icchasi ciram bhoktum mā kṛthā rāma vipriyam
english: Do not bring about Rāma's mischief if do you wish to live happily with your wives and friends.

sanskrit: निवार्यमाणः सुहृदा मया भृशम्प्रसह्य सीताम् यदि धर्षयिष्यसि
गमिष्यसि क्षीण बलः स बान्धवोयम क्षयम् राम शर आत्त जीवितः
transliteration: nivāryamāṇaḥ suhṛdā mayā bhṛśamprasahya sītām yadi dharṣayiṣyasi
gamiṣyasi kṣīṇa balaḥ sa bāndhavoyama kṣayam rāma śara ātta jīvitaḥ

sanskrit: एवम् अस्मि तदा मुक्तः कथंचित् तेन संयुगे
इदानीम् अपि यत् वृत्तम् तत् शृउणुष्व यत् उत्तरम्
transliteration: evam asmi tadā muktaḥ kathaṃcit tena saṃyuge
idānīm api yat vṛttam tat śṛuṇuṣva yat uttaram
english: I Was however somehow saved by Rāma in that conflict. Listen what happened afterwards.

sanskrit: राक्षाभ्याम् अहम् द्वाभ्याम् अनिर्विण्णः तथा कृतः
सहितो मृग रूपाभ्याम् प्रविष्टो दंडका वने
transliteration: rākṣābhyām aham dvābhyām anirviṇṇaḥ tathā kṛtaḥ
sahito mṛga rūpābhyām praviṣṭo daṃḍakā vane
english: I was not humbled even by the danger of my life. Once again I entered the forest of Dandaka accompanied by two Rākşasas assuming the shape of deer.

sanskrit: दीप्त जिह्वो महादंष्ट्रः तीक्ष्ण शृंगो महाबलः
transliteration: dīpta jihvo mahādaṃṣṭraḥ tīkṣṇa śṛṃgo mahābalaḥ

sanskrit: रुधिराणि पिबन्तः तेषाम् तन् मांसानि च भक्षयन्
transliteration: rudhirāṇi pibantaḥ teṣām tan māṃsāni ca bhakṣayan

sanskrit: ऋषि माअंस अशनः क्रूरः त्रासयन् वनगोचरान्
तदा रुधिर मत्तो अहम् व्यचरन् दंडका वनम्
transliteration: ṛṣi māaṃsa aśanaḥ krūraḥ trāsayan vanagocarān
tadā rudhira matto aham vyacaran daṃḍakā vanam
english: I had a most ugly figure and was maddened with drinking blood, and all the animals of the forest were exceedingly frightened at me.

sanskrit: तदा अहम् दंडकारण्ये विचरन् धर्म दूषकः
आसादयम् तदा रामम् तापसम् धर्मम् आश्रितम्
transliteration: tadā aham daṃḍakāraṇye vicaran dharma dūṣakaḥ
āsādayam tadā rāmam tāpasam dharmam āśritam
english: While I was thus traversing the forest of Dandaka throwing obstacles in the way of religious services I saw the pious ascetic Răma living on a restricted fare, the honoured Sītā and the mighty Lakşmaņa, taking recourse to asceticism, moderate in eating and ever engaged in the welfare of created beings.

sanskrit: वैदेहि च महाभागाम् लक्ष्मणम् च महरथम्
तापसम् नियत आहारम् सर्व बूत हिते रतम्
transliteration: vaidehi ca mahābhāgām lakṣmaṇam ca maharatham
tāpasam niyata āhāram sarva būta hite ratam
english: While I was thus traversing the forest of Dandaka throwing obstacles in the way of religious services I saw the pious ascetic Răma living on a restricted fare, the honoured Sītā and the mighty Lakşmaņa, taking recourse to asceticism, moderate in eating and ever engaged in the welfare of created beings.

sanskrit: सः अहम् वन गतम् रामम् परिभूय महाबलम्
तापसो अयम् इति ज्ञात्वा पूर्व वैरम् अनुस्मरन्
transliteration: saḥ aham vana gatam rāmam paribhūya mahābalam
tāpaso ayam iti jñātvā pūrva vairam anusmaran

sanskrit: अभ्यधावम् सुसंक्रुद्धः तीक्ष्ण शृंगो मृग आकृतिः
transliteration: abhyadhāvam susaṃkruddhaḥ tīkṣṇa śṛṃgo mṛga ākṛtiḥ
english: Remembering his former enmity and aggrandisement, I, being extremely wrathful, in my deer shape and with my sharpened horns, darted towards him with a view to kill him, considering through my ignorance the effulgent Rāma as none other but an ascetic living in the forest.

sanskrit: तेन त्यक्ताः त्रयो बाणाः शिताः शत्रु निबर्हणाः
विकृष्य सुमहत् चापम् सुपर्ण अनिल तुल्य गाः
transliteration: tena tyaktāḥ trayo bāṇāḥ śitāḥ śatru nibarhaṇāḥ
vikṛṣya sumahat cāpam suparṇa anila tulya gāḥ
english: Then stringing his huge bow he darted three sharpened arrows at me. Those three terrible arrows with bent knots resembling thunderbolts, killing enemies and drinking blood and having the motion of Garuda and air, coalescing with each other came before us.

sanskrit: ते बाणा वज्र संकाशाः सुघोरा रक्त भोजनाः
transliteration: te bāṇā vajra saṃkāśāḥ sughorā rakta bhojanāḥ
english: Then stringing his huge bow he darted three sharpened arrows at me. Those three terrible arrows with bent knots resembling thunderbolts, killing enemies and drinking blood and having the motion of Garuda and air, coalescing with each other came before us.

sanskrit: पराक्रमज्ञो रामस्य शठो दृष्ट भयः पुरा
समुत्क्रांतः ततः मुक्तः तौ उभौ राक्षसौ हतौ
transliteration: parākramajño rāmasya śaṭho dṛṣṭa bhayaḥ purā
samutkrāṃtaḥ tataḥ muktaḥ tau ubhau rākṣasau hatau
english: Wicked as I am, I was fully aware of his prowess having been frightened by him on a former occasion, and so I saved myself by escaping, but those two Raksasas were killed.

sanskrit: इह प्रव्राजितो युक्तः तापसो अहम् समाहितः
transliteration: iha pravrājito yuktaḥ tāpaso aham samāhitaḥ
english: O Rāvana, any how saved from the arrows of Rāma and having got my life back I have resorted to the life of an ascetic and have been carrying on asceticism here being absorbed in Yoga.

sanskrit: वृक्षे वृक्षे हि पश्यामि चीर कृष्ण अजिन अंबरम्
गृहीत धनुषम् रामम् पाश हस्तम् इव अंतकम्
transliteration: vṛkṣe vṛkṣe hi paśyāmi cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbaram
gṛhīta dhanuṣam rāmam pāśa hastam iva aṃtakam
english: From that very day I see Rāma wearing bark and deerskin even in the very trees before me like to Death with the noose in his hands.

sanskrit: अपि राम सहस्राणि भीतः पश्यामि रावण
राम भूतम् इदम् सर्वम् अरण्यम् प्रतिभाति मे
transliteration: api rāma sahasrāṇi bhītaḥ paśyāmi rāvaṇa
rāma bhūtam idam sarvam araṇyam pratibhāti me
english: Terrified as I am I always see thousands of Rāma around me. Me seems the entire forest is inhabited by Rāma only.

sanskrit: रामम् एव हि पश्यामि रहिते राक्षसेश्वर
दृष्ट्वा स्वप्न गतम् रामम् उद् भ्रमामि विचेतनः
transliteration: rāmam eva hi paśyāmi rahite rākṣaseśvara
dṛṣṭvā svapna gatam rāmam ud bhramāmi vicetanaḥ
english: O king of Räksasas, I see Rāma even in the quarter where there is no Rāma. Seeing him in my dreams even I look around like one awaken.

sanskrit: र कार अदीनि नामानि राम त्रस्तस्य रवण
रत्नानि च रथाः च एव वित्रासम् जनयन्ति मे
transliteration: ra kāra adīni nāmāni rāma trastasya ravaṇa
ratnāni ca rathāḥ ca eva vitrāsam janayanti me
english: O Rāvana what more shall I speak to you, I am so much afraid of Rāma that such words as Ratna (jewel), Ratha (chariot) which begin with the letter Ra administer consternation to me.

sanskrit: अहम् तस्य प्रभावज्ञो न युद्धम् तेन ते क्षमम्
बलिम् वा नमुचिं वा अपि हन्यद्धि रघुनंअंदन
transliteration: aham tasya prabhāvajño na yuddham tena te kṣamam
balim vā namuciṃ vā api hanyaddhi raghunaṃaṃdana
english: I am fully apprised of the prowess of that descendant of Raghu; it dose not behove you to enter into conflict with him; he can destroy Vāli and Namuci.

sanskrit: रणे रामेण युद्ध्स्व क्षमाम् वा कुरु रावण
न ते राम कथा कार्या यदि माम् द्रष्टुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: raṇe rāmeṇa yuddhsva kṣamām vā kuru rāvaṇa
na te rāma kathā kāryā yadi mām draṣṭum icchasi
english: O Rāvana, whether do you fight with Rāma or not, do not mention him to me if do you wish to see me.

sanskrit: बहवः साधवो लोके युक्ता धर्मम् अनुष्टिताः
transliteration: bahavaḥ sādhavo loke yuktā dharmam anuṣṭitāḥ
english: Many persons pious and devoted to asceticism on this earth have met with destruction for another's misdeeds.

sanskrit: सः अहम् पर अपराधेन विनाशेयम् निशाचर
कुरु यत् ते क्षमम् तत् त्वम् अहम् त्वाम् न अनुयामि वै
transliteration: saḥ aham para aparādhena vināśeyam niśācara
kuru yat te kṣamam tat tvam aham tvām na anuyāmi vai
english: And I shall meet with a similar fate for your sins. O you the ranger of night do whatever you like, I shall not follow you.

sanskrit: रामः च हि महातेजा महासत्त्वो महाबलः
अपि राक्षस लोकस्य भवेत् अन्तकरो अपि हि
transliteration: rāmaḥ ca hi mahātejā mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ
api rākṣasa lokasya bhavet antakaro api hi
english: Truely is that highly intelligent and effulgent Rāma of mighty prowess, like death itself to the rangers of night.

sanskrit: यदि शूर्पणखा हेतोः जनस्थान गत खरः
अति वृत्तो हतः पूर्वम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा
अत्र ब्रूहि यथावत् त्वम् को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhā hetoḥ janasthāna gata kharaḥ
ati vṛtto hataḥ pūrvam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa karmaṇā
atra brūhi yathāvat tvam ko rāmasya vyatikramaḥ
english: Though the wicked Khara of Janasthāna has been slain by him on Sūrpanakhā's account, yet how is he to blame for it do you truly speak.

sanskrit: इदम् वचो बन्धु हित अर्थिना मयायथा उच्यमानम् यदि न अभिपत्स्यसे
स बान्धवः त्यक्ष्यसि जीवितम् रणेहतो अद्य रामेण शरैः जिह्मगैः
transliteration: idam vaco bandhu hita arthinā mayāyathā ucyamānam yadi na abhipatsyase
sa bāndhavaḥ tyakṣyasi jīvitam raṇehato adya rāmeṇa śaraiḥ jihmagaiḥ
english: You are my friend; it is for this and for your welfare that I speak this truth to you. If do you not follow my words, yourself with all your kinsmen, shall be slain in battle by Rāma.

sanskrit: मारीचस्य तु तत् वाक्यम् क्षमम् युक्तम् च रावणः
उक्तो न प्रतिजग्राह मर्तु काम इव औषधम्
transliteration: mārīcasya tu tat vākyam kṣamam yuktam ca rāvaṇaḥ
ukto na pratijagrāha martu kāma iva auṣadham
english: As a person desirous of meeting with his end dose not take medicine, Ravana, the king of night-rangers paid no heed to the appropriate and sound words of Márica skilled in speech, foreboding good to him.

sanskrit: तम् पथ्य हित वक्तारम् मारीचम् राक्षसाधिपः
अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् अयुक्तम् काल चोदितः
transliteration: tam pathya hita vaktāram mārīcam rākṣasādhipaḥ
abravīt paruṣam vākyam ayuktam kāla coditaḥ
english: Moreover he addressed him with the following harsh words.

sanskrit: यत् किल एतत् अयुक्तार्थम् मारीच मयि कथ्यते
वाक्यम् निष्फलम् अत्यर्थम् बीजम् उप्तम् इव ऊषरे
transliteration: yat kila etat ayuktārtham mārīca mayi kathyate
vākyam niṣphalam atyartham bījam uptam iva ūṣare
english: O, Marica, what you have spoken to me, shall bear no fruit like to seeds sown into a desertland.

sanskrit: त्वत् वाक्यैः न तु माम् शक्यम् - भेतुम् - भेत्तुम् रामस्य संयुगे
transliteration: tvat vākyaiḥ na tu mām śakyam - bhetum - bhettum rāmasya saṃyuge
english: I shall not be frightened thereby to fight with that foolish Rāma—a human being of vicious deeds.

sanskrit: यः त्यक्त्वा सुहृदो राज्यम् मातरम् पितरम् तथा
स्त्री वाक्यम् प्राकृतम् श्रुत्वा वनम् एक पदे गतः
transliteration: yaḥ tyaktvā suhṛdo rājyam mātaram pitaram tathā
strī vākyam prākṛtam śrutvā vanam eka pade gataḥ
english: Surely shall I before you take away from that Rāma the destroyer of Khara his favourite wife, at whose words he has sojourned into woods renouncing his father mother, kingdom and friends.

sanskrit: अवश्यम् तु मया तस्य संयुगे खर घातिनः
प्राणैः प्रियतरा सीता हर्तव्या तव संनिधौ
transliteration: avaśyam tu mayā tasya saṃyuge khara ghātinaḥ
prāṇaiḥ priyatarā sītā hartavyā tava saṃnidhau
english: Surely shall I before you take away from that Rāma the destroyer of Khara his favourite wife, at whose words he has sojourned into woods renouncing his father mother, kingdom and friends.

sanskrit: एवम् मे निश्चिता बुद्धिः हृदि मारीच विद्यते
न व्यावर्तयितुम् शक्या स इन्द्रैः अपि सुर असुरैः
transliteration: evam me niścitā buddhiḥ hṛdi mārīca vidyate
na vyāvartayitum śakyā sa indraiḥ api sura asuraiḥ
english: I have made this firm resolution in my mind O, Marica; even Indra, with the celestials and Asuras shall not be able to shake it.

sanskrit: दोषम् गुणम् वा संपृष्टः त्वम् एवम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि
अपायम् वा अपि उपायम् वा कार्यस्य अस्य विनिश्चये
transliteration: doṣam guṇam vā saṃpṛṣṭaḥ tvam evam vaktum arhasi
apāyam vā api upāyam vā kāryasya asya viniścaye
english: It would have been proper for you to give vent to these expressions had I but asked you for advice to ascertain my duty, the propriety or impropriety of my action its way or losses,

sanskrit: उद्यत अंजलिना राज्ञे य इच्छेत् भूतिम् आत्मनः
transliteration: udyata aṃjalinā rājñe ya icchet bhūtim ātmanaḥ
english: A wise counsellor who wishes prosperity to himself should always communicate to his master his desire with joined hands whenever asked to do so.

sanskrit: वाक्यम् अप्रतिकूलम् तु मृदु पूर्वम् शुभम् हितम्
उपचारेण युक्तम् च वक्तव्यो वसुधा अधिपः
transliteration: vākyam apratikūlam tu mṛdu pūrvam śubham hitam
upacāreṇa yuktam ca vaktavyo vasudhā adhipaḥ
english: It is always proper to speak before monarchs such pleasant and favourable words as are intended for the welfare of the master and are sanctioned by the royal etiquette.

sanskrit: स अवमर्दम् तु यत् वाक्यम् अथवा मारीच हितम् उच्यते
न अभिनंदति तत् राजा मानार्थी मान वर्जितम्
transliteration: sa avamardam tu yat vākyam athavā mārīca hitam ucyate
na abhinaṃdati tat rājā mānārthī māna varjitam
english: A respectable king dose not receive with good grace friendly words even when they are expressed disre .pectfully.

sanskrit: पंच रूपाणि राजानो धारयन्ति अमित ओजसः
अग्नेः इन्द्रस्य सोमस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च
transliteration: paṃca rūpāṇi rājāno dhārayanti amita ojasaḥ
agneḥ indrasya somasya yamasya varuṇasya ca
english: Sovereigns of superb prowess assume the semblance of five deities–Agni, Indra, Moon, Yama, and Varuna. Powerful kings, O Ranger of the night, assume haughtiness, power, a placid look and contentment and administer punishment to the wicked.

sanskrit: औष्ण्यम् तथा विक्रमम् च सौम्यम् दण्डम् प्रसन्नताम्
transliteration: auṣṇyam tathā vikramam ca saumyam daṇḍam prasannatām
english: Sovereigns of superb prowess assume the semblance of five deities–Agni, Indra, Moon, Yama, and Varuna. Powerful kings, O Ranger of the night, assume haughtiness, power, a placid look and contentment and administer punishment to the wicked.

sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वासु अवस्थासु मान्याः पूज्याः च पार्थिवाः
त्वम् तु धर्मम् अविज्ञाय केवलम् मोहम् आश्रितः
transliteration: tasmāt sarvāsu avasthāsu mānyāḥ pūjyāḥ ca pārthivāḥ
tvam tu dharmam avijñāya kevalam moham āśritaḥ
english: They are to be adored and honoured therefore on all occasions. You are ignorant of kingly morality and fully absorbed in illusion. It is for this that you do out of your wickedness of heart address me your guest with these harsh words. I do not ask you, O, Raksasa about the propriety (of my conduct) or about my welfare.

sanskrit: अभ्यागतम् माम् दौरात्म्यात् परुषम् वदसि ईदृशम्
गुण दोषौ न पृच्छामि क्षमम् च आत्मनि राक्षस
transliteration: abhyāgatam mām daurātmyāt paruṣam vadasi īdṛśam
guṇa doṣau na pṛcchāmi kṣamam ca ātmani rākṣasa
english: They are to be adored and honoured therefore on all occasions. You are ignorant of kingly morality and fully absorbed in illusion. It is for this that you do out of your wickedness of heart address me your guest with these harsh words. I do not ask you, O, Raksasa about the propriety (of my conduct) or about my welfare.

sanskrit: मया उक्तम् अपि च एतावत् त्वाम् प्रति अमितविक्रम
अस्मिन् तु स भवान् कृत्ये साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: mayā uktam api ca etāvat tvām prati amitavikrama
asmin tu sa bhavān kṛtye sāhāyyam kartum arhasi
english: I did only ask you for your help.

sanskrit: श्रुणु तत् कर्म साहाय्ये यत् कार्यम् वचनात् मम
सौवर्णः त्वम् मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजत बिन्दुभिः
transliteration: śruṇu tat karma sāhāyye yat kāryam vacanāt mama
sauvarṇaḥ tvam mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajata bindubhiḥ
english: Listen what you shall have to do at my request in my aid; assuming the shape of a deer having golden skin painted with silvery drops do you proceed to the asylum of Rāma, and ranging at large before Vaidehī do you after captivating her take your wished-for way.

sanskrit: आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर
प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेहीम् यथा इष्टम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara
pralobhayitvā vaidehīm yathā iṣṭam gantum arhasi
english: Listen what you shall have to do at my request in my aid; assuming the shape of a deer having golden skin painted with silvery drops do you proceed to the asylum of Rāma, and ranging at large before Vaidehī do you after captivating her take your wished-for way.

sanskrit: त्वाम् हि माया मयम् दृष्ट्वा कांचनम् जात विस्मया
आनय एनम् इति क्षिप्रम् रामम् वक्ष्यति मैथिली
transliteration: tvām hi māyā mayam dṛṣṭvā kāṃcanam jāta vismayā
ānaya enam iti kṣipram rāmam vakṣyati maithilī
english: Vaidehi, being struck with wonder seeing you a golden deer capable of illusions, shall request Rāma to get you soon for her.

sanskrit: अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे दूरम् च यात्वा अपि उदाहर
हा सीते लक्ष्मणे इति एवम् राम वाक्य अनुरूपकम्
transliteration: apakrānte ca kākutsthe dūram ca yātvā api udāhara
hā sīte lakṣmaṇe iti evam rāma vākya anurūpakam
english: Kākutstha issuing out of the asylum, you shall, at a great distance utter such cries as O Sītā, O Lakşmaņa imitating his (Rāma's) voice.

sanskrit: तत् श्रुत्वा राम पदवीम् सीताया च प्रचोदितः
transliteration: tat śrutvā rāma padavīm sītāyā ca pracoditaḥ
english: Hearing those cries Lakşmaņa also, at the behest of Sītā, shall proceed to Rāma,

sanskrit: अपक्रान्ते च काकुत्स्थे लक्ष्मण च यथा सुखम्
transliteration: apakrānte ca kākutsthe lakṣmaṇa ca yathā sukham
english: When both Rāma and Laksmana shall go elsewhere in this way, I shall to my felicity carry away Vaidehī like to the thousand-eyed deity carrying away Sací.

sanskrit: एवम् कृत्वा तु इदम् कार्यम् यथा इष्टम् गच्छ राक्षस
राज्यस्य अर्धम् प्रदास्यामि मारीच तव सुव्रत
transliteration: evam kṛtvā tu idam kāryam yathā iṣṭam gaccha rākṣasa
rājyasya ardham pradāsyāmi mārīca tava suvrata
english: O Rākşasa, do you go wherever you like after doing this. I shall confer on you, O Mārīca, half of my kingdom.

sanskrit: गच्छ सौम्य शिवम् मार्गम् कार्यस्य अस्य विवृद्धये
अहम् तु अनुगमिष्यामि स रथो दण्डका वनम्
transliteration: gaccha saumya śivam mārgam kāryasya asya vivṛddhaye
aham tu anugamiṣyāmi sa ratho daṇḍakā vanam
english: O you of auspicious look, do you proceed towards the forest of Dandaka to compass this end of mine; I shall follow you in my chariot,

sanskrit: प्राप्य सीताम् अयुद्धेन वंचयित्वा तु राघवम्
लंकाम् प्रति गमिष्यामि कृत कार्यः सह त्वया
transliteration: prāpya sītām ayuddhena vaṃcayitvā tu rāghavam
laṃkām prati gamiṣyāmi kṛta kāryaḥ saha tvayā
english: Acquiring Sītā without any conflict, after imposing upon Rāma I shall return to Lankā successful along with you.

sanskrit: नो चेत् करोषि मारीच हन्मि त्वाम् अहम् अद्य वै
एतत् कार्यम् अवश्यम् मे बलाद् अपि करिष्यसि
राज्ञो हि प्रतिकूलस्थो न जातु सुखम् एधते
transliteration: no cet karoṣi mārīca hanmi tvām aham adya vai
etat kāryam avaśyam me balād api kariṣyasi
rājño hi pratikūlastho na jātu sukham edhate
english: I shall kill you, O Mārīca, if do you not obey my behest. I shall compel you to do this. No body can attain to prosperity and happiness, acting against his sovereign's will.

sanskrit: आसाद्या तम् जीवित सम्शयः तेमृत्युर् ध्रुवो हि अद्य मया विरुध्यतः
एतत् यथावत् परिगृह्य बुद्ध्यायत् अत्र पथ्यम् कुरु तत् तथा त्वम्
transliteration: āsādyā tam jīvita samśayaḥ temṛtyur dhruvo hi adya mayā virudhyataḥ
etat yathāvat parigṛhya buddhyāyat atra pathyam kuru tat tathā tvam
english: Truly shall you risk your life if you approaches Rāma, but you shall meet with sure destruction if do you act against my will. Consider about it, and do what you think proper.

sanskrit: आज्ञप्तो रावणेन इत्थम् प्रतिकूलम् च राजवत्
transliteration: ājñapto rāvaṇena ittham pratikūlam ca rājavat
english: Being thus commended by Rāvana like a king to act against his will Mārica fearlessly addressed the lord of the Rākṣasas with the following bold words.

sanskrit: केन अयम् उपदिष्टः ते विनाशः पाप कर्मणा
स पुत्रस्य स राज्यस्य स अमात्यस्य निशाचर
transliteration: kena ayam upadiṣṭaḥ te vināśaḥ pāpa karmaṇā
sa putrasya sa rājyasya sa amātyasya niśācara
english: What person of impious deeds has advised you ( ranger of the night thus in order to exterminate you with your kingdom, counsellors and children?

sanskrit: कः त्वया सुखिना राजन् न अभिनन्दति पापकृत्
केन इदम् उपदिष्टम् ते मृत्यु द्वारम् उपायतः
transliteration: kaḥ tvayā sukhinā rājan na abhinandati pāpakṛt
kena idam upadiṣṭam te mṛtyu dvāram upāyataḥ
english: Who of a vicious heart, O King, dose not feel himself happy at your welfare? Who has pointed out to you the way of your death under the cover of your means?

sanskrit: शत्रवः तव सुव्यक्तम् हीन वीर्या निशा चर
transliteration: śatravaḥ tava suvyaktam hīna vīryā niśā cara
english: O Ranger of night surely do your weak enemies wish to bring about your destruction by making you enter into a conflict with a powerful man.

sanskrit: केन इदम् उपदिष्टम् ते क्षुद्रेण अहित बुद्धिना
यः त्वाम् इच्छति नश्यन्तम् स्व कृतेन निशाचर
transliteration: kena idam upadiṣṭam te kṣudreṇa ahita buddhinā
yaḥ tvām icchati naśyantam sva kṛtena niśācara
english: What little-minded man of evil intent has counselled you thus? O Ranger of night, really do they desire that you do bring destruction upon yourself by your own actions.

sanskrit: वध्याः खलु न वध्यन्ते सचिवाः तव रावण
ये त्वाम् उत्पथम् आरूढम् न निगृह्णन्ति सर्वशः
transliteration: vadhyāḥ khalu na vadhyante sacivāḥ tava rāvaṇa
ye tvām utpatham ārūḍham na nigṛhṇanti sarvaśaḥ
english: You do not exterminate your counsellors O Rāvana, albeit they are worthy of being destroyed. For they do not prevent these entirely from your evil course.

sanskrit: अमात्यैः काम वृत्तो हि राजा कापथम् आश्रितः
निग्राह्यः सर्वथा सद्भिः न निग्राह्यो निगृह्यसे
transliteration: amātyaiḥ kāma vṛtto hi rājā kāpatham āśritaḥ
nigrāhyaḥ sarvathā sadbhiḥ na nigrāhyo nigṛhyase
english: Wise counsellors do always restrain a king who wends a vicious track being guided by his impulses and passions; but about you they are quite unmindful, though you should by every means be brought under restraint.

sanskrit: धर्मम् अर्थम् च कामम् च यशः च जयताम् वर
transliteration: dharmam artham ca kāmam ca yaśaḥ ca jayatām vara
english: O you the best of conquerors, O you the ranger of high, ministers by the grace of their sovereign attain virtue, wealth, desires and fame.

sanskrit: विपर्यये तु तत् सर्वम् व्यर्थम् भवति रावण
व्यसनम् स्वामि वैगुण्यात् प्राप्नुवन्ति इतरे जनाः
transliteration: viparyaye tu tat sarvam vyartham bhavati rāvaṇa
vyasanam svāmi vaiguṇyāt prāpnuvanti itare janāḥ
english: But those objects are never attained O Rāvana when they are not in good odour with their sovereign; moreover the subjects meet with dangers when he is devoid of all qualities.

sanskrit: राज मूलो हि धर्मः च जयः च जयताम् वर
transliteration: rāja mūlo hi dharmaḥ ca jayaḥ ca jayatām vara
english: O you the best of conquerors, the king is the root of virtue and fame to the subjects; he should therefore be always protected by them.

sanskrit: राज्यम् पालयितुम् शक्यम् न तीक्ष्णेन निशाचर
न च अपि प्रतिकूलेन न अविनीतेन राक्षस
transliteration: rājyam pālayitum śakyam na tīkṣṇena niśācara
na ca api pratikūlena na avinītena rākṣasa
english: O ranger of night, proud kings of cruel temperament, acting against the subjects can never administer their kingdoms.

sanskrit: ये तीक्ष्ण मंत्राः सचिवा भज्यन्ते सह तेन वै
विषमे तुरगाः शीघ्रा मन्द सारथयो यथा
transliteration: ye tīkṣṇa maṃtrāḥ sacivā bhajyante saha tena vai
viṣame turagāḥ śīghrā manda sārathayo yathā
english: So do the ministers of cruel counsel meet with their end like to a chariot driven into a wild track by an unskilled charioteer.

sanskrit: बहवः साधवो लोके युक्त धर्मम् अनुष्ठिताः
transliteration: bahavaḥ sādhavo loke yukta dharmam anuṣṭhitāḥ
english: Many a pious person, on this earth, ever engaged in the performance of religious services, have, for the folly of other persons, met with destruction along with their relatives.

sanskrit: रक्ष्यमाणा न वर्धन्ते मेषा गोमायुना यथा
transliteration: rakṣyamāṇā na vardhante meṣā gomāyunā yathā
english: Verily the subjects, O Ravana, can never expect to prosper under the regime of hotnatured sovereigns acting against their subjects like to deer under the protection of a jackal.

sanskrit: येषाम् त्वम् कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिः अजित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: yeṣām tvam karkaśo rājā durbuddhiḥ ajita indriyaḥ
english: All the Rākşasas shall surely die, O Rāvana whose lord are you, foolish, cruel and under the control of your passions.

sanskrit: तद् इदम् काक तालीयम् घोरम् आसादितम् मया
अत्र त्वम् शोचनीयो असि स सैन्यो विनशिष्यसि
transliteration: tad idam kāka tālīyam ghoram āsāditam mayā
atra tvam śocanīyo asi sa sainyo vinaśiṣyasi
english: I shall not be the least sorry if I do meet with a sudden accident—what I do deplore most is that you shall meet in no time with destruction along with your soldiery.

sanskrit: माम् निहत्य तु रामो असौ अचिरात् त्वाम् वधिष्यति
अनेन कृत कृत्यो अस्मि म्रिये च अपि अरिणा हतः
transliteration: mām nihatya tu rāmo asau acirāt tvām vadhiṣyati
anena kṛta kṛtyo asmi mriye ca api ariṇā hataḥ
english: Compassing my end Rāma shall exterminate you in no time and blessed I shall be being killed by an enemy in the conflict.

sanskrit: दर्शनात् एव रामस्य हतम् माम् अवधारय
आत्मानम् च हतम् विद्धि हृत्वा सीताम् स बान्धवम्
transliteration: darśanāt eva rāmasya hatam mām avadhāraya
ātmānam ca hatam viddhi hṛtvā sītām sa bāndhavam
english: Surely do you know that no sooner shall I see Rāma I shall be done away with; you shall carrying away Sītā meet with your end along with your kinsmen.

sanskrit: आनयिष्यसि चेत् सीताम् आश्रमात् सहितो मया
न एव त्वम् असि न एव अहम् न एव लंका न राक्षसाः
transliteration: ānayiṣyasi cet sītām āśramāt sahito mayā
na eva tvam asi na eva aham na eva laṃkā na rākṣasāḥ
english: And if do you bring Şītā with me from the asylum, none shall be saved, me, yourself, the city of Lankā and the Rākşasas.

sanskrit: निवार्यमाणः तु मया हित एषिणान मृष्यसे वाक्यम् इदम् निशाचर
परेत कल्पा हि गत आयुषो नराहितम् न गृह्णन्ति सुहृद्भिः ईरितम्
transliteration: nivāryamāṇaḥ tu mayā hita eṣiṇāna mṛṣyase vākyam idam niśācara
pareta kalpā hi gata āyuṣo narāhitam na gṛhṇanti suhṛdbhiḥ īritam
english: You do not relish my words O ranger of the night though prevented by me, who wishes you welfare; those men who range on the verge of death, well-nigh finishing the term of their existence do not receive with good grace the counsels of friends.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु परुषम् मारीचो रावणम् ततः
गच्छावः इति अब्रवीत् दीनो भयात् रात्रिम् चर प्रभोः
transliteration: evam uktvā tu paruṣam mārīco rāvaṇam tataḥ
gacchāvaḥ iti abravīt dīno bhayāt rātrim cara prabhoḥ
english: Speaking these harsh words to Rāvana, Mārīca being afraid of him said, We shall both go.

sanskrit: दृष्टाः च अहम् पुनः तेन शर चाप असि धारिणा
मद्वधो उद्यत शस्त्रेण विनष्टम् जीवितम् च मे
transliteration: dṛṣṭāḥ ca aham punaḥ tena śara cāpa asi dhāriṇā
madvadho udyata śastreṇa vinaṣṭam jīvitam ca me
english: Surely shall I be deprived of my life b, (Rāma) taking up his scimitar and having a bow and arrows in his hands, if I go before hiin again.

sanskrit: न हि रामम् पराक्रम्य जीवन् प्रति निवर्तते
वर्तते प्रति रूपो असौ यम दण्ड हतस्य ते
transliteration: na hi rāmam parākramya jīvan prati nivartate
vartate prati rūpo asau yama daṇḍa hatasya te
english: Meeting with his prowess you shall never return with your life; he is like the noose of Death to you though you had baffled its power.

sanskrit: किम् नु कर्तुम् मया शक्यम् एवम् त्वयि दुरात्मनि
एष गच्छामि अहम् तात स्वस्ति ते अस्तु निशाचरः
transliteration: kim nu kartum mayā śakyam evam tvayi durātmani
eṣa gacchāmi aham tāta svasti te astu niśācaraḥ
english: You are vicious-souled, what can I do for you? be you crowned with success O ranger of the night, I shall go.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टः तु अभवत् तेन वचनेन स राक्षसः
transliteration: prahṛṣṭaḥ tu abhavat tena vacanena sa rākṣasaḥ
english: The Lord of Rākşasas being pleased with Mārīca's words embraced him warmly and said,

sanskrit: एतत् शौण्डीर्य - चौत्तिर्य -न्युक्तम् ते मत् च्छंद वश वर्तिनः
इदानीम् असि मारीचः पूर्वम् अन्यो निशाचरः
transliteration: etat śauṇḍīrya - cauttirya -nyuktam te mat cchaṃda vaśa vartinaḥ
idānīm asi mārīcaḥ pūrvam anyo niśācaraḥ
english: This is worthy of your heroism that you have addressed yourself to act after my desire. You were another Raksasa before and have now become true Mārīca.

sanskrit: मया सह रथो युक्तः पिशाच वदनैः खरैः
transliteration: mayā saha ratho yuktaḥ piśāca vadanaiḥ kharaiḥ
english: Do you now with me ascend this chariot coursing in the air, crested with jewels and driven by asses having faces of a demon.

sanskrit: प्रलोभयित्वा वैदेहीम् यथा इष्टम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि
ताम् शून्ये प्रसभम् सीताम् आनयिष्यामि मैथिलीम्
transliteration: pralobhayitvā vaidehīm yathā iṣṭam gantum arhasi
tām śūnye prasabham sītām ānayiṣyāmi maithilīm
english: Enchanting Vaidehī you shall wend your way and away shall I carry the daughter of the king of Mithilā by force (when there shall be neither Rāma nor Laksmana by her.)

sanskrit: तथा इति उवाच एनम् रावणम् ताटका सुतः
ततो रावण मारीचौ विमानम् इव तम् रथम्
transliteration: tathā iti uvāca enam rāvaṇam tāṭakā sutaḥ
tato rāvaṇa mārīcau vimānam iva tam ratham
english: Thereupon Tārakā's son assented to Rāvana's words, and both of them ascending the chariot like to a heavenly car set out for the hermitage.

sanskrit: आरुह्य ययतुः शीघ्रम् तस्मात् आश्रम मण्डलात्
तथैव तत्र पश्यन्तौ पत्तनानि वनानि च
transliteration: āruhya yayatuḥ śīghram tasmāt āśrama maṇḍalāt
tathaiva tatra paśyantau pattanāni vanāni ca

sanskrit: गिरीम् च सरिताः सर्वा राष्ट्राणि नगराणि च
समेत्य दण्डक अरण्यम् राघवस्य आश्रमम् ततः
transliteration: girīm ca saritāḥ sarvā rāṣṭrāṇi nagarāṇi ca
sametya daṇḍaka araṇyam rāghavasya āśramam tataḥ
english: And beholding diverse towns, forests, mountains, rivers, kingdoms and cities they reached the forest of Dandaka and the asylum of Rāma.

sanskrit: अवतीर्य रथात् तस्मात् ततः कांचन भूषणात्
transliteration: avatīrya rathāt tasmāt tataḥ kāṃcana bhūṣaṇāt

sanskrit: हस्ते गृहीत्वा मारीचम् रावणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
एतत् राम आश्रम पदम् दृश्यते कदली वृतम्
transliteration: haste gṛhītvā mārīcam rāvaṇo vākyam abravīt
etat rāma āśrama padam dṛśyate kadalī vṛtam

sanskrit: क्रियताम् तत् सखे शीघ्रम् यत् अर्थम् वयम् आगताः
स रावण वचः श्रुत्वा मारीचो राक्षसः तदा
transliteration: kriyatām tat sakhe śīghram yat artham vayam āgatāḥ
sa rāvaṇa vacaḥ śrutvā mārīco rākṣasaḥ tadā

sanskrit: मृगो भूत्वा आश्रम द्वारि रामस्य विचचार ह
स तु रूपम् समास्थाय महत् अद्भुत दर्शनम्
transliteration: mṛgo bhūtvā āśrama dvāri rāmasya vicacāra ha
sa tu rūpam samāsthāya mahat adbhuta darśanam

sanskrit: किम्चित् अभ्युन्नत ग्रीव इन्द्रनील निभ उदरः
मधूक निभ पार्श्वः च कंज किंजल्क सम्निभः
transliteration: kimcit abhyunnata grīva indranīla nibha udaraḥ
madhūka nibha pārśvaḥ ca kaṃja kiṃjalka samnibhaḥ

sanskrit: वैदूर्य संकाश खुरः तनु जंघः सुसंहतः
इन्द्र आयुध सवर्णेन पुच्छेन ऊर्ध्वम् विराजितः
transliteration: vaidūrya saṃkāśa khuraḥ tanu jaṃghaḥ susaṃhataḥ
indra āyudha savarṇena pucchena ūrdhvam virājitaḥ

sanskrit: मनोहर स्निग्ध वर्णो रत्नैः नाना विधैः वृतः
क्षणेन राक्षसो जातो मृगः परम शोभनः
transliteration: manohara snigdha varṇo ratnaiḥ nānā vidhaiḥ vṛtaḥ
kṣaṇena rākṣaso jāto mṛgaḥ parama śobhanaḥ

sanskrit: वनम् प्रज्वलयन् रम्यम् राम आश्रम पदम् च तत्
मनोहरम् दर्शनीयम् रूपम् कृत्वा स राक्षसः
transliteration: vanam prajvalayan ramyam rāma āśrama padam ca tat
manoharam darśanīyam rūpam kṛtvā sa rākṣasaḥ
english: And in no time the Rākşasa assumed the shape of a beautiful deer. To tempt Vaidehī that ranger of the night, assuming a beautiful countenance painted with diverse metals, illumining the beautiful forest and Rāma's asylum with its beauty, and ranging at large on the green field and living on grass, began to

And in no time the Rākşasa assumed the shape of a beautiful deer. To tempt Vaidehī that ranger of the night, assuming a beautiful countenance painted with diverse metals, illumining the beautiful forest and Rāma's asylum with its beauty, and ranging at large on the green field and living on grass, began to

sanskrit: रोप्यैः बिन्दु शतैः चित्रो भूत्वा च प्रिय दर्शनः
transliteration: ropyaiḥ bindu śataiḥ citro bhūtvā ca priya darśanaḥ
english: That one of lively presence having its body painted with hundreds of silver drops and living on twigs of trees began to range in the forest.

sanskrit: कदली गृहकम् गत्वा कर्णिकारानि ततः ततः
transliteration: kadalī gṛhakam gatvā karṇikārāni tataḥ tataḥ
english: Sometimes walking into the plantain house, sometimes walking around the forest of Karņikā, sometimes coming within the compass of Sītā's vision, that best of deer having its back painted with gold began to range slowly around the hermitage.

sanskrit: राजीव चित्र पृष्ठः स विरराज महामृगः
राम आश्रम पद अभ्याशे विचचार यथा सुखम्
transliteration: rājīva citra pṛṣṭhaḥ sa virarāja mahāmṛgaḥ
rāma āśrama pada abhyāśe vicacāra yathā sukham
english: It began to walk at pleasure near Rāma's asylum. Sometimes going, sometimes stopping, at one time running very swiftly and receding the next moment, that best of deer began to range at large.

sanskrit: पुनर् गत्वा निवृत्तः च विचचार मृगोत्तमः
गत्वा मुहूर्तम् त्वरया पुनः प्रति निवर्तते
transliteration: punar gatvā nivṛttaḥ ca vicacāra mṛgottamaḥ
gatvā muhūrtam tvarayā punaḥ prati nivartate
english: It began to walk at pleasure near Rāma's asylum. Sometimes going, sometimes stopping, at one time running very swiftly and receding the next moment, that best of deer began to range at large.

sanskrit: विक्रीडन् च पुनर् भूमौ पुनर् एव निषीदति
आश्रम द्वारम् आगम्य मृग यूथानि गच्छति
transliteration: vikrīḍan ca punar bhūmau punar eva niṣīdati
āśrama dvāram āgamya mṛga yūthāni gacchati
english: Sometimes playing around, sometimes lying on earth and sometimes following the deer-herd having come within the thresh hold of the asylum and then followed again by them that Rākṣasa assuming the form of a deer came back to see Sītā.

sanskrit: मृग यूथैः अनुगतः पुनर् एव निवर्तते
सीता दर्शनम् आकांक्षन् राक्षसो मृगताम् गतः
transliteration: mṛga yūthaiḥ anugataḥ punar eva nivartate
sītā darśanam ākāṃkṣan rākṣaso mṛgatām gataḥ
english: Sometimes playing around, sometimes lying on earth and sometimes following the deer-herd having come within the thresh hold of the asylum and then followed again by them that Rākṣasa assuming the form of a deer came back to see Sītā.

sanskrit: समुद्वीक्ष्य च सर्वे तम् मृगा ये अन्ये वनेचराः
transliteration: samudvīkṣya ca sarve tam mṛgā ye anye vanecarāḥ
english: He then began to range at large in the beautiful forest (extending far and wide). Seeing him other forest-deer came (by hiin) and smelling him fled away into different quarters.

sanskrit: राक्षसः सो अपि तान् वन्यान् मृगान् मृगवधे रतः
transliteration: rākṣasaḥ so api tān vanyān mṛgān mṛgavadhe rataḥ
english: That Raksasa, though expert in killing deer, did not eat them up, though touching, in order to hide his real self.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् एव ततः काले वैदेही शुभलोचना
transliteration: tasmin eva tataḥ kāle vaidehī śubhalocanā
english: In the meantime Vaidehī, of auspicious looks whose eyes inebriate like wine, being engaged in plucking flowers, was going sometimes to the Karņikā grove and sometimes to the mango grove.

sanskrit: कर्णिकारान् अशोकान् च चूताम् च मदिरेक्षणा
transliteration: karṇikārān aśokān ca cūtām ca madirekṣaṇā
english: In the meantime Vaidehī, of auspicious looks whose eyes inebriate like wine, being engaged in plucking flowers, was going sometimes to the Karņikā grove and sometimes to the mango grove.

sanskrit: अनर्हा अरण्य वासस्य सा तम् रत्नमयम् मृगम्
transliteration: anarhā araṇya vāsasya sā tam ratnamayam mṛgam
english: That best of women, ever inured to living in the forest and possessed of a graceful countenance, walking and plucking flowers, saw that jewelled deer, having its body diversified with pearls and diamonds,

sanskrit: मुक्ता मणि विचित्र अंगम् ददर्श परम अंगना
तम् वै रुचिर दंत ओष्ठम् रूप्य धातु तनू रुहम्
transliteration: muktā maṇi vicitra aṃgam dadarśa parama aṃganā
tam vai rucira daṃta oṣṭham rūpya dhātu tanū ruham

sanskrit: विस्मयात् उत्फुल्ल नयना स स्नेहम् समुदैक्षत
स च ताम् राम दयिताम् पश्यन् मायामयो मृगः
transliteration: vismayāt utphulla nayanā sa sneham samudaikṣata
sa ca tām rāma dayitām paśyan māyāmayo mṛgaḥ

sanskrit: विचचार ततः तत्र दीपयन् इव तत् वनम्
अदृष्ट पूर्वम् दृष्ट्वा तम् नाना रत्नमयम् मृगम्
विस्मयम् परमम् सीता जगाम जनक आत्मजा
transliteration: vicacāra tataḥ tatra dīpayan iva tat vanam
adṛṣṭa pūrvam dṛṣṭvā tam nānā ratnamayam mṛgam
vismayam paramam sītā jagāma janaka ātmajā
english: Beholding that deer ornamented with diverse jewels, and the like of which she had never seen before, the daughter of Janaka was struck with immense wonder. Beholding that deer ornamented with diverse jewels, and the like of which she had never seen before, the daughter of Janaka was struck with immense wonder.

sanskrit: सा तम् संप्रेक्ष्य सुश्रोणी कुसुमानि विचिन्वती
transliteration: sā tam saṃprekṣya suśroṇī kusumāni vicinvatī
english: Beholding that deer with its sides painted with gold and silver, while collecting flowers, Sītā, having blameless limbs and beautiful hips and having the colour of her body like that of pure gold became immensely pleased and called aloud her husband and Lakşmaņa with scimitars in their hands.

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टा च अनवद्यान्गी मृष्ट हाटक वर्णिनी
भर्तारम् अपि च आक्रन्द लक्ष्मणम् चैव सायुधम्
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā ca anavadyāngī mṛṣṭa hāṭaka varṇinī
bhartāram api ca ākranda lakṣmaṇam caiva sāyudham
english: Beholding that deer with its sides painted with gold and silver, while collecting flowers, Sītā, having blameless limbs and beautiful hips and having the colour of her body like that of pure gold became immensely pleased and called aloud her husband and Lakşmaņa with scimitars in their hands.

sanskrit: आहूय आहूय च पुनः तम् मृगम् साधु वीक्षते
आगच्छ आगच्छ शीघ्रम् वै आर्यपुत्र सह अनुज
transliteration: āhūya āhūya ca punaḥ tam mṛgam sādhu vīkṣate
āgaccha āgaccha śīghram vai āryaputra saha anuja
english: Do you come soon, do you come soon, O son of the worshipful Sire, along with your younger brother

sanskrit: तया आहूतौ नरव्याघ्रौ वैदेह्या राम लक्ष्मणौ
वीक्षमाणौ तु तम् देशम् तदा ददृशतुः मृगम्
transliteration: tayā āhūtau naravyāghrau vaidehyā rāma lakṣmaṇau
vīkṣamāṇau tu tam deśam tadā dadṛśatuḥ mṛgam
english: Having called (her husband) again and again in this strain she continued beholding that deer. Being thus called by the daughter of the king of Videha those two best of men Rāma and Laks maņa, casting their looks around beheld that deer.

sanskrit: शंकमानः तु तम् दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणो रामम् अब्रवीत्
तम् एव एनम् अहम् मन्ये मारीचम् राक्षसम् मृगम्
transliteration: śaṃkamānaḥ tu tam dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇo rāmam abravīt
tam eva enam aham manye mārīcam rākṣasam mṛgam
english: Seeing him Lakşmana, struck with fear, said Me-thinks, this deer is the Raksasa Marica.

sanskrit: चरन्तो मृगयाम् हृष्टाः पापेन उपाधिना वने
अनेन निहता राम राजानः काम रूपिणा
transliteration: caranto mṛgayām hṛṣṭāḥ pāpena upādhinā vane
anena nihatā rāma rājānaḥ kāma rūpiṇā
english: This vicious Mārīca, O Rāma, assuming the shape of a deer oftentimes kills at pleasure the kings who come here a-hunting.

sanskrit: अस्य मायाविदो माया मृग रूपम् इदम् कृतम्
transliteration: asya māyāvido māyā mṛga rūpam idam kṛtam
english: He is cognizant of illusions, by virtue of which he has assumed this shape, O best of men; its countenance is perfectly fine like the abode of Gandharvas and resplendent like the Sun; there is no such jewelled deer on earth. O Rāghava, O Lord of earth, there is no doubt that this is nothing but illusion.

sanskrit: मृगो हि एवम् विधो रत्न विचित्रो न अस्ति राघव
जगत्याम् जगतीनाथ माया एषा हि न संशयः
transliteration: mṛgo hi evam vidho ratna vicitro na asti rāghava
jagatyām jagatīnātha māyā eṣā hi na saṃśayaḥ
english: He is cognizant of illusions, by virtue of which he has assumed this shape, O best of men; its countenance is perfectly fine like the abode of Gandharvas and resplendent like the Sun; there is no such jewelled deer on earth. O Rāghava, O Lord of earth, there is no doubt that this is nothing but illusion.

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् काकुत्स्थम् प्रतिवार्य शुचि स्मिता
उवाच सीता संहृष्टा चद्मना हृत चेतना
transliteration: evam bruvāṇam kākutstham prativārya śuci smitā
uvāca sītā saṃhṛṣṭā cadmanā hṛta cetanā
english: When Lakşınaņa spoke thus Sītā with a pure smile being under the influence of enchantment contradicted him, and being pleased said

sanskrit: आर्यपुत्र अभिरामो असौ मृगो हरति मे मनः
आनय एनम् महाबाहो क्रीडार्थम् नः भविष्यति
transliteration: āryaputra abhirāmo asau mṛgo harati me manaḥ
ānaya enam mahābāho krīḍārtham naḥ bhaviṣyati
english: O son of the worshipful Sire, this deer has attracted my mind, get it for me, pray, O you of mighty arms: it shall be an object of sport for us.

sanskrit: इह आश्रम पदे अस्माकम् बहवः पुण्य दर्शनाः
मृगाः चरन्ति सहिताः चमराः सृमराः तथा
transliteration: iha āśrama pade asmākam bahavaḥ puṇya darśanāḥ
mṛgāḥ caranti sahitāḥ camarāḥ sṛmarāḥ tathā

sanskrit: ऋक्षाः पृषत संघाः च वानराः किनराः तथा
transliteration: ṛkṣāḥ pṛṣata saṃghāḥ ca vānarāḥ kinarāḥ tathā

sanskrit: न च अस्य सदृशो राजन् दृष्ट पूर्वो मृगः मया
तेजसा क्षमया दीप्त्या यथा अयम् मृग सत्तमः
transliteration: na ca asya sadṛśo rājan dṛṣṭa pūrvo mṛgaḥ mayā
tejasā kṣamayā dīptyā yathā ayam mṛga sattamaḥ

sanskrit: नाना वर्ण विचित्र अंगो रत्न भूतो मम अग्रतः
द्योतयन् वनम् अव्यग्रम् शोभते शशि संनिभः
transliteration: nānā varṇa vicitra aṃgo ratna bhūto mama agrataḥ
dyotayan vanam avyagram śobhate śaśi saṃnibhaḥ
english: Its cntire body is diversified with various colours, nay, it is a jewel itself. It moves before me beautifying the forest with its resplendence, like to Moon himself.

sanskrit: अहो रूपम् अहो लक्ष्मीः स्वर संपत् च शोभना
मृगो अद्भुतो विचित्रांगो हृदयम् हरति इव मे
transliteration: aho rūpam aho lakṣmīḥ svara saṃpat ca śobhanā
mṛgo adbhuto vicitrāṃgo hṛdayam harati iva me
english: Ah! what beauty, what beautiful a lustre, how musical a voice, this wonderful deer of variegated countenance, has indeed captivated my heart!

sanskrit: यदि ग्रहणम् अभ्येति जीवन् एव मृगः तव
transliteration: yadi grahaṇam abhyeti jīvan eva mṛgaḥ tava
english: If can you get by this deer alive, O what wonder, what surprise!

sanskrit: समाप्त वन वासानाम् राज्य स्थानाम् च नः पुनः
transliteration: samāpta vana vāsānām rājya sthānām ca naḥ punaḥ
english: When shall we regain our kingdom after the expire of the term of our banishment, this deer shall beautify the interior of our palace.

sanskrit: भरतस्य आर्यपुत्रस्य श्वश्रूणाम् मम च प्रभो
मृग रूपम् इदम् दिव्यम् विस्मयम् जनयिष्यति
transliteration: bharatasya āryaputrasya śvaśrūṇām mama ca prabho
mṛga rūpam idam divyam vismayam janayiṣyati
english: O Lord, truly shall this celestial deer create surprise in Bharata, yourself, me and my mothers-in-law.

sanskrit: जीवन् न यदि ते अभ्येति ग्रहणम् मृग सत्तमः
transliteration: jīvan na yadi te abhyeti grahaṇam mṛga sattamaḥ
english: O best of men, if can you not get hold of it alive its skin shall also look very beautiful (to us).

sanskrit: शष्प बृस्याम् विनीतायाम् इच्छामि अहम् उपासितुम्
transliteration: śaṣpa bṛsyām vinītāyām icchāmi aham upāsitum
english: Spreading on Kuća the skin of this golden deer when killed do I wish to invoke the Almighty.

sanskrit: कामवृत्तम् इदम् रौद्रम् स्त्रीणाम् असदृशम् मतम्
वपुषा तु अस्य सत्त्वस्य विस्मयो जनितो मम
transliteration: kāmavṛttam idam raudram strīṇām asadṛśam matam
vapuṣā tu asya sattvasya vismayo janito mama
english: It looks (no doubt) unseemly and terrible and smacks of wilfulness, on the part of a wife to command her husband in this way, but I am sunk in surprise seeing the countenance of the deer.

sanskrit: तेन कांचन रोम्णा तु मणि प्रवर शृंगिणा
तरुण आदित्य वर्णेन नक्षत्र पथ वर्चसा
transliteration: tena kāṃcana romṇā tu maṇi pravara śṛṃgiṇā
taruṇa āditya varṇena nakṣatra patha varcasā

sanskrit: बभूव राघवस्य अपि मनो विस्मयम् आगतम्
एवम् सीता वचः श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा च मृगम् अद्भुतम्
transliteration: babhūva rāghavasya api mano vismayam āgatam
evam sītā vacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca mṛgam adbhutam

sanskrit: लोबितः तेन रूपेण सीताया च प्रचोदितः
उवाच राघवो हृष्टो भ्रातरम् लक्ष्मणम् वचः
transliteration: lobitaḥ tena rūpeṇa sītāyā ca pracoditaḥ
uvāca rāghavo hṛṣṭo bhrātaram lakṣmaṇam vacaḥ

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याः स्पृहाम् उल्लसिताम् इमाम्
रूप श्रेष्ठतया हि एष मृगो अद्य न भविष्यति
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyāḥ spṛhām ullasitām imām
rūpa śreṣṭhatayā hi eṣa mṛgo adya na bhaviṣyati
english: Behold, O Laksmana, it has immensely excited Vaidehi's desire. On account of its exquisite beauty it shall loose its life to-day.

sanskrit: न वने नंदनोद्देशे न चैत्ररथ संश्रये
कुतः पृथिव्याम् सौमित्रे यो अस्य कश्चित् समो मृगः
transliteration: na vane naṃdanoddeśe na caitraratha saṃśraye
kutaḥ pṛthivyām saumitre yo asya kaścit samo mṛgaḥ
english: It has its equal no where on the earth-neither in the celestial garden nor in the Caitraratha forest.

sanskrit: प्रतिलोम अनुलोमाः च रुचिरा रोम राजयः
शोभन्ते मृगम् आश्रित्य चित्राः कनक बिन्दुभिः
transliteration: pratiloma anulomāḥ ca rucirā roma rājayaḥ
śobhante mṛgam āśritya citrāḥ kanaka bindubhiḥ
english: The hairs of its body being arranged in regular and contrary courses and being painted with golden drops do indeed look very beautiful.

sanskrit: पश्य अस्य जृंभमाणस्य दीप्ताम् अग्नि शिखोपमाम्
जिह्वाम् मुखात् निःसरंतीम् मेघात् इव शत ह्रदाम्
transliteration: paśya asya jṛṃbhamāṇasya dīptām agni śikhopamām
jihvām mukhāt niḥsaraṃtīm meghāt iva śata hradām
english: Do you see, while expanding its inouth, its tongue comes out resembling flaming fire like to a thunder-bolt reaving the mass of clouds.

sanskrit: मसार गल्वर्क मुखः शंख मुक्ता निभ उदरः
कस्य नाम अनिरूप्यः असौ न मनो लोभयेत् मृगः
transliteration: masāra galvarka mukhaḥ śaṃkha muktā nibha udaraḥ
kasya nāma anirūpyaḥ asau na mano lobhayet mṛgaḥ
english: Its face is like a glass made of a best blue sapphire, its belly resembling a conch and pearl, and it is very difficult to ascertain its shapes. Beholding it who is there (on earth) whose heart is not enamoured?

sanskrit: कस्य रूपम् इदम् दृष्ट्वा जांबूनदमय प्रभम्
नाना रत्नमयम् दिव्यम् न मनो विस्मयम् व्रजेत्
transliteration: kasya rūpam idam dṛṣṭvā jāṃbūnadamaya prabham
nānā ratnamayam divyam na mano vismayam vrajet
english: Its beauty resembles the rays of gold and is variegated with diverse hues of jewels. Whose heart is not enveloped with surprise beholding such a celestial beauty, O Laksmana?

sanskrit: मांस हेतोः अपि मृगान् विहारार्थम् च धन्विनः
transliteration: māṃsa hetoḥ api mṛgān vihārārtham ca dhanvinaḥ
english: Princes, with bows in their hands, while-a hunting in a deep forest destroy deer either for flesh or for sport.

sanskrit: धातवो विविधाः च अपि मणि रत्न सुवर्णिनः
transliteration: dhātavo vividhāḥ ca api maṇi ratna suvarṇinaḥ
english: Moreover while engaged in sporting they collect many a jewel and various metals as gold and silver, in the woods.

sanskrit: तत् सारम् अखिलम् नॄणाम् धनम् निचय वर्धनम्
मनसा चिन्तितम् सर्वम् यथा शुक्रस्य लक्ष्मण
transliteration: tat sāram akhilam nṝṇām dhanam nicaya vardhanam
manasā cintitam sarvam yathā śukrasya lakṣmaṇa
english: There is not the least doubt that these wild riches filling up their coffers are comparatively far better (than the wealth acquired by other sources) like to the objects of enjoyment, enjoyed at their fancy by the people inhabiting the celestial region.

sanskrit: अर्थी येन अर्थ कृत्येन संव्रजति अविचारयन्
तम् अर्थम् अर्थ शास्त्रज्ञः प्राहुः अर्थ्याः च लक्ष्मण
transliteration: arthī yena artha kṛtyena saṃvrajati avicārayan
tam artham artha śāstrajñaḥ prāhuḥ arthyāḥ ca lakṣmaṇa
english: The object which persons desirous of acquiring wealth follow without any discretion in their actions, is the true definition of wealth given by the political economists.

sanskrit: एतस्य मृग रत्नस्य परार्ध्ये कांचन त्वचि
transliteration: etasya mṛga ratnasya parārdhye kāṃcana tvaci
english: Vaidehi of slender waist desire to sit with me on the exquisitely fine golden skin of this gem of a deer, me-seems no deer skin is so comfortable to touch as this neither the skin of Kādali, Priyaki, Praveni nor of Caviki.

sanskrit: न कादली न प्रियकी न प्रवेणी न च अविकी
भवेत् एतस्य सदृशी स्पर्शनेन इति मे मतिः
transliteration: na kādalī na priyakī na praveṇī na ca avikī
bhavet etasya sadṛśī sparśanena iti me matiḥ
