english: Vaidehi of slender waist desire to sit with me on the exquisitely fine golden skin of this gem of a deer, me-seems no deer skin is so comfortable to touch as this neither the skin of Kādali, Priyaki, Praveni nor of Caviki.

sanskrit: एष चैव मृगः श्रीमान् यः च दिव्यो नभः चरः
उभौ एतौ मृगौ दिव्यौ तारामृग महीमृगौ
transliteration: eṣa caiva mṛgaḥ śrīmān yaḥ ca divyo nabhaḥ caraḥ
ubhau etau mṛgau divyau tārāmṛga mahīmṛgau
english: Truly handsome in this deer and the one that range in the welkin, indeed these two deer only are celestial—the one that range in the sky* (Mrgasirā) and this that range on earth. This refers to Mrgaşiră, the fifth lunar constellation which resembles a deer.

sanskrit: यदि वा अयम् तथा यत् माम् भवेत् वदसि लक्ष्मण
माया एषा राक्षसस्य इति कर्तव्यो अस्य वधो मया
transliteration: yadi vā ayam tathā yat mām bhavet vadasi lakṣmaṇa
māyā eṣā rākṣasasya iti kartavyo asya vadho mayā
english: And if it be a Raksasa's illusion as you say, O Laksmana, then it must be killed by me.

sanskrit: एतेन हि नृशंसेन मारीचेन अकृत आत्मना
वने विचरता पूर्वम् हिंसिता मुनि पुंगवाः
transliteration: etena hi nṛśaṃsena mārīcena akṛta ātmanā
vane vicaratā pūrvam hiṃsitā muni puṃgavāḥ
english: This cruel vicious-souled Mārica made away with many eminent ascetics, while travelling in the forest; and this Räkşasa assuming the shape of an illusive deer destroyed many kings-mighty archers while a-hunting in this forest; it is for this that this deer must be killed.

sanskrit: निहताः परम इष्वासाः तस्मात् वध्यः तु अयम् मृगः
transliteration: nihatāḥ parama iṣvāsāḥ tasmāt vadhyaḥ tu ayam mṛgaḥ

sanskrit: उदरस्थो द्विजान् हन्ति स्व गर्भो अश्वतरीम् इव
transliteration: udarastho dvijān hanti sva garbho aśvatarīm iva
english: Formerly this Vātăpi entering into the womb of twice-born ones used to come out reaving them like to the embryo of a mule. The name of an Asur devoured by Agastya.

sanskrit: स कदाचित् चिरात् लोभात् आससाद महामुनिम्
अगस्त्यम् तेजसा युक्तम् भक्ष्यः तस्य बभूव ह
transliteration: sa kadācit cirāt lobhāt āsasāda mahāmunim
agastyam tejasā yuktam bhakṣyaḥ tasya babhūva ha
english: Once on a time this Vātāpi approached the eminent saint Agastya and was devoured by him.

sanskrit: समुत्थाने च तत् रूपम् कर्तु कामम् समीक्ष्य तम्
उत्स्मयित्वा तु भगवान् वातापिम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: samutthāne ca tat rūpam kartu kāmam samīkṣya tam
utsmayitvā tu bhagavān vātāpim idam abravīt
english: After the Šrāddha ceremony had been over, finding that Bātāpi desirous of assuming the shape of a Rākṣasa the great saint Agastya said smiling.

sanskrit: त्वया अविगण्य वातापे परिभूताः च तेजसा
जीव लोके द्विज श्रेष्ठाः तस्मात् असि जराम् गतः
transliteration: tvayā avigaṇya vātāpe paribhūtāḥ ca tejasā
jīva loke dvija śreṣṭhāḥ tasmāt asi jarām gataḥ
english: Being blinded with your prowess O Vātāpi, you have destroyed many eminent twice-born ones on this earth and for this that I do digest you.

sanskrit: तत् एतत् न भवेत् रक्षो वातापिः इव लक्ष्मण
मत् विधम् यो अतिमन्येत धर्म नित्यम् जितेन्द्रियम्
transliteration: tat etat na bhavet rakṣo vātāpiḥ iva lakṣmaṇa
mat vidham yo atimanyeta dharma nityam jitendriyam
english: Truly that Raksasa, O, Laksmana who wish to surpass one like me who has controlled his senses and is ever engaged in pious offices shall meet with his end like to this Vātāpi.

sanskrit: भवेत् हतो अयम् वातापिः अगस्त्येन इव मा गतः
इह त्वम् भव संनद्धो यंत्रितो रक्ष मैथिलीम्
transliteration: bhavet hato ayam vātāpiḥ agastyena iva mā gataḥ
iha tvam bhava saṃnaddho yaṃtrito rakṣa maithilīm
english: Therefore this Mārīca approaching me shall be killed by me like to Vātāpi being devoured by Agastya. Do you therefore vigilantly protect Vaidehi with mail and armours on.

sanskrit: अस्याम् आयत्तम् अस्माकम् यत् कृत्यम् रघुनंदन
अहम् एनम् वधिष्यामि ग्रहीष्यामि अथवा मृगम्
transliteration: asyām āyattam asmākam yat kṛtyam raghunaṃdana
aham enam vadhiṣyāmi grahīṣyāmi athavā mṛgam
english: It is our prime duty, O descendant of Raghu, to protect Jānaki. I shall either kill this deer or shall get hold of it.

sanskrit: यावत् गच्छामि सौमित्रे मृगम् आनयितुम् द्रुतम्
पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेहीम् मृग त्वचि गताम् स्पृहाम्
transliteration: yāvat gacchāmi saumitre mṛgam ānayitum drutam
paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehīm mṛga tvaci gatām spṛhām
english: Look, O Laksmana, Vaidehi is extremely anxious to get the skin of this deer I shall therefore proceed at once, O son of Sumitrā, to catch this deer.

sanskrit: त्वचा प्रधानया हि एष मृगो अद्य न भविष्यति
transliteration: tvacā pradhānayā hi eṣa mṛgo adya na bhaviṣyati
english: The skin of this deer is the best of its kind; for certain shall it loose its life today. As long as I do not kill this deer, O Lakşmaņa, do you with Sītā remain with vigilance in this asylum. I shall in no time come back with its skin after killing in with one arrow.

sanskrit: यावत् पृषतम् एकेन सायकेन निहन्मि अहम्
हत्वा एतत् चर्म च आदाय शीघ्रम् एष्यामि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: yāvat pṛṣatam ekena sāyakena nihanmi aham
hatvā etat carma ca ādāya śīghram eṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa
english: The skin of this deer is the best of its kind; for certain shall it loose its life today. As long as I do not kill this deer, O Lakşmaņa, do you with Sītā remain with vigilance in this asylum. I shall in no time come back with its skin after killing in with one arrow.

sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणेन अतिबलेन पक्षिणाजटायुषा बुद्धिमता च लक्ष्मण
भव अप्रमत्तः प्रतिगृह्य मैथिलीम्प्रति क्षणम् सर्वत एव शन्कितः
transliteration: pradakṣiṇena atibalena pakṣiṇājaṭāyuṣā buddhimatā ca lakṣmaṇa
bhava apramattaḥ pratigṛhya maithilīmprati kṣaṇam sarvata eva śankitaḥ
english: Do you stay here, O Lakşmaņa, with Jānakī in constant fear and vigilance, along with the mighty Jațāyu, intelligent and ever engaged in pious offices.

sanskrit: तथा तु तम् समादिश्य भ्रातरम् रघुनंदनः
transliteration: tathā tu tam samādiśya bhrātaram raghunaṃdanaḥ
english: Having thus directed his brother, the highly energetic son of Raghu equipped himself with his gold-hilted scimitar.

sanskrit: ततः त्रि विनतम् चापम् आदाय आत्म विभूषणम्
आबध्य च कलापौ द्वौ जगाम उदग्र विक्रमः
transliteration: tataḥ tri vinatam cāpam ādāya ātma vibhūṣaṇam
ābadhya ca kalāpau dvau jagāma udagra vikramaḥ
english: And girding himself with his bow bent at three places, which served him ornament,—as well as a couple of quivers, that one of fierce energy sallied out.

sanskrit: तम् वंचयानो राजेन्द्रम् आपतन्तम् निरीक्ष्य वै
बभूव अंतर्हितः त्रासात् पुनः संदर्शने अभवत्
transliteration: tam vaṃcayāno rājendram āpatantam nirīkṣya vai
babhūva aṃtarhitaḥ trāsāt punaḥ saṃdarśane abhavat
english: Seeing that foremost of monarchs approach, that best of beasts from fear disappeared; and then again showed himself. as an

sanskrit: बद्ध असिः धनुः आदाय प्रदुद्राव यतो मृगः
तम् स्म पश्यति रूपेण द्योतमानम् इव अग्रतः
transliteration: baddha asiḥ dhanuḥ ādāya pradudrāva yato mṛgaḥ
tam sma paśyati rūpeṇa dyotamānam iva agrataḥ

sanskrit: अवेक्ष्य अवेक्ष्य धावन्तम् धनुष् पाणिः महावने
transliteration: avekṣya avekṣya dhāvantam dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ mahāvane

sanskrit: शंकितम् तु समुद् भ्रान्तम् उत्पतन्तम् इव अंबरे
दृअश्यमानम् अदृश्यम् च वन उद्देशेषु केषुचित्
transliteration: śaṃkitam tu samud bhrāntam utpatantam iva aṃbare
dṛaśyamānam adṛśyam ca vana uddeśeṣu keṣucit

sanskrit: चिन्न अभ्रैः इव संवीतम् शारदम् चन्द्र मण्डलम्
मुहूर्तात् एव ददृशे मुहुर् दूरात् प्रकाशते
transliteration: cinna abhraiḥ iva saṃvītam śāradam candra maṇḍalam
muhūrtāt eva dadṛśe muhur dūrāt prakāśate

sanskrit: दर्शन अदर्शनेन एव सः अपाकर्षत राघवम्
सुदूरम् आश्रमस्य अस्य मारिचो मृगताम् गतः
transliteration: darśana adarśanena eva saḥ apākarṣata rāghavam
sudūram āśramasya asya mārico mṛgatām gataḥ
english: And Mārica wearing the shape of a deer, showing himself and disappearing from sight, drew Rāghava a long way from the hermitage.

sanskrit: आसीत् क्रुद्धः तु काकुत्स्थो विवशः तेन मोहितः
अथ अवतस्थे सुश्रान्तः च्छायाम् आश्रित्य शाद्वले
transliteration: āsīt kruddhaḥ tu kākutstho vivaśaḥ tena mohitaḥ
atha avatasthe suśrāntaḥ cchāyām āśritya śādvale
english: Thereat Rāma, eagerly anxious to secure the deer, being foiled by the deer, and in consequence growing enraged, wearied out, rested under a shadow, on a sward.

sanskrit: मृगैः परिवृतो अथ वन्यैः अदूरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत
transliteration: mṛgaiḥ parivṛto atha vanyaiḥ adūrāt pratyadṛśyata
english: And that ranger of the night, wearing the form of a deer, maddening Rāma, discovered himself (again) at a distance surrounded by (other) deer,

sanskrit: ग्रहीतु कामम् दृष्ट्वा तम् पुनः एव अभ्यधावत
तत् क्षणात् एव संत्रासात् पुनर् अंतर्हितो अभवत्
transliteration: grahītu kāmam dṛṣṭvā tam punaḥ eva abhyadhāvata
tat kṣaṇāt eva saṃtrāsāt punar aṃtarhito abhavat
english: And Rama desirous of taking (the beast), seeing him again, set off at speed. At the very moment the deer disappeared from fear,

sanskrit: पुनर् एव ततो दूरात् वृक्ष खण्डात् विनिःसृतः
दृष्ट्वा रामो महातेजाः तम् हन्तुम् कृत निश्चयः
transliteration: punar eva tato dūrāt vṛkṣa khaṇḍāt viniḥsṛtaḥ
dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahātejāḥ tam hantum kṛta niścayaḥ

sanskrit: भूयः तु शरम् उद्धृत्य कुपितः तत्र राघवः
सूर्य रश्मि प्रतीकाशम् ज्वलंतम् अरि मर्दनम्
transliteration: bhūyaḥ tu śaram uddhṛtya kupitaḥ tatra rāghavaḥ
sūrya raśmi pratīkāśam jvalaṃtam ari mardanam

sanskrit: संधाय सुदृढे चापे विकृष्य बलवत् बली
तम् एव मृगम् उद्दिश्य श्वसंतम् इव पन्नगम्
transliteration: saṃdhāya sudṛḍhe cāpe vikṛṣya balavat balī
tam eva mṛgam uddiśya śvasaṃtam iva pannagam

sanskrit: मुमोच ज्वलितम् दीप्तम् अस्त्रम् ब्रह्म विनिर्मितम्
transliteration: mumoca jvalitam dīptam astram brahma vinirmitam

sanskrit: मारीचस्य एव हृदयम् विभेद अशनि संनिभः
ताल मात्रम् अथ उत्प्लुत्य न्यपतत् स भृश आतुरः
transliteration: mārīcasya eva hṛdayam vibheda aśani saṃnibhaḥ
tāla mātram atha utplutya nyapatat sa bhṛśa āturaḥ

sanskrit: व्यनदत् भैरवम् नादम् धरण्याम् अल्प जीवितः
म्रियमाणः तु मारीचो जहौ ताम् कृत्रिमाम् तनुम्
transliteration: vyanadat bhairavam nādam dharaṇyām alpa jīvitaḥ
mriyamāṇaḥ tu mārīco jahau tām kṛtrimām tanum

sanskrit: स्मृत्वा तत् वचनम् रक्षो दध्यौ केन तु लक्ष्मणम्
इह प्रस्थापयेत् सीता ताम् शून्ये रावणे हरेत्
transliteration: smṛtvā tat vacanam rakṣo dadhyau kena tu lakṣmaṇam
iha prasthāpayet sītā tām śūnye rāvaṇe haret
english: And while on the point of death, Mārīca renounced his counterfeit shape. And remembering the words of Rāvana, the Rākşasa reflected, by what means can Sītā send away Lakşmaņa, and Rāvana carry off Sītā staying in solitude?

sanskrit: स प्राप्त कालम् अज्ञाय चकार च ततः स्वरम्
सदृशम् राघवस्य एव हा सीते लक्ष्मण इति च
transliteration: sa prāpta kālam ajñāya cakāra ca tataḥ svaram
sadṛśam rāghavasya eva hā sīte lakṣmaṇa iti ca
english: And pierced to the marrow by that peerless shaft, Marica, renouncing his deer form, resumed his Rākşasa lineaments; and giving up his life attaining a huge person, considering the time had come (for availing himself of the advice tendered by Rāvana), began to cry with the voice of Rāghava, Ah Sita! Ah Laksmana!

sanskrit: तेन मर्मणि निर्विद्धम् शरेण अनुपमेन हि
मृग रूपम् तु तत् त्यक्त्वा राक्षसम् रूपम् आस्थितः
transliteration: tena marmaṇi nirviddham śareṇa anupamena hi
mṛga rūpam tu tat tyaktvā rākṣasam rūpam āsthitaḥ
english: And pierced to the marrow by that peerless shaft, Marica, renouncing his deer form, resumed his Rākşasa lineaments; and giving up his life attaining a huge person, considering the time had come (for availing himself of the advice tendered by Rāvana), began to cry with the voice of Rāghava, Ah Sita! Ah Laksmana!

sanskrit: चक्रे स सुमहा कायम् मारीचो जीवितम् त्यजन्
तम् दृष्ट्वा पतितम् भूमौ राक्षसम् भीम दर्शनम्
transliteration: cakre sa sumahā kāyam mārīco jīvitam tyajan
tam dṛṣṭvā patitam bhūmau rākṣasam bhīma darśanam
english: And seeing that grim-visaged Rākşasa lying low on the ground, with his person bathed in blood, and rolling hither and thither, Rāma proceeded towards the asylum thinking of Sītā and revolving within himself Laksmana's words.

sanskrit: रामो रुधिर सिक्त अंगम् चेष्टमानम् महीतले
जगाम मनसा सीताम् लक्ष्मणस्य वचः स्मरन्
transliteration: rāmo rudhira sikta aṃgam ceṣṭamānam mahītale
jagāma manasā sītām lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ smaran
english: And seeing that grim-visaged Rākşasa lying low on the ground, with his person bathed in blood, and rolling hither and thither, Rāma proceeded towards the asylum thinking of Sītā and revolving within himself Laksmana's words.

sanskrit: मारीचस्य तु माय एषा पूर्व उक्तम् लक्ष्मणेन तु
तत् तदा हि अभवत् च अद्य मारीचो अयम् मया हतः
transliteration: mārīcasya tu māya eṣā pūrva uktam lakṣmaṇena tu
tat tadā hi abhavat ca adya mārīco ayam mayā hataḥ
english: While returning he thought Mārīca aside Lakş mana said before that this was Mārica's illusion! His words have been verified now. Truly have I killed Mārīca.

sanskrit: हा सीते लक्ष्मण इति एवम् आक्रुश्य तु महा स्वनम्
ममार राक्षसः सो अयम् श्रुत्वा सीता कथम् भवेत्
transliteration: hā sīte lakṣmaṇa iti evam ākruśya tu mahā svanam
mamāra rākṣasaḥ so ayam śrutvā sītā katham bhavet
english: Mārīca has given up his ghost exclaiming aloud Ah! Sītā, Ah! Laksmana. I do not know what shall Sītā do hearing the cry? And what shall the mighty-armed Laksmana do?

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणः च महाबाहुः काम् अवस्थाम् गमिष्यति
इति संचिन्त्य धर्माअत्मा रामो हृष्ट तनू रुहः
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahābāhuḥ kām avasthām gamiṣyati
iti saṃcintya dharmāatmā rāmo hṛṣṭa tanū ruhaḥ
english: While pondering thus the hairs of the virtuous-souled Rāma stood on their end. Killing that Räkşasa assuming the shape of a deer and hearing his terrible cry Rāma was overwhelmed with fear arising out of sorrow.

sanskrit: तत्र रामम् भयम् तीव्रम् आविवेश विषादजम्
राक्षसम् मृग रूपम् तम् हत्वा श्रुत्वा च तत् स्वनम्
transliteration: tatra rāmam bhayam tīvram āviveśa viṣādajam
rākṣasam mṛga rūpam tam hatvā śrutvā ca tat svanam
english: While pondering thus the hairs of the virtuous-souled Rāma stood on their end. Killing that Räkşasa assuming the shape of a deer and hearing his terrible cry Rāma was overwhelmed with fear arising out of sorrow.

sanskrit: निहत्य पृषतम् च अन्यम् मांसम् आदाय राघवः
transliteration: nihatya pṛṣatam ca anyam māṃsam ādāya rāghavaḥ
english: Thereupon killing a deer and taking its flesh he hastened towards Janasthāna.

sanskrit: आर्तस्वरम् तु तम् भर्तुः विज्ञाय सदृशम् वने
उवाच लक्ष्मणम् सीता गच्छ जानीहि राघवम्
transliteration: ārtasvaram tu tam bhartuḥ vijñāya sadṛśam vane
uvāca lakṣmaṇam sītā gaccha jānīhi rāghavam
english: Hearing that cry in the forest resembling her husband's voice Sítā spake to Laksmana saying Do you go and learn what has befallen Rāghava.

sanskrit: न हि मे जीवितम् स्थाने हृदयम् वा अवतिष्ठते
क्रोशतः परम आर्तस्य श्रुतः शब्दो मया भृशम्
transliteration: na hi me jīvitam sthāne hṛdayam vā avatiṣṭhate
krośataḥ parama ārtasya śrutaḥ śabdo mayā bhṛśam
english: He is crying aloud in pitiable accents; hearing them my life and soul are incapable of remaining any longer in their proper places.

sanskrit: आक्रन्दमानम् तु वने भ्रातरम् त्रातुम् अर्हसि
तम् क्षिप्रम् अभिधाव त्वम् भ्रातरम् शरण एषिणम्
transliteration: ākrandamānam tu vane bhrātaram trātum arhasi
tam kṣipram abhidhāva tvam bhrātaram śaraṇa eṣiṇam
english: It behoveth you to save your brother who is crying aloud in the forest; do you immediately repair hence to save him, who is in need of your help. He has been over-powered by the Rākşasas like to a bullock brought under the power of a lion, Remembering the behest of Rāma, Laks maņa did not go, though accosted thus by Sītā.

sanskrit: रक्षसाम् वशम् आपन्नम् सिंहानाम् इव गोवृषम्
न जगाम तथा उक्तः तु भ्रातुः आज्ञाय शासनम्
transliteration: rakṣasām vaśam āpannam siṃhānām iva govṛṣam
na jagāma tathā uktaḥ tu bhrātuḥ ājñāya śāsanam
english: It behoveth you to save your brother who is crying aloud in the forest; do you immediately repair hence to save him, who is in need of your help. He has been over-powered by the Rākşasas like to a bullock brought under the power of a lion, Remembering the behest of Rāma, Laks maņa did not go, though accosted thus by Sītā.

sanskrit: तम् उवाच ततः तत्र क्षुभिता जनक आत्मजा
सौमित्रे मित्र रूपेण भ्रातुः त्वम् असि शत्रुवत्
transliteration: tam uvāca tataḥ tatra kṣubhitā janaka ātmajā
saumitre mitra rūpeṇa bhrātuḥ tvam asi śatruvat
english: Extremely mortified, the daughter of Janaka spake to him saying O Son of Sumitra, you are an enemy to Rāma, in the grab of a brother. You did not proceed for the relief of they brother who has been reduced to such a plight.

sanskrit: यः त्वम् अस्याम् अवस्थायाम् भ्रातरम् न अभिपद्यसे
इच्छसि त्वम् विनश्यन्तम् रामम् लक्ष्मण मत् कृते
transliteration: yaḥ tvam asyām avasthāyām bhrātaram na abhipadyase
icchasi tvam vinaśyantam rāmam lakṣmaṇa mat kṛte
english: Extremely mortified, the daughter of Janaka spake to him saying O Son of Sumitra, you are an enemy to Rāma, in the grab of a brother. You did not proceed for the relief of they brother who has been reduced to such a plight.

sanskrit: लोभात् तु मत् कृतम् नूनम् न अनुगच्छसि राघवम्
व्यसनम् ते प्रियम् मन्ये स्नेहो भ्रातरि न अस्ति ते
transliteration: lobhāt tu mat kṛtam nūnam na anugacchasi rāghavam
vyasanam te priyam manye sneho bhrātari na asti te
english: Truely being under the influence of lust for me you did not follow Rāghava! For this you did welcome Rāma's disaster; you have no affection for him.

sanskrit: तेन तिष्ठसि विस्रब्धः तम् अपश्यन् महाद्युतिम्
किम् हि संशयम् आपन्ने तस्मिन् इह मया भवेत्
transliteration: tena tiṣṭhasi visrabdhaḥ tam apaśyan mahādyutim
kim hi saṃśayam āpanne tasmin iha mayā bhavet
english: For this it is that you did sit here without anxiety not seeing the highly effulgent (Rāma). Råma, following whom you have repaired to this forest, being in danger, of what avail is life to me.?'

sanskrit: कर्तव्यम् इह तिष्ठन्त्या यत् प्रधानः त्वम् आगतः
एवम् ब्रुवाणम् वैदेहीम् बाष्प शोक समन्वितम्
transliteration: kartavyam iha tiṣṭhantyā yat pradhānaḥ tvam āgataḥ
evam bruvāṇam vaidehīm bāṣpa śoka samanvitam

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् लक्ष्मणः त्रस्ताम् सीताम् मृग वधूम् इव
पन्नग असुर गन्धर्व देव दानव राक्षसैः
transliteration: abravīt lakṣmaṇaḥ trastām sītām mṛga vadhūm iva
pannaga asura gandharva deva dānava rākṣasaiḥ

sanskrit: अशक्यः तव वैदेही भर्ता जेतुम् न संशयः
transliteration: aśakyaḥ tava vaidehī bhartā jetum na saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: दानवेषु च घोरेषु न स विद्येत शोभने
transliteration: dānaveṣu ca ghoreṣu na sa vidyeta śobhane
english: Worshipful madam! Celestials, Danavas, Gandharvas, Raksasas, Pisacas, men, Kinnaras, animals, or birds, there is none among them, who can withstand Rāghava, who equals the lord of celestials in warfare. In fact there is none who can do away with Ráma in battle.

sanskrit: यो रामम् प्रतियुध्येत समरे वासव उपमम्
अवध्यः समरे रामो न एवम् त्वम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: yo rāmam pratiyudhyeta samare vāsava upamam
avadhyaḥ samare rāmo na evam tvam vaktum arhasi

sanskrit: न त्वाम् अस्मिन् वने हातुम् उत्सहे राघवम् विना
अनिवार्यम् बलम् तस्य बलैः बलवताम् अपि
transliteration: na tvām asmin vane hātum utsahe rāghavam vinā
anivāryam balam tasya balaiḥ balavatām api
english: It does not behove you therefore to accost me thus. Nor do I dare leave you here alone in this forest without Rāma. Even the mighty heroes, as the Lord of celestials, cannot subdue his prowess with all their strength. Even the Almighty Himself, with the celestials and the three world, cannot defeat him. Do you therefore renounce grief and console theyself.

sanskrit: त्रिभिः लोकैः समुदितैः स ईश्वरैः स अमरैः अपि
हृदयम् निर्वृतम् ते अस्तु संतापः त्यज्यताम् तव
transliteration: tribhiḥ lokaiḥ samuditaiḥ sa īśvaraiḥ sa amaraiḥ api
hṛdayam nirvṛtam te astu saṃtāpaḥ tyajyatām tava
english: It does not behove you therefore to accost me thus. Nor do I dare leave you here alone in this forest without Rāma. Even the mighty heroes, as the Lord of celestials, cannot subdue his prowess with all their strength. Even the Almighty Himself, with the celestials and the three world, cannot defeat him. Do you therefore renounce grief and console theyself.

sanskrit: आगमिष्यति ते भर्ता शीघ्रम् हत्वा मृगोत्तमम्
न सस् तस्य स्वरो व्यक्तम् न कश्चित् अपि दैवतः
transliteration: āgamiṣyati te bhartā śīghram hatvā mṛgottamam
na sas tasya svaro vyaktam na kaścit api daivataḥ
english: Sooner shall your husband return killing the best of deer. It is not his voice nor one sent by any deity. It is but an illusion of that Rākşasa (Mārīca).

sanskrit: गन्धर्व नगर प्रख्या माया तस्य च रक्षसः
न्यास भूता असि वैदेहि न्यस्ता मयि महात्मना
transliteration: gandharva nagara prakhyā māyā tasya ca rakṣasaḥ
nyāsa bhūtā asi vaidehi nyastā mayi mahātmanā

sanskrit: रामेण त्वम् वरारोहे न त्वाम् त्यक्तुम् इह उत्सहे
कृत वैराः च कल्याणि वयम् एतैः निशाचरैः
transliteration: rāmeṇa tvam varārohe na tvām tyaktum iha utsahe
kṛta vairāḥ ca kalyāṇi vayam etaiḥ niśācaraiḥ

sanskrit: खरस्य निधने देवि जनस्थान वधम् प्रति
transliteration: kharasya nidhane devi janasthāna vadham prati

sanskrit: हिंसा विहारा वैदेहि न चिन्तयितुम् अर्हसि
लक्ष्मणेन एवम् उक्ता तु क्रुद्धा संरक्त लोचना
transliteration: hiṃsā vihārā vaidehi na cintayitum arhasi
lakṣmaṇena evam uktā tu kruddhā saṃrakta locanā

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् सत्य वादिनम्
transliteration: abravīt paruṣam vākyam lakṣmaṇam satya vādinam

sanskrit: अहम् तव प्रियम् मन्ये रामस्य व्यसनम् महत्
रामस्य व्यसन्म् दृष्ट्वा तेन एतानि प्रभाषसे
transliteration: aham tava priyam manye rāmasya vyasanam mahat
rāmasya vyasanm dṛṣṭvā tena etāni prabhāṣase
english: O cruel one! O you the destroyer of your line! it is a disgrace to you that you wishest to protect me (killing Răma). Methinks, this mighty disaster of Rāma is welcome to you, or else why should you seeing this, speak thus, O Laksmana.

sanskrit: न एव चित्रम् सपत्नेषु पापम् लक्ष्मण यत् भवेत्
त्वत् विधेषु नृशंसेषु नित्यम् प्रच्छन्न चारिषु
transliteration: na eva citram sapatneṣu pāpam lakṣmaṇa yat bhavet
tvat vidheṣu nṛśaṃseṣu nityam pracchanna cāriṣu
english: It is not a wonder that an evil desire lurks in you who are a hypocrite and a cruel-hearted cnemy.

sanskrit: सुदुष्टः त्वम् वने रामम् एकम् एको अनुगच्छसि
मम हेतोः प्रतिच्छन्नः प्रयुक्तो भरतेन वा
transliteration: suduṣṭaḥ tvam vane rāmam ekam eko anugacchasi
mama hetoḥ praticchannaḥ prayukto bharatena vā
english: Verily are you a monster of wickedness, that Rāma repairing to woods, you have, being lustful for me, followed him alone. Or hast you been engaged by Bharata to act thus?

sanskrit: तत् न सिद्ध्यति सौमित्रे तव अपि भरतस्य वा
कथम् इंदीवर श्यामम् रामम् पद्म निभेक्षणम्
transliteration: tat na siddhyati saumitre tava api bharatasya vā
katham iṃdīvara śyāmam rāmam padma nibhekṣaṇam
english: But your or Bharata's intention shall not be satisfied, O Saumitre. How shall I desire another man after serving the lotus-eyed Rāma of dark blue hue as my husband?

sanskrit: समक्षम् तव सौमित्रे प्राणान् त्यक्ष्यामि असंशयम्
transliteration: samakṣam tava saumitre prāṇān tyakṣyāmi asaṃśayam

sanskrit: रामम् विना क्षणम् अपि न एव जीवामि भू तले
इति उक्तः परुषम् वाक्यम् सीतया रोमहर्षणम्
transliteration: rāmam vinā kṣaṇam api na eva jīvāmi bhū tale
iti uktaḥ paruṣam vākyam sītayā romaharṣaṇam

sanskrit: उत्तरम् न उत्सहे वक्तुम् दैवतम् भवती मम
transliteration: uttaram na utsahe vaktum daivatam bhavatī mama
english: Hearing these brazen words of Sītā, capable of making one's down stand on end, the selfcontrolled Lakşmaņa with joined hands spake to her saying You are a very Goddess to me, I therefore dare not answer you.

sanskrit: वाक्यम् अप्रतिरूपम् तु न चित्रम् स्त्रीषु मैथिलि
स्वभावः तु एष नारीणाम् एषु लोकेषु दृश्यते
transliteration: vākyam apratirūpam tu na citram strīṣu maithili
svabhāvaḥ tu eṣa nārīṇām eṣu lokeṣu dṛśyate
english: What you have spoken, O Maithelee, is nothing surprising-for fernales. Such is the nature of womankind on this earth.

sanskrit: विमुक्त धर्माः चपलाः तीक्ष्णा भेदकराः स्त्रियः
न सहे हि ईदृशम् वाक्यम् वैदेही जनक आत्मजे
transliteration: vimukta dharmāḥ capalāḥ tīkṣṇā bhedakarāḥ striyaḥ
na sahe hi īdṛśam vākyam vaidehī janaka ātmaje
english: Women by nature are crooked, fickle, devoid of religious knowledge, and bring about difference between father and sons. O Vaidehi, O daughter of Janaka, truly am I incapable of putting up with these words of yours. They have pierced through both of my ears like a heated Nāraca.

sanskrit: श्रोत्रयोः उभयोः मध्ये तप्त नाराच सन्निभम्
उपशृण्वंतु मे सर्वे साक्षिनो हि वनेचराः
transliteration: śrotrayoḥ ubhayoḥ madhye tapta nārāca sannibham
upaśṛṇvaṃtu me sarve sākṣino hi vanecarāḥ

sanskrit: न्याय वादी यथा वाक्यम् उक्तो अहम् परुषम् त्वया
धिक् त्वाम् अद्य प्रणश्यन्तीम् यन् माम् एवम् विशंकसे
transliteration: nyāya vādī yathā vākyam ukto aham paruṣam tvayā
dhik tvām adya praṇaśyantīm yan mām evam viśaṃkase

sanskrit: स्त्रीत्वात् दुष्ट स्वभावेन गुरु वाक्ये व्यवस्थितम्
गमिष्ये यत्र काकुत्स्थः स्वस्ति ते अस्तु वरानने
transliteration: strītvāt duṣṭa svabhāvena guru vākye vyavasthitam
gamiṣye yatra kākutsthaḥ svasti te astu varānane
english: However the deities ranging in this woodland are my witnesses—may they hear you. I spoke what was fair and have been thus addressed by you with these harsh words. I do always obey my superior's commands. Fie on you! Your destruction is near at hand that do you suspect me, being influenced' by this womanish nature. I shall go where Kākutstha is, may good betide you, O you the best of damsel!

sanskrit: रक्षन्तु त्वाम् विशालाक्षि समग्रा वन देवताः
निमित्तानि हि घोराणि यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे
अपि त्वाम् सह रामेण पश्येयम् पुनरागतः
transliteration: rakṣantu tvām viśālākṣi samagrā vana devatāḥ
nimittāni hi ghorāṇi yāni prādurbhavanti me
api tvām saha rāmeṇa paśyeyam punarāgataḥ
english: May the deities of the forest protect you, O you of expansive eyes! many a bad omen appear before me. My I see you again when I shall come back with Rāina.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेन एवम् उक्ता तु रुदती जनकाअत्मजा
प्रत्युवाच ततो वाक्यम् तीव्रम् बाष्प परिप्लुता
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena evam uktā tu rudatī janakāatmajā
pratyuvāca tato vākyam tīvram bāṣpa pariplutā
english: Being thus accosted by Lakşmaņa the daughter of Janaka replied weeping and being bathed in tears.

sanskrit: आबन्धिष्ये अथवा त्यक्ष्ये विषमे देहम् आत्मनः
transliteration: ābandhiṣye athavā tyakṣye viṣame deham ātmanaḥ
english: Without Rama, O Laksmana, I shall drink virulent poison, enter fire or dive into the Godāverī. I shall destroy this body either by hanging or by falling down from the top of a high object. I shall never be able to touch another man but Rāma.

sanskrit: पिबामि वा विषम् तीक्ष्णम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्
न तु अहम् राघवात् अन्यम् कदाअपि पुरुषम् स्पृशे
transliteration: pibāmi vā viṣam tīkṣṇam pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam
na tu aham rāghavāt anyam kadāapi puruṣam spṛśe
english: Without Rama, O Laksmana, I shall drink virulent poison, enter fire or dive into the Godāverī. I shall destroy this body either by hanging or by falling down from the top of a high object. I shall never be able to touch another man but Rāma.

sanskrit: इति लक्ष्मणम् आश्रुत्य सीता दुह्ख समन्विता
पाणिभ्याम् रुदती दुह्खाद् उदरम् प्रजघान ह
transliteration: iti lakṣmaṇam āśrutya sītā duhkha samanvitā
pāṇibhyām rudatī duhkhād udaram prajaghāna ha
english: Speaking thus to Lakşmaņa, Sītā, being enveloped with grief, weeping, struck her belly* with her hands. Properly it should be Struck her breast. But it has a special significance here, i.e.-she would not be satisfied until her belly be filled with all the Raksasas salin.तामार्तरूपां विमना रुदन्ती

sanskrit: ताम् आर्त रूपाम् विमना रुदन्तीम्सौमित्रिः आलोक्य विशाल नेत्राम्
आश्वासयामास न चैव भर्तुःतम् भ्रातरम् किंचित् उवाच सीता
transliteration: tām ārta rūpām vimanā rudantīmsaumitriḥ ālokya viśāla netrām
āśvāsayāmāsa na caiva bhartuḥtam bhrātaram kiṃcit uvāca sītā
english: Seeing the daughter of Janaka of expansive eyes weep thus in pitiable accents, Lakşmaņa losing his attention began to console her.

sanskrit: ततः तु सीताम् अभिवाद्य लक्ष्मणःकृत अन्जलिः किम्चिद् अभिप्रणम्य
अवेक्षमाणो बहुशः स मैथिलीम्जगाम रामस्य समीपम् आत्मवान्
transliteration: tataḥ tu sītām abhivādya lakṣmaṇaḥkṛta anjaliḥ kimcid abhipraṇamya
avekṣamāṇo bahuśaḥ sa maithilīmjagāma rāmasya samīpam ātmavān
english: Afterwards the pure-hearted Laksmana, having control over his senses, saluting Sītā with clasped palms and bending low a little proceeded where Rāma was, casting again and again his glance upon her as he went.

sanskrit: तया परुषम् उक्तः तु कुपितो राघव अनुजः
स विकांक्षन् भृशम् रामम् प्रतस्थे न चिरात् इव
transliteration: tayā paruṣam uktaḥ tu kupito rāghava anujaḥ
sa vikāṃkṣan bhṛśam rāmam pratasthe na cirāt iva
english: Having been addressed with those harsh words the younger brother of Rāghava, enraged, proceeded at once, being anxious to see Rāma.

sanskrit: तदा आसाद्य दशग्रीवः क्षिप्रम् अंतरम् आस्थितः
transliteration: tadā āsādya daśagrīvaḥ kṣipram aṃtaram āsthitaḥ
english: Thereupon the ten-necked one, availing of this opportunity came before Vaidehī assuming the semblance of a mendicant.

sanskrit: श्लक्ष्ण काषाय संवीतः शिखी चत्री उपानही
वामे च अंसे अवसज्य अथ शुभे यष्टि कमण्डलू
transliteration: ślakṣṇa kāṣāya saṃvītaḥ śikhī catrī upānahī
vāme ca aṃse avasajya atha śubhe yaṣṭi kamaṇḍalū
english: Wearing a soft silken cloth, with a lock of hair on his head with an umbrella and shoes and having on his left shoulder a rod and kamandalu the highly powerful one assuming the appearance of a wandering devotee carrying three long bamboo staves appeared before Vaidehi in the forest when there was none of the brothers by her.

sanskrit: ताम् आससाद अतिबलो भ्रातृभ्याम् रहिताम् वने
transliteration: tām āsasāda atibalo bhrātṛbhyām rahitām vane
english: Wearing a soft silken cloth, with a lock of hair on his head with an umbrella and shoes and having on his left shoulder a rod and kamandalu the highly powerful one assuming the appearance of a wandering devotee carrying three long bamboo staves appeared before Vaidehi in the forest when there was none of the brothers by her.

sanskrit: रहिताम् सूर्य चन्द्राभ्याम् संध्याम् इव महत् तमः
ताम् अपश्यत् ततो बालाम् राज पुत्रीम् यशस्विनीम्
transliteration: rahitām sūrya candrābhyām saṃdhyām iva mahat tamaḥ
tām apaśyat tato bālām rāja putrīm yaśasvinīm
english: He saw there the young and pious daughter of the king like to an evening void of both sun and moon and as the highly terrible Rahu eyes Rohini forsaken by Moon.

sanskrit: रोहिणीम् शशिना हीनाम् ग्रहवत् भृश दारुणः
तम् उग्रम् पाप कर्माणम् जनस्थान गता द्रुमाः
transliteration: rohiṇīm śaśinā hīnām grahavat bhṛśa dāruṇaḥ
tam ugram pāpa karmāṇam janasthāna gatā drumāḥ

sanskrit: संदृश्य न प्रकंपन्ते न प्रवाति च मारुतः
शीघ्र स्रोताः च तम् दृष्ट्वा वीक्षंतम् रक्त लोचनम्
transliteration: saṃdṛśya na prakaṃpante na pravāti ca mārutaḥ
śīghra srotāḥ ca tam dṛṣṭvā vīkṣaṃtam rakta locanam
english: Seeing that terrible one the doer of evil deeds, the trees of Janasthāna did not move nor the wind did blow. Seeing him eye Sītā with his blood-red eyes, the fast streaming river Godāverī even slackened its course out of fear.

sanskrit: स्तिमितम् गंतुम् आरेभे भयात् गोदावरी नदी
रामस्य तु अंतरम् प्रेप्सुः दशग्रीवः तत् अंतरे
transliteration: stimitam gaṃtum ārebhe bhayāt godāvarī nadī
rāmasya tu aṃtaram prepsuḥ daśagrīvaḥ tat aṃtare

sanskrit: उपतस्थे च वैदेहीम् भिक्षु रूपेण रावणः
transliteration: upatasthe ca vaidehīm bhikṣu rūpeṇa rāvaṇaḥ

sanskrit: सहसा भव्य रूपेण तृणैः कूप इव आवृतः
transliteration: sahasā bhavya rūpeṇa tṛṇaiḥ kūpa iva āvṛtaḥ

sanskrit: अतिष्ठत् प्रेक्ष्य वैदेहीम् राम पत्नीम् यशस्विनीम्
तिष्टन् संप्रेक्ष्य च तदा पत्नीम् रामस्य रावण
transliteration: atiṣṭhat prekṣya vaidehīm rāma patnīm yaśasvinīm
tiṣṭan saṃprekṣya ca tadā patnīm rāmasya rāvaṇa

sanskrit: शुभाम् रुचिर दन्त ओष्ठीम् पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननाम्
transliteration: śubhām rucira danta oṣṭhīm pūrṇa candra nibha ānanām
english: Her lips and teeth were extremely fine, her face resembled the full moon and her eyes were like lotus-petals. She had a yellow siiken cloth on and sat in the thatched cottage, overwhelmed with grief and bathed in tears.

sanskrit: स ताम् पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् पीत कौशेय वासिनीम्
अभ्यगच्छत वैदेहीम् हृष्ट चेता निशा चरः
transliteration: sa tām padma palāśa akṣīm pīta kauśeya vāsinīm
abhyagacchata vaidehīm hṛṣṭa cetā niśā caraḥ
english: And that ranger of the night with a pleased heart approached Vaidehī.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा काम शर आविद्धो ब्रह्म घोषम् उदीरयन्
अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् रहिते राक्षस अधिपः
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kāma śara āviddho brahma ghoṣam udīrayan
abravīt praśritam vākyam rahite rākṣasa adhipaḥ
english: Seeing her that lord of Rākṣasas was pierced with the shafts of passion. And speaking highly of her, surpassing in beauty the three worlds and resembling by the excellence of her own person the very goddess of wealth herself Rāvana uttering the name of God spake to her,

sanskrit: ताम् उत्तमाम् त्रिलोकानाम् पद्म हीनाम् इव श्रियम्
transliteration: tām uttamām trilokānām padma hīnām iva śriyam
english: Seeing her that lord of Rākṣasas was pierced with the shafts of passion. And speaking highly of her, surpassing in beauty the three worlds and resembling by the excellence of her own person the very goddess of wealth herself Rāvana uttering the name of God spake to her,

sanskrit: का त्वम् कांचन वर्ण आभे पीत कौशेय वासिनि
कमलानाम् शुभाम् मालाम् पद्मिनी इव च बिभ्रती
transliteration: kā tvam kāṃcana varṇa ābhe pīta kauśeya vāsini
kamalānām śubhām mālām padminī iva ca bibhratī
english: O you having the colour of gold and silver, O you wearing silken cloth, O you appearing like a lotus wearing a garland of lotus-petals, O you of beautiful countenance!

sanskrit: ह्रीः श्रीः कीर्तिः शुभा लक्ष्मीः अप्सरा वा शुभ आनने
भूतिर् वा त्वम् वराअरोहे रतिर् वा स्वैर चारिणी
transliteration: hrīḥ śrīḥ kīrtiḥ śubhā lakṣmīḥ apsarā vā śubha ānane
bhūtir vā tvam varāarohe ratir vā svaira cāriṇī
english: Are you Bashfulness, Beauty, Fame, Wealth, Apsarā, Dignity or Rati herself who is ranging at will in this forest?

sanskrit: समाः शिखरिणः स्निग्धाः पाण्डुरा दशनाः तव
विशाले विमले नेत्रे रक्तान्ते कृष्ण तारके
transliteration: samāḥ śikhariṇaḥ snigdhāḥ pāṇḍurā daśanāḥ tava
viśāle vimale netre raktānte kṛṣṇa tārake
english: All your teeth are equal having their tops like to the buds of Kunda flower, beautiful and yellow. Your eyes are expansive, clear, of bloody hue, and having black pupils. Your hip is fleshy and spacious. Your thighs are like those of elephants, round, fleshy and perfectly strong.

sanskrit: विशालम् जघनम् पीनम् ऊरू करि कर उपमौ
transliteration: viśālam jaghanam pīnam ūrū kari kara upamau

sanskrit: पीन उन्नत मुखौ कान्तौ स्निग्ध ताल फल उपमौ
मणि प्रवेक आभरणौ रुचिरौ ते पयो धरौ
transliteration: pīna unnata mukhau kāntau snigdha tāla phala upamau
maṇi praveka ābharaṇau rucirau te payo dharau
english: Your nipples are bulky, pointed, highly captivating like cold palm fruits, beautiful and ornamented with diverse jewels.

sanskrit: चारु स्मिते चारु दति चारु नेत्रे विलासिनि
मनो हरसि मे रामे नदी कूलम् इव अंभसा
transliteration: cāru smite cāru dati cāru netre vilāsini
mano harasi me rāme nadī kūlam iva aṃbhasā
english: O you of beautiful smile! O you of beautiful teeth! O you of beautiful eyes! O fine damsel, you did carry away my heart like to a river carrying away its banks by its stream.

sanskrit: करान्तमित मध्या असि सुकेशी संहत स्तनी
न एव देवी न गन्धर्वी न यक्षी न च किंनरी
transliteration: karāntamita madhyā asi sukeśī saṃhata stanī
na eva devī na gandharvī na yakṣī na ca kiṃnarī
english: The lock of your hair is exquisitely fine, your breast very close and your waist is so thin that they may be got round even by fingers. There is none so beautiful like you-a Goddess, a Gandharvi, a Yaksi or a Kinnari.

sanskrit: न एवम् रूपा मया नारी दृष्ट पूर्वा मही तले
रूपम् अग्र्यम् च लोकेषु सौकुमार्यम् वयः च ते
transliteration: na evam rūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭa pūrvā mahī tale
rūpam agryam ca lokeṣu saukumāryam vayaḥ ca te
english: I had never seen before on this earth a damsel so beautiful as you. This your beauty the best on earth, your youth, your grace and your abode in the forest do agitate my mind. So it is well for you to come (with me); it does not behove you to remain here.

sanskrit: इह वासः च कांतारे चित्तम् उन्मथयन्ति मे
सा प्रतिक्राम भद्रम् ते न त्वम् वस्तुम् इह अर्हसि
transliteration: iha vāsaḥ ca kāṃtāre cittam unmathayanti me
sā pratikrāma bhadram te na tvam vastum iha arhasi
english: I had never seen before on this earth a damsel so beautiful as you. This your beauty the best on earth, your youth, your grace and your abode in the forest do agitate my mind. So it is well for you to come (with me); it does not behove you to remain here.

sanskrit: राक्षसानाम् अयम् वासो घोराणाम् काम रूपिणाम्
प्रासाद अग्राणि रम्याणि नगर उपवनानि च
transliteration: rākṣasānām ayam vāso ghorāṇām kāma rūpiṇām
prāsāda agrāṇi ramyāṇi nagara upavanāni ca
english: This is the abode of terrible Rākşasas wearing shapes at will. Picturesque palaces, prosperous cities and sweet-smelling gardens are worthy of your abode.

sanskrit: वरम् माल्यम् वरम् गंधम् वरम् वस्त्रम् च शोभने
transliteration: varam mālyam varam gaṃdham varam vastram ca śobhane

sanskrit: भर्तारम् च वरम् मन्ये त्वत् युक्तम् असितेक्षणे
का त्वम् भवसि रुद्राणाम् मरुताम् वा शुचिस्मिते
transliteration: bhartāram ca varam manye tvat yuktam asitekṣaṇe
kā tvam bhavasi rudrāṇām marutām vā śucismite

sanskrit: वसूनाम् वा वराअरोहे देवता प्रतिभासि मे
न इह गच्छंति गंधर्वा न देवा न च किन्नराः
transliteration: vasūnām vā varāarohe devatā pratibhāsi me
na iha gacchaṃti gaṃdharvā na devā na ca kinnarāḥ

sanskrit: राक्षसानाम् अयम् वासः कथम् तु त्वम् इह आगता
इह शाखामृगाः सिंहा द्वीपि व्याघ्र मृगाः तथा
transliteration: rākṣasānām ayam vāsaḥ katham tu tvam iha āgatā
iha śākhāmṛgāḥ siṃhā dvīpi vyāghra mṛgāḥ tathā

sanskrit: ऋक्षाः तरक्षवः कंकाः कथम् तेभ्यो न बिभ्यसे
transliteration: ṛkṣāḥ tarakṣavaḥ kaṃkāḥ katham tebhyo na bibhyase

sanskrit: कथम् एका महारण्ये न बिभेषि वराअनने
का असि कस्य कुतः च त्वम् किम् निमित्तम् च दण्डकान्
transliteration: katham ekā mahāraṇye na bibheṣi varāanane
kā asi kasya kutaḥ ca tvam kim nimittam ca daṇḍakān

sanskrit: एका चरसि कल्याणि घोरान् राक्षस सेवितान्
इति प्रशस्ता वैदेही रावणेन दुरात्मना - महात्मना-
transliteration: ekā carasi kalyāṇi ghorān rākṣasa sevitān
iti praśastā vaidehī rāvaṇena durātmanā - mahātmanā-

sanskrit: द्विजाति वेषेण हि तम् दृष्ट्वा रावणम् आगतम्
transliteration: dvijāti veṣeṇa hi tam dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇam āgatam
english: Thus addressed was Vaidehĩ by the vicious souled Rāvana. Seeing him come under the guise of a twice-born one, Maithelee worshipped him with diverse articles necessary for serving a guest.

sanskrit: उपानीय आसनम् पूर्वम् पाद्येन अभिनिमंत्र्य च
अब्रवीत् सिद्धम् इति एव तदा तम् सौम्य दर्शनम्
transliteration: upānīya āsanam pūrvam pādyena abhinimaṃtrya ca
abravīt siddham iti eva tadā tam saumya darśanam
english: Offering him a seat first and afterwards inviting him to wash his feet she said to that one of placid look cooked rice is ready.

sanskrit: द्विजाति वेषेण समीक्ष्य मैथिलीतम् आगतम् पात्र कुसुंभ धारिणम्
अशक्यम् उद्द्वेष्टुम् उपाय दर्शनान्न्यमंत्रयत् ब्राह्मणवत् यथा आगतम्
transliteration: dvijāti veṣeṇa samīkṣya maithilītam āgatam pātra kusuṃbha dhāriṇam
aśakyam uddveṣṭum upāya darśanānnyamaṃtrayat brāhmaṇavat yathā āgatam
english: Seeing Rāvaņa approach with Kamandalu and wearing a red cloth under the guise of a Brāhmana, Maithelee could not pass by him any way, and considering him a twice-born one by various signs invited him as if a Brāhmana ,

sanskrit: इयम् बृसी ब्राह्मण कामम् आस्यताम्इदम् च पाद्यम् प्रतिगृह्यताम् इति
निमंत्र्यमाणः प्रतिपूर्ण भाषिणीम्नरेन्द्र पत्नीम् प्रसमीक्ष्य मैथिलीम्
प्रसह्य तस्या हरणे धृढम् मनःसमर्पयामास आत्म वधाय रावणः
transliteration: iyam bṛsī brāhmaṇa kāmam āsyatāmidam ca pādyam pratigṛhyatām iti
nimaṃtryamāṇaḥ pratipūrṇa bhāṣiṇīmnarendra patnīm prasamīkṣya maithilīm
prasahya tasyā haraṇe dhṛḍham manaḥsamarpayāmāsa ātma vadhāya rāvaṇaḥ
english: Jānakí the wife of Lord of men inviting him thus, Ravana, casting a look upon her, addressed himself for his own destruction, to carry her away.

sanskrit: ततः सुवेषम् मृगया गतम् पतिम्प्रतीक्षमाणा सह लक्ष्मणम् तदा
निरीक्षमाणा हरितम् ददर्श तत्महद् वनम् न एव तु राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: tataḥ suveṣam mṛgayā gatam patimpratīkṣamāṇā saha lakṣmaṇam tadā
nirīkṣamāṇā haritam dadarśa tatmahad vanam na eva tu rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: She was anxiously expecting the return of Rāma who had gone a-hunting with Lakşmaņa; she looked around and beheld but on all sides the spacious yellow forest-land-~-there was neither Rāma nor Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: रावणेन तु वैदेही तदा पृष्टा जिहीर्षुणा
transliteration: rāvaṇena tu vaidehī tadā pṛṣṭā jihīrṣuṇā
english: Being thus addressed by Rāvaņa under the guise of a mendicant, desirous of carrying her away Vaidehī thought within herself.

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणः च अतिथिः च एष अनुक्तो हि शपेत माम्
इति ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तम् तु सीता वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: brāhmaṇaḥ ca atithiḥ ca eṣa anukto hi śapeta mām
iti dhyātvā muhūrtam tu sītā vacanam abravīt
english: This person is my guest and a Brahmin; he may curse me if I do not speak to him. Thinking this for a moment Sītā said.

sanskrit: सीता नाम्ना अस्मि भद्रम् ते रामस्य महिषी प्रिया
transliteration: sītā nāmnā asmi bhadram te rāmasya mahiṣī priyā
english: May good betide you! I am the daughter of the high-souled Janaka, the king of Mithilā, the beloved Queen of Rāma and my name is Sītā.

sanskrit: उषित्वा द्वा दश समाः इक्ष्वाकूणाम् निवेशने
भुंजाना मानुषान् भोगान् सर्व काम समृद्धिनी
transliteration: uṣitvā dvā daśa samāḥ ikṣvākūṇām niveśane
bhuṃjānā mānuṣān bhogān sarva kāma samṛddhinī
english: Dwelling in the palace of Ikşäkus for twelve years, I enjoyed many things passing human and had all my desires satisfied.

sanskrit: तत्र त्रयो दशे वर्षे राज अमंत्र्यत प्रभुः
transliteration: tatra trayo daśe varṣe rāja amaṃtryata prabhuḥ
english: On the thirteenth year king (Dasaratha) counselled with his ministers about the installation of Rāma.

sanskrit: कैकेयी नाम भर्तारम् मम आर्या याचते वरम्
transliteration: kaikeyī nāma bhartāram mama āryā yācate varam
english: Accordingly everything necessary for the installation being made ready, KaikeyI, one of my mothers-in-law, begged of her husband a boon.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य तु कैकेयी श्वशुरम् सुकृतेन मे
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu kaikeyī śvaśuram sukṛtena me
english: Bringing my father-in-law under control by means of her virtuous deeds, Kaikeyi begged, of that truthful, best of monarchs, two boons namely the exile of my husband into woods and the installation of Bharata,

sanskrit: न अद्य भोक्ष्ये न च स्वप्स्ये न पास्ये कदाचन
transliteration: na adya bhokṣye na ca svapsye na pāsye kadācana

sanskrit: एष मे जीवितस्य अन्तो रामो यदि अभिषिच्यते
इति ब्रुवाणाम् कैकेयीम् श्वशुरो मे स पार्थिवः
transliteration: eṣa me jīvitasya anto rāmo yadi abhiṣicyate
iti bruvāṇām kaikeyīm śvaśuro me sa pārthivaḥ

sanskrit: अयाचत अर्थैः अन्वर्थैः न च यांचाम् चकार सा
मम भर्ता महातेजा वयसा पंच विंशकः
transliteration: ayācata arthaiḥ anvarthaiḥ na ca yāṃcām cakāra sā
mama bhartā mahātejā vayasā paṃca viṃśakaḥ

sanskrit: अष्टा दश हि वर्षाणि मम जन्मनि गण्यते
राम इति प्रथितो लोके सत्यवान् शीलवान् शुचिः
transliteration: aṣṭā daśa hi varṣāṇi mama janmani gaṇyate
rāma iti prathito loke satyavān śīlavān śuciḥ

sanskrit: विशालाक्षो महाबाहुः सर्व भूत हिते रतः
कामार्तः च महाराजः पिता दशरथः स्वयम्
transliteration: viśālākṣo mahābāhuḥ sarva bhūta hite rataḥ
kāmārtaḥ ca mahārājaḥ pitā daśarathaḥ svayam

sanskrit: कैकेय्याः प्रिय कामार्थम् तम् रामम् न अभिषेचयत्
अभिषेकाय तु पितुः समीपम् रामम् आगतम्
transliteration: kaikeyyāḥ priya kāmārtham tam rāmam na abhiṣecayat
abhiṣekāya tu pituḥ samīpam rāmam āgatam

sanskrit: कैकेयी मम भर्तारम् इति उवाच द्रुतम् वचः
तव पित्रा समाज्ञप्तम् मम इदम् शृणु राघव
transliteration: kaikeyī mama bhartāram iti uvāca drutam vacaḥ
tava pitrā samājñaptam mama idam śṛṇu rāghava

sanskrit: त्वया तु खलु वस्तव्यम् नव वर्षाणि पंच च
transliteration: tvayā tu khalu vastavyam nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca
english: Do you hear, O Rāghava, how I have been ordered by your Sire. This kingdom, rid of thorns is to be conferred of Bharata, and you shall have to sojourn into woods for years nine and five. Do you therefore repair to forest, O Kākutstha and save your Sire from untruth.

sanskrit: वने प्रव्रज काकुत्स्थ पितरम् मोचय अनृतात्
तथा इति उवाच ताम् रामः कैकेयीम् अकुतो भयः
transliteration: vane pravraja kākutstha pitaram mocaya anṛtāt
tathā iti uvāca tām rāmaḥ kaikeyīm akuto bhayaḥ

sanskrit: चकार तत् वचः तस्या मम भर्ता दृढ व्रतः
दद्यात् न प्रतिगृह्णीयात् सत्यम् ब्रूयात् न च अनृतम्
transliteration: cakāra tat vacaḥ tasyā mama bhartā dṛḍha vrataḥ
dadyāt na pratigṛhṇīyāt satyam brūyāt na ca anṛtam

sanskrit: एतत् ब्राह्मण रामस्य व्रतम् ध्रुवम् अनुत्तमम्
तस्य भ्राता तु वैमात्रो लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्
transliteration: etat brāhmaṇa rāmasya vratam dhruvam anuttamam
tasya bhrātā tu vaimātro lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān

sanskrit: स भ्राता लक्ष्मणो नाम धर्म चारी दृढ व्रतः
transliteration: sa bhrātā lakṣmaṇo nāma dharma cārī dṛḍha vrataḥ
english: His half-brother named Lakşmaņa is of mighty prowess. That best of men is Rāma's help and the destroyer of foes in battle. That brother of his named Lakşmaņa is of firm resolution and given to asceticism.

sanskrit: अन्वगच्छत् धनुष् पाणिः प्रव्रजंतम् मया सह
जटी तापस रूपेण मया सह सह अनुजः
transliteration: anvagacchat dhanuṣ pāṇiḥ pravrajaṃtam mayā saha
jaṭī tāpasa rūpeṇa mayā saha saha anujaḥ
english: With a bow in hand he has followed (Rama) flying as an exile to woods along with me. Thus that one (Rāma) of firm resolution and ever engaged in pious offices wearing matted hair and assuming the semblance of an ascetic has entered this forest of Dandaka along with myself and his younger brother,

sanskrit: प्रविष्टो दंडकारण्यम् धर्म नित्यो धृढ व्रतः
ते वयम् प्रच्युता राज्यात् कैकेय्याः तु कृते त्रयः
transliteration: praviṣṭo daṃḍakāraṇyam dharma nityo dhṛḍha vrataḥ
te vayam pracyutā rājyāt kaikeyyāḥ tu kṛte trayaḥ

sanskrit: विचराम द्विज श्रेष्ठ वनम् गंभीरम् ओजसा
समाश्वस मुहूर्तम् तु शक्यम् वस्तुम् इह त्वया
transliteration: vicarāma dvija śreṣṭha vanam gaṃbhīram ojasā
samāśvasa muhūrtam tu śakyam vastum iha tvayā

sanskrit: आगमिष्यति मे भर्ता वन्यम् आदाय पुष्कलम्
रुरून् गोधान् वराहान् च हत्वा आदाय अमिषान् बहु
transliteration: āgamiṣyati me bhartā vanyam ādāya puṣkalam
rurūn godhān varāhān ca hatvā ādāya amiṣān bahu

sanskrit: सः त्वम् नाम च गोत्रम् च कुलम् आचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः
एकः च दण्डकारण्ये किम् अर्थम् चरसि द्विज
transliteration: saḥ tvam nāma ca gotram ca kulam ācakṣva tattvataḥ
ekaḥ ca daṇḍakāraṇye kim artham carasi dvija

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवत्याम् सीतायाम् राम पत्नीआम् महाबलः
transliteration: evam bruvatyām sītāyām rāma patnīām mahābalaḥ
english: Sītā the wife of Rāma speaking thus, the mighty Lord of Rākşasas-Rävana replied with these harsh words,

sanskrit: येन वित्रासिता लोकाः स देव असुर मानुषा
अहम् सः रावणो नाम सीते रक्षो गण ईश्वरः
transliteration: yena vitrāsitā lokāḥ sa deva asura mānuṣā
aham saḥ rāvaṇo nāma sīte rakṣo gaṇa īśvaraḥ
english: O Sītā I am that Rāvaņa, the lord of Rākşasas, whoin fear the celestials, Asuras and human beings.

sanskrit: त्वाम् तु कांचन वर्ण आभाम् दृष्ट्वा कौशेय वासिनीम्
रतिम् स्वकेषु दारेषु न अधिगच्छामि अनिन्दिते
transliteration: tvām tu kāṃcana varṇa ābhām dṛṣṭvā kauśeya vāsinīm
ratim svakeṣu dāreṣu na adhigacchāmi anindite
english: O you of blameless beauty, seeing you of golden hue and wearing silk cloth I do not relish my own wives.

sanskrit: बह्वीनाम् उत्तम स्त्रीणाम् आहृतानाम् इतः ततः
सर्वासाम् एव भद्रम् ते मम अग्र महिषी भव
transliteration: bahvīnām uttama strīṇām āhṛtānām itaḥ tataḥ
sarvāsām eva bhadram te mama agra mahiṣī bhava
english: I have brought many a beautiful damsel from various quarters, do you become my foremost Queen among them.

sanskrit: लंका नाम समुद्रस्य मध्ये मम महापुरी
transliteration: laṃkā nāma samudrasya madhye mama mahāpurī
english: That great city in the midst of the ocean, Larkā, encircled on all sides by the sea and situated on the summit of a hill, is my capital.

sanskrit: तत्र सीते मया सार्धम् वनेषु विचरिष्यसि
न च अस्य वन वासस्य स्पृहयिष्यसि भामिनि
transliteration: tatra sīte mayā sārdham vaneṣu vicariṣyasi
na ca asya vana vāsasya spṛhayiṣyasi bhāmini
english: There shall you with me, O Sītā, walk in gardens, and thus you shall no more long for living in the forest.

sanskrit: पंच दास्यः सहस्राणि सर्व आभरण भूषिताः
सीते परिचरिष्यन्ति भार्या भवसि मे यदि
transliteration: paṃca dāsyaḥ sahasrāṇi sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ
sīte paricariṣyanti bhāryā bhavasi me yadi
english: If you did become my wife, O Sītā, five thousand maid-servants decorated with divers ornaments shall serve you.

sanskrit: रावणेन एवम् उक्ता तु कुपिता जनक आत्मजा
transliteration: rāvaṇena evam uktā tu kupitā janaka ātmajā
english: That blameless daughter of Janaka, being thus addressed by Ravana, was highly enraged, and, passing by him, replied.

sanskrit: महा गिरिम् इव अकंप्यम् महेन्द्र सदृशम् पतिम्
महा उदधिम् इव अक्षोभ्यम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता
transliteration: mahā girim iva akaṃpyam mahendra sadṛśam patim
mahā udadhim iva akṣobhyam aham rāmam anuvratā
english: I am a dependant of Rāma, who is incapable of being, shaken, like to a mighty mountain, incapable of being agitated, like to a vast ocean, and resembling Mahendra in effulgence.

sanskrit: सर्व लक्षण संपन्नम् न्यग्रोध परि मण्डलम्
transliteration: sarva lakṣaṇa saṃpannam nyagrodha pari maṇḍalam
english: I am a dependant of that great and truthful Rāma who is gifted with auspicious marks and like to a fig tree.

sanskrit: नृसिंहम् सिंह संकाशम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता
transliteration: nṛsiṃham siṃha saṃkāśam aham rāmam anuvratā
english: I am a dependant of that lion among men, Rāma, of mighty arms, of a spacious breast an treading like a lion.

sanskrit: पूर्ण चन्द्र आननम् वीरम् राज वत्सम् जितेन्द्रियम्
पृथु कीर्तिम् महाबाहुम् अहम् रामम् अनुव्रता
transliteration: pūrṇa candra ānanam vīram rāja vatsam jitendriyam
pṛthu kīrtim mahābāhum aham rāmam anuvratā
english: I am a dependant of that son of a king, Rāma, of mighty arms, having control over his passions, whose face resembles the full moon and whose fame has spread far and wide over the earth.36

sanskrit: त्वम् पुनः जंबुकः सिंहीम् माम् इह इच्छसि दुर्लभाम्
न अहम् शक्या त्वया स्प्रष्टुम् आदित्यस्य प्रभा यथा
transliteration: tvam punaḥ jaṃbukaḥ siṃhīm mām iha icchasi durlabhām
na aham śakyā tvayā spraṣṭum ādityasya prabhā yathā
english: Why do you being a tiger wish for a she-lion? You shall not be able to touch me like to the rays of the sun.

sanskrit: पादपान् कांचनान् नूनम् बहून् पश्यसि मंदभाक्
राघवस्य प्रियाम् भार्याम् यः त्वम् इच्छसि राक्षस
transliteration: pādapān kāṃcanān nūnam bahūn paśyasi maṃdabhāk
rāghavasya priyām bhāryām yaḥ tvam icchasi rākṣasa
english: O you wretched Rākşasa, when you have desired to steal away Raghhava's beloved spouse, surely do you see these trees (before you) as made of gold.

sanskrit: क्षुधितस्य च सिंहस्य मृग शत्रोः तरस्विनः
आशी विषस्य वदनात् दम्ष्ट्राम् आदातुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: kṣudhitasya ca siṃhasya mṛga śatroḥ tarasvinaḥ
āśī viṣasya vadanāt damṣṭrām ādātum icchasi

sanskrit: मंदरम् पर्वत श्रेष्ठम् पाणिना हर्तुम् इच्छसि
काल कूटम् विषम् पीत्वा स्वस्तिमान् गंतुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: maṃdaram parvata śreṣṭham pāṇinā hartum icchasi
kāla kūṭam viṣam pītvā svastimān gaṃtum icchasi

sanskrit: अक्षि सूच्या प्रमृजसि जिह्वया लेढि च क्षुरम्
राघवस्य प्रियाम् भार्याम् अधिगंतुम् त्वम् इच्छसि
transliteration: akṣi sūcyā pramṛjasi jihvayā leḍhi ca kṣuram
rāghavasya priyām bhāryām adhigaṃtum tvam icchasi

sanskrit: अवसज्य शिलाम् कण्ठे समुद्रम् तर्तुम् इच्छसि
सूर्या चन्द्रमसौ च उभौ प्राणिभ्याम् हर्तुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: avasajya śilām kaṇṭhe samudram tartum icchasi
sūryā candramasau ca ubhau prāṇibhyām hartum icchasi

sanskrit: यो रामस्य प्रियाम् भार्याम् प्रधर्षयितुम् इच्छसि
अग्निम् प्रज्वलितम् दृष्ट्वा वस्त्रेण आहर्तुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: yo rāmasya priyām bhāryām pradharṣayitum icchasi
agnim prajvalitam dṛṣṭvā vastreṇa āhartum icchasi

sanskrit: कल्याण वृत्ताम् यो भार्याम् रामस्य हर्तुम् इच्छसि
अयो मुखानाम् शूलानाम् अग्रे चरितुम् इच्छसि
रामस्य सदृशीम् भार्याम् यो अधिगंतुम् त्वम् इच्छसि
transliteration: kalyāṇa vṛttām yo bhāryām rāmasya hartum icchasi
ayo mukhānām śūlānām agre caritum icchasi
rāmasya sadṛśīm bhāryām yo adhigaṃtum tvam icchasi

sanskrit: यद् अंतरम् सिंह शृगालयोः वनेयद् अंतरम् स्यन्दनिका समुद्रयोः
सुर अग्र्य सौवीरकयोः यद् अंतरम्तद् अंतरम् दाशरथेः तव एव च
transliteration: yad aṃtaram siṃha śṛgālayoḥ vaneyad aṃtaram syandanikā samudrayoḥ
sura agrya sauvīrakayoḥ yad aṃtaramtad aṃtaram dāśaratheḥ tava eva ca

sanskrit: यद् अंतरम् कांचन सीस लोहयोःयद् अंतरम् चन्दन वारि पंकयोः
यद् अंतरम् हस्ति बिडालयोः वनेतद् अंतरम् दशरथेः तव एव च
transliteration: yad aṃtaram kāṃcana sīsa lohayoḥyad aṃtaram candana vāri paṃkayoḥ
yad aṃtaram hasti biḍālayoḥ vanetad aṃtaram daśaratheḥ tava eva ca

sanskrit: यद् अंतरम् वायस वैनतेययोःयद् अंतरम् मद्गु मयूरयोः अपि
यद् अंतरम् हंस गृध्रयोः वनेतद् अंतरम् दाशरथेः तव एव च
transliteration: yad aṃtaram vāyasa vainateyayoḥyad aṃtaram madgu mayūrayoḥ api
yad aṃtaram haṃsa gṛdhrayoḥ vanetad aṃtaram dāśaratheḥ tava eva ca

sanskrit: तस्मिन् सहस्राक्ष सम प्रभावेरामे स्थिते कार्मुक बाण पाणौ
हृता अपि ते अहम् न जराम् गमिष्येवज्रम् यथा मक्षिकया अवगीर्णम्
transliteration: tasmin sahasrākṣa sama prabhāverāme sthite kārmuka bāṇa pāṇau
hṛtā api te aham na jarām gamiṣyevajram yathā makṣikayā avagīrṇam

sanskrit: इति इव तत् वाक्यम् अदुष्ट भावासुदुष्टम् उक्त्वा रजनी चरम् तम्
गात्र प्रकंपात् व्यथिता बभूववात उद्धता सा कदली इव तन्वी
transliteration: iti iva tat vākyam aduṣṭa bhāvāsuduṣṭam uktvā rajanī caram tam
gātra prakaṃpāt vyathitā babhūvavāta uddhatā sā kadalī iva tanvī
english: Addressing those words to that wicked ranger of the night, that innocent ($ītā) shook like a plantain tree shaken by the wind.

sanskrit: ताम् वेपमानाम् उपलक्ष्य सीताम्स रावणो मृत्यु सम प्रभावः
कुलम् बलम् नाम च कर्म च आत्मनःसमाचचक्षे भय कारण अर्थम्
transliteration: tām vepamānām upalakṣya sītāmsa rāvaṇo mṛtyu sama prabhāvaḥ
kulam balam nāma ca karma ca ātmanaḥsamācacakṣe bhaya kāraṇa artham
english: There upon Rāvaņa, like to Death in prowess, trembling, began to relate to her with a view to frighten (her) his race, power, name and actions.

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवत्याम् सीतायाम् संरब्धः परुष अक्षरम्
ललाटे भ्रुकुटीम् कृत्वा रावणः प्रति उवाच ह
transliteration: evam bruvatyām sītāyām saṃrabdhaḥ paruṣa akṣaram
lalāṭe bhrukuṭīm kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ prati uvāca ha
english: After Sītā had spoken these harsh words, Rāvana, enraged, with a frown, replied.

sanskrit: रावणो नाम भद्रम् ते दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्
transliteration: rāvaṇo nāma bhadram te daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān
english: O you of a beatiful countenance, I am the step-brother of the Lord of wealth and my name is the mighty Ten-necked Rāvana May good betide you!

sanskrit: यस्य देवाः स गंधर्वाः पिशाच पतग उरगाः
विद्रवन्ति भयात् भीता मृत्योः इव सदा प्रजाः
transliteration: yasya devāḥ sa gaṃdharvāḥ piśāca pataga uragāḥ
vidravanti bhayāt bhītā mṛtyoḥ iva sadā prajāḥ
english: Like to people fearing Death, the celestials, Gandharvas, Piśāchas, Pannagas and Serpents fly in diverse directions being frightened by me. I have subdued by my prowess, my step-brother, the Lord of wealth in a conflict, quarrelling with him for some reason.

sanskrit: द्वन्द्वम् आसादितः क्रोधात् रणे विक्रम्य निर्जितः
transliteration: dvandvam āsāditaḥ krodhāt raṇe vikramya nirjitaḥ
english: Like to people fearing Death, the celestials, Gandharvas, Piśāchas, Pannagas and Serpents fly in diverse directions being frightened by me. I have subdued by my prowess, my step-brother, the Lord of wealth in a conflict, quarrelling with him for some reason.

sanskrit: मत् भय आर्तः परित्यज्य स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् ऋद्धिमत्
कैलासम् पर्वत श्रेष्ठम् अध्यास्ते नर वाहनः
transliteration: mat bhaya ārtaḥ parityajya svam adhiṣṭhānam ṛddhimat
kailāsam parvata śreṣṭham adhyāste nara vāhanaḥ
english: Thereat, that one carried by men, renouncing out of my fear this wealthy abode of Lankā, has been living on that Lord of mountains, Kailāśa.

sanskrit: यस्य तत् पुष्पकम् नाम विमानम् कामगम् शुभम्
वीर्याद् आवर्जितम् भद्रे येन यामि विहायसम्
transliteration: yasya tat puṣpakam nāma vimānam kāmagam śubham
vīryād āvarjitam bhadre yena yāmi vihāyasam
english: O you auspicious one, by virtue of my prowess I have taken away that beautiful chariot of his called Puspaka. Ascending that chariot you shall travei by the ethereal route.

sanskrit: मम संजात रोषस्य मुखम् दृष्ट्वा एव मैथिलि
transliteration: mama saṃjāta roṣasya mukham dṛṣṭvā eva maithili
english: O Maithilee, when I am excited with ire, Indra and other celestials at the mere sight of my countenance fly away in divers directions out of fear.

sanskrit: यत्र तिष्ठामि अहम् तत्र मारुतो वाति शन्कितः
तीव्र अंशुः शिशिर अंशुः च भयात् संपद्यते रविः
transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhāmi aham tatra māruto vāti śankitaḥ
tīvra aṃśuḥ śiśira aṃśuḥ ca bhayāt saṃpadyate raviḥ
english: Wherever I live, the Wind bloweth cautiously and the Sun (of piercing rays) out of fear for me appeareth in the welkin like the Moon.

sanskrit: निष्कंप पत्राः तरवो नद्यः च स्तिमित उदकाः
भवन्ति यत्र तत्र अहम् तिष्ठामि च चरामि च
transliteration: niṣkaṃpa patrāḥ taravo nadyaḥ ca stimita udakāḥ
bhavanti yatra tatra aham tiṣṭhāmi ca carāmi ca
english: What shall I say more? Wherever I live, even the leaves of the trees do not flutter and the currents of the rivers are stopped.

sanskrit: मम पारे समुद्रस्य लंका नाम पुरी शुभा
संपूर्णा राक्षसैः घोरैः यथा इन्द्रस्य अमरावती
transliteration: mama pāre samudrasya laṃkā nāma purī śubhā
saṃpūrṇā rākṣasaiḥ ghoraiḥ yathā indrasya amarāvatī
english: Beyond the ocean stands my beautiful capital Larikā like to Indra's Amaravati, (the capital of the Lord of celestials), guarded on all sides by the terrible night-rangers and encircled by yellow walls.

sanskrit: हेम कक्ष्या पुरी रम्या वैदूर्यमय तोरणा
transliteration: hema kakṣyā purī ramyā vaidūryamaya toraṇā
english: That beautiful city has gate-ways of ornamented and jewelled arches and golden apartinents.

sanskrit: हस्ति अश्व रथ संभाधा तूर्य नाद विनादिता
सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः संकुल उद्यान भूषिता
transliteration: hasti aśva ratha saṃbhādhā tūrya nāda vināditā
sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ saṃkula udyāna bhūṣitā
english: It is filled with clephants, horses and chariots, always resounds with the sounds of bugles, and is beautified with gardens having divers trees of wished-for fruits.

sanskrit: तत्र त्वम् वस हे सीते राजपुत्रि मया सह
transliteration: tatra tvam vasa he sīte rājaputri mayā saha
english: O Sītā, O you the daughter of a king, in this city shall you dwell with me. O large-minded damsel, you shall never think of earthly women.

sanskrit: भुंजाना मानुषान् भोगान् दिव्यान् च वरवर्णिनि
न स्मरिष्यसि रामस्य मानुषस्य गत आयुषः
transliteration: bhuṃjānā mānuṣān bhogān divyān ca varavarṇini
na smariṣyasi rāmasya mānuṣasya gata āyuṣaḥ
english: O you of an exquisite countenance, enjoying these many things passing human, you shall not any more think of Rāma a human being of brief existence.

sanskrit: स्थापयित्वा प्रियम् पुत्रम् राज्ञा दशरथेन यः
मन्द वीर्यः सुतो ज्येष्ठः ततः प्रस्थापितो वनम्
transliteration: sthāpayitvā priyam putram rājñā daśarathena yaḥ
manda vīryaḥ suto jyeṣṭhaḥ tataḥ prasthāpito vanam
english: Placing his beloved son on the throne, king Dasaratha has sent away his eldest son of weak prowess into the woods. O you of expansive eyes, what shall you do with that wretched ascetic Rāma who has been deprived of his kingdom?

sanskrit: तेन किम् भ्रष्ट राज्येन रामेण गत चेतसा
transliteration: tena kim bhraṣṭa rājyena rāmeṇa gata cetasā
english: Placing his beloved son on the throne, king Dasaratha has sent away his eldest son of weak prowess into the woods. O you of expansive eyes, what shall you do with that wretched ascetic Rāma who has been deprived of his kingdom?

sanskrit: सर्व राक्षस भर्तारम् कामय - कामात् - स्वयम् आगतम्
न मन्मथ शर आविष्टम् प्रति आख्यातुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
transliteration: sarva rākṣasa bhartāram kāmaya - kāmāt - svayam āgatam
na manmatha śara āviṣṭam prati ākhyātum tvam arhasi
english: I am the lord of the whole world of Rākşasas; being pierced by the shafts of Kāma have I come by you. It does not behave you therefore to pass by me.

sanskrit: प्रति आख्याय हि माम् भीरु परितापम् गमिष्यसि
transliteration: prati ākhyāya hi mām bhīru paritāpam gamiṣyasi
english: O timid damsel, truly shall you repent afterwards if you did disregard me, like to Urvasi kicking Pururavā.

sanskrit: अंगुल्या न समो रामो मम युद्धे स मानुषः
transliteration: aṃgulyā na samo rāmo mama yuddhe sa mānuṣaḥ
english: Rāma is a human being and is not even equal to a finger of mine in battle. By your good luck have I come to you-do you give yourself up to me, O you of a beautiful countenance. Being thus addressed by him, Vaidehi exceedingly wroth and with blood-red eyes spoke to that Lord of Rākşasas in the lonely forest, these bold words.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्त लोचना
अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् रहिते राक्षस अधिपम्
transliteration: evam uktā tu vaidehī kruddhā saṃrakta locanā
abravīt paruṣam vākyam rahite rākṣasa adhipam
english: Rāma is a human being and is not even equal to a finger of mine in battle. By your good luck have I come to you-do you give yourself up to me, O you of a beautiful countenance. Being thus addressed by him, Vaidehi exceedingly wroth and with blood-red eyes spoke to that Lord of Rākşasas in the lonely forest, these bold words.

sanskrit: कथम् वैश्रवणम् देवम् सर्व देव नमस्कृतम्
भ्रातरम् व्यपदिश्य त्वम् अशुभम् कर्तुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: katham vaiśravaṇam devam sarva deva namaskṛtam
bhrātaram vyapadiśya tvam aśubham kartum icchasi
english: How do you wish to perpetrate such an impious deed after introducing as your brother that highly worshipful Kubera adored by all the deities.

sanskrit: येषाम् त्वम् कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिः अजित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: yeṣām tvam karkaśo rājā durbuddhiḥ ajita indriyaḥ
english: O Rāvana, surely shall all the Räkşasas meet with death, who have such a stupid, harsh and lustful person like you for their king.

sanskrit: अपहृत्य शचीम् भार्याम् शक्यम् इन्द्रस्य जीवितुम्
न हि रामस्य भार्याम् माम् अपनीय अस्ति जीवितम्
transliteration: apahṛtya śacīm bhāryām śakyam indrasya jīvitum
na hi rāmasya bhāryām mām apanīya asti jīvitam
english: One can breathe on this earth carrying away Indra's wife, Śacī—but stealing me, the wife of Rāma, no body shall be able to live in peace.

sanskrit: जीवेत् चिरम् वज्र धरस्य हस्तात्शचीम् प्रधृष्य अप्रतिरूप रूपाम्
न मा दृशीम् राक्षस धर्षयित्वापीत अमृतस्य अपि तव अस्ति मोक्षः
transliteration: jīvet ciram vajra dharasya hastātśacīm pradhṛṣya apratirūpa rūpām
na mā dṛśīm rākṣasa dharṣayitvāpīta amṛtasya api tava asti mokṣaḥ
english: O Räkşasa, it might be possible for one to live on this earth treating contemptuously the wife of the holder of thunder-bolt, but insulting me none shall escape the hands of Death even if he drinketh nectar.

sanskrit: हस्ते हस्तम् समाहत्य चकार सुमहत् वपुः
transliteration: haste hastam samāhatya cakāra sumahat vapuḥ
english: Hearing those words of Sītā the highly powerful Ten necked one striking his hands together, increased his body too high.

sanskrit: स मैथिलीम् पुनः वाक्यम् बभाषे वाक्य कोविदः
न उन्मत्तया श्रुतौ मन्ये मम वीर्य पराक्रमौ
transliteration: sa maithilīm punaḥ vākyam babhāṣe vākya kovidaḥ
na unmattayā śrutau manye mama vīrya parākramau
english: Thereupon, that one skilled in speech again spake to Maithili, Methinks you have run mad. Have you not heard of my valour and prowess?

sanskrit: उद् वहेयम् भुजाभ्याम् तु मेदिनीम् अंबरे स्थितः
आपिबेयम् समुद्रम् च मृत्युम् हन्याम् रणे स्थितः
transliteration: ud vaheyam bhujābhyām tu medinīm aṃbare sthitaḥ
āpibeyam samudram ca mṛtyum hanyām raṇe sthitaḥ
english: Stationing myself in the welkin I can with my hands raise up the earth. I can drink up the waters of the ocean. And engaged in conflict I can destroy Death itself

sanskrit: अर्कम् तुंद्याम् शरैः तीक्ष्णैर् विभिंद्याम् हि महीतलम्
काम रूपिणम् उन्मत्ते पश्य माम् कामदम् पतिम्
transliteration: arkam tuṃdyām śaraiḥ tīkṣṇair vibhiṃdyām hi mahītalam
kāma rūpiṇam unmatte paśya mām kāmadam patim
english: With my sharpened shafts I can pierce the Sun and cut asunder the earth. You are mad with your beauty. Do you look upon me, who am capable of illusions.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तवतः तस्य रावणस्य शिखि प्रभे
क्रुद्धस्य हरि पर्यन्ते रक्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः
transliteration: evam uktavataḥ tasya rāvaṇasya śikhi prabhe
kruddhasya hari paryante rakte netre babhūvatuḥ
english: When he had spoken thus, his yellow eyes became blood-red with rage and assumed the, semblance of flaming fire.

sanskrit: सद्यः सौम्यम् परित्यज्य तीक्ष्ण रूपम् स रावणः
स्वम् रूपम् काल रूप आभम् भेजे वैश्रवण अनुजः
transliteration: sadyaḥ saumyam parityajya tīkṣṇa rūpam sa rāvaṇaḥ
svam rūpam kāla rūpa ābham bheje vaiśravaṇa anujaḥ
english: Thereat Răvana, the younger brother of the Lord of wealth, changing his placid countenance, instantly assumed his own terrible shape resembling that of Yama.

sanskrit: संरक्त नयनः श्रीमान् तप्त कांचन भूषणः
क्रोधेन महता आविष्टो नील जीमूत सन्निभः
transliteration: saṃrakta nayanaḥ śrīmān tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇaḥ
krodhena mahatā āviṣṭo nīla jīmūta sannibhaḥ
english: Highly exercised with ire, that ranger of the night became of ten countenances and twenty arms; his eyes were bloody and he appeared beautiful like to blue clouds, being dressed in gold-hued apparel.

sanskrit: दश आस्यो विंशति भुजो बभूव क्षणदा चरः
स परिव्राजक च्छद्म महाकायो विहाय तत्
transliteration: daśa āsyo viṃśati bhujo babhūva kṣaṇadā caraḥ
sa parivrājaka cchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat
english: Highly exercised with ire, that ranger of the night became of ten countenances and twenty arms; his eyes were bloody and he appeared beautiful like to blue clouds, being dressed in gold-hued apparel.

sanskrit: प्रतिपेदे स्वकम् रूपम् रावणो राक्षस अधिपः
रक्त अंबर धरः तस्थौ स्त्री रत्नम् प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्
transliteration: pratipede svakam rūpam rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ
rakta aṃbara dharaḥ tasthau strī ratnam prekṣya maithilīm
english: Leaving aside the semblance of a mendicant, that lord of Raksasas, Ravana, increasing in bulk, assumed his own shape. And wearing a blood-red cloth he stood there fixing his look upon that jewel of a damsel–Maithili.

sanskrit: स ताम् असित केश अन्ताम् भास्करस्य प्रभाम् इव
वसन आभरण उपेताम् मैथिलीम् रावणो अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa tām asita keśa antām bhāskarasya prabhām iva
vasana ābharaṇa upetām maithilīm rāvaṇo abravīt
english: Thereupon Rāvaņa spake to Mathili like to the rays of the sun, having a head of black hair and wearing apparel and ornaments, saying, O you fine damsel, if you did wish to have a husband known all over the world, do you surrender yourself to me.

sanskrit: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातम् यदि भर्तारम् इच्छसि
माम् आश्रय वरारोहे तव अहम् सदृशः पतिः
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātam yadi bhartāram icchasi
mām āśraya varārohe tava aham sadṛśaḥ patiḥ
english: Thereupon Rāvaņa spake to Mathili like to the rays of the sun, having a head of black hair and wearing apparel and ornaments, saying, O you fine damsel, if you did wish to have a husband known all over the world, do you surrender yourself to me.

sanskrit: माम् भजस्व चिराय त्वम् अहम् श्लाघ्यः पतिः तव
न एव च अहम् क्वचित् भद्रे करिष्ये तव विप्रियम्
transliteration: mām bhajasva cirāya tvam aham ślāghyaḥ patiḥ tava
na eva ca aham kvacit bhadre kariṣye tava vipriyam
english: I am a worthy husband for you. Do you serve me for ever, your praiseworthy husband. O fine lady, I hall never do what you did not like.

sanskrit: त्यज्यताम् मानुषो भावो मयि भावः प्रणीयताम्
राज्यात् च्युतम् असिद्ध अर्थम् रामम् परिमित आयुषम्
transliteration: tyajyatām mānuṣo bhāvo mayi bhāvaḥ praṇīyatām
rājyāt cyutam asiddha artham rāmam parimita āyuṣam

sanskrit: कैः गुणैः अनुरक्ता असि मूढे पण्डित मानिनि
यः स्त्रिया वचनात् राज्यम् विहाय ससुहृत् जनम्
transliteration: kaiḥ guṇaiḥ anuraktā asi mūḍhe paṇḍita mānini
yaḥ striyā vacanāt rājyam vihāya sasuhṛt janam

sanskrit: अस्मिन् व्याल अनुचरिते वने वसति दुर्मतिः
इति उक्त्वा मैथिलीम् वाक्यम् प्रिय अर्हाम् प्रिय वादिनीम्
transliteration: asmin vyāla anucarite vane vasati durmatiḥ
iti uktvā maithilīm vākyam priya arhām priya vādinīm

sanskrit: अभिगम्य सुदुष्ट आत्मा राक्षसः काम मोहितः
जग्राह रावणः सीताम् बुधः खे रोहिणीम् इव
transliteration: abhigamya suduṣṭa ātmā rākṣasaḥ kāma mohitaḥ
jagrāha rāvaṇaḥ sītām budhaḥ khe rohiṇīm iva
english: Speaking thus to Maithili, sweet-speeched and worthy of being sweetly addressed, that highly wicked Raksasa, Rāvaņa, being exercised with lust, approached towards Sītā and got hold of her, like to Budha holding Rohinī in the sky.

sanskrit: वामेन सीताम् पद्माक्षीम् मूर्धजेषु करेण सः
ऊर्वोः तु दक्षिणेन एव परिजग्राह पाणिना
transliteration: vāmena sītām padmākṣīm mūrdhajeṣu kareṇa saḥ
ūrvoḥ tu dakṣiṇena eva parijagrāha pāṇinā
english: With his left hand he held her, having eyes like to lotus-petals, by the hair, and with his right hand got hold of her thighs.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा गिरि शृंग आभम् तीक्ष्ण दंष्ट्रम् महा भुजम्
प्राद्रवन् मृत्यु संकाशम् भय आर्ता वन देवताः
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā giri śṛṃga ābham tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭram mahā bhujam
prādravan mṛtyu saṃkāśam bhaya ārtā vana devatāḥ
english: Seeing Rāvaņa of sharpened teeth, and mighty arms, resembling the summit of a mountain and like to death itself, the deities of the forest became highly terrified and fled in different directions.

sanskrit: स च मायामयो दिव्यः खर युक्तः खर स्वनः
transliteration: sa ca māyāmayo divyaḥ khara yuktaḥ khara svanaḥ
english: Instantly appeared there the celestial car of Ravana, decked in gold, drawn by asses and making a terrible sound.

sanskrit: ततः ताम् परुषैः वाक्यैः अभितर्ज्य महास्वनः
अंकेन आदाय वैदेहीम् रथम् आरोपयत् तदा
transliteration: tataḥ tām paruṣaiḥ vākyaiḥ abhitarjya mahāsvanaḥ
aṃkena ādāya vaidehīm ratham āropayat tadā
english: Thereupon, that one emmiting terrible accents, remonstrated with Vaidehī in harsh words and clasping her ascended the car.

sanskrit: रामा इति सीता दुःख आर्ता रामम् दूरम् गतम् वने
transliteration: rāmā iti sītā duḥkha ārtā rāmam dūram gatam vane
english: The virtuous Sīta, being thus caught by Ravana, began to cry aloud, addressing Rama, who had gone away to a distant forest.

sanskrit: ताम् अकामाम् स काम आर्तः पन्नग इन्द्र वधूम् इव
transliteration: tām akāmām sa kāma ārtaḥ pannaga indra vadhūm iva
english: Rāvaņa, racked with lust, rose high up with her like to the wife of a Pannaga, though she tried her best (to get rid of him), for she was not in the least attached to him.

sanskrit: भृशम् चुक्रोश मत्ता इव भ्रांत चित्ता यथा आतुरा
transliteration: bhṛśam cukrośa mattā iva bhrāṃta cittā yathā āturā
english: Being thus carried away by the ethereal track by that Lord of Rākṣasas, Sītā began to cry aloud, like one mad, distressed and of deranged senses.

sanskrit: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो गुरु चित्त प्रसादक
ह्रियमाणाम् न जानीषे रक्षसा काम रूपिणा
transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho guru citta prasādaka
hriyamāṇām na jānīṣe rakṣasā kāma rūpiṇā
english: Ah! mighty Laksmana, ever ministering to the satisfaction of your superiors, do you not know that I have been stolen away by a Rākṣasa assuming shapes at will?

sanskrit: जीवितम् सुखम् अर्थाम् च धर्म हेतोः परित्यजन्
ह्रियमाणाम् अधर्मेण माम् राघव न पश्यसि
transliteration: jīvitam sukham arthām ca dharma hetoḥ parityajan
hriyamāṇām adharmeṇa mām rāghava na paśyasi
english: O Rāghava, for virtue have you renounced your life, happiness and wealth,-do you not see that I have been carried away by one of mighty iniquity?

sanskrit: ननु नाम अविनीतानाम् विनेता असि परंतप
कथम् एवम् विधम् पापम् न त्वम् शास्सि हि रावणम्
transliteration: nanu nāma avinītānām vinetā asi paraṃtapa
katham evam vidham pāpam na tvam śāssi hi rāvaṇam
english: O you the subduer of foes, you did always control the rebellious,-why do you not punish such a vicious Rākşasa?

sanskrit: ननु सद्यो अविनीतस्य दृश्यते कर्मणः फलम्
कालो अपि अंगी भवति अत्र सस्यानाम् इव पक्तये
transliteration: nanu sadyo avinītasya dṛśyate karmaṇaḥ phalam
kālo api aṃgī bhavati atra sasyānām iva paktaye
english: The vicious do not instantaneously meet with the fruits of their actions, as for corn to ripen requires the assistance of time.

sanskrit: त्वम् कर्म कृतवान् एतत् काल उपहत चेतनः
जीवित अंतकरम् घोरम् रामात् व्यसनम् आप्नुहि
transliteration: tvam karma kṛtavān etat kāla upahata cetanaḥ
jīvita aṃtakaram ghoram rāmāt vyasanam āpnuhi
english: For this iniquitous deed, which you have perpetrated, availing of the time and losing your sense, you shall meet with a mighty disaster from Rāma, bringing about your end.

sanskrit: हन्त इदानीम् सकामा तु कैकेयी बान्धवैः सह
ह्रियेयम् धर्म कामस्य धर्म पत्नी यशस्विनः
transliteration: hanta idānīm sakāmā tu kaikeyī bāndhavaiḥ saha
hriyeyam dharma kāmasya dharma patnī yaśasvinaḥ
english: Ah! being the virtuous wife of the virtuous and far-famed Rāma, I have been stolen away. Now has the desire of Kaikeyi and other relations been fulfilled.

sanskrit: क्षिप्रम् रामाय शंसध्वम् सीताम् हरति रावणः
transliteration: kṣipram rāmāya śaṃsadhvam sītām harati rāvaṇaḥ
english: I invoke this Janasthāna and these flowery Karnikās to tell Rāma that Rāvana has stolen away Sītā.

sanskrit: हंस सारस संघुष्टाम् वन्दे गोदावरीम् नदीम्
क्षिप्रम् रामाय शंस त्वम् सीताम् हरति रावणः
transliteration: haṃsa sārasa saṃghuṣṭām vande godāvarīm nadīm
kṣipram rāmāya śaṃsa tvam sītām harati rāvaṇaḥ
english: I invoke you, O Godāvarī, having swans and cranes sporting in your stream, to tell Ráma that Rāvana has stolen away Sītã.

sanskrit: दैवतानि च यान्ति अस्मिन् वने विविध पादपे
नमस्करोमि अहम् तेभ्यो भर्तुः शंसत माम् हृताम्
transliteration: daivatāni ca yānti asmin vane vividha pādape
namaskaromi aham tebhyo bhartuḥ śaṃsata mām hṛtām
english: I salute and invoke the deities that live in this forest of many trees to tell my husband of my being stolen away (by Ravana).

sanskrit: यानि कानिचित् अपि अत्र सत्त्वानि निवसन्ति उत
सर्वाणि शरणम् यामि मृग पक्षि गणान् अपि
transliteration: yāni kānicit api atra sattvāni nivasanti uta
sarvāṇi śaraṇam yāmi mṛga pakṣi gaṇān api

sanskrit: ह्रियमाणाम् प्रियाम् भर्तुः प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम्
विवश अपहृता सीता रावणेन इति शंसत
transliteration: hriyamāṇām priyām bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm
vivaśa apahṛtā sītā rāvaṇena iti śaṃsata
english: I do seek the refuge of all deer, birds and other animals that live in this forest, and may they all cominunicate to Rāma the news of his dear spouse being carried away, and tell him that Sītā, losing her control, has been stolen away by Rāvana.

sanskrit: विदित्वा माम् महाबाहुः अमुत्र अपि महाबलः
transliteration: viditvā mām mahābāhuḥ amutra api mahābalaḥ
english: Even if I am taken away by Yama, and if the mighty-armed Rāma is apprised of it, surely shall he bring me back by the display of his prowess.

sanskrit: सा तदा करुणा वाचो विलपंती सुदुःखिता
वनस्पति गतम् ग्रिध्रम् ददर्श आयत लोचना
transliteration: sā tadā karuṇā vāco vilapaṃtī suduḥkhitā
vanaspati gatam gridhram dadarśa āyata locanā
english: Racked with sorrow that one of expansive eyes, while thus bewailing in piteous accents, she espied Jațāyu, the king of vultures, seated on a tree.

sanskrit: सा तम् उद् वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणी रावणस्य वशम् गता
transliteration: sā tam ud vīkṣya suśroṇī rāvaṇasya vaśam gatā
english: Thereat the daughter of Janaka, brought under the control of Rāvana and terrified, began to cry and utter those piteous words.

sanskrit: जटायो पश्य मम आर्य ह्रियमाणम् अनाथ वत्
transliteration: jaṭāyo paśya mama ārya hriyamāṇam anātha vat
english: O worshipful Jațāyu, do you see that this vicious lord of Rākşasas has ruthlessly carried me away like one having no husband.

sanskrit: न एष वारयितुम् शक्यः त्वया क्रूरो निशाचर
सत्त्ववान् जितकाशी च स आयुधः चैव दुर्मतिः
transliteration: na eṣa vārayitum śakyaḥ tvayā krūro niśācara
sattvavān jitakāśī ca sa āyudhaḥ caiva durmatiḥ
english: You will not be able to withstand this mighty, wicked and cruel night-ranger wearing emblems of conquest and having a scimitar in his hand!

sanskrit: रामाय तु यथा तत्त्वम् जटायो हरणम् मम
लक्ष्मणाय च तत् सर्वम् आख्यातव्यम् अशेषतः
transliteration: rāmāya tu yathā tattvam jaṭāyo haraṇam mama
lakṣmaṇāya ca tat sarvam ākhyātavyam aśeṣataḥ
english: Do you relate to Rāma and to Lakşmaņa everything about my being carried away from the beginning to the end.

sanskrit: तम् शब्दम् अवसुप्तस्य जटायुः अथ शुश्रुवे
निरैक्षत् रावणम् क्षिप्रम् वैदेहीम् च ददर्श सः
transliteration: tam śabdam avasuptasya jaṭāyuḥ atha śuśruve
niraikṣat rāvaṇam kṣipram vaidehīm ca dadarśa saḥ
english: Hearing these words Jațāyu, who lay buried in a deep slumber, awoke and beheld both Rāvana and Janaki.

sanskrit: ततः पर्वत शृंग आभः तीक्ष्ण तुण्डः खग उत्तमः
वनस्पति गतः श्रीमान् व्याजहार शुभाम् गिरम्
transliteration: tataḥ parvata śṛṃga ābhaḥ tīkṣṇa tuṇḍaḥ khaga uttamaḥ
vanaspati gataḥ śrīmān vyājahāra śubhām giram
english: There-at the lord of birds resting on the tree, having a big sharp beak like to the summit of a hill, addressed these soft words to Rāvana,

sanskrit: दशग्रीव स्थितो धर्मे पुराणे सत्य संश्रयः
भ्रातः सः त्वम् निन्दितम् कर्म कर्तुम् न अर्हसि संप्रताम्
transliteration: daśagrīva sthito dharme purāṇe satya saṃśrayaḥ
bhrātaḥ saḥ tvam ninditam karma kartum na arhasi saṃpratām
english: O brother Ten-necked one, I am conversant with Purāņas, of truthful vows and abide by religion. It does not behove you to perpetrate such an iniquitous deed before me. I am Jātayu, the mighty lord of vultures.

sanskrit: जटायुः नाम नाम्ना अहम् गृध्र राजो महाबलः
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य महेन्द्र वरुण उपमः
transliteration: jaṭāyuḥ nāma nāmnā aham gṛdhra rājo mahābalaḥ
rājā sarvasya lokasya mahendra varuṇa upamaḥ

sanskrit: लोकानाम् च हिते युक्तो रामो दशरथ आत्मजः
तस्य एषा लोक नाथस्य धर्म पत्नी यशस्विनी
transliteration: lokānām ca hite yukto rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ
tasya eṣā loka nāthasya dharma patnī yaśasvinī

sanskrit: सीता नाम वरारोहा याम् त्वम् हर्तुम् इह इच्छसि
कथम् राजा स्थितो धर्मे पर दारान् परामृशेत्
transliteration: sītā nāma varārohā yām tvam hartum iha icchasi
katham rājā sthito dharme para dārān parāmṛśet

sanskrit: निवर्तय गतिम् नीचाम् पर दार अभिमर्शनात्
transliteration: nivartaya gatim nīcām para dāra abhimarśanāt

sanskrit: न तत् समाचरेत् धीरो यत् परो अस्य विगर्हयेत्
यथा आत्मनः तथा अन्येषाम् दारा रक्ष्या विमर्शनात्
transliteration: na tat samācaret dhīro yat paro asya vigarhayet
yathā ātmanaḥ tathā anyeṣām dārā rakṣyā vimarśanāt
english: How do you yourself being a monarch and engaged in the royal office of maintaining subjects, carry away by stealth another's wife? O you of mighty prowess, you should specially protect the wives of kings. Do you therefore control your base inclination of oppressing another's wife. A hero does never perform what bring calumny upon himself. It becometh every individual to save another's wife from the touch of a second man like to his own wife.

sanskrit: अर्थम् वा यदि वा कामम् शिष्टाः शास्त्रेषु अनागतम्
व्यवस्यन्ति अनु राजानम् धर्मम् पौलस्त्य नंदन
transliteration: artham vā yadi vā kāmam śiṣṭāḥ śāstreṣu anāgatam
vyavasyanti anu rājānam dharmam paulastya naṃdana
english: O son of Paulastya, at the instance of the king mild subjects perform many an action conducing to virtue, wealth and desire, though not mentioned in the Šāstras.

sanskrit: राजा धर्मः च कामः च द्रव्याणाम् च उत्तमो निधिः
धर्मः शुभम् वा पापम् वा राज मूलम् प्रवर्तते
transliteration: rājā dharmaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca dravyāṇām ca uttamo nidhiḥ
dharmaḥ śubham vā pāpam vā rāja mūlam pravartate
english: The king is the virtue, the king is the desire and the king is the prime jewel of all subjects. Virtue, desire or sin-every thing ariseth from the king.

sanskrit: पाप स्वभावः चपलः कथम् त्वम् रक्षसाम् वर
transliteration: pāpa svabhāvaḥ capalaḥ katham tvam rakṣasām vara
english: O you the best of Rākṣasas, you are vicious and unsteady; how have you come by riches like to a sinner attaining to the abode of celestials?

sanskrit: काम स्वभावो यः सः असौ न शक्यः तम् प्रमार्जितुम्
न हि दुष्ट आत्मनाम् आर्यम् आवसति आलये चिरम्
transliteration: kāma svabhāvo yaḥ saḥ asau na śakyaḥ tam pramārjitum
na hi duṣṭa ātmanām āryam āvasati ālaye ciram
