english: A vicious person can never relinquish his sinful habits—virtue does never reside in the abodes of impious persons.

sanskrit: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा रामो महाबलः
न अपराध्यति धर्मात्मा कथम् तस्य अपराध्यसि
transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā rāmo mahābalaḥ
na aparādhyati dharmātmā katham tasya aparādhyasi
english: The mighty and the virtuous-souled Rāma has committed nothing wrong in your city or your dominions. Why do you then commit wrong by him?

sanskrit: यदि शूर्पणखा हेतोः जनस्थान गतः खरः
अतिवृत्तो हतः पूर्वम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhā hetoḥ janasthāna gataḥ kharaḥ
ativṛtto hataḥ pūrvam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa karmaṇā
english: Khara of Janasthāna is highly wicked and if Rāma of blameless actions has killed him on Surpanakha's account how is he to blame? Why do you then carry away the wife of that lord of men?

sanskrit: अत्र ब्रूहि यथा तत्त्वम् को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः
यस्य त्वम् लोक नाथस्य हृत्वा भार्याम् गमिष्यसि
transliteration: atra brūhi yathā tattvam ko rāmasya vyatikramaḥ
yasya tvam loka nāthasya hṛtvā bhāryām gamiṣyasi
english: Khara of Janasthāna is highly wicked and if Rāma of blameless actions has killed him on Surpanakha's account how is he to blame? Why do you then carry away the wife of that lord of men?

sanskrit: क्षिप्रम् विसृज वैदेहीम् मा त्वा घोरेण चक्षुषा
दहेत् दहनभूतेन वृत्रम् इन्द्र अशनिः यथा
transliteration: kṣipram visṛja vaidehīm mā tvā ghoreṇa cakṣuṣā
dahet dahanabhūtena vṛtram indra aśaniḥ yathā
english: Do you soon leave off Vaidehī. Like to Indra burning down Vịtrāsura, Rāma, looking with his terrible eyes like flaming fire, shall reduce you to ashes.

sanskrit: सर्पम् आशीविषम् बद्ध्वा वस्त्र अन्ते न अवबुध्यसे
ग्रीवायाम् प्रतिमुक्तम् च काल पाशम् न पश्यसि
transliteration: sarpam āśīviṣam baddhvā vastra ante na avabudhyase
grīvāyām pratimuktam ca kāla pāśam na paśyasi
english: Do you not understand that you have tied with cloth a virulent serpent? Do you not see that you have placed around your neck the noose of death?

sanskrit: स भारः सौम्य भर्तव्यो यो नरम् न अवसादयेत्
तत् अन्नम् अपि भोक्तव्यम् जीर्यते यत् अनामयम्
transliteration: sa bhāraḥ saumya bhartavyo yo naram na avasādayet
tat annam api bhoktavyam jīryate yat anāmayam
english: It is always proper to carry such a weight as does not exhaust (him who carries); it is always proper to take such a food as does not cause illness.

sanskrit: यत् कृत्वा न भवेत् धर्मो न कीर्तिः न यशः ध्रुवम्
शरीरस्य भवेत् खेदः कः तत् कर्म समाचरेत्
transliteration: yat kṛtvā na bhavet dharmo na kīrtiḥ na yaśaḥ dhruvam
śarīrasya bhavet khedaḥ kaḥ tat karma samācaret
english: Who engageth himself in such an action as does not confer virtue, fame or glory, but bring about physical affliction only?

sanskrit: षष्टि वर्ष सहस्राणि जातस्य मम रावण
transliteration: ṣaṣṭi varṣa sahasrāṇi jātasya mama rāvaṇa
english: O Rāvana, I am sixty thousand years old and have been administering regularly my ancestral kingdom.

sanskrit: वृद्धो अहम् त्वम् युवा धन्वी स रथः कवची शरी
न च अपि आदाय कुशली वैदेहीम् न गमिष्यसि
transliteration: vṛddho aham tvam yuvā dhanvī sa rathaḥ kavacī śarī
na ca api ādāya kuśalī vaidehīm na gamiṣyasi
english: Old though I am, you shall not be able to carry away with safety Jānakī in my presence, young, accoutred in mails as you are with bow and arrows in your hands and ascending a car.

sanskrit: न शक्तः त्वम् बलात् हर्तुम् वैदेहीम् मम पश्यतः
हेतुभिः न्याय संयुक्तैः ध्रुवाम् वेद श्रुतीम् इव
transliteration: na śaktaḥ tvam balāt hartum vaidehīm mama paśyataḥ
hetubhiḥ nyāya saṃyuktaiḥ dhruvām veda śrutīm iva
english: As it is not easy to destroy, by the reasonings of Logic, Vedas and Śrutis containing eternal and immutable truths, so you shall not be able to carry away Vaidehi by force before me.

sanskrit: युध्यस्व यदि शूरो असि मुहूर्तम् तिष्ठ रावण
शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा पूर्वम् खरः तथा
transliteration: yudhyasva yadi śūro asi muhūrtam tiṣṭha rāvaṇa
śayiṣyase hato bhūmau yathā pūrvam kharaḥ tathā
english: If you are a hero do you fight. Or do you wait for a moment, O Rāvana, you shall also embrace the earth like to Khara.

sanskrit: असकृत् संयुगे येन निहता दैत्य दानवाः
न चिरात् चीर वासाः त्वाम् रामो युधि वधिष्यति
transliteration: asakṛt saṃyuge yena nihatā daitya dānavāḥ
na cirāt cīra vāsāḥ tvām rāmo yudhi vadhiṣyati
english: Soon shall Rāma clad in bark destroy you in the battle field, who had many a time and oft destroyed in conflict the celestials and Dānavas.

sanskrit: किम् नु शक्यम् मया कर्तुम् गतौ दूरम् नृप आत्मजौ
क्षिप्रम् त्वम् नश्यसे नीच तयोः भीतो न संशयः
transliteration: kim nu śakyam mayā kartum gatau dūram nṛpa ātmajau
kṣipram tvam naśyase nīca tayoḥ bhīto na saṃśayaḥ
english: These two princes Rāma and Lakşmaņa are at a distance, what shall I do now? O vile being, undoubtedly shall you, terrified, be destroyed by thein.

sanskrit: न हि मे जीवमानस्य नयिष्यसि शुभाम् इमाम्
सीताम् कमल पत्र अक्षीम् रामस्य महषीम् प्रियाम्
transliteration: na hi me jīvamānasya nayiṣyasi śubhām imām
sītām kamala patra akṣīm rāmasya mahaṣīm priyām
english: Myself drawing my breath you shall not be able to carry away this beloved queen of Rāma, the pure-natured Sitä having eyes resembling lotuses.

sanskrit: अवश्यम् तु मया कार्यम् प्रियम् तस्य महात्मनः
जीवितेन अपि रामस्य तथा दशरथस्य च
transliteration: avaśyam tu mayā kāryam priyam tasya mahātmanaḥ
jīvitena api rāmasya tathā daśarathasya ca
english: It is my duty to do good to the high-souled Rāma and Dasaratha even at the sacrifice of my life.

sanskrit: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ दशग्रीव मुहूर्तम् पश्य रावण
वृन्तात् इव फलम् त्वाम् तु पातयेयम् रथ उत्तमात्
युद्ध आतिथ्यम् प्रदास्यामि यथा प्राणम् निशा चर
transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha daśagrīva muhūrtam paśya rāvaṇa
vṛntāt iva phalam tvām tu pātayeyam ratha uttamāt
yuddha ātithyam pradāsyāmi yathā prāṇam niśā cara
english: Do you stand, O ten-necked one. Behold for a moment. O Ravana, I shall throw you headlong from this car, like to a fruit from its stalk. O ranger of the night, even to my utmost might I will render you hospitality in encounter.

sanskrit: इति उक्तः क्रोध ताम्राक्षः तप्त कांचन कुण्डलः
transliteration: iti uktaḥ krodha tāmrākṣaḥ tapta kāṃcana kuṇḍalaḥ
english: While Jatayu, the king of birds, spake this, Rāvana, the lord of Rākşasas, wearing pendants made of pure gold, having his eyes reddened with ire, darted towards him.

sanskrit: स संप्रहारः तुमुलः तयोः तस्मिन् महा मृधे
बभूव वात उद्धतयोः मेघयोः गगने यथा
transliteration: sa saṃprahāraḥ tumulaḥ tayoḥ tasmin mahā mṛdhe
babhūva vāta uddhatayoḥ meghayoḥ gagane yathā
english: Thereupon they began a terrible conflict in the welkin, like to clouds driven by wind.

sanskrit: तत् बभूव अद्भुतम् युद्धम् गृध्र राक्षसयोः तदा
transliteration: tat babhūva adbhutam yuddham gṛdhra rākṣasayoḥ tadā
english: There occurred a mighty conflict between Jatayu, the lord of vultures, and Ravana, the lord of Raksasas, like to two Malyavān* hills supplies with wings. A mountainous range described as one of the smaller mountains of India proper, lying eastward of mount Meru.—

sanskrit: ततो नालीक नाराचैः तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः च विकर्णिभिः
transliteration: tato nālīka nārācaiḥ tīkṣṇa agraiḥ ca vikarṇibhiḥ
english: Thereat Răvaņa began to shower continually terrible and sharpened pikes, iron arrows and Vikarnis upon the mighty lord of vultures.

sanskrit: स तानि शर जालानि गृध्रः पत्ररथ ईश्वरः
transliteration: sa tāni śara jālāni gṛdhraḥ patraratha īśvaraḥ
english: Jatayu, the king of birds, began to withstand in conflict the arrows and weapons darted by Rāvana, and wounded Rāvana's person with his feet supplies with sharpened talons.

sanskrit: तस्य तीक्ष्ण नखाभ्याम् तु चरणाभ्याम् महाबलः
चकार बहुधा गात्रे व्रणान् पतग सत्तमः
transliteration: tasya tīkṣṇa nakhābhyām tu caraṇābhyām mahābalaḥ
cakāra bahudhā gātre vraṇān pataga sattamaḥ
english: Jatayu, the king of birds, began to withstand in conflict the arrows and weapons darted by Rāvana, and wounded Rāvana's person with his feet supplies with sharpened talons.

sanskrit: अथ क्रोधात् दशग्रीवः जग्राह दश मार्गणान्
मृत्यु दण्ड निभान् घोरान् शत्रोर् निधन कान्क्षया
transliteration: atha krodhāt daśagrīvaḥ jagrāha daśa mārgaṇān
mṛtyu daṇḍa nibhān ghorān śatror nidhana kānkṣayā
english: Thereupon, to destroy his enemy, that mighty hero, the Ten-necked Ravana, being exercised with ire, took up ten terrible arrows like to the sceptre of Death, and stretching the bow to the full he shot those straight-coursing sharpened shafts at Jatayu, the king of birds.

sanskrit: स तैः बाणैः महावीर्यः पूर्ण मुक्तैः अजिह्म गैः
बिभेद निशितैः तीक्ष्णैः गृध्रम् घोरैः शिली मुखैः
transliteration: sa taiḥ bāṇaiḥ mahāvīryaḥ pūrṇa muktaiḥ ajihma gaiḥ
bibheda niśitaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ gṛdhram ghoraiḥ śilī mukhaiḥ
english: Thereupon, to destroy his enemy, that mighty hero, the Ten-necked Ravana, being exercised with ire, took up ten terrible arrows like to the sceptre of Death, and stretching the bow to the full he shot those straight-coursing sharpened shafts at Jatayu, the king of birds.

sanskrit: स राक्षस रथे पश्यन् जानकीम् बाष्प लोचनाम्
transliteration: sa rākṣasa rathe paśyan jānakīm bāṣpa locanām
english: Beholding Jānaki with tears in her eyes in that Raksasa's car, Jatayu, the king of birds, disregarding those arrows, darted towards Rāvana, and with his feet broke asunder his bow with the arrows, adorned with pearls and diamonds.

sanskrit: ततो अस्य सशरम् चापम् मुक्ता मणि विभूषितम्
transliteration: tato asya saśaram cāpam muktā maṇi vibhūṣitam
english: Beholding Jānaki with tears in her eyes in that Raksasa's car, Jatayu, the king of birds, disregarding those arrows, darted towards Rāvana, and with his feet broke asunder his bow with the arrows, adorned with pearls and diamonds.

sanskrit: ततो अन्यत् धनुः आदाय रावणः क्रोध मूर्च्छितः
ववर्ष शर वर्षाणि शतशो अथ सहस्रशः
transliteration: tato anyat dhanuḥ ādāya rāvaṇaḥ krodha mūrcchitaḥ
vavarṣa śara varṣāṇi śataśo atha sahasraśaḥ
english: Thereat Rävana, almost beside himself with wrath, taking up another bow, began to shower arrows by hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit: कुलायम् अभिसंप्राप्तः पक्षिः इव बभौ तदा
transliteration: kulāyam abhisaṃprāptaḥ pakṣiḥ iva babhau tadā
english: Being covered with those arrows, the lord of birds appeared like a bird lying in his nest.

sanskrit: स तानि शर जालानि पक्षाभ्याम् तु विधूय ह
चरणाभ्याम् महातेजा बभंज अस्य महत् धनुः
transliteration: sa tāni śara jālāni pakṣābhyām tu vidhūya ha
caraṇābhyām mahātejā babhaṃja asya mahat dhanuḥ
english: Pushing away these arrows by the wind of his wings, he again snapped that mighty bow with his feet, and with a stroke of his wings shattered Rāvaņa's flaming shield like to burning fire.

sanskrit: तत् च अग्नि सदृशम् दीप्तम् रावणस्य शरावरम्
transliteration: tat ca agni sadṛśam dīptam rāvaṇasya śarāvaram
english: Pushing away these arrows by the wind of his wings, he again snapped that mighty bow with his feet, and with a stroke of his wings shattered Rāvaņa's flaming shield like to burning fire.

sanskrit: कांचन उरः छदान् दिव्यान् पिशाच वदनान् खरान्
तान् च अस्य जव संपन्नान् जघान समरे बली
transliteration: kāṃcana uraḥ chadān divyān piśāca vadanān kharān
tān ca asya java saṃpannān jaghāna samare balī
english: Thereupon moving away with the wind of his wings Rāvana's blazing cuirass resembling flaming fire, Jațāyu in that conflict made away with his fleet-coursing asses having the faces of demons.

sanskrit: अथ त्रिवेणु संपन्नम् कामगम् पावक अर्चिषम्
मणि सोपान चित्र अंगम् बभंज च महारथम्
transliteration: atha triveṇu saṃpannam kāmagam pāvaka arciṣam
maṇi sopāna citra aṃgam babhaṃja ca mahāratham

sanskrit: पूर्ण चन्द्र प्रतीकाशम् छत्रम् च व्यजनैः सह
transliteration: pūrṇa candra pratīkāśam chatram ca vyajanaiḥ saha

sanskrit: सारथेः च अस्य वेगेन तुण्डेन च महत् शिरः
transliteration: sāratheḥ ca asya vegena tuṇḍena ca mahat śiraḥ

sanskrit: स भग्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः
अंकेन आदाय वैदेहीम् पपात भुवि रावणः
transliteration: sa bhagna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ
aṃkena ādāya vaidehīm papāta bhuvi rāvaṇaḥ
english: Having his bow snapped and deprived of his car, horses and charioteer, Rāvana fell down to the earth, taking Vaidehi on his lap.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा निपतितम् भूमौ रावणम् भग्न वाहनम्
साधु साधु इति भूतानि गृध्र राजम् अपूजयन्
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nipatitam bhūmau rāvaṇam bhagna vāhanam
sādhu sādhu iti bhūtāni gṛdhra rājam apūjayan
english: Beholding Rāvaņa fallen on the ground and of broken conveyance, all creatures praised the king of vultures again and again and worshipped him.

sanskrit: परिश्रान्तम् तु तम् दृष्ट्वा जरया पक्षि यूथपम्
उत्पपात पुनर् हृष्टो मैथिलीम् गृह्य रावणः
transliteration: pariśrāntam tu tam dṛṣṭvā jarayā pakṣi yūthapam
utpapāta punar hṛṣṭo maithilīm gṛhya rāvaṇaḥ
english: Thereupon, finding the lord of birds worn out on account of his old age, Ravana, highly encouraged, again rose high up in the welkin, taking Maithill with him.

sanskrit: तम् प्रहृष्टम् निधाय अंके रावणम् जनक आत्मजाम्
गच्छंतम् खड्ग शेषम् च प्रणष्ट हत साधनम्
transliteration: tam prahṛṣṭam nidhāya aṃke rāvaṇam janaka ātmajām
gacchaṃtam khaḍga śeṣam ca praṇaṣṭa hata sādhanam
english: He had all his weapons broken in the conflict, and had but his dagger left to him. beholding him proceed thus pleased, taking the daughter of Janaka on his lap, all his weapons having been lost, with his sword alone left, the mighty and powerful lord of vultures, Jațāyu, rose up and, darting towards Rāvana, resisted him and said,

He had all his weapons broken in the conflict, and had but his dagger left to him. beholding him proceed thus pleased, taking the daughter of Janaka on his lap, all his weapons having been lost, with his sword alone left, the mighty and powerful lord of vultures, Jațāyu, rose up and, darting towards Rāvana, resisted him and said,

sanskrit: वर्ज संस्पर्श बाणस्य भार्याम् रामस्य रावण
अल्प बुद्धे हरसि एनाम् वधाय खलु रक्षसाम्
transliteration: varja saṃsparśa bāṇasya bhāryām rāmasya rāvaṇa
alpa buddhe harasi enām vadhāya khalu rakṣasām
english: O Rāvana of feeble sense, it is for the destruction of the whole line of Rākşasas that you carries away this spouse of Răma, having arrows like to thunderbolts.

sanskrit: स मित्र बन्धुः स अमात्यः स बलः स परिच्छदः
विष पानम् पिबसि एतत् पिपासित इव उदकम्
transliteration: sa mitra bandhuḥ sa amātyaḥ sa balaḥ sa paricchadaḥ
viṣa pānam pibasi etat pipāsita iva udakam
english: Like one thirsty drinking water, you do address yourself to drinking poison along with your friends, courtiers, four-fold forces, servants and relatives.

sanskrit: शीघ्रम् एव विनश्यन्ति यथा त्वम् विनशिष्यसि
transliteration: śīghram eva vinaśyanti yathā tvam vinaśiṣyasi
english: Foolish persons unaware of the fruit of their actions, meet in a short time with their own destruction, so shall you very soon meet with your own end.

sanskrit: बद्धः त्वम् काल पाशेन क्व गतः तस्य मोक्ष्यसे
वधाय बडिशम् गृह्य स अमिषम् जलजो यथा
transliteration: baddhaḥ tvam kāla pāśena kva gataḥ tasya mokṣyase
vadhāya baḍiśam gṛhya sa amiṣam jalajo yathā
english: You have been bound up by the noose of Death; and, proceeding whither, shall you save yourself, like to fish eating up baits with hooks for their own destruction?

sanskrit: न हि जातु दुराधर्षौ काकुत्स्थौ तव रावण
धर्षणम् च आश्रमस्य अस्य क्षमिष्येते तु राघवौ
transliteration: na hi jātu durādharṣau kākutsthau tava rāvaṇa
dharṣaṇam ca āśramasya asya kṣamiṣyete tu rāghavau
english: O Rāvana, it is beyond your power to defeat the Kakutsthas. They shall not forgive you for this your encroachment upon their asylum.

sanskrit: यथा त्वया कृतम् कर्म भीरुणा लोक गर्हितम्
तस्कर आचरितो मार्गो न एष वीर निषेवितः
transliteration: yathā tvayā kṛtam karma bhīruṇā loka garhitam
taskara ācarito mārgo na eṣa vīra niṣevitaḥ
english: What have been perpetrated by you coward, is blamed by all, and is the way taken recourse to by thieves and not by heroes.

sanskrit: युध्यस्व यदि शूरो असि मुहूर्तम् तिष्ठ रावण
शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा भ्राता खरः तथा
transliteration: yudhyasva yadi śūro asi muhūrtam tiṣṭha rāvaṇa
śayiṣyase hato bhūmau yathā bhrātā kharaḥ tathā
english: Do you fight. O Ravana, if you are a hero, or wait for a moment and you shall lie down on the earth like to your brother Khara.

sanskrit: परेत काले पुरुषो यत् कर्म प्रतिपद्यते
विनाशाय आत्मनो अधर्म्यम् प्रतिपन्नो असि कर्म तत्
transliteration: pareta kāle puruṣo yat karma pratipadyate
vināśāya ātmano adharmyam pratipanno asi karma tat
english: Truly have you for your own destruction engaged yourself in these impious acts, which are perpetrated by men on the eve of their death.

sanskrit: पाप अनुबंधो वै यस्य कर्मणः को नु तत् पुमान्
कुर्वीत लोक अधिपतिः स्वयंभूः भगवान् अपि
transliteration: pāpa anubaṃdho vai yasya karmaṇaḥ ko nu tat pumān
kurvīta loka adhipatiḥ svayaṃbhūḥ bhagavān api
english: What person do that which lead solely into sin? neither the lord of celestials nor the selfcreate Deity do engage in such an action.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा शुभम् वाक्यम् जटायुः तस्य रक्षसः
transliteration: evam uktvā śubham vākyam jaṭāyuḥ tasya rakṣasaḥ

sanskrit: तम् गृहीत्वा नखैः तीक्ष्णैः विददार समंततः
अधिरूढो गज आरोहो यथा स्यात् दुष्ट वारणम्
transliteration: tam gṛhītvā nakhaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ vidadāra samaṃtataḥ
adhirūḍho gaja āroho yathā syāt duṣṭa vāraṇam

sanskrit: विददार नखैः अस्य तुण्डम् पृष्ठे समर्पयन्
केशान् च उत्पाटयामास नख पक्ष मुख आयुधः
transliteration: vidadāra nakhaiḥ asya tuṇḍam pṛṣṭhe samarpayan
keśān ca utpāṭayāmāsa nakha pakṣa mukha āyudhaḥ

sanskrit: स तथा गृध्र राजेन क्लिश्यमानो मुहुर् मुहुः
अमर्ष स्फुरित ओष्ठः सन् प्राकंपत स राक्षसः
transliteration: sa tathā gṛdhra rājena kliśyamāno muhur muhuḥ
amarṣa sphurita oṣṭhaḥ san prākaṃpata sa rākṣasaḥ
english: Being thus afflicted again and again by the king of vultures, the Răkşasa shook, with his lips quivering in anger.

sanskrit: तलेन अभिजघान आर्तो जटायुम् क्रोध मूर्चितः
transliteration: talena abhijaghāna ārto jaṭāyum krodha mūrcitaḥ
english: Beside himself with anger, Ravana, holding Jānaki fast by her left flank, struck Jațāyu with his palms.

sanskrit: जटायुः तम् अतिक्रम्य तुण्डेन अस्य खग अधिपः
वाम बाहून् दश तदा व्यपाहरत् अरिन्दमः
transliteration: jaṭāyuḥ tam atikramya tuṇḍena asya khaga adhipaḥ
vāma bāhūn daśa tadā vyapāharat arindamaḥ
english: Jatayu, the subduer of foes, bearing the strokes, tore into pieces his ten left arms with his beak.

sanskrit: संच्छिन्न बाहोः सद्यो वै बाहवः सहसा अभवन्
विष ज्वालावली युक्ता वल्मीकत् इव पन्नगाः
transliteration: saṃcchinna bāhoḥ sadyo vai bāhavaḥ sahasā abhavan
viṣa jvālāvalī yuktā valmīkat iva pannagāḥ
english: His arms cut off, instantly sprang up as many others, like to serpents issuing out of ant-hills, being exercised with the pangs of poison.

sanskrit: ततः क्रोद्धात् दशग्रीवः सीताम् उत्सृज्य वीर्यवान्
मुष्टिभ्याम् चरणाभ्याम् च गृध्र राजम् अपोथयत्
transliteration: tataḥ kroddhāt daśagrīvaḥ sītām utsṛjya vīryavān
muṣṭibhyām caraṇābhyām ca gṛdhra rājam apothayat
english: The mighty Ten-necked one, leaving aside Sitä, out of anger bore down Jațāyu with his fists and feet.

sanskrit: ततो मुहूर्तम् संग्रामो बभूव अतुल वीर्ययोः
राक्षसानाम् च मुख्यस्य पक्षिणाम् प्रवरस्य च
transliteration: tato muhūrtam saṃgrāmo babhūva atula vīryayoḥ
rākṣasānām ca mukhyasya pakṣiṇām pravarasya ca
english: Thereupon arose a mighty conflict between the lord of vultures and the lord of Rākṣasas of incomparable prowess.

sanskrit: तस्य व्यायच्छमानस्य रामस्य अर्थे अथ रावणः
पक्षौ पादौ च पार्श्वौ च खड्गम् उद्धृत्य सो अच्छिनत्
transliteration: tasya vyāyacchamānasya rāmasya arthe atha rāvaṇaḥ
pakṣau pādau ca pārśvau ca khaḍgam uddhṛtya so acchinat
english: Jațāyu addressing himself to displaying his prowess for the benefit of Rāma, Rāvaņa taking out his dagger, cut off his two wings, two legs and two sides.

sanskrit: स छिन्न पक्षः सहसा रक्षसा रौद्र कर्मणा
निपपात महा गृध्रो धरण्याम् अल्प जीवितः
transliteration: sa chinna pakṣaḥ sahasā rakṣasā raudra karmaṇā
nipapāta mahā gṛdhro dharaṇyām alpa jīvitaḥ
english: The ranger of the night of cruel deeds having şundered his wings, the king of vultures approaching well-nigh the verge of death, fell। down on the earth.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा पतितम् भूमौ क्षतज आर्द्रम् जटायुषम्
अभ्यधावत वैदेही स्व बंधुम् इव दुःखिता
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā patitam bhūmau kṣataja ārdram jaṭāyuṣam
abhyadhāvata vaidehī sva baṃdhum iva duḥkhitā
english: Beholding him fallen on the ground with his person bathed in blood, Sītā became exceedingly aggrieved and darted towards him like to a friend.

sanskrit: तम् नील जीमूत निकाश कल्पम्सुपाण्डुर उरस्कम् उदार वीर्यम्
ददर्श लंका अधिपतिः पृथिव्याम्जटायुषम् शान्तम् इव अग्नि दावम्
transliteration: tam nīla jīmūta nikāśa kalpamsupāṇḍura uraskam udāra vīryam
dadarśa laṃkā adhipatiḥ pṛthivyāmjaṭāyuṣam śāntam iva agni dāvam
english: The lord of Lankā beheld Jațāyu, fallen on the ground, resembling sable clouds, having a yellow breast and of exceeding prowess, like to an extinguished forest-fire.

sanskrit: ततः तु तम् पत्ररथम् मही तलेनिपातितम् रावण वेग मर्दितम्
पुनः च संगृह्य शशि प्रभ आननारुरोद सीता जनक आत्मजा तदा
transliteration: tataḥ tu tam patraratham mahī talenipātitam rāvaṇa vega marditam
punaḥ ca saṃgṛhya śaśi prabha ānanāruroda sītā janaka ātmajā tadā
english: Then Sītā the daughter of Janaka, having a moon-like countenance began lamenting, clasping with her hands Jațāyu, crushed and fallen on the ground by the vehemence of Rāvana's prowess.

sanskrit: सा तु तारा अधिप मुखी रावणेन निरीक्ष्य तम्
transliteration: sā tu tārā adhipa mukhī rāvaṇena nirīkṣya tam
english: Beholding the king of vultures slain by Rāvana, that one possessed of a face fair as the moon, stricken with grief, broke out into lamentations.

sanskrit: निमित्तम् लक्षणम् स्वप्नम् शकुनि स्वर दर्शनम्
transliteration: nimittam lakṣaṇam svapnam śakuni svara darśanam
english: Throbbings of the eyes or other parts of the body, dreams, seeing birds or hearing their voice, are found to augur happiness or misery to men.

sanskrit: न नूनम् राम जानासि महत् व्यसनम् आत्मनः
धावन्ति नूनम् काकुत्स्थ मत् अर्थम् मृग पक्षिणः
transliteration: na nūnam rāma jānāsi mahat vyasanam ātmanaḥ
dhāvanti nūnam kākutstha mat artham mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ
english: And, O Rāma, although birds and beasts are scampering away before you on my account, you under-stand not the mighty mishap that has befallen you.

sanskrit: अयम् हि कृपया राम माम् त्रातुम् इह संगतः
शेते विनिहतो भूमौ मम अभाग्यात् विहंगमः
transliteration: ayam hi kṛpayā rāma mām trātum iha saṃgataḥ
śete vinihato bhūmau mama abhāgyāt vihaṃgamaḥ
english: O Rāma, this bird, who, moved by kindness, had come to rescue me, owing to my (ill) luck, lies slain on the ground.

sanskrit: त्राहि माम् अद्य काकुत्स्थ लक्ष्मण इति वरांगना
सु संत्रस्ता समाक्रंदत् शृण्वताम् तु यथा अन्तिके
transliteration: trāhi mām adya kākutstha lakṣmaṇa iti varāṃganā
su saṃtrastā samākraṃdat śṛṇvatām tu yathā antike
english: O Kākutstha, O Laksmana, save me! Thus did that best of females, afflicted with fear, bewail; and those near (her) heard her lamentations.

sanskrit: ताम् क्लिष्ट माल्य आभरणाम् विलपन्तीम् अनाथवत्
transliteration: tām kliṣṭa mālya ābharaṇām vilapantīm anāthavat
english: Thereat, that lord of the Rākşasas, Rāvana, darted towards Vaidehi, who, with a faded wreath for her ornament, was bewailing in forlorn guise.

sanskrit: ताम् लताम् इव वेष्टन्तीम् आलिंगन्तीम् महाद्रुमान्
मुंच मुंच इति बहुशः प्रवदन् राक्षस अधिपः
transliteration: tām latām iva veṣṭantīm āliṃgantīm mahādrumān
muṃca muṃca iti bahuśaḥ pravadan rākṣasa adhipaḥ
english: Exclaiming repeatedly, Leave off! Leave off, the lord of the Rākşasas got at her, as she was clasping a mighty trees as if it were a creeper.

sanskrit: क्रोशन्तीम् राम राम इति रामेण रहिताम् वने
जीवित अन्ताय केशेषु जग्राह अन्तक संनिभः
transliteration: krośantīm rāma rāma iti rāmeṇa rahitām vane
jīvita antāya keśeṣu jagrāha antaka saṃnibhaḥ
english: And as she, bereft of the company of Răma in the wilderness, was wailing, saying, O Rāma, O Rāma, that one resembling the Destroyer himself, with the view of compassing his own end, seized her by her hair. On Vaidehi being thus outraged, this entire world consisting of mobile and immobile objects, had its nature altered. A dense darkness enveloped (everything).

sanskrit: प्रधर्षितायाम् वैदेह्याम् बभूव स चरा अचरम्
जगत् सर्वम् अमर्यादम् तमसा अन्धेन संवृतम्
transliteration: pradharṣitāyām vaidehyām babhūva sa carā acaram
jagat sarvam amaryādam tamasā andhena saṃvṛtam
english: And as she, bereft of the company of Răma in the wilderness, was wailing, saying, O Rāma, O Rāma, that one resembling the Destroyer himself, with the view of compassing his own end, seized her by her hair. On Vaidehi being thus outraged, this entire world consisting of mobile and immobile objects, had its nature altered. A dense darkness enveloped (everything).

sanskrit: न वाति मारुतः तत्र निष् प्रभो अभूत् दिवाकरः
दृष्ट्वा सीताम् परा मृष्टाम् देवो दिव्येन चक्षुषा
transliteration: na vāti mārutaḥ tatra niṣ prabho abhūt divākaraḥ
dṛṣṭvā sītām parā mṛṣṭām devo divyena cakṣuṣā
english: And the air did not breathe there; and the sun grew dim. Espying with his divine vision that Sītā was overcome, that Deity, the graceful Great-father exclaimed, Our work is accomplished.

sanskrit: कृतम् कार्यम् इति श्रीमान् व्याजहार पितामहः
प्रहृष्टा व्यथिताः च आसन् सर्वे ते परम ऋषयः
transliteration: kṛtam kāryam iti śrīmān vyājahāra pitāmahaḥ
prahṛṣṭā vyathitāḥ ca āsan sarve te parama ṛṣayaḥ

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सीताम् परा मृष्टाम् दण्डकारण्य वासिनः
रावणस्य विनाशम् च प्राप्तम् बुद्ध्वा यदृच्छया
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sītām parā mṛṣṭām daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinaḥ
rāvaṇasya vināśam ca prāptam buddhvā yadṛcchayā
english: And seeing Sītā overpowered, the supreme saints inhabiting the Dandaka forest, concluding the destruction of Rāvaņa to be as good as accomplished without much ado, became at once delighted and aggrieved.

sanskrit: स तु ताम् राम राम इति रुदन्तीम् लक्ष्मण इति च
जगाम आदाय च आकाशम् रावणो राक्षसेश्वर
transliteration: sa tu tām rāma rāma iti rudantīm lakṣmaṇa iti ca
jagāma ādāya ca ākāśam rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvara
english: As she went on weeping with ( Rāma, O Lakşmaņa, Rāvana-lord of Rākşasas—taking her, coursed through the sky.

sanskrit: तप्त आभरण वर्ण अन्गी पीत कौशेय वासनी
रराज राज पुत्री तु विद्युत् सौदामनी यथा
transliteration: tapta ābharaṇa varṇa angī pīta kauśeya vāsanī
rarāja rāja putrī tu vidyut saudāmanī yathā
english: And then the king's daughter hued like molten gold, clad in a yellow silken cloth, looked exceedingly beautiful like to lighting.

sanskrit: उद्धूतेन च वस्त्रेण तस्याः पीतेन रावणः
अधिकम् परिबभ्राज गिरिः दीप इव अग्निना
transliteration: uddhūtena ca vastreṇa tasyāḥ pītena rāvaṇaḥ
adhikam paribabhrāja giriḥ dīpa iva agninā
english: And on her yellow cloth streaming up, Rāvaņa looked surpassingly graceful like a hill aflame with fire.

sanskrit: तस्याः परम कल्याण्याः ताम्राणि सुरभीणि च
पद्म पत्राणि वैदेह्या अभ्यकीर्यन्त रावणम् - यद्वा -- च्युतानि पद्म पत्राणि रावणम् समावाकिरन् -
transliteration: tasyāḥ parama kalyāṇyāḥ tāmrāṇi surabhīṇi ca
padma patrāṇi vaidehyā abhyakīryanta rāvaṇam - yadvā -- cyutāni padma patrāṇi rāvaṇam samāvākiran -
english: And coppery fragrant lotus-leaves belonging to the eminently auspicious Vaidehī showered upon Ravana.

sanskrit: तस्याः कौशेयम् उद्धूतम् आकाशे कनक प्रभम्
बभौ च आदित्य रागेण ताम्रम् अभ्रम् इव आतपे
transliteration: tasyāḥ kauśeyam uddhūtam ākāśe kanaka prabham
babhau ca āditya rāgeṇa tāmram abhram iva ātape
english: And her gold-glowing silken cloth, flying in the air, appeared like clouds coloured by the sunken sun.

sanskrit: तस्याः तत् विमलम् - सु नसम् - वक्त्रम् आकाशे रावण अंक गम्
न रराज विना रामम् विनालम् इव पंकजम्
transliteration: tasyāḥ tat vimalam - su nasam - vaktram ākāśe rāvaṇa aṃka gam
na rarāja vinā rāmam vinālam iva paṃkajam
english: And her blameless countenance on Rāvana's lap in the sky did not appear beauteous without Rāma, like a lotus without its stalk;

sanskrit: बभूव जलदम् नीलम् भित्त्वा चन्द्र इव उदितः
सु ललाटम् सु केश अंतम् पद्म गर्भ आभम् अव्रणम्
transliteration: babhūva jaladam nīlam bhittvā candra iva uditaḥ
su lalāṭam su keśa aṃtam padma garbha ābham avraṇam

sanskrit: शुक्लैः सु विमलैर् दन्तैः प्रभावद्भिः अलंकृतम्
तस्याः सु नयनम् वक्त्रम् आकाशे रावण अंक गम्
transliteration: śuklaiḥ su vimalair dantaiḥ prabhāvadbhiḥ alaṃkṛtam
tasyāḥ su nayanam vaktram ākāśe rāvaṇa aṃka gam

sanskrit: रुदितम् व्यपमृष्ट अस्रम् चन्द्रवत् प्रिय दर्शनम्
सु नासम् चारु ताम्र ओष्ठम् आकाषे हाटक प्रभम्
transliteration: ruditam vyapamṛṣṭa asram candravat priya darśanam
su nāsam cāru tāmra oṣṭham ākāṣe hāṭaka prabham

sanskrit: राक्षसेन्द्र समाधूतम् तस्याः तत् वदनम् शुभम्
शुशुभे न विना रामम् दिवा चन्द्र इव उदितः
transliteration: rākṣasendra samādhūtam tasyāḥ tat vadanam śubham
śuśubhe na vinā rāmam divā candra iva uditaḥ

sanskrit: सा हेम वर्णा नील अंगम् मैथिली राक्षस अधिपम्
शुशुभे कांचनी कांची नीलम् मणिम् - गजम् - इव आश्रिता
transliteration: sā hema varṇā nīla aṃgam maithilī rākṣasa adhipam
śuśubhe kāṃcanī kāṃcī nīlam maṇim - gajam - iva āśritā
english: And furnished with the hue of gold, Mithila's daughter beside the dark-bodied lord of the Rākşasas, looked like a golden girth round a sable elephant.

sanskrit: सा पद्म पीता हेम आभा रावणम् जनक आत्मजा
विद्युत् घनम् इव आविश्य शुशुभे तप्त भूषणा
transliteration: sā padma pītā hema ābhā rāvaṇam janaka ātmajā
vidyut ghanam iva āviśya śuśubhe tapta bhūṣaṇā
english: Janaka's daughter, yellow-hued like lotus, having the lustre of gold-and adorned with shining ornaments, coming in contact with Rāvana, appeared like lightning embosomed among clouds.

sanskrit: तस्या भूषण घोषेण वैदेह्या राक्षस अधिपः
बभूव विमलो नीलः सघोष इव तोयदः
transliteration: tasyā bhūṣaṇa ghoṣeṇa vaidehyā rākṣasa adhipaḥ
babhūva vimalo nīlaḥ saghoṣa iva toyadaḥ
english: And in consequence of Vaidehi's ornaments sending sounds, the lord of Rākşasas resembled an entirely dark rumbling cloud.

sanskrit: उत्तम अंग च्युता तस्याः पुष्प वृष्टिः समन्ततः
transliteration: uttama aṃga cyutā tasyāḥ puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ samantataḥ
english: As Sītā was being borne away, showers of blossoms, falling off from her head, were scattered all around on the earth beneath.

sanskrit: सा तु रावण वेगेन पुष्प वृष्टिः समन्ततः
transliteration: sā tu rāvaṇa vegena puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ samantataḥ
english: And that blossoms shower all around, drawn up by the vehemence of the ten-headed Rāvana, again alighted beside him.

sanskrit: नक्षत्र माला विमला मेरुम् नगम् इव उन्नतम्
transliteration: nakṣatra mālā vimalā merum nagam iva unnatam
english: And the showers of blossoms scattered around Vaisravana's younger brother, looked like rows of burning stars round the foremost of mountains*. Sumerus

sanskrit: चरणात् नूपुरम् भ्रष्टम् वैदेह्या रत्न भूषितम्
विद्युत् मण्डल संकाशम् पपात धरणी तले
transliteration: caraṇāt nūpuram bhraṣṭam vaidehyā ratna bhūṣitam
vidyut maṇḍala saṃkāśam papāta dharaṇī tale
english: And the bangles studded with gems, loosened . from Vaidehi's feet, fell on the earth, like the lighting circle. Instead of On the earth-some texts have [bangles] sweet-sounding.

sanskrit: तरु प्रवाल रक्ता सा नील अंगम् राक्षस ईश्वरम्
प्राशोभयत वैदेही गजम् कक्ष्या इव कांचनी
transliteration: taru pravāla raktā sā nīla aṃgam rākṣasa īśvaram
prāśobhayata vaidehī gajam kakṣyā iva kāṃcanī
english: O hue like the light red of tender twigs, Vaidehi set off the dark-bodied lord of Rākşasas, as does a golden cover an elephant.

sanskrit: ताम् महा उल्काम् इव आकाशे दीप्यमानाम् स्व तेजसा
जहार आकाशम् आविश्य सीताम् वैश्रवण अनुजः
transliteration: tām mahā ulkām iva ākāśe dīpyamānām sva tejasā
jahāra ākāśam āviśya sītām vaiśravaṇa anujaḥ
english: Vaisravana's younger brother carried away Sītā, who, like a mighty meteor, filled the heavens with her splendour.

sanskrit: तस्याः तानि अग्नि वर्णानि भूषणानि मही तले
स घोषाणि अवकीर्यन्त क्षीणाः तारा इव अंबरात्
transliteration: tasyāḥ tāni agni varṇāni bhūṣaṇāni mahī tale
sa ghoṣāṇi avakīryanta kṣīṇāḥ tārā iva aṃbarāt
english: And like stars of exhausted religious merit dropping down from the sky, her fiery ornaments began to fall to the earth with sounds.

sanskrit: तस्याः स्तन अन्तरात् भ्रष्टो हारः तारा अधिप द्युतिः
वैदेह्या निपतन् भाति गंगा इव गगनात् च्युता
transliteration: tasyāḥ stana antarāt bhraṣṭo hāraḥ tārā adhipa dyutiḥ
vaidehyā nipatan bhāti gaṃgā iva gaganāt cyutā
english: And the chain of the splendour of the moon, removed from Vaidehi's breast, falling down, shone like the Gangā dropping from the sky.

sanskrit: उत्पात वात अभिहता नाना द्विज गण आयुताः
मा भैः इति विधूत अग्रा व्याजह्रुः इव पादपाः
transliteration: utpāta vāta abhihatā nānā dvija gaṇa āyutāḥ
mā bhaiḥ iti vidhūta agrā vyājahruḥ iva pādapāḥ
english: The trees filled with various fowls, with their tops waving because of the wind blowing on high and swaying them, seemed to say, No fear, [to Sita.]

sanskrit: नलिन्यो ध्वस्त कमलाः त्रस्त मीन जले चराः
सखीम् इव गत उत्साहाम् शोचन्ति इव स्म मैथिलीम्
transliteration: nalinyo dhvasta kamalāḥ trasta mīna jale carāḥ
sakhīm iva gata utsāhām śocanti iva sma maithilīm
english: And the pools with their lotuses faded and their fishes agitated, seemed to sorrow for the desponding daughter of Mithilā as for their friend.

sanskrit: समंतात् अभिसंपत्य सिंह व्याघ्र मृग द्विजाः
अन्वधावन् तदा रोषात् सीताम् छाया अनुगामिनः
transliteration: samaṃtāt abhisaṃpatya siṃha vyāghra mṛga dvijāḥ
anvadhāvan tadā roṣāt sītām chāyā anugāminaḥ
english: And following Sītā's shadow, lions, and tigers, and other beasts and birds, rushed from all sides in wrath.

sanskrit: जल प्रपात अस्र मुखाः शृन्गैः उच्छ्रित बाहवः
transliteration: jala prapāta asra mukhāḥ śṛngaiḥ ucchrita bāhavaḥ
english: And the mountains, with their faces washed with water-falls representing tears, and their summits resembling uplifted arms, seemed to lament for Sītă, as she was being carried away.

sanskrit: ह्रियमाणाम् तु वैदेहीम् दृष्ट्वा दीनो दिवाकरः
प्रविध्वस्त प्रभः श्रीमान् आसीत् पाण्डुर मण्डलः
transliteration: hriyamāṇām tu vaidehīm dṛṣṭvā dīno divākaraḥ
pravidhvasta prabhaḥ śrīmān āsīt pāṇḍura maṇḍalaḥ
english: And beholding Vaidehỉ carried away, the glorious Sun, oppressed with sadness, had his rays dimmed and his disc darkened.

sanskrit: न अस्ति धर्मः कुतः सत्यम् न आर्जवम् न अनृशम्सता
यत्र रामस्य वैदेहीम् भार्याम् हरति रावणः
transliteration: na asti dharmaḥ kutaḥ satyam na ārjavam na anṛśamsatā
yatra rāmasya vaidehīm bhāryām harati rāvaṇaḥ

sanskrit: वित्रस्तका दीन मुखा रुरुदुः मृग पोतकाः
transliteration: vitrastakā dīna mukhā ruruduḥ mṛga potakāḥ
english: Virtue is not; and where is truth? And there is neither sincerity nor kindness, in a case in which Rāvana is carrying away Rāma's Vaidehī; thus did all creatures lament in numbers. And the young of deer, afflicted with fear, wept with woe-began faces.

sanskrit: उद्वीक्ष्य उद्वीक्ष्य नयनैः अस्र पात आविल ईक्षणाः
सुप्रवेपित गात्राः च बभूवुः वन देवताः
transliteration: udvīkṣya udvīkṣya nayanaiḥ asra pāta āvila īkṣaṇāḥ
supravepita gātrāḥ ca babhūvuḥ vana devatāḥ
english: And the sylvan deities, looking up now and again with eyes betokening fear, had their persons all in a tremble.

sanskrit: विक्रोशन्तीम् दृढम् सीताम् दृष्ट्वा दुःखम् तथा गताम्
ताम् तु लक्ष्मण राम इति क्रोशन्तीम् मधुर स्वराम्
transliteration: vikrośantīm dṛḍham sītām dṛṣṭvā duḥkham tathā gatām
tām tu lakṣmaṇa rāma iti krośantīm madhura svarām

sanskrit: स ताम् आकुल केशान्ताम् विप्रमृष्ट विशेषकाम्
transliteration: sa tām ākula keśāntām vipramṛṣṭa viśeṣakām
english: headed one carried away the intelligent Vaidehī, bewailing bitterly, Sītā, who had come by such misfortune, sweet-voiced, crying, O Lakşmaņa O Rāma, and casting glances on the ground many time and oft, the ends of her hair waving and her tilika wiped out.

sanskrit: ततः तु सा चारु दती शुचि स्मिताविना कृता बन्धु जनेन मैथिली
अपश्यती राघव लक्ष्मणाउ उभौविवर्ण वक्त्रा भय भार पीडिता
transliteration: tataḥ tu sā cāru datī śuci smitāvinā kṛtā bandhu janena maithilī
apaśyatī rāghava lakṣmaṇāu ubhauvivarṇa vaktrā bhaya bhāra pīḍitā
english: Then oppressed with the load of fear, Sītā of luminous smiles, Mithila's daughter, bereft of her friends-not beholding either Rāma or Lakşmaņa, became pale of countenance.

sanskrit: खम् उत्पतन्तम् तम् दृष्ट्वा मैथिली जनक आत्मजा
दुःखिता परम उद्विग्ना भये महति वर्तिनी
transliteration: kham utpatantam tam dṛṣṭvā maithilī janaka ātmajā
duḥkhitā parama udvignā bhaye mahati vartinī
english: Seeing him fly up into the air, Janaka's daughter, Maithili, became aggrieved and exceedingly agitated, and great was the fear that possessed her.

sanskrit: रोष रोदन ताम्राक्षी भीमाक्षम् राक्षस अधिपम्
रुदती करुणम् सीता ह्रियमाणा इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: roṣa rodana tāmrākṣī bhīmākṣam rākṣasa adhipam
rudatī karuṇam sītā hriyamāṇā idam abravīt
english: Her eyes expressing rage, weeping and fright, Sītā, as she was being carried away, weeping piteously, spoke to the grim-eyed lord of the Raksasas.

sanskrit: न व्यपत्रपसे नीच कर्मणा अनेन रावण
ज्ञात्वा विरहिताम् यो माम् चोरयित्वा पलायसे
transliteration: na vyapatrapase nīca karmaṇā anena rāvaṇa
jñātvā virahitām yo mām corayitvā palāyase
english: Do you not, O base wretch, O Ravana, feel shame on account of this act-you, who, knowing that I was alone fly away, carrying me?

sanskrit: त्वया एव नूनम् दुष्टात्मन् भीरुणा हर्तुम् इच्छता
मम अपवाहितो भर्ता मृग रूपेण मायया
transliteration: tvayā eva nūnam duṣṭātman bhīruṇā hartum icchatā
mama apavāhito bhartā mṛga rūpeṇa māyayā
english: Coward that you are, you it was, who, desirous of carrying me off, by the shape of a deer, had, by your (powers of] illusion taken away my lord.

sanskrit: यो हि माम् उद्यतः त्रातुम् सो अपि अयम् विनिपातितः
गृध्र राजः पुराणो असौ श्वशुरस्य सखा मम
transliteration: yo hi mām udyataḥ trātum so api ayam vinipātitaḥ
gṛdhra rājaḥ purāṇo asau śvaśurasya sakhā mama
english: And he also that endeavoured to rescue me, has been slain by you—the ancient king of vultures, who was the friend of my father-in-law.

sanskrit: परमम् खलु ते वीर्यम् दृश्यते राक्षसाधम
विश्राव्य नामधेयम् हि युद्धे न अस्मि जिता त्वया
transliteration: paramam khalu te vīryam dṛśyate rākṣasādhama
viśrāvya nāmadheyam hi yuddhe na asmi jitā tvayā
english: Great, forsooth, is found to be your might, you vilest of Rākşasas, in that you have carried me off; by simply declaring your name, but have not won me in war. Why do you not, O execrable one, take shame to yourself, having perpetrated such a heinous act-having carried off another's wife in the absence of her husband?

sanskrit: ईदृशम् गर्हितम् कर्म कथम् कृत्वा न लज्जसे
स्त्रियाः च हरणम् नीच रहिते च परस्य च
transliteration: īdṛśam garhitam karma katham kṛtvā na lajjase
striyāḥ ca haraṇam nīca rahite ca parasya ca
english: Great, forsooth, is found to be your might, you vilest of Rākşasas, in that you have carried me off; by simply declaring your name, but have not won me in war. Why do you not, O execrable one, take shame to yourself, having perpetrated such a heinous act-having carried off another's wife in the absence of her husband?
This fell and foul ict of yours fraught with unrighteousness, heroic persons shall bruit about the world.

sanskrit: धिक् ते शौर्यम् च सत्त्वम् च यत् त्वया कथितम् तदा
कुल आक्रोशकरम् लोके धिक् ते चारित्रम् ईदृशम्
transliteration: dhik te śauryam ca sattvam ca yat tvayā kathitam tadā
kula ākrośakaram loke dhik te cāritram īdṛśam
english: Fie on your heroism and your truth, of which you did speak at that time; and fie also on this character of yours, calculated to sully your line in this world.

sanskrit: किम् शक्यम् कर्तुम् एवम् हि यत् जवेन एव धावसि
मुहूर्तम् अपि तिष्ठस्व न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि
transliteration: kim śakyam kartum evam hi yat javena eva dhāvasi
muhūrtam api tiṣṭhasva na jīvan pratiyāsyasi
english: What can I do (to you), as you proceed with speed? But stay you for a moment; and you shall not return with life.

sanskrit: न हि चक्षुः पथम् प्राप्य तयोः पार्थिव पुत्रयोः
स सैन्यो अपि समर्थः त्वम् मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम्
transliteration: na hi cakṣuḥ patham prāpya tayoḥ pārthiva putrayoḥ
sa sainyo api samarthaḥ tvam muhūrtam api jīvitum
english: Should you come within the range of the vision of those sons of the king, you could not, although you should happen to be accompanied with your army, live for a moment.

sanskrit: न त्वम् तयोः शर स्पर्शम् सोढुम् शक्तः कथंचन
वने प्रज्वलितस्य इव स्पर्शम् अग्नेः विहंगमः
transliteration: na tvam tayoḥ śara sparśam soḍhum śaktaḥ kathaṃcana
vane prajvalitasya iva sparśam agneḥ vihaṃgamaḥ
english: Even as a bird cannot bear the touch of a flaming fire in a forest, you can never bear the touch of their arrows. Effecting your own welfare, do you, O Ravana, leave me.

sanskrit: साधु कृत्वा आत्मनः पथ्यम् साधु माम् मुंच रावण
मत् प्रधर्षण रुष्टो हि भ्रात्रा सह पतिः मम
transliteration: sādhu kṛtvā ātmanaḥ pathyam sādhu mām muṃca rāvaṇa
mat pradharṣaṇa ruṣṭo hi bhrātrā saha patiḥ mama

sanskrit: विधास्यति विनाशाय त्वम् माम् यदि न मुंचसि
येन त्वम् व्यवसायेन बलात् माम् हर्तुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: vidhāsyati vināśāya tvam mām yadi na muṃcasi
yena tvam vyavasāyena balāt mām hartum icchasi

sanskrit: व्यवसायः तु ते नीच भविष्यति निरर्थकः
न हि अहम् तम् अपश्यन्ती भर्तारम् विबुध उपमम्
transliteration: vyavasāyaḥ tu te nīca bhaviṣyati nirarthakaḥ
na hi aham tam apaśyantī bhartāram vibudha upamam

sanskrit: उत्सहे शत्रु वशगा प्राणान् धारयितुम् चिरम्
न नूनम् च आत्मनः श्रेयः पथ्यम् वा समवेक्षसे
transliteration: utsahe śatru vaśagā prāṇān dhārayitum ciram
na nūnam ca ātmanaḥ śreyaḥ pathyam vā samavekṣase

sanskrit: मृत्यु काले यथा मर्त्यो विपरीतानि सेवते
मुमूर्षूणाम् तु सर्वेषाम् यत् पथ्यम् तत् न रोचते
transliteration: mṛtyu kāle yathā martyo viparītāni sevate
mumūrṣūṇām tu sarveṣām yat pathyam tat na rocate
english: As one dwelling on earth perceives objects in their reversed relations at the time of one's death SO you do not perceive what is for your good or profit. Those moribund do not relish what would do them good.

sanskrit: पश्यामि इव हि कण्ठे त्वाम् काल पाश अवपाशितम्
यथा च अस्मिन् भय स्थाने न बिभेषि दशानन
transliteration: paśyāmi iva hi kaṇṭhe tvām kāla pāśa avapāśitam
yathā ca asmin bhaya sthāne na bibheṣi daśānana

sanskrit: व्यक्तम् हिरण्मयान् हि त्वम् संपश्यसि मही रुहान्
नदीम् वैतरणीम् घोराम् रुधिर ओघ विवाहिनीम्
transliteration: vyaktam hiraṇmayān hi tvam saṃpaśyasi mahī ruhān
nadīm vaitaraṇīm ghorām rudhira ogha vivāhinīm

sanskrit: खड्ग पत्र वनम् चैव भीमम् पश्यसि रावण
तप्त कांचन पुष्पाम् च वैदूर्य प्रवर च्छदाम्
transliteration: khaḍga patra vanam caiva bhīmam paśyasi rāvaṇa
tapta kāṃcana puṣpām ca vaidūrya pravara cchadām

sanskrit: द्रक्ष्यसे शाल्मलीम् तीक्ष्णाम् आयसैः कण्टकैः चिताम्
न हि त्वम् ईदृशम् कृत्वा तस्य अलीकम् महात्मनः
transliteration: drakṣyase śālmalīm tīkṣṇām āyasaiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ citām
na hi tvam īdṛśam kṛtvā tasya alīkam mahātmanaḥ
english: But, O shameless one, like a person that has drunk poison, having done this wrong to that high-souled one, you with not be able to save yourself. O Rāvana, you are fast fettered in the noose of Death.

sanskrit: धारितुम् शक्स्यसि चिरम् विषम् पीत्वा इव निर्घृणः
बद्धः त्वम् काल पाशेन दुर्निवारेण रावण
transliteration: dhāritum śaksyasi ciram viṣam pītvā iva nirghṛṇaḥ
baddhaḥ tvam kāla pāśena durnivāreṇa rāvaṇa

sanskrit: क्व गतो लप्स्यसे शर्म भर्तुः मम महात्मनः
निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण विना भ्रातरम् आहवे
transliteration: kva gato lapsyase śarma bhartuḥ mama mahātmanaḥ
nimeṣa antara mātreṇa vinā bhrātaram āhave
english: Having done this foul turn to that high-souled one, repairing whither, shall you obtain respite? Shall not that strong and heroic Rāghava, skilled in all weapons, who without his brother, in the twinkling of an eye, in battle slew fourteen thousand Rākṣasas, slay you, who carries away his beloved wife?

sanskrit: कथम् स राघवो वीरः सर्व अस्त्र कुशलो बली
transliteration: katham sa rāghavo vīraḥ sarva astra kuśalo balī
english: Having done this foul turn to that high-souled one, repairing whither, shall you obtain respite? Shall not that strong and heroic Rāghava, skilled in all weapons, who without his brother, in the twinkling of an eye, in battle slew fourteen thousand Rākṣasas, slay you, who carries away his beloved wife?

sanskrit: न त्वाम् हन्यात् शरैः तीक्ष्णैः इष्ट भार्या अपहारिणम्
एतत् च अन्यत् च परुषम् वैदेही रावण अंक गा
भय शोक समाविष्टा करुणम् विललाप ह
transliteration: na tvām hanyāt śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ iṣṭa bhāryā apahāriṇam
etat ca anyat ca paruṣam vaidehī rāvaṇa aṃka gā
bhaya śoka samāviṣṭā karuṇam vilalāpa ha
english: Thus and in other ways, Videha's daughter, lying on the lap of Rāvana, overwhelmed with fear and grief, indulged in piteous lamentations.

sanskrit: तथा भृश आर्ताम् बहु चैव भाषिणीम्विललाप पूर्वम् करुणम् च भामिनीम्
जहार पापः तरुणीम् विवेष्टतीम्नृपात्मजाम् आगत गात्र वेपथुम्
transliteration: tathā bhṛśa ārtām bahu caiva bhāṣiṇīmvilalāpa pūrvam karuṇam ca bhāminīm
jahāra pāpaḥ taruṇīm viveṣṭatīmnṛpātmajām āgata gātra vepathum
english: And the wicked (Rävaņa) with a shaking frame carried away the daughter of the king extremely distressed, speaking much, and speaking piteously, uttering lamentations, and putting forth endeavours (to free herself.) saw

sanskrit: ह्रियमाणा तु वैदेही कंचित् नाथम् अपश्यती
ददर्श गिरि शृंगस्थान् पंच वानर पुंगवान्
transliteration: hriyamāṇā tu vaidehī kaṃcit nātham apaśyatī
dadarśa giri śṛṃgasthān paṃca vānara puṃgavān
english: Carried away (by Ravana), Vaidehi, not finding any defender, five principal monkeys stationed on the top of a hill.

sanskrit: तेषाम् मध्ये विशालाक्षी कौशेयम् कनक प्रभम्
transliteration: teṣām madhye viśālākṣī kauśeyam kanaka prabham
english: Thereat, that lady of expansive eyes and surpassing charms, in the hope that they might convey the intelligence to Rāma, flung off in their midst her gold-gleaming silken sheet, and elegant ornaments.

sanskrit: मुमोच यदि रामाय शंसेयुः इति भामिनी
वस्त्रम् उत्सृज्य तन् मध्ये विनिक्षिप्तम् स भूषणम्
transliteration: mumoca yadi rāmāya śaṃseyuḥ iti bhāminī
vastram utsṛjya tan madhye vinikṣiptam sa bhūṣaṇam
english: Thereat, that lady of expansive eyes and surpassing charms, in the hope that they might convey the intelligence to Rāma, flung off in their midst her gold-gleaming silken sheet, and elegant ornaments.

sanskrit: संभ्रमात् तु दशग्रीवः तत् कर्म न च बुद्ध्वान्
पिंगाक्षाः ताम् विशालाक्षीम् नेत्रैः अनिमिषैः इव
transliteration: saṃbhramāt tu daśagrīvaḥ tat karma na ca buddhvān
piṃgākṣāḥ tām viśālākṣīm netraiḥ animiṣaiḥ iva
english: But the Ten headed one owing to hurry did not observe the throwing of the cloth along with the ornaments. Those foremost of monkeys having tawny eyes observes with winkless eyes the large-eyed Sītā as she was giving way to grief.

sanskrit: विक्रोशन्तीम् तदा सीताम् ददृशुः वानर ऋषभाः
स च पंपाम् अतिक्रम्य लंकाम् अभिमुखः पुरीम्
transliteration: vikrośantīm tadā sītām dadṛśuḥ vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
sa ca paṃpām atikramya laṃkām abhimukhaḥ purīm

sanskrit: जगाम रुदतीम् गृह्य मैथिलीम् राक्षस ईश्वरः
ताम् जहार सुसंहृष्टो रावणो मृत्युम् आत्मनः
transliteration: jagāma rudatīm gṛhya maithilīm rākṣasa īśvaraḥ
tām jahāra susaṃhṛṣṭo rāvaṇo mṛtyum ātmanaḥ

sanskrit: उत्संगेन एव भुजगीम् तीक्ष्ण दंष्ट्राम् महाविषाम्
वनानि सरितः शैलान् सराम्सि च विहायसा
transliteration: utsaṃgena eva bhujagīm tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭrām mahāviṣām
vanāni saritaḥ śailān sarāmsi ca vihāyasā

sanskrit: स क्षिप्रम् समतीयाय शरः चापात् इव च्युतः
तिमि नक्र निकेतम् तु वरुण आलयम् अक्षयम्
transliteration: sa kṣipram samatīyāya śaraḥ cāpāt iva cyutaḥ
timi nakra niketam tu varuṇa ālayam akṣayam

sanskrit: संभ्रमात् परिवृत्त ऊर्मी रुद्ध मीन महोरगः
transliteration: saṃbhramāt parivṛtta ūrmī ruddha mīna mahoragaḥ

sanskrit: अन्तरिक्ष गता वाचः ससृजुः चारणाः तदा
transliteration: antarikṣa gatā vācaḥ sasṛjuḥ cāraṇāḥ tadā

sanskrit: एतत् अन्तो दशग्रीव इति सिद्धाः तदा अब्रुवन्
स तु सीताम् विचेष्टन्तीम् अंकेन आदाय रावणः
transliteration: etat anto daśagrīva iti siddhāḥ tadā abruvan
sa tu sītām viceṣṭantīm aṃkena ādāya rāvaṇaḥ

sanskrit: प्रविवेश पुरीम् लन्काम् रूपिणीम् मृत्युम् आत्मनः
सः अभिगम्य पुरीम् लंकाम् सुविभक्त महापथाम्
transliteration: praviveśa purīm lankām rūpiṇīm mṛtyum ātmanaḥ
saḥ abhigamya purīm laṃkām suvibhakta mahāpathām

sanskrit: संरूढ कक्ष्या बहुलम् स्वम् अंतः पुरम् आविशत्
तत्र ताम् असित अपांगाम् शोक मोह परायणाम्
transliteration: saṃrūḍha kakṣyā bahulam svam aṃtaḥ puram āviśat
tatra tām asita apāṃgām śoka moha parāyaṇām

sanskrit: निदधे रावणः सीताम् मयो मायाम् इव आसुरीम्
अब्रवीत् च दशग्रीवः पिशाचीः घोर दर्शनाः
transliteration: nidadhe rāvaṇaḥ sītām mayo māyām iva āsurīm
abravīt ca daśagrīvaḥ piśācīḥ ghora darśanāḥ

sanskrit: यथा न एनाम् पुमान् स्त्री वा सीताम् पश्यति असम्मतः
मुक्ता मणि सुवर्णानि वस्त्राणि आभरणानि च
transliteration: yathā na enām pumān strī vā sītām paśyati asammataḥ
muktā maṇi suvarṇāni vastrāṇi ābharaṇāni ca

sanskrit: यत् यत् इच्छेत् तत् एव अस्या देयम् मत् च्छंदतो यथा
या च वक्ष्यति वैदेहीम् वचनम् किंचित् अप्रियम्
transliteration: yat yat icchet tat eva asyā deyam mat cchaṃdato yathā
yā ca vakṣyati vaidehīm vacanam kiṃcit apriyam

sanskrit: अज्ञानात् यदि वा ज्ञानान् न तस्या जीवितम् प्रियम्
तथा उक्त्वा राक्षसीः ताः तु राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्
transliteration: ajñānāt yadi vā jñānān na tasyā jīvitam priyam
tathā uktvā rākṣasīḥ tāḥ tu rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān

sanskrit: निष्क्रम्य अन्तः पुरात् तस्मात् किम् कृत्यम् इति चिंतयन्
ददर्श अष्टौ महावीर्यान् राक्षसान् पिशित अशनान्
transliteration: niṣkramya antaḥ purāt tasmāt kim kṛtyam iti ciṃtayan
dadarśa aṣṭau mahāvīryān rākṣasān piśita aśanān
english: Heaving said this to the Rākşasis, the puissant lord of the Rākṣasas, went out of the inner apartment, and thought within himself as to what was to be done (next). And he saw eight flesheating Rākşasas of wondrous prowess.

sanskrit: स तान् दृष्ट्वा महावीर्यो वर दानेन मोहितः
उवाच तान् इदम् वाक्यम् प्रशस्य बल वीर्यतः
transliteration: sa tān dṛṣṭvā mahāvīryo vara dānena mohitaḥ
uvāca tān idam vākyam praśasya bala vīryataḥ
english: And seeing them, the exceedingly powerful. (Ravana), blinded by the bestowal of the boon, after extolling their strength and heroism, addressed them.

sanskrit: नाना प्रहरणाः क्षिप्रम् इतो गच्छत सत्वराः
जनस्थानम् हत स्थानम् भूत पूर्वम् खर आलयम्
transliteration: nānā praharaṇāḥ kṣipram ito gacchata satvarāḥ
janasthānam hata sthānam bhūta pūrvam khara ālayam
english: Equipped with various weapons, do you speedily take yourself to Janasthāna-that field of carnage-which ere this contained the abode of Khara; and casting off fear at a distance, do you sojourn in vacant Janasthāna with all its Raksasas slain (by Rama).

sanskrit: तत्र उष्यताम् जनस्थाने शून्ये निहत राक्षसे
पौरुषम् बलम् आश्रित्य त्रासम् उत्सृज्य दूरतः
transliteration: tatra uṣyatām janasthāne śūnye nihata rākṣase
pauruṣam balam āśritya trāsam utsṛjya dūrataḥ
english: Equipped with various weapons, do you speedily take yourself to Janasthāna-that field of carnage-which ere this contained the abode of Khara; and casting off fear at a distance, do you sojourn in vacant Janasthāna with all its Raksasas slain (by Rama).

sanskrit: स दूषण खरम् युद्धे निहतम् राम सायकैः
transliteration: sa dūṣaṇa kharam yuddhe nihatam rāma sāyakaiḥ
english: A great many troops endued with exceeding prowess, who had been posted in Janasthāna, have, along with Düşana and Khara, been slain by the shafts of Rāma.

sanskrit: ततः क्रोधो मम अपूर्वो धैर्यस्य उपरि वर्धते
वैरम् च सुमहत् जातम् रामम् प्रति सुदारुणम्
transliteration: tataḥ krodho mama apūrvo dhairyasya upari vardhate
vairam ca sumahat jātam rāmam prati sudāruṇam
english: Hence unprecedented is my wrath, towering above my patience; and great and fierce also is the hostility I have conceived against Rāma.

sanskrit: निर्यातयितुम् इच्छामि तत् च वैरम् अहम् रिपोः
न हि लप्स्यामि अहम् निद्राम् अहत्वा संयुगे रिपुम्
transliteration: niryātayitum icchāmi tat ca vairam aham ripoḥ
na hi lapsyāmi aham nidrām ahatvā saṃyuge ripum
english: I wish to avenge myself on my mighty enemy. Sleep find I none without slaying my foe in fight. Slaying that slayer of Khara and Dūşaņa, Rāma, I shall attain delight like to that attained by a pauper on gaining riches.

sanskrit: तम् तु इदानीम् अहम् हत्वा खर दूषण घातिनम्
रामम् शर्म उपलप्स्यामि धनम् लब्ध्वा इव निर्धनः
transliteration: tam tu idānīm aham hatvā khara dūṣaṇa ghātinam
rāmam śarma upalapsyāmi dhanam labdhvā iva nirdhanaḥ
english: I wish to avenge myself on my mighty enemy. Sleep find I none without slaying my foe in fight. Slaying that slayer of Khara and Dūşaņa, Rāma, I shall attain delight like to that attained by a pauper on gaining riches.

sanskrit: जनस्थाने वसद्भिः तु भवद्भिः रामम् आश्रिता
प्रवृत्तिः उपनेतव्या किम् करोति इति तत्त्वतः
transliteration: janasthāne vasadbhiḥ tu bhavadbhiḥ rāmam āśritā
pravṛttiḥ upanetavyā kim karoti iti tattvataḥ
english: Staying in Janasthāna, you shall gather true information touching Rāma as to what he is about. Repair all you rangers of the night carefully, and strive yourselves always for slaying Rāma.

sanskrit: अप्रमादात् च गंतव्यम् सर्वैः एव निशाचरैः
कर्तव्यः च सदा यत्नो राघवस्य वधम् प्रति
transliteration: apramādāt ca gaṃtavyam sarvaiḥ eva niśācaraiḥ
kartavyaḥ ca sadā yatno rāghavasya vadham prati
english: Staying in Janasthāna, you shall gather true information touching Rāma as to what he is about. Repair all you rangers of the night carefully, and strive yourselves always for slaying Rāma.

sanskrit: युष्माकम् तु बलम् ज्ञातम् बहुशो रण मूर्धनि
अतः तु अस्मिन् जनस्थाने मया यूयम् नियोजिताः
transliteration: yuṣmākam tu balam jñātam bahuśo raṇa mūrdhani
ataḥ tu asmin janasthāne mayā yūyam niyojitāḥ
english: I have been well acquainted with your strength in many a field, and it is for this that I set you in Janasthāna.

sanskrit: ततः प्रियम् वाक्यम् उपेत्य राक्षसामहाअर्थम् अष्टौ अभिवाद्य रावणम्
विहाय लंकाम् सहिताः प्रतस्थिरेयतो जनस्थानम् अलक्ष्य दर्शनाः
transliteration: tataḥ priyam vākyam upetya rākṣasāmahāartham aṣṭau abhivādya rāvaṇam
vihāya laṃkām sahitāḥ pratasthireyato janasthānam alakṣya darśanāḥ
english: Hearing these agreeable and weighty words of Ravana, those Raksasas, bowing down to Rāvana, left Lankā, and in a body invisible proceeded in the direction of Janasthāna.

sanskrit: ततः तु सीताम् उपलभ्य रावणःसुसंप्रहृष्टः परिगृह्य मैथिलीम्
प्रसज्य रामेण च वैरम् उत्तमम्बभूव मोहात् मुदितः स राक्षसः
transliteration: tataḥ tu sītām upalabhya rāvaṇaḥsusaṃprahṛṣṭaḥ parigṛhya maithilīm
prasajya rāmeṇa ca vairam uttamambabhūva mohāt muditaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ
english: Having obtained Mithilā's daughter, Rāvaņa experienced great joy in establishing her (in his own house); and having created high hostility with Rāma, Rāvana through blindness rejoiced greatly.

sanskrit: संदिश्य राक्षसान् घोरान् रावणो अष्टौ महाबलान्
आत्मानम् बुद्धि वैक्लव्यात् कृत कृत्यम् अमन्यत
transliteration: saṃdiśya rākṣasān ghorān rāvaṇo aṣṭau mahābalān
ātmānam buddhi vaiklavyāt kṛta kṛtyam amanyata
english: Having commissioned those eight terrible and mighty Rākşasas, Rāvana, in consequence of perversion of sense, considered himself as crowned with success.

sanskrit: स चिंतयानो वैदेहीम् काम बाण संप्रपीडितः
प्रविवेश गृहम् रम्यम् सीताम् द्रष्टुम् अभित्वरन्
transliteration: sa ciṃtayāno vaidehīm kāma bāṇa saṃprapīḍitaḥ
praviveśa gṛham ramyam sītām draṣṭum abhitvaran
english: And brooding over Vaidehi, he, sore pierced by the shafts of Kāma, hastily entered his charming mansion, with the intention of secing Sitā.

sanskrit: स प्रविश्य तु तत् वेश्म रावणो राक्षस अधिपः
अपश्यत् राक्षसी मध्ये सीताम् दुःख परायणम्
transliteration: sa praviśya tu tat veśma rāvaṇo rākṣasa adhipaḥ
apaśyat rākṣasī madhye sītām duḥkha parāyaṇam
english: And entering that apartment, Rāvana-lord of Rākşasas-saw the distressed Sītā in the midst of the Raksasas, with a tearful countenance, oppressed with a load of grief, like to a bark sinking in the ocean through the violence of the winds; like to a doe separated from the herd of deer, and surrounded by dogs.

sanskrit: अश्रु पूर्ण मुखीम् दीनाम् शोक भार अवपीडिताम्
वायु वेगैः इव आक्रांताम् मज्जन्तीम् नावम् अर्णवे
transliteration: aśru pūrṇa mukhīm dīnām śoka bhāra avapīḍitām
vāyu vegaiḥ iva ākrāṃtām majjantīm nāvam arṇave
english: And entering that apartment, Rāvana-lord of Rākşasas-saw the distressed Sītā in the midst of the Raksasas, with a tearful countenance, oppressed with a load of grief, like to a bark sinking in the ocean through the violence of the winds; like to a doe separated from the herd of deer, and surrounded by dogs.

sanskrit: मृग यूथ परिभ्रष्टाम् मृगीम् श्वभिः इव आवृताम्
अधोगत मुखीम् सीताम् ताम् अभ्येत्य निशाचरः
transliteration: mṛga yūtha paribhraṣṭām mṛgīm śvabhiḥ iva āvṛtām
adhogata mukhīm sītām tām abhyetya niśācaraḥ

sanskrit: ताम् तु शोक वशात् दीनाम् अवशाम् राक्षस अधिपः
स बलात् दर्शयामास गृहम् देव गृह उपमम्
transliteration: tām tu śoka vaśāt dīnām avaśām rākṣasa adhipaḥ
sa balāt darśayāmāsa gṛham deva gṛha upamam

sanskrit: हर्म्य प्रासाद संबधम् स्त्री सहस्र निषेवितम्
नाना पक्षि गणैः जुष्टम् नाना रत्न समन्वितम्
transliteration: harmya prāsāda saṃbadham strī sahasra niṣevitam
nānā pakṣi gaṇaiḥ juṣṭam nānā ratna samanvitam

sanskrit: दान्तकैः तापनीयैः च स्फाटिकै राजतैः तथा
वज्र वैदूर्य चित्रैः च स्तम्भैः दृष्टि मनोरमैः
transliteration: dāntakaiḥ tāpanīyaiḥ ca sphāṭikai rājataiḥ tathā
vajra vaidūrya citraiḥ ca stambhaiḥ dṛṣṭi manoramaiḥ

sanskrit: दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषम् तप्त कांचन भूषणम्
सोपानम् कांचनम् चित्रम् आरुरोह तया सह
transliteration: divya dundubhi nirghoṣam tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇam
sopānam kāṃcanam citram āruroha tayā saha
english: Rāvana in company with Şītā ascended the beautiful golden stairs, resounding with the sounds of kettle-drums and embellished with ornaments of burnished gold.

sanskrit: दान्तका राजताः चैव गवाक्षाः प्रिय दर्शनाः
हेम जाला आवृताः च आसन् तत्र प्रासाद पंक्तयः
transliteration: dāntakā rājatāḥ caiva gavākṣāḥ priya darśanāḥ
hema jālā āvṛtāḥ ca āsan tatra prāsāda paṃktayaḥ
english: And those loftily edifices had excellent windows made of vory and silver, and covered with golden nets.

sanskrit: सुधा मणि विचित्राणि भूमि भागानि सर्वशः
transliteration: sudhā maṇi vicitrāṇi bhūmi bhāgāni sarvaśaḥ
english: The ground all over was decorated with ambrosia and gems. The Ten-headed one in his own mansion showed to Maithilī large tanks and pools covered with various kinds of flowers. (All this) Rāvaņa showed to Sítā overmastered by sorrow.

sanskrit: दीर्घिकाः पुष्करिण्यः च नाना पुष्प समावृताः
transliteration: dīrghikāḥ puṣkariṇyaḥ ca nānā puṣpa samāvṛtāḥ
english: The ground all over was decorated with ambrosia and gems. The Ten-headed one in his own mansion showed to Maithilī large tanks and pools covered with various kinds of flowers. (All this) Rāvaņa showed to Sítā overmastered by sorrow.

sanskrit: दर्शयित्वा तु वैदेहीम् कृत्स्नम् तत् भवन उत्तमम्
उवाच वाक्यम् पापात्मा सीताम् लोभितुम् इच्छया
transliteration: darśayitvā tu vaidehīm kṛtsnam tat bhavana uttamam
uvāca vākyam pāpātmā sītām lobhitum icchayā
english: And after having showed to Vaidehi the whole of that good lie of mansions, that wicked one, with the intention of tempting Sītā, spoke to her.

sanskrit: दश राक्षस कोट्यः च द्वाविंशतिः अथ अपराः
वर्जयित्वा जरा वृद्धान् बालान् च रजनीचरान्
transliteration: daśa rākṣasa koṭyaḥ ca dvāviṃśatiḥ atha aparāḥ
varjayitvā jarā vṛddhān bālān ca rajanīcarān
english: O Sītā, leaving out old men and boys, I am the lord of thirty two crore of night-rangers of terrible deeds. And a thousand come forward whenever required for any service.

sanskrit: तेषाम् प्रभुः अहम् सीते सर्वेषाम् भीम कर्मणाम्
सहस्रम् एकम् एकस्य मम कार्य पुरःसरम्
transliteration: teṣām prabhuḥ aham sīte sarveṣām bhīma karmaṇām
sahasram ekam ekasya mama kārya puraḥsaram
english: O Sītā, leaving out old men and boys, I am the lord of thirty two crore of night-rangers of terrible deeds. And a thousand come forward whenever required for any service.

sanskrit: यत् इदम् राज्य तंत्रम् मे त्वयि सर्वम् प्रतिष्ठितम्
जीवितम् च विशालाक्षि त्वम् मे प्राणैः गरीयसी
transliteration: yat idam rājya taṃtram me tvayi sarvam pratiṣṭhitam
jīvitam ca viśālākṣi tvam me prāṇaiḥ garīyasī
english: If such is my sovereignty, all this is established in you, O large-eyed lady, as well as my life. You are dearer to me than life.

sanskrit: बह्वीनाम् उत्तम स्त्रीणाम् मम यो असौ परिग्रहः
तासाम् त्वम् ईश्वरी सीते मम भार्या भव प्रिये
transliteration: bahvīnām uttama strīṇām mama yo asau parigrahaḥ
tāsām tvam īśvarī sīte mama bhāryā bhava priye
english: O Sītā, be you the mistress of those numerous excellent women who are my wives. Dear, be you my wife.

sanskrit: साधु किम् ते अन्यया बुद्ध्या रोचयस्व वचो मम
भजस्व मा अभितप्तस्य प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: sādhu kim te anyayā buddhyā rocayasva vaco mama
bhajasva mā abhitaptasya prasādam kartum arhasi
english: This is for your good. Why should you act otherwise? Do you relish my speech. Do you bend your mind towards me. It behoves you to favour me, who am burning in the heat of desire).

sanskrit: परिक्षिप्ता समुद्रेण लंका इयम् शत योजना
न इयम् धर्षयितुम् शक्या स इन्द्रैः अपि सुर असुरैः
transliteration: parikṣiptā samudreṇa laṃkā iyam śata yojanā
na iyam dharṣayitum śakyā sa indraiḥ api sura asuraiḥ
english: This Larkă measuring an hundred Yojanas girt round by the ocean, is incapable of being harassed by the celestials themselves headed by Indra.

sanskrit: न देवेषु न यक्षेषु न गंधर्वेषु न ऋषिषु
अहम् पश्यामि लोकेषु यो मे वीर्य समो भवेत्
transliteration: na deveṣu na yakṣeṣu na gaṃdharveṣu na ṛṣiṣu
aham paśyāmi lokeṣu yo me vīrya samo bhavet
english: Neither among the celestials nor Yakşãs nor Gandharvas nor Serpents, find I any one that can match me in prowess.

sanskrit: किम् करिष्यसि रामेण मानुषेण अल्प तेजसा
transliteration: kim kariṣyasi rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇa alpa tejasā
english: What will you do with Rāma a human being of short life, poor, of small prowess, practising mendicancy?

sanskrit: भजस्व सीते माम् एव भर्ता अहम् सदृशः तव
यौवनम् हि अध्रुवम् भीरु रमस्व इह मया सह
transliteration: bhajasva sīte mām eva bhartā aham sadṛśaḥ tava
yauvanam hi adhruvam bhīru ramasva iha mayā saha
english: O Sītā, bend your mind to me. I am a fit husband for you. O timed one, youth is uncertain. Sport with me here.

sanskrit: दर्शने मा कृथाः बुद्धिम् राघवस्य वरानने
का अस्य शक्तिः इह आगंतुम् अपि सीते मनोरथैः
transliteration: darśane mā kṛthāḥ buddhim rāghavasya varānane
kā asya śaktiḥ iha āgaṃtum api sīte manorathaiḥ
english: And, O you of a handsome countenance, do not wish for the sight of Rāghava. O Sītā, what power has he to come hither even in thought?

sanskrit: न शक्यो वायुः आकाशे पाशैः बद्धम् महाजवः
दीप्यमानस्य वा अपि अग्नेः ग्रहीतुम् विमलाम् शिखाम्
transliteration: na śakyo vāyuḥ ākāśe pāśaiḥ baddham mahājavaḥ
dīpyamānasya vā api agneḥ grahītum vimalām śikhām
english: None can fetter the exceedingly fleet wind in the sky, or hold the bright flame of a burning fire.

sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् न तम् पश्यामि शोभने
विक्रमेण नयेत् यः त्वाम् मत् बाहु परिपालिताम्
transliteration: trayāṇām api lokānām na tam paśyāmi śobhane
vikrameṇa nayet yaḥ tvām mat bāhu paripālitām
english: O beauteous one, in these three worlds I find no one that can by his might carry you away, who are protected by my arms.

sanskrit: लंकायाम् सुमहत् राज्यम् इदम् त्वम् अनुपालय
त्वत् प्रेष्या मत् विधा चैव देवाः च अपि चर अचरम्
transliteration: laṃkāyām sumahat rājyam idam tvam anupālaya
tvat preṣyā mat vidhā caiva devāḥ ca api cara acaram
english: Do you govern at Lankā this extensive kingdom. The like of me and celestials and all that are mobile and immobile shall be your servants.

sanskrit: अभिषेक उदक क्लिन्ना तुष्टा च रमयस्व माम्
दुष्कृतम् यत् पुरा कर्म वन वासेन तद् गतम्
transliteration: abhiṣeka udaka klinnā tuṣṭā ca ramayasva mām
duṣkṛtam yat purā karma vana vāsena tad gatam
english: Laving your limbs with water, do you gratify me. The evil that you had done, has been expiated by your life in the forest: now do you reap the fruit of your good deeds.

sanskrit: यत् च ते सुकृतो धर्मः तस्य इह फलम् आप्नुहि
इह सर्वाणि माल्यानि दिव्य गंधानि मैथिलि
transliteration: yat ca te sukṛto dharmaḥ tasya iha phalam āpnuhi
iha sarvāṇi mālyāni divya gaṃdhāni maithili

sanskrit: भूषणानि च मुख्यानि तानि सेव मया सह
पुष्पकम् नाम सुश्रोणि भ्रातुः वैश्रवणस्य मे
transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni ca mukhyāni tāni seva mayā saha
puṣpakam nāma suśroṇi bhrātuḥ vaiśravaṇasya me

sanskrit: विमानम् सूर्य संकाशम् तरसा निर्जितम् रणे
विशालम् रमणीयम् च तत् विमानम् मनो जवम्
transliteration: vimānam sūrya saṃkāśam tarasā nirjitam raṇe
viśālam ramaṇīyam ca tat vimānam mano javam

sanskrit: तत्र सीते मया सार्धम् विहरस्व यथा सुखम्
वदनम् पद्म संकाशम् विमलम् चारु दर्शनम्
transliteration: tatra sīte mayā sārdham viharasva yathā sukham
vadanam padma saṃkāśam vimalam cāru darśanam

sanskrit: शोक आर्तम् तु वरारोहे न भ्राजति वर आनने
एवम् वदति तस्मिन् सा वस्त्र अन्तेन वर अंगना
transliteration: śoka ārtam tu varārohe na bhrājati vara ānane
evam vadati tasmin sā vastra antena vara aṃganā

sanskrit: पिधाय इन्दु निभम् सीता मंदम् अश्रून् अवर्तयत्
ध्यायन्तीम् ताम् इव अस्वस्थाम् सीताम् चिंता हत प्रभाम्
transliteration: pidhāya indu nibham sītā maṃdam aśrūn avartayat
dhyāyantīm tām iva asvasthām sītām ciṃtā hata prabhām

sanskrit: उवाच वचनम् वीरो रावणो रजनी चरः
अलम् व्रीडेन वैदेहि धर्म लोप कृतेन ते
transliteration: uvāca vacanam vīro rāvaṇo rajanī caraḥ
alam vrīḍena vaidehi dharma lopa kṛtena te

sanskrit: आर्षो अयम् देवि निष्यन्दो यः त्वाम् अभिगमिष्यति
एतौ पादौ मया स्निग्धौ शिरोभिः परिपीडितौ
transliteration: ārṣo ayam devi niṣyando yaḥ tvām abhigamiṣyati
etau pādau mayā snigdhau śirobhiḥ paripīḍitau

sanskrit: प्रसादम् कुरु मे क्षिप्रम् वश्यो दासो अहम् अस्मि ते
इमाः शून्या मया वाचः शुष्यमाणेन भाषिताः
transliteration: prasādam kuru me kṣipram vaśyo dāso aham asmi te
imāḥ śūnyā mayā vācaḥ śuṣyamāṇena bhāṣitāḥ

sanskrit: न च अपि रावणः कांचित् मूर्ध्ना स्त्रीम् प्रणमेत ह
एवम् उक्त्वा दशग्रीवो मैथिलीम् जनक आत्मजाम्
कृत अन्त वशम् आपन्नो मम इयम् इति मन्यते
transliteration: na ca api rāvaṇaḥ kāṃcit mūrdhnā strīm praṇameta ha
evam uktvā daśagrīvo maithilīm janaka ātmajām
kṛta anta vaśam āpanno mama iyam iti manyate
english: Let not these words of mine spoken by me under the withering influence of love prove fruitless. Rāvana has never bowed his head to any female. Having said this, the Ten-headed one, come under the subjection of the Destroyer, looked upon Maithili, Janaka's daughter (as his own) saying, She is mine.

sanskrit: सा तथा उक्ता तु वैदेही निर्भया शोक कर्शिता
तृणम् अन्तरतः कृत्वा रावणम् प्रति अभाषत
transliteration: sā tathā uktā tu vaidehī nirbhayā śoka karśitā
tṛṇam antarataḥ kṛtvā rāvaṇam prati abhāṣata
english: Having been thus addressed, Vaidehī unaffected by fear, although exercised with grief, placing a blade of grass between herself and Rāvana, answered him.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो नाम धर्म सेतुः इव अचलः
सत्य सन्धः परिज्ञातो यस्य पुत्रः स राघवः
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma dharma setuḥ iva acalaḥ
satya sandhaḥ parijñāto yasya putraḥ sa rāghavaḥ
english: There was a king named Dasaratha, the bridge of righteousness, like to a mountain, ever bearing regard towards the truth, and renowned among men, whose son is Rāghava. He is named Rāma, and is righteous-souled and celebrated over the three worlds. he is long-armed, of expansive eyes, like to a celestial—he is my husband.

sanskrit: रामो नाम स धर्मात्मा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
दीर्घ बाहुः विशालाक्षो दैवतम् स पतिः मम
transliteration: rāmo nāma sa dharmātmā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
dīrgha bāhuḥ viśālākṣo daivatam sa patiḥ mama
english: There was a king named Dasaratha, the bridge of righteousness, like to a mountain, ever bearing regard towards the truth, and renowned among men, whose son is Rāghava. He is named Rāma, and is righteous-souled and celebrated over the three worlds. he is long-armed, of expansive eyes, like to a celestial—he is my husband.

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् कुले जातः सिंह स्कन्धो महाद्युतिः
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा यः ते प्राणान् हरिष्यति
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām kule jātaḥ siṃha skandho mahādyutiḥ
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā yaḥ te prāṇān hariṣyati
english: Born in the race of the Ikşvākus, the has the shoulders of a lion and is possessed of exceeding effulgence-the same that along with his brother, Laksmana, shall take your life. If you had wronged me forcibly in his presence, you would have slain in battle in Janasthāna even as Khara.

sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षम् यदि अहम् तस्य त्वया स्याम् धर्षिता बलात्
शयिता त्वम् हतः संख्ये जनस्थाने यथा खरः
transliteration: pratyakṣam yadi aham tasya tvayā syām dharṣitā balāt
śayitā tvam hataḥ saṃkhye janasthāne yathā kharaḥ
english: Born in the race of the Ikşvākus, the has the shoulders of a lion and is possessed of exceeding effulgence-the same that along with his brother, Laksmana, shall take your life. If you had wronged me forcibly in his presence, you would have slain in battle in Janasthāna even as Khara.

sanskrit: य एते राक्षसाः प्रोक्ता घोर रूपा महाबलाः
राघवे निर्विषाः सर्वे सुपर्णे पन्नगा यथा
transliteration: ya ete rākṣasāḥ proktā ghora rūpā mahābalāḥ
rāghave nirviṣāḥ sarve suparṇe pannagā yathā
english: All the mighty Rākşasas of grim visages, whom you have extolled (before me), shall be deprived of their venom before Rāma, as serpents are before Suparna,

sanskrit: तस्य ज्या विप्रमुक्ताः ते शराः कांचन भूषणाः
शरीरम् विधमिष्यन्ति गंगा कूलम् इव ऊर्मयः
transliteration: tasya jyā vipramuktāḥ te śarāḥ kāṃcana bhūṣaṇāḥ
śarīram vidhamiṣyanti gaṃgā kūlam iva ūrmayaḥ
english: The shafts decorated with gold shot by the bow-string of Rāghava, shall pierce their bodies, as the waves of the Ganga (beat against) her banks.

sanskrit: असुरैः वा सुरैः वा त्वम् यदि अवध्यो असि रावण
उत्पाद्य सुमहत् वैरम् जीवन् तस्य न मोक्ष्यसे
transliteration: asuraiḥ vā suraiḥ vā tvam yadi avadhyo asi rāvaṇa
utpādya sumahat vairam jīvan tasya na mokṣyase
english: Although, O Rāvana, you may be incapable of being slain either by the gods or the Asuras, yet having roused the high hostility of Rāghava, you will not be able to liberate your life.

sanskrit: स ते जीवित शेषस्य राघवो अन्त करो बली
पशोः यूप गतस्य इव जीवितम् तव दुर्लभम्
transliteration: sa te jīvita śeṣasya rāghavo anta karo balī
paśoḥ yūpa gatasya iva jīvitam tava durlabham
english: The strong Rāghava will compass the end of what remains of your life. Like the life of a beast tied to the sacrificial stake, your own is incapable of being reclaimed.

sanskrit: यदि पश्येत् स रामः त्वाम् रोष दीप्तेन चक्षुषा
रक्षः त्वम् अद्य निर्दग्धो यथा रुद्रेण मन्मधः
transliteration: yadi paśyet sa rāmaḥ tvām roṣa dīptena cakṣuṣā
rakṣaḥ tvam adya nirdagdho yathā rudreṇa manmadhaḥ
english: Should Rāma look at you with eyes aglow with anger, you, O Raksasa, would be consumed even as Manmatha was by, Rudra.

sanskrit: यः चन्द्रम् नभसो भूमौ पातयेन् नाशयेत वा
सागरम् शोषयेत् वा अपि स सीताम् मोचयेत् इह
transliteration: yaḥ candram nabhaso bhūmau pātayen nāśayeta vā
sāgaram śoṣayet vā api sa sītām mocayet iha
english: He who is able to bring down the Moon or destroy him, and to drink up the ocean dry, will surely liberate Sītā from here.

sanskrit: गत आयुः त्वम् गत श्रीकः गत सत्त्वो गत इन्द्रियः
लंका वैधव्य संयुक्ता त्वत् कृतेन भविष्यति
transliteration: gata āyuḥ tvam gata śrīkaḥ gata sattvo gata indriyaḥ
laṃkā vaidhavya saṃyuktā tvat kṛtena bhaviṣyati
english: Your days are numbered, and auspiciousness has bidden you adieu. You are shorn of strength, and your senses have been dulled. And it is owing to you that Larkā shall be subject to widowhood.

sanskrit: न ते पापम् इदम् कर्म सुख उदर्कम् भविष्यति
या अहम् नीता विना भावम् पति पार्श्वात् त्वया वनात्
transliteration: na te pāpam idam karma sukha udarkam bhaviṣyati
yā aham nītā vinā bhāvam pati pārśvāt tvayā vanāt
english: That you by force have for naught carried me away from the side of my husband-this sinful act can never conduce to your felicity.

sanskrit: स हि देवर - दैवत - संयुक्तो मम भर्ता महाद्युतिः
निर्भयो वीर्यम् आश्रित्य शून्ये वसति दण्डके
transliteration: sa hi devara - daivata - saṃyukto mama bhartā mahādyutiḥ
nirbhayo vīryam āśritya śūnye vasati daṇḍake
english: That exceedingly effulgent lord of mine along with my husband's younger brother, summoning up their energy, is fearlessly dwelling in the vacant Dandaka.

sanskrit: स ते वीर्यम् दर्पम् बलम् उत्सेकम् च तथा विधम्
transliteration: sa te vīryam darpam balam utsekam ca tathā vidham
english: By means of an arrowy shower in conflict, he will take your prowess and strength, your hauteur and wickedness out of your person,

sanskrit: यदा विनाशो भूतानाम् दृश्यते काल चोदितः
तदा कार्ये प्रमाद्यन्ति नराः काल वशम् गताः
transliteration: yadā vināśo bhūtānām dṛśyate kāla coditaḥ
tadā kārye pramādyanti narāḥ kāla vaśam gatāḥ
english: When urged by the Destroyer, the destruction of creatures is perceptible, then, coming under the sway of the Destroyer, men become careless in their actions.

sanskrit: माम् प्रधृष्य स ते कालः प्राप्तो अयम् रक्षस अधम
आत्मनो राक्षसानाम् च वधाय अन्तः पुरस्य च
transliteration: mām pradhṛṣya sa te kālaḥ prāpto ayam rakṣasa adhama
ātmano rākṣasānām ca vadhāya antaḥ purasya ca
english: Having outraged me, you, O worst of Rāks asas your time come; for compassing your own destruction as well as that of the Rākşasas and those dwelling in your inner apartment.

sanskrit: न शक्या यज्ञ मध्यस्था वेदिः स्रुक् भाण्ड मण्डिता
transliteration: na śakyā yajña madhyasthā vediḥ sruk bhāṇḍa maṇḍitā
english: A Candāla cannot tread the dais reared the midst of a sacrifice beauteous with ladies, and vessels, and sanctified by the twice-born ones.

sanskrit: तथा अहम् धर्म नित्यस्य धर्म पत्नी दृढ व्रता
त्वया संप्रष्टुम् न शक्या अहम् राक्षसाधम पापिना
transliteration: tathā aham dharma nityasya dharma patnī dṛḍha vratā
tvayā saṃpraṣṭum na śakyā aham rākṣasādhama pāpinā
english: So I, the religiously wedded wife of that one, ever intent on virtue, and (always) firm in my vows, is incapable, you vilest of Raksasas, of being touched by you, a sinner.

sanskrit: क्रीडन्ती राज हंसेन पद्म षंडेषु नित्यशः
हंसी सा तृण षण्डस्थम् कथम् द्रक्षेत मद्गुकम्
transliteration: krīḍantī rāja haṃsena padma ṣaṃḍeṣu nityaśaḥ
haṃsī sā tṛṇa ṣaṇḍastham katham drakṣeta madgukam
english: How can the female that has always ‘sported with her mate amidst lotuses, cast her eyes on a shag staying among rushes.

sanskrit: इदम् शरीरम् निःसंज्ञम् बन्ध वा घातयस्व वा
न इदम् शरीरम् रक्ष्यम् मे जीवितम् वा अपि राक्षस
transliteration: idam śarīram niḥsaṃjñam bandha vā ghātayasva vā
na idam śarīram rakṣyam me jīvitam vā api rākṣasa
english: Do you either bind or destroy this body deprived of sensation. This body will I not protect, nor yet this life, O Rāvana;

sanskrit: न तु शक्यामि उपक्रोशम् पृथिव्याम् धातुम् आत्मनः
एवम् उक्त्वा तु वैदेही क्रोद्धात् सु परुषम् वचः
transliteration: na tu śakyāmi upakrośam pṛthivyām dhātum ātmanaḥ
evam uktvā tu vaidehī kroddhāt su paruṣam vacaḥ
english: And I shall not be able to bring blame on myself in this world. having said these harsh words in wrath, Videha's daughter, Janaki, did not there again say anything to Rāvaņa.

sanskrit: रावणम् मैथिली तत्र पुनः न उवाच किंचन
सीताया वचनम् श्रुत्वा परुषम् रोम हर्षणम्
transliteration: rāvaṇam maithilī tatra punaḥ na uvāca kiṃcana
sītāyā vacanam śrutvā paruṣam roma harṣaṇam
english: Hearing Sita's words, harsh and calculated to make one's down stand on end, Rāvana answered her in words tending to excite one's apprehension,

sanskrit: प्रति उवाच ततः सीताम् भय संदर्शनम् वचः
शृणु मैथिलि मत् वाक्यम् मासान् द्वादश भामिनि
transliteration: prati uvāca tataḥ sītām bhaya saṃdarśanam vacaḥ
śṛṇu maithili mat vākyam māsān dvādaśa bhāmini

sanskrit: कालेन अनेन न अभ्येषि यदि माम् चारु हासिनि
ततः त्वाम् प्रातः आशा अर्थम् सूदाः छेत्स्यन्ति लेशशः
transliteration: kālena anena na abhyeṣi yadi mām cāru hāsini
tataḥ tvām prātaḥ āśā artham sūdāḥ chetsyanti leśaśaḥ
english: Hear, O Maithili, my words. O damsel if, O you of sweet smiles, within this time you do not turn yourself to me, the cooks shall cut you off in pieces to serve my morning mcal.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा परुषम् वाक्यम् रावणः शत्रु रावणः
राक्षसीः च ततः क्रुद्ध इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: iti uktvā paruṣam vākyam rāvaṇaḥ śatru rāvaṇaḥ
rākṣasīḥ ca tataḥ kruddha idam vacanam abravīt
english: Having herself spoken thus, Ravana-challenger of foes-growing exceedingly wroth, addressed the Rākşasis in these words,

sanskrit: शीघ्रम् एव हि राक्षस्यो विकृता घोर दर्शनाः
दर्पम् अस्या अपनेष्यन्तु मांस शोणित भोजनाः
transliteration: śīghram eva hi rākṣasyo vikṛtā ghora darśanāḥ
darpam asyā apaneṣyantu māṃsa śoṇita bhojanāḥ
english: You frightful Rākşasīs terrible to behold, subsisting on flesh and gore, do you at once crush her pride.

sanskrit: वचनात् एव ताः तस्य विकृता घोर दर्शनाः
transliteration: vacanāt eva tāḥ tasya vikṛtā ghora darśanāḥ
english: As soon as he had said this, those frightful and terrible Rākṣasīs with joined hands encircled Maithili.

sanskrit: स ताः प्रोवाच राजा तु रावणो घोर दर्शनाः
प्रचाल्य चरण उत्कर्षैः दारयन् इव मेदिनीम्
transliteration: sa tāḥ provāca rājā tu rāvaṇo ghora darśanāḥ
pracālya caraṇa utkarṣaiḥ dārayan iva medinīm
english: Then the grim-visaged king Ravana, as if riving the earth by his tread, proceeding a pace or two, said,

sanskrit: अशोक वनिका मध्ये मैथिली नीयताम् इति
तत्र इयम् रक्ष्यताम् गूढम् युष्माभिः परिवारिता
transliteration: aśoka vanikā madhye maithilī nīyatām iti
tatra iyam rakṣyatām gūḍham yuṣmābhiḥ parivāritā
english: Do you take Maithilī to the wood of Asokas. There surrounding her, do you secretly guard her; and there (sometimes) by storming, and (at other) by means of soft speech, do you all strive to bring Mithila's daughter, like a wild female elephant, under your sway.

sanskrit: तत्र एनाम् तर्जनैः घोरैः पुनः सांत्वैः च मैथिलीम्
आनयध्वम् वशम् सर्वा वन्याम् गज वधूम् इव
transliteration: tatra enām tarjanaiḥ ghoraiḥ punaḥ sāṃtvaiḥ ca maithilīm
ānayadhvam vaśam sarvā vanyām gaja vadhūm iva
english: Do you take Maithilī to the wood of Asokas. There surrounding her, do you secretly guard her; and there (sometimes) by storming, and (at other) by means of soft speech, do you all strive to bring Mithila's daughter, like a wild female elephant, under your sway.

sanskrit: इति प्रति समादिष्टा राक्षस्यो रावणेन ताः
अशोक वनिकाम् जग्मुः मैथिलीम् परिगृह्य तु
transliteration: iti prati samādiṣṭā rākṣasyo rāvaṇena tāḥ
aśoka vanikām jagmuḥ maithilīm parigṛhya tu
english: Thus commanded by Rāvana, those Rākşasis taking Maithili along with them, went to the Asoka wood, abounding with trees granting every desire, and filled with various kinds of fruits and flowers, and frequented by fowls fraught with juices at all seasons.

sanskrit: सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैर्नानापुष्पफलैर्वृताम् - यद्वा -सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः नाना पुष्प फलैः वृताम्
सर्व काल मदैः च अपि द्विजैः समुपसेविताम्
transliteration: sarvakāmaphalairvṛkṣairnānāpuṣpaphalairvṛtām - yadvā -sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ nānā puṣpa phalaiḥ vṛtām
sarva kāla madaiḥ ca api dvijaiḥ samupasevitām
english: Thus commanded by Rāvana, those Rākşasis taking Maithili along with them, went to the Asoka wood, abounding with trees granting every desire, and filled with various kinds of fruits and flowers, and frequented by fowls fraught with juices at all seasons.

sanskrit: सा तु शोक परीत अंगी मैथिली जनकात्मजा
राक्षसी वशम् आपन्ना व्याघ्रीणाम् हरिणी यथा
transliteration: sā tu śoka parīta aṃgī maithilī janakātmajā
rākṣasī vaśam āpannā vyāghrīṇām hariṇī yathā
english: And as a doe comes under the subjection of tigresses, Janaka's daughter, Maithili, her frame worked up with grief, came under the sway of the Raksasis.

sanskrit: न शर्म लभते भीरुः पाश बद्धा मृगी यथा
transliteration: na śarma labhate bhīruḥ pāśa baddhā mṛgī yathā
english: And like a female deer fast bound by a trap, Janaka's timid daughter Maithilī, agitated by the mighty grief, did not attain respite.

sanskrit: न विन्दते तत्र तु शर्म मैथिलीविरूप नेत्राभिः अतीव तर्जिता
पतिम् स्मरन्ती दयितम् च देवरम्विचेतना अभूत् भय शोक पीडिता
transliteration: na vindate tatra tu śarma maithilīvirūpa netrābhiḥ atīva tarjitā
patim smarantī dayitam ca devaramvicetanā abhūt bhaya śoka pīḍitā
english: And greatly up-braided by the fierce eyes (of the Raksasis), Maithili did not know repose; and, afflicted with grief and fear, she, remembering her beloved lord along with Lakşmaņa swooned away.

sanskrit: राक्षसम् मृग रूपेण चरन्तम् काम रूपिणम्
निहत्य रामो मारीचम् तूर्णम् पथि न्यवर्तत
