transliteration: rākṣasam mṛga rūpeṇa carantam kāma rūpiṇam
nihatya rāmo mārīcam tūrṇam pathi nyavartata
english: Killing the Rākṣasa, Mārīca assuming shapes at will and ranging in the shape of a deer, Rāma vended speedily his way.

sanskrit: क्रूर स्वरो अथ गोमायुः विननाद अस्य पृष्ठतः
transliteration: krūra svaro atha gomāyuḥ vinanāda asya pṛṣṭhataḥ
english: And as he hurried himself, eager to behold Maithilī, jackals began to howl hideously at his back.

sanskrit: स तस्य स्वरम् आज्ञाय दारुणम् रोम हर्षणम्
transliteration: sa tasya svaram ājñāya dāruṇam roma harṣaṇam
english: Hearing their harsh cries, capable of making one's hair stand on end, Rāma struck with fear at the voices of the jackals, became filled with alarm.

sanskrit: अशुभम् बत मन्ये अहम् गोमायुः वाश्यते यथा
स्वस्ति स्यात् अपि वैदेह्या राक्षसैः भक्षणम् विना
transliteration: aśubham bata manye aham gomāyuḥ vāśyate yathā
svasti syāt api vaidehyā rākṣasaiḥ bhakṣaṇam vinā
english: Ah! I consider this as inauspicious—that these jackals are crying. Escaping being devoured by the Raksasas, may fair fortune befall Vaidehi!

sanskrit: मारीचेन तु विज्ञाय स्वरम् आलक्ष्य मामकम्
विक्रुष्टम् मृग रूपेण लक्ष्मणः शृणुयात् यदि
transliteration: mārīcena tu vijñāya svaram ālakṣya māmakam
vikruṣṭam mṛga rūpeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ śṛṇuyāt yadi
english: If Laksmana should have heard the cries which Mārica, knowing my voice, and fixing on the means of harming me, uttered in the form of a deer, Saumitrī, hearing that voice, leaving Mithila's daughter and commissioned by herself, must have come near me.

sanskrit: स सौमित्रिः स्वरम् श्रुत्वा ताम् च हित्वा अथ मैथिलीम्
तया एव प्रहितः क्षिप्रम् मत् सकाशम् इह एष्यति
transliteration: sa saumitriḥ svaram śrutvā tām ca hitvā atha maithilīm
tayā eva prahitaḥ kṣipram mat sakāśam iha eṣyati
english: If Laksmana should have heard the cries which Mārica, knowing my voice, and fixing on the means of harming me, uttered in the form of a deer, Saumitrī, hearing that voice, leaving Mithila's daughter and commissioned by herself, must have come near me.

sanskrit: राक्षसैः सहितैर् नूनम् सीताया ईप्सितो वधः
कांचनः च मृगो भूत्वा व्यपनीय आश्रमात् तु माम्
transliteration: rākṣasaiḥ sahitair nūnam sītāyā īpsito vadhaḥ
kāṃcanaḥ ca mṛgo bhūtvā vyapanīya āśramāt tu mām
english: Surely, the Rākṣasas in a body are desirous of slaying Sitä. Becoming a golden deer, Mārica, having allured me far, transformed himself into a Rākşasa, as soon as he had been struck with my shafts; and exclaimed, 'Ah! Laksmana, slain am I.'

sanskrit: दूरम् नीत्वा अथ मारीचो राक्षसो अभूत् शर आहतः
हा लक्ष्मण हतो अस्मि इति यत् वाक्यम् व्यजहार ह
transliteration: dūram nītvā atha mārīco rākṣaso abhūt śara āhataḥ
hā lakṣmaṇa hato asmi iti yat vākyam vyajahāra ha
english: Surely, the Rākṣasas in a body are desirous of slaying Sitä. Becoming a golden deer, Mārica, having allured me far, transformed himself into a Rākşasa, as soon as he had been struck with my shafts; and exclaimed, 'Ah! Laksmana, slain am I.'

sanskrit: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत् द्वाभ्याम् रहिताभ्याम् मया वने
जनस्थान निमित्तम् हि कृत वैरो अस्मि राक्षसैः
transliteration: api svasti bhavet dvābhyām rahitābhyām mayā vane
janasthāna nimittam hi kṛta vairo asmi rākṣasaiḥ
english: It is doubtless, we having left (Sītā, whether all is well with her. I having raised the hostility of the Räksasas for the sake of Janasthāna;

sanskrit: निमित्तानि च घोराणि दृश्यन्ते अद्य बहूनि च
इति एवम् चिंतयन् रामः श्रुत्वा गोमायु निःस्वनम्
transliteration: nimittāni ca ghorāṇi dṛśyante adya bahūni ca
iti evam ciṃtayan rāmaḥ śrutvā gomāyu niḥsvanam
english: And many and dreadful are the omens I see (around me). Thus reflecting as he heard the howlings of the jackals, the self-possessed Rāma with hasty steps returned to the asylum.

sanskrit: आत्मनः च अपनयनम् मृग रूपेण रक्षसा
transliteration: ātmanaḥ ca apanayanam mṛga rūpeṇa rakṣasā

sanskrit: तम् दीन मानसम् दीनम् आसेदुः मृग पक्षिणः
transliteration: tam dīna mānasam dīnam āseduḥ mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ

sanskrit: सव्यम् कृत्वा महात्मानम् घोराम् च ससृजुः स्वरान्
न्यवर्तत अथ त्वरितो जवेन आश्रमम् आत्मनः
transliteration: savyam kṛtvā mahātmānam ghorām ca sasṛjuḥ svarān
nyavartata atha tvarito javena āśramam ātmanaḥ

sanskrit: ततो लक्षणम् आयान्तम् ददर्श विगत प्रभम्
ततो अविदूरे रामेण समीयाय स लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: tato lakṣaṇam āyāntam dadarśa vigata prabham
tato avidūre rāmeṇa samīyāya sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: As he was witnessing the exceedingly dreadful signs, Rāghava saw Lakşmaņa coming with a lacklustre (countenance); and Lakşmaņa came up to Rāma.

sanskrit: विषण्णः स विषण्णेन दुःखितो दुःख भागिना
संजगर्हे अथ तम् भ्राता दृष्टा लक्ष्मणम् आगतम्
transliteration: viṣaṇṇaḥ sa viṣaṇṇena duḥkhito duḥkha bhāginā
saṃjagarhe atha tam bhrātā dṛṣṭā lakṣmaṇam āgatam
english: And depressed in spirit, he was rendered still more sad by that one who, afflicted with depression shared his sorrow. And, seeing that (Laksmana) bad come, leaving Sita in that solitary wood frequented by Rākşasas, his brother fell to reprimanding him.

sanskrit: विहाय सीताम् विजने वने राक्षस सेविते
गृहीत्वा च करम् सव्यम् लक्ष्मणम् रघुनंदनः
transliteration: vihāya sītām vijane vane rākṣasa sevite
gṛhītvā ca karam savyam lakṣmaṇam raghunaṃdanaḥ

sanskrit: उवाच मधुर उदर्कम् इदम् परुषम् आर्तवत्
अहो लक्ष्मण गर्ह्यम् ते कृतम् यः त्वम् विहाय ताम्
transliteration: uvāca madhura udarkam idam paruṣam ārtavat
aho lakṣmaṇa garhyam te kṛtam yaḥ tvam vihāya tām

sanskrit: सीताम् इह आगतः सौम्य कच्चित् स्वस्ति भवेत् इति
न मे अस्ति संशयो वीर सर्वथा जनकात्मजा
transliteration: sītām iha āgataḥ saumya kaccit svasti bhavet iti
na me asti saṃśayo vīra sarvathā janakātmajā

sanskrit: विनष्टा भक्षिता वा अप राक्षसैः वन चारिभिः
अशुभानि एव भूयिष्ठम् यथा प्रादुर् भवन्ति मे
transliteration: vinaṣṭā bhakṣitā vā apa rākṣasaiḥ vana cāribhiḥ
aśubhāni eva bhūyiṣṭham yathā prādur bhavanti me

english: And, considering the many omens that take place before me, O Laksmana, I do not know whether we shall light upon welfare of Janaka's daughter Sita being alive, O best of men.

sanskrit: यथा वै मृग संघाःअ गोमायुः च भैरवम्
वाश्यन्ते शकुनाः च अपि प्रदीप्ताम् अभितो दिशम्
अपि स्वस्ति भवेत् तस्या राज पुत्र्या महाबल
transliteration: yathā vai mṛga saṃghāḥa gomāyuḥ ca bhairavam
vāśyante śakunāḥ ca api pradīptām abhito diśam
api svasti bhavet tasyā rāja putryā mahābala
english: As these multitudes of beasts and these jackals are crying frightfully in the flaming direction*, I do not know, O you of mighty strength, whether it is well with that daughter of the king. i.e. The quarter presided over by the sun, vic., the East.

sanskrit: इदम् हि रक्षो मृग संनिकाशम्प्रलोभ्य माम् दूरम् अनुप्रयातम्
हतम् कथंचित् महता श्रमेणस राक्षसो अभूत् म्रियमाण एव
transliteration: idam hi rakṣo mṛga saṃnikāśampralobhya mām dūram anuprayātam
hatam kathaṃcit mahatā śrameṇasa rākṣaso abhūt mriyamāṇa eva
english: This Rākşasa, who, wearing the shape of a deer, and, alluring me, had drawn me far, has in some sort been slain by me wiih much ado; and he became a Rāksasa at the time of his death.

sanskrit: मनः च मे दीनम् इह अप्रहृष्टम्चक्षुः च सव्यम् कुरुते विकारम्
असंशयम् लक्ष्मण न अस्ति सीताहृता मृता वा पथि वर्तते वा
transliteration: manaḥ ca me dīnam iha aprahṛṣṭamcakṣuḥ ca savyam kurute vikāram
asaṃśayam lakṣmaṇa na asti sītāhṛtā mṛtā vā pathi vartate vā
english: Yet my mind is poor and cheerless; and my left eye throbs. Doubtless, O Laksmana, Sita is not, she is either carried away, or dead, or is wandering on the way. SECITION 58

sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणम् दीनम् शून्यम् दशरथ आत्मजः
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇam dīnam śūnyam daśaratha ātmajaḥ

sanskrit: प्रस्थितम् दण्डक अरण्यम् या माम् अनुजगाम ह
क्व सा लक्ष्मण वैदेही याम् हित्वा त्वम् इह आगतः
transliteration: prasthitam daṇḍaka araṇyam yā mām anujagāma ha
kva sā lakṣmaṇa vaidehī yām hitvā tvam iha āgataḥ

sanskrit: क्व सा दुःख सहाया मे वैदेही तनु मध्यमा
transliteration: kva sā duḥkha sahāyā me vaidehī tanu madhyamā

sanskrit: याम् विना न उत्सहे वीर मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम्
क्व सा प्राण सहाया मे सीता सुर सुत उपमा
transliteration: yām vinā na utsahe vīra muhūrtam api jīvitum
kva sā prāṇa sahāyā me sītā sura suta upamā

sanskrit: पतित्वम् अमराणाम् वा पृथिव्याः च अपि लक्ष्मण
विना ताम् तपनीय आभाम् न इच्छेयम् जनक आत्मजाम्
transliteration: patitvam amarāṇām vā pṛthivyāḥ ca api lakṣmaṇa
vinā tām tapanīya ābhām na iccheyam janaka ātmajām

sanskrit: कच्चित् जीवति वैदेही प्राणैः प्रियतरा मम
कच्चित् प्रव्राजनम् वीर न मे मिथ्या भविष्यति
transliteration: kaccit jīvati vaidehī prāṇaiḥ priyatarā mama
kaccit pravrājanam vīra na me mithyā bhaviṣyati

sanskrit: सीता निमित्तम् सौमित्रे मृते मयि गते त्वयि
कच्चित् स कामा सुखिता कैकेयी सा भविष्यति
transliteration: sītā nimittam saumitre mṛte mayi gate tvayi
kaccit sa kāmā sukhitā kaikeyī sā bhaviṣyati

sanskrit: स पुत्र राज्याम् सिद्ध अर्थाम् मृत पुत्रा तपस्विनी
उपस्थास्यति कौसल्या कच्चित् सौम्येन - सौम्य न - कैकयीम्
transliteration: sa putra rājyām siddha arthām mṛta putrā tapasvinī
upasthāsyati kausalyā kaccit saumyena - saumya na - kaikayīm

sanskrit: यदि जीवति वैदेही गमिष्याम्य् आश्रमम् पुनः
सुवृत्ता यदि वृत्ता सा प्राणान् त्यक्ष्यामि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: yadi jīvati vaidehī gamiṣyāmy āśramam punaḥ
suvṛttā yadi vṛttā sā prāṇān tyakṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa

sanskrit: यदि माम् आश्रम गतम् वैदेही न अभिभाषते
transliteration: yadi mām āśrama gatam vaidehī na abhibhāṣate

sanskrit: ब्रूहि लक्ष्मण वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा
त्वयि प्रमत्ते रक्षोभिः भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी
transliteration: brūhi lakṣmaṇa vaidehī yadi jīvati vā na vā
tvayi pramatte rakṣobhiḥ bhakṣitā vā tapasvinī

sanskrit: सुकुमारी च बाला च नित्यम् च अदुःख दर्शिनी
मत् वियोगेन वैदेही व्यक्तम् शोचति दुर्मनाः
transliteration: sukumārī ca bālā ca nityam ca aduḥkha darśinī
mat viyogena vaidehī vyaktam śocati durmanāḥ

sanskrit: वदता लक्ष्मण इति उच्Cऐः तव अपि जनितम् भयम्
transliteration: vadatā lakṣmaṇa iti ucaiḥ tava api janitam bhayam

sanskrit: श्रुतः च मन्ये वैदेह्या स स्वरः सदृशो मम
त्रस्तया प्रेषितः त्वम् च द्रष्टुम् माम् शीघ्रम् आगतः
transliteration: śrutaḥ ca manye vaidehyā sa svaraḥ sadṛśo mama
trastayā preṣitaḥ tvam ca draṣṭum mām śīghram āgataḥ

sanskrit: सर्वथा तु कृतम् कष्टम् सीताम् उत्सृजता वने
transliteration: sarvathā tu kṛtam kaṣṭam sītām utsṛjatā vane

sanskrit: दुःखिताः खर घातेन राक्षसाः पिशित अशनाः
तैः सीता निहता घोरैः भविष्यति न संशयः
transliteration: duḥkhitāḥ khara ghātena rākṣasāḥ piśita aśanāḥ
taiḥ sītā nihatā ghoraiḥ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: अहो अस्मि व्यसने मग्नः सर्वथा रिपु नाशन
किम् तु इदानीम् करिष्यामि शंके प्राप्तव्यम् ईदृशम्
transliteration: aho asmi vyasane magnaḥ sarvathā ripu nāśana
kim tu idānīm kariṣyāmi śaṃke prāptavyam īdṛśam

sanskrit: इति सीताम् वरारोहाम् चिंतयन् एव राघवः
आजगाम जन स्थानम् त्वरया सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: iti sītām varārohām ciṃtayan eva rāghavaḥ
ājagāma jana sthānam tvarayā saha lakṣmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: विगर्हमाणो अनुजम् आर्त रूपम्क्षुधा श्रमेण एव पिपासया च
विनिःश्वसन् शुष्क मुखो विषण्णःप्रतिश्रयम् प्राप्य समीक्ष्य शून्यम्
transliteration: vigarhamāṇo anujam ārta rūpamkṣudhā śrameṇa eva pipāsayā ca
viniḥśvasan śuṣka mukho viṣaṇṇaḥpratiśrayam prāpya samīkṣya śūnyam

sanskrit: स्वम् आश्रमम् स प्रविगाह्य वीरोविहार देशान् अनुसृत्य कांश्चित्
एतत् तत् इति एव निवास भूमौप्रहृष्ट रोमा व्यथितो बभूव
transliteration: svam āśramam sa pravigāhya vīrovihāra deśān anusṛtya kāṃścit
etat tat iti eva nivāsa bhūmauprahṛṣṭa romā vyathito babhūva

sanskrit: परिपप्रच्छ सौमित्रिम् रामो दुःख अर्दितः पुनः
transliteration: paripapraccha saumitrim rāmo duḥkha arditaḥ punaḥ
english: Then coming out of the hermitage, Raghu's descendant, Rāma, after a while, from grief, spoke these words to the son of Sumitrā,

sanskrit: तम् उवाच किम् अर्थम् त्वम् आगतो अपास्य मैथिलीम्
यदा सा तव विश्वासात् वने विहरिता मया
transliteration: tam uvāca kim artham tvam āgato apāsya maithilīm
yadā sā tava viśvāsāt vane viharitā mayā
english: When confiding myself in you, I had left Maithilī with you in the wood, why then did you go out, leaving her behind?

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा एव अभ्यागतम् त्वाम् मे मैथिलीम् त्यज्य लक्ष्मण
शंकमानम् महत् पापम् यत् सत्यम् व्यथितम् मनः
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā eva abhyāgatam tvām me maithilīm tyajya lakṣmaṇa
śaṃkamānam mahat pāpam yat satyam vyathitam manaḥ
english: O Laksmana, directly I saw you approach, renouncing Maithilī, my mind, apprehending great wrong, became really aggrieved.

sanskrit: स्फुरते नयनम् सव्यम् बाहुः च हृदयम् च मे
दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मण दूरे त्वाम् सीता विरहितम् पथि
transliteration: sphurate nayanam savyam bāhuḥ ca hṛdayam ca me
dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇa dūre tvām sītā virahitam pathi
english: O Lakşmaņa, seeing you coming at a distance, renouncing her, my left eye and arm as well as my heart keep throbbing.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सौमित्रिः लक्ष्मणः शुभ लक्षणः
भूयो दुःख संआविष्टो दुःखितम् रामम् अब्रवी
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu saumitriḥ lakṣmaṇaḥ śubha lakṣaṇaḥ
bhūyo duḥkha saṃāviṣṭo duḥkhitam rāmam abravī
english: Thus accosted, Laksmana having auspicious signs, afflicted with great grief, said to the aggrieved Rāma,

sanskrit: न स्वयम् काम कारेण ताम् त्यक्त्वा अहम् इह आगतः
प्रचोदितस्तयैवोग्रैत्वत्सकाशमिहाअगतः - यद्वा -प्रचोदितः तया एव उग्रैः त्वत् सकाशम् इह आगतः
transliteration: na svayam kāma kāreṇa tām tyaktvā aham iha āgataḥ
pracoditastayaivograitvatsakāśamihāagataḥ - yadvā -pracoditaḥ tayā eva ugraiḥ tvat sakāśam iha āgataḥ
english: I have not come hither, of my own accord, renouncing Sītā; but I have come to you, having been urged thereto by herself with rudeness.

sanskrit: आर्येण एव परिक्रुष्टम् - पराक्रुष्टम् - हा सीते लक्ष्मण इति च
परित्राहि इति यत् वाक्यम् मैथिल्याः तत् श्रुतिम् गतम्
transliteration: āryeṇa eva parikruṣṭam - parākruṣṭam - hā sīte lakṣmaṇa iti ca
paritrāhi iti yat vākyam maithilyāḥ tat śrutim gatam
english: The cries of O Laksimana, save me, as if uttered by the master, came to the ears of Maithili.

sanskrit: सा तम् आर्त स्वरम् श्रुत्वा तव स्नेहेन मैथिली
गच्छ गच्छ इति माम् आह रुदन्ती भय - विक्लवा - विह्वला
transliteration: sā tam ārta svaram śrutvā tava snehena maithilī
gaccha gaccha iti mām āha rudantī bhaya - viklavā - vihvalā
english: Hearing those distressful accents, Maithili from affection [for you], breaking out into lamentations, and overwhelmed with fear, spoke to me, Off, off.

sanskrit: प्रचोद्यमानेन मया गच्छ इति बहुशः तया
प्रत्युक्ता मैथिली वाक्यम् इदम् तत् प्रत्यय अन्वितम्
transliteration: pracodyamānena mayā gaccha iti bahuśaḥ tayā
pratyuktā maithilī vākyam idam tat pratyaya anvitam
english: On being repeatedly urged, with Go, answered Maithili in these words, tending to inspire her confidence.

sanskrit: न तत् पश्यामि अहम् रक्षो यत् अस्य भयम् आवहेत्
निर्वृता भव न अस्ति एतत् केन अपि एवम् उदाहृतम्
transliteration: na tat paśyāmi aham rakṣo yat asya bhayam āvahet
nirvṛtā bhava na asti etat kena api evam udāhṛtam
english: I do not see such a Rākṣasa, as can excite his fear. Do you desist. These cries do not come from him; but must have been uttered by someone else.

sanskrit: विगर्हितम् च नीचम् च कथम् आर्यो अभिधास्यति
त्राहि इति वचनम् सीते यः त्रायेत् त्रिदशान् अपि
transliteration: vigarhitam ca nīcam ca katham āryo abhidhāsyati
trāhi iti vacanam sīte yaḥ trāyet tridaśān api
english: How can he that can rescue the celestials themselves, utter, O Sītā, such a blame-worthy and base word as-save me?

sanskrit: किम् निमित्तम् तु केन अपि भ्रातुः आलंब्य मे स्वरम्
विस्वरम् व्याहृतम् वाक्यम् लक्ष्मण त्राहि माम् इति
transliteration: kim nimittam tu kena api bhrātuḥ ālaṃbya me svaram
visvaram vyāhṛtam vākyam lakṣmaṇa trāhi mām iti
english: Some one for some purpose, assuming my brother's voice, is crying-O Laksmana, save me.

sanskrit: राक्षसेन ईरितम् वाक्यम् त्रसात् त्राहि इति शोभने
न भवत्या व्यथा कार्या कुनारी जन सेविता
transliteration: rākṣasena īritam vākyam trasāt trāhi iti śobhane
na bhavatyā vyathā kāryā kunārī jana sevitā
english: O beauteous lady, these words, save memust have been uttered by some Rākşasa from fear. You should not act like a mean woman.

sanskrit: अलम् वैक्लवताम् गंतुम् स्वस्था भव निर् उत्सुका
न च अस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु पुमान् यो राघवम् रणे
transliteration: alam vaiklavatām gaṃtum svasthā bhava nir utsukā
na ca asti triṣu lokeṣu pumān yo rāghavam raṇe
english: Do not be over-whelmed; and banish your anxiety. There breathes no person, nor yet shall there be born any one in these three worlds who in the field shall vanquish Rāghava in fight. Rāghava is incapable of being beaten in battle by the very gods headed by Indra.'

sanskrit: जातो वा जायमानो वा संयुगे यः पराजयेत्
अजेयो राघवो युद्धे देवैः शक्र पुरोगमैः
transliteration: jāto vā jāyamāno vā saṃyuge yaḥ parājayet
ajeyo rāghavo yuddhe devaiḥ śakra purogamaiḥ
english: Do not be over-whelmed; and banish your anxiety. There breathes no person, nor yet shall there be born any one in these three worlds who in the field shall vanquish Rāghava in fight. Rāghava is incapable of being beaten in battle by the very gods headed by Indra.'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही परिमोहित चेतना
उवाच अश्रूणि मुंचन्ती दारुणम् माम् इदम् वचः
transliteration: evam uktā tu vaidehī parimohita cetanā
uvāca aśrūṇi muṃcantī dāruṇam mām idam vacaḥ
english: Thus addressed (by me) Vaidehi, deprived of her sense, shedding tears, spoke to me these cruel words,

sanskrit: भावो मयि तव अत्यर्थम् पाप एव निवेशितः
विनष्टे भ्रातरि प्राप्तुम् न च त्वम् माम् अवाप्स्यसि
transliteration: bhāvo mayi tava atyartham pāpa eva niveśitaḥ
vinaṣṭe bhrātari prāptum na ca tvam mām avāpsyasi
english: You cherish the vile idea that on your brother perishing, you shall come by me; but me you shall never have.

sanskrit: क्रोशन्तम् हि यथा अत्यर्थम् न एनम् अभ्यवपद्यसे
transliteration: krośantam hi yathā atyartham na enam abhyavapadyase
english: As you do not go to him albeit he is crying loudly (for help), you follow Rāma in consonance with a hint from Bharata.

sanskrit: रिपुः प्रच्छन्न चारी त्वम् मत् अर्थम् अनुगच्छसि
राघवस्य अन्तर प्रेप्सुः तथा एनम् न अभिपद्यसे
transliteration: ripuḥ pracchanna cārī tvam mat artham anugacchasi
rāghavasya antara prepsuḥ tathā enam na abhipadyase
english: A foe going about in disguise, you follow Rāma for my sake, prying into Rāghava's draw backs; and it is for this that you do not go (to him)?

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो हि वैदेह्या संरब्धो रक्त लोचनः
transliteration: evam ukto hi vaidehyā saṃrabdho rakta locanaḥ
english: Thus accosted by Vaidehi, I, with eyes reddened in wrath, and my nether lip swollen in ire, rushed out of the asylum.

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् रामः संताप मोहितः
अब्रवीत् दुष्कृतम् सौम्य ताम् विना यत् त्वम् आगतः
transliteration: evam bruvāṇam saumitrim rāmaḥ saṃtāpa mohitaḥ
abravīt duṣkṛtam saumya tām vinā yat tvam āgataḥ
english: When Saumitri had spoken thus, Rāma transported by grief; said to Laksmana, O gentle one, you have done wrong in having come out hither without her.

sanskrit: जानन् अपि समर्थम् माम् रक्षसाम् अपवारणे
अनेन क्रोध वाक्येन मैथिल्या निर्गतो भवान्
transliteration: jānan api samartham mām rakṣasām apavāraṇe
anena krodha vākyena maithilyā nirgato bhavān
english: Although you knew (full well) that I was able to withstand the Rākşasas, yet did you sally out at the angry words of Mithila's daughter.

sanskrit: न हि ते परितुष्यामि त्यक्त्वा यत् यासि मैथिलीम्
क्रुद्धायाः परुषम् श्रुत्वा स्त्रिया यत् त्वम् इह आगतः
transliteration: na hi te parituṣyāmi tyaktvā yat yāsi maithilīm
kruddhāyāḥ paruṣam śrutvā striyā yat tvam iha āgataḥ
english: I am not pleased with you that hearing her harsh speech spoken in wrath, you have come hither, leaving Vaidehi behind.

sanskrit: सर्वथा तु अपनीतम् ते सीतया यत् प्रचोदितः
क्रोधस्य वशम् आगम्य न अकरोः शासनम् मम
transliteration: sarvathā tu apanītam te sītayā yat pracoditaḥ
krodhasya vaśam āgamya na akaroḥ śāsanam mama
english: You have every way done wrong in not acting out my mandate in consequence of being urged by Sītā, and under the influence of indignation.

sanskrit: असौ हि राक्षसः शेते शरेण अभिहतो मया
मृग रूपेण येन अहम् आश्रमात् अपवाहितः
transliteration: asau hi rākṣasaḥ śete śareṇa abhihato mayā
mṛga rūpeṇa yena aham āśramāt apavāhitaḥ
english: That Rākṣasa lie low, being wounded by my shafts—that had drawn me away from the asylum wearing the form of a deer.

sanskrit: विकृष्य चापम् परिधाय सायकम्स लील बाणेन च ताडितो मया
मार्गीम् तनुम् त्यज्य च विक्लव स्वरोबभूव केयूर धरः स राक्षसः
transliteration: vikṛṣya cāpam paridhāya sāyakamsa līla bāṇena ca tāḍito mayā
mārgīm tanum tyajya ca viklava svarobabhūva keyūra dharaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ
english: I hit him stretching my brow slightly and fixing the shaft on it; when, renouncing his deerform he became a Rākṣasa wearing a bracelet and began to emit distressful shrieks.

sanskrit: शर आहतेन एव तदा आर्तया गिरास्वरम् मम आलंब्य सु दूर सु श्रवम्
उदाहृतम् तत् वचनम् सु दारुणम्त्वम् आगतो येन विहाय मैथिलीम्
transliteration: śara āhatena eva tadā ārtayā girāsvaram mama ālaṃbya su dūra su śravam
udāhṛtam tat vacanam su dāruṇamtvam āgato yena vihāya maithilīm
english: Wounded by my shaft, he, assuming my voice, and in accents capable of being heard from far, uttered those dreadful words fraught with dole, hearing which, you have come hither, renouncing Mithilā's daughter.

sanskrit: भृशम् आव्रजमानस्य तस्य अधो वाम लोचनम्
प्रास्फुरत् च अस्खलत् रामो वेपथुः च अस्य जायते
transliteration: bhṛśam āvrajamānasya tasya adho vāma locanam
prāsphurat ca askhalat rāmo vepathuḥ ca asya jāyate
english: As Rāma went on, his feet failed him, his left eye to beat, and a trembling came over his frame.

sanskrit: उपालक्ष्य निमित्तानि सो अशुभानि मुहुर् मुहुः
अपि क्षेमम् तु सीताया इति वै व्याजहार ह
transliteration: upālakṣya nimittāni so aśubhāni muhur muhuḥ
api kṣemam tu sītāyā iti vai vyājahāra ha
english: Seeing again and again all these signs, he continually kept on asking (Lakşmaņa), Is it well with Sita?

sanskrit: त्वरमाणो जगाम अथ सीता दर्शन लालसः
शून्यम् आवसथम् दृष्ट्वा बभूव उद्विग्न मानसः
transliteration: tvaramāṇo jagāma atha sītā darśana lālasaḥ
śūnyam āvasatham dṛṣṭvā babhūva udvigna mānasaḥ
english: Eager to behold Sītā, he proceeded fast; but finding the abode empty, he was filled with anxiety.

sanskrit: उद् भ्रमन् इव वेगेन विक्षिपन् रघु नन्दनः
तत्र तत्र उटज स्थानम् अभिवीक्ष्य समंततः
transliteration: ud bhraman iva vegena vikṣipan raghu nandanaḥ
tatra tatra uṭaja sthānam abhivīkṣya samaṃtataḥ
english: And proceeding with swiftness, throwing about his limbs, Raghu's son began to survey all around the hut. He then found it empty of Sītā, like to a tank in evil plight and bereft of lotuses-during the winter.

sanskrit: ददर्श पर्ण शालाम् च सीतया रहिताम् तदा
श्रिया विरहिताम् ध्वस्ताम् हेमन्ते पद्मिनीम् इव
transliteration: dadarśa parṇa śālām ca sītayā rahitām tadā
śriyā virahitām dhvastām hemante padminīm iva
english: And proceeding with swiftness, throwing about his limbs, Raghu's son began to survey all around the hut. He then found it empty of Sītā, like to a tank in evil plight and bereft of lotuses-during the winter.

sanskrit: रुदन्तम् इव वृक्षैः च ग्लान पुष्प मृग द्विजम्
श्रिया विहीनम् विध्वस्तम् संत्यक्त वन दैवतैः
transliteration: rudantam iva vṛkṣaiḥ ca glāna puṣpa mṛga dvijam
śriyā vihīnam vidhvastam saṃtyakta vana daivataiḥ
english: And seeing the cottage empty, with its trees as if sorrowing, and its flowers faded, and its beasts and birds sunk in gloom, shorn of grace, worn out, forsaken by the sylvan deities, strewn with deer-skins and Kusa, and twists of Kasa, he wept again and again.

sanskrit: विप्रकीर्ण अजिन कुशम् विप्रविद्ध बृसी कटम्
दृष्ट्वा शून्य उटज स्थानम् विललाप पुनः पुनः
transliteration: viprakīrṇa ajina kuśam vipraviddha bṛsī kaṭam
dṛṣṭvā śūnya uṭaja sthānam vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ
english: And seeing the cottage empty, with its trees as if sorrowing, and its flowers faded, and its beasts and birds sunk in gloom, shorn of grace, worn out, forsaken by the sylvan deities, strewn with deer-skins and Kusa, and twists of Kasa, he wept again and again.

sanskrit: हृता मृता वा नष्टा वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति
निलीना अपि अथवा भीरुः अथवा वनम् आश्रिता
transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā naṣṭā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati
nilīnā api athavā bhīruḥ athavā vanam āśritā
english: Has the timid one been carried off, or is she dead, or has any one eaten her up, or has she vanished (from the earth), or has she gone to the wood, or has she gone to cull flowers and fruits, or has she gone to the pool for procuring water, or has she repaired to the river?

sanskrit: गता विचेतुम् पुष्पाणि फलानि अपि च वा पुनः
अथवा पद्मिनीम् याता जल अर्थम् वा नदीम् गता
transliteration: gatā vicetum puṣpāṇi phalāni api ca vā punaḥ
athavā padminīm yātā jala artham vā nadīm gatā
english: Has the timid one been carried off, or is she dead, or has any one eaten her up, or has she vanished (from the earth), or has she gone to the wood, or has she gone to cull flowers and fruits, or has she gone to the pool for procuring water, or has she repaired to the river?

sanskrit: यत्नात् मृगयमाणः तु न आससाद वने प्रियाम्
शोक रक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते
transliteration: yatnāt mṛgayamāṇaḥ tu na āsasāda vane priyām
śoka rakta īkṣaṇaḥ śrīmān unmatta iva lakṣyate
english: Although he searched his beloved one carefully, yet he failed to find her out in the wood-land. And that graceful one with his eyes reddened with grief, seemed like a maniac

sanskrit: वृक्षात् वृक्षम् प्रधावन् स गिरीम् च अपि नदी नदम्
बभ्राम विलपन् रामः शोक पंक अर्णव प्लुतः
transliteration: vṛkṣāt vṛkṣam pradhāvan sa girīm ca api nadī nadam
babhrāma vilapan rāmaḥ śoka paṃka arṇava plutaḥ
english: He rushed from tree to tree, and bewailing being sunk in an ocean of grief traversed all the rivers and mountains.

sanskrit: अस्ति कच्चित् त्वया दृष्टा सा कदम्ब प्रिया प्रिया
कदम्ब यदि जानीषे शंस सीताम् शुभ आननाम्
transliteration: asti kaccit tvayā dṛṣṭā sā kadamba priyā priyā
kadamba yadi jānīṣe śaṃsa sītām śubha ānanām
english: O Kadamba, have you seen where is that one fond of Kadamba groves? If know you this do you tell me of Sītā having an auspicious countenance. O Bilva, tell me pray, if you have seen her, wearing silken cloth, resembling cool leaves and having breast like to Bilva fruits.

sanskrit: स्निग्ध पल्लव संकाशाम् पीत कौशेय वासिनीम्
शंसस्व यदि सा दृष्टा बिल्व बिल्व उपम स्तनी
transliteration: snigdha pallava saṃkāśām pīta kauśeya vāsinīm
śaṃsasva yadi sā dṛṣṭā bilva bilva upama stanī
english: O Kadamba, have you seen where is that one fond of Kadamba groves? If know you this do you tell me of Sītā having an auspicious countenance. O Bilva, tell me pray, if you have seen her, wearing silken cloth, resembling cool leaves and having breast like to Bilva fruits.

sanskrit: अथवा अर्जुन शंस त्वम् प्रियाम् ताम् अर्जुन प्रियाम्
जनकस्य सुता तन्वी यदि जीवति वा न वा
transliteration: athavā arjuna śaṃsa tvam priyām tām arjuna priyām
janakasya sutā tanvī yadi jīvati vā na vā
english: Or, O Aryunā, she was very fond of you, tell me if live that daughter of Janaka of slender frame.

sanskrit: ककुभः ककुभ ऊरुम् ताम् व्यक्तम् जानाति मैथिलीम्
लता पल्लव पुष्प आढ्यो भाति हि एष वनस्पतिः
transliteration: kakubhaḥ kakubha ūrum tām vyaktam jānāti maithilīm
latā pallava puṣpa āḍhyo bhāti hi eṣa vanaspatiḥ
english: This Kakubha know for certain about Maithilī having thighs like to Kakubha. You stands beautifully that Vanaspati being enveloped with creepers flowers and leaves and filled with the hum of Bhramaras. Surely dose this Tilaka know about her who was fond of her.

sanskrit: भ्रमरैर् उपगीतः च यथा द्रुम वरो हि असि
एष व्यक्तम् विजानाति तिलकः तिलक प्रियाम्
transliteration: bhramarair upagītaḥ ca yathā druma varo hi asi
eṣa vyaktam vijānāti tilakaḥ tilaka priyām
english: This Kakubha know for certain about Maithilī having thighs like to Kakubha. You stands beautifully that Vanaspati being enveloped with creepers flowers and leaves and filled with the hum of Bhramaras. Surely dose this Tilaka know about her who was fond of her.

sanskrit: अशोक शोक अपनुद शोक उपहत चेतनम्
त्वन् नामानम् कुरु क्षिप्रम् प्रिया संदर्शनेन माम्
transliteration: aśoka śoka apanuda śoka upahata cetanam
tvan nāmānam kuru kṣipram priyā saṃdarśanena mām
english: O Asoka, who dose remove sorrows, do you make good your name by making me, who am exercised with grief, see instantly my beloved (spouse).

sanskrit: यदि ताल त्वया दृष्टा पक्व ताल फल स्तनी
कथयस्व वरारोहाम् कारुण्यम् यदि ते मयि
transliteration: yadi tāla tvayā dṛṣṭā pakva tāla phala stanī
kathayasva varārohām kāruṇyam yadi te mayi
english: O Tāla, if you have any pity on me do you tell me whether you have beheld that fair damsel having breast resembling ripe Tāla fruits.

sanskrit: यदि दृष्टा त्वया सीता जम्बो जांबूनद सम प्रभा
प्रियाम् यदि विजानासि निःशंक कथयस्व मे
transliteration: yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā sītā jambo jāṃbūnada sama prabhā
priyām yadi vijānāsi niḥśaṃka kathayasva me
english: Do you tell me without fear, O Jāmbu, if you have seen my dear one resembling in hue the river Jāmbu.

sanskrit: अहो त्वम् कर्णिकार अद्य पुष्पितः शोभसे भृशम्
कर्णिकार प्रियाम् साध्वीम् शंस दृष्टा यदि प्रिया
transliteration: aho tvam karṇikāra adya puṣpitaḥ śobhase bhṛśam
karṇikāra priyām sādhvīm śaṃsa dṛṣṭā yadi priyā
english: O Karnikar, you appear very beautiful with this blossoming flowers, tell me if you have seen my dear devoted wife who was fond of you.

sanskrit: चूत नीप महा सालान् पनसान् कुरवान् धवान्
दाडिमान् अपि तान् गत्वा दृष्ट्वा रामो महायशाः
transliteration: cūta nīpa mahā sālān panasān kuravān dhavān
dāḍimān api tān gatvā dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahāyaśāḥ
english: Thus the highly famous Rāma asking about Sītā, nearing the various trees such as mangoes, Nipa, Mahaśālā, Panasa, Kurava, Pomegranate, Bakula, Punnaga, Sandal and Ketak began to traverse the forest like a maniac.

sanskrit: बकुलान् अथ पुन्नागान् च चंदनान्केतकान् तथा
पृच्छन् रामो वने भ्रान्त उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते
transliteration: bakulān atha punnāgān ca caṃdanānketakān tathā
pṛcchan rāmo vane bhrānta unmatta iva lakṣyate
english: Thus the highly famous Rāma asking about Sītā, nearing the various trees such as mangoes, Nipa, Mahaśālā, Panasa, Kurava, Pomegranate, Bakula, Punnaga, Sandal and Ketak began to traverse the forest like a maniac.

sanskrit: अथवा मृग शाब अक्षीम् मृग जानासि मैथिलीम्
मृग विप्रेक्षणी कांता मृगीभिः सहिता भवेत्
transliteration: athavā mṛga śāba akṣīm mṛga jānāsi maithilīm
mṛga viprekṣaṇī kāṃtā mṛgībhiḥ sahitā bhavet
english: Again addressed he the diverse animals-O dear, know you for certain about Janakī having the eyes of a doe; is she engaged in play with the does?

sanskrit: गज सा गज नासोरुः यदि दृष्टा त्वया भवेत्
ताम् मन्ये विदिताम् तुभ्यम् आख्याहि वर वारण
transliteration: gaja sā gaja nāsoruḥ yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā bhavet
tām manye viditām tubhyam ākhyāhi vara vāraṇa
english: O elephant, methinks you do know about the daughter of Janaka having thighs resembling your trunk; pray tell me if you have beheld her.

sanskrit: शार्दूल यदि सा दृष्टा प्रिया चंद्र निभ आनना
मैथिली मम विस्रब्धम् कथयस्व न ते भयम्
transliteration: śārdūla yadi sā dṛṣṭā priyā caṃdra nibha ānanā
maithilī mama visrabdham kathayasva na te bhayam
english: O tiger, fearlessly do you relate to me if you have seen my beloved Maithilī, having a countenance resembling Moon.

sanskrit: किम् धावसि प्रिये नूनम् दृष्टा असि कमल ईक्षणे
वृक्षेण आच्चाद्य च आत्मानम् किम् माम् न प्रतिभाषसे
transliteration: kim dhāvasi priye nūnam dṛṣṭā asi kamala īkṣaṇe
vṛkṣeṇa āccādya ca ātmānam kim mām na pratibhāṣase
english: O dear! O you having eyes like to lotuses! why do you fly away? Surely have I seen you. Why do you not address me hiding yourself behind the tree?

sanskrit: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ वरारोहे न ते अस्ति करुणा मयि
न अत्यर्थम् हास्य शीला असि किम् अर्थम् माम् उपेक्षसे
transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha varārohe na te asti karuṇā mayi
na atyartham hāsya śīlā asi kim artham mām upekṣase
english: Wait, wait, O you fair damsel, you have no compassion for me! Never had you mock me before in this way! Why do you neglect me now?

sanskrit: पीत कौशेयकेन असि सूचिता वर वर्णिनि
धावन्ति अपि मया दृष्टा तिष्ठ यदि अस्ति सौहृदम्
transliteration: pīta kauśeyakena asi sūcitā vara varṇini
dhāvanti api mayā dṛṣṭā tiṣṭha yadi asti sauhṛdam
english: O exquisitely fair damsel, truly have I found you out from this your yellow silken cloth. I have seen you flying away. Stand if you have any love for me.

sanskrit: न एव सा नूनम् अथवा हिंसिता चारु हासिनी
कृच्छ्रम् प्राप्तम् न माम् नूनम् यथा उपेक्षितुम् अर्हति
transliteration: na eva sā nūnam athavā hiṃsitā cāru hāsinī
kṛcchram prāptam na mām nūnam yathā upekṣitum arhati
english: Or, O you having a sweet smile, you are not she; truly you have been killed or else you would not have neglected me at this time of dire affliction.

sanskrit: व्यक्तम् सा भक्षिता बाला राक्षसैः पिशित अशनैः
विभज्य अंगानि सर्वाणि मया विरहिता प्रिया
transliteration: vyaktam sā bhakṣitā bālā rākṣasaiḥ piśita aśanaiḥ
vibhajya aṃgāni sarvāṇi mayā virahitā priyā
english: True it is that she has been devoured in my absence by the Rākşasas living on flesh having torn into pieces her limbs.

sanskrit: नूनम् तत् शुभ दंत ओष्ठम् सुनासम् शुभ कुण्डलम्
पूर्ण चंद्र निभम् ग्रस्तम् मुखम् निष्प्रभताम् गतम्
transliteration: nūnam tat śubha daṃta oṣṭham sunāsam śubha kuṇḍalam
pūrṇa caṃdra nibham grastam mukham niṣprabhatām gatam
english: Truly has her face, resembling the full-moon, having beautiful teeth a fine nose and white Kundalas, become of pale countenance being brought under the possession of the Rākșasas.

sanskrit: सा हि चंपक वर्ण आभा ग्रीवा ग्रैवेयक उचिता
कोमला विलपन्त्याः तु कान्ताया भक्षिता शुभा
transliteration: sā hi caṃpaka varṇa ābhā grīvā graiveyaka ucitā
komalā vilapantyāḥ tu kāntāyā bhakṣitā śubhā
english: Her neck had the hue of sandal and was adorned with necklace—that beautiful tender neck was eaten up by the Rākşasas, my beloved wife wailing.

sanskrit: नूनम् विक्षिप्यमाणौ तौ बाहू पल्लव कोमलौ
भक्षितौ वेपमान अग्रौ स हस्त आभरण अंगदौ
transliteration: nūnam vikṣipyamāṇau tau bāhū pallava komalau
bhakṣitau vepamāna agrau sa hasta ābharaṇa aṃgadau
english: Her arms were tender like leaves and adorned with various ornaments; truly have the Rākşasas eaten them up, shaken as they were, by throwing them here and there.

sanskrit: मया विरहिता बाला रक्षसाम् भक्षणाय वै
सार्थेन इव परित्यक्ता भक्षिता बहु बांधवा
transliteration: mayā virahitā bālā rakṣasām bhakṣaṇāya vai
sārthena iva parityaktā bhakṣitā bahu bāṃdhavā
english: Alas! did I leave her alone only to be devoured by the Rākşasas? And she has been eaten up like one weak and helpless albeit she has many friends.

sanskrit: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो पश्यसे त्वम् प्रियाम् क्वचित्
हा प्रिये क्व गता भद्रे हा सीते इति पुनः पुनः
transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho paśyase tvam priyām kvacit
hā priye kva gatā bhadre hā sīte iti punaḥ punaḥ
english: O Lakşmaņa, O you of mighty-arms, have you seen where my dear wife is? O dear! O Sītā! where have you gone? bewailing again and again in this strain Rāma began to range the forest. Sometimes leaping, sometimes walking in an uncertain direction, again and again he looked like one void of sense.

sanskrit: इति एवम् विलपन् रामः परिधावन् वनात् वनम्
क्वचित् उद् भ्रमते वेगात् क्वचित् विभ्रमते बलात्
transliteration: iti evam vilapan rāmaḥ paridhāvan vanāt vanam
kvacit ud bhramate vegāt kvacit vibhramate balāt
english: O Lakşmaņa, O you of mighty-arms, have you seen where my dear wife is? O dear! O Sītā! where have you gone? bewailing again and again in this strain Rāma began to range the forest. Sometimes leaping, sometimes walking in an uncertain direction, again and again he looked like one void of sense.

sanskrit: क्वचित् मत्त इव आभाति कांता अन्वेषण तत्परः
स वनानि नदीः शैलान् गिरि प्रस्रवणानि च
transliteration: kvacit matta iva ābhāti kāṃtā anveṣaṇa tatparaḥ
sa vanāni nadīḥ śailān giri prasravaṇāni ca
english: And again intent on searching Sītā he furiously engaged in traversing the rivers, mountains, fountains and the woods. he could not wait patiently anywhere.

sanskrit: तदा स गत्वा विपुलम् महत् वनम्परीत्य सर्वम् तु अथ मैथिलीम् प्रति
अनिष्ठित आशः स चकार मार्गणेपुनः प्रियायाः परमम् परिश्रमम्
transliteration: tadā sa gatvā vipulam mahat vanamparītya sarvam tu atha maithilīm prati
aniṣṭhita āśaḥ sa cakāra mārgaṇepunaḥ priyāyāḥ paramam pariśramam
english: Entering a vast forest he searched every nook and corner for Maithilī; his desire was not satisfied and he again engaged with great labour in the finding out of his dear spouse.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा आश्रम पदम् शून्यम् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः
रहिताम् पर्णशालाम् च प्रविद्धानि आसनानि च
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā āśrama padam śūnyam rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ
rahitām parṇaśālām ca praviddhāni āsanāni ca
english: Beholding the hermitage and cottage desolate and the seats strewn here and there, Rāma the son of Dasaratha looked around. And finding Sītā nowhere he raised up his beautiful arm and broke out into lamentations.

sanskrit: अदृष्ट्वा तत्र वैदेहीम् संनिरीक्ष्य च सर्वशः
उवाच रामः प्राक्रुश्य प्रगृह्य रुचिरौ भुजौ
transliteration: adṛṣṭvā tatra vaidehīm saṃnirīkṣya ca sarvaśaḥ
uvāca rāmaḥ prākruśya pragṛhya rucirau bhujau
english: Beholding the hermitage and cottage desolate and the seats strewn here and there, Rāma the son of Dasaratha looked around. And finding Sītā nowhere he raised up his beautiful arm and broke out into lamentations.

sanskrit: क्व नु लक्ष्मण वैदेही कम् वा देशम् इतो गता
केन आहृता वा सौमित्रे भक्षिता केन वा प्रिया
transliteration: kva nu lakṣmaṇa vaidehī kam vā deśam ito gatā
kena āhṛtā vā saumitre bhakṣitā kena vā priyā
english: O Laksmana where is Sītā? Where has she gone hence? O Saumitri, who has carried away my dear one or who has devoured her?

sanskrit: वृक्षेण आवार्य यदि माम् सीते हसितुम् इच्छसि
अलम् ते हसितेन अद्य माम् भजस्व सुदुःखितम्
transliteration: vṛkṣeṇa āvārya yadi mām sīte hasitum icchasi
alam te hasitena adya mām bhajasva suduḥkhitam
english: O Sītā, if wish you to mock me, hiding yourself behind the tree, enough-~-enough it is-console me who am exercised with grief.

sanskrit: यैः सह क्रीडसे सीते विश्वस्तैः मृग पोतकैः
एते हीनाः त्वया सौम्ये ध्यायन्ति अस्र आविल ईक्षणाः
transliteration: yaiḥ saha krīḍase sīte viśvastaiḥ mṛga potakaiḥ
ete hīnāḥ tvayā saumye dhyāyanti asra āvila īkṣaṇāḥ
english: O pleasant Sītā, without you these faithful little deer have engaged in meditation being bathed in tears.

sanskrit: सीताया रहितो अहम् वै न हि जीवामि लक्ष्मण
वृतम् शोकेन महता सीता हरणजेन माम्
transliteration: sītāyā rahito aham vai na hi jīvāmi lakṣmaṇa
vṛtam śokena mahatā sītā haraṇajena mām

sanskrit: पर लोके महाराजो नूनम् द्रक्ष्यति मे पिता
कथम् प्रतिज्ञाम् संश्रुत्य मया त्वम् अभियोजितः
transliteration: para loke mahārājo nūnam drakṣyati me pitā
katham pratijñām saṃśrutya mayā tvam abhiyojitaḥ
english: Without Sita I shall not breathe, O Laksmana. A mighty grief has overtaken me in consequence of her being carried away. My father the monarch shall surely behold me in the next world and ask me 'I engaged you in the observance of a vow; without fulfilling that, why have you come here?

sanskrit: अपूरयित्वा तम् कालम् मत् सकाशम् इह आगतः
काम वृत्तम् अनार्यम् माम् मृषा वादिनम् एव च
transliteration: apūrayitvā tam kālam mat sakāśam iha āgataḥ
kāma vṛttam anāryam mām mṛṣā vādinam eva ca

sanskrit: धिक् त्वाम् इति परे लोके व्यक्तम् वक्ष्यति मे पिता
विवशम् शोक संतप्तम् दीनम् भग्न मनोरथम्
transliteration: dhik tvām iti pare loke vyaktam vakṣyati me pitā
vivaśam śoka saṃtaptam dīnam bhagna manoratham

sanskrit: माम् इह उत्सृज्य करुणम् कीर्तिः नरम् इव अन्ऋजुम्
क्व गच्चसि वरारोहे मा मोत्सृज्य - मा मा उत्सृज्य - सुमध्यमे
transliteration: mām iha utsṛjya karuṇam kīrtiḥ naram iva anṛjum
kva gaccasi varārohe mā motsṛjya - mā mā utsṛjya - sumadhyame
english: All my desires have now been baffled and I have lost all control over myself and have been exercised with grief. O fine damsel, O you of slender waist, where do you repair leaving me behind like to fame renouncing a person of vicious nature?

sanskrit: त्वया विरहितः च अहम् त्यक्ष्ये जीवितम् आत्मनः
इति इव विलपन् रामः सीता दर्शन लालसः
transliteration: tvayā virahitaḥ ca aham tyakṣye jīvitam ātmanaḥ
iti iva vilapan rāmaḥ sītā darśana lālasaḥ
english: Without you I shall renounce my own life. Being desirous of seeing Sītā, Rāma afflicted with grief began to bewail in this strain, but did not behold the daughter of Janaka.

sanskrit: न ददर्श सुदुःख आर्तो राघवो जनक आत्मजाम्
transliteration: na dadarśa suduḥkha ārto rāghavo janaka ātmajām

sanskrit: पंकम् आसाद्य विपुलम् सीदन्तम् इव कुंजरम्
लक्ष्मणो रामम् अत्यर्थम् उवाच हित काम्यया
transliteration: paṃkam āsādya vipulam sīdantam iva kuṃjaram
lakṣmaṇo rāmam atyartham uvāca hita kāmyayā
english: Being sunk in grief on Sītā's account he became worn out like to an elephant fallen in mud.' Thereat for his well being, Laksmana spoke to him.

sanskrit: मा विषादम् महाबुद्धे कुरु यत्नम् मया सह
इदम् गिरि वरम् वीर बहु कन्दर शोभितम्
transliteration: mā viṣādam mahābuddhe kuru yatnam mayā saha
idam giri varam vīra bahu kandara śobhitam

sanskrit: प्रिय कानन संचारा वन उन्मत्ता च मैथिली
सा वनम् वा प्रविष्टा स्यात् नलिनीम् वा सुपुष्पिताम्
transliteration: priya kānana saṃcārā vana unmattā ca maithilī
sā vanam vā praviṣṭā syāt nalinīm vā supuṣpitām

sanskrit: सरितम् वा अपि संप्राप्ता मीन वंजुल सेविताम्
वित्रासयितु कामा वा लीना स्यात् कानने क्वचित्
transliteration: saritam vā api saṃprāptā mīna vaṃjula sevitām
vitrāsayitu kāmā vā līnā syāt kānane kvacit

sanskrit: जिज्ञासमाना वैदेही त्वाम् माम् च पुरुषर्षभ
तस्या हि अन्वेषणे श्रीमन् क्षिप्रम् एव यतावहे
transliteration: jijñāsamānā vaidehī tvām mām ca puruṣarṣabha
tasyā hi anveṣaṇe śrīman kṣipram eva yatāvahe

sanskrit: वनम् सर्वम् विचिनुवो यत्र सा जनक आत्मजा
मन्यसे यदि काकुत्स्थ मा स्म शोके मनः कृथाः
transliteration: vanam sarvam vicinuvo yatra sā janaka ātmajā
manyase yadi kākutstha mā sma śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सौहार्दात् लक्ष्मणेन समाहितः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sauhārdāt lakṣmaṇena samāhitaḥ
english: O Kākutstha, if think you that she is somewhere in this forest, we shall leave no quarter untried. Do you not grieve. After Laks maņa had spoken thus out of fraternal affection, Rāma, with a composed heart, set out along with him in quest of Sītā.

sanskrit: तौ वनानि गिरीन् चैव सरितः च सरांसि च
transliteration: tau vanāni girīn caiva saritaḥ ca sarāṃsi ca

sanskrit: तस्य शैलस्य सानूनि शिलाः च शिखराणि च
निखिलेन विचिन्वन्तौ न एव ताम् अभिजग्मतुः
transliteration: tasya śailasya sānūni śilāḥ ca śikharāṇi ca
nikhilena vicinvantau na eva tām abhijagmatuḥ

sanskrit: विचित्य सर्वतः शैलम् रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
न इह पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीम् पर्वते शुभाम्
transliteration: vicitya sarvataḥ śailam rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
na iha paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīm parvate śubhām

sanskrit: ततो दुःख अभिसंतप्तो लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
विचरन् दण्डक अरण्यम् भ्रातरम् दीप्त तेजसम्
transliteration: tato duḥkha abhisaṃtapto lakṣmaṇo vākyam abravīt
vicaran daṇḍaka araṇyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam
english: Ranging the entire forest of Dandaka, Laks mana, sore distressed, spoke to his brother of flaming energy.

sanskrit: प्राप्स्यसि त्वम् महाप्राज्ञ मैथिलीम् जनक आत्मजाम्
यथा विष्णुः महाबाहुः बलिम् बद्ध्वा महीम् इमाम्
transliteration: prāpsyasi tvam mahāprājña maithilīm janaka ātmajām
yathā viṣṇuḥ mahābāhuḥ balim baddhvā mahīm imām
english: Surely shall you come by Maithilī the daughter of Janaka like to the mighty armed Viş ņu obtaining this earth after having bound Vāli.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु वीरेण लक्ष्मणेन स राघवः
उवाच दीनया वाचा दुःख अभिहत चेतनः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu vīreṇa lakṣmaṇena sa rāghavaḥ
uvāca dīnayā vācā duḥkha abhihata cetanaḥ
english: Being thus addressed by the heroic Lakşmaņa, Rāghava, greatly afflicted with sorrow, replied in piteous accents .

sanskrit: वनम् सुविचितम् सर्वम् पद्मिन्यः फुल्ल पंकजाः
गिरिः च अयम् महाप्राज्ञ बहु कन्दर निर्झरः
न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीम् प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम्
transliteration: vanam suvicitam sarvam padminyaḥ phulla paṃkajāḥ
giriḥ ca ayam mahāprājña bahu kandara nirjharaḥ
na hi paśyāmi vaidehīm prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm
english: O you of mighty intellect I have searched every nook of this forest, this pool abounding in blown lotuses, and this mountain containing many a cave and fountain; but nowhere have I seen Vaidehi dearer than my life.

sanskrit: एवम् स विलपन् रामः सीता हरण कर्शितः
दीनः शोक समाविष्टो मुहूर्तम् विह्वलो अभवत्
transliteration: evam sa vilapan rāmaḥ sītā haraṇa karśitaḥ
dīnaḥ śoka samāviṣṭo muhūrtam vihvalo abhavat
english: Thus bewailing Rāma, racked with sorrow consequent on Sītā being carried away, became poorly and afflicted with grief and swooned away for sometime.

sanskrit: स विह्वलित सर्व अंगो गत बुद्धिः विचेतनः
निषसाद आतुरो दीनो निःश्वस्य अशीतम् आयतम्
transliteration: sa vihvalita sarva aṃgo gata buddhiḥ vicetanaḥ
niṣasāda āturo dīno niḥśvasya aśītam āyatam
english: He lost his sense and his whole frame was worked with grief. Being greatly anxious and breathless he sighed hot and fast and began to lament.

sanskrit: बहुशः स तु निःश्वस्य रामो राजीव लोचनः
हा प्रिये ति विचुक्रोश बहुशो बाष्प गद्गदः
transliteration: bahuśaḥ sa tu niḥśvasya rāmo rājīva locanaḥ
hā priye ti vicukrośa bahuśo bāṣpa gadgadaḥ
english: And sobbing again and again the lotus-eyed Rāma bewailed with his voice choked with the vapour of grief, exclaiming “Ah Sītā!”

sanskrit: तम् सान्त्वयामास ततो लक्ष्मणः प्रिय बान्धवम्
बहु प्रकारम् शोक आर्तः प्रश्रितः प्रश्रित अंजलिः
transliteration: tam sāntvayāmāsa tato lakṣmaṇaḥ priya bāndhavam
bahu prakāram śoka ārtaḥ praśritaḥ praśrita aṃjaliḥ
english: Thereat his dear brother Lakşmaņa, aggrieved, consoled him with joined hands.

sanskrit: अनादृत्य तु तत् वाक्यम् लक्ष्मण ओष्ठ पुट च्युतम्
अपश्यन् ताम् प्रियाम् सीताम् प्राक्रोशत् स पुनः पुनः
transliteration: anādṛtya tu tat vākyam lakṣmaṇa oṣṭha puṭa cyutam
apaśyan tām priyām sītām prākrośat sa punaḥ punaḥ
english: But passing by the words dropping from Laks mana's lips Rāma again and again bewailed not beholding his dear Sītā.

sanskrit: सीताम् अपश्यन् धर्मात्मा शोक उपहत चेतनः
transliteration: sītām apaśyan dharmātmā śoka upahata cetanaḥ
english: Not beholding Sītā the virtuous-souled Rāma, of mighty arms, having eyes resembling lotuses, beside himself with grief, lamented in many a way).

sanskrit: पश्यन् इव च ताम् सीताम् अपश्यन् मदन अर्दितः
उवाच राघवो वाक्यम् विलाप आश्रय दुर्वचम्
transliteration: paśyan iva ca tām sītām apaśyan madana arditaḥ
uvāca rāghavo vākyam vilāpa āśraya durvacam
english: Pierced with the shafts of Manmatha, Rāghava, as if beholding Sītā though he actually did not see her, uttered the following piteous accents

sanskrit: त्वम् अशोकस्य शाखाभिः पुष्प प्रिय तराअ प्रिये
अवृणोषि शरीरम् ते मम शोक विवर्धिनी
transliteration: tvam aśokasya śākhābhiḥ puṣpa priya tarāa priye
avṛṇoṣi śarīram te mama śoka vivardhinī
english: O my dear, you delights greatly in flowers. Covering your own Person with Asoka twigs you are increasing my grief.

sanskrit: कदली काण्ड सदृशौ कदल्या संवृता उभौ
ऊरू पश्यामि ते देवि न असि शक्ता निगूहितुम्
transliteration: kadalī kāṇḍa sadṛśau kadalyā saṃvṛtā ubhau
ūrū paśyāmi te devi na asi śaktā nigūhitum
english: Your thighs are like to the trunks of plantain trees and you have hidden your self behind the plantain grove. But I perceive you, O fair one, you are incapable of keeping yourself hidden.

sanskrit: कर्णिकार वनम् भद्रे हसंती देवि सेवसे
अलम् ते परिहासेन मम बाधावहेन वै
transliteration: karṇikāra vanam bhadre hasaṃtī devi sevase
alam te parihāsena mama bādhāvahena vai
english: O auspicious one, you have entered smiling the Karņikara grove. Now more with your pastime, O dear one, leading to my death.

sanskrit: विशेषेण आश्रमस्थाने हासो अयम् न प्रशस्यते
अवगच्छामि ते शीलम् परिहास प्रियम् प्रिये
transliteration: viśeṣeṇa āśramasthāne hāso ayam na praśasyate
avagacchāmi te śīlam parihāsa priyam priye
english: Moreover it is not proper to sport in this way in a herinitage. I know it full well, O my dear, that you are by nature fond of pastimes. But O you of expansive eyes, this cottage lie desolate, do you came here.

sanskrit: आगच्छ त्वम् विशालाक्षी शून्यो अयम् उटजः तव
सु व्यक्तम् राक्षैः सीता भक्षिता वा हृता अपि वा
transliteration: āgaccha tvam viśālākṣī śūnyo ayam uṭajaḥ tava
su vyaktam rākṣaiḥ sītā bhakṣitā vā hṛtā api vā

sanskrit: न हि सा विलपंतम् माम् उपसम्प्रैति लक्ष्मण
एतानि मृग यूधानि स अश्रु नेत्राणि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: na hi sā vilapaṃtam mām upasampraiti lakṣmaṇa
etāni mṛga yūdhāni sa aśru netrāṇi lakṣmaṇa
english: Evident it is that Sītā has either been devoured by the Rākşasas or carried away by them, and therefore she dose not approach me, O Laks mana, who am thus bewailing. These deer, O Lakşmaņa, with tearful eyes have been as if declaring that Sītā has been devoured by the night-rangers.

sanskrit: शंशन्ति इव हि मे देवीम् भक्षिताम् रजनीचरैः
हा मम आर्ये क्व याता असि हा साध्वि वर वर्णिनि
transliteration: śaṃśanti iva hi me devīm bhakṣitām rajanīcaraiḥ
hā mama ārye kva yātā asi hā sādhvi vara varṇini

sanskrit: हा स कामा अद्य कैकेयी देवि मे अद्य भविष्यति
सीताया सह निर्यातो विना सीताम् उपागतः
transliteration: hā sa kāmā adya kaikeyī devi me adya bhaviṣyati
sītāyā saha niryāto vinā sītām upāgataḥ

sanskrit: कथम् नाम प्रवेक्ष्यामि शून्यम् अन्तः पुरम् मम
निर्वीर्य इति लोको माम् निर्दयः च इति वक्ष्यति
transliteration: katham nāma pravekṣyāmi śūnyam antaḥ puram mama
nirvīrya iti loko mām nirdayaḥ ca iti vakṣyati

sanskrit: कातरत्वम् प्रकाशम् हि सीता अपनयनेन मे
निवृत्त वन वासः च जनकम् मिथिल अधिपम्
transliteration: kātaratvam prakāśam hi sītā apanayanena me
nivṛtta vana vāsaḥ ca janakam mithila adhipam

sanskrit: विदेह रजो नूनम् माम् दृष्ट्वा विरहितम् तया
transliteration: videha rajo nūnam mām dṛṣṭvā virahitam tayā

sanskrit: सुता विनाश संतप्तो मोहस्य वशम् एष्यति
अथवा न गमिष्यामि पुरीम् भरत पालितम्
transliteration: sutā vināśa saṃtapto mohasya vaśam eṣyati
athavā na gamiṣyāmi purīm bharata pālitam

sanskrit: स्वर्गो अपि हि तया हीनः शून्य एव मतो मम
तत् माम् उत्सृज्य हि वने गच्छ अयोध्या पुरीम् शुभाम्
transliteration: svargo api hi tayā hīnaḥ śūnya eva mato mama
tat mām utsṛjya hi vane gaccha ayodhyā purīm śubhām

sanskrit: न तु अहम् ताम् विना सीताम् जीवेयम् हि कथंचन
गाढम् आश्लिष्य भरतो वाच्यो मत् वचनात् त्वया
transliteration: na tu aham tām vinā sītām jīveyam hi kathaṃcana
gāḍham āśliṣya bharato vācyo mat vacanāt tvayā

sanskrit: अनुज्ञातो असि रामेण पालय इति वसुंधराम्
अंबा च मम कैकेयी सुमित्रा च त्वया विभो
transliteration: anujñāto asi rāmeṇa pālaya iti vasuṃdharām
aṃbā ca mama kaikeyī sumitrā ca tvayā vibho

sanskrit: कौसल्या च यथा न्यायम् अभिवाद्या मम अज्ञया
रक्षणीया प्रयत्नेन भवता सा उक्त कारिणा
transliteration: kausalyā ca yathā nyāyam abhivādyā mama ajñayā
rakṣaṇīyā prayatnena bhavatā sā ukta kāriṇā
english: As ordered by me do you with proper respect salute "ll my muchers Kausalyā, Kaikeyi and Sumitrā and protect them all with great care and respectful compliments.

sanskrit: सीतायाः च विनाशो अयम् मम च अमित्र सूदन
transliteration: sītāyāḥ ca vināśo ayam mama ca amitra sūdana
english: O destroyer of foes, do you relate at length to my mnother the story of Sītā's destruction.

sanskrit: इति विलपति राघवो तु दीनोवनम् उपगम्य तया विना सु केश्या
भय विकल मुखः तु लक्ष्मणो अपिव्यथित मना भृशम् आतुरो बभूव
transliteration: iti vilapati rāghavo tu dīnovanam upagamya tayā vinā su keśyā
bhaya vikala mukhaḥ tu lakṣmaṇo apivyathita manā bhṛśam āturo babhūva
english: Rāma bewailing thus, being overwhelmed with grief on account of his separation from Sītā having a head of fine hair, Laksmana became of pale countenance and was greatly distressed at heart.

sanskrit: स राज पुत्र प्रिया विहीनःशोकेन मोहेन च पीड्यमानः
विषादयन् भ्रातरम् आर्त रूपोभूयो विषादम्प्रविवेश तीव्रम्
transliteration: sa rāja putra priyā vihīnaḥśokena mohena ca pīḍyamānaḥ
viṣādayan bhrātaram ārta rūpobhūyo viṣādampraviveśa tīvram
english: That son of a king, stricken as he was with grief consequent upon separation from his dear one, was again overwhelmed with a terrible grief after causing sorrow to his brother,

sanskrit: स लक्ष्मणम् शोक वश अभिपन्नम्शोके निमग्नो विपुले तु रामः
उवाच वाक्यम् व्यसनानुरूपम्उष्णम् विनिःश्वस्य रुदन् स शोकम्
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇam śoka vaśa abhipannamśoke nimagno vipule tu rāmaḥ
uvāca vākyam vyasanānurūpamuṣṇam viniḥśvasya rudan sa śokam
english: Sunk in the abyss of grief, Rāma, sighing hot and weeping piteously, spoke to Laksmana who was equally aggrieved, words worthy of being said on that occasion.

sanskrit: न मत् विधो दुष्कृत कर्म कारीमन्ये द्वितीयो अस्ति वसुंधरायाम्
शोक अनुशोको हि परंपरायामाम् एति भिन्दन् हृदयम् मनः च
transliteration: na mat vidho duṣkṛta karma kārīmanye dvitīyo asti vasuṃdharāyām
śoka anuśoko hi paraṃparāyāmām eti bhindan hṛdayam manaḥ ca
english: Methinks there is none other on this earth like me, the perpetrator of vicious crimes. My heart or soul is not riven though crushed again and again without respite with a multitude of doleful events.

sanskrit: पूर्वम् मया नूनम् अभीप्सितानिपापानि कर्माणि असत्कृत् कृतानि
तत्र अयम् अद्य पतितो विपाकोदुःखेन दुःखम् यद् अहम् विशामि
transliteration: pūrvam mayā nūnam abhīpsitānipāpāni karmāṇi asatkṛt kṛtāni
tatra ayam adya patito vipākoduḥkhena duḥkham yad aham viśāmi
english: Surely did I perpetrate many a vicious deed in of my my previous birth, the fruit of which I do now suffer and in consequence where-of misfortune after misfortune has befallen me.

sanskrit: राज्य प्रणाशः स्व जनैः वियोगःपितुर् विनाशो जननी वियोगः
सर्वानि मे लक्ष्मण शोक वेगम्आपूरयन्ति प्रविचिन्तितानि
transliteration: rājya praṇāśaḥ sva janaiḥ viyogaḥpitur vināśo jananī viyogaḥ
sarvāni me lakṣmaṇa śoka vegamāpūrayanti pravicintitāni
english: Coming within the compass remembrance, the loss of my kingdom, the death of my father, the separation of my mother and other kinsmen culminates my grief.

sanskrit: सर्वम् तु दुःखम् मम लक्ष्मण इदम्शान्तम् शरीरे वनम् एत्य क्लेशम्
सीता वियोगात् पुनर् अपि उदीर्णम्काष्टैः इव अग्निः सहसा प्रदीप्तः
transliteration: sarvam tu duḥkham mama lakṣmaṇa idamśāntam śarīre vanam etya kleśam
sītā viyogāt punar api udīrṇamkāṣṭaiḥ iva agniḥ sahasā pradīptaḥ
english: Repairing to woods, O Laksmana, in Sita's company my grief was assuaged, nay I did not suffer physical affliction even. Without Sītā these sorrows have grown anew like to fire flaming again by means of fuel.

sanskrit: सा नूनम् आर्या मम राक्षसेन हिअभ्याहृता खम् समुपेत्य भीरुः
अपस्वरम् सु स्वर विप्रलापाभयेन विक्रन्दितवति अभीक्ष्णम्
transliteration: sā nūnam āryā mama rākṣasena hiabhyāhṛtā kham samupetya bhīruḥ
apasvaram su svara vipralāpābhayena vikranditavati abhīkṣṇam
english: Truly my wife, timid as she is, has been carried away by a Rākşasa by the ethereal track. Alas! doubtless it is, that one of pleasant accents, wept piteously out of fear many a time and oft.

sanskrit: तौ लोहितस्य प्रिय दर्शनस्यसदा उचितौ उत्तम चंदनस्य
वृत्तौ स्तनौ शोणित पंक दिग्धौनूनम् प्रियाया मम न अभिभात
transliteration: tau lohitasya priya darśanasyasadā ucitau uttama caṃdanasya
vṛttau stanau śoṇita paṃka digdhaunūnam priyāyā mama na abhibhāta
english: For certain my dear wife's breast round and sprinkled as it was with red sandal paste, was bathed in blood (while devoured by the Rākş asas) but there is no death for me.

sanskrit: तत् श्लक्ष्ण सु व्यक्त मृदु प्रलापम्तस्या मुखम् कुंचित केश भारम्
रक्षो वशम् नूनम् उपगतायान भ्राजते राहु मुखे यथा इंदुः
transliteration: tat ślakṣṇa su vyakta mṛdu pralāpamtasyā mukham kuṃcita keśa bhāram
rakṣo vaśam nūnam upagatāyāna bhrājate rāhu mukhe yathā iṃduḥ
english: That countenance the beauty of which was enhanced by a head of curly hair and which used to emit forth tender, soft and clear accents, has become pale, being taken possession of by the Rākşasas like to the Moon almost devoured by Rahu.

sanskrit: ताम् हार पाशस्य सदा उचित अंतम्ग्रीवाम् प्रियाया मम सु व्रताया
रक्षांसि नूनम् परिपीतवन्तिशून्ये हि भित्वा रुधिर अशनानि
transliteration: tām hāra pāśasya sadā ucita aṃtamgrīvām priyāyā mama su vratāyā
rakṣāṃsi nūnam paripītavantiśūnye hi bhitvā rudhira aśanāni
english: Surely have the Räkşasas subsisting on gore drunk her blood in the sky tearing off the neck of my dear one ever devoted to pious observances.

sanskrit: मया विहीना विजने वने यारक्षोभिः आहृत्य विकृष्यमाणा
नूनम् विनादम् कुररि इव दीनासा मुक्तवती आयत कान्त नेत्रा
transliteration: mayā vihīnā vijane vane yārakṣobhiḥ āhṛtya vikṛṣyamāṇā
nūnam vinādam kurari iva dīnāsā muktavatī āyata kānta netrā
english: Surely did that one of beautifully expansive eyes cry aloud poorly like to a hind when she was drawn hither and thither by the Rākşasas encircling her in the forest in my absence.

sanskrit: अस्मिन् मया सार्थम् उदार शीलाशिला तले पूर्वम् उपोपविष्टा
कान्त स्मिता लक्ष्मण जात हासात्वाम् आह सीता बहु वाक्य जातम्
transliteration: asmin mayā sārtham udāra śīlāśilā tale pūrvam upopaviṣṭā
kānta smitā lakṣmaṇa jāta hāsātvām āha sītā bahu vākya jātam
english: O Lakşmana, sitting at the foot of this hill with me that large-hearted, pious Sītā, of smiling countenance, used to address you on many a topic.

sanskrit: गोदावरी इयाम् सरिताम् वरिष्टाप्रिया प्रियाया मम नित्य कालम्
अपि अत्र गच्छेत् इति चिंतयामिन एकाकिनी याति हि सा कदाचित्
transliteration: godāvarī iyām saritām variṣṭāpriyā priyāyā mama nitya kālam
api atra gacchet iti ciṃtayāmina ekākinī yāti hi sā kadācit
english: This is Godāvarī, the best of rivers, my dear wife took delight in her-has she gone there?—But she never goes there alone.

sanskrit: पद्म आनना पद्म पलाश नेत्रापद्मानि वा आनेतुम् अभिप्रयाता
तत् अपि अयुक्तम् न हि सा कद्दचित्मया विना गच्छति पंकजानि
transliteration: padma ānanā padma palāśa netrāpadmāni vā ānetum abhiprayātā
tat api ayuktam na hi sā kaddacitmayā vinā gacchati paṃkajāni
english: Or has Janaki having eyes resembling lotuspetals has gone to bring lotuses? But how is that possible, she never goes without me to bring lotuses.

sanskrit: कामम् तु इदम् पुष्पित वृक्ष सण्डम्नाना विधैः पक्षि गणैः उपेतम्
वनम् प्रयाता नु तत् अपि अयुक्तम्एकाकिनी सा अति बिभेति भीरुः
transliteration: kāmam tu idam puṣpita vṛkṣa saṇḍamnānā vidhaiḥ pakṣi gaṇaiḥ upetam
vanam prayātā nu tat api ayuktamekākinī sā ati bibheti bhīruḥ
english: Has she entered at her pleasure this forest filled with many flowery trees and diverse birds? But that is not possible too-she is timid and fear much to enter alone in this forest.

sanskrit: आदित्य भो लोक क्रृत अकृत ज्ञःलोकस्य सत्य अनृत कर्म साक्षिन्
मम प्रिया सा क्व गता हृता वाशंसव मे शोक हतस्य सर्वम्
transliteration: āditya bho loka krṛta akṛta jñaḥlokasya satya anṛta karma sākṣin
mama priyā sā kva gatā hṛtā vāśaṃsava me śoka hatasya sarvam
english: O.Aditya, know you the pious and vicious actions of men; bear you testimony to the truth and untruth of their actions-do you tell me, pray, who am stricken with grief, whither has my dear on repaired, or whether has she been killed?

sanskrit: लोकेषु सर्वेषु न नास्ति किंचित्यत् ते न नित्यम् विदितम् भवेत् तत्
शंसस्व वयोः कुल शालिनीम् ताम्मृता हृता वा पथि वर्तते वा
transliteration: lokeṣu sarveṣu na nāsti kiṃcityat te na nityam viditam bhavet tat
śaṃsasva vayoḥ kula śālinīm tāmmṛtā hṛtā vā pathi vartate vā
english: O Air, there is nothing on earth which is not within the compass of your vision, do you relate to me whether Sītā preserving the fame of my ancestry, has been killed or carried away or if she wait on the way.

sanskrit: इति इव तम् शोक विधेय देहम्रामम् विसंज्ञम् विलपंतम् एव
उवाच सौमित्रिःअदीन सत्त्वःन्याये स्थितः काल युतम् च वाक्यम्
transliteration: iti iva tam śoka vidheya dehamrāmam visaṃjñam vilapaṃtam eva
uvāca saumitriḥadīna sattvaḥnyāye sthitaḥ kāla yutam ca vākyam
english: After Rāma had bewailed thus being beside himself with grief, Saumitrī, ever treading the right path and not of poorly mind spoke words worthy of being said on that occasion.

sanskrit: शोकम् विमुंच आर्य धृतिम् भजस्वसह उत्साहता च अस्तु विमार्गणे अस्याः
उत्साहवन्तो हि नरा न लोकेसीदन्ति कर्मसु अति दुष्करेषु
transliteration: śokam vimuṃca ārya dhṛtim bhajasvasaha utsāhatā ca astu vimārgaṇe asyāḥ
utsāhavanto hi narā na lokesīdanti karmasu ati duṣkareṣu
english: Do you take heart renouncing your grief and engage with energy of Sita. Persons of high energy are never exhausted on the earth in quest even in the face of arduous works.

sanskrit: इति इव सौमित्रिम् उदग्र पौरुषम्ब्रुवन्तम् आर्तो रघु वंश वर्धनः
न चिंतयामास धृतिम् विमुक्तवान्पुनः च दुःखम् महत् अभ्युपागमत्
transliteration: iti iva saumitrim udagra pauruṣambruvantam ārto raghu vaṃśa vardhanaḥ
na ciṃtayāmāsa dhṛtim vimuktavānpunaḥ ca duḥkham mahat abhyupāgamat
english: The highly powerful Lakşmaņa having spoken thus being afflicted with grief, Rāma, the best of Raghu's descendants, did not consider that worth pondering over. Renouncing patience he again indulged in excessive grief.

sanskrit: स दीनो दीनया वाचा लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
शीघ्रम् लक्ष्मण जानीहि गत्वा गोदावरीम् नदीम्
transliteration: sa dīno dīnayā vācā lakṣmaṇam vākyam abravīt
śīghram lakṣmaṇa jānīhi gatvā godāvarīm nadīm
english: Rāma stricken with grief spoke to Lakşmaņa the following piteous words saying, O Laks mana, do you speedily repair to the river Godaverſ and learn if Sītā has gone there to fetch lotuses.

sanskrit: अपि गोदावरीम् सीता पद्मानि आनयितुम् गता
एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः पुनः एव हि
transliteration: api godāvarīm sītā padmāni ānayitum gatā
evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ punaḥ eva hi

sanskrit: नदीम् गोदावरीम् रम्याम् जगाम लघु विक्रमः
ताम् लक्ष्मणः तीर्थवतीम् विचित्वा रामम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: nadīm godāvarīm ramyām jagāma laghu vikramaḥ
tām lakṣmaṇaḥ tīrthavatīm vicitvā rāmam abravīt

sanskrit: नैनाम् पश्यामि तीर्थेषु क्रोशतो न शृणोति मे
कम् नु सा देशम् आपन्ना वैदेही क्लेश नाशिनी
transliteration: nainām paśyāmi tīrtheṣu krośato na śṛṇoti me
kam nu sā deśam āpannā vaidehī kleśa nāśinī

sanskrit: न हि तम् वेद्मि वै राम यत्र सा तनु मध्यमा
लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीनः संताप मोहितः
transliteration: na hi tam vedmi vai rāma yatra sā tanu madhyamā
lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dīnaḥ saṃtāpa mohitaḥ

sanskrit: स ताम् उपस्थितो रामः क्व सीते इति एवम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa tām upasthito rāmaḥ kva sīte iti evam abravīt

sanskrit: भूतानि राक्षसेन्द्रेण वध अर्हेण हृताम् अपि
न ताम् शशंसू रामाय तथा गोदावरी नदी
transliteration: bhūtāni rākṣasendreṇa vadha arheṇa hṛtām api
na tām śaśaṃsū rāmāya tathā godāvarī nadī
english: Arriving there cried he where is Şītā? Neither did the world of creatures nor the river Godāvarī apprise Rāma of Sītā's being carried away by the Lord of Rākşasas worthy of being slain.

sanskrit: ततः प्रचोदिता भूतैः शंस च अस्मै प्रियाम् इति
न च सा हि अवदत् सीताम् पृष्टा रामेण शोचता
transliteration: tataḥ pracoditā bhūtaiḥ śaṃsa ca asmai priyām iti
na ca sā hi avadat sītām pṛṣṭā rāmeṇa śocatā
english: Thinking of the terrible figure and monstrous action of that vicious-souled Råvaņa, that river did not dare relate to him anything about Sītā, albeit appointed by the creatures to relate the story concerning her and accosted by Răma in piteous accents.

sanskrit: रावणस्य च तत् रूपम् कर्माणि च दुरात्मनः
ध्यात्वा भयात् तु वैदेहीम् सा नदी न शशंस ह
transliteration: rāvaṇasya ca tat rūpam karmāṇi ca durātmanaḥ
dhyātvā bhayāt tu vaidehīm sā nadī na śaśaṃsa ha
english: Thinking of the terrible figure and monstrous action of that vicious-souled Råvaņa, that river did not dare relate to him anything about Sītā, albeit appointed by the creatures to relate the story concerning her and accosted by Răma in piteous accents.

sanskrit: निराशः तु तया नद्या सीताया दर्शने कृतः
उवाच रामः सौमित्रिम् सीता दर्शन कर्शितः
transliteration: nirāśaḥ tu tayā nadyā sītāyā darśane kṛtaḥ
uvāca rāmaḥ saumitrim sītā darśana karśitaḥ
english: Being thus disappointed by the river in beholding Sītā, Răma racked with her separation spoke to Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: एषा गोदावरी सौम्य किंचन् न प्रतिभाषते
किम् नु लक्ष्मण वक्ष्यामि समेत्य जनकम् वचः
transliteration: eṣā godāvarī saumya kiṃcan na pratibhāṣate
kim nu lakṣmaṇa vakṣyāmi sametya janakam vacaḥ
english: O you of auspicious looks, this river Godāvarī dose give no reply. But O Laksmana, returning without her what shall I say to Janaka and Vaidehi's mother?

sanskrit: मातरम् चैव वैदेह्या विना ताम् अहम् अप्रियम्
या मे राज्य विहीनस्य वने वन्येन जीवतः
transliteration: mātaram caiva vaidehyā vinā tām aham apriyam
yā me rājya vihīnasya vane vanyena jīvataḥ

sanskrit: सर्वम् व्यपनयत् शोकम् वैदेही क्व नु सा गता
ज्ञाति वर्ग विहीनस्य राज पुत्रीम् अपश्यतः
transliteration: sarvam vyapanayat śokam vaidehī kva nu sā gatā
jñāti varga vihīnasya rāja putrīm apaśyataḥ
english: Where has that Vaidehi gone who used to assuage my grief who had been deprived of kingdom and living in this forest on wild fruits and vegetables? Nights shall appear too long to me, keeping late liquors being deprived of my kinsmen and relatives and not beholding Vaidehi.

sanskrit: मन्ये दीर्घा भविष्यन्ति रात्रयो मम जाग्रतः
transliteration: manye dīrghā bhaviṣyanti rātrayo mama jāgrataḥ
english: I can range this Mandakini, this Janasthāna and this Pasravana hill if I can find Sītā there.

sanskrit: सर्वाणि अनुचरिष्यामि यदि सीता हि लभ्यते
एते महा मृगा वीर माम् ईक्षन्ते पुनः पुनः
transliteration: sarvāṇi anucariṣyāmi yadi sītā hi labhyate
ete mahā mṛgā vīra mām īkṣante punaḥ punaḥ

sanskrit: वक्तु कामा इह हि मे इंगितानि अनुपलक्षये
तान् तु दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्र राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह
transliteration: vaktu kāmā iha hi me iṃgitāni anupalakṣaye
tān tu dṛṣṭvā naravyāghra rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca ha

sanskrit: क्व सीत इति निरीक्षन् वै बाष्प संरुद्धया गिरा
एवम् उक्ता नरेन्द्रेण ते मृगाः सहसा उत्थिता
transliteration: kva sīta iti nirīkṣan vai bāṣpa saṃruddhayā girā
evam uktā narendreṇa te mṛgāḥ sahasā utthitā
english: Beholding them, Rāghava, the best of men, looked at them and said in accents choked with vapour-Where is Sītā? Being thus addressed by that Lord of men the deer rose up all on a sudden and looked up to the sky facing the south and proceeded to the direction by which Maithili had been carried away.

sanskrit: दक्षिण अभिमुखाः सर्वे दर्शयन्तो नभः स्थलम्
मैथिली ह्रियमाणा सा दिशम् याम् अभ्यपद्यत
transliteration: dakṣiṇa abhimukhāḥ sarve darśayanto nabhaḥ sthalam
maithilī hriyamāṇā sā diśam yām abhyapadyata

sanskrit: येन मार्गम् च भूमिम् च निरीक्षन्ते स्म ते मृगाः
transliteration: yena mārgam ca bhūmim ca nirīkṣante sma te mṛgāḥ

sanskrit: तेषाम् वचन सर्वस्वम् लक्षयामास च इन्गितम्
transliteration: teṣām vacana sarvasvam lakṣayāmāsa ca ingitam

sanskrit: उवाच लक्ष्मणो धीमान् ज्येष्ठम् भ्रातरम् आर्तवत्
क्व सीत इति त्वया पृष्टा यथा इमे सहसा उथिताः
transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇo dhīmān jyeṣṭham bhrātaram ārtavat
kva sīta iti tvayā pṛṣṭā yathā ime sahasā uthitāḥ

sanskrit: दर्शयन्ति क्षितिम् चैव दक्षिणाम् च दिशम् मृगाः
सधु गच्छावहे देव दिशम् एताम् च नैर्ऋतीम्
transliteration: darśayanti kṣitim caiva dakṣiṇām ca diśam mṛgāḥ
sadhu gacchāvahe deva diśam etām ca nairṛtīm

sanskrit: यदि तस्य आगमः कश्चित् आर्या वा सा अथ लक्ष्यते
बाढम् इति एव काकुत्स्थः प्रस्थितो दक्षिणाम् दिशम्
transliteration: yadi tasya āgamaḥ kaścit āryā vā sā atha lakṣyate
bāḍham iti eva kākutsthaḥ prasthito dakṣiṇām diśam

sanskrit: एवम् संभाषमाणौ तौ अन्योन्यम् भ्रातरौ उभौ
transliteration: evam saṃbhāṣamāṇau tau anyonyam bhrātarau ubhau

sanskrit: पुष्प वृष्टिम् निपतिताम् दृष्ट्वा रामो मही तले
transliteration: puṣpa vṛṣṭim nipatitām dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahī tale

sanskrit: उवाच लक्ष्मणम् वीरो दुःखितो दुःखितम् वचः
अभिजानामि पुष्पाणि तानि इमानि इह लक्ष्मण
transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇam vīro duḥkhito duḥkhitam vacaḥ
abhijānāmi puṣpāṇi tāni imāni iha lakṣmaṇa

sanskrit: मन्ये सूर्यः च वायुः च मेदिनी च यशशिविनि
transliteration: manye sūryaḥ ca vāyuḥ ca medinī ca yaśaśivini

sanskrit: उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा गिरिम् प्रसवण आकुलम्
कच्चित् क्षिति भृताम् नाथ दृष्टा सर्वांग सुंदरीम्
transliteration: uvāca rāmo dharmātmā girim prasavaṇa ākulam
kaccit kṣiti bhṛtām nātha dṛṣṭā sarvāṃga suṃdarīm

sanskrit: रामा रम्ये वनोद् देशे मया विरहिता त्वया
क्रुद्धो अब्रवीत् गिरिम् तत्र सिंहः क्षुद्र मृगम् यथा
transliteration: rāmā ramye vanod deśe mayā virahitā tvayā
kruddho abravīt girim tatra siṃhaḥ kṣudra mṛgam yathā

sanskrit: ताम् हेम वर्णाम् हेम अंगीम् सीताम् दर्शय पर्वत
यावत् सानूनि सर्वाणि न ते विध्वंसयामि अहम्
transliteration: tām hema varṇām hema aṃgīm sītām darśaya parvata
yāvat sānūni sarvāṇi na te vidhvaṃsayāmi aham

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण पर्वतो मैथिलीम् प्रति
दर्शयन् इव ताम् सीताम् न दर्शयत राघवे
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa parvato maithilīm prati
darśayan iva tām sītām na darśayata rāghave

sanskrit: मम बाण अग्नि निर्दग्धो भस्मी भूतो भविष्यसि
transliteration: mama bāṇa agni nirdagdho bhasmī bhūto bhaviṣyasi
english: Again addressed him Rāma—You shall by the fire of my arrows, be reduced to ashes-your twigs and leaves shall be totally destroyed and no one shall resort to you.

sanskrit: असेव्यः सततम् चैव निस्तृण द्रुम पल्लवः
इमाम् वा सरितम् च अद्य शोषयिष्यामि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: asevyaḥ satatam caiva nistṛṇa druma pallavaḥ
imām vā saritam ca adya śoṣayiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa

sanskrit: यदि न आख्याति मे सीताम् अद्य चन्द्र निभ आननाम्
एवम् प्ररुषितो रामो दिधक्षन् इव चक्षुषा
transliteration: yadi na ākhyāti me sītām adya candra nibha ānanām
evam praruṣito rāmo didhakṣan iva cakṣuṣā

sanskrit: ददर्श भूमौ निष्क्रांतम् राक्षसस्य पदम् महत्
त्रस्तया राम काङ्क्षिण्याः प्रधावन्त्या इतः ततः
transliteration: dadarśa bhūmau niṣkrāṃtam rākṣasasya padam mahat
trastayā rāma kāṅkṣiṇyāḥ pradhāvantyā itaḥ tataḥ
english: Rāma, exceedingly wroth, cast his looks around as if desiring to burn everything with his eyes and beheld footprints of the Räkşasas on the earth as well as those of Sītā moving wildly hither and thither, terrified and desirous to see Rāma, while pursued by the Rākşasas.

sanskrit: राक्षसेन अनुवृत्तया वैदेह्या च पादानि तु
स समीक्ष्य परिक्रान्तम् सीताया राक्षसस्य च
transliteration: rākṣasena anuvṛttayā vaidehyā ca pādāni tu
sa samīkṣya parikrāntam sītāyā rākṣasasya ca

sanskrit: भंगम् धनुः च तूणी च विकीर्णाम् बहुधा रथम्
संभ्रांत हृदयो रामः शशंस भ्रातरम् प्रियम्
transliteration: bhaṃgam dhanuḥ ca tūṇī ca vikīrṇām bahudhā ratham
saṃbhrāṃta hṛdayo rāmaḥ śaśaṃsa bhrātaram priyam
english: Beholding these foot marks, the snapped bow, the quiver and the chariot broken into many pieces, Rāma, terrified spoke to his dear brother.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याः कीर्णाम् कनक बिन्दवः
भूषणानाम् हि सौमित्रे माल्यानि विविधानि च
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyāḥ kīrṇām kanaka bindavaḥ
bhūṣaṇānām hi saumitre mālyāni vividhāni ca
english: Behold O, Laksmana, the remnants of Vaidehi's golden ornaments, strewn hither and thither, and diverse garlands.

sanskrit: तप्त बिन्दु निकाशैः च चित्रैः क्षतज बिन्दुभिः
आवृतम् पश्य सौमित्रे सर्वतो धरणी तलम्
transliteration: tapta bindu nikāśaiḥ ca citraiḥ kṣataja bindubhiḥ
āvṛtam paśya saumitre sarvato dharaṇī talam
english: Behold O Saumitrī, the earth covered with drops of blood resembling golden drops.

sanskrit: मन्ये लक्ष्मण वैदेही राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः
भित्त्वा भित्त्वा विभक्ता वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति
transliteration: manye lakṣmaṇa vaidehī rākṣasaiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ
bhittvā bhittvā vibhaktā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati
english: Methinks, O Laksmana, Vaidehi has been devoured by the Rākşasas assuming shapes at will, having sundered her in pieces.

sanskrit: बभूव युद्धम् सौमित्रे घोरम् राक्षसयोः इह
transliteration: babhūva yuddham saumitre ghoram rākṣasayoḥ iha
english: O Saumitrī, there took place a terrible conflict between the Rākṣasas, fighting with each other on Sita's account.

sanskrit: मुक्ता मणि चितम् च इदम् तपनीय विभूषितम्
धरण्याम् पतितम् सौम्य कस्य भग्नम् महत् धनुः
transliteration: muktā maṇi citam ca idam tapanīya vibhūṣitam
dharaṇyām patitam saumya kasya bhagnam mahat dhanuḥ
english: O gentle one, whose is this snapped bow lying on the breast of the earth adorned and crested with pearls and diamonds?

sanskrit: राक्षसानाम् इदम् वस्त सुराणाम् अधवा अपि
तरुण आदित्य संकाशम् वैदूर्य गुलिका चितम्
transliteration: rākṣasānām idam vasta surāṇām adhavā api
taruṇa āditya saṃkāśam vaidūrya gulikā citam

sanskrit: विशीर्णम् पतितम् भूमौ कवचम् कस्य कांचनम्
छत्रम् शत शलाकम् च दिव्य माल्य उपशोभितम्
transliteration: viśīrṇam patitam bhūmau kavacam kasya kāṃcanam
chatram śata śalākam ca divya mālya upaśobhitam

sanskrit: भग्न दण्डम् इदम् कस्य भूमौ सौम्य निपातितम्
कान्चन उरः छदाः च इमे पिशाच वदनाः खराः
transliteration: bhagna daṇḍam idam kasya bhūmau saumya nipātitam
kāncana uraḥ chadāḥ ca ime piśāca vadanāḥ kharāḥ

sanskrit: भीम रूपा महाकायाः कस्य वा निहता रणे
दीप्त पावक संकाशो द्युतिमान् समर ध्वजः
transliteration: bhīma rūpā mahākāyāḥ kasya vā nihatā raṇe
dīpta pāvaka saṃkāśo dyutimān samara dhvajaḥ

sanskrit: अपविद्धः च भग्नः च कस्य सांग्रामिको रथः
रथ अक्ष मात्रा विशिखाः तपनीय विभूषणाः
transliteration: apaviddhaḥ ca bhagnaḥ ca kasya sāṃgrāmiko rathaḥ
ratha akṣa mātrā viśikhāḥ tapanīya vibhūṣaṇāḥ

sanskrit: कस्य इमे निहता बाणाः प्रकीर्णा घोर दर्शनः
शरावरौ शरैः पूर्णौ विध्वस्तौ पश्य लक्ष्मण
transliteration: kasya ime nihatā bāṇāḥ prakīrṇā ghora darśanaḥ
śarāvarau śaraiḥ pūrṇau vidhvastau paśya lakṣmaṇa

sanskrit: प्रतोद अभीशु हस्तो अयम् कस्य वा सारथिः हतः
पदवी पुरुषस्य एषा व्यक्तम् कस्य अपि राक्षसः
transliteration: pratoda abhīśu hasto ayam kasya vā sārathiḥ hataḥ
padavī puruṣasya eṣā vyaktam kasya api rākṣasaḥ

sanskrit: वैरम् शत गुणम् पश्य मम तैः जीवित अंतकम्
सुघोर हृदयैः सौम्य राक्षसैः काम रूपिभिः
transliteration: vairam śata guṇam paśya mama taiḥ jīvita aṃtakam
sughora hṛdayaiḥ saumya rākṣasaiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ
english: These foot-marks must be some Raksasa's. I made these Rākşasas my fatal enemies, assuming shapes at will and of crooked hearts.

sanskrit: हृता मृता वा सीता हि भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी
न धर्मः त्रायते सीताम् ह्रियमाणाम् महावने
transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā sītā hi bhakṣitā vā tapasvinī
na dharmaḥ trāyate sītām hriyamāṇām mahāvane
english: Poor Sītā must have been either dead, carried away by them or devoured. Virtue did not save her from being carried away in this mighty forest.

sanskrit: भक्षितायाम् हि वैदेह्याम् हृतायाम् अपि लक्ष्मण
के हि लोके प्रियम् कर्तुम् शक्ताः सौम्य मम ईश्वराः
transliteration: bhakṣitāyām hi vaidehyām hṛtāyām api lakṣmaṇa
ke hi loke priyam kartum śaktāḥ saumya mama īśvarāḥ
english: O Lakşmaņa, while virtue did not protect Janakī being devoured or taken away by stealth, what person else gifted with heavenly power, on this earth shall bring about my well-being?

sanskrit: कर्तारम् अपि लोकानाम् शूरम् करुण वेदिनम्
transliteration: kartāram api lokānām śūram karuṇa vedinam
english: For this it is that people through ignorance disregard the ever kind Almighty-the lord of creatures and the best of the celestials.

sanskrit: मृदुम् लोक हिते युक्तम् दांतम् करुण वेदिनम्
निर्वीर्य इति मन्यन्ते नूनम् माम् त्रिदश ईश्वराः
transliteration: mṛdum loka hite yuktam dāṃtam karuṇa vedinam
nirvīrya iti manyante nūnam mām tridaśa īśvarāḥ
english: Truly shall the celestials regard me as one devoid of prowess, who am mild-tempered, kind, ever engaged in the welfare of the humanity, and have controlled all my senses.

sanskrit: माम् प्राप्य हि गुणो दोषः संवृत्तः पश्य लक्ष्मण
अद्य एव सर्व भूतानाम् रक्षसाम् अभवाय च
transliteration: mām prāpya hi guṇo doṣaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ paśya lakṣmaṇa
adya eva sarva bhūtānām rakṣasām abhavāya ca
english: Observe, O Laksmana, obtaining me as the stay these accomplishments have been turned into so many blemishes. Truly shall my prowess manifest itself to-day overshadowing all my other accomplishments for the destruction of the Rākşasas and all created beings like to the rising of the Sun casting the Moon into shade on the day of dissolution.

sanskrit: संहृत्य एव शशि ज्योत्स्नाम् महान् सूर्य इव उदितः
संहृत्य एव गुणान् सर्वान् मम तेजः प्रकाश्ते
transliteration: saṃhṛtya eva śaśi jyotsnām mahān sūrya iva uditaḥ
saṃhṛtya eva guṇān sarvān mama tejaḥ prakāśte
english: Observe, O Laksmana, obtaining me as the stay these accomplishments have been turned into so many blemishes. Truly shall my prowess manifest itself to-day overshadowing all my other accomplishments for the destruction of the Rākşasas and all created beings like to the rising of the Sun casting the Moon into shade on the day of dissolution.

sanskrit: न एव यक्षा न गंधर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः
किन्नरा वा मनुष्या वा सुखम् प्राप्स्यन्ति लक्ष्मण
transliteration: na eva yakṣā na gaṃdharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ
kinnarā vā manuṣyā vā sukham prāpsyanti lakṣmaṇa
english: None shall enjoy felicity, O Lakşmaņa,-Yaksas, Gandharvas, Pisacas, Raksasas, Kinnaras, or human beings.

sanskrit: मम अस्त्र बाण संपूर्णम् आकाशम् पश्य लक्ष्मण
असंपातम् करिष्यामि हि अद्य त्रैलोक्य चारिणाम्
transliteration: mama astra bāṇa saṃpūrṇam ākāśam paśya lakṣmaṇa
asaṃpātam kariṣyāmi hi adya trailokya cāriṇām
english: Today shall the welkin be filled up with my arrows. Motionless shall I make all the animals inhabiting the three worlds.

sanskrit: यद्व -संनिरुद्ध ग्रह गणम् आवारित निशा करम्
विप्रनष्ट अनल मरुत् भास्कर द्युति संवृतम्
transliteration: yadva -saṃniruddha graha gaṇam āvārita niśā karam
vipranaṣṭa anala marut bhāskara dyuti saṃvṛtam

sanskrit: यद्वा -विनिर्मथित शैल अग्रम् शुष्यमाण जल आशयम्
ध्वस्त द्रुम लता गुल्मम् विप्रणाशित सागरम्
transliteration: yadvā -vinirmathita śaila agram śuṣyamāṇa jala āśayam
dhvasta druma latā gulmam vipraṇāśita sāgaram

sanskrit: त्रै लोक्यम् तु करिष्यामि संयुक्तम् काल कर्मणा
न ते कुशलिनीम् सीताम् प्रदास्यन्ति मम ईश्वराः
transliteration: trai lokyam tu kariṣyāmi saṃyuktam kāla karmaṇā
na te kuśalinīm sītām pradāsyanti mama īśvarāḥ

sanskrit: अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते सौमित्रे मम द्रक्ष्यन्ति विक्रमम्
न आकाशम् उत्पतिष्यन्ति सर्व भूतानि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: asmin muhūrte saumitre mama drakṣyanti vikramam
na ākāśam utpatiṣyanti sarva bhūtāni lakṣmaṇa

sanskrit: मम चाप गुण उन्मुक्तैः बाण जालैः निरंतरम्
मर्दितम् मम नाराचैः ध्वस्त भ्रांत मृग द्विजम्
transliteration: mama cāpa guṇa unmuktaiḥ bāṇa jālaiḥ niraṃtaram
marditam mama nārācaiḥ dhvasta bhrāṃta mṛga dvijam
english: None shall be able to range the welkin. Behold O Lakşmaņa, being perpetually crushed down by my arrows shot off my bow, the world shall be disturbed and dislodged and the animals and birds shall be confused and destroyed.

sanskrit: समाकुलम् अमर्यादम् जगत् पश्य अद्य लक्ष्मण
यद्वा -आकर्ण पूर्णैर् इषुभिर् जीव लोकम् दुरावरैः
transliteration: samākulam amaryādam jagat paśya adya lakṣmaṇa
yadvā -ākarṇa pūrṇair iṣubhir jīva lokam durāvaraiḥ

sanskrit: मम रोष प्रयुक्तानाम् विशिखानाम् बलम् सुराः
transliteration: mama roṣa prayuktānām viśikhānām balam surāḥ

sanskrit: द्रक्ष्यन्ति अद्य विमुक्तानाम् अमर्षात् दूर गामिनाम्
न एव देवा न दैतेया न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः
transliteration: drakṣyanti adya vimuktānām amarṣāt dūra gāminām
na eva devā na daiteyā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ

sanskrit: देव दानव यक्षाणाम् लोका ये रक्षसाम् अपि
transliteration: deva dānava yakṣāṇām lokā ye rakṣasām api
english: Three worlds, destroyed on account of my wrath, celestials, Sanavas, Pisacas or Raks asas,-none shall be saved.

sanskrit: यद्वा -बहुधा नि पतिष्यन्ति बाण ओघैः शकली कृताः
यद्वा -निर् मर्यादान् इमान् लोकान् करिष्यामि अद्य सायकैः
transliteration: yadvā -bahudhā ni patiṣyanti bāṇa oghaiḥ śakalī kṛtāḥ
yadvā -nir maryādān imān lokān kariṣyāmi adya sāyakaiḥ

sanskrit: हृताम् मृताम् वा सौमित्रे न दास्यन्ति मम ईश्वराः
तथा रूपम् हि वैदेहीम् न दास्यन्ति यदि प्रियाम्
transliteration: hṛtām mṛtām vā saumitre na dāsyanti mama īśvarāḥ
tathā rūpam hi vaidehīm na dāsyanti yadi priyām

sanskrit: नाशयामि जगत् सर्वम् त्रैलोक्यम् स चर अचरम्
यावत् दर्शनम् अस्या वै तापयामि च सायकैः
transliteration: nāśayāmi jagat sarvam trailokyam sa cara acaram
yāvat darśanam asyā vai tāpayāmi ca sāyakaiḥ

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा क्रोध ताम्र अक्षः स्फुरमाण ओष्ट संपुटः
वल्कल अजिनम् आबद्ध्य जटा भारम् बन्धयत्
transliteration: iti uktvā krodha tāmra akṣaḥ sphuramāṇa oṣṭa saṃpuṭaḥ
valkala ajinam ābaddhya jaṭā bhāram bandhayat
english: Having spoken thus, Rāma, with his eyes reddened with fire and lips swollen, tying fast his bark and deer-skin, braided his matted locks.

sanskrit: तस्य क्रुद्धस्य रामस्य तथा अभूतस्य धीमतः
त्रि पुरम् जग्नुषः पूर्वम् रुद्रस्य इव बभौ तनुः
transliteration: tasya kruddhasya rāmasya tathā abhūtasya dhīmataḥ
tri puram jagnuṣaḥ pūrvam rudrasya iva babhau tanuḥ
english: Having done this, being exceedingly wroth he looked like Rudra about to destroy Tripura.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणात् अथ च आदाय रामो निष्पीड्य कार्मुकम्
शरम् आदाय संदीप्तम् घोरम् अशी विष उपमम्
transliteration: lakṣmaṇāt atha ca ādāya rāmo niṣpīḍya kārmukam
śaram ādāya saṃdīptam ghoram aśī viṣa upamam
