स हि स्थानानि सर्वाणि कार्त्स्न्येन कपि कुंजरः
transliteration: kuru rāghava satyena vayasyam vana cāriṇam
sa hi sthānāni sarvāṇi kārtsnyena kapi kuṃjaraḥ

sanskrit: नर मांस अशिनाम् लोके नैपुण्यात् अधिगच्छति
न तस्य अविदितम् लोके किंचित् अस्ति हि राघव
transliteration: nara māṃsa aśinām loke naipuṇyāt adhigacchati
na tasya aviditam loke kiṃcit asti hi rāghava

sanskrit: स नदीः विपुलान् शैलान् गिरि दुर्गाणि कंदरान्
transliteration: sa nadīḥ vipulān śailān giri durgāṇi kaṃdarān

sanskrit: अन्विष्य वानरैः सार्धम् पत्नीम् ते अधिगमिष्यति
transliteration: anviṣya vānaraiḥ sārdham patnīm te adhigamiṣyati

sanskrit: दिशो विचेतुम् ताम् सीताम् त्वत् वियोगेन शोचयतीम्
transliteration: diśo vicetum tām sītām tvat viyogena śocayatīm
english: He shall search that exquisitely fine damsel Maithili in Ravana's abode, bewailing on your separation, and to find her out he shall despatch, O Rāghava, many a monkey of huge proportions to various quarters.

sanskrit: स मेरु शृंग अग्र गताम् अनिंदिताम्प्रविश्य पाताल तले अपि वा आश्रिताम्
प्लवंगमानाम् ऋषभः तव प्रियाम्निहत्य रक्षाम्सि पुनः प्रदास्यति
transliteration: sa meru śṛṃga agra gatām aniṃditāmpraviśya pātāla tale api vā āśritām
plavaṃgamānām ṛṣabhaḥ tava priyāmnihatya rakṣāmsi punaḥ pradāsyati
english: Whether on the summit of the mount Meru or in the region under the earth, that lord of monkeys, shall give you back your blameless spouse, killing all the Raksasas.

sanskrit: वाक्यम् अन्वर्थम् अर्थज्ञः कबंधः पुनः अब्रवीत्
transliteration: vākyam anvartham arthajñaḥ kabaṃdhaḥ punaḥ abravīt
english: Having pointed out to Rāma the expedient for finding out Sītā the wise Kabandha began with the following significant words.

sanskrit: एष राम शिवः पंथा यत्र एते पुष्पिता द्रुमाः
प्रतीचीम् दिशम् आश्रित्य प्रकाशन्ते मनो रमाः
transliteration: eṣa rāma śivaḥ paṃthā yatra ete puṣpitā drumāḥ
pratīcīm diśam āśritya prakāśante mano ramāḥ

sanskrit: जंबू प्रियाल पनसाः प्लक्ष न्यग्रोध तिंदुकाः
अश्वत्थाः कर्णिकाराः च चूताः च अन्ये च पादपाः
transliteration: jaṃbū priyāla panasāḥ plakṣa nyagrodha tiṃdukāḥ
aśvatthāḥ karṇikārāḥ ca cūtāḥ ca anye ca pādapāḥ

sanskrit: नील अशोक कदंबाः च करवीराः च पुष्पिताः
transliteration: nīla aśoka kadaṃbāḥ ca karavīrāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ

sanskrit: तान् आरुह्य अथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा च तान् बलात्
transliteration: tān āruhya athavā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tān balāt

sanskrit: तत् अतिक्रम्य काकुत्स्थ वनम् पुषित पादपम्
transliteration: tat atikramya kākutstha vanam puṣita pādapam

sanskrit: नंदन प्रतिमम् तु अन्यत् कुरवः उत्तरा इव
सर्व काल फला यत्र पादपा मधुर स्रवाः
transliteration: naṃdana pratimam tu anyat kuravaḥ uttarā iva
sarva kāla phalā yatra pādapā madhura sravāḥ

sanskrit: सर्वे च ऋतवः तत्र वने चैत्ररथे यथा
फल भार नताः तत्र महा विटप धारिणः
transliteration: sarve ca ṛtavaḥ tatra vane caitrarathe yathā
phala bhāra natāḥ tatra mahā viṭapa dhāriṇaḥ

sanskrit: शोबन्ते सर्वतः तत्र मेघ पर्वत संनिभाः
तान् आरुह्य अथवा भूमौ पातैत्वा यथा सुखम्
transliteration: śobante sarvataḥ tatra megha parvata saṃnibhāḥ
tān āruhya athavā bhūmau pātaitvā yathā sukham

sanskrit: फलानि अमृत कल्पानि लक्षमणः ते प्रदास्यति
चङ्क्रमंतौ वरान् शैलान् शैलात् शैलम् वनात् वनम्
transliteration: phalāni amṛta kalpāni lakṣamaṇaḥ te pradāsyati
caṅkramaṃtau varān śailān śailāt śailam vanāt vanam

sanskrit: ततः पुष्करिणीम् वीरौ पंपाम् नाम गमिष्यथः
transliteration: tataḥ puṣkariṇīm vīrau paṃpām nāma gamiṣyathaḥ
english: O heroes, ranging from forest to forest, from high mountains to hillocks, you shall get at the lake Pampā, void of gravels and acquatic plants and hence there is no danger of falling down to the people, having level watering-places, covered with sands and blooming with red and white lotuses.

sanskrit: राम संजात वालूकाम् कमल उत्पल शोभिताम्
तत्र हंसाः प्लवाः क्रौङ्चाः कुरराः चैव राघव
transliteration: rāma saṃjāta vālūkām kamala utpala śobhitām
tatra haṃsāḥ plavāḥ krauṅcāḥ kurarāḥ caiva rāghava

sanskrit: वल्गु स्वरा निकूजन्ति पंपा सलिल गोचराः
न उद्विजन्ते नरान् दृष्ट्वा वधस्य अकोविदाः शुभाः
transliteration: valgu svarā nikūjanti paṃpā salila gocarāḥ
na udvijante narān dṛṣṭvā vadhasya akovidāḥ śubhāḥ
english: There emit forth musical notes, swans, frogs, cranes and ospreys sporting in the lake Pampā. They are not filled with terror in view of human beings, inexperienced as they are in the matter of destruction.

sanskrit: घृत पिण्ड उपमान् स्थूलान् तान् द्विजान् भक्षयिष्यथः
रोहितान् वक्र तुण्डान् च नल मीनान् च राघव
transliteration: ghṛta piṇḍa upamān sthūlān tān dvijān bhakṣayiṣyathaḥ
rohitān vakra tuṇḍān ca nala mīnān ca rāghava

sanskrit: पंपायाम् इषुभिः मत्स्यान् तत्र राम वरान् हतान्
निस्त्वक्पक्षानयसतप्तानकृशान्नैककण्टकान् - यद्वा -निः त्वक् पक्षान् अयस तप्तान् अकृशान् न अनेक कण्टकान्
transliteration: paṃpāyām iṣubhiḥ matsyān tatra rāma varān hatān
nistvakpakṣānayasataptānakṛśānnaikakaṇṭakān - yadvā -niḥ tvak pakṣān ayasa taptān akṛśān na aneka kaṇṭakān

sanskrit: भृशम् तान् खादतो मत्स्यान् पंपायाः पुष्प संचये
transliteration: bhṛśam tān khādato matsyān paṃpāyāḥ puṣpa saṃcaye

sanskrit: पद्म गन्धि शिवम् वारि सुख शीतम् अनामयम्
उद्धृत्य स तदा अक्लिष्टम् रूप्य स्फटिक सन्निभम्
transliteration: padma gandhi śivam vāri sukha śītam anāmayam
uddhṛtya sa tadā akliṣṭam rūpya sphaṭika sannibham

sanskrit: स्थूलान् गिरि गुहा शय्यान् वानरान् वन चारिणः
transliteration: sthūlān giri guhā śayyān vānarān vana cāriṇaḥ

sanskrit: साय आह्ने विचरन् राम दर्शयिष्यति लक्ष्मणः
अपाम् लोभात उपावृत्तान् वृषभान् इव नर्दतः
transliteration: sāya āhne vicaran rāma darśayiṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ
apām lobhāta upāvṛttān vṛṣabhān iva nardataḥ

sanskrit: रूप अन्वितान् च पंपायाम् द्रक्ष्यसि त्वम् नरोत्तम
साय अह्ने विचरन् राम विटपीन् माल्य धारिणः
transliteration: rūpa anvitān ca paṃpāyām drakṣyasi tvam narottama
sāya ahne vicaran rāma viṭapīn mālya dhāriṇaḥ

sanskrit: शिव उदकम् च पंपायाम् दृष्ट्वा शोकम् विहास्यसि
सु मनोभिः चितान् तत्र तिलकान् नक्त मालकान्
transliteration: śiva udakam ca paṃpāyām dṛṣṭvā śokam vihāsyasi
su manobhiḥ citān tatra tilakān nakta mālakān

sanskrit: उत्पलानि च फुल्लानि पंकजानि च राघव
न तानि कश्चित् माल्यानि तत्र आरोपयिता नरः
transliteration: utpalāni ca phullāni paṃkajāni ca rāghava
na tāni kaścit mālyāni tatra āropayitā naraḥ

sanskrit: न च वै म्लानताम् यान्ति न च शीर्यन्ति राघव
मतंग शिष्याः तत्र आसन् ऋषयः सुसमाहितः
transliteration: na ca vai mlānatām yānti na ca śīryanti rāghava
mataṃga śiṣyāḥ tatra āsan ṛṣayaḥ susamāhitaḥ

sanskrit: तेषाम् भार अभितप्तानाम् वन्यम् आहरताम् गुरोः
ये प्रपेतुः महीम् तूर्णम् शरीरात् स्वेद बिन्दवः
transliteration: teṣām bhāra abhitaptānām vanyam āharatām guroḥ
ye prapetuḥ mahīm tūrṇam śarīrāt sveda bindavaḥ

sanskrit: तानि माल्यानि जातानि मुनीनाम् तपसा तदा
स्वेद बिन्दु समुत्थानि न विनश्यन्ति राघव
transliteration: tāni mālyāni jātāni munīnām tapasā tadā
sveda bindu samutthāni na vinaśyanti rāghava

sanskrit: तेषाम् गतानाम् अद्य अपि दृश्यते परिचारिणी
श्रमणी शबरी नाम काकुत्स्थ चिर जीविनी
transliteration: teṣām gatānām adya api dṛśyate paricāriṇī
śramaṇī śabarī nāma kākutstha cira jīvinī
english: Even at the present day, O Kakutstha, there live an immortal mendicant woman, by name Savari, who had waited in attendance upon those departed ones. Beholding you, O Rāma, who are adored of all creatures like to the Deity Himself, that mendicant woman, ever engaged in pious observances, shall attain to the abode of celestials.

sanskrit: त्वाम् तु धर्मे स्थिता नित्यम् सर्व भूत नमस्कृतम्
दृष्ट्वा देव उपमम् राम स्वर्ग लोकम् गमिष्यति
transliteration: tvām tu dharme sthitā nityam sarva bhūta namaskṛtam
dṛṣṭvā deva upamam rāma svarga lokam gamiṣyati
english: Even at the present day, O Kakutstha, there live an immortal mendicant woman, by name Savari, who had waited in attendance upon those departed ones. Beholding you, O Rāma, who are adored of all creatures like to the Deity Himself, that mendicant woman, ever engaged in pious observances, shall attain to the abode of celestials.

sanskrit: ततः तत् राम पंपायाः तीरम् आश्रित्य पश्चिमम्
आश्रम स्थानम् अतुलम् गुह्यम् काकुत्स्थ पश्यसि
transliteration: tataḥ tat rāma paṃpāyāḥ tīram āśritya paścimam
āśrama sthānam atulam guhyam kākutstha paśyasi
english: O Rāma, turning to the western bank of Pampa, you shall, O Kakutstha, behold the incomparable and secret asylum of Matanga.

sanskrit: न तत्र आक्रमितुम् नागाः शक्नुवन्ति तद् आश्रमे
ऋषेः तस्य मतंगस्य विधानात् तत् च काननम्
transliteration: na tatra ākramitum nāgāḥ śaknuvanti tad āśrame
ṛṣeḥ tasya mataṃgasya vidhānāt tat ca kānanam
english: Fearing the divine authority of that great ascetic Matanga, the elephants, though there are many, dare not cross the threshold of his asylum.

sanskrit: मातंग वनम् इति एव विश्रुतम् रघुनंदन
तस्मिन् नंदन संकाशे देव अरण्य उपमे वने
transliteration: mātaṃga vanam iti eva viśrutam raghunaṃdana
tasmin naṃdana saṃkāśe deva araṇya upame vane
english: O Rāghava, this forest is widely known as Matanga wood. You shall sport, O Rāma, with a delighted heart in that forest resembling the celestial garden-Nandana and filled with various birds.

sanskrit: नाना विहग संकीर्णे रंस्यसे राम निर्वृतः
ऋष्यमूकः तु पंपायाः पुरस्तात् पुष्पित द्रुमः
transliteration: nānā vihaga saṃkīrṇe raṃsyase rāma nirvṛtaḥ
ṛṣyamūkaḥ tu paṃpāyāḥ purastāt puṣpita drumaḥ

sanskrit: सु दुःख आरोहणः च एव शिशु नाग अभिरक्षितः
उदारो ब्रह्मणा चैव पूर्व काले विनिर्मितः
transliteration: su duḥkha ārohaṇaḥ ca eva śiśu nāga abhirakṣitaḥ
udāro brahmaṇā caiva pūrva kāle vinirmitaḥ
english: There stands in front of Pampă the highly inaccessible mount Rşyamūka, ornamented with many a blossoming tree and guarded on all sides by little serpents. That mount is highly munificent. It was created by Brahmā in the days of yore.

sanskrit: शयानः पुरुषो राम तस्य शैलस्य मूर्धनि
यत् स्वप्ने लभते वित्तम् तत् प्रबुद्धो अधिगच्छति
transliteration: śayānaḥ puruṣo rāma tasya śailasya mūrdhani
yat svapne labhate vittam tat prabuddho adhigacchati
english: A person, sleeping on the summit of that hill and dreaming of an accession of wealth, really gets at it after the dream is over. A perpetrator of iniquitous deeds and engaged in impious observances ascending that hill, the Rākṣasas seize upon him, asleep, and bruise him.

sanskrit: यः तु एनम् विषम आचारः पाप कर्मा अधिरोहति
तत्र एव प्रहरन्ति एनम् सुप्तम् आदाय राक्षसाः
transliteration: yaḥ tu enam viṣama ācāraḥ pāpa karmā adhirohati
tatra eva praharanti enam suptam ādāya rākṣasāḥ
english: A person, sleeping on the summit of that hill and dreaming of an accession of wealth, really gets at it after the dream is over. A perpetrator of iniquitous deeds and engaged in impious observances ascending that hill, the Rākṣasas seize upon him, asleep, and bruise him.

sanskrit: तत्र अपि शिशु नागानाम् आक्रंदः श्रूयते महान्
क्रीडताम् राम पंपायाम् मतंग आश्रम वासिनाम्
transliteration: tatra api śiśu nāgānām ākraṃdaḥ śrūyate mahān
krīḍatām rāma paṃpāyām mataṃga āśrama vāsinām
english: You shall hear the terrible roar of the young elephants ranging in the asylum of Matanga, situated on the banks of Pampā.

sanskrit: सिक्ता रुधिर धाराभिः संहत्य परम द्विपाः
प्रचरन्ति पृथक् कीर्णा मेघ वर्णाः तरस्विनः
transliteration: siktā rudhira dhārābhiḥ saṃhatya parama dvipāḥ
pracaranti pṛthak kīrṇā megha varṇāḥ tarasvinaḥ
english: You shall furthermore observe many a quickly moving, infuriated elephant, resembling clouds in hue and with red temporal juice oozing out of their heads, roaming here and there sometimes separately and again in a band. Those mighty elephants, roaming the forest, return to their woody homes, drinking the pleasant, pure and sweet smelling water of Pampā.

sanskrit: ते तत्र पीत्वा पानीयम् विमलम् चारु शोभनम्
अत्यन्त सुख संस्पर्शम् सर्व गन्ध समन्वितम्
transliteration: te tatra pītvā pānīyam vimalam cāru śobhanam
atyanta sukha saṃsparśam sarva gandha samanvitam

sanskrit: ऋक्षाम् च द्विपिनः चैव नील कोमलक प्रभान्
transliteration: ṛkṣām ca dvipinaḥ caiva nīla komalaka prabhān

sanskrit: रुरून् अपेता अपजयान् दृष्ट्वा शोकम् प्रहास्यसि
राम तस्य तु शैलस्य महती शोभते गुहा
transliteration: rurūn apetā apajayān dṛṣṭvā śokam prahāsyasi
rāma tasya tu śailasya mahatī śobhate guhā

sanskrit: शिला पिधाना काकुत्स्थ दुःखम् च अस्याः प्रवेशनम्
तस्या गुहायाः प्राक् द्वारे महान् शीत उदको ह्रदः
transliteration: śilā pidhānā kākutstha duḥkham ca asyāḥ praveśanam
tasyā guhāyāḥ prāk dvāre mahān śīta udako hradaḥ

sanskrit: बहु मूल फलो रम्यो नाना नग समाकुलः
तस्याम् वसति सुग्रीवः चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः
transliteration: bahu mūla phalo ramyo nānā naga samākulaḥ
tasyām vasati sugrīvaḥ caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ

sanskrit: कदाचित् शिखरे तस्य पर्वतस्य अपि तिष्ठते
कबंधः तु अनुशास्य एवम् तौ उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: kadācit śikhare tasya parvatasya api tiṣṭhate
kabaṃdhaḥ tu anuśāsya evam tau ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau

sanskrit: स्रग्वी भास्कर वर्ण आभः खे व्यरोचत वीर्यवान्
तम् तु ख स्थम् महाभागम् कबंधम् राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: sragvī bhāskara varṇa ābhaḥ khe vyarocata vīryavān
tam tu kha stham mahābhāgam kabaṃdham rāma lakṣmaṇau

sanskrit: प्रस्थितौ त्वम् व्रजस्व इति वाक्यम् ऊचतुः अन्तिके
गम्यताम् कार्य सिद्धि अर्थम् इति तौ अब्रवीत् च सः
transliteration: prasthitau tvam vrajasva iti vākyam ūcatuḥ antike
gamyatām kārya siddhi artham iti tau abravīt ca saḥ

sanskrit: सुप्रीतौ तौ अनुज्ञाप्य कबंधः प्रस्थितः तदा
transliteration: suprītau tau anujñāpya kabaṃdhaḥ prasthitaḥ tadā
english: Whereto Kabandha replied, saying Do you proceed to make good your end and bidding them adieu, who were well pleased, departed.

sanskrit: स तत् कबंधः प्रतिपद्य रूपम्वृतः श्रिया भास्कर सर्व देहः
निदर्शयन् रामम् अवेक्ष्य ख स्थःसख्यम् कुरुष्व इति तदा अभ्युवाच
transliteration: sa tat kabaṃdhaḥ pratipadya rūpamvṛtaḥ śriyā bhāskara sarva dehaḥ
nidarśayan rāmam avekṣya kha sthaḥsakhyam kuruṣva iti tadā abhyuvāca
english: Regaining his pristine beauty and shining in grace and effulgence that Kabandha, who was on the sky, fixing his looks upon Rāma, and pointing out to him his way, said Do you make friends with (Sugrīva).

sanskrit: तौ कबन्धेन तम् मार्गम् पम्पाया दर्शितम् वने
आतस्थतुः दिशम् गृह्य प्रतीचीम् नृ वर आत्मजौ
transliteration: tau kabandhena tam mārgam pampāyā darśitam vane
ātasthatuḥ diśam gṛhya pratīcīm nṛ vara ātmajau
english: Thereupon Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, sons of a kingly father, passing along the way, pointed out by Kabandha, leading to the lake Pampā, proceeded towards the West.

sanskrit: तौ शैलेषु आचित अनेकान् क्षौद्र कल्प फल द्रुमान्
वीक्षन्तौ जग्मतुः द्रष्टुम् सुग्रीवम् राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: tau śaileṣu ācita anekān kṣaudra kalpa phala drumān
vīkṣantau jagmatuḥ draṣṭum sugrīvam rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: They wending their way desirous of seeing Sugrīva, there came within the compass of their vision many trees, grown on the summits of the mountains, blossoming with flowers and abounding in fruits tasting sweet like to honey.

sanskrit: कृत्वा च शैल पृष्ठे तु तौ वासम् रघु नन्दनौ
transliteration: kṛtvā ca śaila pṛṣṭhe tu tau vāsam raghu nandanau

sanskrit: तौ पुष्करिण्याः पंपायाः तीरम् आसाद्य पश्चिमम्
अपश्यताम् ततः तत्र शबर्या रम्यम् आश्रमम्
transliteration: tau puṣkariṇyāḥ paṃpāyāḥ tīram āsādya paścimam
apaśyatām tataḥ tatra śabaryā ramyam āśramam
english: Passing the night on the summit of a hill those two descendants of Raghu arrived at the western bank of Pampā and espied the pleasant asylum of Savari.

sanskrit: तौ तम् आश्रमम् आसाद्य द्रुमैः बहुभिः आवृतम्
transliteration: tau tam āśramam āsādya drumaiḥ bahubhiḥ āvṛtam
english: Getting at that charming hermitage covered on all sides with trees and casting their looks around they beheld that female mendicant-Savari.

sanskrit: तौ दृष्ट्वा तु तदा सिद्धा समुत्थाय कृतांजलिः
पादौ जग्राह रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः
transliteration: tau dṛṣṭvā tu tadā siddhā samutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ
pādau jagrāha rāmasya lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ
english: No sooner had that one of perfect asceticism beheld those highly intelligent Rāma and Laks maņa than she rose up with folded hands and touching their feet offered them duly water for washing their feet and mouth. Thereupon Rāma spoke to that female ascetic, engaged in religious services.

sanskrit: पाद्यम् आचमनीयम् च सर्वम् प्रददात् यथा विधि
ताम् उवाच ततो रामः श्रमणीम् धर्म संस्थिताम्
transliteration: pādyam ācamanīyam ca sarvam pradadāt yathā vidhi
tām uvāca tato rāmaḥ śramaṇīm dharma saṃsthitām

sanskrit: कच्चित् ते निर्जिता विघ्नाः कच्चित् ते वर्धते तपः
कच्चित् ते नियतः कोप आहारः च तपोधने
transliteration: kaccit te nirjitā vighnāḥ kaccit te vardhate tapaḥ
kaccit te niyataḥ kopa āhāraḥ ca tapodhane
english: O you of sweet accents, have you got all hindrances to asceticism removed? Is your asceticism growing stronger every day? O you having asceticism for your wealth, have you restricted your anger and fare? Have you observed the commandments and attained to mental felicity? Have your attendance upon your spiritual guide born fruits?

sanskrit: कच्चित् ते नियमाः प्राप्ताः कच्चित् ते मनसः सुखम्
कच्चित् ते गुरु शुश्रूषा सफला चारु भाषिणि
transliteration: kaccit te niyamāḥ prāptāḥ kaccit te manasaḥ sukham
kaccit te guru śuśrūṣā saphalā cāru bhāṣiṇi
english: O you of sweet accents, have you got all hindrances to asceticism removed? Is your asceticism growing stronger every day? O you having asceticism for your wealth, have you restricted your anger and fare? Have you observed the commandments and attained to mental felicity? Have your attendance upon your spiritual guide born fruits?

sanskrit: रामेण तापसी पृष्ठा सा सिद्धा सिद्ध सम्मता
शशंस शबरी वृद्धा रामाय प्रति अवस्थिता
transliteration: rāmeṇa tāpasī pṛṣṭhā sā siddhā siddha sammatā
śaśaṃsa śabarī vṛddhā rāmāya prati avasthitā
english: Being thus accosted by Rāma that old Savarī, of accomplished asceticism and recognised by the Siddhas, approaching Rāma spoke.

sanskrit: अद्य प्राप्ता तपः सिद्धिः तव संदर्शनात् मया
अद्य मे सफलम् जन्म गुरवः च सुपूजिताः
transliteration: adya prāptā tapaḥ siddhiḥ tava saṃdarśanāt mayā
adya me saphalam janma guravaḥ ca supūjitāḥ
english: Favoured with your presence my asceticism has attained to its consummation. Blessed is my birth, fruitful is my service to my spiritual guides and accomplished is my asceticism.

sanskrit: अद्य मे सफलम् तप्तम् स्वर्गः चैव भविष्यति
त्वयि देव वरे राम पूजिते पुरुषर्षभ
transliteration: adya me saphalam taptam svargaḥ caiva bhaviṣyati
tvayi deva vare rāma pūjite puruṣarṣabha
english: O best of men, you are the foremost of celestials; worshipping you I attain to the abode of deities. O gentle one, O slayer of foes, O you that do confer honours on men, yourself casting your auspicious looks upon me, consecrated I, by your favour, shall attain to the imperishable land of celestials.

sanskrit: तव अहम् चक्षुषा सौम्य पूता सौम्येन मानद
गमिष्याम्यक्षयांलोकांस्वत्प्रसादादरिन्दम - यद्वा -गमिष्यामि अक्षयान् लोकान् त्वत् प्रसादात् अरिंदम
transliteration: tava aham cakṣuṣā saumya pūtā saumyena mānada
gamiṣyāmyakṣayāṃlokāṃsvatprasādādarindama - yadvā -gamiṣyāmi akṣayān lokān tvat prasādāt ariṃdama

sanskrit: चित्रकूटम् त्वयि प्राप्ते विमानैः अतुल प्रभैः
इतः ते दिवम् आरूढा यान् अहम् पर्यचारिषम्
transliteration: citrakūṭam tvayi prāpte vimānaiḥ atula prabhaiḥ
itaḥ te divam ārūḍhā yān aham paryacāriṣam
english: On your setting foot on the mount Citrakūta, the ascetics whom I served, ascending celestial cars of incomparable lustre, departed to heaven.

sanskrit: तैः च अहम् उक्ता धर्म ज्ञैः महाभागैः महर्षिभिः
आगमिष्यति ते रामः सु पुण्यम् इमम् आश्रमम्
transliteration: taiḥ ca aham uktā dharma jñaiḥ mahābhāgaiḥ maharṣibhiḥ
āgamiṣyati te rāmaḥ su puṇyam imam āśramam
english: Those great ascetics, cognizant of virtue, said to me, Rāma shall come to your holy asylum. Do you receive with great reverence that guest together with Laksmana. On beholding him, you shall attain to that best land of the celestials whence none return.

sanskrit: स ते प्रतिग्रहीतव्यः सौमित्रि सहितो अतिथिः
तम् च दृष्ट्वा वरान् लोकान् अक्षयान् त्वम् गमिष्यसि
transliteration: sa te pratigrahītavyaḥ saumitri sahito atithiḥ
tam ca dṛṣṭvā varān lokān akṣayān tvam gamiṣyasi
english: Those great ascetics, cognizant of virtue, said to me, Rāma shall come to your holy asylum. Do you receive with great reverence that guest together with Laksmana. On beholding him, you shall attain to that best land of the celestials whence none return.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता महाभागैः तदा अहम् पुरुषर्षभ
मया तु विविधम् वन्यम् संचितम् पुरुषर्षभ
transliteration: evam uktā mahābhāgaiḥ tadā aham puruṣarṣabha
mayā tu vividham vanyam saṃcitam puruṣarṣabha
english: O best of men, I was thus told by those great ascetics, and for you I have collected various wild fruits growing on the banks of Pampā.

sanskrit: तव अर्थे पुरुषव्याघ्र पम्पायाः तीर संभवम्
एवम् उक्तः स धर्मात्मा शबर्या शबरीम् इदम्
transliteration: tava arthe puruṣavyāghra pampāyāḥ tīra saṃbhavam
evam uktaḥ sa dharmātmā śabaryā śabarīm idam

sanskrit: राघवः प्राह विज्ञाने ताम् नित्यम् अबहिष्कृताम्
दनोः सकाशात् तत्त्वेन प्रभावम् ते महात्मनः
transliteration: rāghavaḥ prāha vijñāne tām nityam abahiṣkṛtām
danoḥ sakāśāt tattvena prabhāvam te mahātmanaḥ

sanskrit: श्रुतम् प्रत्यक्षम् इच्छामि संद्रष्टुम् यदि मन्यसे
एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा राम वक्त्रात् विनिःसृतम्
transliteration: śrutam pratyakṣam icchāmi saṃdraṣṭum yadi manyase
etat tu vacanam śrutvā rāma vaktrāt viniḥsṛtam

sanskrit: शबरी दर्शयामास तौ उभौ तत् वनम् महत्
पश्य मेघ घन प्रख्यम् मृग पक्षि समाकुलम्
transliteration: śabarī darśayāmāsa tau ubhau tat vanam mahat
paśya megha ghana prakhyam mṛga pakṣi samākulam

sanskrit: मतंग वनम् इति एव विश्रुतम् रघुनंदन
इह ते भावित आत्मानो गुरवो मे महाद्युते
जुहवान् चक्रिरे नीडम् मंत्रवत् मंत्र पूजितम्
transliteration: mataṃga vanam iti eva viśrutam raghunaṃdana
iha te bhāvita ātmāno guravo me mahādyute
juhavān cakrire nīḍam maṃtravat maṃtra pūjitam
english: Here in this forest the pure-souled preceptors sacrificed to fire their persons consecrated by the Mantras as Mantra itself.

sanskrit: इयम् प्रत्यक् स्थली वेदी यत्र ते मे सुसत्कृताः
पुष्प उपहारम् कुर्वन्ति श्रमात् उद् वेपिभिः करैः
transliteration: iyam pratyak sthalī vedī yatra te me susatkṛtāḥ
puṣpa upahāram kurvanti śramāt ud vepibhiḥ karaiḥ
english: This is that alter Pratyaksthalī, ascending which my worshipful preceptors used to offer flowers to the deities with hands trembling with toil,

sanskrit: तेषाम् तपः प्रभावेन पश्य अद्य अपि रघूत्तम
द्योतयन्ति दिशः सर्वाः श्रिया वेद्यः अतुल प्रभाः
transliteration: teṣām tapaḥ prabhāvena paśya adya api raghūttama
dyotayanti diśaḥ sarvāḥ śriyā vedyaḥ atula prabhāḥ
english: Behold, O best of Raghus, this alter of incomparable beauty, by virtue of their asceticism, has been still shedding its lustre on all the sides.

sanskrit: अशक्नुवद्भिस्तैर्गन्तुमुपवासश्रमालसैः - यद्वा -अशक्नुवद्भिः तैः गन्तुम् उपवास श्रम आलसैः
चिन्तिते अभ्यागतान् पश्य समेतान् सप्त सागरान्
transliteration: aśaknuvadbhistairgantumupavāsaśramālasaiḥ - yadvā -aśaknuvadbhiḥ taiḥ gantum upavāsa śrama ālasaiḥ
cintite abhyāgatān paśya sametān sapta sāgarān
english: Behold, again, the seven seas have appeared here in conjunction, at their very thought, worn out with fast and therefore incapable of moving on.

sanskrit: कृत अभिषेकैः तैः न्यस्ता वल्कलाः पादपेषु इह
अद्य अपि न विशुष्यन्ति प्रदेशे रघुनंदन
transliteration: kṛta abhiṣekaiḥ taiḥ nyastā valkalāḥ pādapeṣu iha
adya api na viśuṣyanti pradeśe raghunaṃdana
english: Even those barks, which they used to place on these trees after ablution have not yet been dried up.

sanskrit: देव कार्याणि कुर्वद्भिः यानि इमानि कृतानि वै
पुष्पैः कुवलयैः सार्थम् म्लानत्वम् न तु यान्ति वै
transliteration: deva kāryāṇi kurvadbhiḥ yāni imāni kṛtāni vai
puṣpaiḥ kuvalayaiḥ sārtham mlānatvam na tu yānti vai
english: These flowers, of blue colour which they offered to the deities, being engaged in divine services, have not yet been withered away.

sanskrit: कृत्स्नम् वनम् इदम् दृष्टम् श्रोतव्यम् च श्रुतम् त्वया
तत् इच्छामि अभ्यनुज्ञाता त्यक्ष्यामि एतत् कलेवरम्
transliteration: kṛtsnam vanam idam dṛṣṭam śrotavyam ca śrutam tvayā
tat icchāmi abhyanujñātā tyakṣyāmi etat kalevaram
english: You have observed this entire forest and heard every thing worth hearing. I purpose now to renounce my body being commanded by you.

sanskrit: तेषाम् इच्छामि अहम् गन्तुम् समीपम् भावित आत्मनाम्
मुनीनाम् आश्रमो येषाम् अहम् च परिचारिणी
transliteration: teṣām icchāmi aham gantum samīpam bhāvita ātmanām
munīnām āśramo yeṣām aham ca paricāriṇī
english: I wish to approach those pure-souled ascetics, whom I used to wait upon, and whom these asylums belong to.

sanskrit: धर्मिष्ठम् तु वचः श्रुत्वा राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः
प्रहर्सम् अतुलम् लेभे आश्चर्यम् इदम् च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: dharmiṣṭham tu vacaḥ śrutvā rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
praharsam atulam lebhe āścaryam idam ca abravīt
english: Hearing with Lakşmaņa the speech of the pious one, Rāma gained an excess of joy and exclaiming, Wonderful it is!

sanskrit: ताम् उवाच ततो रामः शबरी संश्रित व्रताम्
अर्चितो अहम् त्वया भद्रे गच्छ कामम् यथा सुखम्
transliteration: tām uvāca tato rāmaḥ śabarī saṃśrita vratām
arcito aham tvayā bhadre gaccha kāmam yathā sukham
english: Again spoke to Savarī of keen austerities-0 gentle one, I have been worshipped by you. Do you repair at your ease and pleasure.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्ता जटिला चीर कृष्ण अजिन अंबरा
अनुज्ञाता तु रामेण हुत्वा आत्मानम् हुत अशने
transliteration: iti evam uktā jaṭilā cīra kṛṣṇa ajina aṃbarā
anujñātā tu rāmeṇa hutvā ātmānam huta aśane

sanskrit: ज्वलत् पावक संकाशा स्वर्गम् एव जगाम सा
दिव्यम् आभरण संयुक्ता दिव्य माल्य अनुलेपना
transliteration: jvalat pāvaka saṃkāśā svargam eva jagāma sā
divyam ābharaṇa saṃyuktā divya mālya anulepanā

sanskrit: दिव्य अंबर धरा तत्र बभूव प्रिय दर्शन
विराजयन्ती तम् देशम् विद्युत् सौदामिनी यथा
transliteration: divya aṃbara dharā tatra babhūva priya darśana
virājayantī tam deśam vidyut saudāminī yathā

sanskrit: यत्र ते सुकृत आत्मानो विहरन्ति महर्षयः
तत् पुण्यम् शबरी स्थानम् जगाम आत्म समाधिना
transliteration: yatra te sukṛta ātmāno viharanti maharṣayaḥ
tat puṇyam śabarī sthānam jagāma ātma samādhinā
english: By virtue of her devout meditation, Savarī repaired to that holy region where dwelt her spiritual preceptors-the pure-hearted ascetics.

sanskrit: दिवम् तु तस्याम् यातायाम् शबर्याम् स्वेन तेजसा
transliteration: divam tu tasyām yātāyām śabaryām svena tejasā
english: After Savarī had repaired to heaven by virtue of her divine prowess, Rāma with his brother Lakşmaņa began to ponder over the pious influence of those great ascetics. Thinking within himself about the divine authority of those great ones, the virtuous-souled Rāma spoke to Lakşmaņa, devoted and ever engaged in his well-being.

sanskrit: चिंतयित्वा तु धर्मात्मा प्रभावम् तम् महात्मनाम्
हित कारिणम् एक अग्रम् लक्ष्मणम् राघवो अब्रवीत्
transliteration: ciṃtayitvā tu dharmātmā prabhāvam tam mahātmanām
hita kāriṇam eka agram lakṣmaṇam rāghavo abravīt
english: After Savarī had repaired to heaven by virtue of her divine prowess, Rāma with his brother Lakşmaņa began to ponder over the pious influence of those great ascetics. Thinking within himself about the divine authority of those great ones, the virtuous-souled Rāma spoke to Lakşmaņa, devoted and ever engaged in his well-being.

sanskrit: दृष्टो मया आश्रमः सौम्य बहु आश्चर्यः कृतआत्मनाम्
विश्वस्त मृग शार्दूलो नाना विहग सेवितः
transliteration: dṛṣṭo mayā āśramaḥ saumya bahu āścaryaḥ kṛtaātmanām
viśvasta mṛga śārdūlo nānā vihaga sevitaḥ
english: Beheld have I, O gentle one, the wondrous asylum of the pure-souled ascetics filled with diverse birds and tigers rambling friendly with antelopes.

sanskrit: सप्तानाम् च समुद्राणाम् तेषाम् तीर्थेषु लक्ष्मण
उपस्पृष्टम् च विधिवत् पितरः च अपि तर्पिताः
transliteration: saptānām ca samudrāṇām teṣām tīrtheṣu lakṣmaṇa
upaspṛṣṭam ca vidhivat pitaraḥ ca api tarpitāḥ
english: O Laksmana, we have performed ablutions in the sacred waters of these seven seas and offered oblations to our manes. Our misfortunes have ended and prosperity has appeared and my mind is now filled with ecstasy of delight.

sanskrit: प्रणष्टम् अशुभम् यत् नः कल्याणम् समुपस्थितम्
तेन तु एतत् प्रहृष्टम् मे मनो लक्ष्मण संप्रति
transliteration: praṇaṣṭam aśubham yat naḥ kalyāṇam samupasthitam
tena tu etat prahṛṣṭam me mano lakṣmaṇa saṃprati
english: O Laksmana, we have performed ablutions in the sacred waters of these seven seas and offered oblations to our manes. Our misfortunes have ended and prosperity has appeared and my mind is now filled with ecstasy of delight.

sanskrit: हृदये हि नर व्याघ्र शुभम् आविर्भविष्यति
तत् आगच्छ गमिष्यावः पंपाम् ताम् प्रिय दर्शनाम्
transliteration: hṛdaye hi nara vyāghra śubham āvirbhaviṣyati
tat āgaccha gamiṣyāvaḥ paṃpām tām priya darśanām
english: Me-thinks, O best of men, auspiciousness shall soon appear to us; do you come, therefore, we shall proceed towards the picturesque lake Pampā.

sanskrit: ऋष्यमूको गिरिः यत्र न अति दूरे प्रकाशते
यस्मिन् वसति धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवो अंशुमतः सुतः
transliteration: ṛṣyamūko giriḥ yatra na ati dūre prakāśate
yasmin vasati dharmātmā sugrīvo aṃśumataḥ sutaḥ
english: You appear in view, at no distance, the mount Rşyamūka. Here dwells with four monkeys, the virtuous-souled Sugrīva.

sanskrit: नित्यम् वालि भयात् त्रस्तः चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः
अहम् त्वरे च तम् द्रष्टुम् सुग्रीवम् वानरर्षभम्
transliteration: nityam vāli bhayāt trastaḥ caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ
aham tvare ca tam draṣṭum sugrīvam vānararṣabham
english: Surya's son, in constant fear of Vāli. I am in a hurry to behold Sugrīva the best of monkeys, for my business—Sītā's quest-is entirely at his hands.

sanskrit: तत् अधीनम् हि मे कार्यम् सीतायाः परिमार्गणम्
इति ब्रुवाणम् तम् वीरम् सौमित्रिः इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tat adhīnam hi me kāryam sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam
iti bruvāṇam tam vīram saumitriḥ idam abravīt

sanskrit: गच्छावः त्वरितम् तत्र मम अपि त्वरते मनः
आश्रमात् तु ततः तस्मात् निष्क्रम्य स विशाम् पतिः
transliteration: gacchāvaḥ tvaritam tatra mama api tvarate manaḥ
āśramāt tu tataḥ tasmāt niṣkramya sa viśām patiḥ

sanskrit: समीक्षमाणः पुष्प आढ्यम् सर्वतो विपुल द्रुमम्
transliteration: samīkṣamāṇaḥ puṣpa āḍhyam sarvato vipula drumam

sanskrit: कोयष्टिभिः च अर्जुनकैः शत पत्रैः च कीरकैः
एतैः च अन्यैः च बहुभिः नादितम् तत् वनम् महत्
transliteration: koyaṣṭibhiḥ ca arjunakaiḥ śata patraiḥ ca kīrakaiḥ
etaiḥ ca anyaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ nāditam tat vanam mahat

sanskrit: स रामो विविधान् वृक्षान् सरांसि विविधानि च
पश्यन् काम अभिसंतप्तो जगाम परमम् ह्रदम्
transliteration: sa rāmo vividhān vṛkṣān sarāṃsi vividhāni ca
paśyan kāma abhisaṃtapto jagāma paramam hradam

sanskrit: स ताम् आसाद्य वै रामो दूरात् पानीय वाहिनीम्
transliteration: sa tām āsādya vai rāmo dūrāt pānīya vāhinīm

sanskrit: तत्र जग्मतुः अव्यग्रौ राघवौ हि समाहितौ
स तु शोक समाविष्टो रामो दशरथात्मजः
transliteration: tatra jagmatuḥ avyagrau rāghavau hi samāhitau
sa tu śoka samāviṣṭo rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ

sanskrit: विवेश नलिनीम् रम्याम् पंकजैः च समावृताम्
तिलकाशोकपुंनागबकुलोद्दालकाशिनीम् - यद्वा -तिलक अशोक पुन्नाग बकुल उद्दाल काशिनीम्
transliteration: viveśa nalinīm ramyām paṃkajaiḥ ca samāvṛtām
tilakāśokapuṃnāgabakuloddālakāśinīm - yadvā -tilaka aśoka punnāga bakula uddāla kāśinīm

sanskrit: रम्य उपवन संबाधाम् पद्म संपीडित उदकाम्
स्फटिक उपम तोय आढ्याम् श्लक्ष्ण वालुक संतताम्
transliteration: ramya upavana saṃbādhām padma saṃpīḍita udakām
sphaṭika upama toya āḍhyām ślakṣṇa vāluka saṃtatām

sanskrit: मत्स्य कच्छप संबाधाम् तीरस्थ द्रुम शोभिताम्
transliteration: matsya kacchapa saṃbādhām tīrastha druma śobhitām

sanskrit: किन्नर उरग गन्धर्व यक्ष राक्षस सेविताम्
नाना द्रुम लता आकीर्णाम् शीत वारि निधिम् शुभाम्
transliteration: kinnara uraga gandharva yakṣa rākṣasa sevitām
nānā druma latā ākīrṇām śīta vāri nidhim śubhām

sanskrit: पद्म सौगन्धिकैः ताम्राम् शुक्लाम् कुमुद मण्डलैः
नीलाम् कुवलय उद् घाटैः बहु वर्णाम् कुथाम् इव
transliteration: padma saugandhikaiḥ tāmrām śuklām kumuda maṇḍalaiḥ
nīlām kuvalaya ud ghāṭaiḥ bahu varṇām kuthām iva

sanskrit: पुष्पित आम्र वणोपेताम् बर्हिण उद् घुष्ट नादिताम्
transliteration: puṣpita āmra vaṇopetām barhiṇa ud ghuṣṭa nāditām

sanskrit: स ताम् दृष्ट्वा ततः पंपाम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह
transliteration: sa tām dṛṣṭvā tataḥ paṃpām rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha

sanskrit: तिलकैः बीज पूरैः च वटैः शुक्ल द्रुमैः तथा
पुष्पितैः करवीरैः च पुन्नागैः च सु पुष्पितैः
transliteration: tilakaiḥ bīja pūraiḥ ca vaṭaiḥ śukla drumaiḥ tathā
puṣpitaiḥ karavīraiḥ ca punnāgaiḥ ca su puṣpitaiḥ

sanskrit: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च भण्डीरैः निचुलैः तथा
अशोकैः सप्त पर्णैः च केतकैः अतिमुक्तकैः
transliteration: mālatī kuṃda gulmaiḥ ca bhaṇḍīraiḥ niculaiḥ tathā
aśokaiḥ sapta parṇaiḥ ca ketakaiḥ atimuktakaiḥ

sanskrit: अन्यैः च विविधैः वृक्षैः प्रमदा इव उपशोभिताम्
अस्याः तीरे तु पूर्व उक्तः पर्वतो धातु मण्डितः
transliteration: anyaiḥ ca vividhaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ pramadā iva upaśobhitām
asyāḥ tīre tu pūrva uktaḥ parvato dhātu maṇḍitaḥ

sanskrit: ऋश्यमूक इति ख्यातः चित्र पुष्पित पादपः
हरेः ऋक्षरजो नाम्नः पुत्रः तस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: ṛśyamūka iti khyātaḥ citra puṣpita pādapaḥ
hareḥ ṛkṣarajo nāmnaḥ putraḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ

sanskrit: अध्यास्ते तु महावीर्यः सुग्रीव इति विश्रुतः
transliteration: adhyāste tu mahāvīryaḥ sugrīva iti viśrutaḥ

sanskrit: इति उवाच पुनः वाक्यम् लक्ष्मणम् सत्य विक्रमम्
कथम् मया विना सीताम् शक्यम् लक्ष्मण जीवितुम्
transliteration: iti uvāca punaḥ vākyam lakṣmaṇam satya vikramam
katham mayā vinā sītām śakyam lakṣmaṇa jīvitum
english: O best of men, do you approach the chief of monkeys. Rāma, having truth for his prowess, again spoke to Laksmana, saying, O Laksmana, how shall I live without Sitā, who have been deprived of my kingdom, who am poorly and have Sītā for my life?

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा मदन अभिपीडितःस लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् अनन्य चेतनः
विवेश पंपाम् नलिनी मनो रमाम्तम् उत्तमम् शोकम् उदीरयाणः
transliteration: iti evam uktvā madana abhipīḍitaḥsa lakṣmaṇam vākyam ananya cetanaḥ
viveśa paṃpām nalinī mano ramāmtam uttamam śokam udīrayāṇaḥ
english: Having said this to Lakşmaņa, who had nothing else in view, that best of Raghus, racked with sorrow and grief and oppressed by Cupid, entered the lake Pampā graced with lotuses.

sanskrit: क्रमेण गत्वा प्रविलोकयन् वनम्ददर्श पंपाम् शुभ दर्श काननाम्
अनेक नाना विध पक्षि संकुलाम्विवेश रामः सह लक्ष्मणेन
transliteration: krameṇa gatvā pravilokayan vanamdadarśa paṃpām śubha darśa kānanām
aneka nānā vidha pakṣi saṃkulāmviveśa rāmaḥ saha lakṣmaṇena
english: Proceeding slowly, observing the forest, Rāma beheld and entered with Lakşmaņa Pampā, girt on all sides with beautiful woods and filled with a multitude of diverse birds.

sanskrit: स ताम् पुष्करिणीम् गत्वा पद्म उत्पल झषाकुलाम्
transliteration: sa tām puṣkariṇīm gatvā padma utpala jhaṣākulām
english: Repairing with Lakşmaņa to the lake Pampā filled with red and while lotuses and fish Rāma having his senses agitated began to lament.

sanskrit: तत्र दृष्ट्वैवा ताम् हर्षात् इन्द्रियाणि चकम्पिरे
स कामवशम् आपन्नः सौमित्रिम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tatra dṛṣṭvaivā tām harṣāt indriyāṇi cakampire
sa kāmavaśam āpannaḥ saumitrim idam abravīt
english: And beholding there that lake, his senses were stirred with delight. Troubled with passion he spoke to Saumitri saying,

sanskrit: सौमित्रे शोभते पम्पा वैदूर्य विमल उदका
फुल्ल पद्म उत्पलवती शोभिता विविधैः द्रुमैः
transliteration: saumitre śobhate pampā vaidūrya vimala udakā
phulla padma utpalavatī śobhitā vividhaiḥ drumaiḥ
english: Behold, O Saumitri, how beautifully appear Pampā of transparent water like to Vaidurya, graced with full-blown red and white lotuses and various trees.

sanskrit: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः काननम् शुभ दर्शनम्
यत्र राजन्ति शैला वा द्रुमाः स शिखरा इव
transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyāḥ kānanam śubha darśanam
yatra rājanti śailā vā drumāḥ sa śikharā iva
english: Observe again, O son of Sumitra, the picturesque wood-land around the lake, where trees, crowned with large branches resembling the summits of a mountain, appear like so many hills.

sanskrit: माम् तु शोकाभि सन्तप्तम् आधयः पीडयन्ति वै
भरतस्य च दुःखेन वैदेह्या हरणेन च
transliteration: mām tu śokābhi santaptam ādhayaḥ pīḍayanti vai
bharatasya ca duḥkhena vaidehyā haraṇena ca
english: Mental agony arising from Sītā's ravishment and Bharata's grief, have been grinding me who am already stricken with sorrow.

sanskrit: शोकार्तस्य अपि मे पम्पा शोभते चित्र कानना
व्यवकीर्णा बहु विधैः पुष्पैः शीतोदका शिवा
transliteration: śokārtasya api me pampā śobhate citra kānanā
vyavakīrṇā bahu vidhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śītodakā śivā
english: Verily conduce to my felicity the pleasant lake Pampã of cool water, scattered with various flowers, covered with lotuses, highly graceful, girt with variegated' woods abounding in voracious animals and frequented by deer and birds.

sanskrit: नलिनैः अपि संछन्ना हि अत्यर्थ शुभ दर्शना
सर्प व्याल अनुचरिता मृग द्विज समाकुला
transliteration: nalinaiḥ api saṃchannā hi atyartha śubha darśanā
sarpa vyāla anucaritā mṛga dvija samākulā
english: Verily conduce to my felicity the pleasant lake Pampã of cool water, scattered with various flowers, covered with lotuses, highly graceful, girt with variegated' woods abounding in voracious animals and frequented by deer and birds.

sanskrit: अधिकम् प्रविभाति एतत् नील पीतम् तु शाद्वलम्
द्रुमाणाम् विविधैः पुष्पैः परिस्तोमैः इव अर्पितम्
transliteration: adhikam pravibhāti etat nīla pītam tu śādvalam
drumāṇām vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristomaiḥ iva arpitam
english: This green common, chequered with yellow and blue, appeared of enhanced beauty by the various flowers of the trees as if covered with a blanket of diverse hues.

The tops of the trees rich with flowery bunches are gnarled with creepers of blossoming tips. Now has appeared, O Saumitri, the fragrant spring of pleasant breezes, when greatly prevail the influence of Cupid and the trees are graced with fruits and flowers.

sanskrit: सुख अनिलोऽयम् सौमित्रे कालः प्रचुर मन्मथः
गन्धवान् सुरभिर् मासो जात पुष्प फल द्रुमः
transliteration: sukha anilo'yam saumitre kālaḥ pracura manmathaḥ
gandhavān surabhir māso jāta puṣpa phala drumaḥ
english: The tops of the trees rich with flowery bunches are gnarled with creepers of blossoming tips. Now has appeared, O Saumitri, the fragrant spring of pleasant breezes, when greatly prevail the influence of Cupid and the trees are graced with fruits and flowers.

sanskrit: पश्य रूपाणि सौमित्रे वनानाम् पुष्प शालिनाम्
सृजताम् पुष्प वर्षाणि वर्षम् तोयमुचाम् इव
transliteration: paśya rūpāṇi saumitre vanānām puṣpa śālinām
sṛjatām puṣpa varṣāṇi varṣam toyamucām iva
english: Behold, O Saumitri, the beauty of the flowery woods, showering flowers like to clouds pouring forth rain.

sanskrit: प्रस्तरेषु च रम्येषु विविधाः कानन द्रुमाः
वायु वेग प्रचलिताः पुष्पैः अवकिरन्ति गाम्
transliteration: prastareṣu ca ramyeṣu vividhāḥ kānana drumāḥ
vāyu vega pracalitāḥ puṣpaiḥ avakiranti gām
english: Various trees growing on rock surfaces, moved by the wind have been scattering flowers on the earth.

sanskrit: पतितैः पतमानैः च पादपस्थैः च मारुतः
transliteration: patitaiḥ patamānaiḥ ca pādapasthaiḥ ca mārutaḥ
english: Behold, O Saumitri, the wind is sporting at all sides as it were with flowers drops, dropping and hanging on the trees.
The black bees, driven off and singing, pursue the wind, moving the many kinds of flowery branches of the trees.

sanskrit: मत्त कोकिल सन्नादैः नर्तयन् इव पादपान्
शैल कन्दर निष्क्रान्तः प्रगीत इव च अनिलः
transliteration: matta kokila sannādaiḥ nartayan iva pādapān
śaila kandara niṣkrāntaḥ pragīta iva ca anilaḥ
english: While issuing out of the mountainous hollows the wind is singing as it were and making the trees dance with the musical notes of the delighted cuckoos.

sanskrit: अमी संसक्त शाखाग्रा ग्रथिता इव पादपाः
transliteration: amī saṃsakta śākhāgrā grathitā iva pādapāḥ
english: The wind, which was violently shaking them, making the tops of the trees collide with each other, appear as it were stringing them together.

sanskrit: स एव सुख संस्पर्शो वाति चन्दन शीतलः
गन्धम् अभ्यवहन् पुण्यम् श्रम अपनयो अनिलः
transliteration: sa eva sukha saṃsparśo vāti candana śītalaḥ
gandham abhyavahan puṇyam śrama apanayo anilaḥ
english: The sandal-cool wind, of pleasant touch, ever removing the exhaustion of toil, is blowing every where carrying with it pure fragrance.

sanskrit: अमी पवन विक्षिप्ता विनन्दन्ती इव पादपाः
transliteration: amī pavana vikṣiptā vinandantī iva pādapāḥ
english: Violently shaken by wind the trees in this nectar-smelling forest are sounding as it were with the hum of bees.
Hillocks over-topped with picturesque and flowery trees stand beautifully on this mountainous expanse.

sanskrit: पुष्प संछन्न शिखरा मारुतः उत्क्षेप चंचला
transliteration: puṣpa saṃchanna śikharā mārutaḥ utkṣepa caṃcalā
english: Trees with flowery tops, tossed by the airy currents and crested with the bees, are as if dancing in accompaniment with melodious strains.

sanskrit: हाटक प्रति संच्छन्नान् नरान् पीतांबरान् इव
transliteration: hāṭaka prati saṃcchannān narān pītāṃbarān iva
english: Behold, the Karņikāras covered with flowers appear on all sides like to human beings decorated with golden ornaments and wearing yellow cloths.

sanskrit: अयम् वसन्तः सौमित्रे नाना विहग नादितः
transliteration: ayam vasantaḥ saumitre nānā vihaga nāditaḥ
english: This spring, O Saumitri, sounded by the musical notes of the birds of different spacies has been kindling my grief who am without Sītā.

sanskrit: माम् हि शोक समाक्रान्तम् संतापयति मन्मथः
transliteration: mām hi śoka samākrāntam saṃtāpayati manmathaḥ
english: Cupid has been smiting me the more who am stricken with grief, and the cuckoos have been defying me, displaying their mirth, O Laksmana.

sanskrit: एष दाअत्यूहको हृष्टो रम्ये माम् वन निर्झरे
transliteration: eṣa dāatyūhako hṛṣṭo ramye mām vana nirjhare
english: At the pleasant fountains the delighted Dátyūahas with their warblings have been afflicting me who am possessed by Cupid.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा एतस्य पुरा शब्दम् आश्रमस्था मम प्रिया
transliteration: śrutvā etasya purā śabdam āśramasthā mama priyā
english: Formerly my dear one, while in the asylum, delighted with the music of these birds, used to attain to a greater joy addressing me to hear them.

sanskrit: एवम् विचित्राः पतगा नाना राव विराविणः
वृक्ष गुल्म लताः पश्य संपतन्ति समन्ततः
transliteration: evam vicitrāḥ patagā nānā rāva virāviṇaḥ
vṛkṣa gulma latāḥ paśya saṃpatanti samantataḥ
english: Behold, birds of variegated hues, emitting forth diverse notes have been alighting upon the trees, groves and creepers from various quarters.

sanskrit: विमिश्रा विहगाः पुंभिः आत्म व्यूह अभिनन्दिताः
transliteration: vimiśrā vihagāḥ puṃbhiḥ ātma vyūha abhinanditāḥ
english: O Saumitri, birds and bees of melodious notes accompanied by their co-mates and delighted with their mutual companionship are on the banks of this lake.
There live happily flocks of delighted vultures. The trees sounded by the lascivious murmurs of Dätyűhas and Purnskokilas have been kindling my amour.

sanskrit: स्वनन्ति पादपाः च इमे माम् अनङ्ग प्रदीपकाः
अशोक स्तबक अङ्गारः षट्पद स्वन निस्वनः
transliteration: svananti pādapāḥ ca ime mām anaṅga pradīpakāḥ
aśoka stabaka aṅgāraḥ ṣaṭpada svana nisvanaḥ

sanskrit: माम् हि पल्लव ताम्रार्चिः वसन्ताग्निः प्रधक्ष्यति
न हि ताम् सूक्ष्मपक्ष्माक्षीम् सुकेशीम् मृदु भाषिणीम्
transliteration: mām hi pallava tāmrārciḥ vasantāgniḥ pradhakṣyati
na hi tām sūkṣmapakṣmākṣīm sukeśīm mṛdu bhāṣiṇīm

sanskrit: अयम् हि रुचिरः तस्याः कालो रुचिर काननः
transliteration: ayam hi ruciraḥ tasyāḥ kālo rucira kānanaḥ

sanskrit: मन्मध आयास संभूतो वसन्त गुण वर्धितः
transliteration: manmadha āyāsa saṃbhūto vasanta guṇa vardhitaḥ

sanskrit: अयम् माम् धक्ष्यति क्षिप्रम् शोकाग्निः न चिरादिव
अपश्यत ताम् वनिताम् पश्यतो रुचिर द्रुमान्
transliteration: ayam mām dhakṣyati kṣipram śokāgniḥ na cirādiva
apaśyata tām vanitām paśyato rucira drumān

sanskrit: अदृश्यमाना वैदेही शोकम् वर्धयती इह मे
transliteration: adṛśyamānā vaidehī śokam vardhayatī iha me

sanskrit: दृश्यमानो वसन्तः च स्वेद संसर्ग दूषकः
माम् हि सा मृगशाबाक्षी चिन्ता शोक बलात्कृतम्
transliteration: dṛśyamāno vasantaḥ ca sveda saṃsarga dūṣakaḥ
mām hi sā mṛgaśābākṣī cintā śoka balātkṛtam

sanskrit: अमी मयूराः शोभन्ते प्रनृत्यन्तः ततः ततः
transliteration: amī mayūrāḥ śobhante pranṛtyantaḥ tataḥ tataḥ

sanskrit: स्त्वैः पक्षैः पवन उद्धूतैः गवाक्षैः स्फाटिकैः इव
transliteration: stvaiḥ pakṣaiḥ pavana uddhūtaiḥ gavākṣaiḥ sphāṭikaiḥ iva

sanskrit: शिखिनी मन्मथ आर्तैः एषा भर्तारम् गिरि सानुनि
ताम् एव मनसा रामाम् मयुरोऽपि अनुधावति
transliteration: śikhinī manmatha ārtaiḥ eṣā bhartāram giri sānuni
tām eva manasā rāmām mayuro'pi anudhāvati

sanskrit: वितत्य रुचिरौ पक्षौ रुतैः उपहसन् इव
मयूरस्य वने नूनम् रक्षसा न हृता प्रिया
transliteration: vitatya rucirau pakṣau rutaiḥ upahasan iva
mayūrasya vane nūnam rakṣasā na hṛtā priyā

sanskrit: तस्मात् नृत्यति रम्येषु वनेषु सह कान्तया
मम त्वयम् विना वासः पुष्पमासे सुदुःसहः
transliteration: tasmāt nṛtyati ramyeṣu vaneṣu saha kāntayā
mama tvayam vinā vāsaḥ puṣpamāse suduḥsahaḥ

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण संरागः तिर्यक् योनिगतेषु अपि
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa saṃrāgaḥ tiryak yonigateṣu api
english: It is unbearable for me to live without Sītā in this season of flowers. Behold, O Laksmana, this attachment is to be seen even among the brutes. The pea-hen being influenced by passion is approaching her mate.

sanskrit: माम् अपि एवम् विशालाक्षी जानकी जात संभ्रमा
मदनेन अभिवर्तेत यदि न अपहृता भवेत्
transliteration: mām api evam viśālākṣī jānakī jāta saṃbhramā
madanena abhivarteta yadi na apahṛtā bhavet
english: Sītā of expansive eyes would have thus neared me being influenced by amour had she not been carried away.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण पुष्पाणि निष्फलानि भवन्ति मे
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa puṣpāṇi niṣphalāni bhavanti me
english: Behold, O Laksmana, In this season of spring flowers of this forest rich in their load of flowers are of no avail to me. These pleasant flowers of the trees have been uselessly falling on the earth along with the swarms of black bees.

Behold, O Laksmana, In this season of spring flowers of this forest rich in their load of flowers are of no avail to me. These pleasant flowers of the trees have been uselessly falling on the earth along with the swarms of black bees.

sanskrit: नदन्ति कावम् मुदिताः शकुना सङ्घशः कलम्
आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् काम उन्मादकरा मम
transliteration: nadanti kāvam muditāḥ śakunā saṅghaśaḥ kalam
āhvayanta iva anyonyam kāma unmādakarā mama
english: The birds exciting my desire have been delightedly warbling in flocks as if welcoming each other.

sanskrit: वसन्तो यदि तत्र अपि यत्र मे वसति प्रिया
नूनम् परवशा सीता सा अपि शोच्यति अहम् यथा
transliteration: vasanto yadi tatra api yatra me vasati priyā
nūnam paravaśā sītā sā api śocyati aham yathā
english: Surely Sītā, under the influence of another person, is lamenting in the same strain, as I do, if spring has appeared there.

sanskrit: नूनम् न तु वसन्तः तम् देशम् स्पृशति यत्र सा
कथम् हि असित पद्माक्षी वर्तयेत् सा मया विना
transliteration: nūnam na tu vasantaḥ tam deśam spṛśati yatra sā
katham hi asita padmākṣī vartayet sā mayā vinā
english: Even if spring has not appeared there how can Sītā having eyes resembling full-blown lotuses live in my separation?

sanskrit: अथवा वर्तते तत्र वसन्तो यत्र मे प्रिया
किम् करिष्यति सुश्रोणी सा तु निर् भर्त्सिता परैः
transliteration: athavā vartate tatra vasanto yatra me priyā
kim kariṣyati suśroṇī sā tu nir bhartsitā paraiḥ
english: If spring is there, what can it do her having a beautiful hip and loins, who has already been overpowered by a mighty enemy?

sanskrit: श्यामा पद्म पलाशाक्षी मृदु भाषा च मेम् प्रिया
transliteration: śyāmā padma palāśākṣī mṛdu bhāṣā ca mem priyā
english: Surely shall my dear wife of a slender make, having eyes like lotus-petals and of sweet accents renounce her life at the appearance of this spring?

sanskrit: दृढम् हि हृदये बुधिः मम संप्रतिवर्तते
न अलम् वर्तयितुम् सीता साध्वी मत् विरहम् गता
transliteration: dṛḍham hi hṛdaye budhiḥ mama saṃprativartate
na alam vartayitum sītā sādhvī mat viraham gatā
english: Methinks, for certain, the chaste Sītā shall not be able to maintain her being at my separation.

sanskrit: मयि भावो हि वैदेह्याः तत्त्वतो विनिवेशितः
मम अपि भावः सीतायाम् सर्वधा विनिवेशितः
transliteration: mayi bhāvo hi vaidehyāḥ tattvato viniveśitaḥ
mama api bhāvaḥ sītāyām sarvadhā viniveśitaḥ
english: Vaidehi's attachment is entirely centred in me and my affection also riveted entirely in Sītā.

sanskrit: एष पुष्पवहो वायुः सुख स्पर्शो हिमावहः
ताम् विचिन्तयतः कान्ताम् पावक प्रतिमो मम
transliteration: eṣa puṣpavaho vāyuḥ sukha sparśo himāvahaḥ
tām vicintayataḥ kāntām pāvaka pratimo mama
english: This cool breeze of a pleasant touch, carrying the fragrance of flowers appears like a fire-brand to me who am thinking of my spouse.

sanskrit: सदा सुखम् अहम् मन्ये यम् पुरा सह सीताया
मारुतः स विना सीताम् शोक संजनओ मम
transliteration: sadā sukham aham manye yam purā saha sītāyā
mārutaḥ sa vinā sītām śoka saṃjanao mama
english: That breeze appears painful to me in Sītā's absence which ere this, had been regarded by me as a source of pleasure in her company.

sanskrit: ताम् विन अथ विहङ्गो असौ पक्षी प्रणदितः तदा
transliteration: tām vina atha vihaṅgo asau pakṣī praṇaditaḥ tadā
english: This bird set up a cry in the sky at that time* and now in the absence of Sītā, that crow, sitting on the tree is crying delightedly. This refers to the time when Rāma was united with Sītā i.e. at the time of his wedding, At that time the bird, flying up in the sky set up an inauspicious cry indicating that in no distant time he should be separated form her; and now his sitting on the tree and cawing delightedly indicated that he should soon be re-united with her.

sanskrit: एष वै तत्र वैदेह्या विहगः प्रतिहारकः
पक्षी माम् तु विशालाक्ष्याः समीपम् उपनेष्यति
transliteration: eṣa vai tatra vaidehyā vihagaḥ pratihārakaḥ
pakṣī mām tu viśālākṣyāḥ samīpam upaneṣyati
english: This bird flying up in the sky brought about Sītā's ravishment and this bird shall take me to her having expansive eyes.

sanskrit: पश्य लक्ष्मण संनादम् वने मद विवर्धनम्
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa saṃnādam vane mada vivardhanam
english: Hear, O Laksmana, the maddening notes of those birds sitting on the tops of the flowery trees and setting up their melody.

sanskrit: विक्षिप्ताम् पवनेन एताम् असौ तिलक मञ्जरीम्
षट्पदः सहसा अभ्येति मद उद्धूताम् इव प्रियाम्
transliteration: vikṣiptām pavanena etām asau tilaka mañjarīm
ṣaṭpadaḥ sahasā abhyeti mada uddhūtām iva priyām
english: The Bhramaras (black-bees) are approaching the flower-stalk of Tilaka trees tossed by the wind like to intoxicated damsels.

sanskrit: कामिनाम् अयम् अत्यन्तम् अशोकः शोक वर्धनः
स्तबकैः पवन उत्क्षिप्तैः तर्जयन् इव माम् स्थितः
transliteration: kāminām ayam atyantam aśokaḥ śoka vardhanaḥ
stabakaiḥ pavana utkṣiptaiḥ tarjayan iva mām sthitaḥ
english: This Asoka, enhancing the desires of the amorous, stands here, as if remonstrating with me by its clusters shaken by the wind.

sanskrit: अमी लक्ष्मण दृश्यन्ते चूताः कुसुम शालिनः
विभ्रम उत्सिक्त मनसः स अङ्गरागा नरा इव
transliteration: amī lakṣmaṇa dṛśyante cūtāḥ kusuma śālinaḥ
vibhrama utsikta manasaḥ sa aṅgarāgā narā iva
english: There appear, O Laksmana, those blossoming mango trees like to persons, exercised with passion and smeared with unguents of sandal.

sanskrit: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः चित्रासु वन राजिषु
transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyāḥ citrāsu vana rājiṣu
english: Behold, O Saumitri, O foremost of men, the Kinnaras are ranging at large in this variegated forest land on the banks of Pampā. Behold, O Lakşmaņa, here the fragrant red lotuses are shedding forth their splendour like to the newly risen sun.

sanskrit: इमानि शुभ गन्धीनि पश्य लक्ष्मण सर्वशः
नलिनानि प्रकाशन्ते जले तरुण सूर्य वत्
transliteration: imāni śubha gandhīni paśya lakṣmaṇa sarvaśaḥ
nalināni prakāśante jale taruṇa sūrya vat
english: Behold, O Saumitri, O foremost of men, the Kinnaras are ranging at large in this variegated forest land on the banks of Pampā. Behold, O Lakşmaņa, here the fragrant red lotuses are shedding forth their splendour like to the newly risen sun.

sanskrit: एषा प्रसन्न सलिला पद्म नील उत्पलायुता
हंस कारण्डव आकीर्णा पम्पा सौगन्धिका युता
transliteration: eṣā prasanna salilā padma nīla utpalāyutā
haṃsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇā pampā saugandhikā yutā

sanskrit: जले तरुण सूर्याभैः षट्पद आहत केसरैः
transliteration: jale taruṇa sūryābhaiḥ ṣaṭpada āhata kesaraiḥ

sanskrit: चक्रवाक युता नित्यम् चित्र प्रस्थ वनान्तरा
मातंग मृग यूथैः च शोभते सलिल अर्थिभिः
transliteration: cakravāka yutā nityam citra prastha vanāntarā
mātaṃga mṛga yūthaiḥ ca śobhate salila arthibhiḥ

sanskrit: पवन आहत वेगाभिः ऊर्मिभिः विमले अंभसि
transliteration: pavana āhata vegābhiḥ ūrmibhiḥ vimale aṃbhasi
english: Behold, O Laksmana, the picturesque view of the lotuses oscillated by the ripples driven to and fro by the wind.

sanskrit: पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षीम् सततम् प्रिय पन्कजाम्
अपश्यतो मे वैदेहीम् जीवितम् न अभिरोचते
transliteration: padma patra viśālākṣīm satatam priya pankajām
apaśyato me vaidehīm jīvitam na abhirocate
english: I do not delight in my life, not beholding Sītā, having expansive eyes like to lotus-petals and ever fond of lotuses.

sanskrit: अहो कामस्य वामत्वम् यो गताम् अपि दुर्लभाम्
transliteration: aho kāmasya vāmatvam yo gatām api durlabhām
english: O how wily is the course of Kāma who has been presenting to my mind that auspicious one, hard to attain and of sweet-accents!

sanskrit: शक्यो धारयितुम् कामो भवेत् अभ्यागतो मया
यदि भूयो वसन्तो माम् न हन्यात् पुष्पित द्रुमः
transliteration: śakyo dhārayitum kāmo bhavet abhyāgato mayā
yadi bhūyo vasanto mām na hanyāt puṣpita drumaḥ
english: Had I not been overpowered by this season of spring with blossoming trees, I would have been able to put up with the presentamorous infliction.

sanskrit: यानि स्म रमणीयानि तया सह भवन्ति मे
तानि एव अरमणीयानि जायन्ते मे तया विना
transliteration: yāni sma ramaṇīyāni tayā saha bhavanti me
tāni eva aramaṇīyāni jāyante me tayā vinā
english: The objects which appeared beautiful to me while in the company of Sītā, now seem shorn of all grace in her separation.

sanskrit: पद्मकोश पलाशानि द्रष्टुम् दृष्टिः हि मन्यते
सीताया नेत्र कोशाभ्याम् सदृशान् इति लक्ष्मण
transliteration: padmakośa palāśāni draṣṭum dṛṣṭiḥ hi manyate
sītāyā netra kośābhyām sadṛśān iti lakṣmaṇa
english: My eyes pant for beholding those lotus-petals, O Lakṣmaṇa, because of their resemblance with Sītā's eyes.

sanskrit: निःश्वास इव सीताया वाति वायुः मनोहरः
transliteration: niḥśvāsa iva sītāyā vāti vāyuḥ manoharaḥ
english: Issuing out of the trees and touching the filaments, the pleasant wind is blowing like to Sita's breath.

sanskrit: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पाया दक्षिणे गिरि सानुषु
transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyā dakṣiṇe giri sānuṣu
english: Behold O Lakşmaņa, the flowery branches of the Karņikāras on the summits of the mountain situated on the southern bank of Pampā.

sanskrit: अधिकम् शैल राजोऽयम् धातुभिः तु विभूषितः
विचित्रम् सृजते रेणुम् वायु वेग विघट्टितम्
transliteration: adhikam śaila rājo'yam dhātubhiḥ tu vibhūṣitaḥ
vicitram sṛjate reṇum vāyu vega vighaṭṭitam
english: This prince of mountains, beautified with various metals, has been throwing up dusts of diverse colours driven by the wind.

sanskrit: निष्पत्रैः सर्वतो रम्यैः प्रदीप्ता इव किंशुकैः
transliteration: niṣpatraiḥ sarvato ramyaiḥ pradīptā iva kiṃśukaiḥ
english: O Saumitri, these mountainous expanses are burning in beauty with blossoming and beautiful Kinsukas void of leaves.

sanskrit: पम्पा तीर रुहाः च इमे संसक्ता मधु गन्धिनः
मालती मल्लिका पद्म करवीराः च पुष्पिताः
transliteration: pampā tīra ruhāḥ ca ime saṃsaktā madhu gandhinaḥ
mālatī mallikā padma karavīrāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ

sanskrit: केतक्यः सिन्धुवाराः च वासन्त्यः च सुपुष्पिताः
माधव्यो गन्धपूर्णाः च कुंदगुल्माः च सर्वशः
transliteration: ketakyaḥ sindhuvārāḥ ca vāsantyaḥ ca supuṣpitāḥ
mādhavyo gandhapūrṇāḥ ca kuṃdagulmāḥ ca sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: चिरिबिल्वा मधूकाः च वञ्जुला वकुलाः तथा
चम्पकाः तिलकाः च एव नागवृक्षाः च पुष्पिताः
transliteration: ciribilvā madhūkāḥ ca vañjulā vakulāḥ tathā
campakāḥ tilakāḥ ca eva nāgavṛkṣāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ

sanskrit: पद्मकाः च एव शोभन्ते नील अशोकाः
च पुष्पिताःलोध्राः च गिरि पृष्ठेषु सिंह केसर पिन्जराः
transliteration: padmakāḥ ca eva śobhante nīla aśokāḥ
ca puṣpitāḥlodhrāḥ ca giri pṛṣṭheṣu siṃha kesara pinjarāḥ

sanskrit: अन्कोलाः च कुरण्टाः च पूर्णकाः पारिभद्रकाः
चूताः पाटलयः च अपि कोविदाराः च पुष्पिताः
transliteration: ankolāḥ ca kuraṇṭāḥ ca pūrṇakāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ
cūtāḥ pāṭalayaḥ ca api kovidārāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ

sanskrit: मुचुकुंद अर्जुनाः च एव दृश्यन्ते गिरिसानुषुकेतक उद्दालकाः
transliteration: mucukuṃda arjunāḥ ca eva dṛśyante girisānuṣuketaka uddālakāḥ

sanskrit: शाल्मल्यः किंशुकाः च एव रक्ताः कुरवकाः तथा
तिनिशा नक्तमालाः च चंदनाः स्यंदनाः तथा
transliteration: śālmalyaḥ kiṃśukāḥ ca eva raktāḥ kuravakāḥ tathā
tiniśā naktamālāḥ ca caṃdanāḥ syaṃdanāḥ tathā

sanskrit: हिन्तालः तिलकाः च एव नाग वृक्षाः च पुष्पिताः
transliteration: hintālaḥ tilakāḥ ca eva nāga vṛkṣāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ

sanskrit: द्रुमान् पश्य इह सौमित्रे पम्पाया रुचिरान् बहून्
वात विक्षिप्त विटपान् यथा आसन्नान् द्रुमान् इमान्
transliteration: drumān paśya iha saumitre pampāyā rucirān bahūn
vāta vikṣipta viṭapān yathā āsannān drumān imān

sanskrit: लताः समनुवर्तन्ते मत्ता इव वर स्त्रियः
पादपात् पादपम् गच्छन् शैलात् शैलम् वनात् वनम्
transliteration: latāḥ samanuvartante mattā iva vara striyaḥ
pādapāt pādapam gacchan śailāt śailam vanāt vanam

sanskrit: वाति न एक रस आस्वाद सम्मोदित इव अनिलः
केचित् पर्याप्त कुसुमाः पादपा मधु गन्धिनः
transliteration: vāti na eka rasa āsvāda sammodita iva anilaḥ
kecit paryāpta kusumāḥ pādapā madhu gandhinaḥ

sanskrit: केचित् मुकुल संवीताः श्याम वर्णा इव आबभुः
इदम् मृष्टम् इदम् स्वादु प्रफुल्लम् इदम् इत्यपि
transliteration: kecit mukula saṃvītāḥ śyāma varṇā iva ābabhuḥ
idam mṛṣṭam idam svādu praphullam idam ityapi

sanskrit: निलीय पुनर् उत्पत्य सहसा अन्यत्र गच्छति
मधु लुब्धो मधुकरः पंपा तीर द्रुमेषु असौ
transliteration: nilīya punar utpatya sahasā anyatra gacchati
madhu lubdho madhukaraḥ paṃpā tīra drumeṣu asau

sanskrit: इयम् कुसुम सन्घातैः उपस्तीर्णा सुखा कृता
स्वयम् निपतितैः भूमिः शयन प्रस्तरैः इव
transliteration: iyam kusuma sanghātaiḥ upastīrṇā sukhā kṛtā
svayam nipatitaiḥ bhūmiḥ śayana prastaraiḥ iva
english: This forest-land, strewn with flowers dropping spontaneously from the trees like to a bed sheet, has become pleasant.

sanskrit: विविधा विविधैः पुष्पैः तैः एव नगसानुषु
विस्तेएर्णाः पीत रक्ताभा सौमित्रे प्रस्तराः कृताः
transliteration: vividhā vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ taiḥ eva nagasānuṣu
visteerṇāḥ pīta raktābhā saumitre prastarāḥ kṛtāḥ
english: O Saumitri, the mountainous levels variegated with flowers of different species, are appearing like to beds.

sanskrit: हिमान्ते पश्य सौमित्रे वृक्षाणाम् पुष्प संभवम्
पुष्प मासे हि तरवः संघर्षात् इव पुष्पिताः
transliteration: himānte paśya saumitre vṛkṣāṇām puṣpa saṃbhavam
puṣpa māse hi taravaḥ saṃgharṣāt iva puṣpitāḥ
english: Behold O Saumitri, the origination of flowers in the trees at the expiry of the winter. The trees as if viewing with each other, have blossomed in this season of flowers. The trees, O Lakşmaņa, with bees humming around and with flowery branches are as if welcoming each other.

sanskrit: आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् नगाः षट्पद नादिताः
transliteration: āhvayanta iva anyonyam nagāḥ ṣaṭpada nāditāḥ
english: Behold O Saumitri, the origination of flowers in the trees at the expiry of the winter. The trees as if viewing with each other, have blossomed in this season of flowers. The trees, O Lakşmaņa, with bees humming around and with flowery branches are as if welcoming each other.

sanskrit: एष कारण्डवः पक्षी विगाह्या सलिलम् शुभम्
रमते कान्ताया सार्थम् कामम् उद्दीपयन् इव
transliteration: eṣa kāraṇḍavaḥ pakṣī vigāhyā salilam śubham
ramate kāntāyā sārtham kāmam uddīpayan iva
english: This swan, has been sporting with its mate in the lucid water of Pampă exciting my amour.

sanskrit: स्थाने जगति विख्याता गुणाः तस्या मनोरमाः
transliteration: sthāne jagati vikhyātā guṇāḥ tasyā manoramāḥ
english: Truly does this lake like to Mandākini itself, deserve the accomplishments that are known all over the world.

sanskrit: यदि दृश्येत सा साध्वी यदि च इह वसेम हि
स्पृहयेयम् न शक्राय न अयोध्यायै रघूत्तम
transliteration: yadi dṛśyeta sā sādhvī yadi ca iha vasema hi
spṛhayeyam na śakrāya na ayodhyāyai raghūttama
english: O best of Raghus, I do not desire Ayodhyā or the dignity of Indra if that chaste Sītā be found here and if I can live with her.

sanskrit: न हि एवम् रमणीयेषु शाद्वलेषु तया सह
रमतो मे भवेत् चिन्ता न स्पृहा अन्येषु वा भवेत्
transliteration: na hi evam ramaṇīyeṣu śādvaleṣu tayā saha
ramato me bhavet cintā na spṛhā anyeṣu vā bhavet
english: I shall renounce all desires and thoughts if I can sport with her in this picturesque and green forest-land.

sanskrit: अमी हि विविधैः पुष्पैः तरवो रुचिर च्छदाः
कानने अस्मिन् विना कान्ताम् चित्तम् उत्पादयन्ति मे
transliteration: amī hi vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ taravo rucira cchadāḥ
kānane asmin vinā kāntām cittam utpādayanti me
english: These trees, clothed in diverse flower attires, have been exciting my thought in this forest, who have been deprived of my dear one.

sanskrit: पश्य शीत जलाम् च इमाम् सौमित्रे पुष्कर आयुताम्
transliteration: paśya śīta jalām ca imām saumitre puṣkara āyutām
english: O Saumitri, behold this Pampā of cool water, enveloped on all sides with lotuses, and frequented by Cakravākas, Karandavas, Krauñcas, Plavas and high deer.

sanskrit: प्लवैः क्रौञ्चैः च संपूर्णाम् महा मृग निषेविताम्
transliteration: plavaiḥ krauñcaiḥ ca saṃpūrṇām mahā mṛga niṣevitām

sanskrit: दीपयन्ती इव मे कामम् विविधा मुदिता द्विजाः
श्यामाम् चन्द्र मुखीम् स्मृत्वा प्रियाम् पद्म निभ ईक्षणाम्
transliteration: dīpayantī iva me kāmam vividhā muditā dvijāḥ
śyāmām candra mukhīm smṛtvā priyām padma nibha īkṣaṇām
english: The beauty of Pampā has been further enhanced by the birds carolling. Diverse delighted birds have been exciting my passion, reminding me of my dear spouse, of blameless countenance, having a moon like face and eyes resembling lotus-petals.

sanskrit: पश्य सानुषु चित्रेषु मृगीभिः सहितान् मृगान्
माम् पुनः मृग शबाक्षी वैदेह्या विरहीकृतम्
व्यधयन्तीव मे चित्तम् संचरन्तः ततः ततः
transliteration: paśya sānuṣu citreṣu mṛgībhiḥ sahitān mṛgān
mām punaḥ mṛga śabākṣī vaidehyā virahīkṛtam
vyadhayantīva me cittam saṃcarantaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
english: Behold on the yonder mountainous expanse of various colours, stags sporting with hinds and myself on the other hand forsaken by Vaidehi having eyes resembling those of an antelope.

sanskrit: अस्मिन् सानुनि रम्ये हि मत्त द्विज गणाकुले
पश्य अयम् यदि ताम् कन्ताम् ततः स्वस्ति भवेत् मम
transliteration: asmin sānuni ramye hi matta dvija gaṇākule
paśya ayam yadi tām kantām tataḥ svasti bhavet mama
english: These deer ranging hither and thither have been distressing my soul. It is then only that I shall attain to mental quietude if I can behold Sītā on this charming mountainous expanse filled with birds and deer.

sanskrit: जीवेयम् खलु सौमित्रे मया सह सुमध्यमा
सेवेत यदि वैदेही पम्पायाः पवनम् शुभम्
transliteration: jīveyam khalu saumitre mayā saha sumadhyamā
seveta yadi vaidehī pampāyāḥ pavanam śubham
english: It is then that I shall draw my vital breath, O Saumitri, if Vaidehi, of slender waist, with me, enjoy the fine breeze of Pampā dispersing the fragrance of lotuses and Saugandhikas and ever assuaging grief. Blessed are they, O Laksmana who enjoy this wild breeze of Pampā.

sanskrit: पद्म सौगन्धिक वहम् शिवम् शोक विनाशनम्
धन्या लक्ष्मण सेवन्ते पम्पाया वन मरुतम्
transliteration: padma saugandhika vaham śivam śoka vināśanam
dhanyā lakṣmaṇa sevante pampāyā vana marutam
english: It is then that I shall draw my vital breath, O Saumitri, if Vaidehi, of slender waist, with me, enjoy the fine breeze of Pampā dispersing the fragrance of lotuses and Saugandhikas and ever assuaging grief. Blessed are they, O Laksmana who enjoy this wild breeze of Pampā.

sanskrit: श्यमा पद्म पलाशाक्षी प्रिया विरहिता मया
transliteration: śyamā padma palāśākṣī priyā virahitā mayā
english: How has that exquisitely fine daughter of Janaka, my beloved spouse, having eyes resembling lotus-petals, brought under the control of another person, been living forsaken by me?

sanskrit: किम् नु वक्ष्यामि धर्मज्ञम् राजानम् सत्य वादिनम्
जनकम् पृष्ट सीतम् तम् कुशलम् जन संसदि
transliteration: kim nu vakṣyāmi dharmajñam rājānam satya vādinam
janakam pṛṣṭa sītam tam kuśalam jana saṃsadi
english: What shall I speak to that virtuous, truthful king Janaka when he shall interrogate me about Sītā's welfare in an assembly?

sanskrit: या मम् अनुगता मन्दम् पित्रा प्रस्थापितुम् वनम्
सीता धर्मम् समास्थय क्व नु सा वर्तते प्रिया
transliteration: yā mam anugatā mandam pitrā prasthāpitum vanam
sītā dharmam samāsthaya kva nu sā vartate priyā
english: Where is that Sītā now who followed me in the track of virtue, who am unfortunate and have been exiled to woods by my Sire?

sanskrit: तया विहीनः कृपणः कथम् लक्ष्मण धारये
य माम् अनुगता रज्यात् भ्रष्टम् विहत चेतसम्
transliteration: tayā vihīnaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ katham lakṣmaṇa dhāraye
ya mām anugatā rajyāt bhraṣṭam vihata cetasam
english: How shall I keep up (my being) being poorly, O Lakşmaņa, being forsaken by that Sītā who followed me, deprived of kingdom and sense?

sanskrit: तत् चारु अञ्चित पद्माक्षम् सुगन्धि शुभम् अव्रणम्
अपश्यतो मुखम् तस्याः सीदति इव मतिः मम
transliteration: tat cāru añcita padmākṣam sugandhi śubham avraṇam
apaśyato mukham tasyāḥ sīdati iva matiḥ mama
english: My heart is sinking not beholding her fine spotless countenance, having eyes resembling lotuses and smelling sweet.

sanskrit: स्मित हास्यान्तर युतम् गुणवत् मधुरम् हितम्
वैदेह्याः वाक्यम् अतुलम् कदा श्रोष्यामि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: smita hāsyāntara yutam guṇavat madhuram hitam
vaidehyāḥ vākyam atulam kadā śroṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa
english: When shall I hear again O Lakṣmaṇa, the sweet incomparable and auspicious accents of Vaidehī, intervened by smiles and couched in an elegant and easy style?

sanskrit: प्राप्य दुःखम् वने श्यामा माम् मन्मध विकर्शितम्
नष्ट दुःखेव हृष्टेव साध्वी साधु अभ्यभाषत
transliteration: prāpya duḥkham vane śyāmā mām manmadha vikarśitam
naṣṭa duḥkheva hṛṣṭeva sādhvī sādhu abhyabhāṣata
english: Thai chaste and exquisitely fine damsel even when afflicted in the woods used to welcome me under the influence of Cupid as if she were delighted and had her sorrows removed.

sanskrit: किम् नु वक्ष्यामि अयोध्यायाम् कौसल्याम् हि नृपात्मज
क्व सा स्नुषा इति पृच्छन्तीम् कथम् च अति मनस्विनीम्
transliteration: kim nu vakṣyāmi ayodhyāyām kausalyām hi nṛpātmaja
kva sā snuṣā iti pṛcchantīm katham ca ati manasvinīm
english: O son of a king, what shall I speak to Kausalya in Ayodhyā when she will ask me of her high-souled daughter-in-law's welfare and whereabouts?

sanskrit: गच्छ लक्ष्मण पश्य त्वम् भरतम् भ्रातृउ वत्सलम्
न हि अहम् जीवितुम् शक्तः ताम् ऋते जनकात्मजम्
transliteration: gaccha lakṣmaṇa paśya tvam bharatam bhrātṛu vatsalam
na hi aham jīvitum śaktaḥ tām ṛte janakātmajam
english: Do you proceed, O Lakşmaņa, and join Bharata gifted with fraternal affection. I am incapable of living any more without that daughter of Janaka. Thereupon Lakşmaņa addressed to the high-souled Rāma who was thus bewailing like one helpless with the following pregnant and immutable words.

sanskrit: इति रामम् महात्मानम् विलपन्तम् अनाथ वत्
उवाच लक्ष्मणो भ्राता वचनम् युक्तम् अव्ययम्
transliteration: iti rāmam mahātmānam vilapantam anātha vat
uvāca lakṣmaṇo bhrātā vacanam yuktam avyayam
english: Do you proceed, O Lakşmaņa, and join Bharata gifted with fraternal affection. I am incapable of living any more without that daughter of Janaka. Thereupon Lakşmaņa addressed to the high-souled Rāma who was thus bewailing like one helpless with the following pregnant and immutable words.

sanskrit: संस्थम्भ राम भद्रम् ते मा शुचः पुरुषोत्तम
न ईदृइशानाम् मतिः मन्दा भवति अकलुषात्मनाम्
transliteration: saṃsthambha rāma bhadram te mā śucaḥ puruṣottama
na īdṛiśānām matiḥ mandā bhavati akaluṣātmanām
english: Forsake your grief, O Rāma. May good betide you. Do not grieve O best of men. Even the sinless persons lose their sense when they are afflicted with grief.

sanskrit: स्मृत्वा वियोगजम् दुःखम् त्यज स्नेहम् प्रिये जने
अति स्नेह परिष्वन्गात् वर्तिः अर्द्रा अपि दह्यते
transliteration: smṛtvā viyogajam duḥkham tyaja sneham priye jane
ati sneha pariṣvangāt vartiḥ ardrā api dahyate
english: Remembering the grief consequent on separation do you forsake your attachment to your dear one. Out of an excess of oil even the wick burn itself.

sanskrit: यदि गच्छति पतालम् ततो अभ्यऽधिकम् एव वा
सर्वधा रावणः तात न भविष्यति राघव
transliteration: yadi gacchati patālam tato abhya'dhikam eva vā
sarvadhā rāvaṇaḥ tāta na bhaviṣyati rāghava
english: O worshipful one, even if he hide himself in the region under the earth or in a darker quarter, Rāvana shall not be able to draw his breath.

sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिः लभ्यताम् तावत् तस्य पापस्य रक्षसः
ततः हास्यति वा सीताम् निधनम् वा गमिष्यति
transliteration: pravṛttiḥ labhyatām tāvat tasya pāpasya rakṣasaḥ
tataḥ hāsyati vā sītām nidhanam vā gamiṣyati
english: Do you procure information about the vicioussouled Rākṣasa; either he shall give up Sītā or meet with destruction.

sanskrit: यदि याति दितेः गर्भम् रावणः सह सीताया
तत्र अपि एनम् हनिष्यामि न चेत् दास्यति मैथिलीम्
transliteration: yadi yāti diteḥ garbham rāvaṇaḥ saha sītāyā
tatra api enam haniṣyāmi na cet dāsyati maithilīm
english: Unless he gives back Sītā, forsooth I shall kill him even if he enters with her into Diti's womb.

sanskrit: स्वास्थ्यम् भद्रम् भजस्व आर्यः त्यजताम् कृपणा मतिः
अर्थो हि नष्ट कार्यार्थैः न अयत्ने न अधिगम्यते
transliteration: svāsthyam bhadram bhajasva āryaḥ tyajatām kṛpaṇā matiḥ
artho hi naṣṭa kāryārthaiḥ na ayatne na adhigamyate
english: Do you, console yourself and renounce your poorliness of mind, O worshipful one. Without sufficient endeavours even men of energy do not regain their lost ends.

sanskrit: उत्साहो बलवान् आर्य नास्ति उत्साहात् परम् बलम्
सः उत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किंचित् अपि दुर्लभम्
transliteration: utsāho balavān ārya nāsti utsāhāt param balam
saḥ utsāhasya hi lokeṣu na kiṃcit api durlabham
english: O worshipful one mighty is the course of energy. And than this there is no greater powerful on earth. And there is nothing unattainable in this world to one gifted with energy.

sanskrit: उत्साह मत्रम् आश्रित्य सीताम् प्रतिलप्स्याम् जनकीम्
transliteration: utsāha matram āśritya sītām pratilapsyām janakīm
english: Persons endowed with zeal do never wear away in their actions. And resorting to this energy only that we shall regain Jānaki.

sanskrit: त्यज्य काम वृत्तत्वम् शोकम् सम् न्यस्य पृष्टतः
transliteration: tyajya kāma vṛttatvam śokam sam nyasya pṛṣṭataḥ
english: Do you not perceive that you are high-souled and highly educated? And leaving behind grief do you forsake your amorous madness.

sanskrit: त्य्ज्य शोकम् च मोहम् च रामो धैर्यम् उपागमत्
transliteration: tyjya śokam ca moham ca rāmo dhairyam upāgamat
english: Being thus accosted by Lakşmaņa, Rāma having his mind stricken with sorrow, attained to mental quietude renouncing grief and dolour.

sanskrit: सोऽभ्य अतिक्रामत् अव्यग्रः ताम् अचिन्त्य पराक्रमः
रामः पम्पाम् सु रुचिराम् रम्याम् पारिप्लव द्रुमान्
transliteration: so'bhya atikrāmat avyagraḥ tām acintya parākramaḥ
rāmaḥ pampām su rucirām ramyām pāriplava drumān
english: Thereupon Răma, of unimaginable prowess, passed slowly by the pleasant and charming Pampā with banks girt with trees shaken by the wind.

sanskrit: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा महात्मा सर्वम् वनम् निर्झर कन्दराम् च
उद्विग्न चेताः सह लक्ष्मणेन विचार्य दुःखोपहतः प्रतस्थे
transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā mahātmā sarvam vanam nirjhara kandarām ca
udvigna cetāḥ saha lakṣmaṇena vicārya duḥkhopahataḥ pratasthe
english: Thereupon the high-souled Rāma, stricken with grief passed along beholding the forestland, fountains, caves and revolving aside (the 'pregnant words of Laksmana).

sanskrit: तम् मत्त मातङ्ग विलास गामी गच्छन्तम् अव्यग्र मनाः महात्मा
स लक्ष्मणो राघवम् अप्रमत्तो ररक्ष धर्मेण बलेन च एव
transliteration: tam matta mātaṅga vilāsa gāmī gacchantam avyagra manāḥ mahātmā
sa lakṣmaṇo rāghavam apramatto rarakṣa dharmeṇa balena ca eva
english: And the high-souled Lakşmaņa, of unagitated mind, intent upon Rāma's welfare and wending like to an infuriated elephant, cheered him up by means of moral and heroic counsels.

sanskrit: तौ ऋष्यमूकस्य समीप चारी चरन् ददर्श अद्भुत दर्शनीयौ
शाखा मृगाणाम् अधिपः तरस्वी वितत्रसे नैव चिचेष्ट चेष्टाम्
transliteration: tau ṛṣyamūkasya samīpa cārī caran dadarśa adbhuta darśanīyau
śākhā mṛgāṇām adhipaḥ tarasvī vitatrase naiva ciceṣṭa ceṣṭām
english: Beholding their countenances passing strange, that mighty chief, of monkeys, while ranging near the mount Rșyamuka, became highly terrified and motionless.

sanskrit: स तौ महात्मा गज मन्द गामि शखा मृगः तत्र चिरन् चरन्तौ
दृष्ट्वा विषादम् परमम् जगाम चिन्ता परीतो भय भार मग्नः
transliteration: sa tau mahātmā gaja manda gāmi śakhā mṛgaḥ tatra ciran carantau
dṛṣṭvā viṣādam paramam jagāma cintā parīto bhaya bhāra magnaḥ
english: Observing them range there, that high-souled monkey, wending slowly like to an elephant and stricken with fear and grief, became exceedingly sorry.

sanskrit: तम् आश्रमम् पुण्य सुखम् शरण्यम् सदैव शाखा मृग सेवितान्तम्
त्रस्ताः च दृष्ट्वा हरयोः अभिजग्मुः महौजसौ राघव लक्ष्मणौ तौ
transliteration: tam āśramam puṇya sukham śaraṇyam sadaiva śākhā mṛga sevitāntam
trastāḥ ca dṛṣṭvā harayoḥ abhijagmuḥ mahaujasau rāghava lakṣmaṇau tau
english: Espying the highly powerful Rāma and Lakş mana there, monkeys, terrified, entered into that holy and pleasant asylum, a worthy refuge and having its inside always frequented by them.

sanskrit: तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महात्मानौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
वर आयुध धरौ वीरौ सुग्रीवः श्ङ्कितोऽभवत्
transliteration: tau tu dṛṣṭvā mahātmānau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
vara āyudha dharau vīrau sugrīvaḥ śṅkito'bhavat
english: Beholding those two high-souled brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa, heroic and with great scimitars in their hands, Sugrīva became terrified.

sanskrit: न व्यतिष्ठत कस्मिन् चित् देशे वानर पुङ्गवः
transliteration: na vyatiṣṭhata kasmin cit deśe vānara puṅgavaḥ
english: That best of monkeys, of a disturbed mind, cast his looks around and could not stand (patiently) at any place.

sanskrit: नैव चक्रे मनः स्थातुम् वीक्षमाणो महाबलौ
कपेः परम भीतस्य चित्तम् व्यवससाद ह
transliteration: naiva cakre manaḥ sthātum vīkṣamāṇo mahābalau
kapeḥ parama bhītasya cittam vyavasasāda ha
english: Beholding those two of great prowess he could not make up his mind to remain there and the heart of that terrified monkey, sank.

sanskrit: चिन्तयित्वा स धर्मात्मा विमृश्य गुरु लाघवम्
सुग्रीवः परम उद्विग्नः सर्वैः तैः वानरैः सह
transliteration: cintayitvā sa dharmātmā vimṛśya guru lāghavam
sugrīvaḥ parama udvignaḥ sarvaiḥ taiḥ vānaraiḥ saha
english: Pondering over what is more and what is less important the virtuous-souled Sugrīva became highly anxious along with that monkey-herd.

sanskrit: ततः स सचिवेभ्यः तु सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः
शशंस परम उद्विग्नः पश्यन् तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: tataḥ sa sacivebhyaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ
śaśaṃsa parama udvignaḥ paśyan tau rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: Beholding Rāma and Laksmana, Sugriva, the king of monkeys, greatly exercised with anxiety spoke to his counsellors, saying.

sanskrit: एतौ वनम् इदम् दुर्गम् वालि प्रणिहितौ ध्रुवम्
छद्मना चीर वसनौ प्रचरन्तौ इह आगतौ
transliteration: etau vanam idam durgam vāli praṇihitau dhruvam
chadmanā cīra vasanau pracarantau iha āgatau
english: Forsooth, these two heroes, in false guises and wearing bark, despatched by Vāli, have come here traversing the forest stronghold.

sanskrit: ततः सुग्रीव सचिवा दृष्ट्वा परम धन्विनौ
जग्मुः गिरि तटात् तस्माद् अन्यत् शिखरम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: tataḥ sugrīva sacivā dṛṣṭvā parama dhanvinau
jagmuḥ giri taṭāt tasmād anyat śikharam uttamam
english: Beholding these two mighty archers the counsellors of Sugriva, quitting that mountainous expanse proceeded to another best of hills.

sanskrit: ते क्षिप्रम् अभिगम्य अथ यूथपा यूथपर्षभम्
transliteration: te kṣipram abhigamya atha yūthapā yūthaparṣabham
english: Thereupon proceeding quickly the commanders of various monkey herds stood encircling the king of monkeys and the chief of · leaders.

sanskrit: एवम् एक आयन गताः प्लवमाना गिरेः गिरिम्
transliteration: evam eka āyana gatāḥ plavamānā gireḥ girim
english: The monkeys thus sharing in the misery and happiness (of their chief) proceeded jumping from hill to hill shaking the summits thereof, with the velocity (of their persons). Thereupon those mighty monkeys, jumping, broke down the flowery trees of that stronghold.

sanskrit: ततः शाखा मृगाः सर्वे प्लवमाना महाबलाः
बभंजुः च नगान् तत्र पुष्पितान् दुर्गम् आश्रितान्
transliteration: tataḥ śākhā mṛgāḥ sarve plavamānā mahābalāḥ
babhaṃjuḥ ca nagān tatra puṣpitān durgam āśritān
english: The monkeys thus sharing in the misery and happiness (of their chief) proceeded jumping from hill to hill shaking the summits thereof, with the velocity (of their persons). Thereupon those mighty monkeys, jumping, broke down the flowery trees of that stronghold.

sanskrit: मृग मार्जार शार्दूलान् त्रासयन्तो ययुः तदा
transliteration: mṛga mārjāra śārdūlān trāsayanto yayuḥ tadā
english: Those best of monkeys, springing all around that mighty hill, proceeded terrifying the deer, the wild cats and the tigers.

sanskrit: संगम्य कपि मुख्येन सर्वे प्रांजलयः स्थिताः
transliteration: saṃgamya kapi mukhyena sarve prāṃjalayaḥ sthitāḥ
english: Stationed on that best of mountains the ministers of Sugrīva, coming in the front of that monkey-chief, stood with clasped palms.

sanskrit: ततः तु भय संत्रस्तम् वालि किल्बिष शन्कितम्
उवाच हनुमान् वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् वाक्य कोविदः
transliteration: tataḥ tu bhaya saṃtrastam vāli kilbiṣa śankitam
uvāca hanumān vākyam sugrīvam vākya kovidaḥ
english: Thereupon Hanumān, skilled in speech, spoke to Sugrīva, terrified and afraid of Vāli's wicked wiles.

sanskrit: संभ्रमः त्यजताम् एष सर्वैः वालि कृते महान्
मलयोऽयम् गिरिवरो भयम् न इह अस्ति वालिनः
transliteration: saṃbhramaḥ tyajatām eṣa sarvaiḥ vāli kṛte mahān
malayo'yam girivaro bhayam na iha asti vālinaḥ
english: Let all the monkeys renounce Vāli's fear; in this best of mountains, Malaya-there is no fear of him.

sanskrit: यस्मात् उद्विग्न चेताः त्वम् विद्रुतो हरिपुंगव
तम् क्रूर दर्शनम् क्रूरम् न इह पश्यामि वालिनम्
transliteration: yasmāt udvigna cetāḥ tvam vidruto haripuṃgava
tam krūra darśanam krūram na iha paśyāmi vālinam
english: I do not behold, O best of monkeys, that wicked Vāli of terrible looks, afraid of whom you had fled away and for whom you are anxious.

sanskrit: यस्मात् तव भयम् सौम्य पूर्वजात् पाप कर्मणः
स न इह वाली दुष्टात्मा न ते पश्यामि अहम् भयम्
transliteration: yasmāt tava bhayam saumya pūrvajāt pāpa karmaṇaḥ
sa na iha vālī duṣṭātmā na te paśyāmi aham bhayam
english: I do not observe here, O gentle one, the wicked-souled Väli your elder brother of impious actions and whom you do fear and I do not perceive any terror proceeding from him.

sanskrit: अहो शाखा मृगत्वम् ते व्यक्तम् एव प्लवंगम
लघु चित्ततया आत्मानम् न स्थापयसि यो मतौ
transliteration: aho śākhā mṛgatvam te vyaktam eva plavaṃgama
laghu cittatayā ātmānam na sthāpayasi yo matau
english: O monkey-chief, truly manifest is your monkey-hood and it is through your lightheartedness that you are incapable of fixing your soul.

sanskrit: बुद्धि विज्ञान संपन्न इङ्गितैः सर्वम् आचर
न हि अबुद्धिम् गतो राजा सर्व भूतानि शास्ति हि
transliteration: buddhi vijñāna saṃpanna iṅgitaiḥ sarvam ācara
na hi abuddhim gato rājā sarva bhūtāni śāsti hi
english: Gifted with intellect and knowledge do you perforin all by means of gestures. A king void of sense cannot govern all creatures.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः तु शुभम् वाक्यम् श्रुत्वा सर्वम् हनूमतः
ततः शुभतरम् वाक्यम् हनूमन्तम् उवाच ह
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ tu śubham vākyam śrutvā sarvam hanūmataḥ
tataḥ śubhataram vākyam hanūmantam uvāca ha
english: Hearing those pregnant words of Hanumār in its entirety, Sugrīva addressed to Hanumān in better accents.

sanskrit: दीर्घ बाहू विशालाक्षौ शर चाप असि धारिणौ
कस्य न स्यात् भयम् दृष्ट्वा हि एतौ सुर सुत उपमौ
transliteration: dīrgha bāhū viśālākṣau śara cāpa asi dhāriṇau
kasya na syāt bhayam dṛṣṭvā hi etau sura suta upamau
english: Who is not terrified beholding those two mighty armed heroes, having expansive eyes, with bows, arrow, and daggers in their hands like to two sons of a celestial?

sanskrit: वालि प्रणिहितौ एव शन्के अहम् पुरुषोत्तमौ
राजानो बहु मित्राः च विश्वासो न अत्र हि क्षमः
transliteration: vāli praṇihitau eva śanke aham puruṣottamau
