rājāno bahu mitrāḥ ca viśvāso na atra hi kṣamaḥ
english: Methinks these two best of men have been despatched by Vali. Kings have many friends. And it is not proper for me to place confidence in them.

sanskrit: अरयः च मनुष्येण विज्ञेयाः छद्म चारिणः
transliteration: arayaḥ ca manuṣyeṇa vijñeyāḥ chadma cāriṇaḥ
english: People should know that enemies, always treacherous by nature, range under false guises. And those foes, availing of their credulity, bring about their destruction whenever opportunity presents itself.

sanskrit: कृत्येषु वाली मेधावी राजानो बहु दर्शनः
भवन्ति पर हन्तारः ते ज्ञेयाः प्राकृतैः नरैः
transliteration: kṛtyeṣu vālī medhāvī rājāno bahu darśanaḥ
bhavanti para hantāraḥ te jñeyāḥ prākṛtaiḥ naraiḥ
english: Vāli is eminently expert in despatching business. Monarchs, cognizant of many a wily expedient, bring about others' destruction. It is proper to discern them by means of disguised spies.

sanskrit: तौ त्वया प्राकृतेन एव गत्वा ज्ञेयौ प्लवंगम
इङ्गितानाम् प्रकारैः च रूपव्या भाषणेन च
transliteration: tau tvayā prākṛtena eva gatvā jñeyau plavaṃgama
iṅgitānām prakāraiḥ ca rūpavyā bhāṣaṇena ca
english: O monkey, do you proceed under a false guise and come by their intentions, examining them aright by their countenances, gestures and words.

sanskrit: लक्षयस्व तयोः भावम् प्रहृष्ट मनसौ यदि
विश्वासयन् प्रशंसाभिः इङ्गितैः च पुनः पुनः
transliteration: lakṣayasva tayoḥ bhāvam prahṛṣṭa manasau yadi
viśvāsayan praśaṃsābhiḥ iṅgitaiḥ ca punaḥ punaḥ
english: Do you ascertain their intention. If do you find them delighted, secure their confidence in my favour by eulogising me again and again and giving out to them my views.

sanskrit: मम एव अभिमुखम् स्थित्वा पृच्छ त्वम् हरि पुंगव
प्रयोजनम् प्रवेशस्य वनस्य अस्य धनुर् धरौ
transliteration: mama eva abhimukham sthitvā pṛccha tvam hari puṃgava
prayojanam praveśasya vanasya asya dhanur dharau
english: O best of monkeys, do you ask them why they have entered this forest, if you do perceive that these two archers are pure souled.

sanskrit: शुद्ध आत्मानौ यदि एतौ जानीहि त्वम् प्लवंगम
व्याभाषितैः वा रूपैः वा विज्ञेया दुष्टता अनयोः
transliteration: śuddha ātmānau yadi etau jānīhi tvam plavaṃgama
vyābhāṣitaiḥ vā rūpaiḥ vā vijñeyā duṣṭatā anayoḥ
english: O monkey, if you determine the fairness and unfairness of their purpose, their wickedness should be discovered by means of their gestures and conversation.

sanskrit: चकार गमने बुद्धिम् यत्र तौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
transliteration: cakāra gamane buddhim yatra tau rāma lakṣmaṇau
english: Being commanded by that chief of monkeys, the son of Maruta purposed to approach Rāma and Laksmana.

sanskrit: तथा इति संपूज्य वचः तु तस्य कपेः सुभीतस्य दुरासदस्य
महानुभावो हनुमान् ययौ तदा स यत्र रामो अतिबली स लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: tathā iti saṃpūjya vacaḥ tu tasya kapeḥ subhītasya durāsadasya
mahānubhāvo hanumān yayau tadā sa yatra rāmo atibalī sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: Assenting to the words of the terrified and unconquerable Sugriva and saying 'Be it so, Hanumān, the high-souled monkey proceeded where the heroic Râma was with Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: पर्वतात् ऋष्यमूकात् तु पुप्लुवे यत्र राघवौ
transliteration: parvatāt ṛṣyamūkāt tu pupluve yatra rāghavau
english: Understanding the words of the high-souled Sugrīva, Hanumān, proceeded, springing, from the mount Rsyamūka, towards the descendants of Raghu.

sanskrit: भिक्षु रूपम् ततो भेजे शठबुद्धितया कपिः
transliteration: bhikṣu rūpam tato bheje śaṭhabuddhitayā kapiḥ
english: Thereupon renouncing his monkey shape the son of Māruta, not confiding in them, assumed the semblance of a mendicant.

sanskrit: ततः च हनुमान् वाचा श्लक्ष्णया सुमनोज्ञया
transliteration: tataḥ ca hanumān vācā ślakṣṇayā sumanojñayā

sanskrit: अबभाषे च तौ वीरौ यथावत् प्रशशंस च
transliteration: ababhāṣe ca tau vīrau yathāvat praśaśaṃsa ca

sanskrit: उवाच कामतो वाक्यम् मृदु सत्य पराक्रमौ
राजर्षि देव प्रतिमौ तापसौ संशित व्रतौ
transliteration: uvāca kāmato vākyam mṛdu satya parākramau
rājarṣi deva pratimau tāpasau saṃśita vratau

sanskrit: देशम् कथम् इमम् प्राप्तौ भवन्तौ वर वर्णिनौ
त्रासयन्तौ मृग गणान् अन्याम् च वन चारिणः
transliteration: deśam katham imam prāptau bhavantau vara varṇinau
trāsayantau mṛga gaṇān anyām ca vana cāriṇaḥ

sanskrit: पम्पा तीर रुहान् वृक्षान् वीक्षमाणौ समंततः
इमाम् नदीम् शुभ जलाम् शोभयन्तौ तरस्विनौ
transliteration: pampā tīra ruhān vṛkṣān vīkṣamāṇau samaṃtataḥ
imām nadīm śubha jalām śobhayantau tarasvinau

sanskrit: धैर्यवन्तौ सुवर्णाभौ कौ युवाम् चीर वाससौ
निःश्वसन्तौ वर भुजौ पीडयन्तौ इमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: dhairyavantau suvarṇābhau kau yuvām cīra vāsasau
niḥśvasantau vara bhujau pīḍayantau imāḥ prajāḥ

sanskrit: शक्र चाप निभे चापे गृहीत्वा शत्रु नाशनौ
transliteration: śakra cāpa nibhe cāpe gṛhītvā śatru nāśanau

sanskrit: श्रीमन्तौ रूप संपन्नौ वृषभ श्रेष्ठ विक्रमौ
हस्ति हस्त उपम भुजौ द्युतिमन्तौ नरर्षभौ
transliteration: śrīmantau rūpa saṃpannau vṛṣabha śreṣṭha vikramau
hasti hasta upama bhujau dyutimantau nararṣabhau

sanskrit: प्रभया पर्वत इन्द्रः असौ युवयोः अवभासितः
राज्य अर्हौ अमर प्रख्यौ कथम् देशम् इह आगतौ
transliteration: prabhayā parvata indraḥ asau yuvayoḥ avabhāsitaḥ
rājya arhau amara prakhyau katham deśam iha āgatau

sanskrit: पद्म पत्र ईक्षणौ वीरौ जटा मण्डल धारिणौ
अन्योन्य सदृशौ वीरौ देव लोकात् इह आगतौ
transliteration: padma patra īkṣaṇau vīrau jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇau
anyonya sadṛśau vīrau deva lokāt iha āgatau
english: Having eyes resembling lotus-petals, heroic, wearing matted locks, resembling each other, have you come here from the celestial region?

sanskrit: विशाल वक्षसौ वीरौ मानुषौ देव रूपिणौ
transliteration: viśāla vakṣasau vīrau mānuṣau deva rūpiṇau

sanskrit: सिंह स्कन्धौ महा उत्साहौ समदौ इव गोवृषौ
आयताः च सुवृत्ताः च बाहवः परिघोपमाः
transliteration: siṃha skandhau mahā utsāhau samadau iva govṛṣau
āyatāḥ ca suvṛttāḥ ca bāhavaḥ parighopamāḥ

sanskrit: सर्व भूषण भूषार्हाः किम् अर्थम् न विभूषिताः
उभौ योग्यौ अहम् मन्ये रक्षितुम् पृथिवीम् इमाम्
transliteration: sarva bhūṣaṇa bhūṣārhāḥ kim artham na vibhūṣitāḥ
ubhau yogyau aham manye rakṣitum pṛthivīm imām

sanskrit: स सागर वनाम् कृत्स्नाम् विन्ध्य मेरु विभूषिताम्
इमे च धनुषी चित्रे श्लक्ष्णे चित्र अनुलेपने
transliteration: sa sāgara vanām kṛtsnām vindhya meru vibhūṣitām
ime ca dhanuṣī citre ślakṣṇe citra anulepane

sanskrit: प्रकाशेते यथा इन्द्रस्य वज्रे हेम विभूषिते
संपूर्णाः च शितैः बाणैः तूणाः च शुभ दर्शनाः
transliteration: prakāśete yathā indrasya vajre hema vibhūṣite
saṃpūrṇāḥ ca śitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ tūṇāḥ ca śubha darśanāḥ

sanskrit: जीवित अन्तकरैः घोरैः ज्वलद्भिः इव पन्नगैः
महा प्रमाणौ विपुलौ तप्त हाटक भूषणौ
transliteration: jīvita antakaraiḥ ghoraiḥ jvaladbhiḥ iva pannagaiḥ
mahā pramāṇau vipulau tapta hāṭaka bhūṣaṇau

sanskrit: खड्गौ एतौ विराजेते निर्मुक्त भुजगौ इव
एवम् माम् परिभाषन्तम् कस्माद् वै न अभि भाषतः
transliteration: khaḍgau etau virājete nirmukta bhujagau iva
evam mām paribhāṣantam kasmād vai na abhi bhāṣataḥ

sanskrit: सुग्रीवो नाम धर्मात्मा कश्चित् वानर पुंगवः
वीरो विनिकृतो भ्रात्रा जगत् भ्रमति दुःखितः
transliteration: sugrīvo nāma dharmātmā kaścit vānara puṃgavaḥ
vīro vinikṛto bhrātrā jagat bhramati duḥkhitaḥ
english: Why do you not answer me accosting you thus? A certain heroic and virtuous monkeychief, by name Sugrīva, has been journeying on this carth, distressed at heart, being driven away by his brother.

sanskrit: प्राप्तः अहम् प्रेषितः तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना
राज्ञा वानर मुख्यानाम् हनुमान् नाम वानरः
transliteration: prāptaḥ aham preṣitaḥ tena sugrīveṇa mahātmanā
rājñā vānara mukhyānām hanumān nāma vānaraḥ
english: I have come here being despatched by that high-souled Sugriva-my name is Hanuman, the foremost of monkeys.

sanskrit: युवाभ्याम् स हि धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवः सख्यम् इच्छति
तस्य माम् सचिवम् वित्तम् वानरम् पवनात्मजम्
transliteration: yuvābhyām sa hi dharmātmā sugrīvaḥ sakhyam icchati
tasya mām sacivam vittam vānaram pavanātmajam

sanskrit: भिक्षु रूप प्रति च्छन्नम् सुग्रीव प्रिय कारणात्
transliteration: bhikṣu rūpa prati cchannam sugrīva priya kāraṇāt
english: That virtuous souled Sugrīva desires to make friends with you. And know me to be his counsellor-a monkey, the son of Pavana, ranging every where at my will, coming here, under the guise of a mendicant, from the mount Rsymuka, for the welfare of Sugriva.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु हनुमाम् तौ वीरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
वाक्यज्ञो वाक्य कुशलः पुनः न उवाच किंचन
transliteration: evam uktvā tu hanumām tau vīrau rāma lakṣmaṇau
vākyajño vākya kuśalaḥ punaḥ na uvāca kiṃcana
english: Having addressed thus those two heroes-Rama and Laksmana, Hanuman, conversant with words and skilled in speech, did not speak again.

sanskrit: एतत् श्रुत्वा वचः तस्य रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
प्रहृष्ट वदनः श्रीमान् भ्रातरम् पार्श्वतः स्थितम्
transliteration: etat śrutvā vacaḥ tasya rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
prahṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śrīmān bhrātaram pārśvataḥ sthitam
english: Hearing those words, the effulgent Rāma, with a delighted countenance, spoke to his younger brother, Laksmana-~-sitting by him.

sanskrit: तम् एव काङ्क्षमाणस्य मम अन्तिकम् इह आगतः
transliteration: tam eva kāṅkṣamāṇasya mama antikam iha āgataḥ
english: He is the counsellor of the high-souled Sugriva, the lord of monkeys and has approached me, soliciting my friendship in his (Sugriva's) favour.

sanskrit: तम् अभ्यभाष सौमित्रे सुग्रीव सचिवम् कपिम्
वाक्यज्ञम् मधुरैः वाक्यैः स्नेह युक्तम् अरिन्दम
transliteration: tam abhyabhāṣa saumitre sugrīva sacivam kapim
vākyajñam madhuraiḥ vākyaiḥ sneha yuktam arindama
english: Do you welcome, with pleasant words, O Saumitri, this monkey-Sugrīva's minister, the subduer of foes, affectionate and skilled in speech.

sanskrit: न अन् ऋग्वेद विनीतस्य न अ\-\-यजुर्वेद धारिणः
न अ\-\-साम वेद विदुषः शक्यम् एवम् विभाषितुम्
transliteration: na an ṛgveda vinītasya na a--yajurveda dhāriṇaḥ
na a--sāma veda viduṣaḥ śakyam evam vibhāṣitum
english: None can speak thus who has not mastered the Rgveda, borne well the Yajurveda and acquainted himself thoroughly with the ſāyamveda.

sanskrit: नूनम् व्यकरणम् कृत्स्नम् अनेन बहुधा श्रुतम्
बहु व्याहरता अनेन न किंचित् अप शब्दितम्
transliteration: nūnam vyakaraṇam kṛtsnam anena bahudhā śrutam
bahu vyāharatā anena na kiṃcit apa śabditam
english: Forsooth he has studied well all the Grammars, for he has not used a single in elegant word though he has addressed me with a number of them.

sanskrit: न मुखे नेत्रयोः च अपि ललाटे च भ्रुवोः तथा
अन्येषु अपि च सर्वेषु दोषः संविदितः क्वचित्
transliteration: na mukhe netrayoḥ ca api lalāṭe ca bhruvoḥ tathā
anyeṣu api ca sarveṣu doṣaḥ saṃviditaḥ kvacit
english: And no defect was perceived on his countenance, eyes, forehead, eyebrows or on any of his limbs.

sanskrit: उरःस्थम् कण्ठगम् वाक्यम् वर्तते मध्यमे स्वरम्
transliteration: uraḥstham kaṇṭhagam vākyam vartate madhyame svaram
english: His words,-few, beyond all suspicion, pleasant, and uttered in a mild tone, came out readily of his throat and breast.
He has uttered accents, which was wonderful, ready, accomplished, auspicious and captivating.

sanskrit: कस्य न आराध्यते चित्तम् उद्यत् असे अरेः अपि
transliteration: kasya na ārādhyate cittam udyat ase areḥ api
english: Whose heart is not moved by these wonderful words, proceeding (from heart, throat and brain)? Even an enemy, who has his sword uplifted, (is moved).

sanskrit: एवम् विधो यस्य दूतो न भवेत् पार्थिवस्य तु
सिद्ध्यन्ति हि कथम् तस्य कार्याणाम् गतयोऽनघ
transliteration: evam vidho yasya dūto na bhavet pārthivasya tu
siddhyanti hi katham tasya kāryāṇām gatayo'nagha
english: O sinless one, how does that monarch accomplish his objects who has not got such a messenger?

sanskrit: एवम् गुण गणैर् युक्ता यस्य स्युः कार्य साधकाः
तस्य सिद्ध्यन्ति सर्वेऽर्था दूत वाक्य प्रचोदिताः
transliteration: evam guṇa gaṇair yuktā yasya syuḥ kārya sādhakāḥ
tasya siddhyanti sarve'rthā dūta vākya pracoditāḥ
english: Indeed whose emissaries are so accomplished, all his missions are fulfilled only by virtue of their words.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सोउमित्रिः सुग्रीव सचिवम् कपिम्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu soumitriḥ sugrīva sacivam kapim
english: Thus addressed, Saumitri, skilled in speech, welcomed that monkey-Sugrīva's counsellor and son of Pavana.

sanskrit: विदिता नौ गुणा विद्वन् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः
तम् एव च अवाम् मार्गावः सुग्रीवम् प्लवगेश्वरम्
transliteration: viditā nau guṇā vidvan sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
tam eva ca avām mārgāvaḥ sugrīvam plavageśvaram
english: O learned one! We knew well the accomplishments of the high-souled Sugrīva. We shall find out that king of monkey herds.

sanskrit: यथा ब्रवीषि हनुमान् सुग्रीव वचनाद् इह
तत् तथा हि करिष्यावो वचनात् तव सत्तम
transliteration: yathā bravīṣi hanumān sugrīva vacanād iha
tat tathā hi kariṣyāvo vacanāt tava sattama
english: O Hanumān, O best of monkeys, we shall go by whatever you shall say, under the instructions of Sugriva.

sanskrit: तत् तस्य वाक्यम् निपुणम् निशम्यप्रहृष्ट रूपः पवनात्मजः कपिः
मनः समाधाय जय उपपत्तौसख्यम् तदा कर्तुम् इयेष ताभ्याम्
transliteration: tat tasya vākyam nipuṇam niśamyaprahṛṣṭa rūpaḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ
manaḥ samādhāya jaya upapattausakhyam tadā kartum iyeṣa tābhyām
english: Hearing these skilful words, that son of Pavana, delighted, revolving within him the means for Sugrīva's conquest, purposed to bring about a friendly union between them.

sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टो हनुमान् कृत्यवान् इति तत् वचः
श्रुत्वा मधुर भावम् च सुग्रीवम् मनसा गतः
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭo hanumān kṛtyavān iti tat vacaḥ
śrutvā madhura bhāvam ca sugrīvam manasā gataḥ
english: Hearing those words (of Rāma) and learning his amicable feeling (in relation to Sugrīva) as also, seeing that Rāma was willing to assist Sugrīva, Hanuman, getting exceedingly delighted, remembered Sugrīva.

sanskrit: यत् अयम् कृत्यवान् प्राप्तः कृत्यम् च एतत् उपागतम्
transliteration: yat ayam kṛtyavān prāptaḥ kṛtyam ca etat upāgatam
english: Since this one of successful acts has been come by and also this business is in hand, the high-souled Sugrīva will most probably obtain the monarchy.

sanskrit: प्रति उवाच ततो वाक्यम् रामम् वाक्य विशारदः
transliteration: prati uvāca tato vākyam rāmam vākya viśāradaḥ
english: Then transported with joy, that foremost of monkeys, Hanumān, in these words, replied to Rāma, deft in speech, saying,

sanskrit: किम् अर्थम् त्वम् वनम् घोरम् पम्पा कानन मण्डितम्
आगतः सानुजो दुर्गम् नाना व्याल मृग आयुतम्
transliteration: kim artham tvam vanam ghoram pampā kānana maṇḍitam
āgataḥ sānujo durgam nānā vyāla mṛga āyutam
english: Why is it, thất accompanied with your younger brother, have you come to this dense and trackless forest, garnished with the woodlands of Pampā, and filled with various kinds of ferocious beasts?

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो राम चोदितः
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇo rāma coditaḥ
english: Hearing those words of his, Laksmana, directed by Råma, informed (Hanumān) of all about Rama, the son of Dasaratha.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो नाम द्युतिमान् धर्म वत्सलः
चातुर् वर्ण्यम् स्व धर्मेण नित्यम् एव अभिपालयन्
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma dyutimān dharma vatsalaḥ
cātur varṇyam sva dharmeṇa nityam eva abhipālayan
english: There was a king named Dasaratha. Possessed of effulgence, and attached to righteousness, he, in consonance with his proper duties, for aye, governed the four orders.

sanskrit: न द्वेष्टा विद्यते तस्य स तु द्वेष्टि न कंचन
स तु सर्वेषु भूतेषु पितामह इव अपरः
transliteration: na dveṣṭā vidyate tasya sa tu dveṣṭi na kaṃcana
sa tu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pitāmaha iva aparaḥ
english: He has no hater; nor does he hate any one. And in relation to all creatures he was like another great-father.

sanskrit: तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः
transliteration: tasya ayam pūrvajaḥ putro rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ
english: And he celebrated Agniştoma and other sacrifices with presents (to Brāhmaṇas). This one is his eldest son, named Rama, famous among men.

sanskrit: शरण्यः सर्व भूतानाम् पितुः निर्देश पारगः
transliteration: śaraṇyaḥ sarva bhūtānām pituḥ nirdeśa pāragaḥ
english: He is the refuge of all creatures, and competent to carry out the injunctions of his father. The eldest son of Dasaratha, he is foremost of all his sons in merit.

sanskrit: राज लक्षण संयुक्तः संयुक्तो राज्य सम्पदा
राजात् भ्रष्टो मया वस्तुम् वने सार्धम् इह आगतः
transliteration: rāja lakṣaṇa saṃyuktaḥ saṃyukto rājya sampadā
rājāt bhraṣṭo mayā vastum vane sārdham iha āgataḥ
english: He bears marks of royalty, and has the prosperity of a kingdom. Deprived of his kingdom, in company with myself, he has come hither with the view of dwelling in this wood.

sanskrit: भार्यया च महाभाग सीतया अनुगतो वशी
दिन क्षये महातेजाः प्रभ एव दिवाकरः
transliteration: bhāryayā ca mahābhāga sītayā anugato vaśī
dina kṣaye mahātejāḥ prabha eva divākaraḥ
english: And, O highly exalted one, this one of subdued senses is followed by his wife Sītā even as the decline of day the exceedingly effulgent Sun is followed by (his spouse) Splendour.

sanskrit: अहम् अस्य अवरः भ्राता गुणैः दास्यम् उपागतः
transliteration: aham asya avaraḥ bhrātā guṇaiḥ dāsyam upāgataḥ
english: I am the younger brother of this one endued with gratitude and of various lore. Subdued by his virtues, I, Laksimana by name, have dedicated myself to his service.

Worthy of happiness, homage, and intent upon the welfare of all beings, deprived of wealth and living in the forest, he has his wife carried off by a Rākşasa, wearing shapes at will. Nor have we yet (been able) to ascertain who is that Rākşasa that has carried off his wife.

sanskrit: रक्षस अपहृता भार्या रहिते काम रूपिणा
तत् च न ज्ञायते रक्षः पत्नी येन अस्य वा हृता
transliteration: rakṣasa apahṛtā bhāryā rahite kāma rūpiṇā
tat ca na jñāyate rakṣaḥ patnī yena asya vā hṛtā
english: Worthy of happiness, homage, and intent upon the welfare of all beings, deprived of wealth and living in the forest, he has his wife carried off by a Rākşasa, wearing shapes at will. Nor have we yet (been able) to ascertain who is that Rākşasa that has carried off his wife.

sanskrit: दनुः नाम दितेः पुत्रः शापात् राक्षसताम् गतः
transliteration: danuḥ nāma diteḥ putraḥ śāpāt rākṣasatām gataḥ
english: A son of Diti named Danu, had, by virtue of an imprecation, undergone Raksasa-hood. He it is who had related to us all about the capable Sugrīva.—That exceedingly puissant one shall have a knowledge of the ravisher of your wife? Having said this, Danu beaming (with a halo) went to heaven.

sanskrit: स ज्ञास्यति महावीर्यः तव भार्या अपहारिणम्
एवम् उक्त्वा दनुः स्वर्गम् भ्राजमानो दिवम् गतः
transliteration: sa jñāsyati mahāvīryaḥ tava bhāryā apahāriṇam
evam uktvā danuḥ svargam bhrājamāno divam gataḥ
english: A son of Diti named Danu, had, by virtue of an imprecation, undergone Raksasa-hood. He it is who had related to us all about the capable Sugrīva.—That exceedingly puissant one shall have a knowledge of the ravisher of your wife? Having said this, Danu beaming (with a halo) went to heaven.

sanskrit: एतत् ते सर्वम् आख्यातम् याथातथ्येन पृच्छतः
अहम् चैव च रामः च सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतौ
transliteration: etat te sarvam ākhyātam yāthātathyena pṛcchataḥ
aham caiva ca rāmaḥ ca sugrīvam śaraṇam gatau
english: Thus have 1 related to you all as it fell out. Both Rāma and myself have saught the shelter of Sugriva.

sanskrit: एष दत्त्वा च वित्तानि प्राप्य च अनुत्तमम् यशः
लोकनाथः पुरा भूत्वा सुग्रीवम् नाथम् इच्छति
transliteration: eṣa dattvā ca vittāni prāpya ca anuttamam yaśaḥ
lokanāthaḥ purā bhūtvā sugrīvam nātham icchati
english: Having given away profuse wealth and attained high fame, this one who formerly was the lord of the worlds, now wishes to make Sugrīva his master.

sanskrit: सीता यस्य स्नुषा च आसीत् शरण्यो धर्मवत्सलः
तस्य पुत्रः शरण्यस्य सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः
transliteration: sītā yasya snuṣā ca āsīt śaraṇyo dharmavatsalaḥ
tasya putraḥ śaraṇyasya sugrīvam śaraṇam gataḥ
english: That one attached to virtue, that refuge (of all)—the son of that shelter (of all beings) has come under the protection of Sugrīva.

sanskrit: सर्व लोकस्य धर्मात्मा शरण्यः शरणम् पुरा
गुरुर् मे राघवः सोऽयम् सुग्रीवम् शरणम् गतः
transliteration: sarva lokasya dharmātmā śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇam purā
gurur me rāghavaḥ so'yam sugrīvam śaraṇam gataḥ
english: That spiritual guide, who ere now was worthy of being the shelter (of all) and who (actually) was the refuge (of all creatures) Rāghava, has saught the shelter of Sugrīva.

sanskrit: यस्य प्रसादे सततम् प्रसीदेयुः इमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: yasya prasāde satatam prasīdeyuḥ imāḥ prajāḥ
english: That Rāma in whose happiness and favour the subjects found their felicity, seeketh the good graces of Sugrīva.

sanskrit: येन सर्व गुणोपेताः पृथिव्याम् सर्व पार्थिवाः
मानिताः सततम् राज्ञा सदा दशरथेन वै
transliteration: yena sarva guṇopetāḥ pṛthivyām sarva pārthivāḥ
mānitāḥ satatam rājñā sadā daśarathena vai
english: Famed over the three worlds the eldest son of that monarch who had always and for aye honoured all the kings of the earth crowned with every virtue,-, viz. Rāma, has sought the protection of Sugrīva, lord of monkeys.

sanskrit: तस्य अयम् पूर्वजः पुत्रः त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः
सुग्रीवम् वानरेन्द्रम् तु रामः शरणम् आगतः
transliteration: tasya ayam pūrvajaḥ putraḥ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
sugrīvam vānarendram tu rāmaḥ śaraṇam āgataḥ
english: Famed over the three worlds the eldest son of that monarch who had always and for aye honoured all the kings of the earth crowned with every virtue,-, viz. Rāma, has sought the protection of Sugrīva, lord of monkeys.

sanskrit: शोक अभिभूते रामे तु शोक आर्ते शरणम् गते
कर्तुम् अर्हति सुग्रीवः प्रसादम् सह यूथपैः
transliteration: śoka abhibhūte rāme tu śoka ārte śaraṇam gate
kartum arhati sugrīvaḥ prasādam saha yūthapaiḥ
english: On Rāma being overwhelmed with sorrow, tried by grief, and having come under his refuge,' it behoveth Sugrīva along with the leaders of bands to show favour to Rāma?

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् करुणम् स अश्रु पातनम्
हनुमान् प्रति उवाच इदम् वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः
transliteration: evam bruvāṇam saumitrim karuṇam sa aśru pātanam
hanumān prati uvāca idam vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ

english: When Sumitrā's son shedding tears had spoken thus, that one skilled in speech, Hanumān, answered in these words, 'Persons of such a stamp, endued with understanding, of controlled anger and subdued senses, should be seen by the master of monkeys, and such come within one's ken through blessed luck.

sanskrit: स हि राज्यात् च विभ्रष्टः कृत वैरः च वालिना
हृत दारो वने त्रस्तः भ्रात्रा विनिकृतः भृशम्
transliteration: sa hi rājyāt ca vibhraṣṭaḥ kṛta vairaḥ ca vālinā
hṛta dāro vane trastaḥ bhrātrā vinikṛtaḥ bhṛśam
english: He also has been driven out of his kingdom, and has incurred the hostility of Vali. And his wife torn away from him, he dwelleth in this wood, in fear, having been exceedingly harassed by his brother.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः सह च अस्माभिः सीतायाः परिमार्गणे
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ saha ca asmābhiḥ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe
english: That son of the Sun, Sugriva, along with us, will help you in seeking out Sītā.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा हनुमान् श्लक्ष्णम् मधुरया गिरा
बभाषे साधु गच्छामः सुग्रीवम् इति राघवम्
transliteration: iti evam uktvā hanumān ślakṣṇam madhurayā girā
babhāṣe sādhu gacchāmaḥ sugrīvam iti rāghavam
english: Having said these sweet and hurried words, Hanuman said to Rāghava, 'I will (now) repair to Sugriva.'

sanskrit: एवम् ब्रुवन्तम् धर्मात्मा हनूमन्तम् स लक्ष्मणः
प्रतिपूज्य यथा न्यायम् इदम् प्रोवाच राघवम्
transliteration: evam bruvantam dharmātmā hanūmantam sa lakṣmaṇaḥ
pratipūjya yathā nyāyam idam provāca rāghavam
english: When Hanumān had said this, the righteous Lakşmaņa duly paying homage to the former, addressed Rāghava, saying.

sanskrit: कपिः कथयते हृष्टो यथा अयम् मारुतात्मजः
कृत्यवान् सोऽपि संप्राप्तः कृत कृत्योऽसि राघव
transliteration: kapiḥ kathayate hṛṣṭo yathā ayam mārutātmajaḥ
kṛtyavān so'pi saṃprāptaḥ kṛta kṛtyo'si rāghava
english: From the glad way in which this son of the god of the wind is speaking, it appears that he also seeks your service; and, arriving (at this region) you also, Rāghava, have reaped success.

sanskrit: प्रसन्न मुख वर्णः च व्यक्तम् हृष्टः च भाषते
न अनृतम् वक्ष्यते वीरो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः
transliteration: prasanna mukha varṇaḥ ca vyaktam hṛṣṭaḥ ca bhāṣate
na anṛtam vakṣyate vīro hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ
english: He speaketh openly with a delightful light in his countenance; and cheerfulness. (It seems) that the heroic Hanuman, son to the God of wind does not speak anything that is false.

sanskrit: जगाम आदाय तौ वीरौ हरि राजाय राघवौ
transliteration: jagāma ādāya tau vīrau hari rājāya rāghavau
english: Then that vastly wise one Hanumān the son of the wind god departed, taking with him the heroic descendants of Raghu, for (presenting them) to the monarch of monkeys.

sanskrit: भिक्षु रूपम् परित्यज्य वानरम् रूपम् आस्थितः
पृष्टम् आरोप्य तौ वीरौ जगाम कपिकुङ्जरः
transliteration: bhikṣu rūpam parityajya vānaram rūpam āsthitaḥ
pṛṣṭam āropya tau vīrau jagāma kapikuṅjaraḥ
english: Renouncing the guise of a beggar, and assuming the form of a monkey, that foremost of monkeys went away, placing those heroes on his back.

sanskrit: स तु विपुल यशाः कपि प्रवीरः पवनसुतः कृत कृत्यवत् प्रहृष्टः
गिरि वरम् उरुविक्रमः प्रयातः स शुभमतिः सह राम लक्ष्मणाभ्याम्
transliteration: sa tu vipula yaśāḥ kapi pravīraḥ pavanasutaḥ kṛta kṛtyavat prahṛṣṭaḥ
giri varam uruvikramaḥ prayātaḥ sa śubhamatiḥ saha rāma lakṣmaṇābhyām
english: Then the heroic monkey, the son of the windgod, of wide fame, and great prowess, with his mind perfectly pure, considering himself as crowned with success, and experiencing exceeding delight, arrived at that best of mountains in company with Rāma and Laks mana.

sanskrit: ऋश्यमूकात् तु हनुमान् गत्वा तम् मलयम् गिरिम्
आचचक्षे तदा वीरौ कपि राजाय राघवौ
transliteration: ṛśyamūkāt tu hanumān gatvā tam malayam girim
ācacakṣe tadā vīrau kapi rājāya rāghavau
english: Having departed from Rşyamuka, and arrived at the Malaya hill, Hanumān informed the king of monkeys of (the arrival of) the descendants of Raghu.

sanskrit: अयम् रामो महाप्राज्ञ संप्राप्तो दृढ विक्रमः
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा रामोऽयम् सत्य विक्रमः
transliteration: ayam rāmo mahāprājña saṃprāpto dṛḍha vikramaḥ
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā rāmo'yam satya vikramaḥ
english: O exceedingly wise one, this one that has come here is Rāma having truth for his prowess.

sanskrit: धर्मे निगदितः च एव पितुर् निर्देश कारकः
transliteration: dharme nigaditaḥ ca eva pitur nirdeśa kārakaḥ
english: This is Rāma having truth for his prowess, in company with his brother, Lakşmaņa. Rāma the son of Dasaratha, is born in the race of the Ikş wākus. Ever doing the will of his sire, he has been sent hither, in order that his father's verity may stand in tact.

sanskrit: राजसूय अश्वमेधैः च वह्निः येन अभितर्पितः
दक्षिणाः च तथा उत्सृष्टा गावः शत सहस्रशः
transliteration: rājasūya aśvamedhaiḥ ca vahniḥ yena abhitarpitaḥ
dakṣiṇāḥ ca tathā utsṛṣṭā gāvaḥ śata sahasraśaḥ
english: Raima, who has come to the forest, is the son of him who has propitiated Fire with Rājasuyas and horse sacrifices,-dispensing Dakshinas and kine by hundreds and thousands-and who has governed the earth by asceticism and truthful speech. His son Rāma has come to the forest through a woman.

sanskrit: तपसा सत्य वाक्येन वसुधा येन पालिता
स्त्री हेतोः तस्य पुत्रोऽयम् रामः अरणयम् समागतः
transliteration: tapasā satya vākyena vasudhā yena pālitā
strī hetoḥ tasya putro'yam rāmaḥ araṇayam samāgataḥ
english: Raima, who has come to the forest, is the son of him who has propitiated Fire with Rājasuyas and horse sacrifices,-dispensing Dakshinas and kine by hundreds and thousands-and who has governed the earth by asceticism and truthful speech. His son Rāma has come to the forest through a woman.

sanskrit: तस्य अस्य वसतो अरण्ये नियतस्य महात्मनः
रावणेन हृता भार्या स त्वाम् शरणम् आगतः
transliteration: tasya asya vasato araṇye niyatasya mahātmanaḥ
rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā sa tvām śaraṇam āgataḥ
english: While that high-souled one having his senses under control was dwelling in the woods, his wife was carried off by Rāvana; and he (Rāma) has (in consequence) sought your protection.

sanskrit: भवता सख्य कामौ तौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
प्रगृह्य च अर्चयस्व एतौ पूजनीयतमौ उभौ
transliteration: bhavatā sakhya kāmau tau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
pragṛhya ca arcayasva etau pūjanīyatamau ubhau
english: Do you, granting an interview to the brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa-both of them worthy of homage-who pe eager for your friendship, receive them respectfully.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यम् सुग्रीवो वानर अधिपः
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyam sugrīvo vānara adhipaḥ
english: Hearing Hanuman's words, Sugrīva-lord of monkeys, becoming visible (at his will), gladly spoke to Rāghava, sir, you are versed in morality, and bear love towards all. The son of the wind-god has faithfully described your virtues to me.

sanskrit: भवान् धर्म विनीतः च सुतपाः सर्व वत्सलः
आख्याता वायुपुत्रेण तत्त्वतो मे भवद् गुणाः
transliteration: bhavān dharma vinītaḥ ca sutapāḥ sarva vatsalaḥ
ākhyātā vāyuputreṇa tattvato me bhavad guṇāḥ
english: Hearing Hanuman's words, Sugrīva-lord of monkeys, becoming visible (at his will), gladly spoke to Rāghava, sir, you are versed in morality, and bear love towards all. The son of the wind-god has faithfully described your virtues to me.

sanskrit: तन् मम एव एष सत्कारो लाभः च एव उत्तमः प्रभो
यत् त्वम् इच्छसि सौहार्दम् वानरेण मया सह
transliteration: tan mama eva eṣa satkāro lābhaḥ ca eva uttamaḥ prabho
yat tvam icchasi sauhārdam vānareṇa mayā saha
english: That you, O lord, are anxious to contract friendship with me who am a monkey does me honour and is my gain.

sanskrit: रोचते यदि मे सख्यम् बाहुः एष प्रसारितः
गृह्यताम् पाणिना पाणिः मर्यादा बध्यताम् ध्रुवा
transliteration: rocate yadi me sakhyam bāhuḥ eṣa prasāritaḥ
gṛhyatām pāṇinā pāṇiḥ maryādā badhyatām dhruvā
english: If you relish friendship with me, do you take this stretched arm and my hand with yours, and bind yourself fast with a vow.

sanskrit: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य सुभाषितम्
transliteration: etat tu vacanam śrutvā sugrīvasya subhāṣitam
english: Hearing these sweet words of Sugrīva, (Rāma) exceedingly delighted, pressed Sugrīva's hand with his. And contracting friendship with Surgrīva, Rāma experiencing great joy embraced him warmly.

sanskrit: ततो हनूमान् संत्यज्य भिक्षु रूपम् अरिन्दमः
transliteration: tato hanūmān saṃtyajya bhikṣu rūpam arindamaḥ

sanskrit: दीप्यमानम् ततो वह्निम् पुष्पैः अभ्यर्च्य सत्कृतम्
transliteration: dīpyamānam tato vahnim puṣpaiḥ abhyarcya satkṛtam

sanskrit: तयोर् मध्ये तु सुप्रीतो निदधौ सुसमाहितः
ततो अग्निम् दीप्यमानम् तौ चक्रतुः च प्रदक्षिणम्
transliteration: tayor madhye tu suprīto nidadhau susamāhitaḥ
tato agnim dīpyamānam tau cakratuḥ ca pradakṣiṇam
english: Then worshipping that flaming fire with flowers, he, well pleased, carefully placed it between them (Rāma and Sugrīva). Then Sugrīva and Rāghava went round the fire; and (thus) were fastened in friendship.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवो राघवः च एव वयस्यत्वम् उपागतौ
ततः सुप्रीत मनसौ तौ उभौ हरि राघवौ
transliteration: sugrīvo rāghavaḥ ca eva vayasyatvam upāgatau
tataḥ suprīta manasau tau ubhau hari rāghavau

sanskrit: त्वम् वयस्योऽसि हृद्यः मे हि एकम् दुःखम् सुखम् च नौ
transliteration: tvam vayasyo'si hṛdyaḥ me hi ekam duḥkham sukham ca nau

sanskrit: सुग्रीवो राघवम् वाक्यम् इति उवाच प्रहृष्टवत्
ततः सुपर्ण बहुलाम् भंक्त्वा शाखाम् सुपुष्पिताम्
transliteration: sugrīvo rāghavam vākyam iti uvāca prahṛṣṭavat
tataḥ suparṇa bahulām bhaṃktvā śākhām supuṣpitām

sanskrit: सालस्य आस्तीर्य सुग्रीवः निषसाद स राघवः
transliteration: sālasya āstīrya sugrīvaḥ niṣasāda sa rāghavaḥ

sanskrit: शखाम् चन्दन वृक्षस्य ददौ परम पुष्पिताम्
ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः श्लक्ष्णम् मधुरया गिरा
transliteration: śakhām candana vṛkṣasya dadau parama puṣpitām
tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ ślakṣṇam madhurayā girā

sanskrit: प्रति उवाच तदा रामम् हर्ष व्याकुल लोचनः
अहम् विनिकृतो राम चरमि इह भय आर्दितः
transliteration: prati uvāca tadā rāmam harṣa vyākula locanaḥ
aham vinikṛto rāma carami iha bhaya ārditaḥ

sanskrit: हृत भार्यो वने त्रस्तो दुर्गम् एतत् उपाश्रितः
सोऽहम् त्रस्तो वने भीतो वसामि उद् भ्रान्त चेतनः
transliteration: hṛta bhāryo vane trasto durgam etat upāśritaḥ
so'ham trasto vane bhīto vasāmi ud bhrānta cetanaḥ

sanskrit: वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृत वैरः च राघव
वालिनो मे महाभाग भय आर्तस्य अभयम् कुरु
transliteration: vālinā nikṛto bhrātrā kṛta vairaḥ ca rāghava
vālino me mahābhāga bhaya ārtasya abhayam kuru

sanskrit: कर्तुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थः भयम् मे न भवेद् यथा
एवम् उक्तः तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः
transliteration: kartum arhasi kākutsthaḥ bhayam me na bhaved yathā
evam uktaḥ tu tejasvī dharmajño dharma vatsalaḥ

sanskrit: प्रति अभाषत काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीवम् प्रहसन् इव
उपकार फलम् मित्रम् विदितम् मे महाकपे
transliteration: prati abhāṣata kākutsthaḥ sugrīvam prahasan iva
upakāra phalam mitram viditam me mahākape

sanskrit: वालिनम् तम् वधिष्यामि तव भार्य अपहारिणम्
अमोघोः सूर्य संकाशाः मम इमे निशिताः शराः
transliteration: vālinam tam vadhiṣyāmi tava bhārya apahāriṇam
amoghoḥ sūrya saṃkāśāḥ mama ime niśitāḥ śarāḥ

sanskrit: कन्क पत्र प्रतिच्छन्ना महेन्द्र अशनि संनिभाः
transliteration: kanka patra praticchannā mahendra aśani saṃnibhāḥ
english: These infallible sharpened shafts of inine, resembling the sun, feathered with the plumes of the Kanka, like to the thunderbolt of the great Indra, having sharp heads and even knots, like in infuriated serpents,-being let go with vehermence, shall alight upon the impious Vali.

sanskrit: तीक्ष्णाग्रा ऋजुपर्वाणः स रोषा भुजगा इव
तम् अद्य वालिनम् पश्य तीक्ष्णैः आशी विष उपमैः
transliteration: tīkṣṇāgrā ṛjuparvāṇaḥ sa roṣā bhujagā iva
tam adya vālinam paśya tīkṣṇaiḥ āśī viṣa upamaiḥ

sanskrit: शरैः विनिहितम् भूमौ प्रकीर्णम् इव पर्वतम्
स तु तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा राघवस्य आत्मनोहितम्
सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतः परमम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: śaraiḥ vinihitam bhūmau prakīrṇam iva parvatam
sa tu tad vacanam śrutvā rāghavasya ātmanohitam
sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ paramam vākyam abravīt
english: Hearing those words of Răghava fraught with his welfare, Sugrīva supremely rejoiced, said these words, informed with rapture, You hero!

sanskrit: तव प्रसादेन नृसिंह वीरप्रियाम् च राज्यम् च समाप्नुयाम् अहम्
तथा कुरु त्वम् नर देव वैरिणम्यथा न हिंस्यत् स पुनर् मम अग्रजम्
transliteration: tava prasādena nṛsiṃha vīrapriyām ca rājyam ca samāpnuyām aham
tathā kuru tvam nara deva vairiṇamyathā na hiṃsyat sa punar mama agrajam
english: You lion among men! by your grace shall I obtain both my beloved and my monarchy. O God among men, do you so deal with that foe, my elder brother, that he may not again wrong venomous me.

sanskrit: सीत कपीन्द्र क्षणदा चराणाम्राजीव हेम ज्वलनोपमानानि
सुग्रीव राम प्रणय पसङ्गेवामानि नेत्राणि समम् स्फुरन्ति
transliteration: sīta kapīndra kṣaṇadā carāṇāmrājīva hema jvalanopamānāni
sugrīva rāma praṇaya pasaṅgevāmāni netrāṇi samam sphuranti
english: The left eyes of Sītā, the lord of apes, and night rangers-respectively like the lotus, gold, and flaming fire, throbbed when the friendship between Rāma and Sugrīva was contracted.

sanskrit: अयम् आख्याति ते राम सेवकः मन्त्रि सत्तमः
transliteration: ayam ākhyāti te rāma sevakaḥ mantri sattamaḥ
english: Sugrīva well pleased again addressed Rāghava, the son of Raghu, saying, O Rāma, this servant of thine, foremost of my counsellors, Hanumān, has related (to me), the reason of your arrival in this lone forest.

sanskrit: हनुमान् यन् निमित्तम् त्वम् निर्जनम् वनम् आगतः
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वसतः च वने तव
transliteration: hanumān yan nimittam tvam nirjanam vanam āgataḥ
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vasataḥ ca vane tava

sanskrit: रक्षसा अपहृता भार्या मैथिली जनक आत्मजा
त्वया वियुक्ता रुदती लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता
transliteration: rakṣasā apahṛtā bhāryā maithilī janaka ātmajā
tvayā viyuktā rudatī lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā
english: Your wife, Maithili, daughter to Janaka, separated from you as well as the intelligent Laksmana, and weeping (in consequence) was carried off by a Rākṣa. Seeing for opportunities of doing mischief that Rākşa, having slain Jațáyu, has caused to you the grief that comes of separation from one's wife.

sanskrit: अन्तरम् प्रेप्सुना तेन हत्वा गृध्रम् जटायुषम्
भार्या वियोगजम् दुःखम् प्रापितः तेन रक्ष्सा
transliteration: antaram prepsunā tena hatvā gṛdhram jaṭāyuṣam
bhāryā viyogajam duḥkham prāpitaḥ tena rakṣsā

sanskrit: भर्या वियोगजम् दुःखम् न चिरात् त्वम् विमोक्ष्यसे
अहम् ताम् आनयिष्यामि नष्टाम् वेदश्रुतीम् इव
transliteration: bharyā viyogajam duḥkham na cirāt tvam vimokṣyase
aham tām ānayiṣyāmi naṣṭām vedaśrutīm iva
english: But you with soon be relieved from the sorrow that comes of separation from one's wife. Her will I bring like to the ravished Devasruti.

sanskrit: रसातले वा वर्तन्तीम् वर्तन्तीम् वा नभः तले
अहम् आनीय दास्यामि तव भार्याम् अरिन्दम
transliteration: rasātale vā vartantīm vartantīm vā nabhaḥ tale
aham ānīya dāsyāmi tava bhāryām arindama
english: O repressor of foes, whether she be in the nether regions or under the sky, I will, bringing your wife, make her over to you.

sanskrit: इदम् तथ्यम् मम वचः त्वम् अवेहि च राघव
न शक्या सा जरयितुम् अपि सः इन्द्रैः सुर असुरैः
transliteration: idam tathyam mama vacaḥ tvam avehi ca rāghava
na śakyā sā jarayitum api saḥ indraiḥ sura asuraiḥ
english: O Rāghava, know my words to be true. O mighty-armed one, like to poison, your wife is incapable of being digested even by the gods and Asuras with Indra (at their head). O mightyarmed one, leave off sorrow, I will bring back your beloved.

sanskrit: तव भार्या महाबाहो भक्ष्यम् विष कृतम् यथा
त्यज शोकम् महाबाहो ताम् कान्ताम् आनयामि ते
transliteration: tava bhāryā mahābāho bhakṣyam viṣa kṛtam yathā
tyaja śokam mahābāho tām kāntām ānayāmi te
english: O Rāghava, know my words to be true. O mighty-armed one, like to poison, your wife is incapable of being digested even by the gods and Asuras with Indra (at their head). O mightyarmed one, leave off sorrow, I will bring back your beloved.

sanskrit: अनुमानात् तु जानामि मैथिली सा न संशयः
ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रक्षसा रौउद्र कर्मणा
transliteration: anumānāt tu jānāmi maithilī sā na saṃśayaḥ
hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rakṣasā rauudra karmaṇā
english: From guess I find that it was doubtless Mithilā's daughter whom I saw when she was being carried away by that Räksa of terrific deeds. She was crying, Rama, Laksmana, Laks maņa,' and in the lap of Răvaņa she looked like the wife of the Snake-chief.

sanskrit: क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम्
स्फुरन्ती रावणस्य अन्के पन्नगेन्द्र वधूः यथा
transliteration: krośantī rāma rāmeti lakṣmaṇeti ca visvaram
sphurantī rāvaṇasya anke pannagendra vadhūḥ yathā
english: From guess I find that it was doubtless Mithilā's daughter whom I saw when she was being carried away by that Räksa of terrific deeds. She was crying, Rama, Laksmana, Laks maņa,' and in the lap of Răvaņa she looked like the wife of the Snake-chief.

sanskrit: आत्मना पञ्चमम् माम् हि दृष्ट्वा शैल तले स्थितम्
उत्तरीयम् तया त्यक्तम् शुभानि आभरणानि च
transliteration: ātmanā pañcamam mām hi dṛṣṭvā śaila tale sthitam
uttarīyam tayā tyaktam śubhāni ābharaṇāni ca
english: Seeing me along with my four counsellors stationed at the hill, she dropped down her scarf and her ornaments.

sanskrit: तानि अस्माभिः गृहीतानि निहितानि च राघव
transliteration: tāni asmābhiḥ gṛhītāni nihitāni ca rāghava
english: All these, O Rāghava, I have taken and kept (with me). I will bring them. It behoveth you to recognise them.

sanskrit: तम् अब्रवीत् ततः रामः सुग्रीवम् प्रिय वादिनम्
आनयस्व सखे शीघ्रम् किम् अर्थम् प्रविलम्बसे
transliteration: tam abravīt tataḥ rāmaḥ sugrīvam priya vādinam
ānayasva sakhe śīghram kim artham pravilambase
english: There upon Rāma spoke to the sweetspeeched Sugrīva, 'Bring (them), at once, my friend. Why did you tarry?'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवः शैलस्य गहनाम् गुहाम्
प्रविवेश ततः शीघ्रम् राघव प्रिय काम्यया
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ śailasya gahanām guhām
praviveśa tataḥ śīghram rāghava priya kāmyayā
english: Having been thus addressed, Sugrīva swiftly entered a deep cavern in the mountain, with the view of doing what was dear to Rāghava. Then taking the scarf as well as the ornaments. Look at this, (Saying this) the monkey held them before Rāma.

sanskrit: उत्तरीयम् गृहीत्वा तु स तानि आभरणानि च
इदम् पश्य इति रामाय दर्शयामास वानरः
transliteration: uttarīyam gṛhītvā tu sa tāni ābharaṇāni ca
idam paśya iti rāmāya darśayāmāsa vānaraḥ
english: Having been thus addressed, Sugrīva swiftly entered a deep cavern in the mountain, with the view of doing what was dear to Rāghava. Then taking the scarf as well as the ornaments. Look at this, (Saying this) the monkey held them before Rāma.

sanskrit: ततो गृहीत्वा वासः तु शुभानि आभरणानि च
अभवत् बाष्प सम्रुद्धः नीहारेण इव चन्द्रमाः
transliteration: tato gṛhītvā vāsaḥ tu śubhāni ābharaṇāni ca
abhavat bāṣpa samruddhaḥ nīhāreṇa iva candramāḥ
english: Taking the sheet and the ornaments, (Rama) had his ayes filled with tears, like the moon covered by the dew.

sanskrit: सीता स्नेह प्रवृत्तेन स तु बाष्पेण दूषितः
हा प्रिये इति रुदन् धैर्यम् उत्सृज्य न्यपतत् क्षितौ
transliteration: sītā sneha pravṛttena sa tu bāṣpeṇa dūṣitaḥ
hā priye iti rudan dhairyam utsṛjya nyapatat kṣitau
english: From affection for Sītā, (Rāma,) his eyes filled with tears, deprived of patience, fell down to the ground.

sanskrit: हृदि कृत्वा स बहुशः तम् अलंकारम् उत्तमम्
निशश्वास भृशम् सर्पः बिलस्थ इव रोषितः
transliteration: hṛdi kṛtvā sa bahuśaḥ tam alaṃkāram uttamam
niśaśvāsa bhṛśam sarpaḥ bilastha iva roṣitaḥ
english: And placing the elegant ornaments on his bosom, he sighed again and again, like an enraged serpent in a hole.

sanskrit: अविच्छिन्न अश्रु वेगः तु सौमित्रिम् प्रेक्ष्य पार्श्वतः
transliteration: avicchinna aśru vegaḥ tu saumitrim prekṣya pārśvataḥ
english: Seeing Sumitrā's son at his side, Rāma shedding ceaseless tears, began to lament piteously,

sanskrit: उत्तरीयम् इदम् भूमौ शरीराद् भूषणानि च
transliteration: uttarīyam idam bhūmau śarīrād bhūṣaṇāni ca
english: O Lakşmaņa, behold this scarf and these ornaments which Vaidehī, while being carried away, let fall from her person to the earth.

sanskrit: उत्सृष्टम् भूषणाम् इदम् तथा रूपम् हि दृश्यते
transliteration: utsṛṣṭam bhūṣaṇām idam tathā rūpam hi dṛśyate
english: Surely Sītā, while being ravished, let these fall on a sward, for these remain as before.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तसः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
न अहम् जानामि केयूरे न अहम् जानामि कुन्डले
transliteration: evam uktasaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇo vākyam idam abravīt
na aham jānāmi keyūre na aham jānāmi kunḍale
english: Thus accosted, Laksmana spoke, saying, I do not know her bracelets; I do not know her earrings. But I know full well her bangles on account of my always bowing down to her feet.

sanskrit: नूपुरे तु अभिजनामि नित्यम् पाद अभिवंदनात्
ततः तु राघवो वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: nūpure tu abhijanāmi nityam pāda abhivaṃdanāt
tataḥ tu rāghavo vākyam sugrīvam idam abravīt
english: Thereupon Rāghava said these words to Sugriva, Tell me, O Sugriva, at what place didst you see Sītā, while she, dear to me as life, was taken away by the fierce-looking Raksasas?

sanskrit: ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कम् देशम् ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया
transliteration: brūhi sugrīva kam deśam hriyantī lakṣitā tvayā
english: Thereupon Rāghava said these words to Sugriva, Tell me, O Sugriva, at what place didst you see Sītā, while she, dear to me as life, was taken away by the fierce-looking Raksasas?

sanskrit: क्व वा वसति तत् रक्षJः महत् व्यसनदम् मम
यन् निमित्तम् अहम् सर्वान् नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसान्
transliteration: kva vā vasati tat rakṣaḥ mahat vyasanadam mama
yan nimittam aham sarvān nāśayiṣyāmi rākṣasān
english: Where does that Rākṣa, who has brought on this high peril, and for whom I will slay all the Rākşasas, live?

sanskrit: हरता मैथिलीम् येन माम् च रोषयता ध्रुवम्
आत्मनो जीवित अन्ताय मृत्यु द्वारम् अपावृतम्
transliteration: haratā maithilīm yena mām ca roṣayatā dhruvam
ātmano jīvita antāya mṛtyu dvāram apāvṛtam
english: He, that has carried off Mithila's daughter, and roused my wrath, has certainly for his own end, opened the door of death.

sanskrit: मम दयित तमा हृता वनात् रजनिचरेण विमथ्य येन सा
कथय मम रिपुम् तम् अद्य वै प्लवगपते यम सन्निधिम् नयामि
transliteration: mama dayita tamā hṛtā vanāt rajanicareṇa vimathya yena sā
kathaya mama ripum tam adya vai plavagapate yama sannidhim nayāmi
english: Tell me all about that ranger of the night, that deceitfully has carried away my dearest wife from the forest. My foe, O lord of monkey will I to-day send to the neighbourhood of Yāma.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवः रामेण आर्तेन वानरः
अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिः वाक्यम् सबाष्पम् बाष्प गद्गदः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ rāmeṇa ārtena vānaraḥ
abravīt prāñjaliḥ vākyam sabāṣpam bāṣpa gadgadaḥ
english: Thus addressed by the aggrieved Rāma, the monkey, Sugriva, his accents obstructed by vapour and his eyes filled with tears, said with joined hands,

sanskrit: न जाने निलयम् तस्य सर्वथा पाप रक्षसः
सामर्थ्यम् विक्रमम् वा अपि दौष्कुलेयस्य वा कुलम्
transliteration: na jāne nilayam tasya sarvathā pāpa rakṣasaḥ
sāmarthyam vikramam vā api dauṣkuleyasya vā kulam
english: I do not know the hidden abode of that exceedingly wicked Raksasa,-nor do l know his heroism and prowess, or the lineage of that one sprung from a vicious race.

sanskrit: सत्यम् तु प्रतिजानामि त्यज शोकम् अरिन्दम
करिष्यामि तथा यत्नम् यथा प्राप्स्यसि मैथिलीम्
transliteration: satyam tu pratijānāmi tyaja śokam arindama
kariṣyāmi tathā yatnam yathā prāpsyasi maithilīm
english: O vanquisher of foes, leave off sorrowing. I promise to you truly, I will exert so that you mayst obtain Maithilī.

sanskrit: रावणम् सगणम् हत्वा परितोष्य आत्म पौरुषम्
तथा अस्मि कर्ता नचिराद् यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि
transliteration: rāvaṇam sagaṇam hatvā paritoṣya ātma pauruṣam
tathā asmi kartā nacirād yathā prīto bhaviṣyasi
english: Slaying Rāvaņa with his hosts, and putting forth my manliness capable of pleasing others, I will speedily act so that you mayst be pleased.

sanskrit: अलम् वैक्लव्यम् आलम्ब्य धैर्यम् आत्मगतम् स्मर
त्वत् विधानाम् न सदृशम् ईदृशम् बुद्धि लाघवम्
transliteration: alam vaiklavyam ālambya dhairyam ātmagatam smara
tvat vidhānām na sadṛśam īdṛśam buddhi lāghavam
english: Do not be overwhelmed with grief: summon the fortitude that is in you. Such lightness of sense does not become persons like you.

sanskrit: मया अपि व्यसनम् प्राप्तम् भार्या विरहजम् महत्
न अहम् एवम् हि शोचामि धैर्यम् न च परित्यजे
transliteration: mayā api vyasanam prāptam bhāryā virahajam mahat
na aham evam hi śocāmi dhairyam na ca parityaje
english: I also have experienced mighty disaster arising out of separation from my wife; but I do not weep in this wise,-nor do I forsake my fortitude.

sanskrit: न अहम् ताम् अनुशोचामि प्राकृतो वानरो अपि सन्
महात्मा च विनीतः च किम् पुनर् धृतिमान् महान्
transliteration: na aham tām anuśocāmi prākṛto vānaro api san
mahātmā ca vinītaḥ ca kim punar dhṛtimān mahān
english: A despicable monkey as I am, I do not grieve for her,-and what again shall I say of one that is magnanimous, endued with meekness and firmness, and great?

sanskrit: बाष्पम् आपतितम् धैर्यात् निग्रहीतुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
मर्यादाम् सत्त्व युक्तानाम् धृतिम् न उत्स्रष्टुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: bāṣpam āpatitam dhairyāt nigrahītum tvam arhasi
maryādām sattva yuktānām dhṛtim na utsraṣṭum arhasi
english: It behoveth you to restrain your falling tears by patience. It behoveth you not to resign that patience which is the dignity of persons possessed of the quality of goodness.

sanskrit: व्यसने वा अर्थ कृच्छ्रे वा भये वा जीवितान्तगे
विमृशन् वै स्वया बुद्ध्या धृतिमान् न अवसीदति
transliteration: vyasane vā artha kṛcchre vā bhaye vā jīvitāntage
vimṛśan vai svayā buddhyā dhṛtimān na avasīdati
english: Persons endued with firmness of understanding by help of their intellect, do not in calamity consequent on separation from dear ones, or on the occasion of loss of wealth, or of fear arising from thieves, wild beasts, etc., or of loss of life itself, lose their self-possession.

sanskrit: बालिशस् तु नरो नित्यम् वैक्लब्यम् योऽनुवर्तते
स मज्जति अवशः शोके भार आक्रान्ता इव नौः जले
transliteration: bāliśas tu naro nityam vaiklabyam yo'nuvartate
sa majjati avaśaḥ śoke bhāra ākrāntā iva nauḥ jale
english: He that is senseless as well as he that suffers himself to be overwhelmed with grief, losing all control over self, drown themselves in sorrow like a boat bearing a heavy load in water.

sanskrit: एषो अन्जलिः मया बद्धः प्रणयात् त्वाम् प्रसादये
पौरुषम् श्रय शोकस्य न अन्तरम् दातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: eṣo anjaliḥ mayā baddhaḥ praṇayāt tvām prasādaye
pauruṣam śraya śokasya na antaram dātum arhasi
english: I soothe you from the love I bear towards you. Do you have recourse to manliness. It does not behove you to let grief overcome you.

sanskrit: ये शोकम् अनुवर्तन्ते न तेषाम् विद्यते सुखम्
तेजः च क्षीयते तेषाम् न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: ye śokam anuvartante na teṣām vidyate sukham
tejaḥ ca kṣīyate teṣām na tvam śocitum arhasi
english: Those that indulge in sorrow, know no happiness; and their virtue* goeth out of them. Therefore it behoveth you not to grieve. In the sense of energy.

sanskrit: शोकेन अभिप्रपन्नस्य जीविते च अपि संशयः
स शोकम् त्यज राजेन्द्र धैर्यम् आश्रय केवलम्
transliteration: śokena abhiprapannasya jīvite ca api saṃśayaḥ
sa śokam tyaja rājendra dhairyam āśraya kevalam
english: The life even of him that is mastered by sorrow is in jeopardy. Therefore, you foremost of monarchs, leave off that grief. Do you entirely have recourse to fortitude.

sanskrit: हितम् वयस्य भावेन ब्रूमि न उपदिशामि ते
वयस्यताम् पूजयन् मे न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: hitam vayasya bhāvena brūmi na upadiśāmi te
vayasyatām pūjayan me na tvam śocitum arhasi
english: In the spirit of a friend I tell what is for your good: I do not instruct you. Honour the amity I bear towards you. It behoveth you not to weep.

sanskrit: मधुरम् सान्त्वितः तेन सुग्रीवेण स राघवः
मुखम् अश्रु परि क्लिन्नम् वस्त्र अन्तेन प्रमार्जयत्
transliteration: madhuram sāntvitaḥ tena sugrīveṇa sa rāghavaḥ
mukham aśru pari klinnam vastra antena pramārjayat
english: Thus sweetly consoled by Sugrīva, Rāghava with the end of his cloth wiped his face tarnished with tears.

sanskrit: प्रकृतिः स्थः तु काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीव वचनात् प्रभुः
transliteration: prakṛtiḥ sthaḥ tu kākutsthaḥ sugrīva vacanāt prabhuḥ
english: And after that lord, Kakutstha, had recovered his natural state through the words of Sugrīva he embraced Sugrīva and addressed him, saying,

sanskrit: कर्तव्यम् यत् वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च
अनुरूपम् च युक्तम् च कृतम् सुग्रीव तत् त्वया
transliteration: kartavyam yat vayasyena snigdhena ca hitena ca
anurūpam ca yuktam ca kṛtam sugrīva tat tvayā
english: O Sugriva, that which, pleasing and profitable, proper and fit, ought to be done by a friend, has been done by you.

sanskrit: एष च प्रकृतिः स्थः अहम् अनुनीतः त्वया सखे
दुर्लभो हि ईदृशो बन्धुः अस्मिन् काले विशेषतः
transliteration: eṣa ca prakṛtiḥ sthaḥ aham anunītaḥ tvayā sakhe
durlabho hi īdṛśo bandhuḥ asmin kāle viśeṣataḥ
english: Solicited by you, I have, O friend, regained my natural tone of mind. Such a friend is rare, specially at such a time.

sanskrit: किम् तु यत्नः त्वया कार्यो मैथिल्याः परिमार्गणे
transliteration: kim tu yatnaḥ tvayā kāryo maithilyāḥ parimārgaṇe
english: But you should strive to trace Maithili as well as bring about the destruction of that fierce Räks asa, the impious Rāvana.

sanskrit: मया च यद् अनुष्ठेयम् विस्रब्धेन तत् उच्यताम्
वर्षासु इव च सुक्षेत्रे सर्वम् संपद्यते तव
transliteration: mayā ca yad anuṣṭheyam visrabdhena tat ucyatām
varṣāsu iva ca sukṣetre sarvam saṃpadyate tava
english: Do you also without reserve say what I shall have to do for you. Like corn sown in a fertile field in the rainy season, every concern of thine shall attain success.

sanskrit: मया च यदिदम् वाक्यम् अभिमानात् समीरितम्
तत् त्वया हरिशार्दूल तत् त्वम् इति उपधार्यताम्
transliteration: mayā ca yadidam vākyam abhimānāt samīritam
tat tvayā hariśārdūla tat tvam iti upadhāryatām
english: O best of monkeys, do you verily consider as true the words that I have uttered through affection.

sanskrit: अनृतम् न उक्त पूर्वम् मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन
एतत् ते प्रतिजानामि सत्येन एव शपामि अहम्
transliteration: anṛtam na ukta pūrvam me na ca vakṣye kadācana
etat te pratijānāmi satyena eva śapāmi aham
english: Falsehoods have I never spoken before, nor will I ever say one (in future). This I promise to you. I swear by truth itself.

sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः वानरैः सचिवैः सह
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ vānaraiḥ sacivaiḥ saha
english: Hearing Rāghava's words, and in special his promise, Sugrīva felt exceedingly delighted along with this monkey ministers.

sanskrit: एवम् एकान्त संपृक्तौ ततः तौ नर वानरौ
उभौ अन्योन्य सदृशम् सुख दुःखम् अभाष्ताम्
transliteration: evam ekānta saṃpṛktau tataḥ tau nara vānarau
ubhau anyonya sadṛśam sukha duḥkham abhāṣtām
english: Thus fast bound in friendship, the man and the monkey conversed with each other about (topics) which each thought fit, connected with their joys and griefs.

sanskrit: महानुभावस्य वचो निशम्यहरिर् नृपाणाम् अधिपस्य तस्य
कृतम् स मेने हरिवीर मुख्यःतदा च कार्यम् हृदयेन विद्वान्
transliteration: mahānubhāvasya vaco niśamyaharir nṛpāṇām adhipasya tasya
kṛtam sa mene harivīra mukhyaḥtadā ca kāryam hṛdayena vidvān
english: Hearing the words of that illustrious monarch of kings, that hero-greatest of monkeys-considered and felt in his heart as if his work had already been accomplished.

sanskrit: परितुष्टः तु सुग्रीवः तेन वाक्येन हर्षितः
लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रजम् शूरम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: parituṣṭaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ tena vākyena harṣitaḥ
lakṣmaṇasya agrajam śūram idam vacanam abravīt
english: Sugrīva, rejoiced at the words of Rāma, said to that hero, the elder brother of Laksmana; who was well pleased.

sanskrit: सर्वथा अहम् अनुग्राह्यो देवतानाम् न संशयः
उपपन्नः गुण उपेतः सखा यस्य भवान् मम
transliteration: sarvathā aham anugrāhyo devatānām na saṃśayaḥ
upapannaḥ guṇa upetaḥ sakhā yasya bhavān mama
english: I am, without doubt, worthy of being favoured by the gods, since you accomplished and furnished with virtues are my friend.

sanskrit: शक्यम् खलु भवेत् राम सहायेन त्वया अनघ
सुर राज्यम् अपि प्राप्तुम् स्व राज्यम् किमुत प्रभो
transliteration: śakyam khalu bhavet rāma sahāyena tvayā anagha
sura rājyam api prāptum sva rājyam kimuta prabho
english: By your help, O Rama, one can, O sinless one, obtain the kingdom of the celestials,-what is to be said of one's kingdom, O lord?

sanskrit: सोऽहम् सभाज्यो बन्धूनाम् सुहृदाम् चैव राघव
यस्य अग्नि साक्षिकम् मित्रम् लब्धम् राघव वंशजम्
transliteration: so'ham sabhājyo bandhūnām suhṛdām caiva rāghava
yasya agni sākṣikam mitram labdham rāghava vaṃśajam
english: I, who have, in the presence of Fire, gained for my friend (you) sprung from the Rāghava race, am, O Rāghava worthy of being honoured by my friends and relations.

sanskrit: अहम् अपि अनुरूपः ते वयस्यो ज्ञास्यसे शनैः
न तु वक्तुम् समर्थोऽहम् त्वयि आत्मगतान् गुणान्
transliteration: aham api anurūpaḥ te vayasyo jñāsyase śanaiḥ
na tu vaktum samartho'ham tvayi ātmagatān guṇān
english: You also shall by and by learn that I am a fit friend for you; but I can not speak to you of the qualities that abide in me.

sanskrit: महात्मनाम् तु भूयिष्ठम् त्वत् विधानाम् कृत आत्मनाम्
निश्चला भवति प्रीतिः धैर्यम् आत्मवताम् वर
transliteration: mahātmanām tu bhūyiṣṭham tvat vidhānām kṛta ātmanām
niścalā bhavati prītiḥ dhairyam ātmavatām vara
english: O free one, the felicity of high-souled and self-governed friends like you abounds and is enduring.

sanskrit: रजतम् वा सुवर्णम् वा शुभानि आभरणानि च
transliteration: rajatam vā suvarṇam vā śubhāni ābharaṇāni ca
english: Pious friends look upon the silver, and gold, and the elegant ornaments of pious friends as common property.

sanskrit: आढ्यो वा अपि दरिद्रो वा दुःखितः सुखितोऽपि वा
निर्दोषः च सदोषः च वयस्यः परमा गतिः
transliteration: āḍhyo vā api daridro vā duḥkhitaḥ sukhito'pi vā
nirdoṣaḥ ca sadoṣaḥ ca vayasyaḥ paramā gatiḥ
english: Whether rich or poor, happy or miserable, good or bad, a friend is the greatest refuge (of his friend).

sanskrit: धन त्यागः सुख त्यागो देश त्यागोऽपि वा अनघः
वयस्यार्थे प्रवर्तन्ते स्नेहम् दृष्ट्वा तथा विधम्
transliteration: dhana tyāgaḥ sukha tyāgo deśa tyāgo'pi vā anaghaḥ
vayasyārthe pravartante sneham dṛṣṭvā tathā vidham
english: Witnessing such affection, people can, O sinless one, forsake wealth, comfort, and even their native land for the sake of their friends.

sanskrit: तत् तथा इति अब्रवीत् रामः सुग्रीवम् प्रिय दर्शनम्
लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रतः लक्ष्म्या वासवस्य इव धीमतः
transliteration: tat tathā iti abravīt rāmaḥ sugrīvam priya darśanam
lakṣmaṇasya agrataḥ lakṣmyā vāsavasya iva dhīmataḥ
english: There at the graceful Rāma, in front of the intelligent Lakşmaņa resembling Väsava, said to Sugriva of a pleasing presence,-It is even so.

sanskrit: ततो रामम् स्थितम् दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणम् च महाबलम्
सुग्रीवः सर्वतः चक्षुः वने लोलम् अपातयत्
transliteration: tato rāmam sthitam dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇam ca mahābalam
sugrīvaḥ sarvataḥ cakṣuḥ vane lolam apātayat
english: The next day seeing Rāma as well as the mighty Lakşmaņa seated on the ground, Sugrīva briskly cast his eyes about the forest.

sanskrit: स ददर्श ततः सालम् अविदूरे हरीश्वरः
सुपुष्पम् ईषत् पत्र आढ्यम् भ्रमरैः उपशोभितम्
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ sālam avidūre harīśvaraḥ
supuṣpam īṣat patra āḍhyam bhramaraiḥ upaśobhitam
english: And hard by that lord of monkeys discovered a Sāla tree, bearing a few beautiful blossoms, with its wealth of foliage, decked by black bees.

sanskrit: तस्य एकाम् पर्ण बहुलाम् शाखाम् भंक्त्वा सुशोभिताम्
रामस्य आस्तीर्य सुग्रीवो निषसाद स राघवः
transliteration: tasya ekām parṇa bahulām śākhām bhaṃktvā suśobhitām
rāmasya āstīrya sugrīvo niṣasāda sa rāghavaḥ
english: There at tearing off a beautiful bough full of leaves, Sugrīva spread it (on the earth), and then sat down with Rāghava.

sanskrit: तौ आसीनौ ततः दृष्ट्वा हनूमान् अपि लक्ष्मणम्
transliteration: tau āsīnau tataḥ dṛṣṭvā hanūmān api lakṣmaṇam
english: Seeing them seated, Hanumān breaking off a branch of śāla, humbly made Lakşmaņa sit down.

sanskrit: सुख उपविष्टम् रामम् तु प्रसन्नम् उदधिम् यथा
साल पुष्पाव संकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवर उत्तमे
transliteration: sukha upaviṣṭam rāmam tu prasannam udadhim yathā
sāla puṣpāva saṃkīrṇe tasmin girivara uttame
english: Seeing Rāma seated at his case in that best of mountains abounding in Sāla flowers, and cheerful like the ocean, Sugrīva from love spoke to Rāma sweet and excellent words, of which the letters vibrated with delight.

sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः श्लक्ष्णया शुभया गिरा
उवाच प्रणयाद् रामम् हर्ष व्याकुलित अक्षरम्
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ ślakṣṇayā śubhayā girā
uvāca praṇayād rāmam harṣa vyākulita akṣaram
english: Seeing Rāma seated at his case in that best of mountains abounding in Sāla flowers, and cheerful like the ocean, Sugrīva from love spoke to Rāma sweet and excellent words, of which the letters vibrated with delight.

sanskrit: अहम् विनिकृतो भ्रात्रा चरामि एष भयार्दितः
ऋष्यमूकम् गिरि वरम् हृत भार्यः सुदुःखितः
transliteration: aham vinikṛto bhrātrā carāmi eṣa bhayārditaḥ
ṛṣyamūkam giri varam hṛta bhāryaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ
english: Wronged by my brother, I deprived of my wife and exceedingly distressed, and exercised with fear, live in this foremost of mountains, Rs yamuka.

sanskrit: सोऽहम् त्रस्तः भये मग्नः वने संब्रान्त चेतनः
वालिना निकृतः भ्रात्रा कृत वैरः च राघव
transliteration: so'ham trastaḥ bhaye magnaḥ vane saṃbrānta cetanaḥ
vālinā nikṛtaḥ bhrātrā kṛta vairaḥ ca rāghava
english: O Rāghava, my senses wildered, having been oppressed by Vāli, and having incurred his enmity, I am afflicted with fear, and tormented with fright.

sanskrit: वालिनः मे भय आर्तस्य सर्वलोक अभयंकर
मम अपि त्वम् अनाथस्य प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: vālinaḥ me bhaya ārtasya sarvaloka abhayaṃkara
mama api tvam anāthasya prasādam kartum arhasi
english: O you, that remove the fear of all creatures, it behove you who am tormented by fear and am helpless, to extend your favour to me.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्म वत्सलः
प्रत्युवाच स काकुत्स्थः सुग्रीवम् प्रहसन् इव
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu tejasvī dharmajño dharma vatsalaḥ
pratyuvāca sa kākutsthaḥ sugrīvam prahasan iva
english: Thus accosted, that ever energetic one knowing righteousness and devoted to it, Kākutstha, smiling, said to Sugrīva,

sanskrit: उपकार फलम् मित्रम् अपकारो अरि लक्षणम्
अद्य एव तम् वधिष्यामि तव भार्या अपहारिणम्
transliteration: upakāra phalam mitram apakāro ari lakṣaṇam
adya eva tam vadhiṣyāmi tava bhāryā apahāriṇam
english: Benefits make friends, while injuries denote enemies. Even this very day will I slay him that has deprived you of your wife.

sanskrit: इमे हि मे महाभाग पत्रिणः तिग्म तेजसः
कार्तिकेय वन उद्भूताः शरा हेम विभूषिताः
transliteration: ime hi me mahābhāga patriṇaḥ tigma tejasaḥ
kārtikeya vana udbhūtāḥ śarā hema vibhūṣitāḥ
english: O exalted one, these feathered shafts of exceeding energy, sprung from the Kārtikeya forest, decked with gold, furnished with the plumes of the Kanka, resembling the thunderbolt of the great Indra, having smooth knots, and sharp heads, are like enraged serpents.

sanskrit: कन्क पत्र परिच्छन्ना महेन्द्र अशनि सन्निभाः
सुपर्वाणः सुतीक्ष्ण अग्रा सरोषा भुजगा इव
transliteration: kanka patra paricchannā mahendra aśani sannibhāḥ
suparvāṇaḥ sutīkṣṇa agrā saroṣā bhujagā iva
english: O exalted one, these feathered shafts of exceeding energy, sprung from the Kārtikeya forest, decked with gold, furnished with the plumes of the Kanka, resembling the thunderbolt of the great Indra, having smooth knots, and sharp heads, are like enraged serpents.

sanskrit: वालि सज्ञम् अमित्रम् ते भ्रातरम् कृत किल्बिषम्
शरैः विनिहतम् पश्य विकीर्णम् इव पर्वतम्
transliteration: vāli sajñam amitram te bhrātaram kṛta kilbiṣam
śaraiḥ vinihatam paśya vikīrṇam iva parvatam
english: You shall behold your brother and enemy, who is named Vāli slain by my shafts, and lying like a dislodged hill.

sanskrit: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनी पतिः
प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे साधु साध्विति च अब्रवीत्
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā sugrīvo vāhinī patiḥ
praharṣam atulam lebhe sādhu sādhviti ca abravīt
english: Hearing Rāghava's words, Sugrīva-lord of host-felt excess of joy and exclaimed, Excellent well! Excellent well!

sanskrit: राम शोक अभिभूतो अहम् शोक आर्तानाम् भवान् गतिः
वयस्य इति कृत्वा हि त्वयि अहम् परिदेवये
transliteration: rāma śoka abhibhūto aham śoka ārtānām bhavān gatiḥ
vayasya iti kṛtvā hi tvayi aham paridevaye
english: O Rāma, overwhelmed am I by grief. You are the succour of those afflicted with sorrow. Having made you my friend, I express to you my grief.

sanskrit: त्वम् हि पाणि प्रदानेन वयस्यो मे अग्नि साक्षिकम्
कृतः प्राणैः बहुमतः सत्येन च शपामि अहम्
transliteration: tvam hi pāṇi pradānena vayasyo me agni sākṣikam
kṛtaḥ prāṇaiḥ bahumataḥ satyena ca śapāmi aham
english: I have, in the presence of Fire by giving you my hand, made you my friend. You are dearer to me than life itself. This I swear to you by Truth.

sanskrit: वयस्य इति कृत्वा च विस्रब्धः प्रवदामि अहम्
दुःखम् अन्तर्गतम् तन् मे मनो हरति नित्यशः
transliteration: vayasya iti kṛtvā ca visrabdhaḥ pravadāmi aham
duḥkham antargatam tan me mano harati nityaśaḥ
english: Having made you my friend, I inspired with confidence am unbosoming myself to you. The sorrow, that is in my heart, is constantly enfeebling my mind.

sanskrit: एतावत् उक्त्वा वचनम् बाष्प दूषित लोचनः
बाष्प दूषितया वाचा न उच्चैः श्क्नोति भाषितुम्
transliteration: etāvat uktvā vacanam bāṣpa dūṣita locanaḥ
bāṣpa dūṣitayā vācā na uccaiḥ śknoti bhāṣitum
english: Having proceeded thus far, he, his eyes filled with tears and his words faltering because of vapour, could not speak aloud.

sanskrit: बाष्प वेगम् तु सहसा नदी वेगम् इव आगतम्
transliteration: bāṣpa vegam tu sahasā nadī vegam iva āgatam
english: Sugrīva suddenly restrained, before Rāma, the force of tears, like to the tide of a river.

sanskrit: स निगृह्य तु तम् बाष्पम् प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे
transliteration: sa nigṛhya tu tam bāṣpam pramṛjya nayane śubhe
english: Having restrained his tears and wiped his fair eyes, that energetic one, sighing heavily, again went on,

sanskrit: पुरा अहम् वलिना राम राज्यात् स्वात् अवरोपितः
परुषाणि च संश्राव्य निर्धूतो अस्मि बलीयसा
transliteration: purā aham valinā rāma rājyāt svāt avaropitaḥ
paruṣāṇi ca saṃśrāvya nirdhūto asmi balīyasā
english: Formerly, O Rāma, I was deprived of my kingdom and reproached in harsh language by the strong Vāli.

sanskrit: हृता भार्या च मे तेन प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसी
सुहृदः च मदीया ये संयता बन्धनेषु ते
transliteration: hṛtā bhāryā ca me tena prāṇebhyo api garīyasī
suhṛdaḥ ca madīyā ye saṃyatā bandhaneṣu te
english: He also took away my wife dearer to me than life; and my friends have been imprisoned and been bound.

sanskrit: यत्नवान् च स दुष्टात्मा मद् विनाशाय राघव
बहुशः तत् प्रयुक्ताः च वानरा निहता मया
transliteration: yatnavān ca sa duṣṭātmā mad vināśāya rāghava
bahuśaḥ tat prayuktāḥ ca vānarā nihatā mayā
english: That wicked wight, O Rāghava, seeks my life. Many monkeys commissioned by him have been slain by me.

sanskrit: शंकया एतया अहम् च दृष्ट्वा त्वाम् अपि राघव
न उपसर्पामि अहम् भीतो भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति
transliteration: śaṃkayā etayā aham ca dṛṣṭvā tvām api rāghava
na upasarpāmi aham bhīto bhaye sarve hi bibhyati
english: It was, O Rāghava, in consequence of this fear that when I (first) saw you, I did not come out. This is all the fear that oppresses me.

sanskrit: केवलम् हि सहाया मे हनुमत् प्रमुखास्त्विमे
अतः अहम् धारयामि अद्य प्राणान् कृच्छ्र गतः अपि सन्
transliteration: kevalam hi sahāyā me hanumat pramukhāstvime
ataḥ aham dhārayāmi adya prāṇān kṛcchra gataḥ api san
english: My adherents are only these headed by Hanumān. It is for this that although reduced to the greatest straits I have been able to preserve my life.

sanskrit: एते हि कपयः स्निग्धा माम् रक्षन्ति समन्ततः
सह गच्छन्ति गन्तव्ये नित्यम् तिष्ठन्ति च स्थिते
transliteration: ete hi kapayaḥ snigdhā mām rakṣanti samantataḥ
saha gacchanti gantavye nityam tiṣṭhanti ca sthite
english: These affectionate apes protect me on all sides. They go when I go, and stay when I stay.

sanskrit: संक्षेपः ते एष मे राम किम् उक्त्वा विस्तरम् हि ते
स मे ज्येष्ठो रिपुः भ्राता वाली विश्रुत पौरुषः
transliteration: saṃkṣepaḥ te eṣa me rāma kim uktvā vistaram hi te
sa me jyeṣṭho ripuḥ bhrātā vālī viśruta pauruṣaḥ
english: Why should I expatiate? In brief, Vāli my elder brother, famed for his prowess, is my foe.

sanskrit: तद् विनाशे अपि मे दुःखम् प्रमृष्टम् स्यात् अनन्तरम्
सुखम् मे जीवितम् चैव तद् विनाश निबन्धनम्
transliteration: tad vināśe api me duḥkham pramṛṣṭam syāt anantaram
sukham me jīvitam caiva tad vināśa nibandhanam
english: Even by his death my present pain would be removed. Both my life and my happiness are bound up with his death.

sanskrit: एष मे राम शोकान्तः शोक आर्तेन निवेदितः
दुःखितः सुखितः वा अपि सख्युः नित्यम् सखा गतिः
transliteration: eṣa me rāma śokāntaḥ śoka ārtena niveditaḥ
duḥkhitaḥ sukhitaḥ vā api sakhyuḥ nityam sakhā gatiḥ
english: I have, O Rāma, communicated to you, the way in which my grief might be removed. Whether in joy or in sorrow, a friend is the refuge of his friend.

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा एतत् च वचः रामः सुग्रीवम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
किम् निमित्तम् अभूत् वैरम् श्रोतुम् इच्छामि तत्त्वतः
transliteration: śrutvā etat ca vacaḥ rāmaḥ sugrīvam idam abravīt
kim nimittam abhūt vairam śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ
english: Hearing these words, Rāma said to Sugrīva, What for arose hostility between yourself and Vāli? I wish to hear this (related) faithfully.

sanskrit: सुखम् हि कारणम् श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर
transliteration: sukham hi kāraṇam śrutvā vairasya tava vānara
english: Having learnt the cause of your hostility, and ascertained your strength and weakness, I will, O monkey, understanding the irritation that has ensued, compass your happiness.

sanskrit: बलवान् हि मम अमर्षः श्रुत्वा त्वाम् अवमानितम्
वर्धते हृदय उत्कम्पी प्रावृड् वेग इव अंभसः
transliteration: balavān hi mama amarṣaḥ śrutvā tvām avamānitam
vardhate hṛdaya utkampī prāvṛḍ vega iva aṃbhasaḥ
english: Great is my wrath, on hearing you disgraced; and like a down-pour in the rainy season my ire increases, shaking my very heart.

sanskrit: हृष्टः कथय विस्रब्धो यावत् आरोप्यते धनुः
सृष्टः च हि मया बाणो निरस्तः च रिपुः तव
transliteration: hṛṣṭaḥ kathaya visrabdho yāvat āropyate dhanuḥ
sṛṣṭaḥ ca hi mayā bāṇo nirastaḥ ca ripuḥ tava
english: Do you cheerfully and confidingly speak while I fix the string to my bow. As soon as my shaft is off, your foe is beaten.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना
प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे चतुर्भिः सह वानरैः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvaḥ kākutsthena mahātmanā
praharṣam atulam lebhe caturbhiḥ saha vānaraiḥ

sanskrit: वाली नाम मम भ्राता ज्येष्ठः शत्रु निषूदनः
पितुः बहुमतः नित्यम् मम च अपि तथा पुरा
transliteration: vālī nāma mama bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ śatru niṣūdanaḥ
pituḥ bahumataḥ nityam mama ca api tathā purā
english: My elder brother named Väli-destroyer of foes, was formerly highly, honoured both by my father and myself.

sanskrit: पितरि उपरते तस्मिन् ज्येष्ठो अयम् इति मंत्रिभिः
कपीनाम् ईश्वरो राज्ये कृतः परम सम्मतः
transliteration: pitari uparate tasmin jyeṣṭho ayam iti maṃtribhiḥ
kapīnām īśvaro rājye kṛtaḥ parama sammataḥ
english: At the death of our father, the counsellors, saying,-This is the eldest son', made him, who was well loved (of all), lord of the monkeys in the kingdom.

sanskrit: राज्यम् प्रशासतः तस्य पितृ पैतामहम् महत्
अहम् सर्वेषु कालेषु प्रणतः प्रेष्यवत् स्थितः
transliteration: rājyam praśāsataḥ tasya pitṛ paitāmaham mahat
aham sarveṣu kāleṣu praṇataḥ preṣyavat sthitaḥ
english: While he was governing the kingdom which had belonged to his father and grand-father, I, at all times, in humiliation, remained like a servant.

sanskrit: मायावी नाम तेजस्वी पूर्वजो दुन्दुभेः सुतः
तेन तस्य महद् वैरम् वालिनः स्त्री कृतम् पुरा
transliteration: māyāvī nāma tejasvī pūrvajo dundubheḥ sutaḥ
tena tasya mahad vairam vālinaḥ strī kṛtam purā
english: There was one endued with energy, named Māyāvi. He was the eldest son of Dunduvī. Formerly there arose a mighty hostility between himself and Vali.

sanskrit: स तु सुप्ते जने रात्रौ किष्किन्धा द्वारम् आगतः
नर्दति स्म सुसम्रब्धो वालिनम् च आह्वयत् रणे
transliteration: sa tu supte jane rātrau kiṣkindhā dvāram āgataḥ
nardati sma susamrabdho vālinam ca āhvayat raṇe
english: It came to pass that one night when all had fallen asleep, (Māyāvi) coming to Kişkindhā, began to emit roars in great wrath, and challenged Väli to an encounter.

sanskrit: प्रसुप्तः तु मम भ्राता नर्दितो भैरव स्वनम्
श्रुत्वा न ममृषे वाली निष्पपात जवात् तदा
transliteration: prasuptaḥ tu mama bhrātā nardito bhairava svanam
śrutvā na mamṛṣe vālī niṣpapāta javāt tadā
english: My brother, who was fast asleep, hearing those dreadful yells, could not bear them; but at once rushed out vehemently.

sanskrit: स तु वै निःसृतः क्रोधात् तम् हन्तुम् असुरोत्तमम्
वार्यमाणः ततः स्त्रीभिः मया च प्रणत आत्मना
transliteration: sa tu vai niḥsṛtaḥ krodhāt tam hantum asurottamam
vāryamāṇaḥ tataḥ strībhiḥ mayā ca praṇata ātmanā
english: And as he rushed out in wrath, for the purpose of slaying that foremost of Asuras, he was opposed by his wives as well as myself, who humbled himself before him.

sanskrit: स तु निर्धूय सर्वान् नो निर्जगाम महाबलः
ततः अहम् अपि सौहार्दान् निःसृतः वालिना सह
transliteration: sa tu nirdhūya sarvān no nirjagāma mahābalaḥ
tataḥ aham api sauhārdān niḥsṛtaḥ vālinā saha
english: But moving them aside, that exceedingly powerful one sallied out. Thereupon out of affection I also went out with Vāli.

sanskrit: स तु मे भ्रातरम् दृष्ट्वा माम् च दूरात् अवस्थितम्
असुरो जात संत्रासः प्रदुद्राव तदा भृशम्
transliteration: sa tu me bhrātaram dṛṣṭvā mām ca dūrāt avasthitam
asuro jāta saṃtrāsaḥ pradudrāva tadā bhṛśam
english: And seeing my brother and me present from a distance, the Asura, seized with a panic, fled with speed.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् द्रवति संत्रस्ते हि आवाम् द्रुततरम् गतौ
प्रकाशः अपि कृतः मार्गः चन्द्रेण उद्गच्छता तदा
transliteration: tasmin dravati saṃtraste hi āvām drutataram gatau
prakāśaḥ api kṛtaḥ mārgaḥ candreṇa udgacchatā tadā
english: And as he was rushing on in fear and when we had proceeded further, the moon arising, discovered the way.

sanskrit: स तृणैः आवृतम् दुर्गम् धरण्या विवरम् महत्
प्रविवेश असुरः वेगात् आवाम् आसाद्य विष्ठितौ
transliteration: sa tṛṇaiḥ āvṛtam durgam dharaṇyā vivaram mahat
praviveśa asuraḥ vegāt āvām āsādya viṣṭhitau
english: And the Asura, coming by a capacious and impregnable hole covered with grass (on the surface), entered it amain; and we remained there.

sanskrit: तम् प्रविष्टम् रिपुम् दृष्ट्वा बिलम् रोष वशम् गतः
माम् उवाच ततो वाली वचनम् क्षुभित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: tam praviṣṭam ripum dṛṣṭvā bilam roṣa vaśam gataḥ
mām uvāca tato vālī vacanam kṣubhita indriyaḥ
english: Seeing his enemy enter the hole, Vāli, overcome by anger, and with his senses agitated, spoke to me, saying,

sanskrit: इह तिष्ठ अद्य सुग्रीव बिल द्वारि समाहितः
यावत् अत्र प्रविश्य अहम् निहन्मि समरे रिपुम्
transliteration: iha tiṣṭha adya sugrīva bila dvāri samāhitaḥ
yāvat atra praviśya aham nihanmi samare ripum
english: Do you, O Sugriva, carefully stay at the mouth of the hole, while I entering in, slay my foe in battle.

sanskrit: मया तु एतत् वचः श्रुत्वा याचितः स परंतपः
शापयित्वा च माम् पद्भ्याम् प्रविवेश बिलम् ततः
transliteration: mayā tu etat vacaḥ śrutvā yācitaḥ sa paraṃtapaḥ
śāpayitvā ca mām padbhyām praviveśa bilam tataḥ
english: Hearing his speech, that subduer of foes was besought by me (for permission to enter the cave along with him). But making me swear by touching his feet he entered the cave.

sanskrit: तस्य प्रविष्टस्य बिलम् साग्रः संवत्सरः गतः
स्थितस्य च बिल द्वारि सः कालः व्यत्यवर्तत
transliteration: tasya praviṣṭasya bilam sāgraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ gataḥ
sthitasya ca bila dvāri saḥ kālaḥ vyatyavartata
english: After he had entered the cave, and as I remained at its mouth, a space of over a complete year rolled away.

sanskrit: अहम् तु नष्टम् तम् ज्ञात्वा स्नेहात् आगत संभ्रमः
भ्रातरम् न प्रपश्यामि पाप शङ्कि च मे मनः
transliteration: aham tu naṣṭam tam jñātvā snehāt āgata saṃbhramaḥ
bhrātaram na prapaśyāmi pāpa śaṅki ca me manaḥ
english: And seized with sorrow (I reflected), 'As I do not see my brother, he must be lost—and my mind was alarmed, apprehending his death.

sanskrit: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य बिलात् तस्मात् विनिःसृतम्
सः फेनम् रुधिरम् दृष्ट्वा ततो अहम् भृशदुःखितः
transliteration: atha dīrghasya kālasya bilāt tasmāt viniḥsṛtam
saḥ phenam rudhiram dṛṣṭvā tato aham bhṛśaduḥkhitaḥ
english: After a long time, I saw frothy blood issuing from the cave. There at I was greatly aggrieved.

sanskrit: नर्दताम् असुराणाम् च ध्वनिः मे श्रोत्रम् आगतः
न रस्तस्य च संग्रामे क्रोशतो अपि स्वनो गुरोः
transliteration: nardatām asurāṇām ca dhvaniḥ me śrotram āgataḥ
na rastasya ca saṃgrāme krośato api svano guroḥ
english: And roars of Asuras also reached my ears; but I could not hear the cries of my superior, engaged in conflict.

sanskrit: अहम् तु अवगतः बुद्ध्या चिह्नैः तैः भ्रातरम् हतम्
पिधाय च बिल द्वारम् शिलया गिरि मात्रया
transliteration: aham tu avagataḥ buddhyā cihnaiḥ taiḥ bhrātaram hatam
pidhāya ca bila dvāram śilayā giri mātrayā

sanskrit: शोकार्तः च उदकम् कृत्वा किष्किन्धाम् आगतः सखे
गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वम् यत्नतः मंत्रिभिः श्रुतम्
transliteration: śokārtaḥ ca udakam kṛtvā kiṣkindhām āgataḥ sakhe
gūhamānasya me tattvam yatnataḥ maṃtribhiḥ śrutam
english: And from these signs concluding my brother to be slain, I, closing the mouth of the cavern with a crag, huge as a hill, and afflicted with grief, after performing his watery rites, came (back) to Kiskindha, O my friend. And although I carefully concealed (the matter), the counsellors heard it all.

sanskrit: ततः अहम् तैः समागम्य समेतैः अभिषेचितः
राज्यम् प्रशासतः तस्य न्यायतो मम राघव
transliteration: tataḥ aham taiḥ samāgamya sametaiḥ abhiṣecitaḥ
rājyam praśāsataḥ tasya nyāyato mama rāghava

sanskrit: आजगाम रिपुम् हत्वा दानवम् स तु वानरः
अभिषिक्तम् तु माम् दृष्ट्वा कोपात् संरक्त लोचनः
transliteration: ājagāma ripum hatvā dānavam sa tu vānaraḥ
abhiṣiktam tu mām dṛṣṭvā kopāt saṃrakta locanaḥ

sanskrit: मदीयान् मंत्रिणः बद्ध्वा परुषम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
निग्रहे च समर्थस्य तम् पापम् प्रति राघव
transliteration: madīyān maṃtriṇaḥ baddhvā paruṣam vākyam abravīt
nigrahe ca samarthasya tam pāpam prati rāghava

sanskrit: न प्रावर्तत मे बुद्धिः भ्रातृ गौरव यंत्रिता
हत्वा शत्रुम् सः मे भ्राता प्रविवेश पुरम् तदा
transliteration: na prāvartata me buddhiḥ bhrātṛ gaurava yaṃtritā
hatvā śatrum saḥ me bhrātā praviveśa puram tadā

sanskrit: मानयन् तम् महात्मानम् यथावत् च अभिअवादयम्
उक्ताः च न आशिषः तेन संतुष्टेन अन्तरात्मना
transliteration: mānayan tam mahātmānam yathāvat ca abhiavādayam
uktāḥ ca na āśiṣaḥ tena saṃtuṣṭena antarātmanā
english: Having slain his foe, he then entered his city; and I, honouring that high-souled one, duly saluted him. He withal did not with a glad heart utter his benediction.

sanskrit: नत्वा पादौ अहम् तस्य मुकुटेन अस्पृशम् प्रभो
अपि वाली मम क्रोधात् न प्रसादम् चकार सः
transliteration: natvā pādau aham tasya mukuṭena aspṛśam prabho
api vālī mama krodhāt na prasādam cakāra saḥ
english: And, O lord, I, bowing, touched his feet with my crown; yet from anger Vāli did not extend to me his grace.

sanskrit: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे नवमः सर्गः
transliteration: iti vālmīki rāmāyaṇe ādi kāvye kiṣkindha kāṇḍe navamaḥ sargaḥ

sanskrit: ततः क्रोध समाविष्टम् सम्रब्धम् तम् उपागतम्
अहम् प्रसादयान् चक्रे भ्रातरम् हित काम्यया
transliteration: tataḥ krodha samāviṣṭam samrabdham tam upāgatam
aham prasādayān cakre bhrātaram hita kāmyayā
english: Then wishing for my welfare I strove to propitiate my angry brother, wrought up with wrath, who was seated (there).

sanskrit: दिष्ट्या असि कुशली प्राप्तो निहतः च त्वया रिपुः
अनाथस्य हि मे नाथः त्वम् एको अनाथ नन्दनः
transliteration: diṣṭyā asi kuśalī prāpto nihataḥ ca tvayā ripuḥ
anāthasya hi me nāthaḥ tvam eko anātha nandanaḥ
english: By good luck it is that you had come off safely; and that you had slain the foe. O you that rejoicest the forlorn, you are the only protector of me who am helpless.

sanskrit: इदम् बहु शलाकम् ते पूर्ण चन्द्रम् इव उदितम्
छत्रम् स वाल व्यजनम् प्रतीच्छस्व मया धृतम्
transliteration: idam bahu śalākam te pūrṇa candram iva uditam
chatram sa vāla vyajanam pratīcchasva mayā dhṛtam
english: I hold this. umbrella furnished with many ribs, resembling the moon risen; as well as this chowrī containing hair,—do you accept my service.

sanskrit: आर्तस्य अथ बिला द्वारि स्थितः संवत्सरम् नृप
दृष्ट्वा च शोणितम् द्वारि बिलात् च अपि समुत्थितम्
transliteration: ārtasya atha bilā dvāri sthitaḥ saṃvatsaram nṛpa
dṛṣṭvā ca śoṇitam dvāri bilāt ca api samutthitam
english: O king, suffering greatly, I remained for a whole year at the mouth of the cave. And seeing blood issuing from the cave, I had my heart agitated with grief and my senses extremely overwhelmed.

sanskrit: शोक संविग्न हृदयो भृशम् व्याकुलित इन्द्रियः
अपिधाय बिल द्वारम् शैल शृङ्गेण तत् तदा
transliteration: śoka saṃvigna hṛdayo bhṛśam vyākulita indriyaḥ
apidhāya bila dvāram śaila śṛṅgeṇa tat tadā

sanskrit: तस्मात् देशात् अपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धाम् प्राविशम् पुनः
विषादात् इह माम् दृष्ट्वा पोउरैः मंत्रिभिर् एव च
transliteration: tasmāt deśāt apākramya kiṣkindhām prāviśam punaḥ
viṣādāt iha mām dṛṣṭvā pouraiḥ maṃtribhir eva ca

sanskrit: अभिषिक्तो न कामेन तन्मे क्षन्तुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
त्वम् एव राजा मानार्हः सदा च अहम् यथा पुरा
transliteration: abhiṣikto na kāmena tanme kṣantum tvam arhasi
tvam eva rājā mānārhaḥ sadā ca aham yathā purā

sanskrit: राजभावे नियोगः अयम् मम त्वत् विरहात् कृतः
स अमात्य पौर नगरम् स्थितम् निहत कण्टकम्
transliteration: rājabhāve niyogaḥ ayam mama tvat virahāt kṛtaḥ
sa amātya paura nagaram sthitam nihata kaṇṭakam
english: You are the king, O worthy of honour; and I am, as before, ever (your servant). I was entrusted with regal power in consequence of your absence. This kingdom consisting of courtiers and citizens, remains now rid of its thorns. It was established in me as a trust. And I protected it as such.

sanskrit: न्यास भूतम् इदम् राज्यम् तव निर्यातयामि अहम्
मा च रोषम् कृथाः सौम्य मम शत्रु निषूदन
transliteration: nyāsa bhūtam idam rājyam tava niryātayāmi aham
mā ca roṣam kṛthāḥ saumya mama śatru niṣūdana

sanskrit: याचे त्वाम् शिरसा राजन् मया बद्धो अयम् अंजलिः
