अपतत् देव राजस्य मुक्त रश्मिर् इव ध्वजः
transliteration: sa bhūmau nyasta sarvāṃgaḥ tapta kāṃcana bhūṣaṇaḥ
apatat deva rājasya mukta raśmir iva dhvajaḥ
english: Ornamented with burning gold, he stretched the whole length of his person on the ground like to the banner of the Lord of celestials, loosened and thrown (off the chariot).

sanskrit: अस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ हरि ऋषाणाम् गणेश्वरे
नष्ट चन्द्रम् इव व्योम न व्यराजत मेदिनी
transliteration: asmin nipatite bhūmau hari ṛṣāṇām gaṇeśvare
naṣṭa candram iva vyoma na vyarājata medinī
english: That lord of monkeys being levelled to the ground, his kingdom appeared like to the sky, shorn of the Moon.

sanskrit: भूमौ निपतितस्य अपि तस्य देहम् महात्मनः
न श्रीर् जहाति न प्राणा न तेजो न पराक्रमः
transliteration: bhūmau nipatitasya api tasya deham mahātmanaḥ
na śrīr jahāti na prāṇā na tejo na parākramaḥ
english: Though struck down to the earth, neither vitality, effulgence nor prowess did renounce the body of that high-souled one.

sanskrit: शक्र दत्ता वरा माला कान्चनी रत्न भूषिता
दधार हरि मुख्यस्य प्राणान् तेजः श्रियम् च सा
transliteration: śakra dattā varā mālā kāncanī ratna bhūṣitā
dadhāra hari mukhyasya prāṇān tejaḥ śriyam ca sā
english: That excellent gold and jewel-crested garland conferred on him by Sakra maintained the vitality, effulgence and prowess of that lord of monkeys.

sanskrit: स तया मालया वीरो हैमया हरियूथपः
transliteration: sa tayā mālayā vīro haimayā hariyūthapaḥ
english: Being adorned with that golden garland, that heroic lord, of monkey-herds, appeared like to an evening cloud.

sanskrit: तस्य माला च देहः च मर्मघाती च यः शरः
त्रिधा इव रचिता लक्ष्मीः पतितस्य अपि शोभते
transliteration: tasya mālā ca dehaḥ ca marmaghātī ca yaḥ śaraḥ
tridhā iva racitā lakṣmīḥ patitasya api śobhate
english: Though felled to the ground, his beauty appeared as if divided into three, namely, his garland, his body and the shaft piercing his heart.

sanskrit: तत् अस्त्रम् तस्य वीरस्य स्वर्ग मार्ग प्रभावनम्
राम बाणासन क्षिप्तम् आवहत् परमाम् गतिम्
transliteration: tat astram tasya vīrasya svarga mārga prabhāvanam
rāma bāṇāsana kṣiptam āvahat paramām gatim
english: The arrow thrown off Răma's bow pointing out to him the way to the celestial region, became an excellent means to that hero.

sanskrit: तम् तथा पतितम् संख्ये गत अर्चिषम् इव अनलम्
ययातिम् इव पुण्यान्ते देव लोकात् परिच्युतम्
transliteration: tam tathā patitam saṃkhye gata arciṣam iva analam
yayātim iva puṇyānte deva lokāt paricyutam

sanskrit: आदित्यम् इव कालेन युगान्ते भुवि पातितम्
महेन्द्रम् इव दुर्धर्षम् उपेन्द्रम् इव दुस्सहम्
transliteration: ādityam iva kālena yugānte bhuvi pātitam
mahendram iva durdharṣam upendram iva dussaham

sanskrit: महेन्द्र पुत्रम् पतितम् वालिनम् हेम मालिनम्
व्यूढ उरस्कम् महाबाहुम् दीप्तास्यम् हरि लोचनम्
transliteration: mahendra putram patitam vālinam hema mālinam
vyūḍha uraskam mahābāhum dīptāsyam hari locanam

sanskrit: लक्ष्मण अनुचरो रामो ददर्श उपससर्प च
तम् तथा पतितम् वीरम् गत अर्चिष्मतम् इव अनलम्
transliteration: lakṣmaṇa anucaro rāmo dadarśa upasasarpa ca
tam tathā patitam vīram gata arciṣmatam iva analam

sanskrit: बहुमान्य च तम् वीरम् वीक्षमाणम् शनैरिव
transliteration: bahumānya ca tam vīram vīkṣamāṇam śanairiva

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा राघवम् वाली लक्ष्मणम् च महाबलम्
अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् प्रश्रितम् धर्म संहितम्
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā rāghavam vālī lakṣmaṇam ca mahābalam
abravīt paruṣam vākyam praśritam dharma saṃhitam
english: And beholding that highly powerful Rāghava and Laksmana, Vāli addressed them with the following bold and pious words.

sanskrit: स भूमौ अल्पतेजोसुः निहतो नष्ट चेतनः
अर्थ सहितया वाचा गर्वितम् रण गर्वितम्
transliteration: sa bhūmau alpatejosuḥ nihato naṣṭa cetanaḥ
artha sahitayā vācā garvitam raṇa garvitam
english: And thereupon Vāli, of mitigated prowess, waning vitality, motionless and stretched on the ground, spoke to Rāma, proud of warfare, saying these pregnant words.

sanskrit: त्वम् नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रथितः प्रिय दर्शनः
पराङ्मुख वधम् कृत्वा को अत्र प्राप्तः त्वया गुणः
यदहम् युद्ध सम्रब्धः त्वत् कृते निधनम् गतः
transliteration: tvam narādhipateḥ putraḥ prathitaḥ priya darśanaḥ
parāṅmukha vadham kṛtvā ko atra prāptaḥ tvayā guṇaḥ
yadaham yuddha samrabdhaḥ tvat kṛte nidhanam gataḥ
english: What merit have you reaped by destroying me, who was not engaged in fight with you? I was exercised with ire, being engaged in conflict (with another person) and for you I have met with destruction.

sanskrit: रामः करुणवेदी च प्रजानाम् च हितेरतः
transliteration: rāmaḥ karuṇavedī ca prajānām ca hiterataḥ
english: People speak highly of you, O Rāma, on this earth, describing you as coming of a high family, gifted with manliness and prowess, ever engaged in the welfare of your subjects, compassionate, energetic, of firm resolution and knowing time.

sanskrit: इति एतत् सर्व भूतानि कथयन्ति यशो भुवि
transliteration: iti etat sarva bhūtāni kathayanti yaśo bhuvi
english: People speak highly of you, O Rāma, on this earth, describing you as coming of a high family, gifted with manliness and prowess, ever engaged in the welfare of your subjects, compassionate, energetic, of firm resolution and knowing time.

sanskrit: दमः शमः क्षमा धर्मो धृति सत्यम् पराक्रमः
पर्थिवानाम् गुणा राजन् दण्डः च अपकारिषु
transliteration: damaḥ śamaḥ kṣamā dharmo dhṛti satyam parākramaḥ
parthivānām guṇā rājan daṇḍaḥ ca apakāriṣu
english: Punishment, control of passions, forgiveness, piety, firmness, truth, prowess and suppression of the wicked-these all are the royal virtues.

sanskrit: तान् गुणान् संप्रधार्य अहम् अग्र्यम् च अभिजनम् तव
transliteration: tān guṇān saṃpradhārya aham agryam ca abhijanam tava
english: And knowing your high pedigree, and all these your accomplishments I approached Sugrīva with a hostile intention, albeit prevented by Tārā.

sanskrit: न माम् अन्येन संरब्धम् प्रमत्तम् वेद्धुम् अर्हसि
इति मे बुद्धिर् उत्पन्ना बभूव अदर्शने तव
transliteration: na mām anyena saṃrabdham pramattam veddhum arhasi
iti me buddhir utpannā babhūva adarśane tava
english: Before I saw you I had thought within myself:-'Forsooth Rāma shall not destroy me, engaged as I am with another person and hence not prepared to fight with him.'

sanskrit: न त्वाम् विनिहत आत्मानम् धर्म ध्वजम् अधार्मिकम्
जाने पाप समाचारम् तृणैः कूपम् इव आवृतम्
transliteration: na tvām vinihata ātmānam dharma dhvajam adhārmikam
jāne pāpa samācāram tṛṇaiḥ kūpam iva āvṛtam
english: I do now know you as one who has spoliated his soul through impious actions, feigning religion while in truth an irreligious person, resorting to all vicious deeds, like to a well crusted with grass, unrighteous while passing under the clock of honesty and religion like to a hidden fire.

sanskrit: सताम् वेष धरम् पापम् प्रच्छन्नम् इव पावकम्
न अहम् त्वाम् अभिजानामि धर्म छद्माभि संवृतम्
transliteration: satām veṣa dharam pāpam pracchannam iva pāvakam
na aham tvām abhijānāmi dharma chadmābhi saṃvṛtam
english: I do now know you as one who has spoliated his soul through impious actions, feigning religion while in truth an irreligious person, resorting to all vicious deeds, like to a well crusted with grass, unrighteous while passing under the clock of honesty and religion like to a hidden fire.

sanskrit: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा पापम् करोमि अहम्
न च त्वाम् अवजाने अहं कस्मात् त्वम् हंसि अकिल्बिषम्
transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā pāpam karomi aham
na ca tvām avajāne ahaṃ kasmāt tvam haṃsi akilbiṣam

sanskrit: फल मूल अशनम् नित्यम् वानरम् वन गोचरम्
माम् इह अप्रतियुध्यन्तम् अन्येन च समागतम्
transliteration: phala mūla aśanam nityam vānaram vana gocaram
mām iha apratiyudhyantam anyena ca samāgatam

sanskrit: लिन्गम् अपि अस्ति ते राजन् दृश्यते धर्म सम्हितम्
transliteration: lingam api asti te rājan dṛśyate dharma samhitam

sanskrit: धर्म लिंग प्रतिच्छन्नः क्रूरम् कर्म समाचरेत्
transliteration: dharma liṃga praticchannaḥ krūram karma samācaret
english: Who, born in the race of Kșatriyas, versed in religious lore, having his doubts removed and marks of piety on his person, perpetrates such an iniquitous deed?

sanskrit: राम राघव कुले जातो धर्मवान् इति विश्रुतः
अभव्यो भव्य रूपेण किम् अर्थम् परिधावसे
transliteration: rāma rāghava kule jāto dharmavān iti viśrutaḥ
abhavyo bhavya rūpeṇa kim artham paridhāvase
english: You are born in the family of Raghus and known all over the world as being pious. Being clothed in righteousness why did you commit such an unrighteous act?

sanskrit: साम दानम् क्षमा धर्मः सत्यम् धृति पराक्रमौ
पार्थिवानाम् गुणा राजन् दण्डः च अपि अपकारिषु
transliteration: sāma dānam kṣamā dharmaḥ satyam dhṛti parākramau
pārthivānām guṇā rājan daṇḍaḥ ca api apakāriṣu
english: Chastisement, charity, forgiveness, piety, truthfulness firmness, prowess and the punishment of the iniquitous are the virtues of a king, O prince.

sanskrit: वयम् वनचरा राम मृगा मूल फल अशनाः
एषा प्रकृतिर् अस्माकम् पुरुषः त्वम् नरेश्वरः
transliteration: vayam vanacarā rāma mṛgā mūla phala aśanāḥ
eṣā prakṛtir asmākam puruṣaḥ tvam nareśvaraḥ
english: We are, O Rama, wild beasts ranging in the forest and living on roots and fruits-our nature is such—but you are a man, O king.

sanskrit: भूमिर् हिरण्यम् रूपम् च निग्रहे कारणानि च
तत्र कः ते वने लोभो मदीयेषु फलेषु वा
transliteration: bhūmir hiraṇyam rūpam ca nigrahe kāraṇāni ca
tatra kaḥ te vane lobho madīyeṣu phaleṣu vā
english: Land, gold and silver are the causes of dissension. But who is there who is avaricious enough to get by our forest habitations and fruits?

sanskrit: नयः च विनयः च उभौ निग्रह अनुग्रहौ अपि
राज वृत्तिर् असंकीर्णा न नृपाः काम वृत्तयः
transliteration: nayaḥ ca vinayaḥ ca ubhau nigraha anugrahau api
rāja vṛttir asaṃkīrṇā na nṛpāḥ kāma vṛttayaḥ
english: The royal virtue consists in humbly and freely administering discipline, favour and punishment. Kings by no means, should follow their whims.

sanskrit: त्वम् तु काम प्रधानः च कोपनः च अनवस्थितः
transliteration: tvam tu kāma pradhānaḥ ca kopanaḥ ca anavasthitaḥ
english: But you are angry and unsteady by nature, capricious, perfectly narrow-minded in the discharge of your royal duties and did use your bow and shaft: (any where and every time).

sanskrit: न ते अस्ति अपचितिः धर्मे न अर्थे बुद्धिर् अवस्थिता
इन्द्रियैः काम वृत्तः सन् कृष्यसे मनुजेश्वर
transliteration: na te asti apacitiḥ dharme na arthe buddhir avasthitā
indriyaiḥ kāma vṛttaḥ san kṛṣyase manujeśvara
english: You have no attachment for virtue, no comprehension of right things and are always guided by your passions albeit you are a lord of men.

sanskrit: हत्वा बाणेन काकुत्स्थ माम् इह अनपराधिनम्
किम् वक्ष्यसि सताम् मध्ये कर्म कृत्वा जुगुप्सितम्
transliteration: hatvā bāṇena kākutstha mām iha anaparādhinam
kim vakṣyasi satām madhye karma kṛtvā jugupsitam
english: O Kākutstha, destroying me sinless, with your shaft and perpetrating such a disgraceful act, how shall you relate it to the pious.

sanskrit: राजहा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः चोरः प्राणिवधे रतः
नास्तिकः परिवेत्ता च सर्वे निरय गामिनः
transliteration: rājahā brahmahā goghnaḥ coraḥ prāṇivadhe rataḥ
nāstikaḥ parivettā ca sarve niraya gāminaḥ
english: Those, who commit treason, destroy Brahmins and kine, who are thieves and always engaged in the destruction of animals, and who are atheists and marry before their elder brothers are married, do all go to hell.

sanskrit: सूचकः च कदर्यः च मित्र्घ्नो गुरुतल्पगः
लोकं पापात्मानम् एते गच्छन्ते न अत्र संशयः
transliteration: sūcakaḥ ca kadaryaḥ ca mitrghno gurutalpagaḥ
lokaṃ pāpātmānam ete gacchante na atra saṃśayaḥ
english: The villainous, the avaricious, those who kill their friends and elope with their preceptor's wives, do always visit the land of the vicious.

sanskrit: अधार्यम् चर्म मे सद्भी रोमाणि अस्थि च वर्जितम्
अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि त्वत् विधैः धर्मचारिभिः
transliteration: adhāryam carma me sadbhī romāṇi asthi ca varjitam
abhakṣyāṇi ca māṃsāni tvat vidhaiḥ dharmacāribhiḥ
english: And there is not the least doubt about it. My skin is not worthy of your touch and my bones and hairs should always be avoided by the virtuous. And my flesh is not worthy of being eaten by persons of your piety.

sanskrit: पंच पंच नखा भक्ष्या ब्रह्म क्षत्रेण राघव
शल्यकः श्वाविधो गोधा शशः कूर्मः च पंचमः
transliteration: paṃca paṃca nakhā bhakṣyā brahma kṣatreṇa rāghava
śalyakaḥ śvāvidho godhā śaśaḥ kūrmaḥ ca paṃcamaḥ
english: A hedge-hog a porcupine, an iguana, a hare and a tortoise these five animals only, having five toes, are worthy of being eaten by the Ks atryas and Brahmins, O Rāghava.

sanskrit: चर्म च अस्थि च मे राजन् न स्पृशन्ति मनीषिणः
अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि सो अहम् पंच नखो हतः
transliteration: carma ca asthi ca me rājan na spṛśanti manīṣiṇaḥ
abhakṣyāṇi ca māṃsāni so aham paṃca nakho hataḥ
english: The wise, O Rāma, do not touch my skin and bones and my flesh is not worthy of being taken-I am that (monkey) having five toes who have been killed by you.

sanskrit: तारया वाक्यम् उक्तो अहम् सत्यम् सर्वज्ञया हितम्
तद् अतिक्रम्य मोहेन कालस्य वशम् आगतः
transliteration: tārayā vākyam ukto aham satyam sarvajñayā hitam
tad atikramya mohena kālasya vaśam āgataḥ
english: Alas! disregarding the well meaning and truthful words of Tārā, I have placed myself under the control of Kāla (Death).

sanskrit: त्वया नाथेन काकुत्स्थ न सनाथा वसुंधरा
प्रमदा शील संपूर्णा पति एव च विधर्मिणा
transliteration: tvayā nāthena kākutstha na sanāthā vasuṃdharā
pramadā śīla saṃpūrṇā pati eva ca vidharmiṇā
english: O Kākutstha, the Earth has got you as her husband like to a good natured damsel being wedded to a husband who has forsaken his own religion.

sanskrit: शठो नैकृतिकः क्षुद्रो मिथ्या प्रश्रित मानसः
कथम् दशरथेन त्वम् जातः पापो महात्मना
transliteration: śaṭho naikṛtikaḥ kṣudro mithyā praśrita mānasaḥ
katham daśarathena tvam jātaḥ pāpo mahātmanā
english: How are you, who are wicked, narrowminded, a liar and ever intent upon bringing about others' misfortune, born of the loins of the high-souled Dasaratha?

sanskrit: छिन्न चारित्र्य कक्ष्येण सताम् धर्म अतिवर्तिना
त्यक्त धर्म अंकुशेन अहम् निहतो राम हस्तिना
transliteration: chinna cāritrya kakṣyeṇa satām dharma ativartinā
tyakta dharma aṃkuśena aham nihato rāma hastinā
english: I have been killed by an elephant-Rāma, disregarding the virtue of the pious, breaking the chord of character, and neglecting the goad of religion.

sanskrit: अशुभम् च अपि अयुक्तम् च सताम् च एव विगर्हितम्
वक्ष्यसे च ईदृशम् कृत्वा सद्भिः सह समागतः
transliteration: aśubham ca api ayuktam ca satām ca eva vigarhitam
vakṣyase ca īdṛśam kṛtvā sadbhiḥ saha samāgataḥ
english: Perpetrating this inauspicious, and improper act, blamed of the worthy what shall you speak to the pious when you shall return in their company?

sanskrit: उदासीनेषु यो अस्मासु विक्रमो अयम् प्रकाशितः
अपकारिषु ते राम न एवम् पश्यामि विक्रमम्
transliteration: udāsīneṣu yo asmāsu vikramo ayam prakāśitaḥ
apakāriṣu te rāma na evam paśyāmi vikramam
english: The prowess, you had displayed towards me, careless, O Rāma you did never employ for the suppression of the iniquitous.

sanskrit: दृश्यमानः तु युध्येथा मया युधि नृपात्मज
अद्य वैवस्वतम् देवम् पश्येः त्वम् निहतो मया
transliteration: dṛśyamānaḥ tu yudhyethā mayā yudhi nṛpātmaja
adya vaivasvatam devam paśyeḥ tvam nihato mayā
english: O son of a king, hadst you fought with me openly you wouldst have, forsooth, seen the abode of Death being killed by me.

sanskrit: त्वया अदृश्येन तु रणे निहतो अहम् दुरासदः
प्रसुप्तः पन्नगेन इव नरः पाप वशम् गतः
transliteration: tvayā adṛśyena tu raṇe nihato aham durāsadaḥ
prasuptaḥ pannagena iva naraḥ pāpa vaśam gataḥ
english: O Rāma, like to a serpent destroying persons asleep, you, that are under the control of vice, have killed me, who am hard to repress, keeping yourself out of my sight in the battle.

sanskrit: सुग्रीव प्रिय कामेन यद् अहम् निहतः त्वया
माम् एव यदि पूर्वम् त्वम् एतद् अर्थम् अचोदयः
मैथिलिम् अहम् एक आह्ना तव च आनीतवान् भवेः
transliteration: sugrīva priya kāmena yad aham nihataḥ tvayā
mām eva yadi pūrvam tvam etad artham acodayaḥ
maithilim aham eka āhnā tava ca ānītavān bhaveḥ
english: I have been killed by you, desirous of encompassing Sugrīva's well being. Hadst you apprized me of your object before, I would have got you your Maithili in the course of a day, and brought, by the neck, that vicious-souled Raks asa-Rāvaņa, the ravisher of your spouse with out putting an end to his life in the battle.

sanskrit: राक्षसम् च दुरात्मानाम् तव भार्य अपहारिणम्
कण्ठे बद्ध्वा प्रदद्याम् ते अनिहतम् रावणम् रणे
transliteration: rākṣasam ca durātmānām tava bhārya apahāriṇam
kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyām te anihatam rāvaṇam raṇe

sanskrit: न्यस्ताम् सागर तोये वा पाताले वा अपि मैथिलीम्
आनयेयम् तव आदेशात् श्वेताम् अश्वतरीम् इव
transliteration: nyastām sāgara toye vā pātāle vā api maithilīm
ānayeyam tava ādeśāt śvetām aśvatarīm iva
english: Whether in the deep ocean or in the region under the earth, I shall bring your Maithili like to an Asyatar* Here is an allusion. A prince of Daityas, named Hayagriva, stole the Vedas at the end of Kalpa; in the recovery of them he was slain by Vişnu after his descent as Matshya.

sanskrit: युक्तम् यत् प्रप्नुयात् राज्यम् सुग्रीवः स्वर् गते मयि
अयुक्तम् यद् अधर्मेण त्वया अहम् निहतो रणे
transliteration: yuktam yat prapnuyāt rājyam sugrīvaḥ svar gate mayi
ayuktam yad adharmeṇa tvayā aham nihato raṇe
english: It is perfectly proper that Sugrīva shall inherit my kingdom on my ascension to heaven. And it is equally improper that I have been viciously killed by you in the battle.

sanskrit: कामम् एवम् विधम् लोकः कालेन विनियुज्यते
क्षमम् चेत् भवता प्राप्तम् उत्तरम् साधु चिंत्यताम्
transliteration: kāmam evam vidham lokaḥ kālena viniyujyate
kṣamam cet bhavatā prāptam uttaram sādhu ciṃtyatām
english: Every one in time meets with death and hence there is nothing to be sorry for me. But do you think of a proper reply you shall give to the people (when asked about the cause of my destruction).

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा परिशुष्क वक्त्रःशर अभिघातात् व्यथितो महात्मा
समीक्ष्य रामम् रवि संनिकाशम्तूष्णीम् बभौ वानर राज सूनुः
transliteration: iti evam uktvā pariśuṣka vaktraḥśara abhighātāt vyathito mahātmā
samīkṣya rāmam ravi saṃnikāśamtūṣṇīm babhau vānara rāja sūnuḥ
english: Having said this, that high-souled Son of monkey-chief, greatly distressed being wounded by (Rāma's) shaft and having his countenance dried up, became silent, fixing his look upon Rāma, resembling the sun.

And thus Rāma was addressed by Vāli, wounded and senseless, with those modest, pious and auspicious words. And being thus reproached he spoke to that excellent lord of monkeys, gifted with virtue and other accomplishments, resembling the Sun shorn of its lustre, a cloud which has already discharged its waters and fire extinguished.

sanskrit: तं निष्प्रभम् इव आदित्यं मुक्त तोयम् इवाम्बुदम्
उक्त वाक्यं हरि श्रेष्ठम् उपशांतम् इवानलम्
transliteration: taṃ niṣprabham iva ādityaṃ mukta toyam ivāmbudam
ukta vākyaṃ hari śreṣṭham upaśāṃtam ivānalam

sanskrit: धर्मम् अर्थञ्च कामञ्च समयञ्च अपि लौकिकम्
अविज्ञाय कथम् बाल्यात् माम् इह अद्य विगर्हसे
transliteration: dharmam arthañca kāmañca samayañca api laukikam
avijñāya katham bālyāt mām iha adya vigarhase
english: Not cognizant of virtue, knowledge, passion and custom, why did you blame me like a child?

sanskrit: अपृष्ट्वा बुद्धि संपन्नान् वृद्धान् आचार्य संमतान्
सौम्य वानर चापल्यात् त्वम् माम् वक्तुम् इह इच्छसि
transliteration: apṛṣṭvā buddhi saṃpannān vṛddhān ācārya saṃmatān
saumya vānara cāpalyāt tvam mām vaktum iha icchasi
english: Why did you purpose to address me thus out of fickleness, consequent upon your monkeyhood not asking your wise elders recognized by the preceptors?

sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् इयम् भूमिः स शैल वन कानना
मृग पक्षि मनुष्याणाम् निग्रह अनुग्रहेषु अपि
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇām iyam bhūmiḥ sa śaila vana kānanā
mṛga pakṣi manuṣyāṇām nigraha anugraheṣu api
english: This land, abounding in hills and woods, belongs to the lkşwakus. Along with it was conferred on them the power of administering favour and chastisement to beasts, birds and human beings.

sanskrit: ताम् पालयति धर्मात्मा भरतः सत्यवान् ऋजुः
धर्म काम अर्थ तत्त्वज्ञो निग्रह अनुग्रहे रतः
transliteration: tām pālayati dharmātmā bharataḥ satyavān ṛjuḥ
dharma kāma artha tattvajño nigraha anugrahe rataḥ
english: The upright, virtuous and truthful king Bharata, cognizant of virtue, knowledge and passion and ever engaged in administering favour and punisl.ment, governs this kingdom.

sanskrit: नयः च विनयः च उभौ यस्मिन् सत्यम् च सुस्थितम्
विक्रमः च यथा दृष्टः स राजा देश कालवित्
transliteration: nayaḥ ca vinayaḥ ca ubhau yasmin satyam ca susthitam
vikramaḥ ca yathā dṛṣṭaḥ sa rājā deśa kālavit
english: That king is said to be cognizant of time and place; in him dwelleth modesty, truthfulness, prowess and a love for discipline.

sanskrit: तस्य धर्म कृत आदेशा वयम् अन्ये च पार्थिवः
चरामो वसुधाम् कृत्स्नाम् धर्म संतानम् इच्छवः
transliteration: tasya dharma kṛta ādeśā vayam anye ca pārthivaḥ
carāmo vasudhām kṛtsnām dharma saṃtānam icchavaḥ
english: Ourselves and other kings, being commanded by him to practise piety, have been journeying in this wide world desirous of multiplying virtue.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् नृपति शार्दूल भरते धर्म वत्सले
पालयति अखिलाम् पृथ्वीम् कः चरेत् धर्म विप्रियम्
transliteration: tasmin nṛpati śārdūla bharate dharma vatsale
pālayati akhilām pṛthvīm kaḥ caret dharma vipriyam
english: That foremost of monarchs, Bharatalover of virtue, governing this entire earth, who dares perpetrate an iniquity.?

sanskrit: ते वयम् मार्ग विभ्रष्टम् स्वधर्मे परमे स्थिताः
भरत आज्ञाम् पुरस्कृत्य निगृह्णीमो यथा विधि
transliteration: te vayam mārga vibhraṣṭam svadharme parame sthitāḥ
bharata ājñām puraskṛtya nigṛhṇīmo yathā vidhi
english: Stationed in the excellent virtue of our own and placing Bharata's commandments on our heads, we shall consider how we shall punish them who go astray (from the path of virtue).

sanskrit: त्वम् तु संक्लिष्ट धर्मः च कर्मणा च विगर्हितः
काम तंत्र प्रधानः च न स्थितो राज वर्त्मनि
transliteration: tvam tu saṃkliṣṭa dharmaḥ ca karmaṇā ca vigarhitaḥ
kāma taṃtra pradhānaḥ ca na sthito rāja vartmani
english: You have oppressed virtue and perpetrated a gross iniquity. You have placed yourself under the control of your passions and deviated from the track of royal duties.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पिता चैव यः च विद्याम् प्रयच्छति
त्रयः ते पितरो ज्ञेया धर्मे च पथि वर्तिनः
transliteration: jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitā caiva yaḥ ca vidyām prayacchati
trayaḥ te pitaro jñeyā dharme ca pathi vartinaḥ
english: The elder brother, father, and the instructor—these three should always be regarded in the light of a father if they tread the paths of virtue and morality,

sanskrit: यवीयान् आत्मनः पुत्रः शिष्यः च अपि गुणोदितः
पुत्रवत् ते त्रयः चिंत्या धर्मः चैव अत्र कारणम्
transliteration: yavīyān ātmanaḥ putraḥ śiṣyaḥ ca api guṇoditaḥ
putravat te trayaḥ ciṃtyā dharmaḥ caiva atra kāraṇam
english: A younger brother, a son and an accomplished follower should always be regarded as sons. And virtue is always at the bottom of all such considerations.

sanskrit: सूक्ष्मः परम दुर्ज्ञेयः सताम् धर्मः प्लवंगम
हृदिस्थः सर्व भूतानाम् आत्मा वेद शुभाशुभम्
transliteration: sūkṣmaḥ parama durjñeyaḥ satām dharmaḥ plavaṃgama
hṛdisthaḥ sarva bhūtānām ātmā veda śubhāśubham
english: O monkey, the religion of the good is indeed very subtle and can comprehend great things the immortal soul can understand what is good or bad.

sanskrit: चपलः चपलैः सार्धम् वानरैः अकृत आत्मभिः
जात्यंध इव जात्यन्धैः मंत्रयन् द्रक्ष्यसे नु किम्
transliteration: capalaḥ capalaiḥ sārdham vānaraiḥ akṛta ātmabhiḥ
jātyaṃdha iva jātyandhaiḥ maṃtrayan drakṣyase nu kim
english: Fickle as you are, how canst you comprehend what is proper, consulting with your monkey companions who are equally stupid and lighthearted, like to one, born blind, leading with another such?

sanskrit: अहम् तु व्यक्तताम् अस्य वचनस्य ब्रवीमि ते
न हि माम् केवलम् रोषात् त्वम् विगर्हितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: aham tu vyaktatām asya vacanasya bravīmi te
na hi mām kevalam roṣāt tvam vigarhitum arhasi
english: I do fairly speak to you that it is not anger only that has led me to bring about your destruction.

sanskrit: तत् एतत् कारणम् पश्य यत् अर्थम् त्वम् मया हतः
भ्रातुर् वर्तसि भार्यायाम् त्यक्त्वा धर्मम् सनातनम्
transliteration: tat etat kāraṇam paśya yat artham tvam mayā hataḥ
bhrātur vartasi bhāryāyām tyaktvā dharmam sanātanam
english: Do you consider why I have killed you-you had ravished your brother's wife renouncing that ever-existing virtue.

sanskrit: रुमायाम् वर्तसे कामात् स्नुषायाम् पाप कर्मकृत्
transliteration: rumāyām vartase kāmāt snuṣāyām pāpa karmakṛt
english: You, the perpetrator of many evil deeds, have got by Rumā, the wife of your brother-the high-souled Sugrīva.

sanskrit: तद् व्यतीतस्य ते धर्मात् काम वृत्तस्य वानर
भ्रातृ भार्या अभिमर्शे अस्मिन् दण्डो अयम् प्रतिपादितः
transliteration: tad vyatītasya te dharmāt kāma vṛttasya vānara
bhrātṛ bhāryā abhimarśe asmin daṇḍo ayam pratipāditaḥ
english: O monkey, you had thus violated the path of virtue. And thus I have punished you who have ravished your elder brother's spouse.

sanskrit: न हि लोक विरुद्धस्य लोक वृत्तात् अपेयुषः
दण्डात् अन्यत्र पश्यामि निग्रहम् हरि यूथप
transliteration: na hi loka viruddhasya loka vṛttāt apeyuṣaḥ
daṇḍāt anyatra paśyāmi nigraham hari yūthapa
english: o you, the leader of monkey-herds-I find no other alternative than to punish him who act against humanity and violates the sacred sanctions of custom.

sanskrit: न च ते मर्षये पापम् क्ष्त्रियो अहम् कुलोद्गतः
औरसीम् भगिनीम् वा अपि भार्याम् वा अपि अनुजस्य यः
transliteration: na ca te marṣaye pāpam kṣtriyo aham kulodgataḥ
aurasīm bhaginīm vā api bhāryām vā api anujasya yaḥ
english: I am a Ksatrya coming of a high pedigree. I cannot put up with your immoral conduct. Šāstras sanction the destruction of one who under the influence of passion ravishes his own daughter, sister and younger brother's wife.

sanskrit: प्रचरेत नरः कामात् तस्य दण्डो वधः स्मृतः
भरतः तु महीपालो वयम् तु आदेश वर्तिनः
transliteration: pracareta naraḥ kāmāt tasya daṇḍo vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ
bharataḥ tu mahīpālo vayam tu ādeśa vartinaḥ

sanskrit: त्वम् च धर्मात् अतिक्रान्तः कथम् शक्यम् उपेक्षितुम्
गुरु धर्म व्यतिक्रान्तम् प्राज्ञो धर्मेण पालयन्
transliteration: tvam ca dharmāt atikrāntaḥ katham śakyam upekṣitum
guru dharma vyatikrāntam prājño dharmeṇa pālayan

sanskrit: वयम् तु भरत आदेशम् विधिम् कृत्वा हरीश्वर
त्वत् विधान् भिन्न मर्यादान् निग्रहीतुम् व्यवस्थिताः
transliteration: vayam tu bharata ādeśam vidhim kṛtvā harīśvara
tvat vidhān bhinna maryādān nigrahītum vyavasthitāḥ
english: A wise man, living in virtue, cannot let go one who has passed by the sanctions of morality. Bharata has sanctioned the destruction of the amorous; and we, O lord of monkeys, following his orders, thought proper, to encompass the destruction of one like you who has spoliated virtue and morality.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवेण च मे सख्यम् लक्ष्मणेन यथा तथा
दार राज्य निमित्तम् च निःश्रेयसकरः स मे
transliteration: sugrīveṇa ca me sakhyam lakṣmaṇena yathā tathā
dāra rājya nimittam ca niḥśreyasakaraḥ sa me
english: Like to Laksmana, I have contracted friendship with Sugrīva. And with a view to regain his wife and kingdom, he resolved to engage in my well-being. I too also promised the same before the monkeys. And how can a man of my position neglect to make good his promise?

sanskrit: प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता तदा वानर संनिधौ
प्रतिज्ञा च कथम् शक्या मत् विधेन अनवेक्षितुम्
transliteration: pratijñā ca mayā dattā tadā vānara saṃnidhau
pratijñā ca katham śakyā mat vidhena anavekṣitum
english: Like to Laksmana, I have contracted friendship with Sugrīva. And with a view to regain his wife and kingdom, he resolved to engage in my well-being. I too also promised the same before the monkeys. And how can a man of my position neglect to make good his promise?

sanskrit: तत् एभिः कारणैः सर्वैर् महद्भिः धर्म संहितैः
शासनम् तव यत् युक्तम् तत् भवान् अनुमन्यताम्
transliteration: tat ebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ sarvair mahadbhiḥ dharma saṃhitaiḥ
śāsanam tava yat yuktam tat bhavān anumanyatām
english: For these causes of very great moment, favoured by virtue, I have adininistered to you this condign punishment. Do you now approve it.

sanskrit: सर्वथा धर्म इति एव द्रष्टव्यः तव निग्रहः
transliteration: sarvathā dharma iti eva draṣṭavyaḥ tava nigrahaḥ
english: Your discomfiture is quite of a piece with the sanctions of morality-and to assist friends in one of the codes of religion.

sanskrit: शक्यम् त्वया अपि तत् कार्यम् धर्मम् एव अनुवर्तता
श्रूयते मनुना गीतौ श्लोकौ चारित्र वत्सलौ
गृहीतौ धर्म कुशलैः तथा तत् चरितम् मयाअ
transliteration: śakyam tvayā api tat kāryam dharmam eva anuvartatā
śrūyate manunā gītau ślokau cāritra vatsalau
gṛhītau dharma kuśalaiḥ tathā tat caritam mayāa
english: Hear, Manu has composed a couple of couplets tending to the purification of character and highly prized by the virtuous as well as myself.

sanskrit: राजभिः धृत दण्डाः च कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः
निर्मलाः स्वर्गम् आयान्ति सन्तः सुकृतिनो यथा
transliteration: rājabhiḥ dhṛta daṇḍāḥ ca kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ
nirmalāḥ svargam āyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā
english: Those who, perpetrating iniquity, bear with fortitude the punishment, inflicted by their sovereign get at the abode of the celestials being purified like to the pious. People are freed from their sins, when they confessing their crimes, are either punished or forgiven. But the monarch who does not punish the perpetrator of an evil deed, is visited by a mighty sin.

sanskrit: शसनात् वा अपि मोक्षात् वा स्तेनः पापात् प्रमुच्यते
राजा तु अशासन् पापस्य तद् आप्नोति किल्बिषम्
transliteration: śasanāt vā api mokṣāt vā stenaḥ pāpāt pramucyate
rājā tu aśāsan pāpasya tad āpnoti kilbiṣam
english: Those who, perpetrating iniquity, bear with fortitude the punishment, inflicted by their sovereign get at the abode of the celestials being purified like to the pious. People are freed from their sins, when they confessing their crimes, are either punished or forgiven. But the monarch who does not punish the perpetrator of an evil deed, is visited by a mighty sin.

sanskrit: आर्येण मम मान्धात्रा व्यसनम् घोरम् ईप्सितम्
श्रमणेन कृते पापे यथा पापम् कृतम् त्वया
transliteration: āryeṇa mama māndhātrā vyasanam ghoram īpsitam
śramaṇena kṛte pāpe yathā pāpam kṛtam tvayā
english: Formerly an iniquity, like one perpetrated by you, was committed by a devotee who was punished severely by my forefather Māndhäta.

sanskrit: अन्यैः अपि कृतम् पापम् प्रमत्तैः वसुधा अधिपैः
प्रायश्चित्तम् च कुर्वन्ति तेन तत् शाम्यते रजः
transliteration: anyaiḥ api kṛtam pāpam pramattaiḥ vasudhā adhipaiḥ
prāyaścittam ca kurvanti tena tat śāmyate rajaḥ
english: And other lords of earth punish in the same way the authors of misdeeds. What more, the perpetrators of crime, themselves undergo penances and are thus released from their sins.

sanskrit: वधो वानरशार्दूल न वयम् स्व वशे स्थिताः
transliteration: vadho vānaraśārdūla na vayam sva vaśe sthitāḥ
english: Therefore do not repent any more, O best of monkeys. The punishment, I have inflicted on you, is in consonance with the sanctions of morality. We are not our own masters.

sanskrit: श्रुणु च अपि अपरम् भूयः कारणम् हरिपुंगव
तत् श्रुत्वा हि महत् वीर न मन्युम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: śruṇu ca api aparam bhūyaḥ kāraṇam haripuṃgava
tat śrutvā hi mahat vīra na manyum kartum arhasi
english: Hearken, O best of monkeys, there is another argument (for your destruction); and hearing which, O great hero, it behoveth you to renounce your ire.

sanskrit: न मे तत्र मनस्तापो न मन्युः हरिपुंगव
वागुराभिः च पाशैः च कूटैः च विविधैः नराः
transliteration: na me tatra manastāpo na manyuḥ haripuṃgava
vāgurābhiḥ ca pāśaiḥ ca kūṭaiḥ ca vividhaiḥ narāḥ

sanskrit: प्रतिच्छन्नाः च दृश्याः च गृह्णन्ति सुबहून् मृगान्
transliteration: praticchannāḥ ca dṛśyāḥ ca gṛhṇanti subahūn mṛgān
english: Many persons living on flesh, either lying in ambush, or openly catch and pierce by means of net, noose and trap, many a deer, terrified and trusted, taking to their heels or quarrelling with their companions, careful or careless. They are not to blame in this and I do not cherish, O best of monkeys, any mortification or ire for this.

sanskrit: प्रमत्तान् अप्रमत्तान् वा नरा माम्स अशिनो भृशम्
विध्यन्ति विमुखाम् च अपि न च दोषो अत्र विद्यते
transliteration: pramattān apramattān vā narā māmsa aśino bhṛśam
vidhyanti vimukhām ca api na ca doṣo atra vidyate
english: And even many royal ascetics, versed in religious lore, go a-hunting; and hence you had been killed by me with a shaft, O monkey, in the conflict.

sanskrit: यान्ति राजर्षयः च अत्र मृगयाम् धर्म कोविदाः
तस्मात् त्वम् निहतो युद्धे मया बाणेन वानर
अयुध्यन् प्रतियुध्यन् वा यस्मात् शाखा मृगो हि असि
transliteration: yānti rājarṣayaḥ ca atra mṛgayām dharma kovidāḥ
tasmāt tvam nihato yuddhe mayā bāṇena vānara
ayudhyan pratiyudhyan vā yasmāt śākhā mṛgo hi asi

sanskrit: दुर्लभस्य च धर्मस्य जीवितस्य शुभस्य च
transliteration: durlabhasya ca dharmasya jīvitasya śubhasya ca

sanskrit: तान् न हिंस्यात् न च आक्रोशेन् न आक्षिपेन् न अप्रियम् वदेत्
देवा मानुष रूपेण चरन्ति एते मही तले
transliteration: tān na hiṃsyāt na ca ākrośen na ākṣipen na apriyam vadet
devā mānuṣa rūpeṇa caranti ete mahī tale

sanskrit: त्वम् तु धर्मम् अविज्ञाय केवलम् रोषम् आस्थितः
विदूषयसि माम् धर्मे पितृ पैतामहे स्थितम्
transliteration: tvam tu dharmam avijñāya kevalam roṣam āsthitaḥ
vidūṣayasi mām dharme pitṛ paitāmahe sthitam
english: Not knowing virtue and growing angry why did you blame me who am following the religion of my forefathers?

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण वाली प्रव्यथितो भृशम्
न दोषम् राघवे दध्यौ धर्मे अधिगत निश्चयः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa vālī pravyathito bhṛśam
na doṣam rāghave dadhyau dharme adhigata niścayaḥ
english: Being thus accosted by Rāma, Vāli, greatly mortified and informed of the principle of religion, observed no delinquency in Rāghava.

sanskrit: यत् त्वम् आत्थ नरश्रेष्ठ तत् थथा एव न अत्र संशयः
transliteration: yat tvam āttha naraśreṣṭha tat thathā eva na atra saṃśayaḥ
english: Thereupon that lord of monkeys spoke to Răma, with folded hands, saying:-There is not the least doubt, О best of men, in all that you had said.

sanskrit: प्रतिवक्तुम् प्रकृष्टे हि न अपकृष्टः तु शक्नुयात्
यत् अयुक्तम् मया पूर्वम् प्रमादात् वाक्यम् अप्रियम्
transliteration: prativaktum prakṛṣṭe hi na apakṛṣṭaḥ tu śaknuyāt
yat ayuktam mayā pūrvam pramādāt vākyam apriyam

sanskrit: तत्र अपि खलु माम् दोषम् कर्तुम् न अर्हसि राघव
त्वम् हि दृष्टार्थ तत्त्वज्ञः प्रजानाम् च हिते रतः
कार्य कारण सिद्धौ च प्रसन्ना बुद्धिः अव्यया
transliteration: tatra api khalu mām doṣam kartum na arhasi rāghava
tvam hi dṛṣṭārtha tattvajñaḥ prajānām ca hite rataḥ
kārya kāraṇa siddhau ca prasannā buddhiḥ avyayā
english: An inferior person can by no means address his superior improperly. It does not behove you, O Rāghava, therefore to blame me for those unpleasant words which I used towards you, out of foolishness. You have acquired a practical mastery over the principles of religion and are ever engaged in the welfare of your subjects. Your eternal power of ascertaining the crime and meeting its condign punishment is perfectly clear.

sanskrit: माम् अपि अवगतम् धर्मात् व्यतिक्रान्त पुरस्कृतम्
transliteration: mām api avagatam dharmāt vyatikrānta puraskṛtam
english: Do you know me as the foremost of sinners and one who has deviated from the track of imorality. Do you conduct me, with pious words, to a better land.

sanskrit: बाष्प संरुद्ध कण्ठः तु वाली स आर्त रवः शनैः
उवाच रामम् संप्रेक्ष्य पंकलग्न इव द्विपः
transliteration: bāṣpa saṃruddha kaṇṭhaḥ tu vālī sa ārta ravaḥ śanaiḥ
uvāca rāmam saṃprekṣya paṃkalagna iva dvipaḥ
english: Vāli, having his throat choked with vapour, addressed again and again, Rāma, with piteous accents, saying.

sanskrit: न च आत्मानम् अहम् शोचे न ताराम् न अपि बान्धवान्
transliteration: na ca ātmānam aham śoce na tārām na api bāndhavān
english: I do not mourn so much for me, Tāră, or other friends as for my son Angada, eldest and wearing a golden Angada* *A bracelet worn on the upper arm.

sanskrit: स मम अदर्शनात् दीनो बाल्यात् प्रभृति लालितः
transliteration: sa mama adarśanāt dīno bālyāt prabhṛti lālitaḥ
english: Brought up by me from his very infancy, he shall by my separation, wear away like to a pond having its liquid contents drunk up by an elephant.

sanskrit: बालः च अकृतबुद्धिः च एक पुत्रः च मे प्रियः
transliteration: bālaḥ ca akṛtabuddhiḥ ca eka putraḥ ca me priyaḥ
english: He is my only son, dear and born of Tārā. A mere child and of unripe understanding as he is, that one of mighty strength should always be protected by you, O Rāma.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवे च अंगदे चैव विधत्स्व मतिम् उत्तमाम्
त्वम् हि गोप्ता च शास्ता च कार्याकार्य विधौ स्थितः
transliteration: sugrīve ca aṃgade caiva vidhatsva matim uttamām
tvam hi goptā ca śāstā ca kāryākārya vidhau sthitaḥ
english: Do you regard favourable Sugrīva and Angada. You are their protector, and chastiser punishing them for their sins.

sanskrit: या ते नरपते वृत्तिः भरते लक्ष्मणे च या
सुग्रीवे च अंगदे राजन् ताम् चिंतयितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: yā te narapate vṛttiḥ bharate lakṣmaṇe ca yā
sugrīve ca aṃgade rājan tām ciṃtayitum arhasi
english: O king, O lord of men, it behoveth you to regard Sugrīva and Angada in the same light in which you regardest Bharata and Laksmana.

sanskrit: मत् दोष कृत दोषाम् ताम् यथा ताराम् तपस्विनीम्
सुग्रीवो न अवमन्येत तथा अवस्थातुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: mat doṣa kṛta doṣām tām yathā tārām tapasvinīm
sugrīvo na avamanyeta tathā avasthātum arhasi
english: It behoveth you to so arrange as Sugrīva may not disregard that chaste Tārā who is blameable for my folly only.

sanskrit: त्वया हि अनुगृहीतेन शक्यम् राज्यम् उपासितुम्
त्वत् वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्त अनुवर्तिना
transliteration: tvayā hi anugṛhītena śakyam rājyam upāsitum
tvat vaśe vartamānena tava citta anuvartinā
english: He, who is favoured by you, abideth by yourcommandments and acteth after your heart, can acquire kingdom, attain to heaven, and govern the earth.

sanskrit: शक्यम् दिवम् च आर्जयितुम् वसुधाम् च अपि शासितुम्
त्वतः अहम् वधम् आकांक्षयन् वार्यमाणो अपि तारया
transliteration: śakyam divam ca ārjayitum vasudhām ca api śāsitum
tvataḥ aham vadham ākāṃkṣayan vāryamāṇo api tārayā

sanskrit: सुग्रीवेण सह भ्राता द्वन्द्व युद्धम् उपागतम्
इति उक्त्वा वानरो रामम् विरराम हरीश्वरः
transliteration: sugrīveṇa saha bhrātā dvandva yuddham upāgatam
iti uktvā vānaro rāmam virarāma harīśvaraḥ

sanskrit: स तम् आश्वासयत् रामो वालिनम् व्यक्त दर्शनम्
साधु सम्मतया वाचा धर्म तत्त्वार्त्ध युक्तया
transliteration: sa tam āśvāsayat rāmo vālinam vyakta darśanam
sādhu sammatayā vācā dharma tattvārtdha yuktayā

sanskrit: न संतापः त्वया कार्यम् एतत् अर्थम् प्लवंगम
न वयम् भवता चिंत्या न अपि आत्मा हरिसत्तम
वयम् भवत् विशेषेण धर्मतः कृत निश्चयाः
transliteration: na saṃtāpaḥ tvayā kāryam etat artham plavaṃgama
na vayam bhavatā ciṃtyā na api ātmā harisattama
vayam bhavat viśeṣeṇa dharmataḥ kṛta niścayāḥ

sanskrit: दण्ड्ये यः पातयेत् दण्डम् दण्ड्यो यः च अपि दण्ड्यते
कार्य कारण सिद्धार्थौ उभौ तौ न अवसीदतः
transliteration: daṇḍye yaḥ pātayet daṇḍam daṇḍyo yaḥ ca api daṇḍyate
kārya kāraṇa siddhārthau ubhau tau na avasīdataḥ
english: They never lose their virtue being proficient in the mode of ascerting crime and punishing it one administering punishment to the criminal and the criminal receiving it. And therefore receiving punishment (from me) you had been released from your sins and acquired a knowledge of religion.

sanskrit: तत् भवान् दण्ड सम्योगात् अस्मात् विगत कल्मषः
गतः स्वाम् प्रकृतिम् धर्म्याम् धर्म दिष्टेन वर्त्मना
transliteration: tat bhavān daṇḍa samyogāt asmāt vigata kalmaṣaḥ
gataḥ svām prakṛtim dharmyām dharma diṣṭena vartmanā
english: They never lose their virtue being proficient in the mode of ascerting crime and punishing it one administering punishment to the criminal and the criminal receiving it. And therefore receiving punishment (from me) you had been released from your sins and acquired a knowledge of religion.

sanskrit: त्यज शोकम् च मोहम् च भयम् च हृदये स्थितम्
त्वया विधानम् हर्यग्र्य न शक्यम् अतिवर्तितुम्
transliteration: tyaja śokam ca moham ca bhayam ca hṛdaye sthitam
tvayā vidhānam haryagrya na śakyam ativartitum
english: Do you therefore renounce your grief, your illusion and the fear that is lurking in your heart. It is impossible for you, O foremost of monkeys, to withstand the course of dispensation.

sanskrit: यथा त्वयि अंगदो नित्यम् वर्तते वानरेश्वरः
तथा वर्तते सुग्रीवो मयि च अपि न संशयः
transliteration: yathā tvayi aṃgado nityam vartate vānareśvaraḥ
tathā vartate sugrīvo mayi ca api na saṃśayaḥ
english: There is not the least doubt, lord of monkeys, that Angada shall be brought up by me and Sugriva in the same way as he was by you.

sanskrit: स तस्य वाक्यम् मधुरम् महात्मनःसमाहितम् धर्म पथानुवर्तिनः
निशम्य रामस्य रणावमर्दिनोवचः सुयुक्तम् निजगाद वानरः
transliteration: sa tasya vākyam madhuram mahātmanaḥsamāhitam dharma pathānuvartinaḥ
niśamya rāmasya raṇāvamardinovacaḥ suyuktam nijagāda vānaraḥ
english: Hearing these sweet, collected and pious words of the high-souled Rāma,-the repressor of the enemies in a battle,-the monkey again addressed him with the following pregnant words.

sanskrit: शराभितप्तेन विचेतसा मयाप्रदूषितः त्वम् यद् अजानता विभो
इदम् महेन्द्रोपम भीम विक्रमप्रसादितः त्वम् क्षम मे नरेश्वर
transliteration: śarābhitaptena vicetasā mayāpradūṣitaḥ tvam yad ajānatā vibho
idam mahendropama bhīma vikramaprasāditaḥ tvam kṣama me nareśvara
english: O lord, O you having Mahendra's prowess, I do propitiate you for my having insulted you with improper words, senseless as I was being wounded by shafts. Do you forgive me, O lord of monkeys.

sanskrit: स वानर महाराजः शयानः शर पीडितः
प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद् वाक्यैः न उत्तरम् प्रत्यपद्यत
transliteration: sa vānara mahārājaḥ śayānaḥ śara pīḍitaḥ
pratyukto hetumad vākyaiḥ na uttaram pratyapadyata
english: Being thus accosted with reasonable words, that lord, of monkeys, lying on the ground and wounded with shafts, gave no reply.

sanskrit: अश्मभिः परिभिन्न अंगः पादपैर् आहतो भृशम्
राम बाणेन च आक्रान्तो जीवित अंते मुमोह सः
transliteration: aśmabhiḥ paribhinna aṃgaḥ pādapair āhato bhṛśam
rāma bāṇena ca ākrānto jīvita aṃte mumoha saḥ
english: Having his limbs dissevered by stones, being struck with trees and wounded by Rama's shaft, he became senseless at the approach of death.

sanskrit: तम् भार्या बाण मोक्षेण राम दत्तेन संयुगे
हतम् प्लवग शार्दूलम् तारा शुश्राव वालिनम्
transliteration: tam bhāryā bāṇa mokṣeṇa rāma dattena saṃyuge
hatam plavaga śārdūlam tārā śuśrāva vālinam
english: His spouse Tārā heard that Váli, the foremost of monkeys, had been killed in the conflict by Rāma's shaft.

sanskrit: सा सपुत्र अप्रियम् श्रुत्वा वधम् भर्तुः सुदारुणम्
निष्पपात भृशम् तस्मात् उद्विग्ना गिरि कंदरात्
transliteration: sā saputra apriyam śrutvā vadham bhartuḥ sudāruṇam
niṣpapāta bhṛśam tasmāt udvignā giri kaṃdarāt
english: Hearing the heart-rending news of her husband's demise, she, big with a child, issued out of the mountain cave with a troubled heart.

sanskrit: ये ते अंगद परीवारा वानरा हि महाबलाः
ते सकार्मुकम् आलोक्य रामम् त्रस्ताः प्रदुद्रुवुः
transliteration: ye te aṃgada parīvārā vānarā hi mahābalāḥ
te sakārmukam ālokya rāmam trastāḥ pradudruvuḥ
english: And beholding Rāma with a bow in his hand, the mighty monkeys, followers of Angada, fled away, terrified.

sanskrit: सा ददर्श ततः त्रस्तान् हरीन् आपततो द्रुतम्
यूथाद् इव परिभ्रष्टान् मृगान् निहत यूथपान्
transliteration: sā dadarśa tataḥ trastān harīn āpatato drutam
yūthād iva paribhraṣṭān mṛgān nihata yūthapān
english: Thereupon Tārā observed those monkeys flying away terrified like to deer alienated from their herd, having lost their king.

sanskrit: तान् उवाच समासाद्य दुःखितान् दुःखिता सती
राम वित्रासितान् सर्वान् अनुबद्धान् इव इषुभिः
transliteration: tān uvāca samāsādya duḥkhitān duḥkhitā satī
rāma vitrāsitān sarvān anubaddhān iva iṣubhiḥ
english: The chaste lady, racked with sorrow, spoke to those monkeys, afraid of Rāma, wounded with shafts and exercised with grief, saying,

sanskrit: वानरा राज सिंहस्य यस्य यूयम् पुरः सराः
तम् विहाय सुवित्रस्ताः कस्माद् द्रवत दुर्गताः
transliteration: vānarā rāja siṃhasya yasya yūyam puraḥ sarāḥ
tam vihāya suvitrastāḥ kasmād dravata durgatāḥ
english: O monkeys, why are you flying away, terrified and distressed, leaving behind that foremost of kings before whom you were used to fight?

sanskrit: राज्य हेतोः स चेत् भ्राता भ्रात्रा कॄरेण पातितः
रामेण प्रसृतैः दूरात् मार्गणैः दूर पातिभिः
transliteration: rājya hetoḥ sa cet bhrātā bhrātrā kṝreṇa pātitaḥ
rāmeṇa prasṛtaiḥ dūrāt mārgaṇaiḥ dūra pātibhiḥ
english: Hath Vāli been killed by Rāma, waiting at a distance with fleet and distant-coursing shafts, being requested by Sugrīva for kingdom?

sanskrit: कपि पत्न्या वचः श्रुत्वा कपयः काम रूपिणः
प्राप्त कालम् अविश्लिष्टम् ऊचुर् वचनम् अंगनाम्
transliteration: kapi patnyā vacaḥ śrutvā kapayaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ
prāpta kālam aviśliṣṭam ūcur vacanam aṃganām
english: Hearing the words of that wife of the monkey, they, wearing shapes at will, addressed that damsel with words, worthy of being said on that occasion,

sanskrit: जीवपुत्रे निवर्तस्व पुत्रम् रक्षस्व च अन्दगम्
अंतको राम रूपेण हत्वा नयति वालिनम्
transliteration: jīvaputre nivartasva putram rakṣasva ca andagam
aṃtako rāma rūpeṇa hatvā nayati vālinam
english: O you, having your son alive, do you go back and bring up your son Angada. Death himself, under Rāma's semblance, has snatched away Vāli.

sanskrit: क्षिप्तान् वृक्षान् समाविध्य विपुलाः च शिलाः तथा
वाली वज्र समैर् बाणैर् वज्रेण इव निपातितः
transliteration: kṣiptān vṛkṣān samāvidhya vipulāḥ ca śilāḥ tathā
vālī vajra samair bāṇair vajreṇa iva nipātitaḥ
english: He was killed by (Rāma's) shafts, resembling thunderbolts as if clapped by thunder itself, having bored trees and big stones (hurled by Vali).

sanskrit: अभिभूतम् इदम् सर्वम् विद्रुतम् वानरम् बलम्
अस्मिन् प्लवग शार्दूले हते शक्र सम प्रभे
transliteration: abhibhūtam idam sarvam vidrutam vānaram balam
asmin plavaga śārdūle hate śakra sama prabhe
english: That king of monkeys, having Sakra's prowess, being made away with this host of monkeys have been taking to their heels being overwhelmed with consternation.

sanskrit: रक्ष्यताम् नगरम् शूरैर् अंगदः च अभिषिच्यताम्
transliteration: rakṣyatām nagaram śūrair aṃgadaḥ ca abhiṣicyatām
english: Let the heroes defend the city and install Angada on the throne. And on his being installed the monkeys shall serve Vāli's son.

sanskrit: अथवा अरुचितम् स्थानम् इह ते रुचिरानने
आविशन्ति हि दुर्गाणि क्षिप्रम् अद्य एव वानराः
transliteration: athavā arucitam sthānam iha te rucirānane
āviśanti hi durgāṇi kṣipram adya eva vānarāḥ
english: O you having a fine countenance, the monkeys shall enter this stronghold, although it is a favourite place with you. Herein dwell many forest-rangers, wifeless and having wives. And we are really afraid of them, avaricious, and formerly deprived of their wealth by us.

sanskrit: अभार्याः सह भार्याः च सन्ति अत्र वन चारिणः
लुब्धेभ्यो विप्रलब्धेयः तेभ्यो नः सुमहद् भयम्
transliteration: abhāryāḥ saha bhāryāḥ ca santi atra vana cāriṇaḥ
lubdhebhyo vipralabdheyaḥ tebhyo naḥ sumahad bhayam
english: O you having a fine countenance, the monkeys shall enter this stronghold, although it is a favourite place with you. Herein dwell many forest-rangers, wifeless and having wives. And we are really afraid of them, avaricious, and formerly deprived of their wealth by us.

sanskrit: अल्पांतर गतानाम् तु श्रुत्वा वचनम् अंगना
आत्मनः प्रतिरूपम् सा बभाषे चारु हासिनी
transliteration: alpāṃtara gatānām tu śrutvā vacanam aṃganā
ātmanaḥ pratirūpam sā babhāṣe cāru hāsinī
english: Hearing those words of the monkeys, lying at a little distance, that lady, smiling sweet, spoke to them, words worthy of herself.

sanskrit: पुत्रेण मम किम् कार्यम् किम् राज्येन किम् आत्मना
कपि सिम्हे महा भागे तस्मिन् भर्तरि नश्यति
transliteration: putreṇa mama kim kāryam kim rājyena kim ātmanā
kapi simhe mahā bhāge tasmin bhartari naśyati
english: That great lord of monkeys, my husband, being dead, what shall I do with my son, my kingdom and myself?

sanskrit: पाद मूलम् गमिष्यामि तस्य एव अहम् महात्मनः
यो असौ राम प्रयुक्तेन शरेण विनिपातितः
transliteration: pāda mūlam gamiṣyāmi tasya eva aham mahātmanaḥ
yo asau rāma prayuktena śareṇa vinipātitaḥ
english: I shall place myself at the feet of that highsouled one, who has been killed by Rama's shaft.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा प्रदुद्राव रुदती शोक मूर्च्छिता
शिरः च उरः च बाहुभ्याम् दुःखेन समभिघ्नती
transliteration: evam uktvā pradudrāva rudatī śoka mūrcchitā
śiraḥ ca uraḥ ca bāhubhyām duḥkhena samabhighnatī
english: Having said this, (Tara) proceeded, overwhelmed with grief, weeping and striking her head with her hands.

sanskrit: सा व्रजन्ती ददर्श अथ पतिम् निपतितम् भुवि
transliteration: sā vrajantī dadarśa atha patim nipatitam bhuvi

sanskrit: क्षेप्तारम् पर्वत इन्द्राणाम् वज्राणाम् इव वासवम्
transliteration: kṣeptāram parvata indrāṇām vajrāṇām iva vāsavam

sanskrit: शक्रतुल्य पराक्रांतम् वृष्ट्वा इव उपरतम् घनम्
नर्दन्तम् नर्दताम् भीमम् शूरम् शूरेण पातितम्
शार्दूलेन आमिषस्य अर्थे मृग राजम् इव आहतम्
transliteration: śakratulya parākrāṃtam vṛṣṭvā iva uparatam ghanam
nardantam nardatām bhīmam śūram śūreṇa pātitam
śārdūlena āmiṣasya arthe mṛga rājam iva āhatam

sanskrit: नाग हेतोः सुपर्णेन चैत्यम् उन्मथितम् यथा
transliteration: nāga hetoḥ suparṇena caityam unmathitam yathā

sanskrit: रामम् रामानुजम् चैव भर्तुः चैव तथा अनुजम्
transliteration: rāmam rāmānujam caiva bhartuḥ caiva tathā anujam
english: She espied Rāma reclining his person on a mighty bow, his younger brother and her husband's younger brother.

sanskrit: तान् अतीत्य समासाद्य भर्तारम् निहतम् रणे
समीक्ष्य व्यथिता भूमौ संभ्रांता निपपात ह
transliteration: tān atītya samāsādya bhartāram nihatam raṇe
samīkṣya vyathitā bhūmau saṃbhrāṃtā nipapāta ha
english: Passing them by and getting at her husband and beholding him killed in battle, she, losing her sense, fell down to the ground.

sanskrit: सुप्ता इव पुनर् उत्थाय आर्य पुत्र इति वादिनी
रुरोद सा पतिम् दृष्ट्वा सम्वीतम् मृत्यु दामभिः
transliteration: suptā iva punar utthāya ārya putra iti vādinī
ruroda sā patim dṛṣṭvā samvītam mṛtyu dāmabhiḥ
english: And thereupon rising again like one asleep, she, beholding her husband engarlanded by death, cried aloud, exclaiming O son of worshipful sire.

sanskrit: ताम् अवेक्ष्य तु सुग्रीवः क्रोशन्तीम् कुररीम् इव
विषादम् अगमत् कष्टम् दृष्ट्वा च अंगदम् आगतम्
transliteration: tām avekṣya tu sugrīvaḥ krośantīm kurarīm iva
viṣādam agamat kaṣṭam dṛṣṭvā ca aṃgadam āgatam
english: And beholding Tārā like to a she-elephant and Angada, bewailing in this wise, Sugrīva attained to an excess of grief.

sanskrit: राम चाप विसृष्टेन शरेण अंतकरेण तम्
दृष्ट्वा विनिहतम् भूमौ तारा ताराधिप आनना
transliteration: rāma cāpa visṛṣṭena śareṇa aṃtakareṇa tam
dṛṣṭvā vinihatam bhūmau tārā tārādhipa ānanā

sanskrit: वानरम् पर्वत इन्द्र आभम् शोक संतप्त मानसा
तारा तरुम् इव उन्मूलम् पर्यदेवयत् आतुरा
transliteration: vānaram parvata indra ābham śoka saṃtapta mānasā
tārā tarum iva unmūlam paryadevayat āturā

sanskrit: रणे दारुण विक्रान्त प्रवीर प्लवताम् वर
किम् इदीनाम् पुरो भागाम् अद्य त्वम् न अभिभाषसे
transliteration: raṇe dāruṇa vikrānta pravīra plavatām vara
kim idīnām puro bhāgām adya tvam na abhibhāṣase
english: O hero, O foremost of monkeys, O powerful one, O you terrible in warfare, why did you not welcome me to-day who am guilty of some iniquity by you?

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठ हरि शार्दूल भजस्व शयन उत्तमम्
न एवम् विधाः शेरते हि भूमौ नृपति सत्तमाः
transliteration: uttiṣṭha hari śārdūla bhajasva śayana uttamam
na evam vidhāḥ śerate hi bhūmau nṛpati sattamāḥ
english: Rise, O best of monkeys, and lie down on a better bed; monarchs do not stretch themselves on earth.

sanskrit: अतीव खलु ते कांता वसुधा वसुधाधिप
गत असुर् अपि ताम् गात्रैः माम् विहाय निषेवसे
transliteration: atīva khalu te kāṃtā vasudhā vasudhādhipa
gata asur api tām gātraiḥ mām vihāya niṣevase
english: O lord of earth, indeed earth is your favourite wife; since renouncing me, you, though dead, are serving her with your body.

sanskrit: व्यक्तम् अद्य त्वया वीर धर्मतः संप्रवर्तता
किष्किंधा इव पुरी रम्या स्वर्ग मार्गे विनिर्मिता
transliteration: vyaktam adya tvayā vīra dharmataḥ saṃpravartatā
kiṣkiṃdhā iva purī ramyā svarga mārge vinirmitā
english: Evident it is, O hero, that while engaged in a lawful conflict, you hadst created another city of Kiskindha, in the region of the celestials.

sanskrit: यानि अस्माभिः त्वया सार्धम् वनेषु मधु गंधिषु
विहृतानि त्वया काले तेषाम् उपरमः कृतः
transliteration: yāni asmābhiḥ tvayā sārdham vaneṣu madhu gaṃdhiṣu
vihṛtāni tvayā kāle teṣām uparamaḥ kṛtaḥ
english: All your enjoyments with me in nectarsmelling woods, have been brought to a close.

sanskrit: निरानंदा निराशा अहम् निमग्ना शोक सागरे
transliteration: nirānaṃdā nirāśā aham nimagnā śoka sāgare
english: You, the lord of monkey-herds, being slain, I am deprived of joy and hope and am sunk in the abyss of grief.

sanskrit: हृदयम् सुस्थिरम् मह्यम् दृष्ट्वा विनिहतम् भुवि
यन् न शोक अभिसंतप्तम् स्फुटते अद्य सहस्रधा
transliteration: hṛdayam susthiram mahyam dṛṣṭvā vinihatam bhuvi
yan na śoka abhisaṃtaptam sphuṭate adya sahasradhā
english: Forsooth, my heart is uncommon hard, since beholding you on the ground it has not been sundered into thousand pieces being overwhelmed with grief.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्य त्वया भार्या हृता स च विवासितः
यत् तत् तस्य त्वया व्युष्टिः प्राप्ता इयम् प्लवगाधिप
transliteration: sugrīvasya tvayā bhāryā hṛtā sa ca vivāsitaḥ
yat tat tasya tvayā vyuṣṭiḥ prāptā iyam plavagādhipa
english: Sugrīva's wife was carried away and banished by you and this is the result of your action, O foremost of monkeys.

sanskrit: निःश्रेयस परा मोहात् त्वया च अहम् विगर्हिता
या एषा अब्रुवम् हितम् वाक्यम् वानरेन्द्र हित एषिणी
transliteration: niḥśreyasa parā mohāt tvayā ca aham vigarhitā
yā eṣā abruvam hitam vākyam vānarendra hita eṣiṇī
english: O lord of monkeys, out of your ignorance you didst neglect all my well meaning words which I said, being intent on your welfare and benefit.

sanskrit: रूप यौवन दृप्तानाम् दक्षिणानाम् च मानद
transliteration: rūpa yauvana dṛptānām dakṣiṇānām ca mānada
english: O worshipful one, you shall captivate today, the hearts of the dextrous Apsarās, proud of their youth and beauty.

sanskrit: कालो निःसंशयो नूनम् जीवित अंतकरः तव
बलात् येन अवपन्नो असि सुग्रीवस्य अवशो वशम्
transliteration: kālo niḥsaṃśayo nūnam jīvita aṃtakaraḥ tava
balāt yena avapanno asi sugrīvasya avaśo vaśam
english: Forsooth, you had been by force brought under the control of Kāla, since you had been discomfited by Sugrīva, albeit you are above the control of others.

sanskrit: अस्थाने वालिनम् हत्वा युध्यमानम् परेण च
transliteration: asthāne vālinam hatvā yudhyamānam pareṇa ca
english: Destroying Vāli unseasonably, while engaged in conflict with another person, and perpetrating such an iniquitous deed Kākutstha does never relent.

sanskrit: वैधव्यम् शोक संतापम् कृपणम् अकृपणा सती
transliteration: vaidhavyam śoka saṃtāpam kṛpaṇam akṛpaṇā satī
english: Unused to miseries before how shall I, being an object commiseration, put up like one helpless, with my widow-hood and grief.

sanskrit: लालितः च अंगदो वीरः सुकुमारः सुखोचितः
वत्स्यते काम् अवस्थाम् मे पितृव्ये क्रोध मूर्च्छिते
transliteration: lālitaḥ ca aṃgado vīraḥ sukumāraḥ sukhocitaḥ
vatsyate kām avasthām me pitṛvye krodha mūrcchite
english: How shall the heroic and youthful Angada, brought up in luxury and happiness, be regarded by his uncle, senseless with wrath?

sanskrit: कुरुष्व पितरम् पुत्र सुदृष्टम् धर्म वत्सलम्
दुर्लभम् दर्शनम् तस्य तव वत्स भविष्यति
transliteration: kuruṣva pitaram putra sudṛṣṭam dharma vatsalam
durlabham darśanam tasya tava vatsa bhaviṣyati
english: Do you cast for good, O my son, your looks towards your pious sire, for since now it will be hard for you to see him again.

sanskrit: समाश्वासय पुत्रम् त्वम् संदेशम् संदिशस्व मे
मूर्ध्नि च एनम् समाघ्राय प्रवासम् प्रस्थितो हि असि
transliteration: samāśvāsaya putram tvam saṃdeśam saṃdiśasva me
mūrdhni ca enam samāghrāya pravāsam prasthito hi asi
english: Do you console your son, favour me with orders, smell his head, as you are going to journey in a foreign land.

sanskrit: रामेण हि महत् कर्म कृतम् त्वाम् अभिनिघ्नता
आनृण्यम् तु गतम् तस्य सुग्रीवस्य प्रतिश्रवे
transliteration: rāmeṇa hi mahat karma kṛtam tvām abhinighnatā
ānṛṇyam tu gatam tasya sugrīvasya pratiśrave
english: By destroying you, Rāma, has performed a great action, since by this he has been released from his vow to Sugriva.

sanskrit: सकामो भव सुग्रीव रुमाम् त्वम् प्रतिपत्स्यसे
भुंक्ष्व राज्यम् अनुद्विग्नः शस्तो भ्राता रिपुः तव
transliteration: sakāmo bhava sugrīva rumām tvam pratipatsyase
bhuṃkṣva rājyam anudvignaḥ śasto bhrātā ripuḥ tava
english: O Sugrīva, do you gain your ends and get back your Rumā, devoid of anxiety do you govern your kingdom-your enemy, the brother has been slain.

sanskrit: किम् माम् एवम् प्रलपतीम् प्रियाम् त्वम् न अभिभाषसे
इमाः पश्य वरा बह्वयः भार्याः ते वानरेश्वर
transliteration: kim mām evam pralapatīm priyām tvam na abhibhāṣase
imāḥ paśya varā bahvayaḥ bhāryāḥ te vānareśvara
english: O lord of monkeys, why did you not welcome me, your beloved spouse, who am bewailing thus? Behold, your other wives are also mourning in the same wise.

sanskrit: तस्या विलपितम् श्रुत्वा वानर्यः सर्वतः च ताः
परिगृह्य अंगदम् दीना दुह्ख आर्ताः परिचुक्रुशुः
transliteration: tasyā vilapitam śrutvā vānaryaḥ sarvataḥ ca tāḥ
parigṛhya aṃgadam dīnā duhkha ārtāḥ paricukruśuḥ
english: Hearing the bewailings of that she-monkey, others, taking Angada, distressed and overwhelmed with grief, began to cry piteously.

sanskrit: किम् अंगदम् स अंगद वीर बाहोविहाय यातो असि अद्य चिरम् प्रवासम्
न युक्तम् एवम् गुण संनिकृष्टम्विहाय पुत्रम् प्रिय पुत्रम् प्रिय चारु वेषम्
transliteration: kim aṃgadam sa aṃgada vīra bāhovihāya yāto asi adya ciram pravāsam
na yuktam evam guṇa saṃnikṛṣṭamvihāya putram priya putram priya cāru veṣam
english: O hero, having Arigada on your arms, why are you proceeding on a journey for good in a foreign land leaving behind (your son) Angada. It does not behove you (to leave aside) your dear son, gifted with diverse accomplishments and wearing a charming and beautiful cloth.

sanskrit: यदि अप्रियम् किंचिद् असंप्रधार्यकृतम् मया स्यात् तव दीर्घ बाहो
क्षमस्व मे तत् हरि वम्श नाथव्रजामि मूर्ध्ना तव वीर पादौ
transliteration: yadi apriyam kiṃcid asaṃpradhāryakṛtam mayā syāt tava dīrgha bāho
kṣamasva me tat hari vamśa nāthavrajāmi mūrdhnā tava vīra pādau
english: you of long arms, O lord of monkeys, if I have offended you in any way, do you forgive me, after ascertaining my crime.

sanskrit: तथा तु तारा करुणम् रुदंतीभर्तुः समीपे सह वानरीभिः
व्यवस्यत प्रायम् अनिन्द्य वर्णाउपोपवेष्टुम् भुवि यत्र वाली
transliteration: tathā tu tārā karuṇam rudaṃtībhartuḥ samīpe saha vānarībhiḥ
vyavasyata prāyam anindya varṇāupopaveṣṭum bhuvi yatra vālī
english: O hero, I touch your feet with my head. Bewailing thus piteously with other sbemonkeys, Tārā, having a blameless countenance, stationing herself where Vāli was, resolved to put an end to her being by fastings.

sanskrit: ततो निपतिताम् ताराम् च्युताम् ताराम् इव अंबरात्
transliteration: tato nipatitām tārām cyutām tārām iva aṃbarāt
english: Thereupon beholding Tārā fallen (on the ground) like to a star dropt down from the sky, Hanumān, the lord of monkey-herds, consoled her again and again.

sanskrit: गुण दोष कृतम् जंतुः स्वकर्म फल हेतुकम्
अव्यग्रः तद् अवाप्नोति सर्वम् प्रेत्य शुभ अशुभम्
transliteration: guṇa doṣa kṛtam jaṃtuḥ svakarma phala hetukam
avyagraḥ tad avāpnoti sarvam pretya śubha aśubham
english: Animals unagitated, attain to happiness or misery, as an outcome of their actions performed (in their previous existence) by merits or demerits.

sanskrit: शोच्या शोचसि कम् शोच्यम् दीनम् दीना अनुकंपसे
कः च कस्य अनुशोच्यो अस्ति देहे अस्मिन् बुद्बुद उपमे
transliteration: śocyā śocasi kam śocyam dīnam dīnā anukaṃpase
kaḥ ca kasya anuśocyo asti dehe asmin budbuda upame
english: Why did you mourn for others, yourself being an object of mourning? Why did you feel commiseration for the poor, yourself being poorly? In this body like to a bubble who is there who mourneth for another?

sanskrit: अंगदः तु कुमारो अयम् द्रष्टव्यो जीव पुत्रया
आयत्या च विधेयानि समर्थानि अस्य चिन्तय
transliteration: aṃgadaḥ tu kumāro ayam draṣṭavyo jīva putrayā
āyatyā ca vidheyāni samarthāni asya cintaya
english: It behoveth you now, O you having your son alive, to look after prince Angada and think of those duties which remain to be executed by you (after the demise of Vāli).

sanskrit: जानासि अनियताम् एवम् भूतानाम् आगतिम् गतिम्
तस्मात् शुभम् हि कर्तव्यम् पण्डितेन इह लौकिकम्
transliteration: jānāsi aniyatām evam bhūtānām āgatim gatim
tasmāt śubham hi kartavyam paṇḍitena iha laukikam
english: Do you know that life and death of the animals is very unsettled. It is therefore proper to perform what tends to the welfare of after-life. It does not behove you, O learned damsel, to mourn like others.

sanskrit: यस्मिन् हरि सहस्राणि शतानि नियुतानि च
वर्तयन्ति कृत आशानि सो अयम् दिष्टांतम् आगतः
transliteration: yasmin hari sahasrāṇi śatāni niyutāni ca
vartayanti kṛta āśāni so ayam diṣṭāṃtam āgataḥ
english: He even, who (while living) was surrounded by thousands of monkeys cherishing hopes, has met his destined end.

sanskrit: यद् अयम् न्याय दृष्ट अर्थः साम दान क्षमा परः
गतो धर्म जिताम् भूमिम् न एनम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: yad ayam nyāya dṛṣṭa arthaḥ sāma dāna kṣamā paraḥ
gato dharma jitām bhūmim na enam śocitum arhasi
english: This hero discharged his royal duties in consonance with the sanctions of morality and was gifted with various kingly accomplishments such as conciliation, clarity and forgiveness. He has attained to the land of kings and it becomes you not to mourn for him.

sanskrit: सर्वे च हरि शार्दूलाः पुत्रः च अयम् तव अंगदः
हरि ऋक्ष पति राज्यम् च त्वत् सनाथम् अनिन्दिते
transliteration: sarve ca hari śārdūlāḥ putraḥ ca ayam tava aṃgadaḥ
hari ṛkṣa pati rājyam ca tvat sanātham anindite
english: O blameless damsel, all these foremost of monkeys, this your son Angada, this kingdom of the monkey chief, do belong to you.

sanskrit: तौ इमौ शोक संतप्तौ शनैः प्रेरय भामिनि
त्वया परिगृहीतो अयम् अंगदः शास्तु मेदिनीम्
transliteration: tau imau śoka saṃtaptau śanaiḥ preraya bhāmini
tvayā parigṛhīto ayam aṃgadaḥ śāstu medinīm
english: Do you soon despatch, O passionate lady, these two (Angada and Sugrīva) exercised with grief as they are (for the performance of Vali's funeral rites). And abiding by your commandments let Angada govern the earth.

sanskrit: संततिः च यथा दृष्टा कृत्यम् यत् च अपि सांप्रतम्
राज्ञः तत् क्रियताम् सर्वम् एष कालस्य निश्चयः
transliteration: saṃtatiḥ ca yathā dṛṣṭā kṛtyam yat ca api sāṃpratam
rājñaḥ tat kriyatām sarvam eṣa kālasya niścayaḥ
english: Let Angada perform all those ceremonies, which should be gone through by sons according to the Šāstras and which are for the well-being of the king; this is the time for the performance of those funeral rites.

sanskrit: संस्कार्यो हरि राजः तु अंगदः च अभिषिच्यताम्
सिंहासन गतम् पुत्रम् पश्यन्ती शान्तिम् एष्यसि
transliteration: saṃskāryo hari rājaḥ tu aṃgadaḥ ca abhiṣicyatām
siṃhāsana gatam putram paśyantī śāntim eṣyasi
english: Performing the funeral ceremonies of the lord of monkeys do you install Angada. And beholding your son thus established on the throne you shall be able to pacify your grief?

sanskrit: सा तस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा भर्तृ व्यसन पीडिता
transliteration: sā tasya vacanam śrutvā bhartṛ vyasana pīḍitā
english: Hearing those words of Hanumān, Tārā, racked with grief consequent upon the loss of her lord, bespake him who was standing there:

sanskrit: हतस्य अपि अस्य वीरस्य गात्र संश्लेषणम् वरम्
transliteration: hatasya api asya vīrasya gātra saṃśleṣaṇam varam
english: I would rather die with this hero who has been slain than have hundred sons like Angada.

sanskrit: न च अहम् हरि राज्यस्य प्रभवामि अंगदस्य वा
पितृव्यः तस्य सुग्रीवः सर्व कार्येषुइ अनंतरः
transliteration: na ca aham hari rājyasya prabhavāmi aṃgadasya vā
pitṛvyaḥ tasya sugrīvaḥ sarva kāryeṣui anaṃtaraḥ
english: I cannot myself govern this kingdom nor can I confer it upon Angada. Such duty-devolves upon his (Angada's) uncle Sugrīva now.

sanskrit: न हि एषा बुद्धिः आस्थेया हनूमन् अंगदम् प्रति
पिता हि बंधुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरि सत्तम
transliteration: na hi eṣā buddhiḥ āstheyā hanūman aṃgadam prati
pitā hi baṃdhuḥ putrasya na mātā hari sattama
english: O Hanumān, do you not consider that I shall confer this kingdom upon Angada-0 best of monkeys, father is son's friend (in this respect) not mother.

sanskrit: न हि मम हरि राज संश्रयात्क्षमतरम् अस्ति परत्र च इह वा
अभिमुख हत वीर सेवितम्शयनम् इदम् मम सेवितुम् क्षमम्
transliteration: na hi mama hari rāja saṃśrayātkṣamataram asti paratra ca iha vā
abhimukha hata vīra sevitamśayanam idam mama sevitum kṣamam

sanskrit: वीक्षमाणः तु मंदासुः सर्वतो मंदम् उच्छ्वसन्
आदौ एव तु सुग्रीवम् ददर्श अनुजम् अग्रतः
transliteration: vīkṣamāṇaḥ tu maṃdāsuḥ sarvato maṃdam ucchvasan
ādau eva tu sugrīvam dadarśa anujam agrataḥ
english: Vāli, ranging on the verge of death, casting his looks arounds and sighing faintly, espied his younger brother Sugrīva before him.

sanskrit: तम् प्राप्त विजयम् वाली सुग्रीवम् प्लवग ईश्वरम्
आभाष्य व्यक्तया वाचा सस्नेहम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tam prāpta vijayam vālī sugrīvam plavaga īśvaram
ābhāṣya vyaktayā vācā sasneham idam abravīt
english: Welcoming that lord of monkeys with clear accents, Vāli addressed him affectionately saying.

sanskrit: सुग्रीव दोषेण न माम् गन्तुम् अर्हसि किल्बिषात्
कृष्यमाणम् भविष्येण बुद्धि मोहेन माम् बलात्
transliteration: sugrīva doṣeṇa na mām gantum arhasi kilbiṣāt
kṛṣyamāṇam bhaviṣyeṇa buddhi mohena mām balāt
english: O Sugrīva, do you not take to your heart the improper conduct I have shown towards you, being attracted by inevitable foolishness, subject as I was to sin.

sanskrit: युगपद् विहितम् तात न मन्ये सुखम् अवयोः
सौहार्दम् भ्रातृ युक्तम् हि तद् इदम् जातम् अन्यथा
transliteration: yugapad vihitam tāta na manye sukham avayoḥ
sauhārdam bhrātṛ yuktam hi tad idam jātam anyathā
english: Methinks, O brother, it is not our fortune to enjoy at the same time the double bliss of fraternal affection and the enjoyment of kingdom, or else why has it happened otherwise?

sanskrit: प्रतिपद्य त्वम् अद्य एव राज्यम् एषाम् वन ओकसाम्
माम् अपि अद्य एव गच्छंतम् विद्धि वैवस्वत क्षयम्
transliteration: pratipadya tvam adya eva rājyam eṣām vana okasām
mām api adya eva gacchaṃtam viddhi vaivasvata kṣayam
english: Do you acquire to-day this kingdom of the forest-ranges and know me as one who has departed to the abode of Death.

sanskrit: जीवितम् च हि राज्यम् च श्रियम् च विपुलाम् इमाम्
प्रजहामि एष वै तूर्णम् अहम् च अगर्हितम् यशः
transliteration: jīvitam ca hi rājyam ca śriyam ca vipulām imām
prajahāmi eṣa vai tūrṇam aham ca agarhitam yaśaḥ
english: Soon shall I renounce iny life, kingdom, my exquisite grace and my blameless fame.

sanskrit: अस्याम् त्वम् अहम् अवस्थायाम् वीर वक्ष्यामि यद् वचः
यदि अपि असुकरम् राजन् कर्तुम् एव तद् अर्हसि
transliteration: asyām tvam aham avasthāyām vīra vakṣyāmi yad vacaḥ
yadi api asukaram rājan kartum eva tad arhasi
english: It behoveth you, O hero, O king, to perform what I shall speak to you in this plight, however difficult it might be.

sanskrit: सुखार्हम् सुख संवृद्धम् बालम् एनम् अबालिशम्
बाष्प पूर्ण मुखम् पश्य भूमौ पतितम् अंगदम्
transliteration: sukhārham sukha saṃvṛddham bālam enam abāliśam
bāṣpa pūrṇa mukham paśya bhūmau patitam aṃgadam
english: Do you behold Angada fallen on the ground with tears in his eyes-a little boy, incapable, brought up in luxury and deserving happiness.

sanskrit: मम प्राणैः प्रियतरम् पुत्रम् पुत्रम् इव औरसम्
transliteration: mama prāṇaiḥ priyataram putram putram iva aurasam
english: Do you maintain this my son, dearer than my life, like to your own son, born of your loins, satisfying all his wants in my absence.

sanskrit: त्वम् अपि अस्य पिता दाता च परित्राता च सर्वतः
भयेषु अभयदः चैव यथा अहम् प्लवगेश्वर
transliteration: tvam api asya pitā dātā ca paritrātā ca sarvataḥ
bhayeṣu abhayadaḥ caiva yathā aham plavageśvara
english: O best of monkeys, like to me, you are his father, protector, conferrer of gifts and remover of fear.

sanskrit: एष तारात्मजः श्रीमान् त्वया तुल्य पराक्रमः
रक्षसाम् च वधे तेषाम् अग्रतः ते भविष्यति
transliteration: eṣa tārātmajaḥ śrīmān tvayā tulya parākramaḥ
rakṣasām ca vadhe teṣām agrataḥ te bhaviṣyati
english: This graceful son of Tārā equals you in prowess and shall precede you in the destruction of Raksasas.

sanskrit: करिष्यति एष तारेयः तरस्वी तरुणो अंगदः
transliteration: kariṣyati eṣa tāreyaḥ tarasvī taruṇo aṃgadaḥ
english: This youthful Angada, Tārā's son, gifted with energy and strength, shall perform befitting exploits displaying his prowess in the battle.

sanskrit: सुषेण दुहिता च इयम् अर्थ सूक्ष्म विनिश्चये
transliteration: suṣeṇa duhitā ca iyam artha sūkṣma viniścaye
english: Surasen's daughter is wonderfully expert in ascertaining sabtle things and giving counsels in the time of danger.

sanskrit: यद् एष साधु इति ब्रूयात् कार्यम् तन् मुक्त संशयम्
न हि तारा मतम् किंचित् अन्यथा परिवर्तते
transliteration: yad eṣa sādhu iti brūyāt kāryam tan mukta saṃśayam
na hi tārā matam kiṃcit anyathā parivartate
english: Do you, without the least doubt perform what shall the chaste lady instruct you to do; for Tārā's advice never goes without effect.

sanskrit: राघवस्य च ते कार्यम् कर्तव्यम् अविशंकया
स्यात् अधर्मो हि अकरणे त्वाम् च हिंस्यात् अमानितः
transliteration: rāghavasya ca te kāryam kartavyam aviśaṃkayā
syāt adharmo hi akaraṇe tvām ca hiṃsyāt amānitaḥ
english: It behoveth you to perform Rāghava's service fearlessly or else you shall be visited with sin: on his being insulted you shall be injured.

sanskrit: इमाम् च मालाम् आधत्स्व दिव्याम् सुग्रीव कांचनीम्
उदारा श्रीः स्थिता हि अस्याम् संप्रजह्यात् मृते मयि
transliteration: imām ca mālām ādhatsva divyām sugrīva kāṃcanīm
udārā śrīḥ sthitā hi asyām saṃprajahyāt mṛte mayi
english: O Sugrīva, do you put on this celestial golden garland-herein dwelleth the bounteous Sree who shall renounce me after my death.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्तः सुग्रीवो वालिना भ्रातृ सौहृदात्
हर्षम् त्यक्त्वा पुनर् दीनो ग्रह ग्रस्त इव उडु राट्
transliteration: iti evam uktaḥ sugrīvo vālinā bhrātṛ sauhṛdāt
harṣam tyaktvā punar dīno graha grasta iva uḍu rāṭ
english: Having been accosted thus by Vāli, out of fraternal affection, Sugrīva renouncing joy again became pale like to the Moon possessed by Rahu.

sanskrit: तत् वालि वचनात् शान्तः कुर्वन् युक्तम् अतंद्रितः
जग्राह सो अभ्यनुज्ञातो मालाम् ताम् चैव कांचनीम्
transliteration: tat vāli vacanāt śāntaḥ kurvan yuktam ataṃdritaḥ
jagrāha so abhyanujñāto mālām tām caiva kāṃcanīm
english: Renouncing his inimical feelings, being thus addressed by Vāli and carrying out his words energetically Sugrīva accepted the golden garland as ordered (by him).

sanskrit: ताम् मालाम् कांचनीम् दत्त्वा वाली दृष्ट्वा आत्मजम् स्थितम्
संसिद्धः प्रेत्य भावाय स्नेहात् अंगदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tām mālām kāṃcanīm dattvā vālī dṛṣṭvā ātmajam sthitam
saṃsiddhaḥ pretya bhāvāya snehāt aṃgadam abravīt
english: And conferring (upon Sugrīva) that golden garland and beholding his son before him, Vāli, resolved upon death, spoke to Angada, saying.

sanskrit: देश कालौ भजस्व अद्य क्षममाणः प्रिय अप्रिये
सुख दुःख सहः काले सुग्रीव वशगो भव
transliteration: deśa kālau bhajasva adya kṣamamāṇaḥ priya apriye
sukha duḥkha sahaḥ kāle sugrīva vaśago bhava
english: Do you place yourself now under the control of Sugrīva, ascertaining time and place, putting up with misery for your welfare and injury.

sanskrit: यथा हि त्वम् महाबाहो लालितः सततम् मया
न तथा वर्तमानम् त्वाम् सुग्रीवो बहु मन्यते
transliteration: yathā hi tvam mahābāho lālitaḥ satatam mayā
na tathā vartamānam tvām sugrīvo bahu manyate
english: O you having long arms, Sugrīva shall not regard you much, if did you remain in the same wise in which you hadst been brought up by me before*. The significance of the passage is as follows:You wert a mere child while I brought you up. But now you are a grown up young man and this is the time for you to serve your elders. Do you therefore serve Sugriva.

sanskrit: ना अस्य अमित्रैः गतम् गच्छेः मा शत्रुभिः अरिंदम
भर्तुः अर्थ परो दान्तः सुग्रीव वशगो भव
transliteration: nā asya amitraiḥ gatam gaccheḥ mā śatrubhiḥ ariṃdama
bhartuḥ artha paro dāntaḥ sugrīva vaśago bhava
english: O slayer of foes, do you never mix with Sugrīva's enemies, and place yourself always under Sugrīva's control, having subdued your senses and being intent upon your master's (Sugriva's) welfare.

sanskrit: न च अतिप्रणयः कार्यः कर्तव्यो अप्रणयः च ते
उभयम् हि महादोषम् तस्मात् अंतर दृक् भव
transliteration: na ca atipraṇayaḥ kāryaḥ kartavyo apraṇayaḥ ca te
ubhayam hi mahādoṣam tasmāt aṃtara dṛk bhava
english: Do you not cultivate too much of friendship nor be wanting in it-for both of these extremes are sources of disasters. Do you therefore follow the golden mean.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा अथ विवृत्त अक्षः शर संपीडितो भृशम्
विवृतैः दशनैः भीमैः बभूव उत्क्रान्त जीवितः
transliteration: iti uktvā atha vivṛtta akṣaḥ śara saṃpīḍito bhṛśam
vivṛtaiḥ daśanaiḥ bhīmaiḥ babhūva utkrānta jīvitaḥ
english: After he had said this, his eyes became expanded, his teeth were opened and his appearance became ghastly. And greatly pained by shafts he breathed his last.

sanskrit: ततो विचुक्रुशुर् तत्र वानरा हत यूथपाः
transliteration: tato vicukruśur tatra vānarā hata yūthapāḥ
english: And thereupon, the monkeys, the foremost of those who go jumping, having lost their chief, bewailed and cried.

sanskrit: किष्किन्धा हि अथ शून्या च स्वर् गते वानरेश्वरे
उद्यानानि च शून्यानि पर्वताः कानानि च
transliteration: kiṣkindhā hi atha śūnyā ca svar gate vānareśvare
udyānāni ca śūnyāni parvatāḥ kānāni ca
english: On that monkey chief's departure to the land of celestials, Kişkindhā was divested of her lord, and gardens, hills and woods were all rendered lonely.

sanskrit: हते प्लवग शार्दूले निष् प्रभा वानराः कृताः
यस्य वेगेन महता काननानि वनानि च
transliteration: hate plavaga śārdūle niṣ prabhā vānarāḥ kṛtāḥ
yasya vegena mahatā kānanāni vanāni ca

sanskrit: पुष्प ओघेण अनुबद्धन्ते करिष्यति तत् अद्य कहः
येन दत्तम् महत् युद्धम् गन्धर्वस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: puṣpa ogheṇa anubaddhante kariṣyati tat adya kahaḥ
yena dattam mahat yuddham gandharvasya mahātmanaḥ

sanskrit: गोलभस्य महाबाहुः दश वर्षाणि पंच च
न एव रात्रौ न दिवसे तत् युद्धम् उपशाम्यति
transliteration: golabhasya mahābāhuḥ daśa varṣāṇi paṃca ca
na eva rātrau na divase tat yuddham upaśāmyati

sanskrit: तम् हत्वा दुर्विनीतिम् तु वाली दंष्ट्र करालवान्
सर्वा अभयम् करः अस्माकम् कथम् एष निपातितः
transliteration: tam hatvā durvinītim tu vālī daṃṣṭra karālavān
sarvā abhayam karaḥ asmākam katham eṣa nipātitaḥ

sanskrit: हते तु वीरे प्लवगाधिपे तदाप्लवंगमाः तत्र न शर्म लेभिरे
वने चराः सिंह युते महावनेयथा हि गावो निहते गवाम् पतौ
transliteration: hate tu vīre plavagādhipe tadāplavaṃgamāḥ tatra na śarma lebhire
vane carāḥ siṃha yute mahāvaneyathā hi gāvo nihate gavām patau
english: Like to kine, incapable of enjoying peace in a mighty forest filled with lions, their chief being dead, these forest-rangers could not attain to felicity on the demise of that lord of monkeys.

sanskrit: ततः तु तारा व्यसन अर्णव प्लुतामृतस्या भर्तुर् वदनम् समीक्ष्य सा
जगाम भूमिम् परिरभ्य वालिनम्महा द्रुमम् छिन्नम् इव आश्रिता लता
transliteration: tataḥ tu tārā vyasana arṇava plutāmṛtasyā bhartur vadanam samīkṣya sā
jagāma bhūmim parirabhya vālinammahā drumam chinnam iva āśritā latā
english: Thereupon, Tārā, sunk in the gulf of disaster, eyeing the countenance of her deceased lord, fell down to the ground embracing Vāli like to a creeper clinging for its support to a mighty but broken tree.

sanskrit: ततः समुपजिघ्रंती कपि राजस्य तत् मुखम्
पतिम् लोकश्रुता तारा मृतम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ samupajighraṃtī kapi rājasya tat mukham
patim lokaśrutā tārā mṛtam vacanam abravīt
english: Thereupon smelling the face of that lord of monkeys, Tārā again addressed her deceased lord, known all over the world, saying.

sanskrit: शेषे त्वम् विषमे दुःखम् अकृत्वा वचनम् मम
उपल उपचिते वीर सुदुःखे वसुधा तले
transliteration: śeṣe tvam viṣame duḥkham akṛtvā vacanam mama
upala upacite vīra suduḥkhe vasudhā tale
english: O hero, disregarding my words, you are lying on the uneven earth, hard and filled with gravels.

sanskrit: मत्तः प्रियतरा नूनम् वानरेन्द्र मही तव
शेषे हि ताम् परिष्वज्य माम् च न प्रतिभाषसे
transliteration: mattaḥ priyatarā nūnam vānarendra mahī tava
śeṣe hi tām pariṣvajya mām ca na pratibhāṣase
english: O lord of monkeys, the earth is dearer to you than I, since you are lying there embracing her and are not welcoming me.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्य वशम् प्राप्तो विधिः एष भवत्य अहो
सुग्रीव एव विक्रांतो वीर साहसिक प्रिय
transliteration: sugrīvasya vaśam prāpto vidhiḥ eṣa bhavatya aho
sugrīva eva vikrāṃto vīra sāhasika priya
english: O hero, O dear, O brave lord, wonder it is that God under the semblance of Rāma, has placed himself under the control of Sugrīva; hither to fore he shall be regarded as a hero.

sanskrit: ऋक्ष वानर मुख्याः त्वाम् बलिनम् पर्युपासते
तेषाम् विलपितम् कृच्छ्रम् अंगदस्य च शोचतः
transliteration: ṛkṣa vānara mukhyāḥ tvām balinam paryupāsate
teṣām vilapitam kṛcchram aṃgadasya ca śocataḥ
english: Why are you not awake, hearing the bewailings of bears and monkeys who used to wait upon you, powerful, as well as that of Angada and myself?

sanskrit: मम च इमा गिरः श्रुत्वा किम् त्वम् न प्रतिबुध्यसे
इदम् तत् वीर शयनम् तत्र शेषे हतो युधि
transliteration: mama ca imā giraḥ śrutvā kim tvam na pratibudhyase
idam tat vīra śayanam tatra śeṣe hato yudhi

sanskrit: शायिता निहता यत्र त्वया एव रिपवः पुरा
विशुद्ध सत्त्व अभिजन प्रिययुद्ध मम प्रिय
transliteration: śāyitā nihatā yatra tvayā eva ripavaḥ purā
viśuddha sattva abhijana priyayuddha mama priya

sanskrit: माम् अनाथाम् विहाय एकाम् गतः त्वम् असि मानद
शूराय न प्रदातव्या कन्या खलु विपश्चिता
transliteration: mām anāthām vihāya ekām gataḥ tvam asi mānada
śūrāya na pradātavyā kanyā khalu vipaścitā

sanskrit: शूर भार्याम् हताम् पश्य सद्यो माम् विधवाम् कृताम्
अवभग्नः च मे मानो भग्ना मे शाश्वती गतिः
transliteration: śūra bhāryām hatām paśya sadyo mām vidhavām kṛtām
avabhagnaḥ ca me māno bhagnā me śāśvatī gatiḥ

sanskrit: अगाधे च निमग्ना अस्मि विपुले शोक सागरे
अश्म सारमयम् नूनम् इदम् मे हृदयम् दृढम्
transliteration: agādhe ca nimagnā asmi vipule śoka sāgare
aśma sāramayam nūnam idam me hṛdayam dṛḍham

sanskrit: भर्तारम् निहतम् दृष्ट्वा यत् न अद्य शतधा गतम्
सुहृत् चैव हि भर्ता च प्रकृत्या च मम प्रियः
transliteration: bhartāram nihatam dṛṣṭvā yat na adya śatadhā gatam
suhṛt caiva hi bhartā ca prakṛtyā ca mama priyaḥ

sanskrit: प्रहारे च पराक्रान्तः शूरः पंचत्वम् आगतः
पति हीना तु या नारी कामम् भवतु पुत्रिणी
transliteration: prahāre ca parākrāntaḥ śūraḥ paṃcatvam āgataḥ
pati hīnā tu yā nārī kāmam bhavatu putriṇī

sanskrit: धन धान्य समृद्धा अपि विधवा इति उच्यते जनैः
स्व गात्र प्रभवे वीर शेषे रुधिर मण्डले
transliteration: dhana dhānya samṛddhā api vidhavā iti ucyate janaiḥ
sva gātra prabhave vīra śeṣe rudhira maṇḍale

sanskrit: कृमि राग परिस्तोमे स्वकीये शयने यथा
रेणु शोणित संवीतम् गात्रम् तव समंततः
transliteration: kṛmi rāga paristome svakīye śayane yathā
reṇu śoṇita saṃvītam gātram tava samaṃtataḥ

sanskrit: कृत कृत्यो अद्य सुग्रीवो वैरे अस्मिन् अतिदारुणे
transliteration: kṛta kṛtyo adya sugrīvo vaire asmin atidāruṇe

sanskrit: यस्य राम विमुक्तेन हृतम् एक इषुणा भयम्
शरेण हृदि लग्नेन गात्र संस्पर्शने तव
transliteration: yasya rāma vimuktena hṛtam eka iṣuṇā bhayam
śareṇa hṛdi lagnena gātra saṃsparśane tava

sanskrit: वार्यामि त्वाम् निरीक्षन्ती त्वयि पंचत्वम् आगते
उद्बबर्ह शरम् नीलः तस्य गात्र गतम् तदा
transliteration: vāryāmi tvām nirīkṣantī tvayi paṃcatvam āgate
udbabarha śaram nīlaḥ tasya gātra gatam tadā

sanskrit: गिरि गह्वर संलीनम् दीप्तम् आशी विषम् यथा
तस्य निष्कृष्यमाणस्य बाणस्य च बभौ द्युतिः
transliteration: giri gahvara saṃlīnam dīptam āśī viṣam yathā
tasya niṣkṛṣyamāṇasya bāṇasya ca babhau dyutiḥ

sanskrit: अस्त मस्तक संरुद्धो रश्मिः दिनकरात् इव
पेतुः क्षतज धाराः तु व्रणेभ्यः तस्य सर्वशः
transliteration: asta mastaka saṃruddho raśmiḥ dinakarāt iva
petuḥ kṣataja dhārāḥ tu vraṇebhyaḥ tasya sarvaśaḥ

sanskrit: ताम्र गैरिक संपृक्ता धारा इव धरा धरात्
transliteration: tāmra gairika saṃpṛktā dhārā iva dharā dharāt
