sanskrit: अस्रैः नयनजैः शूरम् सिषेच अस्त्र समाहतम्
transliteration: asraiḥ nayanajaiḥ śūram siṣeca astra samāhatam

sanskrit: उवाच तारा पिंगाक्षम् पुत्रम् अंगदम् अंगना
अवस्थाम् पश्चिमाम् पश्य पितुः पुत्र सुदारुणाम्
transliteration: uvāca tārā piṃgākṣam putram aṃgadam aṃganā
avasthām paścimām paśya pituḥ putra sudāruṇām

sanskrit: संप्रसक्तस्य वैरस्य गतो अन्तः पाप कर्मणा
बाल सूर्योज्ज्वल तनुम् प्रयातम् यम सादनम्
transliteration: saṃprasaktasya vairasya gato antaḥ pāpa karmaṇā
bāla sūryojjvala tanum prayātam yama sādanam

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणौ पितुः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ samutthāya jagrāha caraṇau pituḥ

sanskrit: भुजाभ्याम् पीन वृताभ्याम् अंगदो अहम् इति ब्रुवन्
अभिवादयमानम् त्वाम् अंगदम् त्वम् यथा पुरा
transliteration: bhujābhyām pīna vṛtābhyām aṃgado aham iti bruvan
abhivādayamānam tvām aṃgadam tvam yathā purā

sanskrit: दीर्घ आयुर् भव पुत्र इति किम् अर्थम् न अभिभाषसे
अहम् पुत्र सहाया त्वाम् उपासे गत चेतनम्
सिंहेन पातितम् सद्यो गौः स वत्सा इव गो वृषम्
transliteration: dīrgha āyur bhava putra iti kim artham na abhibhāṣase
aham putra sahāyā tvām upāse gata cetanam
siṃhena pātitam sadyo gauḥ sa vatsā iva go vṛṣam
english: I am with my son, standing by you who are dead, like to a cow with her calf, having the bull slain by a lion.

sanskrit: इष्ट्वा संग्राम यज्ञेन राम प्रहरण अंभसा
अस्मिन् अवभृथे स्नातः कथम् पत्न्या मया विना
transliteration: iṣṭvā saṃgrāma yajñena rāma praharaṇa aṃbhasā
asmin avabhṛthe snātaḥ katham patnyā mayā vinā
english: How have you, without me, your wife, bathed in the water of Rāma's shafts, at the end of your battle-like sacrifice? Why do I not behold here that favourite golden garland of thine, which was conferred on you by the lord of celestials, pleased in a battle?

sanskrit: या दत्ता देव राजेन तव तुष्टेन संयुगे
शात कौम्भीम् प्रियाम् मालाम् ताम् ते पश्यामि न इह किम्
transliteration: yā dattā deva rājena tava tuṣṭena saṃyuge
śāta kaumbhīm priyām mālām tām te paśyāmi na iha kim
english: How have you, without me, your wife, bathed in the water of Rāma's shafts, at the end of your battle-like sacrifice? Why do I not behold here that favourite golden garland of thine, which was conferred on you by the lord of celestials, pleased in a battle?

sanskrit: राज्यश्रीः न जहाति त्वाम् गत असुम् अपि मानद
सूर्यस्य आवर्तमानस्य शैल राजम् इव प्रभा
transliteration: rājyaśrīḥ na jahāti tvām gata asum api mānada
sūryasya āvartamānasya śaila rājam iva prabhā
english: Royal grace has not renounced you, O conferrer of honours, albeit you are dead, like to the rays not quitting the king of mountains, even after the Sun is set.

sanskrit: न मे वचः पथ्यम् इदम् त्वया कृतम्न च अस्मि शक्ता हि निवारणे तव
हता सपुत्रा अस्मि हतेन संयुगेसह त्वया श्रीः विजहाति माम् अपि
transliteration: na me vacaḥ pathyam idam tvayā kṛtamna ca asmi śaktā hi nivāraṇe tava
hatā saputrā asmi hatena saṃyugesaha tvayā śrīḥ vijahāti mām api
english: You didst not act by my wholesome words, nor could I prevent you. And I am now destroyed with my son, along with you in the battle. Truly has Sree (goddess of wealth) renounced me.

sanskrit: तम् आशु वेगेन दुरासदेन तु अभिप्लुताम् शोक महार्णवेन
पश्यन् तदा वालि अनुजः तरस्वी भ्रात्रुः वधेन अप्रतिमेन तेपे
transliteration: tam āśu vegena durāsadena tu abhiplutām śoka mahārṇavena
paśyan tadā vāli anujaḥ tarasvī bhrātruḥ vadhena apratimena tepe
english: Beholding Tārā emerged in a deep and mighty ocean of grief, Vali's younger brother was overwhelmed with penitence, in consequence of the unbecoming destruction of his brother.

sanskrit: स बाष्प पूर्णेन मुखेन् पश्यन् क्षणेन निर्विण्ण मना मनस्वी
जगाम रामस्य शनैः समीपम् भृत्यैः वृत्तः संपरिदूयमानः
transliteration: sa bāṣpa pūrṇena mukhen paśyan kṣaṇena nirviṇṇa manā manasvī
jagāma rāmasya śanaiḥ samīpam bhṛtyaiḥ vṛttaḥ saṃparidūyamānaḥ
english: And seeing her countenance full of tears, the high-souled (Sugriva), racked with grief and repentance, approached slowly Ráma along with his followers.

sanskrit: स तम् समासाद्य गृहीत चापम् उदात्तम् आशी विष तुल्य बाणम्
यशश्विनम् लक्षण लक्षित अंगम् अवस्थितम् राघवम् इति उवाच
transliteration: sa tam samāsādya gṛhīta cāpam udāttam āśī viṣa tulya bāṇam
yaśaśvinam lakṣaṇa lakṣita aṃgam avasthitam rāghavam iti uvāca
english: And nearing him, with a bow in his hand, having arrows like to serpents, famed and having auspicious marks on his person, he spoke to Rāghava, seated there, saying.

sanskrit: यथा प्रतिज्ञातम् इदम् नरेन्द्र कृतम् त्वया दृउष्ट फलम् च कर्म
मम अद्य भोगेषु नरेन्द्र सूनो मनो निवृत्तम् हत जिवितेन
transliteration: yathā pratijñātam idam narendra kṛtam tvayā dṛuṣṭa phalam ca karma
mama adya bhogeṣu narendra sūno mano nivṛttam hata jivitena
english: O lord of men, you had fulfilled your promise by carrying it out into practice; and as for wretched me, O son of a king, I shall refrain today from all enjoyments.

sanskrit: अस्याम् महिष्याम् तु भृशम् रुदत्याम् पुरे अति विक्रोशति दुःख तप्ते
हते नृपे संशयिते अंगदे च न राम राज्ये रमते मनो मे
transliteration: asyām mahiṣyām tu bhṛśam rudatyām pure ati vikrośati duḥkha tapte
hate nṛpe saṃśayite aṃgade ca na rāma rājye ramate mano me
english: This queen lamenting piteously, these subjects and retinue bewailing, being overwhelmed with grief, this king being slain, how can kingdom please me.?

sanskrit: क्रोधाद् अमर्षाद् अतिविप्रधर्षाद् भ्रातुर् वधो मे अनुमतः पुरस्तात्
हते तु इदानीम् हरि यूधपे अस्मिन् सुतीक्ष्णम् इक्ष्वाकु वर प्रतप्स्ये
transliteration: krodhād amarṣād ativipradharṣād bhrātur vadho me anumataḥ purastāt
hate tu idānīm hari yūdhape asmin sutīkṣṇam ikṣvāku vara pratapsye
english: O Rāma out of anger, and passion, and on account of my being insulted by him, I did formerly desire to bring about my brother's destruction. But that lord of monkey-herds being shain, O best of lkswakus, I am truly pierced to the quick with anguish.

sanskrit: श्रेयो अद्य मन्ये मम शैल मुख्ये तस्मिन् हि वासः चिरम् ऋष्यमूके
यथा तथा वर्तयतः स्व वृत्या न इमम् निहत्य त्रिदिवसय लाभः
transliteration: śreyo adya manye mama śaila mukhye tasmin hi vāsaḥ ciram ṛṣyamūke
yathā tathā vartayataḥ sva vṛtyā na imam nihatya tridivasaya lābhaḥ
english: I do prefer living for good in the mount Rșyamūka, earning my livelihood somehow or other, to the accession of heaven by destroying (Vāli).

sanskrit: न त्वा जिघांसामि चर इति यत् माम् अयम् महात्मा मतिमान् उवाच
तस्य एवे तत् राम वचो अनुरूपम् इदम् वचः कर्म च मे अनुरूपम्
transliteration: na tvā jighāṃsāmi cara iti yat mām ayam mahātmā matimān uvāca
tasya eve tat rāma vaco anurūpam idam vacaḥ karma ca me anurūpam

sanskrit: भ्राता कथम् नाम महा गुणस्य भ्रातुर् वधम् राम विरोचयेत
राजस्य दुःखस्य च वीर सारम् विचिन्तयन् काम पुरस्कृतो अपि
transliteration: bhrātā katham nāma mahā guṇasya bhrātur vadham rāma virocayeta
rājasya duḥkhasya ca vīra sāram vicintayan kāma puraskṛto api
english: How can a brother, O Rāma, however avaricious he might be, relish the destruction of his qualified brother, comparing the happiness of a kingdom, with the grief (consequent upon his brother's demise)?

sanskrit: वधो हि मे मतो न असीत् स्व महात्म्या अव्यतिक्रमात्
मम आसीत् बुद्धिः दुरात्म्यात् प्राण हारी व्यतिक्रमः
transliteration: vadho hi me mato na asīt sva mahātmyā avyatikramāt
mama āsīt buddhiḥ durātmyāt prāṇa hārī vyatikramaḥ
english: He did not desire to slay me, lest his greatness inight be spoiled; but alas! through my wicked sense, I performed an iniquity by taking the life of my brother.

sanskrit: द्रुम शाका अवभग्नो अहम् मुहुर्तम् परिनिष्टनन्
स्वान्तयित्वा अनेन उक्तः न पुनः कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: druma śākā avabhagno aham muhurtam pariniṣṭanan
svāntayitvā anena uktaḥ na punaḥ kartum arhasi
english: Being struck by him with branches of trees, while I fled away and wept, he, consoling me, said only Do not do this again.

sanskrit: भ्रातृत्वम् आर्य भावः च धर्मः च अनेन रक्षितः
मया क्रोधः च कामः च कपित्वम् च प्रदर्शितम्
transliteration: bhrātṛtvam ārya bhāvaḥ ca dharmaḥ ca anena rakṣitaḥ
mayā krodhaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca kapitvam ca pradarśitam
english: He all along maintained his fraternal feelings, his honesty and piety; but (woe to me) I have displayed my wrath, passion and monkey-hood.

sanskrit: प्राप्तो अस्मि पाप्मानम् वयस्यभ्रातुः वध त्वाष्ट्र वधात् इव इन्द्रः
transliteration: prāpto asmi pāpmānam vayasyabhrātuḥ vadha tvāṣṭra vadhāt iva indraḥ
english: O friend, like to the lord of celestials perpetrating sin by destroying Biswarupa, I have been, by bringing about the destruction of my brother, visited. with this sin, beyond comprehensio”, avoidable, undesirable and invisible.

sanskrit: पाप्मानम् इन्द्रस्य मही जलम् च वृक्षाः च कामम् जगृहुः स्त्रियः च
को नाम पाप्मानम् इमम् सहेत शाखा मृगस्य प्रतिपत्तुम् इच्छेत्
transliteration: pāpmānam indrasya mahī jalam ca vṛkṣāḥ ca kāmam jagṛhuḥ striyaḥ ca
ko nāma pāpmānam imam saheta śākhā mṛgasya pratipattum icchet
english: Indra's sin was shared by earth, water, trees and women; but who is there who will bear and desire to participate this monkey's sin?-

sanskrit: ना अर्हामि सन्मानम् इमम् प्रजानाम् न यौव राज्यम् कुत एव राज्यम्
अधर्म युक्तम् कुल नाश युक्तम् एवम् विधम् राघव कर्म कृत्वा
transliteration: nā arhāmi sanmānam imam prajānām na yauva rājyam kuta eva rājyam
adharma yuktam kula nāśa yuktam evam vidham rāghava karma kṛtvā
english: Perpetrating such an improper and irreligious act, tending to the decay of my family, I do not deserve the respect of my subjects and the heirapparentship; what of kingdom, O Rāghava.

sanskrit: पापस्य कर्ता अस्मि विगर्हितस्यक्षुद्रस्य लोक अपकृतस्य लोके
शोको महान् मम अभिवर्तते अयम्वृष्टेः यथा निम्नम् इव अम्बु वेगः
transliteration: pāpasya kartā asmi vigarhitasyakṣudrasya loka apakṛtasya loke
śoko mahān mama abhivartate ayamvṛṣṭeḥ yathā nimnam iva ambu vegaḥ
english: I am the perpetrator of a vile and disgraceful sin, blamed of all in this world. And like to a current of rain going downwards, this mighty grief has overcome me.

sanskrit: सोदर्य अघाता अपर गात्र वालः संताप हस्त अक्षि शिरो विषाणः
एनोमयो माम् अभिहन्ति हस्ती दृप्तो नदी कूलम् इव प्रवृद्धः
transliteration: sodarya aghātā apara gātra vālaḥ saṃtāpa hasta akṣi śiro viṣāṇaḥ
enomayo mām abhihanti hastī dṛpto nadī kūlam iva pravṛddhaḥ
english: This mighty and infuriated elephant of a sin, having the destruction of a brother as its body, repentance, as its trunk, head, eyes and tusks, has been crushing me like to the banks of a river.

sanskrit: अंहो बतेदम् नृ वर अविषह्य निवर्तते मे हृदि साधु वृत्तम्
अग्नौ विवर्णम् परितप्य मानम् किट्टम् यथा राघव जात रूपम्
transliteration: aṃho batedam nṛ vara aviṣahya nivartate me hṛdi sādhu vṛttam
agnau vivarṇam paritapya mānam kiṭṭam yathā rāghava jāta rūpam
english: Alas! O best of kings, this unbearable sin has been driving away all pious feelings from my heart like to alloy leaking out of discoloured gold when molten in fire, O Rāghava.

sanskrit: महा बलानाम् हरि यूथपानाम् इदम् कुलम् राघव मन् निमित्तम्
अस्य अंगदस्य अपि च शोक तापात् अर्थ स्थित प्राणम् इतीव मन्ये
transliteration: mahā balānām hari yūthapānām idam kulam rāghava man nimittam
asya aṃgadasya api ca śoka tāpāt artha sthita prāṇam itīva manye
english: Methinks, for me, O Rāghava, these mighty monkeys and Angada are almost half-dead (with grief).

sanskrit: सुतः सुलभः सुजनः सुवश्यः कुतः तु पुत्रः सदृशः अंगदेन
न च अपि विद्येत स वीर देशो यस्मिन् भवेत् सोदर संनिकर्षः
transliteration: sutaḥ sulabhaḥ sujanaḥ suvaśyaḥ kutaḥ tu putraḥ sadṛśaḥ aṃgadena
na ca api vidyeta sa vīra deśo yasmin bhavet sodara saṃnikarṣaḥ
english: A good-natured and obedient son is rare. Where is to be found Angada's equal? O hero, there is no such land where I may meet again my brother.

sanskrit: अद्य अंगदो वीर वरो न जीवेत् जीवेत माता परि पालनार्थम्
विना तु पुत्रम् परिताप दीना सा नैव जीवेत् इत् निश्चितम् मे
transliteration: adya aṃgado vīra varo na jīvet jīveta mātā pari pālanārtham
vinā tu putram paritāpa dīnā sā naiva jīvet it niścitam me
english: The heroic Angada shall not live to-day and if he lives, his another shall live to bring him up. Forsooth, without her son, she shall not live long.

sanskrit: सो अहम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि अति दीप्तम् अग्निम्भ्रत्रा च पुत्रेण च सख्यम् इच्छन्
इमे विचेष्यन्ति हरि प्रवीराःसीताम् निदेशे परिवर्तमानाः
transliteration: so aham pravekṣyāmi ati dīptam agnimbhratrā ca putreṇa ca sakhyam icchan
ime viceṣyanti hari pravīrāḥsītām nideśe parivartamānāḥ
english: Therefore shall I enter this flaming fire with a view to place myself on the same level with my brother and his son and all these mighty monkeys shall engage in quest of Sītā, abiding by your commandments.

sanskrit: कृत्स्नम् तु ते सेत्स्यति कार्यम् एतत् मयि अपि अतीते मनुजेन्द्र पुत्र
कुलस्य हन्तारम् अजीवन अर्हम् राम अनुजानीहि कृत अगसम् माम्
transliteration: kṛtsnam tu te setsyati kāryam etat mayi api atīte manujendra putra
kulasya hantāram ajīvana arham rāma anujānīhi kṛta agasam mām
english: O son of a king, they shall all carry out your orders even in my absence, do you, therefore, order me (to enter fire) who am the destroyer of my own race, have performed an inequity and do not deserve living any more.

sanskrit: इति एवम् आर्तस्य रघु प्रवीरः श्रुत्वा वचो वालि जघन्य जस्य
संजात बाष्प पर वीर हन्ता रामो मुहूर्तम् विमना बभूव
transliteration: iti evam ārtasya raghu pravīraḥ śrutvā vaco vāli jaghanya jasya
saṃjāta bāṣpa para vīra hantā rāmo muhūrtam vimanā babhūva
english: Hearing the words of Vali's younger brother, who was bewailing thus, Rāma, the heroic descendant of Rāghu and the slayer of foes, remained stupefied for some time with tears in his eyes.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् क्षणे अभीक्ष्णम् अवेक्षमाणः क्षिति क्षमावान् भुवनस्य गोप्ता
रामो रुदन्तीम् व्यसने निमग्नाम् समुत्सुकः सः अथ ददर्श ताराम्
transliteration: tasmin kṣaṇe abhīkṣṇam avekṣamāṇaḥ kṣiti kṣamāvān bhuvanasya goptā
rāmo rudantīm vyasane nimagnām samutsukaḥ saḥ atha dadarśa tārām
english: In the mean-time, Rāma patient like to the protector of the world, worked with curiosity looked again and again towards the bewailing Tārā sunk in the gulf of disaster.

sanskrit: ताम् चारु नेत्राम् कपि सिंह नाथाम् पतिम् समाश्लिष्य तद शयानाम्
उत्थापयामासुः अदीन सत्त्वाम् मंत्रि प्रधानाः कपि राज पत्नीम्
transliteration: tām cāru netrām kapi siṃha nāthām patim samāśliṣya tada śayānām
utthāpayāmāsuḥ adīna sattvām maṃtri pradhānāḥ kapi rāja patnīm
english: Thereupon the principal counsellors raised up the brave spouse of the lord of monkeys, having graceful eyes and lying on the earth, embracing her husband.

sanskrit: सा विस्फुरंती परिरभ्यमाणा भर्तुः समीपात् अपनीयमाना
ददर्श रामम् शर चाप पाणिम् स्व तेजसा सूर्यम् इव ज्वलंतम्
transliteration: sā visphuraṃtī parirabhyamāṇā bhartuḥ samīpāt apanīyamānā
dadarśa rāmam śara cāpa pāṇim sva tejasā sūryam iva jvalaṃtam
english: And snatched away from her husband and trembling, she beheld Rāma, with bow and arrows in his hand burning like to the Sun by virtue of his own effulgence.

sanskrit: सु संवृत्तम् पार्थिव लक्षणैः च तम् चारु नेत्रम् मृगशाव नेत्रा
अदृष्ट पूर्वम् पुरुष प्रधानम् अयम् स काकुत्स्थ इति प्रजज्ञे
transliteration: su saṃvṛttam pārthiva lakṣaṇaiḥ ca tam cāru netram mṛgaśāva netrā
adṛṣṭa pūrvam puruṣa pradhānam ayam sa kākutstha iti prajajñe
english: Beholding him gifted with all royal marks, having beautiful eyes and never seen before, that one, having the eyes of a fawn, thought within herself. This great one must be Kākutstha.

sanskrit: तस्य इन्द्र कल्पस्य दुरासदस्य महानुभावस्य समीपम् आर्या
आर्त अति तूर्णम् व्यसनम् प्रपन्ना जगाम तारा परिविह्वलन्ती
transliteration: tasya indra kalpasya durāsadasya mahānubhāvasya samīpam āryā
ārta ati tūrṇam vyasanam prapannā jagāma tārā parivihvalantī
english: The worshipful Tārā, worked with grief, and overwhelmed with disasters, bewailing, neared quickly that high-souled one, resembling the lord of celestials and hard to approach.

sanskrit: तम् सा समासाद्य विशुद्ध सत्त्वम् शोकेन संभ्रांत शरीर भावा
मनस्विनी वाक्यम् उवाच तारा रामम् रण उत्कर्षण लब्ध लक्ष्यम्
transliteration: tam sā samāsādya viśuddha sattvam śokena saṃbhrāṃta śarīra bhāvā
manasvinī vākyam uvāca tārā rāmam raṇa utkarṣaṇa labdha lakṣyam
english: And having reached the pure-souled Rāma, who had his ends fully attained in battle, the high-minded Tārā, having her frame worked with grief, spoke to him, saying.

sanskrit: त्वम् अप्रमेयः च दुरासदः च जितेन्द्रियः च उत्तम धर्मकः च
अक्षीण कीर्तिः च विचक्षणः च क्षिति क्षमवान् क्षतजोपमा अक्षः
transliteration: tvam aprameyaḥ ca durāsadaḥ ca jitendriyaḥ ca uttama dharmakaḥ ca
akṣīṇa kīrtiḥ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ca kṣiti kṣamavān kṣatajopamā akṣaḥ
english: You are immeasurable, hard to approach, highly pious, prudent of controlled senses and increasing fame, forgiving like to earth and of blood-red eyes.

sanskrit: त्वम् आत्त बाणासन बाण पाणिः महाबलः संहनन उपपन्नः
मनुष्य देहाभुदयम् विहाय दिव्येन देहाभ्युदयेन युक्तः
transliteration: tvam ātta bāṇāsana bāṇa pāṇiḥ mahābalaḥ saṃhanana upapannaḥ
manuṣya dehābhudayam vihāya divyena dehābhyudayena yuktaḥ
english: You have bow and arrows in hand, are highly powerful and of a tough body. And renouncing human grace you had assumed the grace of a celestial person.

sanskrit: एन एव बाणेन हतः प्रियो मे तेन एव बाणेन हि माम् जहि हि
हता गमिष्यामि समीपम् अस्य न माम् विना वीर रमेत वाली
transliteration: ena eva bāṇena hataḥ priyo me tena eva bāṇena hi mām jahi hi
hatā gamiṣyāmi samīpam asya na mām vinā vīra rameta vālī
english: Do you slay me with that self-same shaft with which my dear one was slain. And thus slain, O hero, I shall near him, for Vāli does not relish the company of any other woman but me.

sanskrit: स्वर्गे अपि पद्म अमल पत्र नेत्र समेत्य संप्रेक्ष्य च माम् अपश्यन्
न हि एष उच्चावच ताम्र चूडा विचित्र वेषाः अप्सरो अभजिष्यत्
transliteration: svarge api padma amala patra netra sametya saṃprekṣya ca mām apaśyan
na hi eṣa uccāvaca tāmra cūḍā vicitra veṣāḥ apsaro abhajiṣyat
english: O you having eyes resembling clean lotuspetals, this (hero) departing to the abode of celestials and not beholding me there, shall not delight in the company of Apsarās, wearing diversified garments and copper-coloured coronets.

sanskrit: स्वर्गे अपि शोकम् विवर्णताम् च मया विना प्राप्स्यति वीर वाली
रम्ये नगेन्द्रस्य तटा अवकाशे विदेह कन्या अरहितो यथा त्वम्
transliteration: svarge api śokam vivarṇatām ca mayā vinā prāpsyati vīra vālī
ramye nagendrasya taṭā avakāśe videha kanyā arahito yathā tvam
english: Even in the land of celestials, O hero, Vāli shall turn pale with grief in my separation, like to you in the picuresque dale of the Lord of mountains, separated from the daughter of the king of Videha.

sanskrit: त्वम् वेत्थ तावत् वनिता विहीनःप्राप्नोति दुःखम् पुरुषः कुमारः
तत् त्वम् प्रजानन् जहि माम् न वालीदुःखम् मम अदर्शनजम् भजेत
transliteration: tvam vettha tāvat vanitā vihīnaḥprāpnoti duḥkham puruṣaḥ kumāraḥ
tat tvam prajānan jahi mām na vālīduḥkham mama adarśanajam bhajeta
english: You know well that a hand-some man is greatly afflicted with the separation of his spouse; and knowing this, do you slay me, and Vāli shall not be tormented with grief consequent upon my absence.

sanskrit: यत् च अपि मन्येत भवान् महात्मास्त्री घात दोषः तु भवेन् न मह्यम्
आत्मा इयम् अस्य इति हि माम् जहि त्वम्न स्त्री वधः स्यात् मनुजेन्द्र पुत्र
transliteration: yat ca api manyeta bhavān mahātmāstrī ghāta doṣaḥ tu bhaven na mahyam
ātmā iyam asya iti hi mām jahi tvamna strī vadhaḥ syāt manujendra putra
english: High-souled as you are, you are thinking that you shall, slaying me, be visited with a sin arising from the destruction of a female. But do you kill me, O son of a king, knowing me as the soul of Vali, and you shall not be responsible for destroying a woman.

sanskrit: शास्त्र प्रयोगात् विविधाः च वेदात् अनन्य रूपाः पुरुषस्य दाराः
दार प्रदानात् न हि दानम् अन्यत् प्रदृश्यते ज्ञानवताम् हि लोके
transliteration: śāstra prayogāt vividhāḥ ca vedāt ananya rūpāḥ puruṣasya dārāḥ
dāra pradānāt na hi dānam anyat pradṛśyate jñānavatām hi loke
english: According to the Vedas and various other sacred texts, wives are inseparably blended with their husbands. And the wise say that there is no other gift better than that of a wife in this world.

sanskrit: त्वम् च अपि माम् तस्य मम प्रियस्य प्रदास्यसे धर्मम् अवेक्ष्य वीर
अनेन दानेन न लप्स्यसे त्वम् अधर्म योगम् मम वीर घातात्
transliteration: tvam ca api mām tasya mama priyasya pradāsyase dharmam avekṣya vīra
anena dānena na lapsyase tvam adharma yogam mama vīra ghātāt
english: You shall, O hero, confer me religiously upon my dear one and by this gift you shall be saved from the sin consequent upon killing me.

sanskrit: आर्ताम् अनाथाम् अपनीयमानाम् एवम् गताम् न अर्हसि माम् अहन्तुम्
अहम् हि मातंग विलास गामिना प्लवंगमानाम् ऋषभेण धीमता
विना वरार्होत्तम हेम मालिना चिरम् न शक्ष्यामि नरेन्द्र जीवितुम्
transliteration: ārtām anāthām apanīyamānām evam gatām na arhasi mām ahantum
aham hi mātaṃga vilāsa gāminā plavaṃgamānām ṛṣabheṇa dhīmatā
vinā varārhottama hema mālinā ciram na śakṣyāmi narendra jīvitum
english: It does not behove you not to kill me, who am exercised with grief, without my lord, snatched away from him and reduced to such a (pitiable) plight. O lord of men, I cannot live long without that highly intelligent lord of monkeys, having an elephantine gait and wearing an excellent golden garland.

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्तः तु विभुः महात्मा ताराम् समाश्वास्य हितम् बभाषे
मा वीर भार्ये विमतिम् कुरुष्व लोको हि सर्वो विहितो विधात्रा
transliteration: iti evam uktaḥ tu vibhuḥ mahātmā tārām samāśvāsya hitam babhāṣe
mā vīra bhārye vimatim kuruṣva loko hi sarvo vihito vidhātrā
english: Thus accosted, the high-souled lord consoling Tārā, spoke to her the following well-meaning words.–Do you not lose yourself, O wife of a hero. This whole world of creation is being guided by God's dispensation.

sanskrit: तम् चैव सर्वम् सुख दुःख योगम् लोको अब्रवीत् तेन कृतम् विधात्रा
त्रयो अपि लोका विहितम् विधानम् न अति क्रमन्ते वशगा हि तस्य
transliteration: tam caiva sarvam sukha duḥkha yogam loko abravīt tena kṛtam vidhātrā
trayo api lokā vihitam vidhānam na ati kramante vaśagā hi tasya
english: And by Him is administered misery or happiness as people say. These three worlds cannot neglect His dispensations and are entirely subject to Him.

sanskrit: प्रीतिम् पराम् प्राप्स्यसि ताम् तथा एव पुत्रः च ते प्रप्स्यति यौव राज्यम्
धात्र विधानम् विहितम् तथा एव न शूर पत्न्यः परिदेवयन्ति
transliteration: prītim parām prāpsyasi tām tathā eva putraḥ ca te prapsyati yauva rājyam
dhātra vidhānam vihitam tathā eva na śūra patnyaḥ paridevayanti
english: Your son shall attain to the heir apparentship of the throne and you shall enjoy excellent joy therefrom.

sanskrit: आश्वासिता तेन महत्मना तु प्रभाव युक्तेन परंतपेन
सा वीर पत्नी ध्वनता मुखेन सुवेष रूपा विरराम् तारा
transliteration: āśvāsitā tena mahatmanā tu prabhāva yuktena paraṃtapena
sā vīra patnī dhvanatā mukhena suveṣa rūpā virarām tārā
english: This has been decreed by the Almighty. Wives of heroes do never relent. Being thus consoled by the high-souled (Rāma) gifted with prowess, and the slayer of foes, Tārā, the wife of a heroic husband and wearing a graceful garment, ceased bewailing.

sanskrit: स सुग्रीवम् च ताराम् च स अंगदाम् सह लक्ष्मणः
समान शोकः काकुत्स्थः सांत्वयन् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa sugrīvam ca tārām ca sa aṃgadām saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
samāna śokaḥ kākutsthaḥ sāṃtvayan idam abravīt
english: Thereupon, Kākutstha, with Laksmana, equally aggrieved, said, consoling Sugrīva, and Tārā together with Angada.

sanskrit: न शोक परितापेन श्रेयसा युज्यते मृतः
यद् अत्र अनंतरम् कार्यम् तत् समाधातुम् अर्हथ
transliteration: na śoka paritāpena śreyasā yujyate mṛtaḥ
yad atra anaṃtaram kāryam tat samādhātum arhatha
english: Grief and lamentations do not tend to the welfare of the deceased. It therefore behoveth you to perform the after ceremonies.

sanskrit: लोक वृत्तम् अनुष्ठेयम् कृतम् वो बाष्प मोक्षणम्
न कालाद् उत्तरम् किंचित् कर्म शक्यम् उपासितुम्
transliteration: loka vṛttam anuṣṭheyam kṛtam vo bāṣpa mokṣaṇam
na kālād uttaram kiṃcit karma śakyam upāsitum
english: You have satisfied the worldly practice with a profuse discharge of tears. It is not proper to delay the performance of appointed actions.

sanskrit: नियतिः कारणम् लोके नियतिः कर्म साधनम्
नियतिः सर्व भूतानाम् नियोगेषु इह कारणम्
transliteration: niyatiḥ kāraṇam loke niyatiḥ karma sādhanam
niyatiḥ sarva bhūtānām niyogeṣu iha kāraṇam
english: Time is the prime cause in this world, and the source of the accomplishment of actions. And Time it is that leads men to actions.

sanskrit: न कर्ता कस्यचित् कश्चित् नियोगे च अपि न ईश्वरः
स्वभावे वर्तते लोकः तस्य कालः परायणम्
transliteration: na kartā kasyacit kaścit niyoge ca api na īśvaraḥ
svabhāve vartate lokaḥ tasya kālaḥ parāyaṇam
english: No one is the lord of another person, and no one leads him to actions. People are subject to their actions of previous existence and Time aids them.

sanskrit: न कालः कालम् अत्येति न कालः परिहीयते
स्वभावम् च समासाद्य न कश्चित् अतिवर्तते
transliteration: na kālaḥ kālam atyeti na kālaḥ parihīyate
svabhāvam ca samāsādya na kaścit ativartate
english: Even the Eternal being cannot withstand the ways of Time. He never decayeth-and no one else can withstand the course of Time.

sanskrit: न कालस्य अस्ति बंधुत्वम् न हेतुर् न पराक्रमः
न मित्र ज्ञाति संबन्धः कारणम् न आत्मनो वशः
transliteration: na kālasya asti baṃdhutvam na hetur na parākramaḥ
na mitra jñāti saṃbandhaḥ kāraṇam na ātmano vaśaḥ
english: It has no friend, no cause and no one can overcome it. It has no kinsman, no relation; even it is not subject to itself.

sanskrit: किम् तु काल परीणामो द्रष्टव्यः साधु पश्यता
धर्मः च अर्थः च कामः च कालक्रम समाहिताः
transliteration: kim tu kāla parīṇāmo draṣṭavyaḥ sādhu paśyatā
dharmaḥ ca arthaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca kālakrama samāhitāḥ
english: The wise can perceive the work of Time. Piety, wealth and desire are all subject to it.

sanskrit: इतः स्वाम् प्रकृतिम् वाली गतः प्राप्तः क्रिया फलम्
साम दान अर्थ संयोगैः पवित्रम् प्लवग ईश्वर
transliteration: itaḥ svām prakṛtim vālī gataḥ prāptaḥ kriyā phalam
sāma dāna artha saṃyogaiḥ pavitram plavaga īśvara
english: Vāli, the lord of monkeys, has attained to his own true state, reaping the fruits of his actions, acquired by virtue of his royal accomplishments namely forgiveness and charity.

sanskrit: स्व धर्मस्य च संयोगात् जितः तेन महात्मना
transliteration: sva dharmasya ca saṃyogāt jitaḥ tena mahātmanā
english: The abode of the celestials, which was conquered by this high-souled one by his former piety, has now been occupied by him after resigning his body.

sanskrit: एषा वै नियतिः श्रेष्ठा याम् गतो हरि यूथपः
तत् अलम् परितापेन प्राप्त कालम् उपास्यताम्
transliteration: eṣā vai niyatiḥ śreṣṭhā yām gato hari yūthapaḥ
tat alam paritāpena prāpta kālam upāsyatām
english: This is the best course of Time that has been attained to by the lord of monkey-herds. No more with lamentations therefore; do you perform the actions that are worthy of being performed on this occasion.

sanskrit: वचन अन्ते तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः पर वीर हा
अवदत् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् गत चेतसम्
transliteration: vacana ante tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīra hā
avadat praśritam vākyam sugrīvam gata cetasam
english: After Rāma had spoken thus, Laksmana, the slayer of foes, addressed Sugrīva, senseless with grief, with the following sound words.

sanskrit: कुरु त्वम् अस्य सुग्रीव प्रेत कार्यम् अनंतरम्
तारा अंगदाभ्याम् सहितो वालिनो दहनम् प्रति
transliteration: kuru tvam asya sugrīva preta kāryam anaṃtaram
tārā aṃgadābhyām sahito vālino dahanam prati
english: Sugrīva, do you perform the funeral ceremonies of Vali along with Tārā and Angada.

sanskrit: समाज्ञापय काष्ठानि शुष्काणि च बहूनि च
चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि वालि संस्कार कारणात्
transliteration: samājñāpaya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇi ca bahūni ca
candanāni ca divyāni vāli saṃskāra kāraṇāt
english: Do you collect for cremation many a dry fuel and celestial sandal.

sanskrit: समाश्वासय दीनम् त्वम् अंगदम् दीन चेतसम्
मा भूः बालिश बुद्धिः त्वम् त्वत् अधीनम् इदम् पुरम्
transliteration: samāśvāsaya dīnam tvam aṃgadam dīna cetasam
mā bhūḥ bāliśa buddhiḥ tvam tvat adhīnam idam puram
english: Do you console the unfortunate Angada, who is beside himself with grief. Do not conduct yourself like an ignorant person, for this city is now under you.

sanskrit: अंगदः तु आनयेत् माल्यम् वस्त्राणि विविधानि च
घृतम् तैलम् अथो गन्धान् यत् च अत्र समनंतरम्
transliteration: aṃgadaḥ tu ānayet mālyam vastrāṇi vividhāni ca
ghṛtam tailam atho gandhān yat ca atra samanaṃtaram
english: Let Angada bring clothes, garlands, scents, clarified butter, oil and other necessary articles.

sanskrit: त्वम् तार शिबिकाम् शीघ्रम् आदाय आगच्छ संभ्रमात्
त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता हि अस्मिन् काले विशेषतः
transliteration: tvam tāra śibikām śīghram ādāya āgaccha saṃbhramāt
tvarā guṇavatī yuktā hi asmin kāle viśeṣataḥ
english: O Tārā, do you go and bring soon a conveyance; for speediness is a special virtue on an occasion like this.

sanskrit: सज्जी भवन्तु प्लवगाः शिबिक वाहन उचिताः
transliteration: sajjī bhavantu plavagāḥ śibika vāhana ucitāḥ
english: Let the monkeys dress themselves who can convey this hearse. The powerful and the capable only shall carry Vali.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवम् सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनः
तस्थौ भ्रातृ समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः पर वीरहा
transliteration: evam uktvā tu sugrīvam sumitra ānanda vardhanaḥ
tasthau bhrātṛ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīrahā
english: Having thus addressed Sugriva, Laksmana, the enhancer of Sumitrā's joy and the destroyer of foes, stood before his elder brother.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारः संभ्रान्त मानसः
प्रविवेश गुहाम् शीघ्रम् शिबिका आसक्त मानसः
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tāraḥ saṃbhrānta mānasaḥ
praviveśa guhām śīghram śibikā āsakta mānasaḥ
english: And hearing the words of Laksmana, the counsellor respectfully entered the cave with a view to bring the conveyance.

sanskrit: आदाय शिबिकाम् तारः स तु पर्यापयत् पुनः
वानरैः उह्यमानाम् ताम् शूरैः उद्वहन उचितैः
transliteration: ādāya śibikām tāraḥ sa tu paryāpayat punaḥ
vānaraiḥ uhyamānām tām śūraiḥ udvahana ucitaiḥ
english: And taking that conveyance carried by the monkeys and worthy of being carried by the heroes, he issued out again of the cave.

sanskrit: दिव्याम् भद्र आसन युताम् शिबिकाम् स्यंदन उपमम्
पक्षि कर्मभिः आचित्राम् द्रुम कर्म विभूषिताम्
transliteration: divyām bhadra āsana yutām śibikām syaṃdana upamam
pakṣi karmabhiḥ ācitrām druma karma vibhūṣitām
english: It had a celestial throne and was like to a warchariot and had trees and birds painted on it.

sanskrit: विमानम् इव सिद्धानाम् जाल वात आयान आयुताम्
transliteration: vimānam iva siddhānām jāla vāta āyāna āyutām
english: It was painted on all sides with the figures of foot soldiers, had latticed windows and was like to the car of the Siddhas-spacious and artistically and stoutly built by artizans with beautiful carvings like to a wooden hill.

sanskrit: सुनियुक्तानाम् विशालाम् च सुकृताम् शिल्पिभिः कृतात्
transliteration: suniyuktānām viśālām ca sukṛtām śilpibhiḥ kṛtāt
english: It was ornamented with excellent ornaments and beautiful garlands, sprinkled with red sandal and skirted with strong ribs.

sanskrit: वर आभरण हारैः च चित्र माल्य उपशोभिताम्
transliteration: vara ābharaṇa hāraiḥ ca citra mālya upaśobhitām
english: It was ornamented with excellent ornaments and beautiful garlands, sprinkled with red sandal and skirted with strong ribs.

sanskrit: पुष्प ओघैः समभिच्छन्नाम् पद्म मालाभिः एव च
transliteration: puṣpa oghaiḥ samabhicchannām padma mālābhiḥ eva ca
english: It was covered with flowers and lotus garlands, crusted with precious clothes and had the colour of the rising Sun.

sanskrit: ईदृशी शिबिकाम् दृष्ट्वा रमो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
क्षिप्रम् विनीयताम् वली प्रेत कार्यम् विधीयताम्
transliteration: īdṛśī śibikām dṛṣṭvā ramo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
kṣipram vinīyatām valī preta kāryam vidhīyatām
english: Beholding such a conveyance, Rāma spoke to Lakşmaņa, saying-Do you soon conduct the funeral service of Vāli,

sanskrit: ततो वालिनम् उद्यम्य सुग्रीवः शिबिकाम् तदा
आरोपयत विक्रोशन् अंगदेन सह एव तु
transliteration: tato vālinam udyamya sugrīvaḥ śibikām tadā
āropayata vikrośan aṃgadena saha eva tu
english: Thereupon Sugrīva, long with Angada, placing Väli on the conveyance, began to bewail.

sanskrit: आरोप्य शिबिकाम् चैव वालिनम् गत जीवितम्
अलंकारैः च विविधैः माल्यैः वस्त्रैः च भूषितम्
transliteration: āropya śibikām caiva vālinam gata jīvitam
alaṃkāraiḥ ca vividhaiḥ mālyaiḥ vastraiḥ ca bhūṣitam
english: And placing the lifeless body of Vāli on it, he covered it with various ornaments, garlands, and clothes.

sanskrit: आज्ञापयत् तदा राजा सुग्रीवः प्लवग ईश्वरः
transliteration: ājñāpayat tadā rājā sugrīvaḥ plavaga īśvaraḥ
english: Thereat Sugrīva, the king of monkeys, ordered for the performance of Vāli's funeral rites.

sanskrit: अग्रतः प्लवगा यान्तु शिबिका तद् अनंतरम्
transliteration: agrataḥ plavagā yāntu śibikā tad anaṃtaram
english: Let the monkeys go before, scattering many a precious jewel and let the conveyance follow them.

sanskrit: राज्ञाम् ऋद्धि विशेषा हि दृश्यन्ते भुवि यादृशाः
तादृशैः इह कुर्वन्तु वानरा भ्रतृउ सत् क्रियाम्
transliteration: rājñām ṛddhi viśeṣā hi dṛśyante bhuvi yādṛśāḥ
tādṛśaiḥ iha kurvantu vānarā bhratṛu sat kriyām
english: Let the monkeys perform the obsequies of our master with such grandeur as befits the riches of the kings on this earth, a

sanskrit: अंगदम् परिरभ्य आशु तार प्रभृतयः तथा
transliteration: aṃgadam parirabhya āśu tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tathā
english: With view to perform the funeral ceremonies of Vāli, the counsellors and other monkeys, having lost their king and embraced Angada, proceeded weeping.

sanskrit: क्रोशन्तः प्रययुः सर्वे वानरा हत बान्धवाः
ततः प्रणिहिताः सर्वा वानर्यो अस्य वशानुगाः
transliteration: krośantaḥ prayayuḥ sarve vānarā hata bāndhavāḥ
tataḥ praṇihitāḥ sarvā vānaryo asya vaśānugāḥ

sanskrit: चुक्रुशुः वीर वीर इति भूयः क्रोशन्ती ताः प्रियम्
तारा प्रभृतयः सर्वा वानर्यो हत बान्धव
transliteration: cukruśuḥ vīra vīra iti bhūyaḥ krośantī tāḥ priyam
tārā prabhṛtayaḥ sarvā vānaryo hata bāndhava

sanskrit: अनुजग्मुः च भर्तारम् क्रोशंत्यः करुण स्वनाः
तासाम् रुदित शब्देन वानरीणाम् वन अंतरे
transliteration: anujagmuḥ ca bhartāram krośaṃtyaḥ karuṇa svanāḥ
tāsām rudita śabdena vānarīṇām vana aṃtare

sanskrit: वनानि गिरयः चैव विक्रोशंति इव सर्वतः
पुलिने गिरि नद्याः तु विविक्ते जल संवृते
transliteration: vanāni girayaḥ caiva vikrośaṃti iva sarvataḥ
puline giri nadyāḥ tu vivikte jala saṃvṛte

sanskrit: चिताम् चक्रुः सुबहवो वानरा वन चारिणः
transliteration: citām cakruḥ subahavo vānarā vana cāriṇaḥ
english: Monkeys, ranging in the forest, made funeral piles on the banks of the hill-streams and in solitary watery nooks. Thereupon laying down from their shoulders the conveyance, those foremost of monkeys stationed themselves in a corner, being stricken with grief.

sanskrit: तस्थुः एकांतम् आश्रित्य सर्वे शोक परायणाः
ततः तारा पतिम् दृष्ट्वा शिबिका तल शायिनम्
transliteration: tasthuḥ ekāṃtam āśritya sarve śoka parāyaṇāḥ
tataḥ tārā patim dṛṣṭvā śibikā tala śāyinam
english: And Tārā, beholding her husband's body on the conveyance, placed his head on her lap and bewailed, overwhelmed with griet.

sanskrit: आरोप्य अंके शिरः तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता
हा वानर महाराज हा नाथ माम् वत्सल
transliteration: āropya aṃke śiraḥ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā
hā vānara mahārāja hā nātha mām vatsala

sanskrit: हा महार्हः महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम्
जनम् न पश्यसि इमम् त्वम् कस्मात् शोक अभिपीडितम्
transliteration: hā mahārhaḥ mahābāho hā mama priya paśya mām
janam na paśyasi imam tvam kasmāt śoka abhipīḍitam
english: O lord of monkeys! O my lord! O my dear one! O you used to luxuries! Oyou having long arms! O my darling! behold me. Why did you not behold these monkeys, racked with sorrow?

sanskrit: प्रहृष्टम् इह ते वक्त्रम् गत असोः अपि मानद
अस्त अर्क सम वर्णम् च दृश्यते जीवतो यथा
transliteration: prahṛṣṭam iha te vaktram gata asoḥ api mānada
asta arka sama varṇam ca dṛśyate jīvato yathā
english: O conferrer of honours, your countenance looks as if beaming with joy; although you are dead, and you appearest as if alive, having the hue of the setting Sun.

sanskrit: एष त्वाम् राम रूपेण कालः कर्षति वानर
येन स्म विधवाः सर्वाः कृता एक इषुणा रणे
transliteration: eṣa tvām rāma rūpeṇa kālaḥ karṣati vānara
yena sma vidhavāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtā eka iṣuṇā raṇe
english: O monkey, Death himself, under the semblance of Rāma, is attracting you, who with one shaft in the battle, has rendered us all widows.

sanskrit: इमाः ताः तव राजेन्द्र वानर्यो अप्लवगाः तव
पादैः विकृष्टम् अध्वानम् आगताः किम् न बुध्यसे
transliteration: imāḥ tāḥ tava rājendra vānaryo aplavagāḥ tava
pādaiḥ vikṛṣṭam adhvānam āgatāḥ kim na budhyase
english: O best of kings, these she-monkeys cannot go by jumping. Did you not perceive that they have travelled so far on foot?

sanskrit: तव इष्टा ननु चैव इमा भार्याः चन्द्र निभ आननाः
इदानीम् न ईक्षसे कस्मात् सुग्रीवम् प्लवग ईश्वरम्
transliteration: tava iṣṭā nanu caiva imā bhāryāḥ candra nibha ānanāḥ
idānīm na īkṣase kasmāt sugrīvam plavaga īśvaram
english: Those your wives, having moon-like countenances, have always your welfare in view. Why did you not, O best of monkeys, cast your looks towards them and Sugrīva?

sanskrit: एते हि सचिवा राजन् तार प्रभृतयः तव
पुर वासि जनः च अयम् परिवार्य विषीदति
transliteration: ete hi sacivā rājan tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tava
pura vāsi janaḥ ca ayam parivārya viṣīdati
english: O king, these your counsellors, your wives headed by Tårā, and all these citizens are bewailing around you.

sanskrit: विसर्जय एनान् सचिवान् यथा उचितम् अरिन्दम
transliteration: visarjaya enān sacivān yathā ucitam arindama
english: O slayer of foes, do you despatch your counsellors to the city and we shall all enjoy in this forest, excited with amour.

sanskrit: एवम् विलपतीम् ताराम् पति शोक परीवृताम्
उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यः शोक कर्शिताः
transliteration: evam vilapatīm tārām pati śoka parīvṛtām
utthāpayanti sma tadā vānaryaḥ śoka karśitāḥ
english: The other she-monkeys, worked with sorrow, raised up Tārā bewailing thus being exercised with grief consequent upon the demise of her husband.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवेण ततः सार्धम् अंगदः पितरम् रुदन्
transliteration: sugrīveṇa tataḥ sārdham aṃgadaḥ pitaram rudan
english: Thereupon Angada along with Sugrīva, overwhelmed with grief, weeping, placed his Sire's body on the funeral pile.

sanskrit: ततो अग्निम् विधिवत् दत्त्वा सो अपसव्यम् चकार ह
पितरम् दीर्घम् अध्वानम् प्रस्थितम् व्याकुल इन्द्रियः
transliteration: tato agnim vidhivat dattvā so apasavyam cakāra ha
pitaram dīrgham adhvānam prasthitam vyākula indriyaḥ
english: And putting fire duly, he circumambulated his Sire, bound for a journey for good.

sanskrit: संस्कृत्य वालिनम् तम् तु विधिवत् प्लवगर्षभाः
आजग्मुः उदकम् कर्तुम् नदीम् शुभ जलाम् शिवाम्
transliteration: saṃskṛtya vālinam tam tu vidhivat plavagarṣabhāḥ
ājagmuḥ udakam kartum nadīm śubha jalām śivām
english: Having duly cremated Vāli's body, the foremost of monkeys arrived at a river of auspicious water with a view to perform the watery ceremony.

sanskrit: ततः ते सहिताः तत्र हि सः अंगदम् स्थाप्य च अग्रतः
सुग्रीव तारा सहिताः सिषिचुः वानरा जलम्
transliteration: tataḥ te sahitāḥ tatra hi saḥ aṃgadam sthāpya ca agrataḥ
sugrīva tārā sahitāḥ siṣicuḥ vānarā jalam
english: And all these monkeys along with Sugrīva and Tārā, placing Angada before them, sprinkled water.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवेण एव दीनेन दीनो भूत्वा महाबलः
समान शोकः काकुत्स्थः प्रेत कार्याणि अकारयत्
transliteration: sugrīveṇa eva dīnena dīno bhūtvā mahābalaḥ
samāna śokaḥ kākutsthaḥ preta kāryāṇi akārayat
english: And the highly powerful Käkutstha, equally aggrieved like Sugriva, being as poorly, conducted duly the obsequious ceremonies of Vali.

sanskrit: ततो अथ तम् वालिनम् अग्र्य पौरुषम्प्रकाशम् इक्ष्वाकु वर इषुणा हतम्
प्रदीप्य दीप्त अग्नि सम ओजसम् तदास लक्ष्मणम् रामम् उपेयवान् हरिः
transliteration: tato atha tam vālinam agrya pauruṣamprakāśam ikṣvāku vara iṣuṇā hatam
pradīpya dīpta agni sama ojasam tadāsa lakṣmaṇam rāmam upeyavān hariḥ
english: Thereupon cremating Våli, gifted with unequalled prowess, slain with one shaft of the foremost of Ikṣwakus, and like to flaming fire, Sugrīva appeared before Rāma who was in the company of Laksmana.

sanskrit: ततः शोक अभिसंतप्तम् सुग्रीवम् क्लिन्न वासनम्
transliteration: tataḥ śoka abhisaṃtaptam sugrīvam klinna vāsanam
english: And thereupon those foremost of monkeys waited there, surrounding Sugrīva exercised with grief and wearing wetted cloth. And they all, approaching the mighty-armed Rāma of unwearied actions, stationed themselves with folded hands like to the great ascetics around the Grand-Father of the celestials).

sanskrit: स्थिताः प्रांजलयः सर्वे पितामहम् इव ऋषयः
transliteration: sthitāḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve pitāmaham iva ṛṣayaḥ
english: And thereupon those foremost of monkeys waited there, surrounding Sugrīva exercised with grief and wearing wetted cloth. And they all, approaching the mighty-armed Rāma of unwearied actions, stationed themselves with folded hands like to the great ascetics around the Grand-Father of the celestials).

sanskrit: ततः कांचन शैल आभः तरुण अर्क निभ आननः
अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिर् वाक्यम् हनुमान् मारुत आत्मजः
transliteration: tataḥ kāṃcana śaila ābhaḥ taruṇa arka nibha ānanaḥ
abravīt prāṃjalir vākyam hanumān māruta ātmajaḥ
english: Thereupon Hanuman, the son of Marut, resembling a golden hill and having a countenance resembling the rising Sun, spoke with folded hands, saying.

sanskrit: भवत् प्रसादात् काकुत्स्थ पितृ पैतामहम् महत्
transliteration: bhavat prasādāt kākutstha pitṛ paitāmaham mahat
english: By your assistance, O Kākutstha, O lord, this great ancestral kingdom of the highly powerful monkeys, having sharpened teeth, incapable of being acquired by the high-souled ones, has been attained to (by Sugrīva). Being commanded by you, he along with his friends, entering this city, shall perform the royal duties.

sanskrit: महात्मानाम् सुदुष्प्रापम् प्राप्तम् राज्यम् इदम् प्रभो
transliteration: mahātmānām suduṣprāpam prāptam rājyam idam prabho
english: By your assistance, O Kākutstha, O lord, this great ancestral kingdom of the highly powerful monkeys, having sharpened teeth, incapable of being acquired by the high-souled ones, has been attained to (by Sugrīva). Being commanded by you, he along with his friends, entering this city, shall perform the royal duties.

sanskrit: स्नातो अयम् विविधैर् गन्धैर् औषधैः च यथा विधि
transliteration: snāto ayam vividhair gandhair auṣadhaiḥ ca yathā vidhi

sanskrit: अर्चयिष्यति माल्यैः च रत्नैः च त्वाम् विशेषतः
इमाम् गिरि गुहाम् रम्याम् अभिगन्तुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
transliteration: arcayiṣyati mālyaiḥ ca ratnaiḥ ca tvām viśeṣataḥ
imām giri guhām ramyām abhigantum tvam arhasi

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तो हनुमता राघवः पर वीरहा
transliteration: evam ukto hanumatā rāghavaḥ para vīrahā

sanskrit: चतुर्दश समाः सौम्य ग्रामम् वा यदि वा पुरम्
transliteration: caturdaśa samāḥ saumya grāmam vā yadi vā puram

sanskrit: न प्रवेक्ष्यामि हनुमन् पितुर् निर्देश पालकः
transliteration: na pravekṣyāmi hanuman pitur nirdeśa pālakaḥ

sanskrit: प्रविष्टो विधिवत् वीरः क्षिप्रम् राज्ये अभिषिच्यताम्
एवम् उक्त्वा हनूमन्तम् रामः सुग्रीवम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: praviṣṭo vidhivat vīraḥ kṣipram rājye abhiṣicyatām
evam uktvā hanūmantam rāmaḥ sugrīvam abravīt

sanskrit: वृत्तज्ञो वृत्त संपन्नम् उदार बल विक्रमम्
इमम् अपि अंगदम् वीरम् यौवराज्ये अभिषेचय
transliteration: vṛttajño vṛtta saṃpannam udāra bala vikramam
imam api aṃgadam vīram yauvarājye abhiṣecaya
english: Having thus addressed Hanumān, Rāma spoke to Sugriva, saying:-Conversant with customs as you are, do you install this generous and heroic Angada, gifted with gifted with prowess and honouring customs, as the heir-apparent of the throne.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठस्य हि सुतो ज्येष्ठः सदृशो विक्रमेण च
transliteration: jyeṣṭhasya hi suto jyeṣṭhaḥ sadṛśo vikrameṇa ca
english: This brave and eldest son of your elder brother-Angada, is truly worthy of the heirapparentship.

sanskrit: पूर्वो अयम् वार्षिको मासः श्रावणः सलिल आगमः
प्रवृत्ताः सौम्य चत्वारो मासा वार्षिक संज्ञिताः
transliteration: pūrvo ayam vārṣiko māsaḥ śrāvaṇaḥ salila āgamaḥ
pravṛttāḥ saumya catvāro māsā vārṣika saṃjñitāḥ
english: O gentle one, this month of Sravana, which is the first of those four months which make up the rainy season, has set in and this is not the time therefore enter your auspicious city and I shall live in this mountain along with Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: न अयम् उद्योग समयः प्रविश त्वम् पुरीम् शुभाम्
अस्मिन् वत्स्यामि अहम् सौम्य पर्वते सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: na ayam udyoga samayaḥ praviśa tvam purīm śubhām
asmin vatsyāmi aham saumya parvate saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: O gentle one, this month of Sravana, which is the first of those four months which make up the rainy season, has set in and this is not the time therefore enter your auspicious city and I shall live in this mountain along with Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: इयम् गिरि गुहा रम्या विशाला युक्त मारुता
प्रभूत सलिला सौम्य प्रभूत कमल उत्पला
transliteration: iyam giri guhā ramyā viśālā yukta mārutā
prabhūta salilā saumya prabhūta kamala utpalā
english: Pleasant indeed is this mountain cave, spacious, filled with air, water and many lotuses.

sanskrit: कार्तिके समनुप्राप्ते त्वम् रावण वधे यत
एष नः समयः सौम्य प्रविश त्वम् स्वम् आलयम्
transliteration: kārtike samanuprāpte tvam rāvaṇa vadhe yata
eṣa naḥ samayaḥ saumya praviśa tvam svam ālayam
english: You shall engage in endeavours to bring about the destruction of Rāvana, after Kārtika sets in. This is not the proper time, O gentle one, and do you enter your own city. And being installed on the throne do you enhance the joy of your friends.

sanskrit: प्रविवेश पुरीम् रम्याम् किष्किंधाम् वालि पालिताम्
तम् वानर सहस्राणि प्रविष्टम् वानर ईश्वरम्
transliteration: praviveśa purīm ramyām kiṣkiṃdhām vāli pālitām
tam vānara sahasrāṇi praviṣṭam vānara īśvaram

sanskrit: ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वा दृष्ट्वा हरि गण ईश्वरम्
transliteration: tataḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvā dṛṣṭvā hari gaṇa īśvaram

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः प्रकृतीः सर्वाः संभाष्य उत्थाप्य वीर्यवान्
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ prakṛtīḥ sarvāḥ saṃbhāṣya utthāpya vīryavān

sanskrit: भ्रातुर् अंतः पुरम् सौम्यम् प्रविवेश महाबलः
transliteration: bhrātur aṃtaḥ puram saumyam praviveśa mahābalaḥ

sanskrit: तस्य पाण्डुरम् आजह्रुः छत्रम् हेम परिष्कृतम्
transliteration: tasya pāṇḍuram ājahruḥ chatram hema pariṣkṛtam

sanskrit: शुक्ले च वाल व्यजने हेम दण्डे यशस्करे
तथा सर्वाणि रत्नानि सर्व बीज औषधानि च
transliteration: śukle ca vāla vyajane hema daṇḍe yaśaskare
tathā sarvāṇi ratnāni sarva bīja auṣadhāni ca

sanskrit: स क्षीराणाम् च वृक्षाणाम् प्ररोहान् कुसुमानि च
शुक्लानि चैव वस्त्राणि श्वेतम् चैव अनुलेपनम्
transliteration: sa kṣīrāṇām ca vṛkṣāṇām prarohān kusumāni ca
śuklāni caiva vastrāṇi śvetam caiva anulepanam

sanskrit: सुगंधीनि च माल्यानि स्थलजानि अंबुजानि च
चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि गन्धाम् च विविधान् बहून्
transliteration: sugaṃdhīni ca mālyāni sthalajāni aṃbujāni ca
candanāni ca divyāni gandhām ca vividhān bahūn

sanskrit: अक्षतम् जात रूपम् च प्रियंगु मधु सर्पिषी
दधि चर्म च वैयाघ्रम् परार्ध्ये च अपि उपानहौ
transliteration: akṣatam jāta rūpam ca priyaṃgu madhu sarpiṣī
dadhi carma ca vaiyāghram parārdhye ca api upānahau

sanskrit: आजग्मुः तत्र मुदिता वराः कन्याः च षोडश
transliteration: ājagmuḥ tatra muditā varāḥ kanyāḥ ca ṣoḍaśa

sanskrit: ततः ते वानर श्रेष्ठम् अभिषेक्तुम् यथा विधि
रत्नैर् वस्त्रैः च भक्ष्यैः च तोषयित्वा द्विजर्षभान्
transliteration: tataḥ te vānara śreṣṭham abhiṣektum yathā vidhi
ratnair vastraiḥ ca bhakṣyaiḥ ca toṣayitvā dvijarṣabhān
english: Thereupon those monkeys pleased the foremost of twice-born ones with jewels clothes and eatables, with a view to install that best of monkeys.

sanskrit: ततः कुश परिस्तीर्णम् समिद्धम् जात वेदसम्
मंत्र पूतेन हविषा हुत्वा मंत्रविदो जनाः
transliteration: tataḥ kuśa paristīrṇam samiddham jāta vedasam
maṃtra pūtena haviṣā hutvā maṃtravido janāḥ
english: And these conversant with mantras threw clarified butter, sanctified by mantras, into flaming fire burning on a Kusa bed.

sanskrit: ततो हेम प्रतिष्ठाने वर आस्तरण संवृते
प्रासाद शिखरे रम्ये चित्र माल्य उपशोभिते
transliteration: tato hema pratiṣṭhāne vara āstaraṇa saṃvṛte
prāsāda śikhare ramye citra mālya upaśobhite

sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखम् विधिवत् मंत्रैः स्थापयित्वा वर आसने
नदी नदेभ्यः संहृत्य तीर्थेभ्यः च समंततः
transliteration: prāṅmukham vidhivat maṃtraiḥ sthāpayitvā vara āsane
nadī nadebhyaḥ saṃhṛtya tīrthebhyaḥ ca samaṃtataḥ

sanskrit: अपः कनक कुंभेषु निधाय विमलम् जलम्
transliteration: apaḥ kanaka kuṃbheṣu nidhāya vimalam jalam

sanskrit: शुभैः वृषभ शृन्गैः च कलशैः च एव कांचनैः
शास्त्र दृष्टेन विधिना महर्षि विहितेन च
transliteration: śubhaiḥ vṛṣabha śṛngaiḥ ca kalaśaiḥ ca eva kāṃcanaiḥ
śāstra dṛṣṭena vidhinā maharṣi vihitena ca

sanskrit: मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव हनूमान् जांबवान् तथा
transliteration: maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ caiva hanūmān jāṃbavān tathā

sanskrit: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे सर्वे वानर पुंगवाः
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu sugrīve sarve vānara puṃgavāḥ

sanskrit: रामस्य तु वचः कुर्वन् सुग्रीवो हरि पुंगवः
transliteration: rāmasya tu vacaḥ kurvan sugrīvo hari puṃgavaḥ
english: Abiding by Rama's words, Sugriva, the lord of monkeys, embracing Angada conferred on him the heir-apparentship of the throne.

sanskrit: अंगदे च अभिषिक्ते तु सानुक्रोशाः प्लवंगमाः
साधु साधु इति सुग्रीवम् महात्मानो हि अपूजयन्
transliteration: aṃgade ca abhiṣikte tu sānukrośāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ
sādhu sādhu iti sugrīvam mahātmāno hi apūjayan
english: Angada being thus installed, those best of monkeys, highly delighted adored the highsouled Sugrīva, extolling him again and again.

sanskrit: रामम् च एव महात्मानम् लक्ष्मणम् च पुनः पुनः
प्रीताः च तुष्टुवुः सर्वे तादृशे तत्र वर्तिनि
transliteration: rāmam ca eva mahātmānam lakṣmaṇam ca punaḥ punaḥ
prītāḥ ca tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve tādṛśe tatra vartini
english: Angada and Sugrīva being thus established, they all, greatly delighted, praised again and again the high-souled Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आकीर्णा पताका ध्वज शोभिता
बभूव नगरी रम्या क्षिकिंधा गिरि गह्वरे
transliteration: hṛṣṭa puṣṭa jana ākīrṇā patākā dhvaja śobhitā
babhūva nagarī ramyā kṣikiṃdhā giri gahvare
english: The city of Kiskindhā, filled with stoutly built people and adorned with pennons and flags, appeared beautiful in the mountain cave.

sanskrit: निवेद्य रामाय तदा महात्मनेमहा अभिषेकम् कपि वाहनी पतिः
रुमाम् च भार्याम् उपलभ्य वीर्यवान्अवाप राज्यम् त्रिदश अधिपो यथा
transliteration: nivedya rāmāya tadā mahātmanemahā abhiṣekam kapi vāhanī patiḥ
rumām ca bhāryām upalabhya vīryavānavāpa rājyam tridaśa adhipo yathā
english: Communicating to the high-souled Rāma the news of installation the highly powerful lord of monkey hosts (Sugrīva) getting back his wife Rumā, regained the kingdom like to the lord of celestials.

sanskrit: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम्
आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणम् गिरिम्
transliteration: abhiṣikte tu sugrīve praviṣṭe vānare guhām
ājagāma saha bhrātrā rāmaḥ prasravaṇam girim

sanskrit: शार्दूल मृग संघुष्टम् सिंहैः भीम रवैः वृतम्
नाना गुल्म लता गूढम् बहु पादप संकुलम्
transliteration: śārdūla mṛga saṃghuṣṭam siṃhaiḥ bhīma ravaiḥ vṛtam
nānā gulma latā gūḍham bahu pādapa saṃkulam

sanskrit: ऋक्ष वानर गोपुच्छैः मार्जारैः च निषेवितम्
मेघ राशि निभम् शैलम् नित्यम् शुचिकरम् शिवम्
transliteration: ṛkṣa vānara gopucchaiḥ mārjāraiḥ ca niṣevitam
megha rāśi nibham śailam nityam śucikaram śivam

sanskrit: तस्य शैलस्य शिखरे महतीम् आयताम् गुहाम्
transliteration: tasya śailasya śikhare mahatīm āyatām guhām
english: Rāma, along with Saumitri, selected for his habitation, a spacious cave, situated on the summit of that hill.

sanskrit: कृत्वा च समयम् रामः सुग्रीवेण सह अनघ
काल युक्तम् महद् वाक्यम् उवाच रघुनन्दन
transliteration: kṛtvā ca samayam rāmaḥ sugrīveṇa saha anagha
kāla yuktam mahad vākyam uvāca raghunandana
english: Making the above condition with Sugrīva, Rāma, the pure-souled descendant of Raghu, spoke to his humble younger brother Lakşmaņa, the enhance of wealth, the following sound words, worthy of being spoken on that occasion.

sanskrit: विनीतम् भ्रातरम् भ्राता लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मि वर्धनम्
इयम् गिरि गुहा रम्या विशाला युक्त मारुता
transliteration: vinītam bhrātaram bhrātā lakṣmaṇam lakṣmi vardhanam
iyam giri guhā ramyā viśālā yukta mārutā

sanskrit: अस्याम् वस्त्याम सौमित्रे वर्ष रात्रम् अरिंदम
गिरि शृंगम् इदम् रम्यम् उत्तमम् पार्थिवात्मज
transliteration: asyām vastyāma saumitre varṣa rātram ariṃdama
giri śṛṃgam idam ramyam uttamam pārthivātmaja

sanskrit: नाना धातु समाकीर्णम् नदी दर्दुर संयुतम्
transliteration: nānā dhātu samākīrṇam nadī dardura saṃyutam

sanskrit: विविधैः वृक्ष षण्डैः च चारु चित्र लता युतम्
नाना विहग संघुष्टम् मयूर वर नादितम्
transliteration: vividhaiḥ vṛkṣa ṣaṇḍaiḥ ca cāru citra latā yutam
nānā vihaga saṃghuṣṭam mayūra vara nāditam

sanskrit: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च सिंदुवारैः शिरीषकैः
कदंब अर्जुन सर्जैः च पुष्पितैः उपशोभितम्
transliteration: mālatī kuṃda gulmaiḥ ca siṃduvāraiḥ śirīṣakaiḥ
kadaṃba arjuna sarjaiḥ ca puṣpitaiḥ upaśobhitam

sanskrit: इयम् च नलिनि रम्या फुल्ल पंकज मण्डितैः
न अति दूरे गुहाया नौ भविष्यति नृपात्मज
transliteration: iyam ca nalini ramyā phulla paṃkaja maṇḍitaiḥ
na ati dūre guhāyā nau bhaviṣyati nṛpātmaja
english: O son of a king, this pond filled with full blown lotuses shall always be near our cave.

sanskrit: प्राग् उदक् प्रवणे देशे गुहा साधु भविष्यति
पश्चात् च एव उन्नता सौम्य निवाते अयम् भविष्यति
transliteration: prāg udak pravaṇe deśe guhā sādhu bhaviṣyati
paścāt ca eva unnatā saumya nivāte ayam bhaviṣyati
english: This cave shall be worthy of our habitation, O gentle one, having its north-eastern part low and the western part high.

sanskrit: गुहा द्वारे च सौमित्रे शिला सम तला शिवा
कृष्णा च एव आयता चैव भिन्न अंजन चय उपममा
transliteration: guhā dvāre ca saumitre śilā sama talā śivā
kṛṣṇā ca eva āyatā caiva bhinna aṃjana caya upamamā
english: There is, O Saumitri, at the entrance of the cave, a level beautiful, spacious stone, black like to collyrium.

sanskrit: गिरि शृंगम् इदम् तात पश्य च उत्तरतः सुभम्
भिन्न अंजन चय आकारम् अंभोधरम् इव उदितम्
transliteration: giri śṛṃgam idam tāta paśya ca uttarataḥ subham
bhinna aṃjana caya ākāram aṃbhodharam iva uditam
english: Behold O my brother, on the north, the summit of the hill, resembling collyrium and a rising cloud.

sanskrit: दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिश स्थितम् श्वेतम् इव अंबरम्
कैलास शिखर प्रख्यम् नाना धातु विराजितम्
transliteration: dakṣiṇasyām api diśa sthitam śvetam iva aṃbaram
kailāsa śikhara prakhyam nānā dhātu virājitam
english: There appears on the south a beautiful white hill resembling the Kailasa filled with various metals.

sanskrit: प्राचीन वाहिनीम् चैव नदीम् भृशम् अकर्दमम्
गुहायाः परतः पश्य त्रिकूटे जह्नवीम् इव
transliteration: prācīna vāhinīm caiva nadīm bhṛśam akardamam
guhāyāḥ parataḥ paśya trikūṭe jahnavīm iva

sanskrit: पद्मकैः सरलैः चैव अशोकैः चैव शोभितम्
transliteration: padmakaiḥ saralaiḥ caiva aśokaiḥ caiva śobhitam

sanskrit: वानीरैः तिमिदैः चैव वकुलैः केतकैः अपि
transliteration: vānīraiḥ timidaiḥ caiva vakulaiḥ ketakaiḥ api

sanskrit: तीरजैः शोभिता भाति नाना रूपैः ततः ततः
वसन आभरण उपेत प्रमद एव अभ्यलंकृता
transliteration: tīrajaiḥ śobhitā bhāti nānā rūpaiḥ tataḥ tataḥ
vasana ābharaṇa upeta pramada eva abhyalaṃkṛtā

sanskrit: शतशः पक्षि सन्घैः च नाना नाद विनादिता
transliteration: śataśaḥ pakṣi sanghaiḥ ca nānā nāda vināditā
english: This rivulet resounded with various notes of hundreds of various birds, filled with Cakravākas attached to each other, crowded with geese and Sārasas, having picturesque banks, and various jewels, is as it were laughing on all sides.

sanskrit: पुलिनैः अति रम्यैः च हंस सारस सेविता
प्रहसंती इव भाति एषा नारी रत्न विभूषिता
transliteration: pulinaiḥ ati ramyaiḥ ca haṃsa sārasa sevitā
prahasaṃtī iva bhāti eṣā nārī ratna vibhūṣitā

sanskrit: क्वचित् नीलोत्पलैः च्छन्न भाति रक्तोत्पलैः क्वचित्
क्वचित् भाति शुक्लैः च दिव्यैः कुमुद कुड्मलैः
transliteration: kvacit nīlotpalaiḥ cchanna bhāti raktotpalaiḥ kvacit
kvacit bhāti śuklaiḥ ca divyaiḥ kumuda kuḍmalaiḥ
english: Here it appears covered with violet lotuses, here with red lotuses and there again with celestial white water-lilies.

sanskrit: पारिप्लव शतैः जुष्टा बर्हि क्रौन्च विनादिता
रमणिया नदी सौम्य मुनि संघ निषेविता
transliteration: pāriplava śataiḥ juṣṭā barhi kraunca vināditā
ramaṇiyā nadī saumya muni saṃgha niṣevitā
english: This pleasant and picturesque stream is filled with various water fowls and Chakravākas and served by many a saint.

sanskrit: पश्य चंदन वृक्षाणाम् पंक्ती सुरुचिरा इव
ककुभानम् च दृश्यन्ते मनसा इव उदिताः समम्
transliteration: paśya caṃdana vṛkṣāṇām paṃktī surucirā iva
kakubhānam ca dṛśyante manasā iva uditāḥ samam
english: Behold there the rows of pleasant sandal trees and those Kukubhas which have grown up as it were like to mental emotion.

sanskrit: अहो सुरमणीयो अयम् देशः शत्रु निषूदन
दृढम् रंस्याव सौमित्रे साधु अत्र निवसावहे
transliteration: aho suramaṇīyo ayam deśaḥ śatru niṣūdana
dṛḍham raṃsyāva saumitre sādhu atra nivasāvahe
english: Picturesque indeed is this place, O slayer of foes, and we shall happily live here, O son of Sumitra.

sanskrit: इतः च न अति दूरे सा किष्किंधा चित्र कानना
transliteration: itaḥ ca na ati dūre sā kiṣkiṃdhā citra kānanā
english: At no distance, O son of a king, from this place is situate the pleasant city of Sugrīva-Kiş kindha, filled with forests.

sanskrit: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषः श्रूयते जयताम् वर
नदताम् वानराणाम् च मृदंग आडंबरैः सह
transliteration: gīta vāditra nirghoṣaḥ śrūyate jayatām vara
nadatām vānarāṇām ca mṛdaṃga āḍaṃbaraiḥ saha
english: Hear then, O best of conquerors, the sound of music, and the clatter of monkeys mingled with the sound of Mşdangas.

sanskrit: लब्ध्वा भार्याम् कपिवरः प्राप्य राज्यम् सुहृत् वृतः
ध्रुवम् नंदति सुग्रीवः संप्राप्य महतीम् श्रियम्
transliteration: labdhvā bhāryām kapivaraḥ prāpya rājyam suhṛt vṛtaḥ
dhruvam naṃdati sugrīvaḥ saṃprāpya mahatīm śriyam
english: Forsooth is rejoicing Sugrīva—the foremost of monkeys, getting back his wife, regaining his kingdom, and attaining to regal splendour.

sanskrit: इति उक्त्वा न्यवसत् तत्र राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः
बहु दृश्य दरी कुंजे तस्मिन् प्रस्रवणे गिरौ
transliteration: iti uktvā nyavasat tatra rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
bahu dṛśya darī kuṃje tasmin prasravaṇe girau
english: Having said this, Rāghava, along with Laks maņa, dwelt in that Prasravana hill abounding in caves and bowers.

sanskrit: सुसुखे हि बहु द्रव्ये तस्मिन् हि धरणी धरे
वसतः तस्य रामस्य रतिः अल्पा अपि न अभवत्
transliteration: susukhe hi bahu dravye tasmin hi dharaṇī dhare
vasataḥ tasya rāmasya ratiḥ alpā api na abhavat
english: He did not attain to a best felicity although he lived in that pleasant hill filled with many things.

sanskrit: हृताम् हि भार्याम् स्मरतः प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम्
उदय अभ्युदितम् दृष्ट्वा शशांकम् च विशेषतः
transliteration: hṛtām hi bhāryām smarataḥ prāṇebhyo api garīyasīm
udaya abhyuditam dṛṣṭvā śaśāṃkam ca viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: आविवेश न तम् निद्रा निशासु शयनम् गतम्
तत् समुत्थेन शोकेन बाष्प उपहत चेतसम्
transliteration: āviveśa na tam nidrā niśāsu śayanam gatam
tat samutthena śokena bāṣpa upahata cetasam

sanskrit: तम् शोचमानम् काकुत्स्थम् नित्यम् शोक परायणम्
तुल्य दुःखो अब्रवीद् भ्राता लक्ष्मणो अनुनयम् वचः
transliteration: tam śocamānam kākutstham nityam śoka parāyaṇam
tulya duḥkho abravīd bhrātā lakṣmaṇo anunayam vacaḥ
english: His younger brother Laksmana, equally aggrieved, spoke to Kākutstha, thus bewailing being exercised with grief and almost beside himself with sorrow, consequent upon Sita's bereavement, saying.

sanskrit: अलम् वीर व्यथाम् गत्वा न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि
शोचतो हि अवसीदन्ति सर्व अर्था विदितम् हि ते
transliteration: alam vīra vyathām gatvā na tvam śocitum arhasi
śocato hi avasīdanti sarva arthā viditam hi te
english: It does not behove you to lament thus, being exercised with grief—it is not unknown to you that people, thus bewailing do exhaust themselves by and by.

sanskrit: भवान् क्रिया परो लोके भवान् देव परायणः
आस्तिको धर्म शीलः च व्यवसायी च राघव
transliteration: bhavān kriyā paro loke bhavān deva parāyaṇaḥ
āstiko dharma śīlaḥ ca vyavasāyī ca rāghava
english: O Rāghava, you are devoted to pious actions and the services of the Deity in this world-and pious, energetic and did believe in the existence of God.

sanskrit: न हि अव्यवसितः शत्रुम् राक्षसम् तम् विशेषतः
समर्थः त्वम् रणे हन्तुम् विक्रमैः जिह्म कारिणम्
transliteration: na hi avyavasitaḥ śatrum rākṣasam tam viśeṣataḥ
samarthaḥ tvam raṇe hantum vikramaiḥ jihma kāriṇam
english: Without being persevering you shall not be able to destroy in conflict your enemy—that terrible, wily Rākşasa.

sanskrit: समुन्मूलय शोकम् त्वम् व्यवसायम् स्थिरी कुरु
ततः सपरिवारम् तम् राक्षसम् हन्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: samunmūlaya śokam tvam vyavasāyam sthirī kuru
tataḥ saparivāram tam rākṣasam hantum arhasi
english: Do you renounce your grief and take recourse to energy and you shall be able to slay that Rākş asa with all his family.

sanskrit: पृथिवीम् अपि काकुत्स्थ ससागर वन अचलाम्
परिवर्तयितुम् शक्तः किम् पुनः तम् हि रावणम्
transliteration: pṛthivīm api kākutstha sasāgara vana acalām
parivartayitum śaktaḥ kim punaḥ tam hi rāvaṇam
english: What of the destruction of Rāvana, you are O Kākutstha. capable of uprooting the earth with oceans, forest and hills.

sanskrit: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृट् कालो अयम् आगतः
ततः स राष्ट्रम् स गणाम् रावणम् तम् वधिष्यसि
transliteration: śarat kālam pratīkṣasva prāvṛṭ kālo ayam āgataḥ
tataḥ sa rāṣṭram sa gaṇām rāvaṇam tam vadhiṣyasi
english: Rains have set in and do you wait for the autumn shall encompass the destruction of Rāvana with his kingdom and kinsmen.

sanskrit: अहम् तु खलु ते वीर्यम् प्रसुप्तम् प्रतिबोधये
दीप्तैः आहुतिभिः काले भस्म चन्नम् इव अनलम्
transliteration: aham tu khalu te vīryam prasuptam pratibodhaye
dīptaiḥ āhutibhiḥ kāle bhasma cannam iva analam
english: I, too, am exciting your latent energy like to fire hidden in ashes with oblations.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य हि तद् वाक्यम् प्रतिपूज्य हितम् शुभम्
राघवः सुहृदम् स्निग्धम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya hi tad vākyam pratipūjya hitam śubham
rāghavaḥ suhṛdam snigdham idam vacanam abravīt
english: Welcoming the auspicious and well-meaning accents of Lakşmaņa, Raghava again spoke to him the following affectionate words. when you

sanskrit: वाच्यम् यद् अनुरक्तेन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च
सत्य विक्रम युक्तेन तद् उक्तम् लक्ष्मण त्वया
transliteration: vācyam yad anuraktena snigdhena ca hitena ca
satya vikrama yuktena tad uktam lakṣmaṇa tvayā
english: O Lakşmaņa, truly do your words become you, affectionate, devoted, truthful and intent in my welfare as you are.

sanskrit: एष शोकः परित्यक्तः सर्व कार्य अवसादकः
transliteration: eṣa śokaḥ parityaktaḥ sarva kārya avasādakaḥ
english: Renouncing this grief standing in the way of all business, I shail call forth, the more, this my energy on the occasion of displaying my prowess.

sanskrit: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितो अस्मि वचने तव
transliteration: śarat kālam pratīkṣiṣye sthito asmi vacane tava
english: I shall live here, awaiting the autumn and abiding by your words and awaiting as well Sugrīva's pleasure and the clear currents of the rivers.

sanskrit: तत् एव युक्तम् प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणःकृत अंजलि तत् प्रतिपूजय भाषितम्
उवाच रामम् स्वभिराम दर्शनम्प्रदर्शयन् दर्शनम् आत्मनः शुभम्
transliteration: tat eva yuktam praṇidhāya lakṣmaṇaḥkṛta aṃjali tat pratipūjaya bhāṣitam
uvāca rāmam svabhirāma darśanampradarśayan darśanam ātmanaḥ śubham
english: Heroes receiving favours always return them; the ungrateful lose the friendship of the welcoming them therefore, Laksmana, with folded hands, spoke to Rāma of graceful appearance, displaying his own intelligence,

sanskrit: यथोक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्नरेन्द्र कर्ता न चिरात् तु वानर
शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः
transliteration: yathoktam etat tava sarvam īpsitamnarendra kartā na cirāt tu vānara
śarat pratīkṣaḥ kṣamatām imam bhavānjala prapātam ripu nigrahe dhṛtaḥ
english: O lord of men, I fully approve of all you had said. The monkey-chief shall soon engage in our service. Resolved on the destruction of your enemy, do you spend here this rainy season awaiting the autumn.

sanskrit: नियम्य कोपम् प्रतिपाल्यताम् शरत्क्षमस्व मासाम् चतुरो मया सह
वस अचले अस्मिन् मृग राज सेवितेसंवर्तयन् शत्रु वधे समर्थः
transliteration: niyamya kopam pratipālyatām śaratkṣamasva māsām caturo mayā saha
vasa acale asmin mṛga rāja sevitesaṃvartayan śatru vadhe samarthaḥ
english: Subduing your wrath, and awaiting the autumn, do you with me spend these four months in this hill filled with deer, capable as you are of encompassing the destruction of your enemy.

sanskrit: स तदा वालिनम् हत्वा सुग्रीवम् अभिषिच्य च
वसन् माल्यवतः पृष्टे रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa tadā vālinam hatvā sugrīvam abhiṣicya ca
vasan mālyavataḥ pṛṣṭe rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: Thereupon encompassing the destruction of Vāli, installing Sugrīva and dwelling on the summit of the Mālyabana hill, Rāma spoke to Laksmana, saying,

sanskrit: अयम् स कालः संप्राप्तः समयो अद्य जल आगमः
संपश्य त्वम् नभो मेघैः संवृतम् गिरि संनिभैः
transliteration: ayam sa kālaḥ saṃprāptaḥ samayo adya jala āgamaḥ
saṃpaśya tvam nabho meghaiḥ saṃvṛtam giri saṃnibhaiḥ
english: This is the time the beginning of the rainy season-do you behold the sky enveloped with clouds resembling so many hills.

sanskrit: नव मास धृतम् गर्भम् भास्करस्य गभस्तिभिः
पीत्वा रसम् समुद्राणाम् द्यौः प्रसूते रसायनम्
transliteration: nava māsa dhṛtam garbham bhāskarasya gabhastibhiḥ
pītvā rasam samudrāṇām dyauḥ prasūte rasāyanam
english: The sky, drinking the liquid contents of the ocean through the rays of the Sun, and being enceinite for nine months, is giving birth to showers.

sanskrit: शक्यम् अंबरम् आरुह्य मेघ सोपान पंक्तिभिः
transliteration: śakyam aṃbaram āruhya megha sopāna paṃktibhiḥ
english: Ascending the sky by the steps of clouds, one can ornameni the Sun with garlands of Kutajas and Arjunas.

sanskrit: संध्या राग उत्थितैः ताम्रैः अंतेषु अधिक पाण्डुरैः
स्निग्धैः अभ्र पट च्छेदैः बद्ध व्रणम् इव अंबरम्
transliteration: saṃdhyā rāga utthitaiḥ tāmraiḥ aṃteṣu adhika pāṇḍuraiḥ
snigdhaiḥ abhra paṭa cchedaiḥ baddha vraṇam iva aṃbaram
english: Like to a wound covered with a torn cloth, the sky is enveloped with cool clouds, coppery with the rays of the setting Sun, and yellow at another end.

sanskrit: मन्द मारुत निःश्वासम् संध्या चंदन रंजितम्
आपाण्डु जलदम् भाति काम आतुरम् इव अंबरम्
transliteration: manda māruta niḥśvāsam saṃdhyā caṃdana raṃjitam
āpāṇḍu jaladam bhāti kāma āturam iva aṃbaram
english: The sky, having mild breezes as its breath, sprinkled with sandal-like evening rays and covered with yellow clouds, is appearing as it were like one stricken with amour.

sanskrit: एषा घर्म परिक्लिष्टा नव वारि परिप्लुता
सीता इव शोक संतप्ता मही बाष्पम् विमुंचति
transliteration: eṣā gharma parikliṣṭā nava vāri pariplutā
sītā iva śoka saṃtaptā mahī bāṣpam vimuṃcati
english: The earth, afflicted with perspiration and filled with new water, is emitting forth vapour like to Sitā racked with sorrow.

sanskrit: मेघ उदर विनिर्मुक्ताः कर्पूर दल शीतलाः
शक्यम् अंजलिभिः पातुम् वाताः केतकि गन्धिनः
transliteration: megha udara vinirmuktāḥ karpūra dala śītalāḥ
śakyam aṃjalibhiḥ pātum vātāḥ ketaki gandhinaḥ
english: Ketaka smelling breezes may be drunk up in the cavity formed by putting the hands together, like to cold water discharged off the clouds and mixed with camphor.

sanskrit: एष फुल्ल अर्जुनः शैलः केतकैः अधिवासितः
सुग्रीव इव शान्त अरिः धाराभिः अभिषिच्यते
transliteration: eṣa phulla arjunaḥ śailaḥ ketakaiḥ adhivāsitaḥ
sugrīva iva śānta ariḥ dhārābhiḥ abhiṣicyate
english: This hill, having blown Arjunas and Ketakas and rid of its enemies like to Sugriva, has been bathed with showers.

sanskrit: मेघ कृष्ण अजिन धरा धारा यज्ञ उपवीतिनः
मारुत आपूरित गुहाः प्राधीता इव पर्वताः
transliteration: megha kṛṣṇa ajina dharā dhārā yajña upavītinaḥ
māruta āpūrita guhāḥ prādhītā iva parvatāḥ
english: These hillocks, having clouds for dark deerskins, heavy showers for sacred threads and having caves filled with air, are appearing like so many Brahmins who have finished their studies.

sanskrit: कशाभिः इव हैमीभिः विद्युद्भिः इव ताडितम्
अन्तः स्तनित निर्घोषम् सवेदनम् इव अंबरम्
transliteration: kaśābhiḥ iva haimībhiḥ vidyudbhiḥ iva tāḍitam
antaḥ stanita nirghoṣam savedanam iva aṃbaram
english: The sky, being struck by thunders like to so many golden lashes, is, as if, groaning under a deep mental agony.

sanskrit: नील मेघ आश्रिता विद्युत् स्फुरंती प्रतिभाति मे
स्फुरंती रावणस्य अंके वैदेही इव तपस्विनी
transliteration: nīla megha āśritā vidyut sphuraṃtī pratibhāti me
sphuraṃtī rāvaṇasya aṃke vaidehī iva tapasvinī
english: Methinks, the lighting, shining by the violet clouds, is appearing like to the poor Vaidehi at the lap of Rävaņa.

sanskrit: इमाः ता मन्मथवताम् हिताः प्रतिहता दिशः
अनुलिप्ता इव घनैः नष्ट ग्रह निशा कराः
transliteration: imāḥ tā manmathavatām hitāḥ pratihatā diśaḥ
anuliptā iva ghanaiḥ naṣṭa graha niśā karāḥ
english: These quarters, enveloped with clouds and having therefore the Moon and stars hidden, are indeed very pleasant to those who are under the influence of Cupid

sanskrit: क्वचित् बाष्प अभिसंरुद्धान् वर्ष आगम समुत्सुकान्
कुटजान् पश्य सौमित्रे पुष्टितान् गिरि सानुषु
मम शोक अभिभूतस्य काम सम्दीपनान् स्थितान्
transliteration: kvacit bāṣpa abhisaṃruddhān varṣa āgama samutsukān
kuṭajān paśya saumitre puṣṭitān giri sānuṣu
mama śoka abhibhūtasya kāma samdīpanān sthitān
english: Behold, O Saumitri, on the summits of the hill the flowery Kuțajas enveloped with the vapour arising out of the earth, gladdened at the approach of the rainy season and exciting my amour who am stricken with grief.

sanskrit: रजः प्रशांतम् स हिमो अद्य वायुःनिदाघ दोष प्रसराः प्रशांताः
स्थिता हि यात्रा वसुधा अधिपानाम्प्रवासिनो यांति नराः स्व देशान्
transliteration: rajaḥ praśāṃtam sa himo adya vāyuḥnidāgha doṣa prasarāḥ praśāṃtāḥ
sthitā hi yātrā vasudhā adhipānāmpravāsino yāṃti narāḥ sva deśān
english: (In this season) the dust is watered, the air is saturated with dews, all the evils of the summer are stopped, the kings no longer proceed on royal marches and those journeying in a foreign land return their native homes.

sanskrit: संप्रस्थिता मानस वास लुब्धाःप्रिय अन्विताः संप्रति चक्रवाकः
अभीक्ष्ण वर्ष उदक विक्षतेषुयानानि मार्गेषु न संपतन्ति
transliteration: saṃprasthitā mānasa vāsa lubdhāḥpriya anvitāḥ saṃprati cakravākaḥ
abhīkṣṇa varṣa udaka vikṣateṣuyānāni mārgeṣu na saṃpatanti
english: The Cakravākas along with their mates are proceeding, being desirous to live in the Mänasa Sarovara, and in consequence of incessant rains, chariots and other conveyances cannot pass along the wayfares.

sanskrit: क्वचित् प्रकाशम् क्वचिद् अप्रकाशम्नभः प्रकीर्णा अंबु धरम् विभाति
क्वचित् क्वचित् पर्वत संनिरुद्धम्रूपम् यथा शान्त महार्णवस्य
transliteration: kvacit prakāśam kvacid aprakāśamnabhaḥ prakīrṇā aṃbu dharam vibhāti
kvacit kvacit parvata saṃniruddhamrūpam yathā śānta mahārṇavasya
english: Somewhere hidden, somewhere open, the sky, covered with clouds, appears like a vast ocean, being encircled here and there with hills.

sanskrit: व्यामिश्रितम् सर्ज कदंब पुष्पैःनवम् जलम् पर्वत धातु ताम्रम्
मयूर केकाभिः अनुप्रयातम्शैल अपगाः शीघ्रतरम् वहन्ति
transliteration: vyāmiśritam sarja kadaṃba puṣpaiḥnavam jalam parvata dhātu tāmram
mayūra kekābhiḥ anuprayātamśaila apagāḥ śīghrataram vahanti
english: There speedily pass by the hill streams, being resounded with the cries of peacocks, carrying with the current Sarja and Kadamba flowers and having their coppery contents mixed with the metals of the mountain.

sanskrit: रस आकुलम् षट्पद संनिकाशम्प्रभुज्यते जंबु फलम् प्रकामम्
अनेक वर्णम् पवन अवधूतम्भूमौ पतति आम्र फलम् विपक्वम्
transliteration: rasa ākulam ṣaṭpada saṃnikāśamprabhujyate jaṃbu phalam prakāmam
aneka varṇam pavana avadhūtambhūmau patati āmra phalam vipakvam
english: People (in this season) live upon Inany a sweet rose-apple; and ripe mangoes, of diverse colours, being shaken by the wind, fall on the earth.

sanskrit: विद्युत् पताकाः स बलाक मालाःशैलेन्द्र कूट आकृति संनिकाशाः
गर्जन्ति मेघाः समुदीर्ण नादामत्त गजेन्द्रा इव संयुगस्थाः
transliteration: vidyut patākāḥ sa balāka mālāḥśailendra kūṭa ākṛti saṃnikāśāḥ
garjanti meghāḥ samudīrṇa nādāmatta gajendrā iva saṃyugasthāḥ
english: The clouds, resembling the summits of a mountain, having lightnings for pennons and cranes for garlands, are muttering like to infuriated elephants in a field of battle.

sanskrit: वर्ष उदक आअप्यायित शाद्वलानिप्रवृत्त नृत्त उत्सव बर्हिणानि
वनानि निर्वृष्ट बलाहकानिपश्य अपराह्णेषु अधिकम् विभान्ति
transliteration: varṣa udaka āapyāyita śādvalānipravṛtta nṛtta utsava barhiṇāni
vanāni nirvṛṣṭa balāhakānipaśya aparāhṇeṣu adhikam vibhānti
english: The forest-lands, having their green pastures emerged in water, with peacocks dancing all around with joy and clouds discharging their watery volumes incessantly, are appearing more graceful in the evening.

sanskrit: सम् उद् वहन्तः सलिल अति भारम्बलाकिनो वारि धरा नदन्तः
महत्सु शृंगेषु मही धराणाम्विश्रम्य विश्रम्य पुनः प्रयान्ति
transliteration: sam ud vahantaḥ salila ati bhārambalākino vāri dharā nadantaḥ
mahatsu śṛṃgeṣu mahī dharāṇāmviśramya viśramya punaḥ prayānti
english: (In this season) clouds, surrounded by cranes and heavily laden with water, are constantly moving, sometimes resting on the high summits of the mountains and emitting a muttering sound,

sanskrit: मेघ अभिकामा परिसंपतन्तीसम्मोदिता भाति बलाक पंक्तिः
वात अवधूता वर पौण्डरीकीलंब इव माला रुचिर अंबरस्य
transliteration: megha abhikāmā parisaṃpatantīsammoditā bhāti balāka paṃktiḥ
vāta avadhūtā vara pauṇḍarīkīlaṃba iva mālā rucira aṃbarasya
english: And rows of cranes, fond of clouds, rising up in the sky, delighted and moved by the wind, are appearing like a garland of white lotuses, spread along the welkin.

sanskrit: बाल इन्द्रगोप्ता अंतर चित्रितेनविभाति भूमिः नव शाद्वलेन
गात्र अनुपृक्तेन शुक प्रभेणनारी इव लाक्ष उक्षित कंबलेन
transliteration: bāla indragoptā aṃtara citritenavibhāti bhūmiḥ nava śādvalena
gātra anupṛktena śuka prabheṇanārī iva lākṣa ukṣita kaṃbalena
english: And the earth, covered with green grass and variegated with newly born insects, is appearing like a damsel clothed with a white blanket spotted here and there with lac.

sanskrit: निद्रा शनैः केशवम् अभ्युपैतिद्रुतम् नदी सागरम् अभ्युपैति
हृष्टा बलाका घनम् अभ्युपैतिकान्ता स कामा प्रियम् अभ्युपैति
transliteration: nidrā śanaiḥ keśavam abhyupaitidrutam nadī sāgaram abhyupaiti
hṛṣṭā balākā ghanam abhyupaitikāntā sa kāmā priyam abhyupaiti
english: (In this part of the year) sleep is gradually overcoming the great God Nārāyaṇa, the river is flowing speedily towards the ocean, the delighted cranes are approaching the clouds and the damsels are proceeding towards their lovers.

sanskrit: जाता वनान्ताः शिखि सुप्रनृत्ताजाताः कदंबाः स कदंब शाखाः
जाता वृषा गोषु समान कामाजाता मही सस्य वन अभिरामा
transliteration: jātā vanāntāḥ śikhi supranṛttājātāḥ kadaṃbāḥ sa kadaṃba śākhāḥ
jātā vṛṣā goṣu samāna kāmājātā mahī sasya vana abhirāmā
english: The peacocks are dancing at the forest skirts, the Kadamba trees are covered with flowers, the bulls have become attached to her and the earth has become charming with corns and forests.

sanskrit: वहन्ति वर्षन्ति नदन्ति भान्तिध्यायन्ति नृत्यन्ति समाश्वसन्ति
नद्यो घना मत्त गजा वन अन्ताःप्रिया विहीनाः शिखिनः प्लवंगाः
transliteration: vahanti varṣanti nadanti bhāntidhyāyanti nṛtyanti samāśvasanti
nadyo ghanā matta gajā vana antāḥpriyā vihīnāḥ śikhinaḥ plavaṃgāḥ
english: The rivers are flowing by; the clouds are discharging waters; the infuriated elephants are emitting terrible roars; the forest-lands are growing more charming; persons, separated from their wives, are growing more anxious; the peacocks are dancing with delight and the monkeys are greatly comforted for Sugrīva's attaining to the kingdom.

sanskrit: प्रहर्षिताः केतक पुष्प गन्धम्आघ्राय मत्ता वन निर्झरेषु
प्रपात शब्द आकुलिता गजेन्द्राःसार्धम् मयूरैः स मदा नदन्ति
transliteration: praharṣitāḥ ketaka puṣpa gandhamāghrāya mattā vana nirjhareṣu
prapāta śabda ākulitā gajendrāḥsārdham mayūraiḥ sa madā nadanti
english: By the fountains in he forests, the infuriated elephants delighted with the fragrance of the Ketaka flowers and maddened with the noise of the water falls, are emitting terrible roars along with the peacocks.

sanskrit: क्षण अर्जितम् पुष्प रस अवगाढम्शनैर् मदम् षट् चरणाः त्यजन्ति
transliteration: kṣaṇa arjitam puṣpa rasa avagāḍhamśanair madam ṣaṭ caraṇāḥ tyajanti
english: The black bees, resorting to the branches of the Kadamba trees and overwhelmed with showers, are, as if, slowly discharging their temporal juice-namely the honey of flowers collected by them ere while.

sanskrit: अंगार चूर्ण उत्कर संनिकाशैःफलैः सुपर्याप्त रसैः समृद्धैः
जंबू द्रुमाणाम् प्रविभान्ति शाखानिपीयमाना इव षट्पद ओघैः
transliteration: aṃgāra cūrṇa utkara saṃnikāśaiḥphalaiḥ suparyāpta rasaiḥ samṛddhaiḥ
jaṃbū drumāṇām pravibhānti śākhānipīyamānā iva ṣaṭpada oghaiḥ
english: The branches of rose-apple trees containing enough of fruits like to a collection of char coal are so appearing as if the black bees are drinking the juice thereof.

sanskrit: तडित् पताकाभिः अलंकृतानाम्उदीर्ण गंभीर महा रवाणाम्
विभान्ति रूपाणि बलाहकानाम्रण उत्सुकानाम् इव वारणानाम्
transliteration: taḍit patākābhiḥ alaṃkṛtānāmudīrṇa gaṃbhīra mahā ravāṇām
vibhānti rūpāṇi balāhakānāmraṇa utsukānām iva vāraṇānām
english: The dense clouds, ornamented with pennonlike lightnings and emitting terrible roars, are appearing like so many elephants, mad after fighting.

sanskrit: मार्ग अनुगः शैल वन अनुसारीसंप्रस्थितो मेघ रवम् निशम्य
युद्ध अभिकामः प्रतिनाद शन्कीमत्तो गजेन्द्रः प्रतिसंनिवृत्तः
transliteration: mārga anugaḥ śaila vana anusārīsaṃprasthito megha ravam niśamya
yuddha abhikāmaḥ pratināda śankīmatto gajendraḥ pratisaṃnivṛttaḥ
english: The infuriated lord of elephants, following in the track and ranging in the hills and forests hearing the muttering of clouds and taking it for the uproar of another elephant, has turned back, with a view to enter into conflict with him.

sanskrit: क्वचित् प्रगीता इव षट्पद ओघैःक्वचित् प्रवृत्ता इव नील कण्ठैः
क्वचित् प्रमत्ता इव वारण इन्द्रैःविभाति अनेक आश्रयिणो वनान्ता
transliteration: kvacit pragītā iva ṣaṭpada oghaiḥkvacit pravṛttā iva nīla kaṇṭhaiḥ
kvacit pramattā iva vāraṇa indraiḥvibhāti aneka āśrayiṇo vanāntā
english: Somewhere the bees are humming, somewhere the peacocks are dancing-somewhere are raging the infuriated elephants and in this way the forest-land has assumed diverse appearances.

sanskrit: कदंब सर्जा अर्जुन कंदल आढ्यावनान्त भूमि मधु वारि पूर्णा
मयूर मत्ता अभिरुत प्रवृत्तैःअपान भूमि प्रतिमा विभाति
transliteration: kadaṃba sarjā arjuna kaṃdala āḍhyāvanānta bhūmi madhu vāri pūrṇā
mayūra mattā abhiruta pravṛttaiḥapāna bhūmi pratimā vibhāti
english: It appears like to a drinking-place covered with Kadambas, Sarjas, Arjunas and lotuses growing on land, filled with water resembling honey and with the dance and cries of mad peacocks.

sanskrit: मुक्ता समाभम् सलिलम् पतत् वैसुनिर्मलम् पत्र पुटेषु लग्नम्
हृष्टा विवर्ण च्छदना विहंगाःसुरेन्द्र दत्तम् तृषिताः पिबन्ति
transliteration: muktā samābham salilam patat vaisunirmalam patra puṭeṣu lagnam
hṛṣṭā vivarṇa cchadanā vihaṃgāḥsurendra dattam tṛṣitāḥ pibanti
english: The birds, having their wings discoloured, being wet with water, delighted and thirsty, are drinking the drops of clear water, falling on leaves and discharged by the Lord of celestials*. *According to Hindu mythology Indra is the god of rains.

sanskrit: षत्पद तंत्री मधुर अभिधानम्प्लवंगम् उदीरित कण्ठ तालम्
आविष्कृतम् मेघ मृदंग नादैःवनेषु संगीतम् इव प्रवृत्तम्
transliteration: ṣatpada taṃtrī madhura abhidhānamplavaṃgam udīrita kaṇṭha tālam
āviṣkṛtam megha mṛdaṃga nādaiḥvaneṣu saṃgītam iva pravṛttam
english: The sonorous humming of the bees, being accompanied by the guttural sound of the frogs and the mutterings of the clouds resembling the sound of Mrdangas, an organised music, as if, has began in the forest.

sanskrit: क्वचित् प्रनृत्तैः क्वचित् उन् नदद्भिःक्वचित् च वृक्ष अग्र निषण्ण कायैः
व्यालंब बर्ह आभरणैः मयूरैःवनेषु संगितम् इव प्रवृत्तम्
transliteration: kvacit pranṛttaiḥ kvacit un nadadbhiḥkvacit ca vṛkṣa agra niṣaṇṇa kāyaiḥ
vyālaṃba barha ābharaṇaiḥ mayūraiḥvaneṣu saṃgitam iva pravṛttam
english: Sometimes dancing, sometimes setting up loud cries, sometimes placing themselves against the tops of the trees, the peacocks, having beautifully ornamented exteriors, have commenced music in the forest.
