sanskrit: स्वनैः घनानाम् प्लवगाः प्रबुद्धाविहाय निद्राम् चिर संनिरुद्धाम्
अनेक रूपा आकृति वर्ण नादानव अंबु धारा अभिहता नदन्ति
transliteration: svanaiḥ ghanānām plavagāḥ prabuddhāvihāya nidrām cira saṃniruddhām
aneka rūpā ākṛti varṇa nādānava aṃbu dhārā abhihatā nadanti
english: And rising from their perpetual sleep by the muttering of clouds, the frogs, assuming various shapes and making diverse sounds, are setting up cries being distressed with new watery showers.

sanskrit: दृप्ता नव प्राभृत पूर्ण भोगाद्रुतम् स्व भर्तारम् उपोप यान्ति
transliteration: dṛptā nava prābhṛta pūrṇa bhogādrutam sva bhartāram upopa yānti
english: The rivers, carrying Cakravākas as their breast and leaving behind their old banks, are approaching, being excited, their own lord with various new presents.

sanskrit: नीलेषु नीला नव वारि पूर्णामेघेषु मेघाः प्रविभान्ति सक्ताः
दवाग्नि दग्धेषु दवाग्नि दग्धाःशैलेषु शैला इव बद्ध मूलाः
transliteration: nīleṣu nīlā nava vāri pūrṇāmegheṣu meghāḥ pravibhānti saktāḥ
davāgni dagdheṣu davāgni dagdhāḥśaileṣu śailā iva baddha mūlāḥ
english: Clouds, big with new waters coming in, contact with violet ones are appearing as such; and sometimes, touching the hills brunt by forest-fire, are appearing like deep-rooted hills.

sanskrit: प्रमत्त संनाददित बर्हिणानिस शक्रगोप अकुल शाद्वलानि
चरन्ति नीप अर्जुन वासितानिगजाः सुरम्याणि वन अन्तराणि
transliteration: pramatta saṃnādadita barhiṇānisa śakragopa akula śādvalāni
caranti nīpa arjuna vāsitānigajāḥ suramyāṇi vana antarāṇi
english: The elephants are ranging in this charming forest-land, carrying the fragrance of Neepas and Arjunas, having its green swards filled with Indragopas* and with delighted, peacocks dancing all around. *An insect (Coccinella of various kinds).

sanskrit: नव अंबु धार आहत केसराणिद्रुतम् परित्यज्य सरोरुहाणि
कदंब पुष्पाणि स केसराणिनवानि हृष्टा भ्रमराः पिबन्ति
transliteration: nava aṃbu dhāra āhata kesarāṇidrutam parityajya saroruhāṇi
kadaṃba puṣpāṇi sa kesarāṇinavāni hṛṣṭā bhramarāḥ pibanti
english: The black bees, delighted, are drinking honey, embracing the shower-distressed and filaments of the lotuses and Kadamba flowers.

sanskrit: मत्ता गजेन्द्रा मुदिता गवेन्द्रावनेषु विक्रांततरा मृगेन्द्राः
रम्या नगेन्द्रा निभृता नरेन्द्राःप्रक्रीडितो वारि धरैः सुरेन्द्रः
transliteration: mattā gajendrā muditā gavendrāvaneṣu vikrāṃtatarā mṛgendrāḥ
ramyā nagendrā nibhṛtā narendrāḥprakrīḍito vāri dharaiḥ surendraḥ
english: (In this season) the elephants are infuriated, the bulls are delighted, the lions have grown more powerful, the hills are charming-the kings are devoid of all active pursuits, are the Lord of celestials is engaged in sport with clouds.

sanskrit: मेघाः समुद् भूत समुद्र नादामहाजल ओघैः गगन अवलंबाः
नदीः तटाकानि सरांसि वापिःमहीम् च कृत्स्नाम् अपवाहयन्ति
transliteration: meghāḥ samud bhūta samudra nādāmahājala oghaiḥ gagana avalaṃbāḥ
nadīḥ taṭākāni sarāṃsi vāpiḥmahīm ca kṛtsnām apavāhayanti
english: The clouds ranging in the welkin and discharging heavy showers, are roaring like to ocean; and the rivers, ponds and pools are deluging the earth with their watery contents.

sanskrit: वर्ष प्रवेगा विपुला पतन्तिप्रवान्ति वाताः समुदीर्ण वेगाः
प्रनष्ट कूलाः प्रवहन्ति शीघ्रम्नद्यो जलम् विप्रतिपन्न मार्गाः
transliteration: varṣa pravegā vipulā patantipravānti vātāḥ samudīrṇa vegāḥ
pranaṣṭa kūlāḥ pravahanti śīghramnadyo jalam vipratipanna mārgāḥ
english: (In this season) heavy showers set in—the wind bloweth mightily and the rivers breaking down their banks flow quickly blockading the wayfares.

sanskrit: नरैः नरेन्द्रा इव पर्वतेन्द्राःसुरेन्द्र नीतैः पवन उपनीतैः
घन अंबु कुम्भैः अभिषिच्यमानारूपम् श्रियम् स्वाम् इव दर्शयन्ति
transliteration: naraiḥ narendrā iva parvatendrāḥsurendra nītaiḥ pavana upanītaiḥ
ghana aṃbu kumbhaiḥ abhiṣicyamānārūpam śriyam svām iva darśayanti
english: The mountains are, as if, displaying their own beauty and grace being an it were bathed by the cloud like jars, conferred by the lord of celestials and brought by the wind.like to a king sprinkled by men.

sanskrit: घन उपगूढम् गगनम् न तारान भास्करो दर्शनम् अभ्युपैति
नवैः जल ओघैः धरणी वितृप्तातमो विलिप्ता न दिशः प्रकाशाः
transliteration: ghana upagūḍham gaganam na tārāna bhāskaro darśanam abhyupaiti
navaiḥ jala oghaiḥ dharaṇī vitṛptātamo viliptā na diśaḥ prakāśāḥ
english: The sky is enveloped with clouds and neither the sun nor the stars can be seen the earth is satisfied with new showers-and the quarters being covered with darkness cannot be seen.

sanskrit: महान्ति कूटानि मही धराणाम्धारा विधौतानि अधिकम् विभान्ति
महा प्रमाणैः विपुलैः प्रपातैःमुक्त कलापैः इव लंबमानैः
transliteration: mahānti kūṭāni mahī dharāṇāmdhārā vidhautāni adhikam vibhānti
mahā pramāṇaiḥ vipulaiḥ prapātaiḥmukta kalāpaiḥ iva laṃbamānaiḥ
english: The high summits, of the mountains, being washed by showers and beautified by farstretching waterfalls resembling pearls, are appearing more graceful.

sanskrit: गुहासु संनादित बर्हिणासुहारा विकीर्यन्त इव अवभान्ति
transliteration: guhāsu saṃnādita barhiṇāsuhārā vikīryanta iva avabhānti
english: The heavy mountain waterfalls, loosening the rocks and stretching over the caves filled with the cries of peacocks, are appearing like a pearlnecklace.

sanskrit: शीघ्र प्रवेगा विपुलाः प्रपातानिर्धौत शृंग उपतला गिरीणाम्
मुक्ता कलाप प्रतिमाः पतन्तोमहा गुह उस्त्संग तलैः ध्रियन्ते
transliteration: śīghra pravegā vipulāḥ prapātānirdhauta śṛṃga upatalā girīṇām
muktā kalāpa pratimāḥ patantomahā guha ustsaṃga talaiḥ dhriyante
english: And the quick streaming waterfalls, of the mountains, washing the summits of the hills, and resembling the pearls, are being deposited in the cave at the foot.

sanskrit: सुरताम् अर्द विच्छिन्नाः स्वर्ग स्त्री हार मौक्तिकाः
पतन्ति च अतुलाः दिक्षु तोय धाराः समन्ततः
transliteration: suratām arda vicchinnāḥ svarga strī hāra mauktikāḥ
patanti ca atulāḥ dikṣu toya dhārāḥ samantataḥ
english: And watery drops resembling the pearls of the necklaces used by celestial damsels are pouring on all sides.

sanskrit: विकसन्त्या च मालत्या गतो अस्तम् ज्ञायते रविः
transliteration: vikasantyā ca mālatyā gato astam jñāyate raviḥ
english: The setting of the Sun is announced by the birds taking to their nests, lotuses growing pale and Málatis blossoming.

sanskrit: वृत्ता यात्रा नरेन्द्राणाम् सेना पथि एव वर्तते
वैराणि चैव मार्गाः च सलिलेन समीकृताः
transliteration: vṛttā yātrā narendrāṇām senā pathi eva vartate
vairāṇi caiva mārgāḥ ca salilena samīkṛtāḥ
english: The royal marches are all stopped, and the soldiers, who have already marched are waiting in the way-hostility and wayfares have been equally blockaded by water.
This month of Bhādra is the time of studying for those Brahmins, who chant Sāma Vedas.

sanskrit: निवृत्त कर्म आयतनो नूनम् संचित संचयः
transliteration: nivṛtta karma āyatano nūnam saṃcita saṃcayaḥ
english: Having roofed all his houses and stored up his food, Bharata, the king of Kosala has set upon the performance of Așara sacrifices.

sanskrit: माम् समीक्ष्य समायान्तम् अयोध्याया इव स्वनः
transliteration: mām samīkṣya samāyāntam ayodhyāyā iva svanaḥ
english: The river Saraju is now brimful with water. Seeing me return as if Ayodhyā herself is making a delightful noise.

sanskrit: इमाः स्फीत गुणा वर्षाः सुग्रीवः सुखम् अश्नुते
विजित अरिः स दारः च राज्ये महति च स्थितः
transliteration: imāḥ sphīta guṇā varṣāḥ sugrīvaḥ sukham aśnute
vijita ariḥ sa dāraḥ ca rājye mahati ca sthitaḥ
english: Clearly manifest are now all the signs of the rainy season and Sugrīva, rid of his enemies, established on the vast kingdom, and regaining his wives, has attained to best felicity.

sanskrit: अहम् तु हृत दारः च राज्यात् च महतः च्युतः
नदी कूलम् इव क्लिन्नम् अवसीदामि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: aham tu hṛta dāraḥ ca rājyāt ca mahataḥ cyutaḥ
nadī kūlam iva klinnam avasīdāmi lakṣmaṇa
english: And I am, O Laksmana, waning every day like to the banks of a river, being separated from my spouse and deprived of my vast kingdom.

sanskrit: शोकः च मम विस्तीर्णो वर्षाः च भृश दुर्गमाः
रावणः च महान् शत्रुः अपारम् प्रतिभाति मे
transliteration: śokaḥ ca mama vistīrṇo varṣāḥ ca bhṛśa durgamāḥ
rāvaṇaḥ ca mahān śatruḥ apāram pratibhāti me
english: Immense is my grief, inaccessible is this rainy season and mighty is my enemy, Ravana; methinks it is impossible for me to bring about the discomfiture of my foe.

sanskrit: अयात्राम् चैव दृष्ट्वा इमाम् मार्गाम् च भृश दुर्गमान्
प्रणते चैव सुग्रीवे न मया किंचित् ईरितम्
transliteration: ayātrām caiva dṛṣṭvā imām mārgām ca bhṛśa durgamān
praṇate caiva sugrīve na mayā kiṃcit īritam
english: Owing to the unfitness of the season (for marching against my foe) and the wayfares being inaccessible, I cannot possibly request Sugrīva (to march) although he is prepared to abide by my mandate.

sanskrit: अपि च अति परिक्लिष्टम् चिरात् दारैः समागतम्
आत्म कार्य गरीयस्त्वात् वक्तुम् न इच्छामि वानरम्
transliteration: api ca ati parikliṣṭam cirāt dāraiḥ samāgatam
ātma kārya garīyastvāt vaktum na icchāmi vānaram
english: Moreover after a good deal of affliction he has regained his wives, and my service is of very great difficulty; so I do not wish to request that monkey-chief now.

sanskrit: स्वयम् एव हि विश्रम्य ज्ञात्वा कालम् उपागतम्
उपकारम् च सुग्रीवो वेत्स्यते न अत्र संशयः
transliteration: svayam eva hi viśramya jñātvā kālam upāgatam
upakāram ca sugrīvo vetsyate na atra saṃśayaḥ
english: Forsooth, shall Sugrīva think of the benefits (he has received from me) after enjoying rest for sometime, when the time for action shall arrive.

sanskrit: तस्मात् काल प्रतीक्षो अहम् स्थितो अस्मि शुभ लक्षण
transliteration: tasmāt kāla pratīkṣo aham sthito asmi śubha lakṣaṇa
english: Therefore I shall, O Laksmana, live here, awaiting the pleasure of Sugrīva and the clear currents of the rivers (the autumn).
Heroes receiving benefits, do always return them. The ungrateful lose the good wishes of the great ones.

sanskrit: अथ एवम् उक्तः प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणःकृत अंजलिः तत् प्रतिपूज्य भाषितम्
उवाच रामम् स्वभिराम दर्शनम्प्रदर्शयन् दर्शनम् आत्मनः शुभम्
transliteration: atha evam uktaḥ praṇidhāya lakṣmaṇaḥkṛta aṃjaliḥ tat pratipūjya bhāṣitam
uvāca rāmam svabhirāma darśanampradarśayan darśanam ātmanaḥ śubham
english: Being thus accosted, Laksmana, with folded hands, respecting highly his words, spoke to the graceful Rāma, pointing out his own welfare.

sanskrit: यत् उक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्नर इन्द्र कर्ता नचिरा हरि ईश्वरः
शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः
transliteration: yat uktam etat tava sarvam īpsitamnara indra kartā nacirā hari īśvaraḥ
śarat pratīkṣaḥ kṣamatām imam bhavānjala prapātam ripu nigrahe dhṛtaḥ
english: Forsooth shall that lord of monkeys carry out all your wishes. Do you therefore spend here the rainy season, awaiting the autumn.

sanskrit: समीक्ष्य विमलम् व्योम गत विद्युत् बलाहकम्
सारसा आकुल संघुष्टम् रम्य ज्योत्स्ना अनुलेपनम्
transliteration: samīkṣya vimalam vyoma gata vidyut balāhakam
sārasā ākula saṃghuṣṭam ramya jyotsnā anulepanam

sanskrit: समृद्ध अर्थम् च सुग्रीवम् मन्द धर्मार्थ संग्रहम्
अत्यर्थम् च असताम् मार्गम् एकांत गत मानसम्
transliteration: samṛddha artham ca sugrīvam manda dharmārtha saṃgraham
atyartham ca asatām mārgam ekāṃta gata mānasam

sanskrit: निवृत्त कार्यम् सिद्धार्थम् प्रमद अभिरतम् सदा
transliteration: nivṛtta kāryam siddhārtham pramada abhiratam sadā

sanskrit: स्वाम् च पात्नीम् अभिप्रेताम् ताराम् च अपि समीप्सिताम्
विहरंतम् अहो रात्रम् कृतार्थम् विगत ज्वरम्
transliteration: svām ca pātnīm abhipretām tārām ca api samīpsitām
viharaṃtam aho rātram kṛtārtham vigata jvaram

sanskrit: क्रीडन्तम् इव देवेशम् गन्धर्व अप्सरसाम् गणैः
मंत्रिषु न्यस्त कार्यम् च मंत्रिणाम् अनवेक्षकम्
transliteration: krīḍantam iva deveśam gandharva apsarasām gaṇaiḥ
maṃtriṣu nyasta kāryam ca maṃtriṇām anavekṣakam

sanskrit: उच्छिन्न राज्य संदेहम् काम वृत्तम् इव स्थितम्
निश्चित अर्थो अर्थ तत्त्वज्ञः काल धर्म विशेष वित्
transliteration: ucchinna rājya saṃdeham kāma vṛttam iva sthitam
niścita artho artha tattvajñaḥ kāla dharma viśeṣa vit

sanskrit: प्रसाद्य वाक्यैः मधुरैः हेतुमद्भिः मनो रमैः
transliteration: prasādya vākyaiḥ madhuraiḥ hetumadbhiḥ mano ramaiḥ

sanskrit: हितम् तथ्यम् च पथ्यम् च साम धर्म अर्थ नीतिमत्
प्रणय प्रीति संयुक्तम् विश्वास कृत निश्चयम्
transliteration: hitam tathyam ca pathyam ca sāma dharma artha nītimat
praṇaya prīti saṃyuktam viśvāsa kṛta niścayam

sanskrit: राज्यम् प्राप्तम् यशः चैव कौली श्रीः अभिवर्थिता
transliteration: rājyam prāptam yaśaḥ caiva kaulī śrīḥ abhivarthitā

sanskrit: मित्राणाम् संग्रहः शेषः तत् भवान् कर्तुम् अर्हति
यो हि मित्रेषु कालज्ञः सततम् साधु वर्तते
transliteration: mitrāṇām saṃgrahaḥ śeṣaḥ tat bhavān kartum arhati
yo hi mitreṣu kālajñaḥ satatam sādhu vartate

sanskrit: तस्य राज्यम् च कीर्तिः च प्रतापः च अपि वर्धते
यस्य कोशः च दण्डः च मित्राणि आत्मा च भूमिप
समानि एतानि सर्वाणि स राज्यम् महत् अश्नुते
transliteration: tasya rājyam ca kīrtiḥ ca pratāpaḥ ca api vardhate
yasya kośaḥ ca daṇḍaḥ ca mitrāṇi ātmā ca bhūmipa
samāni etāni sarvāṇi sa rājyam mahat aśnute
english: O king, truly does he attain to a vast kingdom, who has the same wealth, soldiery and body with his friends.

sanskrit: तत् भवान् वृत्त संपन्नः स्थितः पथि निरत्यये
transliteration: tat bhavān vṛtta saṃpannaḥ sthitaḥ pathi niratyaye
english: It becometh you, therefore, who are crowned with a good character, and who did wend a blameless track, to work out your friend's well being (as promised by you).

sanskrit: संत्यज्य सर्व कर्माणि मित्रार्थम् यो न वर्तते
संभ्रमात् हि कृत उत्साहः सः अनर्थेन अवरुध्यते
transliteration: saṃtyajya sarva karmāṇi mitrārtham yo na vartate
saṃbhramāt hi kṛta utsāhaḥ saḥ anarthena avarudhyate
english: He, who does not engage in the service of his friends renouncing all business, becometh void of all energy and involved in unnecessary troubles.

sanskrit: यो हि काल व्यतीतेषु मित्र कार्येषु वर्तते
स कृत्वा महतो अपि अर्थान् न मित्रार्थेन युज्यते
transliteration: yo hi kāla vyatīteṣu mitra kāryeṣu vartate
sa kṛtvā mahato api arthān na mitrārthena yujyate
english: He, who engage in his friend's service after the proper season is over, does nothing to his well-being, though he performs a great thing.

sanskrit: तत् इदम् मित्रकार्यम् नः काल अतीतम् अरिंदम
transliteration: tat idam mitrakāryam naḥ kāla atītam ariṃdama
english: O slayer of foes, soon shall the time for performing your friend's service, be over; do you therefore encompass Rāghava's good, namely the searching out of Vaidehī.

sanskrit: न च कालम् अतीतम् ते निवेदयति कालवित्
त्वरमाणो अपि स प्राज्ञः तव राजन् वशानुगः
transliteration: na ca kālam atītam te nivedayati kālavit
tvaramāṇo api sa prājñaḥ tava rājan vaśānugaḥ
english: o king, Rāma, conversant with the scasonableness of time and wise as he is, is not inforining you of it, though the proper time is past; and though he is in hurry, he is waiting for you.

sanskrit: कुलस्य हेतुः स्फीतस्य दीर्घ बन्धुः च राघवः
अप्रमेय प्रभावः च स्वयम् च अप्रतिमो गुणैः
transliteration: kulasya hetuḥ sphītasya dīrgha bandhuḥ ca rāghavaḥ
aprameya prabhāvaḥ ca svayam ca apratimo guṇaiḥ
english: Rāghava, as well as Lakşmaņa, who are the instruments of your attaining to this vast kingdom, and your friends for so long a time, are persons of incomparable prowess by virtue of their unequalled accomplishments. He has already performed your service, and it behoveth you now, O lord of monkeys, to command the foremost of monkeys to engage in his service.

sanskrit: तस्य त्वम् कुरु वै कार्यम् पूर्वम् तेन कृतम् तव
transliteration: tasya tvam kuru vai kāryam pūrvam tena kṛtam tava
english: Rāghava, as well as Lakşmaņa, who are the instruments of your attaining to this vast kingdom, and your friends for so long a time, are persons of incomparable prowess by virtue of their unequalled accomplishments. He has already performed your service, and it behoveth you now, O lord of monkeys, to command the foremost of monkeys to engage in his service.

sanskrit: न हि तावत् भवेत् कालो व्यतीतः चोदनात् ऋते
चोदितस्य हि कार्यस्य भवेत् काल व्यतिक्रमः
transliteration: na hi tāvat bhavet kālo vyatītaḥ codanāt ṛte
coditasya hi kāryasya bhavet kāla vyatikramaḥ
english: T To engage, out of season, in a service, uncalled for, is not blameable; but to defer the performance of an action in proper time after promising is indeed an object of censure.

sanskrit: अकर्तुर् अपि कार्यस्य भवान् कर्ता हरीश्वर
किम् पुनः प्रतिकर्तुः ते राज्येन च वधेन च
transliteration: akartur api kāryasya bhavān kartā harīśvara
kim punaḥ pratikartuḥ te rājyena ca vadhena ca
english: O lord of monkeys, you did engage even in the service of one who does you no good, then why shall you not engage in the benefit of Rāma who has favoured you by encompassing the destruction (of Vāli) and securing for you your kingdom.

sanskrit: शक्तिमान् अतिविक्रान्तो वानर ऋष्क गण ईश्वर
कर्तुम् दाशरथेः प्रीतिम् आज्ञायाम् किम् नु सज्जसे
transliteration: śaktimān ativikrānto vānara ṛṣka gaṇa īśvara
kartum dāśaratheḥ prītim ājñāyām kim nu sajjase
english: O lord of monkeys and bears, truly you are gifted with prowess and strength, why did you not prepare yourself for satisfying Dāśarathee's commands?

sanskrit: कामम् खलु शरैः शक्तः सुर असुर महा उरगान्
वशे दाशरथिः कर्तुम् त्वत् प्रतिज्ञाम् अवेक्षते
transliteration: kāmam khalu śaraiḥ śaktaḥ sura asura mahā uragān
vaśe dāśarathiḥ kartum tvat pratijñām avekṣate
english: Dāśarathee himself is capable of subduing the celestials, Asuras and great serpents-he is simply awaiting the fulfilment of your promise.

sanskrit: प्राण त्याग अविशंकेन कृतम् तेन महत् प्रियम्
तस्य मार्गाम वैदेहीम् पृथिव्याम् अपि च अंबरे
transliteration: prāṇa tyāga aviśaṃkena kṛtam tena mahat priyam
tasya mārgāma vaidehīm pṛthivyām api ca aṃbare
english: He has performed a great service at the risk of his life-we shall therefore find out Vaidehī whether she is in this earth or in the welkin,

sanskrit: न देवा न च गंधर्वा न असुरा न मरुत् गणाः
न च यक्षा भयम् तस्य कुर्युः किम् इव राक्षसाः
transliteration: na devā na ca gaṃdharvā na asurā na marut gaṇāḥ
na ca yakṣā bhayam tasya kuryuḥ kim iva rākṣasāḥ
english: Even the celestials, Dānavas, Gandharabas, Asuras, Mārutas, Yakşas are afraid of him in the battle-field-what of the insignificant Raksasas.

sanskrit: तत् एवम् शक्ति युक्तस्य पूर्वम् प्रिय कृतः तथा
रामस्य अर्हसि पिंगेश कर्तुम् सर्व आत्मना प्रियम्
transliteration: tat evam śakti yuktasya pūrvam priya kṛtaḥ tathā
rāmasya arhasi piṃgeśa kartum sarva ātmanā priyam
english: O lord of monkeys, it therefore behoveth you to do good by all means to the powerful Rāma, who benefited you before.

sanskrit: न अधस्तात् अवनौ न अप्सु गतिः न उपरि च अम्बरे
कस्यचित् सज्जते अस्माकम् कपीश्वर तव आज्ञया
transliteration: na adhastāt avanau na apsu gatiḥ na upari ca ambare
kasyacit sajjate asmākam kapīśvara tava ājñayā
english: O lord of monkeys, who is there among us, who shall not at your command proceed to : water, sky or the region under the earth?

sanskrit: तत् आज्ञापय कः किम् ते कुतो वा अपि व्यवस्यतु
हरयो हि अप्रधृष्याः ते सन्ति कोटि अग्रतो अनघ
transliteration: tat ājñāpaya kaḥ kim te kuto vā api vyavasyatu
harayo hi apradhṛṣyāḥ te santi koṭi agrato anagha
english: O blameless one, there are more than one koți of invincible monkeys under you, do you command, who shall proceed and to what quarter?

sanskrit: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा काले साधु निरूपितम्
सुग्रीवः सत्त्व संपन्नः चकार मतिम् उत्तमाम्
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā kāle sādhu nirūpitam
sugrīvaḥ sattva saṃpannaḥ cakāra matim uttamām
english: Hearing these words of Hanumān, said on a very proper occasion, the intelligent Sugrīva, made up his mind for a worthy end.

sanskrit: संदिदेश अति मति मान् नीलम् नित्य कृत उद्यमम्
transliteration: saṃdideśa ati mati mān nīlam nitya kṛta udyamam
english: Thereupon the highly intelligent Sugrīva ordered the ever active Neela, to collect soldiers from various quarters. Do you so arrange as all my hosts and soldiers with their commanders soon come here.

sanskrit: यथा सेना समग्रा मे यूथपालाः च सर्वशः
transliteration: yathā senā samagrā me yūthapālāḥ ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Thereupon the highly intelligent Sugrīva ordered the ever active Neela, to collect soldiers from various quarters. Do you so arrange as all my hosts and soldiers with their commanders soon come here.

sanskrit: ये तु अंतपालाः प्लवगाः शीघ्रगा व्यवसायिनः
समानयंतु ते शीघ्रम् त्वरिताः शासनात् मम
स्वयम् च अनंतरम् सैन्यम् भवान् एव अनुपश्यतु
transliteration: ye tu aṃtapālāḥ plavagāḥ śīghragā vyavasāyinaḥ
samānayaṃtu te śīghram tvaritāḥ śāsanāt mama
svayam ca anaṃtaram sainyam bhavān eva anupaśyatu
english: Do you soon bring here at my behest all the energetic and quick-coursing monkeys and commanders spreading their conquests to the end of the earth.

sanskrit: त्रि पंच रात्रात् ऊर्ध्वम् यः प्राप्नुयात् इह वानरः
तस्य प्राण अन्तिको दण्डो न अत्र कार्या विचारणा
transliteration: tri paṃca rātrāt ūrdhvam yaḥ prāpnuyāt iha vānaraḥ
tasya prāṇa antiko daṇḍo na atra kāryā vicāraṇā
english: (After their arrival) do you yourself inspect and count all those monkeys. He who shall not reach here within fifteen days shall be punished with the loss of his life.

sanskrit: हरीन् च वृद्धान् उपयातु स अंगदोभवान् मम आज्ञाम् अधिकृत्य निश्चितम्
इति व्यवस्थाम् हरि पुंगव ईश्वरोविधाय वेश्म प्रविवेश वीर्यवान्
transliteration: harīn ca vṛddhān upayātu sa aṃgadobhavān mama ājñām adhikṛtya niścitam
iti vyavasthām hari puṃgava īśvarovidhāya veśma praviveśa vīryavān
english: There is no need of scrutinizing my orders. Abiding by my order, do you see along with Angada all the elderly monkeys. having thus arranged, that best of monkeys entered the inner apartment.

sanskrit: गुहाम् प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः
वर्ष रात्रे स्थितो रामः काम शोक अभिपीडितः
transliteration: guhām praviṣṭe sugrīve vimukte gagane ghanaiḥ
varṣa rātre sthito rāmaḥ kāma śoka abhipīḍitaḥ

sanskrit: पाण्डुरम् गगनम् दृष्ट्वा विमलम् चन्द्र मण्डलम्
शारदीम् रजनीम् चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्न अनुलेपनाम्
transliteration: pāṇḍuram gaganam dṛṣṭvā vimalam candra maṇḍalam
śāradīm rajanīm caiva dṛṣṭvā jyotsna anulepanām

sanskrit: काम वृत्तम् च सुग्रीवम् नष्टाम् च जनक आत्मजाम्
दृष्ट्वा कालम् अतीतम् च मुमोह परम आतुरः
transliteration: kāma vṛttam ca sugrīvam naṣṭām ca janaka ātmajām
dṛṣṭvā kālam atītam ca mumoha parama āturaḥ

sanskrit: स तु संज्ञाम् उपागम्य मुहूर्तात् मतिमान् नृपः
मनः स्थाम् अपि वैदेहीम् चिंतयामास राघवः
transliteration: sa tu saṃjñām upāgamya muhūrtāt matimān nṛpaḥ
manaḥ sthām api vaidehīm ciṃtayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
english: And regaining his sense after sometime, the highly intelligent king-Räghava began to think of Vaidehĩ although always present in his mind.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा च विमलम् व्योम गत विद्युत् बलाहकम्
सारस आरव संघुष्टम् विललाप आर्तया गिरा
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā ca vimalam vyoma gata vidyut balāhakam
sārasa ārava saṃghuṣṭam vilalāpa ārtayā girā
english: And beholding the clear sky void of lightnings and clouds and filled with the noise of Sārasas, Rāghava began to lament piteously, stationing himself on the summit of the hill ornamented with metals of golden hue. And beholding the autumnal sky he engaged in the meditation of his beloved spouse.

sanskrit: आसीनः पर्वतस्य अग्रे हेम धातु विभूषिते
शारदम् गगनम् दृष्ट्वा जगाम मनसा प्रियाम्
transliteration: āsīnaḥ parvatasya agre hema dhātu vibhūṣite
śāradam gaganam dṛṣṭvā jagāma manasā priyām
english: And beholding the clear sky void of lightnings and clouds and filled with the noise of Sārasas, Rāghava began to lament piteously, stationing himself on the summit of the hill ornamented with metals of golden hue. And beholding the autumnal sky he engaged in the meditation of his beloved spouse.

sanskrit: सारस आरव संनादैः सारस आरव नादिनी
या आश्रमे रमते बाला सा अद्य मे रमते कथम्
transliteration: sārasa ārava saṃnādaiḥ sārasa ārava nādinī
yā āśrame ramate bālā sā adya me ramate katham
english: How shall that Sarasa-voiced damsel be pleased to-day, who, while sporting in the hermitage, used to warble like Sārasas, to invite them.

sanskrit: पुष्पिताम् च आसनान् दृष्ट्वा कांचनान् इव निर्मलान्
कथम् सा रमते बाला पश्यंती माम् अपश्यती
transliteration: puṣpitām ca āsanān dṛṣṭvā kāṃcanān iva nirmalān
katham sā ramate bālā paśyaṃtī mām apaśyatī
english: Beholding Asana trees, as if covered with golden flowers and not beholding me how shall that damsel be pleased?

sanskrit: या पुरा कलहंसानाम् स्वरेण कल भाषिणी
बुध्यते चारु सर्वांगी सा अद्य मे रमते कथम्
transliteration: yā purā kalahaṃsānām svareṇa kala bhāṣiṇī
budhyate cāru sarvāṃgī sā adya me ramate katham
english: How that exquisitely fine damsel having a sweet voice shall be pleased to-day, who used formerly to awake at the sounds of the drakes.?
Hearing the noise of her companionsCakravākas, how shali that one, of expansive eyes resembling lotuses, live?

sanskrit: सरांसि सरितो वापीः काननानि वनानि च
ताम् विना मृगशावाक्षीम् चरन् न अद्य सुखम् लभे
transliteration: sarāṃsi sarito vāpīḥ kānanāni vanāni ca
tām vinā mṛgaśāvākṣīm caran na adya sukham labhe
english: Without her having the eyes of a fawn, I do not attain to felicity to-day, ranging at large by ponds, streams, pools and in forests and woods.

sanskrit: अपि ताम् मत् वियोगात् च सौकुमार्यात् च भामिनीम्
सुदूरम् पीडयेत् कामः शरत् गुण निरंतरः
transliteration: api tām mat viyogāt ca saukumāryāt ca bhāminīm
sudūram pīḍayet kāmaḥ śarat guṇa niraṃtaraḥ
english: Forsooth shall Cupid excited by the approach of the autumn, distress her the more on account of my separation and her personal charms.
Thus bewailed that best son of a king like to the bird Sāranga soliciting water from the lord of celestials.

sanskrit: ततः चंचूर्य रम्येषु फलार्थी गिरि सानुषु
transliteration: tataḥ caṃcūrya ramyeṣu phalārthī giri sānuṣu
english: And the graceful Lakşmaņa, returning from the picturesque mountain-summits where he had sojourned in quest of fruits, beheld his elder brother.

sanskrit: स चिन्तया दुस्सहया परीतम्विसंज्ञम् एकम् विजने मनस्वी
भ्रातुर् विषादात् त्वरितो अति दीनःसमीक्ष्य सौमित्रिः उवाच रामम्
transliteration: sa cintayā dussahayā parītamvisaṃjñam ekam vijane manasvī
bhrātur viṣādāt tvarito ati dīnaḥsamīkṣya saumitriḥ uvāca rāmam
english: And beholding in that lonely forest his brother, racked with anxious thoughts hard to bear and almost beside himself (with grief) the high-minded Saumitri, prompted by his brother's grief, spoke to him very poorly, saying.

sanskrit: किम् आर्य कामस्य वशम् गतेनकिम् आत्म पौरुष्य पराभवेन
अयम् ह्रिया संह्रियते समाधिःकिम् अत्र योगेन निवर्तितेन
transliteration: kim ārya kāmasya vaśam gatenakim ātma pauruṣya parābhavena
ayam hriyā saṃhriyate samādhiḥkim atra yogena nivartitena
english: O worshipful one, what have you perpetrated by placing yourself under the control of passions and defeating your manliness? Your deep and devout meditation has been purloined by your grief; and it is by religious contemplation that your grief shall be terminated now.

sanskrit: क्रियाभियोगम् मनसः प्रसादम्समाधि योग अनुगतम् च कालम्
न जानकी मानव वंश नाथत्वया सनाथा सुलभा परेण
न च अग्नि चूडाम् ज्वलिताम् उपेत्यन दह्यते वीर वरार्ह कश्चित्
transliteration: kriyābhiyogam manasaḥ prasādamsamādhi yoga anugatam ca kālam
na jānakī mānava vaṃśa nāthatvayā sanāthā sulabhā pareṇa
na ca agni cūḍām jvalitām upetyana dahyate vīra varārha kaścit
english: O lord of men, Jānakī, husbanded by you, is not capable of being easily possessed by others. O hero who getting at a flame of fire, does not burn himself?

sanskrit: सलक्षणम् लक्ष्मणम् अप्रधृष्यम्स्वभावजम् वाक्यम् उवाच रामः
हितम् च पथ्यम् च नय प्रसक्तम्ससाम धर्मार्थ समाहितम् च
transliteration: salakṣaṇam lakṣmaṇam apradhṛṣyamsvabhāvajam vākyam uvāca rāmaḥ
hitam ca pathyam ca naya prasaktamsasāma dharmārtha samāhitam ca
english: Thereupon Rāma spoke to Lakşmaņa, gifted with royal marks, addressing him with natural and resolute words and saying:—What you had said, is sound, well-meaning, sanctioned by polity and speaks of piety, wealth and forgiveness. It should therefore, without the least doubt, be performed by me. It behoveth me to engage in contemplation about the eternal truth regarding the Deity and in ascetic observances. Oh else O Prince, it is not proper to think of the fruits of a difficult, highly developed and energetic action.

sanskrit: निस्संशयम् कार्यम् अवेक्षितव्यम्क्रिया विशेषो अपि अनुवर्तितव्यः
न तु प्रवृद्धस्य दुरासदस्यकुमार वीर्यस्य फलम् च चिन्त्यम्
transliteration: nissaṃśayam kāryam avekṣitavyamkriyā viśeṣo api anuvartitavyaḥ
na tu pravṛddhasya durāsadasyakumāra vīryasya phalam ca cintyam
english: Thereupon Rāma spoke to Lakşmaņa, gifted with royal marks, addressing him with natural and resolute words and saying:—What you had said, is sound, well-meaning, sanctioned by polity and speaks of piety, wealth and forgiveness. It should therefore, without the least doubt, be performed by me. It behoveth me to engage in contemplation about the eternal truth regarding the Deity and in ascetic observances. Oh else O Prince, it is not proper to think of the fruits of a difficult, highly developed and energetic action.

sanskrit: अथ पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मैथिलीम् अनुचिन्तयन्
transliteration: atha padma palāśa akṣīm maithilīm anucintayan
english: Thereupon thinking of Maithelee, having eyes resembling lotus-petals, Rāma spoke to Laks mana with dried countenance.
Having satisfied the earth with a profuse discharge of water, produced crops and thus finished his work, the thousand eyed Deity is sitting silent.

sanskrit: दीर्घ गंभीर निर्घोषाः शैल द्रुम पुरोगमाः
विसृज्य सलिलम् मेघाः परिश्रांता नृप आत्मज
transliteration: dīrgha gaṃbhīra nirghoṣāḥ śaila druma purogamāḥ
visṛjya salilam meghāḥ pariśrāṃtā nṛpa ātmaja
english: O son of a king, the clouds, muttering a long and deep sound and approaching the hills and frees, are calmed having discharged their liquid contents.

sanskrit: नील उत्पल दल श्यामः श्यामी कृत्वा दिशो दश
विमदा इव मातंगाः शान्त वेगाः पयो धराः
transliteration: nīla utpala dala śyāmaḥ śyāmī kṛtvā diśo daśa
vimadā iva mātaṃgāḥ śānta vegāḥ payo dharāḥ
english: Having made the ten quarters dark blue, the clouds, resembling blue lotuses, have become calm, like to elephants without temporal juice.

sanskrit: जल गर्भा महा वेगाः कुटज अर्जुन गंधिनः
चरित्वा विरताः सौम्य वृष्टि वाताः समुद्यताः
transliteration: jala garbhā mahā vegāḥ kuṭaja arjuna gaṃdhinaḥ
caritvā viratāḥ saumya vṛṣṭi vātāḥ samudyatāḥ
english: O gentle one, high gales accompanied with rains, big with water and fragrant with Kutaja and Arjuna flowers being driven before hither and thither, have now become silent.

sanskrit: घनानाम् वारणानाम् च मयूराणाम् च लक्ष्मण
नादः प्रस्रवणानाम् च प्रशान्तः सहसा अनघ
transliteration: ghanānām vāraṇānām ca mayūrāṇām ca lakṣmaṇa
nādaḥ prasravaṇānām ca praśāntaḥ sahasā anagha
english: O innocent Laksmana, the sounds of clouds, elephants, peacocks, and fountains, have been all stopped.

sanskrit: अभिवृष्टा महा मेघैः निर्मलाः चित्र सानवः
अनुलिप्ता इव आभान्ति गिरयः चन्द्र रश्मिभिः
transliteration: abhivṛṣṭā mahā meghaiḥ nirmalāḥ citra sānavaḥ
anuliptā iva ābhānti girayaḥ candra raśmibhiḥ
english: Hills, having variegated summits, being washed by dense clouds and thus free from dirt and impurities, do appear elegant being sprinkled by the rays of the Moon.

sanskrit: शाखासु सप्त च्छद पादपानाम्प्रभासु तार अर्क निशा कराणाम्
लीलासु चैव उत्तम वारणानाम्श्रियम् विभज्य अद्य शरत् प्रवृत्ता
transliteration: śākhāsu sapta cchada pādapānāmprabhāsu tāra arka niśā karāṇām
līlāsu caiva uttama vāraṇānāmśriyam vibhajya adya śarat pravṛttā
english: Forsooth has the autumn set in, dividing its grace in the branches of Saptacada trees, in the rays of the Sun and Moon with stars and in the gaits of the excellent elephants.

sanskrit: संप्रति अनेक आश्रय चित्र शोभालक्ष्मीः शरत् काल गुण उपपन्ना
सूर्य अग्र हस्त प्रतिबोधितेषुपद्माकरेषु अभ्यधिकम् विभाति
transliteration: saṃprati aneka āśraya citra śobhālakṣmīḥ śarat kāla guṇa upapannā
sūrya agra hasta pratibodhiteṣupadmākareṣu abhyadhikam vibhāti
english: Surely has the autumnal grace resorted to many things. And it has appeared more profusely in the lotuses blossomed by the first rays of the Sun.

sanskrit: सप्त च्छदानाम् कुसुमोप गंधीषट् पाद वृन्दैः अनुगीयमानः
मत्त द्विपानाम् पवन अनुसारीदर्पम् विनेष्यन् अधिकम् विभाति
transliteration: sapta cchadānām kusumopa gaṃdhīṣaṭ pāda vṛndaiḥ anugīyamānaḥ
matta dvipānām pavana anusārīdarpam vineṣyan adhikam vibhāti
english: Scented sweet with the flower of Saptacada trees, borrowing the musical notes of bees, following the wind and subduing the pride of infuriated elephants, the autumn is appearing very elegant.

sanskrit: अभ्यागतैः चारु विशाल पक्षैःसरः प्रियैः पद्म रजो अवकीर्णैः
महा नदीनाम् पुलिन उपयातैःक्रीडन्ति हंसाः सह चक्रवाकैः
transliteration: abhyāgataiḥ cāru viśāla pakṣaiḥsaraḥ priyaiḥ padma rajo avakīrṇaiḥ
mahā nadīnām pulina upayātaiḥkrīḍanti haṃsāḥ saha cakravākaiḥ
english: The swans are playing with Cakravākas having splendidly spacious wings, fond of cupid, crusted with the filaments of lotuses, and arriving at the banks of the rivers.

sanskrit: मद प्रगल्भेषु च वारिणेषुगवाम् समूहेषु च दर्पितेषु
प्रसन्न तोयासु च निम्न गासुविभाति लक्ष्मीः बहुधा विभक्ता
transliteration: mada pragalbheṣu ca vāriṇeṣugavām samūheṣu ca darpiteṣu
prasanna toyāsu ca nimna gāsuvibhāti lakṣmīḥ bahudhā vibhaktā
english: The antumnal grace is appearing more elegant being divided in infuriated elephants, in proud kine, and in streams of clear currents.

sanskrit: नभः समीक्ष्या अंबु धरैः विमुक्तम्विमुक्त बर्ह आभरणा वनेषु
प्रियासु अरक्ता विनिवृत्त शोभागत उत्सवा ध्यान परा मयूराः
transliteration: nabhaḥ samīkṣyā aṃbu dharaiḥ vimuktamvimukta barha ābharaṇā vaneṣu
priyāsu araktā vinivṛtta śobhāgata utsavā dhyāna parā mayūrāḥ
english: Beholding the sky divested of clouds, without manifesting the beauty of their tails and renouncing their attachment to their beloved mates, amusements and beauty, the peacocks are as if all engaged in mediation in the forest.

sanskrit: मनोज्ञ गन्धैः प्रियकैः अनल्पैःपुष्प अति भार अवनत अग्र शाखैः
सुवर्ण गौरैः नयन अभिरामैःउद्योतितान् इव वन अन्तराणि
transliteration: manojña gandhaiḥ priyakaiḥ analpaiḥpuṣpa ati bhāra avanata agra śākhaiḥ
suvarṇa gauraiḥ nayana abhirāmaiḥudyotitān iva vana antarāṇi
english: The forest-lands are as if a-blaze with many a sweet-scented picturesque Priyaka trees, having a golden hue and their tops lowered down with the weight of flowers.

sanskrit: प्रिय अन्वितानाम् नलिनी प्रियाणाम्वन प्रियाणाम् कुसुम उद्धतानाम्
मद उत्कटानाम् मद लालसानाम्गज उत्तमानम् गतयो अद्य मन्दाः
transliteration: priya anvitānām nalinī priyāṇāmvana priyāṇām kusuma uddhatānām
mada utkaṭānām mada lālasānāmgaja uttamānam gatayo adya mandāḥ
english: The gaits, of the elephants rendered idle with a profuse discharge of temporal juice, fond of forests and water lilies, smelling the fragrance of the flowers of Saptachada trees and accompanied by their mates, have become slow.

sanskrit: व्यक्तम् नभः शस्त्र विधौत वर्णम्कृश प्रवाहानि नदी जलानि
कह्लार शिताः पवनाः प्रवान्तितमो विमुक्ताः च दिशः प्रकाशाः
transliteration: vyaktam nabhaḥ śastra vidhauta varṇamkṛśa pravāhāni nadī jalāni
kahlāra śitāḥ pavanāḥ pravāntitamo vimuktāḥ ca diśaḥ prakāśāḥ
english: The sky is clear like to a sword—the streams have become of feeble currents—the wind, cool and scented with the fragrance of while esculent waterlilies, is blowing—and quarters have become devoid of darkness.

sanskrit: सूर्य आतप क्रामण नष्ट पंकाभूमिः चिर उद्घाटित सांद्र रेणुः
अन्योन्य वैरेण समायुतानाम्उद्योग कालो अद्य नर अधिपानाम्
transliteration: sūrya ātapa krāmaṇa naṣṭa paṃkābhūmiḥ cira udghāṭita sāṃdra reṇuḥ
anyonya vaireṇa samāyutānāmudyoga kālo adya nara adhipānām
english: The mud has been dried up by the rays of the Sun and the earth is filled with dust-this is the time for preparation for inimical kings (to enter into conflict).

sanskrit: शरत् गुण आप्यायित रूप शोभाःप्रहर्षित पांशु समुक्षित अंगाः
मद उत्कटाः संप्रति युद्ध लुब्धावृषा गवाम् मध्य गता नदन्ति
transliteration: śarat guṇa āpyāyita rūpa śobhāḥpraharṣita pāṃśu samukṣita aṃgāḥ
mada utkaṭāḥ saṃprati yuddha lubdhāvṛṣā gavām madhya gatā nadanti
english: The bulls, having their beauty enhanced by the autumn, and their body covered with dust, delighted, infuriated and hence desirous of entering into skirmish, have been setting up terrible roars in the midst of kine.

sanskrit: स मन्मध तीव्रतर अनुरागाकुलान्विता मन्द गतिः करेणुः
transliteration: sa manmadha tīvratara anurāgākulānvitā manda gatiḥ kareṇuḥ
english: The she-elephants, moving slowly, fond, passionate and accompanied by other members, have been following their passionate mates, in the forest, embracing them.

sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा वराणि आत्म विभूषणानिबर्हाणि तीर उपगता नदीनाम्
निर्भर्त्स्यमाना इव सार ओघैःप्रयान्ति दीना विमना मयूराः
transliteration: tyaktvā varāṇi ātma vibhūṣaṇānibarhāṇi tīra upagatā nadīnām
nirbhartsyamānā iva sāra oghaiḥprayānti dīnā vimanā mayūrāḥ
english: Leaving behind their excellent ornamentsthe tails, the peacocks, getting at the banks of the rivers, have been going away poorly and with depressed hearts as if being remonstrated with by the Sārasas.

sanskrit: सरस्सु बद्ध अंबुज भूषणेषुविक्षोभ्य विक्षोभ्य जलम् पिबन्ति
transliteration: sarassu baddha aṃbuja bhūṣaṇeṣuvikṣobhya vikṣobhya jalam pibanti
english: Having terrified the Kāraņdavas and Cakravākas with their mighty roars, the elephants, having cleft trunks and being agitated again and again, have been drinking water in the ponds filled with full blown lotuses.

sanskrit: व्यपेत पंकजासु स वालुकासुप्रसन्न तोयासु स गो कुलासु
स सारसा राव विनादितासुनदिषु हंसा निपतन्ति हृष्टाः
transliteration: vyapeta paṃkajāsu sa vālukāsuprasanna toyāsu sa go kulāsu
sa sārasā rāva vināditāsunadiṣu haṃsā nipatanti hṛṣṭāḥ
english: The drakes have been jumping delightedly into the rivers mudless, covered with sands, full of clear water, filled with kine and resounded with the notes of Sārasas.

sanskrit: नदी घन प्रस्रवण उदकानाम्अति प्रवृद्ध अनिल बर्हिणानाम्
प्लवंगमानाम् च गत उत्सवानाम्ध्रुवम् रवाः संप्रति संप्रणष्टाः
transliteration: nadī ghana prasravaṇa udakānāmati pravṛddha anila barhiṇānām
plavaṃgamānām ca gata utsavānāmdhruvam ravāḥ saṃprati saṃpraṇaṣṭāḥ
english: Now has stopped the noise of rivers, clouds, fountains, water, the. high winds, the peacocks and the mirthless frogs.

sanskrit: अनेक वर्णाः सुविनष्ट कायाःनव उदितेषु अंबुधरेषु नष्टाः
क्षुध अर्दिता घोर विषा बिलेभ्यःचिर उषिता विप्रसरन्ति सर्पाः
transliteration: aneka varṇāḥ suvinaṣṭa kāyāḥnava uditeṣu aṃbudhareṣu naṣṭāḥ
kṣudha arditā ghora viṣā bilebhyaḥcira uṣitā viprasaranti sarpāḥ
english: And venomous snakes of variegated colours, having lived for a pretty long time during the rains without food, have on the approach of the autumn, come out of their dens, hungry, in quest of their prey.

sanskrit: चंचत् चन्द्र कर स्पर्श हर्ष उन्मीलित तारका
अहो रागवती संध्या जहाति स्वयम् अंबरम्
transliteration: caṃcat candra kara sparśa harṣa unmīlita tārakā
aho rāgavatī saṃdhyā jahāti svayam aṃbaram
english: The red-dyed evening has renounced the welkin, being delighted at the touch of the rays of the Moon and opening a little her eyes—the stars.

sanskrit: रात्रिः शशांक उदित सौम्य वक्त्रातारा गण उन्मीलित चारु नेत्रा
ज्योत्स्ना अंशुक प्रावरणा विभातिनारी इव शुक्ल अंशुक संवृत अंगी
transliteration: rātriḥ śaśāṃka udita saumya vaktrātārā gaṇa unmīlita cāru netrā
jyotsnā aṃśuka prāvaraṇā vibhātinārī iva śukla aṃśuka saṃvṛta aṃgī
english: Having the rising Moon for her elegant countenance, the stars for her excellent open eyes and the rays for a piece of white garment, the night appeareth like a damsel wearing a white cloth.

sanskrit: विपक्व शालि प्रसवानि भुक्त्वाप्रहर्षिता सारस चारु पंक्ति
नभः समाक्रामति शीघ्र वेगावात अवधूता ग्रथित इव माला
transliteration: vipakva śāli prasavāni bhuktvāpraharṣitā sārasa cāru paṃkti
nabhaḥ samākrāmati śīghra vegāvāta avadhūtā grathita iva mālā
english: Having fed on ripe white rice, the excellent rows of delighted Sārasas are flying quickly up to the sky like to a well-strung garland shaken by he wind.

sanskrit: सुप्त एक हंसम् कुमुदैः उपेतम्महा ह्रदस्थम् सलिलम् विभाति
घनैः विमुक्तम् निशि पूर्ण चन्द्रम्तारा गण कीर्णम् इव अंतरिक्षम्
transliteration: supta eka haṃsam kumudaiḥ upetammahā hradastham salilam vibhāti
ghanaiḥ vimuktam niśi pūrṇa candramtārā gaṇa kīrṇam iva aṃtarikṣam
english: The water, of the lake filled with sleeping drakes and water lilies, is appearing like the sky in the night devoid of clouds and filled with the Full Moon and stars.

sanskrit: प्रकीर्ण हंसा अकुल मेखलानाम्प्रबुद्ध पद्म उत्पल मालिनीनाम्
वापीः उत्तमानाम् अधिक अद्य लक्ष्मीःवर अंगनाम् इव भूषितानाम्
transliteration: prakīrṇa haṃsā akula mekhalānāmprabuddha padma utpala mālinīnām
vāpīḥ uttamānām adhika adya lakṣmīḥvara aṃganām iva bhūṣitānām
english: The ponds, having the drakes scattering hither and thither for their girdles and engarlanded with full blown lotuses and water lilies, are appearing like so many damsels ornamented with diverse ornaments.

sanskrit: वेणु स्वर व्यंजित तूर्य मिश्रःप्रत्यूष काले अनिल संप्रवृत्तः
संमूर्च्छितो गह्वर गो वृषाणाम्अन्योन्यम् आपूरयति इव शब्दः
transliteration: veṇu svara vyaṃjita tūrya miśraḥpratyūṣa kāle anila saṃpravṛttaḥ
saṃmūrcchito gahvara go vṛṣāṇāmanyonyam āpūrayati iva śabdaḥ
english: The sound set up by the wind in the dawn like to that of a pipe accompanied by the music of a trumpet, being mixed with the noise of the caves and bulls are as if multiplying each other.

sanskrit: नवैः नदीनाम् कुसुम प्रहासैःव्या धूयमानैः मृदु मारुतेन
धौत अमल क्षौम पट प्रकाशैःकूलानि काशैः उपशोभितानि
transliteration: navaiḥ nadīnām kusuma prahāsaiḥvyā dhūyamānaiḥ mṛdu mārutena
dhauta amala kṣauma paṭa prakāśaiḥkūlāni kāśaiḥ upaśobhitāni
english: The banks of the rivers are being dressed by the newly blossomed flowers shaken by the mild breezes and Kāśas like to clean, washed silken clothes.

sanskrit: वन प्रचण्डा मधु पान शौण्डाःप्रिय अन्विताः षट् चरणाः प्रहृष्टाः
वनेसु मत्ताः पवन अनु यात्राम्कुर्वन्ति पद्म आसन रेणु गौराः
transliteration: vana pracaṇḍā madhu pāna śauṇḍāḥpriya anvitāḥ ṣaṭ caraṇāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ
vanesu mattāḥ pavana anu yātrāmkurvanti padma āsana reṇu gaurāḥ
english: The black bees, bold, given to drinking honey, rendered yellow with the filaments of lotuses and Asana flowers, delighted and accompanied by their mates are following the wind in the forest.

sanskrit: जलम् प्रसन्नम् कुसुम प्रहासम्क्रौन्च स्वनम् शालि वनम् विपक्वम्
मृदुः च वायुः विमलः च चन्द्रःशंसन्ति वर्ष व्यपनीत कालम्
transliteration: jalam prasannam kusuma prahāsamkraunca svanam śāli vanam vipakvam
mṛduḥ ca vāyuḥ vimalaḥ ca candraḥśaṃsanti varṣa vyapanīta kālam
english: The clear water, the blossoming flowers, the noise of Crauncas, the ripe white rice, the mild breezes, the clear Moon announce the approach of the Autumn-the removers of the rains.

sanskrit: मीन उप संदर्शित मेखलानाम्नदी वधूनाम् गतयो अद्य मंदाः
कान्त उपभुक्त अलस गामिनीनाम्प्रभात कालेषु इव कामिनीनाम्
transliteration: mīna upa saṃdarśita mekhalānāmnadī vadhūnām gatayo adya maṃdāḥ
kānta upabhukta alasa gāminīnāmprabhāta kāleṣu iva kāminīnām
english: The rivers, having fishes for their girdles, have become of slackened course like to damsels moving slowly in the dawn being enjoyed by their husbands.

sanskrit: स चक्रवाकानि स शैवलानिकाशैः दुकूलैः इव संवृतानि
स पत्र रेखाणि स रोचनानिवधू मुखानि इव नदी मुखानि
transliteration: sa cakravākāni sa śaivalānikāśaiḥ dukūlaiḥ iva saṃvṛtāni
sa patra rekhāṇi sa rocanānivadhū mukhāni iva nadī mukhāni
english: The mouths of the rivers, filled with Cakravākas, covered with aquatic plants and clothed with Kāśas are appearing like to the countenances of damsels pasted with yellow pigments.

sanskrit: प्रफुल्ल बाण आसन चित्रितेषुप्रहृष्ट षट्पदानि कूजितेषु
गृहीत चापः उद्यत दण्ड चण्डःप्रचण्ड चारो अद्य वनेषु कामः
transliteration: praphulla bāṇa āsana citriteṣuprahṛṣṭa ṣaṭpadāni kūjiteṣu
gṛhīta cāpaḥ udyata daṇḍa caṇḍaḥpracaṇḍa cāro adya vaneṣu kāmaḥ
english: The most powerful Cupid has taken up his terrible bow in this forest filled with Asana flowers appearing like to arrows and the hum of delighted bees.

sanskrit: लोकम् सुवृष्ट्या परितोषयित्वनदीः तटाकानि च पूरयित्वा
निष्पन्न सस्याम् वसुधाम् च कृत्वात्यक्त्वा नभः तोय धराः प्रणष्टाः
transliteration: lokam suvṛṣṭyā paritoṣayitvanadīḥ taṭākāni ca pūrayitvā
niṣpanna sasyām vasudhām ca kṛtvātyaktvā nabhaḥ toya dharāḥ praṇaṣṭāḥ
english: Having satisfied the people with a profuse discharge of water, filled the rivers and pools and covered the earth with crops the clouds have disappeared renouncing the sky.

sanskrit: दर्शयन्ति शरन् नद्यः पुलिनानि शनैः शनैः
नव संगम सव्रीडा जघनानि इव योषितः
transliteration: darśayanti śaran nadyaḥ pulināni śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
nava saṃgama savrīḍā jaghanāni iva yoṣitaḥ
english: The rivers in this season of autumn have been gradually showing their banks.

sanskrit: चक्रवाक गण आकीर्णा विभांति सलिल आशयाः
transliteration: cakravāka gaṇa ākīrṇā vibhāṃti salila āśayāḥ
english: O you of excellent looks, the ponds in this season) appear exquisitely fine, being filled with Kurara birds and Cakravākas.
O son of king, this is the time of preparation for inimical kings, desirous of defeating one another.

sanskrit: इयम् सा प्रथमा यात्रा पार्थिवानाम् नृपात्मज
न च पश्यामि सुग्रीवम् उद्योगम् वा तथा विधम्
transliteration: iyam sā prathamā yātrā pārthivānām nṛpātmaja
na ca paśyāmi sugrīvam udyogam vā tathā vidham
english: O son of king, this is the best time for royal marches, but I do not find Sugrīva preparing himself for that end.

sanskrit: असनाः सप्त पर्णाः च कोविदाराः च पुष्पिताः
दृश्यन्ते बन्धुजीवाः च श्यामाः च गिरि सानुषु
transliteration: asanāḥ sapta parṇāḥ ca kovidārāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ
dṛśyante bandhujīvāḥ ca śyāmāḥ ca giri sānuṣu
english: There appear on the summits of the hills flowers Asanas, Saptaparanas, Kavidaras, Bandhugivas, and Tamālās.

sanskrit: हंस सारस चक्राह्वैः कुररैः च समंततः
transliteration: haṃsa sārasa cakrāhvaiḥ kuraraiḥ ca samaṃtataḥ
english: Behold, O Laksmana, the banks of the rivers filled with swans, Sarasas, Cakravakas and Kuraras.

sanskrit: चत्वारो वार्षिका मासा गता वर्ष शत उपमाः
मम शोक अभितप्तस्य तथा सीताम् अपश्यतः
transliteration: catvāro vārṣikā māsā gatā varṣa śata upamāḥ
mama śoka abhitaptasya tathā sītām apaśyataḥ
english: Stricken as I am with grief, these four months, the season of rains, appeared to me like a hundred year, not beholding Sītā.

sanskrit: चक्रवाकी इव भर्तारम् पृष्टतो अनुगता वनम्
विषमम् दण्डकारण्यम् उद्यान वनम् इव च अंगना
transliteration: cakravākī iva bhartāram pṛṣṭato anugatā vanam
viṣamam daṇḍakāraṇyam udyāna vanam iva ca aṃganā
english: Like to Cakravākas following their inates, Sītā taking the terrible forest of Daņďaka for a picturesque garden, used to follow me there.

sanskrit: प्रिया विहीने दुःख आर्ते हृत राज्ये विवासिते
कृपाम् न कुरुते राजा सुग्रीवो मयि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: priyā vihīne duḥkha ārte hṛta rājye vivāsite
kṛpām na kurute rājā sugrīvo mayi lakṣmaṇa
english: O Laksmana, Sugriva, is not inclined to show any commiseration towards me, who am separated from my beloved spouse, deprived of my kingdom, banished and stricken with sorrow.

sanskrit: अनाथो हृत राज्यो अयम् रावणेन च धर्षितः
दीनो दूर गृहः कामी माम् चैव शरणम् गतः
transliteration: anātho hṛta rājyo ayam rāvaṇena ca dharṣitaḥ
dīno dūra gṛhaḥ kāmī mām caiva śaraṇam gataḥ
english: Regarding me as one without any to back him, deprived of his kingdom, insulted my Rāvaņa, wretched, of a distant land, under the influence of amour and therefore seeking his help, (Sugrīva has not felt pity for me).

sanskrit: इति एतैः कारणैः सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः
transliteration: iti etaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ saumya sugrīvasya durātmanaḥ
english: O subduer of foes, O you of excellent looks, for these reasons, I have been insulted by that vicious-souled king of monkeys-Sugriva.

sanskrit: कृतार्थः समयम् कृत्वा दुर्मतिः न अवबुध्यते
transliteration: kṛtārthaḥ samayam kṛtvā durmatiḥ na avabudhyate
english: Having appointed the time time to institute enquiries about Sītā, that wicked-minded one has now forgot it on the accession of his new dignity.

sanskrit: स किष्किंधाम् प्रविश्य त्वम् ब्रूहि वानर पुंगवम्
मूर्खम् ग्राम्य सुखे सक्तम् सुग्रीवम् वचनात् मम
transliteration: sa kiṣkiṃdhām praviśya tvam brūhi vānara puṃgavam
mūrkham grāmya sukhe saktam sugrīvam vacanāt mama
english: Do you therefore repair to Kişkindhā and speak of me to that stupid lord of monkeys Sugriva, addicted to rural enjoyments.

sanskrit: अर्थिनाम् उपपन्नानाम् पूर्वम् च अपि उपकारिणाम्
आशाम् सम्श्रुत्य यो हन्ति स लोके पुरुषाधमः
transliteration: arthinām upapannānām pūrvam ca api upakāriṇām
āśām samśrutya yo hanti sa loke puruṣādhamaḥ
english: And do you tell him-'He, who breaks his promise made to a powerful benefactor who solicits his favour, is regarded by people as vile.

sanskrit: शुभम् वा यदि वा पापम् यो हि वाक्यम् उदीरितम्
transliteration: śubham vā yadi vā pāpam yo hi vākyam udīritam
english: He is a true hero and an excellent person who verifies his words whether good or bad.

sanskrit: कृतार्था हि अकृतार्थानाम् मित्राणाम् न भवन्ति ये
तान् मृतान् अपि क्रव्यादाः कृतघ्नान् न उपभुंजते
transliteration: kṛtārthā hi akṛtārthānām mitrāṇām na bhavanti ye
tān mṛtān api kravyādāḥ kṛtaghnān na upabhuṃjate
english: Ungrateful they are who do not, after attaining their ends, engage in the service of those of their friends who have not accomplished their objects; even those living on raw flesh do not feed on their gore after their death.

sanskrit: नूनम् कांचन पृष्ठस्य विकृष्टस्य मया रणे
द्रष्टुम् इच्छसि चापस्य रूपम् विद्युत् गण उपमम्
transliteration: nūnam kāṃcana pṛṣṭhasya vikṛṣṭasya mayā raṇe
draṣṭum icchasi cāpasya rūpam vidyut gaṇa upamam
english: And ask him if he wishes to behold in battlefield the golden bow resembling a lightning.

sanskrit: घोरम् ज्या तल निर्घोषम् क्रुद्धस्य मम संयुगे
निर्घोषम् इव वज्रस्य पुनः संश्रोतुम् इच्छसि
transliteration: ghoram jyā tala nirghoṣam kruddhasya mama saṃyuge
nirghoṣam iva vajrasya punaḥ saṃśrotum icchasi
english: And ask him more, if he wishes to hear the terrible twang of my bow resembling the noise of thunder, when I am enraged in battle.

sanskrit: कामम् एवम् गते अपि अस्य परिज्ञाते पराक्रमे
त्वत् सहायस्य मे वीर न चिन्ता स्यात् नृपात्मज
transliteration: kāmam evam gate api asya parijñāte parākrame
tvat sahāyasya me vīra na cintā syāt nṛpātmaja
english: O hero, O son of a king, when apprised of my prowess assisted by you, will he not recapitulate in his mind (that he may be destroyed by us like to Vali)?

sanskrit: यद् अर्थम् अयम् आरंभः कृतः पर पुरम् जय
transliteration: yad artham ayam āraṃbhaḥ kṛtaḥ para puram jaya
english: O conqueror of enemies' cities, does not that lord of monkeys, after accomplishing his object, think of the conditions under which our friendship was contracted?

sanskrit: वर्षा समय कालम् तु प्रतिज्ञाय हरीश्वरः
व्यतीतान् चतुरो मासान् विहरन् न अवबुध्यते
transliteration: varṣā samaya kālam tu pratijñāya harīśvaraḥ
vyatītān caturo māsān viharan na avabudhyate
english: Does not that lord of monkeys think that he has spent four months in enjoyments, having promised and appointed the season, after rains, (for making) enquiries about Sītā?

sanskrit: स अमात्य परिषत् क्रीडन् पानम् एव उपसेवते
शोक दीनेषु न अस्मासु सुग्रीवः कुरुते दयाम्
transliteration: sa amātya pariṣat krīḍan pānam eva upasevate
śoka dīneṣu na asmāsu sugrīvaḥ kurute dayām
english: Does not Sugrīva feel pity for us, who are racked with sorrow, being addicted to drinking with friends and counsellors?

sanskrit: उच्यताम् गच्छ सुग्रीवः त्वया वीरः महाबल
मम रोषस्य यत् रूपम् ब्रूयाः च एनम् इदम् वचः
transliteration: ucyatām gaccha sugrīvaḥ tvayā vīraḥ mahābala
mama roṣasya yat rūpam brūyāḥ ca enam idam vacaḥ
english: Do you go, O hero, O you of mighty strength and relate to Sugrīva these my angry words.

sanskrit: न स संकुचितः पंथा येन वाली हतो गतः
समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालि पथम् अन्वगाः
transliteration: na sa saṃkucitaḥ paṃthā yena vālī hato gataḥ
samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vāli patham anvagāḥ
english: 'O Sugriva, do not neglect your promise and wend your way trodden by Vāli.

sanskrit: एक एव रणे वाली शरेण निहतो मया
त्वाम् तु सत्यात् अतिक्रांतम् हनिष्यामि स बान्धवम्
transliteration: eka eva raṇe vālī śareṇa nihato mayā
tvām tu satyāt atikrāṃtam haniṣyāmi sa bāndhavam
english: I killed Vāli only with my shaft in the battlefield; but if you did deviate from the path of truth I shall destroy you along with your kinsmen and relatives.

sanskrit: तत् एवम् विहिते कार्ये यत् हितम् पुरुषर्षभ
तत् तत् ब्रूहि नरश्रेष्ठ त्वर काल व्यतिक्रमः
transliteration: tat evam vihite kārye yat hitam puruṣarṣabha
tat tat brūhi naraśreṣṭha tvara kāla vyatikramaḥ
english: O you best of men, do you speedily relate to him all those benefits which we shall reap by his actions, for the proper season is well-nigh past.

sanskrit: कुरुष्व सत्यम् मम वानरेश्वरप्रतिश्रुतम् धर्मम् अवेक्ष्य शाश्वतम्
मा वालिनम् प्रेत गतो यम क्षयम्त्वम् अद्य पश्येः मम चोदितः शरैः
transliteration: kuruṣva satyam mama vānareśvarapratiśrutam dharmam avekṣya śāśvatam
mā vālinam preta gato yama kṣayamtvam adya paśyeḥ mama coditaḥ śaraiḥ
english: O best of monkeys, do you carry out your promise remembering the eternal existence of virtue. Do you not behold the spirit of Väli in the abode of Death, being killed by the shaft discharged by me.

sanskrit: स पूर्वजम् तीव्र विवृद्ध कोपम्लालप्यमानम् प्रसमीक्ष्य दीनम्
चकार तीव्राम् मतिम् उग्र तेजाहरीश्वरे मानव वंश वर्थनः
transliteration: sa pūrvajam tīvra vivṛddha kopamlālapyamānam prasamīkṣya dīnam
cakāra tīvrām matim ugra tejāharīśvare mānava vaṃśa varthanaḥ
english: Beholding his elder brother thus enraged and bewailing, the fiery-spirited Laksmana, the best of men, became enraged with Sugrīva.

sanskrit: स कामिनम् दीनम् अदीन सत्त्वःशोक अभिपन्नम् समुदीर्ण कोपम्
नरेन्द्र सूनुर् नरदेव पुत्रम्रामानुजः पूर्वजम् इति उवाच
transliteration: sa kāminam dīnam adīna sattvaḥśoka abhipannam samudīrṇa kopam
narendra sūnur naradeva putramrāmānujaḥ pūrvajam iti uvāca
english: Lakşmaņa again addressed his high-minded elder brother, the son of a king, influenced by passion, stricken with grief, and poorly, with the following words.

sanskrit: न वानरः स्थास्यति साधु वृत्तेन मन्यते कर्म फल अनुषंगान्
न भोक्ष्यते वानर राज्य लक्ष्मीम्तथा हि न अभिक्रमते अस्य बुद्धिः
transliteration: na vānaraḥ sthāsyati sādhu vṛttena manyate karma phala anuṣaṃgān
na bhokṣyate vānara rājya lakṣmīmtathā hi na abhikramate asya buddhiḥ
english: That monkey shall not follow the actions of the pious, shall not think of the great fruit (the accession of kingdom) reaped by our friendship; kingdom because he has not the right understanding to make good his promise.

sanskrit: मति क्षयात् ग्राम्य सुखेषु सक्तःतव प्रसाद अप्रतिकार बुद्धिः
हतो अग्रजम् पश्यतु वालिनम्न राज्यम् एवम् विगुणस्य देयम्
transliteration: mati kṣayāt grāmya sukheṣu saktaḥtava prasāda apratikāra buddhiḥ
hato agrajam paśyatu vālinamna rājyam evam viguṇasya deyam
english: Owing to the wane of his understanding in consequence of your favour he is addicted to rural enjoyments and has forgot to return your benefits. O hero, killed let him espy his elder brother Vāli. It is not proper to confer kingdom upon that wicked-minded one.

sanskrit: न धारये कोपम् उदीर्ण वेगम्निहन्मि सुग्रीवम् असत्यम् अद्य
हरि प्रवीरैः सह वालि पुत्रोनरेन्द्र पुत्र्या विचयम् करोतु
transliteration: na dhāraye kopam udīrṇa vegamnihanmi sugrīvam asatyam adya
hari pravīraiḥ saha vāli putronarendra putryā vicayam karotu
english: I am unable to bear the outburst of my ire forsooth shall I kill today, that liar Sugrīva. May the son of Vāli with other principal monkeys engage in quest of that daughter of a king.

sanskrit: तम् आत्त बाण आसनम् उत्पतंतम्निवेदित अर्थम् रण चण्ड कोपम्
उवच रामः पर वीर हन्तास्व वेक्षितम् स अनुनयम् च वाक्यम्
transliteration: tam ātta bāṇa āsanam utpataṃtamnivedita artham raṇa caṇḍa kopam
uvaca rāmaḥ para vīra hantāsva vekṣitam sa anunayam ca vākyam
english: Beholding him rise up from the seat with bow in his hand and greatly wrought up with anger and hearing him thus announce his intention about the destruction of Sugriva, Rama, the slayer of foes, spoke to him the following humble words worthy of being spoken on that occasion.

sanskrit: न हि वै त्वत् विधो लोके पापम् एवम् समाचरेत्
कोपम् आर्येण यो हन्ति स वीरः पुरुषोत्तमः
transliteration: na hi vai tvat vidho loke pāpam evam samācaret
kopam āryeṇa yo hanti sa vīraḥ puruṣottamaḥ
english: Persons like you on this earth do not perpetrate the crime of destroying their friends. He is truly a great hero and an excellent person who subdues anger by his right understanding, O Lakṣmaṇa, it is not proper for you to bring about the destruction of your friend, do you follow your former friendship and good feelings.

sanskrit: न इदम् अत्र त्वया ग्राह्यम् साधु वृत्तेन लक्ष्मण
ताम् प्रीतिम् अनुवर्तस्व पूर्व वृत्तम् च संगतम्
transliteration: na idam atra tvayā grāhyam sādhu vṛttena lakṣmaṇa
tām prītim anuvartasva pūrva vṛttam ca saṃgatam
english: Persons like you on this earth do not perpetrate the crime of destroying their friends. He is truly a great hero and an excellent person who subdues anger by his right understanding, O Lakṣmaṇa, it is not proper for you to bring about the destruction of your friend, do you follow your former friendship and good feelings.

sanskrit: वक्तुम् अर्हसि सुग्रीवम् व्यतीतम् काल पर्यये
transliteration: vaktum arhasi sugrīvam vyatītam kāla paryaye
english: Avoiding harsh words do you address Sugrīva, who has violated his promise, with soothing words.

sanskrit: सो अग्रजेन अनुशिष्ट अर्थो यथावत् पुरुषर्षभः
प्रविवेश पुरीम् वीरो लक्ष्मणः पर वीर हा
transliteration: so agrajena anuśiṣṭa artho yathāvat puruṣarṣabhaḥ
praviveśa purīm vīro lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīra hā
english: Being thus duly counselled by his elder brother, that best of men, the heroic Laks maņa-the slayer of foes, entered the city.

sanskrit: ततः शुभ मतिः प्राज्ञो भ्रातुः प्रियहितेरतः
transliteration: tataḥ śubha matiḥ prājño bhrātuḥ priyahiterataḥ
english: Thereupon the highly intelligent Lakşmaņa of right understanding, and ever intent upon the welfare of his brother, taking up a bow like to Indra's, resembling the summit of a hill and terrible as Death himself, entered, wrought up with ire, the abode of the king of monkeys like the hill Mandāra.

sanskrit: शक्र बाणासन प्रख्यम् धनुः कालांतक उपमः
प्रगृह्य गिरि शृंगाभम् मन्दरः सानुमान् इव
transliteration: śakra bāṇāsana prakhyam dhanuḥ kālāṃtaka upamaḥ
pragṛhya giri śṛṃgābham mandaraḥ sānumān iva
english: Thereupon the highly intelligent Lakşmaņa of right understanding, and ever intent upon the welfare of his brother, taking up a bow like to Indra's, resembling the summit of a hill and terrible as Death himself, entered, wrought up with ire, the abode of the king of monkeys like the hill Mandāra.

sanskrit: यथा उक्त कारी वचनम् उत्तरम् चैव स उत्तरम्
बृहस्पति समो बुद्ध्या मत्त्वा रामानुजः तदा
transliteration: yathā ukta kārī vacanam uttaram caiva sa uttaram
bṛhaspati samo buddhyā mattvā rāmānujaḥ tadā
english: Intelligent like Bșhaspati and ever abiding by his elder brother's behest, Laksmana, revolving in his mind what he should say as well as Sugrīva's answers, and enveloped with the fire of anger arising from the excitement of his brother's amour, and therefore displeased, proceeded quick as air.

sanskrit: काम क्रोध समुत्थेन भ्रातुः कोपाग्निना वृतः
प्रभंजन इव अप्रीतः प्रययौ लक्ष्मणः तदा
transliteration: kāma krodha samutthena bhrātuḥ kopāgninā vṛtaḥ
prabhaṃjana iva aprītaḥ prayayau lakṣmaṇaḥ tadā
english: Intelligent like Bșhaspati and ever abiding by his elder brother's behest, Laksmana, revolving in his mind what he should say as well as Sugrīva's answers, and enveloped with the fire of anger arising from the excitement of his brother's amour, and therefore displeased, proceeded quick as air.

sanskrit: साल ताल अश्व कर्णाम् च तरसा पातयन् बलात्
पर्यस्यन् गिरि कूटानि द्रुमान् अन्याम् च वेगितः
transliteration: sāla tāla aśva karṇām ca tarasā pātayan balāt
paryasyan giri kūṭāni drumān anyām ca vegitaḥ
english: And on he proceeded, felling down by his velocity, Sāla, Tāla, and Aśvakarņa trees, throwing aside the mountain summits and other trees, breaking rocks into pieces with his feet and striding very quickly like to a fleet-coursing elephant.

sanskrit: शिलाः च शकली कुर्वन् पद्भ्याम् गज इव आशु गः
दूरम् एक पदम् त्यक्त्वा ययौ कार्यवशात् द्रुतम्
transliteration: śilāḥ ca śakalī kurvan padbhyām gaja iva āśu gaḥ
dūram eka padam tyaktvā yayau kāryavaśāt drutam
english: And on he proceeded, felling down by his velocity, Sāla, Tāla, and Aśvakarņa trees, throwing aside the mountain summits and other trees, breaking rocks into pieces with his feet and striding very quickly like to a fleet-coursing elephant.

sanskrit: ताम् अपश्यत् बल आकीर्णाम् हरिराज महापुरीम्
दुर्गाम् इक्ष्वाकु शार्दूलः किष्किंधाम् गिरि संकटे
transliteration: tām apaśyat bala ākīrṇām harirāja mahāpurīm
durgām ikṣvāku śārdūlaḥ kiṣkiṃdhām giri saṃkaṭe
english: And that best of Ikşwakus, beheld that splendid city of the king of monkeys hard to enter, surrounded by monkey-herds, and mountains.

sanskrit: रोषात् प्रस्फुरमाण ओष्ठः सुग्रीवम् प्रति लक्ष्मणः
ददर्श वानरान् भीमान् किष्किंधाया बहिः चरान्
transliteration: roṣāt prasphuramāṇa oṣṭhaḥ sugrīvam prati lakṣmaṇaḥ
dadarśa vānarān bhīmān kiṣkiṃdhāyā bahiḥ carān
english: And having his lips swollen with anger for Sugrīva, Lakşmaņa beheld the terrible monkeys walking outside the city.

sanskrit: तम् दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे लक्ष्मणम् पुरुषर्षभम्शैल शृंगाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धाम् च महीरुहान्
जगृहुः कुंजर प्रख्या वानराः पर्वत अंतरे
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā vānarāḥ sarve lakṣmaṇam puruṣarṣabhamśaila śṛṃgāṇi śataśaḥ pravṛddhām ca mahīruhān
jagṛhuḥ kuṃjara prakhyā vānarāḥ parvata aṃtare
english: Beholding that best of men-Laksmana, the monkeys resembling elephants entered the mountainous stronghold and took up the summits of the hill and huge trees.

sanskrit: तान् गृहीत प्रहरणान् सर्वान् दृष्ट्वा तु लक्ष्मणः
बभूव द्विगुणम् क्रुद्धो बहु इंधन इव अनलः
transliteration: tān gṛhīta praharaṇān sarvān dṛṣṭvā tu lakṣmaṇaḥ
babhūva dviguṇam kruddho bahu iṃdhana iva analaḥ
english: And observing them armed, Lakṣmaṇa was doubly inflamed with anger like to fire kindled with fuels.

sanskrit: तम् ते भयपरीत अंगाः ख्सुब्धम् दृष्ट्वा प्लवंगमाः
काल मृत्यु युगांताअभम् शतशो विद्रुता दिशः
transliteration: tam te bhayaparīta aṃgāḥ khsubdham dṛṣṭvā plavaṃgamāḥ
kāla mṛtyu yugāṃtāabham śataśo vidrutā diśaḥ
english: Beholding Lakṣmaṇa, highly enraged, terrible as Death himself at the time of dissolution, the monkeys, stricken with fear, fled away, by hundreds, into various quarters.
Thereat those foremost of monkeys, entering the palace of Sugrīva, communicated to him, Laksmana's ire and approach.

sanskrit: तारया सहितः कामी सक्तः कपिवृषः तदा
न तेषाम् कपि वीराणाम् शुश्राव वचनम् तदा
transliteration: tārayā sahitaḥ kāmī saktaḥ kapivṛṣaḥ tadā
na teṣām kapi vīrāṇām śuśrāva vacanam tadā
english: That amorous chief of monkeys, attached to Tārā, paid no heed to the words of those foremost of monkeys.

sanskrit: गिरि कुंजर मेघ आभा नगर्या निर्ययुः तदा
transliteration: giri kuṃjara megha ābhā nagaryā niryayuḥ tadā
english: Thereupon those terrible monkeys, resembling hills, elephants and clouds, went out of the city being commanded by the minister.

sanskrit: नख दंष्ट्र आयुधा सर्वे वीराः विकृत दर्शनाः
सर्वे शार्दूल दर्पाः च सर्वे च विकृत आननाः
transliteration: nakha daṃṣṭra āyudhā sarve vīrāḥ vikṛta darśanāḥ
sarve śārdūla darpāḥ ca sarve ca vikṛta ānanāḥ
english: Some of them had sharpened teeth and nails, some were grim-visaged, some had teeth like those of tigers, some had the strength of ten elephants, some had the strength of hundred elephants and some had that of thousand elephants.

sanskrit: दश नाग बलाः केचित् केचित् दश गुणोत्तराः
केचित् नाग सहस्रस्य बभूवुः तुल्य वर्चसः
transliteration: daśa nāga balāḥ kecit kecit daśa guṇottarāḥ
kecit nāga sahasrasya babhūvuḥ tulya varcasaḥ
english: Some of them had sharpened teeth and nails, some were grim-visaged, some had teeth like those of tigers, some had the strength of ten elephants, some had the strength of hundred elephants and some had that of thousand elephants.

sanskrit: ततः तैः कपिभिर् व्याप्ताम् द्रुम हस्तैर् महाबलैः
अपश्यत् लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः किष्किंधाम् ताम् दुरासदम्
transliteration: tataḥ taiḥ kapibhir vyāptām druma hastair mahābalaiḥ
apaśyat lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddhaḥ kiṣkiṃdhām tām durāsadam
english: Thereupon Laksmana, angry, espied the city of Kiskindhă, hard to enter and surrounded by mighty monkeys with trees in their hands.

sanskrit: ततः ते हरयः सर्वे प्राकार परिख अंतरात्
निष्क्रम्य उदग्र सत्त्वाः तु तस्थुर् आविष्कृतम् तदा
transliteration: tataḥ te harayaḥ sarve prākāra parikha aṃtarāt
niṣkramya udagra sattvāḥ tu tasthur āviṣkṛtam tadā
english: And getting over the ditch around the city walls, those terrible-looking monkeys stationed themselves openly.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवस्य प्रमादम् च पूर्वजस्य अर्थम् आत्मवान्
दृष्ट्वा कोप वशम् वीरः पुनर् एव जगाम सः
transliteration: sugrīvasya pramādam ca pūrvajasya artham ātmavān
dṛṣṭvā kopa vaśam vīraḥ punar eva jagāma saḥ
english: And meditating upon Sugrīva's error and his brother's interest, the self-controlled Laksmana, heroic, proceeded on wards.

sanskrit: स दीर्घ उष्ण महा उच्छ्वासः कोप संरक्त लोचनः
बभूव नर शार्दूल स धूम इव पावकः
transliteration: sa dīrgha uṣṇa mahā ucchvāsaḥ kopa saṃrakta locanaḥ
babhūva nara śārdūla sa dhūma iva pāvakaḥ
english: Sighing hot and hard, that best of men-Laks maņa, with reddened eyes appeared like to smoky fire.

sanskrit: बाण शल्य स्फुरत् जिह्वः सायक आसन भोगवान्
स्व तेजो विष संघातः पंच आस्य इव पन्नगः
transliteration: bāṇa śalya sphurat jihvaḥ sāyaka āsana bhogavān
sva tejo viṣa saṃghātaḥ paṃca āsya iva pannagaḥ
english: He appeared like to a terrible serpent of five mouths having the top of the arrow for his tongue, the bow for his expanded hood and his own prowess for the poison.

sanskrit: तम् दीप्तम् इव कालाग्निम् नागेन्द्रम् इव कोपितम्
समासाद्य अंगदः त्रासात् विषादम् अगमत् परम्
transliteration: tam dīptam iva kālāgnim nāgendram iva kopitam
samāsādya aṃgadaḥ trāsāt viṣādam agamat param
english: Beholding him like the flaming fire of dissolution and enraged lord of serpents, Angada, out of fear, became exceedingly sorry.

sanskrit: सो अंगदम् रोष ताम्राक्षः संदिदेश महायशाः
सुग्रीवः कथ्यताम् वत्स मम आगमनम् इति उत
transliteration: so aṃgadam roṣa tāmrākṣaḥ saṃdideśa mahāyaśāḥ
sugrīvaḥ kathyatām vatsa mama āgamanam iti uta

sanskrit: एष रामानुजः प्राप्तः त्वत् सकाशम् अरिन्दमः
भ्रातुर् व्यसन संतप्तो द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: eṣa rāmānujaḥ prāptaḥ tvat sakāśam arindamaḥ
bhrātur vyasana saṃtapto dvāri tiṣṭhati lakṣmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: तस्य वाक्यम् यदि रुचिः क्रियताम् साधु वानरः
इति उक्त्वा शीघ्रम् आगच्छ वत्स वाक्यम् अरिन्दम
transliteration: tasya vākyam yadi ruciḥ kriyatām sādhu vānaraḥ
iti uktvā śīghram āgaccha vatsa vākyam arindama

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शोकाविष्टो अंगदो अब्रवीत्
पितुः समीपम् आगम्य सौमित्रिः अयम् आगतः
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā śokāviṣṭo aṃgado abravīt
pituḥ samīpam āgamya saumitriḥ ayam āgataḥ
english: Hearing Laksmana's words, Angada overwhelmed with grief, approaching his uncle said-'Saumitree has arrived here.'

sanskrit: अथ अंगदः तस्य सुतीव्र वाचासंभ्रांत भावः परिदीन वक्त्रः
निर्गत्य पूर्वम् नृपतेः तरस्वीततो रुमायाः चरणौ ववन्दे
transliteration: atha aṃgadaḥ tasya sutīvra vācāsaṃbhrāṃta bhāvaḥ paridīna vaktraḥ
nirgatya pūrvam nṛpateḥ tarasvītato rumāyāḥ caraṇau vavande
english: Being greatly agitated with harsh words, Angada, with a pale and poorly countenance issued out speedily and approaching touched first the king's feet and afterwards with reverence Ruma's feet.

sanskrit: संगृह्य पादौ पितुः उग्रतेजाजग्राह मातुः पुनर् एव पादौ
पादौ रुमायाः च निपीडयित्वानिवेदयामास ततः तत् अर्थम्
transliteration: saṃgṛhya pādau pituḥ ugratejājagrāha mātuḥ punar eva pādau
pādau rumāyāḥ ca nipīḍayitvānivedayāmāsa tataḥ tat artham
english: That one of exceeding prowess first touched the feet of his uncle then saluted again his mother and afterwards touching the feet of Rumā related to them every thing in full.

sanskrit: स निद्रा मद संवीतो वानरो न विबुद्धवान्
बभूव मद मत्तः च मदनेन च मोहितः
transliteration: sa nidrā mada saṃvīto vānaro na vibuddhavān
babhūva mada mattaḥ ca madanena ca mohitaḥ
english: That monkey, possessed by amour and under the influence of liquor, being asleep could not hear (what Angada had said).

sanskrit: ततः किल किलाम् चक्रुः लक्ष्मणम् प्रेक्ष्य वानराः
प्रसादयन्तः तम् क्रुद्धम् भय मोहित चेतसः
transliteration: tataḥ kila kilām cakruḥ lakṣmaṇam prekṣya vānarāḥ
prasādayantaḥ tam kruddham bhaya mohita cetasaḥ
english: Beholding Lakşmaņa highly enraged, the monkeys, possessed by fear, began to make noise as they were welcoming him.

sanskrit: ते महा ओघ निभम् दृष्ट्वा वज्र अशनि सम स्वनम्
सिंह नादम् समम् चक्रुर् लक्ष्मणस्य समीपतः
transliteration: te mahā ogha nibham dṛṣṭvā vajra aśani sama svanam
siṃha nādam samam cakrur lakṣmaṇasya samīpataḥ
english: They, approaching Lakşmaņa began to set up a terrible roar like to thunder and resembling the uproar of lions and the noise of water-falls.

sanskrit: मद विह्वल ताम्राक्षो व्याकुल स्रग्वि भूषणः
transliteration: mada vihvala tāmrākṣo vyākula sragvi bhūṣaṇaḥ
english: By that terrible sound awoke that monkeychief, having coppery eyes, agitated, adorned with garlands and possessed by liquor.

sanskrit: अथ अंगद वचः श्रुत्वा तेन एव च समागतौ
transliteration: atha aṃgada vacaḥ śrutvā tena eva ca samāgatau
english: Hearing the words of Angada, the tow counsellors of Sugrīva, intelligent and of magnificent looks, along with him, approached that lord of monkeys. And those two ministers Yaksa and Prabhava, to give him proper counsels, informed (that monkey-chief) of the arrival of Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: प्लक्षः च एव प्रभावः च मंत्रिणौ अर्थ धर्मयोः
वक्तुम् उच्चावचम् प्राप्तम् लक्ष्मणम् तौ शशंसतुः
transliteration: plakṣaḥ ca eva prabhāvaḥ ca maṃtriṇau artha dharmayoḥ
vaktum uccāvacam prāptam lakṣmaṇam tau śaśaṃsatuḥ
english: Hearing the words of Angada, the tow counsellors of Sugrīva, intelligent and of magnificent looks, along with him, approached that lord of monkeys. And those two ministers Yaksa and Prabhava, to give him proper counsels, informed (that monkey-chief) of the arrival of Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: प्रसादयित्वा सुग्रीवम् वचनैः स अर्थ निश्चितैः
transliteration: prasādayitvā sugrīvam vacanaiḥ sa artha niścitaiḥ

sanskrit: सत्य संधौ महाभागौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
वयस्य भावम् संप्राप्तौ राज्य अर्हौ राज्य दायिनौ
transliteration: satya saṃdhau mahābhāgau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
vayasya bhāvam saṃprāptau rājya arhau rājya dāyinau

sanskrit: तयोः एको धनुष्पाणिर् द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः
यस्य भीताः प्रवेपन्ते नादान् मुंचन्ति वानराः
transliteration: tayoḥ eko dhanuṣpāṇir dvāri tiṣṭhati lakṣmaṇaḥ
yasya bhītāḥ pravepante nādān muṃcanti vānarāḥ

sanskrit: स एष राघव भ्राता लक्ष्मणो वाक्य सारथिः
व्यवसाय रथः प्राप्तः तस्य रामस्य शासनात्
transliteration: sa eṣa rāghava bhrātā lakṣmaṇo vākya sārathiḥ
vyavasāya rathaḥ prāptaḥ tasya rāmasya śāsanāt
english: That Laksmana, Raghava's brother, having words for his charioteer, and perseverance for his chariot, has approached you at his brother's command.

sanskrit: अयम् च तनयो राजन् ताराया दयितो अंगदः
लक्ष्मणेन सकाशम् ते प्रेषितः त्वरया अनघ
transliteration: ayam ca tanayo rājan tārāyā dayito aṃgadaḥ
lakṣmaṇena sakāśam te preṣitaḥ tvarayā anagha
english: O blameless king, by that Laksmana-Tara's darling, Angada has been despatched to you.

sanskrit: सः अयम् रोष परीताक्षो द्वारि तिष्ठति वीर्यवान्
transliteration: saḥ ayam roṣa parītākṣo dvāri tiṣṭhati vīryavān
english: O king, of monkeys, that highly powerful one, having his eyes full of ire, is waiting at your gate, as if burning down with his eyes all the monkeys.

sanskrit: तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वम् स पुत्र सह बान्धवः
गच्छ शीघ्रम् महाराज रोषो हि अद्य उपशम्यताम्
transliteration: tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvam sa putra saha bāndhavaḥ
gaccha śīghram mahārāja roṣo hi adya upaśamyatām
english: O king, along with your children and friends do you repair to him speedily and bowing to him with your head down do you pacify his wrath.

sanskrit: यथा आह रामो धर्मात्मा तत् कुरुष्व समाहितः
राजन् तिष्ठ स्व समये भव सत्य प्रतिश्रवः
transliteration: yathā āha rāmo dharmātmā tat kuruṣva samāhitaḥ
rājan tiṣṭha sva samaye bhava satya pratiśravaḥ
english: And do you, O king, with a composed heart, perform what the virtuous-souled Rāma has ordered you to do and thus fulfil your promise.

sanskrit: अंगदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवः सचिवैः सह
लक्ष्मणम् कुपितम् श्रुत्वा मुमोच आसनम् आत्मवान्
transliteration: aṃgadasya vacaḥ śrutvā sugrīvaḥ sacivaiḥ saha
lakṣmaṇam kupitam śrutvā mumoca āsanam ātmavān
english: Hearing the words of Angada as well as of Laksmana's wrath, the self-controlled Sugriva along with his counsellors, left his seat.

sanskrit: स च तान् अब्रवीत् वाक्यम् निश्चित्य गुरु लाघवम्
transliteration: sa ca tān abravīt vākyam niścitya guru lāghavam
english: Ascertaining the weight and lightness of the present occasion, that one, expert in counsels and abiding by their advice spoke to the expert counsellors, saying.

sanskrit: न मे दुर् व्याहृतम् किंचित् न अपि मे दुर् अनुष्ठितम्
लक्ष्मणो राघव भ्राता क्रुद्धः किम् इति चिंतये
transliteration: na me dur vyāhṛtam kiṃcit na api me dur anuṣṭhitam
lakṣmaṇo rāghava bhrātā kruddhaḥ kim iti ciṃtaye
english: I have not done him any wrong, nor have I spoken to him any improper word. I do not know why Rāghava's brother Laksmana has become offended with me.

sanskrit: असुहृद्भिः मम अमित्रैः नित्यम् अन्तर दर्शिभिः
transliteration: asuhṛdbhiḥ mama amitraiḥ nityam antara darśibhiḥ
english: Lakşmaņa has been falsely apprised of my imaginary weakness by my enemies, always looking to my dark sides.

sanskrit: अत्र तावत् यथा बुद्धि सर्वैः एव यथा विधि
भावस्य निश्चयः तावत् विज्ञेयो निपुणम् शनैः
transliteration: atra tāvat yathā buddhi sarvaiḥ eva yathā vidhi
bhāvasya niścayaḥ tāvat vijñeyo nipuṇam śanaiḥ
english: It behoveth you all, to ascertain now speedily according to your knowledge and right understanding (the cause of Laksmana's wrath).

sanskrit: न खलु अस्ति मम त्रासो लक्ष्मणान् न अपि राघवात्
मित्रम् तु अस्थान कुपितम् जनयति एव संभ्रमम्
transliteration: na khalu asti mama trāso lakṣmaṇān na api rāghavāt
mitram tu asthāna kupitam janayati eva saṃbhramam
english: I do not fear Lakşmaņa or Rāghava; but friends enraged without any cause do invariable produce fear.

sanskrit: अनित्यत्वात् तु चित्तानाम् प्रीतिः अल्पे अपि भिद्यते
transliteration: anityatvāt tu cittānām prītiḥ alpe api bhidyate
english: It is easy to contract friendship but very difficult to sustain it; for owing to the fickleness of our minds, a very slight cause bring about separation.

sanskrit: अतो निमित्तम् त्रस्तो अहम् रामेण तु महात्मना
यन् मम उपकृतम् शक्यम् प्रतिकर्तुम् न तन् मया
transliteration: ato nimittam trasto aham rāmeṇa tu mahātmanā
yan mama upakṛtam śakyam pratikartum na tan mayā
english: I have not done him any good proportionate to what the high-souled Rāma had done for me; and it is for this reason that I am afraid of him.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवेण एवम् उक्ते तु हनुमान् हरि पुंगवः
उवाच स्वेन तर्केण मध्ये वानर मंत्रिणाम्
transliteration: sugrīveṇa evam ukte tu hanumān hari puṃgavaḥ
uvāca svena tarkeṇa madhye vānara maṃtriṇām
english: Being thus addressed by Sugrīva-Hanumān, the foremost of monkey-counsellors spoke, according to his own understanding, saying.

sanskrit: सर्वथा न एतद् आश्चर्यम् यत् त्वम् हरिगणेश्वर
न विस्मरसि सुस्निग्धम् उपकारम् कृतम् शुभम्
transliteration: sarvathā na etad āścaryam yat tvam harigaṇeśvara
na vismarasi susnigdham upakāram kṛtam śubham
english: It is no wonder, O lord of monkeys, that you had not forgot the unexpected benefit, (you hadst received at the hands of Rāma).

sanskrit: राघवेण तु वीरेण भयम् उत्सृज्य दूरतः
त्वत् प्रिय अर्थम् हतो वाली शक्र तुल्य पराक्रमः
transliteration: rāghaveṇa tu vīreṇa bhayam utsṛjya dūrataḥ
tvat priya artham hato vālī śakra tulya parākramaḥ
english: To encompass your well-being, Vali, powerful as the Lord of celestials, was fearlessly destroyed by the heroic Rāghava. There is not the least doubt, that Rāghava, out of love, is enraged with you, and has despatched his younger brother Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of prosperity.

sanskrit: सर्वथा प्रणयात् क्रुद्धो राघवो न अत्र संशयः
transliteration: sarvathā praṇayāt kruddho rāghavo na atra saṃśayaḥ
english: To encompass your well-being, Vali, powerful as the Lord of celestials, was fearlessly destroyed by the heroic Rāghava. There is not the least doubt, that Rāghava, out of love, is enraged with you, and has despatched his younger brother Lakşmaņa, the enhancer of prosperity.

sanskrit: त्वम् प्रमत्तो न जानीषे कालम् कलविदाम् वर
फुल्ल सप्त च्छद श्यामा प्रवृत्ता तु शरत् शिवा
transliteration: tvam pramatto na jānīṣe kālam kalavidām vara
phulla sapta cchada śyāmā pravṛttā tu śarat śivā
english: O you foremost of those conversant with time, the auspicious autumn, green with Saptchada flowers, has set in and you, given up to enjoyments, does not perceive it.

sanskrit: निर्मल ग्रह नक्षत्रा द्यौः प्रनष्ट बलाहका
प्रसन्नाः च दिशः सर्वाः सरितः च सरांसि च
transliteration: nirmala graha nakṣatrā dyauḥ pranaṣṭa balāhakā
prasannāḥ ca diśaḥ sarvāḥ saritaḥ ca sarāṃsi ca
english: The sky, having the clouds removed, is full of clear stars and planets. The quarters, the ponds and rivers are all clear.

sanskrit: प्राप्तम् उद्योग कालम् तु न अवैषि हरिपुंगव
त्वम् प्रमत्त इति व्यक्तम् लक्ष्मणो अयम् इह आगतः
transliteration: prāptam udyoga kālam tu na avaiṣi haripuṃgava
tvam pramatta iti vyaktam lakṣmaṇo ayam iha āgataḥ
english: O best of monkeys, finding you forgetful, Lakṣmaṇa has come here to inform you that the proper time has arrived.

sanskrit: आर्तस्य हृत दारस्य परुषम् पुरुष अन्तरात्
transliteration: ārtasya hṛta dārasya paruṣam puruṣa antarāt
english: Do you patiently hear all these harsh words of the high-souled Rāma, racked with sorrow and separated from his spouse, which Laksmana, shall relate to you.

sanskrit: कृत अपराधस्य हि ते न अन्यत् पश्यामि अहम् क्षमम्
transliteration: kṛta aparādhasya hi te na anyat paśyāmi aham kṣamam
english: You have acted improperly towards him, and I do not find any thing tending to your welfare but your satisfying Lakşmana with folded hands.

sanskrit: नियुक्तैः मंत्रिभिः वाच्यो अवश्यम् पार्थिवो हितम्
इत एव भयम् त्यक्त्वा ब्रवीमि अवधृतम् वचः
transliteration: niyuktaiḥ maṃtribhiḥ vācyo avaśyam pārthivo hitam
ita eva bhayam tyaktvā bravīmi avadhṛtam vacaḥ
english: The kings should be addressed with auspicious words by their counsellors always ministering to them proper counsels. And it is for this reason, I am addressing you with these sound words.

sanskrit: अभिक्रुद्धः समर्थो हि चापम् उद्यम्य राघवः
स देव असुर गंधर्वम् वशे स्थापयितुम् जगत्
transliteration: abhikruddhaḥ samartho hi cāpam udyamya rāghavaḥ
sa deva asura gaṃdharvam vaśe sthāpayitum jagat
english: Rāghava, taking up his bow, while enraged, can bring under subjection the entire world, inhabited by by the celestials, Asuras and Gandharvas.

sanskrit: न स क्षमः कोपयितुम् यः प्रसाद्य पुनर् भवेत्
transliteration: na sa kṣamaḥ kopayitum yaḥ prasādya punar bhavet
english: Remembering his former service, it does not behove you, grateful as you are, to excite his wrath, who should be pleased again.

sanskrit: तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वम् स पुत्रः स सुहृत् जनः
राजन् तिष्ठ स्व समये भर्तुः भार्या इव तत् वशे
transliteration: tasya mūrdhnā praṇamya tvam sa putraḥ sa suhṛt janaḥ
rājan tiṣṭha sva samaye bhartuḥ bhāryā iva tat vaśe
english: Bowing to him, with your children and friends, do you, O king, satisfying your promise, seek his shelter like to a wife placing herself under the control of her husband.

sanskrit: न राम रामानुज शासनम् त्वयाकपीन्द्र युक्तम् मनसा अपि अपोहितुम्
मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषम् बलम्स राघवस्य अस्य सुरेन्द्र वर्चसः
transliteration: na rāma rāmānuja śāsanam tvayākapīndra yuktam manasā api apohitum
mano hi te jñāsyati mānuṣam balamsa rāghavasya asya surendra varcasaḥ
english: O lord of monkeys, it does not behove you, to neglect even in thought, the behests of Rāma and his younger brother; for you are fully aware of the prowess of Rāghava like to the lord of celestials, and passing human power.

sanskrit: प्रविवेश गुहाम् रम्याम् किष्किंधाम् राम शासनात्
