transliteration: praviveśa guhām ramyām kiṣkiṃdhām rāma śāsanāt
english: Thereupon, Laksmana, the slayer of foes, commanded, entered, at the behest of Rāma, the pleasant city of Kişkindhā situated in the centre of caves.

sanskrit: बभूवुः लक्ष्मणम् दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्रांजलयः स्थिताः
transliteration: babhūvuḥ lakṣmaṇam dṛṣṭvā sarve prāṃjalayaḥ sthitāḥ
english: Beholding Lakşınaņa, the highly powerful monkeys, having huge persons and waiting at the gate, stood all with folded hands.

sanskrit: निःश्वसन्तम् तु तम् दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धम् दशरथ आत्मजम्
बभूवुः हरयः त्रस्ता न च एनम् पर्यवारयन्
transliteration: niḥśvasantam tu tam dṛṣṭvā kruddham daśaratha ātmajam
babhūvuḥ harayaḥ trastā na ca enam paryavārayan
english: And seeing Dasaratha's son highly enraged and sighing again and again, the monkeys stood silent and did not interrupt him.

sanskrit: स तम् रत्नमयीम् दिव्याम् श्रीमान् पुष्पित काननाम्
रम्याम् रत्न समाकीर्णाम् ददर्श महतीम् गुहाम्
transliteration: sa tam ratnamayīm divyām śrīmān puṣpita kānanām
ramyām ratna samākīrṇām dadarśa mahatīm guhām

sanskrit: सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः पुष्पितैः उपशोभिताम्
transliteration: sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpitaiḥ upaśobhitām

sanskrit: देव गंधर्व पुत्रैः च वानरैः काम रूपिभिः
दिव्य माल्य अम्बर धारैः शोभिताम् प्रिय दर्शनैः
transliteration: deva gaṃdharva putraiḥ ca vānaraiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ
divya mālya ambara dhāraiḥ śobhitām priya darśanaiḥ

sanskrit: चन्दन अगरु पद्मानाम् गन्धैः सुरभि गन्धिताम्
मैरेयाणाम् मधूनाम् च सम्मोदित महा पथाम्
transliteration: candana agaru padmānām gandhaiḥ surabhi gandhitām
maireyāṇām madhūnām ca sammodita mahā pathām
english: It was fragrant with the sweet smell of sandal wood, Aguru and lotuses and its highway were equally fragrant with the smell of honey.

sanskrit: विंध्य मेरु गिरि प्रख्यैः प्रासादैः न एक भूमिभिः
ददर्श गिरि नद्यः च विमलाः तत्र राघवः
transliteration: viṃdhya meru giri prakhyaiḥ prāsādaiḥ na eka bhūmibhiḥ
dadarśa giri nadyaḥ ca vimalāḥ tatra rāghavaḥ
english: And Lakşmaņa beheld there many spacious buildings like to the hills Vindhya and Meru and rivers of clear water.

sanskrit: अंगदस्य गृहम् रम्यम् मैन्दस्य द्विविदस्य च
transliteration: aṃgadasya gṛham ramyam maindasya dvividasya ca

sanskrit: वीरबाहोः सुबाहोः च नलस्य च महात्मनः
transliteration: vīrabāhoḥ subāhoḥ ca nalasya ca mahātmanaḥ

sanskrit: एतेषाम् कपि मुख्यानाम् राज मार्गे महात्मनाम्
transliteration: eteṣām kapi mukhyānām rāja mārge mahātmanām

sanskrit: पाण्डुर अभ्र प्रकाशानि गन्ध माल्य युतानि च
प्रभूत धन धान्यानि स्त्री रत्नैः शोभितानि च
transliteration: pāṇḍura abhra prakāśāni gandha mālya yutāni ca
prabhūta dhana dhānyāni strī ratnaiḥ śobhitāni ca

sanskrit: वानरेन्द्र गृहम् रम्यम् महेन्द्र सदन उपमम्
transliteration: vānarendra gṛham ramyam mahendra sadana upamam

sanskrit: शुल्कैः प्रासाद शिखरैः कैलास शिखर उपमैः
सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः पुष्पितैः उपशोभितम्
transliteration: śulkaiḥ prāsāda śikharaiḥ kailāsa śikhara upamaiḥ
sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ puṣpitaiḥ upaśobhitam

sanskrit: महेन्द्र दत्तैः श्रीमद्भिः नील जीमूत संनिभैः
दिव्य पुष्प फलैः वृक्षैः शीत च्छायैः मनोरमैः
transliteration: mahendra dattaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ nīla jīmūta saṃnibhaiḥ
divya puṣpa phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ śīta cchāyaiḥ manoramaiḥ

sanskrit: हरिभिः संवृत द्वारम् बलिभिः शस्त्र पाणिभिः
दिव्य माल्य आवृतम् शुभ्रम् तप्त कांचन तोरणम्
transliteration: haribhiḥ saṃvṛta dvāram balibhiḥ śastra pāṇibhiḥ
divya mālya āvṛtam śubhram tapta kāṃcana toraṇam

sanskrit: स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा यान आसन समावृताः
प्रविश्य सुमहत् गुप्तम् ददर्श अंतःपुरम् महत्
transliteration: sa sapta kakṣyā dharmātmā yāna āsana samāvṛtāḥ
praviśya sumahat guptam dadarśa aṃtaḥpuram mahat
english: And that virtuous-souled one, crossing the seven rooms filled with conveyances and seats beheld the secret apartment (of that monkeychief), having many a gold and silver bed-steads with excellent coverlets and fine seats.

sanskrit: हैम राजत पर्यन्कैः बहुभिः च वर आसनैः
महा अर्ह आस्तरण उपेतैः तत्र तत्र समावृतम्
transliteration: haima rājata paryankaiḥ bahubhiḥ ca vara āsanaiḥ
mahā arha āstaraṇa upetaiḥ tatra tatra samāvṛtam
english: And that virtuous-souled one, crossing the seven rooms filled with conveyances and seats beheld the secret apartment (of that monkeychief), having many a gold and silver bed-steads with excellent coverlets and fine seats.

sanskrit: प्रविशन् एव सततम् शुश्राव मधुर स्वनम्
तंत्री गीत समाकीर्णम् सम ताल पदाक्षरम्
transliteration: praviśan eva satatam śuśrāva madhura svanam
taṃtrī gīta samākīrṇam sama tāla padākṣaram
english: No sooner had he entered the inner apartment than he heard a musical sound, well-measured and accompanied by the music of the stringed instrument.

sanskrit: बह्वीः च विविध आकारा रूप यौवन गर्विताः
स्त्रियः सुग्रीव भवने ददर्श स महाबलः
transliteration: bahvīḥ ca vividha ākārā rūpa yauvana garvitāḥ
striyaḥ sugrīva bhavane dadarśa sa mahābalaḥ
english: And that highly powerful one beheld in the abode of Sugrīva many a beautiful damsel proud of their youth and beauty sprung from respectable families, adorned with splendid ornaments, engaged in stringing excellent garlands.

sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा अभिजन संपन्नाः तत्र माल्य कृत स्रजः
वर माल्य कृत व्यग्रा भूषण उत्तम भूषिताः
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā abhijana saṃpannāḥ tatra mālya kṛta srajaḥ
vara mālya kṛta vyagrā bhūṣaṇa uttama bhūṣitāḥ
english: And he observed Sugrīva's servants, well fed, contented, not hurry in offering their services and without splendid ornaments.

sanskrit: न अतृप्तान् न अति च व्यग्रान् न अनुदात्त परिच्छदान्
सुग्रीव अनुचरान् च अपि लक्षयामास लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: na atṛptān na ati ca vyagrān na anudātta paricchadān
sugrīva anucarān ca api lakṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: And he observed Sugrīva's servants, well fed, contented, not hurry in offering their services and without splendid ornaments.

sanskrit: कूजितम् नूपुराणाम् च कंचनीम् निःस्वनम् तथा
स निशम्य ततः श्रीमान् सौमित्रिः लज्जितो अभवत्
transliteration: kūjitam nūpurāṇām ca kaṃcanīm niḥsvanam tathā
sa niśamya tataḥ śrīmān saumitriḥ lajjito abhavat
english: Hearing the sounds of women's girdles and their Nupurs*, the graceful Lakşınaņa became highly ashamed. *An ornament for their toes or feet.

sanskrit: रोष वेग प्रकुपितः श्रुत्वा च आभरण स्वनम्
चकार ज्या स्वनम् वीरो दिशः शब्देन पूरयन्
transliteration: roṣa vega prakupitaḥ śrutvā ca ābharaṇa svanam
cakāra jyā svanam vīro diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan
english: And highly enraged at the sound of the ornaments, the hero filled all the quarters with the twang of his bow.

sanskrit: तस्थौ एकांतम् आश्रित्य राम शोक समन्वितः
transliteration: tasthau ekāṃtam āśritya rāma śoka samanvitaḥ
english: Lakşmaņa of mighty arms stood silent in a nook, thinking of his improper conduct of entering into (Sugriva's) seraglio, albeit he was wrought up with ire in consequence of Sugrīva's neglecting Rama's service.

sanskrit: तेन चाप स्वनेन अथ सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः
विज्ञाय आगमनम् त्रस्तः स चचाल वर आसनात्
transliteration: tena cāpa svanena atha sugrīvaḥ plavagādhipaḥ
vijñāya āgamanam trastaḥ sa cacāla vara āsanāt
english: Thereupon Sugrīva, the lord of monkeys, being apprised of Laksmana's approach by the twang of his bow and terrified, trembled on his throne, and thought aside.

sanskrit: सुव्यक्तम् एष संप्रप्तः सौमित्रिः भ्रातृ वत्सलः
transliteration: suvyaktam eṣa saṃpraptaḥ saumitriḥ bhrātṛ vatsalaḥ
english: Forsooth has Saumitri, fond of his brother, come, whose approach was announced by Argada before,

sanskrit: अंगदेन समाख्यतो ज्या स्वनेन च वानरः
बुबुधे लक्ष्मणम् प्राप्तम् मुखम् च अस्य व्यशुष्यत
transliteration: aṃgadena samākhyato jyā svanena ca vānaraḥ
bubudhe lakṣmaṇam prāptam mukham ca asya vyaśuṣyata
english: Informed before by Angada of his approach, and made doubly sure by the twang of the bow, that monkey came to know of Lakşmaņa's arrival and turned pale.

sanskrit: ततः ताराम् हरि श्रेष्ठः सुग्रीवः प्रिय दर्शनाम्
उवाच हितम् अव्यग्र त्रास संभ्रांत मानसः
transliteration: tataḥ tārām hari śreṣṭhaḥ sugrīvaḥ priya darśanām
uvāca hitam avyagra trāsa saṃbhrāṃta mānasaḥ
english: Thereupon Sugrīva, the foremost of monkeys, wrought up with fear, addressed the fine looking Tārā with the following well-meaning words.

sanskrit: किम् नु रुट् कारणम् सुभ्रु प्रकृत्या मृदु मानसः
स रोष इव संप्राप्तो येन अयम् राघवानुजः
transliteration: kim nu ruṭ kāraṇam subhru prakṛtyā mṛdu mānasaḥ
sa roṣa iva saṃprāpto yena ayam rāghavānujaḥ
english: O beautiful lady, did you know, why has the mild-natured younger brother of Rāma, arrived here enraged?

sanskrit: किम् पश्यसि कुमारस्य रोष स्थानम् अनिन्दिते
न खलु अकारणे कोपम् आहरेत् नरपुंगवः
transliteration: kim paśyasi kumārasya roṣa sthānam anindite
na khalu akāraṇe kopam āharet narapuṃgavaḥ
english: O blameless lady, did you perceive any cause of the Prince's wrath? Forsooth, that best of men, is not enraged for a slight cause.

sanskrit: यदि अस्य कृतम् अस्माभिः बुध्यसे किंचित् अप्रियम्
तत् बुध्या संप्रधार्य आशु क्षिप्रम् एव अभिधीयताम्
transliteration: yadi asya kṛtam asmābhiḥ budhyase kiṃcit apriyam
tat budhyā saṃpradhārya āśu kṣipram eva abhidhīyatām
english: Considering aright, did you speedily inform me if I have performed any improper act towards Rāma.

sanskrit: अथवा स्वयम् एव एनम् द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि भामिनी
वचनैः स्वांत्व युक्तैः च प्रसादयितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: athavā svayam eva enam draṣṭum arhasi bhāminī
vacanaiḥ svāṃtva yuktaiḥ ca prasādayitum arhasi
english: O fine lady, do you approach him in person and pacify him with soothing words.

sanskrit: त्वत् दर्शने विशुद्ध आत्मा न स कोपम् करिष्यति
न हि स्त्रीषु महात्मानः क्वचित् कुर्वन्ति दारुणम्
transliteration: tvat darśane viśuddha ātmā na sa kopam kariṣyati
na hi strīṣu mahātmānaḥ kvacit kurvanti dāruṇam
english: Beholding you, that pure-souled one shall not be worked with ire; great men do never behave roughly towards the females.

sanskrit: त्वया स्वांत्वैः उपक्रांतम् प्रसन्न इन्द्रिय मानसम्
transliteration: tvayā svāṃtvaiḥ upakrāṃtam prasanna indriya mānasam
english: Approaching him do you console him and thereafter I shall see that conqueror of foes having eyes resembling lotus-petals.

sanskrit: सा प्रस्खलंती मद विह्वल अक्षीप्रलंब कांची गुण हेम सूत्रा
सलक्षणा लक्ष्मण संनिधानम्जगाम तारा नमित अंग यष्टिः
transliteration: sā praskhalaṃtī mada vihvala akṣīpralaṃba kāṃcī guṇa hema sūtrā
salakṣaṇā lakṣmaṇa saṃnidhānamjagāma tārā namita aṃga yaṣṭiḥ
english: Thereupon Tārā, with faltering feet and eyes wild with wine, the golden chains of her zone flowing (about her her hips),-graced with auspicious marks, saught Laksmana's presence with downcast looks.

sanskrit: स ताम् समीक्ष्य एव हरि ईश पत्नीम्तस्थौ उदासीनतया महात्मा
अवाङ्मुखो आभूत् मनुजेन्द्र पुत्रःस्त्री सन्निकर्षात् विनिवृत्त कोपम्
transliteration: sa tām samīkṣya eva hari īśa patnīmtasthau udāsīnatayā mahātmā
avāṅmukho ābhūt manujendra putraḥstrī sannikarṣāt vinivṛtta kopam
english: Beholding Tărā, the queen of the lord of monkeys, Laksmana, the high-souled son of a king, restraining his anger on the approach of a female, stood with his head hung down, conducting himself like an ascetic.

sanskrit: सा पान योगात् च निवृत्त लज्जादृष्टि प्रसादात् च नरेन्द्र सूनोः
उवाच तारा प्रणय प्रगल्भम्वाक्यम् महार्थम् परिसांत्व रूपम्
transliteration: sā pāna yogāt ca nivṛtta lajjādṛṣṭi prasādāt ca narendra sūnoḥ
uvāca tārā praṇaya pragalbhamvākyam mahārtham parisāṃtva rūpam
english: Renouncing modesty under the influence of liquor, and finding the king's son well pleased, Tārā spoke to Lakşmaņa, bold and loving words, in order to console him.

sanskrit: किम् कोप मूलम् मनुजेन्द्र पुत्रकः ते न सन्तिष्ठति वाक् निदेशे
कः शुष्क वृक्षम् वनम् आपतन्तम्दवाग्निम् आसीदति निर्विशंकः
transliteration: kim kopa mūlam manujendra putrakaḥ te na santiṣṭhati vāk nideśe
kaḥ śuṣka vṛkṣam vanam āpatantamdavāgnim āsīdati nirviśaṃkaḥ
english: O son of a king, what is the cause of your wrath? Who is there who has not abode by your commands? Who can remain without anxiety, beholding fire in a forest filled with dried trees?

sanskrit: स तस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा सांत्व पूर्वम् अशंकितः
भूयः प्रणय दृष्टार्थम् लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa tasya vacanam śrutvā sāṃtva pūrvam aśaṃkitaḥ
bhūyaḥ praṇaya dṛṣṭārtham lakṣmaṇo vākyam abravīt
english: Hearing the soothing words of Tārā, Laks maņa, undaunted, spoke again, greatly manifesting his friendship.

sanskrit: किम् अयम् काम वृत्तः ते लुप्त धर्मार्थ संग्रहः
भर्ता भर्तृ हिते युक्ते न च एवम् अवबुध्यसे
transliteration: kim ayam kāma vṛttaḥ te lupta dharmārtha saṃgrahaḥ
bhartā bhartṛ hite yukte na ca evam avabudhyase
english: O you intent on your husband's welfare, did you not perceive that your husband is by and by losing piety and wealth, being addicted to amorcus enjoyments.?

sanskrit: न चिंतयति राज्यार्थम् सः अस्मान् शोक परायणान्
स अमात्य परिषत् तारे कामम् एव उपसेवते
transliteration: na ciṃtayati rājyārtham saḥ asmān śoka parāyaṇān
sa amātya pariṣat tāre kāmam eva upasevate
english: O Tāră, your husband does not think of us who are moved with sorrow—but is addicted to sensual enjoyments only, being surrounded by parasites.

sanskrit: स मासान् चतुर कृत्वा प्रमाणम् प्लवगेश्वरः
व्यतीतान् तान् मद उदग्रो विहरन् न अवबुध्यते
transliteration: sa māsān catura kṛtvā pramāṇam plavageśvaraḥ
vyatītān tān mada udagro viharan na avabudhyate
english: (Having promised that he would institute enquiries about Sītā after four months), that lord of monkeys has well-nigh spent the entire period, being influenced by liquor and addicted to enjoyments along with you.

sanskrit: न हि धर्मार्थ सिद्ध्यर्थम् पानम् एवम् प्रशस्यते
पानात् अर्थस्य कामः च धर्मः च परिहीयते
transliteration: na hi dharmārtha siddhyartham pānam evam praśasyate
pānāt arthasya kāmaḥ ca dharmaḥ ca parihīyate
english: For the attainment of piety and wealth, drinking is not a proper course. It is by drinking that people lose piety, wealth and desire.

sanskrit: धर्म लोपो महान् तावत् कृते हि अप्रति कुर्वतः
अर्थ लोपः च मित्रस्य नाशे गुणवतो महान्
transliteration: dharma lopo mahān tāvat kṛte hi aprati kurvataḥ
artha lopaḥ ca mitrasya nāśe guṇavato mahān
english: He who does not return the services of his benefactor, loseth piety. He who who loseth friendship with a qualified friend, loseth wealth.

sanskrit: मित्रम् हि अर्थ गुण श्रेष्ठम् सत्य धर्म परायणम्
तत् द्वयम् तु परित्यक्तम् न तु धर्मे व्यवस्थितम्
transliteration: mitram hi artha guṇa śreṣṭham satya dharma parāyaṇam
tat dvayam tu parityaktam na tu dharme vyavasthitam
english: He is the best friend who is gifted with wealth and is truthful; and your husband has relinquished such a friend gifted with these two qualities.

sanskrit: तत् एवम् प्रस्तुते कार्ये कार्यम् अस्माभिः उत्तरम्
यत् कार्यम् कार्य तत्त्वज्ञे त्वम् उदाहर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: tat evam prastute kārye kāryam asmābhiḥ uttaram
yat kāryam kārya tattvajñe tvam udāhartum arhasi
english: And, therefore, he does not abide by the virtue of preserving friendship. O you expert in business, this being the case, do you advice us as to what we should do.

sanskrit: सा तस्य धर्मार्थ समाधि युक्तम्निशम्य वाक्यम् मधुर स्वभावम्
तारा गतार्थे मनुजेन्द्र कार्येविश्वास युक्तम् तम् उवाच भूयः
transliteration: sā tasya dharmārtha samādhi yuktamniśamya vākyam madhura svabhāvam
tārā gatārthe manujendra kāryeviśvāsa yuktam tam uvāca bhūyaḥ
english: Hearing the sweet words of Lakşmaņa consonant with piety and wealth, Tārā again addressed him about Räma's business, yet remaining unaccomplished with words inspiring confidence.

sanskrit: न कोप कालः क्षितिपाल पुत्रन च अपि कोपः स्व जने विधेयः
त्वत् अर्थ कामस्य जनस्य तस्यप्रमादम् अपि अर्हसि वीर सोढुम्
transliteration: na kopa kālaḥ kṣitipāla putrana ca api kopaḥ sva jane vidheyaḥ
tvat artha kāmasya janasya tasyapramādam api arhasi vīra soḍhum
english: O son of a king, this is not the time for displaying your wrath; it is not proper to be angry with one's own friends. O hero, it behoveth you to put up with the error of him who has your welfare in view.

sanskrit: कोपम् कथम् नाम गुण प्रकृष्टःकुमार कुर्यात् अपकृष्ट सत्त्वे
कः त्वत् विधः कोप वशम् हि गच्छेसत्त्व अवरुद्धः तपसः प्रसूतिः
transliteration: kopam katham nāma guṇa prakṛṣṭaḥkumāra kuryāt apakṛṣṭa sattve
kaḥ tvat vidhaḥ kopa vaśam hi gacchesattva avaruddhaḥ tapasaḥ prasūtiḥ
english: O prince, who, accomplished with excellent virtues, gets enraged with one of inferior merits? O prince, who, like you, an offspring of asceticism, is worked up with ire against the virtue of forgiveness?

sanskrit: जानामि कोपम् हरि वीर बन्धोःजानामि कार्यस्य च काल संगम्
जानामि कार्यम् त्वयि यत् कृतम् नःतत् च अपि जानामि यत् अत्र कार्यम्
transliteration: jānāmi kopam hari vīra bandhoḥjānāmi kāryasya ca kāla saṃgam
jānāmi kāryam tvayi yat kṛtam naḥtat ca api jānāmi yat atra kāryam
english: I know the cause of the) wrath of that heroic monkey's friend. I know the time for action. I know what you had done for us. I know what is due from us to you.

sanskrit: तत् च अपि जानामि यथा अविषह्यम्बलम् नरश्रेष्ठ शरीरजस्य
जानामि यस्मिन् च जने अवबद्धम्कामेन सुग्रीवम् अस्तकम् अद्य
transliteration: tat ca api jānāmi yathā aviṣahyambalam naraśreṣṭha śarīrajasya
jānāmi yasmin ca jane avabaddhamkāmena sugrīvam astakam adya
english: And, O foremost of men, I also know the irresistible force of Kāma. I know by whom Sugrīva has been taken captive, and that his heart is not now in the work.

sanskrit: न काम तंत्रे तव बुद्धिः अस्तित्वम् वै यथा मन्यु वशम् प्रपन्नः
न देश कालौ हि न च अर्थ धर्मौअवेक्षते काम रतिः मनुष्यः
transliteration: na kāma taṃtre tava buddhiḥ astitvam vai yathā manyu vaśam prapannaḥ
na deśa kālau hi na ca artha dharmauavekṣate kāma ratiḥ manuṣyaḥ
english: As you had come under the governance of anger, your mind has not felt the influence of desire. Even a human being that has conceived love, does not stay for place or time or interest

sanskrit: तम् काम वृत्तम् मम सन्निकृष्टम्काम अभियोगात् च विमुक्त लज्जम्
क्षमस्व तावत् पर वीर हन्तःतव भ्रातर्म वानर वंश नाथम्
transliteration: tam kāma vṛttam mama sannikṛṣṭamkāma abhiyogāt ca vimukta lajjam
kṣamasva tāvat para vīra hantaḥtava bhrātarma vānara vaṃśa nātham
english: Do you forgive that lord of the monkey race, your brother influenced by carnality, who is by you, and who through the urgency of lust, has banished shame.

sanskrit: महर्षयो धर्म तपोभिरामाःकामा अनुकामाः प्रति बद्ध मोहाः
अयम् प्रकृत्या चपलः कपिः तुकथम् न सज्जेत सुखेषु राजा
transliteration: maharṣayo dharma tapobhirāmāḥkāmā anukāmāḥ prati baddha mohāḥ
ayam prakṛtyā capalaḥ kapiḥ tukatham na sajjeta sukheṣu rājā
english: Even Maharșis finding delight in religion and asceticism, setting their hearts upon satisfying lust, (ultimately) become fast bound by ignorance. But this is a monkey, volatile by nature, and has, further more, been enjoying regal state-why should he not act thus?

sanskrit: इति एवम् उक्त्वा वचनम् महार्थम्सा वानरी लक्ष्मणम् अप्रमेयम्
पुनः स खेदम् मद विह्वलाक्षीभर्तुर् हितम् वाक्यम् इदम् बभाषे
transliteration: iti evam uktvā vacanam mahārthamsā vānarī lakṣmaṇam aprameyam
punaḥ sa khedam mada vihvalākṣībhartur hitam vākyam idam babhāṣe
english: Having thus said Lakşmaņa of immeasurable intelligence words fraught with high import, that female monkey, her eyes drooping with languor, again sadly spoke in this wise for the behoof of her husband.

sanskrit: उद्योगः तु चिर आज्ञप्तः सुग्रीवेण नरोत्तम
काम्स्य अपि विधेयेन तव अर्थ प्रति साधने
transliteration: udyogaḥ tu cira ājñaptaḥ sugrīveṇa narottama
kāmsya api vidheyena tava artha prati sādhane
english: O foremost of men, although Sugrīva has come under the sway of desire, he has, to secure your good, ere this issued orders for preparations to be made.

sanskrit: आगता हि महा वीर्या हरयः काम रूपिणः
कोटि शत सहस्राणि नाना नग निवासिनः
transliteration: āgatā hi mahā vīryā harayaḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ
koṭi śata sahasrāṇi nānā naga nivāsinaḥ
english: And monkeys by hundreds and thousands and koțis, inhabiting various mountains, possessed of exceeding prowess, have already arrived (here). to

sanskrit: तत् आगच्छ महाबाहो चारित्रम् रक्षितम् त्वया
अच्छलम् मित्र भावेन सताम् दरा अवलोकनम्
transliteration: tat āgaccha mahābāho cāritram rakṣitam tvayā
acchalam mitra bhāvena satām darā avalokanam
english: Do you therefore, O mighty-armed one, come. (Having rushed towards the inner apartment), you had not suffered in character. For the good to behold others' wives in a friendly spirit, cannot bring on unrighteousness.

sanskrit: ताराया च अभ्यनुज्ञात त्वरया चा अपि चोदितः
transliteration: tārāyā ca abhyanujñāta tvarayā cā api coditaḥ
english: Permitted by Tārā, that long-arined repressor of urged on by (the required) speed, entered the inner apartment.

sanskrit: ततः सुग्रीवम् आसीनम् कांचने परम आसने
transliteration: tataḥ sugrīvam āsīnam kāṃcane parama āsane
english: There seated on a superb seat spread with a costly carpet, he found Sugrīva resembling the sun himself, his person decked with noble ornaments, of a dignified presence, famous, wearing gay garlands and attire, invincible like to the great Indra.

sanskrit: दिव्य आभरण चित्रांगम् दिव्य रूपम् यशस्विनम्
दिव्य माल्यांबर धरम् महेन्द्रम् इव दुर्जयम्
transliteration: divya ābharaṇa citrāṃgam divya rūpam yaśasvinam
divya mālyāṃbara dharam mahendram iva durjayam
english: There seated on a superb seat spread with a costly carpet, he found Sugrīva resembling the sun himself, his person decked with noble ornaments, of a dignified presence, famous, wearing gay garlands and attire, invincible like to the great Indra.
And surrounded by dames adorned with elegant ornaments and wreaths, Sugrīva with his eyes still more reddened in wrath, looked like the destroyer himself.

sanskrit: रुमाम् तु वीरः परिरभ्य गाढम्वर आसनस्थो वर हेम वर्णः
ददर्श सौमित्रिम् अदीन सत्त्वम्विशाल नेत्रः स विशाल नेत्रम्
transliteration: rumām tu vīraḥ parirabhya gāḍhamvara āsanastho vara hema varṇaḥ
dadarśa saumitrim adīna sattvamviśāla netraḥ sa viśāla netram
english: Then deeply embracing Umā, the large-eyed hero of the hue of fine gold, seated on an excellent seat, saw the powerful Saumitri having expansive eyes.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणम् दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथित इन्द्रियः
transliteration: sugrīvo lakṣmaṇam dṛṣṭvā babhūva vyathita indriyaḥ
english: Seeing that foremost of men, Laksmana, exercised with wrath, as he entered in without let, Sugrīva was seized with sadness.

sanskrit: क्रुद्धम् निःश्वसमानम् तम् प्रदीप्तम् इव तेजसा
भ्रातुर् व्यसन संतप्तम् दृष्ट्वा दशरथ आत्मजम्
transliteration: kruddham niḥśvasamānam tam pradīptam iva tejasā
bhrātur vyasana saṃtaptam dṛṣṭvā daśaratha ātmajam
english: And seeing Dasaratha's son, wroth, and breathing hard, and flaming up in energy, and burning in consequence of the calamity that had overtaken his brother, that chief of monkeys started up, leaving his golden seat, like to the mighty ornamented standard of the great Indra.

sanskrit: महान् महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलंकृत इव ध्वजः
transliteration: mahān mahendrasya yathā svalaṃkṛta iva dhvajaḥ
english: And seeing Dasaratha's son, wroth, and breathing hard, and flaming up in energy, and burning in consequence of the calamity that had overtaken his brother, that chief of monkeys started up, leaving his golden seat, like to the mighty ornamented standard of the great Indra.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवम् गगने पूर्णम् चंद्रम् तारा गणा इव
transliteration: sugrīvam gagane pūrṇam caṃdram tārā gaṇā iva
english: And as Sugrīva rose up, Umā and the other females rose up, like to stars appearing in the sky when the full moon has risen.

sanskrit: बभूव अवस्थितः तत्र कल्प वृक्षो महान् इव
transliteration: babhūva avasthitaḥ tatra kalpa vṛkṣo mahān iva
english: And with eyes reddened, and his hands folded, the graceful Sugrīva came (before Laks maņa) and stood there like a mighty Kalpa tree.

sanskrit: रुमा द्वितीयम् सुग्रीवम् नारी मध्य गतम् स्थितम्
अब्रवीत् लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः स तारम् शशिनम् यथा
transliteration: rumā dvitīyam sugrīvam nārī madhya gatam sthitam
abravīt lakṣmaṇaḥ kruddhaḥ sa tāram śaśinam yathā
english: And the wrathful Lakşmaņa spoke to Sugrīva stationed among women, having Umā for his second, and resembling the moon with the stars, saying.

sanskrit: सत्त्व अभिजन संपन्नः स अनुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः
कृतज्ञः सत्य वादी च राजा लोके महीयते
transliteration: sattva abhijana saṃpannaḥ sa anukrośo jitendriyaḥ
kṛtajñaḥ satya vādī ca rājā loke mahīyate
english: The king that is nobly endowed by heredily, and is kind, that has subdued his senses, and is grateful and truth telling, obtains renown in this world.

sanskrit: यस्तु राजा स्थितो अधर्मे मित्राणाम् उपकारिणाम्
मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञाम् कुरुते को नृशंस तरः ततः
transliteration: yastu rājā sthito adharme mitrāṇām upakāriṇām
mithyā pratijñām kurute ko nṛśaṃsa taraḥ tataḥ
english: And who is more wicked than that king who, rooted in unrighteousness, makes false promises to friends intent upon his welfare?

sanskrit: शतम् अश्व अनृते हन्ति सहस्रम् तु गव अनृते
आत्मानम् स्व जनम् हन्ति पुरुषः पुरुष अनृते
transliteration: śatam aśva anṛte hanti sahasram tu gava anṛte
ātmānam sva janam hanti puruṣaḥ puruṣa anṛte
english: He that speaks a falsehood with reference to a horse, becomes guilty of the deaths of an hundred horses: he committing himself to a falsehood relative to a cow, reapeth the demerit of slaying a thousand kine; while he that uttereth an untruth touching a person, destroys self as well as his kindred.

sanskrit: पूर्वम् कृतार्थो मित्राणाम् न तत् प्रति करोति यः
कृतघ्नः सर्व भूतानाम् स वध्यः प्लवगेश्वर
transliteration: pūrvam kṛtārtho mitrāṇām na tat prati karoti yaḥ
kṛtaghnaḥ sarva bhūtānām sa vadhyaḥ plavageśvara
english: That ungrateful might that having at first attained benefit at the hands of his friends, does not requite it, is, O lord of monkeys, worthy of being slain by all creatures.

sanskrit: गीतो अयम् ब्रह्मणा श्लोकः सर्व लोक नमस्कृतः
दृष्ट्वा कृतघ्नम् क्रुद्धेन तम् निबोध प्लवम्गम
transliteration: gīto ayam brahmaṇā ślokaḥ sarva loka namaskṛtaḥ
dṛṣṭvā kṛtaghnam kruddhena tam nibodha plavamgama
english: Seeing an ingrate wretch, the wrathful Brahmā sang the (previous) śloka, bowed down to by all the worlds.

sanskrit: गो घ्ने च एव सुरापे च चौरे भग्न व्रते तथा
निष्कृतिर् विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने न अस्ति निष्कृतिः
transliteration: go ghne ca eva surāpe ca caure bhagna vrate tathā
niṣkṛtir vihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne na asti niṣkṛtiḥ
english: Do you understand that, O monkey. The pious provide deliverance for the cow-killer, the winebiber, the thief, and the violator of vows; but for the ungrateful person there is no deliverance whatever.

sanskrit: अनार्य त्वम् कृतघ्नः च मिथ्या वादी च वानर
पूर्वम् कृतार्थो रामस्य न तत् प्रतिकरोषि यत्
transliteration: anārya tvam kṛtaghnaḥ ca mithyā vādī ca vānara
pūrvam kṛtārtho rāmasya na tat pratikaroṣi yat
english: You are ignoble and ungrateful and lying, O monkey, since, having been formerly benefited by Rāma, you did not requite his services.

sanskrit: ननु नाम कृतार्थेन त्वया रामस्य वानर
सीताया मार्गणे यत्नः कर्तव्यः कृतम् इच्छता
transliteration: nanu nāma kṛtārthena tvayā rāmasya vānara
sītāyā mārgaṇe yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ kṛtam icchatā
english: Having been benefited by Rāma, you, anxious to repay his kindness, should exert yourself in search of Sita.

sanskrit: स त्वम् ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्या प्रतिश्रवः
न त्वाम् रामो विजानीते सर्पम् मण्डूक राविणम्
transliteration: sa tvam grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu sakto mithyā pratiśravaḥ
na tvām rāmo vijānīte sarpam maṇḍūka rāviṇam
english: But, of false promises, you had been indulging in gross enjoyments,-nor does Rāma know you for a serpent, croaking like a frog*. *Crying through the voice of the frog in its mouth. Another meaning is, croaking like a frog, to allure frog to it.

sanskrit: हरीणाम् प्रापितो राज्यम् त्वम् दुरात्मा महात्मना
transliteration: harīṇām prāpito rājyam tvam durātmā mahātmanā
english: A sinful wretch and of wicked soul, you had obtained the kingdom of the monkeys through the agency of the eminently virtuous, kind and high-souled Rāma.

sanskrit: कृतम् चेत् न अभिजानीषे राघवस्य महात्मनः
सद्यः त्वम् निशितैर् बाणैर् हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम्
transliteration: kṛtam cet na abhijānīṣe rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ
sadyaḥ tvam niśitair bāṇair hato drakṣyasi vālinam
english: You did not acknowledge the good offices rendered to you by the high-souled Rāghava; and therefore, slain by means of sharpened shafts, you shall soon see Vali.

sanskrit: न च संकुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः
समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालि पथम् अन्वगाः
transliteration: na ca saṃkucitaḥ panthā yena vālī hato gataḥ
samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vāli patham anvagāḥ
english: The way that has been wended by the slain Vali, is not yet narrowed. Do you, O Sugriva, desist in time: do not walk in the wake of Vāli.

sanskrit: न नूनम् इक्ष्वाकु वरस्य कार्मुकात्शरान् च तान् पश्यसि वज्र संनिभान्
ततः सुखम् नाम विषेवसे सुखीन राम कार्यम् मनसा अपि अवेक्षसे
transliteration: na nūnam ikṣvāku varasya kārmukātśarān ca tān paśyasi vajra saṃnibhān
tataḥ sukham nāma viṣevase sukhīna rāma kāryam manasā api avekṣase
english: Do not behold the shafts resembling thunderbolts shot from the bow of that best of the Ikş wakus. Then, attaining happiness, you shall pass your days in peace. Nor do you mentally neglect Rāma's business.

sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् प्रदीप्तम् इव तेजसा
अब्रवीत् लक्ष्मणम् तारा तारा अधिप निभ आनना
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇam saumitrim pradīptam iva tejasā
abravīt lakṣmaṇam tārā tārā adhipa nibha ānanā
english: When Sumitra's son, Laksmana, had spoken thus, flaming in energy, Tārā of face fair as the moon, said to him,

sanskrit: न एवम् लक्ष्मण वक्तव्यो न अयम् परुषम् अर्हति
हरीणाम् ईश्वरः श्रोतुम् तव वक्त्रात् विशेषतः
transliteration: na evam lakṣmaṇa vaktavyo na ayam paruṣam arhati
harīṇām īśvaraḥ śrotum tava vaktrāt viśeṣataḥ
english: O Lakşmaņa, you ought not to speak thus: and this lord of monkeys does not deserve to hear this harsh speech from your lips, in especial.

sanskrit: न एव अकृतज्ञः सुग्रीवो न शठो न अपि दारुणः
न एव अनृत कथो वीर न जिह्मः च कपीश्वरः
transliteration: na eva akṛtajñaḥ sugrīvo na śaṭho na api dāruṇaḥ
na eva anṛta katho vīra na jihmaḥ ca kapīśvaraḥ
english: Sugrīva is not ungrateful, or cunning, or heartless; nor does he, O hero, deal in falsehood; nor is he deceitful.

sanskrit: उपकारम् कृतम् वीरो न अपि अयम् विस्मृतः कपिः
रामेण वीर सुग्रीवो यत् अन्यैः दुष्करम् रणे
transliteration: upakāram kṛtam vīro na api ayam vismṛtaḥ kapiḥ
rāmeṇa vīra sugrīvo yat anyaiḥ duṣkaram raṇe
english: Nor has the heroic monkey, O hero, forgotten the good, incapable of being done by others in battle, that the hero; Rāma, has done in his behalf.

sanskrit: राम प्रसादात् कीर्तिम् च कपि राज्यम् च शाश्वतम्
प्राप्तवान् इह सुग्रीवो रुमाम् माम् च परंतप
transliteration: rāma prasādāt kīrtim ca kapi rājyam ca śāśvatam
prāptavān iha sugrīvo rumām mām ca paraṃtapa
english: O afflictor of foes, through Rāma's grace, Sugriva has here attained fame and the enduring empire of the monkeys, as well as Umā and myself.

sanskrit: सुदुःख शयितः पूर्वम् प्राप्य इदम् सुखम् उत्तमम्
प्राप्त कालम् न जानीते विश्वामित्रो यथा मुनिः
transliteration: suduḥkha śayitaḥ pūrvam prāpya idam sukham uttamam
prāpta kālam na jānīte viśvāmitro yathā muniḥ
english: Having lain down miserable before, Sugrīva, now that he has attained this supreme happiness, does not heed his urgent duties, like the ascetic Visvamitra.

sanskrit: घृताच्याम् किल संसक्तो दश वर्षाणि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: ghṛtācyām kila saṃsakto daśa varṣāṇi lakṣmaṇa
english: Attached to Ghrtāci, O Laksmana, the pious and mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra looked upon ten years as one day; and that best of those conversant with time, Viśvāmitra of mighty energy, did not perceive that the time (for doing a certain act) had arrived. What is to be said of other people?

sanskrit: स हि प्राप्तम् न जानीते कालम् कालविदाम् वरः
विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः किम् पुनर् यः पृथग् जनः
transliteration: sa hi prāptam na jānīte kālam kālavidām varaḥ
viśvāmitro mahātejāḥ kim punar yaḥ pṛthag janaḥ
english: Attached to Ghrtāci, O Laksmana, the pious and mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra looked upon ten years as one day; and that best of those conversant with time, Viśvāmitra of mighty energy, did not perceive that the time (for doing a certain act) had arrived. What is to be said of other people?

sanskrit: देह धर्म गतस्य अस्य परिश्रान्तस्य लक्ष्मण
अवितृप्तस्य कामेषु रामः क्षन्तुम् इह अर्हति
transliteration: deha dharma gatasya asya pariśrāntasya lakṣmaṇa
avitṛptasya kāmeṣu rāmaḥ kṣantum iha arhati
english: O Lakşmaņa, it behoveth Rāma to forgive one who has all the bodily exigencies, who is fatigued, and who is not satisfied with the pleasures of Kama. Nor, O Laksmana, does it behove you, without ascertaining the exact import of things, to become suddenly subject to wrath, like any inferior person.

sanskrit: न च रोष वशम् तात गंतुम् अर्हसि लक्ष्मण
transliteration: na ca roṣa vaśam tāta gaṃtum arhasi lakṣmaṇa
english: O Lakşmaņa, it behoveth Rāma to forgive one who has all the bodily exigencies, who is fatigued, and who is not satisfied with the pleasures of Kama. Nor, O Laksmana, does it behove you, without ascertaining the exact import of things, to become suddenly subject to wrath, like any inferior person.

sanskrit: सत्त्व युक्ता हि पुरुषाः त्वत् विधाः पुरुषर्षभ
अविमृश्य न रोषस्य सहसा यान्ति वश्यताम्
transliteration: sattva yuktā hi puruṣāḥ tvat vidhāḥ puruṣarṣabha
avimṛśya na roṣasya sahasā yānti vaśyatām
english: O chief of men, persons endowed with the quality of goodness, like to you, do not suffer themselves to come under the sway of passion, without (at first) heedfully revolving matters.

sanskrit: महान् रोष समुत्पन्नः संरंभः त्यज्यताम् अयम्
transliteration: mahān roṣa samutpannaḥ saṃraṃbhaḥ tyajyatām ayam
english: I crave your favour with concentrated mind, O you that know morality. Renounce the mighty grief that springs from your ire.

sanskrit: रुमाम् माम् च अंगदम् राज्यम् धन धान्य पशूनि च
राम प्रियार्थम् सुग्रीवः त्यजेत् इति मतिर् मम
transliteration: rumām mām ca aṃgadam rājyam dhana dhānya paśūni ca
rāma priyārtham sugrīvaḥ tyajet iti matir mama
english: This is my conviction that for compassing Rāma's welfare, Sugrīva can resign Umã and myself, and Angada, and the kingdom and wealth and corn and animals.

sanskrit: शशांकम् इव रोहिण्या हत्वा तम् राक्षस अधमम्
transliteration: śaśāṃkam iva rohiṇyā hatvā tam rākṣasa adhamam
english: Slaying that worst of Rākṣasas, Sugrīva will bring Rāghava with Sītā, like to the moon accompanied by Rohiņi.

sanskrit: शत कोटि सहस्राणि लंकायाम् किल रक्षसाम्
अयुतानि च षट् त्रिंशत् सहस्राणि शतानि च
transliteration: śata koṭi sahasrāṇi laṃkāyām kila rakṣasām
ayutāni ca ṣaṭ triṃśat sahasrāṇi śatāni ca
english: Without slaying hundreds of thousands of Kotis, and thirty-six Ayutas, thousands and hundreds of irrepressible Rākṣasas wearing shapes at will, (Rāma) can not slay Rāvana, by whom Maithili has been carried away.

sanskrit: अहत्वा ताम् च दुर्धर्षान् राक्षसान् काम रूपिणः
न शक्यो रावणो हंतुम् येन सा मैथिली हृता
transliteration: ahatvā tām ca durdharṣān rākṣasān kāma rūpiṇaḥ
na śakyo rāvaṇo haṃtum yena sā maithilī hṛtā
english: Without slaying hundreds of thousands of Kotis, and thirty-six Ayutas, thousands and hundreds of irrepressible Rākṣasas wearing shapes at will, (Rāma) can not slay Rāvana, by whom Maithili has been carried away.

sanskrit: ते न शक्या रणे हंतुम् असहायेन लक्ष्मण
रावणः क्रूर कर्मा च सुग्रीवेण विशेषतः
transliteration: te na śakyā raṇe haṃtum asahāyena lakṣmaṇa
rāvaṇaḥ krūra karmā ca sugrīveṇa viśeṣataḥ
english: They are incapable, O Laksmana, of being slain (by Rāma) in battle, unless he is supported (by others).

sanskrit: एवम् आख्यातवान् वाली स हि अभिज्ञो हरीश्वरः
आगमः तु न मे व्यक्तः श्रवात् तस्य ब्रवीमि अहम्
transliteration: evam ākhyātavān vālī sa hi abhijño harīśvaraḥ
āgamaḥ tu na me vyaktaḥ śravāt tasya bravīmi aham
english: Rāvana is a wily warrior, and hence is the special need of Sugrīva. That knowing lord of monkeys, Väli, had told me all this. I do not know how Rāvana had secured this host: I say what I had heard from Vāli.

sanskrit: त्वत् सहाय निमित्तम् हि प्रेषिता हरिपुंगवाः
transliteration: tvat sahāya nimittam hi preṣitā haripuṃgavāḥ
english: For rendering you assistance, the foremost monkeys have been despatched in order to summon to the conflict numerous principal monkeys.

sanskrit: ताम् च प्रतीक्षमाणो अयम् विक्रांतान् सुमहा बलान्
राघवस्य अर्थ सिद्धि अर्थम् न निर्याति हरि ईश्वरः
transliteration: tām ca pratīkṣamāṇo ayam vikrāṃtān sumahā balān
rāghavasya artha siddhi artham na niryāti hari īśvaraḥ
english: Expecting these powerful and exceedingly strong ones, for attaining Rāghava's end, this lord of monkeys does not (yet) sally out.

sanskrit: कृता सुसंस्था सौमित्रे सुग्रीवेण यथा पुरा
अद्य तैः वानरैः सर्वैः आगंतव्यम् महाबलैः
transliteration: kṛtā susaṃsthā saumitre sugrīveṇa yathā purā
adya taiḥ vānaraiḥ sarvaiḥ āgaṃtavyam mahābalaiḥ
english: Things, O Saumitri, have beforehand been so satisfactorily arranged by Sugrīva, that this very day the mighty one will be joined with all those monkeys.

sanskrit: ऋक्ष कोटि सहस्राणि गोलांगूल शतानि च
अद्य त्वाम् उपयास्यन्ति जहि कोपम् अरिन्दमकोट्यो अनेकाः तु काकुत्स्थ कपीनाम् दीप्त तेजसाम्
transliteration: ṛkṣa koṭi sahasrāṇi golāṃgūla śatāni ca
adya tvām upayāsyanti jahi kopam arindamakoṭyo anekāḥ tu kākutstha kapīnām dīpta tejasām
english: This very day billions of bears and thousands of golangulas as well as innumerable Koțis of monkeys flaming in energy shall join you. Therefore, O subduer of enemies, banish your anger.

sanskrit: तव हि मुखम् इदम् निरीक्ष्य कोपात्क्षतज समे नयने निरीक्षमाणाः
हरि वर वनिता न यान्ति शान्तिम्प्रथम भयस्य हि शन्किताः स्म सर्वाः
transliteration: tava hi mukham idam nirīkṣya kopātkṣataja same nayane nirīkṣamāṇāḥ
hari vara vanitā na yānti śāntimprathama bhayasya hi śankitāḥ sma sarvāḥ
english: Seeing this your face wrought up with wrath, and your eyes appearing like red sores, the wives of the best of monkeys experience no peace, and they are agitated by the fear that exercised them of late.

sanskrit: इति उक्तः तारया वाक्यम् प्रश्रितम् धर्म संहितम्
मृदु स्वभावः सौमित्रिः प्रतिजग्राह तत् वचः
transliteration: iti uktaḥ tārayā vākyam praśritam dharma saṃhitam
mṛdu svabhāvaḥ saumitriḥ pratijagrāha tat vacaḥ
english: Humbly addressed in these words informed with morality, Sumitra's son, resuming his native mildness, accepted them.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् प्रतिगृहीते तु वाक्ये हरि गण ईश्वरः
लक्ष्मणात् सुमहत् त्रासम् वस्त्रम् क्लिन्नम् इव अत्यजत्
transliteration: tasmin pratigṛhīte tu vākye hari gaṇa īśvaraḥ
lakṣmaṇāt sumahat trāsam vastram klinnam iva atyajat
english: On his accepting the speech, the lord of monkeys like a wet cloth cast off from him the fear he had conceived on account of Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: ततः कण्ठ गतम् माल्यम् चित्रम् बहु गुणम् महत्
चिच्छेद विमदः च आसीत् सुग्रीवो वानर ईश्वरः
transliteration: tataḥ kaṇṭha gatam mālyam citram bahu guṇam mahat
ciccheda vimadaḥ ca āsīt sugrīvo vānara īśvaraḥ
english: Then Sugriva-lord of monkeys-tore away the gaudy and variegated garland on his neck-potent with many a virtue, and become deprived of energy.

sanskrit: स लक्ष्मणम् भीम बलम् सर्व वानर सत्तमः
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇam bhīma balam sarva vānara sattamaḥ
english: And that master of all the monkeys, Sugrīva, gladdening Lakşmaņa of dreadful prowess, humbly observed to him,

sanskrit: प्रनष्टा श्रीः च कीर्तिः च कपि राज्यम् च शाश्वतम्
राम प्रसादात् सौमित्रे पुनः च आप्तम् इदम् मया
transliteration: pranaṣṭā śrīḥ ca kīrtiḥ ca kapi rājyam ca śāśvatam
rāma prasādāt saumitre punaḥ ca āptam idam mayā
english: You son to Sumitrā, by the favour of Rāma have I received back my lost luck, my fame, and this eternal monarchy of the monkeys.

sanskrit: कः शक्तः तस्य देवस्य ख्यातस्य स्वेन कर्मणा
transliteration: kaḥ śaktaḥ tasya devasya khyātasya svena karmaṇā
english: O king's son, who is capable of repaying even in part an action like that of the divine (Rāma) renowned by means of his own acts?

sanskrit: सीताम् प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम्
सहाय मात्रेण मया राघवः स्वेन तेजसा
transliteration: sītām prāpsyati dharmātmā vadhiṣyati ca rāvaṇam
sahāya mātreṇa mayā rāghavaḥ svena tejasā
english: By virtue of native energy, and merely with my help, the righteous Rāghava shall recover Sītā and slay Rāvana to boot.

sanskrit: सहाय कृत्यम् किम् तस्य येन सप्त महाद्रुमाः
शैलः च वसुधा चैव बाणेन एकेन दारिताः
transliteration: sahāya kṛtyam kim tasya yena sapta mahādrumāḥ
śailaḥ ca vasudhā caiva bāṇena ekena dāritāḥ
english: What need of assistance to him who with a single shaft rived seven giant trees, a mountain, and the Earth.

sanskrit: स शैला कम्पिता भूमिः सहायैः किम् नु तस्य वै
transliteration: sa śailā kampitā bhūmiḥ sahāyaiḥ kim nu tasya vai
english: O Lakşmaņa, what is the use of help to him the sounds of whose stretching bow made the Earth tremble with her mountains?

sanskrit: अनुयात्राम् नर इन्द्रस्य करिष्ये अहम् नरषभ
गच्छतो रावणम् हन्तुम् वैरिणम् स पुरःसरम्
transliteration: anuyātrām nara indrasya kariṣye aham naraṣabha
gacchato rāvaṇam hantum vairiṇam sa puraḥsaram
english: O best of men, when that foremost of men shall set out for slaying his enemy, Rāvaņa along with those going before him, I will follow him.

sanskrit: यदि किंचित् अतिक्रान्तम् विश्वासात् प्रणयेन वा
प्रेष्यस्य क्षमितव्यम् मे न कश्चिन् न अपराध्यति
transliteration: yadi kiṃcit atikrāntam viśvāsāt praṇayena vā
preṣyasya kṣamitavyam me na kaścin na aparādhyati
english: I through my confidence, or presuming upon our amity. I have transgressed in any way, (Rāma) ought to excuse his servant,—for there is no servant that does not transgress.

sanskrit: अभवत् लक्ष्मणः प्रीतः प्रेम्णा च इदम् उवाच ह
transliteration: abhavat lakṣmaṇaḥ prītaḥ premṇā ca idam uvāca ha
english: When the high-souled Sugrīva had said this, Lakşmaņa became well pleased and he spoke from love,

sanskrit: सर्वथा हि मम भ्राता स नाथो वानरेश्वर
transliteration: sarvathā hi mama bhrātā sa nātho vānareśvara
english: Having in especial, you endued with humility, my brother, O monarch of monkeys, is every way strong, O Sugriva.

sanskrit: यः ते प्रभावः सुग्रीव यत् च ते शौचम् ईदृशम्
अर्हः तम् कपि राज्यस्य श्रियम् भोक्तुम् अनुत्तमाम्
transliteration: yaḥ te prabhāvaḥ sugrīva yat ca te śaucam īdṛśam
arhaḥ tam kapi rājyasya śriyam bhoktum anuttamām
english: Such is your strength, O Sugriva, and such your self-denial, that you are fully worthy to enjoy the good fortune of the king of monkeys.

sanskrit: सहायेन च सुग्रीव त्वया रामः प्रतापवान्
वधिष्यति रणे शत्रून् अचिरात् न अत्र संशयः
transliteration: sahāyena ca sugrīva tvayā rāmaḥ pratāpavān
vadhiṣyati raṇe śatrūn acirāt na atra saṃśayaḥ
english: O Sugrīva, by your help, the puissant Rāma shall speedily slay his foe. Of this there is not the least doubt.

sanskrit: उपपन्नम् च युक्तम् च सुग्रीव तव भाषितम्
transliteration: upapannam ca yuktam ca sugrīva tava bhāṣitam
english: O Sugrīva, what you virtuous, grateful and never turning away from fight, have said is fit and proper.

sanskrit: दोषज्ञः सति सामर्थ्ये को अन्यो भाषितुम् अर्हति
वर्जयित्वा मम ज्येष्ठम् त्वाम् च वानर सत्तम
transliteration: doṣajñaḥ sati sāmarthye ko anyo bhāṣitum arhati
varjayitvā mama jyeṣṭham tvām ca vānara sattama
english: What knowing person, excepting, O foremost of monkeys, yourself and my elder brother, can speak so.

sanskrit: सदृशः च असि रामस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च
सहायो दैवतैः दत्तः चिराय हरि पुंगव
transliteration: sadṛśaḥ ca asi rāmasya vikrameṇa balena ca
sahāyo daivataiḥ dattaḥ cirāya hari puṃgava
english: Resembling Rāma himself in strength and prowess, you, O chief of monkeys, have been ordained his help by the gods.

sanskrit: किम् तु शीघ्रम् इतो वीर निष्क्राम त्वम् मया सह
सान्त्वयस्व वयस्यम् च भार्या हरण दुःखितम्
transliteration: kim tu śīghram ito vīra niṣkrāma tvam mayā saha
sāntvayasva vayasyam ca bhāryā haraṇa duḥkhitam

sanskrit: यत् च शोक अभिभूतस्य श्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्
मया त्वम् परुषाणि उक्तः तत् क्षमस्व सखे मम
transliteration: yat ca śoka abhibhūtasya śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam
mayā tvam paruṣāṇi uktaḥ tat kṣamasva sakhe mama

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना
हनूमन्तम् स्थितम् पार्श्वे वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā
hanūmantam sthitam pārśve vacanam ca idam abravīt
english: Thus addressed by the magnanimous Lakşmana Sugrīva said to Hanumān, staying beside him,

sanskrit: महेन्द्र हिमवत् विंध्य कैलास शिखरेषु च
मन्दरे पाण्डु शिखरे पंच शैलेषु ये स्थिताः
transliteration: mahendra himavat viṃdhya kailāsa śikhareṣu ca
mandare pāṇḍu śikhare paṃca śaileṣu ye sthitāḥ

sanskrit: पर्वतेषु समुद्र अंते पश्चिमस्याम् तु ये दिशि
transliteration: parvateṣu samudra aṃte paścimasyām tu ye diśi

sanskrit: आदित्य भवने चैव गिरौ संध्या अभ्र संनिभे
पद्म ताल वनम् भीमाः संश्रिता हरि पुंगवाः
transliteration: āditya bhavane caiva girau saṃdhyā abhra saṃnibhe
padma tāla vanam bhīmāḥ saṃśritā hari puṃgavāḥ

sanskrit: अंजन अंबुद संकाशाः कुंजर प्रतिम ओजसः
अंजने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवंगमाः
transliteration: aṃjana aṃbuda saṃkāśāḥ kuṃjara pratima ojasaḥ
aṃjane parvate caiva ye vasanti plavaṃgamāḥ

sanskrit: महाशैल गुहा आवासा वानराः कनक प्रभाः
मेरु पार्श्व गताः चैव ये च धूम्र गिरिम् श्रिताः
transliteration: mahāśaila guhā āvāsā vānarāḥ kanaka prabhāḥ
meru pārśva gatāḥ caiva ye ca dhūmra girim śritāḥ

sanskrit: तरुण आदित्य वर्णाः च पर्वते ये महाअरुणे
पिबंतो मधु मैरेयम् भीम वेगाः प्लवंगमाः
transliteration: taruṇa āditya varṇāḥ ca parvate ye mahāaruṇe
pibaṃto madhu maireyam bhīma vegāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ

sanskrit: वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च
तापस आश्रम रम्येषु वन अन्तेषु समंततः
transliteration: vaneṣu ca suramyeṣu sugandhiṣu mahatsu ca
tāpasa āśrama ramyeṣu vana anteṣu samaṃtataḥ

sanskrit: तान् तान् त्वम् आनय क्षिप्रम् पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानरान्
साम दान आदिभिः कल्पैः वानरैः वेगवत्तरैः
transliteration: tān tān tvam ānaya kṣipram pṛthivyām sarva vānarān
sāma dāna ādibhiḥ kalpaiḥ vānaraiḥ vegavattaraiḥ

sanskrit: प्रेषिताः प्रथमम् ये च मया आज्ञाताः महाजवाः
त्वरण अर्थम् तु भूयः त्वम् संप्रेषय हरीश्वरान्
transliteration: preṣitāḥ prathamam ye ca mayā ājñātāḥ mahājavāḥ
tvaraṇa artham tu bhūyaḥ tvam saṃpreṣaya harīśvarān
english: I know those monkeys that I have first despatched, to be gifted with great velocity*, yet, for urging speed upon them, do you send other foremost of monkeys. *The commentator slips the sense here. According to him, the meaning is, Those monkeys whom I have first sent, are known to me.

sanskrit: ये प्रसक्ताः च कामेषु दीर्घ सूत्राः च वानराः
इह आनयस्व तान् शीघ्रम् सर्वान् एव कपीश्वरान्
transliteration: ye prasaktāḥ ca kāmeṣu dīrgha sūtrāḥ ca vānarāḥ
iha ānayasva tān śīghram sarvān eva kapīśvarān
english: Do you directly bring up here those monkeychiefs that are given up to lust or are dilatory.

sanskrit: अहोभिः दशभिः ये च न आगच्छन्ति मम आज्ञया
हन्तव्याः ते दुरात्मानो राज शासन दूषकाः
transliteration: ahobhiḥ daśabhiḥ ye ca na āgacchanti mama ājñayā
hantavyāḥ te durātmāno rāja śāsana dūṣakāḥ
english: Those wicked ones, that finding fault with the royal mandate, do not (come in) at my command within ten days, must be slain.

sanskrit: शतानि अथ सहस्राणि कोट्यः च मम शासनात्
प्रयान्तु कपि सिंहानाम् निदिशे मम ये स्थिताः
transliteration: śatāni atha sahasrāṇi koṭyaḥ ca mama śāsanāt
prayāntu kapi siṃhānām nidiśe mama ye sthitāḥ
english: Let those hundreds and thousands and kotis of leonine monkeys that abide by my mandate, hie (hence) at my behest.

sanskrit: मेघ पर्वत संकाशाः छादयन्त इव अंबरम्
घोर रूपाः कपि श्रेष्ठा यान्तु मत् शासनात् इतः
transliteration: megha parvata saṃkāśāḥ chādayanta iva aṃbaram
ghora rūpāḥ kapi śreṣṭhā yāntu mat śāsanāt itaḥ
english: Let (monkey) resembling clouds or mountains, cover up the sky; and let the foremost monkeys of dreadful forms march hence at my command.

sanskrit: ते गतिज्ञा गतिम् गत्वा पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानराः
आनयंतु हरीन् सर्वान् त्वरिताः शासनान् मम
transliteration: te gatijñā gatim gatvā pṛthivyām sarva vānarāḥ
ānayaṃtu harīn sarvān tvaritāḥ śāsanān mama
english: Let all the monkeys on earth, acquainted with motion lying themselves and summoning speed at my command, bring all the monkeys.

sanskrit: तस्य वानर राजस्य श्रुत्वा वायु सुतो वचः
transliteration: tasya vānara rājasya śrutvā vāyu suto vacaḥ
english: Hearing the words of the monkey-king, the son of the Wind-god despatched powerful monkeys in all directions.

sanskrit: ते पदम् विष्णु विक्रान्तम् पतत्रि ज्योतिः अध्वगाः
प्रयाताः प्रहिता राज्ञा हरयः तु क्षणेन वै
transliteration: te padam viṣṇu vikrāntam patatri jyotiḥ adhvagāḥ
prayātāḥ prahitā rājñā harayaḥ tu kṣaṇena vai
english: Despatched by the king, the monkeys, ranging the sphere of birds and stars, immediately went through the welkin.

sanskrit: ते समुद्रेषु गिरिषु वनेषु च सरःसु च
वानरा वानरान् सर्वान् राम हेतोः अचोदयन्
transliteration: te samudreṣu giriṣu vaneṣu ca saraḥsu ca
vānarā vānarān sarvān rāma hetoḥ acodayan
english: And on oceans and mountains, in forests and tanks, the monkeys began to send away all the apes on behalf of Rāma.

sanskrit: मृत्यु काल उपमस्य आज्ञाम् राज राजस्य वानराः
सुग्रीवस्य आययुः श्रुत्वा सुग्रीव भय शन्किताः
transliteration: mṛtyu kāla upamasya ājñām rāja rājasya vānarāḥ
sugrīvasya āyayuḥ śrutvā sugrīva bhaya śankitāḥ
english: Hearing the mandate of that king of kings, Sugriva, resembling the Hour of death, the monkeys, conceiving fear for Sugrīva, set out.

sanskrit: ततः ते अंजन संकाशा गिरेः तस्मात् महाजवाः
तिस्रः कोट्यः प्लवंगानाम् निर्ययुर् यत्र राघवः
transliteration: tataḥ te aṃjana saṃkāśā gireḥ tasmāt mahājavāḥ
tisraḥ koṭyaḥ plavaṃgānām niryayur yatra rāghavaḥ
english: And monkeys resembling collyrium (in hue), numbering three kotis, endued with huge might, set out from the Añjana hill for the place where Rāghava was.

sanskrit: अस्तम् गच्छति यत्र अर्कः तस्मिन् गिरिवरे रताः
संतप्त हेम वर्ण आभा तस्मात् कोट्यो दश च्युताः
transliteration: astam gacchati yatra arkaḥ tasmin girivare ratāḥ
saṃtapta hema varṇa ābhā tasmāt koṭyo daśa cyutāḥ
english: And ten koțis having the splendour of molten gold inhabiting the mountain where the sun sets, set out.

sanskrit: कैलास शिखरेभ्यः च सिंह केसर वर्चसाम्
transliteration: kailāsa śikharebhyaḥ ca siṃha kesara varcasām
english: And a thousand kotis, hued like the lion's mane, came from the peaks of Kailāsa.
And of those dwelling in Himālaya, subsisting on fruits and roots, numbering a thousand and kotis, a thousand appeared.

sanskrit: विंध्यात् वानर कोटीनाम् सहस्राणि अपतन् द्रुतम्
transliteration: viṃdhyāt vānara koṭīnām sahasrāṇi apatan drutam
english: And thousands of dreadful monkeys of terrible deeds, hued like charcoal, numbering kot is, rushed suddenly from Vindhya.

sanskrit: क्षीर उद वेला निलयाः तमाल वन वासिनः
नारि केल अशनाः चैव तेषाम् संख्या न विद्यते
transliteration: kṣīra uda velā nilayāḥ tamāla vana vāsinaḥ
nāri kela aśanāḥ caiva teṣām saṃkhyā na vidyate
english: And there exists no record of the number of those inhabiting the shores of the ocean of milk, and the dwellers in the Tamāla forests, as well as those subsisting on coconuts.

sanskrit: वनेभ्यो गह्वरेभ्यः च सरित्भ्यः च महाबलाः
आगच्छत् वानरी सेना पिबन्ति इव दिवा करम्
transliteration: vanebhyo gahvarebhyaḥ ca saritbhyaḥ ca mahābalāḥ
āgacchat vānarī senā pibanti iva divā karam
english: And, as if drinking up the sun, the mighty monkey host came from forests and caves and rivers.

sanskrit: ये तु त्वरयितुम् याता वानराः सर्व वानरान्
ते वीरा हिमवत् शैले ददृशुः तम् महाद्रुमम्
transliteration: ye tu tvarayitum yātā vānarāḥ sarva vānarān
te vīrā himavat śaile dadṛśuḥ tam mahādrumam
english: And it came to pass that those heroic monkeys that had gone away to spur others on, found a mighty tree on Himayat.

sanskrit: तस्मिन् गिरि वरे पुण्ये यज्ञो माहेश्वरः पुरा
सर्व देव मनः तोषो बभूव सु मनोरमः
transliteration: tasmin giri vare puṇye yajño māheśvaraḥ purā
sarva deva manaḥ toṣo babhūva su manoramaḥ
english: On that sacred mount in days of yore there took place a pleasing Maheswara* sacrifice. *The celestial horse-sacrifice.

sanskrit: अन्न निस्यंद जातानि मूलानि च फलानि च
अमृत स्वादु कल्पानि ददृशुः तत्र वानराः
transliteration: anna nisyaṃda jātāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca
amṛta svādu kalpāni dadṛśuḥ tatra vānarāḥ
english: There the monkeys found grateful fruits and roots sprung from the streams of sacrificial oblations, and resembling ambrosia.

sanskrit: तत् अन्न संभवम् दिव्यम् फलम् मूलम् मनोहरम्
यः कश्चित् सकृत् अश्नाति मासम् भवति तर्पितः
transliteration: tat anna saṃbhavam divyam phalam mūlam manoharam
yaḥ kaścit sakṛt aśnāti māsam bhavati tarpitaḥ
english: He that partakes of those excellent fruits and roots sprung from the sacrificial ingredients, does not experience hunger for a month.

sanskrit: तानि मूलानि दिव्यानि फलानि च फल अशनाः
औषधानि च दिव्यानि जगृहुर् हरि पुंगवाः
transliteration: tāni mūlāni divyāni phalāni ca phala aśanāḥ
auṣadhāni ca divyāni jagṛhur hari puṃgavāḥ
english: Those prime monkeys, feeding on fruits, gathered those sapid fruits and roots and medicinal herbs.

sanskrit: तस्मात् च यज्ञ आयतनात् पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च
आनिन्युर् वानरा गत्वा सुग्रीव प्रिय कारणात्
transliteration: tasmāt ca yajña āyatanāt puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca
āninyur vānarā gatvā sugrīva priya kāraṇāt
english: And for compassing the good of Sugrīva, repairing thither, the monkeys brought ordorous blossoms from the sacrificial ground.

sanskrit: ते तु सर्वे हरिवराः पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानरान्
transliteration: te tu sarve harivarāḥ pṛthivyām sarva vānarān
english: And all those foremost of monkeys, taking all the monkeys of the earth, hastily set off in the van of the herds.

sanskrit: ते तु तेन मुहूर्तेन कपयः शीघ्र चारिणः
किष्किंधाम् त्वरया प्राप्ताः सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः
transliteration: te tu tena muhūrtena kapayaḥ śīghra cāriṇaḥ
kiṣkiṃdhām tvarayā prāptāḥ sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ
english: And in a short while, those fast-fleeting apes speedily reached Kişkindhā, where the monkey Sugriva was.

sanskrit: ते गृहीत्वा ओषधीः सर्वाः फल मूलम् च वानराः
तम् प्रतिग्राहयामासुर् वचनम् च इदम् अब्रुवन्
transliteration: te gṛhītvā oṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ phala mūlam ca vānarāḥ
tam pratigrāhayāmāsur vacanam ca idam abruvan
english: And taking the healing herbs and the fruits and roots, the monkeys made them over to Sugrīva, and said,

sanskrit: सर्वे परिसृताः शैलाः सरितः च वनानि च
पृथिव्याम् वानराः सर्वे शासनात् उपयान्ति ते
transliteration: sarve parisṛtāḥ śailāḥ saritaḥ ca vanāni ca
pṛthivyām vānarāḥ sarve śāsanāt upayānti te
english: Having traversed mountains, rivers and forests, all the monkeys of the earth bend their steps towards you in obedience to your command.

sanskrit: एवम् श्रुत्वा ततो हृष्टः सुग्रीवः प्लवग अधिपः
प्रतिजग्राह च प्रीतः तेषाम् सर्वम् उपायनम्
transliteration: evam śrutvā tato hṛṣṭaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavaga adhipaḥ
pratijagrāha ca prītaḥ teṣām sarvam upāyanam
english: Hearing this, Sugriva-lord of monkeys-was well pleased, and with a glad heart accepted all those present.

sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च तत् सर्वम् उपानयम् उपाहृतम्
वानरान् सान्त्वयित्वा च सर्वान् एव व्यसर्जयत्
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tat sarvam upānayam upāhṛtam
vānarān sāntvayitvā ca sarvān eva vyasarjayat
english: Having accepted all those presents, (Sugrīva), after soothing the monkeys, dismissed them.

sanskrit: विसर्जयित्वा स हरीन् सहस्रान् तान् कृत कर्मणः
मेने कृतार्थम् आत्मानम् राघवम् च महाबलम्
transliteration: visarjayitvā sa harīn sahasrān tān kṛta karmaṇaḥ
mene kṛtārtham ātmānam rāghavam ca mahābalam
english: Having dismissed the thousands of apes, who had performed their task, he deemed himself as well as the mighty Rāghava as having secured success.

sanskrit: स लक्ष्मणो भीम बलम् सर्व वानर सत्तमम्
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇo bhīma balam sarva vānara sattamam
english: Then Lakşmaņa in sweet words spoke to the exceedingly strong chief of monkeysSugriva-gladdening him,

sanskrit: किष्किंधाया विनिष्क्राम यदि ते सौम्य रोचते
तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य सुभाषितम्
transliteration: kiṣkiṃdhāyā viniṣkrāma yadi te saumya rocate
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya subhāṣitam
english: If it please you, O placid one, I will go out of Kiskindhā. Hearing Laksmana's soft speech, Sugriva, highly delighted, said,

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतो वाक्यम् एतत् उवाच ह
एवम् भवतु गच्छामः स्थेयम् त्वत् शासने मया
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ parama prīto vākyam etat uvāca ha
evam bhavatu gacchāmaḥ stheyam tvat śāsane mayā

sanskrit: तम् एवम् उक्त्वा सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणम् शुभ लक्षणम्
विसर्जयामास तदा तारा अद्याः च एव योषितः
transliteration: tam evam uktvā sugrīvo lakṣmaṇam śubha lakṣaṇam
visarjayāmāsa tadā tārā adyāḥ ca eva yoṣitaḥ
english: Be it so. Let us go. I abide by your behest. Having said this to Lakşmaņa of auspicious marks, Sugrīva dismissed the women with Tārā at their head.

sanskrit: एहि इति उच्छैः हरि वरान् सुग्रीवः समुदाहरत्
तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरयः शीघ्रम् आययुः
transliteration: ehi iti ucchaiḥ hari varān sugrīvaḥ samudāharat
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā harayaḥ śīghram āyayuḥ
english: Then Sugrīva in a loud voice summoned the foremost monkey, saying, Come (hither). hearing his words, those monkeys that could present themselves before the females, did so with joined hands.

sanskrit: बद्ध अंजलि पुटाः सर्वे ये स्युः स्त्री दर्शन क्षमाः
तान् उवाच ततः प्राप्तान् राजा अर्क सदृश प्रभः
transliteration: baddha aṃjali puṭāḥ sarve ye syuḥ strī darśana kṣamāḥ
tān uvāca tataḥ prāptān rājā arka sadṛśa prabhaḥ

sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु वचनम् तस्य हरयः शीघ्र विक्रमाः
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanam tasya harayaḥ śīghra vikramāḥ

sanskrit: लक्ष्मण आरुह्यताम् शीघ्रम् इति सौमित्रिम् अब्रवीत्
इति उक्त्वा कांचनम् यानम् सुग्रीवः सूर्य सन्निभम्
transliteration: lakṣmaṇa āruhyatām śīghram iti saumitrim abravīt
iti uktvā kāṃcanam yānam sugrīvaḥ sūrya sannibham

sanskrit: बहुभिः हरिभिः युक्तम् आरुरोह स लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: bahubhiḥ haribhiḥ yuktam āruroha sa lakṣmaṇaḥ

sanskrit: शुक्लैः च वाल व्यजनैः धूयमानैः समंततः
शंख भेरी निनादैः च वन्दिभिः च अभिवन्दितः
transliteration: śuklaiḥ ca vāla vyajanaiḥ dhūyamānaiḥ samaṃtataḥ
śaṃkha bherī ninādaiḥ ca vandibhiḥ ca abhivanditaḥ
english: With a pale umbrella held over his head, and white chowris waving around, with conchs and trumpets blowing, eulogized by bards, Sugrīva marched out, having obtained supreme regal auspiciousness.

sanskrit: निर्ययौ प्राप्य सुग्रीवो राज्य श्रियम् अनुत्तमाम्
स वानर शतैः तीष्क्णैः बहुभिः शस्त्र पाणिभिः
transliteration: niryayau prāpya sugrīvo rājya śriyam anuttamām
sa vānara śataiḥ tīṣkṇaiḥ bahubhiḥ śastra pāṇibhiḥ
english: And surrounded by hundreds of high-spirited apes and armed people, he proceeded whither Rāma was staying.

sanskrit: परिकीर्णो ययौ तत्र यत्र रामो व्यवस्थितः
स तम् देशम् अनुप्राप्य श्रेष्ठम् राम निषेवितम्
transliteration: parikīrṇo yayau tatra yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ
sa tam deśam anuprāpya śreṣṭham rāma niṣevitam
english: And having arrived at the excellent spot which was the home of Rāma, that highly energetic one alighted from the car along with Lakşmaņa. And having come to Rāma, Sugrīva (stood) folding his hands.

sanskrit: आसाद्य च ततो रामम् कृत अंजलि पुटो अभवत्
transliteration: āsādya ca tato rāmam kṛta aṃjali puṭo abhavat
english: And having arrived at the excellent spot which was the home of Rāma, that highly energetic one alighted from the car along with Lakşmaņa. And having come to Rāma, Sugrīva (stood) folding his hands.

sanskrit: कृत अंजलौ स्थिते तस्मिन् वानराः च अभवन् तथा
तटाकम् इव तम् दृष्ट्वा रामः कुड्मल पंकजम्
transliteration: kṛta aṃjalau sthite tasmin vānarāḥ ca abhavan tathā
taṭākam iva tam dṛṣṭvā rāmaḥ kuḍmala paṃkajam
english: And when Sugrīva has folded his hands, the monkeys also did so. And beholding the mighty host of the monkeys resembling a tank filled with lotus buds, Rāma was well-pleased with Sugriva.

sanskrit: वानराणाम् महत् सैन्यम् सुग्रीवे प्रीतिमान् अभूत्
पादयोः पतितम् मूर्ध्ना तम् उत्थाप्य हरीश्वरम्
transliteration: vānarāṇām mahat sainyam sugrīve prītimān abhūt
pādayoḥ patitam mūrdhnā tam utthāpya harīśvaram

sanskrit: प्रेम्णा च बहुमानात् च राघवः परिषस्वजे
परिष्वज्य च धर्मात्मा निषीद इति ततो अब्रवीत्
transliteration: premṇā ca bahumānāt ca rāghavaḥ pariṣasvaje
pariṣvajya ca dharmātmā niṣīda iti tato abravīt

sanskrit: निषण्णम् तम् ततो दृष्ट्वा क्षितौ रामो अब्रवीत् ततः
धर्मम् अर्थम् च कामम् च काले यः तु निषेवते
transliteration: niṣaṇṇam tam tato dṛṣṭvā kṣitau rāmo abravīt tataḥ
dharmam artham ca kāmam ca kāle yaḥ tu niṣevate

sanskrit: विभज्य सततम् वीर स राजा हरिसत्तम
हित्वा धर्मम् तथा अर्थम् च कामम् यः तु निषेवते
transliteration: vibhajya satatam vīra sa rājā harisattama
hitvā dharmam tathā artham ca kāmam yaḥ tu niṣevate
english: He, O best of monkeys, is a king who, O hero, in season follows righteousness, pleasure and profit, always dividing the same (among all). He that, renouncing righteousness and the good, devotes himself to pleasure solely, is like a man that falling asleep on the top of a tree, wakes when he has fallen down.

sanskrit: स वृक्ष अग्रे यथा सुप्तः पतितः प्रतिबुध्यते
अमित्राणाम् वधे युक्तो मित्राणाम् संग्रहे रतः
transliteration: sa vṛkṣa agre yathā suptaḥ patitaḥ pratibudhyate
amitrāṇām vadhe yukto mitrāṇām saṃgrahe rataḥ

sanskrit: त्रिवर्ग फल भोक्ता च राजा धर्मेण युज्यते
उद्योग समयः तु एष प्राप्तः शत्रु निषूदन
transliteration: trivarga phala bhoktā ca rājā dharmeṇa yujyate
udyoga samayaḥ tu eṣa prāptaḥ śatru niṣūdana

sanskrit: संचिंत्यताम् हि पिंगेश हरिभिः सह मंत्रिभिः
एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवो रामम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: saṃciṃtyatām hi piṃgeśa haribhiḥ saha maṃtribhiḥ
evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvo rāmam vacanam abravīt

sanskrit: प्रनष्टा श्रीः च कीर्तिः च कपि राज्यम् च शाश्वतम्
त्वत् प्रसादात् महाबाहो पुनः प्राप्तम् इदम् मया
transliteration: pranaṣṭā śrīḥ ca kīrtiḥ ca kapi rājyam ca śāśvatam
tvat prasādāt mahābāho punaḥ prāptam idam mayā
english: Thus addressed, Sugrīva said to Räma, O mighty-armed one, my lost luck, and repute, and the entire monkey kingdom I have received back through your gift, owing to thine and your brother's grace, you foremost of victors.

sanskrit: तव देव प्रसदात् च भ्रातुः च जयताम् वर
कृतम् न प्रतिकुर्यात् यः पुरुषाणाम् स दूषकः
transliteration: tava deva prasadāt ca bhrātuḥ ca jayatām vara
kṛtam na pratikuryāt yaḥ puruṣāṇām sa dūṣakaḥ
english: He that, having received a good office, does not requite it, reapeth obloquy among persons.

sanskrit: एते वानर मुख्याः च शतशः शत्रु सूदन
प्राप्ताः च आदाय बलिनः पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानरान्
transliteration: ete vānara mukhyāḥ ca śataśaḥ śatru sūdana
prāptāḥ ca ādāya balinaḥ pṛthivyām sarva vānarān
english: These hundreds of prime monkeys, O destroyer of enemies, have come here, bringing with them all the monkeys of the world.

sanskrit: ऋक्षाः च वानराः शूरा गोलांगूलाः च राघव
कांतार वन दुर्गाणाम् अभिज्ञा घोर दर्शनाः
transliteration: ṛkṣāḥ ca vānarāḥ śūrā golāṃgūlāḥ ca rāghava
kāṃtāra vana durgāṇām abhijñā ghora darśanāḥ

sanskrit: देव गन्धर्व पुत्राः च वानराः काम रूपिणः
स्वैः स्वैः परिवृताः सैन्यैः वर्तन्ते पथि राघव
transliteration: deva gandharva putrāḥ ca vānarāḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ
svaiḥ svaiḥ parivṛtāḥ sainyaiḥ vartante pathi rāghava

sanskrit: शतैः शत सहस्रैः च कोटिभिः च प्लवंगमाः
अयुतैः च आवृता वीरा शंकुभिः च परंतप
transliteration: śataiḥ śata sahasraiḥ ca koṭibhiḥ ca plavaṃgamāḥ
ayutaiḥ ca āvṛtā vīrā śaṃkubhiḥ ca paraṃtapa

sanskrit: अर्बुदैः अर्बुद शतैः मध्यैः च अन्तैः च वानराः
समुद्राः च परार्धाः च हरयो हरि यूथपाः
transliteration: arbudaiḥ arbuda śataiḥ madhyaiḥ ca antaiḥ ca vānarāḥ
samudrāḥ ca parārdhāḥ ca harayo hari yūthapāḥ

sanskrit: आगमिष्यन्ति ते राजन् महेन्द्र सम विक्रमाः
मेघ पर्वत संकाशा मेरु विन्ध्य कृत आलयाः
transliteration: āgamiṣyanti te rājan mahendra sama vikramāḥ
megha parvata saṃkāśā meru vindhya kṛta ālayāḥ

sanskrit: ते त्वाम् अभिगमिष्यन्ति राक्षसम् योद्धुम् आहवे
निहत्य रावणम् युद्धे हि आनयिष्यन्ति मैथिलीम्
transliteration: te tvām abhigamiṣyanti rākṣasam yoddhum āhave
nihatya rāvaṇam yuddhe hi ānayiṣyanti maithilīm
english: They will join you for battling the fiend in the field; and, slaying Ravana in fight, shall bring Mithilā's daughter.

sanskrit: ततः समुद्योगम् अवेक्ष्य वीर्यवान्हरि प्रवीरस्य निदेश वर्तिनः
बभूव हर्षात् वसुधा अधिप आत्मजःप्रबुद्ध नील उत्पल तुल्य दर्शनः
transliteration: tataḥ samudyogam avekṣya vīryavānhari pravīrasya nideśa vartinaḥ
babhūva harṣāt vasudhā adhipa ātmajaḥprabuddha nīla utpala tulya darśanaḥ
english: Thereat the puissant son of the Earth's lord, witnessing the preparations made by the heroic monkey, remaining under his his command, appeared like a blown blue lotus.

sanskrit: इति ब्रुवाणम् सुग्रीवम् रामो धर्मभृताम् वरः
transliteration: iti bruvāṇam sugrīvam rāmo dharmabhṛtām varaḥ
english: As Sugrīva was speaking thus with joined hands, that best of the righteous, Rāma, embraced him with his arms, and then replied,

sanskrit: यत् इन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षम् न तत् चित्रम् भविष्यति
आदित्यो असौ सहस्रांशुः कुर्यात् वितिमिरम् नभः
transliteration: yat indro varṣate varṣam na tat citram bhaviṣyati
ādityo asau sahasrāṃśuḥ kuryāt vitimiram nabhaḥ
english: That Indra poureth down showers, is no wonder, nor that this thousand-rayed Sun dispels darkness from the sky; nor yet that, O mild one, the Moon by his rays causes the clear night. (And in a similar way), friends like you bring delight, O subduer of foes. O mild one, that 'whatever is graceful, should be harboured in you is not strange.* *The commentator in his usual way of reading between the lines, says that the sense is—That you had gathered forces for serving your friend, is not strange. O placid one, it is well. I give the sense the śloka naturally yields.

sanskrit: चन्द्रमा रजनीम् कुर्यात् प्रभया सौम्य निर्मलाम्
त्वत् विधो वा अपि मित्राणाम् प्रीतिम् कुर्यात् परंतप
transliteration: candramā rajanīm kuryāt prabhayā saumya nirmalām
tvat vidho vā api mitrāṇām prītim kuryāt paraṃtapa
english: That Indra poureth down showers, is no wonder, nor that this thousand-rayed Sun dispels darkness from the sky; nor yet that, O mild one, the Moon by his rays causes the clear night. (And in a similar way), friends like you bring delight, O subduer of foes. O mild one, that 'whatever is graceful, should be harboured in you is not strange.* *The commentator in his usual way of reading between the lines, says that the sense is—That you had gathered forces for serving your friend, is not strange. O placid one, it is well. I give the sense the śloka naturally yields.

sanskrit: एवम् त्वयि तत् न चित्रम् भवेत् यत् सौम्य शोभनम्
जानामि अहम् त्वाम् सुग्रीव सततम् प्रिय वादिनम्
transliteration: evam tvayi tat na citram bhavet yat saumya śobhanam
jānāmi aham tvām sugrīva satatam priya vādinam
english: I know, O Sugrīva, that you always speakst what is for my good.

sanskrit: त्वत् स नाथः सखे संख्ये जेता अस्मि सकलान् अरीन्
त्वम् एव मे सुहृत् मित्रम् साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: tvat sa nāthaḥ sakhe saṃkhye jetā asmi sakalān arīn
tvam eva me suhṛt mitram sāhāyyam kartum arhasi
english: Assisted by you, my friend, I shall in battle vanquish all my foes. You being my friend and my ally, should assist me.

sanskrit: जहार आत्म विनाशाय वैदेहीम् राक्षस अधमः
वंचयित्वा तु पौलोमीम् अनुह्लादो यथा शचीम्
transliteration: jahāra ātma vināśāya vaidehīm rākṣasa adhamaḥ
vaṃcayitvā tu paulomīm anuhlādo yathā śacīm
english: That worst of Rākșasas has carried away Maithilī, to bring down destruction upon himself, even as Anuhlāda ravished Puloma's daughter, Sachi, deceiving her sire.

sanskrit: न चिरात् तम् हनिष्यामि रावणम् निशितैः शरैः
पौलोम्याः पितरम् दृप्तम् शत क्रतुः इव अरिहा
transliteration: na cirāt tam haniṣyāmi rāvaṇam niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
paulomyāḥ pitaram dṛptam śata kratuḥ iva arihā
english: That Rāvana I will at no distant date slay with my sharpened shafts, even as that slayer of enemies, he of an hundred sacrifices-slew the haughty father of Paulomi.

sanskrit: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे च एव रजः समभिवर्तत
उष्णाम् तीव्राम् सहस्रांशोः छादयत् गगने प्रभाम्
transliteration: etasmin antare ca eva rajaḥ samabhivartata
uṣṇām tīvrām sahasrāṃśoḥ chādayat gagane prabhām
english: Presently appeared volumes of dust, and the hot and fierce rays of the sun were hid in the sky.

sanskrit: दिशः पर्याकुलाः च आसन् तमसा तेन दूषिताः
चचाल च मही सर्वा स शैल वन कानना
transliteration: diśaḥ paryākulāḥ ca āsan tamasā tena dūṣitāḥ
cacāla ca mahī sarvā sa śaila vana kānanā
english: And darkened by the gloom, all sides became bewildered. And the entire earth with her mountains, forests, and wocds, trembled.

sanskrit: ततो नगेन्द्र संकाशैः तीक्ष्ण दन्ष्ट्रैः महाबलैः
transliteration: tato nagendra saṃkāśaiḥ tīkṣṇa danṣṭraiḥ mahābalaiḥ
english: Then the whole ground was covered with innumerable monkeys gifted with great strength, and having sharp teeth, and resembling kings of men.

sanskrit: निमेष अंतर मात्रेण ततः तैः हरि यूथपैः
transliteration: nimeṣa aṃtara mātreṇa tataḥ taiḥ hari yūthapaiḥ

sanskrit: नादेयैः पार्वतेयैः च सामुद्रैः च महाबलैः
हरिभिः मेघ निर्ह्रादैः अन्यैः च वन वासिभिः
transliteration: nādeyaiḥ pārvateyaiḥ ca sāmudraiḥ ca mahābalaiḥ
haribhiḥ megha nirhrādaiḥ anyaiḥ ca vana vāsibhiḥ

sanskrit: तरुण आदित्य वर्णैः च शशि गौरैः च वानरैः
पद्म केसर वर्णैः च श्वेतैः मेरु कृत आलयैः
transliteration: taruṇa āditya varṇaiḥ ca śaśi gauraiḥ ca vānaraiḥ
padma kesara varṇaiḥ ca śvetaiḥ meru kṛta ālayaiḥ

sanskrit: कोटी सहस्रैः दशभिः श्रीमान् परिवृतः तदा
transliteration: koṭī sahasraiḥ daśabhiḥ śrīmān parivṛtaḥ tadā

sanskrit: ततः कांचन शैल आभः ताराया वीर्यवान् पिता
transliteration: tataḥ kāṃcana śaila ābhaḥ tārāyā vīryavān pitā
english: Then, having the splendour of the Golden hill, the puissant sire of Tārā was seen at the head of many thousand kotis.

sanskrit: पिता रुमयाः संप्राप्तः सुग्रीव श्वशुरो विभुः
transliteration: pitā rumayāḥ saṃprāptaḥ sugrīva śvaśuro vibhuḥ
english: Then Umā's father, that lord, the father-in-law of Sugrīva, arrived, accompanied with other thousands of kotis (of monkeys),... resembling the filaments of the lotus, of face like to the youthful sun, intelligent, the foremost of monkeys-supreme among them all.

sanskrit: पद्म केसर संकाशः तरुण अर्क निभ आननः
बुद्धिमान् वानर श्रेष्ठः सर्व वानर सत्तमः
transliteration: padma kesara saṃkāśaḥ taruṇa arka nibha ānanaḥ
buddhimān vānara śreṣṭhaḥ sarva vānara sattamaḥ
english: And Hanuman's father, the graceful Kasarī, appeared in company with many thousands of monkeys.
And Hanuman's father, the graceful Kasarī, appeared in company with many thousands of monkeys.

sanskrit: गो लांगूल महाराजो गवाक्षो भीम विक्रमः
transliteration: go lāṃgūla mahārājo gavākṣo bhīma vikramaḥ
english: And Gavaksa-sovereign of Golangulas-endowed with dreadful might, appeared, surrounded by thousand koțis of monkeys.

sanskrit: ऋक्षाणाम् भीम वेगानाम् धूम्रः शत्रु निबर्हणः
transliteration: ṛkṣāṇām bhīma vegānām dhūmraḥ śatru nibarhaṇaḥ
english: And Dhūmra of bears endowed with terrific speed—destroyer of foes—appeared, surrounded by two thousand kotis.

sanskrit: महा अचल निभैः घोरैः पनसो नाम यूथपः
transliteration: mahā acala nibhaiḥ ghoraiḥ panaso nāma yūthapaḥ
english: And the leader of herds, named Panasa, of exceeding prowess, came, accompanied with three kotis, mighty and dreadful.

sanskrit: नील अंजन चय आकारो नीलो नाम अथ यूथपः
transliteration: nīla aṃjana caya ākāro nīlo nāma atha yūthapaḥ
english: And the leader of herds, named Nīla, of huge body, resembling a mass of blue collyrium. appeared with ten kotis.

sanskrit: ततः कांचन आभो गवयो नाम यूथपः
transliteration: tataḥ kāṃcana ābho gavayo nāma yūthapaḥ
english: Then the exceedingly powerful Gavayaleader of herds, having the splendour of the Golden mountain, arrived with five koțis.

sanskrit: दरीमुखः च बलवान् यूथपो अभ्याययौ तदा
transliteration: darīmukhaḥ ca balavān yūthapo abhyāyayau tadā
english: And that powerful leader of herdsDarimukha, came, sutrounded by thousands of kotis, and took up his post by Sugriva.

sanskrit: मैन्दः च द्विविदः च उभौ अश्वि पुत्रौ महाबलौ
transliteration: maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ ca ubhau aśvi putrau mahābalau
english: And Mainda and Dvivida-sons of Asvi both-of mighty strength, appeared with kotis upon thousands of koțis of monkeys.

sanskrit: गजः च बलवान् वीरः त्रिसृभिः कोटिभिः वृतः
transliteration: gajaḥ ca balavān vīraḥ trisṛbhiḥ koṭibhiḥ vṛtaḥ
english: And the powerful and heroic Gaja (came), surrounded by three kotis. And the king of bears, Jāmbavān by name, (came), surrounded by ten koțis, and enlisted himself under the command of Sugriva.

sanskrit: ऋक्ष राजो महातेजा जांबवान् नाम नामतः
कोटिभिः दशभिः व्याप्तः सुग्रीवस्य वशे स्थितः
transliteration: ṛkṣa rājo mahātejā jāṃbavān nāma nāmataḥ
koṭibhiḥ daśabhiḥ vyāptaḥ sugrīvasya vaśe sthitaḥ
english: And the powerful and heroic Gaja (came), surrounded by three kotis. And the king of bears, Jāmbavān by name, (came), surrounded by ten koțis, and enlisted himself under the command of Sugriva.

sanskrit: रुमणो नाम तेजस्वी विक्रान्तैः वानरैः वृतः
आगतो बलवान् तूर्णम् कोटि शत समावृतः
transliteration: rumaṇo nāma tejasvī vikrāntaiḥ vānaraiḥ vṛtaḥ
āgato balavān tūrṇam koṭi śata samāvṛtaḥ
english: And (the monkey) named Rumna, possessed of energy, and strong, came swiftly, surrounded by an hundred koțis of powerful monkeys.

sanskrit: ततः कोटि सहस्राणाम् सहस्रेण शतेन च
transliteration: tataḥ koṭi sahasrāṇām sahasreṇa śatena ca
english: Then, followed at his back by hundreds and thousands of koțis, came the monkey, Gandhamādana.

sanskrit: ततः पद्म सहस्रेण वृतः शन्कु शतेन च
युव राजो अंगदः प्राप्तः पितृ तुल्य पराक्रमः
transliteration: tataḥ padma sahasreṇa vṛtaḥ śanku śatena ca
yuva rājo aṃgadaḥ prāptaḥ pitṛ tulya parākramaḥ
english: Then came the young prince Angada, in prowess resembling his sire, accompanied by a thousand padmas and an hundred sankhas.

sanskrit: ततः तारा द्युतिः तारो हरिः भीम पराक्रमः
transliteration: tataḥ tārā dyutiḥ tāro hariḥ bhīma parākramaḥ
english: Then appeared at a distance, accompanied by five koțis of monkeys endowed with dreadful prowess,-Tārā, having the splendour of a star.

sanskrit: एकादशानाम् कोटीनाम् ईश्वरः तैः च सम्वृतः
transliteration: ekādaśānām koṭīnām īśvaraḥ taiḥ ca samvṛtaḥ
english: And then appeared Indrajāni, the heroic monkey and leader of herds-lord of eleven kotis-surrounded by them.

sanskrit: ततो रंभः तु अनुप्राप्तः तरुण आदित्य संनिभः
आयुतेन वृतः चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च
transliteration: tato raṃbhaḥ tu anuprāptaḥ taruṇa āditya saṃnibhaḥ
āyutena vṛtaḥ caiva sahasreṇa śatena ca
english: Then followed Rambha, resembling the infant sun, accompanied by an ayuta, a thousand, and an hundred.

sanskrit: ततो यूथ पतिः वीरो दुर्मुखो नाम वानरः
transliteration: tato yūtha patiḥ vīro durmukho nāma vānaraḥ
english: Then appeared to the view the stout monkey, named Durmukha, heroic lord of herds, surrounded by two koțis.

sanskrit: कैलास शिखर आकारैः वानरैः भीम विक्रमैः
transliteration: kailāsa śikhara ākāraiḥ vānaraiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ
english: And Hanumān showed himself, surrounded by a thousand koțis of monkeys, resembling peaks of Kailāsa, of dreadful vigour.

sanskrit: नलः च अपि महावीर्यः संवृतो द्रुम वासिभिः
कोटी शतेन संप्राप्तः सहस्रेण शतेन च
transliteration: nalaḥ ca api mahāvīryaḥ saṃvṛto druma vāsibhiḥ
koṭī śatena saṃprāptaḥ sahasreṇa śatena ca
english: And the exceedingly energetic Nala came, attended with an hundred kotis, a thousand, and an hundred monkeys, living in trees.

sanskrit: ततो दधिमुखः श्रीमान् कोटिभिः दशभिः वृतः
transliteration: tato dadhimukhaḥ śrīmān koṭibhiḥ daśabhiḥ vṛtaḥ
english: Then surrounded by ten kotis (of monkeys), came the shapely Darimukha before the highsouled Sugriva, from a country bordering on a river.

sanskrit: शरभः कुमुदो वह्निः वानरो रंहः एव च
एते च अन्ये च बहवो वानराः काम रूपिणः
transliteration: śarabhaḥ kumudo vahniḥ vānaro raṃhaḥ eva ca
ete ca anye ca bahavo vānarāḥ kāma rūpiṇaḥ
english: And Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni, the monkey Rambha,-and many other monkeys-lords of herds-passing ennumeration-wearing shapes at will, came covering the entire earth with her mountains and forests.

sanskrit: आवृत्य पृथिवीम् सर्वाम् पर्वतान् च वनानि च
यूथपाः समनुप्राप्ता एषाम् संख्या न विद्यते
transliteration: āvṛtya pṛthivīm sarvām parvatān ca vanāni ca
yūthapāḥ samanuprāptā eṣām saṃkhyā na vidyate
english: And Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni, the monkey Rambha,-and many other monkeys-lords of herds-passing ennumeration-wearing shapes at will, came covering the entire earth with her mountains and forests.

sanskrit: आगताः च निविष्टाः च पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानराः
आप्लवंतः प्लवंतः च गर्जंतः च प्लवंगमाः
अभ्यवर्तन्त सुग्रीवम् सूर्यम् अभ्र गणा इव
transliteration: āgatāḥ ca niviṣṭāḥ ca pṛthivyām sarva vānarāḥ
āplavaṃtaḥ plavaṃtaḥ ca garjaṃtaḥ ca plavaṃgamāḥ
abhyavartanta sugrīvam sūryam abhra gaṇā iva
english: And all the monkeys of the world were some of them coming and others putting up. And monkeys-some of them dripping, and some leaping, and some roaring-gathered round Sugriva, like clouds gathering round the sun.

sanskrit: कुर्वाणा बहु शब्दान् च प्रकृष्टा बलशालिनः
transliteration: kurvāṇā bahu śabdān ca prakṛṣṭā balaśālinaḥ
english: And, crying in various tones, prime monkeys furnished with arms, with bent heads spoke humbly to that lord of monkeys—Sugrīva.

sanskrit: अपरे वानर श्रेष्ठाः संगम्य च यथा उचितम्
transliteration: apare vānara śreṣṭhāḥ saṃgamya ca yathā ucitam
english: And other foremost of monkeys, gathering together duly, came before Sugrīva with joined hands.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः त्वरितो रामे सर्वान् तान् वानरर्षभान्
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ tvarito rāme sarvān tān vānararṣabhān
english: Sugrīva standing with joined hands, expeditiously informed Rāma of the arrival of the monkey-leaders in hot haste; and then spoke (to them, saying, O chiefs of monkeys, stationing the forces duly near mountain-rills and all the woods, let him that is conversant with the army, ascertain who have come and who have not.

sanskrit: यथा सुखम् पर्वत निर्झरेषुवनेषु सर्वेषु च वानरेन्द्राः
निवेशयित्वा विधिवत् बलानिबलम् बलज्ञः प्रतिपत्तुम् ईष्टे
transliteration: yathā sukham parvata nirjhareṣuvaneṣu sarveṣu ca vānarendrāḥ
niveśayitvā vidhivat balānibalam balajñaḥ pratipattum īṣṭe
english: Sugrīva standing with joined hands, expeditiously informed Rāma of the arrival of the monkey-leaders in hot haste; and then spoke (to them, saying, O chiefs of monkeys, stationing the forces duly near mountain-rills and all the woods, let him that is conversant with the army, ascertain who have come and who have not.

sanskrit: अथ राजा समृद्ध अर्थः सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः
transliteration: atha rājā samṛddha arthaḥ sugrīvaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
english: Then that lord of monkeys, the successful Sugrīva, spoke to Rāma-lion among men and destroyer of hostile hosts-saying,

sanskrit: वानरेन्द्रा महेन्द्र आभा ये मत् विषय वासिनः
transliteration: vānarendrā mahendra ābhā ye mat viṣaya vāsinaḥ
english: Those foremost monkeys endued strength and capable of wearing any shape at will, and possessed of the splendour of the mishty Indra,-that inhabit my territories, have come and stationed themselves.

sanskrit: त इमे बहु विक्रान्तैः बलिभिः भीम विक्रमैः
आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः
transliteration: ta ime bahu vikrāntaiḥ balibhiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ
āgatā vānarā ghorā daitya dānava saṃnibhāḥ
english: And in company with many thousands and innumerable ones that have shewn their ability in many a field, have come monkeys dreadful, and resembling Daityas and Dänavas.

sanskrit: ख्यात कर्म अपदानाः च बलवन्तो जित क्लमाः
transliteration: khyāta karma apadānāḥ ca balavanto jita klamāḥ
english: And these monkeys-dreadful, and resembling Daityas and Dānvas are accompanied by powerful monkeys of terrific prowess, who have displayed their virtue in many a field, and are of famed renown in battle and, powerful, and who have mastered languor and are celebrated in prowess and sterling in their profession.

sanskrit: पृथिवि अंबु चरा राम नाना नग निवासिनः
कोटि ओघाः च इमे प्राप्ता वानराः तव किंकराः
transliteration: pṛthivi aṃbu carā rāma nānā naga nivāsinaḥ
koṭi oghāḥ ca ime prāptā vānarāḥ tava kiṃkarāḥ
english: O Rāma, these koțis of apes that have arrived, inhabiting earth and water and various mountainous tracts, are at your service.

sanskrit: निदेश वर्तिनः सर्वे सर्वे गुरु हिते स्थिताः
transliteration: nideśa vartinaḥ sarve sarve guru hite sthitāḥ
english: All abide by your command all are intent upon the welfare of their master, and, O subduer of foes, they are competent to bring about your end.

sanskrit: त इमे बहु साहस्रैः अनेकैः बहु विक्रमैः
आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्य दानव संनिभाः
transliteration: ta ime bahu sāhasraiḥ anekaiḥ bahu vikramaiḥ
āgatā vānarā ghorā daitya dānava saṃnibhāḥ
