english: And in company with many thousands and innumerable ones that have shewn their ability in many a field, have come monkeys dreadful, and resembling Daityas and Dänavas.

sanskrit: यत् मन्यसे नरव्याघ्र प्राप्त कालम् तत् उच्यताम्
तत् सैन्यम् त्वत् वशे युक्तम् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: yat manyase naravyāghra prāpta kālam tat ucyatām
tat sainyam tvat vaśe yuktam ājñāpayitum arhasi
english: If, O lion among men, you conceive that the time is ripe, tell it (to me). It behoves you to command those forces, remaining under your sway.

sanskrit: कामम् एषाम् इदम् कार्यम् विदितम् मम तत्त्वतः
तथा अपि तु यथा युक्तम् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि
transliteration: kāmam eṣām idam kāryam viditam mama tattvataḥ
tathā api tu yathā yuktam ājñāpayitum arhasi
english: Although I am full well acquainted with the work in which they are to be employed, yet you ought to order them as to what they are to accomplish.
When Sugriva had spoken thus, Dasaratha's son, Räma, embracing him with his arms, said,

sanskrit: ज्ञायताम् सौम्य वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा
स च देशो महाप्राज्ञ यस्मिन् वसति रावणः
transliteration: jñāyatām saumya vaidehī yadi jīvati vā na vā
sa ca deśo mahāprājña yasmin vasati rāvaṇaḥ
english: O placid one, do you learn whether Videha's daughter is alive or not; as well as ascertain the country, where, O you endowed with eminent wisdom,.liveth Ravana.

sanskrit: अधिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च
प्राप्त कालम् विधास्यामि तस्मिन् काले सह त्वया
transliteration: adhigamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca
prāpta kālam vidhāsyāmi tasmin kāle saha tvayā
english: Having come at Vaidehi and Ravana's abode, shall I then appoint the time along with you.

sanskrit: न अहम् अस्मिन् प्रभुः कार्ये वानरेन्द्र न लक्ष्मणः
त्वम् अस्य हेतुः कार्यस्य प्रभुः च प्लवगेश्वर
transliteration: na aham asmin prabhuḥ kārye vānarendra na lakṣmaṇaḥ
tvam asya hetuḥ kāryasya prabhuḥ ca plavageśvara
english: O lord of monkeys, I am not the master in this matter, nor Lakşmaņa: you are the cause of this undertaking, as well as, O monarch of monkeys, the lord.

sanskrit: त्वम् एव आज्ञापय विभो मम कार्य विनिश्चयम्
त्वम् हि जानासि यत् कार्यम् मम वीर न संशयः
transliteration: tvam eva ājñāpaya vibho mama kārya viniścayam
tvam hi jānāsi yat kāryam mama vīra na saṃśayaḥ
english: Do you therefore, O lord, command these as to what is to be done by them in my behalf. O hero, you certainly know my business.

sanskrit: सुहृद् द्वितीयो विक्रान्तः प्राज्ञः काल विशेष वित्
भवान् अस्मत् हिते युक्तः सुहृद् आप्तो अर्थवित्तमः
transliteration: suhṛd dvitīyo vikrāntaḥ prājñaḥ kāla viśeṣa vit
bhavān asmat hite yuktaḥ suhṛd āpto arthavittamaḥ
english: My second friend (Laksmana being first), you potent, wise, conversant with seasonableness, cognisant of profit, and engaged in our welfare.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवो विनतम् नाम यूथपम्
अब्रवीत् राम सांनिध्ये लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvo vinatam nāma yūthapam
abravīt rāma sāṃnidhye lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ

sanskrit: सोम सूर्य निभैः सार्धम् वानरैः वानरोत्तम
transliteration: soma sūrya nibhaiḥ sārdham vānaraiḥ vānarottama

sanskrit: देश काल नयैः युक्तः विज्ञः कार्य विनिश्चये
transliteration: deśa kāla nayaiḥ yuktaḥ vijñaḥ kārya viniścaye

sanskrit: अधिगच्छ दिशम् पूर्वाम् स शैल वन काननाम्
तत्र सीताम् च वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च
transliteration: adhigaccha diśam pūrvām sa śaila vana kānanām
tatra sītām ca vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca

sanskrit: मार्गध्वम् गिरि दुर्गेषु वनेषु च नदीषु च
नदीम् भागीरथीम् रम्याम् सरयूम् कौशिकीम् तथा
transliteration: mārgadhvam giri durgeṣu vaneṣu ca nadīṣu ca
nadīm bhāgīrathīm ramyām sarayūm kauśikīm tathā

sanskrit: कालिंदीम् यमुनाम् रम्याम् यामुनम् च महागिरिम्
सरस्वतीम् च सिंधुम् च शोणम् मणि निभ उदकम्
transliteration: kāliṃdīm yamunām ramyām yāmunam ca mahāgirim
sarasvatīm ca siṃdhum ca śoṇam maṇi nibha udakam

sanskrit: महीम् कालमहीम् चैव शैल कानन शोभिताम्
ब्रह्ममालान् विदेहान् च मालवान् काशि कोसलान्
transliteration: mahīm kālamahīm caiva śaila kānana śobhitām
brahmamālān videhān ca mālavān kāśi kosalān

sanskrit: मागधाम् च महाग्रामान् पुण्ड्रान् अंगाम् तथैव च
भूमिम् च कोशकाराणाम् भूमिम् च रजत आकराम्
transliteration: māgadhām ca mahāgrāmān puṇḍrān aṃgām tathaiva ca
bhūmim ca kośakārāṇām bhūmim ca rajata ākarām

sanskrit: सर्वम् च तत् विचेतव्यम् मार्गयद्भिः ततः ततः
रामस्य दयिताम् भार्याम् सीताम् दशरथः स्नुषाम्
transliteration: sarvam ca tat vicetavyam mārgayadbhiḥ tataḥ tataḥ
rāmasya dayitām bhāryām sītām daśarathaḥ snuṣām

sanskrit: समुद्रम् अवगाढान् च पर्वतान् पत्तनानि च
मंदरस्य च ये कोटिम् संश्रिताः केचित् आलयाः
transliteration: samudram avagāḍhān ca parvatān pattanāni ca
maṃdarasya ca ye koṭim saṃśritāḥ kecit ālayāḥ

sanskrit: कर्ण प्रावरणाः चैव तथा च अपि ओष्ठ कर्णकाः
घोर लोह मुखाः चैव जवनाः च एक पादकाः
transliteration: karṇa prāvaraṇāḥ caiva tathā ca api oṣṭha karṇakāḥ
ghora loha mukhāḥ caiva javanāḥ ca eka pādakāḥ

sanskrit: अक्षया बलवंतः च तथैव पुरुष आदकाः
किराताः तीक्ष्ण चूडाः च हेमाभाः प्रिय दर्शनाः
transliteration: akṣayā balavaṃtaḥ ca tathaiva puruṣa ādakāḥ
kirātāḥ tīkṣṇa cūḍāḥ ca hemābhāḥ priya darśanāḥ

sanskrit: आम मीन अशनाः चापि किराता द्वीप वासिनः
अंतर् जल चरा घोरा नरव्याघ्रा इति स्मृताः
transliteration: āma mīna aśanāḥ cāpi kirātā dvīpa vāsinaḥ
aṃtar jala carā ghorā naravyāghrā iti smṛtāḥ

sanskrit: एतेषाम् आश्रयाः सर्वे विचेयाः कानन ओकसः
गिरिभिर् ये च गम्यन्ते प्लवनेन प्लवेन च
transliteration: eteṣām āśrayāḥ sarve viceyāḥ kānana okasaḥ
giribhir ye ca gamyante plavanena plavena ca

sanskrit: यत्नवन्तो यव द्वीपम् सप्त राज्य उपशोभितम्
सुवर्ण रूप्यकम् द्वीपम् सुवर्ण आकर मण्डितम्
transliteration: yatnavanto yava dvīpam sapta rājya upaśobhitam
suvarṇa rūpyakam dvīpam suvarṇa ākara maṇḍitam

sanskrit: यव द्वीपम् अतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः
दिवम् स्पृशति शृन्गेण देव दानव सेवितः
transliteration: yava dvīpam atikramya śiśiro nāma parvataḥ
divam spṛśati śṛngeṇa deva dānava sevitaḥ
english: And, going beyond the island of Yava. (one comes upon) the hill called Sisira, which pierceth the heavens by its peaks, and is inhabited by gods and demons.

sanskrit: एतेषाम् गिरि दुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च
मार्गध्वम् सहिताः सर्वे राम पत्नीम् यशस्विनीम्
transliteration: eteṣām giri durgeṣu prapāteṣu vaneṣu ca
mārgadhvam sahitāḥ sarve rāma patnīm yaśasvinīm
english: In all these mountain fastnesses, cascades and woods, do you together search for the renowned wife of Rama.

sanskrit: ततो रक्त जलम् प्राप्य शोण आख्यम् शीघ्र वाहिनीम्
गत्वा पारम् समुद्रस्य सिद्ध चारण सेवितम्
transliteration: tato rakta jalam prāpya śoṇa ākhyam śīghra vāhinīm
gatvā pāram samudrasya siddha cāraṇa sevitam
english: Then, arriving at the rapid red waters going under the name of Sona, and repairing to the other shore of the ocean, the abode of Siddhas and Chāraņas, do you search all round for Răvaņa in company with Sītā in the sweet sacred spots and picturesque woods.

sanskrit: तस्य तीर्थेषु रम्येषु विचित्रेषु वनेषु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: tasya tīrtheṣu ramyeṣu vicitreṣu vaneṣu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ

sanskrit: पर्वत प्रभवा नद्यः सुभीम बहु निष्कुटाः
मार्गितव्या दरीमन्तः पर्वताः च वनानि च
transliteration: parvata prabhavā nadyaḥ subhīma bahu niṣkuṭāḥ
mārgitavyā darīmantaḥ parvatāḥ ca vanāni ca
english: And you should explore forests, mountainsprung streams, wild tracts subject to storms, and montains cer.aining ceverms.

sanskrit: ततः समुद्र द्वीपान् च सुभीमान् द्रष्टुम् अर्हथ
transliteration: tataḥ samudra dvīpān ca subhīmān draṣṭum arhatha
english: Then it behoves you to examine horrible ocean islands, heaving with waves, terrific, resounding,-of haughty bearing in consequence of winds.

sanskrit: तत्र असुरा महाकायाः छायाम् गृह्णन्ति नित्यशः
transliteration: tatra asurā mahākāyāḥ chāyām gṛhṇanti nityaśaḥ
english: There, huge-bodied Asuras, hungering for a long period, permitted by Brahmā, capture creatures, resorting to shades.

sanskrit: तम् काल मेघ प्रतिमम् महोरग निषेवितम्
transliteration: tam kāla megha pratimam mahoraga niṣevitam
english: And adroitly arriving at that great sea, like to clouds at the universal dissolution, inhabited by mighty snakes, sending loud sounds.

sanskrit: ततो रक्तजलम् भीमम् लोहितम् नाम सागरम्
गत्वा प्रेक्ष्यथ ताम् चैव बृहतीम् कूटशाल्मलीम्
transliteration: tato raktajalam bhīmam lohitam nāma sāgaram
gatvā prekṣyatha tām caiva bṛhatīm kūṭaśālmalīm

sanskrit: गृहम् च वैनतेयस्य नाना रत्न विभूषितम्
transliteration: gṛham ca vainateyasya nānā ratna vibhūṣitam

sanskrit: तत्र शैल निभा भीमा मन्देहा नाम राक्षसाः
शैल शृंगेषु लंबन्ते नाना रूपा भयावहाः
transliteration: tatra śaila nibhā bhīmā mandehā nāma rākṣasāḥ
śaila śṛṃgeṣu laṃbante nānā rūpā bhayāvahāḥ

sanskrit: ते पतन्ति जले नित्यम् सूर्यस्य उदयनम् प्रति
अभितप्ताः च सूर्येण लंबन्ते स्म पुनः पुनः
transliteration: te patanti jale nityam sūryasya udayanam prati
abhitaptāḥ ca sūryeṇa laṃbante sma punaḥ punaḥ
english: Day after day at sunrise, these Rākşasas heated (by solar rays) and struck dead by Brahmā energy,* again and again (hang on the crags). *The commentator explains: energy darted from the three orders.

sanskrit: निहता ब्रह्म तेजोभिः अहनि अहनि राक्षसाः
ततः पाण्डुर मेघाभम् क्षीरौदम् नाम सागरम्
transliteration: nihatā brahma tejobhiḥ ahani ahani rākṣasāḥ
tataḥ pāṇḍura meghābham kṣīraudam nāma sāgaram
english: Then wilt you, O you that are hard to repress, proceeding, view the sea named Kșiroda, having the hue of pale clouds, and looking like a necklace, because of the ripples (on its surface).

sanskrit: गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ दुर्धर्षा मुक्ता हारम् इव ऊर्मिभिः
तस्य मध्ये महा श्वेतो ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः
transliteration: gatvā drakṣyatha durdharṣā muktā hāram iva ūrmibhiḥ
tasya madhye mahā śveto ṛṣabho nāma parvataḥ
english: In it there are the mighty white mountain going by the name of Rsabha, covered with trees bearing odorous blossoms; as well as the tank known under the name of Sudarśana, swarming with swans and shining silver lotuses having golden filaments.

sanskrit: दिव्य गन्धैः कुसुमितै आचितैः च नगैः वृतः
सरः च राजतैः पद्मैः ज्वलितैः हेम केसरैः
transliteration: divya gandhaiḥ kusumitai ācitaiḥ ca nagaiḥ vṛtaḥ
saraḥ ca rājataiḥ padmaiḥ jvalitaiḥ hema kesaraiḥ

sanskrit: विबुधाः चारणा यक्षाः किन्नराः स अप्सरो गणाः
transliteration: vibudhāḥ cāraṇā yakṣāḥ kinnarāḥ sa apsaro gaṇāḥ

sanskrit: जलोदम् सागरम् शीघ्रम् सर्व भूत भयावहम्
तत्र तत् कोपजम् तेजः कृतम् हयमुखम् महत्
transliteration: jalodam sāgaram śīghram sarva bhūta bhayāvaham
tatra tat kopajam tejaḥ kṛtam hayamukham mahat

sanskrit: अस्य आहुः तन् महावेगम् ओदनम् स चराचरम्
तत्र विक्रोशताम् नादो भूतानाम् सागर ओकसाम्
श्रूयते च असमर्थानाम् दृष्ट्वा तत् वडवा मुखम्
transliteration: asya āhuḥ tan mahāvegam odanam sa carācaram
tatra vikrośatām nādo bhūtānām sāgara okasām
śrūyate ca asamarthānām dṛṣṭvā tat vaḍavā mukham

sanskrit: स्वादु उदस्य उत्तरे देशे योजनानि त्रयोदश
जातरूप शिलो नाम सुमहान् कनक प्रभः
transliteration: svādu udasya uttare deśe yojanāni trayodaśa
jātarūpa śilo nāma sumahān kanaka prabhaḥ
english: On the north of the Swādu sea, lie thirteen Yojanas (of land), named Jātarūpasila, * exceeding spacious, and of the splendour of gold. Lit. of gold and stone.

sanskrit: तत्र चन्द्र प्रतीकाशम् पन्नगम् धरणी धरम्
पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षम् ततो द्रक्ष्यध वानराः
transliteration: tatra candra pratīkāśam pannagam dharaṇī dharam
padma patra viśālākṣam tato drakṣyadha vānarāḥ
english: There, you monkeys, you will behold that serpent, the holder of Earth-resembling the moon, and with expansive eyes like lotuspetals-seated at the summit of the mount,-that one worshipped of all deities, having a thousand heads,-the god Ananta, clad in blue apparel.

sanskrit: आसीनम् पर्वतस्य अग्रे सर्व भूत नमस्कृतम्
सहस्र शिरसम् देवम् अनंतम् नील वाससम्
transliteration: āsīnam parvatasya agre sarva bhūta namaskṛtam
sahasra śirasam devam anaṃtam nīla vāsasam

sanskrit: त्रिशिराः कांचनः केतुः तालः तस्य महात्मनः
स्थापितः पर्वतस्य अग्रे विराजति स वेदिकः
transliteration: triśirāḥ kāṃcanaḥ ketuḥ tālaḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ
sthāpitaḥ parvatasya agre virājati sa vedikaḥ
english: And by the dais (there) at the top of the mount is the golden palm, planted by that high souled one,—which is like a banner.

sanskrit: पूर्वस्याम् दिशि निर्माणम् कृतम् तत् त्रिदशेश्वरैः
ततः परम् हेममयः श्रीमान् उदय पर्वतः
transliteration: pūrvasyām diśi nirmāṇam kṛtam tat tridaśeśvaraiḥ
tataḥ param hemamayaḥ śrīmān udaya parvataḥ
english: The chief of the celestials reared it in the Eastern region. After that is the fair Rising mountain.

sanskrit: तस्य कोटिः दिवम् स्पृष्ट्वा शत योजनम् आयता
transliteration: tasya koṭiḥ divam spṛṣṭvā śata yojanam āyatā
english: Its golden peak measuring a hundred Yojanas, reaching to the heavens, rises nobly, with mountains at its base; and looks beautiful with Sālas, palms, Tamālas, and flowering Karnikāras,-golden, splendid and resembling the sun.

sanskrit: सालैः तालैः तमालैः च कर्णिकारैः च पुष्पितैः
transliteration: sālaiḥ tālaiḥ tamālaiḥ ca karṇikāraiḥ ca puṣpitaiḥ
english: Its golden peak measuring a hundred Yojanas, reaching to the heavens, rises nobly, with mountains at its base; and looks beautiful with Sālas, palms, Tamālas, and flowering Karnikāras,-golden, splendid and resembling the sun.

sanskrit: तत्र योजन विस्तारम् उच्छ्रितम् दश योजनम्
transliteration: tatra yojana vistāram ucchritam daśa yojanam
english: There, spreading a Yojana around, towering up ten, is the peak named Saumanasa-all certainly of gold.

sanskrit: तत्र पूर्वम् पदम् कृत्वा पुरा विष्णुः त्रिविक्रमे
transliteration: tatra pūrvam padam kṛtvā purā viṣṇuḥ trivikrame
english: There, formerly on the occasion of invading the earth with three paces, that foremost of persons, Vişņu, planting his first foot planted the other on the summit of Meru.

sanskrit: दृश्यो भवति भूयिष्ठम् शिखरम् तन् महोच्छ्रयम्
transliteration: dṛśyo bhavati bhūyiṣṭham śikharam tan mahocchrayam
english: The sun, having passed by Jambūdwipa on the north, and, arriving at that mighty and eminent summit, (Saumanasa), again becomes visible to the dwellers of Jambūdwipa.
There are seen those Vālakhilya Maharșis, named Vaikhānasas,-wearing the hue of the sun, leading an ascetic mode of life.

sanskrit: अयम् सुदर्शनो द्वीपः पुरो यस्य प्रकाशते
तस्मिन् तेजः च चक्षुः च सर्व प्राणभृताम् अपि
transliteration: ayam sudarśano dvīpaḥ puro yasya prakāśate
tasmin tejaḥ ca cakṣuḥ ca sarva prāṇabhṛtām api
english: This is the island of Sudarsana, before which all creatures inspire energy and have their sight granted to them.

sanskrit: शैलस्य तस्य पृष्ठेषु कंदरेषु वनेषु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: śailasya tasya pṛṣṭheṣu kaṃdareṣu vaneṣu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
english: You should search for Rāvana with Vaidehi all round the top of that mountain as well as in its forests and woods.

sanskrit: कांचनस्य च शैलस्य सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः
आविष्टा तेजसा संध्या पूर्वा रक्ता प्रकाशते
transliteration: kāṃcanasya ca śailasya sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ
āviṣṭā tejasā saṃdhyā pūrvā raktā prakāśate
english: (Here) the first twilight enfolded in the glory of the golden hill and that of the high-souled Sun, appeareth roseate.

sanskrit: पूर्वम् एतत् कृतम् द्वारम् पृथिव्या भुवनस्य च
सूर्यस्य उदयनम् चैव पूर्वा हि एषा दिक् उच्यते
transliteration: pūrvam etat kṛtam dvāram pṛthivyā bhuvanasya ca
sūryasya udayanam caiva pūrvā hi eṣā dik ucyate
english: As this is the first gateway of both Earth and Heaven, and as the sun first rises in this quarter, this is called the East.

sanskrit: तस्य शलस्य पृष्ठेषु निर्झरेषु गुहासु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गतव्या ततः ततः
transliteration: tasya śalasya pṛṣṭheṣu nirjhareṣu guhāsu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgatavyā tataḥ tataḥ
english: You should search the breast of its mountain, and fountains, and caves for Rāvana in company with Vaidehi.

sanskrit: ततः परम् अगम्या स्यात् दिक् पूर्वा त्रिदश आवृता
रहिता चन्द्र सूर्याभ्याम् अदृश्या तिमिर आवृता
transliteration: tataḥ param agamyā syāt dik pūrvā tridaśa āvṛtā
rahitā candra sūryābhyām adṛśyā timira āvṛtā
english: Beyond that, is the exceedingly impassable Eastern quarter, thronged by the celestials, covered with darkness and devoid of the sun and the moon.

sanskrit: शैलेषु तेषु सर्वेषु कंदरेषु वनेषु च
ये च न उक्ता मयोद्देशा विचेया तेषु जानकी
transliteration: śaileṣu teṣu sarveṣu kaṃdareṣu vaneṣu ca
ye ca na uktā mayoddeśā viceyā teṣu jānakī
english: Do you search for Jānaki in all those rocks, woods and streams as well as in such spots as I have not mentioned.

sanskrit: एतावत् वानरैः शक्यम् गन्तुम् वानर पुंगवाः
अभास्करम् अमर्यादम् न जानीमः ततः परम्
transliteration: etāvat vānaraiḥ śakyam gantum vānara puṃgavāḥ
abhāskaram amaryādam na jānīmaḥ tataḥ param
english: You foremost of monkeys, the monkeys are competent to proceed thus far. Beyond this, of the tract without sun and without limit, I know nothing.

sanskrit: अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च
मासे पूर्णे निवर्तध्वम् उदयम् प्राप्य पर्वतम्
transliteration: abhigamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca
māse pūrṇe nivartadhvam udayam prāpya parvatam
english: Meeting with Vaidehi and arriving at) Rāvana's mansion, do you, having reached the Rising hill, turn back, when it shall be a full month.

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वम् मासात् न वस्तव्यम् वसन् वध्यो भवेन् मम
सिद्ध अर्थाः संनिवर्तध्वम् अधिगम्य च मैथिलीम्
transliteration: ūrdhvam māsāt na vastavyam vasan vadhyo bhaven mama
siddha arthāḥ saṃnivartadhvam adhigamya ca maithilīm
english: Do not stay longer than a month. If you do, you shall be slain by me. Having attained your end, do you turn back, having met with Maithili.

sanskrit: महेन्द्र कांताम् वन षण्ड मण्डिताम्दिशम् चरित्वा निपुणेन वानराः
अवाप्य सीताम् रघु वंशज प्रियाम्ततो निवृत्ताः सुखिनो भविष्यथ
transliteration: mahendra kāṃtām vana ṣaṇḍa maṇḍitāmdiśam caritvā nipuṇena vānarāḥ
avāpya sītām raghu vaṃśaja priyāmtato nivṛttāḥ sukhino bhaviṣyatha
english: Having adroitly explored (the tract) loved of Mahendra, plated with woods, do you, you monkeys, having come at Sītā—the beloved wife of that descendant of Raghu-desist, attaining happiness.

sanskrit: ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवः तन् महत् वानरम् बलम्
transliteration: tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvaḥ tan mahat vānaram balam
english: Then having sent away that mighty host of monkeys, Sugriva despatched to the South others competent to perform the several tasks entrusted to them.

sanskrit: नीलम् अग्नि सुतम् चैव हनूमन्तम् च वानरम्
transliteration: nīlam agni sutam caiva hanūmantam ca vānaram

sanskrit: सुहोत्रम् च शरारिम् च शरगुल्मम् तथा एव च
गजम् गवाक्षम् गवयम् सुषेणम् वृषभम् तथा
transliteration: suhotram ca śarārim ca śaragulmam tathā eva ca
gajam gavākṣam gavayam suṣeṇam vṛṣabham tathā

sanskrit: मैन्दम् च द्विविदम् चैव सुषेणम् गन्धमादनम्
उल्कामुखम् अनंगम् च हुतशन सुतौ उभौ
transliteration: maindam ca dvividam caiva suṣeṇam gandhamādanam
ulkāmukham anaṃgam ca hutaśana sutau ubhau

sanskrit: अंगद प्रमुखान् वीरान् वीरः कपि गण ईश्वरः
transliteration: aṃgada pramukhān vīrān vīraḥ kapi gaṇa īśvaraḥ

sanskrit: तेषाम् अग्रेसरम् चैव बृहद् बलम् अथ अंगदम्
विधाय हरि वीराणाम् आदिशद् दक्षिणाम् दिशम्
transliteration: teṣām agresaram caiva bṛhad balam atha aṃgadam
vidhāya hari vīrāṇām ādiśad dakṣiṇām diśam

sanskrit: ये केचन समुद्देशाः तस्याम् दिशि सुदुर्गमाः
कपीइशः कपि मुख्यानाम् स तेषाम् समुदाहरत्
transliteration: ye kecana samuddeśāḥ tasyām diśi sudurgamāḥ
kapīiśaḥ kapi mukhyānām sa teṣām samudāharat

sanskrit: सहस्र शिरसम् विंध्यम् नाना द्रुम लता आयुतम्
नर्मदाम् च नदीम् रम्याम् महोरग निषेविताम्
transliteration: sahasra śirasam viṃdhyam nānā druma latā āyutam
narmadām ca nadīm ramyām mahoraga niṣevitām

sanskrit: मेखलान् उत्कलाम् चैव दशार्ण नगराणि अपि
transliteration: mekhalān utkalām caiva daśārṇa nagarāṇi api

sanskrit: अब्रवंतीम् अवंतीम् च सर्वम् एव अनुपश्यत
विदर्भान् ऋष्टिकान् चैव रम्यान् माहिषकान् अपि
transliteration: abravaṃtīm avaṃtīm ca sarvam eva anupaśyata
vidarbhān ṛṣṭikān caiva ramyān māhiṣakān api

sanskrit: तथा वन्गान् कलिन्गाम् च कौशिकान् च समंततः
अन्वीक्ष्य दण्डक अरण्यम् स पर्वत नदी गुहम्
transliteration: tathā vangān kalingām ca kauśikān ca samaṃtataḥ
anvīkṣya daṇḍaka araṇyam sa parvata nadī guham

sanskrit: नदीम् गोदावरीम् चैव सर्वम् एव अनुपश्यत
तथैव आन्ध्रान् च पुण्ड्रान् च चोलान् पाण्ड्यान् केरलान्
transliteration: nadīm godāvarīm caiva sarvam eva anupaśyata
tathaiva āndhrān ca puṇḍrān ca colān pāṇḍyān keralān

sanskrit: अयोमुखः च गंतव्यः पर्वतो धातु मण्डितः
विचित्र शिखरः श्रीमान् चित्र पुष्पित काननः
transliteration: ayomukhaḥ ca gaṃtavyaḥ parvato dhātu maṇḍitaḥ
vicitra śikharaḥ śrīmān citra puṣpita kānanaḥ
english: Then shall you repair to the mountain Ayomukha,* plated with ore, having taking summits, graceful, furnished with picturesque flowering woods,-the mighty mountain having groves of excellent sandal. *Another name of this hill is Malaya.

sanskrit: ततः ताम् आपगाम् दिव्याम् प्रसन्न सलिलाशयान्
transliteration: tataḥ tām āpagām divyām prasanna salilāśayān

sanskrit: तत्र द्रक्ष्यथ कावेरीम् विहृताम् अप्सरो गणैः
तस्य आसीनम् नगस्य अग्रे मलयस्य महोजसम्
transliteration: tatra drakṣyatha kāverīm vihṛtām apsaro gaṇaiḥ
tasya āsīnam nagasya agre malayasya mahojasam

sanskrit: द्रक्ष्यथ आदित्य संकाशम् अगस्त्यम् ऋषि सत्तमम्
transliteration: drakṣyatha āditya saṃkāśam agastyam ṛṣi sattamam

sanskrit: सा चन्दन वनैः चित्रैः प्रच्छन्ना द्वीप वारिणी
transliteration: sā candana vanaiḥ citraiḥ pracchannā dvīpa vāriṇī

sanskrit: कान्ता इव युवती कान्तम् समुद्रम् अवगाहते
ततो हेममयम् दिव्यम् मुक्ता मणि विभूषितम्
transliteration: kāntā iva yuvatī kāntam samudram avagāhate
tato hemamayam divyam muktā maṇi vibhūṣitam

sanskrit: युक्तम् कवाटम् पाण्ड्यानाम् गता द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः
ततः समुद्रम् आसाद्य संप्रधार्य अर्थ निश्चयम्
transliteration: yuktam kavāṭam pāṇḍyānām gatā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ
tataḥ samudram āsādya saṃpradhārya artha niścayam

sanskrit: चित्र सानु नगः श्रीमान् महेन्द्रः पर्वतोत्तमः
transliteration: citra sānu nagaḥ śrīmān mahendraḥ parvatottamaḥ
english: Then arriving at the main, you shall ascertain your ability or otherwise of crossing the same. In the bosom of the deep there, Agastya has placed that foremost of mountains-the charming Mahendra, having picturesque plateaus; golden, and beautiful,-with a portion of it sunk in the great ocean.

sanskrit: नाना विधैः नगैः फुल्लैः लताभिः च उपशोभितम्
transliteration: nānā vidhaiḥ nagaiḥ phullaiḥ latābhiḥ ca upaśobhitam

sanskrit: देव ऋषि यक्ष प्रवरैः अप्सरोभिः च सेवितम्
सिद्ध चारण संघैः च प्रकीर्णम् सुमनोहरम्
transliteration: deva ṛṣi yakṣa pravaraiḥ apsarobhiḥ ca sevitam
siddha cāraṇa saṃghaiḥ ca prakīrṇam sumanoharam

sanskrit: तम् उपैति सहस्राक्षः सदा पर्वसु पर्वसु
द्वीपः तस्य अपरे पारे शत योजन विसृतः
transliteration: tam upaiti sahasrākṣaḥ sadā parvasu parvasu
dvīpaḥ tasya apare pāre śata yojana visṛtaḥ

sanskrit: अगम्यो मानुषैः दीप्तः तम् मार्गध्वम् समंततः
तत्र सर्व आत्मना सीता मार्गितव्या विशेषतः
transliteration: agamyo mānuṣaiḥ dīptaḥ tam mārgadhvam samaṃtataḥ
tatra sarva ātmanā sītā mārgitavyā viśeṣataḥ
english: On its other shore is an island extending over an hundred Yojanas, inaccessible to men*, and of splendid aspect. Do you explore it all round. There, in particular, you must every way search for Sita. *Because, says the commentator,. of the profusion of gold in it.

sanskrit: स हि देशः तु वध्यस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
transliteration: sa hi deśaḥ tu vadhyasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ
english: That country belongs to the impious Rāvana, worthy of being slain—the lord of Raksasas, like to the thousand-eyed (deity) in splendour.

sanskrit: दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य मध्ये तस्य तु राक्षसी
अंगारक इति विख्याता चायाम् आक्षिप्य भोजिनी
transliteration: dakṣiṇasya samudrasya madhye tasya tu rākṣasī
aṃgāraka iti vikhyātā cāyām ākṣipya bhojinī
english: In the midst of the Southern sea belonging to him (Ravana), there is a Raksasi, named Angāraketi, who procureth her pray by casting her shadow.

sanskrit: एवम् निःसंशयान् कृत्वा संशयान् नष्ट संशयाः
transliteration: evam niḥsaṃśayān kṛtvā saṃśayān naṣṭa saṃśayāḥ
english: Having (by your search) satisfied yourselves as to those countries where you might suspect Sītā to be, do you, your doubts dispelled, proceeding beyond that, (Lankā), search for the spouse of that monarch endued with unbounded energy.

sanskrit: तम् अतिक्रम्य लक्ष्मीवान् समुद्रे शत योजने
गिरिः पुष्पितको नाम सिद्ध चारण सेवितः
transliteration: tam atikramya lakṣmīvān samudre śata yojane
giriḥ puṣpitako nāma siddha cāraṇa sevitaḥ

sanskrit: चन्द्र सूर्य अंशु संकाशः सागर अंबु समाश्रयः
भ्राजते विपुलैः शृन्गैः अम्बरम् विलिखन् इव
transliteration: candra sūrya aṃśu saṃkāśaḥ sāgara aṃbu samāśrayaḥ
bhrājate vipulaiḥ śṛngaiḥ ambaram vilikhan iva

sanskrit: तस्य एकम् कांचनम् शृंगम् सेवते यम् दिवाकरः
श्वेतम् राजतम् एकम् च सेवते यम् निशाकरः
न तम् कृतघ्नाः पश्यन्ति न नृशंसा न नास्तिकाः
transliteration: tasya ekam kāṃcanam śṛṃgam sevate yam divākaraḥ
śvetam rājatam ekam ca sevate yam niśākaraḥ
na tam kṛtaghnāḥ paśyanti na nṛśaṃsā na nāstikāḥ

sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा शैलम् तम् विमार्गथ वानराः
तम् अतिक्रम्य दुर्धर्षम् सूर्यवान् नाम पर्वतः
transliteration: praṇamya śirasā śailam tam vimārgatha vānarāḥ
tam atikramya durdharṣam sūryavān nāma parvataḥ

sanskrit: ततः तम् अपि अतिक्रम्य वैद्युतो नाम पर्वतः
transliteration: tataḥ tam api atikramya vaidyuto nāma parvataḥ

sanskrit: सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः सर्व काल मनोहरैः
तत्र भुक्त्वा वर अर्हाणि मूलानि च फलानि च
transliteration: sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ sarva kāla manoharaiḥ
tatra bhuktvā vara arhāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca

sanskrit: मधूनि पीत्वा जुष्टानि परम् गच्छत वानराः
तत्र नेत्र मनः कांतः कुंजरो नाम पर्वतः
transliteration: madhūni pītvā juṣṭāni param gacchata vānarāḥ
tatra netra manaḥ kāṃtaḥ kuṃjaro nāma parvataḥ

sanskrit: तत्र योजन विस्तारम् उच्छ्रितम् दश योजनम्
transliteration: tatra yojana vistāram ucchritam daśa yojanam
english: There is the hill named Kunjara, grateful both to the eye and the mind, where Viśvakarmā had built the abode of Agastya*. There (rises) that stately golden pile, adorned with various gems, extending over one Yojana, and ten in height. *i.e. in that hill.

sanskrit: शरणम् कांचनम् दिव्यम् नाना रत्न विभूषितम्
तत्र भोगवती नाम सर्पाणाम् आलयः पुरी
transliteration: śaraṇam kāṃcanam divyam nānā ratna vibhūṣitam
tatra bhogavatī nāma sarpāṇām ālayaḥ purī

sanskrit: रक्षिता पन्नगैः घोरैः तीष्क्ण दम्ष्ट्रैः महा विषैः
transliteration: rakṣitā pannagaiḥ ghoraiḥ tīṣkṇa damṣṭraiḥ mahā viṣaiḥ
english: In it also there is that palace, which is the abode of snakes; having spacious ways, i incapable of being captured, guarded around, and protected by dreadful snakes and sharptoothed serpents of virulent poison; where dwelleth Vāsuki, the exceedingly terrible king of snakes. Proceeding heedfully, you must explore that Bhogavatī palace; also whatever concealed place may lie there.

sanskrit: सर्प राजो महाघोरो यस्याम् वसति वासुकिः
निर्याय मार्गितव्या च सा च भोगवती पुरी
transliteration: sarpa rājo mahāghoro yasyām vasati vāsukiḥ
niryāya mārgitavyā ca sā ca bhogavatī purī

sanskrit: तत्र च अंतरोद्देशा ये केचन समावृताः
तम् च देशम् अतिक्रम्य महान् ऋषभ संस्थितिः
transliteration: tatra ca aṃtaroddeśā ye kecana samāvṛtāḥ
tam ca deśam atikramya mahān ṛṣabha saṃsthitiḥ

sanskrit: सर्व रत्नमयः श्रीमान् ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः
गोशीर्षकम् पद्मकम् च हरिश्यामम् च चन्दनम्
transliteration: sarva ratnamayaḥ śrīmān ṛṣabho nāma parvataḥ
gośīrṣakam padmakam ca hariśyāmam ca candanam

sanskrit: दिव्यम् उत्पद्यते यत्र तत् चैव अग्नि सम प्रभम्
न तु तत् चन्दनम् दृष्ट्वा स्प्रष्टव्यम् च कदाचन
transliteration: divyam utpadyate yatra tat caiva agni sama prabham
na tu tat candanam dṛṣṭvā spraṣṭavyam ca kadācana

sanskrit: रोहिता नाम गंधर्वा घोरम् रक्षन्ति तद् वनम्
तत्र गंधर्व पतयः पंच सूर्य सम प्रभाः
transliteration: rohitā nāma gaṃdharvā ghoram rakṣanti tad vanam
tatra gaṃdharva patayaḥ paṃca sūrya sama prabhāḥ

sanskrit: शैलूषो ग्रामणीः शिक्षः शुको बभ्रुः तथैव च
रवि सोम अग्नि वपुषा निवासः पुण्य कर्मणाम्
transliteration: śailūṣo grāmaṇīḥ śikṣaḥ śuko babhruḥ tathaiva ca
ravi soma agni vapuṣā nivāsaḥ puṇya karmaṇām

sanskrit: अन्ते पृथिव्या दुर्धर्षाः ततः स्वर्ग जितः स्थिताः
ततः परम् न वः सेव्यः पितृ लोकः सुदारुणः
transliteration: ante pṛthivyā durdharṣāḥ tataḥ svarga jitaḥ sthitāḥ
tataḥ param na vaḥ sevyaḥ pitṛ lokaḥ sudāruṇaḥ

sanskrit: राजधानी यमस्य एषा कष्टेन तमसा आवृता
एतावत् एव युष्माभिः वीरा वानर पुंगवाः
शक्यम् विचेतुम् गन्तुम् वा न अतो गतिमताम् गतिः
transliteration: rājadhānī yamasya eṣā kaṣṭena tamasā āvṛtā
etāvat eva yuṣmābhiḥ vīrā vānara puṃgavāḥ
śakyam vicetum gantum vā na ato gatimatām gatiḥ
english: You heroic monkey chiefs, you can seek thus far. Further there is no course for those endued with motion.

sanskrit: सर्वम् एतत् समालोक्य यत् च अन्यत् अपि दृश्यते
transliteration: sarvam etat samālokya yat ca anyat api dṛśyate
english: Having examined all these, as well others that may come within your ken, it behoves you, after having ascertained Vaidehi's course, to return (hither).

sanskrit: यः च मासान् निवृत्तो अग्रे दृष्टा सीत इति वक्ष्यति
मत् तुल्य विभवो भोगैः सुखम् स विहरिष्यति
transliteration: yaḥ ca māsān nivṛtto agre dṛṣṭā sīta iti vakṣyati
mat tulya vibhavo bhogaiḥ sukham sa vihariṣyati
english: He that, returning within a month, shall say,—I have seen Sītā,' shall pass his days in happiness, enjoying affluence like mine own and indulging all pleasures.

sanskrit: ततः प्रियतरो न अस्ति मम प्राणात् विशेषतः
कृत अपराधो बहुशो मम बन्धुः भविष्यति
transliteration: tataḥ priyataro na asti mama prāṇāt viśeṣataḥ
kṛta aparādho bahuśo mama bandhuḥ bhaviṣyati
english: He shall be dearer to me than life itself, and none dearer (to me) that he; and although he might commit innumerable wrongs, still should he become my friend.

sanskrit: अमित बल पराक्रमा भवन्तोविपुल गुणेषु कुलेषु च प्रसूताः
मनुज पति सुताम् यथा लभध्वम्तत् अधिगुणम् पुरुषार्थम् आरभध्वम्
transliteration: amita bala parākramā bhavantovipula guṇeṣu kuleṣu ca prasūtāḥ
manuja pati sutām yathā labhadhvamtat adhiguṇam puruṣārtham ārabhadhvam
english: Possessed of immeasurable strength and prowess, and sprung from lines crowned with sterling virtues, do you strive manfully in such a glorious way that the king's daughter may be recovered. prowess, and sprung from lines crowned with sterling virtues, do you strive manfully in such a glorious way that the king's daughter may be recovered.

sanskrit: ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवः तान् हरीन् दक्षिणाम् दिशम्
अब्रवित् मेघ संकाशम् सुशेषणम् नाम वानरम्
transliteration: tataḥ prasthāpya sugrīvaḥ tān harīn dakṣiṇām diśam
abravit megha saṃkāśam suśeṣaṇam nāma vānaram

sanskrit: तारायाः पितरम् राजा श्वशुरम् भीम विक्रमम्
अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् अभिगम्य प्रणम्य च
transliteration: tārāyāḥ pitaram rājā śvaśuram bhīma vikramam
abravīt prāṃjaliḥ vākyam abhigamya praṇamya ca

sanskrit: वृ^इतम् कपिवरैः शूरैः महेन्द्र सदृ^इश द्युतिम्
transliteration: vṛitam kapivaraiḥ śūraiḥ mahendra sadṛiśa dyutim

sanskrit: बुद्धि विक्रम सम्पन्नान् वैनतेय सम द्युतिम्
transliteration: buddhi vikrama sampannān vainateya sama dyutim

sanskrit: ऋषि पुत्रान् च तान् सर्वान् प्रतीचीम् आदिशत् दिशम्
द्वाभ्याम् शत सहस्राभ्याम् कपीनाम् कपि सत्तमाः
transliteration: ṛṣi putrān ca tān sarvān pratīcīm ādiśat diśam
dvābhyām śata sahasrābhyām kapīnām kapi sattamāḥ

sanskrit: सौराष्ट्रान् सह बाह्लीकान् चंद्रचित्रान् तथैव च
transliteration: saurāṣṭrān saha bāhlīkān caṃdracitrān tathaiva ca

sanskrit: स्फीतान् जन पदान् रम्यान् विपुलानि पुराणि च
पुंनाग गहनम् कुक्षिम् वकुल उद्दालक आकुलम्
transliteration: sphītān jana padān ramyān vipulāni purāṇi ca
puṃnāga gahanam kukṣim vakula uddālaka ākulam

sanskrit: तथा केतक खंडान् च मार्गध्वम् हरि पुंगवाः
प्रत्यक् स्रोतो वहाः चैव नद्यः शीतजलाः शिवाः
transliteration: tathā ketaka khaṃḍān ca mārgadhvam hari puṃgavāḥ
pratyak sroto vahāḥ caiva nadyaḥ śītajalāḥ śivāḥ

sanskrit: तापसानाम् अरण्यानि कांतारा गिरयः च ये
तत्र स्थलीः मरुप्राया अति उच्च शिखराः शिलाः
transliteration: tāpasānām araṇyāni kāṃtārā girayaḥ ca ye
tatra sthalīḥ maruprāyā ati ucca śikharāḥ śilāḥ

sanskrit: गिरि जाल आवृताम् दुर्गाम् मार्गित्वा पश्चिमाम् दिशम्
ततः पश्चिमम् आगम्य समुद्रम् द्रष्टुम् अर्हथ
transliteration: giri jāla āvṛtām durgām mārgitvā paścimām diśam
tataḥ paścimam āgamya samudram draṣṭum arhatha

sanskrit: तिमि नक्र आकुल जलम् गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः
ततः केतक खंडेषु तमाल गहनेषु च
transliteration: timi nakra ākula jalam gatvā drakṣyatha vānarāḥ
tataḥ ketaka khaṃḍeṣu tamāla gahaneṣu ca

sanskrit: तत्र सीताम् च मार्गध्वम् निलयम् रावणस्य च
transliteration: tatra sītām ca mārgadhvam nilayam rāvaṇasya ca

sanskrit: मुरची पत्तनम् चैव रम्यम् चैव जटा पुरम्
transliteration: muracī pattanam caiva ramyam caiva jaṭā puram
english: In hills and woods on the shores of the sea; and (explore) Muracipattana, and the delightful Jațāpura, and Avantī, and Angalepā, as well as in the wood (called) Alaksita, and spacious monarchies, and emporiums.

sanskrit: अवंतीम् अंगलेपाम् च तथा च अलक्षितम् वनम्
राष्ट्राणि च विशालानि पत्तनानि ततः ततः
transliteration: avaṃtīm aṃgalepām ca tathā ca alakṣitam vanam
rāṣṭrāṇi ca viśālāni pattanāni tataḥ tataḥ
english: In hills and woods on the shores of the sea; and (explore) Muracipattana, and the delightful Jațāpura, and Avantī, and Angalepā, as well as in the wood (called) Alaksita, and spacious monarchies, and emporiums.

sanskrit: सिंधु सागरयोः चैव संगमे तत्र पर्वतः
महान् हेम गिरिः नाम शत शृंगो महाद्रुमः
transliteration: siṃdhu sāgarayoḥ caiva saṃgame tatra parvataḥ
mahān hema giriḥ nāma śata śṛṃgo mahādrumaḥ

sanskrit: तत्र प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु सिंहाः पक्ष गमाः स्थिताः
तिमि मत्स्य गजाम्ब् चैव नीडानि आरोपयन्ति ते
transliteration: tatra prastheṣu ramyeṣu siṃhāḥ pakṣa gamāḥ sthitāḥ
timi matsya gajāmb caiva nīḍāni āropayanti te
english: There is a mighty mountain where the Sindhu falls into the sea, Somagiri by name; having an hundred summits and tall trees. In its plateaus there are certain birds (called) Sinhas. These lift up to their nests whales and elephants.

sanskrit: तानि नीडानि सिंहानाम् गिरि शृंग गताः च ये
दृप्ताः तृप्ताः च मातंगाः तोयद स्वन निःस्वनाः
transliteration: tāni nīḍāni siṃhānām giri śṛṃga gatāḥ ca ye
dṛptāḥ tṛptāḥ ca mātaṃgāḥ toyada svana niḥsvanāḥ
english: The proud elephants carried to the nests and remaining on the summits of the mountain, possessing the roar of clouds, having been gratified (with food), range around this extensive table-land filled with water.

sanskrit: विचरन्ति विशाले अस्मिन् तोय पूर्णे समन्ततः
तस्य शृंगम् दिव स्पर्शम् कांचनम् चित्र पादपम्
transliteration: vicaranti viśāle asmin toya pūrṇe samantataḥ
tasya śṛṃgam diva sparśam kāṃcanam citra pādapam

sanskrit: सर्वम् आशु विचेतव्यम् कपिभिः काम रूपिभिः
कोटिम् तत्र समुद्रे तु कांचनीम् शत योजनम्
transliteration: sarvam āśu vicetavyam kapibhiḥ kāma rūpibhiḥ
koṭim tatra samudre tu kāṃcanīm śata yojanam

sanskrit: वसन्ति अग्नि निकाशानाम् घोराणाम् काम रूपिणाम्
transliteration: vasanti agni nikāśānām ghorāṇām kāma rūpiṇām
english: There dwell all around in a body four and twenty kotis of ascetic Gandharvas, resembling fire, dreadful, practicising impiety, and like to flames of fire.

sanskrit: न अति आसादयित्वाः ते वानरैः भीम विक्रमैः
न अदेयम् च फलम् तस्मात् देशात् किम्चित् प्लवंगमैः
transliteration: na ati āsādayitvāḥ te vānaraiḥ bhīma vikramaiḥ
na adeyam ca phalam tasmāt deśāt kimcit plavaṃgamaiḥ
english: The monkeys of dreadful prowess should not present themselves before those, nor should they take any fruits from that country.

sanskrit: दुरासदा हि ते वीराः सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः
फल मूलानि ते तत्र रक्षन्ते भीम विक्रमाः
transliteration: durāsadā hi te vīrāḥ sattvavanto mahābalāḥ
phala mūlāni te tatra rakṣante bhīma vikramāḥ
english: Those heroes are hard to approach; and they are truthful and possessed of great might. And there they of dreadful prowess stow away their fruits and roots.

sanskrit: तत्र यत्नः च कर्तव्यो मार्गितव्या च जानकी
न हि तेभ्यो भयम् किंचित् कपित्वम् अनुवर्तताम्
transliteration: tatra yatnaḥ ca kartavyo mārgitavyā ca jānakī
na hi tebhyo bhayam kiṃcit kapitvam anuvartatām
english: There you should heedfully search for Jānakī. you have no fear whatever from them; do you only follow your native nature as monkeys.

sanskrit: तत्र वैदूर्य वर्णाभो वज्र संस्थान संस्थितः
नाना द्रुम लता आकीर्णो वज्रः नाम महागिरिः
transliteration: tatra vaidūrya varṇābho vajra saṃsthāna saṃsthitaḥ
nānā druma latā ākīrṇo vajraḥ nāma mahāgiriḥ
english: There, in hue like lapises, abounding in various kinds of trees and plants, is a mighty hill of an adamantine basis, called Vajra; beautiful, famous, and measuring an hundred Yojanas in height and area. There let the monkeys carefully explore the caves.

sanskrit: श्रीमान् समुदितः तत्र योजनानाम् शतम् समम्
transliteration: śrīmān samuditaḥ tatra yojanānām śatam samam
english: There, in hue like lapises, abounding in various kinds of trees and plants, is a mighty hill of an adamantine basis, called Vajra; beautiful, famous, and measuring an hundred Yojanas in height and area. There let the monkeys carefully explore the caves.

sanskrit: चतुर् भागे समुद्रस्य चक्रवान् नाम पर्वतः
transliteration: catur bhāge samudrasya cakravān nāma parvataḥ
english: On the fourth side of the Ocean is a mountain named Cakravān. There Viśvakarmā forged the discus (called) Sahasrāra.

sanskrit: तत्र पंचजनम् हत्वा हयग्रीवम् च दानवम्
आजहार ततः चक्रम् शंखम् च पुरुषोत्तमः
transliteration: tatra paṃcajanam hatvā hayagrīvam ca dānavam
ājahāra tataḥ cakram śaṃkham ca puruṣottamaḥ
english: There, slaying Panchajana and the Dānava, Hayagriva*, the best of male beings obtained the discus as well as the conch. *Lit. horse-necked.

sanskrit: तस्य सानुषु रम्येषु विशालासु गुहासु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: tasya sānuṣu ramyeṣu viśālāsu guhāsu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ

sanskrit: योजनानि चतुः षष्टिः वराहो नाम पर्वतः
सुवर्ण शृंगः सुमहान् अगाधे वरुण आलये
transliteration: yojanāni catuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ varāho nāma parvataḥ
suvarṇa śṛṃgaḥ sumahān agādhe varuṇa ālaye
english: Sunk in the depths of the sea, is a very great mountain named Varāha, having golden peaks and measuring four and sixty yojanas.

sanskrit: तत्र प्राक् ज्योतिषम् नाम जातरूपमयम् पुरम्
यस्मिन् वसति दुष्ट आत्मा नरको नाम दानवः
transliteration: tatra prāk jyotiṣam nāma jātarūpamayam puram
yasmin vasati duṣṭa ātmā narako nāma dānavaḥ
english: In it is a city named Prāgjyotişa, all of gold. There dwells the wicked Dänava named Naraka.* *i.e. in the Varadha hill.

sanskrit: तत्र सानुषु रम्येषु विशालासु गुहासु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: tatra sānuṣu ramyeṣu viśālāsu guhāsu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ

sanskrit: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् कांचनान् अन्तर दर्शनम्
पर्वतः सर्व सौवर्णो धारा प्रस्रवण आयुतः
transliteration: tam atikramya śailendram kāṃcanān antara darśanam
parvataḥ sarva sauvarṇo dhārā prasravaṇa āyutaḥ
english: Passing beyond that foremost of mountains, whose sight betrays the secret of its bowels being freighted with gold, (you shall come upon) the mountain Sarvasauvarna, furnished with fountains and cascades.

sanskrit: तम् गजाः च वराहाः च सिंहा व्याघ्राः च सर्वतः
transliteration: tam gajāḥ ca varāhāḥ ca siṃhā vyāghrāḥ ca sarvataḥ
english: Coming to it, elephants, and boars, and lions, and tigers, on all sides roar ceaselessly, wrought up by the echoes their own cries have produced.

sanskrit: यस्मिन् हरि हयः श्रीमान् महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः
अभिषिक्तः सुरै राजा मेघो नाम स पर्वतः
transliteration: yasmin hari hayaḥ śrīmān mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ
abhiṣiktaḥ surai rājā megho nāma sa parvataḥ
english: This is the mountain named Megha, where the graceful green-horsed vanquisher of Pāka, Mahendra, was installed king by the gods.

Having passed by that mountain protected by Mahendra, you shall repair to sixty thousand hills of gold; in hue like the infant sun, and blazing on all sides and embellished by blossoming golden trees,

Having passed by that mountain protected by Mahendra, you shall repair to sixty thousand hills of gold; in hue like the infant sun, and blazing on all sides and embellished by blossoming golden trees,

sanskrit: तेषाम् मध्ये स्थितो राजा मेरुः उत्तम पर्वतः
आदित्येन प्रसन्नेन शैलो दत्त वरः पुरा
transliteration: teṣām madhye sthito rājā meruḥ uttama parvataḥ
ādityena prasannena śailo datta varaḥ purā

sanskrit: तेन एवम् उक्तः शैलेन्द्रः सर्व एव त्वत् आश्रयाः
मत् प्रसादात् भविष्यन्ति दिवा रात्रौ च कांचनाः
transliteration: tena evam uktaḥ śailendraḥ sarva eva tvat āśrayāḥ
mat prasādāt bhaviṣyanti divā rātrau ca kāṃcanāḥ

sanskrit: त्वयि ये च अपि वत्स्यन्ति देव गन्धर्व दानवाः
ते भविष्यन्ति भक्ताः च प्रभया कांचन प्रभाः
transliteration: tvayi ye ca api vatsyanti deva gandharva dānavāḥ
te bhaviṣyanti bhaktāḥ ca prabhayā kāṃcana prabhāḥ

sanskrit: विश्वेदेवाः च वसवो मरुतः च दिव ओकसः
आगत्य पश्चिमाम् संध्याम् मेरुम् उत्तम पर्वतम्
transliteration: viśvedevāḥ ca vasavo marutaḥ ca diva okasaḥ
āgatya paścimām saṃdhyām merum uttama parvatam
english: Coming to the excellent mountain Meru. Viśvadevas, the Vasus, the Maruts and the celestials, adore the Sun in the western twilight. Adored by them, the Sun, becoming invisible, repaireth to the Setting hill*. The commentator remarks: Although not expressly stated, it is implied that the islands to the west of it are also to be searched.

sanskrit: आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ति तैः च सूर्यो अभिपूजितः
अदृश्यः सर्व भूतानाम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम्
transliteration: ādityam upatiṣṭhanti taiḥ ca sūryo abhipūjitaḥ
adṛśyaḥ sarva bhūtānām astam gacchati parvatam
english: Coming to the excellent mountain Meru. Viśvadevas, the Vasus, the Maruts and the celestials, adore the Sun in the western twilight. Adored by them, the Sun, becoming invisible, repaireth to the Setting hill*. The commentator remarks: Although not expressly stated, it is implied that the islands to the west of it are also to be searched.

sanskrit: मुहूर्त अर्धेन तम् शीघ्रम् अभियाति शिल उच्चयम्
transliteration: muhūrta ardhena tam śīghram abhiyāti śila uccayam
english: In half a muhurta, the Sun swiftly passes over this (mountain), measuring, as it does, ten thousand Yojanas.

sanskrit: शृंगे तस्य महत् दिव्यम् भवनम् सूर्य संनिभम्
transliteration: śṛṃge tasya mahat divyam bhavanam sūrya saṃnibham
english: On its peak rises an edifice; resembling the sun (in splendour); consisting of palatial mansions built by Viśvakarmā; and graced by goodly trees rife with various birds,-the residence of the high-souled Varuna, bearing the noose in his hand.

sanskrit: शोभितम् तरुभिः चित्रैः नाना पक्षि समाकुलैः
transliteration: śobhitam tarubhiḥ citraiḥ nānā pakṣi samākulaiḥ
english: On its peak rises an edifice; resembling the sun (in splendour); consisting of palatial mansions built by Viśvakarmā; and graced by goodly trees rife with various birds,-the residence of the high-souled Varuna, bearing the noose in his hand.

sanskrit: अन्तरा मेरुम् अस्तम् च तालो दश शिरा महान्
transliteration: antarā merum astam ca tālo daśa śirā mahān
english: Between Meru and the Setting hill, towers a tall palm having ten heads. Golden and graceful, it shineth on a variegated dais.

sanskrit: तेषु सर्वेषु दुर्गेषु सरस्सु च सरित्सु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: teṣu sarveṣu durgeṣu sarassu ca saritsu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
english: In all these, difficult of access, as also in rivers and tanks, you should thoroughly search for Rāvana along with Vaidehī.

sanskrit: यत्र तिष्ठति धर्मज्ञः तपसा स्वेन भावितः
मेरु सावर्णिर् इति एष ख्यातो वै ब्रह्मणा समः
transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhati dharmajñaḥ tapasā svena bhāvitaḥ
meru sāvarṇir iti eṣa khyāto vai brahmaṇā samaḥ
english: There dwells there the righteous and famous Merusāvarani, sanctified by virtue of his own ascesticism, and like to Brahmā himself*. *Like to Prajāpati dwelling by Mahameru.

sanskrit: प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रवृत्तिम् मैथिलीम् प्रति
transliteration: praṇamya śirasā bhūmau pravṛttim maithilīm prati
english: Bowing down your heads to the earth, you should ask the Maharși Merusăvarņi, resembling the sun, touching Mithila's daughter.

sanskrit: एतावत् जीव लोकस्य भास्करो रजनी क्षये
कृत्वा वितिमिरम् सर्वम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम्
transliteration: etāvat jīva lokasya bhāskaro rajanī kṣaye
kṛtvā vitimiram sarvam astam gacchati parvatam
english: On the departure of night, the sun dispels the darkness of the world to this extent, and then enters the Setting hill.

sanskrit: एतावत् वानरैः शक्यम् गन्तुम् वानर पुंगवाः
अभास्करम् अमर्यादम् न जानीमः ततः परम्
transliteration: etāvat vānaraiḥ śakyam gantum vānara puṃgavāḥ
abhāskaram amaryādam na jānīmaḥ tataḥ param
english: You foremost of monkeys, the monkeys are able to proceed thus far. Beyond this, of what is sunless and boundless I know nothing.

sanskrit: अवगम्य तु वैदेहीम् निलयम् रावणस्य च
अस्तम् पर्वतम् आसाद्य पूर्णे मासे निवर्तत
transliteration: avagamya tu vaidehīm nilayam rāvaṇasya ca
astam parvatam āsādya pūrṇe māse nivartata
english: Having come to Vaidehi and Rāvana's mansions, and arrived at the Setting-hill, do you return of the month being complete.

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वम् मासान् न वस्तव्यम् वसन् वध्यो भवेन् मम
सह एव शूरो युष्माभिः श्वशुरो मे गमिष्यति
transliteration: ūrdhvam māsān na vastavyam vasan vadhyo bhaven mama
saha eva śūro yuṣmābhiḥ śvaśuro me gamiṣyati
english: You must not stay above a month; and if you do, you must be slain by me. And along with you goeth that hero, my father-in-law.

sanskrit: श्रोतव्यम् सर्वम् एतस्य भवद्भिः दिष्ट कारिभिः
गुरुः एष महाबाहुः श्वशुरो मे महाबलः
transliteration: śrotavyam sarvam etasya bhavadbhiḥ diṣṭa kāribhiḥ
guruḥ eṣa mahābāhuḥ śvaśuro me mahābalaḥ
english: You, abiding by his orders, should listen to all that he sayeth. My mighty-armed father-in-law, gifted with great strength, is my spiritual preceptor.

sanskrit: भवन्तः च अपि विक्रान्ताः प्रमाणम् सर्वे एव हि
प्रमाणम् एनम् संस्थाप्य पश्यध्वम् पश्चिमाम् दिशम्
transliteration: bhavantaḥ ca api vikrāntāḥ pramāṇam sarve eva hi
pramāṇam enam saṃsthāpya paśyadhvam paścimām diśam
english: All of you possessed of prowess, yourselves certainly constitute the measure whereby to ascertain the wisdom or otherwise of a course. Making this one also into a measure, survey the western quarter. Having requited the good that has been done to us, we shall attain our end.

sanskrit: दृष्टायाम् तु नरेन्द्रस्या पत्न्याम् अमित तेजसः
transliteration: dṛṣṭāyām tu narendrasyā patnyām amita tejasaḥ

sanskrit: अतो अन्यत् अपि यत् कार्यम् कार्यस्य अस्य प्रियम् भवेत्
संप्रधार्य भवद्भिः च देश काल अर्थ संहितम्
transliteration: ato anyat api yat kāryam kāryasya asya priyam bhavet
saṃpradhārya bhavadbhiḥ ca deśa kāla artha saṃhitam
english: De you also determine what else is agreeable (to Rāma), and in consonance with place, season and profit, should be performed by you in the matter of this business.

sanskrit: ततः सुषेण प्रमुखाः प्लवंगमाःसुग्रीव वाक्यम् निपुणम् निशम्य
आमंत्र्य सर्वे प्लवगाधिपम् तेजग्मुर् दिशम् ताम् वरुण अभिगुप्ताम्
transliteration: tataḥ suṣeṇa pramukhāḥ plavaṃgamāḥsugrīva vākyam nipuṇam niśamya
āmaṃtrya sarve plavagādhipam tejagmur diśam tām varuṇa abhiguptām
english: Then those monkeys-the monkey-chiefs headed by Sușeņa, having heard Sugrīva's deft speech, set out for the quarter protected by Varuna.

sanskrit: ततः संदिश्य सुग्रीवः श्वशुरम् पश्चिमाम् दिशम्
transliteration: tataḥ saṃdiśya sugrīvaḥ śvaśuram paścimām diśam
english: Having directed his father-in-law to proceed to the West, that best to monkeys, the allknowing king Sugrīva, lord of apes, then spoke to the heroic monkey, named Satavala, words fraught with good to himself as well as to Rāma,

sanskrit: उवाच राजा सर्वज्ञः सर्व वानर सत्तम
वाक्यम् आत्म हितम् चैव रामस्य च हितम् तदा
transliteration: uvāca rājā sarvajñaḥ sarva vānara sattama
vākyam ātma hitam caiva rāmasya ca hitam tadā
english: Having directed his father-in-law to proceed to the West, that best to monkeys, the allknowing king Sugrīva, lord of apes, then spoke to the heroic monkey, named Satavala, words fraught with good to himself as well as to Rāma,

sanskrit: वृतः शत सहस्रेण त्वत् विधानाम् वन ओकसाम्
वैवस्वत सुतैः सार्धम् प्रविष्ठ सर्व मंत्रिभिः
transliteration: vṛtaḥ śata sahasreṇa tvat vidhānām vana okasām
vaivasvata sutaiḥ sārdham praviṣṭha sarva maṃtribhiḥ
english: Surrounded by hundreds and thousands of rangers of the forest like yourself, in company with the offspring of Yama as well as the counsellors in a body, do you, O you possessed of prowess, entering the northern quarter furnished with the Himaśaila, search everywhere for the illustrious spouse of Rāma.

sanskrit: दिशम् हि उदीचीम् विक्रान्त हिम शैल अवतंसिकाम्
transliteration: diśam hi udīcīm vikrānta hima śaila avataṃsikām
english: Surrounded by hundreds and thousands of rangers of the forest like yourself, in company with the offspring of Yama as well as the counsellors in a body, do you, O you possessed of prowess, entering the northern quarter furnished with the Himaśaila, search everywhere for the illustrious spouse of Rāma.

sanskrit: अस्मिन् कार्ये विनिवृत्ते कृते दाशरथेः प्रिये
ऋणान् मुक्ता भविष्यामः कृत अर्था अर्थविदाम् वराः
transliteration: asmin kārye vinivṛtte kṛte dāśaratheḥ priye
ṛṇān muktā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛta arthā arthavidām varāḥ
english: Having performed this task satisfactorily, and brought about what is dear to Dasaratha's son, we shall, O best of those that achieve success, be freed from our debts.

sanskrit: कृतम् हि प्रियम् अस्माकम् राघवेण महात्मना
तस्य चेत् प्रतिकारो अस्ति सफलम् जीवितम् भवेत्
transliteration: kṛtam hi priyam asmākam rāghaveṇa mahātmanā
tasya cet pratikāro asti saphalam jīvitam bhavet
english: The high-souled Rāghava had done us good. If we can serve him in turn, our life shall be crowned with success.

sanskrit: अर्थिनः कार्य निर्वृत्तिम् अकर्तुम् अपि यः चरेत्
तस्य स्यात् सफलम् जन्म किम् पुनः पूर्व कारिणः
transliteration: arthinaḥ kārya nirvṛttim akartum api yaḥ caret
tasya syāt saphalam janma kim punaḥ pūrva kāriṇaḥ
english: Even the life of him that accomplishes the work of one to whom the former is not obliged, is successful, — what then is to be said in respect of him that has served one formerly.?

sanskrit: एताम् बुद्धिम् समास्थाय दृश्यते जानकी यथा
तथा भवद्भिः कर्तव्यम् अस्मत् प्रिय हित एषिभिः
transliteration: etām buddhim samāsthāya dṛśyate jānakī yathā
tathā bhavadbhiḥ kartavyam asmat priya hita eṣibhiḥ
english: Pondering this, those that are engaged in our welfare, should so act that Jānaki may be discovered.

sanskrit: अयम् हि सर्व भूतानाम् मान्यः तु नर सत्तमः
अस्मासु च गतः प्रीतिम् रामः पर पुरम् जयः
transliteration: ayam hi sarva bhūtānām mānyaḥ tu nara sattamaḥ
asmāsu ca gataḥ prītim rāmaḥ para puram jayaḥ
english: And this foremost of men is worthy of being honoured by all creatures; and Rāmacaptor of hostile capitals—has also found delight in us.

sanskrit: इमानि बहु दुर्गाणि नद्यः शैल अंतराणि च
transliteration: imāni bahu durgāṇi nadyaḥ śaila aṃtarāṇi ca
english: Endowed with sense and prowess, do you explore these many inaccessible places, rivers and mountains.

sanskrit: तत्र म्लेच्छान् पुलिन्दान् च शूरसेनान् तथैव च
प्रस्थालान् भरतान् चैव कुरूम् च सह मद्रकैः
transliteration: tatra mlecchān pulindān ca śūrasenān tathaiva ca
prasthālān bharatān caiva kurūm ca saha madrakaiḥ
english: Having searched there Mlechās, Pulindas, Surasensas, Prasthalas, Bharatas, Kurus, and Madrakas, and Varadas, as well as the cities of Kambojas, Yavanas and Sakas, do you explore Himavān.

sanskrit: कांबोज यवनान् चैव शकान् पत्तनानि च
transliteration: kāṃboja yavanān caiva śakān pattanāni ca

sanskrit: लोध्र पद्मक खण्डेषु देवदारु वनेषु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्या ततः ततः
transliteration: lodhra padmaka khaṇḍeṣu devadāru vaneṣu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyā tataḥ tataḥ
english: And in tracts of Lodhras and Padmakas, and in Devadāru woods* do you search thoroughly for Ravana along with Videha's daughter. *Belonging, according to the commentator, to Himavān.

sanskrit: ततः सोम आश्रमम् गत्वा देव गन्धर्व सेवितम्
कालम् नाम महासानुम् पर्वतम् तम् गमिष्यथ
transliteration: tataḥ soma āśramam gatvā deva gandharva sevitam
kālam nāma mahāsānum parvatam tam gamiṣyatha
english: Then, coming upon the hermitage of Soma, frequented by gods and Gandharvas, do you repair to the mountain called kāla possessing spacious plateaus,

sanskrit: महत्सु तस्य शैलेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च
transliteration: mahatsu tasya śaileṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca
english: In those mighty mountains, as also in others and in their caves, do you search for that exalted lady, the blameless wife of Rāma.

sanskrit: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् हेम गर्भम् महागिरिम्
ततः सुदर्शनम् नाम पर्वतम् गन्तुम् अर्हथ
transliteration: tam atikramya śailendram hema garbham mahāgirim
tataḥ sudarśanam nāma parvatam gantum arhatha
english: Having passed beyond that mighty mountain containing gold in its womb, it behoves you to go to the mountain called Sudarsana.

sanskrit: ततो देवसखो नाम पर्वतः पतग आलय
नाना पक्षि समाकीर्णो विविध द्रुम भूषितः
transliteration: tato devasakho nāma parvataḥ pataga ālaya
nānā pakṣi samākīrṇo vividha druma bhūṣitaḥ
english: Then (lies) the mountain called Devasakhā, the home of feathered tribes; abounding in various fowls, and embellished with diverse trees.

sanskrit: तस्य कानन खण्डेषु निर्झरेषु गुहासु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: tasya kānana khaṇḍeṣu nirjhareṣu guhāsu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
english: In its golden tracts, fountains and caves, do you search for Rāvaņa along with Videha's daughter.

sanskrit: तम् अतिक्रम्य च आकाशम् सर्वतः शत योजनम्
अपर्वत नदी वृक्षम् सर्व सत्त्व विवर्जितम्
transliteration: tam atikramya ca ākāśam sarvataḥ śata yojanam
aparvata nadī vṛkṣam sarva sattva vivarjitam
english: Going beyond it, (you come upon) a vacant land, measuring an hundred Yojanas, without mountains, or rivers, or trees; and void of all living beings.

sanskrit: तत् तु शीघ्रम् अतिक्रम्य कांतारम् रोम हर्षणम्
कैलासम् पाण्डुरम् प्राप्य हृष्टा यूयम् भविष्यथ
transliteration: tat tu śīghram atikramya kāṃtāram roma harṣaṇam
kailāsam pāṇḍuram prāpya hṛṣṭā yūyam bhaviṣyatha
english: Speedily passing that desert land capable of making one's hair stand on end, you shall feel delighted, on coming to the pale Kailasa.

There (you will behold) the charming mansion of Kuvera, resembling pale clouds, of burnished gold, built by Viśvakarmā; where (lies) the spacious tank overflowing with lotuses and lilies, thronged with swans and Kāraņdavas, and frequented by troops of Apsarās.

sanskrit: हंस कारण्डव आकीर्णा अप्सरो गण सेविता
transliteration: haṃsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇā apsaro gaṇa sevitā
english: There (you will behold) the charming mansion of Kuvera, resembling pale clouds, of burnished gold, built by Viśvakarmā; where (lies) the spacious tank overflowing with lotuses and lilies, thronged with swans and Kāraņdavas, and frequented by troops of Apsarās.

sanskrit: तत्र वैश्रवणो राजा सर्व भूत नमस्कृतः
धनदो रमते श्रीमान् गुह्यकैः सह यक्ष राट्
transliteration: tatra vaiśravaṇo rājā sarva bhūta namaskṛtaḥ
dhanado ramate śrīmān guhyakaiḥ saha yakṣa rāṭ
english: There king Vaiśravana, the lord of Yakşas, bowed down to by all creatures,-the graceful giver of riches—sporteth along with the Guhyakas.

sanskrit: तस्य चन्द्र निकशेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च
रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यः ततः ततः
transliteration: tasya candra nikaśeṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca
rāvaṇaḥ saha vaidehyā mārgitavyaḥ tataḥ tataḥ
english: In the offshoots belonging to Kailasa resembling the moon, as also in their caverns, do you thoroughly search for Rāvaņa in company with Vaidehī.

sanskrit: क्रौन्चम् तु गिरिम् आसाद्य बिलम् तस्य सुदुर्गमम्
अप्रमत्तैः प्रवेष्टव्यम् दुष्प्रवेशम् हि तत् स्मृतम्
transliteration: krauncam tu girim āsādya bilam tasya sudurgamam
apramattaiḥ praveṣṭavyam duṣpraveśam hi tat smṛtam
english: And coming to the Kruncha mountain, you should, having your wits about you, enter its inaccessible cavern; for that is well known as difficult of entrance.

sanskrit: वसन्ति हि महात्मानः तत्र सूर्य सम प्रभाः
देवैः अभ्यर्थिताः सम्यक् देव रूपा महर्षयः
transliteration: vasanti hi mahātmānaḥ tatra sūrya sama prabhāḥ
devaiḥ abhyarthitāḥ samyak deva rūpā maharṣayaḥ
english: There dwell certain Maharsis, high-souled, of effulgence resembling that of the sun-complete god-like shapes,—who are sought by the deities themselves.

sanskrit: क्रौन्चस्य तु गुहाः च अन्याः सानूनि शिखराणि च
निर्दराः च नितंबाः च विचेतव्याः ततः ततः
transliteration: krauncasya tu guhāḥ ca anyāḥ sānūni śikharāṇi ca
nirdarāḥ ca nitaṃbāḥ ca vicetavyāḥ tataḥ tataḥ
english: And you should thoroughly explore the other caves of Krauncha, its plateaus and peaks; its passes and sides.

sanskrit: अवृक्षम् काम शैलम् च मानसम् विहग आलयम्
न गतिः तत्र भूतानाम् देवानाम् न च रक्षसाम्
transliteration: avṛkṣam kāma śailam ca mānasam vihaga ālayam
na gatiḥ tatra bhūtānām devānām na ca rakṣasām
english: (Then is) the treeless Manasa-abode of birds-the scene of Kāma's austerities. Way there is none for creatures, or for gods, or for Raksasas.

sanskrit: स च सर्वैः विचेतव्यः स सानु प्रस्थ भूधरः
क्रौन्चम् गिरिम् अतिक्रम्य मैनाको नाम पर्वतः
transliteration: sa ca sarvaiḥ vicetavyaḥ sa sānu prastha bhūdharaḥ
krauncam girim atikramya maināko nāma parvataḥ
english: are That also must be explored by you, that mountain with plains and plateous. Going beyond Krauncha, (you shall see) the mountain, named Maināka.

sanskrit: मयस्य भवनम् तत्र दानवस्य स्वयम् कृतम्
मैनाकः तु विचेतव्यः स सानु प्रस्थ कंदरः
transliteration: mayasya bhavanam tatra dānavasya svayam kṛtam
mainākaḥ tu vicetavyaḥ sa sānu prastha kaṃdaraḥ
english: There is the residence of the Danvava, Maya, reared by himself. Mainaka also with its plains, plateaus and woods must be searched by you.

sanskrit: स्त्रीणाम् अश्व मुखीनाम् च निकेताः तत्र तत्र तु
तम् देशम् समतिक्रम्य आश्रमम् सिद्ध सेवितम्
transliteration: strīṇām aśva mukhīnām ca niketāḥ tatra tatra tu
tam deśam samatikramya āśramam siddha sevitam

sanskrit: सिद्धा वैखानसाः तत्र वालखिल्याः च तापसाः
वन्दितव्याः ततः सिद्धाः तापसा वीत कल्मषाः
transliteration: siddhā vaikhānasāḥ tatra vālakhilyāḥ ca tāpasāḥ
vanditavyāḥ tataḥ siddhāḥ tāpasā vīta kalmaṣāḥ

sanskrit: प्रष्टव्याः च अपि सीतायाः प्रवृत्तिम् विनय अन्वितैः
हेम पुष्कर संछन्नम् तत्र वैखानसम् सरः
transliteration: praṣṭavyāḥ ca api sītāyāḥ pravṛttim vinaya anvitaiḥ
hema puṣkara saṃchannam tatra vaikhānasam saraḥ

sanskrit: तरुण आदित्य संकाशैः हंसैः विचरितम् शुभैः
transliteration: taruṇa āditya saṃkāśaiḥ haṃsaiḥ vicaritam śubhaiḥ

sanskrit: गजः पर्येति तम् देशम् सदा सह करेणुभिः
तत् सारः समतिक्रम्य नष्ट चन्द्र दिवाकरम्
transliteration: gajaḥ paryeti tam deśam sadā saha kareṇubhiḥ
tat sāraḥ samatikramya naṣṭa candra divākaram

sanskrit: गभस्तिभिः इव अर्कस्य स तु देशः प्रकाशते
विश्राम्यद्भिः तपः सिद्धैः देव कल्पैः स्वयंप्रभैः
transliteration: gabhastibhiḥ iva arkasya sa tu deśaḥ prakāśate
viśrāmyadbhiḥ tapaḥ siddhaiḥ deva kalpaiḥ svayaṃprabhaiḥ
english: Going beyond that expanse of water, (you come upon) a sky void of stars, and where the sun and the moon have been put out; and that land is visible by the rays, as if of the sun, proceeding from (the persons of) self-luminous, god-like ones, who are reposing there, after achieving success in austerities.

sanskrit: तम् तु देशम् अतिक्रम्य शैलोदा नाम निम्नगा
उभयोः तीरयोः तस्याः कीचका नाम वेणवः
transliteration: tam tu deśam atikramya śailodā nāma nimnagā
ubhayoḥ tīrayoḥ tasyāḥ kīcakā nāma veṇavaḥ
english: Leaving behind that region, (you come to) a stream named Sailoda. On its both banks are bamboos named Kīcaka.

sanskrit: ते नयंति परम् तीरम् सिद्धान् प्रत्यानयन्ति च
उत्तराः कुरवः तत्र कृत पुण्य प्रतिश्रियाः
transliteration: te nayaṃti param tīram siddhān pratyānayanti ca
uttarāḥ kuravaḥ tatra kṛta puṇya pratiśriyāḥ
english: These take the Siddhas to the other shore and bring them back again. There (are seen the northern Kurus, the abode of those that have acquired religious merit.

sanskrit: नील वैदूर्य पत्राढ्या नद्यः तत्र सहस्रशः
transliteration: nīla vaidūrya patrāḍhyā nadyaḥ tatra sahasraśaḥ
english: And there are tanks there with their waters crowned with golden lotuses. There are rivers by thousands with copious blue lapis leaves.

sanskrit: रक्तोत्पल वनैः च अत्र मण्डिताः च हिरण्मयैः
तरुण आदित्य संकाशा भान्ति तत्र जलाशयाः
transliteration: raktotpala vanaiḥ ca atra maṇḍitāḥ ca hiraṇmayaiḥ
taruṇa āditya saṃkāśā bhānti tatra jalāśayāḥ
english: And the pools here, resembling the tender sun, are embellished with assemblages of golden red lotuses.

sanskrit: महाअर्ह मणि पत्रैः च कांचन प्रभ केसरैः
नीलोत्पल वनैः चित्रैः स देशः सर्वतो वृतः
transliteration: mahāarha maṇi patraiḥ ca kāṃcana prabha kesaraiḥ
nīlotpala vanaiḥ citraiḥ sa deśaḥ sarvato vṛtaḥ
english: And that tract is every where filled with costly gems, and jewels, and woods of blue lotuses, having filaments splendid like gold; and with round pearls and costly jewels.

sanskrit: निस्तुलाभिः च मुक्ताभिः मणिभिः च महाधनैः
उद्भूत पुलिनाः तत्र जातरूपैः च निम्नगाः
transliteration: nistulābhiḥ ca muktābhiḥ maṇibhiḥ ca mahādhanaiḥ
udbhūta pulināḥ tatra jātarūpaiḥ ca nimnagāḥ
english: And the rivers there have islets covered with gold; and are crowded with lovely hills of gold, bright as fire, furnished with all kinds of precious stones.

sanskrit: जातरूपमयैः च अपि हुताशन सम प्रभैः
transliteration: jātarūpamayaiḥ ca api hutāśana sama prabhaiḥ
english: And the rivers there have islets covered with gold; and are crowded with lovely hills of gold, bright as fire, furnished with all kinds of precious stones.

sanskrit: नित्य पुष्प फलाः तत्र नगाः पत्ररथ आकुलाः
दिव्य गन्ध रस स्पर्शाः सर्व कामान् स्रवन्ति च
transliteration: nitya puṣpa phalāḥ tatra nagāḥ patraratha ākulāḥ
divya gandha rasa sparśāḥ sarva kāmān sravanti ca
english: And the trees there, thronged with birds, bear flowers and fruits daily; and, charged with savoury juices, publishing superb perfumes, and of delicious feel, they confer every wish.

sanskrit: नाना आकाराणि वासांसि फलन्ति अन्ये नगोत्तमाः
मुक्ता वैदूर्य चित्राणि भूषणानि तथैव च
स्त्रीणाम् यानि अनुरूपाणि पुरुषाणाम् तथैव च
transliteration: nānā ākārāṇi vāsāṃsi phalanti anye nagottamāḥ
muktā vaidūrya citrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni tathaiva ca
strīṇām yāni anurūpāṇi puruṣāṇām tathaiva ca
english: Other excellent trees bring forth attires of divers kinds, and ornaments decked with pearls and lapises,-coveted alike by males and females*. *The present text, according to Kataka, drops a sloka, whose last line is, Beings possessed of powerful effulgence, sport here always in company with females.

sanskrit: सर्व ऋतु सुख सेव्यानि फलन्ति अन्ये नगोत्तमाः
महा अर्हाणि मणि चित्राणि फलन्ति अन्ये नगोत्तमाः
transliteration: sarva ṛtu sukha sevyāni phalanti anye nagottamāḥ
mahā arhāṇi maṇi citrāṇi phalanti anye nagottamāḥ
english: And other excellent trees bear fruits fit to be partaken at all seasons. And other excellent trees bring forth precious beds dight with costly jewels and furnished with variegated covers.

sanskrit: मनः कान्तानि माल्यानि फलन्ति अत्र अपरे द्रुमाः
transliteration: manaḥ kāntāni mālyāni phalanti atra apare drumāḥ

sanskrit: पानानि च महा अर्हाणि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च
स्त्रियः च गुण संपन्ना रूप यौवन लक्षिताः
transliteration: pānāni ca mahā arhāṇi bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca
striyaḥ ca guṇa saṃpannā rūpa yauvana lakṣitāḥ

sanskrit: गन्धर्वाः किंनरा सिद्धा नागा विद्याधराः तथा
रमन्ते सहिताः तत्र नारीभिः भास्वर प्रभाः
transliteration: gandharvāḥ kiṃnarā siddhā nāgā vidyādharāḥ tathā
ramante sahitāḥ tatra nārībhiḥ bhāsvara prabhāḥ

sanskrit: सर्वे सुकृत कर्माणः सर्वे रति परायणाः
सर्वे काम अर्थ सहिता वसंति सह योषितः
transliteration: sarve sukṛta karmāṇaḥ sarve rati parāyaṇāḥ
sarve kāma artha sahitā vasaṃti saha yoṣitaḥ
english: And all of righteous deeds, and all engaged in amorous disports, and all furnished with desire and profit,-dwell in that place in association with their females.

sanskrit: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषः स उत्कृष्ट हसित स्वनः
श्रूयते सततम् तत्र सर्व भूत मनोरमः
transliteration: gīta vāditra nirghoṣaḥ sa utkṛṣṭa hasita svanaḥ
śrūyate satatam tatra sarva bhūta manoramaḥ
english: And there are continually heard there the sounds of instruments and the voice of song mixed with sweet hilarious laughter, capable of taking all crcatures.

sanskrit: तत्र न अमुदितः कश्चिन् न अत्र कश्चित् असत् प्रियः
अहनि अहनि वर्धन्ते गुणाः तत्र मनोरमाः
transliteration: tatra na amuditaḥ kaścin na atra kaścit asat priyaḥ
ahani ahani vardhante guṇāḥ tatra manoramāḥ
english: No one is depressed there; nor does any one there want any desirable object; and day after day the delightful qualities find their development there.

sanskrit: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् उत्तरः पय्साम् निधिः
तत्र सोम गिरिर् नाम मध्ये हेममयो महान्
transliteration: tam atikramya śailendram uttaraḥ paysām nidhiḥ
tatra soma girir nāma madhye hemamayo mahān
english: Passing beyond that is the Northern ocean. In the bosom (of the deep) is the mountain named Somagiri, golden and of great dimensions.

sanskrit: इन्द्र लोक गता ये च ब्रह्म लोक गताः च ये
देवाः तम् समवेक्षन्ते गिरि राजम् दिवम् गताः
transliteration: indra loka gatā ye ca brahma loka gatāḥ ca ye
devāḥ tam samavekṣante giri rājam divam gatāḥ

sanskrit: स तु देशो विसूर्यो अपि तस्य भासा प्रकाशते
सूर्य लक्ष्म्या अभिविज्ञेयः तपता इव विवस्वता
transliteration: sa tu deśo visūryo api tasya bhāsā prakāśate
sūrya lakṣmyā abhivijñeyaḥ tapatā iva vivasvatā
english: Albeit without the sun, yet through the brightness of the Soma mountain, the land shines forth with all the loveliness and reality of one warmed by the sun.

sanskrit: भगवान् तत्र विश्वात्मा शम्भुः एकादश आत्मकः
ब्रह्मा वसति देवेशो ब्रह्म ऋषि परिवारितः
transliteration: bhagavān tatra viśvātmā śambhuḥ ekādaśa ātmakaḥ
brahmā vasati deveśo brahma ṛṣi parivāritaḥ
english: There that Soul of the Universe, the adorable Sambhu, fraught with the spirits of the eleven Rudras-that lord of the gods-Brahmā.dwelleth, surrounded by the Brahmarsis.

sanskrit: न कथंचन गंतव्यम् कुरूणाम् उत्तरेण वः
अन्येषाम् अपि भूतानाम् न अनुक्रामति वै गतिः
transliteration: na kathaṃcana gaṃtavyam kurūṇām uttareṇa vaḥ
anyeṣām api bhūtānām na anukrāmati vai gatiḥ
english: You cannot proceed to the north of the Kurus; nor is there way in that region for any other creatures.

sanskrit: सा हि सोम गिरिः नाम देवानाम् अपि दुर्गमः
तम् आलोक्य ततः क्षिप्रम् उपावर्तितुम् अर्हथ
transliteration: sā hi soma giriḥ nāma devānām api durgamaḥ
tam ālokya tataḥ kṣipram upāvartitum arhatha
english: And that mountain is named Soma, incapable of being entered even by the gods, Sighting this you should speedily turn back.

sanskrit: एतावत् वानरैः शक्यम् गंतुम् वानर पुंगवाः
अभास्करम् अमर्यादम् न जानीमः ततः परम्
transliteration: etāvat vānaraiḥ śakyam gaṃtum vānara puṃgavāḥ
abhāskaram amaryādam na jānīmaḥ tataḥ param
english: You foremost of monkey, the monkeys are competent to proceed thus far. Beyond that, of regions sunless and limitless I know nothing.

sanskrit: सर्वम् एतत् विचेतव्यम् यन् मया परिकीर्तितम्
यत् अन्यत् अपि न उक्तम् च तत्र अपि क्रियताम् मतिः
transliteration: sarvam etat vicetavyam yan mayā parikīrtitam
yat anyat api na uktam ca tatra api kriyatām matiḥ
english: You should search all these which I have described (to you); and you should also turn your attention to others besides, which I have omitted to mention.

sanskrit: ततः कृतम् दाशरथेः महत् प्रियम्महत्तरम् च अपि ततो मम प्रियम्
transliteration: tataḥ kṛtam dāśaratheḥ mahat priyammahattaram ca api tato mama priyam
english: You that are comparable to the wind or fire, by accomplishing the work of beholding Videha's daughter, you will do what is held as exceedingly dear to Daśaratha's son as well as highly grateful to me.

sanskrit: ततः कृतार्थाः सहिताः सबान्धवामया अर्चिताः सर्व गुणैः मनो रमैः
चरिष्यथ उर्वीम् प्रतिशान्त शत्रवाअःसह प्रिया भूत धराः प्लवंगमाः
transliteration: tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ sahitāḥ sabāndhavāmayā arcitāḥ sarva guṇaiḥ mano ramaiḥ
cariṣyatha urvīm pratiśānta śatravāaḥsaha priyā bhūta dharāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ
english: Then, having achieved success, do you, along with your friends, honoured by me, and crowned with every virtue, you monkeys, with your enemies slain, range the earth in company with your wives,-the support of all beings.

sanskrit: विशेषेण तु सुग्रीवो हनूमति अर्थम् उक्तवान्
स हि तस्मिन् हरि श्रेष्ठे निश्चितार्थो अर्थ साधने
transliteration: viśeṣeṇa tu sugrīvo hanūmati artham uktavān
sa hi tasmin hari śreṣṭhe niścitārtho artha sādhane
english: Sugrīva had declared his conviction that he relied particularly upon Hanumān.

sanskrit: अब्रवीत् च हनूमंतम् विक्रंतम् अनिल आत्मजम्
सुग्रीवः परम प्रीतः प्रभुः सर्व वन ओकसाम्
transliteration: abravīt ca hanūmaṃtam vikraṃtam anila ātmajam
sugrīvaḥ parama prītaḥ prabhuḥ sarva vana okasām
english: And convinced as to the ability of that best of monkeys to accomplish the work, Sugrīva, that lord of all the dwellers of the woods, well pleased, spoke to Hanumān, son to the windgod, saying,

sanskrit: न भूमौ न अंतरिक्षे वा न अंबरे न अमर आलये
न अप्सु वा गति संगम् ते पश्यामि हरि पुम्गव
transliteration: na bhūmau na aṃtarikṣe vā na aṃbare na amara ālaye
na apsu vā gati saṃgam te paśyāmi hari pumgava
english: O foremost of monkeys, neither on the earth, nor in the sky', nor in the etherial regions, nor yet in water, find I any obstacle to your course. 1. Antariksa-regions above the earth in which the birds fly. 2. Ambara— Upper air.

sanskrit: स असुराः सह गंधर्वाः स नाग नर देवताः
विदिताः सर्व लोकाः ते स सागर धरा धराः
transliteration: sa asurāḥ saha gaṃdharvāḥ sa nāga nara devatāḥ
viditāḥ sarva lokāḥ te sa sāgara dharā dharāḥ
english: The entire worlds with Asuras, and Gandharvas, and Nāgas, and men, and gods, with oceans, and the earth and the regions beneath—are well known to you.

sanskrit: गतिः वेगः च तेजः च लाघवम् च महाकपे
पितुः ते सदृशम् वीर मारुतस्य महा ओजसः
transliteration: gatiḥ vegaḥ ca tejaḥ ca lāghavam ca mahākape
pituḥ te sadṛśam vīra mārutasya mahā ojasaḥ

sanskrit: तेजसा वा अपि ते भूतम् न समम् भुवि विद्यते
तत् यथा लभ्यते सीता तत् त्वम् एव अनुचिंतय
transliteration: tejasā vā api te bhūtam na samam bhuvi vidyate
tat yathā labhyate sītā tat tvam eva anuciṃtaya
english: And your motion, vehemence, energy and fleetness, are, O hero, O mighty ape, even like those of your sire, the powerful wind god; and there exists no creature on earth that is like to you in energy. Therefore do you bethink you how Sītā may be recovered.

sanskrit: त्वयि एव हनुमन् अस्ति बलम् बुद्धिः पराक्रमः
देश काल अनुवृत्तिः च नयः च नय पण्डित
transliteration: tvayi eva hanuman asti balam buddhiḥ parākramaḥ
deśa kāla anuvṛttiḥ ca nayaḥ ca naya paṇḍita
english: Even in you, O you versed in policy, are strength, and wit, and courage, and policy, and conduct in consonance with season and place.
Thereat, understanding that success in the task depended upon Hanumān, and also knowing what Hanumān was, Rāghava reflected,

sanskrit: सर्वथा निश्चित अर्थो अयम् हनूमति हरि ईश्वरः
निश्चित अर्थतरः च अपि हनूमान् कार्य साधने
transliteration: sarvathā niścita artho ayam hanūmati hari īśvaraḥ
niścita arthataraḥ ca api hanūmān kārya sādhane
english: This lord of monkeys is every way confident concerning Hanumān; and Hanumān himself is even more confident of achieving success in the work.

sanskrit: तत् एवम् प्रस्थितस्य अस्य परिज्ञातस्य कर्मभिः
transliteration: tat evam prasthitasya asya parijñātasya karmabhiḥ
english: He that has been tested by his deed, and who has been considered worthiest by his master, having veen commissioned in this business,-success in the work is certain.

sanskrit: कृतार्थ इव संहृष्टः प्रहृष्ट इन्द्रिय मानसः
transliteration: kṛtārtha iva saṃhṛṣṭaḥ prahṛṣṭa indriya mānasaḥ
english: Then beholding that monkey who was the fittest for the task, that exceedingly energetic senses one, (Rāma), with his mind and exhilarated, considering himself as already crowned with success, felt the excess of joy.

sanskrit: ददौ तस्य ततः प्रीतः स्व नामांक उपशोभितम्
transliteration: dadau tasya tataḥ prītaḥ sva nāmāṃka upaśobhitam
english: And well pleased, that subduer of enemies handed to Hanuman a ring inscribed with his name, as a sign to the king's daughter.
By this sign, O foremost of monkeys, Janaka's daughter will be able to see you fearlessly, as one that has come from me.

sanskrit: व्यवसायः च ते वीर सत्त्व युक्तः च विक्रमः
सुग्रीवस्य च संदेशः सिद्धिम् कथयति इव मे
transliteration: vyavasāyaḥ ca te vīra sattva yuktaḥ ca vikramaḥ
sugrīvasya ca saṃdeśaḥ siddhim kathayati iva me
english: Your firmness, O hero, and sterling prowess, as well as Sugrīva's saying, tell me greatly of success.

sanskrit: स तत् गृह्य हरिश्रेष्ठः स्थाप्य मूर्ध्नि कृतांजलिः
transliteration: sa tat gṛhya hariśreṣṭhaḥ sthāpya mūrdhni kṛtāṃjaliḥ
english: Thereupon, taking that (ring), and raising his joined palms to his head, that foremost and best of monkeys, saluting (Rāma's) feet, went away.

sanskrit: स तत् प्रकर्षन् हरिणाम् महत् बलम्बभूव वीरः पवनात्मजः कपिः
गत अंबुदे व्योम्नि विशुद्ध मण्डलःशशी इव नक्षत्र गणोपशोभितः
transliteration: sa tat prakarṣan hariṇām mahat balambabhūva vīraḥ pavanātmajaḥ kapiḥ
gata aṃbude vyomni viśuddha maṇḍalaḥśaśī iva nakṣatra gaṇopaśobhitaḥ
english: Then taking with him that mighty host of monkeys, that hero, the son of the wind, resembled the moon of bright disc in the sky, garnished by the stars, after the clouds have departed.

sanskrit: अतिबल बलम् आश्रितः तव अहम्हरि वर विक्रम विक्रमैः अनल्पैः
पवन सुत यथा अधिगम्यते साजनक सुता हनुमन् तथा कुरुष्व
transliteration: atibala balam āśritaḥ tava ahamhari vara vikrama vikramaiḥ analpaiḥ
pavana suta yathā adhigamyate sājanaka sutā hanuman tathā kuruṣva
english: O you of excessive strength! I take refuge in your mighty. O you endowed with the prowess of the foremost of lions! do you, O son of the Wind, O Hanuman, exert yourself so, summoning the great strength you are master of, that we may obtain Janaka's daughter.* The commentator says that this speech is equally attributable to Rāma and Sugrīva. But I think, it would fit Rāma's lips to a nicely. The commentator says that this speech is equally attributable to Rāma and Sugrīva. But I think, it would fit Rāma's lips to a nicely.

sanskrit: सर्वाः च आहूय सुग्रीवः प्लवगान् प्लवगर्षभः
समस्तान् च अब्रवीत् राजा राम कार्यार्थ सिद्धये
transliteration: sarvāḥ ca āhūya sugrīvaḥ plavagān plavagarṣabhaḥ
samastān ca abravīt rājā rāma kāryārtha siddhaye
english: Summoning all the monkeys, that foremost of monkeys, king Sugriva, spoke to them all touching the success of Rāma's work.

sanskrit: तत् उग्र शासनम् भर्तुर् विज्ञाय हरि पुंगवाः
transliteration: tat ugra śāsanam bhartur vijñāya hari puṃgavāḥ
english: The monkey-chiefs, knowing the stern command of their lord should search in all these places. Then, covering up the earth like locusts, they marched away.

sanskrit: रामः प्रस्रवणे तस्मिन् न्यवसत् सह लक्ष्मणः
transliteration: rāmaḥ prasravaṇe tasmin nyavasat saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
english: Expecting tidings of Sītä, Rāma remained that month in the vicinity of that cascade, in company with Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: प्रतीक्षमाणः तम् मासम् यः सीता अधिगमे कृतः
उत्तराम् तु दिशम् रम्याम् गिरि राज समावृताम्
transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇaḥ tam māsam yaḥ sītā adhigame kṛtaḥ
uttarām tu diśam ramyām giri rāja samāvṛtām

sanskrit: प्रतस्थे सहसा वीरो हरिः शतबलिः तदा
पूर्वाम् दिशम् प्रति ययौ विनतो हरि यूथपः
transliteration: pratasthe sahasā vīro hariḥ śatabaliḥ tadā
pūrvām diśam prati yayau vinato hari yūthapaḥ

sanskrit: अगस्त्य चरिताम् आशाम् दक्षिणाम् हरि यूथपः
transliteration: agastya caritām āśām dakṣiṇām hari yūthapaḥ

sanskrit: पश्चिमाम् तु दिशम् घोराम् सुषेणः प्लवगेश्वरः
प्रतस्थे हरि शार्दूलो दिशम् वरुण पालिताम्
transliteration: paścimām tu diśam ghorām suṣeṇaḥ plavageśvaraḥ
pratasthe hari śārdūlo diśam varuṇa pālitām

sanskrit: ततः सर्वा दिशो राजा चोदयित्वा यथा तथम्
कपि सेना पतीन् वीरो मुमोद सुखितः सुखम्
transliteration: tataḥ sarvā diśo rājā codayitvā yathā tatham
kapi senā patīn vīro mumoda sukhitaḥ sukham
english: Then, having properly despatched (his forces) in all directions, that general of the monkey hosts, being pleased, gave himself up to sport.

sanskrit: एवम् संचोदिताः सर्वे राज्ञा वानर यूथपाः
स्वाम् स्वाम् दिशम् अभिप्रेत्य त्वरिताः संप्रतस्थिरे
transliteration: evam saṃcoditāḥ sarve rājñā vānara yūthapāḥ
svām svām diśam abhipretya tvaritāḥ saṃpratasthire
english: Thus despatched by the king, the monkeychiefs proceeded apace respectively towards their destined quarters.

sanskrit: नदन्तः च उन्नदन्तः च गर्जन्तः च प्लवंगमाः
transliteration: nadantaḥ ca unnadantaḥ ca garjantaḥ ca plavaṃgamāḥ

sanskrit: एवम् संचोदिताः सर्वे राज्ञा वानर यूथपाः
transliteration: evam saṃcoditāḥ sarve rājñā vānara yūthapāḥ
english: Thus despatched by the king, the monkeychiefs proceeded apace respectively towards their destined quarters.

sanskrit: अहम् एको वधिष्यामि प्राप्तम् रावणम् आहवे
ततः च उन्मथ्य सहसा हरिष्ये जनक आत्मजाम्
transliteration: aham eko vadhiṣyāmi prāptam rāvaṇam āhave
tataḥ ca unmathya sahasā hariṣye janaka ātmajām

sanskrit: वेपमानम् श्रमेण अद्य भवद्भिः स्थीयताम् इति
एक एव आहरिष्यामि पातालात् अपि जानकीम्
transliteration: vepamānam śrameṇa adya bhavadbhiḥ sthīyatām iti
eka eva āhariṣyāmi pātālāt api jānakīm

sanskrit: विधमिष्यामि अहम् वृक्षान् दारयिष्यामि अहम् गिरीन्
transliteration: vidhamiṣyāmi aham vṛkṣān dārayiṣyāmi aham girīn

sanskrit: अहम् योजन संख्यायाः प्लविता न अत्र संशयः
शतम् योजन संख्यायाः शतम् समधिकम् हि अहम्
transliteration: aham yojana saṃkhyāyāḥ plavitā na atra saṃśayaḥ
śatam yojana saṃkhyāyāḥ śatam samadhikam hi aham

sanskrit: भू तले सागरे वा अपि शैलेषु च वनेषु च
पातालस्य अपि वा मध्ये न मम आच्छिद्यते गतिः
transliteration: bhū tale sāgare vā api śaileṣu ca vaneṣu ca
pātālasya api vā madhye na mama ācchidyate gatiḥ

sanskrit: इति एकैकः तदा तत्र वानरा बल दर्पिताः
ऊचुः च वचनम् तस्य हरि राजस्य सन्निधौ
transliteration: iti ekaikaḥ tadā tatra vānarā bala darpitāḥ
ūcuḥ ca vacanam tasya hari rājasya sannidhau
english: Thus did the apes proud of their strength, severally speak in presence of the sovereign of the monkeys.

sanskrit: कथम् भवान् विजानीते सर्वम् वै मण्डलम् भुवः
transliteration: katham bhavān vijānīte sarvam vai maṇḍalam bhuvaḥ
english: On the monkey-chiefs having departed, Rāma said to Sugrīva, How is it that you know all the quarters of this earth?'

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः च ततो रामम् उवाच प्रणत आत्मवान्
श्रूयताम् सर्वम् आख्यास्ये विस्तरेण वचो मम
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ ca tato rāmam uvāca praṇata ātmavān
śrūyatām sarvam ākhyāsye vistareṇa vaco mama
english: Thereupon, the self-controlled Sugrīva, bowing low, said to Rāma, Do you listen to my words. I shall relate everything.

sanskrit: यदा तु दुंदुभिम् नाम दानवम् महिष आकृतिम्
transliteration: yadā tu duṃdubhim nāma dānavam mahiṣa ākṛtim
english: When Vāli pursued the Dānava Dundubhi, wearing the form of a buffalo towards the Malaya mountain, Mahișa entered a cave of that mountain. And Vali also, desirous of slaying the Asura, entered Malaya.

sanskrit: तदा विवेश महिषो मलयस्य गुहाम् प्रति
विवेश वाली तत्र अपि मलयम् तत् जिघांसया
transliteration: tadā viveśa mahiṣo malayasya guhām prati
viveśa vālī tatra api malayam tat jighāṃsayā
english: When Vāli pursued the Dānava Dundubhi, wearing the form of a buffalo towards the Malaya mountain, Mahișa entered a cave of that mountain. And Vali also, desirous of slaying the Asura, entered Malaya.

sanskrit: ततो अहम् तत्र निक्षिप्तो गुहा द्वारि विनीतवत्
न च निष्क्रमते वाली तदा संवत्सरे गते
transliteration: tato aham tatra nikṣipto guhā dvāri vinītavat
na ca niṣkramate vālī tadā saṃvatsare gate
english: And I was made to stand at the mouth in humble guise; nor did Väli issue out, although a good year rolled away.

sanskrit: ततः क्षतज वेगेन आपुपूरे तदा बिलम्
तत् अहम् विस्मितो दृष्ट्वा भ्रातुः शोक विष अर्दितः
transliteration: tataḥ kṣataja vegena āpupūre tadā bilam
tat aham vismito dṛṣṭvā bhrātuḥ śoka viṣa arditaḥ
english: Then the cave became filled with blood gushing out vehemently. Seeing this, I became amazed, and exercised with the poison of grief of accountri my brother.

sanskrit: अथ अहम् गत बुद्धिः तु सुव्यक्तम् निहतो गुरुः
शिला पर्वत संकाशा बिल द्वारि मया कृता
transliteration: atha aham gata buddhiḥ tu suvyaktam nihato guruḥ
śilā parvata saṃkāśā bila dvāri mayā kṛtā
english: And I, losing my sense, thought that my superior had for certain been slain. And I placed 7 crag huge as a hill at the mouth of the cave. took to my

sanskrit: ततो अहम् आगाम् किष्किंधाम् निराशः तस्य जीविते
transliteration: tato aham āgām kiṣkiṃdhām nirāśaḥ tasya jīvite
