sanskrit: तत् तु श्रुत्वा तदा वाक्यम् अंगदस्य मुख उद्गतम्
अब्रवीत् वचनम् गृध्रः तीक्ष्ण तुण्डो महास्वनः
transliteration: tat tu śrutvā tadā vākyam aṃgadasya mukha udgatam
abravīt vacanam gṛdhraḥ tīkṣṇa tuṇḍo mahāsvanaḥ
english: Hearing the words that issued from Angada's mouth, the sharp-beaked and high-toned vulture, said,

sanskrit: को अयम् गिरा घोषयति प्राणैः प्रियतरस्य मे
जटायुषो वधम् भ्रातुः कंपयन् इव मे मनः
transliteration: ko ayam girā ghoṣayati prāṇaiḥ priyatarasya me
jaṭāyuṣo vadham bhrātuḥ kaṃpayan iva me manaḥ
english: Who is it that, making my mind tremble, speak of the death of my brother, Jațāyu, dearer to me than life.

sanskrit: कथम् आसीत् जनस्थाने युद्धम् राक्षस गृध्रयोः
नामधेयम् इदम् भ्रातुः चिरस्य अद्य मया श्रुतम्
transliteration: katham āsīt janasthāne yuddham rākṣasa gṛdhrayoḥ
nāmadheyam idam bhrātuḥ cirasya adya mayā śrutam
english: How happened in Janasthāna the fight between the Rākṣasa and the vulture? It is after a long time that to-day I hear the name of my brother.

sanskrit: इच्छेयम् गिरि दुर्गात् च भवद्भिः अवतारितुम्
transliteration: iccheyam giri durgāt ca bhavadbhiḥ avatāritum

sanskrit: अति दीर्घस्य कालस्य परितुष्टो अस्मि कीर्तितनात्
तत् इच्छेयम् अहम् श्रोतुम् विनाशम् वानर ऋषभाः
transliteration: ati dīrghasya kālasya parituṣṭo asmi kīrtitanāt
tat iccheyam aham śrotum vināśam vānara ṛṣabhāḥ

sanskrit: तस्य एव च मम भ्रातुः सखा दशरथः कथम्
transliteration: tasya eva ca mama bhrātuḥ sakhā daśarathaḥ katham

sanskrit: यस्य रामः प्रियः पुत्रो ज्येष्ठो गुरु जन प्रियः
सूर्य अंशु दग्ध पक्षत्वात् न शक्नोमि विसर्पितुम्
transliteration: yasya rāmaḥ priyaḥ putro jyeṣṭho guru jana priyaḥ
sūrya aṃśu dagdha pakṣatvāt na śaknomi visarpitum
english: I can not move in consequence of my wings having been burnt by the solar rays. But I wish that you may take me down from this mountain.

sanskrit: शोकात् भ्रष्ट स्वरम् अपि श्रुत्वा ते हरि यूथपाः
श्रद्दधुः न एव तत् वाक्यम् कर्मणा तस्य शन्किताः
transliteration: śokāt bhraṣṭa svaram api śrutvā te hari yūthapāḥ
śraddadhuḥ na eva tat vākyam karmaṇā tasya śankitāḥ
english: Hearing his accents faltering through grief, the leaders of monkey-herds, alarmed by his action*, did not repose confidence in his speech. Karmaņā (instru.) by his action. The commentator explains: alarmed by his speech about eating up the monkeys. The passage is

sanskrit: ते प्रायम् उपविष्टाः तु दृष्ट्वा गृध्रम् प्लवंगमाः
चक्रुः बुद्धिम् तदा रौद्राम् सर्वान् नः भक्षयिष्यति
transliteration: te prāyam upaviṣṭāḥ tu dṛṣṭvā gṛdhram plavaṃgamāḥ
cakruḥ buddhim tadā raudrām sarvān naḥ bhakṣayiṣyati
english: Seated for the purpose of fasting to death, the monkeys, seeing the vulture, with terror thought within themselves, he shall eat us all up.

sanskrit: सर्वथा प्रायम् आसीनान् यदि नः भक्षयिष्यति
कृत कृत्या भविष्यामः क्षिप्रम् सिद्धिम् इतो गताः
transliteration: sarvathā prāyam āsīnān yadi naḥ bhakṣayiṣyati
kṛta kṛtyā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṣipram siddhim ito gatāḥ
english: If he eat us up, who have sat down to fast to death, we shall secure success, and speedily attain our end.

sanskrit: एताम् बुद्धिम् ततः चक्रुः सर्वे ते हरि यूथपाः
अवतार्य गिरेः शृंगात् गृध्रम् आह अंगदः तदा
transliteration: etām buddhim tataḥ cakruḥ sarve te hari yūthapāḥ
avatārya gireḥ śṛṃgāt gṛdhram āha aṃgadaḥ tadā
english: Then those monkey-chiefs resolved thus. And descending from the summit of the mountain, Angada spoke to the vulture,

sanskrit: मम आर्यः पार्थिवः पक्षिन् धार्मिकौ तस्य च आत्मजौ
transliteration: mama āryaḥ pārthivaḥ pakṣin dhārmikau tasya ca ātmajau
english: There was a lord of monkeys named Riksaraja, endowed with prowess. That king, O bird, was my grandsire. He had two virtuous sons, exceedingly powerful both-Vāli and Sugriva. My father, Vali, was famed in the world for his deeds.

sanskrit: सुग्रीवः चैव वली च पुत्रौ घन बलौ उभौ
लोके विश्रुत कर्मा अभूत् राजा वाली पिता मम
transliteration: sugrīvaḥ caiva valī ca putrau ghana balau ubhau
loke viśruta karmā abhūt rājā vālī pitā mama
english: There was a lord of monkeys named Riksaraja, endowed with prowess. That king, O bird, was my grandsire. He had two virtuous sons, exceedingly powerful both-Vāli and Sugriva. My father, Vali, was famed in the world for his deeds.

sanskrit: रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् प्रविष्टो दण्डका वनम्
transliteration: rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmān praviṣṭo daṇḍakā vanam
english: It came to pass that mighty monarch of all this earth, descendant of the Ikṣwākus, the great and graceful car warrior, Rāma, son to Dasaratha, intent upon the injunction of his sire, resorting to the path of righteousness, entered the woods of Dandaka in company with his brother, Lakşmaņa and his wife Vaidehī.

sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या च अपि भार्यया
पितुः निदेश निरतो धर्मम् पन्थानम् आश्रितः
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā ca api bhāryayā
pituḥ nideśa nirato dharmam panthānam āśritaḥ
english: It came to pass that mighty monarch of all this earth, descendant of the Ikṣwākus, the great and graceful car warrior, Rāma, son to Dasaratha, intent upon the injunction of his sire, resorting to the path of righteousness, entered the woods of Dandaka in company with his brother, Lakşmaņa and his wife Vaidehī.

sanskrit: तस्य भार्या जनस्थानात् रावणेन हृता बलात्
रामस्य च पितुः मित्रम् जटायुः नाम गृध्र राट्
transliteration: tasya bhāryā janasthānāt rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt
rāmasya ca pituḥ mitram jaṭāyuḥ nāma gṛdhra rāṭ

sanskrit: रावणम् विरथम् कृत्वा स्थापयित्वा च मैथिलीम्
परिश्रान्तः च वृद्धः च रावणेन हतो रणे
transliteration: rāvaṇam viratham kṛtvā sthāpayitvā ca maithilīm
pariśrāntaḥ ca vṛddhaḥ ca rāvaṇena hato raṇe
english: His spouse was forcibly carried away from Janasthāna. And the friend of Rāma's father, the king of vultures, named Jatayu, saw Videha's daughter, Sītā, as she was being carried away in the sky. And after having thrown down Rāvana from his car, and placed Maithili on the ground, (that vulture) old and overcome with fatigue was (at length) slain by Ravana in battle.

sanskrit: एवम् गृध्रो हतः तेन रावणेन बलीयसा
संस्कृतः च अपि रामेण गतः च गतिम् उत्तमाम्
transliteration: evam gṛdhro hataḥ tena rāvaṇena balīyasā
saṃskṛtaḥ ca api rāmeṇa gataḥ ca gatim uttamām
english: Thus slain by the powerful Rāvana, the vulture, having had his funereal obsequies performed by Rama. (himself), has attained excellent state.

sanskrit: चकार राघवः सख्यम् सः अवधीत् पितरम् मम
transliteration: cakāra rāghavaḥ sakhyam saḥ avadhīt pitaram mama
english: Then Rāghava made friends with my uncle, the high-souled Sugrīva; and he also slew my sire.

sanskrit: मम पित्रा विरुद्धो हि सुग्रीवः सचिवैः सह
निहत्य वालिनम् रामः ततः तम् अभिषेचयत्
transliteration: mama pitrā viruddho hi sugrīvaḥ sacivaiḥ saha
nihatya vālinam rāmaḥ tataḥ tam abhiṣecayat
english: My father had debarred Sugrīva from the kingdom along with his counsellors; but Rāma, having slain Vāli, installed him (Sugrīva).

sanskrit: स राज्ये स्थापितः तेन सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
राजा वानर मुख्यानाम् तेन प्रस्थापिता वयम्
transliteration: sa rājye sthāpitaḥ tena sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ
rājā vānara mukhyānām tena prasthāpitā vayam
english: And established in the monarchy by him (Rāma), Sugriva is (now) the master of the monkeys and king of all the foremost monkeys. By him have we been sent.

sanskrit: एवम् राम प्रयुक्ताः तु मार्गमाणाः ततः ततः
वैदेहीम् न अधिगच्छामो रात्रौ सूर्य प्रभाम् इव
transliteration: evam rāma prayuktāḥ tu mārgamāṇāḥ tataḥ tataḥ
vaidehīm na adhigacchāmo rātrau sūrya prabhām iva
english: Despatched hither by Rāma, we have searched for Sītā all round, but Vaidehī we have not found, as one does not find the solar splendour at night.

sanskrit: अज्ञानात् तु प्रविष्टाः स्म धरण्या विवृतम् बिलम्
transliteration: ajñānāt tu praviṣṭāḥ sma dharaṇyā vivṛtam bilam
english: It came to pass that, having heedfully explored the Dandaka forest, we through ignorance entered a cave lying open before.

sanskrit: मयस्य माया विहितम् तत् बिलम् च विचिन्वताम्
व्यतीतः तत्र नः मासः यः राज्ञा समयः कृतः
transliteration: mayasya māyā vihitam tat bilam ca vicinvatām
vyatītaḥ tatra naḥ māsaḥ yaḥ rājñā samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
english: That cave, you must know, was constructed by the illusive energy of Maya. And there we spent a month the term which had been fixed by the monarch.

sanskrit: ते वयम् कपि राजस्य सर्वे वचन कारिणः
कृताम् संस्थाम् अतिक्रान्ता भयात् प्रायम् उपासिताः
transliteration: te vayam kapi rājasya sarve vacana kāriṇaḥ
kṛtām saṃsthām atikrāntā bhayāt prāyam upāsitāḥ
english: Doing the behests of the king of monkeys, we, having overstayed the terms which had been appointed, have from fear sat here down for the purpose of fasting to death.

sanskrit: क्रुद्धे तस्मिन् तु काकुत्स्थे सुग्रीवे च स लक्ष्मणे
गतानाम् अपि सर्वेषाम् तत्र नः न अस्ति जीवितम्
transliteration: kruddhe tasmin tu kākutsthe sugrīve ca sa lakṣmaṇe
gatānām api sarveṣām tatra naḥ na asti jīvitam
english: On that Kākutstha being wrought up with wrath, as well as Sugrīva together with Lakş maņa, we, repairing thither, shall lose our lives.

sanskrit: इति उक्तः करुणम् वाक्यम् वानरैः त्यक्त जीवितैः
स बाष्पो वानरान् गृध्रः प्रत्युवाच महास्वनः
transliteration: iti uktaḥ karuṇam vākyam vānaraiḥ tyakta jīvitaiḥ
sa bāṣpo vānarān gṛdhraḥ pratyuvāca mahāsvanaḥ
english: When the monkeys, whose lives had well nigh departed out of them, had spoken these piteous words, the vulture, in solemn accents, with tears in his eyes, said to the monkeys,

sanskrit: यवीयान् मम स भ्राता जटायुः नाम वानराः
यम् आख्यात हतम् युद्धे रावणेन बलीयसा
transliteration: yavīyān mama sa bhrātā jaṭāyuḥ nāma vānarāḥ
yam ākhyāta hatam yuddhe rāvaṇena balīyasā
english: You monkeys, you have said that my younger brother, named Jaţāyu, has been slain in battle by the powerful Rāvaņa.

sanskrit: वृद्ध भावात् अपक्षत्वात् शृण्वन् तत् अपि मर्षये
न हि मे शक्तिः अद्य अस्ति भ्रातुः वैर विमोक्षणे
transliteration: vṛddha bhāvāt apakṣatvāt śṛṇvan tat api marṣaye
na hi me śaktiḥ adya asti bhrātuḥ vaira vimokṣaṇe
english: On account of my age and want of wings, I, although hearing this, bear it. Nor have I strength to-day to clear scores touching my brother's enmity.

sanskrit: पुरा वृत्र वधे वृत्ते स च अहम् च जय एषिणौ
आदित्यम् उपयातौ स्वो ज्वलंतम् रश्मि मालिनम्
transliteration: purā vṛtra vadhe vṛtte sa ca aham ca jaya eṣiṇau
ādityam upayātau svo jvalaṃtam raśmi mālinam
english: Formerly, while engaged in the destruction of Vrtra, he and I, burning for victory, soared in the sky near the flaming sun, garlanded by glory. Thence impetuously wheeling round, we went to the celestial regions along the etherial way. And it came to pass that, coming midway of the sun, Jațāyu was faint.

sanskrit: आवृत्य आकाश मार्गेण जवेन स्वर् गतौ भृशम्
मध्यम् प्राप्ते च सूर्ये च जटायुः अवसीदति
transliteration: āvṛtya ākāśa mārgeṇa javena svar gatau bhṛśam
madhyam prāpte ca sūrye ca jaṭāyuḥ avasīdati
english: Formerly, while engaged in the destruction of Vrtra, he and I, burning for victory, soared in the sky near the flaming sun, garlanded by glory. Thence impetuously wheeling round, we went to the celestial regions along the etherial way. And it came to pass that, coming midway of the sun, Jațāyu was faint.

sanskrit: तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् दृष्ट्वा सूर्य रश्मिभिः अर्दितम्
transliteration: tam aham bhrātaram dṛṣṭvā sūrya raśmibhiḥ arditam
english: Witnessing my brother severely struck by the solar rays and exceedingly stupefied, I from affection shadowed him with my wings.

sanskrit: निर्दग्ध पत्रः पतितो विन्ध्ये अहम् वानरर्षभाः
अहम् अस्मिन् वसन् भ्रातुः प्रवृत्तिम् न उपलक्षये
transliteration: nirdagdha patraḥ patito vindhye aham vānararṣabhāḥ
aham asmin vasan bhrātuḥ pravṛttim na upalakṣaye
english: Thereat, my pinions scathed, I dropped down on Vindhya, you foremost of monkeys; and staying here, I could not know the circumstances that have befallen my brother.

sanskrit: जटायुषः तु एवम् उक्तो भ्रात्रा सम्पातिना तदा
युव राजो महाप्राज्ञः प्रत्युवाच अंगदः तदा
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣaḥ tu evam ukto bhrātrā sampātinā tadā
yuva rājo mahāprājñaḥ pratyuvāca aṃgadaḥ tadā
english: Thus addressed by Jatāyu's brother, Sampāti, the eminently wise prince Angada answered,

sanskrit: जटायुषो यदि भ्राता श्रुतम् ते गदितम् मया
आख्याहि यदि जानासि निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo yadi bhrātā śrutam te gaditam mayā
ākhyāhi yadi jānāsi nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ
english: 'If you are indeed the brother of Jațāyu, having heard what I have related, tell (us) if you know touching the abode of that Rākşasa. Tell us if you know anent that short-sighted worst of Raksasas, Ravana, whether staying far or near.

sanskrit: अदीर्घ दर्शिनम् तम् वा रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम्
अन्तिके यदि वा दूरे यदि जानासि शंस नः
transliteration: adīrgha darśinam tam vā rāvaṇam rākṣasādhipam
antike yadi vā dūre yadi jānāsi śaṃsa naḥ
english: 'If you are indeed the brother of Jațāyu, having heard what I have related, tell (us) if you know touching the abode of that Rākşasa. Tell us if you know anent that short-sighted worst of Raksasas, Ravana, whether staying far or near.

sanskrit: ततो अब्रवीत् महातेजा भ्राता ज्येष्ठो जटायुषः
transliteration: tato abravīt mahātejā bhrātā jyeṣṭho jaṭāyuṣaḥ
english: Thereat, rejoicing the monkeys, the exceedingly energetic elder brother of Jațāyu spoke words worthy of him.

sanskrit: निर्दग्ध पक्षो गृध्रो अहम् गत वीर्यः प्लवम् गमाः
वाङ् मात्रेण तु रामस्य करिष्ये साह्यम् उत्तमम्
transliteration: nirdagdha pakṣo gṛdhro aham gata vīryaḥ plavam gamāḥ
vāṅ mātreṇa tu rāmasya kariṣye sāhyam uttamam
english: You monkeys, my pinions have been burnt; and I am a vulture shorn of strength. Therefore I will help Rāma well by my words.

sanskrit: जानामि वारुणान् लोकान् विष्णोः त्रैविक्रमान् अपि
देव असुर विमर्दाम् च हि अमृतस्य च मंथनम्
transliteration: jānāmi vāruṇān lokān viṣṇoḥ traivikramān api
deva asura vimardām ca hi amṛtasya ca maṃthanam
english: I know the realms of Varuna, and Visnu's Trivikrama* worlds, the wars of the gods and Asuras, and the churning for ambrosia. *i.e. the worlds enveloped by his three steps during his Dwarf incarnation.

sanskrit: रामस्य यत् इदम् कार्यम् कर्तव्यम् प्रथमम् मया
जरया च हतम् तेजः प्राणाः च शिथिला मम
transliteration: rāmasya yat idam kāryam kartavyam prathamam mayā
jarayā ca hatam tejaḥ prāṇāḥ ca śithilā mama
english: And albeit age has deprived me of energy, and albeit my life hangs loosely on me, yet, if this is Rāma's work, it should be done by me first.

sanskrit: तरुणी रूप संपन्ना सर्व आभरण भूषिता
transliteration: taruṇī rūpa saṃpannā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā
english: I have seen a youthful and beautiful female, adorned with all ornaments, carried away by the wicked Rāvana,

sanskrit: क्रोशन्ती राम राम इति लक्ष्मण इति च भामिनी
transliteration: krośantī rāma rāma iti lakṣmaṇa iti ca bhāminī
english: The lady (all the while) crying, 'O Rāma!' 'O Rāma!' '0 Lakşmaņa! And And taking her ornaments from her person, she was throwing them on the ground.

sanskrit: सूर्य प्रभा इव शैल अग्रे तस्याः कौशेयम् उत्तमम्
असिते राक्षसे भाति यथा वा तडित् अंबुदे
transliteration: sūrya prabhā iva śaila agre tasyāḥ kauśeyam uttamam
asite rākṣase bhāti yathā vā taḍit aṃbude
english: Her silken cloth seemed like the solar splendour on the summit of a mountain; and herself beside the sable Rākşasa, looked like the lightning in the welkin (beside clouds).

sanskrit: ताम् तु सीताम् अहम् मन्ये रामस्य परिकीर्तनात्
श्रूयताम् मे कथयतो निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः
transliteration: tām tu sītām aham manye rāmasya parikīrtanāt
śrūyatām me kathayato nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ
english: From your relation of Rāma, I conclude that she must be Sītā. Now listen to me as I tell you about the abode of that Rākşasa.

sanskrit: पुत्रो विश्रवसः साक्षात् भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च
अध्यास्ते नगरीम् लंकाम् रावणो नाम राक्षसः
transliteration: putro viśravasaḥ sākṣāt bhrātā vaiśravaṇasya ca
adhyāste nagarīm laṃkām rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ
english: Son to Viśravana and brother to Vaiśravaņa, the Rākşasa named Rāvana resides in the city of Lankā.

sanskrit: इतो द्वीपे समुद्रस्य संपूर्णे शत योजने
तस्मिन् लंका पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा
transliteration: ito dvīpe samudrasya saṃpūrṇe śata yojane
tasmin laṃkā purī ramyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā

sanskrit: प्रासादैः हेम वर्णैः च महद्भिः सुसमाकृता
transliteration: prāsādaiḥ hema varṇaiḥ ca mahadbhiḥ susamākṛtā

sanskrit: प्राकारेण अर्क वर्णेन महता च समन्विता
तस्याम् वसति वैदेही दीना कौशेय वासिनी
transliteration: prākāreṇa arka varṇena mahatā ca samanvitā
tasyām vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeya vāsinī

sanskrit: जनकस्य आत्मजाम् राज्ञः तस्याम् द्रक्ष्यथ मैथिलीम्
transliteration: janakasya ātmajām rājñaḥ tasyām drakṣyatha maithilīm

sanskrit: संप्राप्य सागरस्य अंतम् संपूर्णम् शत योजनम्
transliteration: saṃprāpya sāgarasya aṃtam saṃpūrṇam śata yojanam

sanskrit: आसाद्य दक्षिणम् तीरम् ततो द्रक्ष्यथ रावणम्
तत्र एव त्वरिताः क्षिप्रम् विक्रमध्वम् प्लवंगमाः
transliteration: āsādya dakṣiṇam tīram tato drakṣyatha rāvaṇam
tatra eva tvaritāḥ kṣipram vikramadhvam plavaṃgamāḥ
english: As the end of the ocean after a full hundred Yojanas, arriving at its southern shore, you shall see Rāvana in Laņkā, protected by ocean from all sides. You monkeys, do you hie thither speedily with vigour.

sanskrit: आद्यः पंथाः कुलिंगानाम् ये च अन्ये धान्य जीविनः
transliteration: ādyaḥ paṃthāḥ kuliṃgānām ye ca anye dhānya jīvinaḥ
english: I perceive by my knowledge that having seen (that place) you shall come back. The first course belongs to forktailed shrikes and others living on grain.

sanskrit: द्वितीयो बलि भोजानाम् ये च वृक्ष फल अशिनः
भासाः तृतीयम् गच्छन्ति क्रौन्चाः च कुररैः सह
transliteration: dvitīyo bali bhojānām ye ca vṛkṣa phala aśinaḥ
bhāsāḥ tṛtīyam gacchanti krauncāḥ ca kuraraiḥ saha

sanskrit: श्येनाः चतुर्थम् गच्छन्ति गृध्रा गच्छन्ति पंचमम्
बल वीर्य उपपन्नानाम् रूप यौवन शालिनाम्
transliteration: śyenāḥ caturtham gacchanti gṛdhrā gacchanti paṃcamam
bala vīrya upapannānām rūpa yauvana śālinām

sanskrit: षष्ठः तु पन्था हंसानाम् वैनतेय गतिः परा
वैनतेयात् च नः जन्म सर्वेषाम् वानरर्षभाः
transliteration: ṣaṣṭhaḥ tu panthā haṃsānām vainateya gatiḥ parā
vainateyāt ca naḥ janma sarveṣām vānararṣabhāḥ

sanskrit: गर्हितम् तु कृतम् कर्म येन स्म पिशित अशनाः
प्रतिकार्यम् च मे तस्य वैरम् भ्रातृ कृतम् भवेत्
transliteration: garhitam tu kṛtam karma yena sma piśita aśanāḥ
pratikāryam ca me tasya vairam bhrātṛ kṛtam bhavet
english: (By despatching you thither), I shall avenge the heinous deed perpetrated by the cannibal, as well as the wrong done by Rāvana to my brother.

sanskrit: इह स्थः अहम् प्रपश्यामि रावणम् जानकीम् तथा
अस्माकम् अपि सौपर्णम् दिव्यम् चक्षुर् बलम् तथा
transliteration: iha sthaḥ aham prapaśyāmi rāvaṇam jānakīm tathā
asmākam api sauparṇam divyam cakṣur balam tathā
english: Resting here, I see Ravana and Janaki. We have excellent Sauparana' clairvoyance. *Clairvoyance attained by success in knowledge respecting the spiritual Golden eyes. Thus far the commentator. We leave the abstruse point to the apostles of theosophy and spiritism for illucidation.

sanskrit: तस्मात् आहार वीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः
आयोजन शतात् साग्रात् वयम् पश्याम नित्यशः
transliteration: tasmāt āhāra vīryeṇa nisargeṇa ca vānarāḥ
āyojana śatāt sāgrāt vayam paśyāma nityaśaḥ
english: For this reason, as well as owing to the energy consequent on our feeding on certain kinds of flesh, we, you monkeys, can see a little further than an hundred Yojanas.

sanskrit: अस्माकम् विहिता वृत्तिः निसार्गेण च दूरतः
विहिता पाद मूले तु वृत्तिः चरण योधिनाम्
transliteration: asmākam vihitā vṛttiḥ nisārgeṇa ca dūrataḥ
vihitā pāda mūle tu vṛttiḥ caraṇa yodhinām
english: Therefore (the Deity) has ordained such food for us as are fraught with the power of making one see from a great distance. And the abode of cocks and others being underneath trees, their sight is limited to the extent which they require to see.

sanskrit: उपायो दृश्यताम् कश्चित् लंघने लवण अंभसः
अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीम् समृद्ध अर्था गमिष्यथ
transliteration: upāyo dṛśyatām kaścit laṃghane lavaṇa aṃbhasaḥ
abhigamya tu vaidehīm samṛddha arthā gamiṣyatha
english: Do you look about for means to cross over the salt waters. Having met with Vaidehi, do you, having achieved success, come back. I wish to be taken by you to the ocean-abode of Varuna. I will offer water to (the manes of) my highsouled brother, who has gone to heaven.

sanskrit: समुद्रम् नेतुम् इच्छामि भवद्भिः वरुण आलयम्
प्रदास्यामि उदकम् भ्रातुः स्वर् गतस्य महात्मनः
transliteration: samudram netum icchāmi bhavadbhiḥ varuṇa ālayam
pradāsyāmi udakam bhrātuḥ svar gatasya mahātmanaḥ
english: Do you look about for means to cross over the salt waters. Having met with Vaidehi, do you, having achieved success, come back. I wish to be taken by you to the ocean-abode of Varuna. I will offer water to (the manes of) my highsouled brother, who has gone to heaven.

sanskrit: ततो नीत्वा तु तम् देशम् तीरे नद नदी पतेः
transliteration: tato nītvā tu tam deśam tīre nada nadī pateḥ
english: Thereat those heroes, the monkeys possessed of exceeding energy, carried to the destined spot on the shore of the ocean, Sampāti, whose wings had been scathed. Then carrying that lord of vultures back to the self-same place, the monkeys, furnished with information (concerning Sītā), experienced great joy.

sanskrit: तम् पुनः प्रत्यानयित्वा वै तम् देशम् पतग ईश्वरम्
बभूवुः वानरा हृष्टाः प्रवृत्तिम् उपलभ्य ते
transliteration: tam punaḥ pratyānayitvā vai tam deśam pataga īśvaram
babhūvuḥ vānarā hṛṣṭāḥ pravṛttim upalabhya te
english: Thereat those heroes, the monkeys possessed of exceeding energy, carried to the destined spot on the shore of the ocean, Sampāti, whose wings had been scathed. Then carrying that lord of vultures back to the self-same place, the monkeys, furnished with information (concerning Sītā), experienced great joy.

sanskrit: ततः तत् अमृत आस्वादम् गृध्र राजेन भाषितम्
निशम्य मुदितो हृष्टाः ते वचः प्लवगर्षभाः
transliteration: tataḥ tat amṛta āsvādam gṛdhra rājena bhāṣitam
niśamya mudito hṛṣṭāḥ te vacaḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ
english: Then hearing that ambrosial speech of the vulture-king, the monkey-chiefs, being delighted, kept on parleying (on that topic).

sanskrit: जांबवान् वानर श्रेष्ठः सह सर्वैः प्लवंगमैः
भू तलात् सहसा उत्थाय गृध्र राजानम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: jāṃbavān vānara śreṣṭhaḥ saha sarvaiḥ plavaṃgamaiḥ
bhū talāt sahasā utthāya gṛdhra rājānam abravīt
english: Then Jāmbavān-foremost of monkeystogether with all the monkeys, arising suddenly from the ground, spoke to the vulture-king, saying,

sanskrit: क्व सीता केन वा दृष्टा को वा हरति मैथिलीम्
तत् आख्यातु भवान् सर्वम् गतिः भव वन ओकसाम्
transliteration: kva sītā kena vā dṛṣṭā ko vā harati maithilīm
tat ākhyātu bhavān sarvam gatiḥ bhava vana okasām
english: Where is Sītā? By whom has she been seen? And who has carried away Mithila's daughter? Do you tell us all about this, and (thus) prove the path of these rangers of the woods.

sanskrit: को दाशरथि बाणानाम् वज्र वेग निपातिनाम्
स्वयम् लक्ष्मणम् मुक्तानाम् न चिंतयति विक्रमम्
transliteration: ko dāśarathi bāṇānām vajra vega nipātinām
svayam lakṣmaṇam muktānām na ciṃtayati vikramam
english: Who is there that does not take heed of the force of Dasarathi's* and Laksmana's arrows, speeding with the vehemence of thunder? *Lit. Dasaratha's son. The term is applied in especial to Rāma.

sanskrit: स हरीन् प्रति संयुक्तान् सीता श्रुति समाहितान्
पुनः आश्वासयन् प्रीत इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa harīn prati saṃyuktān sītā śruti samāhitān
punaḥ āśvāsayan prīta idam vacanam abravīt
english: Thereat, cheering up those monkeys, who had risen from their attitudes of fasting, and who were all attention to hear news concerning Sītā, he (Sampāti), well pleased, said these words,

sanskrit: श्रूयताम् इह वैदेह्या यथा मे हरणम् श्रुतम्
येन च अपि मम आख्यातम् यत्र च आयत लोचना
transliteration: śrūyatām iha vaidehyā yathā me haraṇam śrutam
yena ca api mama ākhyātam yatra ca āyata locanā
english: Listen as to how I came to know of the ravishment of Vaidehī, Sītā, at this place; and who it was that told me where that one of expansive eyes is.

sanskrit: अहम् अस्मिन् गिरौ दुर्गे बहु योजनम् आयते
चिरात् निपतितो वृद्धः क्षीण प्राण पराक्रमः
transliteration: aham asmin girau durge bahu yojanam āyate
cirāt nipatito vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇa prāṇa parākramaḥ
english: For a long time I lay here, old, and of feeble life and energy. that best of birds, my son named Supārswa, coming to me, at the proper hour maintained me with food.

sanskrit: तम् माम् एवम् गतम् पुत्रः सुपार्श्वो नाम नामतः
आहारेण यथा कालम् बिभर्ति पतताम् वरः
transliteration: tam mām evam gatam putraḥ supārśvo nāma nāmataḥ
āhāreṇa yathā kālam bibharti patatām varaḥ
english: For a long time I lay here, old, and of feeble life and energy. that best of birds, my son named Supārswa, coming to me, at the proper hour maintained me with food.

sanskrit: तीक्ष्ण कामाः तु गंधर्वाः तीक्ष्ण कोपा भुजंगमाः
मृगाणाम् तु भयम् तीक्ष्णम् ततः तीक्ष्ण क्षुधा वयम्
transliteration: tīkṣṇa kāmāḥ tu gaṃdharvāḥ tīkṣṇa kopā bhujaṃgamāḥ
mṛgāṇām tu bhayam tīkṣṇam tataḥ tīkṣṇa kṣudhā vayam
english: Gandharvas exceedingly lascivious; serpents are exceedingly wrathful; fear is excessive in deer; and we have excessive hunger.

sanskrit: स कदाचित् क्षुधा आर्तस्य मम आहार कान्क्षिणः
गत सूर्यो अहनि प्राप्तो मम पुत्रो हि अनामिषः
transliteration: sa kadācit kṣudhā ārtasya mama āhāra kānkṣiṇaḥ
gata sūryo ahani prāpto mama putro hi anāmiṣaḥ
english: Once on a time my son, going forth about sunrise to procure food for me who was suffering from hunger and (accordingly) eager for it, came back in the evening without any flesh. are

sanskrit: स मया आहार संरोधात् पीडितः प्रीति वर्धनः
अनुमान्य यथा तत्त्वम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: sa mayā āhāra saṃrodhāt pīḍitaḥ prīti vardhanaḥ
anumānya yathā tattvam idam vacanam abravīt
english: Hurt (by my speech uttered) in consequence of my non-receipt of food, that enhancer of my joy, asking my forgiveness, said these words fraught with fact,

sanskrit: अहम् तात यथा कालम् आमिष अर्थी खम् आप्लुतः
महेन्द्रस्य गिरेः द्वारम् आवृत्य च सुसमाश्रितः
transliteration: aham tāta yathā kālam āmiṣa arthī kham āplutaḥ
mahendrasya gireḥ dvāram āvṛtya ca susamāśritaḥ
english: 'Father, taking to my wings at the proper time for procuring flesh, I (went) and stood, obstructing the pass of the Mahendra mountain.

sanskrit: तत्र सत्त्व सहस्राणाम् सागर अन्तर चारिणाम्
पंथानम् एको अध्यवसम् संनिरोद्धुम् अवाङ् मुखः
transliteration: tatra sattva sahasrāṇām sāgara antara cāriṇām
paṃthānam eko adhyavasam saṃniroddhum avāṅ mukhaḥ
english: There stood I looking down, obstructing the way of thousands of creatures ranging the sea.

sanskrit: तत्र कश्चित् मया दृष्टः सूर्य उदय सम प्रभाम्
स्त्रियम् आदाय गच्छन् वै भिन्न अंजन चय उपमः
transliteration: tatra kaścit mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sūrya udaya sama prabhām
striyam ādāya gacchan vai bhinna aṃjana caya upamaḥ
english: There I saw somebody resembling a mass of crushed collyrium, going away, taking a female resembling the rising sun in splendour.

sanskrit: सो अहम् अभ्यवहार अर्थम् तौ दृष्ट्वा कृत निश्चयः
transliteration: so aham abhyavahāra artham tau dṛṣṭvā kṛta niścayaḥ
english: Seeing them I had made up my mind that they should serve for your fare, when he humbly in a pacific manner begged for way.

sanskrit: न हि साम उपपन्नानाम् प्रहर्ता विद्यते भुवि
नीचेषु अपि जनः कश्चित् किम् अङ्ग बत मत् विधः
transliteration: na hi sāma upapannānām prahartā vidyate bhuvi
nīceṣu api janaḥ kaścit kim aṅga bata mat vidhaḥ
english: Even among the mean, there is none on earth that can slay people who assume a mild attitude. What shall I say, alas! of superior ones like myself?

sanskrit: स यातः तेजसा व्योम संक्षिपन् इव वेगतः
अथ अहम् खे चरैः भूतैः अभिगम्य सभाजितः
transliteration: sa yātaḥ tejasā vyoma saṃkṣipan iva vegataḥ
atha aham khe caraiḥ bhūtaiḥ abhigamya sabhājitaḥ
english: And summoning celerity, he went on as if pushing off the sky by his energy. Then the rangers of the air and other beings worshipped me.

sanskrit: दिष्ट्या जीवति सीत इति हि अब्रुवन् माम् महर्षयः
कथंचित् स कलत्रः असौ गतः ते स्वस्ति असंशयम्
transliteration: diṣṭyā jīvati sīta iti hi abruvan mām maharṣayaḥ
kathaṃcit sa kalatraḥ asau gataḥ te svasti asaṃśayam
english: And the Maharsis said to me,-By luck it is that Sītā is still living' — he together with a female, having passed by you, certainly augurs good fortune to you. 1. The commentator supplies the elipsis thus,-Coming within your ken by fuck, Sītā is living. 2. The passage is obscure. The commentator has glossed over this sloka, and the meaning is lone the clear for his explanation.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्तः ततो अहम् तैः सिद्धैः परम शोभनैः
स च मे रावणो राजा रक्षसाम् प्रतिवेदितः
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tato aham taiḥ siddhaiḥ parama śobhanaiḥ
sa ca me rāvaṇo rājā rakṣasām prativeditaḥ
english: Then those eminently handsome Siddhas spoke thus to me.-This is Ravana, the king of the Rākşasas, said they to me.

sanskrit: पश्यन् दाशरथेः भार्याम् रामस्य जनक आत्मजाम्
भ्रष्ट आभरण कौशेयाम् शोक वेग पराजिताम्
transliteration: paśyan dāśaratheḥ bhāryām rāmasya janaka ātmajām
bhraṣṭa ābharaṇa kauśeyām śoka vega parājitām

sanskrit: राम लक्ष्मणयोः नाम क्रोशन्तीम् मुक्त मूर्धजाम्
एष काल अत्ययः तात इति वाक्यविदाम् वरः
transliteration: rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ nāma krośantīm mukta mūrdhajām
eṣa kāla atyayaḥ tāta iti vākyavidām varaḥ

sanskrit: एतत् अर्थम् समग्रम् मे सुपार्श्वः प्रत्यवेदयत्
तत् श्रुत्वा अपि हि मे बुद्धिः न आसीत् काचित् पराक्रमे
transliteration: etat artham samagram me supārśvaḥ pratyavedayat
tat śrutvā api hi me buddhiḥ na āsīt kācit parākrame

sanskrit: अपक्षो हि कथम् पक्षी कर्म किंचित् समारभेत्
यत् तु शक्यम् मया कर्तुम् वाक् बुद्धि गुण वर्तिना
transliteration: apakṣo hi katham pakṣī karma kiṃcit samārabhet
yat tu śakyam mayā kartum vāk buddhi guṇa vartinā
english: How can a bird bereft of wings, undertake any thing? But listen! I will tell you as to what I am capable of through speech, intellect and merit, and what you can exèrt your manliness in.

sanskrit: श्रूयताम् तत्र वक्ष्यामि भवताम् पौरुष आश्रयम्
वाक् मतिभ्याम् हि सार्वेषाम् करिष्यामि प्रियम् हि वः
transliteration: śrūyatām tatra vakṣyāmi bhavatām pauruṣa āśrayam
vāk matibhyām hi sārveṣām kariṣyāmi priyam hi vaḥ

sanskrit: यत् हि दाशरथेः कार्यम् मम तत् न अत्र संशयः
तत् भवन्तो मति श्रेष्ठा बलवन्तो मनस्विनः
transliteration: yat hi dāśaratheḥ kāryam mama tat na atra saṃśayaḥ
tat bhavanto mati śreṣṭhā balavanto manasvinaḥ

sanskrit: प्रहिताः कपि राजेन देवैः अपि दुरासदाः
राम लक्ष्मण बाणाः च निशिताः कंक पत्रिणः
transliteration: prahitāḥ kapi rājena devaiḥ api durāsadāḥ
rāma lakṣmaṇa bāṇāḥ ca niśitāḥ kaṃka patriṇaḥ

sanskrit: त्रयाणाम् अपि लोकानाम् पर्याप्ताः त्राण निग्रहे
कामम् खलु दशग्रीवः तेजो बल समन्वितः
भवताम् तु समर्थानाम् न किंचित् अपि दुष्करम्
transliteration: trayāṇām api lokānām paryāptāḥ trāṇa nigrahe
kāmam khalu daśagrīvaḥ tejo bala samanvitaḥ
bhavatām tu samarthānām na kiṃcit api duṣkaram
english: And although the Ten-necked one is endowed with strength and energy, yet to you who are competent, nothing is hard to accomplish.

sanskrit: तत् अलम् काल संगेन क्रियताम् बुद्धि निश्चयः
न हि कर्मसु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवत् विधाः
transliteration: tat alam kāla saṃgena kriyatām buddhi niścayaḥ
na hi karmasu sajjante buddhimanto bhavat vidhāḥ
english: There is no need of delay. Make up 'yo minds. Persons like you do not give way to laziness in enterprise.

sanskrit: ततः कृत उदकम् स्नातम् तम् गृध्रम् हरि यूथपाः
transliteration: tataḥ kṛta udakam snātam tam gṛdhram hari yūthapāḥ
english: When the vulture had offered oblations of water to the manes of his deceased brother and finished his ablutions, the monkey-chiefs sat down in that charming mountain, surrounding him.

sanskrit: तम् अंगदम् उपासीनम् तैः सर्वैः हरिभिः वृतम्
जनित प्रत्ययो हर्षात् संपातिः पुनः अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tam aṃgadam upāsīnam taiḥ sarvaiḥ haribhiḥ vṛtam
janita pratyayo harṣāt saṃpātiḥ punaḥ abravīt
english: And inspired with confidence in the words of the Nisakara), Sampati, from delight, said to Angada, who was seated, surrounded by all the monkeys.'

sanskrit: कृत्वा निःशब्दम् एक अग्राः शृण्वन्तु हरयो मम
transliteration: kṛtvā niḥśabdam eka agrāḥ śṛṇvantu harayo mama
english: Remaining silent, do you, you monkeys, heedfully hear what I say. I will tell you truly how I came to know Maithili.

sanskrit: अस्य विन्ध्यस्य शिखरे पतितो अस्मि पुरा अनघ
सूर्य ताप परीत अंगो निर्दग्धः सूर्य रश्मिभिः
transliteration: asya vindhyasya śikhare patito asmi purā anagha
sūrya tāpa parīta aṃgo nirdagdhaḥ sūrya raśmibhiḥ
english: My body being affected by solar heat, and my wings burnt by the rays of the sun, O sinless one, I formerly fell to this summit of Vindhya.

sanskrit: लब्ध संज्ञः तु षड् रात्रात् विवशो विह्वलन् इव
वीक्षमाणो दिशः सर्वा न अभिजानामि किंचन
transliteration: labdha saṃjñaḥ tu ṣaḍ rātrāt vivaśo vihvalan iva
vīkṣamāṇo diśaḥ sarvā na abhijānāmi kiṃcana
english: On regaining my senses after six nights, during which I was insensible, I looked around in bewilderment, but could not recognise anything whatever.

sanskrit: ततः तु सागरान् शैलान् नदीः सर्वाः सरांसि च
वनानि च प्रदेशान् च समीक्ष्य मतिः आगताम्
transliteration: tataḥ tu sāgarān śailān nadīḥ sarvāḥ sarāṃsi ca
vanāni ca pradeśān ca samīkṣya matiḥ āgatām
english: Then closely viewing oceans and mountains, rivers and tanks, and woods and countries, my thoughts came back to me.

sanskrit: हृष्ट पक्षि गण आकीर्णः कन्दर उदर कूटवान्
दक्षिणस्य उदधेः तीरे विन्ध्यो अयम् इति निश्चितः
transliteration: hṛṣṭa pakṣi gaṇa ākīrṇaḥ kandara udara kūṭavān
dakṣiṇasya udadheḥ tīre vindhyo ayam iti niścitaḥ
english: Seeing this place abounding in cheerful birds, containing woods and crested with summits, I for certain concluded it to be Vindhya on the shores of the Southern sea.

sanskrit: आसीत् च अत्र आश्रमम् पुण्यम् सुरैः अपि सुपूजितम्
ऋषिः निशाकरो नाम यस्मिन् उग्र तपा अभवत्
transliteration: āsīt ca atra āśramam puṇyam suraiḥ api supūjitam
ṛṣiḥ niśākaro nāma yasmin ugra tapā abhavat
english: And here lay a sacred asylum, honoured even by the celestials, and here dwelt a saint named Niśākara, of fierce austerities.

sanskrit: अष्टौ वर्ष सहस्राणि तेन अस्मिन् ऋषिणा गिरौ
वसतो मम धर्मज्ञो स्वर् गते तु निशाकरे
transliteration: aṣṭau varṣa sahasrāṇi tena asmin ṛṣiṇā girau
vasato mama dharmajño svar gate tu niśākare
english: After Niśākara cognizant of virtue had gone to heaven, I bereft of that saint, passed eight thousand years in this mountain.

sanskrit: अवतीर्य च विन्ध्य अग्रात् कृच्छ्रेण विषमात् शनैः
तीक्ष्ण दर्भाम् वसुमतीम् दुःखेन पुनर् आगतः
transliteration: avatīrya ca vindhya agrāt kṛcchreṇa viṣamāt śanaiḥ
tīkṣṇa darbhām vasumatīm duḥkhena punar āgataḥ
english: Descending with difficulty from the uneven top of Vindhya, I again came* to the earth covered with sharp-pointed grass. *While the saint was staying here.

sanskrit: तम् ऋषिम् द्रष्टु कामो अस्मि दुःखेन अभ्यागतो भृशम्
जटायुषा मया चैव बहुशो अभिगतो हि सः
transliteration: tam ṛṣim draṣṭu kāmo asmi duḥkhena abhyāgato bhṛśam
jaṭāyuṣā mayā caiva bahuśo abhigato hi saḥ
english: I was eager to see the saint; and (therefore), with much ado I came to him; and Jatāyu and myself saw that saint many a time and oft.

sanskrit: तस्य आश्रम पदाभ्याशे ववुः वाताः सुगन्धिनः
वृक्षो न अपुष्पितः कश्चित् अफलो वा न दृश्यते
transliteration: tasya āśrama padābhyāśe vavuḥ vātāḥ sugandhinaḥ
vṛkṣo na apuṣpitaḥ kaścit aphalo vā na dṛśyate
english: A fragrant breeze blew about the hermitage; and no tree was found that did not bear flowers and fruits.

sanskrit: उपेत्य च आश्रमम् पुण्यम् वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रितः
द्रष्टु कामः प्रतीक्षे च भगवंतम् निशाकरम्
transliteration: upetya ca āśramam puṇyam vṛkṣa mūlam upāśritaḥ
draṣṭu kāmaḥ pratīkṣe ca bhagavaṃtam niśākaram
english: Approaching the holy asylum, I, desirous of beholding the worshipful Niśākara, waited at the foot of a tree.

sanskrit: अथ पश्यमि दूरस्थम् ऋषिम् ज्वलित तेजसम्
कृत अभिषेकम् दुर्धर्षम् उपावृत्तम् उदन् मुखम्
transliteration: atha paśyami dūrastham ṛṣim jvalita tejasam
kṛta abhiṣekam durdharṣam upāvṛttam udan mukham
english: Then at a distance I saw the saint, flaming in energy and irrepressible,-returning northwards.

sanskrit: तम् ऋक्षाः सृमरा व्याघ्राः सिंहा नाना सरीसृपाः
transliteration: tam ṛkṣāḥ sṛmarā vyāghrāḥ siṃhā nānā sarīsṛpāḥ
english: As creatures gather round a giver, bears and Srimaras, tigers lions, and various reptiles, were going along, surrounding him.

sanskrit: ततः प्राप्तम् ऋषिम् ज्ञात्वा तानि सत्त्वानि वै ययुः
प्रविष्टे राजनि यथा सर्वम् स अमात्यकम् बलम्
transliteration: tataḥ prāptam ṛṣim jñātvā tāni sattvāni vai yayuḥ
praviṣṭe rājani yathā sarvam sa amātyakam balam
english: And knowing that the saint had arrived (at his home), the animals went away, as go away forces together with counsellors, when the sovereign has entered (his palace).

sanskrit: ऋषिः तु दृष्ट्वा माम् तुष्टः प्रविष्टः च आश्रमम् पुनः
मुहूर्त मात्रान् निर्गम्य ततः कार्यम् अपृच्छत
transliteration: ṛṣiḥ tu dṛṣṭvā mām tuṣṭaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ca āśramam punaḥ
muhūrta mātrān nirgamya tataḥ kāryam apṛcchata
english: The saint was glad on seeing me. Then reentering his asylum for a short space, he came out and enquired for my mission.

sanskrit: सौम्य वैकल्यताम् दृष्ट्वा रोम्णाम् ते न अवगम्यते
अग्नि दग्धौ इमौ पक्षौ प्राणाः चापि शरीरके
transliteration: saumya vaikalyatām dṛṣṭvā romṇām te na avagamyate
agni dagdhau imau pakṣau prāṇāḥ cāpi śarīrake
english: O mild one, in consequence of your feathers having undergone alteration, I cannot recognise you. Your two wings have been blasted by fire; and your powers in your frail frame are in the same condition).

sanskrit: गृध्रौ द्वौ दृष्ट पूर्वौ मे मातरिश्व समौ जवे
गृध्राणाम् चैव राजानौ भ्रातरौ काम रूपिणौ
transliteration: gṛdhrau dvau dṛṣṭa pūrvau me mātariśva samau jave
gṛdhrāṇām caiva rājānau bhrātarau kāma rūpiṇau
english: After time I saw two vultures like to wind in speed,-kings of vultures, brothers, wearing shapes at will.

sanskrit: ज्येष्ठो अवित स्त्वम् तु संपाते जटायुः अनुजः तव
मानुषम् रूपम् आस्थाय गृह्णीताम् चरणौ मम
transliteration: jyeṣṭho avita stvam tu saṃpāte jaṭāyuḥ anujaḥ tava
mānuṣam rūpam āsthāya gṛhṇītām caraṇau mama
english: You are I know, elder, O Sampati; and Jatayu is younger to you. Assuming human forms, you had taken hold of my feet.

sanskrit: किम् ते व्याधि समुत्थानम् पक्षयोः पतनम् कथम्
दण्डो वा अयम् धृतः केन सर्वम् आख्याहि पृच्छतः
transliteration: kim te vyādhi samutthānam pakṣayoḥ patanam katham
daṇḍo vā ayam dhṛtaḥ kena sarvam ākhyāhi pṛcchataḥ
english: Now, what ailment has attacked you? And why have your plumes fallen off? And who has dealt this punishment to you? Do you tell all this to me, who am asking you.

sanskrit: ततः तत् दारुणम् कर्म दुष्करम् साहसात् कृतम्
आचचक्षे मुनेः सर्वम् सूर्य अनुगमनम् तथा
transliteration: tataḥ tat dāruṇam karma duṣkaram sāhasāt kṛtam
ācacakṣe muneḥ sarvam sūrya anugamanam tathā
english: Thereat Sampāti related to the ascetic all about his fearful, arduous, and rash act of following up the sun.

sanskrit: भगवन् व्रण युक्तत्वात् लज्जया च अकुल इन्द्रियः
transliteration: bhagavan vraṇa yuktatvāt lajjayā ca akula indriyaḥ
english: O reverend sire, in consequence of my body suffering from sores, I, my senses bewildered from shame, and myself fatigued, cannot utter words.

sanskrit: अहम् चैव जटायुः च संघर्षात् दर्प मोहितौ
transliteration: aham caiva jaṭāyuḥ ca saṃgharṣāt darpa mohitau
english: From pride for power of flight, I and Jatayu, being intoxicated by conceit, began to voyage the sky afar off, with the view of testing each other's prowess, binding ourselves by the vow that we would follow the Sun so long as he did not enter that mighty Setting mountain,-and appear before the ascetics on the summit of Kailāsa.

sanskrit: कैलास शिखरे बद्ध्वा मुनीनाम् अग्रतः पणम्
रविः स्यात् अनुयातव्यो यावत् अस्तम् महागिरिम्
transliteration: kailāsa śikhare baddhvā munīnām agrataḥ paṇam
raviḥ syāt anuyātavyo yāvat astam mahāgirim
english: From pride for power of flight, I and Jatayu, being intoxicated by conceit, began to voyage the sky afar off, with the view of testing each other's prowess, binding ourselves by the vow that we would follow the Sun so long as he did not enter that mighty Setting mountain,-and appear before the ascetics on the summit of Kailāsa.

sanskrit: अपि आवाम् युगपत् प्राप्तौ अपश्याव मही तले
रथ चक्र प्रमाणानि नगराणि पृथक् पृथक्
transliteration: api āvām yugapat prāptau apaśyāva mahī tale
ratha cakra pramāṇāni nagarāṇi pṛthak pṛthak
english: And simultaneously plunging into the serial deep) we saw on the earth beneath separate cities resembling car-wheels; and here the sound of musical instruments, and there the tinklings of ornaments. And (at places) we beheld many a damsel clad in red attire, engaged in singing.

sanskrit: क्वचित् वादित्र घोषः च क्वचित् भूषण निःस्वनः
गायन्तीः स्म अंगना बह्वीः पश्यावो रक्त वाससः
transliteration: kvacit vāditra ghoṣaḥ ca kvacit bhūṣaṇa niḥsvanaḥ
gāyantīḥ sma aṃganā bahvīḥ paśyāvo rakta vāsasaḥ
english: And simultaneously plunging into the serial deep) we saw on the earth beneath separate cities resembling car-wheels; and here the sound of musical instruments, and there the tinklings of ornaments. And (at places) we beheld many a damsel clad in red attire, engaged in singing.

sanskrit: तूर्णम् उत्पत्य च आकाशम् आदित्य पथम् आस्थितौ
आवाम् आलोकयावः तत् वनम् शाद्वल संस्थितम्
transliteration: tūrṇam utpatya ca ākāśam āditya patham āsthitau
āvām ālokayāvaḥ tat vanam śādvala saṃsthitam
english: And swiftly darting up into the sky and approaching the path of the Sun, we saw a wood interspersed with swards.

sanskrit: उपलैः इव संछन्ना दृश्यते भूः शिल उच्चयैः
आपगाभिः च संवीता सूत्रैः इव वसुंधरा
transliteration: upalaiḥ iva saṃchannā dṛśyate bhūḥ śila uccayaiḥ
āpagābhiḥ ca saṃvītā sūtraiḥ iva vasuṃdharā
english: We saw the earth covered with crags and masses of rocks, and intersected by streams resembling threads.

sanskrit: हिमवान् चैव विन्ध्यः च मेरुः च सुमहान् गिरिः
भू तले संप्रकाशन्ते नागा इव जल आशये
transliteration: himavān caiva vindhyaḥ ca meruḥ ca sumahān giriḥ
bhū tale saṃprakāśante nāgā iva jala āśaye
english: Himavān, and Vindhya, and that mighty mountain, Meru, appeared on the earth like elephants in a tank. Then we began to sweat, and to be filled with regret; and fear seized us both. And we became bewildered; and fainted away frightfully.* *Consequent on Jațāyu having dropped down.

sanskrit: तीव्रः स्वेदः च खेदः च भयम् च आसीत् तदा अवयोः
समाविशत मोहः च ततो मूर्च्छा च दारुणा
transliteration: tīvraḥ svedaḥ ca khedaḥ ca bhayam ca āsīt tadā avayoḥ
samāviśata mohaḥ ca tato mūrcchā ca dāruṇā
english: Himavān, and Vindhya, and that mighty mountain, Meru, appeared on the earth like elephants in a tank. Then we began to sweat, and to be filled with regret; and fear seized us both. And we became bewildered; and fainted away frightfully.* *Consequent on Jațāyu having dropped down.

sanskrit: न च दिक् ज्ञायते याम्या न आग्नेयी न च वारुणी
युग अन्ते नियतो लोको हतो दग्ध इव अग्निना
transliteration: na ca dik jñāyate yāmyā na āgneyī na ca vāruṇī
yuga ante niyato loko hato dagdha iva agninā
english: We knew not the south, or the west, or the quarter presided over by Fire;' and the world that was still burning at the end of a Yuga, appeared (to us) as if it had been consumed quite.? 1. South-east. 2. The passage is obscure. This is however, all the explanation that the commentator has to give.

sanskrit: मनः च मे हतम् भूयः चक्षुः प्राप्य तु संश्रयम्
यत्नेन महता हि अस्मिन् मनः संधाय चक्षुषी
transliteration: manaḥ ca me hatam bhūyaḥ cakṣuḥ prāpya tu saṃśrayam
yatnena mahatā hi asmin manaḥ saṃdhāya cakṣuṣī
english: My mind, combined with my eyes waxed feebler. And then fixing with might and main my eyes as well as my mind (on the sun), I could by a violent exercise of my energy behold the sun. And the sun shining, appeared to us like the earth in extent.

sanskrit: तुल्यः पृथ्वी प्रमाणेन भास्करः प्रतिभाति नौ
transliteration: tulyaḥ pṛthvī pramāṇena bhāskaraḥ pratibhāti nau
english: My mind, combined with my eyes waxed feebler. And then fixing with might and main my eyes as well as my mind (on the sun), I could by a violent exercise of my energy behold the sun. And the sun shining, appeared to us like the earth in extent.

sanskrit: जटायुः माम् अनापृच्छ्य निपपात महीम् ततः
तम् दृष्ट्वा तूर्णम् आकाशात् आत्मानम् मुक्तवान् अहम्
transliteration: jaṭāyuḥ mām anāpṛcchya nipapāta mahīm tataḥ
tam dṛṣṭvā tūrṇam ākāśāt ātmānam muktavān aham

sanskrit: पक्षभ्याम् च मया गुप्तो जटायुः न प्रदह्यत
प्रमादात् तत्र निर्दग्धः पतन् वायु पथात् अहम्
transliteration: pakṣabhyām ca mayā gupto jaṭāyuḥ na pradahyata
pramādāt tatra nirdagdhaḥ patan vāyu pathāt aham

sanskrit: अहम् तु पतितो विन्ध्ये दग्ध पक्षो जडी कृतः
transliteration: aham tu patito vindhye dagdha pakṣo jaḍī kṛtaḥ

sanskrit: राज्यात् हीनो भ्रात्रा च पक्षाभ्याम् विक्रमेण च
सर्वथा मर्तुम् एव इच्छन् पतिष्ये शिखरात् गिरेः
transliteration: rājyāt hīno bhrātrā ca pakṣābhyām vikrameṇa ca
sarvathā martum eva icchan patiṣye śikharāt gireḥ
english: Deprived of my kingdom, and my brother, and my wings, and my prowess, I wishing to put a period to my existence, will hurl myself headlong from this summit of the mountain.

sanskrit: एवम् उक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठम् अरुदम् भृश दुःखितः
अथ ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तम् तु भगवान् इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: evam uktvā muniśreṣṭham arudam bhṛśa duḥkhitaḥ
atha dhyātvā muhūrtam tu bhagavān idam abravīt
english: Having said this to that foremost of ascetics, I smitten with grief, began to weep. Thereat, after, reflecting for a while, that reverend one said,

sanskrit: पक्षौ च ते प्रपक्षौ च पुनः अन्यौ भविष्यतः
चक्षुषी चैव प्राणाः च विक्रमः च बलम् च ते
transliteration: pakṣau ca te prapakṣau ca punaḥ anyau bhaviṣyataḥ
cakṣuṣī caiva prāṇāḥ ca vikramaḥ ca balam ca te
english: Your wings together with two smaller ones shall grow again; as also your sight, energy, prowess and strength.

sanskrit: पुराणे सुमहत् कार्यम् भविष्यम् हि मया श्रुतम्
दृष्टम् मे तपसा चैव श्रुत्वा च विदितम् मम
transliteration: purāṇe sumahat kāryam bhaviṣyam hi mayā śrutam
dṛṣṭam me tapasā caiva śrutvā ca viditam mama
english: Having heard of it, and also seen it through ascetic power, I know that a great deed is going to take place.

sanskrit: राजा दशरथो नाम कश्चित् इक्ष्वाकु वर्धनः
तस्य पुत्रो महातेजा रामो नाम भविष्यति
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma kaścit ikṣvāku vardhanaḥ
tasya putro mahātejā rāmo nāma bhaviṣyati
english: There shall be a king named Daſaratha, increaser of the Ikşwāku race. He shall have a son, named Rāma, endowed with exceeding energy.

sanskrit: अरण्यम् च सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन गमिष्यति
तस्मिन् अर्थे नियुक्तः सन् पित्रा सत्य पराक्रमः
transliteration: araṇyam ca saha bhrātrā lakṣmaṇena gamiṣyati
tasmin arthe niyuktaḥ san pitrā satya parākramaḥ
english: He (Rāma) shall repair to the forest in company with his brother, Laksmana; that one having truth for prowess, having commissioned to that effect by his sire.

sanskrit: नैर्ऋतो रावणो नाम तस्य भार्याम् हरिष्यति
transliteration: nairṛto rāvaṇo nāma tasya bhāryām hariṣyati
english: A friend named Rāvana, the lord of Rākşasas, incapable of being slain by either the gods or the Dāvanas, shall carry off his Rāma's) spouse in Janasthāna.

sanskrit: सा च कामैः प्रलोभ्यन्ती भक्ष्यैः भोज्यैः च मैथिली
न भोक्ष्यति महाभागा दुःख मग्ना यशस्विनी
transliteration: sā ca kāmaiḥ pralobhyantī bhakṣyaiḥ bhojyaiḥ ca maithilī
na bhokṣyati mahābhāgā duḥkha magnā yaśasvinī
english: And albeit tempted by viands and objects of enjoyment and desire, the famous and highly virtuous one, plunged in grief, shall not pertake of those things.

sanskrit: परमान्नम् च वैदेह्या ज्ञात्वा दास्यति वासवः
यत् अन्नम् अमृत प्रख्यम् सुराणाम् अपि दुर्लभम्
transliteration: paramānnam ca vaidehyā jñātvā dāsyati vāsavaḥ
yat annam amṛta prakhyam surāṇām api durlabham
english: And knowing that Videha's daughter (has been fasting for many a day), Vāsava shall offer Vaidehī pāyasa like to ambrosia, difficult of being procured even by the gods.

sanskrit: तत् अन्नम् मैथिली प्राप्य विज्ञाय इन्द्रात् इदम् तु इति
अग्रम् उद्धृत्य रामाय भू तले निर्वपिष्यति
transliteration: tat annam maithilī prāpya vijñāya indrāt idam tu iti
agram uddhṛtya rāmāya bhū tale nirvapiṣyati
english: Receiving that food, Maithili, knowing that it has come from Indra,* took up a little of it from the surface, and dropped it to the earth for Rāma. *From the fact of the food not touching the earth, and other signs. It is humorous to read the explanation of the commentator as to the reason of Indra's supplying Sītā with food. If Sītā remained fasting, Rāvana would forego his attachment for Vaidehi, on seeing her altered appearance; and thus his destruction could not take place. Further, if he saw Sītā retaining her former loveliness, he could conclude that Sītā, as also Rāma, were superhuman character, and that as such they could not be agents for his destruction according to the prophecy Rāvana shall be slain by a human being. This inducing him to persist in his bellicose attitude towards Rāma, would being down ruin upon his head.

sanskrit: यदि जीवति मे भर्ता लक्ष्मणो वा अपि देवरः
देवत्वम् गतयोः वा अपि तयोः अन्नम् इदम् तु इति
transliteration: yadi jīvati me bhartā lakṣmaṇo vā api devaraḥ
devatvam gatayoḥ vā api tayoḥ annam idam tu iti
english: Whether my husband as well as his younger brother live, or they have attained godhead, let this food serve for them.

sanskrit: एष्यन्ति प्रेषिताः तत्र राम दूताः प्लवंगमाः
आख्येया राम महिषी त्वया तेभ्यो विहंगम
transliteration: eṣyanti preṣitāḥ tatra rāma dūtāḥ plavaṃgamāḥ
ākhyeyā rāma mahiṣī tvayā tebhyo vihaṃgama
english: Rāma's envoys, having been despatched thither.* shall come hither. You should relate to them all the facts connected with the queen of Rāma. *For going to Lankā.

sanskrit: सर्वथा तु न गंतव्यम् ईदृशः क्व गमिष्यसि
देश कालौ प्रतीक्षस्व पक्षौ त्वम् प्रतिपत्स्यसे
transliteration: sarvathā tu na gaṃtavyam īdṛśaḥ kva gamiṣyasi
deśa kālau pratīkṣasva pakṣau tvam pratipatsyase
english: Do not by any means go hence; and in this case, whither, again, wilt you repair? Do you stay here for season and place. You shall regain your wings.

sanskrit: उत्सहेयम् अहम् कर्तुम् अद्य एव त्वाम् स पक्षकम्
इह स्थः त्वम् तु लोकानाम् हितम् कार्यम् करिष्यसि
transliteration: utsaheyam aham kartum adya eva tvām sa pakṣakam
iha sthaḥ tvam tu lokānām hitam kāryam kariṣyasi
english: I could this very day furnish you with wings. But, by staying here in this condition, you wilt be able to compass the welfare of the worlds.

sanskrit: त्वया अपि खलु तत् कार्यम् तयोः च नृप पुत्रयोः
ब्राह्मणानाम् गुरूणाम् च मुनीनाम् वासवस्य च
transliteration: tvayā api khalu tat kāryam tayoḥ ca nṛpa putrayoḥ
brāhmaṇānām gurūṇām ca munīnām vāsavasya ca
english: Even you shall do that act in behalf of those sons of the king, of the Brāhmanas, of the spiritual preceptors, of the ascetics, and of Vasava.

sanskrit: इच्छामि अहम् अपि द्रष्टुम् भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ
न इच्छे चिरम् धारयितुम् प्राणान् त्यक्ष्ये कलेवरम्
महर्षि तु तत् अब्रवीत् इदम् दृष्ट तत्त्व अर्थ दर्शिनः
transliteration: icchāmi aham api draṣṭum bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau
na icche ciram dhārayitum prāṇān tyakṣye kalevaram
maharṣi tu tat abravīt idam dṛṣṭa tattva artha darśinaḥ
english: I also am desirous of beholding the brothers, Rāma and Laksmana. I do not wish to hold this life long. I would renounce my life.' That Maharși, conversant with the nature of things, told me this.'

sanskrit: एतैः अन्यैः च बहुभिः वाक्यैः वाक्य विशारदः
माम् प्रशस्य अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य प्रविष्टः स स्वम् आलयम्
transliteration: etaiḥ anyaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ vākyaiḥ vākya viśāradaḥ
mām praśasya abhyanujñāpya praviṣṭaḥ sa svam ālayam
english: Having praised me with these and many other words, and bidden me adieu that one skilled in speech, entered his own habitation.

sanskrit: कंदरात् तु विसर्पित्वा पर्वतस्य शनैः शनैः
transliteration: kaṃdarāt tu visarpitvā parvatasya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
english: Issuing out gently from the cave of that mountain, I, ascending Vindhya, was expecting you.

sanskrit: अद्य तु एतस्य कालस्य साग्रम् वर्ष शतम् गतम्
देश काल प्रतीक्षो अस्मि हृदि कृत्वा मुनेः वचः
transliteration: adya tu etasya kālasya sāgram varṣa śatam gatam
deśa kāla pratīkṣo asmi hṛdi kṛtvā muneḥ vacaḥ
english: The space covered by the time intervening between then and to-day is a little over an hundred years;* and laying up in my heart the speech of that ascetic I have been awaiting season and place. *The commentator says the period is one hundred and eight years.

sanskrit: महाप्रस्थानम् आसाद्य स्वर् गते तु निशाकरे
माम् निर्दहति संतापो वितर्कैः बहुभिः वृतम्
transliteration: mahāprasthānam āsādya svar gate tu niśākare
mām nirdahati saṃtāpo vitarkaiḥ bahubhiḥ vṛtam
english: Setting out on his great journey, on Niśākara having gone to heaven, I distracted with various thoughts, have been consumed by grief. For the loss of my plumage.-

sanskrit: उदिताम् मरणे बुद्धिम् मुनि वाक्यैः निवर्तये
बुद्धिः या तेन मे दत्ता प्राणानाम् रक्षणे मम
transliteration: uditām maraṇe buddhim muni vākyaiḥ nivartaye
buddhiḥ yā tena me dattā prāṇānām rakṣaṇe mama
english: My rising intention of doing away with myself I have suppressed in consideration of the words of the ascetic. The reason which he had imparted to me for preserving my life, has removed my pains even as a flaming fire (dispels darkness).

sanskrit: सा मे अपनयते दुःखम् दीप्ता इव अग्नि शिखा तमः
बुध्यता च मया वीर्यम् रावणस्य दुरात्मनः
transliteration: sā me apanayate duḥkham dīptā iva agni śikhā tamaḥ
budhyatā ca mayā vīryam rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ

sanskrit: पुत्रः संतर्जितो वाग्भिः न त्राता मैथिली कथम्
तस्या विलपितम् श्रुत्वा तौ च सीता वियोजितौ
transliteration: putraḥ saṃtarjito vāgbhiḥ na trātā maithilī katham
tasyā vilapitam śrutvā tau ca sītā viyojitau

sanskrit: न मे दशरथ स्नेहात् पुत्रेण उत्पादितम् प्रियम्
तस्य तु एवम् ब्रुवाणस्य संहतैः वानरैः सह
transliteration: na me daśaratha snehāt putreṇa utpāditam priyam
tasya tu evam bruvāṇasya saṃhataiḥ vānaraiḥ saha

sanskrit: उत्पेततुः तदा पक्षौ समक्षम् वन चारिणाम्
स दृष्ट्वा स्वाम् तनुम् पक्षैः उद्गतैः अरुण च्छदैः
transliteration: utpetatuḥ tadā pakṣau samakṣam vana cāriṇām
sa dṛṣṭvā svām tanum pakṣaiḥ udgataiḥ aruṇa cchadaiḥ

sanskrit: प्रहर्षम् अतुलम् लेभे वानरान् च इदम् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: praharṣam atulam lebhe vānarān ca idam abravīt

sanskrit: आदित्य रश्मि निर्दग्धौ पक्षौ पुनः उपस्थितौ
यौवने वर्तमानस्य मम आसीत् यः पराक्रमः
transliteration: āditya raśmi nirdagdhau pakṣau punaḥ upasthitau
yauvane vartamānasya mama āsīt yaḥ parākramaḥ

sanskrit: तम् एव अद्य अवगच्छामि बलम् पौरुषम् एव च
transliteration: tam eva adya avagacchāmi balam pauruṣam eva ca

sanskrit: पक्ष लाभो मम अयम् वः सिद्धि प्रत्यय कारकः
इति उक्त्वा तान् हरीन् सर्वान् संपातिः पतगोत्तम
transliteration: pakṣa lābho mama ayam vaḥ siddhi pratyaya kārakaḥ
iti uktvā tān harīn sarvān saṃpātiḥ patagottama

sanskrit: उत्पपात गिरेः शृंगात् जिज्ञासुः ख गमो गतिम्
तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा प्रतिसंहृष्ट मानसाः
बभूवुः हरि शार्दूला विक्रम अभ्युदय उन्मुखाः
transliteration: utpapāta gireḥ śṛṃgāt jijñāsuḥ kha gamo gatim
tasya tat vacanam śrutvā pratisaṃhṛṣṭa mānasāḥ
babhūvuḥ hari śārdūlā vikrama abhyudaya unmukhāḥ
english: Hearing his words, those powerful monkeys, with vigour (enhanced, seeing success before them, felt the height of joy.

sanskrit: अथ पवन समान विक्रमाःप्लवग वराः प्रतिलब्ध पौरुषाः
अभिजित् अभिमुखाम् दिशम् ययुःजनक सुता परिमार्गण उन्मुखाः
transliteration: atha pavana samāna vikramāḥplavaga varāḥ pratilabdha pauruṣāḥ
abhijit abhimukhām diśam yayuḥjanaka sutā parimārgaṇa unmukhāḥ
english: Then those foremost of monkeys, in vigour resembling the Wind, getting occasion for displaying their prowess, intent upon searching the Janaka's daughter, set forward towards the quarter crested by Abhijit.* * Abhijitabhimukhan (acc.) Abhijit—the name of a star. Abhijit may also mean-he who is to be conquered. Then the sense would be the region in which Rāvana was.

sanskrit: संगताः प्रीति संयुक्ता विनेदुः सिंह विक्रमाः
transliteration: saṃgatāḥ prīti saṃyuktā vineduḥ siṃha vikramāḥ
english: Having heard all this related to them by the vulture-king, the monkeys possessing the strength of lions, filled with delight, bounded and set up a roar.

sanskrit: संपातेः वचनम् श्रुत्वा हरयो रावण क्षयम्
हृष्टाः सागरम् आजग्मुः सीता दर्शन कान्क्षिणः
transliteration: saṃpāteḥ vacanam śrutvā harayo rāvaṇa kṣayam
hṛṣṭāḥ sāgaram ājagmuḥ sītā darśana kānkṣiṇaḥ
english: Hearing from Sampāti that Rāvana was to be slain, the monkeys growing glad, came to the ocean, with the desire of seeing Sītā.

sanskrit: अभिक्रम्य तु तम् देशम् ददृशुर् भीम विक्रमाः
कृत्स्नम् लोकस्य महतः प्रतिबिंबम् इव स्थितम्
transliteration: abhikramya tu tam deśam dadṛśur bhīma vikramāḥ
kṛtsnam lokasya mahataḥ pratibiṃbam iva sthitam
english: Coming to that country, these ones processing dreadful prowess, beheld (the sea) reflecting the image of this entire mighty world.

sanskrit: संनिवेशम् ततः चक्रुः सहिता वानर उत्तमाः
transliteration: saṃniveśam tataḥ cakruḥ sahitā vānara uttamāḥ
english: Arriving at the northern side of the Southern sea, those exceedingly powerful heroic monkeys took up their quarters there.

sanskrit: प्रसुप्तम् इव च अन्यत्र क्रीडन्तम् इव च अन्यतः
क्वचित् पर्वत मात्रैः च जल राशिभिः आवृतम्
transliteration: prasuptam iva ca anyatra krīḍantam iva ca anyataḥ
kvacit parvata mātraiḥ ca jala rāśibhiḥ āvṛtam
english: Seeing the sea, here as if asleep, there, as if playful, and at another place with surges measuring mountains; and thronged with the foremost Dānavas inhabiting the nether regions; and capable of causing one's hair to stand on end, those powerful monkeys were seized with sadness.

sanskrit: संकुलम् दानव इन्द्रैः च पाताल तल वासिभिः
रोम हर्ष करम् दृष्ट्वा विषेदुः कपिकुंजराः
transliteration: saṃkulam dānava indraiḥ ca pātāla tala vāsibhiḥ
roma harṣa karam dṛṣṭvā viṣeduḥ kapikuṃjarāḥ
english: Seeing the sea, here as if asleep, there, as if playful, and at another place with surges measuring mountains; and thronged with the foremost Dānavas inhabiting the nether regions; and capable of causing one's hair to stand on end, those powerful monkeys were seized with sadness.

sanskrit: आकाशम् इव दुष्पारम् सागरम् प्रेक्ष्य वानराः
विषेदुः सहिता सर्वे कथम् कार्यम् इति ब्रुवन्
transliteration: ākāśam iva duṣpāram sāgaram prekṣya vānarāḥ
viṣeduḥ sahitā sarve katham kāryam iti bruvan
english: Seeing the sea, incapable of being crossed even as the sky, all the monkeys began to lament, saying,-What is to be done?

sanskrit: आश्वासयामास हरीन् भय आर्तान् हरि सत्तमः
transliteration: āśvāsayāmāsa harīn bhaya ārtān hari sattamaḥ
english: That best of monkeys-(Angada), seeing the army cast down because of the sight of the sea, began to comfort the monkeys, afflicted with fear.

sanskrit: न विषादे मनः कार्यम् विषादो दोषवत्तरः
विषादो हन्ति पुरुषम् बालम् क्रुद्ध इव उरगः
transliteration: na viṣāde manaḥ kāryam viṣādo doṣavattaraḥ
viṣādo hanti puruṣam bālam kruddha iva uragaḥ
english: We should not indulge in grief. Grief is injurious.-Grief destroys a person even as a wrathful serpent does a boy.

sanskrit: तेजसा तस्य हीनस्य पुरुष अर्थो न सिद्ध्यति
transliteration: tejasā tasya hīnasya puruṣa artho na siddhyati
english: He that, when the time is come for displaying his prowess, indulges in sorrow, growing weak in energy, fails to attain his objects.

sanskrit: तस्याम् रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् अंगदो वानरैः सह
हरि वृद्धैः समागम्य पुनर् मंत्रम् अमंत्रयत्
transliteration: tasyām rātryām vyatītāyām aṃgado vānaraiḥ saha
hari vṛddhaiḥ samāgamya punar maṃtram amaṃtrayat
english: That night having passed away, Angada in company with the monkeys, joined by the old ones, again took counsel with them.

sanskrit: सा वानराणाम् ध्वजिनी परिवार्य अंगदम् बभौ
वासवम् परिवार्य इव मरुताम् वाहिनी स्थिता
transliteration: sā vānarāṇām dhvajinī parivārya aṃgadam babhau
vāsavam parivārya iva marutām vāhinī sthitā
english: That monkey-host surrounding Angada, resembled the host of Maruts environing Vasava.

sanskrit: को अन्यः ताम् वानरीम् सेनाम् शक्तः स्तंभयितुम् भवेत्
अन्यत्र वालि तनयात् अन्यत्र च हनूमतः
transliteration: ko anyaḥ tām vānarīm senām śaktaḥ staṃbhayitum bhavet
anyatra vāli tanayāt anyatra ca hanūmataḥ
english: Who save Väli's son (stationed) at one place and at another Hanumān, could be capable of stilling that force?

sanskrit: ततः तान् हरि वृद्धान् च तत् च सैन्यम् अरिन्दमः
अनुमान्य अंगदः श्रीमान् वाक्यम् अर्थवत् अब्रवीत्
transliteration: tataḥ tān hari vṛddhān ca tat ca sainyam arindamaḥ
anumānya aṃgadaḥ śrīmān vākyam arthavat abravīt
english: Then saluting the elders as well as army, the-graceful Angada-repressor of foes-~-spoke words fraught with sense,

sanskrit: कः करिष्यति सुग्रीवम् सत्य सन्धम् अरिन्दमम्
transliteration: kaḥ kariṣyati sugrīvam satya sandham arindamam
english: What person, endued with exceeding energy, shall now leap over the main? Who shall serve that subduer of enemies, Sugrīva, ever intent on truth?

sanskrit: को वीरो योजन शतम् लंघयेत प्लवंगमाः
इमान् च यूथपान् सर्वान् मोचयेत् को महाभयात्
transliteration: ko vīro yojana śatam laṃghayeta plavaṃgamāḥ
imān ca yūthapān sarvān mocayet ko mahābhayāt
english: What monkey can leap over an hundred Yojanas? Who shall deliver leaders of herds from a mighty fear?

sanskrit: कस्य प्रसादात् दारान् च पुत्रान् चैव गृहाणि च
इतो निवृत्ताः पश्येम सिद्ध अर्थाः सुखिनो वयम्
transliteration: kasya prasādāt dārān ca putrān caiva gṛhāṇi ca
ito nivṛttāḥ paśyema siddha arthāḥ sukhino vayam
english: By whose favour shall we, crowned with success and rendered happy, returning from this place, shall behold our wives and our son, and our homes?

sanskrit: कस्य प्रसादात् रामम् च लक्ष्मणम् च महाबलम्
transliteration: kasya prasādāt rāmam ca lakṣmaṇam ca mahābalam

sanskrit: यदि कश्चित् समर्थो वः सागर प्लवने हरिः
स ददातु इह नः शीघ्रम् पुण्याम् अभय दक्षिणाम्
transliteration: yadi kaścit samartho vaḥ sāgara plavane hariḥ
sa dadātu iha naḥ śīghram puṇyām abhaya dakṣiṇām

sanskrit: अंगदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा न कश्चित् किंचित् अब्रवीत्
स्तिमिता इव अभवत् सर्वा सा तत्र हरि वाहिनी
transliteration: aṃgadasya vacaḥ śrutvā na kaścit kiṃcit abravīt
stimitā iva abhavat sarvā sā tatra hari vāhinī

sanskrit: पुनर् एव अंगदः प्राह तान् हरीन् हरि सत्तमः
सर्वे बलवताम् श्रेष्ठा भवन्तो दृढ विक्रमाः
व्यपदेश्य कुले जाताः पूजिताः च अपि अभीक्ष्णशः
transliteration: punar eva aṃgadaḥ prāha tān harīn hari sattamaḥ
sarve balavatām śreṣṭhā bhavanto dṛḍha vikramāḥ
vyapadeśya kule jātāḥ pūjitāḥ ca api abhīkṣṇaśaḥ
english: Then that foremost of monkeys addressed those monkeys, saying-All of you are the foremost of strong ones, and of steady prowess. And you have sprung in blameless lines, and are ever honoured (by the king).

sanskrit: न हि वो गमने संगः कदाचित् अपि कस्यचित् भवेत्
ब्रुवध्वम् यस्य या शक्तिः प्लवने प्लवगर्षभाः
transliteration: na hi vo gamane saṃgaḥ kadācit api kasyacit bhavet
bruvadhvam yasya yā śaktiḥ plavane plavagarṣabhāḥ
english: And yet no one of you can promise to undertake this journey? You best of monkeys, unfold your respective powers in bounding.

sanskrit: अथ अंगद वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते वानर उत्तमाः
स्वम् स्वम् गतौ समुत्साहम् ऊचुः तत्र यथा क्रमम्
transliteration: atha aṃgada vacaḥ śrutvā sarve te vānara uttamāḥ
svam svam gatau samutsāham ūcuḥ tatra yathā kramam
english: Hearing Angada's speech, those foremost monkeys one after another began to speak, touching their respective competence in coursing.

sanskrit: मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव सुषेणो जांबवान् तथा
transliteration: maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ caiva suṣeṇo jāṃbavān tathā
english: Gaja, and Gavākṣa, and Gavaya, and Sarabha, and Gandhamādana, and Mainda, and Dwivida, and Angada, and Jāmbavān.

sanskrit: आबभाषे गजः तत्र प्लवेयम् दश योजनम्
गवाक्षो योजनानि आह गमिष्यामि इति विंशतिम्
transliteration: ābabhāṣe gajaḥ tatra plaveyam daśa yojanam
gavākṣo yojanāni āha gamiṣyāmi iti viṃśatim
english: Gaja said, “I can leap over ten Yojanas," and Gavaksa said, "I shall go twenty Yojanas."

sanskrit: शरभो वानरः तत्र वानरान् तान् उवाच ह
transliteration: śarabho vānaraḥ tatra vānarān tān uvāca ha
english: There monkey Sarabha said to those monkeys, “You monkey, I shall go thirty Yojanas."

sanskrit: ऋषरभो वानरः तत्र वानरान् तान् उवाच ह
transliteration: ṛṣarabho vānaraḥ tatra vānarān tān uvāca ha
english: And the monkey, Rhishava, said to those monkeys,-"I shall, without doubt, go forty Yojanas."

sanskrit: योजनानाम् गमिष्यामि पंचाशत् तु न संशयः
transliteration: yojanānām gamiṣyāmi paṃcāśat tu na saṃśayaḥ
english: And the exceedingly energetic monkey, Gandhamädana, said, I shall for certain go fifty Yojanas.

sanskrit: मैन्दः तु वानरः तत्र वानरान् तान् उवाच ह
योजनानाम् परम् षष्टिम् अहम् प्लवितुम् उत्सहे
transliteration: maindaḥ tu vānaraḥ tatra vānarān tān uvāca ha
yojanānām param ṣaṣṭim aham plavitum utsahe
english: And the monkey Mainda said to the monkeys there, I shall undertake to leap over sixty Yojanas.

sanskrit: गमिष्यामि न संदेहः सप्ततिम् योजनानि अहम्
transliteration: gamiṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ saptatim yojanāni aham
english: And then the highly energetic Dwivida said,-I Shall, for certain, go seventy Yojanas.

sanskrit: सुषेणः तु महातेजाः सत्त्ववान् कपि सत्तमः
transliteration: suṣeṇaḥ tu mahātejāḥ sattvavān kapi sattamaḥ
english: And the highly powerful Suşena, possessed of strength-foremost of monkeys said—I declare that in motion I am equal to eighty Yojanas.

sanskrit: तेषाम् कथयताम् तत्र सर्वान् तान् अनुमान्य च
transliteration: teṣām kathayatām tatra sarvān tān anumānya ca
english: As they were speaking thus,' the oldest of them all, Jambavān, saluting them answered.

sanskrit: पूर्वम् अस्माकम् अपि आसीत् कश्चित् गति पराक्रमः
ते वयम् वयसः पारम् अनुप्राप्ताः स्म सांप्रतम्
transliteration: pūrvam asmākam api āsīt kaścit gati parākramaḥ
te vayam vayasaḥ pāram anuprāptāḥ sma sāṃpratam

sanskrit: किम् तु न एवम् गते शक्यम् इदम् कार्यम् उपेक्षितुम्
यद् अर्थम् कपि राजः च रामः च कृत निश्चयौ
transliteration: kim tu na evam gate śakyam idam kāryam upekṣitum
yad artham kapi rājaḥ ca rāmaḥ ca kṛta niścayau

sanskrit: सांप्रतम् कालम् अस्माकम् या गतिः ताम् निबोधत
नवतिम् योजनानाम् तु गमिष्यामि न संशयः
transliteration: sāṃpratam kālam asmākam yā gatiḥ tām nibodhata
navatim yojanānām tu gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: तान् च सर्वान् हरि श्रेष्ठान् जांबवान् इदम् अब्रवीत्
न खलु एतावत् एव आसीत् गमने मे पराक्रमः
transliteration: tān ca sarvān hari śreṣṭhān jāṃbavān idam abravīt
na khalu etāvat eva āsīt gamane me parākramaḥ
english: Jāmbavān said this to those choice monkeys. But (formerly) my prowess in leaping was forsooth not such.* Of old in the sacrifice of Virocana's son, the external Lord Visnu, when he had covered the entire universe with three steps, was circumambulated by me. *i.e. it was greater.

Jāmbavān said this to those choice monkeys. But (formerly) my prowess in leaping was forsooth not such.* Of old in the sacrifice of Virocana's son, the external Lord Visnu, when he had covered the entire universe with three steps, was circumambulated by me. *i.e. it was greater.

sanskrit: स इदानीम् अहम् वृद्धः प्लवने मन्दविक्रमः
यौवने च तदा आसीत् मे बलम् अप्रतिमम् परम्
transliteration: sa idānīm aham vṛddhaḥ plavane mandavikramaḥ
yauvane ca tadā āsīt me balam apratimam param
english: But I who was all this, have waxed old, and my vigour sits feebly upon me. In my youth, ever, my strength was exceeding great and incomparable.

sanskrit: संप्रति एतावत् एव अद्य शक्यम् मे गमने स्वतः
न एतावता च संसिद्धिः कार्यस्य अस्य भविष्यति
transliteration: saṃprati etāvat eva adya śakyam me gamane svataḥ
na etāvatā ca saṃsiddhiḥ kāryasya asya bhaviṣyati
english: Now I can only by my own energy, course thus far. But has a bound shall not bring success on our undertaking.

sanskrit: अथ उत्तरम् उदार अर्थम् अब्रवीत् अंगदः तदा
transliteration: atha uttaram udāra artham abravīt aṃgadaḥ tadā
english: After this, saluting the mighty monkey, Jāmbavān, the wise Angada spoke straight sense, saying,

sanskrit: अहम् एतत् गमिष्यामि योजनानाम् शतम् महत्
निवर्तने तु मे शक्तिः स्यात् न वा इति न निश्चितम्
transliteration: aham etat gamiṣyāmi yojanānām śatam mahat
nivartane tu me śaktiḥ syāt na vā iti na niścitam
english: I can go over this mighty hundred Yojanas; but there is no certainty as to my answer of returning.

sanskrit: तम् उवाच हरि श्रेष्ठो जांबवान् वाक्य कोविदः
ज्ञायते गमने शक्तिः तव हरि ऋक्ष सत्तम
transliteration: tam uvāca hari śreṣṭho jāṃbavān vākya kovidaḥ
jñāyate gamane śaktiḥ tava hari ṛkṣa sattama
english: Thereat, Jāmbavān, cognizant of speech, said to that foremost of monkeys,-0 foremost of leonine as, we know your power of motion, you are capable of ursing a hundred thousand Yojanas, as well as of coming back. But we say that even this is what is fit.

sanskrit: कामम् शत सहस्रम् वा न हि एष विधिः उच्यते
transliteration: kāmam śata sahasram vā na hi eṣa vidhiḥ ucyate
english: Thereat, Jāmbavān, cognizant of speech, said to that foremost of monkeys,-0 foremost of leonine as, we know your power of motion, you are capable of ursing a hundred thousand Yojanas, as well as of coming back. But we say that even this is what is fit.

sanskrit: न हि प्रेषयिता तात स्वामी प्रेष्यः कथंचन
भवता अयम् जनः सर्वः प्रेष्यः प्लवग सत्तम
transliteration: na hi preṣayitā tāta svāmī preṣyaḥ kathaṃcana
bhavatā ayam janaḥ sarvaḥ preṣyaḥ plavaga sattama
english: My child, ore master must on no account be commanded by his servants. foremost of monkeys, all these should be commanded your you.

sanskrit: भवान् कलत्रम् अस्माकम् स्वामि भावे व्यवस्थितः
स्वामी कलत्रम् सैन्यस्य गतिः एषा परंतप
transliteration: bhavān kalatram asmākam svāmi bhāve vyavasthitaḥ
svāmī kalatram sainyasya gatiḥ eṣā paraṃtapa
english: You are our spouse, and (at the same time) occuying the position of our husband. The master is the spouse if the army. This is the way of the world.

sanskrit: अपि वै एतस्य कार्यस्य भवान् मूलम् अरिम् दम
तस्मात् कलत्रवत् तात प्रतिपाल्यः सदा भवान्
transliteration: api vai etasya kāryasya bhavān mūlam arim dama
tasmāt kalatravat tāta pratipālyaḥ sadā bhavān
english: O repressor of oes! O subduer of enemies, you are the root of this business. Therefore, my child, you should always be maintained by us like a wife.

sanskrit: मूलम् अर्थस्य संरक्ष्यम् एष कार्यविदाम् नयः
मूले हि सति सिध्यन्ति गुणाः पुष्प फल उदयः
transliteration: mūlam arthasya saṃrakṣyam eṣa kāryavidām nayaḥ
mūle hi sati sidhyanti guṇāḥ puṣpa phala udayaḥ
english: The root of any work must be preserved. This is the policy of those versed in business. The root existing, all the virtues, obtaining fruit, certainly meet with success.

sanskrit: तद् भवान् अस्य कार्यस्य साधनम् सत्य विक्रमः
बुद्धि विक्रम संपन्नो हेतुः अत्र परंतपः
transliteration: tad bhavān asya kāryasya sādhanam satya vikramaḥ
buddhi vikrama saṃpanno hetuḥ atra paraṃtapaḥ
english: You, O you having truth for prowess are the instrument of this undertaking, and, O subduer of enemies, furnished with sense and vigour, you are the occasion herein. And, O foremost of monkeys, you are both our superior, and our superior's son; and resorting to you we are enabled to accomplish our object.

sanskrit: गुरुः च गुरु पुत्रः च त्वम् हि नः कपि सत्तम
भवन्तम् आश्रित्य वयम् समर्था हि अर्थ साधने
transliteration: guruḥ ca guru putraḥ ca tvam hi naḥ kapi sattama
bhavantam āśritya vayam samarthā hi artha sādhane
english: You, O you having truth for prowess are the instrument of this undertaking, and, O subduer of enemies, furnished with sense and vigour, you are the occasion herein. And, O foremost of monkeys, you are both our superior, and our superior's son; and resorting to you we are enabled to accomplish our object.

sanskrit: प्रत्युवाच उत्तरम् वाक्यम् वालि सूनुः अथ अंगदः
transliteration: pratyuvāca uttaram vākyam vāli sūnuḥ atha aṃgadaḥ
english: Threat that mighty monkey, Angada, son to Vali, answered the exceedingly wise Jambavan, when he had spoken,

sanskrit: यदि न अहम् गमिष्यामि न अन्यो वानर पुंगवः
पुनः खलु इदम् अस्माभिः कार्यम् प्रायोपवेशनम्
transliteration: yadi na aham gamiṣyāmi na anyo vānara puṃgavaḥ
punaḥ khalu idam asmābhiḥ kāryam prāyopaveśanam
english: If I go not, nor any other powerful monkey, then we should for certain again sit ourselves down to fast to death.

sanskrit: न हि अकृत्वा हरि पतेः संदेशम् तस्य धीमतः
तत्र अपि गत्वा प्राणानाम् न पश्यामि परिरक्षणम्
transliteration: na hi akṛtvā hari pateḥ saṃdeśam tasya dhīmataḥ
tatra api gatvā prāṇānām na paśyāmi parirakṣaṇam
english: Without doing the mandate of the intelligent lord of monkeys, we, repairing thither, shall not behold ourselves alive.

sanskrit: स हि प्रसादे च अत्यर्थम् कोपे च हरिः ईश्वरः
अतीत्य तस्य संदेशम् विनाशो गमने भवेत्
transliteration: sa hi prasāde ca atyartham kope ca hariḥ īśvaraḥ
atītya tasya saṃdeśam vināśo gamane bhavet
english: He is extreme both in showing favour and in anger. Disregarding his order, we shall, going there, meet with destruction. And his ire shall, not take any other course.

sanskrit: तत् तथा हि अस्य कार्यस्य न भवति अन्यथा गतिः
तत् भवान् एव दृष्ट अर्थः संचिंतयितुम् अर्हति
transliteration: tat tathā hi asya kāryasya na bhavati anyathā gatiḥ
tat bhavān eva dṛṣṭa arthaḥ saṃciṃtayitum arhati
english: Therefore it behoves you, cap of seeing issues, to reflect.

sanskrit: सः अंगदेन तदा वीरः प्रत्युक्तः प्लवगर्षभः
जांबवान् उत्तमम् वाक्यम् प्रोवाच इदम् ततो अंगदम्
transliteration: saḥ aṃgadena tadā vīraḥ pratyuktaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ
jāṃbavān uttamam vākyam provāca idam tato aṃgadam
english: Thus addressed by Angada that powerful and heroic monkey Jāmbavān answered Angada in excellent words, saying,

sanskrit: तस्य ते वीर कार्यस्य न किंचित् परिहास्यते
एष संचोदयामि एनम् यः कार्यम् साधयिष्यति
transliteration: tasya te vīra kāryasya na kiṃcit parihāsyate
eṣa saṃcodayāmi enam yaḥ kāryam sādhayiṣyati
english: That . business, O hero, say most moult a feather. I shall despatch even him who's bring about success.

sanskrit: ततः प्रतीतम् प्लवताम् वरिष्ठम्एकांतम् आश्रित्य सुखोपविष्टम्
transliteration: tataḥ pratītam plavatām variṣṭhamekāṃtam āśritya sukhopaviṣṭam
english: Then that heroic monkey ordered foremost of monkeys, the highly heroic monkey Hanuman who stood apart, convinced (of the wisdom of Jambavān decision).

sanskrit: अनेक शत साहस्रीम् विषण्णाम् हरि वाहिनीम्
जांबवान् समुदीक्ष्य एवम् हनुमंतम् अथ अब्रवीत्
transliteration: aneka śata sāhasrīm viṣaṇṇām hari vāhinīm
jāṃbavān samudīkṣya evam hanumaṃtam atha abravīt
english: Surveying the monkey-host consisting of many hundred and thousand,-crest-fallen, Jämbavān thus spoke to Hanumān,

sanskrit: वीर वानर लोकस्य सर्व शास्त्र विदाम् वर
तूष्णीम् एकांतम् आश्रित्य हनुमन् किम् न जल्पसि
transliteration: vīra vānara lokasya sarva śāstra vidām vara
tūṣṇīm ekāṃtam āśritya hanuman kim na jalpasi
english: O hero among the monkey-multitude, O be of those versed in all branches of learning, staying apart silent, why did you not speak?

sanskrit: हनुमन् हरि राजस्य सुग्रीवस्य समो हि असि
राम लक्ष्मणयोः च अपि तेजसा च बलेन च
transliteration: hanuman hari rājasya sugrīvasya samo hi asi
rāma lakṣmaṇayoḥ ca api tejasā ca balena ca
english: O Hanuman, you are alil in energy and strength, equal to Sugriva, monarch monkeys, and to Rāma and Lakşmaņa.

sanskrit: गरुत्मान् इव विख्यात उत्तमः सर्व पक्षिणाम्
transliteration: garutmān iva vikhyāta uttamaḥ sarva pakṣiṇām
english: Aristanemi's son the mighty Vainateya,* famous by the cognomen of Garutmā, is the foremost of birds. *Offspring of Vinatā, Garura's mother.

sanskrit: बहुशो हि मया दृष्टः सागरे स महाबलः
transliteration: bahuśo hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sāgare sa mahābalaḥ
english: Many a time and oft. I have see that exceedingly powerful, mighty-armed one, endowed with strength of will,-raise up serpents in the ocean.

sanskrit: पक्षयोः यत् बलम् तस्य तावत् भुज बलम् तव
विक्रमः च अपि वेगः च न ते तेन अपहीयते
transliteration: pakṣayoḥ yat balam tasya tāvat bhuja balam tava
vikramaḥ ca api vegaḥ ca na te tena apahīyate
english: The strength that is in his wings, is equal to the might and virtues your arm.

sanskrit: बलम् बुद्धिः च तेजः च सत्त्वम् च हरि सत्तम
विशिष्टम् सर्व भूतेषु किम् आत्मानम् न सज्जसे
transliteration: balam buddhiḥ ca tejaḥ ca sattvam ca hari sattama
viśiṣṭam sarva bhūteṣu kim ātmānam na sajjase
english: Your energy and prowess are not surpassed by him And your strength, and your understanding, your energy, and your vigour, O foremost of monkeys, (is known among all creatures). Why did not you prepare yourself furnished with everything that is noble or great, (for this feat)?

sanskrit: अंजना इति परिख्याता पत्नी केसरिणो हरेः
transliteration: aṃjanā iti parikhyātā patnī kesariṇo hareḥ

sanskrit: विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु रूपेणा अप्रतिमा भुवि
अभिशापात् अभूत् तात कपित्वे काम रूपिणी
transliteration: vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu rūpeṇā apratimā bhuvi
abhiśāpāt abhūt tāta kapitve kāma rūpiṇī

sanskrit: मानुषम् विग्रहम् कृत्वा रूप यौवन शालिनी
transliteration: mānuṣam vigraham kṛtvā rūpa yauvana śālinī

sanskrit: विचित्र माल्य आभरणा कदाचित् क्षौम धारिणी
अचरत् पर्वतस्य अग्रे प्रावृड् अंबुद सन्निभे
transliteration: vicitra mālya ābharaṇā kadācit kṣauma dhāriṇī
acarat parvatasya agre prāvṛḍ aṃbuda sannibhe

sanskrit: तस्या वस्त्रम् विशालाक्ष्याः पीतम् रक्त दशम् शुभम्
स्थितायाः पर्वतस्य अग्रे मारुतो अपहरत् शनैः
transliteration: tasyā vastram viśālākṣyāḥ pītam rakta daśam śubham
sthitāyāḥ parvatasya agre māruto apaharat śanaiḥ
english: It came moss that as that one of expansive eyes was standing on the mit of the mount, the Wind gently stole away her elegant bow cloth with crimson skirts.

sanskrit: स ददर्श ततः तस्या वृत्तौ ऊरू सुसंहतौ
स्तनौ च पीनौ सहितौ सुजातम् चारु च आननम्
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ tasyā vṛttau ūrū susaṃhatau
stanau ca pīnau sahitau sujātam cāru ca ānanam

sanskrit: ताम् बलात् आयत श्रोणीम् तनु मध्याम् यशस्विनीम्
दृष्ट्वा एव शुभ सर्वान्गीम् पवनः काम मोहितः
transliteration: tām balāt āyata śroṇīm tanu madhyām yaśasvinīm
dṛṣṭvā eva śubha sarvāngīm pavanaḥ kāma mohitaḥ

sanskrit: स ताम् भुजाभ्याम् दीर्घाभ्याम् पर्यष्वजत मारुतः
मन्मथ आविष्ट सर्वान्गो गत आत्मा ताम् अनिन्दिताम्
transliteration: sa tām bhujābhyām dīrghābhyām paryaṣvajata mārutaḥ
manmatha āviṣṭa sarvāngo gata ātmā tām aninditām

sanskrit: सा तु तत्र एव संभ्रांता सुवृत्ता वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
एक पत्नी व्रतम् इदम् को नाशयितुम् इच्छति
transliteration: sā tu tatra eva saṃbhrāṃtā suvṛttā vākyam abravīt
eka patnī vratam idam ko nāśayitum icchati
english: There influenced by fear, that one of excellent vows said,-no is it that desireth to lay violent hands upon my chastity?

sanskrit: न त्वाम् हिंसामि सुश्रोणि मा भूत् ते मनसोइ भयम्
transliteration: na tvām hiṃsāmi suśroṇi mā bhūt te manasoi bhayam
english: Hearing Anjana's words, the Wind answered, do not wrong you, O you of shapely hips. Let not her enter your heart.

sanskrit: मनसा अस्मि गतो यत् त्वाम् परिष्वज्य यशस्विनि
वीर्यवान् बुद्धि संपन्नः पुत्रः तव भविष्यति
transliteration: manasā asmi gato yat tvām pariṣvajya yaśasvini
vīryavān buddhi saṃpannaḥ putraḥ tava bhaviṣyati
english: As, O famous damsel, by embracing the, I have mentally entered into your womb, you shall her a son, intelligent and endued with prowess.

sanskrit: लंघने प्लवने चैव भविष्यति मया समः
transliteration: laṃghane plavane caiva bhaviṣyati mayā samaḥ
english: And, bed with great strength, and possessing exceeding energy, having vast vigour, he shall equal me in bound and leaping.'

sanskrit: एवम् उक्ता ततः तुष्टा जननी ते महाकपेः
transliteration: evam uktā tataḥ tuṣṭā jananī te mahākapeḥ
english: Thus addressed, O mighty monkeys, your other, O long-armed one, O foremost of monkeys, your has to you in a cave.

sanskrit: अभ्युत्थितम् ततः सूर्यम् बालो दृष्ट्वा महा वने
फलंचेतिजिघृक्षुस्त्वमुत्प्लुत्याभ्युत्पतोदिवम् - यद्वा -फलम् च इति जिघृक्षुः त्वम् उत्प्लुत्य अभिउत्पतो दिवम्
transliteration: abhyutthitam tataḥ sūryam bālo dṛṣṭvā mahā vane
phalaṃcetijighṛkṣustvamutplutyābhyutpatodivam - yadvā -phalam ca iti jighṛkṣuḥ tvam utplutya abhiutpato divam
english: In that mighty forest, you, a child, desirous of eating, seeing the sun risen, and taking on to be a fruit, sprang up and leaped into the sky.

sanskrit: शतानि त्रीणि गत्वा अथ योजनानाम् महाकपे
तेजसा तस्य निर्धूतो न विषादम् ततो गतः
transliteration: śatāni trīṇi gatvā atha yojanānām mahākape
tejasā tasya nirdhūto na viṣādam tato gataḥ
english: O mighty monkey, going three thousand Yojanas, you, struck by as energy, didst not feel poverty of spirit.

sanskrit: त्वाम् अपि उपगतम् तूर्णम् अंतरीक्षम् महाकपे
क्षिप्तम् इन्द्रेण ते वज्रम् कोप आविष्टेन तेजसा
transliteration: tvām api upagatam tūrṇam aṃtarīkṣam mahākape
